His focus was on achieving a visually pleasing and artistic effect. **一位画家正在从美学角度创作一幅杰作。他精心挑选颜色和笔触，旨在让这幅画不仅在功能上，而且在美学上都很美。他专注于达到一种视觉上令人愉悦和艺术的效果。**

> A painter was always seeking the perfect aesthetics in his works. He spent days choosing colors and brushstrokes. Finally, his painting was admired for its beautiful aesthetics, making him famous. **一位画家总是在他的作品中追求完美的美学。他花了好几天选择颜色和笔触。最终，他的画作因其美丽的美学而受到赞赏，使他成名。**

> A brave sailor was on a long journey. Standing on the deck, he looked afar and saw a beautiful island. He knew his adventure was not over and there were still unknown wonders waiting for him in the distance. **一位勇敢的水手正在长途旅行。站在甲板上，他向远处眺望，看到了一座美丽的岛屿。他知道他的冒险还没有结束，在远方仍有未知的奇迹在等着他。**
> 有一天，小明参加聚会，遇到了一位非常 affable 的主人。主人满脸笑容，热情地迎接每一位客人，亲切地与大家交流，让所有人都感到温暖和舒适。 **有一天，小明参加聚会，遇到了一位非常和蔼可亲的主人。主人满脸笑容，热情地迎接每一位客人，亲切地与大家交流，让所有人都感到温暖和舒适。**

> A young couple had an affair. They met secretly and shared many romantic moments. But their affair was discovered, causing a big trouble. Remember, \'affair\' means a matter or event, especially a personal or private one. **一对年轻的情侣有了一段风流韵事。他们秘密见面，分享了许多浪漫时刻。但他们的私情被发现了，引起了大麻烦。记住，\'affair\'意思是事情或事件，尤指个人或私密的。**

> A brave knight was affected by a mysterious curse. His strength and skills were weakened. But with determination, he fought against the curse\'s influence and finally overcame it. Here, \'affected\' means influenced or changed. **一位勇敢的骑士受到了神秘诅咒的影响。他的力量和技能被削弱了。但凭借决心，他与诅咒的影响作斗争，最终克服了它。这里，\'affected\'意思是受到影响或改变。**

> A young actor was very affected. He always pretended to be someone else and lost his true self. But one day, he realized this and decided to show his real emotions. Now you know \'affected\' means \'矫揉造作的；假装的\'. **一位年轻的演员非常做作。他总是假装成别人而失去了真实的自己。但有一天，他意识到了这一点，并决定展现真实的情感。现在你知道\'affected\'意思是\'矫揉造作的；假装的\'。**

> A little girl always showed her affection by giving her mom a big hug and a sweet kiss every day. Her mom felt so warm and happy. Affection means a gentle feeling of love and care. **一个小女孩每天总是通过给妈妈一个大大的拥抱和甜甜的吻来表达她的喜爱。她的妈妈感到非常温暖和开心。Affection 意思是喜爱、钟爱、慈爱**

> Once upon a time, there was a puppy who was always affectionate. It would wag its tail and nuzzle its owner, showing love and care. Its affectionate behavior made everyone happy. **从前，有一只小狗总是充满深情。它会摇尾巴，用鼻子蹭主人，展现出爱和关怀。它深情的行为让每个人都很开心。**

> A boy affectionately wrote a letter to his grandma, telling her how much he loved her. The way he expressed his feelings was so warm and sincere. It made grandma feel very happy. **一个男孩深情地给他的奶奶写了一封信，告诉她自己有多么爱她。他表达感情的方式是如此温暖和真诚。这让奶奶感到非常开心。**

> A young artist found that painting could express his affective states. When he was happy, the colors were bright; when sad, they were dull. Through this, he understood the meaning of \'affective\' - related to emotions. **一位年轻的艺术家发现绘画可以表达他的情感状态。当他开心时，色彩明亮；当他悲伤时，色彩暗淡。通过这个，他理解了"affective"这个词 - 与情感有关。**

> A detective was working on a case and needed an affidavIT. A witness came forward and provided a detailed written statement, swearing it was true. The affidavIT became crucial evidence. **一位侦探正在处理一个案件，需要一份书面陈述。一位证人挺身而出，提供了一份详细的书面陈述，并宣誓其真实性。这份书面陈述成为了关键证据。**
> 想象一个大公司 A，它想扩大业务。于是它和一些小公司合作，让小公司成为它的分支，就像孩子与父母的关系。这些小公司就是 A 的 affiliate。它们有联系，但又相对独立。 **想象一个大公司和一些小公司合作，小公司成为大公司的附属机构，以此来理解'affiliate'（附属机构；分公司；使隶属）这个词**
> 想象一家大公司，它有很多小的分支。这些分支就像是孩子与母亲的关系，它们都与大公司 \'affiliated\'（关联、附属）。就像树枝和大树，紧密相连，不可分割。 **想象一家大公司和其众多分支的关联关系来辅助记忆'affiliated'，意思是关联、附属**
> 想象一个孤独的探险家在荒野中迷路，后来他幸运地找到了一个部落。部落接纳了他，这就是一种\'affiliation\'，即归属、隶属关系。探险家从此有了新的归属。 **想象一个孤独的探险家在荒野迷路后被部落接纳，以此来理解\'归属、隶属关系\'这一单词含义的故事**

> Once upon a time, a scientist was studying chemicals. He found that some substances had a natural \'affinity\' to combine easily. It\'s like they were drawn to each other, showing a special closeness and attraction. **从前，有一位科学家在研究化学物质。他发现某些物质有一种天然的"亲和力"，能轻易地结合在一起。就好像它们相互吸引，表现出特殊的亲密和吸引力。**

> A firm boss was always confident. When asked about the company\'s future, he would affirm positively that they would succeed. His firm belief in success made the team work harder. **一位坚定的老板总是充满自信。当被问及公司的未来时，他总会肯定地断言他们会成功。他对成功的坚定信念让团队更加努力工作。**

> A young artist was constantly in doubt about his work. But one day, a famous critic gave him an affirmation, saying, \'Your art is truly wonderful.\' This made the artist believe in himself. **一位年轻的艺术家总是对自己的作品心存疑虑。但有一天，一位著名的评论家给了他肯定，说：'你的艺术真的很棒。'这让艺术家相信了自己。**

> A king was always asked for decisions. When he said yes, it was affirmative. One day, a big project was proposed. The king gave an affirmative answer, meaning it was approved and would go ahead. **一位国王总是被要求做决定。当他说"是"时，那就是肯定的。有一天，有人提出了一个大项目。国王给出了肯定的答复，意味着它被批准并将推进。**
> 想象你是一个邮票收集者，每次得到新邮票，你都会小心地 affix（贴上）它们到集邮册里。这个动作就像把某个东西牢牢固定在一个位置，所以 affix 就是贴上、附加的意思。 **想象你是邮票收集者，小心贴上邮票的动作，来理解 affix 表示贴上、附加的意思。**

> A poor knight was constantly afflicted by evil magic. Every day, he suffered from various pains and hardships. But he never gave up, determined to break the curse. Afflict means to cause pain or suffering to someone. **一个可怜的骑士一直被邪恶的魔法所折磨。每天，他都遭受着各种痛苦和艰难。但他从未放弃，决心打破诅咒。afflict 意思是使某人遭受痛苦或苦难。**

> A poor man was constantly facing various problems. Poverty, illness, and loneliness were his constant companions. These troubles were his afflictions. But he never gave up and kept fighting. **一个可怜的人不断面临着各种各样的问题。贫穷、疾病和孤独一直伴随着他。这些麻烦就是他的苦难。但他从不放弃，一直抗争。**

> A poor man dreamed of having affluence. One day, he found a magic lamp and his wish came true. He had a big house, nice cars, and all the money he needed. Now he lived in affluence. **一个穷人梦想着拥有富裕。有一天，他发现了一盏神灯，他的愿望实现了。他有了大房子、好车和所有需要的钱。现在他过上了富裕的生活。**

> A long time ago, there was a small village. One day, a traveler came and said he was from an affluent town where everyone had a big house and lots of money. The villagers were amazed and wanted to know more about this affluent place. **很久以前，有个小村庄。有一天，一位旅行者来了，说他来自一个富裕的城镇，那里每个人都有大房子和很多钱。村民们很惊讶，想更多地了解这个富裕的地方。**

> One day, Tom saw a beautiful guitar in a store. He really wanted it but was worried. Then he realized his savings could afford it. He was so happy and bought the guitar. **一天，汤姆在一家商店看到一把漂亮的吉他。他非常想要但很担心。然后他意识到他的积蓄能够买得起。他非常高兴并买了那把吉他。**

> A king was very angry when a commoner directly pointed out his mistake in public. This act was seen as an affront to the king\'s dignity. The commoner\'s behavior was bold and disrespectful. **一位国王在公共场合被一个平民直接指出错误时非常生气。这种行为被视为对国王尊严的冒犯。平民的行为大胆且无礼。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He was an aficionado of collecting stamps. Every weekend, he would go to the market to search for rare stamps. His passion made him an expert in this field. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他是集邮的狂热爱好者。每个周末，他都会去市场寻找稀有的邮票。他的热情使他成为这个领域的专家。**

> A young adventurer set off on a journey far afield. He left his hometown and explored unknown lands. Along the way, he faced many challenges but never gave up. \'Afield\' means far away from home or in distant places. **一位年轻的冒险家踏上了远方的旅程。他离开了家乡，去探索未知的土地。一路上，他面临许多挑战，但从未放弃。'afield'意思是远离家乡或在遥远的地方。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. But he managed to keep his small boat afloat by constantly bailing out water. With determination, he finally reached the shore safely. Remember, \'afloat\' means staying on the water surface and not sinking. **一位水手在海上迷失了。但他不断地把水舀出，设法让他的小船漂浮着。凭借决心，他最终安全抵达岸边。记住，'afloat'意思是浮在水面上不沉下去。**

> There was a mystery afoot in the old house. A strange noise was heard, and everyone started to investigate. It turned out to be a cat playing with some fallen objects. \'Afoot\' here means in progress or happening. **在那座老房子里有一件神秘的事在进行。听到了一阵奇怪的声音，大家都开始调查。原来是一只猫在玩一些掉落的物品。"afoot"在这里的意思是在进行中或正在发生。**

> A king was writing a letter and wanted to refer to some things he mentioned earlier. So, he used the word \'aforementioned\' to make his meaning clear. It helped him avoid repeating everything. **一位国王正在写信，想要提及他之前说过的一些事情。于是，他使用了'aforementioned'这个词来表明意思。这帮助他避免重复所有内容。**

> One night, Tom was alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, he heard strange noises. He felt very afraid. His heart was beating fast. But he told himself to be brave and find a way out. **一天晚上，汤姆独自一人在黑暗的森林里。突然，他听到了奇怪的声音。他感到非常害怕。他的心跳得很快。但他告诉自己要勇敢并找到出路。**

> A sailor was standing aft of the ship, looking at the beautiful sunset. He thought about all the adventures he had aft of the bow. Aft means at or near the stern of a ship or aircraft. **一名水手站在船的尾部，看着美丽的日落。他想着在船头后面的所有冒险经历。aft 意思是在船或飞机的尾部或靠近尾部。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in the park. After having a great time, she went home happily. \'After\' here means later or following an event. So, when you say \'after\', think of something happening later. **有一天，一个小女孩在公园玩耍。玩得很开心之后，她高兴地回家了。这里的'after'表示在某个事件之后。所以，当你说'after'时，就想想某事在之后发生。**

> A brave knight fought in many battles. When he died, he wondered about the afterlife. Would there be beautiful castles and friendly companions? He hoped for a peaceful and wonderful afterlife. **一位勇敢的骑士历经多次战斗。当他去世时，他思考着来世。那里会有美丽的城堡和友好的伙伴吗？他希望有一个平静而美好的来世。**

> After a big earthquake, there was chaos and destruction everywhere. The difficult situation and problems that followed were called the aftermath. People had to work hard to recover from it. **一场大地震过后，到处都是混乱和破坏。随之而来的艰难处境和问题被称为余波。人们不得不努力从中恢复。**

> One sunny day, a little girl played in the garden in the morning. When the clock struck 12, she knew it was time for lunch. After having lunch and taking a short rest, she continued playing. This time from 12 to 6 was the afternoon, a wonderful part of the day. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一个小女孩早上在花园里玩耍。当钟敲响 12 点时，她知道该吃午饭了。吃完午饭并短暂休息后，她继续玩耍。从 12 点到 6 点这段时间就是下午，一天中美好的时段。**

> A brave scientist was studying earthquakes. After a big quake, there were smaller tremors. The scientist called them \'aftershocks\'. These aftershocks were like the echoes of the main quake, causing more fear and damage. **一位勇敢的科学家正在研究地震。在一次大地震后，出现了较小的震动。这位科学家把它们称为"余震"。这些余震就像主震的回声，造成了更多的恐惧和破坏。**

> One day, Tom planned a party. After everything was done, he suddenly realized he forgot to invite his best friend. This realization was an afterthought. It made him feel bad. **一天，汤姆计划了一个聚会。一切都完成后，他突然意识到他忘了邀请他最好的朋友。这个意识就是事后的想法。这让他感觉很不好。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl lost her toy. She looked everywhere. Afterward, she found it under the bed. It made her very happy. The word \'afterward\' means later or subsequently. **从前，一个小女孩丢了她的玩具。她到处找。后来，她在床底下找到了。这让她非常高兴。单词\'afterward\'意思是后来，随后。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl lost her way. After many efforts, she found it. Afterwards, she happily went home and shared the adventure with her parents. **从前，有个小女孩迷路了。经过许多努力，她找到了路。之后，她开心地回家，并和父母分享了这次冒险经历。**
> One day, Tom lost his key. But he found it again in the garden. He was so happy. \'Again\' means to do something a second time or once more. **一天，汤姆丢了他的钥匙。但他又在花园里找到了。他非常高兴。\'again\'意思是再一次、又一次。**

> A brave knight was standing against the evil dragon. The dragon breathed fire, but the knight didn\'t back down. \'Against\' here means facing and opposing the danger bravely. **一位勇敢的骑士正对抗着恶龙。恶龙喷火，但骑士没有退缩。这里的'against'意味着勇敢地面对和对抗危险。**

> A little prince was always curious about his age. One day, he asked the wise owl. The owl said, \'Your age is just a number, but it shows how much you\'ve grown and learned.\' **一位小王子总是对自己的年龄感到好奇。有一天，他问了聪明的猫头鹰。猫头鹰说：'你的年龄只是一个数字，但它显示了你成长和学习了多少。'**

> Once upon a time, there was an AGED man. He had wrinkles and walked slowly. But his wisdom was like a bright light. Despite his aged body, his spirit was young. People respected him for his experience. **从前，有一位上了年纪的老人。他满脸皱纹，走路缓慢。但他的智慧却如明灯般闪耀。尽管身体年迈，但他的精神依然年轻。人们因他的阅历而尊敬他。**

> A young man dreams of starting his own business. He needs an agency to help. The agency finds resources and partners for him. Finally, his dream comes true. The agency made it happen! **一个年轻人梦想创业。他需要一家代理机构帮忙。这家代理机构为他寻找资源和合作伙伴。最终，他的梦想成真了。是代理机构促成了这一切！**
> 想象一下，一个忙碌的国王每天都要处理很多事务。他有一个特别的本子，上面写满了待办事项，这个本子就叫\'agenda\'。国王会按照本子上的安排，一项一项去完成任务。 **想象一位忙碌的国王的待办事项本叫"agenda"，国王按其安排完成任务**
> 想象一个神秘的特工 agent，他总是在黑夜中穿梭，执行着危险又重要的任务。他机智勇敢，凭借着出色的能力，为了正义而战，就像这个单词代表的'代理人、特工'一样神秘而强大。 **想象一位神秘的特工，他在黑夜中执行任务，展现这个单词'代理人、特工'的含义。**

> A man was already in a bad mood. But his friend kept teasing him, which aggravated his bad mood even more. It made him extremely angry and frustrated. **一个男人本来心情就不好。但他的朋友不停地逗弄他，这让他的坏心情更加严重了。这使他极度生气和沮丧。**
> 想象一下，在一个大花园里，有很多不同的小花聚在一起（aggregate），形成了一大束美丽的花束。这些小花就像一个个单独的个体，而聚在一起就成为了一个整体。 **想象在花园里很多小花聚集成一大束花的情景来辅助记忆【aggregate】，意为合计；聚集；集合体**
> 想象一下，一群小蚂蚁在森林里搬运食物。它们从不同地方找来食物碎块，然后聚集（aggregation）在一起，形成了一个大大的食物堆。就像数据或物品从分散到集中的过程，这就是 aggregation 的意思。 **想象一群蚂蚁搬运食物并聚集的场景来理解聚合、集合的意思**

> A group of fierce wolves showed aggression towards the sheep. They bared their teeth and growled, ready to attack. This scene made the sheep very scared. Remember, aggression means a hostile or attacking behavior. **一群凶猛的狼对羊表现出了攻击性。它们龇牙咧嘴，咆哮着，准备攻击。这一幕让羊非常害怕。记住，aggression 意思是敌对或攻击的行为。**

> A tiger was very aggressive. It always roared loudly and rushed towards other animals. But one day, it met a wise monkey. The monkey taught it to be calm and friendly. Finally, the tiger changed. Remember, aggressive means being full of attack and hostility. **一只老虎非常有攻击性。它总是大声吼叫并冲向其他动物。但有一天，它遇到了一只聪明的猴子。猴子教它要冷静和友好。最后，老虎改变了。记住，aggressive 意思是有攻击性的，充满敌意的。**

> A brave knight always fought aggressively to protect his kingdom. He charged forward without fear, showing great determination. His aggressive actions scared the enemies away and kept his people safe. **一位勇敢的骑士总是富有攻击性地战斗以保卫他的王国。他无所畏惧地向前冲锋，展现出极大的决心。他的激进行动把敌人吓跑了，保护了他的人民。**

> In a war, a fierce army invaded a peaceful country. The soldiers leading the invasion were the aggressors. They were cruel and unreasonable, causing great harm. Remember, an aggressor is the one who initiates the attack. **在一场战争中，一支凶猛的军队入侵了一个和平的国家。带头入侵的士兵就是侵略者。他们残忍且无理，造成了巨大的伤害。记住，aggressor 就是发起攻击的人。**

> One night, I was walking alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, a strange figure appeared in front of me. I was aghast and couldn\'t move. My heart was pounding with fear. **一天晚上，我独自在黑暗的森林里走着。突然，一个奇怪的身影出现在我面前。我被吓得目瞪口呆，动弹不得。我的心因恐惧而狂跳。**

> A monkey was climbing trees in the forest. It moved nimbly and quickly, showing its agile body. It could jump from one branch to another easily. This is how I remember \'agile\' meaning quick and nimble. **一只猴子在森林里爬树。它动作敏捷迅速，展示出它灵活的身体。它能轻松地从一个树枝跳到另一个树枝。这就是我记住\'敏捷的；灵活的\'这个单词\'agile\'的方式。**

> A monkey was showing its agility by jumping from tree to tree with ease. It moved quickly and nimbly, never missing a step. This is what \'agility\' means - the ability to move quickly and easily. **一只猴子轻松地从一棵树跳到另一棵树，展示着它的敏捷性。它动作迅速灵活，从不失误。这就是"agility"的意思------快速且轻松移动的能力。**

> A young prince was worried about aging. One day, he met a wise old man who told him aging is like a journey that brings wisdom and experience. The prince understood that aging is not something to fear but to embrace. **一位年轻的王子担心衰老。有一天，他遇到了一位智慧的老人，老人告诉他衰老就像一段旅程，会带来智慧和经验。王子明白了衰老是不必害怕而是要去拥抱的。**

> A little ant was trying to cross a river. The flowing water agitated it and made it hard to stay on course. But the ant didn\'t give up and finally reached the other side. Here, \'agitate\' means to disturb or excite. **一只小蚂蚁试图过河。流动的水使它动荡不安，难以保持路线。但蚂蚁没有放弃，最终到达了对岸。这里，\'agitate\'意思是使不安，使激动。**

> A little mouse was trapped in a cage and kept running around agitatedly. It wanted to escape but couldn\'t find a way out. Finally, a kind person set it free. \'Agitated\' means being disturbed or excited. **一只小老鼠被困在笼子里，焦躁不安地到处跑。它想逃跑但找不到出路。最后，一个善良的人把它放了出来。'agitated'意思是不安的；激动的。**

> A group of people were protesting on the street. Their voices were filled with agitation as they shouted for justice. The commotion and unrest showed their strong emotions and eagerness for change. **一群人正在街上抗议。他们的声音中充满了激动，大声呼喊着要求正义。这种骚乱和不安显示出他们强烈的情感和对变革的渴望。**

> Long ago, there was a little prince. He lived in a big castle. One day, he decided to go on an adventure. \'Ago\' means a time in the past. So, when we say \'long ago\', we are talking about a distant past. **很久之前，有一位小王子。他住在一座大城堡里。有一天，他决定去冒险。'ago'表示过去的某个时间。所以，当我们说'long ago'时，我们说的是遥远的过去。**

> A king was in great pain as his kingdom was under attack. He agonized over the difficult decisions to save his people. Every moment was filled with worry and torment. **一位国王因其王国遭受攻击而极度痛苦。他为拯救子民的艰难决定而苦苦挣扎。每一刻都充满了忧虑和折磨。**

> A brave soldier was injured in the battle. The pain was agonizing. But his strong will kept him fighting. Finally, he was rescued and the pain ended. **一位勇敢的士兵在战斗中受伤了。疼痛是极度痛苦的。但他坚强的意志让他继续战斗。最后，他被救了，痛苦结束了。**

> A girl was lost in a forest and got injured. She felt extreme pain and distress, crying out in agony. Later, she was finally rescued. The word \'agony\' describes her intense suffering at that moment. **一个女孩在森林里迷路并受伤了。她感到极度的痛苦和苦恼，痛苦地哭喊着。后来，她终于获救了。单词\'agony\'描述了她当时强烈的痛苦。**

> Once upon a time, in a small village, all the people were engaged in agrarian work. They farmed the land, grew crops, and lived a simple life. This shows that \'agrarian\' is related to farming and agriculture. **从前，在一个小村庄里，所有人都从事农业工作。他们耕种土地，种植庄稼，过着简单的生活。这表明'agrarian'与农业和耕种有关。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a discussion about where to go for a picnic. Tom suggested the park and Jerry agreed. They had a great time there. It shows that when you say yes to a suggestion or idea, that\'s \'agree\'. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞讨论去哪里野餐。汤姆建议去公园，杰瑞同意了。他们在那里度过了美好的时光。这表明当你对一个建议或想法表示赞同，就是'agree'。**

> One day, I went on a picnic with my friends. The weather was agreeable. We had a great time chatting and laughing. It means pleasant and enjoyable. The picnic was so agreeable that we all wanted to do it again. **有一天，我和朋友们去野餐。天气宜人。我们愉快地聊天、大笑。它意味着令人愉快的、惬意的。这次野餐如此惬意，我们都想再来一次。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a discussion. After a while, they finally reached an agreement. They agreed to share the cake equally. It was a happy ending. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞进行了一场讨论。过了一会儿，他们最终达成了一致。他们同意平均分享蛋糕。这是一个快乐的结局。**

> One day, two friends were arguing. But finally, they reached an agreement. They decided to share the cake equally and play happily together. Agreement means a mutual decision or consent. **有一天，两个朋友在争吵。但最终，他们达成了一项协议。他们决定平分蛋糕，并一起开心地玩耍。Agreement 意思是协议、同意。**
> 想象一个巨大的农场，里面不仅种植各种农作物，还进行农产品加工和销售。这个将农业与商业完美结合的庞大运作体系就是 agribusiness。 **想象一个大型农场，其涵盖农作物种植、加工及销售，这种农业与商业的结合体就是农业综合企业。**

> A young farmer dreams of making his agricultural land the most productive. He works hard, using new methods, and finally his agricultural products are loved by everyone. **一位年轻的农民梦想着让他的农田成为产量最高的。他努力工作，采用新方法，最终他的农产品受到了大家的喜爱。**

> A group of friends decided to start a business related to growing food. They learned about plants, soil, and animals. This adventure was all about agriculture, the art and science of farming. **一群朋友决定开展与种植食物有关的业务。他们学习了植物、土壤和动物的知识。这次冒险全是关于农业，即耕种的艺术和科学。**
> 小明在森林中迷路了，又饿又累。突然，他发现了一个神秘的洞穴，怀着恐惧走进去，却听到一声'ah'，原来是一只可爱的小兔子，这声'ah'让他紧绷的神经放松了下来。 **小明在森林迷路，听到洞穴里兔子发出'啊'的声音，他放松了。**

> One day, I was doing a difficult math problem. After thinking for a long time, I suddenly had an idea and shouted \'Aha!\' I finally found the solution. **有一天，我在做一道很难的数学题。思考了很久之后，我突然有了一个主意，大喊'啊哈！' 我终于找到了解决办法。**

> A brave explorer was in a jungle. He wanted to reach the hidden treasure. He kept walking ahead, facing many difficulties but never stopped. Finally, he found the treasure. Ahead means in front or forward. **一位勇敢的探险家在丛林中。他想要找到隐藏的宝藏。他一直向前走，面对许多困难但从未停歇。最终，他找到了宝藏。ahead 意思是在前面；向前。**

> One day, a little boy got lost in the forest. Just when he was scared and helpless, a kind fairy appeared and used her magic to aid him. With the fairy\'s aid, the boy found his way home safely. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。就在他害怕又无助的时候，一个善良的仙女出现了，用她的魔法来帮助他。在仙女的帮助下，男孩安全地找到了回家的路。**

> A king was in trouble and needed help. His trusted aide, a brave and smart person, came to his rescue. The aide used his wisdom and skills to solve the problems. The king was very grateful. **一位国王陷入困境需要帮助。他信赖的助手，一个勇敢且聪明的人，前来营救。这位助手运用他的智慧和技能解决了问题。国王非常感激。**

> A little fairy was ill. Her wings ailed and she couldn\'t fly. Everyone was worried. But with love and care, she finally got better. Remember, \'ail\' means to be ill or have problems. **一个小仙女生病了。她的翅膀出了问题，她飞不起来了。大家都很担心。但在爱和关怀下，她最终好了起来。记住，\'ail\'意思是生病或有问题。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little bird. It was ailing and couldn\'t fly. A kind girl found it and took care of it. Soon, the bird became healthy again. \'Ailing\' means being sick or in poor health. **从前，有一只小鸟。它生病了，飞不起来。一个善良的女孩发现了它并照顾它。很快，小鸟又恢复了健康。'ailing'意思是生病的或身体不好的。**

> A poor little rabbit was always feeling weak and uncomfortable. The doctor said it had an ailment. It needed to rest and take medicine to get better. Finally, with care, the rabbit recovered from the ailment. **一只可怜的小兔子总是感觉虚弱和不舒服。医生说它患了一种小病。它需要休息和吃药才能好起来。最后，在悉心照料下，小兔子从病痛中康复了。**

> A brave archer was in a competition. His aim was to hit the bullseye. He focused hard, took a deep breath, and released the arrow. Finally, he achieved his aim and won the prize. **一位勇敢的弓箭手参加比赛。他的目标是射中靶心。他全神贯注，深吸一口气，射出了箭。最终，他达成了目标，赢得了奖品。**

> A lost traveler was walking aimlessly in the forest. He had no destination and just wandered around, not knowing where to go. Finally, he realized that aimlessly moving wouldn\'t lead him anywhere. **一位迷路的旅行者在森林里漫无目的地走着。他没有目的地，只是四处游荡，不知道该往哪儿走。最后，他意识到漫无目的地走不会带他去任何地方。**

> A bird is flying freely in the air. It enjoys the fresh air and the beautiful view. The air is so clean and makes the bird feel happy and energetic. **一只鸟在空中自由飞翔。它享受着新鲜的空气和美丽的景色。空气如此清新，让这只鸟感到快乐和充满活力。**

> A brave soldier was on a mission. He jumped out of the plane and became airborne. He flew through the air with courage, ready to face any challenge. Remember, when you are airborne, you are in the air! **一位勇敢的士兵在执行任务。他从飞机上跳下，处于空中飞行的状态。他勇敢地在空中飞行，准备迎接任何挑战。记住，当你处于 airborne 状态，就是在空中！**

> One day, a little boy was playing with his toy planes. He called them \'aircraft\'. He imagined these aircraft flying high in the sky, carrying passengers to different places. The word \'aircraft\' stuck in his mind. **有一天，一个小男孩在玩他的玩具飞机。他称它们为"飞机"。他想象这些飞机在高空飞翔，载着乘客去不同的地方。"aircraft"这个词就留在了他的脑海里。**

> One day, Tom planned a trip. He was very worried about the cost. But when he found out the airfare was reasonable, he was so happy and booked the flight immediately. **有一天，汤姆计划旅行。他非常担心费用。但当他发现机票价格合理时，他非常高兴并立刻预订了航班。**

> A brave pilot was lost in a storm. He desperately searched for a safe place and finally found an airfield. There, he landed smoothly and was saved. The airfield became his savior in the crisis. **一位勇敢的飞行员在暴风雨中迷失了方向。他拼命寻找一个安全的地方，最后找到了一个机场。在那里，他平稳着陆并获救。这个机场在危机中成为了他的救星。**

> Imagine a magical factory where toys are made. The gentle movement of the fresh air as it passes through the factory, helping the machines work smoothly, is like the \'airflow\'. It\'s the smooth and continuous flow of air. **想象一个神奇的工厂，里面正在制造玩具。清新空气轻柔地穿过工厂，帮助机器平稳运行，这就像是\'airflow\'。它指的是空气平稳且持续的流动。**

> One sunny day, I opened the window to give my room an airing. The fresh air came in, making everything feel so nice. It was like the room was breathing and becoming lively. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我打开窗户给房间通风。清新的空气进来了，让一切都感觉那么美好。就好像房间在呼吸，变得充满活力。**

> One day, Tom wanted to travel far away. He went to the airport and chose an airline. The airline\'s planes were big and beautiful. They flew him to his dream destination. **一天，汤姆想去远方旅行。他去了机场并选择了一家航空公司。这家航空公司的飞机又大又漂亮。它们把他带到了梦想的目的地。**

> One day, I dreamt of being a pilot on an airliner. I flew through the clouds, carrying passengers safely to their destinations. The huge airliner was like a magic bird in the sky. **有一天，我梦到自己成为一架客机的飞行员。我穿越云层，将乘客安全地送达目的地。这架巨大的客机就像天空中的神奇大鸟。**

> One day, a brave boy named Tom dreamed of flying in the sky. He worked hard and finally became an airman. He wore a cool uniform and controlled the plane freely in the air, fulfilling his dream. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的勇敢男孩梦想着在天空飞翔。他努力工作，最终成为了一名飞行员。他穿着帅气的制服，在空中自由地操控着飞机，实现了他的梦想。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, he saw an airplane flying high in the sky. The airplane had big wings and made a loud noise. The boy was so excited and shouted, \'Look at that airplane!\' **一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，他看到一架飞机在高空飞行。这架飞机有大大的机翼，还发出很大的噪音。小男孩非常兴奋，大喊道："看那架飞机！"**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to catch a flight. He rushed to the airport. There were many planes taking off and landing. He found the check-in counter and finally boarded the plane smoothly. The airport was a busy place full of excitement and anticipation. **有一天，汤姆着急赶飞机。他匆忙赶到机场。那里有许多飞机起飞和降落。他找到了值机柜台，最后顺利登上了飞机。机场是个繁忙的地方，充满了兴奋和期待。**

> A brave pilot was flying through the airspace. Suddenly, a storm appeared. But he knew the boundaries of the airspace well and managed to avoid danger. Remember, airspace is the space above the earth where planes fly. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在空域飞行。突然，一场风暴出现了。但他很清楚这个空域的范围，成功避开了危险。记住，airspace 就是飞机飞行的地球上方的空间。**

> A pilot was lost in a storm. Luckily, he found an airstrip and landed safely. The airstrip was a narrow path in the middle of nowhere, but it saved his life. **一位飞行员在暴风雨中迷失了方向。幸运的是，他找到了一条简易跑道并安全着陆。这条简易跑道是在荒郊野外的一条狭窄通道，但它救了他的命。**

> A thief wanted to steal from a room filled with treasures. But the door was airtight, not even a tiny bit of air could get in or out. So, the thief had no chance. Remember, \'airtight\' means no air can pass through. **一个小偷想从一个装满财宝的房间偷东西。但那扇门是密封的，一点儿空气都进不去出不来。所以，小偷没有机会。记住，'airtight'意思是密封的，不透气的。**

> A brave pilot was flying through the airwaves. He communicated with the control tower, sharing his experiences. The airwaves carried his voice, ensuring a safe journey. The airwaves were like a magical path in the sky. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在电波中飞行。他与控制塔台交流，分享着他的经历。电波传送着他的声音，确保了安全的旅程。电波就像天空中神奇的路径。**

> One day, a little bird was flying high in the sky. Suddenly, it got lost and needed to find the airway to go home. It looked around and finally followed the right path. The airway led it back safely. **有一天，一只小鸟在高空飞翔。突然，它迷路了，需要找到回家的气道。它四处张望，最终沿着正确的路径。气道将它安全地带回了家。**

> A fairy was flying in the air. She felt so airy and light. She danced and sang, enjoying the freedom. Remember, when you think of \'airy\', think of this fairy having a wonderful time in the air. **一个仙女在空中飞翔。她感觉如此轻盈、通风。她跳舞唱歌，享受着自由。记住，当你想到\'airy\'时，就想到这个在空中度过美好时光的仙女。**
> 想象你在一个巨大的图书馆里，书架之间狭窄的通道让你很难行走。这个通道就像\'aisle\'。你在这个\'aisle\'里寻找一本珍贵的书籍，终于找到了它。 **想象在图书馆中狭窄的通道，帮助记忆单词\'aisle\'（通道；走道；侧廊）**

> A jar of honey was left ajar. The bees smelled it and flew towards it. Poor honey keeper! Now he had to quickly close the jar tightly. Remember, ajar means slightly open. **一罐蜂蜜被留得微开着。蜜蜂闻到了，朝它飞去。可怜的养蜂人！现在他不得不赶紧把罐子紧紧盖上。记住，ajar 意思是微开的。**

> Once upon a time, a king found a lost kitten. Its eyes and the king\'s cat were akin. The king took it home, knowing they shared similar traits. Now you know \'akin\' means similar or related. **从前，有一位国王发现了一只迷路的小猫。它的眼睛和国王的猫很相似。国王把它带回家，知道它们有相似的特征。现在你知道\'akin\'意思是相似的或相关的。**

> One night, a thief broke into a house. The loud noise set off the alarm. The owner woke up immediately and called the police. The alarm saved the day! **一天晚上，一个小偷闯进了一所房子。巨大的声响触发了警报。主人立刻醒来并报了警。警报起了大作用！**

> A thief broke into a quiet village at night. The sound of breaking glass was alarming. People woke up and called the police. The thief was caught in the end. This incident was really alarming. **一个小偷在晚上闯进了一个安静的村庄。玻璃破碎的声音令人惊恐。人们被惊醒然后报了警。最后小偷被抓住了。这个事件真的令人惊恐。**

> A brave knight set out on a dangerous quest. Alas! His horse got injured and he had to return. He was so sad and the word \'alas\' expressed his disappointment. **一位勇敢的骑士出发去进行一项危险的任务。哎呀！他的马受伤了，他不得不返回。他非常伤心，\'alas\'这个词表达了他的失望。**

> A man wanted to go on a long hike, albeit the weather was not perfect. He decided to brave it and enjoy the journey. Despite the challenges, he had a great time. Remember, albeit means although. **一个男人想去长途徒步旅行，尽管天气不太好。他决定勇敢面对并享受旅程。尽管有挑战，他还是玩得很开心。记住，albeit 意思是尽管。**

> I once went to a friend\'s house and saw a beautiful album on the table. It was filled with precious memories of our childhood. The album had photos, tickets, and notes. From then on, I never forgot the word \'album\'. **我曾经去一个朋友家，看到桌上有一本漂亮的相册。里面装满了我们童年的珍贵回忆。相册里有照片、票根和笔记。从那以后，我就再也忘不了'album（相册）'这个词。**
> 从前有个神秘的学者，一心想要把普通金属变成黄金，他不断尝试各种配方和实验，这种神奇的技艺就被称为\'alchemy\'。他梦想通过\'alchemy\'改变世界，但最终未能成功。 **从前有个神秘学者想通过各种实验把普通金属变成黄金，这种神奇技艺被称为'炼金术'。他想靠它改变世界但没成功。**

> A long time ago, a scientist was doing experiments. He found a special liquid that made people feel strange and happy. He called it \'alcohol\'. Later, people used it in drinks but needed to be careful not to have too much. **很久以前，一位科学家在做实验。他发现了一种特殊的液体，能让人感觉奇怪和愉悦。他称之为"酒精"。后来，人们把它用在饮料中，但要注意不能喝太多。**

> One day, Tom was at a party. He drank a lot of alcohol and couldn\'t stop. From then on, he became an alcoholic, always seeking alcohol and unable to control himself. **一天，汤姆在一个派对上。他喝了很多酒并且停不下来。从那以后，他变成了一个酒鬼，总是找酒喝并且无法控制自己。**

> A man named Tom loved drinking alcohol every day. His excessive intake led to problems at work and in his family. Eventually, he was diagnosed with alcoholism. This made him realize the harm and decide to change. **一个叫汤姆的男人每天都爱喝酒。他过度饮酒导致工作和家庭出现问题。最终，他被诊断出酗酒症。这让他意识到危害并决定改变。**

> A long time ago, a poor artist sought refuge in an alcove. There, he could paint undisturbed. The alcove became his secret haven, protected from the outside world. **很久以前，一个贫穷的艺术家在一个凹室里寻求庇护。在那里，他可以不受干扰地作画。这个凹室成了他躲避外界的秘密港湾。**

> In the old town, there was an alderman named Tom. He was respected for his wisdom and fairness. Every day, he walked the streets, listening to people\'s problems and finding solutions. His role made the town a better place. **在古老的城镇里，有一位名叫汤姆的市议员。他因其智慧和公正而备受尊敬。每天，他走在街上，倾听人们的问题并寻找解决方案。他的角色让这个城镇变得更美好。**

> A long time ago, a traveler was very thirsty. Luckily, he found a tavern and ordered a big glass of ale. It was so refreshing and made him feel energetic again. **很久以前，一位旅行者非常口渴。幸运的是，他找到了一家小酒馆，并点了一大杯麦芽酒。这酒非常清爽，让他再次感到精力充沛。**

> A spy was on a secret mission. Suddenly, he heard an alert sound. It was a warning that the enemy was coming. He had to be very alert to stay safe and complete the mission. **一名间谍正在执行一项秘密任务。突然，他听到了警报声。这是敌人来袭的警告。他必须保持高度警觉才能保证安全并完成任务。**

> One day, a detective was on a mission. His alertness saved the day when he noticed a tiny clue that others missed. He stayed sharp and focused, and that\'s what alertness means - being watchful and quick to notice things. **有一天，一位侦探在执行任务。他的警觉性挽救了局面，因为他注意到了一个别人错过的小线索。他保持敏锐和专注，这就是'alertness'的意思------警惕，能迅速注意到事物。**

> A farmer named Alf was very proud of his alfalfa field. The alfalfa grew so well that it attracted many animals. Alf took good care of it and made a lot of money selling alfalfa. **一位名叫阿尔夫的农民为他的苜蓿田感到非常自豪。苜蓿长得很好，吸引了很多动物。阿尔夫悉心照料它，并通过出售苜蓿赚了很多钱。**
> 在神秘的海底世界，有一群绿色的小生物，它们总是聚在一起。人们称它们为\'algae\'。这些\'algae\'能为小鱼提供氧气和食物，是海洋生态中不可或缺的一部分。 **在神秘的海底，有一群被称为'藻类'的绿色小生物，它们为小鱼提供氧气和食物，是海洋生态重要部分。**
> 从前有个聪明的学生，在数学课堂上努力学习一种神奇的知识叫\'algebra\'，它能帮助解决各种复杂的方程问题。通过不断练习，学生终于掌握了它，在数学世界里畅游。 **从前有个聪明的学生，在数学课堂上努力学习代数，它能帮助解决各种复杂的方程问题。通过不断练习，学生终于掌握了代数，在数学世界里畅游。**

> A brave knight was lost in a maze. To find the exit, he developed a step-by-step plan, which we can call an \'algorithm\'. It guided him precisely and finally he escaped successfully. **一位勇敢的骑士在迷宫中迷路了。为了找到出口，他制定了一个一步一步的计划，我们可以称之为"算法"。它精确地引导他，最后他成功逃脱了。**

> A thief was caught by the police. But he claimed to have an alibi that he was at a friend\'s house at the time of the crime. However, the police found evidence that proved his alibi was false. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。但他声称有不在场证明，说案发时他在朋友家。然而，警察找到了证据证明他的不在场证明是假的。**

> A spaceship landed on Earth. An alien stepped out. It had strange eyes and a funny shape. People were scared but also curious. They wanted to know where this alien came from. **一艘宇宙飞船降落在地球上。一个外星人走了出来。它有着奇怪的眼睛和滑稽的外形。人们很害怕但也很好奇。他们想知道这个外星人来自哪里。**

> A young man always criticized his friends\' hobbies, which made them feel distant. Gradually, he alienated all his friends. He realized too late that his behavior was wrong. **一个年轻人总是批评朋友们的爱好，这让他们感到疏远。渐渐地，他疏远了所有的朋友。他太晚才意识到自己的行为是错误的。**

> A young man moved to a new city. He found it hard to make friends and felt isolated. His heart was alienated from the lively community. But he didn\'t give up and finally fit in. **一个年轻人搬到了新城市。他发现很难交到朋友，感到很孤立。他的心与热闹的社区疏远了。但他没有放弃，最终融入了进去。**

> A lonely alien came to Earth. But people were scared and avoided it. The alien felt deep alienation. It just wanted friendship but couldn\'t find it. Poor alien! **一个孤独的外星人来到地球。但人们很害怕并避开它。这个外星人感到深深的疏离感。它只是想要友谊却找不到。可怜的外星人！**

> A bird was flying in the sky and suddenly got tired. It alighted on a branch to take a rest. The bird felt so relieved when it finally found a place to stop and relax. **一只鸟在天空中飞翔，突然累了。它落在一根树枝上休息。当这只鸟最终找到一个停歇和放松的地方时，它感到非常欣慰。**

> A group of stars were misaligned. But a wise astronomer came and used special tools to align them perfectly, making a beautiful pattern in the sky. **一群星星排列不齐。但一位聪明的天文学家来了，用特殊的工具将它们完美地对齐，在天空中形成了一个美丽的图案。**

> In a spaceship adventure, the crew struggled to achieve alignment of the engine parts. It was a critical task as incorrect alignment could lead to disaster. Finally, they succeeded, ensuring a smooth journey. **在一次太空飞船冒险中，船员们努力实现发动机部件的对齐。这是一项关键任务，因为不正确的对齐可能导致灾难。最终，他们成功了，确保了旅程顺利。**

> Two friends, Lily and Tom, have very alike personalities. They both love reading and are kind to others. Their likeness makes them inseparable. Alike means similar or having the same characteristics. **两个朋友，莉莉和汤姆，有着非常相似的性格。他们都喜欢阅读并且对他人友善。他们的相似之处使他们形影不离。alike 意思是相似的或具有相同的特征。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a deep forest. After days of struggle, he was found ALIVE. It was a miracle! His survival proved his strong will and determination to stay alive in the harsh environment. **一位勇敢的探险家在幽深的森林中迷路了。数日后，他被发现还活着。这简直是个奇迹！他的存活证明了他在恶劣环境中求生的坚强意志和决心。**

> A little ant was exploring a big garden. It went everywhere and saw everything. When asked what it found, the ant said, \'All the beautiful flowers and interesting bugs!\' Here, \'all\' means every single thing. **一只小蚂蚁在探索一个大花园。它到处走，看到了所有东西。当被问到发现了什么时，蚂蚁说：'所有美丽的花和有趣的虫子！'这里，'all'表示每一个东西。**

> A king was very worried because his people were in panic. But he found a way to allay their fears. He gave them food and comfort, making them calm and peaceful again. **一位国王非常担忧，因为他的子民处于恐慌之中。但他找到了一种方法来减轻他们的恐惧。他给他们食物和安慰，让他们再次变得平静和安宁。**

> A detective was investigating an allegation that a thief had stolen precious jewels from a mansion. The word \'allegation\' here means the claim or assertion that something has happened, often without proof. **一位侦探正在调查一项指控，说有个小偷从一座豪宅偷走了珍贵的珠宝。这里'allegation'这个词指的是声称或断言某事发生了，通常没有证据。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. A suspect was caught and he alleged that he was not at the crime scene. But the detective found some evidence that contradicted his claim. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。一名嫌疑人被抓获，他声称自己不在犯罪现场。但侦探发现了一些与他的说法相矛盾的证据。**

> A detective was investigating an alleged crime. The suspect claimed innocence, but there was much evidence suggesting otherwise. The word \'alleged\' here means said or thought to be true but not proved. **一位侦探正在调查一起据称的犯罪。嫌疑人声称无罪，但有很多证据表明并非如此。这里\'alleged\'这个词的意思是据说或被认为是真实的，但未被证实。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. The suspect was allegedly involved, but there was no solid proof yet. Everyone was waiting to see if the allegation was true. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。嫌疑人据称参与其中，但目前还没有确凿的证据。大家都在等着看这个指控是否属实。**

> A brave knight was always loyal to his king. His heart was filled with allegiance. No matter how hard the battle, he never wavered. His allegiance was unbreakable. **一位勇敢的骑士总是对他的国王忠心耿耿。他的心中充满了忠诚。无论战斗多么艰难，他都从未动摇。他的忠诚坚不可摧。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical forest, there was a mysterious book. Every picture in it had an allegorical meaning. One had a lion representing courage. It was like a puzzle, and you had to figure out the hidden messages. That\'s how I remember \'allegorical\'. **从前，在一个神奇的森林里，有一本神秘的书。书中的每一幅画都有寓意。其中一幅画里的狮子代表着勇气。这就像一个谜题，你得找出隐藏的信息。这就是我记住\'allegorical（寓意的；讽喻的）\'的方法。**

> A king\'s strange dream was full of symbols. A wise man explained that it was an allegory for the kingdom\'s future. The dream wasn\'t real but carried hidden meanings. Remember, allegory is a story with hidden meanings. **一位国王做了一个奇怪的梦，梦里充满了象征。一位智者解释说这是对王国未来的寓言。这个梦不是真实的，但却有着隐藏的含义。记住，allegory 就是有隐藏含义的故事。**

> One day, Tom had a severe allergic reaction. He found out that the culprit was an \'allergen\' in the pollen. From then on, he was very careful to avoid things that might contain allergens to stay healthy. **有一天，汤姆出现了严重的过敏反应。他发现罪魁祸首是花粉中的"过敏原"。从那以后，他非常小心地避开可能含有过敏原的东西以保持健康。**

> One day, Tom ate a lot of strawberries and suddenly felt very uncomfortable. He went to the doctor and was told he was allergic to strawberries. From then on, Tom had to be careful when choosing food. **有一天，汤姆吃了很多草莓，突然感到非常不舒服。他去看医生，被告知他对草莓过敏。从那以后，汤姆在选择食物时不得不小心。**

> One day, Tom ate a lot of strawberries and suddenly felt very uncomfortable. He had itchy skin and a runny nose. The doctor said it was an allergy. Poor Tom never knew he had an allergy to strawberries! **有一天，汤姆吃了很多草莓，突然感觉很不舒服。他皮肤发痒，还流鼻涕。医生说这是过敏。可怜的汤姆从不知道自己对草莓过敏！**

> A poor man was in great pain. A kind fairy appeared and used her magic to alleviate his suffering. She gave him food and a warm bed, making his life better. **一个可怜的人非常痛苦。一位善良的仙女出现了，用她的魔法减轻了他的痛苦。她给了他食物和温暖的床，让他的生活变得更好。**

> One night, I got lost in a dark alley. It was narrow and quiet. I was scared but finally found my way out. Remember, an alley is a narrow street or passage. **一天晚上，我在一条黑暗的小巷里迷路了。它又窄又安静。我很害怕，但最终找到了出路。记住，alley 就是狭窄的街道或通道。**

> One night, a lost cat was wandering in an alleyway. It was dark and narrow, but the cat bravely kept moving forward until it found a warm home. Remember, alleyway is a narrow passage between buildings. **一天晚上，一只迷路的猫在一条小巷里徘徊。它又黑又窄，但猫勇敢地一直往前走，直到找到了一个温暖的家。记住，alleyway 是建筑物之间的狭窄通道。**

> In a magical land, two kingdoms faced a common enemy. They decided to join hands and form an alliance. Through unity and cooperation, they became strong and defeated the evil force. The alliance saved their land. **在一个神奇的国度，两个王国面临着共同的敌人。他们决定携手组成联盟。通过团结与合作，他们变得强大并击败了邪恶势力。这个联盟拯救了他们的土地。**

> In a war, two armies were allied. They fought together against the common enemy. The allied forces shared resources and strategies, showing great unity. Remember, \'allied\' means joined or united for a common purpose. **在一场战争中，两支军队结盟了。他们一起对抗共同的敌人。盟军共享资源和战略，展现出极大的团结。记住，\'allied\'意思是为了共同目的联合或结盟。**

> A little boy was lost in a swamp. Suddenly, he saw an alligator. He was so scared! But he remembered to stay quiet and not move. Finally, the alligator swam away and the boy was safe. **一个小男孩在沼泽地迷路了。突然，他看到了一只短吻鳄。他非常害怕！但他记得要保持安静不动。最后，短吻鳄游走了，男孩安全了。**
> 想象一个国王要分配他的财宝，他坐在王座上，拿着清单，仔细地思考如何 allocate 这些财宝给不同的大臣和子民，以确保公平和合理。 **想象国王分配财宝的场景来辅助记忆'allocate'这个单词，意思是分配、拨出**
> 想象一个大仓库，里面堆满了各种资源。管理员根据需求进行分配，这个分配的过程就是\'allocation\'。就像把糖果分给小朋友一样，确保公平合理。 **想象一个仓库资源分配的场景来辅助记忆\'allocation\'这个单词，意思是分配，配给**

> A group of friends went on a treasure hunt. The leader had to allot the treasures found among them. He carefully divided the jewels and gold, making sure everyone got a fair share. So, \'allot\' means to distribute or give as a share. **一群朋友去寻宝。领队必须分配他们找到的宝藏。他仔细地划分珠宝和黄金，确保每个人都得到公平的份额。所以，\'allot\'意思是分配，分发**

> A poor farmer was given an allotment of land by the king. He was so happy as it was a precious gift. With this allotment, he could grow crops and feed his family. **一位贫穷的农民得到了国王分配的一块土地。他非常高兴，因为这是一份珍贵的礼物。有了这块分配地，他可以种植庄稼并养活家人。**

> One day, I wanted to go to the park. My mom allowed me to go after I finished my homework. It made me so happy. I realized \'allow\' means to give permission. **有一天，我想去公园。在我完成作业后妈妈允许我去了。这让我非常开心。我明白了'allow'意思是准许、允许。**

> A king set a rule that only a certain amount of food was allowable for each person at the feast. If you took more, you\'d be punished. So, \'allowable\' means permitted within certain limits. **一位国王规定在宴会上每人只能有一定量的食物是被允许的。如果你多拿，就会受到惩罚。所以，\'allowable\'意思是在一定限度内被许可的。**

> A poor student was always worried about money. One day, his school announced an \'allowance\' program. He was so happy as it meant he could buy the books he needed. The allowance was like a helping hand in his studies. **一个贫困的学生总是为钱发愁。有一天，他的学校宣布了一项'津贴'计划。他非常高兴，因为这意味着他可以买他需要的书。津贴就像是他学习中的援手。**

> A blacksmith was trying to make a stronger metal. He mixed iron and copper. This mixture was called an alloy. It was tougher and more useful than the original metals. **一位铁匠试图制造一种更坚固的金属。他把铁和铜混合在一起。这种混合物被称为合金。它比原来的金属更坚韧、更有用。**

> A thief alluded to his next crime by leaving mysterious marks. But the smart detective caught on. \'Allude\' means to hint or refer indirectly. So the thief was hinting at his plan without stating it clearly. **一个小偷通过留下神秘的标记来间接暗示他的下一次犯罪。但聪明的侦探察觉到了。\'allude\'意思是间接暗示或提及。所以小偷是在不明确说明的情况下暗示他的计划。**

> A beautiful fairy had the power of allure. Whenever she appeared, her charming smile and gentle voice attracted all the creatures in the forest. Her allure was so strong that no one could resist. **一位美丽的仙女拥有诱惑的力量。每当她出现，她迷人的微笑和温柔的声音吸引着森林里所有的生物。她的魅力如此强大，无人能够抗拒。**

> A prince was on a journey and came across a mysterious forest. In the depth of it, he saw an alluring castle. The beauty and charm of the castle, with its shining towers and peaceful gardens, drew him in. He couldn\'t resist its allure. **一位王子在旅途中遇到了一片神秘的森林。在森林深处，他看到了一座迷人的城堡。城堡有着闪闪发光的塔楼和宁静的花园，其美丽和魅力吸引着他。他无法抗拒它的诱惑。**

> A little mouse was always making allusion to being a brave lion. One day, it faced a real challenge and bravely stood up, showing that its allusion wasn\'t just talk. **一只小老鼠总是暗示自己是勇敢的狮子。有一天，它面临真正的挑战并勇敢地站了出来，表明它的暗示并非只是说说而已。**

> In a fierce battle, a brave warrior was alone until a mysterious figure appeared. It turned out to be an ally who came to support. Together, they fought and won. Remember, \'ally\' means a friend or partner in a fight. **在一场激烈的战斗中，一位勇敢的战士孤身一人，直到一个神秘的身影出现。原来是一位来支援的盟友。他们一起战斗并取得了胜利。记住，'ally'意思是在战斗中的朋友或伙伴。**
> 想象有一位无所不能（almighty）的超级英雄，他能瞬间移动，拯救世界于灾难之中。他的力量无人能敌，任何困难在他面前都能轻松解决，人们对他的全能充满敬畏和感激。 **想象一位全能的超级英雄，展现 almighty 意为全能的、无所不能的意思，人们对其敬畏和感激。**

> A long time ago, a poor boy found an almond tree. He picked the almonds and sold them, earning money to buy food for his family. From then on, almonds became a symbol of hope and luck for him. **很久以前，一个贫穷的男孩发现了一棵杏仁树。他摘了杏仁并卖掉，赚了钱为家人买食物。从那以后，杏仁对他来说成了希望和幸运的象征。**

> Once upon a time, a little rabbit was running in a race. It was very close to the finish line, almost there. But at the last moment, another rabbit crossed the line first. \'Almost\' means very nearly but not completely. **从前，一只小兔子在赛跑。它离终点线非常近，几乎就要到了。但在最后一刻，另一只兔子先冲过了终点线。\'almost\'意思是几乎，差不多，但不完全是。**

> A brave bird was flying aloft in the sky. It soared high above the trees and mountains, feeling free and proud. Suddenly, a strong wind blew, but the bird remained aloft, showing its amazing ability to stay in the air. **一只勇敢的鸟在空中高高飞翔。它在树木和山脉上方翱翔，感到自由和骄傲。突然，一阵强风吹来，但这只鸟仍然高高地飞着，展示了它在空中停留的惊人能力。**

> A lonely traveler was walking in the deep forest alone. Suddenly, he heard strange noises but there was no one around to help. He felt scared but had to be brave. Remember, \'alone\' means being by oneself without others. **一位孤独的旅行者独自在幽深的森林里行走。突然，他听到了奇怪的声音，但是周围没有人能帮忙。他感到害怕但不得不勇敢。记住，\'alone\'意思是独自，没有其他人在身边。**

> A little ant was walking along a long road. It was very tired but kept going along. Finally, it found food along the way. The ant was so happy! **一只小蚂蚁正在一条长长的路上走着。它非常累但一直沿着路走。最后，它沿路找到了食物。这只蚂蚁非常开心！**
> 想象一艘大船在海上航行，旁边（alongside）还有一艘小船紧紧跟随。大船上的人们能清楚看到小船上的情况。Alongside 就是指在旁边、并排的意思。 **想象一艘大船在海上航行，旁边还有一艘小船紧紧跟随。大船上的人们能清楚看到小船上的情况。Alongside 就是指在旁边、并排的意思。**

> A young artist always stood aloof from the noisy parties. He preferred to be alone in his studio, creating masterpieces. People thought he was strange, but he just wanted to focus on his art. **一位年轻的艺术家总是远离喧闹的聚会。他更喜欢独自待在工作室里创作杰作。人们觉得他很奇怪，但他只是想专注于自己的艺术。**
> 小明在学习英语时总是不敢大声读，成绩一直不好。老师告诉他要'aloud'，就是要大声地读出来。小明听了老师的话，每天大声朗读，英语成绩很快提高了。 **小明在学习英语时不敢大声读，老师让他要大声地读出来，即'aloud'，后来小明成绩提高了。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的实验室里，有一只超级聪明的猴子叫 Alpha。它总是第一个解决难题，就像字母表中的 alpha 一样，处于领先和首要的位置。所以，一想到这只厉害的猴子 Alpha，就能记住 alpha 这个单词啦。 **想象在神秘实验室里有一只叫 Alpha 的聪明猴子总是率先解决难题，借此记住 alpha 这个单词，它有首要、领先的意思。**
> 从前有一只聪明的小猴子，它要给森林里的动物们写信。但它发现没有合适的符号来表达意思，于是创造了 26 个不同的符号，这 26 个符号组合起来就像神奇的密码，被称为 alphabet，也就是字母表。 **从前有一只聪明的小猴子创造了 26 个符号，组合起来被称为字母表**

> A brave climber was on an adventure in the alpine region. He struggled but finally reached the peak. The alpine view was so beautiful with snow-capped mountains and clear blue sky. Remember, alpine means related to high mountains. **一位勇敢的登山者在高山地区冒险。他历经艰难，但最终到达了山顶。高山地区的景色美极了，有白雪皑皑的山峰和湛蓝的天空。记住，alpine 意思是与高山有关的。**

> One day, Tom was supposed to finish his homework by 5 pm. But when his mom came back at 4 pm, she found he had already completed it. She was very happy. **一天，汤姆应该在下午 5 点完成作业。但当他妈妈下午 4 点回来时，她发现他已经完成了。她非常高兴。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in the forest. He was scared but kept telling himself \'alright, I\'ll find my way out.\' Finally, he did. \'Alright\' means fine or okay, showing a sense of acceptance or reassurance. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他很害怕，但一直告诉自己'好吧，我会找到出路的。'最后，他做到了。'alright'意思是好的、不错，表示接受或放心。**

> One day, Tom went to a party. He ate delicious food and met many friends. His friend Jerry was there too. \'Also\' Jerry had a great time. It means in addition or as well. **一天，汤姆去参加派对。他吃了美味的食物，还见到了很多朋友。他的朋友杰瑞也在。"Also"杰瑞也玩得很开心。它的意思是此外，也。**

> A long time ago, a young man was lost in a forest. When he was about to give up, he saw a mysterious light and followed it. It led him to an altar where he found hope and guidance. The altar became a symbol of salvation for him. **很久以前，一个年轻人在森林里迷路了。当他快要放弃时，看到了一道神秘的光并跟着它。光把他引到了一个圣坛前，在那里他找到了希望和指引。这个圣坛成了他的救赎象征。**

> A tailor found that the clothes needed to be altered. He had to change the size and style to make them fit better. So, \'alter\' means to change or modify something. **一位裁缝发现衣服需要修改。他不得不改变尺寸和样式以使它们更合身。所以，'alter'意思是改变或修改某物。**

> A tailor was making alterations to a dress. He changed the length and style, showing that \'alteration\' means making changes. The dress looked completely different in the end. **一位裁缝正在对一条裙子进行修改。他改变了长度和款式，这表明'alteration'意味着做出改变。最后裙子看起来完全不同了。**

> Two friends were having a picnic. Suddenly, they had an altercation over which fruit was tastier. Their voices rose, and faces turned red. But in the end, they realized it was a silly fight and made up. **两个朋友正在野餐。突然，他们因为哪种水果更好吃发生了争吵。他们声音提高，脸也变红了。但最后，他们意识到这是一场愚蠢的争吵并和好了。**
> Alice 和 Tom 轮流（alternate）照顾受伤的小鸟。一天 Alice 照顾，第二天 Tom 照顾，就这样交替进行。他们的爱心从未间断，小鸟也慢慢康复了。 **爱丽丝和汤姆交替照顾受伤的小鸟。一天爱丽丝照顾，第二天汤姆照顾，就这样轮流进行。他们的爱心从未间断，小鸟也慢慢康复了。**

> A king had two advisers. They were asked to give suggestions alternately. One day, when it was Adviser A\'s turn, he came up with a brilliant idea and saved the kingdom. Alternately means in turn; one after the other. **一位国王有两位顾问。他们被要求轮流给出建议。有一天，轮到顾问 A 时，他想出了一个绝妙的主意并拯救了王国。alternately 意思是轮流；交替地**
> 想象有个神奇的电路，电流一会儿向上流，一会儿向下流，这种一会儿向上一会儿向下的流动就是\'alter nating\'。就像我们的心情，有时高兴，有时低落，交替变化。 **想象一个关于电流交替流动的神奇电路来辅助记忆\'交替的，轮流的\'这个单词的意思**
> 想象一下，你在沙漠中迷路，水快喝完了。突然发现两条路，一条是继续往前走，可能会遇到水源，这是常规选择；另一条是往回走，去寻找之前经过的绿洲，这就是 alternative 选择。 **想象一下，你在沙漠迷路，水快喝完。突然发现两条路，一条常规，另一条就是可替代的选择。**

> A traveler was lost. He could either keep going straight or alternatively take a detour. The word \'alternatively\' means having the option to choose another way or possibility. **一位旅行者迷路了。他要么一直直走，要么另选一条路走弯路。单词\'alternatively\'意思是有选择另一种方式或可能性的机会。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl wanted to play outside although it was raining. Her mom said no. But the girl insisted, showing that \'although\' means despite something. **从前，有个小女孩想出去玩，尽管正在下雨。她妈妈说不行。但小女孩坚持，这表明'although'的意思是尽管。**

> A brave pilot was flying a plane. He had to be careful with the altitude. If it was too low, he might hit something. If it was too high, the air would be too thin. So, altitude is the height above sea level. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在驾驶飞机。他必须小心飞行高度。如果太低，他可能会撞到东西。如果太高，空气会太稀薄。所以，altitude 就是海拔高度。**

> A group of friends planned a trip. They spent time together, had fun, and in the end, they concluded that the experience was altogether wonderful. It means completely or in all. **一群朋友计划了一次旅行。他们一起度过时光，玩得很开心，最后，他们得出结论，这次经历完全很棒。这个词意思是完全地；总共。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor man. Despite his own hardships, he always helped others selflessly. His actions were a perfect example of altruism, which means unselfish concern for the welfare of others. **从前，有一个穷人。尽管自己处境艰难，但他总是无私地帮助别人。他的行为是利他主义的完美范例，利他主义指的是对他人福利的无私关怀。**

> A long time ago, a student named Tom was very worried about his final exam. His teacher gave him some alum and said it could bring clarity to his mind. With the help of alum, Tom did well in the exam. **很久以前，一个叫汤姆的学生非常担心他的期末考试。他的老师给了他一些明矾，并说它可以让他的头脑清醒。在明矾的帮助下，汤姆在考试中表现出色。**

> A crazy scientist was working on a secret project. He needed a special metal, and he called it \'aluminum\'. This metal was light and strong, helping him create amazing inventions. **一位疯狂的科学家正在进行一个秘密项目。他需要一种特殊的金属，并将其称为"铝"。这种金属既轻又坚固，帮助他创造了惊人的发明。**
> 想象一下，一位成功的商人回到他的母校参加校庆。他自豪地说：\'I am an alumnus of this school.\' （我是这所学校的校友。）大家都为这位优秀的 alumnus 鼓掌。 **想象一位成功商人回母校并自称是校友，大家为其鼓掌的场景**

> A little ant was always trying to find food for its colony. No matter how hard the journey was, it was always persistent. It showed us that \'always\' means at all times, without exception. **一只小蚂蚁总是努力为它的蚁群寻找食物。无论路途多么艰难，它总是坚持不懈。这向我们展示了'always'意味着一直，毫无例外。**
> 想象一个古老的炼金术师，他努力尝试将各种金属混合。终于，他成功创造出一种独特的混合物，取名为\'amalgam\'。这混合物融合了不同金属的特性，就像这个单词融合了多种元素。 **想象一位古老的炼金术师努力混合各种金属，最终创造出名为\'amalgam\'的独特混合物，它融合了不同金属的特性，以此辅助记忆这个单词。**

> A poor man wanted to amass a fortune. So, he worked hard every day, saved money, and invested wisely. Finally, he succeeded and amassed a large amount of wealth. **一个穷人想要积累财富。于是，他每天努力工作，存钱并明智投资。最终，他成功了，积累了大量的财富。**

> A man always loved taking photos of nature but he had no professional training. He was just an amateur. But his passion made his pictures beautiful. **一个男人总是喜欢拍摄大自然的照片，但他没有经过专业训练。他只是个业余爱好者。但他的热情让他的照片很美。**

> One day, I went to a magic show. The magician\'s tricks were so wonderful that they amazed me. I couldn\'t believe my eyes. It was an amazing experience. **有一天，我去看了一场魔术表演。魔术师的戏法太精彩了，让我感到十分惊讶。我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。这是一次令人惊奇的经历。**

> One day, I saw a magic show. The magician\'s tricks were so wonderful that I was amazed. I couldn\'t believe my eyes and my mouth opened wide. It was an unforgettable experience. **有一天，我看了一场魔术表演。魔术师的戏法太精彩了，我感到十分惊奇。我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，嘴巴张得大大的。这是一次难忘的经历。**

> One day, I witnessed a magic show. The magician made a huge elephant disappear in an instant. I was filled with amazement. My eyes widened and my mouth dropped open. I couldn\'t believe what I had just seen! **有一天，我观看了一场魔术表演。魔术师瞬间让一头巨大的大象消失了。我充满了惊愕。我的眼睛睁大，嘴巴张开。我简直不敢相信我刚刚看到的！**

> One day, I went to a magic show. The magician\'s tricks were amazing. He made a rabbit disappear and reappear. Everyone was shocked and couldn\'t believe their eyes. It was an amazing experience. **有一天，我去看了一场魔术表演。魔术师的戏法令人惊叹。他让一只兔子消失又重现。每个人都很震惊，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。这是一次令人惊叹的经历。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. Amazingly, a kind stranger led me to the right place. It was such a wonderful surprise that made me believe in kindness. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。令人惊奇的是，一位善良的陌生人把我带到了正确的地方。这是一个如此美妙的惊喜，让我相信了善良。**

> A king sent a brave man to a foreign land. This man was called Ambassador. He had the important task of making friends and solving problems between the two kingdoms. His wisdom and courage made him a great ambassador. **一位国王派遣了一个勇敢的人去外国。这个人被称为大使。他肩负着在两个王国之间交朋友和解决问题的重要任务。他的智慧和勇气使他成为了一位出色的大使。**

> A long time ago, a traveler was lost in a forest. Suddenly, he saw a light. It was an amber stone shining like a guiding star. The amber\'s warm color led him out of the forest. **很久以前，一位旅行者在森林中迷路了。突然，他看到了一道光。那是一块琥珀石，像一颗指路星一样闪耀着。琥珀温暖的颜色引领他走出了森林。**

> A mouse was exploring a big castle. Every room had a special ambience. Some were warm and cozy, some were cold and mysterious. The mouse felt the different atmospheres as it scurried around. **一只老鼠在探索一座大城堡。每个房间都有一种特殊的氛围。有些温暖舒适，有些寒冷神秘。老鼠在四处奔跑时感受到了不同的气氛。**

> In a forest, the soft light and gentle breeze created an ambient atmosphere. The light was not direct but spread evenly, and the breeze was not strong but surrounded us gently. \'Ambient\' means surrounding or existing everywhere. **在一片森林里，柔和的光线和轻柔的微风营造出一种环境氛围。光线不是直射的而是均匀散布，微风不是强烈的而是轻柔地围绕着我们。\'ambient\'意思是周围的；到处存在的。**

> A detective was solving a case full of ambiguity. The clues were confusing and had multiple possible meanings. It took a lot of effort to clear the ambiguity and find the truth. **一位侦探正在侦破一个充满模棱两可情况的案件。线索令人困惑，有多种可能的含义。花了很大的力气才消除这种模糊不清，找到真相。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The clues were ambiguous. One pointed to the thief being a man, another suggested a woman. It made the detective\'s job very hard. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。线索是模糊不清的。一条指向小偷是个男人，另一条又暗示是个女人。这让侦探的工作变得非常艰难。**

> A young man named Tom had a strong ambition. He dreamt of becoming a famous scientist. He spent days and nights in the lab, working hard towards his goal. His ambition drove him to keep going. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人有强烈的雄心壮志。他梦想成为一位著名的科学家。他日夜在实验室里工作，朝着目标努力。他的雄心壮志驱使他不断前进。**

> A young man named Tom was very ambitious. He dreamed of building a huge empire. Despite facing many difficulties, he never gave up. His ambition drove him to keep working hard and finally he achieved great success. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人非常有雄心壮志。他梦想建立一个庞大的帝国。尽管面临许多困难，他从未放弃。他的雄心驱使他不断努力工作，最终他取得了巨大的成功。**

> A man was invited to two parties on the same night. He felt ambivalence as he couldn\'t decide which one to attend. One party had good music, the other had delicious food. His mixed feelings of being torn between the two options showed his ambivalence. **一个男人在同一天晚上被邀请参加两个聚会。他感到矛盾，因为无法决定参加哪一个。一个聚会有好听的音乐，另一个有美味的食物。他在两者之间难以抉择的这种复杂心情显示了他的矛盾心理。**

> A man was offered a job with high salary but long hours. He felt ambivalent. He loved the money but hated the lack of free time. This confusion and having mixed feelings is what ambivalent means. **一个男人得到了一份高薪但工作时间长的工作。他感到矛盾。他喜欢钱但讨厌没有空闲时间。这种困惑和有复杂的感情就是'ambivalent（矛盾的；好恶参半的）'的意思。**

> One day, a little lamb was lost in the forest. It didn\'t run in panic but ambled slowly, looking for the way home. Finally, it found its flock safely. Remember, \'amble\' means to walk slowly and leisurely. **有一天，一只小羊羔在森林里迷路了。它没有惊慌地跑，而是悠闲缓慢地漫步，寻找回家的路。最后，它安全地找到了羊群。记住，\'amble\'意思是缓慢悠闲地走。**
> 想象一下，一个人在大街上突然受伤，情况危急。这时，一辆'ambulance（救护车）'鸣着笛快速驶来。它的使命就是抢救生命，将伤者迅速送往医院。 **想象一个人受伤，救护车鸣笛赶来救人的场景来辅助记忆'ambulance（救护车）'这个单词**

> A group of soldiers was on a dangerous mission. They hid quietly in the forest, waiting for the enemy. This was an ambush. They planned to attack the enemy suddenly when they passed by. **一群士兵正在执行一项危险的任务。他们安静地躲在森林里等待敌人。这就是埋伏。他们计划在敌人经过时突然发动攻击。**

> A poor farmer\'s crops were constantly bad. But he didn\'t give up. He tried new methods and worked hard. Finally, his situation ameliorated and he had a great harvest. **一个贫穷的农民的庄稼一直不好。但他没有放弃。他尝试了新方法并且努力劳作。最终，他的情况改善了，并且有了大丰收。**
> 在一个古老的教堂里，人们祈祷结束后，都会齐声说\'amen\'。一位小男孩不明白这词的意思，牧师告诉他，这代表着大家对美好愿望的真诚回应和坚定信念。从此，小男孩记住了\'amen\'这个词。 **在一个古老的教堂中，人们祈祷结束后都会齐声说'阿门'。一位小男孩不明白这个词的意思，牧师告诉他，这代表着大家对美好愿望的真诚回应和坚定信念。从此，小男孩记住了'阿门'这个词。**

> A man was always willing to follow the rules and be cooperative. So, people said he was amenable. One day, he easily accepted a difficult task and completed it well. Now you know \'amenable\' means willing to be controlled or influenced. **一个男人总是愿意遵守规则并且乐于合作。所以，人们说他是顺从的。有一天，他轻易地接受了一项困难的任务并且完成得很好。现在你知道\'amenable\'意思是愿意被控制或影响。**
> 想象一个国王犯错了，大臣们建议他改正（amend）。国王接受了，开始修正自己的行为。最终，国家变得更好。所以，amend 就是改正、修正的意思。 **想象国王犯错后接受大臣建议改正，以此记住 amend 意为改正、修正。**

> A king was always making mistakes. So the wise men suggested \'amendment\'. The king finally changed and made the country better. Amendment means a change for the better. **一位国王总是犯错。所以智者们建议"修正"。国王最终改变了，让国家变得更好。Amendment 意思是改进，修正。**

> One day, Tom realized he had hurt his friend. To make things right, he decided to make amends. He bought a gift and sincerely apologized. His friend accepted, and their friendship became stronger. **一天，汤姆意识到他伤害了他的朋友。为了弥补过错，他决定做出赔偿。他买了一份礼物并真诚地道歉。他的朋友接受了，他们的友谊变得更牢固了。**

> A man went to a new town. He was very happy to find many amenities like a beautiful park, a clean swimming pool and a cozy library. These amenities made his life comfortable and enjoyable. **一个男人去了一个新城镇。他很高兴地发现了许多便利设施，比如一个美丽的公园、一个干净的游泳池和一个舒适的图书馆。这些便利设施让他的生活舒适又愉快。**

> Amiable Tom always has a smile on his face. He helps neighbors, plays with kids, and never gets angry. Everyone loves being around him because of his friendly and pleasant nature. **和蔼可亲的汤姆总是面带微笑。他帮助邻居，和孩子们玩耍，从不生气。每个人都喜欢和他在一起，因为他友好、令人愉快的性格。**

> A mouse was running amid a pile of books in the library. It was hard to spot as it hid well amid the chaos of pages. Suddenly, a librarian noticed and caught it. Amid means in the middle of or surrounded by. **一只老鼠在图书馆的一堆书中间跑来跑去。它藏得很好，很难被发现，因为它处在书页的混乱之中。突然，一位图书管理员注意到并抓住了它。amid 意思是在\...\...中间，被\...\...环绕。**

> A brave knight was searching for a lost treasure amidst a dangerous forest. Amidst the thick trees and wild beasts, he remained determined. Finally, he found the treasure hidden amidst some rocks. **一位勇敢的骑士在一片危险的森林中寻找丢失的宝藏。在茂密的树木和野兽之中，他坚定不移。最终，他在一些岩石中间找到了隐藏的宝藏。**
> 想象一个小小的实验室，科学家们正在研究一种神秘的物质。经过努力，他们发现这是一种叫做 amino 的物质，它是构成生命的关键成分，就像小砖块搭建起了生命的大厦。 **想象在一个小实验室中，科学家研究一种叫 amino 的神秘物质，它是构成生命的关键成分，像小砖块构建生命大厦。**

> A mouse was looking for cheese in a strange room. But everything seemed amiss. The furniture was in odd places and there was no smell of cheese. It realized that it had entered the wrong room. **一只老鼠在一个陌生的房间里找奶酪。但一切似乎都不对劲。家具摆放得很奇怪，也没有奶酪的气味。它意识到自己进错房间了。**

> A soldier was in a fierce battle and ran out of ammo. He desperately searched for more, knowing his life depended on it. Finally, he found a hidden cache of ammo and was able to keep fighting. **一名士兵在激烈的战斗中耗尽了弹药。他拼命寻找更多，深知自己的生命取决于此。最后，他找到了一处隐藏的弹药库，得以继续战斗。**

> A mouse was in a chemical factory and smelled a strange smell. The worker told it that was ammonia. The mouse ran away quickly as it was a harmful gas. **一只老鼠在化工厂里闻到一股奇怪的气味。工人告诉它那是氨气。老鼠因为这是有害气体迅速跑开了。**

> A soldier was in a fierce battle and ran out of ammunition. He desperately searched for more, knowing it was his only hope to defend himself and his comrades. Without ammunition, they would be in great danger. **一名士兵在一场激烈的战斗中耗尽了弹药。他拼命寻找更多，深知没有弹药，他和战友们就会陷入极大的危险。**

> One day, a man woke up with amnesia. He couldn\'t remember anything about himself or his past. He felt lost and confused. But with the help of a doctor, he slowly started to regain his memories. **有一天，一个男人醒来后患上了失忆症。他对自己和过去的任何事情都记不起来了。他感到迷茫和困惑。但在医生的帮助下，他慢慢地开始恢复记忆。**

> A king decided to offer amnesty to all prisoners who had committed minor crimes. They were set free and started a new life. The word \'amnesty\' means a general pardon for offenses. **一位国王决定对所有犯了轻罪的囚犯进行大赦。他们被释放，开始了新生活。'amnesty'这个单词的意思是大赦，特赦。**

> A group of scientists went on an adventure to study ancient tribes. They used all kinds of anthropological methods to understand the people\'s lives. This adventure was full of discoveries and mysteries. **一群科学家去探险以研究古代部落。他们使用了各种各样的人类学方法来了解这些人的生活。这次探险充满了发现和神秘。**
> 想象一位 anthropologist 深入古老的丛林，研究原始部落的人类。他观察他们的生活方式、习俗，试图解开人类起源和发展的秘密。这位学者专注且充满好奇，就像一个勇敢的探索者。 **想象一位人类学家深入古老的丛林，研究原始部落的人类。他观察他们的生活方式、习俗，试图解开人类起源和发展的秘密。这位学者专注且充满好奇，就像一个勇敢的探索者。**
> 想象一下，有个勇敢的探险家，他深入各种人群，研究人类的起源和发展。他所从事的工作就是anthropology。这个词就像是打开人类奥秘之门的钥匙，引领我们了解人类的过去和现在。 **想象一下，有个勇敢的探险家，他深入各种人群，研究人类的起源和发展。他所从事的工作就是人类学。这个词就像是打开人类奥秘之门的钥匙，引领我们了解人类的过去和现在。**

> In a magical land, a brave knight wore an \'anti-evil\' amulet to fight against all the dark forces. The \'anti\' in the amulet meant to oppose and prevent evil. So, remember, \'anti\' means against or opposed to. **在一个神奇的国度，一位勇敢的骑士佩戴着一个"抗邪"护身符来对抗所有黑暗力量。护身符中的"anti"意味着反对和抵御邪恶。所以，记住，"anti"表示反对或对抗。**
> A sick ant was very weak. But then it took an antibiotic and started to recover quickly. The antibiotic was like a magic medicine for the ant. **一只生病的蚂蚁非常虚弱。但后来它服用了抗生素，很快就开始恢复了。抗生素对这只蚂蚁来说就像神奇的药。**

> Imagine a battle inside your body. Tiny soldiers called antibodies are always ready to fight off bad invaders. They are like brave heroes, protecting you from getting sick. Antibodies are your body\'s defenders! **想象一下身体内部的一场战斗。被称为抗体的微小士兵总是准备好击退坏的入侵者。它们就像勇敢的英雄，保护你不生病。抗体是你身体的卫士！**

> A little boy anticipated the arrival of his birthday. He imagined the cake, gifts and fun. Every day, he counted down, full of excitement. Finally, his anticipated birthday came and it was wonderful! **一个小男孩期待着他生日的到来。他想象着蛋糕、礼物和欢乐。每天，他都倒数着，充满了兴奋。最后，他期待的生日到来了，非常棒！**

> A little girl was in anticipation of her birthday. She couldn\'t sleep, imagining the gifts and the cake. Her heart was filled with excitement and hope. Finally, the big day came, and her anticipation turned into joy. **一个小女孩满心期待着她的生日。她睡不着觉，想象着礼物和蛋糕。她的心中充满了兴奋和希望。终于，这重要的一天到来了，她的期待变成了喜悦。**

> Once upon a time, a monkey showed its antics in the zoo. It jumped around, made funny faces, and did all kinds of crazy things. People were amused by its antics. **从前，一只猴子在动物园里展示它的古怪滑稽的动作。它跳来跳去，做着滑稽的鬼脸，做着各种疯狂的事情。人们被它的滑稽动作逗乐了。**

> A scientist was working hard in the lab to find a cure for a deadly poison. After many experiments, he finally discovered a special substance - the antidote. It saved countless lives and became a symbol of hope. **一位科学家在实验室里努力工作，试图找到一种致命毒药的解药。经过多次实验，他终于发现了一种特殊的物质------解毒剂。它拯救了无数生命，成为了希望的象征。**

> Imagine a tiny ant carrying a special key (gen). This key is the antigen, which is like a unique marker that the immune system recognizes to fight against invaders. The ant with the key is the antigen! **想象一只小蚂蚁拿着一把特殊的钥匙（gen）。这把钥匙就是抗原，它就像免疫系统识别来对抗入侵者的独特标记。拿着钥匙的蚂蚁就是抗原！**

> Once upon a time, a brave knight named Anti was on a quest to protect the kingdom. He discovered a special shield called Oxidant that could defend against evil magic. Combining them, Antioxidant became a powerful force to keep the kingdom safe. **从前，有个勇敢的骑士叫安蒂，他在一次探索中发现了一个叫氧化剂的特殊盾牌，能抵御邪恶魔法。将它们结合，抗氧化剂就成了保护王国安全的强大力量。**

> A brave knight had an antipathy towards the evil dragon. Every time he saw it, he felt a strong dislike and was determined to defeat it. This dislike was his antipathy. **一位勇敢的骑士对邪恶的龙怀有反感。每次看到它，他都感到强烈的厌恶，并决心打败它。这种厌恶就是他的反感。**

> A young adventurer entered an old castle. Everything inside was antiquated. The furniture was old and worn, and the decorations looked like they were from a bygone era. It made the adventurer realize the meaning of \'antiquated\' - old-fashioned and out of date. **一位年轻的冒险家进入了一座古老的城堡。城堡内的一切都很陈旧。家具老旧磨损，装饰品看起来像是来自过去的时代。这让冒险家明白了'antiquated'这个词的意思------过时的、老式的。**

> One day, I visited an old house. In a corner, I found an antique chair. It was beautifully carved and had a unique style. I imagined the people who sat on it long ago. This chair made me understand the charm of antiques. **有一天，我参观了一座老房子。在一个角落里，我发现了一把古董椅子。它雕刻精美，风格独特。我想象着很久以前坐在上面的人。这把椅子让我明白了古董的魅力。**

> In a faraway land, an archaeologist discovered a hidden cave filled with ancient treasures. These relics belonged to a time of antiquity, revealing the mysteries of a long-gone civilization. The word \'antiquity\' refers to ancient times and things from the past. **在一个遥远的地方，一位考古学家发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面装满了古代的珍宝。这些文物属于古代时期。单词\'antiquity\'指的是古代和过去的事物。**

> A doctor was dealing with a serious wound. To prevent infection, he used an antiseptic liquid. The liquid was so powerful that it killed all the germs and made the wound heal quickly. **一位医生正在处理一个严重的伤口。为了防止感染，他使用了一种抗菌剂。这种液体非常强大，杀死了所有细菌，使伤口很快愈合。**

> One day, Tom refused to join his friends\' party and preferred to stay alone at home. His behavior was antisocial. People thought he was strange and unfriendly. Later, he realized his mistake and changed. **有一天，汤姆拒绝参加朋友们的聚会，宁愿独自呆在家里。他的行为是反社会的。人们觉得他奇怪又不友好。后来，他意识到了自己的错误并做出了改变。**

> Once upon a time, there were two kingdoms. One was peaceful and prosperous, the other was chaotic and poor. These two kingdoms were the antithesis of each other, showing completely opposite states. **从前，有两个王国。一个和平繁荣，另一个混乱贫穷。这两个王国彼此对立，呈现出完全相反的状态。**

> Once upon a time, there were two ideas. One was for peace and the other for war. They were antithetical, completely opposite. Just like light and darkness. Peace was kind and gentle, while war was cruel and harsh. **从前，有两个想法。一个是追求和平，另一个是主张战争。它们是对立的，完全相反。就像光明与黑暗。和平是善良温和的，而战争是残酷无情的。**

> One day, a little deer was running in the forest. Its antlers were so beautiful and strong. But they got caught in some branches. Luckily, it managed to free itself. Remember, those beautiful things on the deer\'s head are antlers. **有一天，一只小鹿在森林里奔跑。它的鹿角既漂亮又强壮。但它们被一些树枝卡住了。幸运的是，它成功挣脱了。记住，小鹿头上那些漂亮的东西就是鹿角。**

> A blacksmith was working hard in his forge. He constantly hit the hot iron on the anvil, shaping it into useful tools. The anvil remained strong and steady, taking the force of each blow. **一位铁匠在他的锻造坊努力工作。他不断地将热铁在铁砧上敲打，将其塑造成有用的工具。铁砧保持坚固和稳定，承受着每一次的击打。**

> A little mouse was always in a state of anxiety because it was afraid of the big cat. It worried day and night. But finally, it learned to be brave and face its fears. \'Anxiety\' is like the mouse\'s constant worry. **一只小老鼠总是处于焦虑的状态，因为它害怕大猫。它日夜担忧。但最后，它学会了勇敢，面对自己的恐惧。\'anxiety\'就像这只老鼠一直以来的担忧。**

> One day, Tom had an important exam. He was very anxious before it. He kept thinking if he could pass. But in the end, with his hard work, he did well. Anxious means feeling worried or nervous. **一天，汤姆有一场重要的考试。考试前他非常焦虑。他一直在想自己是否能通过。但最后，通过他的努力，他考得很好。anxious 意思是感到担心或紧张。**

> One day, Tom was waiting anxiously for his exam results. He paced back and forth, constantly looking at the clock. His heart was beating fast, fearing that he might not have done well. **有一天，汤姆焦急地等待着他的考试成绩。他来回踱步，不停地看钟。他的心跳很快，担心自己可能考得不好。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a big forest. She had no idea which way to go. But she kept asking herself, \'Is there any path that can lead me home?\' Finally, she found a way out. **有一天，一个小女孩在大森林里迷路了。她不知道该走哪条路。但她一直问自己，'有任何能带我回家的路吗？'最后，她找到了出路。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for food. It wondered if anybody could help it. Suddenly, a kind bird appeared and shared some grains. The mouse was so happy. It realized that sometimes, anybody could bring unexpected kindness. **一天，一只小老鼠在寻找食物。它想知道是否有人能帮助它。突然，一只善良的鸟出现并分享了一些谷物。小老鼠非常高兴。它意识到有时候，任何人都可能带来意想不到的善意。**

> A lost traveler was seeking directions. People gave various confusing answers. But anyhow, the traveler decided to follow his instincts and finally found the way. It means in any case or regardless of how things are. **一位迷路的旅行者正在问路。人们给出了各种令人困惑的答案。但不管怎样，旅行者决定跟着自己的直觉走，最终找到了路。它的意思是无论如何，不管怎样。**

> A little boy was always afraid of the dark. But one night, when he faced it bravely, he found there was nothing to be scared of anymore. From then on, he wasn\'t afraid of the dark anymore. **一个小男孩总是害怕黑暗。但有一天晚上，当他勇敢面对时，他发现再也没什么好害怕的了。从那以后，他不再害怕黑暗了。**

> One day, a group of friends were lost in a forest. They needed help. But no one knew if anyone would come to rescue them. Finally, a kind ranger appeared and saved them all. **一天，一群朋友在森林里迷路了。他们需要帮助。但没人知道是否会有人来救他们。最后，一位善良的护林员出现并救了他们所有人。**

> One day, a lost puppy was looking for its home. It wandered around, hoping to find it anyplace. Finally, it found its loving family in a small garden. Anyplace means any location or place. **一天，一只迷路的小狗正在寻找它的家。它到处游荡，希望在任何地方找到它的家。最后，它在一个小花园里找到了它亲爱的家人。anyplace 意思是任何地点或地方。**

> One day, a little monkey was looking for food. He searched everywhere but couldn\'t find anything. Just when he was about to give up, he found a hidden tree with lots of fruits. It taught him that with patience, anything is possible. **有一天，一只小猴子在找食物。它到处找，但什么也找不到。就在它要放弃的时候，它发现了一棵藏着很多水果的树。这教会它只要有耐心，任何事都是有可能的。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. I had no map, but anyway, I decided to keep walking and explore. Eventually, I found my way. It means in any case or regardless of circumstances. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。我没有地图，但不管怎样，我决定继续走并探索。最终，我找到了路。它的意思是无论如何，不管怎样。**

> One day, a little bird wanted to find a beautiful place. It flew high and low, looking anywhere for the perfect spot. Finally, it found a wonderful garden. > A couple was forced to live apart due to a job transfer. The distance made them sad. But they still kept in touch. \'Apart\' means separated or not together. **一对夫妻因为工作调动被迫分开居住。距离让他们难过。但他们仍保持联系。\'apart\'意思是分离的、不在一起的。**

> In a distant land, there was a cruel system called apartheid. People were separated based on their skin color. One brave soul fought against it, saying it was unjust and needed to end. Finally, justice prevailed. **在一个遥远的地方，有一种残酷的制度叫种族隔离。人们因肤色而被分隔。一位勇敢的人站出来反对，称其不公正，必须结束。最终，正义获胜。**

> One day, a young couple was looking for a new place to live. They finally found a nice apartment with a big window and a cozy balcony. They were so happy to call it their home. **有一天，一对年轻夫妇正在寻找新的住所。他们最终找到了一个漂亮的公寓，有一个大窗户和一个舒适的阳台。他们非常高兴称其为家。**

> A young man named Tom showed apathy towards his studies. He didn\'t care about exams or homework. But when he failed to get into his dream college, he realized his apathy had cost him a lot. Now he changed and became passionate. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人对学习表现出冷漠。他不在乎考试和作业。但当他没能进入梦想的大学时，他意识到自己的冷漠让他付出了很多。现在他改变了，变得充满热情。**

> A little mouse was looking for a way out of a dark room. Finally, it found an aperture, a small opening that let in a beam of light. The mouse squeezed through the aperture and escaped. **一只小老鼠正在黑暗的房间里寻找出路。最后，它发现了一个小孔，一个让光线照进来的小开口。老鼠挤过这个小孔逃走了。**
> 想象一下，你正在攀登一座高山，经过艰难的攀爬，终于到达了山顶，那个山顶的尖峰就是 apex。它就像你努力的终极目标，代表着最高、最顶点的位置。 **想象你攀登高山到达山顶尖峰的情景来记住 apex 这个表示顶点、尖端的单词。**

> A farmer was very angry because his plants were covered with aphids. The little aphids were eating all the leaves. But then some ladybugs came and ate the aphids, saving the plants. Remember, aphid is a tiny pest! **一位农民非常生气，因为他的植物上布满了蚜虫。小小的蚜虫正在吃掉所有的叶子。但随后一些瓢虫来了，吃掉了蚜虫，拯救了植物。记住，aphid 是一种小小的害虫！**

> A group of friends went to buy apples. Each apple cost \$1 apiece. They bought several and shared them happily. It was a simple but enjoyable moment. **一群朋友去买苹果。每个苹果 1 美元一个。他们买了几个，开心地分享。这是一个简单但愉快的时刻。**
> 想象一下，一位潜水员在深海中，突然发现氧气设备出了问题，导致他无法正常呼吸，出现了'apnea'（呼吸暂停）的状况。他拼命挣扎，努力寻找解决办法。 **想象一位潜水员在深海中因氧气设备故障而出现呼吸暂停的状况，拼命挣扎寻找解决办法**

> In a post-apocalyptic world, everything was in ruins. A brave survivor named Alex found an ancient book that mentioned \'apocalypse\', meaning the total destruction and the end of the world. > A man was walking alone in a desert when he saw a strange vision. The sky turned dark and everything seemed in chaos. He felt like it was an apocalyptic scene. Later he realized it was just a bad dream. **一个男人独自在沙漠中行走，突然看到一个奇怪的景象。天空变暗，一切都显得混乱不堪。他感觉这像是世界末日的场景。后来他意识到这只是一场噩梦。**

> A king decided to step away from political affairs and focus on art. People called him apolitical. He just wanted to enjoy a life without the hustle and bustle of politics. **一位国王决定远离政治事务，专注于艺术。人们称他为不关心政治的。他只是想享受一种没有政治喧嚣的生活。**

> One day, Tom accidentally broke Mary\'s favorite vase. Feeling very sorry, he had an apologetic look on his face and said, \'I\'m so sorry, Mary. > One day, Tom broke his friend\'s toy by accident. He came to his friend apologetically, saying sorry with a sincere expression. His friend forgave him because of Tom\'s honest apology. **一天，汤姆不小心弄坏了朋友的玩具。他满怀歉意地来到朋友面前，真诚地说着对不起。因为汤姆诚恳的道歉，他的朋友原谅了他。**

> A famous philosopher was often misunderstood. But his student was always there to defend him, becoming an \'apologist\'. > One day, Tom accidentally broke his sister\'s favorite toy. Feeling very sorry, he decided to apologize. > One day, Tom broke Mary\'s favorite vase by accident. Feeling very sorry, Tom wrote Mary an apology letter, saying he was truly sorry and would make it up to her.
