> Once upon a time, a wise apostle traveled far and wide to spread the divine message. His work was considered apostolic, full of sacredness and authority. People respected his mission and followed his teachings. **从前，一位睿智的使徒四处游历去传播神圣的信息。他的工作被认为是使徒的，充满了神圣和权威。人们尊重他的使命并遵循他的教诲。**

> A brave knight was ready to fight in the battle. But when he saw the countless enemies with cruel weapons, it appalled him. He felt his courage fading away. **一位勇敢的骑士准备在战斗中作战。但当他看到无数拿着残酷武器的敌人时，这使他感到惊恐。他感觉自己的勇气在消退。**

> A group of adventurers entered an abandoned castle. The scene inside was appalling. Corpses were everywhere, and the stench was unbearable. It made them want to flee immediately. **一群冒险家进入了一座废弃的城堡。里面的场景令人震惊。到处都是尸体，恶臭难忍。这让他们想立刻逃离。**

> A group of scientists was in a rush to complete an important experiment. But they were missing the key apparatus. Just in time, a brave assistant brought it, and the experiment succeeded. The apparatus was the hero! **一群科学家急于完成一项重要实验。但他们缺少关键仪器。就在这时，一位勇敢的助手带来了它，实验成功了。仪器是英雄！**

> A poor girl had only old and shabby apparel. But one day, a fairy gave her beautiful new clothes. She wore the fine apparel and felt confident. Now she knew good apparel can change how you feel. **一个贫穷的女孩只有又旧又破的衣服。但有一天，一个仙女给了她漂亮的新衣服。她穿着精美的服装，感到自信。现在她知道好的服装能改变你的感觉。**

> A man was lost in a forest. It was apparent that he needed help. But he refused to show his fear. Finally, a rescue team found him. \'Apparent\' here means clearly visible or obvious. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。很明显他需要帮助。但他拒绝表现出害怕。最后，一支救援队找到了他。'apparent'在这里指清晰可见的或明显的。**

> A man was lost in a forest. Apparently, he didn\'t have a map. But luckily, he found a way out eventually. It seemed that his survival skills saved him. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。显然，他没有地图。但幸运的是，他最终找到了出路。似乎是他的生存技能救了他。**

> One night, while walking in the old castle, Tom suddenly saw an apparition. It was a pale figure that seemed to float in the air. Tom was so scared that he ran away as fast as he could. The apparition was like a ghostly presence. **一天晚上，汤姆在古老的城堡里散步时，突然看到一个幽灵。那是一个苍白的身影，似乎在空中飘浮。汤姆吓得尽可能快地跑开了。这个幽灵就像一个鬼魅般的存在。**

> A poor man was wrongly accused of a crime. He made an appeal to the judge, saying he was innocent. His sincere words and desperate look finally made the judge reconsider. Appeal means to make a serious and urgent request. **一个穷人被错误地指控犯罪。他向法官上诉，称自己是无辜的。他真诚的话语和绝望的神情最终让法官重新考虑。appeal 意思是呼吁；申诉；上诉**

> A puppy was sitting in a park, looking appealing with its big eyes and wagging tail. Everyone passing by wanted to play with it. The puppy\'s charm was truly appealing. **一只小狗坐在公园里，它睁着大眼睛，摇着尾巴，看起来很吸引人。每个路过的人都想和它玩。这只小狗的魅力真的很迷人。**

> A fairy was hidden in the forest. One day, when the sun shone brightly, she appeared in front of a lost boy. Her beautiful figure showed up suddenly, making the boy\'s eyes widen with surprise. **一个仙女隐藏在森林里。有一天，当阳光灿烂时，她出现在一个迷路的男孩面前。她美丽的身影突然显现，让男孩惊讶得睁大了眼睛。**

> A prince was seeking a true love based on inner beauty. But everyone was judged by their appearance. Until one day, he met a girl whose kindness behind the plain appearance touched his heart. Appearance can be deceiving. **一位王子在寻找基于内在美的真爱。但每个人都凭外表被评判。直到有一天，他遇到了一个外表平凡但内心善良的女孩触动了他的心。外表可能具有欺骗性。**

> A king was very angry. His ministers were worried. One smart minister brought him precious gifts to make him calm and happy. This act of giving gifts was to appease the king\'s anger. **一位国王非常生气。他的大臣们很担心。一位聪明的大臣给他带来珍贵的礼物以使他平静和高兴。这种送礼物的行为就是为了安抚国王的愤怒。**

> A person was wrongly accused in a court. He desperately needed an appellate process to correct the injustice. The appellate system was like a savior, offering a chance for a fair outcome. **一个人在法庭上被错误指控。他极度需要上诉程序来纠正这不公正。上诉制度就像救世主，为公平的结果提供了机会。**
> 想象一只章鱼，它的触手就是 appendage。这些触手帮助它捕食、移动和感知周围环境。章鱼没有触手就无法正常生活，就像物体没有 appendage 就不完整。 **想象一只章鱼，它的触手就是附属物。这些触手帮助它捕食、移动和感知周围环境。章鱼没有触手就无法正常生活，就像物体没有附属物就不完整。**
> 想象一个古老的图书馆，里面有很多珍贵的书籍。在每本书的末尾，都有一个 appendix ，它就像一个神秘的盒子，装满了对书中内容的补充说明和参考资料，帮助读者更好地理解。 **想象在古老图书馆中，每本书末尾的'appendix（附录）'像装满补充说明和参考资料的神秘盒子，助读者理解。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry and had a strong appetite. He ate a big pizza and two hamburgers. But his stomach still felt empty. Finally, he realized that his appetite was like a bottomless pit that day. **一天，汤姆非常饿，有着很强的食欲。他吃了一个大披萨和两个汉堡包。但他的肚子仍然觉得空。最后，他意识到那天他的食欲就像一个无底洞。**

> A hungry traveler entered a restaurant. The waiter quickly brought an appetizer, a small plate of delicious salad. The traveler\'s appetite was aroused, and he couldn\'t wait for the main course. The appetizer made him eager for more food. **一位饥饿的旅行者走进一家餐馆。服务员很快端上了一份开胃菜，一小盘美味的沙拉。旅行者的食欲被激发了，他迫不及待地等着主菜。这份开胃菜让他渴望更多的食物。**
> 在一场盛大的音乐会上，歌手精彩的演唱结束后，观众们纷纷起立，双手用力鼓掌（applaud），大声欢呼，以此表达对歌手的喜爱和赞赏。 **在一场音乐会上，观众鼓掌欢呼以表达对歌手的喜爱和赞赏。**

> A famous singer gave an amazing performance. When she finished, the audience burst into loud and continuous APPLAUSE. Everyone clapped their hands excitedly to show their love and appreciation. **一位著名歌手进行了一场精彩的演出。当她结束时，观众爆发出响亮而持续的掌声。每个人都兴奋地鼓掌以表示他们的喜爱和赞赏。**

> One day, a little girl was hungry. She saw a big tree full of red apples. She picked one and took a bite. It was so sweet! She was very happy and ate many apples. **一天，一个小女孩饿了。她看到一棵大树上挂满了红苹果。她摘了一个咬了一口。太甜了！她非常开心，吃了好多苹果。**

> One day, I went to a store to buy an appliance. I needed a new fridge to keep my food fresh. The salesperson showed me different models and explained their features. Finally, I chose the one that suited me best. **有一天，我去一家商店买电器。我需要一台新冰箱来保鲜食物。售货员给我展示了不同的款式，并解释了它们的特点。最后，我选了最适合我的那台。**

> A scientist was working on a new invention. He was constantly thinking about the applicability of his idea. Would it work in real life?最终他成功了，因为他找到了广泛的应用场景。 **一位科学家正在研究一项新发明。他一直在思考他的想法的适用性。它在现实生活中会起作用吗？最终他成功了，因为他找到了广泛的应用场景。**

> A student was confused about which rules were applicable to his project. But when he carefully read the instructions, he found the applicable ones and completed the task successfully. **一名学生对哪些规则适用于他的项目感到困惑。但当他仔细阅读说明时，他找到了适用的规则并成功完成了任务。**
> 想象一个招聘现场，很多人排队等待。其中有个焦急的小李，他渴望得到那份工作，不断整理自己的简历。小李就是一个applicant，即申请人，在努力争取被选中。 **想象在招聘现场，小李这个申请人焦急等待，努力争取工作机会的情景，来记住applicant（申请人）这个单词。**
> 小明一直梦想成为一名程序员，他精心准备了一份简历和项目作品，满怀期待地提交了 APPLICATION 给心仪的公司，希望能获得工作机会。 **小明一直梦想成为一名程序员，他精心准备了一份简历和项目作品，满怀期待地提交了申请给心仪的公司，希望能获得工作机会。**

> A scientist was constantly APPLIED to his experiments, never giving up. He used all his knowledge and skills,:focused and determined. Finally, his efforts paid off and he made a great discovery. **一位科学家一直专注于他的实验，从不放弃。他运用自己所有的知识和技能，专注且坚定。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他有了重大发现。**

> A student named Lily wanted to join a club. She filled out a form and applied carefully. She hoped her efforts would be accepted. Finally, she got in! **一个叫莉莉的学生想加入一个俱乐部。她认真填写了表格并申请。她希望自己的努力能被接受。最后，她成功加入了！**

> A king needed to appoint a new general. He had many candidates. Finally, he chose the bravest one. The act of choosing the general is like appointing someone to a position. **一位国王需要任命一位新将军。他有很多候选人。最终，他选择了最勇敢的那个。选择将军的这个行为就像是任命某人担任某个职位。**

> The king appointed a brave knight to protect the kingdom. The knight was given special tasks and powers. Remember, \'appointed\' means officially chosen for a job or position, just like the knight was chosen by the king. **国王任命了一位勇敢的骑士来保护王国。这位骑士被赋予了特殊的任务和权力。记住，\'appointed\'意思是正式选定担任某个工作或职位，就像这位被国王选定的骑士一样。**

> A company needed a new leader. They chose John and he became the appointee. Everyone was curious about how he would perform in this important role. Now you know, appointee is the person who has been appointed! **一家公司需要一位新领导。他们选择了约翰，他就成了被任命者。每个人都好奇他在这个重要角色中会表现如何。现在你知道了，appointee 就是被任命的人！**

> A company needed an appraisal to know the value of a precious painting. The expert carefully examined it and gave a detailed appraisal. It helped the company make a smart decision. **一家公司需要评估来了解一幅珍贵画作的价值。专家仔细检查并给出了详细的评估。这帮助公司做出了明智的决定。**

> A king needed to appraise the value of a precious gem. His wise advisor carefully examined it and gave an accurate assessment. The king was happy with the appraise and rewarded the advisor. **一位国王需要评估一颗珍贵宝石的价值。他聪明的顾问仔细检查后给出了准确的评价。国王对这次评估很满意，并奖励了顾问。**

> One day, a precious painting was brought to a room. Everyone was curious about its value. Then, the appraiser arrived. With expertise and a careful eye, he determined the painting\'s worth, making everyone amazed. **有一天，一幅珍贵的画被带到一个房间里。每个人都好奇它的价值。然后，鉴定师来了。凭借专业知识和仔细的观察，他确定了这幅画的价值，让每个人都感到惊讶。**

> One day, I received a beautiful painting from my friend. I really appreciated it and told him how much it meant to me. His kindness made me feel warm and happy. **有一天，我从朋友那里收到了一幅漂亮的画。我真的很感激，并告诉他这对我意义重大。他的好意让我感到温暖和快乐。**

> A poor artist painted a beautiful landscape. One day, a rich collector saw it and showed great appreciation. The artist was overjoyed as his work was finally recognized. Appreciation made the artist\'s efforts worthwhile. **一位贫穷的艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。有一天，一位富有的收藏家看到了，并表示出极大的赞赏。艺术家非常高兴，因为他的作品终于得到了认可。赞赏让艺术家的努力变得有价值。**

> One day, I helped an old man carry heavy bags. He was very appreciative and said my kindness made his day. It means showing gratitude and recognition. So, remember \'appreciative\' when you think of being thankful! **有一天，我帮一位老人提重物。他非常感激，说我的善举让他这一天都很美好。这个词意味着表示感谢和认可。所以，当你想到感恩时，记住\'appreciative\'这个词！**

> A thief was running away, but the brave police officer was able to apprehend him. The officer understood and caught the thief, showing the meaning of \'apprehend\' which is to arrest or grasp mentally. **一个小偷正在逃跑，但勇敢的警察能够逮捕他。这位警官理解并抓住了小偷，展现了\'apprehend\'这个词的意思，即逮捕或理解。**

> A thief was caught by the police. His face showed apprehension as he knew he would face punishment. He was worried and afraid, which is exactly what \'apprehension\' means - anxiety or fear about something unpleasant that might happen. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。他的脸上露出了忧虑，因为他知道自己将面临惩罚。他感到担心和害怕，这正是\'apprehension\'这个词的意思------对可能发生的不愉快的事情感到焦虑或害怕。**

> A thief was trying to break into a house. The owner, feeling apprehensive, called the police immediately. He was worried and anxious about what might happen. So, \'apprehensive\' means feeling worried or anxious. **一个小偷正试图闯入一所房子。房子的主人感到担忧害怕，立即报了警。他对可能发生的事情感到担心和焦虑。所以，\'apprehensive\'意思是担忧的，焦虑的。**

> A young boy was eager to learn a trade. He became an apprentice to a master craftsman. Every day, he followed the master closely, learning skills and tricks. Through hard work and dedication, he hoped to become a master himself one day. **一个年轻的男孩渴望学习一门手艺。他成为了一位工匠大师的学徒。每天，他紧紧跟随着大师，学习技能和窍门。通过努力和专注，他希望有一天自己也能成为大师。**

> A young person named Tom was eager to learn a trade. He signed up for an apprenticeship with a master carpenter. Through hard work and learning, Tom finally mastered the skills and completed his apprenticeship successfully. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人渴望学习一门手艺。他与一位木匠大师签订了学徒协议。通过努力工作和学习，汤姆最终掌握了技能，成功地完成了学徒期。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a forest. As night approached, he decided to follow a river, hoping it would lead him to safety. Finally, he found a village, approaching it with joy. The way he got closer to the village is like the meaning of \'approach\'. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林里迷路了。当夜晚临近时，他决定沿着一条河走，希望能通向安全之地。最后，他发现了一个村庄，高兴地靠近它。他靠近村庄的方式就像\'approach\'这个单词的意思。**

> A poor artist needed money to buy proper tools. So he decided to appropriate some funds from a charity event. But later, he realized it was wrong and returned the money. Remember, \'appropriate\' can mean to take something for a particular purpose, sometimes wrongly. **一位贫穷的艺术家需要钱买合适的工具。所以他决定挪用慈善活动的一些资金。但后来，他意识到这是错误的，并归还了钱。记住，\'appropriate\' 有占用、挪用的意思，有时是不正当的。**

> A little monkey wanted to dress appropriately for a party. It chose the right clothes and shoes and everyone said it looked great. \'Appropriately\' means in a suitable and proper way, just like the monkey\'s choice. **一只小猴子想要为一个聚会穿着得体。它选对了衣服和鞋子，大家都说它看起来很棒。\'appropriately\'意思是以合适恰当的方式，就像猴子的选择。**

> A poor artist needed funds. One day, a kind benefactor made an appropriation of money for the artist\'s new project. The artist was grateful and used the money appropriately to create wonderful art. **一位贫穷的艺术家需要资金。有一天，一位好心的赞助人给这位艺术家的新项目拨了一笔款。艺术家很感激，并恰当地使用这笔钱创作了精彩的艺术作品。**

> A young artist submitted his painting for a competition. After days of waiting, he finally received the approval from the judges. Their positive feedback made him overjoyed and confident in his talent. **一位年轻的艺术家提交了他的画作参加比赛。经过数日的等待，他终于得到了评委们的认可。他们的积极反馈让他欣喜若狂，并对自己的才能充满信心。**

> A young artist submitted his painting. The jury members carefully examined it and finally gave a nod of approval. It meant they thought his work was good and acceptable. **一位年轻的艺术家提交了他的画作。评审团成员仔细审查后，最终点头表示认可。这意味着他们认为他的作品很好，是可以接受的。**

> A company was considering many projects. One of them was very creative and had great potential. After careful evaluation, it was finally approved. The team was so happy as it meant their hard work paid off. **一家公司在考虑很多项目。其中有一个非常有创意且潜力巨大。经过仔细评估，它最终被批准了。团队非常高兴，因为这意味着他们的努力得到了回报。**

> One day, I presented my painting to my teacher. She looked at it approvingly, nodding and smiling. Her expression made me feel confident and happy. It was like her approvingly gaze was a big encouragement. **有一天，我把我的画展示给老师。她赞许地看着它，点头微笑。她的表情让我感到自信和开心。就好像她赞许的目光是巨大的鼓励。**

> A scientist was trying to approximate the number of stars in a galaxy. He made many calculations and estimations. Finally, he got an approximate result, which was close but not exact. **一位科学家试图估算一个星系中的恒星数量。他进行了许多计算和估计。最后，他得到了一个近似的结果，这个结果接近但不精确。**

> One day, Alice was planning a party. She needed to buy approximately 20 cupcakes. But she wasn\'t sure exactly. So, she guessed and bought a number close to 20. That\'s what approximately means - not exact but close. **有一天，爱丽丝在计划一个聚会。她需要买大约 20 个纸杯蛋糕。但她不确定具体数量。所以，她猜测并买了一个接近 20 的数量。这就是 approximately 的意思 - 不精确但接近。**

> A scientist was working on a complex experiment. He needed an approximation of the result before conducting the final test. With some calculations and estimates, he got a close enough approximation to move forward. **一位科学家正在进行一项复杂的实验。在进行最终测试之前，他需要结果的近似值。通过一些计算和估计，他得到了一个足够接近的近似值，得以继续推进。**

> One day, a little girl was walking in the orchard and saw a tree full of apricots. They were golden and looked so delicious. She picked one and took a bite. The sweet taste made her smile. **有一天，一个小女孩在果园里散步，看到一棵长满杏（apricot）的树。它们是金黄色的，看起来非常美味。她摘了一个咬了一口。甜甜的味道让她笑了。**

> A little girl was playing in the kitchen. She accidentally spilled juice on her dress. Her mother quickly put an apron on her to protect her clothes. The apron was like a shield, keeping her clean. **一个小女孩在厨房玩耍。她不小心把果汁洒在了裙子上。她妈妈迅速给她穿上一条围裙来保护她的衣服。围裙就像一个盾牌，让她保持干净。**

> There was a young student named Lily. She was very apt at solving math problems. Whenever there was a difficult math quiz, Lily was always the first to get the correct answer. So, \'apt\' means having a natural tendency or ability to do something well. **有个叫莉莉的年轻学生。她非常善于解决数学问题。每当有困难的数学测验，莉莉总是第一个得出正确答案。所以，\'apt\'意思是有做某事的天赋或能力。**

> A young student named Tom had an aptitude for solving math problems. Whenever there was a difficult equation, he could solve it quickly. His aptitude made him stand out in the class. **一个叫汤姆的年轻学生有解决数学问题的天资。每当有难题时，他都能很快解决。他的天资使他在班上脱颖而出。**

> A little puppy was always able to find its toy aptly. It didn\'t search randomly but with a precise sense. Just like this puppy, when we do things aptly, we do them precisely and appropriately. **一只小狗总是能恰当地找到它的玩具。它不是随便找，而是有一种精准的感知。就像这只小狗一样，当我们恰当地做事时，就是精准且合适地做事。**

> Aqua means water and culture means growing or developing. Imagine a scientist in a big pool, carefully growing and breeding fish. That\'s aquaculture - the farming of aquatic organisms like fish and shellfish in water. **水（aqua）意味着水，养殖（culture）意味着生长或发展。想象一位科学家在一个大池塘里，精心地养殖和培育鱼类。这就是水产养殖（aquaculture）------在水中养殖鱼类和贝类等水生生物。**

> A little girl named Lily loved fish. One day, her parents took her to a big place called an aquarium. There, she saw many kinds of colorful fish swimming happily. Lily was so excited and never forgot this wonderful place. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩喜欢鱼。有一天，她的父母带她去了一个叫水族馆的大地方。在那里，她看到了许多种五颜六色的鱼快乐地游着。莉莉非常兴奋，永远不会忘记这个美妙的地方。**

> A cute fish was happily swimming in the aquatic world. It showed us the beauty and mystery of the water. All the creatures in this aquatic environment lived in harmony. **一条可爱的鱼在水生世界里欢快地游着。它向我们展示了水的美丽和神秘。在这个水生环境中的所有生物都和谐共处。**

> Imagine a magical underground cave filled with clear water. This cave is like an aquifer. It stores and supplies water to wells and springs. People rely on it to get the precious water they need. **想象一个充满清澈水流的神奇地下洞穴。这个洞穴就像含水层。它储存并向水井和泉眼供水。人们依靠它获取所需的珍贵水资源。**

> Once upon a time, in a sports game, there was a dispute. Then an arbiter came. He was like a wise judge, carefully observing and making fair decisions. Everyone respected him. **从前，在一场体育比赛中，出现了争议。然后一位仲裁者来了。他就像一位睿智的法官，仔细观察并做出公平的决定。每个人都尊重他。**

> A king made decisions arbitrarily. He didn\'t listen to others\' advice and caused chaos in his kingdom. But finally, he realized his mistake and changed. Remember, \'arbitrarily\' means without considering others\' opinions. **一位国王随意地做决定。他不听别人的建议，导致他的王国一片混乱。但最后，他意识到了自己的错误并做出了改变。记住，\'arbitrarily\'意思是不考虑他人意见地。**

> Once upon a time, a king made arbitrary decisions. He didn\'t follow any rules and just did what he wanted. People were unhappy because his choices were so unfair and unpredictable. **从前，有一位国王做出任意的决定。他不遵循任何规则，只凭自己的意愿行事。人们很不高兴，因为他的选择如此不公平和难以预测。**

> A king needed to solve a dispute between two knights. So, he chose a wise old man for arbitration. The old man listened carefully and made a fair decision, ending the conflict. **一位国王需要解决两位骑士之间的争端。于是，他选择了一位睿智的老人进行仲裁。老人仔细聆听后做出了公平的决定，结束了这场冲突。**

> One day, in a heated dispute between two companies, an arbitrator was called in. The arbitrator, like a wise judge, listened carefully to both sides and made a fair decision, ending the conflict. **有一天，在两家公司的激烈争端中，一位仲裁员被请来。这位仲裁员就像一位明智的法官，仔细倾听双方的意见，并做出了公平的决定，结束了这场冲突。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful garden. In the center of it stood an arbor covered with climbing roses. People loved to rest under it, enjoying the shade and the sweet smell. The arbor became a symbol of peace and beauty. **从前，有一个美丽的花园。在它的中心立着一个爬满玫瑰的凉棚。人们喜欢在它下面休息，享受阴凉和甜美的香气。这个凉棚成为了和平与美丽的象征。**

> Once upon a time, an archer was shooting arrows. The trajectory of the arrows formed a beautiful arc in the sky. The arc was like a magical curve, leaving a lasting impression. **从前，有一个弓箭手在射箭。箭的轨迹在天空中形成了一道美丽的弧线。这道弧线就像一条神奇的曲线，令人印象深刻。**

> Once upon a time, I was lost in a strange town. Then I saw an arcade with colorful lights. It was full of games and fun. Remember, arcade is a covered passage with shops or places to play games. **从前，我在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。然后我看到一个有彩灯的拱廊。里面满是游戏和乐趣。记住，arcade 是有商店或游戏场所的拱廊。**

> A young wizard was trying to unlock the arcane secrets of an ancient book. The magic within was hidden and mysterious. Only by solving complex puzzles could he understand the arcane knowledge. **一位年轻的巫师试图解开一本古老书籍的神秘秘密。其中的魔法隐藏且神秘。只有通过解决复杂的谜题，他才能理解这神秘的知识。**
> 想象一下，在古老的城堡前，有一座弯弯的拱门（arch）。一位勇敢的骑士骑着马从下面穿过。这拱门就像一个大大的微笑，欢迎着每一个人的到来。 **想象在古老城堡前有一座弯弯的拱门，一位骑士骑马穿过，拱门像大大的微笑欢迎人到来。**

> A group of brave adventurers went on an archaeological expedition. They dug deep into the ground, looking for ancient treasures and clues. Their efforts were all for understanding the past, which is what \'archaeological\' is about - related to the study of ancient things. **一群勇敢的冒险家进行了一次考古探险。他们深挖土地，寻找古老的宝藏和线索。他们的努力都是为了了解过去，这就是"archaeological"的含义 - 与古代事物的研究有关。**

> Once upon a time, there was an adventurer named Alice. She was passionate about old things and spent her days digging and exploring. Eventually, she became a famous archaeologist, uncovering the secrets of the past. **从前，有个叫爱丽丝的冒险家。她热衷于古老的东西，整天挖掘和探索。最终，她成为了著名的考古学家，揭开了过去的秘密。**

> A brave adventurer was always passionate about uncovering ancient secrets. One day, he embarked on a journey to explore old ruins, and this pursuit led him to the field of archaeology. He dug, discovered, and unlocked the mysteries of the past. **一位勇敢的冒险家一直热衷于揭开古老的秘密。有一天，他踏上了探索古老遗迹的旅程，这一追求将他带入了考古学领域。他挖掘、发现并解开了过去的谜团。**

> Long ago, a traveler found an archaic map in an old castle. It was so old and strange that no one could understand it easily. The map led to hidden treasures from a bygone era. \'Archaic\' means old and outdated. **很久以前，一位旅行者在一座古老的城堡里发现了一张古老的地图。它太古老和奇怪了，以至于没人能轻易理解。这张地图指向了过去时代隐藏的宝藏。\'archaic\'意思是古老的、过时的。**

> In a faraway kingdom, there was a wise and respected leader called the Archbishop. He wore a special hat and had the power to guide people\'s souls. One day, he saved the kingdom from a spiritual crisis with his wisdom. **在一个遥远的王国，有一位睿智且备受尊敬的领袖，被称为大主教。他戴着一顶特殊的帽子，有权引导人们的灵魂。有一天，他用自己的智慧拯救了这个王国的精神危机。**

> Once upon a time, in a big city, there was a special area called an \'archdiocese\'. It was led by a powerful religious leader. People in this area followed certain rules and beliefs. The \'archdiocese\' was like a big family with a strong spiritual bond. **从前，在一个大城市里，有一个特殊的区域叫做"大主教管区"。它由一位强大的宗教领袖领导。这个区域的人们遵循着特定的规则和信仰。"大主教管区"就像一个有着强大精神纽带的大家庭。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful arched bridge over a clear river. People loved to walk on it and enjoy the view. The shape of the bridge, like a rainbow, was arched and very attractive. **从前，有一条清澈的河上有一座漂亮的拱形桥。人们喜欢在上面散步并欣赏风景。桥的形状像彩虹一样，是拱形的，非常迷人。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway kingdom, there was a brave archer. He could shoot arrows accurately and protect the people. One day, a fierce dragon attacked. The archer aimed carefully and shot the dragon, saving everyone. **从前，在一个遥远的王国里，有一位勇敢的弓箭手。他能精准地射箭并保护人民。有一天，一只凶猛的龙来袭。弓箭手仔细瞄准并射中了龙，拯救了所有人。**

> In a magical forest, there was an archetypal tree that had all the typical features of a perfect tree. It was tall, had lush leaves, and was the model for all other trees. This tree made us understand the meaning of \'archetypal\', which means representing a perfect or typical example. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一棵典型的树，它具备完美树木的所有典型特征。它高大，枝叶繁茂，是所有其他树木的典范。这棵树让我们明白了\'archetypal\'这个词的意思，即代表一个完美或典型的范例。**

> In a magical land, there was a unique figure known as the Archetype. This being was the original model for all heroes. Everyone looked up to the Archetype for inspiration and guidance. It was like a guiding star in the darkness. **在一片神奇的土地上，有一个被称为原型的独特人物。这个人物是所有英雄的原始模型。每个人都仰望原型以获取灵感和指导。它就像黑暗中的一颗启明星。**

> A brave sailor was lost in the vast sea. He struggled to find his way among many islands. Finally, he realized he was in an \'archipelago\' - a group of many islands. **一位勇敢的水手在辽阔的大海中迷失了方向。他努力在众多岛屿间寻找出路。最后，他意识到自己身处一个'群岛'------众多岛屿组成的区域。**

> An architect is like a master builder. Imagine a person named Alex who dreams of creating amazing buildings. He studies hard, sketches countless designs, and finally builds beautiful structures. Alex is the architect, making people\'s living dreams come true. **一位建筑师就像是建筑大师。想象一个叫亚历克斯的人，他梦想着创造出令人惊叹的建筑。他努力学习，绘制无数的设计图，最终建造出美丽的建筑。亚历克斯就是建筑师，让人们的居住梦想成真。**

> A young architect was designing a unique building. He spent days thinking about the architectural details, like the shape of the roof and the placement of windows. Finally, his masterpiece was born, showing his amazing architectural skills. **一位年轻的建筑师正在设计一座独特的建筑。他花了好几天思考建筑细节，比如屋顶的形状和窗户的位置。最后，他的杰作诞生了，展现出他惊人的建筑技艺。**

> A young artist was passionate about building. One day, he designed a unique building and called it \'architecture\'. It was a masterpiece that combined beauty and functionality. People were amazed by his creation. **一位年轻的艺术家热衷于建筑。有一天，他设计了一座独特的建筑物，并称之为"建筑"。这是一个将美观和实用功能相结合的杰作。人们对他的创作感到惊叹。**

> A detective was looking for archival records to solve a mystery. He searched through old files and documents, finally finding the key clue in the archival room. Archival means related to archives or records kept for future reference. **一位侦探正在寻找档案记录来解开一个谜团。他在旧文件和文档中搜寻，最终在档案室里找到了关键线索。Archival 意思是与档案或为将来参考保存的记录有关。**

> A long time ago, a wise king had a special room called \'archive\' to store precious scrolls and records. It was like a treasure chest of knowledge. People could find important history and wisdom there. **很久以前，一位睿智的国王有一个特殊的房间叫做'archive（档案库）'，用来存放珍贵的卷轴和记录。它就像一个知识的宝库。人们可以在那里找到重要的历史和智慧。**

> Once upon a time, a prince was lost in a strange place. He found an archway that led him to a beautiful garden. The archway was like a magical door. With its unique shape, it guided the prince to a new adventure. **从前，有一位王子在一个陌生的地方迷路了。他发现了一个拱门，这个拱门带他进入了一个美丽的花园。这个拱门就像一扇神奇的门。凭借其独特的形状，引导王子开启了新的冒险。**

> A young artist was ardent about his paintings. He spent days and nights creating, his passion like a burning fire. This passion made his artworks shine, showing his ardent love for art. **一位年轻的艺术家对他的画作充满热情。他日夜创作，他的热情像燃烧的火焰。这种热情使他的艺术作品大放异彩，展现出他对艺术的炽热之爱。**

> A group of adventurers decided to climb a very high mountain. The path was arduous. They had to struggle through thick forests and steep cliffs. But their determination helped them overcome the difficulties. **一群冒险家决定攀登一座非常高的山。道路艰难。他们不得不艰难地穿过茂密的森林和陡峭的悬崖。但他们的决心帮助他们克服了困难。**

> A rabbit was lost in a strange place. It kept running and found a beautiful area with green grass and colorful flowers. The rabbit was happy as it finally found a nice area to play. **一只兔子在一个陌生的地方迷路了。它一直跑，发现了一个美丽的区域，有绿草和五颜六色的花。兔子很高兴，因为它终于找到了一个玩耍的好地方。**

> In a faraway land, there was a special arena. Heroes from all over came to compete. The arena was full of excitement and challenges. It was a place where only the bravest could shine. **在一个遥远的地方，有一个特殊的竞技场。来自各地的英雄们都来此竞争。竞技场充满了兴奋和挑战。这是一个只有最勇敢的人才能闪耀的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a heated debate. One side claimed something was \'arguably\' true. But others strongly disagreed. It means that something can be debated or questioned. **从前，有一场激烈的辩论。一方声称某事'可论证地'是真的。但其他人强烈不同意。这意味着某事是可以被争论或质疑的。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry argued fiercely about which cartoon was better. Tom insisted his favorite was great, while Jerry argued for his own choice. They shouted and their faces turned red. > One day, Tom and Jerry had an argument over a piece of cheese. Tom insisted it was his, while Jerry claimed it was hers. Their voices got louder and louder. Finally, they decided to share it to end the argument. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞因为一块奶酪发生了争论。汤姆坚持认为是他的，而杰瑞声称是她的。他们的声音越来越大。最后，他们决定分享奶酪来结束这场争论。**

> Aria was a beautiful songbird. She had a lovely voice and could sing the most enchanting melodies. People would stop and listen whenever she sang. Remember, aria means a long and elaborate song for a solo voice. **Aria 是一只美丽的鸣鸟。它有着可爱的嗓音，能唱出最迷人的旋律。每当它唱歌时，人们都会停下来倾听。记住，aria 指的是一种为独唱者准备的长而精心制作的歌曲。**

> In a faraway desert, a traveler was struggling. The land was arid, with no water and few plants. He kept saying, \'This arid place is so hard to survive!\' meaning it was extremely dry and lacking in moisture. **在一个遥远的沙漠中，一位旅行者在艰难前行。这片土地十分干旱，没有水，植物也很少。他不停地说：'这个干旱的地方太难生存了！'意思是这里极度干燥且缺乏水分。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. Suddenly, many problems arose. Monsters appeared, the path was blocked. But the knight didn\'t give up. He faced all the difficulties that arose and continued his journey. **一位勇敢的骑士正在探险。突然，许多问题出现了。怪物出现了，道路被阻塞了。但骑士没有放弃。他面对了所有出现的困难，并继续他的旅程。**

> In a faraway kingdom, the noble and powerful group known as the aristocracy lived in grand palaces. They had special privileges and controlled much of the land. But one day, a brave commoner challenged their authority. **在一个遥远的王国里，被称为贵族阶层的高贵且有权势的群体住在宏伟的宫殿里。他们有特殊的特权，并控制着大量的土地。但有一天，一个勇敢的平民挑战了他们的权威。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway kingdom, there was a nobleman named Arthur. He was an aristocrat, always dressed elegantly and attended grand banquets. His noble status gave him many privileges and responsibilities. **从前，在一个遥远的王国里，有一位名叫亚瑟的贵族。他是一位贵族，总是穿着优雅，参加盛大的宴会。他的贵族身份赋予了他许多特权和责任。**

> A rich man named Alex always wore elegant clothes and lived in a huge mansion. Everyone said he had an aristocratic lifestyle. One day, a poor boy asked him what made him so special. Alex replied, \'It\'s my noble birth and refined taste.\' **一个名叫亚历克斯的富人总是穿着优雅的衣服，住在一座大豪宅里。大家都说他有着贵族般的生活方式。有一天，一个穷孩子问他是什么让他如此特别。亚历克斯回答说：'这是因为我高贵的出身和高雅的品味。'**
> 从前有个聪明的小孩，他特别喜欢玩数字游戏。一天，他发现了一本叫'arithmetic'的神秘书籍，里面充满了加、减、乘、除的奇妙法则，从此他在数学世界里畅游，不断探索数字的奥秘。 **从前有个聪明的小孩喜欢玩数字游戏，他发现一本叫'算术'的书，里面有加减乘除法则，他在数学世界探索。**

> In a world threatened by a great flood, a brave man built an ark to save all kinds of animals. It was a huge vessel that gave hope and protection. Remember, ark means a large boat or ship. **在一个被大洪水威胁的世界里，一位勇敢的人建造了一艘方舟来拯救各种各样的动物。这是一艘巨大的船，给予了希望和保护。记住，ark 意思是大船或方舟。**

> A brave knight was in a battle. His right arm was injured, but he still used his left arm to hold the sword and fight. The arm was his powerful weapon to protect his land. **一位勇敢的骑士正在战斗。他的右臂受伤了，但他仍用左臂握着剑战斗。手臂是他保卫领土的有力武器。**

> In a war-torn land, a brave general was inspecting the armament. He saw rows of powerful guns and piles of ammunition. The armament was the key to their defense and victory. **在一个饱受战争蹂躏的土地上，一位勇敢的将军正在视察军备。他看到一排排强大的枪支和一堆堆弹药。军备是他们防御和胜利的关键。**

> One day, a tired man came home and sat in an \'armchair\'. He put his arms on the sides and felt so relaxed. The chair was like a cozy hug for his arms, making him forget all the stress. **一天，一个疲惫的男人回到家坐在一张扶手椅上。他把胳膊放在两边，感觉非常放松。这把椅子就像给胳膊的一个舒适的拥抱，让他忘却了所有的压力。**

> A brave knight was always armed with a sharp sword and a strong shield. One day, he used his armed equipment to defeat the evil dragon and saved the village. Remember, \'armed\' means having weapons or being equipped. **一位勇敢的骑士总是全副武装，手持锋利的剑和坚固的盾牌。有一天，他凭借武装的装备打败了恶龙，拯救了村庄。记住，\'armed\'意思是配备武器的；武装的**

> A brave knight wore shiny ARMOR to protect himself in the battle. The ARMOR was so strong that it deflected all the enemy\'s attacks. With it, the knight felt safe and confident to fight for justice. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中穿着闪亮的盔甲来保护自己。这副盔甲非常坚固，能挡下敌人所有的攻击。有了它，骑士感到安全且有信心为正义而战。**

> A brave knight wore an armored suit to fight the dragon. The suit was strong and protected him from the dragon\'s fire. With the armored protection, the knight was fearless and finally won the battle. **一位勇敢的骑士穿着一套装甲服去与龙战斗。这套服装坚固无比，保护他免受龙火的伤害。有了装甲的保护，骑士无所畏惧，最终赢得了战斗。**

> One day, Tom was playing basketball and sweated a lot. When he raised his arm, he suddenly felt an uncomfortable smell. He realized it was coming from his armpit. Poor Tom needed to take a bath! **有一天，汤姆在打篮球，出了很多汗。当他抬起胳膊时，突然闻到一股难闻的气味。他意识到这是从他的腋窝传来的。可怜的汤姆得去洗个澡！**

> A brave boy named Tom always dreamed of joining the army. One day, he saw soldiers marching in perfect order. He was deeply impressed and decided to train hard to become one of them. Finally, he achieved his dream and wore the proud uniform of the army. **一个叫汤姆的勇敢男孩一直梦想着参军。有一天，他看到士兵们整齐地行进。他深受触动，决定刻苦训练成为其中一员。最终，他实现了梦想，穿上了军队那自豪的制服。**

> One day, I entered a small bakery. The moment I opened the door, an aroma of freshly baked bread filled the air. It was so inviting that I couldn\'t resist buying some. The aroma made the bakery a magical place. **有一天，我走进一家小面包店。当我打开门的那一刻，新鲜出炉的面包的香气弥漫在空气中。这香气太诱人了，我忍不住买了一些。香气让这家面包店成了一个神奇的地方。**
> 在一个神秘的花园里，有一朵特别的花，它散发着迷人的香气。人们一靠近就被这股芬芳吸引，纷纷称赞它是 \'aromatic\' 的。原来这就是芳香的魅力。 **在一个神秘花园里，有一朵散发迷人香气的花，人们称赞它是芳香的，这就是'aromatic'这个单词所代表的意思。**
> One day, a little monkey was running around the big tree. It looked very happy. It went around and around, enjoying the beautiful scenery. **一天，一只小猴子在一棵大树周围跑来跑去。它看起来非常开心。它一圈又一圈地跑着，欣赏着美丽的风景。**

> A little bird named Lily always aspired to fly higher than the mountains. She practiced every day, dreaming of reaching the blue sky. Finally, her aspiration came true, and she soared freely. **一只叫莉莉的小鸟总是渴望飞得比山还高。她每天练习，梦想着到达蓝天。最终，她的渴望成真了，她自由翱翔。**

> A young artist was constantly drawing and painting, full of energy and dreams. People called him an aspiring painter because he was striving with all his heart to become a great master. **一位年轻的艺术家不停地画画，充满活力和梦想。人们称他为有抱负的画家，因为他全心全意地努力想成为一位大师。**

> A stubborn donkey was always being called an \'ass\' by the farmer. One day, it refused to move and made the farmer very angry. Remember, \'ass\' means donkey. **一头倔强的驴子总是被农夫叫做'ass'。有一天，它不肯走，把农夫气坏了。记住，'ass'意思是驴子。**

> One night, a woman was walking home alone. Suddenly, an assailant jumped out from the corner and tried to rob her. Luckily, the police arrived in time and caught the assailant. **一天晚上，一个女人独自走回家。突然，一个攻击者从角落里跳出来试图抢劫她。幸运的是，警察及时赶到并抓住了攻击者。**

> In a dark alley, a mysterious figure lurked. Suddenly, a nobleman was attacked. The figure was an assassin, hired to end the nobleman\'s life. The assassin moved silently and struck with deadly precision. **在一条黑暗的小巷里，一个神秘的身影潜伏着。突然，一位贵族遭到了袭击。这个身影是一名刺客，被雇来结束这位贵族的性命。刺客悄无声息地移动，攻击精准致命。**

> A secret agent was on a mission to assassinate the evil leader. He sneaked into the enemy\'s base at night, got close to the target, and made the fatal shot. > A spy was on a secret mission. One night, in a dark alley, he witnessed an assassination. A powerful figure was shot and killed. The spy was shocked but managed to escape and report the terrifying assassination. **一名间谍正在执行一项秘密任务。一天晚上，在一条黑暗的小巷里，他目睹了一场暗杀。一个有权势的人物被枪杀了。间谍很震惊，但设法逃脱并报告了这起可怕的暗杀事件。**

> A brave soldier was on guard at the fort. Suddenly, a group of enemies rushed towards him, launching an assault. The soldier bravely fought back, determined to defend his position. **一位勇敢的士兵在堡垒站岗。突然，一群敌人朝他冲过来，发动了攻击。士兵勇敢地反击，决心保卫自己的阵地。**

> A scientist was conducting an assay in the lab. He carefully measured and analyzed the sample, hoping to get accurate results. The assay was crucial for his research project. **一位科学家正在实验室里进行化验分析。他仔细地测量和分析样本，希望能得到准确的结果。这次化验对他的研究项目至关重要。**
> 想象一个盛大的派对，人们从四面八方赶来。房间里逐渐形成了一个 assemblage，有欢笑的孩子、优雅的女士、帅气的男士，大家聚在一起，构成了这个欢乐的集合体。 **想象一个派对中人们聚集形成集合体的场景来辅助记忆【assemblage】这个单词，意思是集合、聚集**

> 想象一个巨大的工厂，工人们聚集（assembly）在一起，将各种零件组装成一辆辆崭新的汽车。这个聚集和组合的过程，就像单词assembly所表达的意思。 **想象一个工厂中工人聚集并组装的场景来辅助记忆单词assembly，其意为集会；集合；组装**

> 想象一下，一位专家来到一座古老的城堡，他要 assess（评估）城堡的价值。他仔细查看每一个房间、每一块石头，计算修复成本，最终给出一个准确的评估结果，就像我们用这个词去衡量事物的价值或状况一样。 **想象一位专家评估城堡价值的故事来辅助记忆'assess'这个单词，意思是评估、评定**

> A student was very nervous about the assessment. But when he remembered all the hard work he put in, he felt confident. The assessment turned out to be a chance to show his knowledge and skills. **一名学生对评估感到非常紧张。但当他想起自己付出的所有努力时，他感到有信心了。这次评估最终成为了他展示知识和技能的机会。**

> One day, a man named Tom was chosen as an assessor. His job was to evaluate the value of houses. He carefully inspected each room, like a detective, to give a fair assessment. **一天，一个叫汤姆的人被选为评估员。他的工作是评估房屋的价值。他像侦探一样仔细检查每个房间，以给出公平的评估。**

> A rich man had many assets, like houses, cars, and gold. But he was not happy. One day, he realized that true assets are not just material things but also good health and happy family. So, he started to cherish them. **一位富人有很多资产，比如房子、车子和黄金。但他并不开心。有一天，他意识到真正的资产不只是物质的东西，还有健康的身体和幸福的家庭。于是，他开始珍惜这些。**

> In a busy office, the boss needed to assign tasks. He wrote names on papers and put them in boxes, telling each employee which task was theirs. \'Assign\' means to give a particular job or duty to someone. **在一个繁忙的办公室里，老板需要分配任务。他把名字写在纸上放进盒子里，告诉每个员工他们的任务是什么。\'assign\'意思是给某人分配特定的工作或职责。**
> 想象一下，老师给了你一个神秘的盒子，说这是\'assignment\'，打开后里面是一项特别的任务，要你画一幅美丽的画并在明天展示。这个任务就是\'assignment\'，代表被分配的工作或任务。 **想象老师给你一个装有特殊任务的盒子来解释'assignment'这个单词，它指被分配的工作或任务。**

> A little alien came to Earth. At first, it found everything strange. But with time, it learned our language and customs, and gradually assimilated into our society. > 想象一只小蚂蚁在努力融入一个庞大的蚁群。它学习蚁群的规则和行为，这就是一种assimilation（同化；吸收）。最终小蚂蚁成功地被接纳，成为群体的一部分。 **想象一只小蚂蚁努力同化融入庞大蚁群的故事，帮助理解同化、吸收的意思**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. A kind person came to my aid and provided me with assistance. He showed me the way and helped me find my destination. Thanks to his assistance, I was no longer confused. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。一个善良的人来帮助我，给我提供了协助。他给我指路，帮我找到了目的地。多亏了他的协助，我不再困惑。**
> 有一只聪明的小蚂蚁 assistant，它总是热心地帮助其他昆虫找食物。一天，它帮助蜜蜂找到了一大片花海，大家都夸它是个好帮手。 **有一只聪明的小蚂蚁 助手，它总是热心地帮助其他昆虫找食物。一天，它帮助蜜蜂找到了一大片花海，大家都夸它是个好帮手。**

> A group of friends decided to form an association to protect the local park. They worked together, associated their efforts, and finally made the park more beautiful. > A store owner was confused about the assortment of goods. There were toys, clothes, and books all mixed up. But with careful sorting, he finally organized the assortment neatly and customers were happy. **一位店主对商品的各类品种感到困惑。有玩具、衣服和书籍全都混在一起。但经过仔细分类，他终于把各类品种整齐地整理好了，顾客们很开心。**
> 一位疲惫的旅行者在沙漠中口渴难耐。幸运的是，他找到了一处清泉，清凉的泉水 assuage 了他的干渴，让他感到舒适和满足。 **一位疲惫的旅行者在沙漠中口渴难耐。幸运的是，他找到了一处清泉，清凉的泉水减轻（或缓和、平息）了他的干渴，让他感到舒适和满足。**

> A student assumed that he could pass the exam without studying hard. But when the results came out, he was wrong. It taught him not to assume things easily. **一个学生假定自己不努力学习也能通过考试。但当成绩出来时，他错了。这教会他不要轻易假定事情。**

> A young detective assumed that the thief was hiding in the old house. But when he entered, he found it was just a wrong assumption. He had to start over to find the real criminal. **一位年轻的侦探假定小偷藏在那座老房子里。但当他进去时，发现这只是个错误的假定。他不得不重新开始寻找真正的罪犯。**

> A detective made an assumption that the thief entered the house through the window. But later, he found it was wrong. Remember, assumption can be wrong and needs to be verified. **一位侦探做出假设，小偷是从窗户进入房子的。但后来，他发现错了。记住，假设可能是错的，需要去核实。**

> A man was very nervous before a big exam. His friend gave him assurance by saying, \'You\'ve studied hard. You\'ll do great!\' The man felt confident. > A king was very worried about the safety of his kingdom. His advisor came and assured him that everything would be fine. > A young artist was always unsure of his talent. But after winning many awards, he became assured. He knew his skills would lead to success. Now he\'s confident and sure of his path. **一位年轻的艺术家总是对自己的才能不确定。但在赢得许多奖项后，他变得自信满满。他知道自己的技能会带来成功。现在他对自己的道路充满信心和确定。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的图书馆里，一本神秘的魔法书上满是奇特的符号。其中有一种像星星的符号*，被称为 asterisk，它有着特殊的魔力，能引导人们找到隐藏的知识。 **想象在古老图书馆中，魔法书上像星星的特殊符号*被称为 asterisk，有引导找隐藏知识的魔力。**

> A little mouse named Asa had trouble breathing. Every time it ran too fast, it felt like its chest was tight. The doctor said Asa had \'asthma\'. Poor Asa had to be careful and take medicine to feel better. **一只叫阿萨的小老鼠呼吸困难。每次它跑得太快，就感觉胸口发紧。医生说阿萨得了'哮喘'。可怜的阿萨不得不小心，还要吃药才能好起来。**

> One day, I received a mysterious package. When I opened it, I found a letter that astonished me. It said I had won a huge prize. This unexpected event really made my jaw drop. **有一天，我收到一个神秘包裹。当我打开时，里面的一封信让我大吃一惊。信上说我中了一个大奖。这个意外事件真的让我目瞪口呆。**

> One day, I was walking in the forest and suddenly saw a huge dinosaur. I was astonished. My eyes widened and my heart raced. I couldn\'t believe what I was seeing. **有一天，我在森林里散步，突然看到一只巨大的恐龙。我惊呆了。我的眼睛睁大，心跳加速。我简直不敢相信自己所看到的。**

> A young artist entered a competition. When he unveiled his painting, it was astonishing. Everyone was stunned by its beauty and creativity. > One day, I was walking in the park. Suddenly, a spaceship landed in front of me. I was filled with astonishment. I couldn\'t believe my eyes and my mind was completely shocked. **有一天，我正在公园里散步。突然，一艘宇宙飞船降落在我面前。我充满了惊讶。我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，我的大脑完全被震惊了。**

> A strong earthquake happened. The damage was huge and it astounded everyone. People couldn\'t believe how powerful the nature could be. It was a shock that left them speechless. **一场强烈的地震发生了。破坏巨大，震惊了所有人。人们不敢相信大自然的力量竟如此强大。这是一场让他们目瞪口呆的震惊。**

> One day, I witnessed a magic show. The magician made an elephant disappear in an astounding way. Everyone was shocked and couldn\'t believe their eyes. It was truly an astonishing feat! **有一天，我观看了一场魔术表演。魔术师以令人震惊的方式让一头大象消失了。每个人都感到震惊，不敢相信自己的眼睛。这真是一个惊人的壮举！**

> A lost puppy wandered astray in the big city. It couldn\'t find its way home. A kind girl saw it and helped the puppy get back on the right path. \'Astray\' means off the correct path or lost. **一只迷路的小狗在大城市里走失了。它找不到回家的路。一个善良的女孩看到了，帮助小狗回到了正确的道路上。\'astray\'意思是偏离正确的道路或迷路。**

> An astronaut was lost in space. He felt scared but remembered his training. With courage, he fixed the problem and returned safely. \'Astronaut\' means a person who travels in space. **一位宇航员在太空中迷失了。他感到害怕，但想起了自己的训练。凭借勇气，他解决了问题并安全返回。\'astronaut\'意思是在太空旅行的人。**

> One night, a little boy looked up at the stars and wondered who studied them. His father told him it was astronomers. They use big telescopes to explore the mysteries of the universe. The boy then dreamt of becoming an astronomer one day. **一天晚上，一个小男孩抬头看着星星，好奇是谁在研究它们。他的父亲告诉他是天文学家。他们用大望远镜探索宇宙的奥秘。这个男孩于是梦想有一天能成为一名天文学家。**

> Astronaut Tom was studying the stars. The numbers and distances he found were so huge that he called them \'astronomical\'. It was like a mystery beyond imagination. **宇航员汤姆在研究星星。他发现的数字和距离大得惊人，他称之为'天文数字般的'。这就像一个超乎想象的谜团。**

> Astronaut Tom was always passionate about the sky. One day, he decided to study the mysteries of the universe. That\'s how he fell in love with astronomy, exploring stars and planets. **宇航员汤姆一直对天空充满热情。有一天，他决定研究宇宙的奥秘。就这样，他爱上了天文学，探索着恒星和行星。**

> Imagine a person who loves looking at the stars and is always curious about their secrets. This person studies the physics of stars and space, and we call them an astrophysicist. They explore how stars are born, live, and die. **想象有一个人，喜欢仰望星空，总是对星星的秘密充满好奇。这个人研究星星和太空的物理学，我们称其为天体物理学家。他们探索星星如何诞生、存在和消亡。**

> A spy needed to be astute. One day, while on a mission, he noticed tiny details others missed and avoided traps. His astute mind helped him complete the task and stay safe. **一名间谍需要机敏。有一天，在执行任务时，他注意到了别人忽略的微小细节，避开了陷阱。他机敏的头脑帮助他完成了任务并保证了安全。**

> A poor man was constantly pursued and in great danger. Finally, he found a safe place called \'asylum\'. Here, he was protected from harm and could live peacefully. **一个可怜的人不断被追捕，处于极大的危险之中。最后，他找到了一个叫做'庇护所'的安全之地。在这里，他受到保护免受伤害，可以平静地生活。**

> A prince wanted a symmetrical castle, but the evil witch made it asymmetrical. The prince was very angry. He decided to find a way to restore its symmetry. Remember, asymmetrical means not having the same shape or size on both sides. **一位王子想要一座对称的城堡，但邪恶的女巫把它变成了不对称的。王子非常生气。他决定想办法恢复其对称性。记住，asymmetrical 意思是两边形状或大小不同。**

> Once upon a time, there was a strange building. Its left side was tall and grand, but the right side was short and plain. This odd layout showed asymmetry. It was not balanced or symmetrical at all. **从前，有一座奇怪的建筑。它的左边高大宏伟，而右边又矮又普通。这种奇怪的布局展现出了不对称性。它一点也不平衡或对称。**

> A little mouse is always at the corner of the room. It hides there and peeks out at night. One day, a cat comes and the mouse is scared. But it\'s still at that corner. **一只小老鼠总是在房间的角落。它晚上躲在那里向外偷看。有一天，一只猫来了，老鼠很害怕。但它仍然在那个角落。**

> One day, a man named Tom was asked if he believed in God. Tom firmly said no and claimed he was an atheist. He believed science could explain everything and didn\'t need a divine power. People were surprised by his strong stance. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的人被问到是否相信上帝。汤姆坚决地说不，并宣称自己是无神论者。他认为科学可以解释一切，不需要神的力量。人们对他坚定的立场感到惊讶。**

> There was once a young person named Tom. He loved sports and trained hard every day. Finally, he became a great athlete and won many medals. His story inspired others to pursue their dreams. **从前有个叫汤姆的年轻人。他热爱运动，每天刻苦训练。最终，他成为了一名出色的运动员，赢得了许多奖牌。他的故事激励着其他人去追求梦想。**

> Once upon a time, there was an athletic boy. He loved running and jumping. Every day, he trained hard and participated in various sports competitions. His athletic skills made him a star in the school. **从前，有一个运动能力很强的男孩。他喜欢跑和跳。每天，他都刻苦训练并参加各种体育比赛。他的运动天赋使他成为学校里的明星。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young man who loved sports. His amazing performance in various games showed his outstanding athleticism. People were impressed by his strength, speed and skills. **从前，有一个年轻人热爱运动。他在各种比赛中的出色表现展现了他卓越的运动能力。人们都对他的力量、速度和技巧印象深刻。**

> Once upon a time, a group of friends loved participating in various sports. They ran, jumped, and threw. This group was called the \'athletics team\'. Their passion for these activities made them stand out. **从前，有一群朋友喜欢参加各种体育项目。他们跑步、跳跃和投掷。这个群体被称为"田径队"。他们对这些活动的热情使他们脱颖而出。**
> 从前有个勇敢的探险家，他在世界各地旅行，绘制了很多地图。人们称他为地图之王，就像 Atlas（阿特拉斯）一样撑起了地图的世界。后来，atlas 就代表了地图集。 **从前有个勇敢的探险家，他绘制很多地图，被称为地图之王，后来atlas代表地图集。**

> Imagine you are in a big balloon floating high in the sky. You feel the gentle wind and look around. This space around you with the wind and the feeling of being up high is the \'atmosphere\'. **想象一下你在一个大大的气球中高高地飘浮在空中。你感受着微风并环顾四周。你周围的这个有着微风和高高在上感觉的空间就是"大气；氛围"。**

> A brave astronaut was exploring the universe. When looking at the Earth from space, he was amazed by the atmospheric layers. The beautiful colors and the mystery made him fall in love with this atmospheric view. **一位勇敢的宇航员正在探索宇宙。当从太空看向地球时，他对大气层感到惊叹。美丽的色彩和神秘让他爱上了这大气的景象。**

> Imagine a tiny world where the smallest particle is an atom. It\'s like a super-tiny building block that everything is made of. One atom is so small that you need a super microscope to see it. It\'s the basic unit of matter! **想象一个微小的世界，其中最小的粒子是原子。它就像一个超级小的积木，所有东西都是由它组成的。一个原子非常小，你需要超级显微镜才能看到它。它是物质的基本单位！**

> Imagine a tiny world where every particle is like a secret agent. These agents work together in an \'atomic\' way. One day, a scientist discovers their hidden patterns. The word \'atomic\' refers to these tiny and powerful building blocks of matter. **想象一个微小的世界，每个粒子都像一个特工。这些特工以"原子的"方式共同工作。有一天，一位科学家发现了它们隐藏的模式。\'atomic\'这个词指的就是这些微小而强大的物质组成部分。**

> A man felt deep guilt for his mistakes. To find peace, he spent years doing good deeds and helping others. His efforts were his atonement. Finally, he was forgiven and felt relieved. **一个男人为自己的错误深感内疚。为了寻求平静，他花了数年做好事和帮助他人。他的这些努力就是他的赎罪。最终，他得到了原谅，感到如释重负。**

> A brave mouse climbed atop a big cake. It was so high that it could see everything around. \'Atop\' means on top of something, just like the mouse on the cake. **一只勇敢的老鼠爬到了一个大蛋糕的顶上。它爬得如此之高以至于能看到周围的一切。\'atop\'意思是在某物的顶部，就像老鼠在蛋糕上一样。**
> 想象你走进一座古老的城堡，首先映入眼帘的是一个宽敞明亮的大厅，这个大厅就是 \'atrium\' 。它有着高高的天花板和精美的装饰，人们在这里交流、休息。记住这个城堡的大厅，就能记住 \'atrium\' 这个单词啦。 **想象你走进一座城堡，最先看到的那个宽敞大厅就是\'心房；中庭\'的意思，记住这个场景就能记住\' atrium\'这个单词。**

> A group of evil villains committed many bad deeds. Their actions were full of atrocities, like burning houses and killing innocent people. People were very angry and decided to stop these atrocities. **一群邪恶的坏人做了很多坏事。他们的行为充满了残暴，比如烧房子和杀害无辜的人。人们非常生气，决定制止这些残暴行为。**

> A thief wanted to attach a precious gem to his bag secretly. But he was caught because the gem was too shiny and attracted attention. \'Attach\' means to fasten or join something to something else. **一个小偷想偷偷地把一颗珍贵的宝石附着在他的包上。但他被抓住了，因为宝石太闪亮，引起了注意。\'attach\'意思是把某物系在、附在或连接在其他东西上。**

> A little ant was attached to a big leaf and couldn\'t get away. It struggled hard but remained attached. Finally, a kind bird helped it and the ant was free. Remember, \'attached\' means fastened or joined to something. **一只小蚂蚁被附着在一片大叶子上，无法脱身。它拼命挣扎但仍被附着着。最后，一只善良的鸟帮助了它，蚂蚁自由了。记住，\'attached\'意思是附属于，系于。**

> A young artist had a strong attachment to his paintbrush. It was not just a tool but a key to his creative world. With this attachment, he could express all his emotions and ideas on the canvas. **一位年轻的艺术家对他的画笔有着强烈的依恋。它不仅仅是一个工具，更是他创意世界的关键。凭借这种依恋，他能够在画布上表达出所有的情感和想法。**

> In a dark forest, a brave knight was suddenly ATTACKED by a fierce dragon. But the knight fought back bravely. Remember, \'attack\' means a sudden and forceful action against someone or something. **在一个黑暗的森林里，一位勇敢的骑士突然遭到了一只凶猛的龙的攻击。但是骑士勇敢地反击了。记住，'attack'意思是对某人或某物突然而有力的行动。**

> In a dark alley, a brave man was suddenly confronted by an attacker. The attacker was fierce and had a weapon, but the man remained calm and fought back. Remember, an attacker is someone who tries to harm you. **在一个黑暗的小巷里，一个勇敢的人突然遭遇了一个攻击者。攻击者很凶猛并且拿着武器，但这个人保持冷静并进行了反击。记住，attacker 就是试图伤害你的人。**

> A brave adventurer was determined to attain the peak of the highest mountain. Despite many difficulties, he never gave up. Finally, through his persistence and hard work, he reached the summit and attained his goal. **一位勇敢的冒险家决心要到达最高山峰的山顶。尽管困难重重，但他从未放弃。最终，通过他的坚持和努力，他到达了山顶，实现了目标。**

> A young athlete dreamed of attaining the championship. He trained hard every day. With his perseverance and effort, the victory became attainable. Finally, he achieved his goal and stood on the podium. **一位年轻的运动员梦想获得冠军。他每天刻苦训练。凭借他的毅力和努力，胜利变得可实现。最终，他达成了目标，站在了领奖台上。**

> A young athlete aimed for the attainment of the championship medal. He trained hard every day, facing difficulties but never giving up. Finally, his efforts led to the attainment of his goal. **一位年轻的运动员志在获得冠军奖牌。他每天刻苦训练，面对困难从不放弃。最终，他的努力让他达成了目标。**

> A brave adventurer decided to attempt climbing the highest mountain. Despite the difficulties and risks, he was determined. It was a bold attempt that would test his limits. **一位勇敢的冒险家决定尝试攀登最高的山峰。尽管困难重重且充满风险，他意志坚定。这是一次大胆的尝试，将考验他的极限。**
> 想象一下，你是一位重要的国王，每次宫廷举行盛大活动，你都必须'attend'（出席）。因为你的出现很关键，大家都期待着你的到来。所以，attend 就是出席、参加的意思。 **想象一下，你是一位重要的国王，每次宫廷举行盛大活动，你都必须'出席、参加'。因为你的出现很关键，大家都期待着你的到来。所以，attend 就是出席、参加的意思。**

> A king was very concerned about the attendance of his subjects at his court. He kept a record to see who came regularly. The act of coming and being present was called \'attendance\'. **一位国王非常在意他的臣民在宫廷的出席情况。他做记录查看谁经常来。来并在场的这种行为就被称为"出席；到场；出勤"。**
> 在一个盛大的宴会上，有一位尽职尽责的 attendant（服务员）。他时刻关注着客人的需求，不停地穿梭在餐桌间，为大家提供优质服务，确保宴会顺利进行。 **在一个盛大的宴会上，有一位尽职尽责的服务员。他时刻关注着客人的需求，不停地穿梭在餐桌间，为大家提供优质服务，确保宴会顺利进行。**

> At a grand conference, many people came. Among them, there was a person named Lily. Lily was an attendee. She attentively listened to every speaker and actively participated in discussions. **在一场盛大的会议上，来了很多人。其中有一个叫莉莉的人。莉莉是一名出席者。她专心地聆听每一位演讲者，并积极参与讨论。**

> One day, a little monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a bird chirped loudly to get its attention. The monkey stopped and looked up, realizing that something important might be happening. Attention means to focus and notice. **一天，一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。突然，一只鸟大声鸣叫以引起它的注意。猴子停了下来并抬头看，意识到可能有重要的事情发生。Attention 意思是专注和留意。**

> A king was very ill. His servants were not attentive and didn\'t care about him. But one young servant was always attentive, listening carefully to the king\'s needs. Finally, the king recovered and rewarded the attentive servant. **一位国王病得很重。他的仆人们都不专心，不关心他。但有一个年轻的仆人总是很专注，仔细倾听国王的需求。最后，国王康复了并奖赏了这位专注的仆人。**

> One day, Tom was listening to a lecture attentively. The speaker noticed his focused eyes and nodding head. Tom\'s attentively listening helped him understand everything clearly. **有一天，汤姆正在专心地听讲座。演讲者注意到他专注的眼神和不停点头。汤姆专心地倾听帮助他清楚地理解了一切。**

> A brave knight was sent to a distant land. When he returned, he attested to the king that the journey was full of challenges and adventures. His words proved the truth of his experiences, and the king believed him. **一位勇敢的骑士被派往遥远的地方。当他回来时，他向国王证实这次旅程充满了挑战和冒险。他的话证明了他经历的真实性，国王相信了他。**

> A thief sneaked into an old house and climbed to the attic. There, he found many dusty treasures. But suddenly, the owner came back. The thief had to hide quickly. Remember, attic is the top room of a house. **一个小偷潜入一座老房子，爬上了阁楼。在那里，他发现了许多布满灰尘的宝藏。但突然，主人回来了。小偷不得不赶紧藏起来。记住，attic 就是房子的顶楼房间。**

> A princess was always worried about her attire for the ball. One day, she realized that it\'s not just the clothes but the confidence within that makes the true attire. So, she went to the ball with a smile and charmed everyone. **一位公主总是为参加舞会的服装（attire）而烦恼。有一天，她意识到真正的服装不只是衣服，而是内心的自信。于是，她微笑着去参加舞会，迷倒了所有人。**

> A little ant was always positive. No matter what difficulties it faced, it kept a good attitude. Its friends asked how it did that. The ant said: \'Just think positively!\' So, remember, \'attitude\' is how we think and feel. **一只小蚂蚁总是很积极。无论遇到什么困难，它都保持良好的态度。它的朋友问它是怎么做到的。蚂蚁说：'只要积极思考！'所以，记住，'attitude'就是我们的想法和感受。**

> A team was working on a project. One member had an attitudinal problem, always being negative and uncooperative. But when they talked to him, he changed and the team succeeded. Attitudinal means relating to attitudes. **一个团队正在做一个项目。其中一名成员有态度方面的问题，总是消极且不合作。但当他们和他谈话后，他改变了，团队成功了。Attitudinal 意思是与态度有关的。**

> A young man dreamed of becoming an attorney. He studied hard, faced many challenges, and finally won his first big case. His determination made him an excellent attorney. **一个年轻人梦想成为一名律师。他努力学习，面对许多挑战，最终赢得了他的第一个大案子。他的决心使他成为一名出色的律师。**

> A beautiful butterfly with colorful wings attracts many children in the garden. They all run towards it, drawn by its charm. Just like this, \'attract\' means to draw someone or something towards you. **一只拥有彩色翅膀的美丽蝴蝶在花园里吸引了许多孩子。他们都朝它跑去，被它的魅力所吸引。就像这样，'attract'意思是吸引某人或某物朝向你。**

> A young man was traveling. When he saw a beautiful garden, he felt a strong attraction. The colorful flowers and peaceful atmosphere made him want to stay. This feeling of being drawn to something wonderful is what \'attraction\' means. **一个年轻人在旅行。当他看到一个美丽的花园时，他感受到了强烈的吸引力。五颜六色的花朵和宁静的氛围让他想要留下来。这种被美好事物吸引的感觉就是\'吸引力\'的意思。**

> A prince was looking for a partner. Among many girls, one stood out. She had a charming smile and a kind heart. The prince found her extremely attractive and chose her. Attractive means having the power to draw people by being appealing and charming. **一位王子正在寻找伴侣。在众多女孩中，有一位脱颖而出。她有着迷人的微笑和善良的心。王子觉得她极具吸引力，于是选择了她。Attractive 意思是有吸引人的魅力，迷人的。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. The success was attributable to his sharp mind. He could attribute every clue correctly and finally caught the criminal. **一位侦探正在解决一个谜团。成功归因于他敏锐的头脑。他能够正确地归因于每一条线索，最终抓住了罪犯。**

> A brave knight was known for his excellent swordsmanship. People attribute his success to his daily practice. One day, a young warrior asked him the secret, and the knight said, \'It\'s the attribute of hard work.\' **一位勇敢的骑士以其精湛的剑术而闻名。人们将他的成功归因于他的日常练习。有一天，一位年轻的战士问他秘诀，骑士说：'这是努力的属性。'**

> A detective was solving a mystery. The success was due to the accurate attribution of clues. He carefully linked each piece of evidence to find the criminal. Attribution here means assigning or crediting something to a particular cause or source. **一位侦探正在破解一个谜团。成功得益于对线索的准确归因。他仔细地将每一条证据联系起来以找到罪犯。这里的attribution意思是把某事归因于某一特定原因或来源。**
> 想象一个战场，士兵们不断受伤和疲惫。敌人没有大规模进攻，而是通过持续的小冲突让我方兵力逐渐减少。这种逐渐的、持续的消耗就是\'attrition\'，就像士兵们的精力和人数慢慢被消磨掉。 **想象在战场中，通过持续小冲突使兵力逐渐减少的消耗情况来理解\'attrition\'，意思是消耗，磨损。**

> A musician was struggling to attune his instrument. But with patience and focus, he finally managed to attune it perfectly, creating beautiful music. It means to make something in harmony or adjust it precisely. **一位音乐家努力为他的乐器调音。但凭借耐心和专注，他最终完美地调好音，创作出了美妙的音乐。这个词意思是使协调或精确调整。**

> A young artist was always seen as atypical. He didn\'t follow the usual painting styles. Instead, he created unique works that surprised everyone. \'Atypical\' means not typical or usual. **一位年轻的艺术家总是被视为与众不同。他不遵循通常的绘画风格。相反，他创作了令所有人惊讶的独特作品。\'atypical\'意思是不典型的；非寻常的。**

> A girl named Auburn had beautiful hair of a special color. It was a mix of brown and red, just like the meaning of the word \'auburn\'. People always praised her unique and charming auburn hair. **一个叫奥本的女孩有着漂亮的特殊发色。它是棕色和红色的混合，就像'auburn'这个词的意思。人们总是称赞她独特迷人的赤褐色头发。**

> A poor farmer needed money, so he decided to hold an auction. He put his precious horse up for sale. Many people came and bid. Finally, the horse was sold at a good price. The auction was a success! **一个贫穷的农民需要钱，所以他决定举行一场拍卖会。他把他珍贵的马拿来出售。许多人前来竞拍。最后，这匹马以一个好价钱售出。这次拍卖会很成功！**

> One day, at a lively market, an auctioneer stood on a stage, shouting loudly and skillfully conducting the auction. People gathered around, excitedly waiting for their chance to bid. The auctioneer\'s enthusiasm made the event a huge success. **有一天，在一个热闹的市场，一位拍卖师站在舞台上，大声喊叫着，熟练地主持拍卖。人们围聚在周围，兴奋地等待着出价的机会。拍卖师的热情使这次活动取得了巨大成功。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. He showed audacious courage when facing a fierce dragon. Without fear, he charged forward, determined to succeed. His audacious act made him a hero. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项任务。当面对凶猛的巨龙时，他展现出了大胆无畏的勇气。他毫不畏惧地向前冲，决心要取得成功。他的大胆行为使他成为了英雄。**

> A group of friends was lost in a forest. They had no map but found an audio device. With its help, they heard directions and safely got out. \'Audio\' means related to sound or hearing. **一群朋友在森林里迷路了。他们没有地图，但找到了一个音频设备。在它的帮助下，他们听到了指示，安全地走了出来。\'audio\'意思是与声音或听觉有关。**

> A young singer went to an audition. She was very nervous but sang beautifully. The judges were impressed. Finally, she got the chance to show her talent on a big stage. > 想象一下，有一个神秘的 auditor ，他像一个侦探，悄悄潜入公司的财务室，仔细审查每一笔账目，寻找任何可能的错误和猫腻，以确保财务的公正和准确。 **想象有一个审计员，像侦探一样潜入公司财务室审查账目，确保财务公正准确。**

> 想象一个国王的财富原本就很多，但他还想让财富进一步增加。于是他不断收集珍贵的宝石和黄金来 augment 自己的财富。最终，他的财富变得更加庞大。 **想象一位国王想增加财富，通过收集宝石和黄金来让财富增多，以此来辅助记忆 augment 这个表示'增加、扩大'的单词。**

> One day, I was lost in the street. A kind woman helped me find my way home. Later, I learned she was my aunt. She always shows love and care just like a warm sun. **有一天，我在街上迷路了。一位善良的女士帮我找到了回家的路。后来，我得知她是我的阿姨。她总是像温暖的太阳一样展现出爱和关怀。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist entered a forest. The moment he stepped in, he felt a special atmosphere. It was like an \'aura\' of mystery and peace. This feeling made him create a wonderful painting. **从前，一位年轻的艺术家走进一片森林。他刚踏入的那一刻，就感受到了一种特殊的氛围。这就像是神秘与平静的"光环"。这种感觉让他创作了一幅精彩的画作。**

> A mouse was in a big cave. It heard strange sounds, but couldn\'t see anything. The sounds were aural clues. Later, it found the source - a small waterfall. Aural means related to the sense of hearing. **一只老鼠在一个大洞穴里。它听到了奇怪的声音，但什么也看不见。这些声音是听觉线索。后来，它找到了源头------一个小瀑布。aural 意思是与听觉有关的。**

> A young artist was struggling to showcase his work. But under the auspice of a famous art critic, his paintings gained recognition. The critic\'s support was like a guiding light. **一位年轻的艺术家努力展示自己的作品。但在一位著名艺术评论家的支持下，他的画作获得了认可。评论家的支持就像一盏指路明灯。**

> In a small village, people faced austerity. There was no extra food or fun. They had to be very careful with resources. But this made them strong and learn to value every little thing. > A writer was struggling to finish a great book. > A young writer dreams of having an authorial voice that stands out. One day, she discovers a magical pen that grants her the unique authorial style she desires. With it, her works become famous. **一位年轻的作家梦想拥有独特的作者风格。有一天，她发现了一支神奇的笔，赋予了她渴望的独特的作者风格。凭借此，她的作品出名了。**
> 想象一个国王，他对臣民非常严厉，总是独断专行，要求绝对的服从，不许有任何异议。这个国王就是典型的 authoritarian 式的人物，即专制独裁的。 **想象一个专制独裁的国王来辅助记忆'authoritarian'这个单词，意思是专制独裁的**

> Once upon a time, in a land ruled by a strict leader, authoritarianism reigned. People had little freedom and had to follow every command. But some brave souls stood up and fought for democracy. > A king is always authoritative. He has the power to make decisions and everyone must follow. Just like the word \'authoritative\', meaning having the power and being commanding. **一位国王总是有权威的。他有权做决定，所有人都必须听从。就像单词\'authoritative\'，意思是有权力和权威性的。**

> A brave king was the authority of the kingdom. He made fair rules and everyone respected him. His authority kept the land peaceful and prosperous. **一位勇敢的国王是这个王国的权威。他制定公平的规则，每个人都尊敬他。他的权威使这片土地和平繁荣。**

> A king needed to give authorization for a new castle to be built. He signed a special paper, allowing the workers to start. Without this authorization, the castle could not be constructed. **一位国王需要给予建造新城堡的授权。他签署了一份特殊的文件，允许工人们开工。没有这个授权，城堡就无法建造。**

> A king needed to give permission for a new castle to be built. So, he authorized the architects to start the project. The word \'authorize\' means to give official permission or power. **一位国王需要批准建造一座新的城堡。于是，他授权建筑师们开始这个项目。单词\'authorize\'意思是给予官方许可或权力。**

> A king authorized his brave knight to lead the army. The knight felt honored and proud because the authorization meant trust and responsibility. With this power, he was ready to fight for the kingdom. **一位国王授权他勇敢的骑士领导军队。骑士感到荣幸和自豪，因为授权意味着信任和责任。有了这个权力，他准备为王国而战。**

> 想象一下，在未来世界，有一辆神奇的汽车叫\'Auto\'。它不需要人类驾驶，自己就能识别道路，智能地行驶。它是自动化的代表，为人们带来极大的便利。 **想象在未来，一辆叫'Auto'的神奇汽车无需人类驾驶，能自己识别道路并行驶，代表自动化，给人便利。**

> A famous singer was at a party. Many fans wanted something special. So, the singer used a pen to write his name on their notebooks. That was an autograph, a special signature given by a famous person. **一位著名歌手在一个聚会上。许多粉丝想要一些特别的东西。于是，歌手用笔在他们的笔记本上写下自己的名字。那就是签名，名人给出的特殊署名。**

> In the autumn, a little squirrel collects nuts for the winter. The leaves turn yellow and red, and fall gently. It\'s a beautiful and cool season. People enjoy apple-picking and admire the changing colors of nature. **在秋天，一只小松鼠为冬天收集坚果。树叶变黄变红，轻轻地飘落。这是一个美丽而凉爽的季节。人们享受摘苹果，并欣赏大自然色彩的变化。**
