> A lost traveler found himself in a strange forest. The confusing paths and unfamiliar sounds filled him with bewilderment. He had no idea which way to go and felt completely lost and confused. **一位迷路的旅行者发现自己身处一片陌生的森林。令人困惑的小路和陌生的声音使他满心迷茫。他不知道该走哪条路，感到完全迷失和困惑。**

> A brave astronaut was on a mission. He flew beyond the known planets and discovered a new world. \'Beyond\' here means farther than or outside the limits of. **一位勇敢的宇航员执行任务。他飞到了已知行星之外，发现了一个新世界。'beyond'在这里指的是在......之外或超出......的范围。**

> Once upon a time, a judge had a bias towards the rich. He always favored them in court. But in the end, he was punished for his unfair bias. Remember, bias means unfair preference. **从前，有个法官对富人有偏见。他在法庭上总是偏袒他们。但最后，他因这不公平的偏见受到了惩罚。记住，bias 意思是不公平的偏爱。**

> A judge was supposed to be fair, but this one was biased. He always favored the rich and powerful. People were angry because justice should be equal for all. Remember, biased means unfair and showing preference. **一位法官理应公正，但这位却是有偏见的。他总是偏袒有钱有势的人。人们很生气，因为正义应该对所有人平等。记住，biased 意思是不公平的、有偏袒的。**

> A young scholar was deeply attracted by ancient texts. One day, he found a mysterious book filled with Biblical stories. The tales were so fascinating that he never forgot the word \'biblical\'. **一位年轻的学者被古代文献深深吸引。有一天，他发现了一本充满圣经故事的神秘书籍。这些故事如此迷人，以至于他永远记住了'biblical'这个词。**
> 想象一下，一位学者在一个巨大的图书馆里，他面前有一堆堆的书籍。他的任务是整理这些书的目录，这个目录就叫 bibliography 。它记录了所有书籍的信息，就像一个知识的地图。 **想象一位学者在图书馆整理书籍目录来辅助记忆bibliography（参考书目；文献目录）这个单词，它就像知识地图。**
> 想象一下，有个大力士在展示他的肌肉。他骄傲地指着手臂上鼓起的两块肌肉说：'看，这就是我的 biceps！' 这两块肌肉让他力量无穷，能轻松举起重物。 **想象大力士展示手臂上的肱二头肌，并强调这就是'肱二头肌'，以辅助记忆这个单词**

> Two little rabbits were always bicker ing over a carrot in the garden. They kept arguing and fighting for it. Finally, they understood sharing is better. Remember, bicker means to quarrel or argue over small matters. **两只小兔子总是在花园里为一根胡萝卜而争吵。它们不停地争论和抢夺。最后，它们明白了分享更好。记住，bicker 意思是为小事争吵或争论。**

> One day, a little boy was very sad because he lost his bicycle. But then, with the help of kind neighbors, he found it. The bicycle had taken him to many wonderful places, and he promised to take good care of it. **一天，一个小男孩非常伤心，因为他弄丢了他的自行车。但随后，在好心邻居的帮助下，他找到了。这辆自行车曾带他去了很多很棒的地方，他承诺会好好照顾它。**

> A little girl was at an auction. She raised her hand and made a bid for a beautiful doll. But someone else made a higher bid. Finally, she saved enough money and won the bid for the doll she loved. **一个小女孩在拍卖会上。她举手为一个漂亮的娃娃出价。但有人出了更高的价。最后，她攒够了钱，成功中标得到了她心爱的娃娃。**

> In an auction, a mysterious person kept raising the price. Everyone wondered who this determined bidder was. Finally, it was revealed that it was a collector passionate about the item up for bid. **在一场拍卖会上，一个神秘的人不断提高价格。大家都好奇这个坚决的出价者是谁。最后发现，原来是一位热衷于竞拍物品的收藏家。**

> In an ancient market, merchants were engaged in intense bidding for rare treasures. Each raised their hands and shouted prices. The bidding process was full of excitement and competition. **在一个古老的市场里，商人们为了稀有的珍宝激烈地竞价。每个人都举手并喊出价格。这个竞价的过程充满了兴奋和竞争。**

> A little mouse was in a big cave. It needed to bide its time to avoid the big bad cat. So it hid quietly and patiently, waiting for the right moment to run away. **一只小老鼠在一个大洞穴里。它需要等待时机来躲避那只大坏猫。所以它安静且耐心地躲藏着，等待合适的时机逃跑。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little bear. One day, it saw a BIG tree. It was so tall and wide that the little bear was amazed. \'Wow, this is a really BIG one!\' the bear said. **从前，有一只小熊。有一天，它看到了一棵大树。这棵树又高又大，小熊感到很惊讶。'哇，这棵树真大！'小熊说道。**

> A man always judged others based on their race and religion. People called him a bigot. He refused to change and kept showing his narrow-mindedness. Remember, a bigot is someone intolerant and prejudiced. **有一个男人总是根据他人的种族和宗教来评判他们。人们称他为偏执的人。他拒绝改变，一直表现出他的狭隘。记住，bigot 就是指心胸狭隘、偏执的人。**

> A king was known for his bigotry. He refused to listen to any new ideas and always judged people based on their appearance. This made his kingdom unhappy. Remember, bigotry means stubborn and narrow-minded intolerance. **一位国王以他的偏执而闻名。他拒绝听取任何新想法，总是根据外表评判人。这让他的王国不快乐。记住，bigotry 意思是顽固且狭隘的偏执，不容忍。**

> One day, a little boy named Tom was very sad because his old bike was broken. But his father fixed it and Tom rode the bike happily again. The bike brought joy to Tom. **一天，一个叫汤姆的小男孩非常伤心，因为他的旧自行车坏了。但是他的父亲修好了它，汤姆又开心地骑上了自行车。这辆自行车给汤姆带来了快乐。**

> One day, a brave biker was riding on a mountain road. Suddenly, a big stone blocked the way. But the biker didn\'t give up and managed to jump over it. His determination made him a true biker. **有一天，一位勇敢的摩托车骑手正在山路上骑行。突然，一块大石头挡住了去路。但这位骑手没有放弃，成功地跃过了它。他的决心使他成为了一名真正的骑手。**

> A girl went to the beach and wore a beautiful bikini. She felt so confident and happy. The bikini made her stand out among the crowd. Everyone admired her style. **一个女孩去海滩并穿上了漂亮的比基尼。她感到非常自信和开心。比基尼让她在人群中脱颖而出。每个人都称赞她的风格。**
> Two countries were discussing trade. They wanted an agreement that was fair on both sides. This fair and two-sided deal was called \'bilateral\'. **两个国家正在讨论贸易。他们想要一个对双方都公平的协议。这种公平且双边的交易被称为'双边的'。**

> A monster had too much bile in its body. It made the monster very angry and aggressive. People were scared of its bad temper. Remember, bile means anger or bad mood. **一只怪物体内有太多的胆汁。这让怪物非常生气和具有攻击性。人们都害怕它的坏脾气。记住，bile 意思是愤怒或坏心情。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She could speak both English and French fluently. People called her bilingual Lily because she had the amazing ability to communicate well in two languages. **从前，有个叫莉莉的女孩。她能流利地说英语和法语。人们称她为双语莉莉，因为她有能用两种语言很好交流的惊人能力。**

> A bird named Bill was always looking for food. One day, it found a bill of a big leaf, thinking it was a worm. But when it got closer, it realized its mistake. Poor Bill! **一只叫比尔的鸟总是在寻找食物。有一天，它发现了一张大大的树叶的边缘，以为是条虫子。但当它靠近时，才意识到自己错了。可怜的比尔！**

> A musician dreamt of seeing his song on a big billboard. He worked hard, and finally, his song was displayed on the most famous billboard in the city. Everyone could see it and loved it. **一位音乐家梦想着能在一块大广告牌上看到他的歌曲。他努力工作，最终，他的歌曲出现在了城市里最有名的广告牌上。每个人都能看到并且喜欢。**

> One day, Tom went to a club and saw some people playing billiards. The colorful balls moved fast on the table. He was so amazed and decided to learn this fun game. **有一天，汤姆去了一个俱乐部，看到一些人在打台球。彩色的球在桌上快速移动。他非常惊讶，并决定学习这个有趣的游戏。**

> A company\'s billing system was in chaos. Bills were sent wrongly. But a smart clerk fixed it. Now the billing is accurate and everyone is happy. Remember, \'billing\' is about the process of sending out bills. **一家公司的计费系统陷入混乱。账单被错误发送。但一位聪明的职员解决了它。现在计费准确，每个人都很开心。记住，'billing'就是发送账单的过程。**
> 想象一个超级富豪，他拥有无数的财富，多到什么程度呢？他的钱可以堆满一整个岛屿。别人问他有多少，他骄傲地说：我有 billion 美元！意思就是十亿啊，这是多么巨大的数字。 **想象一个超级富豪拥有十亿美元的故事来辅助记忆 billion（十亿）这个单词**

> A poor boy named Tom always dreamed of becoming a billionaire. Through years of hard work and smart decisions, he finally achieved it. Now he has countless wealth and lives a happy life. **一个叫汤姆的穷小子一直梦想成为亿万富翁。经过多年的努力工作和明智决策，他终于做到了。现在他拥有数不清的财富，过着幸福的生活。**

> A sailor was on the ship. Suddenly, big waves billowed and the ship rocked hard. The sailor held on tightly, remembering that \'billow\' means the large movement of waves. **一位水手在船上。突然，大浪翻腾，船剧烈摇晃。水手紧紧抓住，记住了'billow'是指波浪的大幅运动。**
> 想象一个计算机世界，只有 0 和 1 两种状态。就像一个开关，要么开（1）要么关（0），这就是 binary 所代表的'二进制'。在这个世界里，一切复杂的信息都由 0 和 1 的组合来表达。 **想象计算机世界中只有 0 和 1 两种状态来理解'二进制'这个单词**

> A brave knight was trying to bind the fierce dragon with a magical rope. But the dragon struggled hard. Finally, the knight succeeded and bound the dragon tightly. Now the dragon couldn\'t move freely. **一位勇敢的骑士试图用一根神奇的绳子绑住凶猛的龙。但龙拼命挣扎。最后，骑士成功了，紧紧地绑住了龙。现在龙无法自由移动了。**

> A young artist was looking for a binder to keep her sketches together. She searched everywhere and finally found one in a hidden corner of the store. The binder saved her precious artworks. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻找一个活页夹来把她的草图整理在一起。她到处寻找，终于在商店的一个角落里找到了一个。这个活页夹保存了她珍贵的艺术作品。**

> A young wizard was crafting a magic book. The binding of the book was very special, as it held powerful spells. Without a strong binding, the pages would scatter. So, \'binding\' means something that holds things together tightly. **一位年轻的巫师正在制作一本魔法书。这本书的装订非常特别，因为它承载着强大的法术。没有牢固的装订，书页就会散开。所以，\'binding\' 意思是将事物紧紧固定在一起的东西。**

> There was a man named Tom. He always had a tendency to binge on chocolates whenever he was stressed. One day, he ate so many chocolates in one go that he felt sick. \'Binge\' means to indulge in something excessively. **有个叫汤姆的人。每当他感到有压力时，总是会狂吃巧克力。有一天，他一下子吃了好多巧克力，结果感到不舒服。\'binge\'意思是过度沉溺于某事。**
> 有一天，小明参加一个猜谜游戏。他绞尽脑汁，终于猜对了最后一题，主持人兴奋地大喊\'Bingo\'！小明这才明白，\'Bingo\'就是表示答对、猜中时的欢呼。 **有一天，小明参加猜谜游戏，猜对最后一题后主持人喊\'Bingo\'，小明明白\'Bingo\'是答对、猜中时的欢呼。**

> One day, while hiking in the mountains, I forgot my binoculars. But a kind stranger lent me his. Through the binoculars, I saw beautiful birds and distant peaks clearly. Binoculars helped me enjoy the wonderful view. **有一天，在山里徒步时，我忘带了双筒望远镜。但一位好心的陌生人把他的借给了我。通过双筒望远镜，我清晰地看到了美丽的鸟儿和远处的山峰。双筒望远镜帮助我欣赏到了美妙的景色。**

> A scientist was working in a lab, studying the biochemical reactions. He mixed two substances and observed a colorful change. He realized that understanding biochemical processes is like unlocking the secrets of life. **一位科学家在实验室工作，研究生化反应。他混合了两种物质，观察到了多彩的变化。他意识到理解生化过程就像解开生命的秘密。**
> 想象一下，有个超级科学家，他在实验室里研究生物（bio）和化学（chemistry）之间的奇妙关系，通过各种实验和观察来揭示生命的化学秘密，这就是 biochemistry（生物化学）的世界。 **想象有个科学家在研究生物和化学之间的关系来揭示生命的化学秘密，这就是'生物化学'**

> A biographer was like a detective. He spent days and nights digging into someone\'s life, collecting every detail. Just like piecing together a puzzle, he wrote a complete story of that person. **一位传记作家就像一个侦探。他日夜不停地挖掘某人的生活，收集每一个细节。就像拼凑拼图一样，他写出了那个人的完整故事。**

> A famous writer was working on a biographical book. He spent days interviewing the subject\'s friends and family. Through these efforts, he could paint a vivid and true picture of the person\'s life. Remember, \'biographical\' is about life stories! **一位著名的作家正在写一本传记。他花了好几天时间采访主人公的朋友和家人。通过这些努力，他能够描绘出这个人生动真实的一生。记住，\'biographical\' 是关于生平故事的！**

> A famous writer was working on his biography. He spent days recalling his life experiences. From childhood adventures to achieving success, every detail was important. Finally, the biography became a bestseller, showing his amazing life journey. **一位著名作家正在创作他的传记。他花了好些天回忆自己的人生经历。从童年的冒险到取得成功，每个细节都很重要。最终，这本传记成了畅销书，展示了他精彩的人生旅程。**

> A scientist was studying the biological processes of a rare plant. He discovered amazing facts about how it grows and reproduces. Remember, \'biological\' is all about life and living things, like this plant\'s processes. **一位科学家正在研究一种稀有植物的生物过程。他发现了有关其生长和繁殖的惊人事实。记住，'biological'就是关于生命和生物的，就像这株植物的过程。**

> A scientist was studying a rare plant. He found that it grew biologically in a very special way. It needed specific conditions to survive. This discovery was amazing! **一位科学家正在研究一种稀有植物。他发现它以一种非常特殊的生物方式生长。它需要特定的条件才能存活。这个发现太令人惊奇了！**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a forest. A kind biologist came and used his knowledge to help her find the way out. The biologist knew all about plants and animals. So, he could lead them safely. **有一天，一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。一位善良的生物学家来了，运用他的知识帮助她找到了出路。这位生物学家知晓所有关于动植物的知识。所以，他能够带领他们安全离开。**

> One day, a little scientist was very excited because he was going to explore the world of BIOLOGY. He wanted to know how living things grow and change. Biology is like a big mystery box waiting for him to open. **有一天，一位小科学家非常兴奋，因为他要去探索生物学的世界。他想知道生物是如何生长和变化的。生物学就像一个等着他去打开的大神秘盒子。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的森林里，有无数的生物，从微小的细菌到高大的树木。这些生物的总体质量和能量就是\'biomass\'。它就像森林的生命总量，代表着大自然的丰富与活力。 **想象在森林中，生物的总体质量和能量就是\'生物质\'。**

> A doctor needed to know what was wrong with a patient\'s mysterious tumor. So, they took a biopsy - a small sample of the tissue. It was like a detective mission to find the truth hidden inside the body. **一位医生需要弄清楚患者神秘肿瘤的问题所在。于是，他们进行了活检------取了一小部分组织样本。这就像是一场寻找隐藏在身体内真相的侦探任务。**

> Imagine a huge bubble protecting all living things on Earth. This bubble is the biosphere. It includes land, water, and air where plants, animals, and humans exist and interact. Just like a magical shield for life! **想象一个巨大的泡泡保护着地球上所有的生物。这个泡泡就是生物圈。它包括陆地、水和空气，植物、动物和人类在其中生存和相互作用。就像一个生命的神奇护盾！**

> A scientist named Tom was passionate about combining biology and technology. He spent years in his lab, working on amazing projects. Finally, he made a breakthrough in biotechnology, making the world a better place. **一位名叫汤姆的科学家热衷于将生物学和技术相结合。他在实验室里花了数年时间，从事着令人惊叹的项目。最终，他在生物技术方面取得了突破，让世界变得更美好。**

> In a kingdom, two political groups always fought. But one day, for the people\'s benefit, they decided to work together. This cooperative effort was called bipartisan. It means involving cooperation between two major political parties. **在一个王国里，两个政治团体总是争斗。但有一天，为了人民的利益，他们决定合作。这种合作的努力被称为两党合作。这个词意味着涉及两个主要政党之间的合作。**

> A person was struggling with mood swings. One day, a doctor told him he had bipolar disorder. It means having two extreme moods, like extreme happiness and extreme sadness. Now he understood his condition better. **一个人一直被情绪波动所困扰。有一天，医生告诉他患有双相情感障碍。这意味着有两种极端的情绪，像极度快乐和极度悲伤。现在他更了解自己的状况了。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. She was scared until she saw a birch tree. The white bark of the birch seemed to guide her home. Remember, \'birch\' is like a guiding light in the dark forest. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她很害怕，直到她看到一棵白桦树。白桦树白色的树皮似乎指引她回家。记住，\'birch\'（白桦树）就像是黑暗森林里的指路明灯。**

> One sunny day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a beautiful bird flew by. It had colorful feathers and sang a sweet song. The boy was so amazed and wanted to be as free as the bird. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，一只漂亮的鸟飞过。它有着五彩的羽毛，唱着甜美的歌。男孩十分惊奇，渴望能像这只鸟一样自由。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in the garden. Suddenly, a cute bird flew over and landed on a branch. The girl called it a birdie and was very happy to see such a lovely creature. **有一天，一个小女孩在花园里玩耍。突然，一只可爱的鸟飞过来并落在一根树枝上。女孩称它为小鸟儿，并非常高兴能看到这么可爱的生物。**

> A baby was coming into the world. There was excitement and joy. The moment the baby was born was called \'birth\'. It\'s a start of a new life, full of possibilities. **一个宝宝即将来到这个世界。充满了兴奋和喜悦。宝宝出生的那一刻被称为"birth"。这是一个新生命的开始，充满了可能性。**

> One day, Tom was very excited because it was his birthday. His friends came with gifts and a big cake. They sang and danced to celebrate. Tom felt so happy. This was a wonderful birthday! **有一天，汤姆非常兴奋，因为这天是他的生日。他的朋友们带着礼物和一个大蛋糕来了。他们唱歌跳舞来庆祝。汤姆感到非常开心。这是一个美好的生日！**

> A baby was born in a small town. Everyone said this town was the baby\'s birthplace. Years passed, and whenever the baby thought of that town, it reminded him of his beginning. The town was special because it was where life started for him. **一个婴儿在一个小镇出生。大家都说这个小镇是婴儿的出生地。多年过去，每当这个婴儿想起那个小镇，就会想起他生命的开端。这个小镇很特别，因为那是他生命开始的地方。**

> A long time ago, in a kingdom, a baby was born. The king declared that this baby had a special gift, called birthright. It meant the rights and privileges the baby got just because of being born into the royal family. **很久以前，在一个王国里，一个婴儿出生了。国王宣布这个婴儿有一个特殊的礼物，叫做生来就有的权利。这意味着婴儿仅仅因为出生在王室就获得的权利和特权。**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food. It found a box of biscuits. But the box was too high. Finally, with great effort, it climbed up and enjoyed the delicious biscuits. **一只饥饿的老鼠正在找食物。它发现了一盒饼干。但盒子太高了。最后，费了好大劲，它爬了上去，享用了美味的饼干。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Lily. She had feelings for both men and women. People called her bisexual. It means being attracted to both sexes. **从前，有个人叫莉莉。她对男性和女性都有感情。人们称她为双性恋。这个词意味着被两性所吸引。**

> In a magical kingdom, a wise bishop always wore a special hat. He used his wisdom to solve problems and bring peace. One day, a big disaster came, but the bishop\'s calmness saved everyone. Remember, bishop means a senior religious leader. **在一个神奇的王国里，一位睿智的主教总是戴着一顶特别的帽子。他用他的智慧解决问题并带来和平。有一天，一场大灾难来临，但主教的沉着拯救了所有人。记住，bishop 意思是主教。**

> A brave hunter was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he saw a huge bison. He was scared but remembered its name. Later, he safely returned and told others about the encounter with the bison. **一位勇敢的猎人在森林里迷路了。突然，他看到了一头巨大的野牛。他很害怕，但记住了它叫 bison。后来，他安全返回并向其他人讲述了与野牛的遭遇。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in a strange town. Just when he was about to give up, he found a small bistro. The warm lights and delicious smells drew him in. He had a wonderful meal and felt happy. **一位饥饿的旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。就在他快要放弃的时候，他发现了一家小餐馆。温暖的灯光和美味的香气吸引着他进去。他享用了一顿美餐，感到很开心。**

> A little mouse was very hungry. It found a bit of cheese in a corner. The bit of cheese made the mouse happy. It ate it quickly and felt full. **一只小老鼠非常饿。它在一个角落里发现了一点奶酪。这一点奶酪让老鼠很开心。它很快就把它吃了，然后觉得饱了。**

> A man was walking in the forest and suddenly saw a female dog barking angrily. He shouted, \'This angry bitch!\' From then on, he remembered that \'bitch\' means a female dog, and it can also be used rudely to describe a bad-tempered woman. **一个男人在森林里走着，突然看到一只母狗在愤怒地叫。他喊道：'这只愤怒的母狗！'从那以后，他记住了'bitch'指母狗，也可用于粗鲁地形容脾气坏的女人。**

> One cold winter day, a little mouse was looking for food. Suddenly, a snake appeared with a biting mouth. The mouse was so scared. It ran away quickly. The snake\'s biting teeth were very sharp. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一只小老鼠正在寻找食物。突然，一条蛇出现了，张着咬人的嘴。小老鼠非常害怕。它迅速跑开了。这条蛇咬人的牙齿非常锋利。**

> A poor man had to drink bitter coffee every day because he couldn\'t afford sugar. But he still worked hard, hoping his life would become sweet. The taste of that coffee made him remember the word \'bitter\'. **一个穷人每天不得不喝苦咖啡，因为他买不起糖。但他仍然努力工作，希望生活能变得甜蜜。那种咖啡的味道让他记住了'bitter（苦的）'这个单词。**

> A man lost his job and had to walk home in the cold winter. He felt bitterly disappointed. Tears froze on his cheeks as he thought about his uncertain future. **一个男人丢了工作，不得不在寒冷的冬天步行回家。他感到极度失望。当他想到不确定的未来时，泪水在他的脸颊上冻住了。**

> A poor man was constantly facing hardships and setbacks. The taste of life for him was full of bitterness. He felt like he was trapped in a dark cave with no way out. But he didn\'t give up and finally found a way to happiness. **一个穷人不断面临艰难和挫折。对他来说，生活的滋味充满了苦涩。他觉得自己被困在一个黑暗的洞穴里，无路可走。但他没有放弃，最终找到了通往幸福的路。**

> A girl had a love experience. The moments spent with her lover were sweet, but the eventual parting was bitter. This feeling was bittersweet. Just like a chocolate with both bitter and sweet flavors. **一个女孩有一段恋爱经历。和爱人相处的时刻是甜蜜的，但最终的分别是痛苦的。这种感受就是又苦又甜的。就像一块既有苦味又有甜味的巧克力。**
> 想象一下，在一个繁华的城市里，有一位年轻人梦想创业。他四处奔波，寻找商机，终于在\'BIZ\'（商业）领域取得成功，实现了自己的梦想。 **想象一位年轻人在商业领域创业成功的故事，来辅助记住\'biz\'这个表示商业的单词。**

> A man wore a hat made of fruits in a bizarre fashion. He danced strangely on the street, attracting everyone\'s attention. His outfit and behavior were so unusual and odd, just like the meaning of \'bizarre\'. **一个男人戴着一顶用水果做成的帽子，样子很怪异。他在街上奇怪地跳舞，吸引了所有人的目光。他的穿着和行为都非常不寻常和古怪，就像'bizarre'这个词的意思。**

> One night, I was walking in a dark forest. Everything was black. Suddenly, a black cat crossed my path. It was so scary! I realized black means the absence of light and often associated with mystery and fear. **一天晚上，我在一片黑暗的森林里散步。一切都是黑色的。突然，一只黑猫穿过我的路。太可怕了！我意识到 black 表示没有光，通常与神秘和恐惧相关。**

> One day, I was lost in a forest. Suddenly, I saw a blackberry bush. The blackberries were shiny and black. I picked them and tasted, so sweet! From then on, I always remember \'blackberry\' as the sweet fruit in the forest. **有一天，我在森林里迷路了。突然，我看到一丛黑莓灌木。黑莓又黑又亮。我摘下来尝了尝，好甜！从那以后，我总是把\'blackberry\'记成森林里甜甜的水果。**

> One day, the teacher pointed to the blackboard and said, \'Look at this blackboard. It\'s like a magic window that shows us knowledge.\' The black color and its role as a board for writing made it easy to remember the word \'blackboard\'. **有一天，老师指着黑板说：'看这块黑板。它就像一个神奇的窗口，为我们展示知识。'黑板的黑色以及它作为书写板的作用，让人很容易记住'blackboard'这个单词。**

> A black cat was playing in the white snow. But when it rolled around, its fur blacken the snow. The scene showed how something pure could be blacken by an outside influence. **一只黑猫在白雪中玩耍。但当它打滚时，它的毛把雪染黑了。这个场景展示了原本纯净的东西是如何被外界影响而变黑的。**

> A brave cowboy was in a saloon. One night, a villain challenged him to a game. The game was called blackjack. The cowboy won with his smart strategies and courage. **一位勇敢的牛仔在酒馆里。一天晚上，一个恶棍向他挑战玩一种游戏。这个游戏叫二十一点。牛仔凭借聪明的策略和勇气赢了。**

> A thief threatened a rich man, saying he would expose the man\'s secrets if he wasn\'t given money. This act of threatening for money was called blackmail. The rich man felt scared and had to pay. **一个小偷威胁一位富人，说如果不给他钱，就会揭露富人的秘密。这种以威胁来要钱的行为就叫做敲诈勒索。富人感到害怕，不得不付钱。**

> In a deep cave, everything was in blackness. A brave adventurer entered with a torch, but even the light struggled to pierce the thick blackness. It was a scary and mysterious place. **在一个深深的洞穴里，一切都处于黑暗之中。一位勇敢的探险家拿着火把进入，但即使有光也难以穿透浓厚的黑暗。这是一个可怕而神秘的地方。**

> One night, the city had a blackout. Everything was dark. People couldn\'t see and were scared. But they found candles and waited for the power to come back. \'Blackout\' means a total loss of electricity. **一天晚上，城市停电了。一切都漆黑一片。人们看不见，很害怕。但他们找到了蜡烛，等待电力恢复。\'blackout\'意思是停电，灯火管制。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He worked in a dark room all day, wearing black clothes. He was good at making tools with a hammer and anvil. People called him the blacksmith. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他整天在一个昏暗的房间里工作，穿着黑色的衣服。他擅长用锤子和铁砧制造工具。人们称他为铁匠。**

> One day, I was walking on a road. The surface was black and smooth. I asked a local, \'What kind of road is this?\' He said, \'This is a blacktop. It\'s made of special materials.\' **有一天，我走在路上。路面又黑又光滑。我问一个当地人：'这是什么样的路？'他说：'这是柏油路。是用特殊材料铺成的。'**

> Imagine a brave knight fighting a huge monster. The monster has a big bladder filled with magic liquid. The knight has to be careful not to let the bladder burst and cause trouble. So, \'bladder\' is like a container for something inside. **想象一位勇敢的骑士与一只巨大的怪物战斗。怪物有一个装满魔法液体的大膀胱。骑士必须小心，不能让膀胱破裂并引发麻烦。所以，\'bladder\'就像是内部装有东西的容器。**

> A brave knight was in a fierce battle. His enemy\'s sword aimed at him, but the knight swiftly blocked it with his blade. The sharp blade shone in the sunlight, saving the knight\'s life. Remember, blade is the sharp part of a weapon. **一位勇敢的骑士正在激烈的战斗中。他敌人的剑向他刺来，但骑士迅速用他的刀刃挡住了。锋利的刀刃在阳光下闪耀，救了骑士的命。记住，blade 是武器的锋利部分。**
> 想象一下，一只小兔子在森林里迷路了，它不停地说\'blah blah blah\'，好像在抱怨自己的处境。其实\'blah\'就是表示乏味的、无聊的话语。就像小兔子的抱怨，没什么实质内容。 **想象一只迷路的小兔子不停地说无实质内容的话来表示\'blah\'这个单词意为乏味无聊的话语**

> One day, a vase was broken. Tom was blamed by his mom wrongly. But he bravely took the blame to protect his sister. Later, mom knew the truth and stopped blaming him. **一天，一个花瓶碎了。汤姆被妈妈错误地责备。但他勇敢地承担责任来保护妹妹。后来，妈妈知道了真相，不再责备他。**

> A brave knight named Blanch was always pale when facing the fierce dragon. But as he grew stronger, he stopped blanching and became fearless. Blanch here means to turn pale from fear or shock. **一位名叫布兰奇的勇敢骑士，每次面对凶猛的巨龙总是脸色苍白。但随着他变得强大，他不再脸色发白，变得无所畏惧。这里 blanch 指因恐惧或震惊而脸色苍白。**

> A chef was criticized for his bland dishes. One day, he decided to add special spices and flavors. Now his food was exciting and no longer bland! Remember, bland means lacking flavor or being dull. **一位厨师因其平淡无味的菜肴而受到批评。有一天，他决定添加特殊的香料和风味。现在他的食物令人兴奋，不再平淡无味了！记住，bland 意思是缺乏味道或枯燥。**

> One day, Tom was given a blank sheet of paper and asked to draw his dream house. He stared at the blank page, thinking hard. Finally, he started to draw and filled the blank with his imagination. **一天，汤姆得到一张空白的纸并被要求画出他梦想中的房子。他盯着这张空白的纸，努力思考。最后，他开始画，用想象填满了空白。**

> One cold night, I was shivering. Then my mom came and covered me with a thick blanket. It was so warm and cozy, just like a big hug. The blanket protected me from the cold. **一个寒冷的夜晚，我在发抖。然后妈妈过来用一条厚毯子把我盖住。它是那么温暖舒适，就像一个大大的拥抱。这条毯子保护我免受寒冷。**

> One day, Tom was sitting blankly in the classroom. His mind was completely empty, and he stared blankly at the blackboard, not knowing what the teacher was saying. Suddenly, he woke up and started to focus. **有一天，汤姆茫然地坐在教室里。他的大脑完全空白，茫然地盯着黑板，不知道老师在说什么。突然，他醒过神来开始集中注意力。**

> A fire truck was speeding along the street, its siren blaring loudly. Everyone knew it was an emergency. The blare of the siren was so intense that it made people cover their ears. **一辆消防车沿着街道疾驰，警笛大声鸣响。每个人都知道有紧急情况。警笛的鸣响如此强烈，以至于人们都捂住了耳朵。**

> A man was caught making blasphemy in the church. He shouted disrespectful words against God. Everyone was shocked. Such an act is considered a serious offense. Remember, blasphemy means speaking irreverently about sacred things. **一个男人在教堂里被抓到亵渎神明。他大声喊出对上帝不敬的话。所有人都震惊了。这种行为被认为是严重的过错。记住，blasphemy 意思是对神圣事物不敬的言语。**

> A powerful monster was about to blast the city. The hero used a special shield to stop the blast. Just in time, the city was saved. The blast was so strong that it made a huge noise. **一只强大的怪物正要炸毁城市。英雄用一面特殊的盾牌阻挡了爆炸。刚好及时，城市得救了。这次爆炸威力巨大，发出了巨大的声响。**

> A king had a servant who was always making blatant mistakes. One day, the servant broke a precious vase loudly and openly. The king was very angry and shouted, \'Your mistakes are so blatant!\' **一位国王有个仆人总是犯明显的错误。有一天，仆人公然大声地打碎了一个珍贵的花瓶。国王非常生气并喊道：'你的错误太明显了！'**

> A thief blatantly stole a bag in the market. Everyone saw it but he showed no shame. Later, the police came and caught him. Blatantly means in an open and unashamed way. **一个小偷公然在市场上偷了一个包。每个人都看见了，但他毫无羞愧。后来，警察来了并抓住了他。Blatantly 意思是以公开且不知羞耻的方式。**
> 在森林中，一只勇敢的小鹿发现了一处 blaze（火焰），它迅速跑回村庄通知大家。村民们拿着水桶赶来，最终成功扑灭了 blaze。小鹿的勇敢和机智，让大家避免了一场灾难。 **在森林里，一只勇敢的小鹿发现了一处火焰，它跑回村庄通知大家。村民们赶来扑灭了火焰。小鹿的勇敢机智让大家避免了灾难。**

> One day, Tom was going to a party. He wore a special jacket called a blazer. It was bright and made him stand out. Everyone praised his stylish blazer. Now, whenever Tom sees a blazer, he remembers that fun party. **有一天，汤姆要去参加一个聚会。他穿了一件特别的夹克，叫做西装外套。它很亮丽，让他脱颖而出。每个人都称赞他时髦的西装外套。现在，每当汤姆看到西装外套，他就会想起那个有趣的聚会。**

> A brave knight was riding through a forest on a blazing hot day. The sun was shining so brightly that it felt like the whole world was on fire. \'Blazing\' means very hot and bright, just like that sun. **一位勇敢的骑士在一个酷热的日子里骑马穿过森林。太阳明亮地照耀着，感觉整个世界都在燃烧。'blazing'意思是非常炎热和明亮，就像那太阳一样。**

> A young artist was painting a beautiful landscape. But the colors were too dark. So, he used bleach to make them brighter and more vivid. Finally, his painting became a masterpiece. **一位年轻的艺术家正在画一幅美丽的风景画。但颜色太暗了。于是，他用漂白剂让颜色更明亮、更生动。最终，他的画成了杰作。**
> 想象在一场激烈的棒球比赛中，观众们都坐在露天的那排座位上，这些座位就是\'bleachers\'。它们没有顶棚，阳光直直照下来，大家却依然热情地为比赛欢呼。 **想象在棒球比赛中露天的那排观众座位来辅助记忆\'bleachers（露天看台）\'这个单词**

> A traveler got lost in a bleak desert. There was no water or food. The sky was gray and the wind was cold. He felt hopeless and alone. Remember, \'bleak\' means desolate and cheerless. **一位旅行者在一片荒凉的沙漠中迷路了。那里没有水也没有食物。天空灰暗，风很冷。他感到绝望和孤独。记住，\'bleak\'意思是荒凉的、凄凉的。**

> A brave knight was injured in a fierce battle. Blood kept bleeding from his wound. But he still held on, showing his unwavering courage. Remember, \'bleed\' means to lose blood. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场激烈的战斗中受伤了。血不断地从他的伤口流出。但他仍然坚持着，展现出坚定不移的勇气。记住，\'bleed\'意思是流血。**

> One day, Tom had a bad fall and his knee was bleeding. He was in great pain. But with the help of a kind doctor, the bleeding finally stopped and he recovered. **一天，汤姆摔得很严重，他的膝盖在流血。他非常痛苦。但在一位好心医生的帮助下，流血终于止住了，他也康复了。**

> A beautiful princess had a blemish on her face. It was a small mark, but it made her very sad. However, a kind fairy used magic to remove the blemish and made her happy again. Remember, blemish means a mark or flaw. **一位美丽的公主脸上有个瑕疵。这是个小斑点，但让她很伤心。然而，一位善良的仙女用魔法去掉了这个瑕疵，让她再次开心起来。记住，blemish 意思是污点、瑕疵。**

> A chef wanted to create a special drink. He took milk, coffee and sugar and carefully BLEND them together. The result was a delicious and unique beverage that everyone loved. **一位厨师想制作一种特别的饮品。他取了牛奶、咖啡和糖，然后仔细地将它们混合在一起。结果是一种美味且独特的饮料，每个人都喜欢。**

> One day, I was in the kitchen and wanted to make a smoothie. I took out the fruits and put them into the blender. With its powerful blades, the blender quickly turned them into a delicious drink. **有一天，我在厨房，想做一杯奶昔。我拿出水果并把它们放进搅拌机里。凭借其强大的刀片，搅拌机很快就把它们变成了美味的饮品。**

> A poor man was lost in the forest. Just when he felt hopeless, an angel appeared and blessed him. Suddenly, he found the way out. The power of bless brought him good luck. **一个穷人在森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，一位天使出现并祝福了他。突然，他找到了出路。祝福的力量给他带来了好运。**

> A man was lost in a desert and almost gave up. But suddenly, he found an oasis and felt truly blessed. It was like a miracle that saved his life. The word \'blessed\' means having a special kind of good fortune or being fortunate. **一个男人在沙漠中迷路几乎要放弃了。但突然，他发现了一片绿洲，感到无比幸运。这就像一个拯救他生命的奇迹。单词\'blessed\'意思是有特别的好运或幸运。**

> A poor man was lost in the desert. Just when he was about to give up, he found an oasis. He believed it was a blessing from God. The oasis gave him water and hope, saving his life. **一个穷人在沙漠中迷路了。就在他要放弃的时候，他发现了一片绿洲。他认为这是上帝的赐福。绿洲给了他水和希望，救了他的命。**

> A farmer\'s crops were growing well until a mysterious blight came. It made the leaves turn brown and the plants wither. The farmer was very sad as all his hard work seemed ruined. But he didn\'t give up and tried to find a way to fight the blight. **一位农民的庄稼本来长得很好，直到一种神秘的枯萎病袭来。它使叶子变成褐色，植物枯萎。农民非常伤心，因为他所有的辛勤劳动似乎都毁了。但他没有放弃，试图找到对抗枯萎病的方法。**

> A man was blind since birth. One day, he heard a bird singing beautifully but couldn\'t see it. This made him realize how much he missed because of being blind. But he didn\'t give up and learned to \'feel\' the world with his heart. **一个男人从出生就失明了。有一天，他听到一只鸟唱得很美却看不到。这让他意识到因为失明错过了多少。但他没有放弃，学会用心去'感受'世界。**

> A thief was caught and the police blindfolded him to prevent him from seeing the way to the police station. Later, when the blindfold was removed, he realized his mistake. **一个小偷被抓住了，警察蒙上了他的眼睛以防止他看到去警察局的路。后来，当眼罩被取下时，他意识到了自己的错误。**

> A driver was on a long journey. Suddenly, a blinding light from the opposite direction made him unable to see clearly. But luckily, he managed to stop the car safely. The \'blinding\' light was so intense! **一位司机正在长途旅行。突然，对面一道刺眼的光让他看不清。但幸运的是，他成功安全地停了车。这道'刺眼的'光太强烈了！**

> A young adventurer was lost in a dark cave. Without thinking, he blindly followed a mysterious sound, hoping it would lead him out. But it only led him deeper into trouble. **一位年轻的冒险者在黑暗的洞穴中迷路了。他不假思索，盲目地跟着一个神秘的声音，希望它能带他出去。但这只让他陷入了更深的困境。**

> Once upon a time, in a dark cave, a brave adventurer was lost. The total darkness caused him blindness. He had to rely on his other senses to find a way out. Finally, he escaped and understood the horror of blindness. **从前，在一个黑暗的洞穴里，一位勇敢的探险家迷路了。完全的黑暗导致他失明。他不得不依靠其他感官寻找出路。最后，他逃脱了，并理解了失明的可怕。**

> One night, when I was walking in the dark alley, a black cat suddenly appeared and blinked at me. Its shining eyes blinked so fast that it scared me. Later I knew \'blink\' means to close and open your eyes quickly. **一天晚上，当我走在黑暗的小巷时，一只黑猫突然出现并朝我眨眼。它闪亮的眼睛快速眨动，把我吓到了。后来我知道了\'blink\'是快速地闭合和睁开眼睛的意思。**

> A little girl was lost in a blinking forest. The lights of fireflies were blinking everywhere, confusing her. But she finally found her way out by following a blinking star. **一个小女孩在一个闪烁的森林里迷路了。萤火虫的光到处闪烁，让她感到困惑。但她最终通过跟随一颗闪烁的星星找到了出路。**
> 想象一下，你正在太空旅行，飞船的雷达屏幕上突然出现一个小小的亮点（blip），引起了大家的警觉。这个亮点一闪而过，就像瞬间的意外。记住这个太空冒险中的小意外，就能记住 blip 这个单词啦。 **想象在太空旅行中飞船雷达屏幕上突然出现又很快消失的亮点来辅助记忆单词 blip，意为（在雷达屏幕显示出的）物体光点，短暂的情况**

> A young artist was constantly seeking inspiration. One day, while painting in a peaceful garden, he suddenly felt a sense of pure joy and contentment. That moment was his bliss. It was like finding a hidden treasure in the midst of chaos. **一位年轻的艺术家一直在寻找灵感。有一天，当他在一个宁静的花园里作画时，突然感到一种纯粹的喜悦和满足。那一刻就是他的极乐。就像在混乱中找到了隐藏的宝藏。**

> A girl was on a vacation by the sea. The gentle breeze, the warm sun, and the peaceful waves made her feel extremely blissful. She knew this was a moment of pure happiness and joy. **一个女孩在海边度假。轻柔的微风、温暖的阳光和平静的海浪让她感到无比的幸福。她知道这是纯粹快乐和喜悦的时刻。**

> One day, I was playing basketball for a long time. When I took off my shoes, I saw blisters on my feet. These blisters were like little balloons filled with liquid, caused by the friction. **有一天，我打了很长时间的篮球。当我脱鞋时，我看到脚上起了水泡。这些水泡就像充满液体的小气球，是由摩擦引起的。**

> A girl was always blithely singing and dancing on the street. No matter how hard the life was, she remained cheerful. This showed that \'blithely\' means happily and carefree. **一个女孩总是愉快地在街上唱歌跳舞。不管生活多么艰难，她都保持着愉悦。这表明'blithely'意味着快乐和无忧无虑。**
> 二战时，敌军突然发动了一场名为 blitz 的闪电袭击。城市瞬间陷入混乱，人们四处奔逃。这种迅猛、突然的攻击就像闪电一样，让人猝不及防。 **在二战时，敌军突然发动的被称为'闪电战'的迅猛、突然的袭击。城市瞬间陷入混乱，人们四处奔逃。这种攻击就像闪电一样，让人猝不及防。**

> One day, Tom was hiking in the mountains. Suddenly, a blizzard came. The strong wind and heavy snow made him lost his way. But he stayed calm and finally found a shelter. **一天，汤姆在山里徒步旅行。突然，一场暴风雪袭来。强风和大雪让他迷失了方向。但他保持冷静，最终找到了一个庇护所。**

> A fish was swimming happily in the river. But after eating too much food, it became bloated and could hardly move. It realized that overeating made it uncomfortable. **一条鱼在河里欢快地游着。但吃了太多食物后，它变得肿胀，几乎无法游动。它意识到吃得过多让自己难受。**

> A blob of paint fell on the floor. A little girl saw it and thought it looked like a funny monster. She started to draw eyes and a mouth on the blob. Now the blob wasn\'t just a blob, it was a cute creature! **一滴颜料掉到了地板上。一个小女孩看到了，觉得它看起来像一个有趣的怪物。她开始在这滴颜料上画眼睛和嘴巴。现在这滴颜料不再只是一滴颜料，而是一个可爱的生物！**

> A group of friends formed a bloc to protect their secret garden. They worked together, like a united team. The bloc was strong and no one could break it. **一群朋友组成了一个集团来保护他们的秘密花园。他们齐心协力，就像一个团结的团队。这个集团很强大，没人能打破它。**

> A thief was running away, but a big block of wood suddenly fell in front of him, blocking his path. The police caught him easily. The block stopped the thief! **一个小偷正在逃跑，但是一块大木头突然掉在他面前，挡住了他的路。警察很容易就抓住了他。这块木头拦住了小偷！**

> A group of brave soldiers decided to blockade the enemy\'s supply route. They built barriers and stood guard day and night to stop any supplies from reaching the enemy. This blockade was crucial for their victory. **一群勇敢的士兵决定封锁敌人的补给路线。他们筑起障碍物，日夜站岗，阻止任何补给到达敌人那里。这次封锁对他们的胜利至关重要。**

> One day, a little mouse was trying to find food in a big house. But there was a blockage in the pipe and it couldn\'t pass. Poor mouse had to look elsewhere. The blockage stopped its way. **有一天，一只小老鼠试图在一所大房子里找食物。但是管道里有堵塞物，它过不去。可怜的老鼠不得不去别的地方找。堵塞物挡住了它的路。**

> Imagine a huge block that was so strong and powerful it could break through anything. This block was like a star in a movie, causing a huge sensation. That\'s what \'blockbuster\' means - a very successful and popular movie or book. **想象有一个巨大的方块，它非常强大有力，能够冲破任何东西。这个方块就像电影里的明星，引起巨大轰动。这就是\'blockbuster\'的意思------非常成功和受欢迎的电影或书籍。**

> A thief was running away, but the brave police formed a blocking line to stop him. The crowd watched as the thief had no way out. \'Blocking\' means creating an obstacle or hindrance. **一个小偷正在逃跑，但勇敢的警察组成了一道阻拦线来阻止他。人群看着小偷无路可逃。\'blocking\'意思是形成阻碍或障碍。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl with long blond hair. Everyone was attracted by her shiny blond locks. She was like a princess in a fairy tale. Her blond hair made her stand out in the crowd. **从前，有一个美丽的女孩，有着长长的金色头发。每个人都被她闪亮的金色头发所吸引。她就像童话里的公主。她的金发使她在人群中脱颖而出。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl with long blonde hair. Everyone was attracted by her shiny blonde locks. She was like a princess in a fairy tale. Blonde hair made her stand out in the crowd. **从前，有一个美丽的女孩，有着长长的金发。每个人都被她闪亮的金发所吸引。她就像童话故事里的公主。金色的头发让她在人群中脱颖而出。**

> A brave knight was injured in a fierce battle. Blood flowed from his wound, but his spirit remained strong. He fought on, determined to protect his land. The sight of blood made everyone realize the cost of victory. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场激烈的战斗中受伤了。血从他的伤口流出，但他的精神依然坚强。他继续战斗，决心保护他的土地。血的景象让每个人都意识到胜利的代价。**

> In a mysterious castle, a vampire was trying to attack a brave knight. But the knight wore a special amulet that made the vampire\'s bite bloodless. The vampire was very frustrated and had to flee. **在一座神秘的城堡里，一个吸血鬼试图攻击一位勇敢的骑士。但骑士戴着一个特殊的护身符，使得吸血鬼的咬击不流血。吸血鬼非常沮丧，不得不逃离。**

> In a dark forest, a fierce battle occurred. Swords clashed and people screamed. There was a lot of bloodshed. Blood flowed freely, staining the ground. It was a terrifying scene of violence and death. **在一片黑暗的森林里，发生了一场激烈的战斗。剑刃相交，人们尖叫。到处都是流血牺牲。鲜血肆意流淌，染红了地面。这是一个充满暴力和死亡的可怕场景。**

> A brave knight was in a bloody battle. His sword was covered in blood as he fought fiercely. The scene was very bloody, but he never gave up. Finally, he won and brought peace. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场血腥的战斗中。他的剑沾满了鲜血，他激烈地战斗着。场面非常血腥，但他从未放弃。最终，他获胜并带来了和平。**

> In the spring garden, a little girl named Lily noticed beautiful flowers in bloom. The roses were bright and the daisies were so charming. She realized that \'bloom\' means when flowers open and look their best. **在春天的花园里，一个叫莉莉的小女孩注意到美丽的花朵绽放。玫瑰鲜艳，雏菊迷人。她意识到'bloom'意思是花朵盛开并处于最美的状态。**

> A blooming flower in the garden attracted a little bee. The flower was so beautiful and full of vitality. \'Blooming\' means growing and flourishing beautifully, just like this flower. **花园里一朵盛开的花吸引了一只小蜜蜂。这朵花如此美丽，充满生机。\'blooming\'意思是美丽地生长和繁荣，就像这朵花一样。**

> In the spring, a little girl named Lily walked in the garden. She saw a tree full of beautiful flowers. The flowers were blossoming, and it was such a wonderful sight. Lily was very happy and she knew that blossom means flowers opening. **在春天，一个叫莉莉的小女孩在花园里散步。她看到一棵满是漂亮花朵的树。花朵正在绽放，这是如此美妙的景象。莉莉非常高兴，她知道了blossom意思是开花。**

> A painter was working on a beautiful landscape. But he accidentally dropped ink, which formed a blot on the canvas. He tried hard to fix it but the blot remained, just like a mistake that\'s hard to erase. **一位画家正在创作一幅美丽的风景画。但他不小心滴了墨水，在画布上形成了一个污点。他努力想修复，但污点仍在，就像难以抹去的错误。**

> A girl was going to a party. But her shirt was dirty. So her mother gave her a beautiful blouse. It was pink with lace and made her look very charming at the party. **一个女孩要去参加聚会。但她的衬衫脏了。所以她妈妈给了她一件漂亮的女衬衫。它是粉色带蕾丝的，让她在聚会上看起来非常迷人。**

> A strong wind began to blow. It blew the papers off the desk and made the tree branches shake. The wind blew so hard that it even blew a hat away. Poor people had to hold onto their things tightly. **一阵强风开始刮起来。它把桌上的纸吹掉了，还让树枝摇晃。风刮得如此猛烈，甚至把一顶帽子吹走了。可怜的人们不得不紧紧抓住他们的东西。**

> One day, when I was walking in the park, a strong wind suddenly blew. I saw a blower machine working hard to clear the fallen leaves. It made a loud noise, like a monster breathing heavily. The blower was so powerful! **有一天，我在公园散步，突然刮起了一阵大风。我看到一个吹风机正在努力清理落叶。它发出很大的噪音，就像一个怪物在沉重地呼吸。这个吹风机太强大了！**

> A strong wind blew and the kite was blown high into the sky. The little boy was so excited. But suddenly, the string was blown off and the kite flew away. \'Blown\' means moved by the wind. **一阵强风吹来，风筝被吹到了高空。小男孩非常兴奋。但突然，线被吹断了，风筝飞走了。'blown'意思是被风吹动。**

> One day, I was driving on the highway. Suddenly, my car tyre had a blowout. It was a scary moment. But luckily, I managed to stop the car safely. A blowout means a sudden failure of a tyre. **有一天，我在高速公路上开车。突然，我的汽车轮胎爆胎了。那是个可怕的时刻。但幸运的是，我设法安全地停了车。blowout 意思是轮胎突然爆裂。**

> One day, a little bird was flying in the blue sky. It was so happy and free. The blue color of the sky made everything look peaceful and beautiful. The bird sang a song, enjoying this wonderful blue world. **有一天，一只小鸟在蓝色的天空中飞翔。它非常开心和自由。天空的蓝色让一切看起来宁静而美丽。小鸟唱着歌，享受着这个美妙的蓝色世界。**

> One day, a little bear went into the forest and found some blue fruits. He didn\'t know what they were. His mom told him they were blueberries, which were very sweet and nutritious. **有一天，一只小熊走进森林，发现了一些蓝色的水果。它不知道这是什么。它的妈妈告诉它这是蓝莓，非常甜美且有营养。**

> A farmer was playing music in the blue sky and green grass. The special music he played was called bluegrass. It was a mix of lively tunes and made people dance happily. **一位农民在蓝天白云和绿草间演奏音乐。他演奏的这种特别的音乐被称为蓝草音乐。它是欢快曲调的混合，让人快乐地跳舞。**

> A young architect was working hard on a special project. One day, he found a mysterious old BLUEPRINT that guided him to create an amazing building. The BLUEPRINT was like a magic key to his success. **一位年轻的建筑师正在努力从事一个特别的项目。有一天，他发现了一张神秘的旧蓝图，这张蓝图引导他建造出了一座令人惊叹的建筑。蓝图就像他成功的神奇钥匙。**

> A man was standing on the edge of a cliff, bluffing that he could jump without fear. But when others challenged him, he backed down. Remember, \'bluff\' means to deceive or pretend with a bold show. **一个男人站在悬崖边，虚张声势地说他能毫不畏惧地跳下去。但当其他人向他挑战时，他退缩了。记住，'bluff'意思是通过大胆的表现来欺骗或假装。**

> One day, I was walking by the lake. The sky was a bit strange. It wasn\'t pure blue but had a bluish tint, like a mix of blue and a hint of grey. It made the scene both mysterious and beautiful. **一天，我在湖边散步。天空有点奇怪。它不是纯蓝色的，而是带有一点蓝色的色调，就像蓝色和一点灰色的混合。这让景色既神秘又美丽。**

> A clumsy bear was walking in the forest. It blundered into a beehive, disturbing all the bees. Poor bear! This shows that to blunder is to make a stupid or careless mistake. **一只笨笨的熊在森林里走着。它莽撞地撞进了一个蜂窝，惊扰了所有的蜜蜂。可怜的熊！这表明 blunder 就是犯愚蠢或粗心的错误。**

> A knight was fighting with a blunt sword. No matter how hard he tried, it couldn\'t cut through. He realized that a blunt weapon is ineffective in battle. So, \'blunt\' means not sharp or having a dull edge. **一位骑士拿着一把钝剑战斗。无论他怎么努力，剑都砍不进去。他意识到钝的武器在战斗中没用。所以，'blunt'意思是不锋利的，钝的。**

> A sharp-tongued detective always spoke bluntly to criminals, never beating around the bush. His straightforward words, like \'You\'re guilty, bluntly\', made the criminals tremble. **一位言辞犀利的侦探总是对罪犯直言不讳，从不拐弯抹角。他直截了当的话，比如'你有罪，直截了当地说'，让罪犯们颤抖。**

> A boy was running in the fog. The fog made everything around him blur. He couldn\'t see clearly and almost got lost. Later, when the fog cleared, the view became sharp again. **一个男孩在雾中奔跑。雾让他周围的一切都变得模糊。他看不清楚，差点迷路。后来，雾散了，视野又变得清晰了。**

> One night, I was walking home alone. The fog was so thick that everything became blurry. I could hardly see the road ahead. It was a scary but memorable experience. **一天晚上，我独自走回家。雾太浓了，一切都变得模糊不清。我几乎看不清前方的路。这是一次可怕但难忘的经历。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry and blurted out the secret without thinking. His friends were shocked. It was like a word that just rushed out of his mouth uncontrollably. **有一天，汤姆很着急，不假思索地脱口说出了秘密。他的朋友们都很震惊。这就像是一个无法控制地从他嘴里冲出来的词。**

> A girl was praised by her teacher in front of the class. She felt shy and her face turned red. This is called a blush. It means to become red in the face, especially from shyness or embarrassment. **一个女孩在全班面前被老师表扬了。她感到害羞，脸变红了。这就叫 blush 。它指的是（尤指因害羞或尴尬）脸红。**

> A hunter was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a wild boar rushed out. The boar had sharp tusks and looked fierce. The hunter was scared but managed to hide. Later, he safely left the forest, never forgetting the scary boar. **一位猎人在森林里迷路了。突然，一头野猪冲了出来。这头野猪有着锋利的獠牙，看起来很凶猛。猎人很害怕，但设法躲了起来。后来，他安全地离开了森林，永远忘不了那可怕的野猪。**
> A mouse was running on the board. Suddenly, a cat jumped onto the board and the mouse was scared. The board was like a stage for this funny scene. **一只老鼠在木板上跑。突然，一只猫跳到木板上，老鼠被吓到了。这块木板就像这个有趣场景的舞台。**

> A little boy was a boarder at a school far from home. He missed his family but made many friends. One day, he wrote a letter to his parents on the board in his room. Boarder means someone who lives at a place, like a school, and is not a permanent resident. **一个小男孩是一所离家很远的学校的寄宿生。他想念家人但交到了很多朋友。有一天，他在自己房间的板子上给父母写信。Boarder 指的是居住在某个地方（如学校）的人，并非永久居民。**

> One day, Tom was at the airport and saw a sign that said \'Boarding\'. He realized it meant getting on the plane. He followed the instructions and successfully boarded the flight to his dream destination. **一天，汤姆在机场看到一个写着'登机'的标志。他意识到这意味着上飞机。他按照指示，成功登上了飞往梦想之地的航班。**

> A young entrepreneur was nervous as he entered the boardroom for a crucial meeting. The long table and serious faces made him tense. But he took a deep breath and presented his ideas bravely. **一位年轻的企业家走进董事会会议室参加一个关键会议时很紧张。长长的桌子和严肃的面孔让他感到紧张。但他深吸一口气，勇敢地展示了他的想法。**

> One sunny day, Tom was strolling along the beach. He saw a long and special path made of boards, which was called the \'boardwalk\'. People were walking, chatting and enjoying the view on it. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆在海滩漫步。他看到一条由木板铺成的长长的特别的路，这被称为"木板路"。人们在路上走着、聊着，欣赏着风景。**

> A king always boasted about his powerful army. But when a real war came, his army failed. He learned that boasting without real strength is meaningless. **一位国王总是吹嘘他强大的军队。但当一场真正的战争来临时，他的军队失败了。他明白了没有真正实力的吹嘘是毫无意义的。**

> One sunny day, Tom went to the lake. He saw a beautiful boat floating on the water. It was red and shiny. Tom wanted to ride in the boat and enjoy the view. So he got on and had a wonderful time. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆去了湖边。他看到一艘漂亮的船漂浮在水面上。它是红色的，闪闪发光。汤姆想乘坐这艘船欣赏风景。于是他上了船，度过了一段美好的时光。**

> One sunny day, Tom went to the lake. He saw a man wearing a hat and rowing a boat skillfully. Tom asked his father who that was. His father said, \'That\'s a boater.\' Tom remembered this word easily. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆去了湖边。他看到一个戴着帽子熟练划船的人。汤姆问他爸爸那是谁。他爸爸说：'那是个划船者。'汤姆很容易就记住了boater这个单词。**

> One sunny day, Tom and his friends decided to go boating on the lake. They rowed the boat happily, enjoying the beautiful scenery. The gentle waves and the blue sky made their boating trip unforgettable. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆和他的朋友们决定去湖上划船。他们开心地划着船，享受着美丽的风景。轻柔的波浪和蓝天让他们的划船之旅难以忘怀。**

> Bob was a little fish who loved to bob up and down in the water. One day, he saw a beautiful pearl and bobbed quickly to get it. From then on, whenever he thought of \'bob\', he remembered his adventure. **鲍勃是一条小鱼，喜欢在水中上下浮动。有一天，它看到一颗美丽的珍珠，快速地上下浮动去获取它。从此，每当它想到'bob'这个词，就会想起这次冒险。**

> A young wizard named Bod was always able to predict the future. One day, he saw a vision that boded well for the village. It meant good things were coming. So, whenever you see \'bode\', think of Bod the wizard\'s predictions. **有个叫博德的年轻巫师总是能预测未来。有一天，他看到了一个预示着村庄会有好事的景象。所以，每当你看到'bode'这个词，就想想巫师博德的预测。**

> A beautiful princess was wearing a stunning dress. The bodice of the dress was decorated with shiny jewels and intricate patterns. It made her look even more charming at the ball. **一位美丽的公主穿着一件华丽的裙子。裙子的上身部分（bodice）装饰着闪亮的珠宝和复杂的图案。这让她在舞会上看起来更加迷人。**

> A thief was running away. The police caught him bodily and took him to the police station. It means they grabbed him with their entire bodies. So, \'bodily\' means related to the whole body. **一个小偷正在逃跑。警察整个身体扑上去抓住了他，并把他带到了警察局。这意味着他们用整个身体去抓他。所以，\'bodily\'意思是与整个身体有关的。**

> One day, a little ant was lost. It searched everywhere and finally found its way back to the body of its ant colony. The body of the colony was like a big family, protecting and supporting each other. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁迷路了。它到处寻找，最后回到了蚁群的主体部分。蚁群的主体就像一个大家庭，相互保护和支持。**

> A rich man was always in danger. So he hired a strong and brave person. This person protected the rich man\'s body from any harm. That person was called a bodyguard. **一个富人总是处于危险之中。所以他雇了一个强壮勇敢的人。这个人保护富人的身体免受任何伤害。那个人被称为保镖。**

> I was lost in a forest and suddenly found myself in a bog. My feet got stuck in the wet mud. It was a scary moment. Later, I learned to avoid such bogs. **我在森林里迷路了，突然发现自己身处一片沼泽。我的脚陷在湿泥里。那是可怕的一刻。后来，我学会了避开这样的沼泽。**

> A golfer was always afraid of hitting the bogey. One day, he faced a difficult hole and thought it was a bogey. But with courage, he made a great shot and overcame his fear. Remember, bogey means something causing fear or trouble. **一位高尔夫球手总是害怕打出柏忌。有一天，他面对一个困难的球洞，认为这会是个柏忌。但凭借勇气，他打出了漂亮的一杆，克服了恐惧。记住，bogey 指令人害怕或带来麻烦的事物。**

> One day, a detective found a bag of counterfeit money. The money looked real but was actually bogus. He had to be very careful to spot the differences. Finally, he succeeded in catching the criminals. **一天，一位侦探发现了一袋假钞。这些钱看起来很真但实际上是伪造的。他必须非常小心才能发现差异。最终，他成功抓住了罪犯。**

> A young artist named Lily lived a bohemian life. She wore colorful clothes, traveled freely, and expressed her creativity without boundaries. Her unconventional way of life was truly bohemian. **一位名叫莉莉的年轻艺术家过着波西米亚式的生活。她穿着色彩斑斓的衣服，自由旅行，无拘无束地展现自己的创造力。她这种非传统的生活方式就是真正的波西米亚风格。**

> A poor little boy was very hungry. He put some potatoes in a pot to boil. But he was so tired that he fell asleep. When he woke up, the water had boiled away and the potatoes were burnt. **一个可怜的小男孩非常饿。他把一些土豆放进锅里煮。但他太累睡着了。当他醒来时，水都煮干了，土豆也烧焦了。**

> A little mouse was very cold. It found a big boiler in an old house. It climbed in and felt warm at once. The boiler was like a magic box keeping it cozy. **一只小老鼠很冷。它在一座老房子里发现了一个大锅炉。它爬进去，立刻就感到温暖了。这个锅炉就像一个神奇的盒子，让它舒适无比。**
> 想象一下，你在厨房煮水，水开始冒泡、翻滚，热气腾腾。这就是 boiling 的场景，水达到了非常热、即将沸腾的状态。 **想象在厨房煮水，水冒泡翻滚、热气腾腾的场景来记住'boiling（沸腾的；炎热的）'这个单词。**

> A group of friends went on a boat trip. The sea was rough and the wind was strong. They were having a boisterous time, laughing loudly and jumping around. It was a wild and energetic scene. **一群朋友乘船旅行。海面波涛汹涌，风也很大。他们度过了喧闹的时光，大声欢笑，四处蹦跳。那是一个狂野且充满活力的场景。**

> A little mouse was always afraid. One day, it decided to be bold. It bravely faced a big cat and didn\'t run away. From then on, it was no longer timid. Being bold made it stronger. **一只小老鼠总是很害怕。有一天，它决定勇敢起来。它勇敢地面对一只大猫并且没有逃跑。从那以后，它不再胆小。勇敢使它变得更强大。**

> A little mouse was trapped in a room. It boldly decided to explore and find a way out. It wasn\'t afraid and moved forward bravely. Finally, it succeeded. The mouse was so boldly. **一只小老鼠被困在一个房间里。它大胆地决定去探索并寻找出路。它毫不畏惧，勇敢地前进。最后，它成功了。这只老鼠真是大胆。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse showed boldness. It bravely faced a big cat and didn\'t run away. Its boldness surprised everyone. With this courage, it became a hero in the mouse world. **从前，有一只小老鼠展现出了大胆。它勇敢地面对一只大猫并且没有逃跑。它的大胆让所有人都感到惊讶。凭借这种勇气，它成为了老鼠世界的英雄。**

> A tired traveler was on a long journey. When night came, he found a hard bed. But luckily, there was a bolster that made the bed more comfortable and helped him have a good sleep. The bolster supported and eased his tiredness. **一位疲惫的旅行者正在长途旅行。当夜幕降临，他发现床很硬。但幸运的是，有一个长枕让床更舒服了，帮助他睡了个好觉。这个长枕支撑并缓解了他的疲惫。**

> A thief was running away with a bag of treasures. Suddenly, a huge bolt from a door flew and hit his leg. The police arrived in time and caught him. The bolt played a key role in stopping the thief. **一个小偷带着一袋财宝逃跑。突然，一扇门的大螺栓飞出来砸中了他的腿。警察及时赶到并抓住了他。螺栓在阻止小偷方面起了关键作用。**

> A spy was sent to plant a bomb in the enemy\'s base. He sneaked in, placed the bomb carefully, and then ran away quickly. Just as the enemy was celebrating, the bomb exploded with a huge bang! **一名间谍被派去在敌人的基地里放置一枚炸弹。他偷偷潜入，小心地放置了炸弹，然后迅速跑开。就在敌人正在庆祝时，炸弹伴随着一声巨响爆炸了！**

> In a war, the enemy\'s city was under bombardment. Bombs were constantly falling from the sky, causing chaos and destruction. The sound of the bombardment was deafening. Remember, bombardment means a continuous attack with bombs or shells. **在一场战争中，敌人的城市遭到轰炸。炸弹不断从天上落下，造成混乱和破坏。轰炸的声音震耳欲聋。记住，bombardment 意思是用炸弹或炮弹的连续攻击。**

> In a war, a brave pilot was chosen to fly the bomber. His mission was to drop bombs precisely on the enemy\'s base. The bomber roared through the sky, ready to strike. **在一场战争中，一位勇敢的飞行员被选中驾驶轰炸机。他的任务是精准地向敌人的基地投掷炸弹。轰炸机在天空中轰鸣，准备出击。**

> In a quiet town, a mysterious package was delivered. When opened, it turned out to be a bombshell that shocked everyone. It was like a sudden explosion of unexpected news. Remember, \'bombshell\' means a shocking surprise. **在一个安静的小镇，一个神秘包裹被送达。打开后，发现是个重磅炸弹，震惊了所有人。就像突然爆发的意外消息。记住，\'bombshell\'意思是令人震惊的意外之事。**

> A miner was about to give up his search for gold. But one day, he found a huge vein of gold in a cave. This unexpected discovery was like a bonanza for him, making him rich and happy. **一位矿工即将放弃寻找黄金。但有一天，他在一个洞穴里发现了一条巨大的金矿脉。这个意外的发现对他来说就像一笔财富，让他变得富有和快乐。**

> A spy was sent to break the bond between two enemy countries. But he was caught and had to face the consequences. The word \'bond\' here means a connection or a tie. **一名间谍被派去破坏两个敌国之间的联系。但他被抓住了，不得不承担后果。单词\'bond\'在这里指的是联系或纽带。**

> A brave adventurer was captured and put in bondage. But with his wits and determination, he broke free. Bondage here means being trapped and controlled by others. Remember the adventurer\'s struggle to understand the word. **一位勇敢的冒险家被俘虏并受到束缚。但凭借他的智慧和决心，他挣脱了。这里的bondage意思是被他人困住和控制。记住冒险家的挣扎来理解这个单词。**

> One day, a dog was playing with a bone. It held the bone tightly in its mouth and refused to let go. The bone was its precious treasure. Finally, it lay down and chewed the bone happily. **一天，一只狗正在玩一块骨头。它紧紧地把骨头咬在嘴里不肯放开。这块骨头是它珍贵的宝贝。最后，它躺下来开心地啃着骨头。**

> A hungry dog was looking for food. It found a piece of meat, but it was boneless. The dog was a little disappointed because it couldn\'t chew on the bones. But at least it still had some meat to eat. **一只饥饿的狗正在找食物。它发现了一块肉，但这块肉是无骨的。狗有点失望，因为它不能啃骨头。但至少它还有一些肉可以吃。**

> One cold night, Tom was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he saw a bonfire in the distance. He ran towards it and felt warm. The bonfire saved him from the cold and darkness. **一个寒冷的夜晚，汤姆在森林里迷路了。突然，他看到远处有一堆篝火。他朝它跑去，感到很温暖。篝火让他摆脱了寒冷和黑暗。**

> A little girl was wearing a pretty bonnet and running in the garden. Suddenly, a gust of wind blew her bonnet away. She chased after it happily. The bonnet finally landed on a branch. **一个小女孩戴着一顶漂亮的帽子在花园里跑。突然，一阵风把她的帽子吹走了。她开心地追着它。帽子最后落在了一根树枝上。**

> A hardworking employee was always dedicated to his job. One day, the boss gave him a bonus as a reward for his excellent performance. The bonus made him very happy and motivated. **一位勤奋的员工总是全身心投入工作。有一天，老板给了他一笔奖金作为对他出色表现的奖励。这笔奖金让他非常高兴并且更有动力了。**

> One night, Tom was walking alone in a dark alley. Suddenly, a strange shadow appeared and made a \'boo\' sound. Tom was so scared that he ran away quickly. > A man was very nervous when he went to a job interview. He kept saying \'boob\' by mistake instead of proper words. Everyone laughed and he felt so embarrassed. Remember, \'boob\' means a stupid mistake or blunder. **一个男人去面试时非常紧张。他一直错误地说\'boob\'而不是恰当的词。大家都笑了，他感到非常尴尬。记住，\'boob\'意思是愚蠢的错误或大错。**

> One day, Tom was in a big library. He saw many beautiful books on the shelves. He picked up a book about adventures and was soon lost in the wonderful world inside. The book became his best friend that day. **一天，汤姆在一个大图书馆里。他看到书架上有很多漂亮的书。他拿起一本关于冒险的书，很快就沉浸在里面精彩的世界里。那天这本书成了他最好的朋友。**

> One day, Tom was looking for his favorite book but couldn\'t find it. Then he remembered he put it in the bookcase. The bookcase was like a treasure chest full of knowledge and stories. **一天，汤姆在找他最喜欢的书但找不到。然后他想起把它放在书柜里了。这个书柜就像一个装满知识和故事的宝箱。**
> One day, Tom wanted to go on a vacation. So, he made a booking for a nice hotel by the beach. With the booking done, he was excited for his trip. **一天，汤姆想去度假。所以，他预订了一家靠海的不错的酒店。完成预订后，他对这次旅行感到兴奋。**
> 想象一个图书馆，管理员每天都在认真记录每本书的借入和归还情况，这个过程就像'bookkeeping'。他把所有关于书的信息都仔细整理，确保没有差错。 **想象图书馆管理员做书籍记录的工作来辅助记忆'bookkeeping'（簿记）这个单词**

> One day, Tom needed a special book. He went to a store and met a friendly man. The man knew every book in the store. He was a bookseller. Tom found the book he wanted with the bookseller\'s help. **一天，汤姆需要一本特别的书。他去了一家店，遇到了一个友好的人。这个人了解店里的每一本书。他是个书商。在书商的帮助下，汤姆找到了他想要的书。**

> One day, Tom was looking for a book but couldn\'t find it. Then he remembered he had put it on the bookshelf. The bookshelf was tall and full of various books. It was like a treasure chest of knowledge. **有一天，汤姆在找一本书但找不到。然后他想起把它放在书架上了。这个书架很高，摆满了各种各样的书。它就像一个知识的宝库。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange town. He was very worried until he saw a sign that said \'bookstore\'. He rushed in and found a map book that helped him find his way home. **有一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他非常担心，直到他看到一个写着\'书店\'的标志。他冲进去，找到了一本地图册，帮助他找到了回家的路。**

> A town was quiet until a new factory opened. Jobs increased, people moved in, and business was booming. The sound of construction and the happy voices made it clear that the town was having a great boom. **一个小镇原本很安静，直到一家新工厂开业。工作机会增多，人们搬进来，商业繁荣起来。建筑的声音和人们欢快的声音清楚地表明这个小镇正在经历繁荣的热潮。**

> In a small town, a new factory opened. It made amazing products and business was booming. People were happy as the economy grew rapidly. The sound of machines and busy workers showed the booming success. **在一个小镇上，一家新工厂开业了。它生产出了很棒的产品，生意兴隆。随着经济迅速增长，人们都很开心。机器的声音和忙碌的工人显示出了繁荣的成功。**
> 有一天，小明在森林中迷路了，又饿又累。这时，他发现了一棵结满果实的树，这棵树成了他生存的救星。这棵树的存在就是一个'boon'，意思是恩惠、福利。 **有一天，小明在森林中迷路，又饿又累时发现一棵结满果实的树，这棵树成为他的救星，这就是'boon'（恩惠、福利）**

> A poor athlete was always losing. One day, he drank a magic potion which gave him a huge boost of energy. He won the race and became a star. The boost changed his life. **一位贫穷的运动员总是输。有一天，他喝了一瓶神奇的药水，这给他带来了巨大的能量提升。他赢得了比赛，成为了明星。这次提升改变了他的人生。**

> A superhero was losing power in a battle. Just when all seemed lost, a mysterious \'booster\' appeared. It was a special device that gave the hero an instant energy boost and helped him win. The \'booster\' means something that gives a boost or increase. **一位超级英雄在战斗中力量流失。就在一切似乎无望之时，一个神秘的"助推器"出现了。它是一个特殊的装置，瞬间给英雄能量提升，助他获胜。"booster"意思是起推动、增强作用的事物。**

> A poor man was walking in the rain. Suddenly, a pair of boots flew from the sky and landed in front of him. He wore the boots and they protected his feet. From then on, whenever he saw \'boot\', he remembered this magical moment. **一个穷人正在雨中行走。突然，一双靴子从天上飞下来落在他面前。他穿上靴子，靴子保护了他的脚。从那以后，每当他看到\'boot\'这个单词，就会想起这个神奇的时刻。**
> A man was lost in a fair. He was looking for a phone booth to call his friend for help. Finally, he found it and was able to get in touch. **一个男人在集市上迷路了。他正在寻找一个电话亭来给他的朋友打电话求助。最后，他找到了，并得以取得联系。**

> A pirate was always looking for booty. One day, he found a chest full of jewels and gold. The valuable items in the chest were what he called booty. It made him very happy. **一个海盗总是在寻找战利品。有一天，他发现了一个装满珠宝和黄金的箱子。箱子里这些有价值的物品就是他所说的战利品，这让他非常高兴。**

> One day, Tom was very sad. His friend Jack came and gave him some booze. Tom drank it and felt better. But he knew he couldn\'t rely on booze to solve problems all the time. **一天，汤姆非常伤心。他的朋友杰克过来给了他一些酒。汤姆喝了之后感觉好了些。但他知道他不能一直依靠酒来解决问题。**

> A little rabbit was playing near the border of the forest. It was curious about what was beyond. But its mother warned it not to cross the border. \'Border\' means the line separating two areas. **一只小兔子在森林的边缘玩耍。它对边界之外的东西很好奇。但它的妈妈警告它不要越过边界。'border'意思是分隔两个区域的线。**

> A young artist was always on the borderline between success and failure. One day, he decided to cross that line and worked hard. Finally, his artworks were widely praised. The borderline no longer limited him. **一位年轻的艺术家总是处于成功与失败的边缘。有一天，他决定跨越这条线并努力工作。最终，他的艺术作品广受赞誉。这条边界线不再限制他。**

> A strong bear was constantly digging holes in the ground, which was so boring. But then, it found a hidden treasure, making the boring digging worthwhile. The act of constantly digging is like \'bore\', meaning to make someone feel dull or tired. **一只强壮的熊一直在地上挖洞，这很无聊。但后来，它发现了一个隐藏的宝藏，让这无聊的挖掘变得有价值。不断挖掘的行为就像'bore'，意思是使某人感到厌烦或疲倦。**

> One day, Tom had to stay at home alone and do nothing. He felt so bored. There were no interesting games or shows. He just sat there, sighing and longing for something exciting to happen. **有一天，汤姆不得不独自待在家里，无事可做。他感到非常无聊。没有有趣的游戏或节目。他就坐在那里，叹气并渴望有刺激的事情发生。**

> One day, Tom was stuck at home with nothing to do. He felt a strange feeling, which was boredom. He was so tired of the same old things and just wanted some excitement. Finally, he decided to go out and find something fun. **有一天，汤姆被困在家里无事可做。他感觉到一种奇怪的感觉，那就是无聊。他厌倦了一成不变的事情，只想来点刺激的。最后，他决定出去找点好玩的。**

> One day, Tom was forced to attend a very long and uninteresting meeting. Everyone was just talking and nothing exciting happened. Tom felt so bored. He wished he could be anywhere else. This is how we remember the word \'boring\'. **一天，汤姆被迫参加一个非常冗长且无趣的会议。每个人都只是在讲话，没有任何令人兴奋的事情发生。汤姆感到非常无聊。他希望自己能在任何别的地方。这就是我们记住\'boring\'这个单词的方式。**

> A baby was born in a peaceful night. The mother held the newborn with love and joy. The moment the baby was born, a new life began, full of hope and possibilities. **一个婴儿在一个宁静的夜晚出生了。母亲怀着爱和喜悦抱着新生儿。婴儿出生的那一刻，一个新的生命开始了，充满了希望和可能性。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse lived in a borough. It had many houses and a big park. The borough was like a small world for the mouse. It was safe and friendly. **从前，有一只小老鼠住在一个行政区。那里有很多房子和一个大公园。这个行政区对小老鼠来说就像一个小世界。它既安全又友好。**

> One day, Tom needed a pen to do his homework. So he went to his friend Lily and said, \'Can I borrow your pen?\' Lily agreed and Tom successfully borrowed the pen. With it, he finished his homework happily. **一天，汤姆做作业需要一支笔。于是他去找朋友莉莉说：'我能借你的笔吗？'莉莉同意了，汤姆成功借到了笔。用这支笔，他开心地完成了作业。**

> One day, Tom needed a pen for his exam. So he went to his friend Lily and borrowed a nice pen from her. After the exam, he returned it and thanked Lily. **有一天，汤姆考试需要一支笔。于是他去找他的朋友莉莉，从她那里借了一支好看的笔。考试结束后，他归还了笔并感谢了莉莉。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who needed money. He went to the bank and became a borrower. The borrower promised to return the money on time. But it was not an easy task for him. **从前，有一个人需要钱。他去了银行，成为了一名借款人。借款人承诺按时还钱。但这对他来说可不是一件容易的事。**

> A poor student needed money for a book. He went to the library and had the borrowing process. With the borrowed book, he learned a lot. Now you know borrowing means getting something temporarily from others. **一个贫困的学生需要钱买一本书。他去了图书馆并经历了借阅过程。凭借借到的书，他学到了很多。现在你知道 borrowing 意思是暂时从他人那里获取某物。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. Feeling scared, she hugged her teddy bear close to her bosom for comfort. Suddenly, she heard her mother\'s voice and ran into her warm bosom. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。感到害怕的她把泰迪熊紧紧抱在怀里以求安慰。突然，她听到了妈妈的声音，然后跑向妈妈温暖的怀抱。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a big forest. She saw many strange plants and wondered about them. Later, a scientist came and told her these were all \'botanical\' wonders. > One day, a curious boy named Tom wanted to know all about plants. So, he studied hard and became a botanist. He traveled around the world, discovering new and rare plants. Now, everyone calls him the plant expert. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的好奇男孩想了解所有关于植物的知识。于是，他努力学习，成为了一名植物学家。他周游世界，发现了新的和稀有的植物。现在，大家都称他为植物专家。**

> A clumsy carpenter always botched his work. He tried to build a table but made a mess of it, with uneven legs and rough surfaces. Poor guy! It shows how \'botch\' means to do a job badly and spoiling it. **一位笨拙的木匠总是把工作搞砸。他试图做一张桌子，结果却弄得一团糟，桌腿不平整，表面粗糙。可怜的家伙！这表明'botch'意思是把工作做得很差并搞砸。**

> There were two cats, one black and one white. They were both very cute. The black cat could catch mice, and the white cat could play with a ball. Both of them made their owner happy. **有两只猫，一只是黑色的，一只是白色的。它们都非常可爱。黑猫能抓老鼠，白猫能玩球。它们两个都让主人很开心。**

> A little rabbit was bothered by a naughty monkey. The monkey kept throwing stones at it. But the rabbit was brave and didn\'t let this bother affect its happy life in the forest. **一只小兔子被一只顽皮的猴子打扰。猴子不停地朝它扔石头。但兔子很勇敢，不让这种打扰影响它在森林里的快乐生活。**

> One day, a little boy was very thirsty. He found a bottle on the table. But it was empty. So, he went to the store and bought a new bottle filled with juice. Now he was happy. **一天，一个小男孩非常口渴。他在桌子上发现一个瓶子。但它是空的。于是，他去商店买了一个装满果汁的新瓶子。现在他开心了。**
> One day, Tom was very thirsty. He opened the fridge and found a bottle of juice. The juice was bottled neatly. He drank it and felt refreshed. **有一天，汤姆非常口渴。他打开冰箱，发现了一瓶果汁。这瓶果汁被整齐地装瓶。他喝了之后感觉神清气爽。**
> 想象一下，在一条繁忙的公路上，有一个狭窄的路段，车辆都在这里被堵住，难以通行。这个狭窄路段就是\'bottleneck\'，就像瓶口一样限制了流量。 **想象在公路上有个狭窄路段导致车辆堵塞的情景来记住'瓶颈；障碍'这个单词**
> 想象一只小蚂蚁在一个巨大的杯子里，它努力爬到了杯子的最底部，这个最底部就是 bottom。小蚂蚁说：'我终于到了 bottom 啦！' **想象一只小蚂蚁在一个巨大的杯子里，努力爬到了杯子的最底部，这个最底部就是 bottom。小蚂蚁说：'我终于到了底部啦！'**

> A little bird was tired and wanted to rest. It found a comfortable bough on a big tree. The bough was strong and could hold the bird safely. The bird sang happily on the bough. **一只小鸟累了想要休息。它在一棵大树上找到了一根舒适的大树枝。这根树枝很结实，能够安全地承载小鸟。小鸟在树枝上欢快地歌唱。**

> A brave adventurer was hiking in the mountains. Suddenly, a huge boulder rolled down towards him. He narrowly escaped, remembering the word \'boulder\' as the big, scary rock that almost got him. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在山里徒步。突然，一块巨大的巨石朝他滚来。他侥幸逃脱，记住了'boulder'这个词，就是那块差点砸到他的大而可怕的岩石。**

> A little ball was thrown on the ground. It hit and bounced up and down many times. The bounce of the ball was so funny. **一个小球被扔到地上。它撞击地面并上下弹了很多次。球的弹跳非常有趣。**

> A little rabbit was happily bouncing on the grass. It jumped up and down with so much energy. The way it was moving was just like the meaning of \'bouncing\', which is to jump repeatedly and energetically. **一只小兔子正在草地上欢快地蹦跳着。它上上下下地跳着，充满了活力。它的这种运动方式就像\'bouncing\'这个单词的意思，即反复且充满活力地跳跃。**

> A brave explorer was on a journey. He reached a place where there was a clear line marking the end of one territory and the start of another. That line was the boundary. > A young adventurer set off on a journey. He faced many challenges but saw boundless stars in the sky. The stars seemed to have no end, just like the boundless possibilities ahead of him. > Once upon a time, a farmer had a bountiful harvest. His fields were filled with countless grains and fruits.
