> Once upon a time, a pirate ship was searching for treasure. When they finally found it, they shouted, \'The bounty is ours!\' meaning the rich reward or valuable prize. Now you know \'bounty\' means a generous gift or reward. **从前，一艘海盗船在寻找宝藏。当他们最终找到时，他们大喊：'赏金是我们的！' 这里的'bounty'意思就是丰富的报酬或有价值的奖赏。现在你知道'bounty'表示慷慨的赠予或报酬了。**

> A young artist was painting a beautiful garden. When she finished, she picked a bunch of flowers and called it a bouquet. It was a symbol of the beauty and fragrance of the garden. **一位年轻的艺术家正在画一个美丽的花园。当她画完时，她摘了一束花，并称之为花束。这是花园美丽和芬芳的象征。**
> 想象一下，一位国王在他的城堡里品尝着一种特别的酒，这种酒就是 bourbon。它的味道浓郁，让国王陶醉。后来，人们就用 bourbon 这个名字来称呼这种独特的酒。 **想象一位国王在城堡里品尝被称为 bourbon 的独特的酒，以此辅助记忆 bourbon 这个单词意为波旁威士忌（一种美国威士忌酒）**
> 从前有个小镇，住着一群商人，他们被称为 bourgeois。这些人经营着各种生意，生活富足。他们注重物质享受，追求舒适的生活，代表着中产阶级的典型形象。 **从前在一个小镇上，有一群被称为"资产阶级"的商人。他们经营生意，生活富裕，注重物质，追求舒适，展现了中产阶级的典型特征。**
> 从前有个小镇，住着一群从事商业和工业的人，他们被称为 bourgeoisie。他们生活富裕，拥有房产和工厂，形成了一个独特的阶层。这个阶层就是 bourgeoisie，代表着中产阶级。 **从前有个小镇，住着被称为'资产阶级'的一群人。他们富裕，有房产和工厂，形成独特阶层。这个阶层就是'资产阶级'，代表中产阶级。**

> There was a strong boxer. Every bout he entered, he gave his all. One memorable bout, he faced a tough opponent but won with determination. \'Bout\' means a period of activity or a fight. **有一个强壮的拳击手。每次参加比赛，他都全力以赴。在一次令人难忘的回合中，他面对强劲的对手但凭借决心获胜。"bout"意思是（疾病等的）发作；一阵；一场；回合**

> A young designer dreamed of opening her own store. After years of hard work, she finally opened a small but charming \'boutique\'. It was filled with unique and fashionable clothes that attracted many customers. **一位年轻的设计师梦想着开一家自己的店。经过多年的努力，她终于开了一家小而迷人的"精品店"。店里满是独特时尚的衣服，吸引了很多顾客。**

> A little girl was given a beautiful bow as a gift. She wore it happily and danced. But when she accidentally broke the bow, she was very sad. Remember, \'bow\' can mean a decorative knot or to bend forward. **一个小女孩收到了一个漂亮的蝴蝶结作为礼物。她开心地戴着它跳舞。但当她不小心弄断了蝴蝶结时，她非常伤心。记住，\'bow\'有蝴蝶结或弯腰的意思。**
> 想象一下，有一个勇敢的探险家在森林中迷路了，又饿又累。突然，他发现了一种神奇的植物，吃了之后肚子里（bowel）感觉特别舒服，不再难受。这让他记住了bowel是肠道、内部的意思。 **想象一个探险家在森林中因一种植物改善肠道状况从而记住bowel表示肠道、内部的故事。**

> One day, I went to a party. There was a big bowl on the table filled with colorful fruits. Everyone took fruits from the bowl and had a great time. The bowl was like a magic container bringing joy. **有一天，我去参加一个派对。桌子上有一个大碗，里面装满了五颜六色的水果。每个人都从碗里拿水果，玩得很开心。这个碗就像一个带来欢乐的神奇容器。**

> A bowler named Tom was always passionate about bowling. He practiced every day, aiming to throw the perfect strike. His dedication made him a star bowler in the local club. Remember, a bowler is someone who bowls, like Tom! **一个叫汤姆的投球手一直对保龄球充满热情。他每天练习，力求投出完美的全中球。他的专注使他成为当地俱乐部的明星投球手。记住，bowler 就是投球手的意思，就像汤姆！**

> One day, Tom went to a place full of excitement. There were people throwing heavy balls down a long lane. It was called bowling. Tom was amazed and decided to try it himself. He had so much fun! **有一天，汤姆去了一个充满兴奋的地方。那里有人沿着长长的通道扔重球。这就叫保龄球。汤姆很惊讶，决定自己试试。他玩得非常开心！**

> One day, a little rabbit found a box in the forest. It was a magic box that could grant wishes. The rabbit wished for a big carrot and it appeared in the box. How amazing! **有一天，一只小兔子在森林里发现了一个盒子。这是一个能实现愿望的魔法盒子。兔子许愿要一个大胡萝卜，然后胡萝卜就出现在盒子里了。太神奇了！**

> There was a brave boxer. He trained hard every day in a small room filled with boxing gloves and punching bags. One day, he won a big match and became a hero. Remember, a boxer is a person who fights with fists! **有一位勇敢的拳击手。他每天都在一个满是拳击手套和沙袋的小房间里刻苦训练。有一天，他赢得了一场大型比赛，成为了英雄。记住，boxer 就是用拳头战斗的人！**

> One day, Tom was walking on the street and saw a big poster. It was about a boxing match. The strong boxers were fighting fiercely in the ring. Tom was so excited and decided to learn boxing himself. **有一天，汤姆走在街上看到一张大海报。是关于一场拳击比赛的。强壮的拳击手们在拳台上激烈打斗。汤姆非常兴奋，决定自己也去学拳击。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. He was scared but brave. He kept walking and finally found a way out. Remember, \'boy\' is a young male child. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他很害怕但很勇敢。他一直走，最后找到了出路。记住，\'boy\'就是年轻的男孩子。**
> 从前有个地主非常霸道，对农民们很不好。一个叫Boycott的人带领大家拒绝为地主工作和交易，以此抗议。后来这种拒绝和抵制的行为就被称为boycott。 **从前有个叫Boycott的人带领大家抵制地主，后来这种抵制行为就用boycott表示，意思是拒绝、抵制。**

> A girl was very sad because she lost her way. Suddenly, a kind boy appeared and helped her. They spent a lot of time together and became close. Later, this boy became the girl\'s boyfriend. **一个女孩迷路了，非常伤心。突然，一个善良的男孩出现并帮助了她。他们在一起度过了很多时光，关系变得亲密。后来，这个男孩成了女孩的男朋友。**

> A boy named Tom had many adventures during his boyhood. He climbed trees, played in the fields, and made friends. Those happy times were the best part of his life. **一个叫汤姆的男孩在他的少年时期有很多冒险经历。他爬树、在田野里玩耍并且结交朋友。那些快乐的时光是他生命中最美好的部分。**

> A girl was very nervous before her first date. She forgot to wear her bra and felt uncomfortable all night. Later, she always remembered to put on a bra before going out. So, \'bra\' is the thing that girls need for support. **一个女孩在第一次约会前非常紧张。她忘了穿胸罩，整晚都感到不舒服。后来，她出门前总会记得穿上胸罩。所以，\'bra\'就是女孩们需要用来支撑的东西。**

> A brave climber was about to fall off a cliff. Just in time, he used a brace to hold on tightly and saved himself. The brace was like a strong friend, giving him support and keeping him safe. **一位勇敢的登山者即将从悬崖上掉落。就在那时，他用一个支架紧紧抓住，救了自己。这个支架就像一个强大的朋友，给予他支撑并保障他的安全。**

> One day, Alice was very sad because she lost her favorite bracelet. She searched everywhere and finally found it under the sofa. The bracelet was shiny and made her happy again. **一天，爱丽丝非常伤心，因为她弄丢了她最喜欢的手镯。她到处找，最后在沙发底下找到了。手镯闪闪发光，让她又开心起来。**

> A little monkey climbed up a tree and found some strange brackets on the branches. He wondered what they were for. Later, he learned that brackets are used to group things together. **一只小猴子爬上一棵树，在树枝上发现了一些奇怪的括号。它想知道它们是干什么用的。后来，它知道了括号是用来把东西组合在一起的。**

> One day, Tom met a new friend. He kept saying, \'I\'m the best at playing football. No one can beat me!\' This is what we call brag. Tom was just bragging about his football skills. **有一天，汤姆遇到了一个新朋友。他不停地说：'我足球踢得最棒。没人能打败我！'这就是我们所说的吹嘘。汤姆只是在吹嘘他的足球技能。**

> A princess had long beautiful hair. Every day, her maid would carefully braid her hair. The braid was like a work of art, making the princess look even more charming. **一位公主有着长长的美丽头发。每天，她的女仆都会仔细地给她编辫子。那辫子就像一件艺术品，让公主看起来更加迷人。**
> 有个失明的小孩叫小明，他渴望学习知识。一天，他得到了一本特殊的书，上面的 braille 盲文让他能'看'懂文字。通过努力，小明凭借 braille 走进了精彩的知识世界。 **有个失明的小孩小明，得到有盲文（braille）的书，通过努力学习走进知识世界。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for food. It needed to use its brain to find the best way. Finally, with its smart brain, it discovered a hidden cheese. The mouse was so happy! **有一天，一只小老鼠正在寻找食物。它需要运用它的大脑来找到最佳的方法。最后，凭借聪明的大脑，它发现了一块隐藏的奶酪。小老鼠非常高兴！**

> A scientist had a brilliant idea for a new invention in his dream. When he woke up, he called it his brainchild. It was like a child born from his brain, full of creativity and potential. **一位科学家在梦中有了一个关于新发明的绝妙想法。当他醒来时，他称其为他的brainchild。这就像从他大脑中诞生的孩子，充满了创造力和潜力。**

> A man was kidnapped and kept in a dark room. Every day, strange voices repeated the same ideas to him. This was an attempt to brainwash him and make him believe things he didn\'t before. **一个男人被绑架并关在一个黑暗的房间里。每天，奇怪的声音向他重复同样的想法。这是企图给他洗脑，让他相信以前不相信的东西。**

> A driver was speeding down the hill. Suddenly, he realized the danger and stepped hard on the brake. The car screeched to a halt just in time, avoiding a crash. Remember, \'brake\' stops the vehicle! **一位司机正在飞速冲下山。突然，他意识到危险，猛踩刹车。汽车及时发出尖锐的声响停了下来，避免了一场碰撞。记住，\'brake\'就是让车辆停下来！**

> Once upon a time, there was a little bird that loved to eat bran. Every morning, it would fly to the barn and look for the delicious bran. It was so happy when it found it. **从前，有一只小鸟喜欢吃麸皮。每天早上，它都会飞到谷仓寻找美味的麸皮。当它找到时，它非常开心。**

> A monkey was swinging in the forest. It jumped from one branch to another. The branches were like a maze for the monkey. It had so much fun exploring them. **一只猴子在森林里荡来荡去。它从一根树枝跳到另一根树枝。这些树枝对猴子来说就像一个迷宫。它在探索它们的过程中玩得很开心。**

> A little monkey was climbing a big tree. It saw many branching paths on the tree. It had to choose carefully to find the way to the top. The branching paths made its journey full of challenges. **一只小猴子正在爬一棵大树。它看到树上有很多分岔的路径。它必须仔细选择才能找到到达树顶的路。这些分岔的路径让它的旅程充满挑战。**

> A cowboy was proud of his horse. One day, he found a mark on the horse\'s flank. It was a special brand that made his horse stand out. With this brand, everyone knew it was his beloved horse. **一位牛仔为他的马感到骄傲。有一天，他在马的侧腹发现了一个印记。这是一个特殊的品牌，使他的马脱颖而出。凭借这个品牌，每个人都知道这是他心爱的马。**

> A thief was trying to escape. The brave policeman caught him and brandished a stick to stop him. The thief was scared and surrendered. It means to wave something, especially a weapon, in a threatening way. **一个小偷正试图逃跑。勇敢的警察抓住了他，并挥舞着一根棍子来阻止他。小偷害怕并投降了。这个单词意思是威胁性地挥动某物，尤指武器。**

> One day, a pirate was very tired after a long voyage. He found a bottle of brandy in the cabin and took a big gulp. The strong and sweet taste of the brandy gave him the energy to continue his adventure. **有一天，一位海盗在漫长的航行后非常疲惫。他在船舱里发现了一瓶白兰地，大口喝了一口。白兰地强烈而甜美的味道给了他继续冒险的能量。**

> A brash young artist entered a prestigious art competition. He was confident but too bold, showing off without listening to others. His brash behavior annoyed the judges. Eventually, he learned to be more humble. **一位轻率的年轻艺术家参加了一个著名的艺术比赛。他自信但过于大胆，炫耀而不听他人意见。他轻率的行为惹恼了评委。最终，他学会了更谦逊。**

> A brave soldier was awarded a medal made of brass. He wore it with pride, as brass symbolized his courage. The shiny brass medal reminded him of his heroic deeds in the battle. **一位勇敢的士兵被授予了一枚黄铜制成的奖章。他自豪地佩戴着它，因为黄铜象征着他的勇气。这枚闪亮的黄铜奖章让他想起在战斗中的英勇事迹。**

> A little boy was always naughty and disobedient. His parents called him a brat. One day, he broke a vase but refused to admit it. His parents were very angry and taught him to be a good child. **一个小男孩总是调皮捣蛋、不听话。他的父母称他为顽童。有一天，他打碎了一个花瓶却拒绝承认。他的父母非常生气，教导他要做个好孩子。**

> A young knight showed bravado in the battle. He charged forward fearlessly, but it was not real bravery. It was just bravado to impress others. Later, he learned true courage. **一位年轻的骑士在战斗中表现出虚张声势。他无所畏惧地向前冲，但这不是真正的勇敢。这只是为了给别人留下深刻印象的虚张声势。后来，他学会了真正的勇气。**

> A young knight named Arthur was always brave. One day, a fierce dragon attacked the village. Arthur didn\'t run away. He faced the dragon bravely and saved everyone. Remember Arthur to remember the word \'brave\'. **一位名叫亚瑟的年轻骑士总是很勇敢。有一天，一只凶猛的龙袭击了村庄。亚瑟没有逃跑。他勇敢地面对巨龙并拯救了所有人。记住亚瑟就能记住'brave'这个单词。**

> A little rabbit was lost in the forest. It bravely faced the unknown and kept looking for the way home. Finally, with its courage, it found the right path. The word \'bravely\' means to show courage and boldness. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。它勇敢地面对未知，不断寻找回家的路。最终，凭借勇气，它找到了正确的路。单词"bravely"意思是勇敢地，英勇地。**

> A soldier was in a fierce battle. Despite the danger and chaos, he charged forward without hesitation. His actions showed true bravery. He wasn\'t afraid and fought for his comrades and country. **一名士兵身处激烈的战斗中。尽管危险和混乱，他毫不犹豫地向前冲。他的行为展现了真正的勇敢。他毫不畏惧，为他的战友和国家而战。**

> A group of kids were playing in the park. Suddenly, two of them started a brawl over a toy car. They shouted and pushed each other. The others were scared and tried to stop them. **一群孩子在公园里玩耍。突然，其中两个因为一辆玩具车开始了争吵打闹。他们大喊大叫，互相推搡。其他人都很害怕，试图阻止他们。**

> A thief had the brazen nerve to walk into a store and steal right in front of the owner. \'Brazen\' here means bold and shameless. The thief was so brazen that he didn\'t even try to hide his actions. **一个小偷竟厚颜无耻地走进一家商店，当着店主的面偷东西。"brazen"在这里表示大胆和不知羞耻。这个小偷如此厚颜无耻，甚至都不试图隐藏他的行为。**

> A soldier was guarding the city wall. One night, an enemy climbed over and made a breach in the wall. The soldier was shocked and quickly raised the alarm. Thanks to him, the city was saved from a big disaster. **一名士兵正在守卫城墙。一天晚上，一个敌人爬了过来，在城墙上弄出了一个缺口。士兵震惊了，迅速拉响警报。多亏了他，这座城市才免于一场大灾难。**

> One day, a hungry mouse was looking for food. It finally found a big loaf of bread on the table. The bread was so delicious that the mouse ate it happily and felt full. **有一天，一只饥饿的老鼠正在寻找食物。它终于在桌子上发现了一大块面包。面包太美味了，老鼠开心地吃了起来，并且感到饱饱的。**

> A brave man was crossing a river. He needed to measure the breadth of the river to ensure safety. With a long rope, he found it was wide. \'Breadth\' means the distance from side to side. **一个勇敢的人正在过河。他需要测量河的宽度以确保安全。用一根长绳子，他发现河很宽。\'breadth\'意思是从一边到另一边的距离。**

> Once upon a time, in a poor family, the father worked hard every day to earn money to buy bread. He was the breadwinner. The family relied on him to have food on the table. Without him, they might go hungry. **从前，在一个贫困的家庭里，父亲每天努力工作挣钱买面包。他是养家糊口的人。一家人依靠他才有饭吃。没有他，他们可能会挨饿。**

> One day, I was playing football. I kicked the ball so hard that it hit a wall and broke. The sound was very loud. It was a bad break for my game. **有一天，我在踢足球。我踢球太用力了，球撞到墙上碎了。声音非常大。这对我的比赛来说是个糟糕的破裂。**

> A group of cyclists were in a race. One of them decided to make a breakaway and ride ahead of the pack. He had the courage to break away from the others and go for the win. **一群自行车手在比赛。其中一人决定突围，骑到队伍前面。他有勇气脱离其他人去争取胜利。**

> A car broke down on a lonely road. The driver was very worried. But luckily, a mechanic came and fixed it. \'Breakdown\' here means a failure or a sudden stop of a machine or vehicle. **一辆汽车在一条偏僻的路上抛锚了。司机非常担心。但幸运的是，一位机械师来了并修好了它。这里的"breakdown"指的是机器或车辆的故障或突然停止。**

> A brave surfer was riding the huge waves. Suddenly, a powerful breaker came and knocked him off the board. But he didn\'t give up and kept challenging the breaker. **一位勇敢的冲浪者正在驾驭巨浪。突然，一股强大的碎浪袭来，把他从冲浪板上掀了下来。但他没有放弃，继续挑战碎浪。**

> One morning, a hungry boy woke up and rushed to the table. He broke the fast of the night by eating bread, eggs, and milk. This meal was called breakfast, the first food to end the period of not eating. **一天早上，一个饥饿的男孩醒来后冲向餐桌。他通过吃面包、鸡蛋和牛奶打破了夜晚的禁食。这顿饭被称为早餐，是结束未进食时段的第一餐。**

> A thief was breaking into a house at night. Suddenly, the lights turned on and he was caught. \'Breaking\' here means to forcefully enter or damage something. **一个小偷在晚上正在闯入一所房子。突然，灯亮了，他被抓住了。'breaking'在这里指强行进入或损坏某物。**

> One night, a group of prisoners planned a breakout. They broke the locks and escaped from the prison. The breakout was a risky but successful attempt for them to regain their freedom. **一天晚上，一群囚犯策划了一次越狱。他们打破锁，从监狱逃了出来。这次越狱对他们来说是一次冒险但成功的重获自由的尝试。**

> A scientist was stuck in his research for a long time. One day, he had a sudden idea and made an experiment. Finally, he achieved a breakthrough and solved the problem. It was like breaking through a thick wall to find a new path. **一位科学家在他的研究中被困了很长时间。有一天，他突然有了一个想法并做了一个实验。最终，他取得了突破，解决了问题。这就像冲破一堵厚墙找到了新的路径。**

> A couple was very happy together. But one day, they had a big fight over a small thing. This led to their breakup. They went separate ways and their love ended. **一对情侣原本很幸福。但有一天，他们因为一件小事大吵一架。这导致了他们的分手。他们分道扬镳，爱情终结。**

> A brave knight was riding his horse. Suddenly, an arrow hit his breast. But he was so strong that he continued the journey. Remember, breast is the chest part of the body. **一位勇敢的骑士正在骑马。突然，一支箭射中了他的胸部。但他非常强壮，继续前行。记住，breast 就是身体的胸部。**

> A brave knight was running in a forest. After a long race, he stopped, breathing heavily. He felt each breath was precious as it gave him the strength to continue his adventure. **一位勇敢的骑士在森林中奔跑。经过长时间的奔跑，他停了下来，喘着粗气。他觉得每一口气都很珍贵，因为这给了他继续冒险的力量。**

> One day, when Tom was running in the park, he felt very tired. But he told himself to breathe deeply and keep going. Finally, he completed the run. Breathe means to take air into and send it out of your lungs. **一天，当汤姆在公园跑步时，他感到非常累。但他告诉自己要深呼吸并继续前进。最终，他跑完了。breathe 这个单词的意思是呼吸，即空气进出肺部。**

> A tired runner was gasping for air. Just when he thought he couldn\'t go on, he found a bench and took a breather. It was a moment of relief and he could breathe easily again. **一位疲惫的跑步者大口喘着气。就在他觉得自己跑不动的时候，他找到了一个长椅并喘口气。这是一个放松的时刻，他又能轻松呼吸了。**

> A diver was deep underwater, and his breathing became difficult. But he remained calm, controlled his breathing, and finally surfaced safely. Remember, breathing is the process of inhaling and exhaling air to stay alive. **一名潜水员在水下深处，他的呼吸变得困难。但他保持冷静，控制呼吸，最终安全浮出水面。记住，breathing 就是吸入和呼出空气以维持生命的过程。**

> A thief was running away after stealing. He ran so fast that he became breathless. He couldn\'t catch his breath and had to stop to rest. Poor thief! **一个小偷偷完东西后逃跑。他跑得太快以至于喘不过气来。他无法呼吸，不得不停下来休息。可怜的小偷！**

> One day, Tom was running a race. He was so eager to win that he sprinted breathlessly. His heart was pounding, and he could hardly catch his breath. But he didn\'t stop and kept going breathlessly until he crossed the finish line. **有一天，汤姆正在参加赛跑。他非常渴望获胜，以至于拼命地冲刺，气喘吁吁。他的心脏怦怦直跳，几乎喘不过气来。但他没有停下，一直气喘吁吁地跑，直到冲过终点线。**

> A brave climber reached the summit of a mountain. The view was breathtaking -- it made him hold his breath in awe. The vast landscape and clear sky left him speechless. Such beauty took his breath away. **一位勇敢的登山者到达了山顶。景色令人惊叹------这让他敬畏得屏住了呼吸。广阔的风景和晴朗的天空让他说不出话来。这般美景使他惊叹不已。**

> A baby was coming into the world, but in a tricky position -- its bottom was first, a breech birth. The doctor had to act quickly to ensure a safe delivery. **一个婴儿即将出生，但胎位很棘手------臀部先出来，这是臀位生产。医生必须迅速行动以确保安全分娩。**

> A farmer had many different animals on his farm. He carefully selected which ones to breed to get better offspring. The right breeding made his farm prosperous. **一位农民在他的农场里养了许多不同的动物。他精心挑选哪些动物进行繁殖以获得更好的后代。正确的繁殖使他的农场繁荣起来。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He was a breeder. He spent all his time taking care of the animals and making sure they were healthy and happy. His job was to breed the best animals. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他是一名饲养员。他把所有时间都花在照顾动物上，确保它们健康快乐。他的工作就是饲养出最好的动物。**

> A farmer was busy with breeding chickens. He carefully selected the best ones for mating to get healthy chicks. His hard work in breeding paid off when he saw the cute little chicks running around. **一位农民正忙于饲养鸡。他精心挑选最好的鸡进行交配以得到健康的小鸡。当他看到可爱的小鸡到处跑时，他在饲养方面的辛勤工作得到了回报。**

> A girl was walking in the park. A gentle breeze blew her hair. She felt so relaxed and happy. The breeze was like a friendly hand touching her gently. **一个女孩在公园里散步。一阵微风拂动她的头发。她感到非常放松和开心。这微风就像一只友好的手轻轻抚摸着她。**

> One sunny day, I went for a walk. The wind was gentle and pleasant, making it a breezy afternoon. The leaves rustled and my hair blew softly. It was such a breezy and wonderful day. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我去散步。风轻柔宜人，这是一个微风拂面的下午。树叶沙沙作响，我的头发轻轻飘动。这真是一个微风徐徐又美好的日子。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to make a special drink. He collected various ingredients and started to brew it. After a while, a wonderful aroma filled the room. The boy successfully brewed a unique and delicious drink! **一天，一个小男孩想制作一种特别的饮料。他收集了各种原料然后开始酿造。过了一会儿，一股美妙的香气充满了房间。男孩成功地酿造出了一种独特又美味的饮料！**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He had a dream of becoming a brewer. He spent years learning and practicing. Finally, he made the most delicious beer and became a famous brewer. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他梦想成为一名酿酒师。他花费数年学习和实践。最终，他酿出了最美味的啤酒，成为了著名的酿酒师。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange town. He followed a delicious smell and found a brewery. Workers were busy making tasty beer. Tom learned that a brewery is where beer is produced. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他顺着一股美味的气味，找到了一家啤酒厂。工人们正忙着酿造美味的啤酒。汤姆了解到啤酒厂就是生产啤酒的地方。**

> A witch was brewing a magic potion in her cauldron. She added strange ingredients one by one. The smell filled the room. Just as the brewing was almost done, a curious cat jumped in and spoiled everything. **一个女巫正在她的大锅里酿造一种魔法药水。她一个接一个地添加奇怪的配料。气味充满了房间。就在酿造即将完成时，一只好奇的猫跳了进去，把一切都搞砸了。**

> A corrupt official was always looking for bribes. One day, a businessman offered him a bag of money as a bribe. But finally, they were both caught. Remember, taking bribes is illegal! **一个腐败的官员总是在寻找贿赂。有一天，一个商人给他一袋钱作为贿赂。但最后，他们都被抓住了。记住，收受贿赂是违法的！**

> A corrupt official was caught accepting bribery. He took a lot of money from a businessman to do illegal favors. But in the end, justice was served, and he was punished. Remember, bribery is a crime! **一位腐败官员被抓到收受贿赂。他从一位商人那里拿了很多钱来做非法的人情。但最终，正义得到了伸张，他受到了惩罚。记住，贿赂是一种犯罪！**

> One day, a little ant was trying to cross a road. Suddenly, a brick fell in front of it. The ant thought the brick was like a huge mountain. But with its perseverance, it finally found a way around the brick and continued its journey. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁正在尝试过马路。突然，一块砖头落在它面前。蚂蚁觉得这块砖头就像一座巨大的山。但凭借它的毅力，最终找到了绕过砖头的路，继续前行。**

> A beautiful princess was preparing for her bridal ceremony. She wore a stunning white dress and a shiny tiara. Everyone was excited for this special bridal moment. **一位美丽的公主正在为她的婚礼做准备。她穿着一件令人惊叹的白色礼服，戴着闪亮的皇冠。每个人都为这个特别的新娘时刻感到兴奋。**

> A beautiful girl was walking in a garden full of flowers. Suddenly, a prince appeared and proposed to her. She accepted and became a bride. From then on, they lived happily ever after. **一个美丽的女孩正在满是鲜花的花园里散步。突然，一位王子出现并向她求婚。她答应了，成为了新娘。从此，他们过上了幸福的生活。**

> A beautiful bride was very nervous before the wedding. Her bridesmaids, dressed in lovely gowns, held her hands and gave her courage. They were like her loyal companions on this important day. **一位美丽的新娘在婚礼前非常紧张。她的伴娘，身着漂亮的礼服，握住她的手给她勇气。在这个重要的日子里，她们就像她忠诚的伙伴。**

> A little mouse wanted to cross a river but couldn\'t swim. Luckily, it found a bridge. It walked carefully on the bridge and finally reached the other side safely. The bridge saved the mouse. **一只小老鼠想要过河但不会游泳。幸运的是，它发现了一座桥。它小心翼翼地在桥上走，最后安全到达了对岸。这座桥救了老鼠。**

> A wild horse was running freely. But when the rider put on the bridle, the horse became controllable. The bridle, like a magic rope, guided the horse\'s movements. **一匹野马自由地奔跑着。但当骑手给它戴上马笼头时，马就变得可控了。马笼头，就像一根神奇的绳子，引导着马的行动。**

> A king needed to give a brief speech to his people. But he was very nervous. So, he wrote the key points on a small piece of paper. With this brief note, he successfully delivered the speech. **一位国王需要向他的子民发表一个简短的演讲。但他非常紧张。所以，他把要点写在一张小纸条上。凭借这张简短的纸条，他成功地发表了演讲。**

> One day, a busy businessman was rushing to a meeting. He held his important documents in a briefcase. But he was so careless that he left the briefcase on the train. It caused him a lot of trouble. **有一天，一位忙碌的商人正匆忙赶去开会。他把重要的文件放在一个公文包里。但他太粗心了，把公文包落在了火车上。这给他带来了很多麻烦。**
> 想象一下，一位将军正在进行一场紧急的军事行动。在行动前，他召集士兵们开了一个短会，快速传达重要信息，这个短会就是 briefing。它就像一个浓缩的信息传递时刻，让大家迅速了解关键要点。 **想象一位将军在军事行动前召集士兵开短会快速传达重要信息来辅助记忆单词 briefing，意思是简要情况介绍会；简报**

> A spy had to report briefly to avoid being caught. He quickly said the key points, using the word \'briefly\' to describe his short and precise message. **一名间谍必须简短地报告以避免被抓住。他迅速说出要点，用'briefly'这个词来形容他简短而精确的消息。**

> A fire broke out in the forest. The brave brigade of firefighters rushed to the scene. They worked together, using hoses and tools to put out the fire and save the forest. Remember, \'brigade\' is a group working for a common goal. **森林里发生了火灾。勇敢的消防队迅速赶到现场。他们齐心协力，用消防水管和工具灭火并拯救了森林。记住，\'brigade\' 就是为了共同目标一起工作的团体。**

> One night, when I was lost in the forest, I saw a bright star. It guided me out. The star\'s bright light was like a hope, making the dark forest less scary. Remember, bright means shining and full of light. **一天晚上，当我在森林里迷路时，我看到了一颗明亮的星星。它指引我走了出去。这颗星星的明亮光芒就像希望，让黑暗的森林不再那么可怕。记住，bright 意思是闪耀的、充满光亮的。**

> One dark night, a little girl was scared. But then a shooting star crossed the sky and brightened everything. The girl felt happy and no longer afraid. The light made the world seem wonderful. **一个漆黑的夜晚，一个小女孩很害怕。但接着一颗流星划过天空，照亮了一切。小女孩感到开心不再害怕。这光芒让世界变得美妙。**

> One night, I was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, a firefly flew brightly, guiding my way out. Its light was so bright that I could see clearly. The brightly shining firefly saved me. **一天晚上，我在黑暗的森林里迷路了。突然，一只萤火虫明亮地飞着，为我指引出路。它的光如此明亮，我能看得很清楚。这只明亮闪烁的萤火虫救了我。**

> One night, a little boy was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he saw a light. It was the brightness of a lantern held by a kind rescuer. The light guided him home. Remember, \'brightness\' is like that saving light. **一天晚上，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。突然，他看到了一束光。那是一位好心的救援者拿着的灯笼的光亮。这束光引导他回了家。记住，\'brightness\' 就像那束救命的光。**

> A young scientist was working in a dim lab. One day, he made a breakthrough discovery that emitted a brilliant light. The light symbolized his brilliance, showing his great intelligence and talent. **一位年轻的科学家在昏暗的实验室工作。有一天，他取得了一项突破性的发现，发出了耀眼的光芒。这光芒象征着他的才华，展现了他的卓越智慧和才能。**

> One night, I was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, a brilliant light appeared, guiding me out. It was so bright and amazing, just like the meaning of \'brilliant\' - shining and wonderful. **一天晚上，我在黑暗的森林里迷路了。突然，一道明亮的光出现了，引导我走出去。它是如此的明亮和惊人，就像'brilliant'这个词的意思------闪耀的、出色的。**

> A young scientist worked brilliantly in the lab. He solved complex problems with ease and his ideas shone like stars. His brilliant mind led to amazing discoveries. **一位年轻的科学家在实验室里表现出色。他轻松地解决了复杂的问题，他的想法像星星一样闪耀。他聪明的头脑带来了惊人的发现。**

> A little boy was playing by the river. He saw a hat floating with its brim touching the water. He carefully picked it up and noticed how the brim kept the water out. That\'s how he remembered the word \'brim\'. **一个小男孩在河边玩耍。他看到一顶帽子漂着，帽檐碰到了水。他小心地捡起它，并注意到帽檐是如何挡水的。就这样他记住了\'brim\'这个词。**

> A fish was swimming in the brine. It felt very salty but also safe, as the brine protected it from predators. One day, a little girl saw the fish and wondered what brine was. Her father explained that brine is salty water, often used to preserve food. **一条鱼在盐水里游着。它觉得盐水很咸但也很安全，因为盐水能保护它免受捕食者的侵害。有一天，一个小女孩看到了这条鱼，好奇盐水是什么。她的父亲解释说盐水是咸水，常被用来保存食物。**

> One day, Tom was in the park. He saw a little bird injured on the ground. So, he decided to bring it home and take care of it. Finally, the bird recovered. **一天，汤姆在公园。他看到一只小鸟受伤在地上。于是，他决定把它带回家照顾。最后，小鸟康复了。**

> A brave adventurer was standing on the brink of a deep canyon. He was about to take a leap of faith. The brink here represents the edge, the critical point. Just like in life, we often find ourselves on the brink of important decisions. **一位勇敢的冒险家正站在一个深峡谷的边缘。他即将要充满信念地纵身一跃。这里的'brink'代表边缘、关键点。就像在生活中，我们经常发现自己处于重要决定的边缘。**

> A brisk wind blew through the town. A girl was briskly walking, full of energy. She quickly crossed the street to meet her friend. The word \'brisk\' means lively and quick. **一阵轻快的风吹过小镇。一个女孩精神饱满地快步走着。她迅速穿过街道去见她的朋友。单词\'brisk\'意思是轻快的，活泼的。**

> A little rabbit was running briskly in the forest. It moved quickly and nimbly to avoid the big bad wolf. The rabbit\'s legs moved fast and smoothly, just like when we do something briskly. **一只小兔子在森林里轻快地跑着。它迅速灵活地移动以躲避大坏狼。兔子的腿移动得又快又顺畅，就像我们轻快地做某事时一样。**

> A little mouse was walking in the forest. Suddenly, it saw a big badger. The badger\'s back was full of bristle, looking very fierce. The mouse was so scared that it ran away quickly. **一只小老鼠在森林里走着。突然，它看到一只大獾。獾的背上长满了刚毛，看起来非常凶猛。老鼠非常害怕，赶紧跑开了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to collect glass dolls. But the dolls were brittle and broke easily when she dropped them. From then on, she knew \'brittle\' meant something easily broken or fragile. **从前，有个小女孩喜欢收集玻璃娃娃。但这些娃娃很脆，当她把它们掉落时很容易就碎了。从那以后，她知道了'brittle'意味着容易破碎或脆弱的东西。**

> A knight was about to go into battle. Before that, he decided to broach the topic of his fear to his comrades. They encouraged him, and he bravely faced the fight. Broach means to bring up or introduce a subject. **一位骑士即将上战场。在此之前，他决定向战友提起他内心的恐惧这个话题。他们鼓励了他，于是他勇敢地面对战斗。broach 意思是提出或引入一个话题。**

> A broad river flows through the big city. The river is so wide that many big ships can pass easily. People enjoy the broad view of the river and the beautiful scenery along the banks. **一条宽阔的河流穿过大城市。这条河很宽，许多大船都能轻松通过。人们享受着河流的宽阔视野和沿岸的美丽风景。**
> 想象一个小镇，以前网络很慢。有一天，一位神奇的工程师带来了一种新的技术，叫做 broadband ，就像一条宽阔的大路，让信息飞速传递，大家上网变得又快又顺畅。 **想象一个小镇，以前网络很慢。有一天，一位神奇的工程师带来了一种叫做'宽带'的新的技术，就像一条宽阔的大路，让信息飞速传递，大家上网变得又快又顺畅。**
> A bird was flying high in the sky and singing loudly. Its beautiful voice was like a broadcast, spreading joy to all the creatures on the ground. **一只鸟在天空中高高飞翔并大声歌唱。它美妙的声音就像广播，把快乐传播给地面上的所有生物。**
> 想象一下，有一个人站在广阔的田野中，拿着大喇叭向四面八方大声呼喊，传递重要的消息。这个人就是 broadcaster，他就像一个信号的传播者，让大家都能听到他的声音。 **想象有个人在田野拿喇叭向四周呼喊传递消息，这个人就是'广播员；播送者；广播公司'**

> A young man dreamed of becoming a star in broadcasting. He practiced hard, spoke clearly and vividly. Finally, his voice was heard by millions, achieving his broadcasting dream. **一个年轻人梦想成为广播界的明星。他努力练习，说得清晰生动。最终，他的声音被数百万人听到，实现了他的广播梦想。**

> A little bird wanted to explore more of the world. It flew higher and wider, and its view broadened. It saw beautiful mountains and vast rivers. Just like the bird\'s expanding sight, \'broaden\' means to become wider or larger. **一只小鸟想要探索更多的世界。它飞得更高更远，视野变得开阔。它看到了美丽的山川和广阔的河流。就像小鸟不断扩展的视野一样，'broaden'意思是变宽或变大。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange land. When asking for directions, the local people pointed the way broadly, meaning in a general direction. The traveler finally understood that \'broadly\' means not precisely but in a wide or general manner. **一位旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。当问路时，当地人宽泛地指路，意思是大致的方向。旅行者最终明白'broadly'意味着不精确，而是大致、宽泛地。**

> A pirate ship was attacked by another. The enemy fired all their cannons in one broadside, causing huge damage. It was a fierce battle at sea. **一艘海盗船遭到另一艘的攻击。敌人一次性用一侧的所有大炮开火（broadside），造成了巨大的破坏。这是一场海上的激烈战斗。**

> A little rabbit named Benny was very picky about food. One day, his mom told him to try broccoli. Benny refused at first, but after a taste, he found it delicious. Now, Benny loves broccoli! **一只叫本尼的小兔子对食物很挑剔。有一天，他的妈妈让他试试西兰花。本尼一开始拒绝了，但尝了一口后，他发现很好吃。现在，本尼喜欢上西兰花了！**

> A tourist was lost in a new city. Luckily, a kind local handed him a brochure with detailed maps and attractions. The tourist followed the brochure and had a wonderful trip. **一位游客在新城市迷路了。幸运的是，一位友善的当地人递给他一本有详细地图和景点介绍的小册子。游客依照这本小册子，度过了美好的旅程。**

> A man was trying to cook a steak. He put it under the hot sun, thinking it would be a unique way to \'broil\' it. But it turned out to be a disaster! \'Broil\' means to cook by direct heat. **一个男人试图烹饪一块牛排。他把它放在炎热的太阳下，认为这会是一种独特的"烤"它的方式。但结果却是一场灾难！"broil"意思是直接用火烤。**

> A little chicken was very worried because it was chosen as a broiler. It didn\'t want to be cooked quickly. But in the end, it became a delicious dish. Poor broiler! **一只小鸡非常担心，因为它被选为了肉用仔鸡。它不想很快被烹饪。但最终，它变成了一道美味的菜肴。可怜的肉用仔鸡！**

> A poor man was always in trouble. One day, he found all his money was gone and he became broke. He had no choice but to start over and work hard to get out of this situation. **一个穷人总是陷入困境。有一天，他发现自己所有的钱都没了，变得身无分文。他别无选择，只能重新开始，努力工作摆脱这种状况。**

> One day, I was walking on the street and saw a broken bike. Its wheel was bent and the chain was off. It looked so sad and helpless, just like the word \'broken\' means something damaged or not working properly. **有一天，我走在街上看到一辆坏掉的自行车。它的轮子弯了，链条也掉了。它看起来如此悲伤和无助，就像单词\'broken\'表示损坏或无法正常工作的意思。**

> A poor man wanted to buy a house but had no idea how. Then a smart broker came and helped him find the perfect one. The broker knew all the ins and outs of the market. **一个穷人想买房子但不知道怎么做。然后一个聪明的经纪人出现了，帮他找到了完美的房子。这个经纪人熟知市场的所有细节。**

> A young man wanted to invest but was confused. Then he met a smart brokerage expert. The expert helped him make wise choices and earn profits. Thanks to the brokerage, the young man\'s financial journey became smooth. **一个年轻人想投资却很困惑。然后他遇到了一位聪明的经纪专家。这位专家帮他做出明智的选择并赚取了利润。多亏了经纪业务，年轻人的理财之路变得顺利。**

> In an ancient competition, the athlete worked hard and won a beautiful medal. The medal was not gold or silver but bronze. It shone with a unique charm, representing the athlete\'s perseverance and effort. **在一场古代的竞赛中，运动员努力拼搏并赢得了一枚漂亮的奖牌。这枚奖牌不是金的也不是银的，而是青铜的。它闪耀着独特的魅力，代表着运动员的坚持不懈和努力。**

> A princess was attending a grand ball. But her dress seemed plain. Then, a fairy appeared and gave her a beautiful brooch. With the brooch, she became the most charming one at the ball. **一位公主正在参加盛大的舞会。但她的裙子看起来很普通。然后，一位仙女出现了，并给了她一枚漂亮的胸针。有了这枚胸针，她成为了舞会上最迷人的人。**

> A hen was brooding over her eggs in the cozy nest. She sat there patiently, thinking about how her little chicks would soon hatch. Brooding means to think deeply and anxiously about something. **一只母鸡在舒适的窝里孵蛋。她耐心地坐在那里，想着她的小鸡很快就要孵出来了。brood 意思是沉思，忧思。**

> A traveler was lost in the forest and very thirsty. Luckily, he found a brook with clear water. He drank from it and felt refreshed. The brook saved his life. **一位旅行者在森林里迷路了，口渴难耐。幸运的是，他发现了一条小溪，溪水清澈。他喝了溪水，感到神清气爽。这条小溪救了他的命。**

> One day, a little witch was flying on her broom. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and the broom started to wobble. But the witch held on tight and continued her magical journey. **有一天，一个小女巫骑着她的扫帚在飞行。突然，一阵强风吹来，扫帚开始摇晃。但女巫紧紧抓住，继续她的神奇之旅。**

> A poor boy was very hungry. A kind cook gave him a bowl of warm broth. The boy felt so good after drinking it. The broth saved him from starving. **一个可怜的男孩非常饥饿。一位善良的厨师给了他一碗温热的肉汤。男孩喝完后感觉非常好。这碗肉汤让他免于挨饿。**

> A man was lost in a strange town. He asked a local for directions but was mistakenly led to a brothel. There, he was shocked to find it was a place of ill repute. Remember, brothel means a house of prostitution. **一个男人在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他向当地人问路，却被误带到了一家妓院。在那里，他震惊地发现这是一个名声不好的地方。记住，brothel 意思是妓院。**

> One day, I got lost. I was so scared. But my brother came to find me. He held my hand and took me home safely. I felt so warm because of my dear brother. **有一天，我迷路了。我非常害怕。但我的哥哥来找我了。他牵着我的手，把我安全地带回了家。因为我亲爱的哥哥，我感到非常温暖。**

> A group of friends were lost in a forest. They faced many difficulties but supported each other like real brothers. This experience strengthened their bond, showing the true meaning of brotherhood - a close and loyal friendship among friends like brothers. **一群朋友在森林里迷路了。他们面临许多困难，但像亲兄弟一样相互支持。这次经历加深了他们的情谊，展现了兄弟情谊的真正含义------朋友之间像兄弟一样亲密和忠诚的友谊。**

> A brave knight climbed a mountain. When he reached the top, sweat dripped from his brow. But the view made it all worth it. The brow here represents the forehead where the sweat gathered. **一位勇敢的骑士爬上了一座山。当他到达山顶时，汗水从他的额头滴落。但风景让这一切都值得。这里的brow代表额头，汗水聚集的地方。**

> One day, a little bear was walking in the forest. Its fur was brown. It saw a brown tree trunk and thought it was a friend. It hugged the trunk and had a great time. The brown color made the bear feel warm and safe. **有一天，一只小熊在森林里散步。它的皮毛是棕色的。它看到一根棕色的树干，还以为是朋友。它抱住树干，玩得很开心。棕色让小熊感到温暖和安全。**

> One day, a little girl was very hungry. Her mom made some delicious brownies. The girl ate them happily and remembered the sweet taste. From then on, whenever she heard \'brownie\', she thought of that lovely moment. **有一天，一个小女孩非常饿。她的妈妈做了一些美味的布朗尼蛋糕。小女孩开心地吃了，并记住了那甜甜的味道。从那以后，每当她听到\'brownie\'这个词，就会想起那个美好的时刻。**

> A young artist was looking for a new home. One day, he found a beautiful old building made of brownstone. The unique texture and color of the brownstone charmed him. He decided to move in and create wonderful art there. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻找新家。有一天，他发现了一座由褐石建造的漂亮老建筑。褐石独特的质地和颜色吸引了他。他决定搬进去并在那里创作精彩的艺术。**

> A little girl named Lily loves to browse through books in the library. One day, she found a magical book while browsing. It opened a new world for her. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩喜欢在图书馆里浏览书籍。有一天，她在浏览时发现了一本神奇的书。这为她打开了一个全新的世界。**
> 想象一下，你在一个巨大的图书馆里，想要找到特定的书籍。这时，有一个神奇的工具，就像一个聪明的向导，能帮你快速浏览（browse）书架，找到你想要的。这个工具就是 browser，也就是浏览器。 **想象你在图书馆，有个像聪明向导的工具帮你快速浏览书架找书，这个工具就是浏览器**

> One day, Tom was playing football and accidentally fell. His leg hit the ground hard and got a bruise. It was purple and painful. But with some rest and care, the bruise gradually healed. **有一天，汤姆在踢足球时不小心摔倒了。他的腿重重地撞到地上，出现了一块淤青。淤青呈紫色，而且很疼。但经过一些休息和护理，淤青逐渐好了。**

> One day, Tom was too lazy to have breakfast and lunch separately. So he combined them and had a meal called \'brunch\'. He enjoyed this new way of eating and shared it with his friends. **有一天，汤姆太懒了，不想分开吃早餐和午餐。于是他把它们合在一起，吃了一顿叫做"早午餐"的饭。他很喜欢这种新的吃法，并分享给了他的朋友们。**

> A brave knight always took the brunt of the enemy\'s attacks to protect his comrades. One day, in a fierce battle, he faced the brunt again and emerged victorious. The brunt here means the main force or impact of something. **一位勇敢的骑士总是承受敌人攻击的主要力量来保护他的同伴。有一天，在一场激烈的战斗中，他再次承受主要冲击并取得胜利。这里的brunt意思是某事的主要力量或冲击。**

> One day, a little girl was painting. She needed to brush the colors smoothly on the paper. But suddenly, the brush fell on the floor. She picked it up and continued creating her beautiful art. **有一天，一个小女孩在画画。她需要把颜色平稳地刷在纸上。但突然，画笔掉到了地上。她捡起来继续创作她美丽的艺术。**

> A knight was fighting against a brutal monster. The monster had sharp teeth and was very fierce. But the brave knight finally defeated it. \'Brutal\' means cruel and violent, just like that monster. **一位骑士正在与一只残暴的怪物战斗。这只怪物有着锋利的牙齿，非常凶猛。但勇敢的骑士最终打败了它。'brutal'意思是残忍的、暴力的，就像那只怪物。**

> A brave knight witnessed the brutality of the evil dragon. It burned villages and hurt innocent people. The knight decided to fight against this cruelty to protect everyone. **一位勇敢的骑士目睹了恶龙的残暴。它烧毁村庄，伤害无辜百姓。骑士决定对抗这种残忍行径来保护所有人。**

> A brave knight was captured by the evil king. The king tried to brutalize the knight, making him suffer greatly. But the knight\'s spirit remained unbroken. Remember, brutalize means to treat someone cruelly or savagely. **一位勇敢的骑士被邪恶的国王俘虏了。国王试图残暴地对待骑士，让他遭受巨大痛苦。但骑士的精神始终未被击垮。记住，brutalize 意思是残忍地或野蛮地对待某人。**

> A brave detective was investigating a crime. The criminal acted brutally, hitting the victim without mercy. But the detective was determined to catch the criminal and bring justice. **一位勇敢的侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。罪犯的行为极其残忍，毫不留情地殴打受害者。但侦探决心抓住罪犯，伸张正义。**

> A strong and wild brute was trapped in a cage. It roared loudly, showing its power and fierceness. But in the end, it was tamed by a kind trainer. Remember, \'brute\' means a powerful and wild creature. **一只强壮且狂野的野兽被困在笼子里。它大声咆哮，展现着它的力量和凶猛。但最终，它被一位善良的驯兽师驯服了。记住，\'brute\' 意思是强大而野蛮的生物。**
> 想象一下，你正在吹泡泡。一个个五彩的泡泡（bubble）从你的泡泡棒中飞出来，它们轻盈地飘在空中，就像梦幻的小气球。你开心地看着这些泡泡，它们是如此美丽和有趣。 **想象你正在吹泡泡。一个个五彩的泡泡从你的泡泡棒中飞出来，它们轻盈地飘在空中，就像梦幻的小气球。你开心地看着这些泡泡，它们是如此美丽和有趣。**

> A girl named Lily was always bubbly. She laughed and talked happily at every party, like bubbles rising joyfully in a glass of champagne. Her bubbly personality made everyone around her feel cheerful. **一个叫莉莉的女孩总是充满活力、热情开朗。她在每个聚会上都欢快地笑着、说着，就像香槟杯里欢快上升的气泡。她这种活泼的性格让周围的每个人都感到愉快。**

> A brave cowboy was riding a wild horse. The horse was trying to buck and throw him off. But the cowboy held on tight. Finally, the horse stopped bucking and became calm. The cowboy won the battle against the bucking horse. **一位勇敢的牛仔骑着一匹野马。这匹马试图跳跃并把他甩下来。但牛仔紧紧抓住。最后，马停止跳跃变得安静了。牛仔赢得了与这匹跳跃的马的战斗。**

> A little boy was playing in the garden. He used a bucket to carry water and pour it on the flowers. The bucket was his helpful tool. It was blue and had a strong handle. **一个小男孩在花园里玩耍。他用一个桶提水并浇花。这个桶是他的得力工具。它是蓝色的，还有一个坚固的把手。**

> A knight was about to go into battle. But as he got on his horse, he noticed the buckle of his armor was loose. He quickly fixed it to ensure his safety. The buckle held everything in place. **一位骑士即将上战场。但当他骑上马时，他发现自己盔甲的带扣松了。他迅速将其固定好以确保自身安全。这个带扣把一切都固定住了。**

> A city boy was lost in the countryside. He saw cows, sheep, and beautiful fields. The peaceful and rural scene made him feel the charm of bucolic life. He decided to stay and enjoy the simplicity and nature. **一个城市男孩在乡村迷路了。他看到了牛、羊和美丽的田野。宁静的乡村景象让他感受到了田园生活的魅力。他决定留下来享受这份质朴和自然。**

> In the beautiful garden, a little bud was trying hard to grow. It was protected by the green leaves. One day, it finally opened up and became a bright flower. The bud\'s journey was full of hope and determination. **在美丽的花园里，有一个小小的芽苞正在努力生长。它被绿叶保护着。有一天，它终于绽放，变成了一朵明艳的花。芽苞的成长之旅充满了希望和决心。**

> A little girl was very interested in gardening. One day, she found a budding flower in her garden. It was just starting to grow and showed great potential. She was so excited and knew it would become a beautiful flower soon. The word \'budding\' means starting to develop. **一个小女孩对园艺很感兴趣。有一天，她在花园里发现了一朵正在萌芽的花。它刚刚开始生长，展现出巨大的潜力。她非常兴奋，知道它很快就会变成一朵美丽的花。单词\'budding\'意思是开始发展。**

> One day, when I was lost in a strange city, a kind man came to my aid. I called him \'buddy\' because he felt like a true friend. He guided me and made me feel safe. From then on, I remember \'buddy\' as a word for a helpful pal. **有一天，当我在一个陌生的城市迷路时，一个善良的人来帮助我。我称他为"buddy（伙伴）"，因为他感觉就像一个真正的朋友。他为我指路，让我感到安全。从那时起，我记住"buddy"这个词是表示有帮助的朋友。**
> 想象一只胖乎乎的小熊，它正躺在舒适的草地上睡觉。无论你怎么推它，它都一动不动。直到你拿出它最爱的蜂蜜，它才稍微 budge 了一下。这里 budge 就是移动、改变位置的意思。 **想象一只胖小熊，无论怎么推都不动，拿出蜂蜜才稍微移动了下，解释 budge 为移动、改变位置的意思。**
> 想象一下，你计划去旅行，首先要做的就是制定一个 budget（预算）。你计算着交通、住宿和餐饮的费用，确保不超支，这样才能尽情享受旅程。budget 就是你规划金钱使用的计划。 **想象一下，你计划去旅行，首先要做的就是制定一个预算。你计算着交通、住宿和餐饮的费用，确保不超支，这样才能尽情享受旅程。预算就是你规划金钱使用的计划。**

> A company was facing budgetary problems. The boss had to make careful decisions to control costs. He looked at the budgetary reports every day, trying to find ways to save money. Finally, they managed to balance the budget. **一家公司面临预算方面的问题。老板不得不谨慎做决定以控制成本。他每天查看预算报告，试图找到省钱的方法。最终，他们成功平衡了预算。**

> A brave warrior was always buff. Before each battle, he trained hard to keep his body strong. His buff muscles made him fearless. One day, he defeated all the enemies easily with his buff power. **一位勇敢的战士总是很强壮。每次战斗前，他都努力训练以保持身体强壮。他强壮的肌肉使他无所畏惧。有一天，他凭借强壮的力量轻松击败了所有敌人。**

> A traveler was lost in the wild. Suddenly, a group of buffalo appeared. They were big and strong. The traveler was scared but then realized they were just peacefully grazing. Buffalo means a large wild animal like this. **一位旅行者在野外迷路了。突然，一群水牛出现了。它们又大又壮。旅行者很害怕，但随后发现它们只是在安静地吃草。buffalo 就是指这样的大型野生动物。**
> 想象有一只小兔子，它总是在森林里跑来跑去收集坚果。为了保护自己不被坚果砸伤，它准备了一个柔软的垫子叫 buffer。这个垫子就像一个缓冲器，能减轻坚果的冲击力。 **想象一只小兔子准备垫子来缓冲坚果的冲击力，以此记住单词 buffer 有缓冲器、缓冲区的意思。**
> 想象一下，在一个豪华餐厅里，有一个长长的自助餐桌（buffet），上面摆满了各种美味的食物。人们可以自由地选择自己喜欢的美食，尽情享受这丰富的自助餐。 **想象在豪华餐厅里有摆满美食的自助餐桌，人们自由选择享用，以此记住buffet（自助餐；打击）这个词。**

> One day, a programmer was working hard on a project. Suddenly, the program stopped working. After checking, he found a bug in the code. It was like a tiny monster causing trouble and preventing the program from running smoothly. **有一天，一个程序员正在努力做一个项目。突然，程序停止运行了。检查之后，他在代码里发现了一个漏洞。它就像一个小怪兽，制造麻烦，阻碍程序顺利运行。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a buggy with colorful balloons passed by. The buggy was so cute that the boy couldn\'t forget it. Later, he learned the word \'buggy\' and always remembered that lovely scene. **有一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，一辆带着彩色气球的轻便马车经过。这辆马车太可爱了，男孩难以忘怀。后来，他学到了'buggy'这个单词，并总是记得那可爱的场景。**

> A little ant wants to build a home. It works hard every day, carrying small stones and branches. Finally, it builds a warm and safe home. Just like we build things with effort and time. **一只小蚂蚁想要建造一个家。它每天都努力工作，搬运小石头和树枝。最终，它建造了一个温暖又安全的家。就像我们花费努力和时间去建造东西一样。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He loved to build things. He could build houses, bridges, and even small toys. So, people called him a builder. Tom was very proud of this title. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他喜欢建造东西。他能建造房屋、桥梁，甚至小玩具。所以，人们称他为建筑工人。汤姆对这个称呼感到非常自豪。**

> One day, a little bird was lost. It flew around and finally landed on a beautiful building. The building was tall and had many windows. The bird found a safe place there. **有一天，一只小鸟迷路了。它到处飞，最后落在了一座漂亮的建筑物上。这座建筑物很高，有很多窗户。小鸟在那里找到了一个安全的地方。**

> One night, the power went out. I was in the dark until I found a BULB in the drawer. I quickly installed it and the room was bright again. The bulb saved me from the darkness! **一天晚上，停电了。我身处黑暗之中，直到在抽屉里找到一个灯泡。我迅速安装上它，房间再次明亮起来。灯泡把我从黑暗中拯救了出来！**

> A thief was trying to hide stolen jewels in his bag, but the bag had a bulge. It was so obvious that he was caught immediately. The bulge gave him away! **一个小偷试图把偷来的珠宝藏在他的包里，但包鼓了起来。太明显了，他马上就被抓住了。鼓包出卖了他！**
> 想象有个叫莉莉的女孩，她总是无法控制自己的食欲，疯狂吃东西，然后又因为内疚而强迫自己呕吐。这种暴饮暴食又催吐的行为就是 bulimia ，可怜的莉莉被这种病折磨着。 **想象一个女孩因无法控制食欲，暴饮暴食后又催吐，这种行为就是\'贪食症\'，以此记住\'bulimia\'这个单词**
> 想象一个巨大的仓库里堆满了各种货物，这些货物形成了一个巨大的整体。这个整体就是\'bulk\'。它代表着大量、大批、体积、容量等。就像仓库里货物的庞大数量和占据的空间。 **想象一个堆满货物的大仓库来理解'bulk'这个表示大量、体积等的单词**

> A brave sailor was working on a ship. When a huge wave hit, he held onto the bulkhead, which was a strong partition that separated different parts of the ship and protected everyone from danger. **一位勇敢的水手在船上工作。当一个巨浪袭来时，他紧紧抓住舱壁，舱壁是分隔船的不同部分的坚固隔板，保护了每个人免受危险。**

> A thief tried to steal a bulky box from a store. But it was so big and heavy that he struggled and was easily caught. \'Bulky\' means large and difficult to handle or carry, just like this box. **一个小偷试图从商店偷一个庞大的箱子。但它又大又重，他费力挣扎，很容易就被抓住了。\'bulky\'意思是庞大的，难以处理或携带的，就像这个箱子。**
> 从前有个农场，里面有只很强壮的公牛（bull），它总是精力充沛，横冲直撞。一天，它冲破了栅栏，大家都吓得四处跑。这只凶猛的公牛可不好惹！ **从前有个农场，里面有只很强壮的公牛，它总是精力充沛，横冲直撞。一天，它冲破了栅栏，大家都吓得四处跑。这只凶猛的公牛可不好惹！**

> A bully was driving a bulldozer in the town. He wanted to bulldoze the houses of the weak. But people united and stopped him. Remember, \'bulldoze\' means to push or destroy forcefully. **一个恶霸在镇上开着推土机。他想强行推倒弱者的房子。但人们团结起来阻止了他。记住，\'bulldoze\'意思是强行推倒或摧毁。**

> One day, a big construction site was in chaos. Then a powerful bulldozer came. It pushed away all the obstacles with its strong blade, like a brave warrior. People were amazed by its might. **一天，一个大型建筑工地一片混乱。随后，一辆强大的推土机来了。它用强大的推土铲推开了所有的障碍，就像一个勇敢的战士。人们对它的力量感到惊讶。**

> A brave detective was chasing a criminal. Suddenly, a bullet flew past his ear. He realized the danger and quickly found cover. The bullet reminded him of the importance of staying alert in dangerous situations. **一位勇敢的侦探正在追捕一名罪犯。突然，一颗子弹从他耳边飞过。他意识到危险，迅速寻找掩护。这颗子弹让他想起在危险情况下保持警惕的重要性。**

> 想象一下，在一个农场里，有一头公牛（bull）总是到处拉便便（shit），搞得农场臭气熏天。人们看到就会说：这简直是胡说八道（bullshit），怎么能这么不讲卫生！ **想象在农场中公牛乱拉便便，人们借此形容胡说八道的情况**

> There was a new student in the class. Some naughty kids tried to bully him. But a brave girl stood up and said, \'Stop bullying! We should be friendly.\' The new student felt safe and happy. **班里来了个新同学。一些调皮的孩子试图欺负他。但一个勇敢的女孩站出来说：'别欺负人！我们应该友好相处。'新同学感到安全又开心。**

> A brave knight stood on the bulwark of the castle, defending it from invaders. The bulwark was strong and tall, giving him a secure position. With his sword in hand, he was determined to protect his home. **一位勇敢的骑士站在城堡的壁垒上，抵御着入侵者。这个壁垒坚固又高大，给他提供了一个安全的位置。他手握长剑，决心保卫家园。**

> A poor man was walking along the street, looking like a bum. He had no job and no money. But one day, he decided to change and worked hard. Finally, he got a good job and a better life. **一个可怜的男人正沿着街道走，看起来像个流浪汉。他没有工作也没有钱。但有一天，他决定改变，努力工作。最终，他得到了一份好工作和更好的生活。**

> One night, I was walking in the dark and suddenly bumped into a big tree. It hurt a lot! \'Bump\' means hitting something unexpectedly. Remember my painful experience to remember this word. **一天晚上，我在黑暗中行走，突然撞到了一棵大树。疼极了！'bump'意思是意外地撞到某物。记住我的痛苦经历来记住这个单词。**
> 想象一辆汽车在公路上飞驰，突然撞到了一个巨大的保险杠（bumper），这个保险杠非常结实，保护了汽车免受严重损伤。司机下车后，庆幸有这个坚固的 bumper。 **想象一辆车撞到结实的保险杠，司机庆幸其保护了车，以此记住'bumper'意为保险杠、缓冲器。**

> One day, I was on a bumpy road. The car kept bouncing up and down. It was a very uncomfortable ride. I\'ll never forget this \'bumpy\' experience. **有一天，我走在一条崎岖不平的路上。车子不停地上下颠簸。这是一次非常不舒服的行程。我永远不会忘记这次"颠簸的"经历。**

> One day, a little girl went to a bakery and saw many delicious buns. She was so happy and bought one. The bun was soft and sweet, making her smile. **一天，一个小女孩去了一家面包店，看到了很多美味的小圆面包。她非常高兴，买了一个。这个面包又软又甜，让她笑了起来。**

> A bunch of monkeys were playing in the forest. They jumped around happily, forming a lively group. The word \'bunch\' here means a group or collection. > 想象一下，在一个寒冷的冬天，你外出时把很多衣服捆在一起（bundle），有毛衣、围巾和手套，这样方便携带又保暖。就像把不同的物品捆成一个整体，这就是\'bundle\'。 **想象在冬天把很多衣服捆在一起以方便携带和保暖来理解\'bundle\'这个单词，意思是捆、束、包**

> A young couple dreamed of having a peaceful life. They found a bungalow by the sea. It was small but cozy, with a beautiful garden. They spent happy days there. > A boy was on a camping trip. At night, he climbed into his bunk bed. But the bunk was so small and uncomfortable. He couldn\'t sleep well. \'Bunk\' means a bed or sleeping place like this. **一个男孩在露营旅行。晚上，他爬上了他的双层床。但这张双层床又小又不舒服。他睡不好。\'bunk\'指的就是这样的床或睡觉的地方。**

> A soldier was trapped in a bunker during the war. The bunker was dark and damp, but it protected him from the enemy\'s attack. Later, he safely left the bunker and won the battle. **一名士兵在战争期间被困在一个地堡里。这个地堡又黑又潮湿，但它保护他免受了敌人的攻击。后来，他安全地离开了地堡并赢得了战斗。**

> One sunny day, a little girl was playing in the garden when a cute bunny hopped by. The bunny had fluffy white fur and long ears. It looked so friendly that the girl wanted to keep it as her pet. **在一个阳光明媚的日子里，一个小女孩正在花园里玩耍，这时一只可爱的小兔子蹦了过来。这只小兔子有毛茸茸的白色皮毛和长长的耳朵。它看起来非常友好，以至于小女孩想把它当作宠物。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. But he saw a buoy floating, which gave him hope. The buoy stayed firm, guiding him safely. Remember, \'buoy\' is like a savior in the vast ocean. **一名水手在海上迷路了。但他看到一个浮标在漂浮，这给了他希望。浮标稳稳地停在那里，引导他安全返航。记住，\'buoy\'就像茫茫大海中的救星。**

> A man was lost at sea. But when he found a buoyant life jacket, he felt hopeful. The jacket kept him afloat, making him feel light and positive. > A little donkey was always sad because it had to carry a heavy burden every day. One day, it realized that this burden was a responsibility that made it stronger. So, the donkey accepted the burden. \'Burden\' means a heavy load or responsibility. **一只小毛驴总是很伤心，因为它每天都得驮着重担。有一天，它意识到这个重担是一种责任，让它变得更强壮。于是，毛驴接受了这个重担。'burden'意思是重担或责任。**

> A little ant was carrying a burdensome leaf. It struggled and sweated, but didn\'t give up. Finally, it reached the nest. This shows how hard it is to deal with something burdensome. **一只小蚂蚁驮着一片沉重的叶子。它费力地挣扎着，汗流浃背，但没有放弃。最终，它到达了蚁巢。这展示了应对沉重负担是多么艰难。**
> 想象一个办公室，里面有很多桌子，人们在忙碌地工作。这个办公室就叫 bureau。有一天，小明去 bureau 找爸爸，看到大家都在认真处理文件。 **想象一个叫做 bureau 的办公室，小明去那里找爸爸，看到大家在工作的情景，以此来记住 bureau 有办公室、局的意思。**

> A young man wanted to start a business but was constantly hindered by bureaucracy. He had to fill countless forms and wait for endless approvals. > A bureaucrat was lost in a big maze. He had many papers and rules in his hands but couldn\'t find the way out. Just like in real life, they often get stuck in complex procedures. **一位官僚在一个大迷宫里迷路了。他手里拿着许多文件和规则，却找不到出路。就像在现实生活中，他们经常被困在复杂的程序里。**

> A young man entered a bureaucratic office. Everyone was tied up in endless paperwork and red tape. He realized the word \'bureaucratic\' means full of complicated rules and procedures. **一个年轻人走进了一个官僚机构的办公室。每个人都被无尽的文书工作和繁文缛节所束缚。他意识到"bureaucratic"这个词意味着充满了复杂的规则和程序。**

> One night, a man named Bob heard strange noises. He saw a figure sneaking through the window. It was a burglar! Bob called the police quickly. The burglar was caught and sent to prison. **一天晚上，一个叫鲍勃的人听到奇怪的声音。他看到一个身影从窗户偷偷进来。那是个窃贼！鲍勃迅速报警。窃贼被抓住并送进了监狱。**

> One night, a thief quietly broke into a house. This illegal act of entering and stealing was called a burglary. The owner was shocked when they discovered the mess in the morning. **一天晚上，一个小偷悄悄地闯入一所房子。这种非法进入并偷窃的行为被称为入室盗窃。早上主人发现一片狼藉时感到十分震惊。**

> A brave knight was killed in battle. His comrades carried his body with great sadness for a burial. > One day, a farmer needed to cover his goods. He found a roll of burlap. It was rough but strong. With it, the goods were protected well. Burlap became the hero of the day! **有一天，一位农民需要遮盖他的货物。他找到了一卷粗麻布。它很粗糙但很结实。用它，货物被保护得很好。粗麻布成了当天的英雄！**

> Once upon a time, there was a strong and burly lumberjack. He could easily chop down big trees with his powerful arms. His burly figure made him stand out in the forest. People always relied on him for heavy work. **从前，有一个强壮魁梧的伐木工人。他能用有力的双臂轻松地砍倒大树。他魁梧的身材使他在森林中很突出。人们总是依靠他做重活。**

> A little firefly was lost in the forest. It accidentally flew into a cave and its tail started to burn. But luckily, a kind bird came and helped it put out the fire. > One day, I was cooking and the burner on the stove suddenly caught fire. It was so scary! But luckily, I managed to turn it off in time. The burner is the part that produces the heat for cooking. **有一天，我正在做饭，炉灶上的燃烧器突然着火了。太可怕了！但幸运的是，我及时把它关掉了。burner 就是产生热量用于烹饪的那个部分。**

> A brave firefighter was running towards a burning house. The flames were high and the heat was intense. > A hardworking athlete trained intensely every day. But soon, he felt exhausted and lost all motivation. This is burnout. It means being completely worn out from too much stress. **一位勤奋的运动员每天都高强度训练。但很快，他感到筋疲力尽，失去了所有动力。这就是 burnout（精疲力竭）。它意味着因压力过大而完全疲惫不堪。**

> A brave firefighter rushed into the burning house. His face was blackened and his clothes were burnt. But he saved the family inside. Remember, \'burnt\' means something damaged by fire. **一位勇敢的消防员冲进了着火的房子。他的脸变黑了，衣服也被烧了。但他救了里面的一家人。记住，\'burnt\'意思是被火烧坏的。**

> One day, I was traveling in Mexico and was extremely hungry. I found a small restaurant and ordered a burrito. > A little rabbit was in danger. It quickly found a place to hide and started to burrow into the ground. With its paws and nose, it made a nice and safe hole. Now it was safe in its burrow. **一只小兔子遇到了危险。它迅速找了个地方藏身，并开始往地下挖洞。用它的爪子和鼻子，它挖了一个漂亮又安全的洞。现在它在自己的洞穴里很安全。**

> A balloon was floating in the air. Suddenly, a naughty child came and pricked it with a needle. With a loud noise, the balloon burst. It was a surprising and quick moment. **一个气球在空中飘浮着。突然，一个淘气的孩子过来用针把它扎破了。随着一声巨响，气球爆开了。这是一个令人惊讶且迅速的瞬间。**

> One day, a little boy named Tom found a dead bird. He decided to bury it in the garden to give it a peaceful rest. With a shovel in hand, he dug a hole and gently placed the bird inside. > One day, Tom was late for school. He ran to the bus stop but the bus had just left. He was very sad. Then he decided to take a taxi. Finally, he arrived at school on time. > A little rabbit was lost in the bush. It was scared and didn\'t know how to find its way home. But finally, with its strong sense of direction, it got out of the bush safely. **一只小兔子在灌木丛中迷路了。它很害怕，不知道怎么找到回家的路。但最后，凭借它强烈的方向感，它安全地走出了灌木丛。**

> One day, a farmer was very busy. He had to measure a lot of grains with a bushel. But he lost his bushel and was very worried. Finally, he found it and happily continued his work. **一天，一个农民非常忙。他得用蒲式耳来测量很多谷物。但他把蒲式耳弄丢了，非常着急。最后，他找到了，开心地继续工作。**

> A little rabbit was lost in a forest full of bushy trees. The branches and leaves were so thick that it was hard to find the way out. \'Bushy\' describes these thick and dense trees. **一只小兔子在长满茂密树木的森林里迷路了。树枝和树叶如此浓密，以至于很难找到出路。\'bushy\'形容的就是这些又厚又密的树木。**

> One day, Tom was busily working on his homework. His mom called him for dinner several times, but he was so focused that he didn\'t hear. Finally, when he finished, he felt relieved. **一天，汤姆正忙碌地做着他的家庭作业。他妈妈叫了他好几次去吃晚饭，但他太专注了以至于没听见。最后，当他完成时，他感到如释重负。**

> A man named Tom was always busy. One day, he decided to start his own company to sell toys. His hard work made the company successful. > A businessman named Tom was always busy. One day, he had many deals to make. But with his smart mind and hard work, he succeeded and made a lot of money. > A thief tried to steal a precious statue, but was caught and his plan went bust. The police arrived just in time and the thief\'s dream of getting rich quickly was completely shattered. **一个小偷试图偷一尊珍贵的雕像，但被抓住了，他的计划破产了。警察及时赶到，小偷快速致富的梦想完全破灭了。**

> A little girl was lost in a busy market. There was a lot of bustle everywhere. People were moving quickly and selling things loudly. But finally, with the help of a kind lady, the girl found her way out of the bustling place. **一个小女孩在繁忙的市场里迷路了。到处都很喧闹。人们快速移动，大声地卖东西。但最后，在一位善良女士的帮助下，女孩走出了这个喧闹的地方。**

> Imagine a busy market where people are constantly moving around. Sellers shout, buyers bargain. It\'s a bustling scene with no moment of calm. This is how you can remember \'bustling\' meaning busy and full of activity. **想象一个繁忙的市场，人们不停地四处走动。卖家大声吆喝，买家讨价还价。这是一个熙熙攘攘的场景，没有一刻平静。这就是你记住'bustling'（繁忙的、热闹的）这个词的方式。**

> One day, Tom was very busy. He had to finish his homework, clean the room and help his mom cook. But he didn\'t complain. He knew being busy means making progress. **有一天，汤姆非常忙碌。他得完成作业、打扫房间并帮妈妈做饭。但他没有抱怨。他知道忙碌意味着进步。**

> One day, I wanted to go shopping, but it started raining. I was so sad. However, I decided to wait for the rain to stop. \'But\' here shows a contrast or exception. **一天，我想去购物，但是天开始下雨了。我很伤心。然而，我决定等雨停。这里的'but'表示一种对比或例外。**

> A brave knight was lost in a forest. He found a hut where a butcher lived. The butcher kindly gave the knight some food and helped him find his way. The knight never forgot the butcher\'s kindness. **一位勇敢的骑士在森林中迷路了。他发现了一间小屋，里面住着一位屠夫。屠夫好心地给了骑士一些食物，并帮助他找到了路。骑士永远不会忘记屠夫的善良。**

> Once upon a time, there was a big house. The owner relied on a man named Butler to manage everything. Butler was responsible for serving meals and taking care of guests. He was the key person to keep the house in order. **从前，有一座大房子。主人依靠一个叫巴特勒的人来管理一切。巴特勒负责上菜和照顾客人。他是让房子保持井然有序的关键人物。**

> A monkey was sitting on a tree branch, happily eating a banana. Suddenly, it slipped and landed on its butt. Poor monkey! But it quickly stood up and continued playing. The word \'butt\' means the part of the body you sit on. **一只猴子正坐在树枝上开心地吃着香蕉。突然，它滑了一下，摔到了屁股上。可怜的猴子！但它很快站起来继续玩耍。单词\'butt\'意思是身体上你坐的那个部位。**

> One day, a little girl wanted to make cookies. She opened the fridge and found no butter. So, she went to the store to buy some. Butter is so important for making delicious cookies! **一天，一个小女孩想做饼干。她打开冰箱发现没有黄油。于是，她去商店买了一些。黄油对于做出美味的饼干是非常重要的！**

> A girl was eating butter and suddenly a fly came. The butter stuck to the fly\'s wings and it transformed into a beautiful butterfly. So, remember, butter + fly = butterfly. **一个女孩正在吃黄油，突然一只苍蝇飞来。黄油粘在了苍蝇的翅膀上，它就变成了一只美丽的蝴蝶。所以，记住，黄油+苍蝇=蝴蝶。**

> A farmer had fresh butter and leftover milk. He mixed them together and got a special drink called buttermilk. The kids loved it and asked for more. It became a favorite treat on the farm. **一位农民有新鲜的黄油和剩余的牛奶。他把它们混合在一起，得到了一种特殊的饮品，叫做酪乳。孩子们很喜欢，还想要更多。它成了农场里最受欢迎的美食。**

> A hungry mouse sneaked into a buttery. It saw shelves filled with jars of butter. But just as it was about to enjoy, the cook came in. The mouse had to run away quickly. Remember, buttery is a room for storing butter. **一只饥饿的老鼠偷偷溜进了黄油储藏室。它看到架子上摆满了一罐罐黄油。但就在它要享用时，厨师进来了。老鼠不得不迅速逃跑。记住，buttery 是存放黄油的房间。**
> 想象一下，一只调皮的猴子坐在树枝上，不小心往后一滑，正好用它的'buttocks'（臀部）重重地撞到了树干。猴子捂着疼痛的buttocks，一脸的懊恼。 **想象一只猴子因滑落撞到树干，着重描述其臀部，以辅助记忆'buttocks（臀部）'这个单词。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to leave the house but couldn\'t find his jacket. Then he noticed a button on the floor and realized it had fallen off his jacket. From then on, whenever he saw a button, he remembered that incident. **一天，汤姆着急出门却找不到他的夹克。然后他注意到地板上有个纽扣，意识到是从他夹克上掉下来的。从那以后，每当他看到纽扣，就会想起那件事。**

> A brave knight was defending the castle. The walls were weak, but he found huge stone buttresses to strengthen them. With the help of the buttresses, the castle stood firm against the enemy\'s attack. **一位勇敢的骑士正在保卫城堡。城墙很脆弱，但他找到了巨大的石扶壁来加固它们。在扶壁的帮助下，城堡稳稳地抵御了敌人的攻击。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He went to a store and decided to buy a big pizza. With excitement, he paid the money and enjoyed the delicious pizza. Buying the pizza made him happy. **一天，汤姆非常饿。他去了一家商店，决定买一个大披萨。他兴奋地付了钱，享受了美味的披萨。买这个披萨让他很开心。**
> One day, Tom went to the market. He wanted to buy some apples. But he was not a seller. He was a buyer. He spent money to get the apples he needed. **一天，汤姆去了市场。他想买一些苹果。但他不是卖家。他是一个买家。他花钱得到了他需要的苹果。**
> 想象一下，在一个热闹的花园里，蜜蜂们（bees）飞来飞去，发出'buzz'的声音。突然，一只调皮的小鸟也学着蜜蜂叫'buzz'，大家都被逗乐了。这个声音就代表着嘈杂的嗡嗡声。 **想象在花园中蜜蜂和小鸟发出嗡嗡声代表'buzz'这个单词，意思是嘈杂的嗡嗡声**

> One day, Tom was in a quiet room when suddenly a buzzer rang loudly. It was so startling! He realized the buzzer was a signal for something important. After that, he never forgot what a buzzer was. **有一天，汤姆在一个安静的房间里，突然一个蜂鸣器大声响了起来。这太让人吃惊了！他意识到蜂鸣器是重要事情的信号。从那以后，他再也忘不了蜂鸣器是什么了。**

> One day, a little girl was walking home by herself. She passed by many beautiful flowers and saw a bird flying by. \'By\' means near or beside. So she knew she was safe with all these nice things by her. **一天，一个小女孩独自走回家。她路过许多美丽的花，看到一只鸟飞过。'by'意思是在......旁边。所以她知道有这些美好的事物在身边她是安全的。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a great time playing together. When it was getting late, Tom said \'bye\' to Jerry and went home happily. Jerry waved and said \'bye\' too. They knew they would meet again soon. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞一起玩得很开心。天色渐晚，汤姆对杰瑞说"bye（再见）"然后开心地回家了。杰瑞挥挥手也说了"bye（再见）"。他们知道很快会再见面。**

> In a small town, an old man often recalled the bygone days when he was young and full of energy. He told tales of simple joys and friendships. Those past times were precious and unforgettable. **在一个小镇上，一位老人经常回忆起过去的日子，那时他年轻且充满活力。他讲述着那些简单的快乐和友谊。那些过去的时光是珍贵且令人难忘的。**

> A brave adventurer was on a mission. There was a dangerous road ahead, but he found a bypass. It was a hidden path that allowed him to avoid the difficulties and reach his destination safely. **一位勇敢的冒险家在执行任务。前方道路危险，但他发现了一条旁路。这是一条隐藏的小路，使他得以避开困难，安全到达目的地。**

> One day, there was a car accident on the street. A man just stood there and watched without helping. He was a bystander. Later, people criticized him for not taking action. **一天，街上发生了一起车祸。一个男人只是站在那儿看着，没有帮忙。他就是一个旁观者。后来，人们批评他没有采取行动。**

> One day, a tired traveler was looking for a way to get home. Suddenly, a cab appeared and saved him. The cab was like a hero, taking him safely to his destination. **一天，一位疲惫的旅行者正在寻找回家的办法。突然，一辆出租车出现并救了他。这辆出租车就像一个英雄，把他安全地带到了目的地。**

> A young artist dreams of performing on a big stage. One day, she gets a chance at a cabaret. The lights, the music, and the excited audience make it a magical night. Remember, cabaret is a place for entertainment and shows. **一位年轻的艺术家梦想在大舞台上表演。有一天，她在一家卡巴莱歌舞厅获得了机会。灯光、音乐和兴奋的观众让这成为一个神奇的夜晚。记住，cabaret 是娱乐和表演的场所。**

> One day, a little rabbit went to the farm and found many green cabbages. It was so happy because cabbages are its favorite food. The rabbit ate a big cabbage and felt full and satisfied. **一天，一只小兔子去农场，发现了好多绿色的卷心菜。它特别开心，因为卷心菜是它最爱的食物。小兔子吃了一个大卷心菜，感到又饱又满足。**

> A traveler got lost in the forest and found a cabin. It was small but cozy, with a warm fireplace. He stayed there for the night and felt safe. The cabin became his refuge. **一位旅行者在森林里迷路了，然后发现了一个小木屋。它虽小但很舒适，还有一个温暖的壁炉。他在那里过夜，感到很安全。这个小木屋成了他的避难所。**
> 想象一下，国王的秘密宝藏被放在一个特别的小房间里，这个小房间就叫 cabinet 。里面有金银珠宝，外面还有卫兵看守。这个房间就像一个藏宝贝的柜子，所以 cabinet 就是橱柜、内阁的意思。 **想象国王的宝藏房间来记住 cabinet 意为橱柜、内阁**

> A brave sailor was repairing the cable on a stormy day. The cable was crucial for the ship\'s communication. He struggled but finally fixed it, ensuring the safety of everyone on board. **一位勇敢的水手在一个暴风雨天修理电缆。这根电缆对船的通信至关重要。他努力挣扎但最终修好了它，确保了船上所有人的安全。**

> A thief was running away with a bag of treasures. To hide them, he found a secret cave and used it as a cache. Later, when he wanted to retrieve the treasures, he remembered exactly where his cache was. **一个小偷带着一袋财宝逃跑。为了藏起它们，他找到了一个秘密洞穴，并把它当作一个藏匿处。后来，当他想取回财宝时，他清楚地记得他的藏匿处在哪。**

> A thief was stealing jewels and hid them in a secret cachet. But the police found it easily because of a clue. Cachet means a mark of distinction or prestige. **一个小偷在偷珠宝并把它们藏在一个秘密的印记处。但警察因为一条线索轻易地找到了。Cachet 意思是声望或卓越的标志。**

> The witch would cackle loudly every time she cast a spell. Her cackle was so distinct that it sent shivers down the spines of those nearby. One day, a brave knight heard the cackle and decided to stop her evil deeds. **女巫每次施魔法时都会大声咯咯笑。她的咯咯笑非常独特，让附近的人脊背发凉。有一天，一位勇敢的骑士听到了这咯咯笑，决定阻止她的恶行。**

> A group of animals were having a competition. The dog barked loudly, the cat meowed sharply, and the bird chirped noisily. This mixture of unpleasant sounds was a perfect example of cacophony. **一群动物在进行比赛。狗大声地叫，猫尖锐地喵喵叫，鸟嘈杂地叽叽喳喳叫。这种不悦耳声音的混合就是'刺耳嘈杂声'的完美范例。**

> One day, a little ant was lost in the desert. It was very thirsty and tired. Suddenly, it saw a cactus. The cactus had sharp thorns but also juicy flesh inside, which saved the ant. Remember, cactus can be a savior in the desert! **有一天，一只小蚂蚁在沙漠中迷路了。它又渴又累。突然，它看到了一棵仙人掌。仙人掌有锋利的刺，但里面也有多汁的果肉，救了这只蚂蚁。记住，仙人掌（cactus）在沙漠中可能是救星！**

> One day, a detective was investigating a crime scene and found a cadaver. It was a mysterious case. The detective had to figure out who the person was and how they died. This scene made the word \'cadaver\' stick in his mind. **有一天，一位侦探在调查犯罪现场时发现了一具尸体。这是一个神秘的案件。侦探必须弄清楚这个人是谁以及他们是怎么死的。这个场景让他记住了\'cadaver\'这个词。**

> One day, a golfer was playing on the course. The caddie, a helpful boy, carried the golfer\'s clubs and gave useful advice. The golfer won the game thanks to the caddie\'s support. **有一天，一位高尔夫球手在球场上打球。球童，一个乐于助人的男孩，帮球手拿着球杆并给出有用的建议。由于球童的支持，球手赢得了比赛。**

> A soldier was marching. The rhythm of his steps, the cadence, was so steady and powerful. It made his march look strong and confident. Just like his cadence, he was determined to reach his goal. **一名士兵正在行军。他步伐的节奏，即 cadence，非常稳定且有力。这使得他的行军看起来强大且自信。就像他的节奏一样，他决心要达到目标。**
> 有个年轻人梦想成为军人，他加入了军校，成为了一名 cadet（军校学员）。他努力训练，学习知识，期待有一天能为国家效力。这个 cadet 不畏困难，勇敢前行。 **有个年轻人梦想成为军人，他加入了军校，成为了一名军校学员。他努力训练，学习知识，期待有一天能为国家效力。这个军校学员不畏困难，勇敢前行。**

> Imagine a chemist in a lab finding a special metal. It\'s shiny and has a unique color. He names it \'cadmium\'. Later, he discovers it\'s used in many important experiments. So, whenever you see \'cadmium\', think of that special metal in the lab. **想象一位化学家在实验室里发现了一种特殊的金属。它闪闪发光，颜色独特。他将其命名为"镉"。后来，他发现它被用于许多重要的实验。所以，每当你看到"镉"这个词，就想想实验室里的那种特殊金属。**
> 想象一个军队的营地，有一群核心成员(cadre)，他们勇敢且有领导能力，总是冲在前面带领大家。他们就像营地的支柱，稳定且可靠。 **想象一个军队营地中一群核心成员的故事来辅助记忆\'cadre\'（骨干；干部；核心成员）这个单词**

> One day, Tom was very tired after work. He entered a cozy cafe. The smell of coffee and the soft music made him relax. He enjoyed a cup of coffee and felt refreshed. From then on, he always remembered the word \'cafe\' as a place of comfort. **有一天，汤姆下班后非常累。他走进了一家舒适的咖啡馆。咖啡的香气和轻柔的音乐让他放松下来。他享用了一杯咖啡，感觉精神焕发。从那以后，他总是把'cafe'这个词记为一个舒适的地方。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个很大的房间，里面有很多人在排队买吃的。这个房间就是 cafeteria，它就像一个美食广场，有各种各样的食物和饮料供大家选择。 **想象你走进一个像美食广场一样的大房间，里面很多人排队买吃的，这就是自助餐厅'cafeteria'**

> One day, Tom was very tired. But after drinking a cup of coffee containing caffeine, he became energetic. Caffeine is like a magic power that wakes us up and boosts our spirit. **有一天，汤姆非常疲倦。但在喝了一杯含有咖啡因的咖啡后，他变得精力充沛。咖啡因就像一种神奇的力量，能唤醒我们并提升我们的精神。**

> A bird was trapped in a cage. It longed for freedom and kept hitting the bars. One day, the cage door opened accidentally, and the bird finally flew away. Remember, \'cage\' is the place that limits freedom. **一只鸟被困在一个笼子里。它渴望自由，不停地撞击着栅栏。有一天，笼子门意外地开了，鸟终于飞走了。记住，\'cage\'就是限制自由的地方。**

> A tricky fox wanted to cajole a bird out of its nest. He used sweet words and false promises, but the wise bird saw through his tricks. Remember, cajole means to persuade with flattery and false promises. **一只狡猾的狐狸想哄骗一只鸟离开它的巢。他用甜言蜜语和虚假的承诺，但聪明的鸟看穿了他的诡计。记住，cajole 意思是用甜言蜜语和虚假承诺劝诱。**

> A little girl wanted to make a cake for her mother\'s birthday. She mixed flour, eggs, and sugar carefully. After baking, a delicious cake was ready. Her mother was so happy! **一个小女孩想为她妈妈的生日做一个蛋糕。她仔细地混合了面粉、鸡蛋和糖。烘烤之后，一个美味的蛋糕就做好了。她的妈妈非常开心！**

> A village was peaceful until a huge flood came. The flood destroyed houses and crops. This disaster was a calamity. People had to work hard to recover. **一个村庄原本安宁，直到一场巨大的洪水袭来。洪水摧毁了房屋和庄稼。这场灾难就是calamity（灾难，不幸事件）。人们不得不努力恢复。**

> One day, a little scientist was doing an experiment. He needed calcium to make a special potion. He found calcium in milk and cheese. With it, his experiment was a great success! **有一天，一位小科学家在做实验。他需要钙来制作一种特殊的药剂。他在牛奶和奶酪中找到了钙。有了钙，他的实验取得了巨大成功！**

> A smart detective was trying to solve a mystery. He needed to calculate the exact time the crime happened. He used all the clues and his math skills to find the answer. Finally, he succeeded! **一位聪明的侦探正在试图解开一个谜团。他需要计算犯罪发生的确切时间。他利用所有的线索和他的数学技能来找到答案。最后，他成功了！**

> A spy was making calculated moves to steal secrets. Every step was carefully planned and thought out. He calculated the risks and opportunities precisely. But in the end, his evil plan was exposed. **一名间谍正在精心策划行动以窃取机密。每一步都经过仔细规划和思考。他精确地计算风险和机会。但最终，他的邪恶计划被曝光了。**

> A math genius was always good at calculation. One day, in a competition, he quickly did complex calculations and won. His secret? Practice and a love for numbers. Remember calculation as the key to his success! **一位数学天才总是很擅长计算。有一天，在一场比赛中，他迅速地进行了复杂的计算并获胜。他的秘诀？练习和对数字的热爱。记住 calculation 是他成功的关键！**

> One day, Tom was doing math homework and was stuck. His friend gave him a calculator. With it, Tom could quickly calculate the answers and finish his homework. The calculator became his helpful tool. **有一天，汤姆在做数学作业时被难住了。他的朋友给了他一个计算器。有了它，汤姆能快速算出答案并完成作业。计算器成了他有用的工具。**
> 想象一个天才数学家，每天都在纸上计算无数的算式。这些算式就像石头，堆积起来形成了一门学问，这门学问就叫 calculus。它代表着数学中的微积分，是解决复杂问题的有力工具。 **想象一位天才数学家通过计算算式形成微积分这门学问，来辅助记忆单词\'calculus\'（微积分）**
> 想象一下，你有一本神奇的日历（calendar），它会说话。每天它都会告诉你当天的重要事情和惊喜。这本日历就像你的贴心伙伴，时刻提醒着你未来的计划和美好时光。 **想象你有一本会说话的日历，它提醒你重要事情和美好时光。**

> A little calf was lost in the forest. It was scared and called for its mother. Finally, with the help of a kind farmer, the calf was reunited with its mother. Remember, calf means a young cow. **一只小牛犊在森林里迷路了。它很害怕，呼喊着它的妈妈。最后，在一位善良的农夫的帮助下，小牛犊和它的妈妈团聚了。记住，calf 意思是小牛。**

> A detective was looking for a criminal. The only clue was the caliber of the bullet. It was a special caliber, which helped the detective catch the bad guy in the end. **一位侦探正在寻找一名罪犯。唯一的线索是子弹的口径。这是一种特殊的口径，最终帮助侦探抓住了坏人。**

> Imagine a scientist working in a laboratory. He has a special tool and he needs to calibrate it precisely to get accurate results. Just like that, \'calibrate\' means to adjust and make exact. **想象一位科学家在实验室工作。他有一个特殊的工具，需要精确校准它以获得准确的结果。就像这样，'calibrate'意思是校准、调整使其精确。**

> A scientist was conducting an important experiment. The success relied on the precise calibration of the instruments. He spent hours adjusting and checking to ensure the calibration was perfect. Finally, the experiment went smoothly. **一位科学家正在进行一项重要的实验。实验的成功依赖于仪器的精确校准。他花了数小时进行调整和检查，以确保校准无误。最终，实验顺利进行。**

> One day, when I was lost in the forest, I desperately CALLed for help. Luckily, a kind hunter heard my CALL and found me. From then on, I remember \'call\' means to shout loudly for someone or something. **有一天，当我在森林里迷路时，我拼命地呼喊求助。幸运的是，一位善良的猎人听到了我的呼喊并找到了我。从那以后，我记住了\'call\'意思是大声呼喊某人或某物。**
