> 画家小明总是带着一块大大的 canvas 去野外写生。有一天，他在 canvas 上画出了美丽的风景，人们都称赞他的作品。这块 canvas 见证了他的才华。 **画家小明总是带着一块大大的画布去野外写生。有一天，他在画布上画出了美丽的风景，人们都称赞他的作品。这块画布见证了他的才华。**

> One day, a brave explorer was lost in a deep and mysterious place. He later found out it was a canyon. With steep cliffs and a narrow path, it was both scary and beautiful. Finally, he managed to get out and tell others about this amazing canyon. **有一天，一位勇敢的探险家在一个幽深神秘的地方迷路了。他后来发现那是一个峡谷。有着陡峭的悬崖和狭窄的通道，既可怕又美丽。最后，他成功走出并向其他人讲述了这个令人惊叹的峡谷。**

> A little mouse was running around with a small cap on its head. It looked so funny. But the cap was too big and kept falling off. Finally, the mouse found a cap that fit perfectly. **一只小老鼠头上戴着一顶小帽子跑来跑去。它看起来很滑稽。但帽子太大了，老是掉下来。最后，老鼠找到了一顶非常合适的帽子。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious cave. He needed the capability to climb, swim and solve puzzles. With his skills and determination, he finally found the treasure. The word \'capability\' means the ability or power to do something. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。他需要具备攀爬、游泳和解决谜题的能力。凭借他的技能和决心，他最终找到了宝藏。单词\'capability\'意思是做某事的能力或本领。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little robot named Cap. He was always able to solve difficult problems. People called him Capable because of his amazing skills. So, whenever we think of \'capable\', we can remember Cap the robot. **从前，有一个叫 Cap 的小机器人。他总是能够解决难题。人们称他为有能力的，因为他出色的技能。所以，每当我们想到'capable'，就可以想起这个机器人 Cap。**

> A little mouse had the capacity to store a large amount of cheese in its tiny hole. It showed that capacity doesn\'t depend on size. The mouse\'s hole was like a container with a surprising storage capacity. **一只小老鼠有能力在它的小洞里储存大量的奶酪。这表明能力不取决于大小。老鼠的洞就像一个有着惊人存储容量的容器。**

> One day, a brave hero wore a special cape and flew to the top of a mountain. The cape gave him the power to overcome difficulties. Remember, \'cape\' is like the hero\'s magic cloth that makes him stand out. **有一天，一位勇敢的英雄穿着一件特别的披肩，飞到了山顶。这件披肩给了他克服困难的力量。记住，\'cape\'就像英雄那件让他脱颖而出的神奇布料。**

> A thief planned a caper to steal jewels from a rich mansion. But in the end, he was caught. Remember, caper means a playful or mischievous adventure or escapade. **一个小偷计划了一场恶作剧，想从一座富有的宅邸偷珠宝。但最后，他被抓住了。记住，caper 意思是嬉戏的或恶作剧式的冒险或越轨行为。**

> A king wanted to expand his territory. The city at the center, where all the wealth and power gathered, was called the capital. It was the most important place, like the heart of the kingdom. **一位国王想要扩张他的领土。位于中心，所有财富和权力聚集的城市被称为首都。它是最重要的地方，就像王国的心脏。**

> In a faraway land, there was a system where people made money by owning businesses and competing freely. This system was called capitalism. It was all about making profits and growing wealth. **在一个遥远的地方，有一种制度，人们通过拥有企业和自由竞争来赚钱。这个制度被称为资本主义。它的一切都与盈利和积累财富有关。**

> A long time ago, there was a rich man. He had a lot of money and businesses. People called him a capitalist because he made profits by owning and controlling resources. But some thought he was too focused on money. **很久以前，有一个富人。他有很多钱和生意。人们称他为资本家，因为他通过拥有和控制资源来获取利润。但有些人认为他太看重钱了。**

> A young entrepreneur started a small business. To grow, he needed funds. When investors showed interest, he learned about capitalization -- how to use money to expand. It was the key to turning his dream into a big success. **一位年轻的企业家创办了一家小企业。为了发展，他需要资金。当投资者表现出兴趣时，他了解了资本化------如何利用资金来扩张。这是将他的梦想变成巨大成功的关键。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to start a business. His mentor told him to capitalize on his unique idea. So, he used all his resources and skills, and finally made his business successful. **一位年轻的企业家想要创业。他的导师告诉他要利用好他独特的想法。于是，他运用了所有的资源和技能，最终使他的生意取得了成功。**
> 想象一下，有个小偷试图闯入国会大厦（capitol）偷取宝物，结果被保安发现并抓住。这个国会大厦有着宏伟的建筑和严密的安保。记住这个场景，就能记住capitol表示'国会大厦'啦。 **想象有个小偷试图闯入国会大厦偷取宝物，结果被抓，以此记住capitol表示'国会大厦'**
> 想象一个国家的首领（capit），在面对强大的敌人时，内心极度恐惧，最终低头认输，放弃抵抗。这个首领的行为就是 capitulate。 **想象一个国家首领在敌人面前认输放弃抵抗的情景来记住 capitulate 这个词，意思是（有条件地）投降；屈服**

> One day, a traveler was very tired. He entered a coffee shop and ordered a cappuccino. The rich and foamy cappuccino gave him great energy and made him feel happy. From then on, he always remembered the taste and the name cappuccino. **一天，一位旅行者非常疲惫。他走进一家咖啡店点了一杯卡布奇诺。那丰富的奶泡和香浓的卡布奇诺给了他巨大的能量，让他感到开心。从那以后，他总是记得卡布奇诺的味道和这个名字。**

> A fairy in the forest was very capricious. One day she decided to make it rain, and the next day she made all the flowers bloom. Her unpredictable decisions and changing moods were just like the meaning of \'capricious\'. **森林里的一个仙女非常反复无常。一天她决定下雨，第二天又让所有的花都开放。她不可预测的决定和多变的情绪就像\'capricious\'这个词的意思。**

> Imagine you are an astronaut. Before going into space, you take a special pill called a capsule. It\'s small but powerful, containing all the necessary nutrients and medicine to keep you safe and healthy in space. **想象你是一名宇航员。在进入太空之前，你服用了一种特殊的药丸，叫做胶囊。它很小但很强大，包含了所有必要的营养和药物，能让你在太空中保持安全和健康。**

> One day, a brave sailor was chosen as the leader of the ship. Everyone called him \'captain\'. He had to make important decisions to keep the ship safe and reach the destination. The captain was respected and trusted by all. **有一天，一位勇敢的水手被选为船的领导者。大家都称呼他为"船长"。他必须做出重要决定以确保船只安全并到达目的地。这位船长受到了所有人的尊敬和信任。**

> A captain was showing a group of kids pictures. He needed to add captions to explain them. The kids learned that a caption helps people understand the meaning of a picture or text. **一位船长正在给一群孩子展示图片。他需要添加标题来解释它们。孩子们了解到标题有助于人们理解图片或文字的意思。**

> A prince was captivated by a mysterious girl\'s smile at a party. Her charm was so powerful that he couldn\'t look away. Just like that, the prince was completely drawn in. Remember, captivate means to attract and hold someone\'s attention. **一位王子在一次聚会上被一个神秘女孩的微笑所迷住。她的魅力如此强大，以至于王子无法将目光移开。就这样，王子完全被吸引住了。记住，captivate 意思是吸引并抓住某人的注意力。**

> A fairy in the forest had a captivating smile. Everyone who saw it was charmed and couldn\'t look away. Her smile was so enchanting that it made people forget all their troubles. Just like this word means charming and attractive. **森林里的一位仙女有着迷人的微笑。每个看到的人都被迷住了，无法移开视线。她的微笑如此迷人，让人们忘却了所有烦恼。正如这个单词captivating所表示的：迷人的，有吸引力的。**

> A brave explorer was captured by a group of villains in a deep forest. He was held captive for days. But with his wits, he finally escaped. Remember, \'captive\' means being held prisoner or under control. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片幽深的森林里被一群坏人抓住了。他被囚禁了好几天。但凭借他的智慧，他最终逃脱了。记住，\'captive\'意思是被俘虏或被控制。**

> A brave bird was captured by a cruel hunter and put in captivity. It longed for freedom every day. Finally, it found a chance to escape and fly freely again. Remember, captivity means being imprisoned or confined. **一只勇敢的鸟被一个残忍的猎人捕获并被囚禁。它每天都渴望自由。最后，它找到了机会逃脱，再次自由飞翔。记住，captivity 意思是监禁；囚禁；关押**

> A brave knight was on a quest. One day, he caught a thief who had been stealing from the villagers. The knight became the captor of the thief. He took the thief to the king for justice. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。有一天，他抓住了一个一直从村民那里偷东西的小偷。骑士成了小偷的捕获者。他把小偷带到国王那里接受审判。**

> A brave detective was on a mission to capture the notorious thief. He followed clues, set traps, and finally caught the thief red-handed. The detective\'s success made him a hero. Remember, \'capture\' means to catch or take hold of. **一位勇敢的侦探肩负着捕获臭名昭著的小偷的任务。他循着线索，设下陷阱，最终当场抓住了小偷。侦探的成功使他成为了英雄。记住，\'capture\'意思是捕获、抓住。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a shiny car passed by with a loud honk. The boy was so amazed by the car\'s speed and beauty. From then on, he dreamed of having a car of his own one day. **一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，一辆闪亮的汽车响着喇叭驶过。男孩对汽车的速度和美丽感到十分惊奇。从那以后，他梦想有一天能拥有一辆属于自己的汽车。**

> One day, I went to a candy store and saw a pot of golden liquid. The clerk told me it was caramel, used to make delicious candies. I imagined myself swimming in the sweet caramel, having a wonderful time. **有一天，我去了一家糖果店，看到一锅金色的液体。店员告诉我这是焦糖，用来制作美味的糖果。我想象自己在甜甜的焦糖里游泳，度过了一段美妙的时光。**

> A family decided to go on a vacation. They loaded all their stuff into a caravan and set off. The caravan was like a small home on wheels, taking them to beautiful places. They had a great time in the caravan. **一家人决定去度假。他们把所有东西装进一辆大篷车然后出发。大篷车就像一个带轮子的小家，带他们去了美丽的地方。他们在大篷车里度过了愉快的时光。**

> Imagine a chef cooking. He has a big bag of carbs (carbohydrate) like rice and potatoes. These give us energy. But too many can make us gain weight. Remember, carbs are our energy source! **想象一位厨师在烹饪。他有一大袋碳水化合物，比如大米和土豆。这些给我们提供能量。但太多会让我们增重。记住，碳水化合物是我们的能量来源！**

> In a secret laboratory, a scientist was working on a special project. The key element was carbon. It was like a magical black stone that could create amazing things. With carbon, new materials were born, changing the world. **在一个秘密实验室里，一位科学家正在进行一个特殊项目。关键元素是碳。它就像一块神奇的黑色石头，可以创造出惊人的东西。有了碳，新的材料诞生了，改变了世界。**

> One day, while hiking in the forest, I came across a carcass of a deer. It was a sad sight. The carcass was left there, a reminder of the cycle of life and death. **有一天，在森林里徒步时，我碰到了一头鹿的尸体。这是一幅悲伤的景象。这具尸体留在那里，提醒着我生命与死亡的循环。**

> A scientist was studying a strange substance. It was later found that this substance was a carcinogen, which could cause cancer. So, be careful of unknown substances as they might be harmful like this one. **一位科学家正在研究一种奇怪的物质。后来发现这种物质是致癌物，会导致癌症。所以，要小心未知的物质，因为它们可能像这样有害。**
> 想象一下，一辆汽车（car）在行驶途中突然发生了严重故障（cin），就像身体里的细胞出了大问题，导致了癌症（carcinoma）。 **想象一辆汽车故障导致癌症来辅助记忆\'carcinoma（癌）\'这个单词**

> One day, Tom went to a party. When he arrived, the host asked him to show his card to enter. Tom took out the special card given to him before and had a great time at the party. **一天，汤姆去参加一个派对。当他到达时，主人要求他出示他的卡片才能进入。汤姆拿出之前给他的特别卡片，然后在派对上度过了愉快的时光。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for a warm place. It found a big box made of cardboard. It decided to make a home in it. The cardboard was thick and could protect it from the cold. **一天，一只小老鼠正在寻找一个温暖的地方。它发现了一个由硬纸板做成的大盒子。它决定在里面安家。硬纸板很厚，可以保护它抵御寒冷。**

> One day, a patient was rushed to the hospital with a serious heart problem. The doctor said, \'This is a cardiac issue.\' From then on, I remembered that \'cardiac\' means related to the heart. **有一天，一位病人因严重的心脏问题被紧急送往医院。医生说："这是心脏方面的问题。"从那以后，我记住了'cardiac'意思是与心脏有关的。**

> One cold winter day, a little girl was shivering. Her grandma gave her a warm cardigan. The cardigan had soft buttons and wrapped her snugly, making her feel loved and protected. From then on, whenever she saw a cardigan, she remembered that warm day. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一个小女孩冻得发抖。她的奶奶给了她一件温暖的开衫。这件开衫有着柔软的扣子，紧紧地包裹着她，让她感到被爱和保护。从那以后，每当她看到开衫，就会想起那个温暖的日子。**

> A cardinal was flying around a beautiful garden. It had bright red feathers, making it stand out like the most important bird. Just like this bird, the word \'cardinal\' means something very important or fundamental. **一只红雀在一个美丽的花园里飞来飞去。它有着鲜艳的红色羽毛，显得像最重要的鸟。就像这只鸟一样，单词\'cardinal\'意味着非常重要或基本的东西。**

> One day, a heart patient was in trouble. The cardiologist, a hero with a special knowledge of the heart, came to the rescue. He examined carefully and prescribed the right treatment. The patient\'s heart was saved thanks to the cardiologist\'s expertise. **有一天，一位心脏病人陷入困境。心脏病专家，一位拥有心脏专业知识的英雄前来救援。他仔细检查并开出了正确的治疗方案。多亏了心脏病专家的专业知识，病人的心脏得救了。**
> 想象一下，心脏（cardio）就像一个强大的国王，血管（vascular）是为国王服务的忠诚士兵。国王指挥士兵们有序工作，共同维护身体的和平与稳定，这就是cardiovascular（心血管的）系统。 **想象心脏像国王，血管像士兵，共同构成心血管系统**

> One day, a little girl was lost in the forest. Her parents cared a lot and searched everywhere. Finally, they found her. The word \'care\' means to show concern and attention. **一天，一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她的父母非常关心，到处寻找。最后，他们找到了她。单词\'care\'的意思是关心、在意。**
> 想象一下，在一条崎岖的山路上，一辆失控的赛车 careen 着冲了下来。它左右摇晃，速度极快，完全失去了控制。就像这个单词 careen 所表达的那样，（意为：（失控地）猛冲，疾驶） **想象在山路上失控猛冲的赛车来辅助记忆 careen 这个单词，意为（失控地）猛冲，疾驶**

> A young man was lost in his life. One day, he saw a race car speeding by and was inspired. He decided to pursue a career as a professional racer. With hard work, he achieved his dream. **一个年轻人曾在生活中迷失。一天，他看到一辆赛车飞驰而过并深受启发。他决定追求成为职业赛车手的职业生涯。通过努力，他实现了梦想。**

> A little bird was flying happily in the blue sky. It didn\'t worry about finding food or a safe place. It was just carefree, enjoying the moment and the freedom. **一只小鸟在蓝天中快乐地飞翔。它不担心寻找食物或安全的地方。它就是无忧无虑的，享受着当下和自由。**

> One day, Tom was climbing a tall tree. His friend Jack shouted, \'Be careful!\' Tom listened and moved slowly to avoid danger. This shows that being careful can keep us safe. **一天，汤姆在爬一棵高高的树。他的朋友杰克喊道：'小心！'汤姆听了，慢慢地移动以避免危险。这表明小心能让我们安全。**

> One day, a little monkey was crossing a river carefully. It stepped on the stones one by one, looking around constantly to make sure it was safe. Finally, it reached the other side safely. The little monkey was so careful! **有一天，一只小猴子小心翼翼地过河。它一块石头一块石头地踩过去，不停地四处张望以确保安全。最后，它安全地到达了对岸。这只小猴子真小心！**

> One day, Tom was so careless that he left his keys at home and locked himself out. When he realized his mistake, he was very frustrated. This shows what can happen when you are careless. **有一天，汤姆非常粗心，他把钥匙落在家里，把自己锁在了外面。当他意识到自己的错误时，他非常沮丧。这表明了粗心会带来什么样的后果。**

> One day, Tom was walking carelessly and didn\'t notice the puddle on the road. He stepped in it and got his shoes all wet. This made him realize that being carelessly can lead to trouble. **一天，汤姆走路漫不经心，没注意到路上的水坑。他踩了进去，把鞋子全弄湿了。这让他意识到粗心大意会带来麻烦。**

> A little girl was sad. Her father came and gently caressed her head to comfort her. The soft touch made her feel loved. Remember, \'caress\' means to touch gently and lovingly. **一个小女孩很伤心。她的父亲走过来，轻轻地抚摸她的头安慰她。这种轻柔的触碰让她感到被爱。记住，'caress'意思是温柔且充满爱意地抚摸。**

> A young man was hired as a caretaker for an old mansion. He cared for the place carefully, looking after every detail. One day, the owner returned and praised him for being a wonderful caretaker. **一个年轻人被雇为一座古老宅邸的管理员。他小心翼翼地照管着这个地方，留意每个细节。有一天，主人回来并称赞他是一位出色的管理员。**

> A pirate ship was sailing on the sea. They were very excited because they found a huge amount of cargo on a merchant ship. The cargo included gold, jewels and precious silks. Now you know \'cargo\' means goods carried by a ship or aircraft. **一艘海盗船在海上航行。他们非常兴奋，因为他们在一艘商船发现了大量的货物。货物包括黄金、珠宝和珍贵的丝绸。现在你知道\'cargo\'指的是由船舶或飞机运载的货物。**

> In the cold Arctic, a little boy was lost. Suddenly, he saw a group of caribou. They had big antlers and warm fur. The boy followed them and finally found his way home. **在寒冷的北极，一个小男孩迷路了。突然，他看到一群北美驯鹿。它们有着大大的鹿角和温暖的皮毛。小男孩跟着它们，最终找到了回家的路。**

> Once upon a time, an artist was asked to create a funny picture. He drew in a strange way, exaggerating features. This special drawing was called a caricature. It made people laugh and remember the unique style. **从前，有一位艺术家被要求创作一幅有趣的画。他以一种奇特的方式作画，夸张了人物特征。这幅特别的画被称为漫画。它让人发笑并记住了这种独特的风格。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He had a big dream of becoming a carmaker. He worked hard, learned skills, and finally made his own wonderful cars. Tom\'s success made him a famous carmaker. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他有个成为汽车制造商的大梦想。他努力工作，学习技能，最终制造出了自己的出色汽车。汤姆的成功让他成为了著名的汽车制造商。**

> In a wild battle, soldiers fought fiercely. Bodies lay everywhere, and the scene was filled with carnage. Blood soaked the ground as the sounds of pain and death echoed. \'Carnage\' means the cruel and extensive killing and destruction. **在一场激烈的战斗中，士兵们激烈地战斗。到处都是尸体，现场充满了大屠杀。鲜血浸湿了地面，痛苦和死亡的声音回荡着。\'carnage\'意思是残酷且大规模的杀戮和破坏。**

> A little girl gave her mother a beautiful carnation on Mother\'s Day. The flower\'s pink color and sweet smell made her mother very happy. Remember, carnation means a lovely flower given to show love. **一个小女孩在母亲节给她妈妈一朵漂亮的康乃馨。这朵花粉色的花瓣和甜甜的香气让她妈妈非常开心。记住，carnation 意思是用来表达爱的可爱花朵。**

The word \'catchy\' means easily remembered and pleasing. **一位音乐家一直在努力创作一首歌。有一天，灵感来袭，他创作了一段非常动听易记的旋律。每个听到的人都忍不住哼唱。单词\'catchy\'意思是容易记住的、动听的。**

> A young student was struggling to understand religious teachings. One day, a wise elder started to explain using the catechism. The student followed carefully and finally grasped the key points. **一个年轻的学生努力去理解宗教教义。有一天，一位睿智的长者开始用问答式教学法来解释。学生认真地听着，最终掌握了要点。**
> 想象一个国王，他对法律的执行态度非常坚决，没有任何商量余地。他的决策总是'categorical'，绝对的、无条件的。就像他说'偷东西就必须受罚'，没有任何例外。 **想象一个国王坚决执行法律的故事来辅助记忆'categorical'（绝对的、无条件的）这个单词**

> A librarian was categorizing books. She put fiction in one section and non-fiction in another. By doing this, she was categorizing them based on their types. It helped readers find books easily. **一位图书管理员正在给书籍分类。她把小说放在一个区域，非小说放在另一个区域。通过这样做，她根据书籍的类型对它们进行分类。这有助于读者轻松找到书籍。**

> A king was trying to organize his kingdom. He divided everything into different groups like food, weapons, and art. These groups were called \'categories\'. So, category means a type or class of things. **一位国王试图管理他的王国。他把所有东西分成不同的组，比如食物、武器和艺术品。这些组被称为"类别"。所以，category 意思是种类或类别。**

> A chef named Tom always catered to his customers\' special requests. He carefully prepared various delicious dishes to meet their needs. \'Cater\' means to provide what is wanted or needed. **一位叫汤姆的厨师总是满足顾客的特殊要求。他精心准备各种美味的菜肴以满足他们的需求。\'cater\'意思是满足需要，提供所需。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Tom. He was a caterer. Every day, he prepared delicious food for parties and events. His job was to make sure everyone had a great meal. So, remember, a caterer like Tom provides food services. **从前，有个人叫汤姆。他是一名餐饮供应商。每天，他为聚会和活动准备美味的食物。他的工作就是确保每个人都能享用美食。所以，记住，像汤姆这样的餐饮供应商提供餐饮服务。**

> A little girl was playing in the garden and saw a cute caterpillar. It was crawling slowly, looking like a train with many segments. The girl was so curious and decided to watch it grow into a beautiful butterfly. **一个小女孩在花园里玩耍，看到一只可爱的毛毛虫。它缓慢地爬行着，看起来像一列有很多节的火车。小女孩很好奇，决定观察它变成美丽的蝴蝶。**

> One day, a little cat was playing by the river. Suddenly, it saw a strange fish with whiskers like a cat. The little cat was very curious and called it a \'catfish\'. **有一天，一只小猫在河边玩耍。突然，它看到了一条有着像猫一样胡须的奇怪的鱼。小猫很好奇，并把它叫做"鲶鱼"。**

> A man was stressed and filled with negative emotions. One day, he decided to write down all his feelings. Through this process, he experienced a catharsis and felt much better. It was like a release of all the pent-up emotions inside him. **一个男人压力很大，充满了负面情绪。有一天，他决定把自己所有的感受都写下来。通过这个过程，他经历了一次精神宣泄，感觉好多了。这就像是释放了他内心压抑的所有情绪。**

> A little cat was lost and wandered into a big building. It was amazed by the beautiful interior and high ceilings. Later, it learned that this place was a cathedral. The cat felt peaceful and decided to stay for a while. **一只小猫迷路了，走进了一座大建筑。它对漂亮的内部装饰和高高的天花板感到惊奇。后来，它知道了这个地方是一座大教堂。小猫感到平静，决定待一会儿。**

> A doctor needed to insert a catheter to help a patient. The patient was very nervous, but the doctor said, \'Don\'t worry, this catheter will make you feel better soon.\' **一位医生需要插入一根导管来帮助一位病人。病人非常紧张，但医生说："别担心，这根导管很快会让你感觉好起来。"**

> A farmer has a big farm with many cattle. The cattle are big and strong. They give the farmer milk and help plow the fields. The farmer loves his cattle very much and takes good care of them. **一位农民有一个大农场，里面有很多牛。这些牛又大又壮。它们给农民提供牛奶，还帮忙犁地。农民非常爱他的牛，并悉心照料它们。**

> A little cat was lost and found itself on a narrow walkway. It was scared but bravely moved forward. This narrow walkway was called a catwalk. Later, people used the word \'catwalk\' for narrow paths, especially in fashion shows. **一只小猫迷路了，发现自己在一条狭窄的走道上。它很害怕但勇敢地向前走。这条狭窄的走道被称为 catwalk。后来，人们用'catwalk'这个词来表示狭窄的通道，特别是在时装秀中。**

> In a small town, politicians gathered for a caucus. They discussed plans in a secret room. A curious kid peeked in and learned about the important decisions. Remember, a caucus is a meeting of a group within a political party. **在一个小镇上，政客们为了一场核心会议聚集。他们在一个秘密房间里讨论计划。一个好奇的孩子偷看，了解到了重要的决定。记住，caucus 指的是政党内部的小组会议。**

> In a dark forest, a witch was brewing a magic potion in a big cauldron. The cauldron was steaming and bubbling, full of mysterious ingredients. Suddenly, a bright light shone from it. **在一片黑暗的森林里，一个女巫正在一个大锅里煮魔法药水。这个大锅冒着热气，翻腾着，里面充满了神秘的配料。突然，一道亮光从里面射出。**

> One day, a little rabbit was very hungry. It found a strange vegetable in the garden. The vegetable looked like a white flower, but it was called cauliflower. The rabbit ate it and felt full and happy. **有一天，一只小兔子非常饿。它在花园里发现了一种奇怪的蔬菜。这种蔬菜看起来像一朵白色的花，但它叫花椰菜。兔子吃了它，感到饱饱的很开心。**

> A scientist was studying a disease. He found that a certain virus was the causal factor. Without this virus, the disease wouldn\'t happen. So, \'causal\' means causing or relating to a cause. **一位科学家正在研究一种疾病。他发现某种病毒是致病因素。没有这种病毒，疾病就不会发生。所以，\'causal\'意思是引起的或与原因有关的。**

> One day, a scientist was studying a series of events. He found that one event always led to another, and this connection was called causality. Just like a domino effect, each cause had an effect. **有一天，一位科学家在研究一系列事件。他发现一个事件总是导致另一个事件，这种联系就被称为因果关系。就像多米诺骨牌效应，每个原因都有一个结果。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He found that one event was the causation of another. A fire was the causation of the damage to the house. Now you know causation means the act of causing something to happen. **一位侦探正在破解一个谜团。他发现一件事是另一件事的起因。一场火灾是房屋受损的起因。现在你知道 causation 意思是导致某事发生的行为。**

> One day, a fire broke out in the forest. People investigated and found that a camper\'s carelessness was the cause. Because of this cause, many trees were damaged. **有一天，森林里发生了火灾。人们调查后发现，是一位露营者的粗心大意导致的。因为这个原因，许多树木被毁了。**

> A chemist was handling some caustic substances in the lab. One drop spilled on his hand, causing a painful burn. He learned that caustic materials can be very dangerous and harmful. **一位化学家在实验室处理一些腐蚀性物质。一滴溅到他手上，导致了疼痛的灼伤。他明白了腐蚀性的 caustic 物质可能非常危险有害。**

> One day, Tom was walking along a busy street. There was a sign that said \'Caution! Wet Floor\'. But Tom didn\'t pay attention and slipped. From then on, he always remembered to be cautious when seeing such signs. **有一天，汤姆走在一条繁忙的街道上。有个牌子写着'小心！地板湿滑'。但汤姆没在意，滑倒了。从那以后，他看到这样的标志总会记得要小心。**

> A young detective was always cautiousary when solving cases. Once, he ignored a small clue and almost made a big mistake. From then on, he reminded himself to be extra careful. This made him a great detective. **一位年轻的侦探在破案时总是小心谨慎。有一次，他忽略了一个小线索，差点犯下大错。从那以后，他提醒自己要格外小心。这使他成为了一名出色的侦探。**

> A little mouse was always cautious when looking for food. It checked every corner carefully before moving, afraid of being caught by cats. Just like this mouse, being cautious means being careful and watchful. **一只小老鼠在寻找食物时总是小心翼翼。它在行动前仔细检查每个角落，害怕被猫抓住。就像这只老鼠一样，cautious 意味着小心谨慎、警惕。**

> One day, Tom was walking in a dark cave cautiously. He moved step by step, afraid of any danger. Finally, he came out safely because of his cautious attitude. **有一天，汤姆小心翼翼地在一个黑暗的洞穴里行走。他一步一步地移动，害怕任何危险。最终，由于他谨慎的态度，他安全地走了出来。**

> In a wild battle, the cavalry charged forward fearlessly. Their horses galloped fast, and the soldiers on horseback were like brave knights. The cavalry\'s appearance turned the tide of the war. **在一场激烈的战斗中，骑兵们无畏地向前冲锋。他们的马飞奔着，马背上的士兵就像勇敢的骑士。骑兵的出现扭转了战争的局势。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a dark forest. When it rained heavily, he luckily found a cave. It was deep and quiet inside. He took shelter there and was safe. The cave became his savior. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗的森林中迷路了。当雨下得很大时，他幸运地发现了一个洞穴。里面又深又安静。他在那里躲避，安然无恙。这个洞穴成了他的救星。**

> A young adventurer was about to enter a mysterious cave. Just as he was about to step in, an old wise man appeared and gave him a caveat: \'Beware of hidden traps inside!\' The adventurer understood the warning and was cautious. **一位年轻的冒险家正要进入一个神秘的洞穴。就在他即将踏入时，一位睿智的老人出现并给他一个告诫：'小心里面隐藏的陷阱！'冒险家明白了这个警告并变得谨慎起来。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, he discovered a hidden entrance and entered. It was a cavern full of mysteries and strange sounds. But he wasn\'t afraid and explored it bravely. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗的森林中迷路了。突然，他发现一个隐藏的入口并进入。这是一个充满神秘和奇怪声音的洞穴。但他并不害怕，勇敢地探索着。**

> A brave explorer entered a cavernous cave. It was so huge and deep that it seemed endless. The darkness and echoes made him feel small. \'Cavernous\' describes something like this cave, very large and spacious. **一位勇敢的探险家进入了一个巨大的洞穴。它是如此的巨大和深邃，似乎没有尽头。黑暗和回声让他感到自己很渺小。'cavernous'这个词就形容像这样巨大且宽敞的东西。**

> A rich man was having a party. He served caviar to show his wealth. But a poor boy had no idea what it was. The rich man explained that caviar is a luxury food made from fish eggs. The boy was amazed. **一个富人正在举办派对。他端上鱼子酱来彰显他的财富。但一个穷孩子不知道那是什么。富人解释说鱼子酱是一种由鱼卵制成的奢侈品食物。孩子感到很惊讶。**

> A brave explorer was in a dark cave. Suddenly, he fell into a deep cavity. It was like a hidden trap. But he didn\'t panic and found a way out. Remember, cavity is a hollow space. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个黑暗的洞穴里。突然，他掉进了一个深深的洞腔。这就像一个隐藏的陷阱。但他没有惊慌，并找到了出路。记住，cavity 是洞；腔；凹处的意思。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a desert. Suddenly, he found a special plant called cayenne. It was so spicy that it gave him the energy to keep going and finally find his way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在沙漠中迷路了。突然，他发现了一种特殊的植物叫卡宴辣椒。它非常辣，给了他继续前进的能量，最终找到了出路。**

> A factory was making a lot of noise and disturbing the neighborhood. But one day, it decided to cease the operation and become quiet. The people were so happy. Now you know \'cease\' means to stop. **一家工厂噪音很大，扰乱了周边。但有一天，它决定停止运作，变得安静了。人们非常高兴。现在你知道'cease'意思是停止。**

> A long time ago, in a deep forest, there was a big cedar tree. It stood tall and strong, providing shade for many little animals. Its fragrance filled the air. Everyone loved this beautiful cedar. **很久很久以前，在一片幽深的森林里，有一棵大大的雪松。它高大挺拔，为许多小动物提供了树荫。它的香气弥漫在空气中。大家都喜爱这棵美丽的雪松。**

> A king was forced to cede his territory during a fierce war. He had no choice but to give up the land he once ruled. Remember, when the king had to give up, that\'s cede. **一位国王在一场激烈的战争中被迫割让他的领土。他别无选择，只能放弃他曾经统治的土地。记住，当国王不得不放弃时，那就是cede（割让；放弃）。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个古老的城堡，抬头看到屋顶上精美的壁画。那个屋顶就是 \'ceiling\' 。它就像天空的边界，阻挡着外面的风雨。你记住这个画面，就能记住 \'ceiling\' 是天花板、顶篷的意思啦。 **想象你走进城堡看到屋顶的画面来记住\'ceiling\'表示天花板、顶篷的意思**

> One day, I was walking in the street and saw a huge crowd. I pushed through and found a celeb signing autographs. It was so exciting! Later I realized that being a celeb means having many fans and attention. **有一天，我走在街上，看到一大群人。我挤过去，发现一位名人在签名。太令人兴奋了！后来我意识到成为名人意味着有很多粉丝和关注。**

> A group of friends gathered to celebrate a special day. They had a big party with music, food and laughter. They were celebrating the success of one of them. It was a joyous occasion. **一群朋友聚在一起庆祝一个特别的日子。他们举办了一场盛大的派对，有音乐、美食和欢笑。他们在庆祝其中一人的成功。这是一个欢乐的时刻。**

> A famous artist was celebrated by the whole city. Everyone came to his exhibition. His paintings were so wonderful that they made him widely known. The word \'celebrated\' means famous and highly praised. **一位著名的艺术家受到了整个城市的赞誉。每个人都来参加他的展览。他的画作如此精彩，使他广为人知。单词\'celebrated\'意思是著名的，备受称赞的。**

> A big celebration was held in the town. Everyone wore colorful clothes and there were balloons everywhere. People danced and sang to celebrate the victory of the local sports team. It was a joyous celebration! **在镇上举行了一场盛大的庆祝活动。每个人都穿着五颜六色的衣服，到处都是气球。人们跳舞唱歌，庆祝当地运动队的胜利。这是一场欢乐的庆祝！**

> A young girl dreams of becoming a celebrity. One day, she gets a chance to perform on a big stage. With hard work and talent, she gains fame and becomes a well-known celebrity. People love her for her amazing skills. **一个年轻女孩梦想成为名人。有一天，她获得在大舞台上表演的机会。凭借努力和天赋，她声名鹊起，成为了知名的名人。人们因她出色的技艺而喜爱她。**

> One day, a little rabbit was very hungry. It found some celery in the garden. The celery was green and fresh. The rabbit ate it happily and felt full. Celery became its favorite food. **有一天，一只小兔子非常饿。它在花园里发现了一些芹菜。芹菜又绿又新鲜。兔子开心地吃了起来，感觉饱饱的。芹菜成了它最喜欢的食物。**

> A brave astronaut was on a mission in space. Looking out of the window, he saw countless celestial bodies like stars and planets. They were so beautiful and mysterious. \'Celestial\' means relating to the sky or heaven. **一位勇敢的宇航员正在执行太空任务。从窗口望去，他看到了无数像星星和行星这样的天体。它们如此美丽和神秘。'celestial'意思是与天空或天堂有关的。**

> A prince chose celibacy to focus on ruling his kingdom. He resisted all romantic distractions and dedicated himself fully to his people. Through this, he achieved great success. **一位王子选择独身生活，以便专注于统治他的王国。他抵制了所有的浪漫诱惑，全身心地投入到他的子民身上。通过这样，他取得了巨大的成功。**

> A young man decided to be a celibate and focus on his art. He resisted all romantic temptations. But one day, a charming girl appeared. He struggled but remained celibate, finally achieving great success in his art career. **一个年轻人决定成为独身者并专注于他的艺术。他抵制了所有浪漫的诱惑。但有一天，一个迷人的女孩出现了。他挣扎但仍保持独身，最终在他的艺术生涯中取得了巨大的成功。**

> A little ant was lost in a big building. It found a small room, which was like a cell. There was only one window and a simple bed. The ant felt lonely in this tiny space. **一只小蚂蚁在一座大建筑里迷路了。它发现了一个小房间，就像一个单人牢房。只有一扇窗户和一张简单的床。这只蚂蚁在这个狭小的空间里感到很孤独。**

> A brave mouse named Jerry lived in a dark cellar. It was full of old wine bottles and mysterious corners. Jerry had many adventures there. One day, he found a hidden treasure chest. The cellar became his secret world. **一只勇敢的老鼠杰瑞住在一个黑暗的地窖里。那里满是旧酒瓶和神秘的角落。杰瑞在那有许多冒险。有一天，他发现了一个隐藏的宝箱。这个地窖成了他的秘密世界。**

> A little mouse wanted to play a big instrument. It found a \'cello\' and climbed on it. The sound it made was so beautiful. The mouse was very happy and decided to practice every day. **一只小老鼠想演奏一个大乐器。它发现了一个'大提琴'并爬了上去。它发出的声音非常美妙。小老鼠非常高兴，决定每天练习。**

> A scientist was working in the lab. One day, he discovered a special material that was transparent and flexible, like magic. He named it \'cellophane\'. It was like a thin veil that could protect and show things clearly. **一位科学家在实验室工作。有一天，他发现了一种特殊的材料，透明且有弹性，像魔法一样。他将其命名为"玻璃纸"。它就像一层薄纱，既能保护又能清晰展示物品。**

> Imagine a city where each building is like a cell. These cells are connected and communicate with each other, forming a complex and organized \'cellular\' network. Just like cells in our body, they work together for the whole to function smoothly. **想象一座城市，每栋建筑就像一个细胞。这些细胞相互连接和交流，形成了一个复杂且有组织的"蜂窝状"网络。就像我们身体里的细胞一样，它们共同协作以使整体运转顺畅。**

> A builder was in a hurry to finish a project. He needed cement to hold the bricks together. Without cement, the building would collapse. So, he made sure to have enough cement to make it strong and stable. **一位建筑工人急于完成一个项目。他需要水泥将砖块粘在一起。没有水泥，建筑物就会倒塌。所以，他确保有足够的水泥使其坚固稳定。**

> A brave knight was lost in a dark forest. He found a sign that said \'cemetery\' and followed it. There, he saw many tombstones and realized it was a place for the dead. He felt scared and ran away quickly. **一位勇敢的骑士在黑暗的森林中迷路了。他发现一个写着\'cemetery（墓地）\'的标志并跟着它。在那里，他看到许多墓碑，意识到这是死者的安息之地。他感到害怕，迅速跑开了。**

> A censor is like a strict guard at the gate of a library. He checks every book and decides if some parts should be hidden. Just like that, a censor examines and may remove or restrict what is considered inappropriate or sensitive. **审查员就像图书馆门口的严格守卫。他检查每一本书，并决定某些部分是否应被隐藏。就像这样，审查员审查并可能删除或限制被认为不合适或敏感的内容。**

> A chaplain was invited to a big party. But he got lost on the way. Luckily, a kind girl guided him. When he finally arrived, everyone was happy. The chaplain brought peace and joy to the party. **一位牧师被邀请去一个大型聚会。但他在路上迷路了。幸运的是，一个善良的女孩给他指路。当他最终到达时，每个人都很高兴。这位牧师给聚会带来了和平与欢乐。**
> 想象一下，你正在读一本精彩的魔法书。每一次书翻开新的一页，就像是进入了一个新的\'chapter\'（章节），里面充满了新奇的冒险和神秘的故事。 **想象你在读一本魔法书，每翻开新的一页就像进入新的章节，充满新奇冒险和神秘故事来辅助记忆单词\'chapter\'（章节）**

> A witch was casting a magic spell. She needed to char some special wood to release the power. But she was too careless and charred her own dress. Now you know \'char\' means to burn and blacken something by fire. **一位女巫正在施魔法。她需要烧焦一些特殊的木头来释放力量。但她太粗心了，把自己的裙子烧焦了。现在你知道'char'意思是用火把某物烧焦变黑。**

> Once upon a time, a hero showed great character. He was brave in the face of danger and kind to others. His strong character made him a role model. Remember, character means the nature or qualities of a person. **从前，有一位英雄展现出了伟大的性格。他在危险面前勇敢，对他人友善。他坚强的性格使他成为榜样。记住，character 意思是人的性格或品质。**

> A brave knight had many characteristics. He was strong, wise, and kind. His strength helped him fight, his wisdom guided his decisions, and his kindness made people love him. These traits made him a true hero. **一位勇敢的骑士有许多特征。他强壮、睿智且善良。他的力量助其战斗，他的智慧引导决策，他的善良让人喜爱。这些特质使他成为真正的英雄。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The key was the characterization of each suspect. He carefully observed their behaviors and words to figure out their true nature. Finally, he caught the criminal based on accurate characterization. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。关键在于对每个嫌疑人的性格刻画。他仔细观察他们的行为和言语来弄清楚他们的真实本性。最终，他依据准确的性格刻画抓住了罪犯。**

> A detective was trying to characterize the criminal. He observed every detail, like the way the criminal walked and talked. Finally, he could describe the criminal accurately and catch him. **一位侦探试图描绘罪犯的特征。他观察每一个细节，比如罪犯走路和说话的方式。最后，他能够准确地描述罪犯并抓住他。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的派对上，人们都戴着面具玩猜谜游戏。每个人的动作和表情都像是一场伪装的表演，这就是 charade（伪装；猜字谜游戏）。 **想象在神秘派对上人们戴面具玩猜谜游戏来体现 charade 这个单词，意思是伪装；猜字谜游戏**

> A brave artist was painting in a forest. Suddenly, his paints ran out. But he found some wood and made charcoal to continue his art. The charcoal helped him create a beautiful picture. **一位勇敢的艺术家正在森林里画画。突然，他的颜料用完了。但他找到了一些木头并制成了木炭，以继续他的艺术创作。木炭帮助他创作了一幅美丽的画。**

> A brave knight was in charge of defending the castle. One day, an enemy army charged towards the castle. The knight led his soldiers to fight and they successfully charged the enemy back. **一位勇敢的骑士负责守卫城堡。有一天，一支敌军向城堡冲锋。骑士带领他的士兵作战，他们成功地向敌军反击。**

> A brave knight was on a long journey. His horse was tired, but luckily he found a charger - a powerful and energetic horse that helped him continue his adventure. With the charger, the knight could move fast and reach his destination. **一位勇敢的骑士正在长途旅行。他的马累了，但幸运的是他找到了一匹战马------一匹强大而精力充沛的马，帮助他继续他的冒险。有了这匹战马，骑士能够快速前进并到达目的地。**

> A brave knight was charging towards the enemy\'s castle on his powerful horse. His face was determined as he held his sword high, ready to fight. The act of moving forward quickly and forcefully was called charging. **一位勇敢的骑士骑着他强壮的马向敌人的城堡冲锋。他高举着剑，表情坚定，准备战斗。这种快速有力地向前移动的行为就叫做charging。**

> In ancient times, a brave warrior named Tom always rode a chariot into battle. The chariot was decorated with colorful flags and shiny metals. It was his powerful weapon and companion. With it, Tom won many victories. **在古代，有个叫汤姆的勇敢战士总是乘着一辆双轮战车进入战场。这辆战车装饰着五彩的旗帜和闪亮的金属。它是他强大的武器和伙伴。凭借它，汤姆赢得了许多胜利。**

> A young leader named Lily had charisma. People were drawn to her like magnets. Her smile and words could inspire and unite. With this charisma, she led her team to success in every project. **一位名叫莉莉的年轻领导者具有非凡的魅力。人们像被磁铁吸引一样被她吸引。她的微笑和话语能够鼓舞和团结大家。凭借这种魅力，她带领她的团队在每个项目中都取得了成功。**

> A young leader was giving a speech. Everyone was attracted by his charm and energy. He had a charismatic personality that made people believe in him. His words and expressions were so powerful. > A rich man saw a poor family struggling. He had a charitable heart and decided to give them money and food. His kind act made a big difference. Remember, \'charitable\' means kind and generous in giving to those in need. **一个富人看到一个贫困的家庭在苦苦挣扎。他有一颗慈善的心，决定给他们钱和食物。他的善举产生了很大的影响。记住，'charitable'意思是对有需要的人友善且慷慨地给予帮助。**

> A poor girl was in trouble. But many kind people came to help her with charity. They gave her food, clothes and money. Because of their charity, the girl\'s life became better. **一个贫穷的女孩陷入了困境。但很多善良的人带着慈善之心来帮助她。他们给她食物、衣服和钱。因为他们的慈善，女孩的生活变得更好了。**

> A fairy had a charm that could make everyone happy. One day, a sad boy met the fairy. She used the charm and the boy\'s smile came back. The charm was like magic, bringing joy wherever it went. **一个仙女有一个魅力，能让每个人都开心。有一天，一个悲伤的男孩遇到了仙女。她使用了魅力，男孩的笑容回来了。这个魅力就像魔法，所到之处带来欢乐。**

> A prince was searching for his true love. One day, he met a girl in a forest. Her smile was charming and her eyes were full of kindness. The prince fell in love with her at first sight. **一位王子正在寻找他的真爱。有一天，他在森林里遇到一个女孩。她的笑容迷人，眼睛里充满了善意。王子对她一见钟情。**

> A brave sailor was lost at sea. He had only a chart to guide him. The chart showed the way to the nearest island. With its help, he finally reached safety. Remember, a chart can save you! **一位勇敢的水手在海上迷路了。他只有一张航海图来指引方向。这张图显示了去最近岛屿的路线。在它的帮助下，他最终安全抵达。记住，chart（图表、航海图）能拯救你！**

> A group of adventurers wanted to explore a mysterious island. So, they got a charter, a special permission document, to rent a ship and start their exciting journey. **一群冒险家想要探索一座神秘的岛屿。于是，他们获得了一份宪章，一份特殊的许可文件，租了一艘船，开始了他们激动人心的旅程。**

> A group of adventurers chartered a special plane to explore a mysterious island. They had a chartered journey full of excitement and unknowns. Chartered here means hired or leased specially for a particular purpose. **一群冒险家包租了一架特殊的飞机去探索一个神秘的岛屿。他们有一次专门包租的充满刺激和未知的旅程。这里的chartered意思是为特定目的专门租用或租赁。**

> One day, a little mouse was happily eating cheese. Suddenly, a big cat appeared and started to chase the mouse. The mouse ran as fast as it could to escape. The chase was very intense! **有一天，一只小老鼠正在开心地吃奶酪。突然，一只大猫出现并开始追逐这只老鼠。老鼠尽可能快地跑以逃脱。这场追逐非常激烈！**

> One day, a little rabbit was running in the forest. Suddenly, it noticed a chaser behind it. The chaser was a fierce wolf. The little rabbit had to run as fast as it could to escape. **一天，一只小兔子在森林里跑。突然，它注意到身后有个追逐者。这个追逐者是一只凶猛的狼。小兔子不得不拼命跑以逃脱。**

> A brave adventurer was crossing a mountain. Suddenly, he encountered a deep and wide chasm. He had to find a way to jump over it to continue his journey. The chasm was like a big gap blocking his path. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在穿越一座山。突然，他遇到了一个又深又宽的裂口。他必须想办法跳过去才能继续他的旅程。这个裂口就像一个巨大的缺口挡住了他的路。**
> 想象一下，一辆酷炫的赛车在赛道上飞驰。赛车的框架，也就是它的'chassis'，是支撑整个车身的关键结构。就像人的骨骼一样，它坚固又重要，让赛车能稳定行驶。 **想象一辆赛车，其框架即'chassis'，是支撑车身的关键，如人的骨骼，坚固重要，使车稳定行驶。**

> A naughty child broke the vase. The angry mother decided to chastise him. She sternly scolded and punished him, making him understand that bad behavior has consequences. **一个顽皮的孩子打碎了花瓶。愤怒的母亲决定惩戒他。她严厉地训斥并惩罚了他，让他明白不良行为是有后果的。**

> A princess named Lily was known for her chastity. Despite many temptations and suitors, she remained pure and true to her values. Her chastity made her a role model in the kingdom. **一位名叫莉莉的公主以贞洁著称。尽管有许多诱惑和追求者，她依然保持纯洁，坚守自己的价值观。她的贞洁使她成为王国中的楷模。**

> One day, Tom was feeling lonely. So, he opened his computer and started to chat with a friendly stranger. They shared stories and jokes, and Tom had a great time. Chat made his day more enjoyable. **一天，汤姆感到很孤独。于是，他打开电脑，开始和一个友好的陌生人聊天。他们分享故事和笑话，汤姆度过了一段美好的时光。聊天让他这一天更愉快了。**
> 有一只小猴子，特别喜欢不停地 chatter 。它整天坐在树枝上，嘴巴动个不停，和同伴们分享着各种趣事。它的 chatter 声在森林里回荡，大家都知道它是个小话痨。 **有一只小猴子，特别喜欢不停地喋喋不休。它整天坐在树枝上，嘴巴动个不停，和同伴们分享着各种趣事。它的喋喋不休声在森林里回荡，大家都知道它是个小话痨。**
> 有一天，一位富豪着急出门，他的司机（chauffeur）迅速将豪车开到门口。这位 chauffeur 技术娴熟，总是能安全准时地送达目的地，富豪对他十分信任。 **有一天，一位富豪着急出门，他的司机迅速将豪车开到门口。这位司机技术娴熟，总是能安全准时地送达目的地，富豪对他十分信任。**

> One day, I went shopping. I found a beautiful dress sold cheaply. I was so happy because I could buy it without spending too much money. It was a great deal! **有一天，我去购物。我发现一件漂亮的裙子卖得很便宜。我非常高兴，因为我不用花太多钱就能买到它。这真是太划算了！**

> One day, in a game competition, Tom was accused of being a cheater. He had secretly used unfair means to win. Everyone was angry and disappointed. > A king was very worried about the safety of his treasure chest. So, he sent a guard to check it every day. The guard carefully examined the chest to make sure everything was fine. **一位国王非常担心他的宝箱的安全。所以，他每天派一名守卫去检查。守卫仔细查看宝箱以确保一切正常。**

> One day, I lost my checkbook. I was very worried because it contained all my important checks. I searched everywhere and finally found it under the sofa. What a relief! **有一天，我弄丢了我的支票簿。我非常担心，因为里面有我所有重要的支票。我到处找，最后在沙发下面找到了。真是松了一口气！**

> A detective was checking every clue carefully. He checked the fingerprints, the footprints, and finally caught the criminal. The word \'checked\' here means examined or verified. **一位侦探正在仔细检查每一条线索。他检查了指纹、脚印，最终抓住了罪犯。单词\'checked\'在这里表示检查、核实。**

> A race car driver had a checkered flag. The flag\'s checkered pattern was so distinct. It made him remember the word \'checkered\', which means having a pattern of alternating squares of different colors. **一位赛车手拿着一面方格旗。这面旗的方格图案非常独特。这让他记住了'checkered'这个单词，意思是有不同颜色交替的方格图案。**

> One day, Tom felt sick. His friend suggested he go for a checkup. So, he visited the doctor. The doctor did various tests during the checkup to find out what was wrong. > A mouse was very hungry and found a big chunk of cheddar cheese in a secret corner. It was the tastiest cheddar it had ever eaten. The mouse was so happy! **一只老鼠非常饿，在一个秘密的角落发现了一大块切达干酪。这是它吃过的最美味的切达干酪。老鼠非常开心！**

> A monkey was very naughty. It climbed up a tree and then jumped down, landing on its cheek. But it still kept playing happily. Remember, cheek is the side of your face. **一只猴子非常顽皮。它爬上树然后跳下来，脸着地了。但它仍然开心地玩耍着。记住，cheek 就是脸颊。**

> One day, a brave knight was injured in a battle. The wound was on his cheekbone. But he still fought bravely. The cheekbone became a symbol of his courage. **一天，一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中受伤了。伤口在他的颧骨上。但他仍然英勇作战。颧骨成了他勇气的象征。**

> A group of friends were lost in a dark forest. Feeling scared, they suddenly saw a light and heard someone shout \'cheer up!\'. With those words of encouragement, they found the way out and were full of joy. **一群朋友在黑暗的森林里迷路了。感到害怕时，他们突然看到一束光，还听到有人喊"振作起来！"。凭借这些鼓励的话，他们找到了出路，满心欢喜。**

> One day, I was feeling down. Then I met a girl with a big smile. Her positive attitude and lively spirit made me happy. She was so cheerful that my mood changed completely. I realized the power of being cheerful. **有一天，我心情低落。然后我遇到了一个面带灿烂笑容的女孩。她积极的态度和活泼的精神让我开心起来。她是如此的欢快，以至于完全改变了我的心情。我意识到了欢快的力量。**

> One day, when I was feeling down, my friend came to me cheerfully. She had a big smile and brought me flowers. Her cheerful presence made my mood better instantly. **有一天，当我心情低落时，我的朋友欢快地向我走来。她满脸笑容，还带给我鲜花。她欢快的出现瞬间让我的心情好了起来。**

> In a big sports game, the team was losing. But the cheerleader kept shouting and dancing, full of energy, making everyone feel excited. Her cheers led the team to victory. > 在一次热闹的聚会上，大家举杯高喊\'cheers\'，互相庆祝友谊和欢乐时刻。小明一开始不明白，后来朋友告诉他这是'干杯、欢呼'的意思，从此小明记住了这个词。 **在一次热闹的聚会上，大家举杯高喊"干杯、欢呼"，互相庆祝友谊和欢乐时刻。小明一开始不明白，后来朋友告诉他这是"干杯、欢呼"的意思，从此小明记住了这个词。**

> A mouse was very hungry. It searched everywhere and finally found a big piece of cheese in a corner. It was so happy and ate the cheese with joy. **一只老鼠非常饿。它到处寻找，最后在一个角落里发现了一大块奶酪。它非常高兴，开心地吃起了奶酪。**

> One day, a hungry boy was walking on the street. Suddenly, he smelled a wonderful aroma. It was a cheeseburger! The thick cheese and juicy patty made him so happy. He bought it and enjoyed it very much. **有一天，一个饥饿的男孩走在街上。突然，他闻到一股美妙的香气。原来是一个芝士汉堡！厚厚的芝士和多汁的肉饼让他非常开心。他买了它，吃得很享受。**

> A mouse was very hungry. It found a big piece of cheesecake in a corner. It was so happy and ate a lot. But it was too full to move. Cheesecake is a kind of delicious cake made with cheese. **一只老鼠非常饿。它在一个角落发现了一大块芝士蛋糕。它非常高兴，吃了很多。但它太饱了以至于动不了。芝士蛋糕是一种用芝士制成的美味蛋糕。**

> A thief wanted to steal the jewels. He couldn\'t enter through the front door, so he tried to circumvent the security by climbing over the back wall. But he was still caught. \'circumvent\' here means to go around or bypass. **一个小偷想要偷珠宝。他无法从前门进入，所以试图从后墙爬过去来规避安保。但他还是被抓住了。\'circumvent\'在这里指的是绕行、避开。**

> One day, I went to a circus. There were funny clowns, brave acrobats and smart animals. The circus was full of joy and excitement. It was a wonderful place that made me happy. **有一天，我去了一个马戏团。那里有有趣的小丑，勇敢的杂技演员和聪明的动物。马戏团充满了欢乐和兴奋。这是一个让我开心的美妙地方。**

> A detective was working on a case. The key citation was a mysterious note left at the crime scene. It pointed to the culprit. Without this citation, the detective would have been lost. **一位侦探正在处理一个案件。关键的引文是留在犯罪现场的一张神秘纸条。它指明了罪犯。没有这个引文，侦探就会迷失方向。**

> A scientist was giving a presentation. To support his ideas, he constantly had to cite previous research. Every time he said \'cite\', he pointed to the references on the screen. This helped him remember the word and made the audience understand its meaning. **一位科学家正在做报告。为了支持自己的观点，他不断地需要引用先前的研究。每次他说'cite'，就指向屏幕上的参考文献。这帮助他记住了这个单词，也让观众明白了其含义。**

> A citizen named Tom always cared about his community. One day, a problem occurred and Tom actively participated in solving it. Because he knew as a citizen, it was his responsibility to make the place better. **有个叫汤姆的公民总是关心他所在的社区。有一天，出现了一个问题，汤姆积极参与解决。因为他知道作为一个公民，让这个地方变得更好是他的责任。**

> In a small town, all the people, the citizenry, worked together to build a beautiful park. They showed that when the citizenry unites, great things can be achieved. **在一个小镇上，所有的民众，即 citizenry，齐心协力建造了一个美丽的公园。这表明当民众团结起来时，就能成就伟大的事情。**

> A young man named Tom always dreamed of having a meaningful citizenship. One day, he actively participated in community service and finally understood the true meaning of citizenship - responsibility and contribution. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人一直梦想拥有有意义的公民身份。有一天，他积极参加社区服务，终于明白了公民身份的真正含义------责任和贡献。**

> One day, Tom was very thirsty. He searched everywhere and finally found some citrus fruits. They were bright and juicy. Tom ate them and felt refreshed. Remember, citrus refers to fruits like oranges and lemons. **有一天，汤姆非常口渴。他到处找，最后找到了一些柑橘类水果。它们又鲜亮又多汁。汤姆吃了之后感到神清气爽。记住，citrus 指的是像橙子和柠檬这样的水果。**

> A little mouse was lost in a big city. It ran around, passing tall buildings and busy streets. Finally, it found a warm home. The home was in a peaceful corner of the city. **一只小老鼠在一个大城市里迷路了。它到处跑，经过高大的建筑和繁忙的街道。最后，它找到了一个温暖的家。这个家在城市一个安静的角落。**

> Once upon a time, a mayor wanted to improve the entire city. So, he launched a \'citywide\' project to build new parks and roads. Everyone in the city joined in to make it better. **从前，一位市长想要改善整个城市。于是，他发起了一个全市范围的项目来建造新的公园和道路。城市里的每个人都参与进来让它变得更好。**

> A civic hero named Tom saved the city. He cared about the community, cleaned the parks, and helped the old. His actions showed what it means to be civic - devoted to the welfare of the city and its people. **一位名叫汤姆的市民英雄拯救了这座城市。他关心社区，打扫公园，并帮助老人。他的行为展示了'civic'的含义------致力于城市及其人民的福祉。**

> A group of students were confused about civics. But one day, they visited a courthouse and saw a fair trial. They understood that civics is about how our society works and our rights and duties. **一群学生对公民学感到困惑。但有一天，他们参观了法院并看到了一场公平的审判。他们明白了公民学是关于我们的社会如何运作以及我们的权利和义务。**

> A civil engineer was working on a project. He needed to be polite and respectful to everyone to make the project go smoothly. \'Civil\' means polite and orderly. **一位土木工程师正在做一个项目。他需要对每个人都礼貌和尊重，以使项目顺利进行。\'civil\'意思是有礼貌的、有秩序的。**

> In a war-torn city, a brave civilian named Lily risked her life to help others. Despite the danger, she showed that civilians can also be heroes. She provided food and shelter, giving hope to all. **在一个饱受战争蹂躏的城市里，一位名叫莉莉的勇敢平民冒着生命危险帮助他人。尽管危险重重，她证明了平民也可以成为英雄。她提供食物和住所，给所有人带来希望。**

> In a chaotic city, people were often rude. But one day, a kind girl showed civility by helping an old man cross the street. Her act changed the mood of the place. Civility means polite and respectful behavior. **在一个混乱的城市里，人们常常很粗鲁。但有一天，一个善良的女孩通过帮助一位老人过马路展现了礼貌。她的行为改变了这个地方的氛围。civility 意思是礼貌和尊重的行为。**

> A long time ago, people lived in chaos. But they learned to build cities, create laws, and develop art. This progress was called civilization. It made their lives better and more organized. **很久以前，人们生活混乱。但他们学会了建造城市、制定法律和发展艺术。这种进步被称为文明。它让他们的生活变得更美好、更有秩序。**

> In a faraway land, there was a tribe that was very chaotic. But one day, a wise leader came and taught them rules and kindness. They started to live in an orderly way, becoming civilized. They learned to respect others and build a harmonious community. **在一个遥远的地方，有一个部落非常混乱。但有一天，一位睿智的领袖到来，教导他们规则和善良。他们开始有序地生活，变得文明起来。他们学会了尊重他人，并建立了一个和谐的社区。**

> A knight was clad in shiny armor. He was ready to fight for justice. The armor protected him and made him look brave. \'Clad\' means dressed or covered. So, the knight was dressed in the armor. **一位骑士身着闪亮的盔甲。他准备为正义而战。盔甲保护着他，使他看起来很勇敢。\'clad\'意思是穿着或覆盖。所以，这位骑士穿着盔甲。**

> A man was lost in the desert and claimed to have seen a hidden oasis. But no one believed him until he led them to it. The word \'claim\' means to assert or say that something is true. **一个男人在沙漠中迷路了，声称看到了一个隐藏的绿洲。但没人相信他，直到他带他们找到了。单词\'claim\'意思是断言或宣称某事是真实的。**

> A poor man lost his job and needed to claim benefits. He became a claimant. But the process was tough. Finally, with persistence, he got the support he needed. **一个穷人丢了工作，需要申请福利。他成为了一名索赔者。但这个过程很艰难。最终，凭借坚持，他得到了所需的支持。**

> A little monkey wanted to get the bananas on the tall tree. It had to clamber up the trunk, using its hands and feet. Finally, it reached the bananas and had a delicious meal. **一只小猴子想要得到高树上的香蕉。它不得不手脚并用爬上树干。最终，它够到了香蕉，美餐了一顿。**

> A group of people were at the market, making a clamor. They were shouting loudly and demanding lower prices. The noise was so intense that it attracted the attention of everyone nearby. **一群人在市场上大声喧哗。他们大声呼喊着要求更低的价格。噪音如此之大，吸引了附近所有人的注意。**

> A thief was trying to steal a precious gem. The police quickly came and used a clamp to hold his hands firmly, preventing him from escaping. The clamp was very strong and reliable. **一个小偷正试图偷一颗珍贵的宝石。警察迅速赶来并用夹子紧紧夹住他的手，防止他逃跑。这个夹子非常坚固可靠。**

> A long time ago, in a faraway village, there was a group of people who always helped each other. They were like a big family and were called a clan. They shared food and protected each other from danger. **很久以前，在一个遥远的村庄里，有一群总是互相帮助的人。他们就像一个大家庭，被称为氏族。他们共享食物，并相互保护免受危险。**

> A spy had a clandestine mission. He had to sneak into the enemy base secretly at night. No one could know about it. \'Clandestine\' means done secretly and kept hidden. **一名间谍有一项秘密任务。他不得不在夜间偷偷潜入敌方基地。不能让任何人知道。\'clandestine\'意思是秘密进行并加以隐藏。**

> A blacksmith was working hard in his forge. Every time he hit the iron with his hammer, there was a loud \'clang\'. The repeated \'clang\' sounds made the blacksmith\'s work full of rhythm. **一位铁匠在他的锻造间努力工作。每次他用锤子敲打铁块，都会发出响亮的"clang"声。反复的"clang"声让铁匠的工作充满了节奏。**

> One day, at a music concert, the audience was very excited. When the singer finished a wonderful song, everyone started to clap their hands loudly. The sound of clapping filled the hall. It was a great moment! **有一天，在一场音乐会上，观众们非常兴奋。当歌手唱完一首精彩的歌曲时，每个人都开始大声拍手。拍手声充满了大厅。这是一个很棒的时刻！**

> A carpenter was working hard. He clapped the boards together to make a clapboard for a house. The sound of the clapping boards was loud. With his effort, the beautiful clapboard was ready. **一位木匠正在努力工作。他把木板拍合在一起，为房子制作一块护墙板。木板拍合的声音很响。经过他的努力，漂亮的护墙板做好了。**

> A scientist was working on a complex experiment. There were many confusing results. So, he spent days seeking clarification. Finally, he understood everything clearly and made a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一项复杂的实验。有很多令人困惑的结果。于是，他花了好几天时间寻求澄清。最后，他清楚地明白了一切，并取得了重大发现。**

> One day, a student had many confusing questions. The teacher clarified them patiently, making the knowledge clear and easy to understand. Just like clearing fog, everything became distinct. **有一天，一个学生有很多令人困惑的问题。老师耐心地为他澄清，让知识变得清晰易懂。就像驱散迷雾一样，一切都变得清晰分明。**

> One day, a little girl named Clara was lost in a forest. Suddenly, she heard a beautiful sound. It was from a musical instrument. Later, she learned it was called a clarinet. The sound guided her out of the forest. **有一天，一个叫克拉拉的小女孩在森林里迷路了。突然，她听到了一种美妙的声音。这声音来自一种乐器。后来，她得知这乐器叫单簧管。这声音引导她走出了森林。**

> A detective was solving a complex case. After days of investigation, he finally found the key evidence, and everything had clarity. Just like fog disappearing, all became clear and understandable. **一位侦探正在侦破一起复杂的案件。经过数天的调查，他终于找到了关键证据，一切都变得清晰明了。就像迷雾消散，所有的都变得清晰易懂。**

> In a big city, two rival gangs had a violent clash. They fought in the streets, making a lot of noise. The police came quickly to stop this chaotic clash. **在一个大城市里，两个敌对的帮派发生了激烈的冲突。他们在街头打斗，制造了很多噪音。警察很快赶来制止这场混乱的冲突。**

> A thief was trying to steal a precious necklace. But the owner tightly clasped it in her hand. The thief had no chance. \'Clasp\' here means to hold something tightly. **一个小偷试图偷一条珍贵的项链。但主人紧紧地把它握在手中。小偷没有机会。这里'clasp'的意思是紧紧地握住某物。**

> In a school, students of different ages gather in one class. They study and play together. The teacher stands in front of the class, teaching and guiding them. Class is like a big family of learning. **在一所学校里，不同年龄的学生聚集在一个班级里。他们一起学习和玩耍。老师站在班级前面，教导和引导他们。班级就像一个学习的大家庭。**

> A young artist dreams of creating a classic painting. After years of hard work and countless attempts, he finally finishes a masterpiece that everyone praises. The painting becomes a classic, remembered for ages. **一位年轻的艺术家梦想创作一幅经典的画作。经过多年的努力和无数次尝试，他终于完成了一幅人人称赞的杰作。这幅画成为了经典，被铭记多年。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的学校里，学生们都穿着古典的校服，认真听着老师讲授经典的知识。这些知识就像古典音乐一样，经久不衰。这就是\'classical\'，代表古典的、经典的。 **想象在古老学校里学生穿着古典校服听经典知识的场景，来记住\'classical\'表示古典的、经典的意思。**

> A student was always classically dressed for school. One day, he wore modern clothes and everyone was surprised. He then realized that classically means in a traditional or typical way. **一名学生上学总是穿着传统风格的服装。有一天，他穿了现代的衣服，所有人都很惊讶。然后他明白了classically意思是传统地、典型地。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a mysterious forest. To find the way out, he made a classification of the trees and paths. He grouped them based on their features and finally found the right direction. **一位勇敢的探险家在神秘森林中迷路了。为了找到出路，他对树木和路径进行分类。他根据它们的特征分组，最终找到了正确的方向。**

> A spy was trying to get classified information. But the security guards protected it well. Finally, the spy failed. \'Classified\' means officially secret and available only to certain people. **一名间谍试图获取机密信息。但保安把它保护得很好。最后，间谍失败了。\'classified\'意思是机密的，仅限特定人员获取。**

> In a big library, there were many books. To organize them neatly, the librarian had to classify them. She grouped them by subject, like history, science, and fiction. This way, it was easy for readers to find what they wanted. **在一个大图书馆里，有很多书。为了将它们整齐地整理好，图书管理员必须对它们进行分类。她按照主题将它们分组，比如历史、科学和小说。这样，读者就很容易找到他们想要的书。**

> One day in class, I forgot my pen. My classmate kindly lent me hers. We studied together and became good friends. Classmate means a person who studies in the same class as you. **有一天在课堂上，我忘记带笔了。我的同学友好地把她的笔借给了我。我们一起学习并成为了好朋友。classmate 意思是和你在同一个班级学习的人。**

> One day, Tom was late for class. When he rushed into the classroom, all the students were quiet and the teacher was writing on the blackboard. Tom realized that the classroom was a place for learning and needed to be respected. **一天，汤姆上课迟到了。当他冲进教室时，所有的学生都很安静，老师正在黑板上写字。汤姆意识到教室是学习的地方，需要被尊重。**

> A girl named Lily always wore elegant dresses and behaved gracefully. Everyone said she was very classy. One day, at a party, she stood out with her classy style and charmed everyone. **一个叫莉莉的女孩总是穿着优雅的裙子，举止得体。大家都说她很有品味。有一天，在一个聚会上，她以其有品味的风格脱颖而出，吸引了所有人。**

> One day, I was in a big factory. The machines were working fast and making a loud \'clatter\' sound. It was like a noisy symphony of metal hitting metal. I\'ll never forget that clattering noise. **有一天，我在一个大工厂里。机器快速运转，发出响亮的"咔嗒咔嗒"声。就像一场嘈杂的金属撞击的交响乐。我永远忘不了那阵咔嗒声。**
> 想象你正在签订一份合同，其中有个重要部分叫 clause （条款）。比如'保密条款''付款条款'，这些条款决定了双方的权利和义务。就像一条条规则，规范着合同的执行。 **想象在签订合同中理解 clause （条款）这个单词，它就像合同中的一条条规则，决定双方权利义务。**

> A man was trapped in a small elevator. The walls seemed to close in on him. He felt extremely uncomfortable and panicked. This feeling made him realize he was claustrophobic - having a fear of being in closed or small spaces. **一个男人被困在一个小电梯里。墙壁似乎向他逼近。他感到极度不适和恐慌。这种感觉让他意识到自己有幽闭恐惧症------害怕处于封闭或狭小的空间。**

> A brave mouse was cornered by a fierce cat. The mouse saw the cat\'s sharp claws and was very scared. But it bravely fought back and bit the cat\'s claw. Finally, it escaped. Remember, \'claw\' means the sharp part of an animal\'s foot. **一只勇敢的老鼠被一只凶猛的猫逼到了角落。老鼠看到了猫锋利的爪子，非常害怕。但它勇敢地反击并咬了猫的爪子。最后，它逃走了。记住，\'claw\'是指动物脚部的锋利部分。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the garden and found a lump of clay. He used the clay to make a cute little animal. The clay was soft and malleable, allowing him to create freely. **有一天，一个小男孩在花园里玩耍，发现了一块黏土。他用这块黏土做了一个可爱的小动物。黏土柔软且可塑，让他能够自由创作。**

> One day, Tom\'s room was very messy. His mother said, \'Tom, you must clean your room.\' So Tom started to put away toys, wipe the table and sweep the floor. Finally, the room became clean and tidy. **一天，汤姆的房间非常凌乱。他妈妈说：'汤姆，你必须打扫你的房间。'于是汤姆开始收拾玩具、擦桌子和扫地。最后，房间变得干净整洁。**

> One day, Tom\'s room was very messy. His mom called a cleaner. The cleaner worked hard, swept the floor, wiped the table, and made the room tidy. Tom learned to keep his room clean after that. **一天，汤姆的房间非常凌乱。他妈妈叫了一位清洁工。清洁工努力工作，扫地、擦桌子，让房间变得整洁。从那以后，汤姆学会了保持房间干净。**

> One day, a princess was very sad because her castle was dirty. Then a fairy appeared and taught her the importance of cleanliness. With hard work, the castle became shiny and clean again. The princess learned that cleanliness brings happiness. **有一天，一位公主非常伤心，因为她的城堡很脏。然后一位仙女出现了，教导她清洁的重要性。通过努力，城堡再次变得闪亮干净。公主明白了清洁会带来快乐。**

> A little monkey was taught to cleanly eat bananas. It learned to not make a mess and finish the fruit neatly. So, when we do things, we should also be cleanly like the monkey. **一只小猴子被教导要干净利落地吃香蕉。它学会了不弄得一团糟，整洁地吃完水果。所以，当我们做事时，也应该像这只猴子一样干净利落。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to cleanse a haunted forest. The evil spirits had made the place dark and scary. With his magic sword, he fought and purified the forest, making it beautiful and peaceful again. \'Cleansed\' means to make clean and pure. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了净化一座闹鬼森林的征程。邪恶的幽灵让这个地方变得黑暗和可怕。他用他的魔法剑战斗并净化了森林，使其再次变得美丽和宁静。\'cleanse\'意思是使清洁、使纯净。**

> One day, Mary\'s face was very dirty. She needed a cleanser to make it clean. So she found a special cleanser and used it carefully. After that, her face became fresh and shiny. **有一天，玛丽的脸非常脏。她需要清洁剂来让脸变干净。于是她找到了一种特别的清洁剂，并小心翼翼地使用。之后，她的脸变得清新又有光泽。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to find a magical spring with cleansing powers. When he finally reached it and bathed in the water, all the dirt and evil spells on him vanished. The word \'cleansing\' means to make clean or pure. **一位勇敢的骑士正在寻找具有清洁力量的神奇泉水。当他终于到达并在水中沐浴时，他身上所有的污垢和邪恶咒语都消失了。单词\'cleansing\'的意思是使清洁或纯净。**

> One day, there was a big mess in the park. Volunteers came for a cleanup. They picked up trash, swept the paths, and made the park beautiful again. Remember, cleanup means to make a place clean and tidy. **有一天，公园里一片狼藉。志愿者们前来进行清理。他们捡垃圾，清扫道路，让公园再次变得美丽。记住，cleanup 意思是清理，使某处整洁。**

> One day, I was in a messy room. I decided to clear it. I threw away the trash, organized the books, and wiped the dust. Finally, the room became clear and tidy. **一天，我在一个凌乱的房间里。我决定清理它。我扔掉垃圾，整理书籍，擦掉灰尘。最后，房间变得干净整洁了。**

> A thief was running in a crowded market. But the police managed to clear the way and get a clearance to catch him. Finally, they arrested the thief and restored order. **一个小偷在拥挤的市场里逃窜。但警察设法清理出道路，并获得许可去抓他。最终，他们逮捕了小偷，恢复了秩序。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a thick forest. After days of wandering, he finally reached a clearing. There, he saw a beautiful lake and found his way out. The clearing was his salvation. **一位勇敢的探险家在茂密的森林中迷路了。经过数天的徘徊，他终于到达了一片空地。在那里，他看到了一个美丽的湖泊，并找到了出路。这片空地是他的救星。**
> 想象一个繁忙的金融市场，有个神秘的地方叫 clearinghouse 。它就像一个超级管家，接收和整理各方的交易信息，确保每一笔交易都准确无误，让资金流动顺畅无阻。 **想象在繁忙的金融市场中，clearinghouse 如同超级管家，接收和整理交易信息，保障交易准确和资金流畅。**

> 想象一个古老的小镇，每当有重大事件，一群身穿长袍的人就会出现引导大家。他们就是 clergy ，被视为宗教的指引者。他们用智慧和信仰，给人们带来心灵的慰藉。 **想象一个关于\'clergy（神职人员）\'的故事，描述他们在小镇中的引导作用，以辅助记忆**

> A young man named Tom always dreamt of becoming a cleric. One day, he received a special mission to help the poor. With his wisdom and kindness, he fulfilled the task and became a respected cleric. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人一直梦想成为一名牧师。有一天，他接到了一个帮助穷人的特殊任务。凭借他的智慧和善良，他完成了任务，成为了一位受人尊敬的牧师。**

> A young man named Tom wanted to be a clerk. One day, he got a chance in a big company. He worked hard, handling papers and data. Finally, he became an excellent clerk. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人想成为一名职员。有一天，他在一家大公司获得了一个机会。他努力工作，处理文件和数据。最后，他成为了一名出色的职员。**

> One day, a little monkey was trapped in a cage. But it was so clever that it found a way to open the lock and escaped. It showed its cleverness and outsmarted the difficult situation. **有一天，一只小猴子被困在了笼子里。但它非常聪明，找到了打开锁的方法并逃走了。它展现出了自己的聪明才智，战胜了困境。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to get the bananas on the tall tree. It thought cleverly and used a long stick to reach them. Finally, it got the bananas successfully. **有一天，一只小猴子想要得到高树上的香蕉。它聪明地思考，并用一根长棍够到了它们。最后，它成功地得到了香蕉。**

> A writer was always using the same old ideas, like \'love conquers all\'. His editor shouted, \'Stop! These are all cliches!\' The writer then realized he needed fresh thoughts. **一位作家总是使用那些老掉牙的想法，比如'爱能战胜一切'。他的编辑大喊：'停下！这些全是陈词滥调！'然后这位作家意识到他需要新的思路。**

> One day, I was in a dark room and heard a strange sound. When I turned on the light with a \'click\', I saw a mouse running away. The \'click\' of the switch made me remember this word. **有一天，我在一个黑暗的房间里，听到了一个奇怪的声音。当我'咔哒'一声打开灯时，我看到一只老鼠跑开了。开关的'咔哒'声让我记住了这个单词。**
> 有一天，一位聪明的律师正在办公室工作，突然来了一位焦急的 client 寻求帮助。这位 client 面临着复杂的法律问题，律师耐心倾听并承诺会全力为他解决。 **有一天，一位聪明的律师正在办公室工作，突然来了一位焦急的客户寻求帮助。这位客户面临着复杂的法律问题，律师耐心倾听并承诺会全力为他解决。**
> 想象一家豪华餐厅，常客们（clientele）总是按时来享受美食。有位新员工不熟悉这些常客，闹了笑话。老板提醒他：要记住咱们的 clientele 哟，他们可是生意的支柱。 **想象一家餐厅中关于常客的故事来辅助记忆\'clientele（常客；顾客）\'这个单词**

> A brave explorer was hiking. Suddenly, he came to the edge of a cliff. It was a very steep and dangerous place. He had to be careful not to fall. The cliff was like a big challenge for him. **一位勇敢的探险家正在徒步旅行。突然，他来到了一处悬崖边。这是一个非常陡峭且危险的地方。他必须小心以免掉落。这处悬崖对他来说就像一个巨大的挑战。**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的登山者努力攀登高峰，在接近山顶时，遭遇恶劣天气。这最关键、最激动人心的时刻就是 climactic 时刻，它意味着高潮的、顶点的。 **想象一位登山者在接近山顶遭遇恶劣天气的关键激动时刻来理解 climactic 意为高潮的、顶点的**

> A brave adventurer traveled to different places. In the desert, it was hot; in the mountains, it was cold. He realized that these different conditions were all part of the \'climate\'. > A brave explorer was on a journey to study the climatic changes in a mysterious land. He faced extreme weather but never gave up. Finally, he understood the patterns of the climatic conditions and became a hero. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片神秘的土地上进行研究气候变迁的旅程。他遭遇了极端天气但从不放弃。最终，他了解了气候状况的模式并成为了英雄。**

> A group of climbers were striving to reach the peak. After days of effort, they finally stood at the top, experiencing the climax of their adventure. It was the most exciting and fulfilling moment. **一群登山者努力攀登以到达山顶。经过数天的努力，他们最终站在了山顶，体验到了他们冒险的高潮。这是最令人兴奋和满足的时刻。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to get the bananas on the tall tree. It started to climb up the tree very carefully. With its efforts, it finally reached the bananas. > One day, a brave climber decided to conquer the highest mountain. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. Finally, he reached the peak and became a hero. Remember, a climber is someone who climbs mountains. **有一天，一位勇敢的登山者决定征服最高的山峰。他面临许多困难但从不放弃。最终，他到达了山顶，成为了英雄。记住，climber 就是登山的人。**

> One day, Tom went climbing. He struggled at first but didn\'t give up. Finally, he reached the top and saw the beautiful view. Climbing made him feel brave and strong. **有一天，汤姆去爬山。一开始他很吃力但没有放弃。最终，他到达了山顶，看到了美丽的景色。爬山让他感到勇敢和强大。**

> A wrestler was in a fierce match. He struggled hard and finally managed to clinch his opponent\'s arm, securing the victory. It means to secure or settle something decisively. **一位摔跤手正在进行一场激烈的比赛。他奋力拼搏，最终成功紧紧抓住对手的手臂，赢得了胜利。这个词意味着决定性地确定或解决某事。**

> A little monkey was climbing a tree. When it was high up, it had to cling tightly to the branch to avoid falling. It was so scared but still held on. Remember, \'cling\' means to hold tightly! **一只小猴子在爬树。当它爬得很高时，它不得不紧紧地抱住树枝以防掉落。它很害怕但仍然坚持着。记住，\'cling\'意思是紧紧抓住！**
> A poor man was very sick. His friend took him to a clinic. There, kind doctors helped him get better. The clinic became his hope for recovery. **一个穷人病得很重。他的朋友带他去了一家诊所。在那里，善良的医生帮助他好转。这家诊所成了他康复的希望。**

> A doctor was in the clinical room, carefully observing patients\' symptoms. He needed to make accurate diagnoses based on clinical signs. Every detail mattered to ensure the best treatment. **一位医生在诊疗室里，仔细观察病人的症状。他需要依据临床迹象做出准确的诊断。每个细节都至关重要，以确保最佳的治疗。**

> A thief was running away, but a brave police officer managed to clip his arm and catch him. The clip, like a tool to hold or fasten, stopped the thief\'s escape. **一个小偷正在逃跑，但一位勇敢的警察设法夹住了他的胳膊并抓住了他。clip 这个词，就像一个用来夹住或固定的工具，阻止了小偷的逃跑。**

> A farmer was clipping the wool from his sheep. The shears made a \'clipping\' sound as the wool was neatly cut. It was a task he did every season to get the soft and useful clippings. **一位农民正在从他的羊身上剪羊毛。剪刀发出"剪"的声音，羊毛被整齐地剪下。这是他每个季节都要做的任务，以获得柔软且有用的剪下物。**

> A group of friends always hung out together after school. They formed a clique. No one outside this small group could join easily. They had their own secrets and inside jokes. It was like a special club. **一群朋友放学后总是一起出去玩。他们组成了一个小团体。这个小团体之外的人很难加入。他们有自己的秘密和内部笑话。就像一个特殊的俱乐部。**

> A spy needed to hide. He put on a special cloak that made him blend into the shadows. With the cloak, no one could see him. It was like a magic shield that kept him safe and unseen. **一个间谍需要隐藏。他穿上了一件特殊的斗篷，使他融入了阴影之中。有了这件斗篷，没人能看见他。它就像一个神奇的盾牌，让他安全且不被发现。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy found a strange toy. It moved precisely like clockwork. Every gear and spring worked perfectly. He was amazed by this mechanical wonder. Later, he learned it was called \'clockwork\'. **从前，一个小男孩发现了一个奇怪的玩具。它像发条装置一样精确地移动。每个齿轮和弹簧都完美地运作。他对这个机械奇迹感到惊奇。后来，他知道这被称为"发条装置"。**

> A little girl was lost in a big forest. She walked and walked, hoping to find a way out. Finally, she saw a house and got closer to it, praying for help. **一个小女孩在大森林里迷路了。她走啊走，希望能找到出路。最后，她看到了一座房子，并向它靠近，祈求帮助。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a big forest. He searched everywhere and finally found the closest exit. It was a narrow path hidden behind some thick bushes. He was so relieved. **一天，汤姆在一个大森林里迷路了。他到处寻找，最后找到了最近的出口。那是一条隐藏在一些茂密灌木丛后面的狭窄小路。他如释重负。**

> One day, Tom was looking for his favorite toy in the closet. It was a small space full of clothes and boxes. He finally found the toy hidden behind some old sweaters. The closet was like a mystery box. **一天，汤姆在壁橱里找他最喜欢的玩具。这是一个满是衣服和盒子的小空间。他最终在一些旧毛衣后面找到了玩具。这个壁橱就像一个神秘的盒子。**

> A store was having its closing sale. Everyone rushed to buy things. The owner was sad but also relieved. Closing means the end of something, like the end of the store\'s business. **一家商店正在进行结业大甩卖。每个人都冲过去买东西。店主很伤心但也松了口气。Closing 意味着某事的结束，比如这家店营业的结束。**

> A small town\'s only factory announced its closure. Many workers lost their jobs. But a brave entrepreneur came and reopened it, bringing hope and closure to this sad chapter. **一个小镇上唯一的工厂宣布关闭。许多工人失去了工作。但一位勇敢的企业家来了，重新开张了它，为这悲伤的篇章带来了结束和新的希望。**

> A brave knight was injured in a battle. His blood started to clot and form a thick mass, stopping the bleeding and saving his life. The clot became a symbol of his survival and strength. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中受伤了。他的血液开始凝结，形成厚厚的团块，止住了流血，救了他的命。凝结的血块成了他生存和力量的象征。**

> One day, a little girl needed a new dress. Her mother took out a beautiful piece of cloth and started sewing. With the magic of the cloth, a lovely dress was made. The girl was so happy! **有一天，一个小女孩需要一件新裙子。她的妈妈拿出一块漂亮的布然后开始缝纫。凭借这块神奇的布，一件可爱的裙子做好了。小女孩非常开心！**

> One day, a poor little girl had no nice clothes. But a kind fairy came and used her magic to clothe the girl beautifully. The girl was so happy and danced with joy. **有一天，一个可怜的小女孩没有漂亮的衣服。但一位善良的仙女来了，用她的魔法给小女孩穿上了漂亮的衣服。小女孩非常开心，高兴地跳起舞来。**

> One day, a little girl opened her closet and saw a mess of clothes. She had to sort them out. Shirts, pants, dresses - all these clothes needed to be organized neatly.
