> One day, I was walking in the garden and saw a cat playing with a ball near the clothesline. The clothesline was full of colorful clothes drying in the sun. It was a beautiful scene. **有一天，我在花园里散步，看到一只猫在晾衣绳附近玩球。晾衣绳上挂满了五颜六色的衣服在太阳下晾晒。那是一幅美丽的景象。**

> One day, a traveler lost all his luggage, including his clothing. But kind villagers gave him new clothing to keep him warm. He was so grateful and never forgot their kindness. **有一天，一位旅行者丢失了他所有的行李，包括他的衣物。但善良的村民给了他新的衣物来保暖。他非常感激，永远不会忘记他们的好意。**

> One day, I was walking in the park. The sky was full of white and fluffy cloud. They looked like cotton candy. Suddenly, a big cloud blocked the sun, and it became a little cooler. I enjoyed the changing scene of the cloud. **有一天，我在公园里散步。天空布满了白色蓬松的云。它们看起来像棉花糖。突然，一大片云遮住了太阳，天气变得有点凉。我享受着云的变化景象。**

> One day, I went for a picnic. The sky was cloudless. The sun shone brightly and warmly. I lay on the grass, enjoying the beautiful and clear view. It was such a cloudless day that made me feel happy and relaxed. **有一天，我去野餐。天空万里无云。太阳明亮而温暖地照耀着。我躺在草地上，享受着美丽清晰的景色。这是如此万里无云的一天，让我感到开心和放松。**

> One day, Tom went for a picnic. But the sky became cloudy very quickly. It looked like it was going to rain. Poor Tom had to pack up and go home. \'Cloudy\' means the sky is covered with clouds. **有一天，汤姆去野餐。但天空很快就变得多云了。看起来要下雨了。可怜的汤姆不得不收拾东西回家。'cloudy'意思是天空布满了云。**

> Once upon a time, a young knight sought clout in the kingdom. He trained hard, won battles, and finally gained the respect and influence - the clout - needed to protect his people. **从前，有一位年轻的骑士在王国中寻求影响力。他刻苦训练，赢得战斗，最终获得了保护人民所需的尊重和影响力------即 clout 。**

> A girl named Clove loved climbing trees. One day, she found a special flower bud on a branch. She didn\'t know it was a clove. But she was amazed by its smell. Later, she learned it was called a clove. **一个叫克洛芙（Clove）的女孩喜欢爬树。有一天，她在一根树枝上发现了一个特别的花芽。她不知道这是丁香花苞。但她被它的气味所吸引。后来，她才知道这叫丁香花苞，也就是 clove 。**

> A little rabbit was lost in the forest. It was very hungry. Suddenly, it found a field of clover and happily ate them. Clover became its lucky food and helped it find its way home. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。它非常饿。突然，它发现了一片三叶草，开心地吃了起来。三叶草成了它的幸运食物，还帮它找到了回家的路。**
> 在一个欢乐的马戏团里，有个总是穿着奇装异服、脸上涂满油彩的人，他的滑稽动作能让大家捧腹大笑，这个人就是 clown （小丑）。他用独特的表演给人们带来无尽欢乐。 **在一个欢乐的马戏团中，有个总是穿着奇装异服、脸上涂满油彩，其滑稽动作能让大家捧腹大笑的人就是小丑。他用独特表演给人们带来无尽欢乐。**

> A group of friends decided to form a club. They met every week to play music, share stories and have fun. The club became a special place for them to enjoy and relax. **一群朋友决定成立一个俱乐部。他们每周都会见面演奏音乐、分享故事并且玩得很开心。这个俱乐部成了他们享受和放松的特别之地。**

> A group of friends decided to build a clubhouse in an old tree. They spent weekends working together, making it a special place to play and share secrets. The clubhouse became their favorite spot. **一群朋友决定在一棵老树上建造一个俱乐部活动室。他们在周末一起工作，把它变成了一个玩耍和分享秘密的特别地方。这个俱乐部活动室成了他们最喜欢的场所。**

> A hen was walking in the farm. Every time it laid an egg, it would cluck loudly. The sound \'cluck\' was like its proud announcement. So, when you hear \'cluck\', think of the hen\'s happy call. **一只母鸡正在农场里走着。每次它下了蛋，都会大声咯咯叫。'cluck'这个声音就像是它骄傲的宣告。所以，当你听到'cluck'，就想到母鸡开心的叫声。**

> A detective was lost in a mystery case. But one day, he found a strange note, which was the clue that finally led him to solve the case. The clue was like a guiding light in the darkness. **一位侦探在一个神秘案件中迷失了方向。但有一天，他发现了一张奇怪的纸条，这就是最终引导他破案的线索。这个线索就像黑暗中的一盏明灯。**

> A group of friends were walking in the forest. Suddenly, they saw a clump of beautiful flowers. They were tightly grouped together. The friends were amazed by this lovely clump. **一群朋友在森林里散步。突然，他们看到一丛美丽的花。它们紧紧地簇拥在一起。朋友们对这可爱的一丛感到惊讶。**

> A clumsily monkey tried to climb a tall tree. It kept slipping and falling because it moved in a clumsy way. Finally, it gave up and sat on the ground, looking very funny. **一只笨手笨脚的猴子试图爬上一棵高大的树。它不停地滑倒和跌落，因为它的动作很笨拙。最后，它放弃了，坐在地上，看起来十分滑稽。**

> A clumsy bear was trying to dance. It kept tripping over its own feet and knocking things down. Poor bear! It was so clumsy that it made everyone laugh. But it didn\'t give up and kept trying. **一只笨拙的熊正试着跳舞。它不停地被自己的脚绊倒，还撞倒东西。可怜的熊！它是如此的笨拙，让大家都笑了。但它没有放弃，一直在努力。**

> Imagine a bunch of colorful balloons tied closely together. They form a cluster. Just like a group of stars in the sky or a group of flowers in a garden, they are a cluster. **想象一堆五颜六色的气球紧紧系在一起。它们形成了一簇。就像天空中的一群星星或花园里的一群花，它们就是一簇。**

> A brave climber was trying to reach the top of the mountain. His hands were in a clutch, tightly grasping the rocks. Just when he thought he might fall, he held on and finally made it. The clutch of his hands saved him. **一位勇敢的登山者试图登顶。他的手紧紧抓着，处于紧握状态。就在他以为自己可能会掉落时，他坚持住了，最终成功。他双手的紧握救了他。**

> One day, Tom\'s room was in a clutter. There were books everywhere, clothes on the floor, and toys all over. His mom said, \'Clean this clutter!\' Tom then spent hours tidying up. **一天，汤姆的房间非常杂乱。到处都是书，衣服在地板上，玩具也到处都是。他妈妈说：'把这堆杂乱清理干净！' 然后汤姆花了几个小时来整理。**

> A young athlete was struggling. Then came a wise coach. The coach trained and guided him. With the coach\'s help, the athlete won the championship. The coach was like a guiding star. **一位年轻的运动员一直在苦苦挣扎。然后来了一位睿智的教练。教练训练并指导他。在教练的帮助下，运动员赢得了冠军。教练就像一颗指路星。**

> A miner worked hard in the dark mine every day to dig out coal. The coal was like black gems, providing heat and light for people\'s lives. With each shovel, he brought hope and warmth to the world. **一位矿工每天在黑暗的矿井里辛勤工作来挖掘煤炭。煤炭就像黑色的宝石，为人们的生活提供热量和光明。每铲一下，他都为世界带来了希望和温暖。**

> A group of small clouds coalesce to form a big cloud. At first, they were separate, but gradually they came together and merged. Just like the meaning of \'coalesce\', which is to come together and combine. **一群小云朵合并形成了一大片云。起初，它们是分散的，但逐渐地它们聚集到一起并融合。这就像\'coalesce\'这个词的意思，即联合、合并。**

> A group of animals was in trouble. Different species needed to work together. They formed a coalition. Tigers, elephants, and birds joined forces to find food and protect themselves. Finally, they succeeded. The coalition made them strong. **一群动物陷入了困境。不同的物种需要共同合作。它们组成了一个联盟。老虎、大象和鸟儿联合起来寻找食物并保护自己。最终，它们成功了。这个联盟让它们变得强大。**

> A traveler was lost in a forest. The path was coarse, full of big stones and prickly bushes. It was so rough that it made the traveler\'s journey very difficult. \'Coarse\' means rough and not fine or smooth. **一位旅行者在森林中迷路了。道路很粗糙，到处都是大石头和带刺的灌木丛。它非常粗糙，使得旅行者的旅程十分艰难。\'coarse\'意思是粗糙的，不精细或不光滑的。**

> A chef was criticized for cutting the vegetables coarsely. The customers were not happy as the rough cuts affected the taste. But later, with practice, the chef learned to do it finely. **一位厨师因把蔬菜切得很粗糙而受到批评。顾客们不高兴，因为粗糙的切法影响了口感。但后来，经过练习，厨师学会了精细地切菜。**

> A brave surfer was always excited to ride the waves along the coast. One day, he saw a beautiful shell on the sandy coast. He knew that the coast was not just a boundary but a place full of surprises. **一位勇敢的冲浪者总是兴奋地沿着海岸冲浪。有一天，他在沙滩海岸上看到了一个漂亮的贝壳。他知道海岸不仅是边界，还是充满惊喜的地方。**

> A brave sailor was always exploring the coastal areas. One day, he found a hidden cave along the coast. The beautiful coastal scenery made him fall in love with these places. **一位勇敢的水手总是在探索沿海地区。有一天，他在海岸边发现了一个隐藏的洞穴。美丽的沿海景色让他爱上了这些地方。**

> One day, I was at a party. I saw a coaster under a drink. It prevented the table from getting wet. The coaster was colorful and had a nice pattern. It made the drink look more attractive. **有一天，我在一个派对上。我看到一杯饮料下面有一个杯垫。它防止桌子被弄湿。这个杯垫色彩鲜艳，还有好看的图案。它让这杯饮料看起来更吸引人。**

> A brave sailor was sailing along the coastline. He saw beautiful beaches and cliffs. The coastline was like a border between the sea and the land, guiding him on his adventure. **一位勇敢的水手沿着海岸线航行。他看到了美丽的海滩和悬崖。海岸线就像大海和陆地之间的边界，引领着他的冒险之旅。**

> One cold winter day, Tom was shivering. His mother gave him a warm coat. The coat was thick and soft, protecting him from the cold wind. With the coat on, Tom felt cozy and happy. **在一个寒冷的冬日，汤姆冻得发抖。他的妈妈给了他一件温暖的外套。这件外套又厚又软，保护他免受寒风侵袭。穿上这件外套，汤姆感到舒适又开心。**

> Imagine a superhero\'s suit. The special material on the outside that protects and gives it a shiny look is called a coating. Just like that, a coating is a layer that covers and protects something. **想象一下超级英雄的战衣。外面那种起到保护作用并且让它看起来闪闪发亮的特殊材料就叫做涂层。就像这样，coating 指的是覆盖并保护某物的一层。**

> A little girl was crying. Her father tried to coax her by saying funny stories and giving her a big hug. Finally, she stopped crying and smiled. \'Coax\' means to gently persuade or try to get someone to do something. **一个小女孩在哭。她的父亲试图哄她，讲有趣的故事并给她一个大大的拥抱。最后，她不哭了还笑了。\'coax\'意思是温和地劝说或试图让某人做某事。**

> A brave miner was exploring a deep cave. Suddenly, he discovered a shiny blue mineral, which was cobalt. He knew it was valuable and brought it back to the surface, making a fortune. **一位勇敢的矿工正在探索一个深洞。突然，他发现了一种闪亮的蓝色矿物，这就是钴。他知道它很有价值，便把它带回了地面，发了大财。**

> A poor cobbler was working hard to cobble shoes. One day, a fairy appeared and rewarded him for his dedication. From then on, whenever people saw well-cobbled shoes, they thought of the cobbler\'s story. **一个贫穷的补鞋匠努力地修补鞋子。有一天，一位仙女出现并因他的专注而奖励了他。从此，每当人们看到修补得很好的鞋子，就会想起这个补鞋匠的故事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor cobbler who worked hard every day, mending shoes. Despite his simple life, his skills made people\'s shoes as good as new. Remember the hardworking cobbler when you think of this word. **从前，有一个贫穷的补鞋匠，他每天都努力工作，修补鞋子。尽管生活简单，但他的手艺能让人们的鞋子焕然一新。当你想到这个单词时，就记住这个勤劳的补鞋匠。**

> One day, I was walking on a street paved with cobblestones. They were uneven but charming. Suddenly, a cobblestone came loose and almost tripped me. I realized these special stones give the street a unique look. **一天，我走在一条用鹅卵石铺成的街道上。它们高低不平但很迷人。突然，一块鹅卵石松动了，差点把我绊倒。我意识到这些特别的石头让街道别具一格。**

> One day, a little spider was busy spinning a web. The web it made was so fine and looked like a beautiful cobweb. When the wind blew, the cobweb swayed gently. Finally, the cobweb became a masterpiece of the little spider. **有一天，一只小蜘蛛正忙着织网。它织的网如此精细，看起来像一张漂亮的蜘蛛网。当风吹来时，蜘蛛网轻轻摇晃。最终，这张蜘蛛网成了小蜘蛛的杰作。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was lost in a jungle. He was very thirsty and finally found a plant called coca. He knew it could help him quench his thirst. But he also knew he should use it carefully. **从前，有一个小男孩在丛林里迷路了。他非常口渴，最后发现了一种叫做古柯的植物。他知道它能帮他解渴。但他也知道应该谨慎使用它。**

> A detective was on a case involving a criminal gang dealing in cocaine. One night, he followed a suspect and saw the exchange of white powder labeled \'cocaine\'. This dangerous drug was ruining lives. **一位侦探正在处理一个涉及贩卖可卡因的犯罪团伙的案件。一天晚上，他跟踪一名嫌疑人，看到了标有\'可卡因\'的白色粉末的交易。这种危险的毒品正在毁掉人们的生活。**

> A rooster, or cock, stands tall in the farmyard. It crows loudly every morning to wake up the farmers. Its colorful feathers and proud stance make it easily recognizable. **一只公鸡，或者说 cock，高高地站在农家庭院里。它每天早上都会大声打鸣来叫醒农民。它多彩的羽毛和骄傲的姿态让人很容易认出它。**
> 想象一下，一只骄傲的公鸡（cock）在飞行比赛中，快速冲进了一个小房间（pit），这个房间就是飞机的驾驶舱。后来人们就把这个驾驶舱称为cockpit。 **想象一只公鸡冲进小房间来辅助记忆单词cockpit（驾驶舱）**

> One day, I saw a big cockroach crawling in the kitchen. It moved very fast and scared me. I tried to catch it but it was too tricky. Finally, I used a spray to drive it away. **有一天，我看到一只大蟑螂在厨房里爬。它移动得非常快，吓到我了。我试图抓住它，但它太狡猾了。最后，我用喷雾把它赶走了。**
> 想象一下，在一个豪华派对上，一只聪明的公鸡（cock）跳上了桌子，尾巴（tail）一甩，打翻了各种酒水，混合出了一杯独特的饮品，这就是鸡尾酒（cocktail）。 **想象在派对上公鸡打翻酒水混合出鸡尾酒的情景来辅助记忆\'cocktail（鸡尾酒）\'这个单词**

> A little rooster was always very cocky. It thought it was the best and strongest in the farm. But one day, it met a big wolf and still showed off. Finally, it got into big trouble. Remember, being cocky can lead to problems! **一只小公鸡总是非常自大。它觉得自己是农场里最棒最强的。但有一天，它遇到了一只大狼，还在炫耀。最后，它陷入了大麻烦。记住，自大可能会导致问题！**

> Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to a farm. There she saw many cocoa trees. The cocoa beans on the trees were used to make delicious chocolate. Lily was so happy to learn about cocoa. **从前，有个叫莉莉的小女孩去了一个农场。在那里她看到了很多可可树。树上的可可豆被用来制作美味的巧克力。莉莉很高兴了解到了可可。**

> A monkey climbed up a tall tree and found a coconut. It tried hard to break the hard shell but failed. Finally, with the help of other animals, it got the delicious milk and flesh inside. **一只猴子爬上一棵高高的树，发现了一个椰子。它努力尝试打破坚硬的外壳但失败了。最后，在其他动物的帮助下，它得到了里面美味的椰汁和椰肉。**

> A little caterpillar built a cozy home called a cocoon. It stayed inside for a long time. Then, one day, it emerged as a beautiful butterfly. The cocoon protected and transformed it. **一只小毛毛虫建造了一个舒适的家，叫做茧。它在里面待了很长时间。然后，有一天，它变成了一只美丽的蝴蝶。茧保护并改变了它。**

> A fisherman was out at sea and caught a big COD. He was so happy as it was a valuable catch. But he needed to be careful handling it to avoid getting hurt. **一位渔夫在海上捕到了一条大鳕鱼。他非常高兴，因为这是很有价值的捕获。但他在处理它时需要小心，以免受伤。**

> A little boy was ill. His mother coddled him, making special soup and tucking him in bed warmly. She was overly protective and spoiling, showing what \'coddle\' means - to treat with excessive care and attention. **一个小男孩生病了。他的妈妈悉心照料他，做特别的汤，还温暖地给他掖好被子。她过度保护和溺爱，这就体现了'coddle'的意思------过分关心和照顾。**

> A spy was sent to steal the secret code. He had to be very careful as the code could unlock vital information. But in the end, our heroes caught him and protected the code. **一名间谍被派去窃取密码。他必须非常小心，因为这个密码可以解锁重要信息。但最终，我们的英雄抓住了他并保护了密码。**

> A group of smart lawyers were working hard to codify a complex set of laws. They sorted and organized them clearly, making it easy for everyone to understand. Just like putting jumbled toys in the right boxes! **一群聪明的律师努力将一套复杂的法律进行编纂。他们清晰地整理和组织，让每个人都能轻松理解。就像把杂乱的玩具放进正确的盒子里！**

> One day, a little monkey was very interested in coding. He sat in front of the computer and typed lines of code to create a game. Through coding, he made his dream come true! **有一天，一只小猴子对编码非常感兴趣。它坐在电脑前，输入一行行代码来创建一个游戏。通过编码，它实现了自己的梦想！**

> A girl named Lily was the only one in her class who was a coed. She had both male and female friends and enjoyed the diverse atmosphere. One day, she realized that being a coed made her more open-minded and understanding of different people. **一个叫莉莉的女孩是她班上唯一的男女同校生。她有男性和女性朋友，并享受这种多元化的氛围。有一天，她意识到作为男女同校生让她思想更开放，更能理解不同的人。**

> A scientist was working on a complex equation. The key to solving it was the \'coefficient\'. It was like a secret code that determined how different elements interacted. Without the right coefficient, the equation would remain a mystery. **一位科学家正在研究一个复杂的方程式。解决它的关键是"系数"。它就像一个密码，决定了不同元素如何相互作用。没有正确的系数，这个方程式将仍是个谜。**

> A brave knight was captured by an evil king. The king tried to coerce the knight to reveal the secret of the treasure. But the knight remained firm and refused to be forced. Finally, he escaped. **一位勇敢的骑士被邪恶的国王俘虏了。国王试图胁迫骑士说出宝藏的秘密。但骑士坚定不移，拒绝被强迫。最后，他逃脱了。**

> A thief was caught and the police used coercion to make him confess. They threatened to keep him in prison for a long time if he didn\'t tell the truth. Coercion means the act of forcing someone to do something. **一个小偷被抓住了，警察使用强制手段让他认罪。他们威胁说如果他不说实话就把他长期关在监狱里。coercion 意思是强迫某人做某事的行为。**

> A thief was caught and the police used coercive measures to make him confess. They were firm and forceful, not giving him any chance to escape. \'Coercive\' means using force or pressure to make someone do something. **一个小偷被抓住了，警察使用强制手段让他招供。他们态度坚决且强硬，不给他任何逃跑的机会。'coercive'意思是使用武力或压力迫使某人做某事。**

> One day, a tired traveler was walking in the desert. Suddenly, he found an oasis with a small coffee shop. The smell of coffee made him energetic. He enjoyed the coffee and continued his journey happily. **一天，一位疲惫的旅行者在沙漠中行走。突然，他发现了一个有小咖啡店的绿洲。咖啡的香气让他充满活力。他享用了咖啡，愉快地继续他的旅程。**

> The king stored his treasures in a big coffer. One day, a thief tried to steal it but was caught. The coffer was so heavy that it needed several people to move. **国王把他的财宝存放在一个大保险箱里。有一天，一个小偷试图偷走它，但被抓住了。这个保险箱太重了，需要好几个人才能搬动。**

> A brave detective was investigating a mysterious case. In a dark room, he found a coffin. But when he opened it, there was nothing inside. It turned out to be a trap set by the criminals. > A little mouse was running in a big machine. It saw a cog that was very important. Without the cog, the machine couldn\'t work. The cog looked like a wheel with teeth. **一只小老鼠在一个大机器里跑。它看到了一个非常重要的齿轮。没有这个齿轮，机器就无法运转。这个齿轮看起来像一个带齿的轮子。**

> One day, a detective was investigating a case in a luxurious mansion. He found a hidden room filled with cognac bottles. The owner of the mansion claimed it was the finest cognac. The detective knew this cognac was the key clue to solving the mystery. **一天，一位侦探在一座豪华宅邸调查案件。他发现一个隐藏的房间里摆满了干邑白兰地酒瓶。宅邸的主人声称这是最优质的干邑。侦探知道这种干邑是解开谜团的关键线索。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a mysterious forest. To find the way out, he had to use all his cognition. He observed, thought, and remembered, finally relying on his cognitive skills to return safely. **一位勇敢的冒险家在神秘森林中迷路了。为了找到出路，他不得不运用他所有的认知能力。他观察、思考、记忆，最终依靠他的认知技能安全返回。**

> Once upon a time, a little robot was lost. To find its way home, it needed to use its cognitive skills to remember the route. It thought hard and finally succeeded. > A detective was cognizant of all the clues in a mysterious case. He carefully observed and analyzed, knowing that being cognizant was the key to solving the puzzle. It means being fully aware or having knowledge of something. **一位侦探清楚知晓一起神秘案件的所有线索。他仔细观察和分析，深知有清楚的认知是解开谜团的关键。这个单词意思是意识到或知晓某事。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He found various clues, but they seemed scattered at first. However, as he kept digging, he discovered the coherence among them and finally solved the case. > A detective was trying to solve a complex case. The clues were all over the place. But then he found some coherent evidence that linked everything together. Finally, he cracked the case! **一位侦探试图侦破一起复杂的案件。线索到处都是。但后来他发现了一些连贯的证据，将所有的东西都联系在了一起。最终，他破了案！**
> 想象一个团队，成员们像拼图块一样紧密相连。无论遇到什么困难，他们都不分散，这种让他们紧密团结的力量就是 cohesion 。就如同胶水把物体粘在一起，cohesion 让团队具有强大的凝聚力。 **想象一个团队中使成员紧密团结的力量，如同胶水的作用，这就是\'凝聚力\'cohesion**

> A king led his cohort of brave soldiers into battle. The cohort was united and strong, ready to face any danger. They were like a family, always standing together. **一位国王率领他的一群勇敢的士兵投入战斗。这群士兵团结一致且强大，准备好面对任何危险。他们就像一个大家庭，始终站在一起。**

> A snake was coiling around a tree trunk. It moved in a circular way, forming loops. Just like a wire coiled neatly. Remember, \'coil\' means to wind or twist in loops! **一条蛇正盘绕在树干上。它以圆形的方式移动，形成圈。就像一根电线整齐地盘绕着。记住，\'coil\'意思是盘绕、卷成圈！**

> One day, a little boy found a shiny coin on the street. He was very happy and decided to save it. Later, he used the coin to buy a sweet candy. The coin brought him joy. **有一天，一个小男孩在街上发现了一枚闪亮的硬币。他非常高兴，决定把它存起来。后来，他用这枚硬币买了一颗甜甜的糖果。这枚硬币给他带来了快乐。**
> 想象有两条不同的路线，一条代表你的计划，一条代表实际发生的事情。有一天，这两条路线神奇地重合了，这就是 coincide ，就像计划和现实恰好相符。 **想象两条路线重合来辅助记忆【coincide】，意思是（想法、意见等）相符；同时发生**

> One day, I met my old friend in a strange city. We both had no plan to be there. It was such a coincidence! We laughed and enjoyed the unexpected encounter. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市遇到了我的老朋友。我们俩都没计划去那里。这真是太巧了！我们笑着享受这意外的相遇。**

> Long ago, a group of brave adventurers set sail. They reached a new land and started to build houses, grow crops. They were colonizing this unknown place, making it their new home. **很久以前，一群勇敢的冒险家扬帆起航。他们到达了一片新大陆，开始建造房屋、种植庄稼。他们正在对这个未知的地方进行殖民，使其成为他们的新家。**

I realized \'colorful\' means full of different and bright colors. **一天，我去了一个满是五颜六色花朵的花园。红的、蓝的、黄的......就像一个神奇的地方。这多彩的场景让我非常开心。我明白了\'colorful\'意思是充满了不同的鲜艳色彩。**

> One day, little Tom was having fun with coloring. He chose his favorite colors and started to fill the pictures. The act of coloring made him very happy and creative. **一天，小汤姆正在开心地着色。他挑选了最喜欢的颜色，开始给图片填色。着色这个行为让他非常快乐且富有创造力。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magic paint. But it was colorless and couldn\'t make beautiful pictures. One day, a fairy gave it color and it became wonderful. So, \'colorless\' means without color. **从前，有一瓶神奇的颜料。但它是无色的，不能画出美丽的画。有一天，一位仙女给了它颜色，它变得很棒。所以，\'colorless\'意思是没有颜色的。**

> A long time ago, there was a colossal statue in a faraway land. It was so huge that it could be seen from miles away. People were amazed by its colossal size and couldn\'t forget it. **很久以前，在一个遥远的地方有一座巨大的雕像。它是如此巨大，以至于在几英里外都能看到。人们对它巨大的尺寸感到惊讶，难以忘怀。**

> A young boy named Tom loved horses. One day, he saw a new colt in the stable. It was energetic and playful. Tom decided to train it to become a great horse. The colt grew strong and fast under Tom\'s care. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩喜欢马。有一天，他在马厩里看到一匹小马驹。它精力充沛又顽皮。汤姆决定训练它成为一匹出色的马。在汤姆的照料下，这匹小马驹长得又壮又快。**
> 想象一下，在古老的城堡中，有一排士兵整齐地站成一列（column）。他们像柱子一样笔直，坚守着自己的位置，保卫着城堡。这一列士兵就是 column 的形象体现。 **想象在古老城堡中一排像柱子般笔直站立的士兵来体现 column（列；柱）**

> A young journalist dreamed of becoming a famous columnist. One day, she got a chance to write a column about a big event. Her unique views made her column popular, and she finally achieved her dream. **一位年轻的记者梦想成为著名的专栏作家。有一天，她得到了一个机会为一件大事写专栏。她独特的观点使她的专栏受欢迎，最终她实现了梦想。**

> A brave astronaut was on a space mission. Suddenly, a strange radiation made him fall into a coma. His team worked hard to bring him back to consciousness. \'Coma\' is like a deep sleep that one can\'t easily wake up from. **一位勇敢的宇航员正在执行太空任务。突然，一种奇怪的辐射使他陷入昏迷。他的团队努力让他恢复意识。\'coma\'就像是一种深度睡眠，人很难从中醒来。**

> A man was in a coma after a serious accident. His state was described as comatose. People worried if he would ever wake up. But finally, with time and care, he regained consciousness. **一个男人在一场严重事故后陷入昏迷。他的状态被描述为昏迷的。人们担心他是否会醒来。但最终，随着时间和照料，他恢复了意识。**

> A princess was lost in a forest. She used a comb to tidy her hair and then found her way back by following the comb\'s reflection in a stream. The comb became her lucky charm. **一位公主在森林里迷路了。她用梳子整理头发，然后通过溪流中梳子的反光找到了回去的路。梳子成了她的幸运符。**

> A brave soldier entered the combat zone. He faced many enemies but didn\'t back down. He fought bravely to protect his country. \'Combat\' means to fight or struggle against something or someone. **一位勇敢的士兵进入战斗区域。他面对众多敌人却毫不退缩。他英勇作战以保卫国家。'combat'意思是与某物或某人战斗或斗争。**

> In a fierce battle, a brave soldier was seen as the most active combatant. He fought fearlessly against the enemy, showing great courage and strength. Remember, a combatant is someone engaged in battle. **在一场激烈的战斗中，一位勇敢的士兵被视为最活跃的战斗人员。他无畏地与敌人作战，展现出巨大的勇气和力量。记住，combatant 就是参与战斗的人。**

> One day, in a boxing ring, a combative boxer was always ready to fight. He had a fierce look and never backed down. His combative spirit made him a tough opponent. **有一天，在拳击台上，一名好斗的拳击手总是准备战斗。他表情凶悍，从不退缩。他的好斗精神使他成为一个强硬的对手。**

> A thief was trying to crack a safe. He needed the right combination of numbers. After many tries, he finally got it - 1234. The combination opened the door to treasures. Remember, combination means a joining of things to form a whole. **一个小偷试图打开一个保险箱。他需要正确的数字组合。经过多次尝试，他终于得到了------1234。这个组合打开了宝藏之门。记住，combination 意思是事物的结合以形成一个整体。**

> A group of scientists were working on a project. They needed to combine different chemicals to create a new medicine. Through their efforts and combination, they finally succeeded. **一组科学家正在进行一个项目。他们需要将不同的化学物质结合起来以制造一种新药。通过他们的努力和结合，他们最终成功了。**

> A group of scientists combined their efforts to solve a difficult problem. They brought together different ideas and skills, just like the parts of \'combined\', and finally achieved success. **一群科学家共同努力去解决一个难题。他们将不同的想法和技能组合在一起，就像'combined'这个词所表达的，最终取得了成功。**

> A musician was struggling to create a unique sound. One day, he combined different instruments in a new way and discovered the amazing \'combo\' that made the audience cheer. It was a magical combination! **一位音乐家一直努力创造独特的声音。有一天，他以新的方式组合了不同的乐器，发现了令人惊叹的"组合"，让观众欢呼。这是一个神奇的组合！**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的实验室里，科学家们正在研究一种神秘的物质。当他们把这种物质加热时，突然发生了剧烈的反应，火焰熊熊燃烧，这就是 combustion（燃烧、氧化）的过程。 **想象在实验室里物质加热后燃烧的情景来记住 combustion 这个表示燃烧、氧化的单词。**

> One day, a little bird was flying in the sky. Suddenly, it saw a beautiful garden and decided to come down and explore. It flew towards the garden and landed safely. The bird was very happy to come to this wonderful place. **一天，一只小鸟在天空中飞翔。突然，它看到一个美丽的花园，决定飞下来探索。它朝着花园飞来并安全着陆。小鸟非常高兴来到这个美妙的地方。**

> A famous singer had a hard time. But with new songs and a strong spirit, she made a powerful comeback. People were amazed and loved her again. The word \'comeback\' means a return to success after a difficult period. **一位著名歌手曾经历艰难时光。但凭借新歌和坚强的精神，她强势回归。人们感到惊讶并再次喜爱她。单词\'comeback\'意思是在困难时期后重新获得成功。**

> A young man always dreamed of becoming a comedian. One day, he bravely stood on the stage and told funny jokes. People laughed and he knew he found his way. Now he\'s a famous comedian, making everyone happy. **一个年轻人一直梦想成为一名喜剧演员。有一天，他勇敢地站在舞台上讲有趣的笑话。人们大笑，他知道自己找到了方向。现在他是一位著名的喜剧演员，给每个人带来快乐。**

> One day, I was feeling down. Then I watched a comedy show. The funny actors and their hilarious jokes made me laugh non-stop. From then on, I knew comedy could bring so much joy and happiness. **有一天，我心情低落。然后我看了一场喜剧表演。有趣的演员和他们滑稽的笑话让我笑个不停。从那时起，我知道了喜剧能带来这么多的欢乐和幸福。**

> A little rabbit was a new comer to the forest. It was nervous but curious. It met other animals and slowly became a familiar face. The rabbit was a brave comer, ready to explore its new home. **一只小兔子是森林的新来者。它很紧张但又充满好奇。它遇到了其他动物，慢慢地变成了熟面孔。这只兔子是个勇敢的来者，准备探索它的新家。**

> One night, a little boy was looking up at the sky. Suddenly, he saw a bright object with a long tail. His father told him it was a comet. The boy was so amazed and never forgot that magical moment. **一天晚上，一个小男孩抬头看天空。突然，他看到一个带有长尾巴的明亮物体。他爸爸告诉他那是一颗彗星。小男孩非常惊讶，永远忘不了那个神奇的时刻。**

> One cold night, I was shivering in a dark corner. Suddenly, a warm blanket and a hot cup of cocoa appeared. They gave me comfort and made me feel safe and at ease. **一个寒冷的夜晚，我在黑暗的角落里瑟瑟发抖。突然，一条温暖的毯子和一杯热可可出现了。它们给了我安慰，让我感到安全和安心。**

> One day, I was very tired after a long walk. When I sat on a soft sofa, I felt so comfortable. It was like all my exhaustion vanished. The sofa hugged me gently, making me relaxed and at ease. **有一天，我走了很长的路后非常累。当我坐在一张柔软的沙发上时，我感觉非常舒服。就好像我所有的疲惫都消失了。沙发轻轻地拥抱着我，让我感到放松和自在。**

> One day, I was very tired after a long walk. But when I sat on a soft sofa comfortably, I felt all my exhaustion fade away. The sofa gave me a great sense of comfort and relaxation. **有一天，我走了很长的路后非常累。但当我舒服地坐在柔软的沙发上时，我感到所有的疲惫都消失了。沙发给了我极大的舒适和放松感。**

> One cold night, I was shivering in bed. Suddenly, a comforter appeared like a magic blanket. It was so soft and warm, making me feel cozy and protected. I hugged it tightly and slept soundly. **在一个寒冷的夜晚，我在床上瑟瑟发抖。突然，一床被子像魔法毯子一样出现了。它又软又暖和，让我感到舒适和受保护。我紧紧地抱住它，睡得很香。**

> One day, I was very tired after a long walk. Then I found a sofa that was so comfy. I sat on it and felt all my stress disappear. It was like a magical place of relaxation. **有一天，我走了很长的路后非常累。然后我发现了一个非常舒适的沙发。我坐在上面，感觉所有的压力都消失了。它就像一个神奇的放松之地。**

> One day, I was feeling sad. Then a friend showed me a comic. The funny pictures and jokes in it made me laugh a lot. From then on, I always remember \'comic\' as something that brings joy. **有一天，我心情低落。然后一个朋友给我看了一本漫画。里面有趣的图片和笑话让我大笑不止。从那以后，我总是记得\'comic\'是能带来欢乐的东西。**

> One day, I went to a circus. There was a clown who had a comical face and did funny moves. Everyone laughed loudly. His performance was so comical that it made our day full of joy. **有一天，我去了一个马戏团。有一个小丑，他有一张滑稽的脸，还做着有趣的动作。每个人都大声笑了。他的表演太滑稽了，让我们这一天都充满了欢乐。**

> One day, a little bird was excitedly chirping, \'The spring is coming!\'. It saw the flowers blooming and the grass turning green. Everyone was happy as the new season was coming. **一天，一只小鸟兴奋地叽叽喳喳叫着："春天要来了！"。它看到花朵绽放，草地变绿。随着新季节的到来，每个人都很开心。**

> One day, a little comma was feeling lost in a long sentence. It thought it was too small and unimportant. But when it was removed, the meaning of the sentence changed completely. Then the comma realized its great value. **有一天，一个小逗号在一个长句子里感到失落。它觉得自己太小太不重要了。但当它被去掉时，句子的意思完全变了。然后逗号意识到了自己的巨大价值。**

> A brave general commanded his soldiers to attack the enemy\'s castle. With his strong and confident voice, everyone knew exactly what to do. The word \'command\' means to give orders or have authority over something. **一位勇敢的将军指挥他的士兵攻打敌人的城堡。凭借他强有力且自信的声音，每个人都清楚地知道该做什么。单词\'command\'意思是下达命令或对某事有权威。**

> One day, during a war, the army needed more vehicles. So, they commandeered all the cars in the town to transport soldiers and supplies. It means to take control of something forcefully for a specific purpose. **有一天，在战争期间，军队需要更多的车辆。于是，他们强行征用了镇上所有的汽车来运输士兵和物资。这个词的意思是为了特定目的强行控制某物。**

> A brave soldier was chosen as the commander. In a fierce battle, he led his troops with wisdom and courage. His orders were clear and precise, making everyone trust him. Remember, commander means the one who leads. **一位勇敢的士兵被选为指挥官。在一场激烈的战斗中，他以智慧和勇气领导他的部队。他的命令清晰准确，让每个人都信任他。记住，commander 意思是领导者。**

> A soldier was on a mission. He showed a commanding presence, leading his team with confidence. His strong voice and determined look made everyone follow his orders. With his commanding skills, they successfully completed the task. **一位士兵正在执行任务。他展现出威严的气质，自信地领导着他的团队。他强有力的声音和坚定的神情让每个人都听从他的命令。凭借他指挥的技能，他们成功完成了任务。**

> One day, a wise old man gave a special commandment to a group of young adventurers. \'Follow this rule,\' he said, \'and it will lead you to success.\' The commandment was like a guiding light in their journey. **有一天，一位智慧的老人给了一群年轻的冒险家一条特殊的诫命。'遵循这个规则，'他说，'它将引领你们走向成功。'这条诫命在他们的旅程中就像一盏指路明灯。**

> A group of brave soldiers were chosen to be the commando. They had to sneak into the enemy\'s base at night. Their mission was dangerous but they were fearless. **一群勇敢的士兵被选为突击队员。他们必须在夜间潜入敌人的基地。他们的任务很危险，但他们无所畏惧。**

> A group of friends decided to plant a special tree to commemorate their graduation. They gathered around, shared memories, and knew this tree would always remind them of that important time. **一群朋友决定种一棵特别的树来纪念他们的毕业。他们聚在一起，分享回忆，并且知道这棵树会永远让他们想起那段重要的时光。**

> A group of friends decided to hold a big party as a commemoration of their graduation. They shared memories, took photos, and promised to keep in touch. It was a day full of joy and nostalgia. **一群朋友决定举办一个盛大的聚会来纪念他们的毕业。他们分享回忆、拍照，并承诺保持联系。这是充满欢乐和怀旧的一天。**

> A group of friends decided to create a commemorative album for their graduation. They collected photos and wrote down memories. This album would always remind them of the wonderful time together. **一群朋友决定为他们的毕业制作一本纪念册。他们收集照片并写下回忆。这本纪念册将永远让他们想起在一起的美好时光。**
> A group of students were very nervous before the exam. But when the bell rang, they commenced writing answers quickly. It means to begin or start. **一群学生在考试前非常紧张。但当铃声响起，他们就开始快速答题。这个单词意思是开始、着手。**
> 想象一下，学校的毕业典礼（commencement）上，同学们兴奋地等待新旅程的开始。校长宣布典礼开始，这就是commencement，标志着一段学习的结束和新生活的开启。 **想象学校毕业典礼上，校长宣布开始，这就是\'commencement\'，表示开始、开端**

> A brave soldier performed outstandingly in the battle. The general commended him in front of all the troops, saying his actions were worthy of praise and recognition. This made the soldier feel extremely proud. **一位勇敢的士兵在战斗中表现出色。将军在全体部队面前称赞了他，说他的行为值得赞扬和认可。这让士兵感到无比自豪。**

> A hardworking student expected a salary commensurate with his efforts. But the company didn\'t offer it. He was very disappointed. It means proportionate or corresponding. **一个勤奋的学生期望得到与他的努力相称的薪水。但公司没有提供。他非常失望。这个单词意思是成比例的；相称的；相应的。**

> One day, Tom saw a strange scene on the street. When his friend asked him about it, he gave a detailed comment. He said, \'I think that person was in a hurry.\' This helped his friend understand the situation better. **一天，汤姆在街上看到一个奇怪的场景。当他的朋友问他时，他给出了详细的评论。他说：'我觉得那个人很匆忙。'这让他的朋友更好地理解了情况。**
> 在一场激烈的足球比赛中，解说员激情地进行着commentary，他详细地描述每个精彩瞬间，观众们通过他的话语更好地理解比赛。 **在一场足球比赛中，解说员激情地进行着评论，他详细地描述每个精彩瞬间，观众们通过他的话语更好地理解比赛。**

> A commentator was at a big sports game. Everyone was excited, but the commentator had to stay calm and clearly describe what was happening. His words guided the viewers and made the game more understandable. **一位评论员在一场大型体育比赛现场。所有人都很兴奋，但评论员必须保持冷静，清晰地描述正在发生的事情。他的话语引导着观众，让比赛更易于理解。**

> A young entrepreneur started a small business. Through hard work and smart strategies, his trade grew and he formed many partnerships. His success was all about commerce - the exchange of goods and services. **一位年轻的企业家创办了一家小企业。通过努力工作和明智的策略，他的贸易不断增长，并建立了许多合作伙伴关系。他的成功都与商业------商品和服务的交换有关。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to start a business. He needed a commercial space to sell his products. After a long search, he found the perfect place and his business thrived. \'Commercial\' means related to business and trade. **一位年轻的企业家想要创业。他需要一个商业空间来销售他的产品。经过长时间的寻找，他找到了完美的地方，他的生意兴隆起来。\'commercial\'意思是与商业和贸易有关的。**

> A young entrepreneur had a brilliant idea for a new product. With determination, he worked hard to commercialize it. He found partners, did marketing, and finally made it available to the public, turning his idea into a successful business. **一位年轻的企业家有一个新产品的绝妙想法。他下定决心努力将其商业化。他找到了合作伙伴，做了营销，最终向公众推出，将他的想法变成了成功的生意。**

> A young entrepreneur struggled to sell his products. But after learning marketing strategies, he finally succeeded commercially. His business grew and made profits. Now he knows how to do well commercially. **一位年轻的企业家努力销售他的产品。但在学习了营销策略后，他终于在商业上取得了成功。他的生意发展并盈利了。现在他知道如何在商业上做好。**

> A brave detective was given the commission to solve a mysterious case. He worked hard and finally completed the mission successfully. The commission made him a hero. **一位勇敢的侦探接到了侦破一起神秘案件的委托。他努力工作，最终成功完成了任务。这次委托使他成为了英雄。**

> A brave man was chosen as the commissioner. His task was to solve the mystery of stolen treasures. With great courage and wisdom, he finally found the clues and completed the mission. **一位勇敢的人被选为专员。他的任务是解开被盗宝藏之谜。凭借巨大的勇气和智慧，他最终找到了线索并完成了使命。**

> A thief committed a crime and was caught. He regretted his actions and committed to changing. Remember, \'commit\' means to do something, whether good or bad. **一个小偷犯了罪并被抓住了。他后悔自己的行为，并承诺要改变。记住，\'commit\'意思是做某事，无论是好是坏。**

> A young man was determined to become a doctor. He made a commitment to study hard every day. Despite difficulties, he kept his promise and finally achieved his goal. The commitment led him to success. **一个年轻人决心成为一名医生。他做出承诺每天努力学习。尽管困难重重，他坚守诺言，最终实现了目标。这份承诺引领他走向成功。**
> 想象一个小镇，要决定是否建公园。一群人聚在一起讨论，他们就是 committee。有老师、商人、农民等，各抒己见。最终做出了对小镇有益的决定。 **想象一个关于小镇决定建公园，一群人组成的委员会讨论并做决定的故事。**

> A merchant was very worried because his ship carrying many commodities, like fine clothes and precious jewels, got lost at sea. But luckily, they were found later and he made a big profit. **一位商人非常担心，因为他那艘载着许多商品，如精美服装和珍贵珠宝的船在海上失踪了。但幸运的是，后来找到了，他赚了一大笔钱。**

> Once upon a time, in a village, everyone used the same well for water. This shared well was common to all. It meant something familiar and widely available. So, \'common\' means shared by many or usual. **从前，在一个村庄里，每个人都用同一口井打水。这口共享的井对所有人来说是常见的。这意味着被许多人共享的或常见的。所以，\'common\'意思是共同的，常见的。**

> In a small village, people shared a commonality -- a love for the local river. They all protected it together. This common interest united them. The word \'commonality\' means something shared by all. **在一个小村庄里，人们有一个共同点------都喜爱当地的河流。他们一起保护它。这种共同的兴趣把他们团结起来。'commonality'这个单词意思是共同的特点或性质。**

> In the old kingdom, the king wore fancy clothes. But outside the palace walls, commoners worked hard in simple clothes. They were the ordinary people, not noble or rich. They were the commoner. **在古老的王国里，国王穿着华丽的衣服。但在宫殿墙外，平民穿着朴素的衣服努力工作。他们是普通人，不是贵族或富人。他们就是平民。**

> Once upon a time, in a small town, people commonly shared their food and helped each other. It was a usual and frequent sight. Commonly here means something that happens often or is usual. **从前，在一个小镇上，人们通常分享他们的食物并且互相帮助。这是常见且频繁的景象。commonly 在这里指经常发生或常见的。**

> A young artist always thought his ideas were unique. But one day, he found that many others had the same thoughts. He realized that what he thought was special was actually commonplace. It taught him to be more humble. **一位年轻的艺术家总认为自己的想法很独特。但有一天，他发现很多其他人也有同样的想法。他意识到自己认为特别的东西实际上很常见。这教会他要更谦逊。**

> In a small town, there was a commons area where everyone could gather and enjoy. It was a place for children to play and adults to chat. The commons belonged to all and was a symbol of unity and sharing. **在一个小镇上，有一块公共区域，每个人都可以在此聚集和享受。这是孩子们玩耍、大人们聊天的地方。这块公共用地属于所有人，是团结和共享的象征。**

> Once upon a time, in a land where people shared resources and worked together, they called it a commonwealth. It meant a group of people united for the common good and prosperity. **从前，在一片土地上，人们共享资源并共同努力，他们把这个地方称为英联邦。它意味着一群人为了共同的利益和繁荣而联合在一起。**

> One day, a commotion happened in the quiet town. A group of monkeys escaped from the zoo and ran around, causing chaos. People were shouting and running everywhere. Such a scene was truly a commotion. **有一天，在安静的小镇上发生了一场骚乱。一群猴子从动物园逃了出来，到处乱跑，造成了混乱。人们到处叫喊着奔跑。这样的场景真是一场骚乱。**

> In a communal garden, people shared their tools and plants. They worked together, enjoying the common space. Communal means shared by all members of a community. **在一个公共花园里，人们共享他们的工具和植物。他们一起劳作，享受着共同的空间。Communal 意思是社区全体成员共有的。**

> In a small town, people lived in a commune. They shared resources and helped each other. It was a place where everyone felt a strong connection and sense of community. They communed with nature and had a peaceful life. **在一个小镇上，人们生活在一个公社里。他们共享资源，互相帮助。这是一个每个人都感到紧密联系和社区感的地方。他们与大自然交流，过着平静的生活。**

> A little bird wanted to communicate with a big elephant. It flew around and chirped loudly. The elephant finally understood through its actions and sounds. Communicating can be in many ways! **一只小鸟想要和一头大象交流。它飞来飞去并大声鸣叫。大象最终通过它的动作和声音明白了。交流可以有很多方式！**

> One day, a little bird was lost. It needed communication to find its way home. It chirped loudly, hoping other birds could understand and help. Finally, with successful communication, it returned safely. **有一天，一只小鸟迷路了。它需要交流来找到回家的路。它大声鸣叫，希望其他鸟儿能够理解并帮助它。最终，通过成功的交流，它安全地回了家。**

> One day, Tom was in a new class. He was very communicative and actively talked to his classmates. He shared his hobbies and listened to theirs. Through communication, he quickly made many friends. **一天，汤姆在一个新班级里。他非常善于交流，积极地和同学们交谈。他分享自己的爱好，也倾听他们的。通过交流，他很快交了很多朋友。**

> In a faraway village, there was a person named Tom. He was an excellent communicator. Whenever there were disputes, Tom could clearly express everyone\'s thoughts and feelings, helping to solve problems. People loved him for his communication skills. **在一个遥远的村庄里，有一个叫汤姆的人。他是一位出色的沟通者。每当有纠纷时，汤姆都能清楚地表达每个人的想法和感受，帮助解决问题。人们因为他的沟通技巧而喜欢他。**

> A young traveler was lost in a strange town. When he entered a church, he felt a sense of communion. People shared smiles and kind words, making him feel part of a warm community. **一个年轻的旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。当他走进一座教堂时，他感受到了一种交流融合。人们分享着微笑和亲切的话语，让他觉得自己成为了一个温暖群体的一部分。**

> A group of scientists was working on a secret project. When they had important findings, they issued a communique to share the news. The communique was like a special message that everyone needed to know. **一群科学家正在进行一个秘密项目。当他们有重要发现时，他们发布了一份公报来分享这个消息。公报就像是每个人都需要知道的特殊消息。**

> Imagine a society where everyone shares resources equally and works for the common good. This ideal society is what communism aims for. People live in harmony, with no one being rich or poor. It\'s a vision of fairness and unity. **想象一个社会，在那里每个人都平等地共享资源，并为共同利益而工作。这种理想的社会就是共产主义所追求的。人们和谐共处，没有人富有或贫穷。这是一种公平和团结的愿景。**

> In a small town, there was a group of people who believed in sharing and equality. They were called communists. They worked together to make sure everyone had enough food and a good life. They cared about the community and its members. **在一个小镇上，有一群人信奉共享和平等。他们被称为共产主义者。他们共同努力，以确保每个人都有足够的食物和美好的生活。他们关心社区及其成员。**

> In a small town, people from different families help each other. They share resources, celebrate festivals together, and care for one another. This is a perfect example of a community, where everyone works for the common good. **在一个小镇上，来自不同家庭的人们互相帮助。他们共享资源，一起庆祝节日，并互相关心。这就是社区的完美范例，每个人都为共同的利益而努力。**

> John had a long commute to work every day. He had to take a train and a bus. But he didn\'t mind because he could read on the way. Commute here means the journey to and from work. **约翰每天上班通勤时间很长。他得先坐火车再坐公交。但他不介意，因为路上能看书。这里的commute指的是上下班的路程。**

> John works in the city but lives in the suburbs. Every day, he takes the train to and from work. John is a typical commuter, spending hours traveling between home and office. **约翰在城市工作但住在郊区。每天，他乘火车上下班。约翰是一个典型的通勤者，花费数小时在家庭和办公室之间往返。**

> A compact car was struggling to fit into a small parking space. It was so tightly packed that it seemed to be saying, \'I\'m compact and need a precise fit!\' **一辆小型汽车努力挤进一个小停车位。它被塞得如此紧，似乎在说：\'我很紧凑，需要精准的停放！\'**

> Once upon a time, a lonely traveler was lost in a forest. Just when he felt hopeless, a friendly dog appeared and became his companion. They walked together and finally found the way out. The dog was a true friend along the journey. **从前，有一个孤独的旅行者在森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望的时候，一只友好的狗出现了，并成为了他的同伴。他们一起走，最终找到了出路。这只狗在旅途中是真正的朋友。**

> Once upon a time, Tom was alone and felt sad. But then he met some nice friends. They shared joys and sorrows together. This connection and time spent with them was called companionship. **从前，汤姆独自一人，感到很悲伤。但后来他遇到了一些很好的朋友。他们一起分享快乐和悲伤。这种联系以及与他们共度的时光就被称为陪伴。**

> One day, Tom was alone in the forest and felt scared. Then a friendly bear appeared and stayed with him. The bear\'s presence was like a good company, making Tom feel safe and no longer afraid. **一天，汤姆独自在森林里感到害怕。然后一只友好的熊出现并陪着他。熊的陪伴就像一个好伙伴，让汤姆感到安全不再害怕。**

> Once upon a time, there were two mountains. One was high and the other was low. We could say the heights of them were comparable. It means they could be compared and were similar in some aspects. **从前，有两座山。一座高，另一座低。我们可以说它们的高度是可比较的。这意味着它们可以被比较并且在某些方面是相似的。**

> A king wanted to know which of his two castles was better. So, he made a comparative study. He looked at size, beauty, and comfort. Finally, he found the differences and chose the better one. **一位国王想知道他的两座城堡哪一个更好。于是，他进行了一项比较研究。他查看了大小、美观和舒适度。最后，他发现了差异并选出了更好的那一个。**

> A little monkey was comparing the heights of two trees comparatively. It found that one was much taller. This helped it understand that \'comparatively\' means in a way of making comparisons. **一只小猴子在相对地比较两棵树的高度。它发现其中一棵高得多。这帮助它理解'comparatively'意思是相对地，比较地。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry decided to compare their collections of toys. Tom had many cars, while Jerry had a bunch of dolls. They carefully looked at each other\'s toys to see which collection was better. This is how they \'compare\'. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞决定比较他们的玩具收藏。汤姆有很多小汽车，而杰瑞有一堆洋娃娃。他们仔细查看彼此的玩具，看谁的收藏更好。这就是他们"比较"的过程。**

> Once, two friends were arguing about whose pet was cuter. They made a comparison. One had a dog, the other a cat. They listed the features and finally decided both were lovely. **有一次，两个朋友在争论谁的宠物更可爱。他们进行了比较。一个有一只狗，另一个有一只猫。他们列出各自的特点，最后认为两只宠物都很可爱。**

> A train has many compartments. One day, a little girl lost her toy in a compartment. She searched everywhere and finally found it under the seat. Remember, compartment means a separate section or room. **火车有很多隔间。有一天，一个小女孩在一个隔间里弄丢了她的玩具。她到处找，最后在座位下找到了。记住，compartment 意思是单独的空间或隔间。**

> A lost traveler in the forest was desperate. Suddenly, he found a compass. The compass pointed the way out, like a magic guide. With its help, he finally reached safety. The compass is a great helper when we are lost. **一位在森林中迷路的旅行者感到绝望。突然，他发现了一个指南针。指南针指明了出路，就像一个神奇的向导。在它的帮助下，他最终到达了安全地带。当我们迷路时，指南针是一个很棒的帮手。**

> A poor man was begging on the street. A kind girl showed compassion and gave him food and money. She felt his pain and wanted to help. Remember, compassion means feeling for others\' suffering and having a desire to ease it. **一个可怜的男人在街上乞讨。一个善良的女孩富有同情心，给了他食物和钱。她感受到了他的痛苦并想要帮忙。记住，compassion 意思是对他人的苦难感同身受并渴望减轻其痛苦。**

> One day, I saw a man helping a stray dog. His eyes showed compassion. He was compassionate, not just ignoring the poor dog. That scene made me understand the meaning of \'compassionate\' - having a kind and sympathetic heart towards others. **有一天，我看到一个男人帮助一只流浪狗。他的眼睛里流露出同情。他富有同情心，而不是仅仅无视这只可怜的狗。那个场景让我明白了\'compassionate\'这个词的意思------对他人怀有善良和同情的心。**
> 想象有两个机器人，一个叫 Comp，一个叫 Tibility。它们一起工作，配合得非常好，没有任何冲突。这就体现了'compatibility'，即兼容性、相容性。 **想象两个机器人配合良好来体现'兼容性、相容性'这个意思的故事**

> Imagine a computer and a printer. They work perfectly together without any glitches. This smooth cooperation shows they are compatible. Just like that, when two things can work well together, we say they are compatible. **想象一台电脑和一台打印机。它们一起工作得非常完美，没有任何故障。这种顺利的合作表明它们是兼容的。就像这样，当两个事物能很好地一起工作时，我们就说它们是兼容的。**

> A compatriot is like a fellow traveler on a long journey. Imagine being lost in a foreign land and suddenly meeting someone from your own country. That person is your compatriot, sharing the same homeland and a sense of belonging. **同胞就像是长途旅行中的同行者。想象在异国他乡迷路时，突然遇到来自自己国家的人。那个人就是你的同胞，共享着相同的祖国和归属感。**

> A brave detective was on a case. The criminal\'s actions were so bad that the law compelled the detective to catch him and bring justice. Compel means to force someone to do something. **一位勇敢的侦探在办案。罪犯的行为太恶劣，法律迫使侦探抓住他并伸张正义。compel 意思是强迫某人做某事。**

> A detective was investigating a mysterious case. The evidence was so compelling that it led him directly to the culprit. It was like a powerful force that couldn\'t be ignored, making the truth impossible to hide. **一位侦探正在调查一起神秘案件。证据是如此令人信服，直接将他引向了罪犯。就像一股强大的力量无法被忽视，让真相无处可藏。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. He found a compendium that held all the essential knowledge and maps to guide him home. The compendium was like a magical key to survival. **一位勇敢的探险家在陌生的土地上迷路了。他发现了一本纲要，里面包含了所有必要的知识和地图来指引他回家。这本纲要就像是生存的神奇钥匙。**

> A worker got injured at work. The company compensated him with money and time off to make up for his loss. So, \'compensate\' means to give something to make up for a loss or damage. **一名工人在工作中受伤了。公司给他补偿了金钱和休假时间，以弥补他的损失。所以，\'compensate\'意思是给予某物来弥补损失或损害。**

> A hardworking employee was injured at work. The company gave him compensation, including money and time off, to make up for his loss. This made him feel valued and helped him recover. **一位勤奋的员工在工作中受伤了。公司给了他补偿，包括金钱和休假，以弥补他的损失。这让他感到被重视，并帮助他恢复。**

> A poor man lost his job. But he got compensatory money from the company. With this, he could pay his bills and start a new life. So, compensatory means providing something to make up for a loss or damage. **一个穷人丢了工作。但他从公司得到了补偿款。有了这笔钱，他能支付账单并开始新生活。所以，compensatory 意思是补偿性的，用以弥补损失或损害。**

> In a magical forest, all the animals wanted to be the king. Rabbits, tigers, and lions all competed to show their strength and wisdom. They ran fast, fought bravely, and thought smartly. Finally, the most outstanding one became the king. **在一个神奇的森林里，所有动物都想成为国王。兔子、老虎和狮子都竞争着展示自己的力量和智慧。它们跑得飞快、战斗勇猛、思考聪慧。最终，最出色的那个成为了国王。**

> Once upon a time, in a fierce job competition, John showed his competence in programming and problem-solving. He got the job easily because of his outstanding skills. Competence means the ability to do something well. **从前，在一场激烈的求职竞争中，约翰展现了他在编程和解决问题方面的能力。他因出色的技能轻松获得了工作。Competence 意思是做某事的能力。**

> A young athlete was determined to prove his competency in the sports field. He trained hard every day, facing challenges and never giving up. Finally, he won the championship and showed his true Competency. **一位年轻的运动员决心在运动场上证明自己的能力。他每天刻苦训练，面对挑战从不放弃。最终，他赢得了冠军，展示了自己真正的能力。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young man seeking a job. In an interview, he showed his competent skills and knowledge, impressing the boss. Finally, he got the position because he was truly capable and qualified. **从前，有个年轻人找工作。在一场面试中，他展现出了自己出色的技能和知识，给老板留下了深刻印象。最终，他得到了这个职位，因为他确实有能力且胜任。**

> A group of animals were having a competition to see who could climb the highest tree. The monkey thought he would win easily, but the squirrel showed great effort and won. It taught them that competition is full of surprises. **一群动物正在进行一场比赛，看谁能爬上最高的树。猴子以为自己能轻松获胜，但松鼠展现出了巨大的努力并赢了。这让它们明白竞争充满了惊喜。**

> There was a running race. Many people participated. They all wanted to win because it was a competitive event. Everyone gave their best to outrun others. The spirit of being competitive made the race exciting. **有一场跑步比赛。很多人参加。这是一场竞争激烈的赛事，所以他们都想赢。每个人都全力以赴想超过其他人。这种竞争的精神让比赛变得令人兴奋。**

> In a big race, there were many runners. One of them was John, who was a strong competitor. He trained hard every day and never gave up. Finally, he had a chance to win the race. **在一场大型比赛中，有很多赛跑者。其中一位是约翰，他是一个强大的竞争者。他每天都刻苦训练，从不放弃。最终，他有机会赢得比赛。**

> A group of students were assigned the task of compilation. They had to collect and organize various data for a project. It was like putting pieces of a puzzle together to form a complete and useful collection. **一组学生被分配了编译的任务。他们必须为一个项目收集和整理各种数据。这就像把拼图的碎片拼在一起，形成一个完整且有用的集合。**

> A programmer named Lily was given a task to COMPILE a bunch of code. She worked hard, gathering and organizing all the necessary parts, just like collecting pieces of a puzzle. Finally, she successfully compiled the code and made it work. **一位名叫莉莉的程序员接到了编译一堆代码的任务。她努力工作，收集并整理所有必要的部分，就像收集拼图的碎片一样。最后，她成功地编译了代码并使其运行。**

> A king became complacency after winning many battles. He stopped training his army and ignored his people\'s needs. Soon, his kingdom was attacked and he lost everything. Remember, complacency can lead to downfall. **一位国王在赢得多次战役后变得自满。他停止训练军队，也不理会人民的需求。很快，他的王国遭到攻击，他失去了一切。记住，自满会导致失败。**

> A complacent cat always thought it was the best climber. But one day, it met a monkey that climbed much faster. The cat realized its complacency was wrong. It needed to keep improving. **一只自满的猫总认为自己是最厉害的攀爬者。但有一天，它遇到了一只爬得更快的猴子。这只猫意识到自己的自满是错误的。它需要不断进步。**

> One day, Tom was very unhappy. He had a lot of problems at work. So he decided to complain to his friend. He said, \'I\'m so tired of all these difficulties.\' This shows the act of expressing dissatisfaction, which is what \'complain\' means. **有一天，汤姆非常不开心。他在工作中有很多问题。所以他决定向他的朋友抱怨。他说：'我受够了所有这些难题。' 这展示了表达不满的行为，这就是'complain'的意思。**

> One day, Tom went to a store. He bought a bad product and was very unhappy. So, he made a complaint to the store manager. The manager listened carefully and promised to solve the problem. **一天，汤姆去了一家商店。他买了一个劣质产品，非常不高兴。于是，他向商店经理投诉。经理认真倾听并承诺解决问题。**

> A king needed a complement of brave soldiers to win the battle. But he only had a few. Then some new soldiers came and completed his force. Finally, they won. The new soldiers were the complement needed. **一位国王需要一批勇敢的士兵作为补充才能赢得战斗。但他起初只有几个。后来一些新士兵到来，补充了他的兵力。最终，他们胜利了。新士兵就是所需要的补充。**

> A doctor told a patient that the new medicine and the old one were complementary. They worked together perfectly to cure the disease. Just like two pieces of a puzzle, they fit and made the treatment successful. **一位医生告诉一位病人，新药和旧药是互补的。它们完美地协同作用来治愈疾病。就像拼图的两块，它们契合并使治疗成功。**

> Once upon a time, a student had many tasks to do. He worked hard and finished all of them. When he crossed the last one off the list, he felt a sense of relief. He had completed everything! **从前，有个学生有很多任务要做。他努力工作并完成了所有任务。当他划掉清单上的最后一项时，他感到如释重负。他完成了所有的事情！**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost in a big forest. She was scared completely. But finally, she found her way out. \'Completely\' here means totally and without any part left. **从前，一个小女孩在大森林里迷路了。她完全被吓到了。但最后，她找到了出路。'completely'在这里表示完全地，毫无保留地。**

> A student was working hard to finish a difficult project. After many days of effort, he finally reached the completion. It felt like a huge achievement and he was very happy. **一名学生努力完成一项困难的项目。经过多日的努力，他终于达成了完工。这感觉像是一项巨大的成就，他非常高兴。**

> A king had a complex castle. It had many rooms and secret passages. It was not simple to navigate. Remember, \'complex\' means not simple and having many parts or details. **一位国王有一座复杂的城堡。它有很多房间和秘密通道。要穿行其中可不简单。记住，\'complex\'意思是不简单的，有很多部分或细节的。**

> A princess had a unique complexion. Her skin was fair and smooth like a pearl. But one day, she got ill and her complexion changed. Everyone was worried. Later, with proper care, her original complexion returned. **一位公主有着独特的面色。她的皮肤如珍珠般白皙光滑。但有一天，她生病了，面色改变了。大家都很担心。后来，经过适当的照料，她原来的面色又回来了。**

> A scientist was studying a complex machine. But as he dug deeper, the complexity of its inner workings confused him. It had so many interrelated parts! Finally, he understood that complexity means the state of having many complicated parts or details. **一位科学家正在研究一台复杂的机器。但随着他深入研究，其内部运作的复杂性让他感到困惑。它有如此多相互关联的部件！最后，他明白了 complexity 意思是具有许多复杂的部分或细节的状态。**

> A company was in danger of being shut down due to non-compliance with safety regulations. But after they strictly followed the rules, they achieved compliance and were saved. **一家公司由于不遵守安全规定而面临被关闭的危险。但在他们严格遵循规则后，实现了合规，从而得救。**

> A little robot was compliant. It always followed the instructions given by its master without any protest. It was known for being easily manageable and obedient. Just like the meaning of \'compliant\'. **一个小机器人很顺从。它总是毫无异议地遵循主人给出的指令。它以容易管理和听话而闻名。就像\'compliant\'这个词的意思。**

> A simple math problem was made to complicate when the teacher added many extra conditions. The students struggled to solve it. Now you know complicate means to make something more complex or difficult. **一道简单的数学题在老师添加了许多额外条件后变得复杂了。学生们努力去解答。现在你知道complicate意思是使某物更复杂或困难。**

> A young detective was solving a case. The clues were all over the place and very complicated. But with patience and sharp thinking, he finally untangled the mess. It was like finding the way out of a complex maze. **一位年轻的侦探正在破案。线索到处都是，非常复杂。但凭借耐心和敏锐的思考，他最终理清了头绪。这就像从一个复杂的迷宫中找到出路。**

> A doctor was treating a patient. After the surgery, an unexpected problem appeared - a complication. It made the patient\'s recovery more difficult. The doctor had to find a new way to solve it. **一位医生正在治疗一位病人。手术后，出现了一个意想不到的问题------并发症。这使得病人的康复更加困难。医生不得不寻找新的方法来解决它。**

> A thief was stealing jewels. His partner, who provided tools and a lookout, was involved in the complicity. They thought they could get away with it, but eventually the police caught them both. **一个小偷正在偷珠宝。他的伙伴，提供工具并放风，参与了同谋。他们以为能逃脱，但最终警察把他们俩都抓住了。**

> One day, Tom did a great job on his presentation. His classmates gave him many nice words, saying \'You are amazing!\' These nice words were compliments that made Tom feel happy and confident. **有一天，汤姆在他的演讲中表现出色。他的同学们对他说了很多好听的话，比如'你太棒了！'这些好听的话就是称赞，让汤姆感到开心和自信。**

> A hotel guest was very happy because the staff gave him a complimentary breakfast. It made his day. The word complimentary means given freely or as a gift. **一位酒店客人非常高兴，因为工作人员给他提供了免费的早餐。这让他一天都很开心。complimentary 这个单词的意思是免费赠送的或作为礼物的。**
> 想象一下，有个名叫小李的员工，老板下达的规定他总是乖乖遵守。有次同事劝他别这么听话，小李说'我必须 comply（遵守），不然会有麻烦'。后来小李因守规矩得到了晋升。 **想象一个员工小李遵守规定最终晋升的故事来辅助记忆'comply（遵守）'这个单词**
> 想象一个机器人，它由很多小零件组成。这些小零件就是 components ，比如手臂的零件、腿部的零件等。它们各自发挥作用，共同让机器人正常运转。 **想象一个由许多小零件组成的机器人，这些小零件就是"component（组成部分；成分；部件）"，它们共同使机器人正常运作。**

> A musician was asked to compose a new song. He sat at the piano, thinking hard. Finally, he combined different notes and rhythms to create a beautiful piece. \'Compose\' means to create or put together. **一位音乐家被要求创作一首新歌。他坐在钢琴前，苦思冥想。最后，他把不同的音符和节奏组合在一起，创作出了一首优美的曲子。\'compose\'意思是创作、组成。**

> A composer is like a magical chef. Imagine a chef creating a delicious dish by combining various ingredients. Similarly, a composer mixes different notes and melodies to create wonderful music. Just as the chef makes people\'s taste buds dance, the composer makes our ears happy. **作曲家就像一位神奇的厨师。想象一下，厨师通过组合各种食材来制作美味的菜肴。同样，作曲家混合不同的音符和旋律来创作美妙的音乐。正如厨师让人们的味蕾舞动，作曲家让我们的耳朵愉悦。**

> Imagine a spaceship made of many different materials - metals, plastics, and glass. This spaceship is a \'composite\' object because it\'s composed of various parts. So, \'composite\' means made up of several distinct elements combined together. **想象一艘由许多不同材料------金属、塑料和玻璃制成的宇宙飞船。这艘宇宙飞船就是一个"复合的"物体，因为它由各种不同的部分组成。所以，"composite"意思是由几个不同的元素组合在一起。**

> A little monkey was asked to write a composition about his adventure in the forest. He struggled at first but finally composed a wonderful story. The composition was full of excitement and fun. **一只小猴子被要求写一篇关于它在森林里冒险的作文。它一开始很挣扎，但最终创作了一篇精彩的故事。这篇作文充满了刺激和乐趣。**

> A farmer named Tom was always worried about his poor soil. One day, he learned about compost. He collected leaves and food waste, mixed them together, and made compost. The soil became fertile. Tom was happy as his crops grew well with the help of compost. **一位名叫汤姆的农民总是为他贫瘠的土壤担忧。有一天，他了解到了堆肥。他收集树叶和食物残渣，把它们混合在一起，制成了堆肥。土壤变得肥沃了。汤姆很高兴，因为他的庄稼在堆肥的帮助下长得很好。**

> A king was in a dangerous battle but kept his composure. He didn\'t panic and calmly gave orders, which led to their victory. Composure means the state of being calm and in control of your feelings and reactions. **一位国王身处危险的战斗中但保持沉着。他没有惊慌，冷静地下达命令，最终取得了胜利。composure 意思是沉着冷静，能控制自己的感情和反应的状态。**

> A chemist was working in the lab. He mixed two substances and created a new one. This new substance was a compound. It had unique properties that neither of the original substances had alone. **一位化学家在实验室工作。他混合了两种物质，创造出了一种新的物质。这种新物质就是化合物。它具有单独的两种原始物质都不具备的独特性质。**

> A little monkey wanted to comprehend the mystery of the stars. It read many books and observed the sky every night. Finally, it began to understand and could explain the movement of the stars. Just like that, the monkey comprehended the unknown. **一只小猴子想要理解星星的奥秘。它读了很多书，每晚都观察天空。最终，它开始明白并且能够解释星星的运动。就像这样，猴子理解了未知的事物。**

> A student was struggling to understand a complex math problem. But when the teacher explained it clearly and simply, it became comprehensible. The student was so happy to finally grasp the concept. **一名学生正在努力理解一个复杂的数学问题。但当老师清晰、简单地解释后，它变得可以理解了。学生终于掌握了这个概念，非常高兴。**

> A student struggled to understand a complex text. But with effort and guidance, they finally had comprehension. They could answer all the questions and felt proud. Comprehension means the ability to understand something. **一个学生努力去理解一篇复杂的文章。但通过努力和指导，最终他有了理解。他能够回答所有问题并感到自豪。Comprehension 意思是理解的能力。**

> Imagine a detective who wants to solve a complex case. He collects all possible clues, examines every detail, and considers every aspect. His investigation is so complete and all-encompassing - that\'s what \'comprehensive\' means. **想象一位侦探想要侦破一起复杂的案件。他收集了所有可能的线索，检查了每一个细节，考虑了每一方面。他的调查是如此完整和全面------这就是'comprehensive'的意思。**
> 想象一下，你有一大团棉花糖，它占据了很大空间。为了方便携带，你用力挤压它，让它变小变紧凑。这个用力挤压的过程就像'compress'，就是压缩、压紧的意思。 **想象你用力挤压一团棉花糖使其变小变紧凑的过程来理解'compress'这个词，意思是压缩、压紧。**

> A big balloon was filled with air. But then a strong hand squeezed it hard and made it compressed. The balloon became smaller and smaller, just like when something is compressed and takes up less space. **一个大气球充满了空气。但随后一只强有力的手用力挤压它，使它被压缩了。气球变得越来越小，就像某物被压缩并占用更少空间时一样。**
> 想象一下，你有一个超级大的气球，你不断地挤压它，让它的体积变小。这个挤压的过程就像是\'compression\'，即压缩、压紧。就像数据被压缩，空间被压紧一样。 **想象气球被挤压来辅助记忆\'compression\'这个单词，意为压缩、压紧**

> Imagine a superhero named Compressor. He has the power to squeeze and compress anything. One day, he compressed a huge mountain into a small pebble. Just like him, a compressor machine squeezes and compresses gases or fluids. **想象一个超级英雄叫压缩机侠。他有压缩任何东西的能力。有一天，他把一座大山压缩成了小石子。就像他一样，压缩机这种机器会压缩气体或液体。**
> 想象一个神秘的城堡，里面有各种房间和宝藏。这个城堡就叫 Comprise，它由（comprise）许多不同的部分组成，有高大的塔楼、宽敞的大厅、秘密的通道。这些部分一起构成了这个神奇的城堡。 **想象一个叫 Comprise 的城堡，它由许多不同部分组成，来辅助记忆单词 comprise 有'由......组成'的意思。**

> A couple had a big fight. But to keep their relationship, they both gave up some of their demands. This act of giving and taking was a compromise. Finally, they solved the problem and stayed happy. **一对夫妻大吵了一架。但为了维持他们的关系，他们都放弃了自己的一些要求。这种有取有舍的行为就是妥协。最终，他们解决了问题，保持了幸福。**

> A man was constantly haunted by a strange thought. He had a compulsion to count every step he took. No matter how hard he tried to stop, he couldn\'t. This urge controlled his life. **一个男人总是被一个奇怪的念头所困扰。他有一种强迫自己数每一步的冲动。无论他怎么努力去停止，都做不到。这种冲动控制了他的生活。**

> A man had a compulsive habit of collecting every pen he saw. He couldn\'t stop himself, even when it filled his house. This shows the meaning of \'compulsive\' - an irresistible urge to do something repeatedly. **一个男人有收集他看到的每一支笔的强迫性习惯。他无法控制自己，即使这让他的房子都堆满了笔。这体现了\'compulsive\'的意思------无法抗拒地反复做某事的冲动。**

> A student was very unhappy because he had to take a compulsory course that he hated. But later he found it useful. \'Compulsory\' means something that you must do and have no choice about. **一个学生很不高兴，因为他不得不上一门他讨厌的必修课。但后来他发现这门课有用。\'compulsory\'意思是你必须做且别无选择的事情。**

> A scientist was working hard on a complex computation to solve a mystery. He spent days and nights calculating and analyzing data. Finally, his precise computation led to a great discovery. **一位科学家正在努力进行一项复杂的计算以解开一个谜团。他日夜花费时间计算和分析数据。最终，他精确的计算带来了重大发现。**

> A scientist was working on a computational project. He spent days in front of the computer, using complex algorithms to solve the problem. Finally, his computational skills led to a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一个计算方面的项目。他在电脑前花费了数天时间，使用复杂的算法来解决问题。最终，他的计算能力带来了一项重大发现。**

> One day, Tom needed to compute the total cost of his shopping. He used a calculator to add up all the prices. After a while, he got the final number and knew exactly how much he needed to pay. **有一天，汤姆需要计算他购物的总花费。他用计算器把所有价格加起来。过了一会儿，他得出了最终的数字，确切地知道了自己需要支付多少钱。**

> One day, a little boy was very curious about the world. His parents bought him a computer. With it, he could explore countless mysteries and learn various knowledge. The computer became his best friend and helper. **有一天，一个小男孩对世界充满好奇。他的父母给他买了一台电脑。有了它，他能够探索无数的奥秘，学习各种各样的知识。电脑成了他最好的朋友和帮手。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. A kind person came to help me. I called him comrade because he was like a partner in my difficult time. We found my way together and became good friends. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。一个善良的人来帮助我。我称他为同志，因为在我困难的时候他就像伙伴一样。我们一起找到了路，并成为了好朋友。**
> 从前有个聪明的小孩，总是能'con'（骗）到小伙伴的糖果。他会编造各种理由，让小伙伴们相信他。但最后大家发现了，不再被他'con'。 **从前有个聪明的小孩，总是能骗到小伙伴的糖果。他会编造各种理由，让小伙伴们相信他。但最后大家发现了，不再被他骗。**

> A thief was trying to conceal the stolen jewels in a secret box. But the police were smart and found them. \'Conceal\' means to hide something carefully to prevent others from seeing or finding it. **一个小偷试图把偷来的珠宝藏在一个秘密的盒子里。但警察很聪明，找到了它们。\'conceal\'意思是小心地隐藏某物，以防他人看到或找到。**

> A spy was on a mission to obtain secret documents. To avoid being noticed, he used various tricks for concealment, like wearing disguises and hiding in dark corners. Finally, he succeeded in his concealment and got the important information. **一名间谍正在执行获取秘密文件的任务。为了避免被发现，他使用了各种隐藏手段，比如乔装打扮和躲在黑暗角落。最终，他成功地隐藏了自己并获得了重要信息。**
> In a heated debate, Team A was very strong. Team B finally had to concede that Team A\'s idea was better. It means to admit or yield. **在一场激烈的辩论中，A 队非常强大。B 队最终不得不承认 A 队的想法更好。这意味着承认或让步。**

> A conceited artist always boasted about his paintings. No one liked him. One day, he realized his conceit was a big problem and started to be humble. **一个自负的艺术家总是吹嘘他的画作。没人喜欢他。有一天，他意识到自己的自负是个大问题，于是开始变得谦逊。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious cave. He thought of every conceivable danger and prepared well. Finally, he safely returned. \'Conceivable\' means something that can be imagined or thought of. **一位勇敢的探险家在探索一个神秘的洞穴。他想到了每一种能想到的危险，并做好了充分准备。最后，他安全返回。'conceivable'意思是可以想象或想到的。**

> A young scientist was working on a complex project. His friend asked if he could finish it. He replied, \'Conceivably, if I get enough resources and time.\' Meaning it was possible in theory. **一位年轻的科学家正在做一个复杂的项目。他的朋友问他是否能完成。他回答："可以想象，如果我有足够的资源和时间。"意思是理论上是有可能的。**

> A couple wanted to have a baby. They imagined and planned for it. This act of imagining and forming the idea of having a child is like \'conceive\'. They conceived the possibility of starting a family. **一对夫妇想要个孩子。他们想象并计划着。这种想象和形成拥有孩子的想法的行为就像是'conceive'。他们构想了组建家庭的可能性。**

> A student was having trouble concentrating on her studies. So, she closed the door, turned off the phone, and focused only on the books. Finally, she could concentrate well and got good grades. **一名学生在学习时难以集中注意力。于是，她关上门，关掉手机，只专注于书本。最终，她能够很好地集中精力，并取得了好成绩。**

> A scientist was doing an experiment. He needed to get a concentrated solution. So he focused all his attention and effort, removing impurities to make the liquid highly concentrated. Finally, he succeeded! **一位科学家正在做实验。他需要得到一种浓缩溶液。所以他集中了所有的注意力和精力，去除杂质以制成高浓度的液体。最终，他成功了！**

> A student was struggling to focus on his studies. But one day, he decided to turn off his phone and sit in a quiet room. With great effort, he achieved a high level of concentration and did well in his exams. **一个学生一直难以专注于学习。但有一天，他决定关掉手机，坐在一个安静的房间里。通过巨大的努力，他达到了高度的集中注意力，并在考试中取得了好成绩。**

> Imagine a group of kids playing a game of rings. They stand in circles, with each circle having the same center. That\'s like concentric circles. The center is shared, and they are all \'concentric\'. **想象一群孩子在玩套圈游戏。他们站成一圈圈，每一圈都有相同的中心。这就像同心的圆圈。中心是共用的，它们都是"同心的"。**

> Imagine a scientist in a white coat. He has a brilliant idea in his mind. This idea is a concept, like a seed of a new discovery. It\'s an abstract but powerful thought waiting to be developed. **想象一位穿着白大褂的科学家。他脑海中有一个绝妙的想法。这个想法就是一个概念，就像新发现的一粒种子。它是一个抽象但强大的念头，等待着被发展。**

> A couple had been longing for a baby. After many efforts, they finally had the conception of a new life. It was a joyous moment, marking the start of a wonderful journey. **一对夫妇一直渴望有个孩子。经过多次努力，他们终于成功受孕。这是一个欢乐的时刻，标志着一段美好旅程的开始。**

> A scientist had a conceptual idea of a time machine. He spent days imagining how it would work. This idea was all in his mind, not yet real. That\'s what \'conceptual\' means - existing in the mind as an idea or concept. **一位科学家有一个关于时间机器的概念性想法。他花了好几天想象它将如何运作。这个想法只存在于他的脑海中，还不是真实的。这就是\'conceptual\'的意思------作为想法或概念存在于头脑中。**

> A scientist had many ideas floating in his mind. He worked hard to bring them together and form a clear understanding, which was the process of conceptualization. Finally, he made a great discovery! **一位科学家脑海中有许多想法在飘荡。他努力将它们整合起来形成清晰的理解，这就是概念化的过程。最终，他有了重大发现！**

> A scientist was always struggling to conceptualize a new theory. One day, while walking in the forest, inspiration struck. He saw how different elements of nature fit together, and finally managed to conceptualize his ground-breaking idea. **一位科学家总是努力去构思一个新的理论。有一天，当他在森林里散步时，灵感来了。他看到了自然界的不同元素如何相互配合，终于成功构思出了他的突破性想法。**

> Imagine a group of scientists discussing a new theory. They are thinking \'conceptually\', not focusing on specific details but on the broad ideas and concepts. This is how we understand \'conceptually\' - in a way related to concepts and ideas. **想象一群科学家在讨论一个新理论。他们正在'从概念上'思考，不关注具体细节，而是关注广泛的想法和概念。这就是我们理解'conceptually'的方式 - 与概念和想法相关的方式。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. Everyone in the village was very concerned. They searched everywhere until they found him. The boy\'s safety was their main concern. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。村里的每个人都非常担心。他们到处寻找，直到找到他。男孩的安全是他们主要的关心之事。**

> A little girl was concerned about her lost puppy. She looked everywhere, with a worried face. Finally, she found it and was happy. \'Concerned\' means worried or interested. **一个小女孩很担心她走失的小狗。她到处寻找，满脸忧愁。最后，她找到了，很开心。\'concerned\'意思是担心的或感兴趣的。**

> A detective was investigating a mysterious case concerning a missing diamond. Everyone was worried and discussing it. Finally, the detective found the key clue concerning the thief. **一位侦探正在调查一个有关失踪钻石的神秘案件。每个人都很担心并讨论着。最后，侦探找到了有关小偷的关键线索。**

> A mouse wanted to enjoy a concert. It climbed into a big hall and saw many people playing instruments. The beautiful music made the mouse dance happily. \'Concert\' is a performance of music. **一只老鼠想去欣赏一场音乐会。它爬进一个大礼堂，看到很多人在演奏乐器。美妙的音乐让老鼠开心地跳舞。\'concert\'就是音乐表演。**

> A group of musicians planned a concerted effort to give a wonderful performance. They practiced hard together, coordinated every detail, and finally achieved a great success on the stage. The word \'concerted\' means joint and coordinated. **一群音乐家计划共同努力来呈现一场精彩的演出。他们一起努力练习，协调每一个细节，最终在舞台上取得了巨大的成功。单词\'concerted\'意思是联合的、协调的。**
> 想象一下，一只聪明的猫（con）在演奏会上（concerto），优雅地跳上钢琴，与音乐家一起演奏，美妙的旋律让所有人陶醉。猫的灵动与音乐的和谐，构成了这场独特的音乐会。 **想象一只猫在音乐会上的情景来辅助记忆\'concerto（协奏曲）\'这个单词**

> A businessman was negotiating a deal. After a long talk, he made a concession by lowering the price to win the contract. It means giving something up or making a compromise. **一位商人正在谈判一笔交易。经过长时间的交谈，他做出了让步，降低价格以赢得合同。这意味着放弃某些东西或做出妥协。**

> A tourist got lost in a big hotel. The concierge, a friendly and helpful person, guided the tourist to the right place. The concierge is like a helpful guide in a strange place. **一位游客在一家大旅馆里迷路了。礼宾员，一个友好且乐于助人的人，引导游客去了正确的地方。礼宾员就像是在陌生地方的有用向导。**

> A king was very angry with his ministers. But a wise advisor used conciliatory words and gifts to ease the king\'s temper. Finally, the king forgave everyone. The advisor\'s conciliatory approach saved the day. **一位国王对他的大臣们非常生气。但是一位聪明的顾问用和解的话语和礼物来缓和国王的脾气。最终，国王原谅了所有人。顾问的和解方式挽救了局面。**

> A king needed to send concise messages to his army quickly. So he trained a special bird to carry short and clear words. With this, his orders were always understood easily. \'Concise\' means short and clear. **一位国王需要快速向他的军队发送简洁的消息。所以他训练了一只特殊的鸟来携带简短清晰的话语。因此，他的命令总是能被轻易理解。\'concise\'意思是简短清晰的。**

> A detective was working hard to solve a mystery case. After collecting all the evidence and analyzing it carefully, he was finally able to conclude that the butler was the culprit. **一位侦探努力工作以侦破一起神秘案件。在收集了所有证据并仔细分析之后，他终于能够得出结论，是管家是罪魁祸首。**

> A detective was working on a difficult case. After days of investigation, he finally found the crucial evidence, making the concluding remarks that caught the criminal. The word \'concluding\' here means the final and decisive part. **一位侦探正在处理一个棘手的案件。经过数天的调查，他终于找到了关键证据，做出了结论性的陈述从而抓住了罪犯。单词\'concluding\'在这里指的是最后的、决定性的部分。**

> A detective spent days investigating a mystery. After gathering all the clues and thinking hard, he finally reached a conclusion. It was like finding the last piece of a puzzle and solving the case. **一位侦探花了好多天调查一个谜团。在收集了所有线索并苦思冥想后，他终于得出了结论。这就像找到了拼图的最后一块并解决了案件。**

> A detective was on a case. After days of investigation, he found conclusive evidence that pointed to the thief. It was so definite that there was no doubt left. The evidence made the case closed. **一位侦探在办案。经过几天的调查，他找到了确凿的证据，指明了小偷。证据如此确定，毫无疑虑。这些证据让案件结案了。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. After collecting all the evidence, he could finally prove the culprit conclusively. It meant he had absolute and definite proof, leaving no room for doubt. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。在收集了所有证据后，他终于确凿地证明了罪犯。这意味着他有绝对和明确的证据，毫无疑问。**
> 想象一个厨师在厨房里，把各种奇怪的食材混在一起，试图 concoct 一道新的菜肴。他不停地搅拌、添加调料，努力创造出独特的味道。 **想象一个厨师在厨房里试图调制一道新菜，以此来辅助记忆 concoct（调制；编造）这个单词**

> A chef was trying to create a new dish. He mixed various ingredients in a strange way. This mixture was his concoction. It was a risky but interesting attempt. **一位厨师正试图创造一道新菜。他以一种奇特的方式混合了各种食材。这种混合物就是他的调制物。这是一次冒险但有趣的尝试。**
> 想象一下，你正在进行一场刺激的冒险之旅，一路上的美景是主菜，而伴随的微风和鸟鸣就是 concomitant。它们始终与美景同时存在，不可分离，就像这个单词所表达的'伴随的，同时发生的'意思。 **想象你在冒险，美景为主，微风鸟鸣为伴，体现'伴随的，同时发生的'含义**
> 想象一个大型的机场，人们从各地赶来，汇聚在一个宽敞明亮的大厅。这个大厅就是 concourse，它是人群聚集、汇合的地方。就像水流汇聚成河，人们在 concourse 相聚。 **想象在机场，人们汇聚的大厅来辅助记忆'concourse（汇合处；大厅）'这个单词**

> A builder was pouring concrete to build a house. He worked hard to make the mixture solid and strong. Concrete made the foundation stable. Remember, concrete means a hard building material! **一位建筑工人正在浇筑混凝土来建造房屋。他努力工作以使混合物坚固结实。混凝土让地基稳固。记住，concrete 意思是混凝土这种坚硬的建筑材料！**

> A group of friends were deciding where to go for vacation. Some wanted the beach, others the mountains. But in the end, they all concurred that a peaceful countryside retreat was the best choice. **一群朋友在决定去哪里度假。一些人想去海滩，另一些人想去山区。但最后，他们都一致认为宁静的乡村度假是最佳选择。**
> 想象一下，在一场盛大的音乐会中，歌手在舞台上唱歌，同时乐队在演奏，观众在欢呼，这三种活动同时发生（concurrent），共同营造出了热烈的氛围。 **想象在音乐会中，歌手唱歌、乐队演奏、观众欢呼同时发生，来记住 concurrent 表示同时发生的意思**

> One day, Tom was playing football. He got hit hard on the head and felt dizzy. The doctor said it was a concussion. Poor Tom needed to rest to recover. Remember, a concussion is a brain injury! **有一天，汤姆在踢足球。他的头被重重地撞了一下，感到头晕。医生说这是脑震荡。可怜的汤姆需要休息来恢复。记住，concussion 就是脑震荡！**

> A thief was caught stealing. The judge condemned him to prison. Everyone said it was fair because his actions were wrong. Condemn means to express strong disapproval and punish. **一个小偷行窃被抓。法官判他入狱。大家都说这很公平，因为他的行为是错误的。condemn 意思是强烈谴责并给予惩罚。**

> A thief was caught stealing. The judge\'s strong condemnation made him realize his mistake. The word condemnation here means the act of expressing very strong disapproval. **一个小偷行窃被抓。法官强烈的谴责让他认识到了自己的错误。这里的 condemnation 这个词意思是表示强烈谴责的行为。**

> A thief was caught stealing. The judge condemned him to prison. Everyone knew he deserved it. Condemned means to express strong disapproval and sentence someone. **一个小偷被抓到偷东西。法官判他入狱。大家都知道他罪有应得。condemned 意思是强烈谴责并判处某人**
> 想象一下，在一个寒冷的夜晚，房间里的热水蒸气碰到冰冷的窗户，逐渐变成小水珠。这个从气态变成液态的过程就是\'condensation\'，就像水蒸气的凝结。 **想象在寒冷夜晚中房间里热水蒸气碰到窗户变成小水珠的过程来理解\'condensation\'（凝结；冷凝；压缩）**
> 想象一下，在一个大工厂里，蒸汽到处弥漫。聪明的工程师想办法把这些分散的蒸汽聚集起来，变得更浓密，这个让蒸汽变浓密聚集的过程就是\'condense\'。 **想象蒸汽在工厂里被聚集变浓密的过程来记住\'condense\'表示凝结、浓缩、压缩的意思**
> 想象一下，有一大锅热气腾腾的汤，厨师不断加热，水分大量蒸发，汤变得越来越浓稠。这就像是\'condensed\'的过程，原本大量分散的物质变得紧凑、浓缩。 **想象汤浓缩的过程来辅助记忆\'condensed\'（浓缩、压缩）这个单词**
> 有一天，骄傲的国王在巡视时，对平民露出了condescending的表情，他觉得自己高高在上，瞧不起民众。但最终民众的力量让他明白，这种傲慢是错误的。 **有一天，骄傲的国王在巡视时，对平民露出了居高临下、傲慢的表情，他觉得自己高高在上，瞧不起民众。但最终民众的力量让他明白，这种傲慢是错误的。**

> Once upon a time, a chef was preparing a delicious meal. But the taste was lacking. Then he remembered the condiments! He added salt, pepper, and various spices. The meal became wonderful. Condiments made all the difference! **从前，有位厨师在准备一顿美味的饭菜。但味道有所欠缺。然后他想起了调味料！他加了盐、胡椒和各种香料。这顿饭变得很棒。调味料起了关键作用！**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a mysterious cave. The cave\'s condition was very bad, full of traps and dark corners. But the adventurer didn\'t give up and finally found the exit. The \'condition\' here refers to the state or situation of the cave. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个神秘的洞穴中迷路了。这个洞穴的状况非常糟糕，到处都是陷阱和黑暗的角落。但探险家没有放弃，最终找到了出口。这里的'condition'指的是洞穴的状态或情形。**

> A king made a conditional offer to his subjects. If they worked hard in the fields, he would reduce taxes. But it was all based on certain conditions. So, \'conditional\' means depending on certain conditions. **一位国王向他的臣民提出了有条件的提议。如果他们在田地里努力劳作，他就会减税。但这一切都基于某些条件。所以，\'conditional\'意思是取决于某些条件的。**

> One hot summer day, I was sweating a lot. Then I used a conditioner to make my hair smooth and shiny. It was like a magic potion that fixed my hair\'s condition and made me feel fresh and confident. **在一个炎热的夏日，我汗流浃背。然后我使用了护发素，让我的头发变得顺滑有光泽。它就像一瓶神奇的药水，改善了我头发的状况，让我感到清新自信。**

> A young athlete was constantly training in the hot sun. This repetitive process of training was called conditioning. It made him stronger and better prepared for competitions. **一位年轻的运动员一直在烈日下不断训练。这种重复的训练过程被称为条件作用。这使他更强壮，为比赛做了更好的准备。**

> A young couple was looking for a new home. They finally found a nice condo. It had a beautiful view and was close to their work. They were so happy to call this condo their own. **一对年轻夫妇正在寻找新家。他们最终找到了一个不错的公寓。它有美丽的景色，而且离他们工作的地方很近。他们非常高兴能拥有这个公寓。**

> One day, when Tom lost his dear pet dog, his friends came to express their condolence. They said kind words and gave him hugs, showing their sympathy and comfort. **一天，当汤姆失去了他亲爱的宠物狗时，他的朋友们前来表示哀悼。他们说了亲切的话并给他拥抱，展现出他们的同情和安慰。**

> One night, a young couple was about to have a romantic moment. The boy remembered to prepare a condom to ensure safety. With the condom, they could enjoy their love without worry. Condom is a safeguard for intimacy. **一天晚上，一对年轻情侣即将度过浪漫时刻。男孩记得准备一个避孕套以确保安全。有了避孕套，他们可以毫无担忧地享受爱情。避孕套是亲密行为的保障。**

> A young couple was looking for a new home. They found a condominium that was perfect. It had a shared pool and garden but also private spaces. They loved it because it combined community and individual comfort. **一对年轻夫妇正在寻找新家。他们发现了一处完美的公寓。那里有共用的泳池和花园，但也有私人空间。他们喜欢它，因为它融合了社区共享和个人舒适。**

> A king condoned the mistakes of his subjects when they showed true repentance. He understood that everyone makes errors and giving a second chance can lead to better outcomes. **一位国王在他的臣民真心忏悔时宽恕了他们的过错。他明白每个人都会犯错，给予第二次机会可能会带来更好的结果。**

> A condor is a huge bird. Imagine a condor soaring high in the sky, its wide wings spreading majestically. It has a special way of hunting and flying that makes it stand out. Now, you\'ll remember condor as this magnificent flying creature. **一只秃鹰是一种巨大的鸟。想象一只秃鹰在高空翱翔，它宽阔的翅膀雄伟地展开。它有一种特殊的捕猎和飞行方式，使它脱颖而出。现在，你会记住 condor 就是这种宏伟的飞行生物。**

> A young scientist was in a conducive laboratory. All the equipment and environment were perfect for his research. It helped him make great progress. \'Conducive\' means helpful or favorable for something to happen or develop. **一位年轻的科学家在一个有利的实验室里。所有的设备和环境都对他的研究非常完美。这帮助他取得了巨大的进步。'conducive'意思是有助于或有利于某事发生或发展。**
> A brave soldier was chosen to conduct the new recruits. He showed them how to march and perform duties. His excellent conduct made him a hero. **一位勇敢的士兵被选来带领新兵。他向他们展示如何行进和执行任务。他的出色行为使他成为了英雄。**
> 想象一下，在一辆拥挤的公交车上，司机掌控着方向盘，引导着车辆前行。这位司机就像一个 conductor，他指挥着车辆，确保每位乘客的安全和顺利出行。 **想象在公交车上，司机就像一个'指挥者'，掌控并引导车辆，这里的指挥者就是单词'conductor'，有指挥者、导体的意思**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的城堡里，有一条神秘的通道（conduit），它是连接城堡内外的秘密管道。水和信息都通过它安全地传输，就像一条神奇的纽带。 **想象在古老城堡里有一条名为 conduit 的神秘通道，水和信息通过它传输，像纽带一样。**

> A little bear was lost in the forest. It saw a big pine tree and found a cone under it. The cone was so special that the bear remembered the way home by it. The cone became its guide. **一只小熊在森林里迷路了。它看到一棵大松树，在树下发现了一个圆锥体。这个圆锥体很特别，小熊凭借它记住了回家的路。这个圆锥体成了它的向导。**

> A little girl went to a candy store. She saw many beautiful confections, like colorful candies and sweet cakes. She was so happy and couldn\'t wait to taste them. Confection means a sweet food, especially a candy or cake. **一个小女孩去了糖果店。她看到了许多漂亮的甜食，像五颜六色的糖果和甜甜的蛋糕。她非常高兴，迫不及待想品尝。confection 意思是甜食，尤指糖果或蛋糕。**

> Once upon a time, there was a confectioner named Jack. He had a magic oven that could produce the most delicious candies and cakes. People from all over came to taste his confections. **从前，有一个叫杰克的糖果商。他有一个神奇的烤箱，可以做出最美味的糖果和蛋糕。各地的人都来品尝他的甜食。**

> Once upon a time, several small kingdoms decided to form a confederation. They joined forces to face common enemies and solve problems together. This confederation made them stronger and more united. **从前，几个小王国决定组成一个联盟。他们联合起来共同面对敌人和解决问题。这个联盟使他们更强大、更团结。**
> 国王召集大臣们开会（confer），讨论如何抵御外敌。大臣们纷纷献策，最终共同商议出了良策。confer 就是商讨、授予的意思，就像国王和大臣们在交流中做出决策。 **国王召集大臣开会，共同商讨出抵御外敌的办法，解释了confer商讨、授予的含义。**

> A group of smart people gathered for a conference. They sat around a big table, sharing ideas and solving problems. It was like a big brain party, full of discussions and decisions. **一群聪明的人聚在一起开了个会议。他们围坐在一张大桌子旁，分享想法并解决问题。这就像一场盛大的头脑派对，充满了讨论和决策。**

> A thief was caught and finally confessed to stealing the jewels. He felt so guilty and decided to tell the truth. \'Confess\' means to admit or own up to something, especially something wrong or embarrassing. **一个小偷被抓住了，最终承认偷了珠宝。他感到非常内疚，决定说出真相。'confess'这个单词意思是承认，尤指承认错误或令人尴尬的事。**

> One day, a thief was caught and made a confession. He admitted to stealing many valuable things. The police were relieved as his confession helped solve the case. **有一天，一个小偷被抓住了并作出了坦白。他承认偷了很多贵重的东西。警察感到欣慰，因为他的供认有助于破案。**

> A thief was caught and taken to a confessional room. There, with a heavy heart, he confessed all his crimes. The confessional became a place of truth and redemption for him. **一个小偷被抓住并被带到忏悔室。在那里，他心情沉重地坦白了自己所有的罪行。这个忏悔室成了他说出真相和获得救赎的地方。**

> A king had a trusted friend who knew all his secrets. This friend was the king\'s confidant. Whenever the king faced difficulties, he would confide in his confidant. The confidant always listened carefully and gave helpful advice. **一位国王有一个值得信赖的朋友，知晓他所有的秘密。这个朋友就是国王的知己。每当国王遇到困难，他都会向他的知己倾诉。这位知己总是认真倾听并给出有用的建议。**

> A girl was too shy to confide her secret love to anyone. But one day, she bravely confided in her best friend and felt relieved. Confide means to tell someone your secrets or private thoughts in a trusting way. **一个女孩太害羞了，不敢向任何人吐露她的暗恋。但有一天，她勇敢地向她最好的朋友倾诉，感到如释重负。Confide 意思是以信任的方式告诉某人你的秘密或私人想法。**

> One day, Tom was very nervous before the exam. But when he thought of all the efforts he had made, he gained confidence. He believed he could do well and finally got a high score. **一天，汤姆在考试前非常紧张。但当他想到自己付出的所有努力，他获得了信心。他相信自己能做好，最终取得了高分。**

> A young singer was very nervous before a big performance. But when she thought of all her hard practice, she became confident. She sang beautifully and won everyone\'s heart. Confident means feeling sure of oneself and one\'s abilities. **一位年轻的歌手在一场大型演出前非常紧张。但当她想到自己所有的刻苦练习时，她变得自信了。她唱得很动听，赢得了大家的心。Confident 意思是对自己和自身能力有把握、有信心。**

> A spy was entrusted with confidential information. He knew that if he leaked it, the mission would fail. So, he kept it secret and safe. Remember, confidential means secret and private. **一名间谍被托付了机密信息。他知道如果泄露，任务就会失败。所以，他保守秘密并确保其安全。记住，confidential 意思是秘密的、机密的、隐私的。**
