> A chef was cooking. He cut the vegetables crisply, making clean and precise cuts. The sound of the knife on the board was sharp and clear, just like the meaning of \'crisply\', which means neatly and precisely. **一位厨师正在烹饪。他干脆利落地切着蔬菜，切得干净又精准。刀在案板上的声音清脆清晰，就像\'crisply\'这个词的意思，即整洁、精准地。**

> One day, I went to a bakery and bought a bag of cookies. They were crispy and made a delightful crunch when I bit into them. The crispy texture was so addictive that I couldn\'t stop eating. **有一天，我去了一家面包店买了一袋饼干。它们酥脆可口，当我咬下去时发出令人愉悦的嘎吱声。这种酥脆的口感让人上瘾，我根本停不下来吃。**

> A detective was solving a case. The criteria for finding the criminal were fingerprints and witnesses. But he needed to be very careful to meet all these criteria and catch the right person. **一位侦探正在破案。找到罪犯的标准是指纹和证人。但他需要非常小心，满足所有这些标准并抓住正确的人。**

> A critic was invited to a concert. But he was very picky and always found faults. Later, he learned to appreciate the efforts of the musicians. Now you know \'critic\' means a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad parts of something. **一位评论家被邀请去一场音乐会。但他非常挑剔，总是挑毛病。后来，他学会了欣赏音乐家的努力。现在你知道\'critic\'意思是对事物的好坏发表意见的人。**

> A detective was in a critical situation. The criminal was about to escape. But with his critical thinking, the detective found the key clue and solved the case. It was a critical moment that needed sharp judgment. **一位侦探处于危急的情况中。罪犯即将逃跑。但凭借他批判性的思维，侦探找到了关键线索并破了案。这是一个需要敏锐判断的关键时刻。**

> A detective was investigating a crime critically. He analyzed every clue carefully, thinking critically to catch the criminal. With his critical mind, he finally solved the case. **一位侦探正在批判性地调查一起犯罪案件。他仔细分析每一条线索，以批判性的思维来抓住罪犯。凭借他批判性的头脑，他最终破了案。**

> A young artist was very nervous when showing her paintings. But when faced with criticism from others, she didn\'t give up. Instead, she used the criticism to improve and finally became famous. **一位年轻的艺术家在展示她的画作时非常紧张。但当面对他人的批评时，她没有放弃。相反，她利用这些批评来改进，最终成名了。**

> One day, a painter showed his new work. But people started to criticize it harshly. They pointed out the colors and shapes they didn\'t like. The painter learned from these critiques and improved. **一天，一位画家展示了他的新作品。但人们开始严厉地批评它。他们指出了他们不喜欢的颜色和形状。画家从这些批评中吸取教训并改进。**

> A young artist submitted her painting for a critique. The expert pointed out both the strengths and weaknesses, helping her improve. \'Critique\' means a detailed assessment and analysis of something, especially a literary, artistic, or philosophical work. **一位年轻的艺术家提交了她的画作以供评论。专家指出了优点和缺点，帮助她改进。\'critique\'意思是对某物，尤其是文学、艺术或哲学作品的详细评估和分析。**

> One day, a little boy was walking in the forest and saw a strange critter. It had big eyes and a fluffy tail. The boy was curious and followed it. Later, he found out it was a rare kind of squirrel. **一天，一个小男孩在森林里散步，看到了一个奇怪的小动物。它有大大的眼睛和毛茸茸的尾巴。小男孩很好奇，就跟着它。后来，他发现这是一种罕见的松鼠。**

> A frog was sitting by a pond. It opened its mouth and made a deep \'croak\' sound. The \'croak\' echoed through the quiet forest. It was as if the frog was saying hello to the world. **一只青蛙坐在池塘边。它张开嘴，发出了深沉的"呱呱"声。"呱呱"声在安静的森林中回荡。仿佛青蛙在向世界打招呼。**

> One day, a little boy saw a strange crock on the road. It was old and cracked. He wondered what was inside. When he opened it, he found some ancient coins. The crock became a treasure chest for him. **一天，一个小男孩在路上看到一个奇怪的瓦罐。它又旧又有裂缝。他好奇里面有什么。当他打开时，发现了一些古老的硬币。这个瓦罐成了他的宝箱。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was playing by the river. Suddenly, a big crocodile appeared. Its mouth was wide open, showing sharp teeth. The boy was scared and ran away quickly. Remember, this scary creature is called crocodile. **从前，有个小男孩在河边玩耍。突然，一只大鳄鱼出现了。它的嘴巴张得大大的，露出锋利的牙齿。小男孩很害怕，迅速跑开了。记住，这种可怕的生物叫鳄鱼。**
> 想象一下，有个国王总是和他的好友们一起玩乐，这些好友被称为 crony。国王无论做什么决策，这些 crony 总是无条件支持。后来国家出了问题，人们才发现这些 crony 只是因为关系好而不是有能力在帮忙。 **想象一个国王和他那些被称为\'密友\'的好友们的故事，借此理解\'crony\'（密友、好友）这个词。**

> A thief was lurking in the dark alley. He held a crooked stick, ready to attack. Suddenly, the police arrived and caught the crook. The crooked stick fell to the ground. **一个小偷潜伏在黑暗的小巷里。他拿着一根弯曲的棍子，准备攻击。突然，警察来了，抓住了这个骗子。弯曲的棍子掉到了地上。**

> A thief was running in the dark alley. His path was crooked, full of turns and bends. Just as he thought he could escape, the police caught him. The crooked way never leads to a good end. **一个小偷在黑暗的小巷里奔跑。他的路线是弯曲的，充满了转弯和曲折。就在他以为自己能逃脱时，警察抓住了他。弯曲的道路永远不会有好结果。**

> A singer was crooning a love song on the stage. The gentle and soft melody made everyone feel the deep emotions. It was like he was whispering sweet nothings to the audience. **一位歌手在舞台上低吟着一首情歌。那轻柔的旋律让每个人都感受到了深深的情感。就好像他在对观众轻声诉说着甜言蜜语。**

> A farmer was very worried about his crop. Because of the bad weather, many of the plants were damaged. But with his hard work and care, finally the crop grew well and he had a great harvest. **一位农民非常担心他的庄稼。由于恶劣的天气，许多作物都受损了。但通过他的辛勤劳作和悉心照料，最终庄稼长得很好，他获得了大丰收。**

> A farmer works hard every day on the cropland. He sows seeds, waters the plants, and waits for a rich harvest. The cropland is his hope and source of life. **一位农民每天都在农田里辛勤劳作。他播种、浇水，等待着丰收。农田是他的希望和生活来源。**

> A brave knight had to cross a dangerous river to save the princess. The river was wide and the current was strong, but he was determined. Finally, he crossed it successfully and became a hero. **一位勇敢的骑士必须穿过一条危险的河流去救公主。这条河很宽，水流很急，但他决心已定。最终，他成功地穿过了它，并成为了英雄。**

> A soldier was caught in the crossfire between two enemy groups. Bullets flew from different directions. It was a dangerous situation where he had to be very careful. **一名士兵陷入了两个敌对阵营的交叉火力中。子弹从不同方向飞来。这是一个危险的局面，他必须非常小心。**

> One day, when I was lost in a strange town, I came to a crossing. There were many people and cars. I was confused but finally found the right way. Crossing means a place where roads cross. **有一天，当我在一个陌生的城镇迷路时，我来到了一个十字路口。那里有很多人和车。我很困惑，但最终找到了正确的路。Crossing 意思是道路交叉的地方。**

> Once upon a time, a car was designed to be a crossover between a sedan and an SUV. It had the elegance of a sedan and the spaciousness of an SUV. This unique combination made it very popular. **从前，有一辆汽车被设计为轿车和 SUV 的交叉车型。它既有轿车的优雅，又有 SUV 的宽敞。这种独特的结合使它非常受欢迎。**

> One day, a little ant was walking crosswise on a big leaf. It was moving not in a straight line but diagonally. Suddenly, a gust of wind blew the leaf, but the ant held on firmly. Remember, \'crosswise\' means diagonally or sideways. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁在一片大叶子上斜向行走。它不是直线移动，而是斜着走。突然，一阵风吹动了叶子，但蚂蚁紧紧抓住。记住，\'crosswise\'意思是斜向地或侧向地。**

> One day, Tom was stuck at home. To have fun, he started doing a crossword. It was like a puzzle adventure. He crossed words here and there, trying to fill the empty boxes. Finally, he solved it and felt so happy! **一天，汤姆被困在家里。为了找点乐子，他开始做填字游戏。这就像一场解谜冒险。他到处交叉填写单词，试图填满空框。最后，他解开了谜题，感到非常开心！**

> A thief was hiding in the crotch of a big tree, thinking he wouldn\'t be found. But a smart detective noticed the odd shape in the crotch and caught him. The crotch here is the part where the branches meet the trunk. **一个小偷藏在一棵大树的杈桠处，以为不会被发现。但聪明的侦探注意到杈桠处的奇怪形状并抓住了他。这里的 crotch 指的是树枝与树干相接的部位。**

> A thief was trying to steal jewels. To hide from the guards, he had to crouch behind a big box. He stayed in that crouched position, hardly breathing, until the danger passed. **一个小偷试图偷珠宝。为了躲避警卫，他不得不蹲在一个大箱子后面。他一直保持着蹲着的姿势，几乎不敢呼吸，直到危险过去。**

> One day, a little crow was very thirsty. It flew around and finally found a pitcher with some water at the bottom. But the pitcher\'s neck was too narrow. The smart crow threw stones into the pitcher and drank the water. **有一天，一只小乌鸦非常口渴。它飞来飞去，终于发现一个罐子里有一些水在底部。但是罐子的口太窄了。聪明的乌鸦把石头扔到罐子里，喝到了水。**

> A king held a party. So many people came and formed a big crowd. The guards had a hard time keeping order. But everyone had fun in this crowded place. **一位国王举办了一场聚会。很多人都来了，形成了一大群人。守卫们很难维持秩序。但每个人在这个拥挤的地方都玩得很开心。**

> One day, I went to a fair. There were so many people everywhere. The paths were filled with people. It was a crowded place. I could hardly move. But it was still fun. **有一天，我去了一个集市。到处都是好多人。道路上挤满了人。这是一个拥挤的地方。我几乎动弹不得。但仍然很有趣。**

> The king wore a magnificent crown. It was shiny and had precious jewels. Everyone bowed when they saw the crown, as it symbolized the king\'s power and authority. **国王戴着一顶华丽的王冠。它闪闪发光，上面镶嵌着珍贵的宝石。当大家看到这顶王冠时都纷纷鞠躬，因为它象征着国王的权力和权威。**

> The king was about to put on the crowning jewel of his crown. But suddenly, a bird flew and snatched it away. This was the most unexpected and crowning moment of the ceremony. **国王即将戴上他王冠上的那颗最璀璨的宝石。但突然，一只鸟飞来把它抢走了。这是典礼上最出乎意料和最重要的时刻。**

> A detective was on a crucial mission to catch a thief. The key to success was finding a hidden clue. If not, the thief would escape. \'Crucial\' here means extremely important and decisive. **一位侦探正在执行一项至关重要的任务去抓小偷。成功的关键是找到一个隐藏的线索。如果找不到，小偷就会逃脱。这里'crucial'意思是极其重要和决定性的。**

> A brave knight was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, he saw a crucifix on a tree, shining with a holy light. It gave him hope and strength to find his way out. The crucifix became his guiding symbol. **一位勇敢的骑士在黑暗的森林中迷路了。突然，他看到树上有一个耶稣受难像，闪耀着神圣的光芒。它给了他找到出路的希望和力量。这个耶稣受难像成了他的指引象征。**

> A criminal was caught and the cruel king decided to crucify him. The poor man was nailed to a cross, suffering greatly. Remember, \'crucify\' means to kill by nailing to a cross. **一个罪犯被抓住了，残忍的国王决定把他钉在十字架上处死。这个可怜的人被钉在十字架上，痛苦万分。记住，\'crucify\'意思是把（某人）钉死在十字架上。**

> Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a crude oil well. The oil was extracted in a very simple and unrefined way. Workers had to deal with the crude process and the messy situation. \'Crude\' here means raw and unprocessed. **从前，在一个小村庄里，有一口原油井。石油是以一种非常简单和未精炼的方式被提取的。工人们不得不应对这种粗糙的过程和混乱的局面。这里的'crude'意思是未加工的、粗糙的。**

> A painter crudely smeared colors on the canvas, not caring about the details. People criticized his work for being so rough and unrefined. This shows what \'crudely\' means - in a rough and unskilled way. **一位画家在画布上粗暴地涂抹颜料，不在乎细节。人们批评他的作品太粗糙和不精细。这展示了\'crudely\'的意思------以粗糙和不熟练的方式。**

> A king was very cruel. He punished people for no good reason. One day, a brave girl stood up and said, \'Your cruelty must stop!\' Finally, the king changed. Remember, cruel means being mean and causing pain to others. **一位国王非常残忍。他毫无理由地惩罚人们。一天，一个勇敢的女孩站出来说：'你的残忍必须停止！'最后，国王改变了。记住，cruel 意思是残忍的，给他人带来痛苦。**

> A poor little rabbit was caught by a bad guy. The bad guy treated it cruelly, not giving it food or water. But in the end, the rabbit was saved by kind people. Remember, \'cruelly\' means being very mean and harsh. **一只可怜的小兔子被一个坏人抓住了。这个坏人残忍地对待它，不给它食物和水。但最后，小兔子被善良的人救了。记住，\'cruelly\'意思是非常刻薄和残酷。**

> Once upon a time, a bad king showed great cruelty. He punished his people for no reason, making their lives miserable. His actions were so mean and heartless, and that\'s what cruelty means. **从前，有个坏国王表现得非常残忍。他无缘无故地惩罚他的人民，让他们的生活痛苦不堪。他的行为如此卑鄙和无情，这就是'cruelty'（残忍；残酷）的意思。**

> A young couple went on a cruise to enjoy their vacation. They had a wonderful time on the ship, enjoying the sea breeze and beautiful views. The word \'cruise\' reminds us of such pleasant voyages. **一对年轻夫妇去乘船巡游享受他们的假期。他们在船上度过了美好时光，享受着海风和美丽的景色。单词\'cruise\'让我们想起这样愉快的航行。**

> A group of pirates were chasing a cruiser in the vast sea. The cruiser was fast and sleek, easily avoiding the pirates\' attacks. Finally, the cruiser outran the pirates and reached safety. **一群海盗在辽阔的大海上追逐一艘巡洋舰。这艘巡洋舰速度快且造型优美，轻松避开了海盗的攻击。最终，巡洋舰摆脱了海盗，抵达了安全地带。**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food in a big kitchen. It finally found some crumbs on the table. The crumbs were so small but they made the mouse happy. **一只饥饿的老鼠在一个大厨房寻找食物。它最终在桌子上发现了一些面包屑。这些面包屑很小，但让老鼠很开心。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful cookie. But when it was dropped on the floor, it began to crumble into small pieces. The cookie was no longer intact. Poor cookie! **从前，有一块漂亮的饼干。但是当它掉到地上时，就开始碎成小块。饼干不再完整。可怜的饼干！**
> One day, I was carrying a stack of papers. Suddenly, I tripped and fell. The papers crumpled under my weight. It looked like a mess! **一天，我拿着一叠纸。突然，我绊了一跤摔倒了。那些纸在我的重压下皱了起来。看起来一团糟！**

> One day, I was in a hurry and accidentally crumpled the important document. I felt so worried. But later, I carefully smoothed it out and fixed the problem. Remember, \'crumpled\' means crushed or wrinkled. **有一天，我匆忙中不小心把重要文件弄皱了。我很担心。但后来，我仔细地把它抚平并解决了问题。记住，\'crumpled\'意思是压皱，弄皱。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I heard a strange crunch. I followed the sound and found a bear crunching nuts. The sound of its teeth breaking the nuts was so distinct. Now, whenever I think of \'crunch\', I remember the bear. **有一天，我在森林里散步时听到了一种奇怪的嘎吱声。我循着声音找去，发现一只熊正在嘎吱嘎吱地咬坚果。它咬碎坚果的声音是如此清晰。现在，每当我想起\'crunch\'这个词，就会想起那只熊。**

> A little rabbit was walking in the forest and found some crunchy carrots. When it bit into them, it heard a pleasant crunching sound. The sound made the rabbit very happy. The carrots were so crunchy and delicious! **一只小兔子在森林里散步，发现了一些脆脆的胡萝卜。当它咬下去时，听到了悦耳的嘎吱声。这个声音让小兔子非常开心。这些胡萝卜又脆又美味！**

> A brave knight joined a crusade to rescue a princess from a dark castle. He fought many battles on this long and difficult journey. The crusade was a noble quest for justice and love. **一位勇敢的骑士参加了一场圣战，去从一座黑暗的城堡中营救公主。在这漫长而艰难的旅程中，他历经了许多战斗。这场圣战是一场为了正义和爱情的崇高追求。**

> A brave knight named Arthur was a passionate crusader. He left his home to fight for justice and protect the weak in distant lands. His determination made him a symbol of hope. Remember Arthur to recall the word \'crusader\'. **一位名叫亚瑟的勇敢骑士是一位充满激情的十字军战士。他离开家乡去遥远的地方为正义而战并保护弱者。他的决心使他成为希望的象征。记住亚瑟就能想起'crusader'这个词。**

> I had a huge crush on a classmate. Every time I saw her smile, my heart raced. One day, I finally gathered the courage to talk to her. \'Crush\' means a strong but short-lived infatuation. **我深深地暗恋着一位同学。每次看到她的笑容，我的心都狂跳不已。有一天，我终于鼓起勇气和她说话。"crush"意思是短暂而强烈的迷恋。**

> A young athlete was training hard for a competition. But in the final race, he got a crushing defeat. It was a huge blow to him. However, he didn\'t give up and kept practicing. Eventually, he achieved great success. **一位年轻的运动员为一场比赛努力训练。但在决赛中，他遭遇了惨败。这对他是个沉重的打击。然而，他没有放弃，继续练习。最终，他取得了巨大的成功。**

> A hungry ant was walking on the ground. Suddenly, it found a piece of bread with a thick crust. It tried hard to bite through the crust but failed. Finally, with its perseverance, it broke the crust and enjoyed the delicious bread inside. **一只饥饿的蚂蚁在地上走着。突然，它发现了一块有着厚厚外皮的面包。它努力咬穿外皮却失败了。最后，凭借毅力，它弄破了外皮，享用了里面美味的面包。**

> A crusty old sailor was always alone on his ship. His rough and crusty appearance scared others, but he was actually kind-hearted. One day, he helped a lost kitten and showed his soft side. **一位脾气暴躁的老水手总是独自在他的船上。他粗糙且暴躁的外表吓到了别人，但实际上他心地善良。有一天，他帮助了一只迷路的小猫，展现出了他温柔的一面。**

> A man hurt his leg and needed a crutch to walk. He relied on the crutch to move around. It was like a helpful friend that supported him when he was weak. Without the crutch, he would have had a hard time. **一个男人伤了腿，需要一根拐杖才能走路。他依靠拐杖四处走动。拐杖就像一个在他虚弱时支持他的好朋友。没有拐杖，他会很艰难。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a vast jungle. The crux of the problem was finding the right path out. He searched and searched until he finally discovered a hidden marker that led him to safety. The \'crux\' was the key point to solve his dilemma. **一位勇敢的探险家在广袤的丛林中迷路了。问题的关键在于找到正确的出路。他不断寻找，直到最终发现了一个隐藏的标记，引领他走向安全。\'crux\'就是解决他困境的关键点。**

> One day, little Tom lost his favorite toy. He felt very sad and began to cry loudly. His tears rolled down his cheeks. His mom came and comforted him. **一天，小汤姆丢了他最喜欢的玩具。他感到非常伤心，开始大声哭起来。他的眼泪顺着脸颊滚落。他的妈妈过来安慰他。**

> One day, I saw a little girl crying on the street. Her ice cream had fallen to the ground. She was so sad. But then a kind man bought her a new one and she stopped crying. **有一天，我看到一个小女孩在街上哭。她的冰淇淋掉到了地上。她非常伤心。但后来一个善良的人给她买了一个新的，她就不哭了。**

> In an old abandoned church, there was a hidden crypt. A brave adventurer found it by following a mysterious map. The crypt was full of secrets and treasures. Remember, \'crypt\' is a hidden place like this one. **在一座古老废弃的教堂里，有一个隐蔽的地下室。一位勇敢的探险家通过一张神秘的地图找到了它。这个地下室充满了秘密和宝藏。记住，\'crypt\'就是这样一个隐蔽的地方。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The clues left at the crime scene were cryptic. They looked like random symbols and numbers. But with his sharp mind, he finally deciphered them. **一位侦探正在努力解开一个谜团。犯罪现场留下的线索是神秘难解的。它们看起来像是随机的符号和数字。但凭借他敏锐的头脑，他最终破解了它们。**
> A fairy had a magic crystal. It shone bright like a star. Whoever held it felt happy and calm. The crystal was so special and precious. **一个仙女有一块神奇的水晶。它像星星一样闪耀。无论谁拿着它都会感到快乐和平静。这块水晶是如此特别和珍贵。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a cave. When he found a shiny mineral, he shouted, \'This crystalline gem is so beautiful!\' It was like a clear crystal. Later he learned it was called \'crystalline\'. **一位勇敢的探险家在洞穴中迷路了。当他发现一块闪闪发光的矿物质时，他大喊："这块水晶般的宝石太漂亮了！"它就像一块透明的水晶。后来他得知这叫做"crystalline（结晶的；水晶般的）"。**

> Once upon a time, a scientist was doing an experiment. He heated a liquid and waited. Suddenly, the substance began to crystallize, forming beautiful and clear crystals. This was the moment of crystallize. **从前，一位科学家在做实验。他加热一种液体并等待。突然，这种物质开始结晶，形成了美丽且清晰的晶体。这就是结晶（crystallize）的时刻。**

> In the forest, a mother bear gave birth to a cute cub. The cub was small and weak but full of curiosity. It learned to walk and play, growing stronger day by day. Remember, \'cub\' is a young animal like this little bear. **在森林里，一只熊妈妈生下了一只可爱的幼崽。这只幼崽又小又弱，但充满了好奇心。它学习走路和玩耍，一天天地变得更强壮。记住，\'cub\'就是像这只小熊一样的幼兽。**

> Imagine a magical world where a cube-shaped treasure chest holds the key to great wealth. The cube is perfectly symmetrical, with six equal square sides. It\'s so shiny and mysterious, making everyone eager to open it. **想象一个神奇的世界，有一个立方体形状的宝箱，它藏着巨大财富的钥匙。这个立方体完美对称，有六个相等的正方形面。它如此闪亮和神秘，让每个人都渴望打开它。**

> Imagine a magical cube that can change its size. This cube is special because it represents the idea of \'cubic\'. Every side is measured and calculated in a cubic way. So, when you see \'cubic\', think of this magical changing cube! **想象一个神奇的立方体，它可以改变大小。这个立方体很特别，因为它代表了"立方的"这个概念。它的每条边都是以立方的方式测量和计算的。所以，当你看到"cubic"时，就想想这个神奇的会变化的立方体！**

> A young artist was looking for a quiet place to create. He found a small cubicle in an old building. It was just right for him to paint and dream. The cubicle became his secret world of art. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻找一个安静的地方创作。他在一座老建筑里找到了一个小隔间。对他来说，这正适合画画和幻想。这个隔间成了他艺术的秘密世界。**

> A hungry rabbit was looking for food in the garden. Suddenly, it saw a big cucumber. It was so happy and ate the cucumber quickly. The cucumber was so fresh and delicious! **一只饥饿的兔子在花园里找食物。突然，它看到了一根大黄瓜。它非常高兴，迅速地吃了黄瓜。这根黄瓜新鲜又美味！**

> One cold night, a little bear was shivering. Its mother came and gave it a warm cuddle. The little bear felt safe and happy. Cuddle means to hold someone or something close in a loving way. **在一个寒冷的夜晚，一只小熊在发抖。它的妈妈过来给了它一个温暖的拥抱。小熊感到安全又开心。cuddle 这个单词意思是充满爱意地紧紧拥抱某人或某物。**
> 在一场精彩的魔术表演中，魔术师一直等待着助手给出 cue 这个暗号，才能开始神奇的魔法。当助手悄悄做了个手势，魔术师瞬间心领神会，为观众带来了令人惊叹的表演。 **在这个故事中，\'cue\'代表暗号、提示，就像魔术师等待的那个特定信号。**

> A detective was chasing a thief. The thief\'s cuff got caught on a fence, giving the detective a chance to catch him. The cuff of the thief\'s shirt was the key to solving the case. **一位侦探正在追捕一个小偷。小偷的袖口被栅栏勾住了，这给了侦探抓住他的机会。小偷衬衫的袖口是破案的关键。**
> 想象一下，一位名叫 Cu 的厨师，他的拿手好戏是创新菜肴。他做的美食独特又美味，大家都称赞他的厨艺。他的烹饪风格就被称为 cuisine 。 **想象一位叫 Cu 的厨师，他的烹饪风格被称为 cuisine，以助记忆该单词意为'烹饪，风味'**

> Once upon a time, a chef was known for his culinary skills. He could turn simple ingredients into delicious dishes. His culinary magic made everyone happy. Remember, \'culinary\' is all about cooking and food skills. **从前，有一位厨师以其烹饪技能而闻名。他能将简单的食材变成美味的菜肴。他的烹饪魔法让每个人都很开心。记住，\'culinary\'与烹饪和食物技能有关。**

> A farmer was in a big orchard. There were too many apples on the trees. To get the best ones, he had to cull the bad and small apples. Finally, he had a basket full of perfect apples. **一位农民在一个大果园里。树上的苹果太多了。为了得到最好的苹果，他不得不剔除坏的和小的苹果。最后，他有了一篮子完美的苹果。**

> A brave climber struggled up the mountain. After days of effort, he finally reached the peak. This moment culminated his long and tough journey. It means reaching the highest or final point. **一位勇敢的登山者奋力爬山。经过数天的努力，他最终到达了山顶。这一刻成为了他漫长而艰难旅程的顶点。这个单词意思是达到顶点或最终阶段。**

> A young scientist worked hard for years. His experiments and research finally reached a critical point. This moment was the culmination of his efforts, leading to a major discovery. It was the peak of his success. **一位年轻的科学家努力了多年。他的实验和研究终于到了关键时刻。这个时刻就是他努力的顶点，带来了一项重大发现。这是他成功的巅峰。**

> A detective was on the hunt for the culprit who stole the precious jewels. He followed clues and finally found the culprit hiding in an old warehouse. The culprit was a sneaky thief who thought he could get away with it. **一位侦探正在追捕偷了珍贵珠宝的罪犯。他循着线索，最终在一个旧仓库里找到了罪犯。罪犯是个鬼鬼祟祟的小偷，还以为能逃脱惩罚。**

> In a small town, there was a strange group. They had unique beliefs and rituals, which made them stand out. This group was known as a cult. People were cautious of their odd ways. **在一个小镇上，有一个奇怪的团体。他们有着独特的信仰和仪式，这使他们与众不同。这个团体被称为邪教。人们对他们奇怪的方式很谨慎。**

> Imagine a magical garden where special plants are grown. These special plants are called \'cultivar\'. They are carefully selected and nurtured to have unique features. Just like in this garden, a cultivar is a type of plant that has been specially developed. **想象一个神奇的花园，里面种着特殊的植物。这些特殊植物被称为'cultivar'。它们经过精心挑选和培育，具有独特的特征。就像在这个花园里，cultivar 就是一种经过特别培育的植物类型。**

> A farmer works hard every day to cultivate his land. He sows seeds, waters them, and removes the weeds. Through his efforts, the crops grow well. \'Cultivate\' means to prepare and care for land to grow plants. **一位农民每天辛勤劳作来耕种他的土地。他播种、浇水并除草。通过他的努力，庄稼长得很好。\'cultivate\'意思是开垦，耕作，栽培**

> Once upon a time, there was a wild field. But a hardworking farmer worked on it every day. Eventually, the field became cultivated, full of beautiful crops. It was no longer wild but well-tended and productive. **从前，有一片荒野。但一位勤劳的农民每天在上面劳作。最终，这片土地变得耕种良好，长满了美丽的庄稼。它不再荒芜，而是被精心照料且多产。**

> A farmer works hard every day for the cultivation of his land. He sows seeds, waters them, and removes weeds. Through his efforts, the crops grow well. Cultivation means the act of preparing and caring for land to grow plants. **一位农民每天都为他的土地耕种而努力工作。他播种、浇水、除草。通过他的努力，庄稼长得很好。cultivation 意思是准备和照料土地以种植植物的行为。**

> A group of friends went on a trip to different countries. They saw many cultural shows, like traditional dances and music. They learned that \'cultural\' means related to the customs and art of a particular group or society. **一群朋友去不同的国家旅行。他们看了很多文化表演，比如传统舞蹈和音乐。他们了解到'cultural'这个词意味着与特定群体或社会的习俗和艺术有关。**

> Once upon a time, a group of people shared the same customs, art, and beliefs. This shared way of life was called \'culture\'. It was like a big garden where different beautiful flowers bloomed, representing the diversity and uniqueness of each group. **从前，有一群人有着相同的习俗、艺术和信仰。这种共同的生活方式被称为"文化"。它就像一个大花园，里面绽放着不同的美丽花朵，代表着每个群体的多样性和独特性。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who traveled to many countries. He learned different cultures, became very knowledgeable and refined. We can say he was cultured. He could talk politely and behave gracefully everywhere. **从前，有一个人游历了许多国家。他学习了不同的文化，变得非常博学和有修养。我们可以说他是有教养的。他在任何地方都能礼貌地交谈，举止优雅。**

> A clumsy elephant was carrying a cumbersome box. It moved slowly and struggled because the box was heavy and awkward to handle. Remember, \'cumbersome\' means difficult to handle or carry due to size or weight, just like that box for the elephant. **一只笨拙的大象正驮着一个笨重的箱子。它移动缓慢，很是吃力，因为这个箱子又大又重，难以搬运。记住，'cumbersome'意思是因尺寸或重量而难以处理或携带，就像大象驮的那个箱子。**

> A chef was making a special dish and couldn\'t find cumin. The dish lacked flavor. Finally, he found cumin and the dish became delicious. Cumin is that important spice! **一位厨师正在做一道特别的菜肴，却找不到孜然。这道菜缺少了味道。最后，他找到了孜然，菜肴变得美味可口。孜然就是那么重要的香料！**

> A student was collecting stickers. Each day he got a few more. Over time, the total number of stickers grew in a cumulative way. It was like building a tower one brick at a time. **一个学生在收集贴纸。每天他都会得到一些。随着时间的推移，贴纸的总数以累积的方式增加。这就像一次一块砖地建造一座塔。**

> A fox was known for its cunning. It always found smart ways to get food. One day, it tricked a farmer and stole some chickens. Its cunning mind helped it succeed. **一只狐狸以它的狡猾而闻名。它总是能找到聪明的办法获取食物。有一天，它骗了一位农夫并偷了几只鸡。它狡猾的头脑帮助它成功了。**

> One day, I was very thirsty. I looked everywhere for a cup to drink water. Finally, I found a beautiful cup on the table and filled it with cool water. It quenched my thirst perfectly. **一天，我非常口渴。我到处找杯子喝水。最后，我在桌子上发现了一个漂亮的杯子，并用它装满了凉水。它完美地解了我的渴。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for food. It found a big cupboard and was very happy. But when it opened the door, there was only a small piece of cheese. Poor mouse! The cupboard was not as full as it hoped. **一天，一只小老鼠在找食物。它发现了一个大橱柜，非常高兴。但当它打开柜门时，里面只有一小块奶酪。可怜的老鼠！这个橱柜不像它期望的那样满。**

> One day, a little girl went to a bakery and saw colorful cupcakes. They looked so delicious with their frosting and sprinkles. She chose one and took a big bite, feeling happy. Cupcakes make people smile! **有一天，一个小女孩去了一家面包店，看到了五颜六色的纸杯蛋糕。它们有着糖霜和糖粒，看起来美味极了。她选了一个，咬了一大口，感到很开心。纸杯蛋糕能让人微笑！**

> A curator is like a guardian of a treasure chest. Imagine a room full of precious artworks. The curator is the one who takes care of them, decides which to show, and makes sure they are safe. Just like that, a curator looks after and manages valuable things. **一位馆长就像是一个宝箱的守护者。想象一个满是珍贵艺术品的房间。馆长是照顾它们、决定展示哪些以及确保它们安全的人。就像这样，馆长照看和管理有价值的东西。**

> A naughty dog always ran onto the busy road. To stop this danger, the owner built a curb. The curb prevented the dog from running freely and kept it safe. Now the dog knew its boundary. **一只顽皮的狗总是跑到繁忙的马路上。为了阻止这种危险，主人修建了一道路缘石。路缘石阻止了狗自由乱跑，保障了它的安全。现在狗知道了自己的界限。**

> One day, I was walking along the street and saw a lost puppy sitting by the curbside. It looked so helpless. I decided to help it find its owner. The curbside became a memorable place for me that day. **有一天，我沿着街道走，看到一只迷路的小狗坐在路边。它看起来很无助。我决定帮它找到主人。那天路边对我来说成了一个难忘的地方。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was making cheese. The thick substance that formed was called curd. She was so happy to see the curd, as it would become delicious cheese. **从前，有个小女孩在制作奶酪。形成的浓稠物质就叫凝乳（curd）。她看到凝乳非常高兴，因为它会变成美味的奶酪。**

> A doctor was trying to find a cure for a mysterious disease. After many experiments, he finally discovered a special medicine that could cure all the patients. The word \'cure\' means to make someone healthy again. **一位医生正在努力寻找一种神秘疾病的治疗方法。经过多次实验，他终于发现了一种特殊的药物，可以治愈所有的病人。单词\'cure\'意思是使某人再次健康。**

> In a small town, there was a curfew every night. One naughty kid always tried to break it. But the strict police caught him every time. Remember, curfew means a time limit after which people must stay at home. **在一个小镇上，每晚都有宵禁。一个顽皮的孩子总是试图打破它。但严格的警察每次都抓住他。记住，curfew 意思是在某个时间之后人们必须待在家里的限制。**

> A little monkey had a strong curiosity. One day, it saw a strange fruit and couldn\'t resist exploring. It climbed up to get it, but ended up in trouble. Remember, curiosity can lead to adventure or danger! **一只小猴子有着很强的好奇心。有一天，它看到一个奇怪的水果，忍不住去探索。它爬上去拿，结果陷入了麻烦。记住，好奇心可能带来冒险或危险！**

> One day, a little boy was very curious. He saw a strange box and couldn\'t wait to open it. When he did, he found many wonderful toys inside. His curiosity led him to a pleasant surprise. **有一天，一个小男孩非常好奇。他看到一个奇怪的盒子，迫不及待地打开它。当他打开时，他发现里面有许多很棒的玩具。他的好奇心给他带来了惊喜。**

> One day, Tom curiously opened a mysterious box. Inside, he found some old letters that told a strange story. This made him even more curious to know the truth behind it. **有一天，汤姆好奇地打开了一个神秘的盒子。在里面，他发现了一些旧信件，讲述了一个奇怪的故事。这让他更加好奇地想要知道背后的真相。**

> A cute cat was sleeping peacefully. Suddenly, it woke up and started to curl its tail around its body like a soft rope. It looked so cozy and warm. **一只可爱的猫咪正在安静地睡觉。突然，它醒了，并开始像柔软的绳子一样把尾巴卷在身体周围。它看起来舒适又温暖。**

> One cold winter day, I went to an ice rink and saw people playing curling. They were sliding heavy stones on the ice. The stones moved in a curling path, which was so interesting. **一个寒冷的冬日，我去了溜冰场，看到人们在玩冰壶。他们在冰面上滑动沉重的石头。石头沿着弯曲的路径移动，非常有趣。**

> One day, a little girl went to a party. She had curly hair that looked like beautiful waves. Everyone loved her curly hairstyle and said she was as cute as a fairy. **一天，一个小女孩去参加派对。她有一头卷发，看起来像美丽的波浪。每个人都喜欢她的卷发，说她像小仙女一样可爱。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was very hungry. She found some currants in the garden. They were small and sweet. She ate them happily and felt full. Remember, currants are these sweet little fruits. **从前，有个小女孩非常饿。她在花园里发现了一些醋栗。它们小小的，甜甜的。她开心地吃了，然后觉得饱了。记住，currant 就是这种小小的甜水果。**

> A traveler was in a strange country. He needed to buy things but had trouble understanding the local currency. Finally, he learned that currency is like a key to unlock purchases and make transactions. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的国家。他需要买东西，但难以理解当地的货币。最后，他明白了货币就像一把钥匙，能解锁购买行为并完成交易。**
> 想象一条河流，水在不停地流淌。这流动的水就像 current 所代表的'水流、电流、趋势'。比如现在流行的时尚趋势，就像这不停变化的水流一样，这就是 current 的含义。 **想象一条河，其中流动的水代表\'current\'的'水流、电流、趋势'等含义，比如流行的时尚趋势就像不停变化的水流。**

> Imagine you are in a time machine. Right now, as you are traveling, you are experiencing the \'currently\' moment. It\'s like being in the present, exactly at this point in time. > 想象一个学校，课程(curricular)安排得满满当当。学生们抱怨着，老师则努力让这些课程变得有趣。最后大家都在丰富的课程中收获了知识。 **想象学校课程安排满满的场景，帮助记忆 curricular 表示课程的、与课程有关的**
> 想象一下，学校是一个大工厂，课程(curriculum)就是工厂里的生产线。这条生产线有序地安排着各种知识零件，就像语文、数学、科学等，把学生们逐步塑造成有知识的成品。 **想象学校中课程如同工厂生产线，有序安排知识，帮助记忆\'curriculum\'这个单词**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He went to a restaurant and ordered curry. The chef cooked the curry carefully with many spices. Tom loved the delicious curry and ate a lot. **有一天，汤姆非常饿。他去了一家餐馆并点了咖喱。厨师用许多香料精心烹制了咖喱。汤姆喜欢这美味的咖喱并吃了很多。**

> A witch cast a curse on the brave knight. The curse made him lose his strength and courage. But the knight didn\'t give up and finally broke the curse. Remember, curse means a magic word or phrase that brings bad luck. **一个女巫对勇敢的骑士施了诅咒。这个诅咒让他失去了力量和勇气。但骑士没有放弃，最终打破了诅咒。记住，curse 意思是带来厄运的魔咒或话语。**

> A detective was doing a cursory search of the crime scene. He just glanced around quickly and missed many important clues. Later, he realized his mistake and started a more thorough investigation. **一位侦探正在对犯罪现场进行粗略的搜查。他只是快速地扫视了一下周围，错过了很多重要线索。后来，他意识到自己的错误，开始了更彻底的调查。**

> A king wanted to curtail the power of a naughty prince. So, he limited the prince\'s privileges and freedoms. Just like cutting something short, curtail means to reduce or limit. **一位国王想要削减一个顽皮王子的权力。于是，他限制了王子的特权和自由。就像把某物剪短一样，curtail 意思是减少或限制。**

> A thief wanted to steal jewels from a rich man\'s room. But when he entered, he accidentally knocked over a vase and the noise woke the owner. The thief quickly hid behind the curtain. The curtain saved him from being caught for the moment. **一个小偷想从一个富人的房间偷珠宝。但当他进入时，不小心打翻了一个花瓶，声音吵醒了主人。小偷迅速躲在窗帘后面。窗帘暂时让他没被抓住。**

> One day, while walking in the park, I saw a beautiful bridge. Its shape had a special charm, and I learned that this feature was called \'curvature\'. The gentle curves made the bridge both elegant and stable. **有一天，在公园散步时，我看到一座漂亮的桥。它的形状有一种特殊的魅力，我了解到这个特征被称为"曲率"。柔和的曲线使这座桥既优雅又稳固。**

> A car was speeding on the road. Suddenly, it had to make a sharp curve to avoid hitting a dog. The curve was so dangerous that the driver\'s heart raced. Remember, \'curve\' means a bend or a turn. **一辆汽车在路上疾驰。突然，它不得不急转弯以避开一只狗。这个弯道太危险了，司机心跳加速。记住，\'curve\'意思是弯曲或转弯。**

> One day, I was walking in a park and saw a beautiful curving path. It was like a snake, smoothly bending and leading to a hidden garden. The curving shape made the path very charming. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到一条美丽的弯曲小路。它就像一条蛇，平滑地弯曲着，通向一个隐藏的花园。弯曲的形状让这条小路非常迷人。**

> One day, I was very tired and sat on a soft cushion. It was like a cloud, making me feel extremely comfortable. The cushion absorbed all my fatigue. Now, whenever I see \'cushion\', I remember that relaxing moment. **有一天，我非常累，坐在了一个柔软的垫子上。它就像一朵云，让我感到极其舒适。这个垫子吸收了我所有的疲惫。现在，每当我看到\'cushion\'这个单词，我就会想起那个放松的时刻。**

> On a dark night, a brave adventurer reached the cusp of a mysterious cave. Just as he was about to step in, a gust of wind blew, making him hesitate. The cusp was the critical point of his decision - to enter or not. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一位勇敢的冒险家到达了一个神秘洞穴的尖端。就在他即将踏入时，一阵风吹过，让他犹豫了。这个尖端是他决定是否进入的关键时刻。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved custard. Every day, he would go to the bakery and ask for a big bowl of custard. The sweet and smooth custard made him very happy. **从前，有一个小男孩特别喜欢蛋奶糊。每天，他都会去面包店要一大碗蛋奶糊。香甜顺滑的蛋奶糊让他非常开心。**

> A thief broke into a museum, but the custodial staff were vigilant. They caught the thief and protected the precious exhibits. The custodial staff here have the responsibility of safeguarding. **一个小偷闯入了博物馆，但看守人员很警惕。他们抓住了小偷并保护了珍贵的展品。这里的看守人员有守护的职责。**
> 想象一个古老的城堡，里面藏着无数珍贵的宝物。有一位忠诚的守卫，他被称为 custodian 。他日夜守护城堡，不让任何人偷走宝物，他就是负责保管和守护的人。 **想象一个古老城堡里有位被称为'保管人、监护人'的忠诚守卫日夜守护宝物**

> A thief was caught and put in custody. The police guarded him closely to ensure he couldn\'t escape. \'Custody\' means the state of being held or guarded by someone. **一个小偷被抓住并被监禁起来。警察紧紧看守着他以确保他无法逃脱。'custody'意思是被某人关押或监护的状态。**

> A foreigner came to a small town. He was confused by the local custom of giving gifts to strangers. But when he received a warm gift, he understood that it was a sign of friendship. **一个外国人来到一个小镇。他对当地给陌生人送礼物的习俗感到困惑。但当他收到一份温暖的礼物时，他明白了这是友谊的象征。**

> A king had a customary way of greeting his subjects every morning. It was his usual and traditional practice. One day, a new subject was amazed by this customary ritual. \'Customary\' means according to the usual and traditional way. **一位国王每天早上都有向臣民问候的习惯方式。这是他一贯的、传统的做法。有一天，一位新来的臣民对这种习惯性的仪式感到惊讶。\'customary\'意思是依照通常的和传统的方式。**

> One day, a man walked into a store. The store owner was very friendly and asked, \'How can I help you, customer?\' The man replied, \'I need a new shirt.\' This shows that a customer is someone who buys things in a store. **有一天，一个男人走进一家商店。店主非常友好地问：'我能怎么帮您，顾客？'这个男人回答：'我需要一件新衬衫。'这表明顾客就是在商店里买东西的人。**

> A designer wanted to create unique clothes. So, he decided to customize each piece based on customers\' requests. He carefully selected materials and added special details to make them one-of-a-kind. **一位设计师想要制作独特的衣服。所以，他决定根据顾客的要求定制每一件。他精心挑选材料并添加特殊细节以使它们独一无二。**

> A woodcutter was in the forest. He needed to cut down a big tree to make firewood. With his sharp axe, he cut through the trunk easily. Finally, he had enough wood for the winter. **一位伐木工人在森林里。他需要砍倒一棵大树来做柴火。用他锋利的斧头，他轻松地砍穿了树干。最后，他有了足够过冬的木材。**

> A factory was in trouble and needed to make a cutback. Workers were worried. But the boss said it was just to cut back on some unnecessary production lines to save money and keep the core business running. **一家工厂陷入困境，需要削减开支。工人们很担心。但老板说只是削减一些不必要的生产线来省钱，并维持核心业务运转。**

> One day, I saw a little puppy in the park. It had big eyes and a fluffy tail. It was so cute that everyone wanted to play with it. Its cuteness made our day brighter. **有一天，我在公园看到一只小狗。它有大眼睛和毛茸茸的尾巴。它太可爱了，每个人都想和它玩。它的可爱让我们这一天都更美好了。**

> One day, a little bug was very sad because its cuticle was damaged. But then it found a magic potion that helped restore its shiny and strong cuticle. Now it could move freely again! **有一天，一只小虫子非常伤心，因为它的角质层受损了。但随后它找到了一瓶神奇的药水，帮助恢复了它闪亮且坚固的角质层。现在它又能自由活动了！**

> A brave sailor was on a ship. One day, a strong storm hit and the rope got tangled. The sailor quickly took out a cutter and cut the rope to save the ship. The cutter became a hero\'s tool. **一位勇敢的水手在船上。有一天，一场强烈的风暴袭来，绳子缠在了一起。水手迅速拿出一把刀具并剪断绳子拯救了船只。这把刀具成为了英雄的工具。**

> In a dark forest, a cutthroat bandit lurked. He had a cruel face and was ready to attack anyone for treasure. One day, he met a brave knight who defeated him. Remember, \'cutthroat\' means a ruthless and cruel person. **在一个黑暗的森林里，有一个凶残的强盗潜伏着。他一脸凶残，随时准备为财宝攻击任何人。有一天，他遇到了一位勇敢的骑士，骑士打败了他。记住，'cutthroat'意思是残忍无情的人。**

> One day, I was in the forest and saw a woodcutter doing cutting. He was skillfully using an axe to cut down trees. The sound of cutting echoed through the woods. **有一天，我在森林里看到一个伐木工人正在砍伐。他熟练地用斧头砍树。砍伐的声音在树林中回荡。**

> A spy was sent to steal the formula of a dangerous chemical called cyanide. But he was caught before he could escape. Cyanide is a highly poisonous substance that can cause death very quickly. **一名间谍被派去窃取一种叫做氰化物的危险化学品的配方。但他在逃跑前被抓住了。氰化物是一种剧毒物质，能很快致人死亡。**

> In a future world, a brave adventurer named Tom explores the mysterious and vast cyberspace. He discovers hidden treasures and faces challenges. Cyberspace becomes his playground of adventure and growth. **在未来世界，一位名叫汤姆的勇敢冒险家探索神秘而广阔的网络空间。他发现隐藏的宝藏并面临挑战。网络空间成为了他冒险和成长的乐园。**

> A brave boy rides his bike in a circle every day. The circular path he takes is like a cycle. One day, he realizes that life also has its own cycles of ups and downs. **一个勇敢的男孩每天都骑着自行车绕圈。他所走的圆形路径就像一个周期。有一天，他意识到生活也有自己的起起落落的周期。**
> 想象一个骑自行车的人，他总是沿着相同的路线循环骑行。有时快，有时慢，但始终在这个循环的路径上。这就像经济的周期性变化，有繁荣也有衰退，就像'cyclical'所表达的循环的、周期的。 **想象一个骑自行车的人来辅助记忆'cyclical'（循环的、周期的）这个单词**

> One day, Tom was very sad because he was stuck at home. Then he decided to go cycling. The wind blew gently as he pedaled. Cycling made him happy and forget all his troubles. **一天，汤姆非常伤心，因为他被困在家里。然后他决定去骑自行车。当他蹬车时，微风轻轻吹拂。骑自行车让他开心起来，忘记了所有烦恼。**

> One day, a cyclist was riding along a beautiful country road. The wind blew through his hair as he pedaled hard. Suddenly, a cute puppy crossed his path, but the skilled cyclist managed to avoid it and continued his journey happily. **一天，一位骑自行车的人沿着一条美丽的乡村道路骑行。风吹过他的头发，他用力蹬着踏板。突然，一只可爱的小狗穿过他的路径，但这位熟练的骑车人设法避开了它，并愉快地继续他的旅程。**

> One day, a brave sailor was on a voyage. Suddenly, a powerful cyclone appeared. The wind howled and the waves rose high. But the sailor held on tight, remembering the terrifying power of the cyclone. **有一天，一位勇敢的水手正在航行。突然，一股强大的旋风出现了。狂风呼啸，海浪高高涌起。但水手紧紧抓住，记住了旋风的可怕力量。**

> A thief wanted to steal something from a factory. He found a strange object - a cylinder. It was long and round like a big pipe. When he tried to move it, he made a lot of noise and was caught. **一个小偷想从一家工厂偷东西。他发现了一个奇怪的物体------一个圆柱体。它又长又圆，像一根大管子。当他试图移动它时，弄出了很大的声响，然后被抓住了。**

> Imagine a huge factory making tubes. The tubes they produce are perfect and have the same shape all around. These tubes are called cylindrical. Just like the shape of a can of soda, smooth and uniform. **想象一家大型工厂制造管子。他们生产的管子非常完美，四周形状相同。这些管子就被称为圆柱形的。就像一罐汽水的形状，光滑且均匀。**

> A man always doubts others\' motives and scoffs at kindness. He is a cynic. One day, when someone helped him sincerely, he still refused to believe. But in the end, he realized his mistake. **一个男人总是怀疑别人的动机，嘲笑善良。他是个愤世嫉俗者。有一天，当有人真诚地帮助他时，他仍然拒绝相信。但最后，他意识到了自己的错误。**

> A young man was always cynical, believing that everyone had selfish motives. One day, he met a kind volunteer who selflessly helped others. This changed his view. Now he understood that not all were cynical. **一个年轻人总是愤世嫉俗，认为每个人都有自私的动机。有一天，他遇到了一位无私帮助他人的善良志愿者。这改变了他的看法。现在他明白了并非所有人都是愤世嫉俗的。**

> A young man always doubted others\' motives and was full of cynicism. One day, he realized this attitude made him lonely. So, he changed and started to see the good in people. Cynicism here means an attitude of distrust and negativity. **一个年轻人总是怀疑别人的动机，充满了犬儒主义。有一天，他意识到这种态度让他很孤独。于是，他改变了，开始看到人们的优点。这里的犬儒主义指的是一种不信任和消极的态度。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, he saw a cypress tree, its tall and straight shape guiding him out. The cypress became his savior and left a deep impression on him. **一位勇敢的冒险家在黑暗的森林中迷路了。突然，他看到了一棵柏树，它高大笔直的形状为他指引了出路。这棵柏树成了他的救星，并给他留下了深刻的印象。**

> Imagine a little monster with a big bag on its body. That bag is like a cyst. It\'s a closed sac filled with liquid or semi-solid stuff. Just like the monster\'s strange bag, a cyst can show up in our body sometimes. **想象一只小怪兽身上有个大袋子。那个袋子就像一个囊肿。它是一个充满液体或半固体物质的封闭囊。就像小怪兽身上奇怪的袋子一样，囊肿有时会出现在我们身体里。**

> A cystic monster had a big cyst on its body. It was very painful. But with the help of a magic doctor, the cyst was removed and the monster became healthy. Remember, \'cystic\' is related to cysts. **一只囊性的怪物身上有个大囊肿，非常痛苦。但在一位神奇医生的帮助下，囊肿被移除，怪物恢复了健康。记住，\'cystic\' 与囊肿有关。**

> Once upon a time, there was a powerful leader called the Czar. He ruled the land with wisdom and might. People respected and feared him. The word \'czar\' came to represent a supreme authority figure. **从前，有一位强大的领导者被称为沙皇。他以智慧和力量统治着这片土地。人们既尊敬又畏惧他。单词\'czar\'就代表着至高无上的权威人物。**

> One day, a little duck was playing in the pond. It saw a bug on a leaf and quickly made a dab with its beak to catch it. The dab was so precise that the bug had no chance to escape. **一天，一只小鸭子在池塘里玩耍。它看到一片叶子上有一只虫子，迅速用嘴轻轻一啄抓住了它。这一啄非常精准，虫子毫无逃脱的机会。**
> 想象一下，一只小鸭子在池塘边好奇地玩水，它只是轻轻地用脚掌触碰水面，浅尝辄止。这种轻轻触碰、浅尝的行为就像\'dabble\'。小鸭子并没有深入水中，只是偶尔玩耍一下。 **想象一只小鸭子在池塘边浅尝玩水的情景来辅助记忆\'dabble\'这个单词，意思是涉猎，浅尝**

> One day, I got lost in a big park. I was so scared. But then, dad showed up. He held my hand and led me home safely. Dad is always there to protect me. **有一天，我在一个大公园里迷路了，我非常害怕。但随后，爸爸出现了。他牵着我的手，安全地把我领回了家。爸爸总是在那里保护我。**

> A little girl lost her way. She was crying and calling \'Daddy! Daddy!\' loudly. A kind policeman heard her and helped her find her daddy. The girl was so happy when she saw her daddy again. **一个小女孩迷路了。她大哭着大声喊'爸爸！爸爸！'。一位好心的警察听到了，帮助她找到了爸爸。当女孩再次见到爸爸时，她非常开心。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. Suddenly, she saw a beautiful daffodil. It was so bright and charming that it led her out of the forest. The daffodil became her lucky flower. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。突然，她看到了一朵美丽的水仙花。它是如此明亮迷人，引领她走出了森林。水仙花成了她的幸运花。**

> A thief was lurking in the dark alley. Suddenly, a brave knight appeared and pointed a dagger at the thief, scaring him away. The sharp dagger glinted in the moonlight. **一个小偷潜伏在黑暗的小巷里。突然，一位勇敢的骑士出现并用一把匕首指着小偷，把他吓跑了。锋利的匕首在月光下闪烁。**

> One day, a little ant had a daily task to collect food. It worked hard every day. \'Daily\' means happening every day, just like the ant\'s routine of collecting food each day. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁有一项日常任务，那就是收集食物。它每天都努力工作。\'daily\'的意思是每天发生的，就像蚂蚁每天收集食物的常规活动。**

> A fairy in the forest was known for her dainty steps. Every move she made was light and graceful, like a gentle breeze. Her dainty appearance and manner charmed all the creatures. **森林里的一位仙女以她轻盈优美的步伐而闻名。她的每一个动作都轻盈而优雅，就像一阵微风。她精致的外表和举止迷住了所有的生物。**

> A girl named Lily worked in a dairy. Every day, she milked cows and made delicious cheese. She loved the smell of fresh milk. One day, she decided to open her own dairy shop. **一个叫莉莉的女孩在一家乳制品厂工作。每天，她给奶牛挤奶并制作美味的奶酪。她喜欢新鲜牛奶的味道。有一天，她决定开一家自己的乳制品店。**

> In a grand hall, a beautiful princess stood on a special platform called a dais. Everyone looked up to her as she gracefully addressed the crowd. The dais made her seem even more noble and important. **在一个宏伟的大厅里，一位美丽的公主站在一个被称为讲台的特殊平台上。当她优雅地向人群讲话时，每个人都抬头看着她。这个讲台使她看起来更加高贵和重要。**

> A little girl named Daisy loved to run in the fields full of flowers. Every time she saw a daisy, she smiled. The daisy became her favorite flower. Remember, Daisy is a kind of flower. **一个叫黛西的小女孩喜欢在满是鲜花的田野里奔跑。每次她看到雏菊，她都会微笑。雏菊成了她最喜欢的花。记住，daisy 是雏菊的意思。**

> A beaver was working hard to build a dam across a river. It carried logs and branches to stop the water flow. The dam was its masterpiece to create a peaceful pool. Remember, \'dam\' means a barrier to hold back water. **一只海狸正在努力地在一条河上建水坝。它搬运原木和树枝来阻止水流。水坝是它创造平静水池的杰作。记住，\'dam\'意思是阻挡水流的障碍物。**

> A naughty monkey was playing in the forest. It accidentally threw a stone and damaged a bird\'s nest. The poor birds were very sad. Remember, \'damage\' means to cause harm or loss. **一只顽皮的猴子在森林里玩耍。它不小心扔了一块石头，损坏了一个鸟窝。可怜的鸟儿们非常伤心。记住，'damage'意思是造成损害或损失。**

> One day, a strong storm came. A big tree fell and damaged the roof of a house. The owner was very sad because the damage was serious and needed a lot of money to repair. **一天，一场强风暴袭来。一棵大树倒下砸坏了一间房子的屋顶。主人非常伤心，因为损坏很严重，需要花很多钱来修复。**

> A naughty monkey was playing in a factory. It accidentally broke some machines, causing damaging effects. The owner was very angry. Remember, \'damaging\' means causing harm or loss. **一只顽皮的猴子在工厂里玩耍。它不小心弄坏了一些机器，造成了破坏性的影响。主人非常生气。记住，\'damaging\'意思是造成损害或损失。**

> Once upon a time, a young knight was seeking a noble dame. He crossed rivers and climbed mountains, finally finding the dame in a beautiful castle. The dame\'s grace and charm left a deep impression on him. **从前，一位年轻的骑士在寻找一位高贵的女士。他穿过河流，爬过山岭，最终在一座美丽的城堡里找到了这位女士。这位女士的优雅和魅力给他留下了深刻的印象。**

> A man was lost in a dark forest. He shouted \'Damn! I can\'t find the way out.\' It means he was very frustrated. \'Damn\' is often used to express annoyance or anger. **一个男人在黑暗的森林中迷路了。他喊道："该死！我找不到出去的路。"这意味着他非常沮丧。"damn"常被用来表达烦恼或愤怒。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a mysterious forest. Every step he took seemed damned. But he didn\'t give up and finally found his way out. Here, \'damned\' means doomed or hopeless. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片神秘森林中迷路了。他走的每一步似乎都注定失败。但他没有放弃，最终找到了出路。这里，\'damned\'意思是注定的或没有希望的。**

> A brave explorer entered a cave. The air inside was damp. Water dripped from the ceiling, making the ground wet. He felt uncomfortable but still moved on. Remember, \'damp\' means a little wet and moist. **一位勇敢的探险家进入了一个洞穴。里面的空气是潮湿的。水从天花板滴下，使地面湿润。他感觉不舒服但仍继续前行。记住，'damp'意思是有点湿且潮湿。**

> A frog was jumping happily in a forest. But when it jumped into a dampen cave, its mood changed. The cave was wet and cold, making the frog feel uncomfortable. So, \'dampen\' means to make something less strong or to make it wet. **一只青蛙在森林里欢快地跳着。但当它跳进一个潮湿的洞穴时，它的心情变了。这个洞穴又湿又冷，让青蛙感到不舒服。所以，\'dampen\'意思是抑制，使变潮湿。**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food in a big house. It found a big damper and thought it was cheese. But when it took a bite, it was so hard! Poor mouse. **一只饥饿的老鼠在一个大房子里找食物。它发现了一个大的阻尼器，还以为是奶酪。但当它咬了一口，发现太硬了！可怜的老鼠。**

> A little girl dreams of becoming a great dancer. Every night, she imagines herself dancing on a big stage with beautiful lights. Her passion for dance keeps her practicing hard. Finally, she achieves her dream. **一个小女孩梦想成为一名伟大的舞者。每天晚上，她想象自己在有美丽灯光的大舞台上跳舞。她对舞蹈的热情使她不断努力练习。最终，她实现了梦想。**

> A young girl always dreamed of being a dancer. She practiced every day, sweating and smiling. Finally, on the big stage, she danced beautifully and became a wonderful dancer. **一个年轻女孩一直梦想成为一名舞者。她每天练习，流汗并微笑着。最终，在大舞台上，她跳得很美，成为了出色的舞者。**

> One night, I dreamed of being in a big party. Everyone was dancing happily. The music was wonderful and the lights were colorful. The scene of people dancing made me feel so cheerful. **一天晚上，我梦到在一个盛大的派对上。每个人都开心地跳着舞。音乐美妙，灯光绚丽。人们跳舞的场景让我感到非常愉快。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in the garden and saw a beautiful dandelion. She blew on it and the seeds flew everywhere. She thought it was like a magic flower that brought joy and dreams. **有一天，一个小女孩在花园里玩耍，看到了一朵漂亮的蒲公英。她对着它吹了一口气，种子到处飞扬。她觉得它就像一朵带来欢乐和梦想的神奇花朵。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who always dressed very stylishly and cared a lot about his appearance. Everyone called him a dandy. He was known for his fancy clothes and perfect grooming. **从前，有个男人总是穿着非常时髦，特别在意自己的外表。大家都称他为花花公子。他以华丽的服装和完美的打扮而闻名。**

> One day, a little rabbit was playing in the forest. Suddenly, it saw a sign that said \'Danger\'. It was a deep pit ahead. The rabbit stopped in time and avoided the danger. **一天，一只小兔子在森林里玩耍。突然，它看到一个写着"危险"的标志。前面是一个深坑。小兔子及时停了下来，避开了危险。**

> One day, a little monkey was playing in the forest. He saw a beautiful flower and wanted to pick it. But he didn\'t know there was a dangerous snake hidden nearby. Luckily, the monkey\'s mother came and took him away safely. **一天，一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。他看到一朵漂亮的花想去摘。但他不知道附近藏着一条危险的蛇。幸运的是，猴子妈妈来了并把他安全地带走了。**
> 想象一下，一只猴子在树枝上，它的尾巴（tail）dangle 着晃来晃去。它轻松自在，尾巴就那样悬垂着，好像在跟大家炫耀它的灵活。 **想象一只猴子的尾巴悬垂晃荡，以此来记住'dangle（悬垂，摇晃）'这个单词。**
> 在一个阴暗潮湿的洞穴里，探险家小明发现了一处dank的角落，那里散发着难闻的气味，地面湿滑。他意识到\'dank\'就是形容这种又湿又冷又令人不舒服的环境。 **在一个阴暗潮湿的洞穴中，探险家小明发现了一处潮湿阴冷令人不适的角落，从而记住\'dank\'表示潮湿阴冷的意思。**

> A king was faced with a difficult choice of deciding which prince would inherit the throne. After much thought and observing their behaviors, he finally made the deciding decision. **一位国王面临着艰难的抉择，要决定哪位王子继承王位。经过深思熟虑和对他们行为的观察，他最终做出了决定性的决定。**
> 想象一下，在一个神奇的森林里，有两种树。一种树的叶子一年四季都不掉，另一种树的叶子每年都会掉落，这种每年掉叶子的树就叫 deciduous 树。就像秋天里变黄飘落的枫叶树，它们就是典型的 deciduous 树。 **想象在神奇森林中，有每年掉叶子的树叫 deciduous 树，如秋天落叶的枫树。**

> 侦探在犯罪现场仔细观察，通过一些细微的线索，如脚印和物品的摆放，deduce（推断）出了罪犯的逃跑方向。这就像是从已知的线索中得出结论一样。 **侦探在犯罪现场通过线索推断出罪犯的逃跑方向。意思是推论，推断，演绎。**

> A king was faced with a difficult decision. After much thought, he deemed the proposal from his advisor as the best choice. It means he considered and judged it to be so. **一位国王面临艰难的抉择。深思熟虑后，他认为顾问的提议是最佳选择。这意味着他觉得并判定是这样。**
> A brave diver went deep into the ocean. It was so dark and quiet. But he wasn\'t afraid because he wanted to explore the deep secrets of the sea. **一位勇敢的潜水员潜入深海。那里又黑又安静。但他不害怕，因为他想探索海洋深处的秘密。**

> A little rabbit wanted to dig a deeper hole to hide from the big bad wolf. It kept digging and digging, making the hole deepen. Finally, it was safe. **一只小兔子想要挖一个更深的洞来躲避大坏狼。它不停地挖呀挖，让洞变得更深了。最后，它安全了。**

> 想象一下，小明参加比赛，却没有做任何准备。当被问到为何如此时，他无奈地说这是他的'default'状态，因为他习惯了不努力。这里'default'就是指惯常的、默认的状态。 **想象小明参加比赛没准备，称这是他惯常的、默认的状态，以此辅助记忆'default'意为惯常的、默认的。**

> A brave warrior led his army into battle. Despite facing a stronger enemy, he refused to give up. In the end, his strategy worked and they achieved a great DEFEAT of the opponents. **一位勇敢的战士带领他的军队投入战斗。尽管面对更强大的敌人，他拒绝放弃。最终，他的策略奏效，他们成功击败了对手。**

> A brave detective was on a case. He found a hidden document that exposed a defect in the company\'s security system. The defect could cause big trouble. **一位勇敢的侦探正在办案。他发现了一份隐藏的文件，揭露了公司安全系统的一个缺陷。这个缺陷可能会引发大麻烦。**

> A spy was considering defection. He was tired of his current job and the risks. One day, he made a brave decision to leave and seek a new, peaceful life. Finally, he achieved it. **一名间谍正在考虑叛逃。他厌倦了当前的工作和风险。有一天，他勇敢地决定离开，去寻求新的、平静的生活。最终，他做到了。**

> A factory was producing toys. But some toys had missing parts and couldn\'t work properly. They were called defective. Workers had to fix them to make them good again. **一家工厂正在生产玩具。但有些玩具缺少部件，不能正常工作。它们被称为有缺陷的。工人们不得不修理它们，使它们再次变好。**

> A soldier was once very loyal, but due to unfair treatment, he became a defector. He left his team, seeking a better place. Remember, a defector is one who leaves a group or organization. **一名士兵曾经非常忠诚，但由于受到不公平的待遇，他变成了一个叛逃者。他离开了自己的队伍，去寻找更好的去处。记住，defector 就是离开一个团体或组织的人。**

> In a fierce battle, our brave soldiers stood firmly to defend the city. They held their weapons tight, not allowing the enemy to invade. Their determination was unwavering, and they successfully protected our home. **在一场激烈的战斗中，我们勇敢的士兵坚定地站着保卫城市。他们紧紧握着武器，不让敌人入侵。他们的决心坚定不移，成功地保护了我们的家园。**

> In a courtroom drama, the poor man was the defendant. He was wrongly accused but remained calm. Finally, the truth came out and he was proved innocent. Remember, a defendant is the person accused in a court case. **在一场法庭剧中，这个可怜的男人是被告。他被错误地指控但保持冷静。最后，真相大白，他被证明是无辜的。记住，defendant 就是法庭案件中被指控的人。**

> In a fierce battle, the city was under attack. But a brave warrior named Tom emerged as the defender. He fought fearlessly, protecting everyone. With his strong shield and sharp sword, Tom was the last line of defense against the enemy. **在一场激烈的战斗中，城市受到了攻击。但一位名叫汤姆的勇敢战士成为了捍卫者。他无畏地战斗，保护着每一个人。凭借他坚固的盾牌和锋利的剑，汤姆是抵御敌人的最后一道防线。**

> A small village was attacked by bandits. The villagers were defenseless as they had no weapons or guards to protect themselves. They could only watch helplessly as their homes were looted. **一个小村庄遭到了强盗的袭击。村民们毫无防备，因为他们既没有武器也没有守卫来保护自己。他们只能眼睁睁地看着自己的家园被洗劫一空。**

> A brave knight stood on the defensible castle wall. The wall was strong and could protect them from enemy attacks. \'Defensible\' means able to be defended, just like this castle. **一位勇敢的骑士站在可防御的城堡墙上。这堵墙很坚固，可以保护他们免受敌人的攻击。\'defensible\'意思是可防御的，就像这座城堡一样。**

> In a football game, the team was constantly under attack. To protect their goal, they played defensively, forming a strong wall of defenders. This helped them prevent the opponents from scoring. **在一场足球比赛中，球队不断受到攻击。为了保护球门，他们采取防守型打法，组成了一堵坚固的防守人墙。这帮助他们阻止了对手得分。**

> A student always wanted to defer doing his homework. He thought he could do it later, but ended up in a rush. \'Defer\' means to put off or delay something to a later time. **一个学生总是想推迟做他的作业。他觉得可以晚点做，但最后却很匆忙。'defer'意思是把某事推迟或延迟到稍后的时间。**

> A young prince always showed deference to the wise elders of his kingdom. He listened carefully to their advice and respected their decisions. This respect and submission was his deference. **一位年轻的王子总是对他王国里睿智的长者表现出顺从。他认真倾听他们的建议，并尊重他们的决定。这种尊重和服从就是他的顺从。**

> A student was supposed to submit his project today, but he got a special permission and his submission was deferred to next week. It means it was put off or postponed. **一名学生本应今天提交他的项目，但他获得了特殊许可，他的提交被推迟到了下周。这意味着它被延期或推迟。**

> A brave knight showed defiance when the evil king ordered him to surrender. He stood firm, looking the king in the eye, refusing to give in. His act of defiance inspired others to fight for justice. **一位勇敢的骑士在邪恶的国王命令他投降时表现出了违抗。他坚定地站着，直视国王的眼睛，拒绝屈服。他的违抗行为激励了其他人去为正义而战。**

> A young warrior was captured by the enemy. Despite being in chains, he remained defiant. He stared at his captors with fierce eyes, refusing to show any fear or submit. His defiant spirit made the enemies tremble. **一位年轻的战士被敌人俘虏。尽管戴着镣铐，他依然桀骜不驯。他用凶狠的眼神盯着俘虏他的人，拒绝表现出任何恐惧或屈服。他这种反抗的精神让敌人颤抖。**

> A naughty boy was caught stealing candy. When asked why he did it, he defiantly raised his head and said, \'I just wanted to!\' Here, \'defiantly\' shows the boy\'s bold and disobedient attitude. **一个顽皮的男孩偷糖果被抓住了。当被问到为什么这么做时，他挑衅地抬起头说：'我就是想！' 这里，'defiantly'展现了男孩大胆且不服的态度。**

> A patient\'s heart stopped. The doctor rushed in with a defibrillator. It sent an electric shock to restart the heart. Everyone held their breath. Luckily, the defibrillator worked and saved the patient\'s life. **一位病人的心脏停止了跳动。医生拿着除颤器冲了进来。它发出电击来重新启动心脏。每个人都屏住了呼吸。幸运的是，除颤器起作用了，挽救了病人的生命。**
> 想象一个国王的王国面临着资源的缺乏（deficiency）。粮食不够，士兵缺少装备。国王心急如焚，因为这种不足威胁着王国的安危。 **想象国王的王国面临资源缺乏的情况，以此记住'deficiency'表示缺乏、不足、缺陷的意思**
> 一个工厂生产的零件总是数量不够，质量也有问题，被客户指责是deficient的。这意味着这个工厂在零件生产方面是不足的、有缺陷的。 **一个工厂生产的零件数量和质量不足，被指责有缺陷，从而辅助记忆【deficient】意为不足的、有缺陷的。**

> A company was in trouble. It spent too much money and had a deficit. The boss was worried as they couldn\'t pay all the bills. But they worked hard, cut costs, and finally overcame the deficit. **一家公司陷入了困境。它花费了太多钱，出现了赤字。老板很担心，因为他们无法支付所有账单。但他们努力工作，削减成本，最终克服了赤字。**

> A group of students were confused about a complex concept. The teacher came and used clear examples to define it precisely. Now the students understood clearly. **一群学生对一个复杂的概念感到困惑。老师来了，用清晰的例子精确地定义了它。现在学生们清楚地理解了。**

> A young artist was constantly seeking the defining feature of her masterpiece. She tried many elements but finally found it in a unique color combination. This feature made her painting stand out. The word \'defining\' means having the power to determine or establish. **一位年轻的艺术家一直在寻找她杰作的决定性特征。她尝试了很多元素，最终在一种独特的色彩组合中找到了。这个特征使她的画脱颖而出。单词"defining"意思是有决定或确立的力量。**

> A detective was on a case to find definite evidence. After days of hard work, he finally got it and solved the mystery. The evidence was clear and certain, just like the meaning of \'definite\'. **一位侦探在处理一个案件，以寻找确凿的证据。经过几天的努力，他终于找到了。证据清晰明确，就像\'definite\'这个单词的意思一样。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a cave. When asked if he would find the exit, he said \'Definitely!\' with confidence. It means without doubt or surely. So, remember the explorer\'s certainty when you think of \'definitely\'. **一位勇敢的探险家在洞穴中迷路了。当被问到他是否能找到出口时，他自信地说'Definitely！' 这个词的意思是毫无疑问地、肯定地。所以，当你想到'definitely'时，就记住这位探险家的笃定。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The key was to find the exact definition of each clue. Finally, with clear definitions, he cracked the case. **一位侦探正在努力侦破一个谜团。关键在于找出每条线索的确切定义。最终，凭借清晰的定义，他破获了此案。**

> A detective was on a case to find the definitive evidence. He searched everywhere, not giving up until he got the exact and final proof. With it, he solved the mystery. **一位侦探在处理一个案子，要寻找确凿的证据。他到处搜寻，不放弃，直到获得确切且最终的证明。凭借它，他解开了谜团。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. After much investigation, he could finally say definitively who the culprit was. It means with certainty and no doubt. **一位侦探正在努力解开一个谜团。经过大量调查，他终于能够明确地说出谁是罪犯。这个词意思是明确地、毫无疑问地。**
> 想象一个气球，它原本充满了气，胀得大大的。但突然被扎了一个小孔，里面的气开始往外跑，气球就慢慢变小了。这就像单词\'deflate\'，意思是放气、使缩小。 **想象一个充满气的气球因被扎孔而放气变小的情景来辅助记忆\'deflate\'这个表示放气、使缩小的单词。**

> A brave knight was attacked by many arrows. But he used his shield to deflect all the arrows and protected himself. The word \'deflect\' means to turn aside or cause to change direction. **一位勇敢的骑士遭到许多箭的攻击。但他用盾牌偏转了所有的箭并保护了自己。单词\'deflect\'意思是使转向，使偏斜。**

> Once upon a time, in a beautiful forest, many workers came with machines. They cut down trees non-stop. This bad action of removing a large number of trees was called deforestation. It made the forest sad and the animals lost their homes. **从前，在一片美丽的森林里，许多工人带着机器来了。他们不停地砍树。这种大量移除树木的不良行为被称为森林砍伐。它让森林伤心，动物们失去了家园。**
> 想象一个美丽的雕塑，它原本完美无瑕。但有一天，一场可怕的地震来袭，雕塑被挤压和扭曲，不再是原来的样子。这种形状的改变就是\'deformation\'，也就是变形、畸形。 **想象一个雕塑因地震而变形，来理解\'deformation\'这个词，意为变形、畸形**

> A prince was cursed and became deformed. His body was no longer normal. But with courage and kindness, he finally broke the curse and returned to his original form. Remember, \'deformed\' means not having the normal shape or form. **一位王子被诅咒而变得畸形。他的身体不再正常。但凭借勇气和善良，他最终打破了诅咒，恢复了原来的样子。记住，\'deformed\'意思是形状或形式不正常。**

> A brave knight was injured in a battle, resulting in a deformity in his leg. But his spirit remained strong. The deformity didn\'t stop him from protecting his kingdom. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场战斗中受伤，导致他的腿有了畸形。但他的精神依然强大。这种畸形并没有阻止他保护他的王国。**

> A thief planned to defraud a rich merchant. He pretended to be a noble and gained the merchant\'s trust. But in the end, his scheme was exposed. Remember, defraud means to cheat someone out of money or property. **一个小偷计划欺骗一位富商。他假装是个贵族并取得了富商的信任。但最终，他的阴谋被揭穿了。记住，defraud 意思是骗取某人的钱财或财产。**

> A young artist was known for his deft hand in drawing. No matter how complex the scene, he could finish it perfectly. His deft skills made him famous. One day, a difficult task came, but with his deftness, he solved it easily. **一位年轻的艺术家以其灵巧的绘画之手而闻名。无论场景多么复杂，他都能完美完成。他的灵巧技艺使他出名。有一天，一个艰巨的任务来临，但凭借他的灵巧，他轻松解决了。**

> A thief deftly sneaked into the house. He moved so smoothly and skillfully that no one noticed. His deftly executed plan allowed him to steal the precious jewels without making a sound. **一个小偷灵巧地潜入房子。他动作如此流畅和熟练，以至于没人注意到。他灵巧地执行计划，无声无息地偷走了珍贵的珠宝。**
> 想象一个古老的工厂，机器不再运转，工人都已离开，它完全失去了功能，变得 defunct 。这个工厂曾经热闹，如今却破败荒凉，就像这个词表示不再起作用、已废止的意思。 **想象一个古老的不再运转的工厂来理解 defunct 这个词，表示不再起作用、已废止。**

> A terrorist placed a bomb in a crowded square. But a brave police officer managed to defuse it by carefully cutting the wires. The people were saved. **一名恐怖分子在一个拥挤的广场放置了一枚炸弹。但是一位勇敢的警察通过小心地剪断导线成功拆除了炸弹。人们得救了。**

> A brave knight named Tom always defied the evil king\'s orders. He refused to follow the unfair rules and fought for justice. His act of defying showed great courage and determination. **一位名叫汤姆的勇敢骑士总是违抗邪恶国王的命令。他拒绝遵循不公平的规则，并为正义而战。他的违抗行为展现了巨大的勇气和决心。**
> 想象一个原本优秀的运动员，因为沉迷于不良习惯，身体和技能都逐渐变差。他的状态从巅峰不断下滑，这就是\'degenerate\'，意味着退化、堕落。 **想象一个原本优秀的运动员逐渐退化、堕落的故事来辅助记忆\'degenerate\'这个单词，意思是退化、堕落**
> 从前有个美丽的花园，人们精心呵护。但后来没人照顾，花草开始衰败（degeneration），失去了往日的生机。这就像degeneration这个词，意味着逐渐变坏、衰退。 **从前有个美丽的花园因无人照顾花草衰败的故事来辅助记忆degeneration这个表示逐渐变坏、衰退的单词**
> 想象一个美丽的花园，原本充满生机。但由于没人照料，花草逐渐衰败。这种从好到坏的变化就像'degenerative'。就好像健康的身体，因为不良习惯逐渐变得衰弱，这就是退化的、变质的。 **想象一个花园无人照料逐渐衰败的情景来理解'退化的、变质的'这个含义**

> A beautiful forest was once full of life. But due to human\'s excessive logging and pollution, it suffered degradation. The trees withered, and the animals lost their homes. Remember, \'degradation\' means the process of becoming worse. **一片美丽的森林曾经充满生机。但由于人类过度砍伐和污染，它遭受了退化。树木枯萎，动物失去了家园。记住，'degradation'意思是变坏的过程。**

> A beautiful princess was cursed by an evil witch and degraded to a poor peasant. But she never gave up and finally broke the curse. Here, \'degrade\' means to lower in rank or status. **一位美丽的公主被一个邪恶的女巫诅咒，地位降低沦为贫穷的农民。但她从未放弃，最终打破了诅咒。这里，'degrade'意思是降低地位或级别。**

> A student worked very hard to get a high degree. He spent countless hours studying and taking tests. Finally, his efforts paid off and he achieved the degree he dreamed of. **一名学生为了获得高学位非常努力。他花费了无数个小时学习和参加考试。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他获得了梦寐以求的学位。**

> A thirsty traveler was lost in the desert. He had no water and his body started to dehydrate. His skin became dry and his mouth was parched. Finally, he was saved before it was too late. **一位口渴的旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。他没有水，身体开始脱水。他的皮肤变得干燥，嘴巴也干渴难耐。最后，他在还不算太晚的时候得救了。**

> A traveler was lost in the desert. He had no water and felt extremely weak. This situation was called dehydration. His body was losing too much water and he needed help urgently. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。他没有水，感觉极度虚弱。这种情况被称为脱水。他的身体流失了太多水分，急需帮助。**
> 在一个神秘的古老森林中，有一座被遗忘的神庙。传说中，神庙里供奉着一位拥有神奇力量的 deity（神），能实现人们最真挚的愿望。许多人冒险前往寻找，只为一睹这位 deity 的风采。 **在一个神秘古老的森林中，有一座被遗忘的神庙。传说神庙里供奉着一位拥有神奇力量的神，能实现人们最真挚的愿望。许多人冒险前往寻找，只为一睹这位神的风采。**

> A little rabbit was supposed to meet its friends at the forest party. But it got lost on the way and had to delay its arrival. All its friends were worried, but finally the rabbit showed up and everyone had fun. **一只小兔子本应在森林派对上与朋友们见面。但它在路上迷路了，不得不延迟到达。它的所有朋友都很担心，但最后兔子出现了，大家都玩得很开心。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in a forest. When he found a hidden cottage, the owner offered him a delectable meal. The taste was so wonderful that he never forgot. It was a meal full of joy and surprise. **一位饥饿的旅行者在森林中迷路了。当他发现一个隐藏的小屋时，主人为他提供了一顿美味可口的饭菜。味道如此美妙，以至于他永远不会忘记。这是一顿充满欢乐和惊喜的饭。**

> A company needed someone to attend a meeting. They chose Tom as their delegate. Tom went and represented the company well. \'Delegate\' means a person chosen to represent others. **一家公司需要有人去参加会议。他们选了汤姆作为他们的代表。汤姆去了并且很好地代表了公司。'delegate'意思是被挑选出来代表他人的人。**

> A company needed to solve a big problem. The boss couldn\'t do it alone, so he chose a delegation of smart workers. They went to handle the task and finally succeeded. The delegation saved the day! **一家公司需要解决一个大问题。老板无法独自完成，于是挑选了一个代表团，由聪明的员工组成。他们去处理任务，最终成功了。这个代表团挽救了局面！**
> 想象一下，你有一本装满错误信息的魔法日记。每次你发现错误，就会喊出\'delete\'，然后错误的内容就像烟雾一样消失不见。这个词就是让东西消失、抹去的意思。 **想象你有本充满错误信息的魔法日记，每次喊出\'delete\'，错误内容就消失，这个词意为消失、抹去。**
> 想象一个邪恶的巫师，他有一瓶神秘的药水，上面标着\'deleterious\'。任何人喝下这药水都会受到伤害，身体变差。所以\'deleterious\'就是有害的、有毒的意思。 **想象一个邪恶巫师的药水，表明\'deleterious\'意为有害的、有毒的**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. He needed to deliberate carefully. He sat in a quiet room, thinking step by step, to make the right decision. Finally, he found the key clue. **一位侦探正在试图解开一个谜团。他需要仔细地思考。他坐在一个安静的房间里，一步一步地思考，以做出正确的决定。最后，他找到了关键线索。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The suspect deliberately left clues to mislead him. But the detective was smart and saw through the deception. He knew the suspect did it on purpose. **一位侦探正在试图解开一个谜团。嫌疑人故意留下线索来误导他。但侦探很聪明，看穿了这个骗局。他知道嫌疑人是有意为之。**

> A king sat in his throne room for hours in deliberation. He needed to decide whether to go to war or find a peaceful solution. His face showed the deep thought and careful consideration that is \'deliberation\'. **一位国王在王座室里坐了几个小时深思熟虑。他需要决定是开战还是寻求和平解决方案。他的表情展现出的深度思考和谨慎考虑就是'深思熟虑'。**

> A princess was invited to a grand feast. Among the many dishes, there was a special one called \'delicacy\'. It was so rare and fine that it was served with great care. The princess loved it and always remembered its taste. **一位公主被邀请参加一场盛大的宴会。在众多菜肴中，有一道特别的菜叫做"美味佳肴"。它非常稀有精致，上菜时小心翼翼。公主很喜欢它，并一直记得它的味道。**

> A princess wore a delicate dress to the ball. But she had to be very careful as it was easily torn. The dress was so fine and needed gentle handling, just like the word \'delicate\' means fragile and needing careful treatment. **一位公主穿着一件精致的裙子去参加舞会。但她必须非常小心，因为它很容易被撕破。这条裙子如此精美，需要轻柔对待，就像'delicate'这个单词意味着脆弱的、需要小心处理的。**

> A fairy was walking delicately on a flower petal. Her every step was light and gentle, as if she was afraid to hurt the beautiful petal. This shows how \'delicately\' means with great care and in a fine, gentle way. **一位仙女正小心翼翼地走在花瓣上。她的每一步都轻盈而温柔，仿佛害怕伤害这美丽的花瓣。这展示了\'delicately\'意思是以非常小心、精细和温柔的方式。**

> One day, I was extremely hungry. When I tasted a piece of cake, it was so wonderful that I shouted \'delicious!\' The cake was soft and sweet, making me feel happy and satisfied. **有一天，我非常饿。当我品尝了一块蛋糕，它是如此美妙，以至于我大喊'美味！'这个蛋糕又软又甜，让我感到开心和满足。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in a forest. When he found a small cottage, the hostess served him a meal. He tasted it and exclaimed, \'This food is deliciously prepared!\' meaning the food was extremely tasty and well-made. **一位饥饿的旅行者在森林里迷路了。当他找到一间小屋时，女主人为他准备了一顿饭。他尝了尝，惊呼道：'这饭菜做得美味极了！' 这里的deliciously表示极其美味地、可口地。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. When she found her way home, her parents\' smiles and hugs filled her with delight. The feeling of being safe and loved was just wonderful. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。当她找到回家的路时，父母的微笑和拥抱让她满心欢喜。那种安全和被爱的感觉真是太棒了。**

> One day, I received a surprise gift. It was exactly what I wanted. I was so delighted that my face lit up with joy. I felt like I was in a wonderful dream. **有一天，我收到了一份惊喜礼物。它正是我想要的。我高兴极了，脸上洋溢着喜悦。我感觉自己像在一个美妙的梦里。**

> One sunny day, I went to a garden full of colorful flowers. The smell and the view were delightful. It made me feel so happy and relaxed, as if all my worries disappeared. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我去了一个满是五颜六色花朵的花园。那花香和景色令人愉快。它让我感到非常开心和放松，仿佛我所有的烦恼都消失了。**

> A detective was trying to delineate the criminal\'s escape route. He carefully marked and described every step, just like we need to clearly define and describe something when we use \'delineate\'. **一位侦探试图描绘罪犯的逃跑路线。他仔细地标记和描述每一步，就像我们使用\'delineate\'这个词时需要清晰地界定和描述某事一样。**

> A young boy named Tom often skipped school and got into trouble, stealing candies from stores. His behavior was called delinquency. His parents were worried and decided to teach him right from wrong to stop this bad behavior. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩经常逃学，还从商店偷糖果，他的这种行为被称为犯罪行为。他的父母很担心，决定教导他明辨是非，以阻止这种不良行为。**

> A young boy was often delinquent, skipping school and causing trouble. One day, he realized his mistakes and decided to change. From then on, he studied hard and became a good student. Remember, delinquent means someone who behaves wrongly or breaks the law. **一个小男孩经常行为不良，逃学并惹麻烦。有一天，他意识到自己的错误并决定改变。从此，他努力学习，成为了一名好学生。记住，delinquent 指的是行为不当或违法的人。**

> A man was lost in the forest for days. Without food and water, he became delirious. He saw strange visions and talked nonsense. Finally, he was rescued. Remember, \'delirious\' means not in a sane state of mind. **一个男人在森林里迷路了好几天。没有食物和水，他变得神志不清。他看到奇怪的幻觉，胡言乱语。最后，他获救了。记住，\'delirious\'意思是精神不正常的。**

> A postman was determined to deliver letters accurately. Despite the bad weather, he bravely went on his way. Finally, he delivered all the letters to the right addresses. **一位邮递员决心准确投递信件。尽管天气恶劣，他仍勇敢前行。最终，他把所有信件都投递到了正确的地址。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to bring deliverance to a village oppressed by a dark wizard. After a fierce battle, the knight defeated the wizard, delivering the villagers from fear and tyranny. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上征程，为一个被黑暗巫师压迫的村庄带来解脱。经过一场激烈的战斗，骑士打败了巫师，使村民们摆脱了恐惧和暴政。**

> A pregnant woman was anxiously waiting for the delivery of her baby. The doctor and nurses worked hard, and finally, the safe delivery happened. It was a moment of joy and relief. **一位孕妇焦急地等待着宝宝的分娩。医生和护士们努力工作，最终，宝宝平安出生了。这是一个充满喜悦和宽慰的时刻。**
> 想象一下，探险家在一片神秘的土地上冒险，他发现了一个形状像三角形的肥沃区域，那里水源丰富。人们把这个独特的三角形地带称为\'delta\'。 **想象一下，探险家在一片神秘的土地上冒险，他发现了一个像三角形的肥沃区域，人们把这个地带称为'三角洲'。**

> A man was constantly deluded by a con artist who promised him huge wealth. But in the end, he realized he was tricked and had wasted a lot of time and money. The man learned a hard lesson about not being deluded by false promises. **一个男人不断被一个骗子哄骗，骗子承诺给他巨额财富。但最后，他意识到自己被骗了，浪费了大量时间和金钱。这个男人深刻地认识到不要被虚假的承诺所迷惑。**

> A village was hit by a deluge. The rain poured down non-stop, flooding the fields and houses. People had to use boats to move around. It was a disaster like a huge wave of water. **一个村庄遭遇了一场大洪水。雨不停地下，淹没了田野和房屋。人们不得不乘船出行。这就像是一波巨大的水浪，是一场灾难。**

> A man always believed he could fly like a bird. He jumped off a building, thinking it was possible. This was a clear delusion. Poor him! His false belief led to a tragic end. **一个男人总是认为自己能像鸟一样飞。他从一栋大楼上跳了下去，觉得这是可行的。这显然是一种错觉。可怜的他！他的错误信念导致了悲惨的结局。**
> 想象你在一家豪华酒店，房间布置精美，设施齐全，这就是\'deluxe\'的体验。你享受着顶级的服务，仿佛置身于奢华的世界。这个酒店的一切都代表着\'deluxe\'------豪华的、高级的。 **想象在豪华酒店的情景来记住\'deluxe\'表示豪华的、高级的意思**

> A curious detective named Delve was always determined to dig deep into cases. He would delve into every clue, no matter how hidden, to solve the mystery. Just like him, \'delve\' means to dig or investigate deeply. **一位名叫德尔夫的好奇侦探总是决心深入调查案件。他会深入研究每一条线索，无论多么隐蔽。就像他一样，'delve'这个单词意思是深入探究或钻研。**

> A customer angrily DEMANDS a refund at the store. The clerk tries to calm the customer down, realizing that meeting this DEMAND is crucial to keeping the business\'s reputation. **一位顾客在商店里愤怒地要求退款。店员试图让顾客冷静下来，意识到满足这个要求对维护店铺的声誉至关重要。**

> A demanding boss always expected his employees to finish tasks perfectly and quickly. One day, a new employee managed to meet all his demands and got praised. \'Demanding\' means making a lot of claims or requiring a lot. **一位苛刻的老板总是期望他的员工完美且快速地完成任务。有一天，一位新员工成功满足了他所有的要求并得到了称赞。\'demanding\'意思是提出很多要求或需要很多。**

> A young man always acted rudely and carelessly, which demeaned his image in the eyes of others. People thought he had no good manners. Later, he realized his mistake and changed. **一个年轻人总是举止粗鲁、漫不经心，这贬低了他在别人眼中的形象。人们认为他没有良好的举止。后来，他意识到了自己的错误并做出了改变。**

> A young artist was invited to a grand party. His calm and confident demeanor made him stand out. He didn\'t panic but showed grace and poise. People were impressed by his demeanor. **一位年轻的艺术家被邀请参加一个盛大的聚会。他冷静且自信的举止使他脱颖而出。他没有惊慌，而是展现出优雅和沉着。人们对他的举止印象深刻。**

> A scientist was working on a secret project. Long hours and high pressure made him demented. He started imagining crazy things and behaving strangely. Remember, \'demented\' means crazy or insane. **一位科学家正在从事一个秘密项目。长时间的工作和巨大的压力使他精神错乱。他开始想象疯狂的事情，行为也变得怪异。记住，\'demented\'意思是疯狂的或精神错乱的。**

> A king was once very wise, but as time passed, his mind started to change. He forgot things easily and acted strangely. This was called \'dementia\', a condition that makes one\'s mind not work properly. **曾经有一位国王非常睿智，但随着时间的流逝，他的心智开始改变。他很容易忘事，行为也变得古怪。这种情况被称为"痴呆症"，即一种使人心智无法正常运作的病症。**
> 国王的健康状况每况愈下，最终迎来了 demise。整个王国都陷入了悲伤，因为他们知道这意味着一个时代的结束。demise 就像国王生命的落幕，象征着死亡、终止。 **国王身体越来越差最终死亡，整个王国都很悲伤，demise 就像国王生命的结束，象征着死亡、终止。**

> A musician was invited to a demo session. He played beautifully and everyone was impressed. \'Demo\' here means a demonstration or a sample performance. **一位音乐家受邀参加一场演示会。他演奏得十分出色，所有人都印象深刻。这里的\'demo\'指的是演示或样本表演。**

> In a distant land, people had the power to choose their leaders. They spoke freely, shared ideas, and made decisions together. This was democracy, where everyone\'s voice mattered. **在一个遥远的地方，人们有权选择他们的领导人。他们自由发言，分享想法，并共同做决定。这就是民主，在这里每个人的声音都很重要。**

> In a faraway land, people had the power to choose their leaders. This was because the country was democratic. Everyone\'s voice mattered, and decisions were made for the common good. It was a land of fairness and equality. **在一个遥远的国度，人们有权选择他们的领导人。这是因为这个国家是民主的。每个人的声音都很重要，决策是为了共同的利益。这是一个公平和平等的国度。**

> In a faraway land, people made decisions Democratically. They listened to each other, shared ideas, and voted fairly. This way, everyone\'s voice was heard and respected, making their community thrive and happy. **在一个遥远的地方，人们以民主的方式做决策。他们相互倾听，分享想法，公平投票。这样，每个人的声音都被听到和尊重，使他们的社区繁荣且快乐。**

> A small kingdom was ruled by a dictator. But the people fought hard for change. Eventually, they achieved democratization. Everyone had a say in how the country was run. **一个小王国被独裁者统治着。但人民为了改变而努力斗争。最终，他们实现了民主化。每个人对国家如何管理都有发言权。**

> In a kingdom ruled by a tyrant, a brave group emerged. They fought to democratize the land, giving the power to the people. Everyone could vote and have a say. Finally, the kingdom became a place of fairness and freedom. **在一个被暴君统治的王国里，出现了一群勇敢的人。他们努力使这个国家民主化，把权力交给人民。每个人都能投票并发表意见。最终，这个王国变成了一个公平自由的地方。**
> 想象一下，有个神秘的人叫德莫（demo），他专门研究人口（grapher）的各种情况，比如数量、分布等。这个人就是 demographer（人口统计学家），他的工作就是搞清楚人口的秘密。 **想象有个叫德莫的人专门研究人口情况，这个人就是人口统计学家，他的工作是搞清楚人口的秘密。**

> Imagine a group of detectives trying to solve a mystery. They need to know all about the people involved - their age, gender, etc. This information is called \'demographic\'. It helps them understand and solve the case. **想象一群侦探试图解开一个谜团。他们需要了解所有相关人员的情况 - 年龄、性别等。这些信息被称为"人口统计特征"。它帮助他们理解并解决案件。**

> A powerful giant was ordered to demolish an old castle. With great strength, he smashed the walls and towers. The act of destroying the castle completely is like the meaning of \'demolish\'. **一个强大的巨人被命令拆除一座古老的城堡。他用巨大的力量打碎了墙壁和塔楼。这种完全摧毁城堡的行为就像\'demolish\'的意思。**

> A crazy scientist was planning the demolition of an old castle. But the villagers stopped him, saying it was a part of their history. Demolition means the act of destroying something, especially a building. **一位疯狂的科学家计划拆除一座古老的城堡。但村民们阻止了他，称这是他们历史的一部分。demolition 意思是拆除某物的行为，尤指建筑物。**
> 在一个黑暗的森林里，有一只可怕的怪物，它被称为 demon。它有着锋利的爪子和邪恶的眼睛，总是在夜晚出来吓人。勇敢的骑士决心除掉它，保护村民。 **在一个黑暗的森林中，有一只被称作恶魔的可怕怪物。它有锋利爪子和邪恶眼睛，总在夜出吓人，勇敢的骑士决心除掉它保护村民。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. In a dark cave, he encountered a demonic monster with red eyes and sharp teeth. The monster was very powerful, but the knight finally defeated it with his courage and skills. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。在一个黑暗的洞穴里，他遇到了一只恶魔般的怪物，有着红色的眼睛和锋利的牙齿。这只怪物非常强大，但骑士最终凭借他的勇气和技能打败了它。**

> A brave knight was falsely accused of being evil. The king\'s advisers tried to demonize him by spreading lies. But the truth prevailed and the knight\'s honor was restored. Remember, \'demonize\' means to represent as evil or bad. **一位勇敢的骑士被诬告为邪恶。国王的顾问们试图通过散布谎言来将他妖魔化。但最终真相大白，骑士的荣誉得以恢复。记住，'demonize'意思是把...描绘成魔鬼；把...描述成恶魔；将...妖魔化**

> A group of students were asked to demonstrate how to solve a math problem. They stood in front of the class and showed the steps clearly. It was a great demonstration of their knowledge. **一群学生被要求展示如何解决一道数学题。他们站在全班同学面前，清晰地展示了步骤。这是他们知识的一次很棒的展示。**

> A group of students held a demonstration in the square. They were protesting against the new school rules. They shouted loudly and waved banners to show their dissatisfaction. This was a powerful demonstration. **一群学生在广场举行了一场示威活动。他们抗议新的校规。他们大声呼喊并挥舞横幅来表明他们的不满。这是一场强有力的示威。**

> A group of people were protesting in the street. One passionate individual stood out as the demonstrator. He held a sign high, clearly showing his demands and leading others to voice their concerns. **一群人在街上抗议。有一个充满激情的人作为示威者脱颖而出。他高举着一个牌子，清楚地展示着他的要求，并带领其他人表达他们的担忧。**

> A group of soldiers were trapped in a dark cave. The lack of food and water, along with constant fear, demoralized them. They lost their confidence and spirit. Eventually, they were rescued but the experience was unforgettable. **一群士兵被困在一个黑暗的洞穴里。食物和水的缺乏，加上持续的恐惧，使他们士气低落。他们失去了信心和斗志。最终，他们获救了，但这次经历令人难以忘怀。**
> 想象一个公司里，有个叫 Tom 的经理，因为犯了大错，被高层从重要职位降级。这个'降级'的行为就是 demote。可怜的 Tom 被 demote 后，工作变得更艰难了。 **想象一个关于'demote（降级）'这个单词的故事，一位叫 Tom 的经理因犯错被降级，工作更艰难。**
> 想象一下，在森林深处有一个神秘的洞穴，那就是\'den\'。一只小熊把这个洞穴当作它温暖又安全的家，它在里面躲避风雨，睡觉休息。这个洞穴就是小熊的专属空间。 **想象在森林里有个洞穴，小熊把它当作家，用来躲避风雨和休息，以此来记住 den 这个单词意为洞穴、兽穴**

> A thief was caught stealing, but he kept insisting it wasn\'t him. His stubborn insistence was a clear denial of the truth. Eventually, the evidence proved his guilt. **一个小偷被抓到偷东西，但他一直坚称不是他。他这种顽固的坚持显然是对真相的否认。最终，证据证明了他的罪行。**

> A painter was angry when someone denigrated his masterpiece. He shouted, \'You can\'t just badmouth my work like this!\' Remember, when someone denigrates, they speak ill or belittle. **一位画家很生气有人诋毁他的杰作。他大喊："你不能这样贬低我的作品！"记住，当有人denigrate，就是说坏话或贬低。**
> 想象一下，一个牛仔在沙漠中迷路了，又饿又渴。突然，他发现了一块神奇的布料，用它做了衣服，最终走出沙漠。这种神奇的布料就是\'denim\'（牛仔布），坚韧耐用，成为了牛仔的救星。 **想象一个牛仔在沙漠中因发现牛仔布而获救的故事来辅助记忆\'denim（牛仔布）\'这个单词**
> 想象一个神秘的森林，里面住着各种奇特的生物。其中有一种小精灵，它被称为森林的 denizen。它熟悉森林的每一个角落，与其他生物和谐共处，是这片森林真正的居民。 **想象在一个神秘森林中，有一种被称为森林居民的小精灵，它熟悉森林的一切，与其他生物和谐相处，以此来记住 denizen 有居民、常客的意思。**

> A traveler was lost in a foreign country. He needed to exchange money but was confused by the different denominations. Finally, with the help of a kind local, he understood and got the right currency. **一位旅行者在异国他乡迷路了。他需要兑换货币，但被不同的面额搞糊涂了。最后，在一位好心当地人的帮助下，他明白了并换到了正确的货币。**

> A group of friends was dividing pizza. They needed to know the number below the fraction line, the denominator, to share equally. It was like finding the key to fair pizza slices! **一群朋友在分披萨。他们需要知道分数线下的数字，即分母，才能平均分。这就像是找到公平分披萨片的关键！**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He found a symbol on a wall that denoted a hidden passage. With this clue, he finally cracked the case. The symbol indicated or pointed to something important, just like \'denote\' means. **一位侦探在破案。他在墙上发现一个符号，这个符号表示着一个隐藏的通道。凭借这个线索，他最终破了案。这个符号指明或指向了重要的东西，就像'denote'的意思一样。**

> A brave journalist denounces the corrupt practices of a powerful politician. The word denounce means to publicly condemn or criticize something strongly and openly. Just like the journalist speaking out against the wrongdoings. **一位勇敢的记者公开指责一位有权势的政客的腐败行为。单词 denounce 意思是公开强烈地谴责或批评某事。就像这位记者公开反对错误行为一样。**

> A group of explorers were lost in a forest. The trees were so dense that they could hardly see the sky. It was like a thick wall blocking their way. They struggled to find a path out. **一群探险家在森林里迷路了。树木是如此茂密，他们几乎看不到天空。就像一堵厚厚的墙挡住了他们的路。他们艰难地寻找出路。**

> A group of tourists got lost in a forest. The trees were planted so densely that they could hardly find their way out. It was a real challenge for them. **一群游客在森林里迷路了。树木种植得如此密集，以至于他们几乎找不到出路。这对他们来说是一个真正的挑战。**

> Imagine a room filled with balls of different sizes. The number of balls packed closely together in a given space shows the density. More balls mean higher density. Just like how crowded a place is decides its density. **想象一个房间里装满了不同大小的球。在给定空间中紧密堆积在一起的球的数量显示了密度。球越多意味着密度越高。就像一个地方的拥挤程度决定了它的密度。**

> One day, I accidentally hit a tree with my bike and made a dent on it. I was very upset. But this incident helped me remember the word \'dent\' which means a small hollow in a surface caused by damage. **有一天，我骑自行车不小心撞到了一棵树，在树上弄出了一个凹痕。我非常沮丧。但这个事件帮助我记住了\'dent\'这个单词，它指的是物体表面因受损而出现的小凹陷。**

> A little boy had a sweet tooth and ate too many candies. One day, he felt a sharp pain in his teeth. His mom took him to the dental clinic. The dentist fixed his teeth and told him to take care of his dental health. **一个小男孩特别爱吃糖，吃了太多。有一天，他的牙齿剧痛。他妈妈带他去了牙科诊所。牙医给他治好了牙，并告诉他要照顾好牙齿健康。**

> One day, Tom had a terrible toothache. His mom took him to see a person who could fix it - a dentist. The dentist was very kind and fixed Tom\'s tooth quickly. Now Tom knows the dentist is the hero for teeth problems. **一天，汤姆牙疼得厉害。他妈妈带他去见一个能解决问题的人------牙医。牙医非常和蔼，很快就治好了汤姆的牙。现在汤姆知道牙医是解决牙齿问题的英雄。**

> One day, Tom had a severe toothache. He went to a place called \'Dentistry\'. There, a kind doctor fixed his teeth. Tom learned that dentistry is all about taking care of our teeth. **有一天，汤姆牙疼得厉害。他去了一个叫"牙科诊所"的地方。在那里，一位和蔼的医生治好了他的牙。汤姆了解到牙科就是关于照顾我们牙齿的。**

> A spy was caught and faced the denunciation of the whole country. People shouted angrily at him for his betrayal. The word denunciation here means the public act of condemning someone strongly. **一名间谍被抓获，并面临全国的谴责。人们愤怒地对他大喊大叫，因为他的背叛。这里"denunciation"这个词意味着强烈谴责某人的公开行为。**

> A thief was caught stealing, but he tried to deny it. He said he was just passing by. However, the evidence was clear and he couldn\'t escape the truth. Eventually, he had to admit his crime. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓，但他试图否认。他说他只是路过。然而，证据确凿，他无法逃避真相。最终，他不得不承认罪行。**

> A brave astronaut was about to depart for a distant planet. He said goodbye to his friends and family, got into the spaceship, and started his exciting journey. Depart means to leave, to set off. **一位勇敢的宇航员即将启程前往一个遥远的星球。他向朋友和家人道别，进入宇宙飞船，开始了他激动人心的旅程。depart 意思是离开，出发。**

> A brave knight departed from his castle to rescue a princess. He rode his horse fast, leaving the familiar place behind. The word \'departed\' means left or set off. **一位勇敢的骑士从他的城堡出发去营救公主。他骑着马快速前行，离开了熟悉的地方。单词\'departed\'意思是离开或出发。**
> 想象一个大公司，有很多不同的区域，其中有一个区域叫 department，这里面的人都在专注做同一件事，比如销售。就像学校里的不同学科部门一样，数学 department、语文 department 等。 **想象一个大公司里有很多叫 department 的区域，人们在里面专注做一类事，就像学校里不同的学科部门。**

> Imagine a big company. Each department has its own special tasks and rules. The word \'departmental\' describes things related to these specific departments. Like departmental meetings or departmental policies. **想象一家大公司。每个部门都有自己的特殊任务和规则。"departmental"这个词描述的就是与这些特定部门有关的事物。比如部门会议或部门政策。**
