> One day, Tom was walking in the forest. Suddenly, he found a hidden cave. This was a new and unknown place for him. Tom felt excited as he discovered this secret place all by himself. **一天，汤姆在森林里散步。突然，他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴。这对他来说是一个全新的未知之地。汤姆很兴奋，因为他独自发现了这个秘密的地方。**

> One day, Tom was exploring a cave. After hours of walking, he made a great discovery - a hidden treasure chest. This exciting find made his adventure unforgettable. **一天，汤姆在探索一个洞穴。经过几个小时的行走，他有了一个重大发现------一个隐藏的宝箱。这个令人兴奋的发现让他的冒险难以忘怀。**

> A famous scientist\'s research was discredited. People spread rumors that his experiments were fake. But later, it was proved that he was right. Discredit means to damage the reputation or trustworthiness of someone or something. **一位著名科学家的研究遭到诋毁。人们散布谣言说他的实验是假的。但后来证明他是对的。discredit 意思是损害某人或某事的声誉或可信度。**

> A spy needed to be discreet. One day, while on a mission, he hid the secret documents carefully and acted calmly. No one suspected him because of his discreet behavior. **一名间谍需要谨慎。有一天，在执行任务时，他小心地藏好秘密文件，表现得很沉着。由于他谨慎的行为，没有人怀疑他。**

> A spy needed to act discreetly to avoid being noticed. He moved quietly, spoke softly, and made sure his actions were not obvious. By behaving discreetly, he managed to complete his mission successfully. **一名间谍需要谨慎行事以避免被注意到。他行动安静，说话轻声，确保自己的行为不引人注目。通过谨慎行事，他成功完成了任务。**

> One day, a detective found a discrepancy in the alibi of a suspect. The time the suspect claimed to be at home didn\'t match the evidence. This difference helped the detective solve the case. **有一天，一位侦探在一名嫌疑人的不在场证明中发现了差异。嫌疑人声称在家的时间与证据不相符。这个差别帮助侦探破了案。**

> Imagine a group of separate, distinct islands in the ocean. Each island is discrete, not connected to the others. Just like these islands, \'discrete\' means separate and distinct. **想象一下海洋中一组相互分离、截然不同的岛屿。每个岛屿都是离散的，彼此不相连。就像这些岛屿一样，'discrete'意味着分离的、不连续的。**

> A spy needed to use discretion when handling secret documents. If not, the enemy would discover their plans. Discretion means the quality of being careful and using good judgment to avoid causing harm or giving away secrets. **一名间谍在处理秘密文件时需要谨慎行事。否则，敌人就会发现他们的计划。discretion 这个词意为谨慎、判断力，即小心行事以避免造成伤害或泄露秘密。**

> A king had discretionary power to decide which noble would get the precious gem. But he used it wisely, considering everyone\'s merits. Remember, discretionary means having the freedom to make choices. **一位国王拥有决定哪一位贵族能得到珍贵宝石的自主决定权。但他明智地使用了这权力，考虑了每个人的功绩。记住，discretionary 意思是有做选择的自由。**

> In a magical math land, there was a special key called the \'discriminant\' that could unlock the secrets of quadratic equations. It was like a magic wand that told us whether the equation had two, one, or no real solutions. **在一个神奇的数学王国里，有一把特殊的钥匙叫'判别式'，它能揭开二次方程的秘密。它就像一根魔法棒，告诉我们方程有两个、一个还是没有实数解。**

> A king had to discriminate between two knights. One was brave and honest, the other was sly. By observing their actions in battles, he finally chose the right one. Here, \'discriminate\' means to make a clear distinction. **一位国王必须区分两位骑士。一位勇敢诚实，另一位狡猾。通过观察他们在战斗中的表现，他最终做出了正确选择。这里，'discriminate'意思是区分、辨别。**

> A king was choosing guards. He needed discriminating eyes to pick the most skilled and loyal ones. He carefully observed and made wise choices. \'Discriminating\' here means having the ability to make fine distinctions. **一位国王正在挑选侍卫。他需要有鉴别力的眼光来挑选最有技能和最忠诚的人。他仔细观察并做出明智的选择。'discriminating'在这里指的是有辨别细微差异的能力。**

> A brave student named Lily fought against discrimination in her school. Some teachers treated students differently based on their looks. Lily spoke up, saying this was unfair. Her action made the school change and end the discrimination. **一位勇敢的名叫莉莉的学生在她的学校里与歧视作斗争。一些老师根据学生的外表区别对待他们。莉莉站出来说这是不公平的。她的行动使学校改变并结束了歧视。**

> One day, a company\'s recruitment policy was found to be discriminatory. It favored certain groups while excluding others. This unfairness caused a public outcry. Remember, discriminatory means showing unfair treatment based on differences. **有一天，一家公司的招聘政策被发现是歧视性的。它偏袒某些群体而排斥其他群体。这种不公平引起了公众的强烈抗议。记住，discriminatory 意思是基于差异表现出不公平的对待。**

> A student was always giving discursive answers in class. One day, the teacher asked a simple question. Instead of a direct reply, the student rambled on and on. The teacher said, \'Your answers are too discursive! Be concise!\' **一名学生在课堂上总是给出散漫的回答。有一天，老师问了一个简单的问题。这位学生没有直接回答，而是东拉西扯说个不停。老师说：'你的回答太散漫了！简洁点！'**

> A group of friends were in a room. They had different ideas about a trip. So they began to discuss it loudly. They shared thoughts and finally made a good plan. **一群朋友在一个房间里。他们对于一次旅行有不同的想法。所以他们开始大声地讨论。他们分享想法，最终制定了一个好计划。**

> A group of friends sat in a circle for a discussion. They talked about their favorite movies and shared different opinions. It was a lively and interesting discussion that made their friendship deeper. **一群朋友围坐成一圈进行讨论。他们谈论自己最喜欢的电影，并分享不同的观点。这是一场生动有趣的讨论，让他们的友谊更加深厚。**

> A proud prince always showed disdain towards the poor villagers. He thought they were beneath him. But one day, when lost and in need, it was a poor villager who helped him. The prince then learned the error of his disdain. **一位骄傲的王子总是对贫穷的村民表现出轻蔑。他认为他们低他一等。但有一天，当他迷路并需要帮助时，是一位贫穷的村民帮助了他。王子这才认识到自己轻蔑态度的错误。**

> A brave doctor was fighting against a mysterious disease. It made people weak and tired. But the doctor never gave up, trying every way to find the cure. Finally, the disease was defeated. **一位勇敢的医生正在与一种神秘的疾病作斗争。它使人虚弱和疲倦。但医生从未放弃，尝试各种方法寻找治疗方法。最终，疾病被打败了。**

> One day, a farmer found that some of his plants looked weak and unhealthy. He realized they were diseased. He quickly took action to save the rest of the crops. **一天，一个农民发现他的一些植物看起来虚弱且不健康。他意识到它们生病了。他迅速采取行动来拯救其余的庄稼。**

> A group of tourists were on a cruise. When the ship reached the port, they disembarked one by one. They happily left the ship and began to explore the new place. **一群游客在游轮上。当船抵达港口时，他们一个接一个地下船。他们开心地离开船，开始探索新的地方。**

> A spirit was wandering in the forest. It was disembodied, having no physical form. People were scared as they couldn\'t see it but could sense its presence. It was like a mystery that couldn\'t be explained. **一个灵魂在森林中游荡。它是无形体的，没有实体形态。人们感到害怕，因为他们看不到它，但能感觉到它的存在。这就像是一个无法解释的谜团。**

> A young prince was disenchanted when he found out the magic in his kingdom was just an illusion. He had believed in it so strongly, but now felt disappointed and lost faith. This is how we remember \'disenchanted\' - losing the charm or magic one once believed in. **一位年轻的王子在发现他王国中的魔法只是一种幻觉时感到心灰意冷。他曾经深信不疑，但现在感到失望并失去了信念。这就是我们记住'disenchanted'的方式------失去曾经相信的魅力或魔力。**

> A soldier was in a fierce battle. But when he saw his comrades were safe, he decided to disengage from the fight. It means to free oneself or withdraw. **一名士兵身处激烈的战斗中。但当他看到战友们安全时，他决定脱离战斗。这个词意思是使脱离、解脱或退出。**

> A soldier was in a war, feeling tired and stressed. But when he got the order of disengagement, it was like a huge relief. He could finally leave the battlefield and return to peace. **一名士兵身处战争中，感到疲惫和压力巨大。但当他接到撤离的命令（disengagement）时，仿佛如释重负。他终于可以离开战场，回归和平。**

> A beautiful princess was kidnapped by an evil witch. The witch cast a spell to disfigure the princess, making her face ugly. But in the end, a brave prince found a way to break the spell and restore her beauty. **一位美丽的公主被一个邪恶的女巫绑架了。女巫施了一个法术使公主毁容，让她的脸变得丑陋。但最后，一位勇敢的王子找到了打破法术的方法，恢复了她的美貌。**

> A king\'s bad behavior in public was a disgrace. People were shocked and disappointed. The king lost the respect of his subjects. His actions brought shame and dishonor to the kingdom. **一位国王在公共场合的不良行为是一件丢脸的事。人们感到震惊和失望。国王失去了臣民的尊重。他的行为给王国带来了耻辱和不光彩。**

> A thief was caught stealing in the supermarket. His behavior was disgraceful. Everyone looked at him with contempt. This scene made it easy to remember that disgraceful means causing shame or dishonor. **一个小偷在超市偷东西被抓住了。他的行为是可耻的。每个人都轻蔑地看着他。这个场景让人很容易记住disgraceful意思是可耻的、不光彩的。**

> A disgruntled employee was always complaining at work. One day, he got a bad evaluation and became even more unhappy. He felt unappreciated and frustrated. So, \'disgruntled\' means being unhappy and dissatisfied. **一位心怀不满的员工总是在工作时抱怨。有一天，他得到了一个糟糕的评价，变得更加不高兴了。他觉得自己不受赏识，很沮丧。所以，\'disgruntled\'意思是不高兴和不满。**

> One day, a spy needed to enter the enemy\'s base. He put on a strange costume and changed his appearance to disguise himself. With this disguise, no one recognized him and he successfully completed his mission. **有一天，一名间谍需要进入敌人的基地。他穿上了奇怪的服装并改变了自己的外貌来伪装自己。凭借这个伪装，没人认出他，他成功完成了任务。**
> One day, I went to a dirty restaurant. The smell and the sight of the food there filled me with disgust. I couldn\'t stand it and left immediately. **有一天，我去了一家脏兮兮的餐厅。那里食物的气味和样子让我感到厌恶。我受不了，马上就离开了。**

> One day, I saw a man throwing garbage everywhere. His behavior disgusted me. I couldn\'t stand such a lack of public morality. It made me feel very unpleasant and annoyed. **有一天，我看到一个男人到处乱扔垃圾。他的行为使我感到厌恶。我无法忍受这种缺乏公德的行为。这让我感到非常不愉快和恼怒。**

> One day, I was walking in the park and saw a man throwing trash everywhere. The smell and the mess were really disgusting. I couldn\'t stand it and decided to clean up the area. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到一个男人到处扔垃圾。那股气味和混乱的场面实在令人恶心。我受不了了，决定清理这个区域。**

> A mouse was very hungry. It ran into a kitchen and found a big dish full of delicious food. It was so happy and ate a lot. The dish became its favorite place. **一只老鼠非常饿。它跑进厨房，发现一个装满美味食物的大盘子。它非常高兴，吃了很多。这个盘子成了它最喜欢的地方。**

> A brave knight was always full of courage. But one day, continuous defeats in battles dishearten him. He lost the spirit to fight. Remember, \'dishearten\' means to make someone lose hope or courage. **一位勇敢的骑士总是充满勇气。但有一天，战斗中的接连失败使他心灰意冷。他失去了战斗的精神。记住，'dishearten'意思是使某人失去希望或勇气。**

> One day, Tom claimed to have found a treasure chest but later it was found he was lying. His behavior was dishonest. He lost the trust of his friends. We should always be honest and not do like Tom. **有一天，汤姆声称找到了一个宝箱，但后来发现他在撒谎。他的行为是不诚实的。他失去了朋友们的信任。我们应该一直诚实，不要像汤姆那样。**

> One day, Tom was accused of dishonesty. He had stolen money from his friend\'s wallet and denied it. But in the end, his conscience made him confess. This showed the bad consequence of dishonesty. **一天，汤姆被指控不诚实。他从朋友的钱包里偷了钱却否认。但最终，他的良心让他坦白了。这显示了不诚实的不良后果。**

> One day, Tom was very tired after a long day at work. But when he saw the dirty dishes in the sink, he didn\'t worry. Because they had a trusty dishwasher that would do all the cleaning. The dishwasher was like a magic helper for Tom. **一天，汤姆工作了一整天后非常累。但当他看到水槽里的脏盘子时，他并不担心。因为他们有一个可靠的洗碗机，会完成所有的清洁工作。洗碗机对汤姆来说就像一个神奇的帮手。**

> A young man had high hopes for a certain job. But when he saw the reality, it was full of chaos and unfairness. This experience brought him disillusion, making him lose the illusion he once had. **一个年轻人对某份工作抱有很高的期望。但当他看到现实时，充满了混乱和不公平。这次经历给他带来了幻灭，使他失去了曾经的幻想。**

> A young artist had high hopes for success. But after facing many rejections, he felt deep disillusionment. He realized that the art world wasn\'t as wonderful as he imagined. It was a harsh awakening from his fantasies. **一位年轻的艺术家对成功抱有很高的期望。但在面临多次拒绝后，他感到深深的幻灭。他意识到艺术世界并不像他想象的那么美好。这是他从幻想中的残酷觉醒。**

> One day, a virus outbreak happened. People were in panic. Luckily, we found the disinfectant to clean and kill the germs. It was like a magic weapon that made our world safe again. **有一天，病毒爆发了。人们陷入恐慌。幸运的是，我们找到了消毒剂来清洁和杀死细菌。它就像一件神奇的武器，让我们的世界再次安全。**

> A merchant claimed his products were of high quality but hid their flaws. This was disingenuous. He wasn\'t sincere and was trying to deceive customers. **一个商人声称他的产品质量很高，但却隐藏了它们的缺陷。这是不真诚的。他不诚恳，试图欺骗顾客。**

> A powerful robot was attacked by a virus and started to disintegrate. Its parts fell apart one by one. \'Disintegrate\' means to break up into small pieces or fall apart completely. **一个强大的机器人受到病毒攻击，开始瓦解。它的零件一个接一个地掉落。'disintegrate'意思是分解成小块或完全破碎。**

> A powerful magician tried to keep a precious gem intact, but his evil rival cast a spell of \'disintegration\'. The gem broke into pieces. Remember, \'disintegration\' means the process of breaking into pieces. **一位强大的魔法师试图保持一颗珍贵宝石的完整，但他邪恶的对手施了一个"瓦解"的咒语。宝石碎成了几块。记住，"disintegration"意思是破碎成块的过程。**

> A judge must be disinterested. Imagine a judge in a courtroom. If he has personal interests or biases, justice could be skewed. But a disinterested judge makes fair decisions based solely on the law and facts, without any self-interest. **法官必须公正无私。想象一下法庭上的法官，如果他有个人利益或偏见，正义可能会被扭曲。但公正无私的法官仅依据法律和事实做出公平的裁决，没有任何私利。**

> A spaceship was flying through the universe. Suddenly, a problem occurred. The captain found that the \'disk\' storing important data was damaged. Everyone was worried. But luckily, they fixed it in time. **一艘宇宙飞船在宇宙中飞行。突然，出现了一个问题。船长发现存储重要数据的"磁盘"损坏了。大家都很担心。但幸运的是，他们及时修好了它。**

> One day, Tom was invited to a party. But the music was too loud and the food wasn\'t good. He felt a strong sense of dislike. He just wanted to go home and have a quiet time. **有一天，汤姆被邀请去参加一个聚会。但是音乐太吵了，食物也不好。他产生了强烈的不喜欢的感觉。他只想回家享受安静的时光。**

> One day, a poor worker had an accident at the construction site. His arm was dislocated. It was a painful experience. But luckily, the doctor managed to put it back in place. **有一天，一个可怜的工人在建筑工地上出了事故。他的胳膊脱臼了。这是一次痛苦的经历。但幸运的是，医生设法把它复位了。**

> A worker was in a hurry and ran too fast, causing a dislocation of his ankle. His colleagues quickly sent him to the hospital. Remember, \'dislocation\' means the displacement of a part of the body from its normal position. **一名工人很着急，跑得太快，导致脚踝脱位。他的同事迅速把他送到了医院。记住，\'dislocation\'意思是身体某部位偏离正常位置。**

> A brave knight was trying to dislodge a huge stone blocking the entrance of a cave. He used all his strength and finally managed to push it away. The act of pushing that stone away is like \'dislodge\'. **一位勇敢的骑士试图移除一块堵住洞穴入口的巨大石头。他用尽全身力气，最终成功将其推开。推开这块石头的行为就像是\'dislodge\'。**

> A traveler got lost in a dismal forest. It was dark, cold and full of strange noises. He felt hopeless and scared. This scene shows the meaning of \'dismal\' - gloomy, cheerless and depressing. **一位旅行者在一片阴沉的森林里迷路了。那里黑暗、寒冷，充满了奇怪的声音。他感到绝望和害怕。这个场景展现了'dismal'这个词的意思------阴暗的、凄凉的和令人沮丧的。**

> A group of workers was assigned to dismantle an old factory. They carefully took apart the machines and structures piece by piece. The process of dismantling was like solving a big puzzle. **一群工人被派去拆除一座旧工厂。他们小心翼翼地把机器和建筑一块一块地拆开。拆除的过程就像在解一个大谜题。**

> One day, Tom was going to give a very important speech. But when he arrived at the stage, he found he forgot his notes. This situation filled him with dismay. He felt extremely frustrated and worried. **有一天，汤姆要进行一场非常重要的演讲。但当他站到台上时，发现自己忘了笔记。这种情况让他满心沮丧。他感到极其懊恼和担忧。**

> A boss was very angry with an employee\'s poor performance. So, he decided to dismiss the employee. It means to send away or remove someone from a position. **一位老板对一位员工的糟糕表现非常生气。所以，他决定解雇这位员工。这意味着遣散或开除某人。**

> A hardworking employee was wrongly accused at work. Despite his efforts to explain, the boss showed no mercy and gave him a dismissal. This was an unfair and sad dismissal that left him heartbroken. **一位勤奋的员工在工作中被冤枉了。尽管他努力解释，老板却毫不留情，给了他解雇通知。这是一次不公平且令人伤心的解雇，让他心碎。**

> A boss was very dismissive when an employee proposed a new idea. He just waved his hand and said no without even listening. This made the employee feel unvalued. Remember, \'dismissive\' means showing lack of respect or consideration. **一位老板在员工提出新想法时非常不屑一顾。他只是挥挥手，甚至不听就说不行。这让员工觉得自己不受重视。记住，\'dismissive\'意思是表示缺乏尊重或考虑。**

> A brave knight was riding his horse in a fierce battle. But when the danger passed, he decided to dismount. He gently slid off the horse\'s back and gave the horse a pat, showing it was time to rest. **一位勇敢的骑士在激烈的战斗中骑着他的马。但当危险过去后，他决定下马。他轻轻地从马背上滑下来，拍了拍马，示意是时候休息了。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy showed disobedience to his parents. He refused to clean his room when asked. This made his parents quite unhappy. But later, he realized his mistake. Disobedience means not obeying. **从前，有个小男孩对他的父母表现出不服从。当被要求打扫房间时，他拒绝了。这让他的父母很不高兴。但后来，他意识到了自己的错误。disobedience 意思是不服从。**
> A soldier was given an order, but he disobey it. As a result, he got punished. This shows that disobeying rules can lead to bad consequences. **一名士兵接到了命令，但他违抗了。结果，他受到了惩罚。这表明违抗规则会导致不良后果。**

> A king\'s palace was in a state of disorder. Valuables were misplaced, and servants were confused. This chaos and lack of proper arrangement was what we call \'disorder\'. **一位国王的宫殿处于混乱状态。贵重物品放错了地方，仆人们也很困惑。这种混乱和缺乏适当安排的情况就是我们所说的"混乱；失调；紊乱"。**

> A detective entered a room that was disordered. Papers were scattered everywhere, furniture was misplaced. It was a total mess. This chaotic scene helped him remember the word \'disordered\'. **一位侦探进入了一个杂乱无章的房间。纸张到处散落，家具摆放错位。完全是一团糟。这个混乱的场景帮助他记住了\'disordered\'这个单词。**

> A group of monkeys were playing in the zoo. They jumped around disorderly, without any organized pattern. Some climbed trees, some fought with each other. It was a disorderly scene. **一群猴子在动物园里玩耍。它们到处乱跳，没有任何有序的模式。有的爬树，有的互相打斗。这是一片混乱无序的场景。**

> A traveler got lost in a strange forest and felt disoriented. He didn\'t know which way was east or west. It was as if his sense of direction had completely vanished. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的森林里迷路了，感到迷失方向。他不知道哪边是东哪边是西，就好像他的方向感完全消失了。**

> A young artist was constantly disparaged by a jealous rival. But she didn\'t give up and proved her talent. Disparage means to speak of or treat someone or something in a way that shows a low opinion. **一位年轻的艺术家不断被嫉妒的对手贬低。但她没有放弃，并证明了自己的才华。disparage 意思是以显示低评价的方式谈论或对待某人或某事。**

> A group of friends went on a treasure hunt. They found various items - some shiny jewels, some old books. These items were disparate, having no obvious connection. But in the end, they realized each had its unique value. **一群朋友去寻宝。他们发现了各种各样的物品 - 一些闪亮的珠宝，一些旧书。这些物品是迥然不同的，没有明显的联系。但最后，他们意识到每个都有其独特价值。**

> A prince and a peasant lived in a kingdom. They had very different lives. The prince had wealth and power, while the peasant struggled. This difference in their situations was a clear disparity. **一位王子和一位农民生活在一个王国里。他们的生活截然不同。王子拥有财富和权力，而农民则苦苦挣扎。他们处境的这种差异就是明显的差距。**

> A brave messenger was given the task to dispatch important letters. He rode his horse fast, making sure the letters reached their destinations promptly. The act of sending those letters quickly was called \'dispatch\'. **一位勇敢的信使被赋予了派送重要信件的任务。他骑着马快速前行，确保信件迅速到达目的地。这种快速发送信件的行为就被称为'dispatch'。**

> A dispatcher in a busy train station is like a super hero. He quickly assigns each train to the right track, making sure everything runs smoothly. Just like this person, a dispatcher arranges and sends things or people to the right places. **在一个繁忙的火车站，调度员就像超级英雄。他迅速地把每列火车安排到正确的轨道上，确保一切顺利运行。就像这个人一样，调度员安排并把事物或人送到正确的地方。**

> A group of people were trapped in a dark cave, filled with fear and doubts. Then a wise leader came and used a torch to dispel the darkness and the negative emotions. Everyone felt relieved and safe. **一群人被困在黑暗的洞穴中，充满了恐惧和疑虑。然后一位睿智的领导者来了，用火炬驱散了黑暗和负面情绪。每个人都感到宽慰和安全。**

> In a magical pharmacy, a wise wizard named Dispense was in charge of giving out the right potions. He carefully dispensed the magical liquids to those in need, making sure everyone got the correct cure. **在一个神奇的药房里，有一位名叫Dispense的睿智巫师负责分发正确的药水。他小心翼翼地给有需要的人分发神奇的药水，确保每个人都得到正确的治疗。**

> Imagine a magical machine that automatically gives out candies when you press a button. That machine is a dispenser. It dispenses candies to make kids happy. Just like that, a dispenser gives out or supplies something. **想象有一台神奇的机器，当你按下按钮时，它会自动分发糖果。那台机器就是一个分发器。它分发糖果让孩子们开心。就像这样，dispenser 指的是分发或供应某物的东西。**

> A group of birds was happily living in a forest. But one day, a big storm came, forcing the birds to disperse. They flew in different directions to find new safe places. Dispersal means to spread or scatter widely. **一群鸟快乐地生活在森林里。但有一天，一场大风暴来临，迫使鸟儿分散。它们朝不同方向飞去寻找新的安全之地。Dispersal 意思是分散、散布。**

> A group of bees was gathering nectar in the garden. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and dispersed the bees. They flew in different directions, unable to stay together. **一群蜜蜂正在花园里采蜜。突然，一阵强风吹来，吹散了蜜蜂。它们向不同的方向飞去，无法再聚集在一起。**

> A group of birds was flying together in the sky. Suddenly, a strong wind came and dispersed them. The birds flew in different directions and were no longer in a group. **一群鸟一起在天空中飞翔。突然，一阵强风袭来把它们吹散了。鸟儿飞向不同的方向，不再聚在一起。**
> 想象一下，一群五颜六色的蝴蝶在花园中飞舞，它们分散在各个角落。这就是\'dispersion\'的场景，蝴蝶们的分散状态。 **想象一群蝴蝶在花园中的分散状态来辅助记忆\'dispersion\'（分散；散布；驱散）这个单词。**

> Once upon a time, a big flood came and displaced many people from their homes. They had to find new places to live. \'Displace\' means to force someone or something to move from its usual or original position. **从前，一场大洪水袭来，使许多人被迫离开家园。他们不得不寻找新的住所。'displace'意思是迫使某人或某物离开其通常或原来的位置。**

> A man was forced to leave his home due to a flood, experiencing displacement. He had to find a new place to live. This sad event made him understand the meaning of \'displacement\' - the act of moving something from its usual or original position. **一个男人因洪水被迫离开家，经历了流离失所。他不得不找新的地方居住。这个悲伤的事件让他明白了'displacement'这个词的意思------将某物从其通常或原来的位置移动。**

> A thief broke into a store. The police arrived and saw the thief\'s loot on display. They quickly caught the thief. Remember, \'display\' means to show something publicly. **一个小偷闯入一家商店。警察到达后看到小偷的赃物被展示着。他们很快抓住了小偷。记住，'display'意思是公开展示某物。**

> A king was always in a good mood. But one day, his subjects didn\'t follow his orders, which brought him displeasure. His frown and stern look showed his dissatisfaction clearly. **一位国王总是心情很好。但有一天，他的臣民没有听从他的命令，这给他带来了不快。他皱起的眉头和严厉的表情清楚地显示出他的不满。**

> A scientist was working on a new project and needed some disposable test tubes. These tubes were designed to be used once and then thrown away, making the experiments more efficient. **一位科学家正在进行一个新项目，需要一些一次性的试管。这些试管被设计成使用一次然后就扔掉，使实验更高效。**

> A king needed to handle the disposal of old treasures. He carefully planned and found the best way. Finally, everything was properly dealt with. The king was happy with the successful disposal. **一位国王需要处理旧宝藏的处置事宜。他精心计划并找到了最佳方式。最终，一切都得到了妥善处理。国王对成功的处置感到高兴。**

> A king needed to dispose of some old treasures. He carefully planned and arranged the process. Finally, he successfully dealt with them. Dispose means to get rid of or arrange something. **一位国王需要处理一些旧宝藏。他仔细规划并安排了这个过程。最终，他成功地处置了它们。dispose 意思是处理；处置；安排**

> A brave knight had a cheerful disposition. No matter how difficult the battle, he always faced it with a smile. His positive attitude made him a hero. Disposition here means a person\'s nature or usual mood. **一位勇敢的骑士有着开朗的性格。无论战斗多么艰难，他总是面带微笑去面对。他这种积极的态度就是性格，也就是disposition的意思，指人的天性或通常的情绪。**

> A scientist was determined to disprove an old theory. He spent years conducting experiments and collecting data. Finally, his hard work paid off and he successfully disproved the theory, making a significant contribution to the field. **一位科学家决心反驳一个旧理论。他花了数年时间进行实验和收集数据。最终，他的努力得到了回报，成功地反驳了该理论，为这个领域做出了重大贡献。**

> Two friends were on a hiking trip. When they got lost, they had a dispute about which way to go. One insisted on going left, the other right. Finally, they used a map to solve the dispute. **两个朋友在徒步旅行。当他们迷路时，对于走哪条路产生了争执。一个坚持往左，另一个坚持往右。最后，他们用地图解决了这场争端。**

> A group of explorers found a disputed treasure chest. Some said it belonged to them, while others claimed it was for the local tribe. The arguments over who owned it made the situation very disputed. **一群探险家发现了一个有争议的宝箱。一些人说它属于他们，而另一些人则声称它属于当地部落。关于谁拥有它的争论使得情况变得非常有争议。**

> In a big sports competition, the athlete was found to have cheated and was disqualify. This means he lost the right to continue the game because he didn\'t follow the rules. **在一场大型体育比赛中，这名运动员被发现作弊然后被取消资格。这意味着他因没有遵守规则而失去了继续比赛的权利。**

> A brave adventurer was on a quest. He disregarded all the warnings about the dangerous path ahead and rushed forward. Eventually, he got lost. Disregard means to pay no attention to or ignore something. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在探险。他无视所有关于前方危险道路的警告，向前冲去。最终，他迷路了。disregard 意思是不理会，忽视。**

> One day, a naughty student showed disrespect to the teacher. He talked loudly and didn\'t follow the rules. The teacher was very sad. Remember, disrespect means being rude and not showing proper respect. **有一天，一个调皮的学生对老师表现出不尊重。他大声说话，不遵守规则。老师非常伤心。记住，disrespect 意思是粗鲁无礼和没有表现出应有的尊重。**

> One day, a boy was very disrespectful to his teacher. He talked back and refused to follow instructions. Everyone was shocked by his bad behavior. Later, he realized his mistake and apologized. **有一天，一个男孩对他的老师非常不尊重。他顶嘴并且拒绝听从指示。每个人都对他的不良行为感到震惊。后来，他意识到了自己的错误并道歉。**

> A group of naughty kids decided to disrupt the quiet library. They shouted and ran around, making it impossible for others to read. Finally, the librarian stopped them. **一群顽皮的孩子决定扰乱安静的图书馆。他们大喊大叫并到处乱跑，使得其他人无法阅读。最后，图书管理员制止了他们。**

> A scientist was working on a new invention. But a sudden power disruption made all the machines stop. It caused chaos in the lab. The scientist had to start over. Disruption means a disturbance that interrupts something. **一位科学家正在研究一项新发明。但突然的电力中断使所有机器停止了运转。这在实验室里造成了混乱。科学家不得不重新开始。Disruption 意思是中断某事的干扰。**

> A group of kids were playing in the classroom. One of them was very disruptive. He kept throwing things around and making a lot of noise. The teacher was very angry. **一群孩子在教室里玩耍。其中一个非常捣乱。他不停地乱扔东西并制造大量噪音。老师非常生气。**

> A customer always had dissatisfaction when visiting a certain restaurant. The food was bad, the service was slow. This made the customer decide never to come back. The feeling of not being satisfied is \'dissatisfaction\'. **一位顾客每次去某家餐厅都感到不满。食物难吃，服务又慢。这使得顾客决定再也不来了。这种不满足的感觉就是\'dissatisfaction\'（不满；不满意）。**

> One day, Tom went to a restaurant. The food was bad and the service was poor. He felt very dissatisfied. He complained to the manager and decided never to come back again. **有一天，汤姆去了一家餐厅。食物很差，服务也不好。他感到非常不满。他向经理抱怨，并决定再也不来了。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mysterious case. To find clues, he had to dissect the crime scene carefully, just like a doctor dissects a body to understand its inner workings. **一位侦探试图侦破一起神秘案件。为了找到线索，他必须仔细剖析犯罪现场，就像医生解剖身体以了解其内部运作一样。**

> A scientist was doing a dissection of a strange creature. He carefully cut it open to understand its inner structure. The process of this dissection was both challenging and fascinating. **一位科学家正在对一个奇怪的生物进行解剖。他小心翼翼地将其切开以了解其内部结构。这个解剖的过程既具有挑战性又令人着迷。**

> A group of birds disseminate seeds as they fly over the fields. The seeds fall everywhere, spreading far and wide. Just like how information is disseminated to many people quickly. **一群鸟在飞过田野时传播种子。种子到处掉落，广泛传播。就像信息迅速传播给很多人一样。**

> A group of scientists were dedicated to the dissemination of knowledge about space. They held lectures and wrote articles, making the wonders of the universe accessible to everyone. Finally, their efforts led to wide public interest. **一群科学家致力于传播有关太空的知识。他们举办讲座并撰写文章，让每个人都能了解宇宙的奇妙之处。最终，他们的努力引起了公众的广泛兴趣。**

> A brave scientist named Tom dissented from the majority\'s opinion in a research project. He insisted on his own view and finally proved his theory right. Dissent means to disagree or have a different opinion. **一位勇敢的科学家汤姆在一个研究项目中与大多数人的意见相左。他坚持自己的观点，最终证明了他的理论是正确的。dissent 意思是不同意或有不同的意见。**

> In a small town, everyone agreed to a new rule. But one brave person, named Tom, was a dissenter. He thought the rule was unfair and spoke out against it. His courage made others start to think again. **在一个小镇上，所有人都同意一项新规定。但有一个勇敢的人，叫汤姆，是个持异议者。他认为这个规定不公平，并公开表示反对。他的勇气让其他人重新思考。**

> In a meeting, most people agreed, but Tom was dissenting. He had different ideas and bravely expressed them. His dissenting opinions made others think twice. **在一次会议中，大多数人都同意，但汤姆持不同意见。他有不同的想法，并勇敢地表达了出来。他的反对意见让其他人重新思考。**
> 一位学者为了完成他的dissertation，日夜泡在图书馆查阅资料，经历无数次修改，最终成功提交。这篇dissertation 就像他精心培育的花朵，绽放出智慧的光芒。 **一位学者为了完成他的学位论文，日夜泡在图书馆查阅资料，经历无数次修改，最终成功提交。这篇学位论文就像他精心培育的花朵，绽放出智慧的光芒。**

> A student always came late to class, causing a disservice to the whole learning atmosphere. The teacher was very angry. This behavior not only affected himself but also brought negative influence to others. **一个学生总是上课迟到，给整个学习氛围造成了损害。老师非常生气。这种行为不仅影响了他自己，也给其他人带来了负面影响。**

> A brave journalist was considered a dissident because he exposed the truth that the government didn\'t want to be known. People respected him for his courage to speak out against injustice. **一位勇敢的记者因揭露政府不想为人所知的真相而被视为持不同政见者。人们尊敬他敢于直言反对不公正的勇气。**

> Two friends went to buy shoes. One chose a sporty pair, while the other picked a formal one. Their choices were dissimilar, showing their different styles and needs. **两个朋友去买鞋。一个选了一双运动款的，另一个挑了一双正式的。他们的选择不同，显示出他们不同的风格和需求。**

> A firefly was shining bright in the forest. But as the dawn came, its light began to dissipate. Just like energy or emotions, it slowly vanished and spread out. **一只萤火虫在森林里闪闪发光。但随着黎明到来，它的光开始消散。就像能量或情绪一样，它慢慢地消失并扩散开来。**

> A king\'s bad decisions led to the dissolution of his kingdom. People were angry and revolted. Finally, the once great kingdom fell apart. Remember, \'dissolution\' means the breaking up or ending of something. **一位国王的糟糕决策导致了他王国的解体。民众愤怒并反抗。最终，这个曾经伟大的王国分崩离析。记住，'dissolution'意思是某物的分解或结束。**

> A king threw a magic stone into water to dissolve his worries. The stone made the water change and his troubles seemed to disappear. Just like \'dissolve\' means to make something disappear or become part of a liquid. **一位国王将一块魔法石投入水中以消除他的烦恼。这块石头使水发生变化，他的烦恼似乎也消失了。就像\'dissolve\'这个单词意思是使某物消失或溶解于液体中。**

> A musician was composing a song. But when he mixed some strange notes, a dissonance occurred. It was like a fight among the sounds, creating an unpleasant and conflicting effect. **一位音乐家在创作一首歌。但当他混入一些奇怪的音符时，不和谐出现了。就像声音在打架，产生了令人不快和冲突的效果。**

> One day, Tom wanted to quit school to start a business. But his friend Jack dissuaded him, saying that education was crucial. Tom listened and stayed in school. Eventually, he graduated and had a successful career. So, to dissuade means to persuade someone not to do something. **一天，汤姆想辍学去创业。但他的朋友杰克劝他不要这样做，说教育至关重要。汤姆听了并留在了学校。最终，他毕业了，事业有成。所以，dissuade 意思是劝某人不要做某事。**
> 想象一个医生在解释人体结构，他指着远离身体中心的肢体部位说：'This part is distal.' （这个部位是远端的。） 这样就能记住 distal 表示远离中心的、末梢的意思。 **想象一位医生指着远离身体中心的肢体部位说'这个部位是远端的'，以此记住 distal 意为远离中心的、末梢的**

> One day, Tom had to walk a long distance to reach his friend\'s house. He felt very tired but finally made it. The distance was so far that he remembered it well. **一天，汤姆不得不走很长一段距离去他朋友家。他感到非常累但最终到达了。这段距离如此之远，以至于他记得很清楚。**

> A man was lost in a forest. He saw a distant light and hoped it was a way out. He walked towards it, thinking it was his salvation. But it was still very far away. \'Distant\' means far away. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。他看到远处有一束光，希望那是出路。他朝着它走去，认为那是他的救星。但它仍然很远。\'distant\'意思是遥远的。**

> A girl named Lily had a distaste for broccoli. Every time she saw it on her plate, she frowned. But one day, she tried it and discovered it wasn\'t so bad. Now, she no longer has that strong distaste. **一个叫莉莉的女孩非常讨厌西兰花。每次看到盘子里有它，她就皱眉。但有一天，她尝试了一下，发现也没那么糟。现在，她不再那么讨厌了。**

> A man was invited to a party. But the food was spoiled and the music was too loud. Everything made him feel distasteful. He left early and decided never to come back. **一个男人被邀请去参加派对。但食物变质了，音乐也太吵。一切都让他感到讨厌。他早早离开并决定再也不来了。**

> A scientist was working hard in the lab to distil a special liquid. He heated and cooled it carefully, removing impurities until he got the pure essence. Finally, the distil process was successful and he got the desired result. **一位科学家在实验室里努力工作以蒸馏一种特殊的液体。他仔细地加热和冷却它，去除杂质，直到得到纯净的精华。最终，蒸馏过程成功了，他得到了想要的结果。**
> 在一个神秘的森林里，有两棵长得完全不同的大树，一棵高大粗壮，一棵矮小纤细，它们的区别非常明显。这种明显的不同，就像 distinct 所表达的清晰可辨。 **在一个神秘森林中，两棵树有明显不同，就像 distinct 表达的清晰可辨的意思**

> A young artist struggled to make a name for himself. But with his unique style, he gained distinction. People could easily recognize his works among others. Finally, his art brought him great fame and success. **一位年轻的艺术家努力想成名。但凭借其独特的风格，他获得了与众不同之处。人们能轻易地在其他作品中认出他的作品。最终，他的艺术为他带来了巨大的声誉和成功。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. The distinctive mark on the criminal\'s coat helped him catch the culprit. This mark was so special and easily recognizable, just like the meaning of \'distinctive\'. **一位侦探正在破解一个谜团。罪犯外套上与众不同的标记帮助他抓住了罪犯。这个标记非常特别且容易辨认，就像'distinctive'这个单词的意思。**

> A little rabbit had a distinctively marked tail. It was different from others and made it stand out in the forest. This tail helped its friends find it easily. \'Distinctively\' means in a way that is easily noticed and different. **一只小兔子有一条特征明显的尾巴。它与其他兔子的尾巴不同，在森林里很突出。这条尾巴让它的朋友们很容易找到它。\'distinctively\'意思是以容易被注意到和与众不同的方式。**

> Once upon a time, in a foggy forest, there were two similar paths. But one was distinctly marked with colorful flags, making it easy to follow. This clearly marked path was distinct from the other. **从前，在一个雾气弥漫的森林里，有两条相似的小路。但其中一条明显地用彩色旗子做了标记，很容易跟随。这条有明显标记的路与另一条截然不同。**

> A detective was trying to distinguish the real criminal from the suspects. He carefully observed their behaviors and finally found the key clues that helped him make the distinction. **一位侦探试图从嫌疑犯中区分出真正的罪犯。他仔细观察他们的行为，最终找到了帮助他做出区分的关键线索。**

> A young scientist was constantly working hard. His achievements in the field made him distinguished. People recognized him easily at conferences for his remarkable work. Eventually, he became a well-known figure in the scientific world. **一位年轻的科学家一直在努力工作。他在该领域的成就使他与众不同。在会议上，人们很容易因为他出色的工作而认出他。最终，他成为了科学界的知名人物。**

> A detective was solving a case. He needed to find the distinguishing feature of the criminal. It was a small scar on the left cheek. With this, he caught the criminal. Remember, \'distinguishing\' means marking as different. **一位侦探在破案。他需要找到罪犯的显著特征。那是左脸颊上的一个小伤疤。凭借这个，他抓住了罪犯。记住，\'distinguishing\'意思是使有别于其他的。**
> 想象一个画家，他总是故意把美丽的风景画得歪歪扭扭。他这种扭曲（distort）真实画面的行为，让人们无法欣赏到原本的美景。 **想象一个画家故意扭曲真实画面的行为来辅助记忆单词distort（扭曲、使变形）**

> A brave detective was investigating a case. He found a mirror that showed distorted images. It was like a puzzle. Later he realized the distorted mirror was a clue to catch the criminal. **一位勇敢的侦探正在调查一个案件。他发现了一面呈现扭曲图像的镜子。这就像一个谜题。后来他意识到这面扭曲的镜子是抓住罪犯的线索。**

> A musician was very angry when he heard the distortion of his beautiful melody. The sound was so bad that it completely changed the charm of the music. This bad change is like the meaning of \'distortion\'. **一位音乐家听到他优美旋律的失真时非常生气。声音太糟糕了，完全改变了音乐的魅力。这种不好的变化就像'distortion'这个词的意思。**

> One day, I was studying in the library. Suddenly, a loud noise outside distracted me from my book. I lost my focus and couldn\'t concentrate anymore. \'Distract\' means to draw someone\'s attention away. **有一天，我在图书馆学习。突然，外面的一阵巨响把我的注意力从书上引开了。我失去了专注，再也无法集中精力。'distract'意思是分散某人的注意力。**

> A student was studying hard for an exam. But the noise from outside was a distraction. It made him unable to focus. Finally, he closed the window to get rid of the distraction and continued studying. **一名学生正在为考试努力学习。但外面的噪音是一种干扰。这使他无法集中注意力。最后，他关上窗户摆脱干扰，继续学习。**

> A distraught man lost his precious ring in a crowded market. He searched everywhere, feeling extremely worried and confused. His mind was in chaos as he desperately tried to find it. **一个心烦意乱的男人在拥挤的市场丢失了他珍贵的戒指。他到处寻找，感到极度担忧和困惑。他的头脑一片混乱，拼命地试图找到它。**

> A poor little puppy was lost in the forest, feeling distress. It couldn\'t find its way home and was very scared. Finally, a kind girl found it and took it home. The puppy was no longer in distress. **一只可怜的小狗在森林里迷路了，感到痛苦。它找不到回家的路，非常害怕。最后，一个善良的女孩发现了它并把它带回了家。小狗不再痛苦了。**

> A poor artist was constantly distressed. His paintings didn\'t sell, debts piled up. But he didn\'t give up. Eventually, his talent was recognized, and his life changed. Remember, \'distressed\' means very worried and unhappy. **一位可怜的艺术家一直很苦恼。他的画卖不出去，债务堆积如山。但他没有放弃。最终，他的才华得到认可，生活改变了。记住，\'distressed\'意思是非常担忧和不开心。**

> A poor little girl was lost in a distressing storm. She was cold and scared, crying for help. But finally, a kind man found her and took her home. The scene of the girl\'s distress was heart-breaking. **一个可怜的小女孩在一场令人痛苦的暴风雨中迷路了。她又冷又怕，哭着求救。但最后，一位善良的男士找到了她并带她回了家。小女孩痛苦的场景令人心碎。**

> A kind fairy was in charge of distributing gifts to children. She flew around, carefully giving each child the right present. The act of her giving out gifts is like \'distribute\'. **一位善良的仙女负责给孩子们分发礼物。她到处飞，仔细地给每个孩子合适的礼物。她送礼物的这个行为就像是'分发'。**

> A group of kind kids distributed candies to all the little friends in the neighborhood. They made everyone happy. \'Distributed\' here means to give things to different people or places. **一群善良的孩子把糖果分发给了小区里所有的小朋友。他们让每个人都很开心。这里的'distributed'意思是把东西分给不同的人或地方。**

> A group of brave kids decided to distribute candies to every corner of the village. They carried bags full of sweets and made sure everyone got some. \'Distribution\' means the act of spreading or giving out something to different places or people. **一群勇敢的孩子决定把糖果分发到村子的每个角落。他们背着装满糖果的袋子，确保每个人都能得到一些。'distribution'意思是把某物散布或分发给不同的地方或人。**
> 想象一个小镇，有个勤劳的人负责把各种新鲜水果分发到各个商店，他就是水果的 distributor。他开着车，准确无误地把水果送到每个需要的地方，确保大家都能买到。 **想象一个小镇中负责把水果分发到各个商店的人，以此来记住distributor（分销商；经销商）这个单词**

> In a big city, there was a special area called the \'district\'. It had its own schools, parks, and shops. People in this district lived happily and knew each other well. It was like a small world of its own. **在一个大城市里，有一个特殊的区域被称为"区"。它有自己的学校、公园和商店。这个区里的人们生活得很幸福，彼此也很熟悉。它就像一个属于自己的小世界。**

> A spy was sent to a secret organization. Everyone distrusted him because of his mysterious background. They were worried he might betray them. This made the spy feel isolated. **一名间谍被派往一个秘密组织。每个人都不信任他，因为他神秘的背景。他们担心他可能会背叛他们。这让间谍感到孤立。**

> One day, I was concentrating on my homework when my little brother came in and made a lot of noise. His behavior disturbed my study. I was very angry and told him to be quiet. **有一天，我正在专心做作业，这时我的弟弟进来制造了很多噪音。他的行为打扰了我的学习。我非常生气并让他安静。**

> A group of monkeys were playing in the forest. Suddenly, a loud noise from a construction site nearby caused a disturbance. The monkeys got scared and scattered. This unexpected event was a clear example of a disturbance. **一群猴子正在森林里玩耍。突然，附近建筑工地传来的巨大噪音引起了一阵骚乱。猴子们受到惊吓，四处逃窜。这个意外事件就是骚乱的一个明显例子。**

> A brave knight was sleeping peacefully in the forest. Suddenly, a wild storm disturbed his sleep. The howling wind and crashing branches made him very uneasy. **一位勇敢的骑士正在森林里安静地睡觉。突然，一场狂风暴雨打扰了他的睡眠。呼啸的风声和折断的树枝让他感到非常不安。**

> A little girl was sleeping peacefully. Suddenly, a loud thunderstorm started, disturbing her sweet dreams. She woke up crying, feeling scared and uneasy. This is how disturbing something can be. **一个小女孩正在安静地睡觉。突然，一场响亮的雷雨开始了，打扰了她甜甜的梦。她哭着醒来，感到害怕和不安。这就是令人不安的事情会造成的影响。**

> A man was driving fast and lost control. His car ended up in a ditch. He was lucky to escape unhurt. The ditch was deep and muddy, teaching him a lesson to drive safely. **一个男人开车开得很快，失去了控制。他的车最后掉进了沟里。他很幸运没有受伤逃脱了。这条沟又深又泥泞，给他上了一堂安全驾驶的课。**
> 想象一下，在一个华丽的舞台上，有一位女歌手，她拥有惊艳的歌喉和无比的魅力，每次出场都能引起全场欢呼。她就是 diva，人们心中的歌唱女神。 **想象在舞台上有一位魅力非凡、歌喉惊艳，被视为歌唱女神的女歌手，以此记住 diva 这个表示著名女歌唱家的单词。**

> A brave man decided to dive into the deep sea to explore. He wore a special suit and took a big breath. With courage, he jumped and went deep underwater. The dive was both thrilling and unforgettable. **一个勇敢的人决定潜入深海去探索。他穿着特制的服装，深吸一口气。带着勇气，他跳了下去，深入水下。这次潜水既刺激又令人难忘。**

> A diver was exploring the deep sea. One day, he saw a beautiful coral reef and many colorful fish. But suddenly, his oxygen tank had a problem. Luckily, he managed to return to the surface safely. **一名潜水员正在深海探索。有一天，他看到了美丽的珊瑚礁和许多五颜六色的鱼。但突然，他的氧气瓶出了问题。幸运的是，他设法安全回到了水面。**

> A group of friends were on a road trip. At one point, the road diverged. Some chose the left path to explore a forest, while others took the right to visit a beach. This shows how paths can diverge and lead to different destinations. **一群朋友在自驾游。在某个地方，道路分岔了。一些人选择左边的路去探索森林，而另一些人则走右边去海滩。这表明道路是如何分岔并通向不同目的地的。**

> A group of divers set off on an adventure. But as they swam deeper, they showed divergence in their paths. Some went left, some right. This difference in direction was a clear example of \'divergence\'. **一群潜水员出发去探险。但当他们游得更深时，他们的路径出现了分歧。一些往左，一些往右。这种方向上的差异就是'divergence（分歧、差异）'的一个明显例子。**

> A group of friends set out on a journey. They had different ideas about the destination. Some wanted to go east, some west. Their thoughts were divergent, just like paths going in opposite directions. **一群朋友出发去旅行。他们对于目的地有不同的想法。一些人想去东边，一些人想去西边。他们的想法是分歧的，就像相反方向的道路。**

> A group of friends decided to travel. They went to diverse places, saw different landscapes and met people of various cultures. The diversity made their journey unforgettable. **一群朋友决定去旅行。他们去了各种各样的地方，看到了不同的风景，遇到了各种文化背景的人。这种多样性让他们的旅程难以忘怀。**

> A small company was in trouble. But with diversification, it started new projects like making toys and clothes. This made it successful. Diversification means having many different types of things or activities. **一家小公司陷入困境。但通过多元化，它开展了制作玩具和服装等新项目。这使它获得成功。多元化意味着拥有许多不同类型的事物或活动。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to expand his business. He tried many different fields and strategies, making his company diversified. From selling clothes to providing tech services, his efforts led to great success. **一位年轻的企业家想要拓展他的业务。他尝试了许多不同的领域和策略，使他的公司变得多元化。从卖衣服到提供技术服务，他的努力带来了巨大的成功。**

> A company was doing only one kind of business. But then the boss decided to diversify. They started making different products and exploring new markets. Now, they have many choices and are less risky. **一家公司原本只做一种业务。但后来老板决定多样化经营。他们开始生产不同的产品，开拓新市场。现在，他们有了很多选择，风险也降低了。**

> A thief was running away from the police. But suddenly, there was a diversion - a big parade on the street. The thief took advantage of the distraction and managed to escape. **一个小偷正在逃避警察的追捕。但突然，出现了一个转向------街道上有一场大型游行。小偷利用这个分心的机会成功逃脱了。**

> In a magical forest, creatures of all kinds lived together. There were tall trees, colorful flowers, and various animals. This scene of many different elements existing peacefully represents \'diversity\'. **在一个神奇的森林里，各种各样的生物生活在一起。有高大的树木、五颜六色的花朵和各种各样的动物。这种许多不同元素和平共存的场景代表了'多样性'。**

> A group of tourists were lost in the forest. Luckily, a guide came and diverted them to the right path. He made them change direction and reach safety. So, \'divert\' means to turn aside or change the direction. **一群游客在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，一位向导来了，把他们引向了正确的道路。他让他们改变方向并到达安全地带。所以，'divert'意思是使转向，改变方向。**

> A rich man decided to divest himself of most of his possessions. He felt they were weighing him down. By divesting, he found freedom and simplicity. **一个富人决定剥离他的大部分财产。他觉得这些财产让他不堪重负。通过剥离，他找到了自由和简单。**

> A king had a big kingdom. To manage it better, he decided to divide it into several parts and assigned different ministers to rule. This action made the kingdom more organized and prosperous. **一位国王拥有一个大王国。为了更好地管理它，他决定将其划分成几个部分，并指派不同的大臣来统治。这个举动让王国变得更有秩序且繁荣。**

> A king\'s kingdom was divided into two parts by a big river. The people on both sides were very sad. But finally, they found a way to unite again. Remember, \'divided\' means separated or split. **一位国王的王国被一条大河分成了两部分。两边的人民都非常伤心。但最终，他们找到了重新联合的方法。记住，\'divided\'意思是被分开或分裂。**

> A company made a lot of money. To share the success, it decided to give a part of the profit to its shareholders. This part was called the dividend. It\'s like getting a surprise gift from the company you have a stake in. **一家公司赚了很多钱。为了分享成功，它决定把一部分利润分给股东。这部分就被称为股息。就像是从你持有股份的公司那里得到一份惊喜礼物。**

> A king needed a divider to split his kingdom evenly among his sons. But finding the right divider proved difficult. Finally, a wise man presented a perfect divider, and peace was restored. **一位国王需要一个划分者来将他的王国平均分给儿子们。但找到合适的划分者很困难。最后，一位智者呈上了完美的划分工具，和平得以恢复。**

> A long time ago, a wise man used special tools and mysterious methods for divination. He could predict the future and help people make important decisions. It was like unlocking secrets hidden in the unknown. **很久以前，一位智者使用特殊的工具和神秘的方法进行占卜。他能够预测未来，帮助人们做出重要决定。这就像是解开隐藏在未知中的秘密。**

> A young priest was seeking the divine power. One day, in a dream, a mysterious voice told him to follow a path. At the end of it, he found a sacred book that revealed the secrets of the divine. **一位年轻的牧师正在寻求神圣的力量。有一天，在梦中，一个神秘的声音告诉他沿着一条路走。在路的尽头，他发现了一本揭示神圣秘密的圣书。**

> One day, Tom went to the beach and saw many people doing diving. They wore special suits and jumped into the deep blue sea. Tom was amazed by their bravery and the beauty of diving. **有一天，汤姆去海滩，看到很多人在潜水。他们穿着特制的服装跳进了深蓝色的大海。汤姆对他们的勇敢和潜水的美妙感到惊讶。**
> 从前有个神秘的小镇，人们传说镇中心的古老寺庙里藏着一股神秘力量，被称为\'divinity\'。一位勇敢的冒险家决定探寻，最终他感受到那是一种超凡的神圣之力，仿佛能触及神灵。 **从前有个神秘小镇，人们传说镇中心古老寺庙里藏着被称为\'神性；神；神学\'的神秘力量，一位勇敢的冒险家决定探寻，最终感受到超凡神圣之力，仿佛能触及神灵。**

> In a big company, there was a division of labor. One team was in charge of sales, another of marketing. This clear division made the company run smoothly. **在一家大公司里，存在着分工。一个团队负责销售，另一个负责市场营销。这种清晰的划分让公司运转顺畅。**

> A divisional manager was in charge of several teams. But there was a big problem. The teams were not working well together. The manager had to find a way to make them united. So \'divisional\' means related to a division or a part of a whole. **一位部门经理负责几个团队。但有个大问题，这些团队合作不佳。经理得想办法让他们团结起来。所以'divisional'意思是与划分或整体的一部分有关。**

> A group of friends was planning a party. But one person\'s suggestion to have a costume party was divisive. Some loved the idea, while others thought it was too complicated. This caused a split among them. **一群朋友在计划一场聚会。但其中一人举办化妆舞会的建议引起了分歧。一些人喜欢这个主意，而另一些人则认为太复杂了。这导致他们之间产生了分裂。**

> A couple was very unhappy. They had many fights and couldn\'t stand each other anymore. Finally, they decided to divorce, meaning they ended their marriage and went their separate ways. **一对夫妻非常不开心。他们争吵不断，再也无法忍受彼此。最终，他们决定离婚，这意味着他们结束了婚姻，各走各的路。**

> A man and a woman were very unhappy in their marriage. They fought a lot and finally decided to end it. So, they became divorced. They went their separate ways and started new lives. **一个男人和一个女人在他们的婚姻中非常不开心。他们经常吵架，最后决定结束这段婚姻。所以，他们离婚了。他们分道扬镳，开始了新的生活。**

> A spy was captured and threatened with punishment. Finally, he couldn\'t bear the pressure and divulged the secret mission. Remember, \'divulge\' means to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret. **一名间谍被抓获并受到惩罚的威胁。最终，他无法承受压力，泄露了秘密任务。记住，\'divulge\'意思是透露本应保密的事情。**

> One day, I was spinning around and around. When I stopped, I felt a strange sensation. It was dizziness. I couldn\'t stand still and everything seemed to be moving. I realized that dizziness makes you lose your balance. **有一天，我不停地转圈。当我停下来时，感觉到一种奇怪的感觉。这就是眩晕。我站不稳，一切似乎都在移动。我意识到眩晕会让你失去平衡。**

> One day, I was on a very fast carousel. After getting off, I felt dizzy. I couldn\'t walk straight and everything around me seemed to be spinning. That\'s how I remember the word \'dizzy\'. **有一天，我在一个非常快的旋转木马上。下来之后，我感到头晕目眩。我走不了直线，周围的一切似乎都在旋转。这就是我记住'dizzy'这个单词的方式。**

> A brave climber reached the top of a very tall mountain. When he looked down, the height was so dizzying that he felt his head spin. It was a view that made him feel unsteady and confused. **一位勇敢的登山者到达了一座非常高的山的山顶。当他向下看时，高度令人眩晕，以至于他觉得头晕目眩。这是一个让他感到不稳定和困惑的景象。**

> One day, Tom had a lot of tasks to do. He needed to do his homework, do the dishes and do the laundry. But he didn\'t complain and just did them one by one. **一天，汤姆有很多任务要做。他需要做作业、洗碗和洗衣服。但他没有抱怨，只是一个接一个地做。**

> One day, Tom was given a difficult task. But he believed it was doable. With hard work and smart thinking, he finally accomplished it. It showed that with determination, even tough things can be doable. **一天，汤姆接到了一个艰巨的任务。但他相信这是可行的。通过努力工作和聪明的思考，他最终完成了。这表明只要有决心，再难的事情也是可行的。**

> A wild horse was very fierce at first. But with the patient training of the cowboy, it became docile. It followed the cowboy\'s instructions obediently and no longer ran wild. **一匹野马起初非常凶猛。但在牛仔耐心的训练下，它变得温顺。它乖乖听从牛仔的指令，不再乱跑了。**

> A spaceship needed to dock at the space station for repairs. The crew worked quickly to align the ship precisely with the dock. Finally, it was safely docked and ready for maintenance. **一艘宇宙飞船需要在空间站停靠进行维修。船员们迅速工作，将飞船与停靠点精确对齐。最终，它安全停靠并准备好进行维护。**

> A detective was assigned a docket full of cases. He worked hard to solve them one by one. The docket was like a roadmap guiding him through the mysteries. **一位侦探被分配了一沓案件记录。他努力地一个接一个地解决它们。这些案件记录就像一张路线图指引着他解开谜团。**

> A spaceship is approaching a space station for docking. The crew is nervous but focused. Finally, the precise operation succeeds and the docking is completed smoothly. This is the exciting moment of docking. **一艘宇宙飞船正在接近空间站进行对接。机组人员既紧张又专注。最终，精确的操作成功了，对接顺利完成。这就是激动人心的对接时刻。**

> One day, I felt very sick. I went to see a person called Doctor Smith. He wore a white coat and had a kind smile. He carefully checked me and gave me the right medicine. Thanks to Doctor Smith, I got better soon. **有一天，我感觉非常不舒服。我去见了一个叫史密斯医生的人。他穿着白大褂，有着亲切的笑容。他仔细地给我做了检查，并给了我正确的药。多亏了史密斯医生，我很快就好了。**

> A young student dreams of achieving a doctoral degree. He studies hard every day, reads countless books, and conducts in-depth research. Finally, his efforts pay off and he gets the doctoral degree. **一位年轻的学生梦想获得博士学位。他每天努力学习，阅读无数书籍，并进行深入研究。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他获得了博士学位。**
> 想象一位聪明的学者，经过多年努力学习和研究，终于在一个盛大的典礼上获得了 doctorate 学位。他戴上博士帽，笑容满面，因为这代表着他在学术领域达到了极高的成就。 **想象一位学者经过努力获得博士学位的情景，以此辅助记忆'doctorate（博士学位）'这个单词。**

> A young scholar was lost in a forest. Suddenly, he met an old wise man who gave him doctrinal advice on how to find the way out. The scholar followed the wise words and successfully escaped. The advice was like guiding principles. **一位年轻的学者在森林中迷路了。突然，他遇到了一位年长的智者，智者给了他一些学说性的建议，告诉他如何走出森林。学者听从了这些明智的话，成功逃脱了。这些建议就像是指导性的原则。**

> A young monk was confused about the monastery\'s doctrines. One day, an elder monk explained them clearly. The young monk finally understood that doctrine means a set of beliefs or principles. Now he follows them with a clear mind. **一个年轻的和尚对寺院的教义感到困惑。有一天，一位年长的和尚清楚地解释了它们。年轻的和尚终于明白，doctrine 指的是一套信仰或原则。现在他头脑清晰地遵循着它们。**

> A detective was looking for important documents to solve a mystery. He found a hidden box filled with papers. These documents held the key to cracking the case. Without them, the truth would remain unknown. **一位侦探正在寻找重要的文件来解开一个谜团。他发现了一个装满纸张的隐藏盒子。这些文件是破案的关键。没有它们，真相将无从知晓。**

> One day, I was looking for interesting things to watch. Then I found a documentary about wild animals. It showed their lives and how they survive. I was so amazed and learned a lot from this documentary. **有一天，我在找有趣的东西看。然后我发现了一部关于野生动物的纪录片。它展示了它们的生活以及如何生存。我非常惊讶，并从这部纪录片中学到了很多。**

> A detective was solving a case and needed DOCUMENTATION to find the truth. He spent hours going through piles of papers and files. Finally, the right documentation led him to the criminal. **一位侦探在破案时需要【文件资料】来寻找真相。他花了数小时查阅成堆的纸张和文件。最终，正确的【文件资料】让他找到了罪犯。**

> A thief was running on the street, trying to dodge the police. The police were smart and finally caught him. Dodge here means to avoid or escape something quickly and nimbly. **一个小偷在街上跑，试图躲避警察。警察很聪明，最终抓住了他。这里的dodge意思是迅速灵活地避开或躲开某物。**

> A doe was peacefully drinking water by the lake. Suddenly, a loud noise scared her and she ran away quickly. Remember, \'doe\' is a female deer. **一只母鹿正在湖边安静地喝水。突然，一声巨响吓到了她，她迅速跑开了。记住，\'doe\'就是母鹿的意思。**

> One day, I was walking in the park and saw a cute dog. It had fluffy fur and a wagging tail. It came to me, looking for a playmate. I petted it and we had a great time together. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到一只可爱的狗。它有着蓬松的毛和摇摆的尾巴。它朝我走来，寻找玩伴。我抚摸它，我们一起度过了美好的时光。**

> A little puppy was lost in the forest. It was dogged in its search for home, not giving up even when it was tired. Finally, it found its way back. \'Dogged\' means being very determined and not giving up easily. **一只小狗在森林里迷路了。它顽强地寻找回家的路，即使累了也不放弃。最后，它找到了回去的路。'dogged'意思是坚定的，不轻易放弃。**

> A little dog was lost and met a wise old owl. The owl said, \'Don\'t follow dogma blindly; find your own way home.\' So the dog explored and finally found its way. Remember, dogma means a set of beliefs that are accepted without question. **一只小狗迷路了，遇到了一只聪明的老猫头鹰。猫头鹰说：'不要盲目遵循教条；找到自己回家的路。'于是小狗去探索，最终找到了家。记住，dogma 指的是被毫无疑问接受的一套信条。**

> A king was very dogmatic. He always insisted his opinions were right and wouldn\'t listen to others. One day, his wrong decision led to a big disaster. So, being dogmatic is not good. **一位国王非常教条、固执己见。他总是坚持自己的意见是正确的，不听他人的。有一天，他错误的决定导致了一场大灾难。所以，教条主义是不好的。**

> A little dog was lost in the forest. It was very scared. Suddenly, it saw a beautiful tree with bright flowers. The tree was dogwood. The dog felt safe under it. Later, people found the dog because of the dogwood tree. **一只小狗在森林里迷路了，它非常害怕。突然，它看到一棵开着鲜艳花朵的美丽的树，这棵树就是山茱萸。小狗在它下面感到安全。后来，人们因为这棵山茱萸树找到了小狗。**

> One day, Tom was curious about his neighbor\'s doings. He saw them carrying a lot of tools and guessed they were doing some home improvement. Later, he learned they were building a new shed. **一天，汤姆对邻居的行为很好奇。他看到他们拿着很多工具，猜测他们在做一些家居改善。后来，他得知他们在搭建一个新棚子。**

> A little girl named Lily lost her favorite doll. She was very sad. But her parents found it and gave it back to her. Lily was so happy and hugged the doll tightly. The doll was always her good friend. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩弄丢了她最喜欢的玩偶。她非常伤心。但她的父母找到了并还给了她。莉莉非常开心，紧紧地抱住了玩偶。这个玩偶一直是她的好朋友。**

> One day, a little girl was very sad because she lost her doll. But then, a kind fairy appeared and gave her a dollop of magic powder. The powder turned into a new doll, and the girl was happy again. **有一天，一个小女孩非常伤心，因为她丢了她的洋娃娃。但随后，一位善良的仙女出现了，给了她一团神奇的粉末。粉末变成了一个新的洋娃娃，小女孩又开心起来了。**

> One day, a little boy was playing by the sea. Suddenly, a dolphin jumped out of the water and danced happily. The boy was so excited and shouted, \'Look, it\'s a dolphin!\' The dolphin was so cute and friendly. **一天，一个小男孩在海边玩耍。突然，一只海豚跳出水面欢快地跳舞。小男孩非常兴奋，大喊：'看，是海豚！'这只海豚非常可爱和友好。**

> Once upon a time, a king had a large DOMAIN. It was a territory full of resources and people. The king controlled and protected this DOMAIN with all his might. Remember, DOMAIN means territory or area of control. **从前，有一位国王拥有一个很大的"领域"。这是一个充满资源和人民的领土。国王竭尽全力控制和保护这个"领域"。记住，domain 意思是领土或控制范围。**

> A long time ago, a king built a huge dome-shaped palace. It was like a big hat protecting everyone inside. The dome was so beautiful and strong. People loved it and called it the \'Dome of Dreams\'. **很久以前，一位国王建造了一座巨大的圆顶宫殿。它就像一顶大帽子保护着里面的每个人。这个圆顶如此美丽且坚固。人们喜欢它，并称之为"梦想之穹"。**

> A man had a pet dog. The dog always stayed at home, was friendly to family members, and helped with simple tasks. This dog was domestic, meaning it was related to home and family life. **一个男人有一只宠物狗。这只狗总是待在家里，对家庭成员很友好，还帮忙做一些简单的事。这只狗是家养的，意味着它与家庭生活有关。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to succeed domestically. He started a local business, providing high-quality products. With hard work and smart strategies, he became famous domestically for his excellent services. **一位年轻的企业家想要在国内取得成功。他创办了一家本地企业，提供高质量的产品。通过努力工作和明智的策略，他因出色的服务在国内声名远扬。**

> Once upon a time, in a forest, a lion showed its dominance. It roared loudly, scaring all the other animals. Its powerful presence made it the ruler of the forest. No one dared to challenge its dominance. **从前，在一片森林里，一头狮子展现出它的统治地位。它大声咆哮，把其他动物都吓到了。它强大的存在使它成为森林的统治者。没人敢挑战它的统治地位。**

> In a forest, there was a huge and powerful lion. It was always the dominant one, leading the other animals. Its roar could make all tremble. The lion\'s dominance was unquestionable. **在一片森林里，有一只体型巨大且强大的狮子。它总是占主导地位，领导着其他动物。它的吼声能让所有动物颤抖。狮子的主导地位毋庸置疑。**

> In a fierce battle of wits, the intelligent and strong-willed king was able to dominate the entire field. His strategies and power made all his enemies submit. No one could challenge his dominance. **在一场激烈的智谋之战中，聪明且意志坚强的国王得以主宰整个战场。他的策略和力量让所有敌人屈服。无人能挑战他的统治地位。**

> A young warrior trained hard to gain domination in the battlefield. He fought bravely and finally achieved his goal, becoming the one who ruled the war. The power of his domination made enemies tremble. **一位年轻的战士努力训练以在战场上取得统治地位。他英勇作战，最终达成目标，成为掌控战争的人。他的统治力量让敌人颤抖。**
> 从前有个国王，他梦想着扩大自己的领土，拥有绝对的统治权（dominion）。他不断征战，最终实现了对众多城邦的掌控。在他的dominion下，人民生活安定。 **从前有个国王渴望扩大领土并实现绝对统治权，他通过征战达成目标，在其统治下人民安定。意思是统治权；管辖；支配。**
> 想象在一个黑暗的房间里，只有烛光闪烁。一排整齐的多米诺骨牌（domino）等待被推倒。当第一块骨牌倒下，引发连锁反应，所有骨牌依次倒下，形成壮观的景象。 **想象在一个黑暗房间里有关多米诺骨牌依次倒下的景象**
> A man was in a hurry to attend a party. But he found his nice suit was dirty. So he quickly donned a clean one and rushed out. **一个男人着急去参加派对。但他发现自己好看的西装脏了。于是他迅速穿上一件干净的，然后冲了出去。**

> One day, Tom saw a charity event for poor children. He decided to donate his favorite toys and some money. His kindness made a big difference. Donate means to give something, usually money or goods, to help others. **一天，汤姆看到一个为贫困儿童举办的慈善活动。他决定捐赠他最喜欢的玩具和一些钱。他的善心产生了很大的影响。donate 意思是给予某物，通常是钱或物品，以帮助他人。**

> One day, a poor family was in trouble. Many kind people made donations to help them. The donations included food, clothes and money. With these donations, the family\'s life became better. **一天，一个贫困家庭陷入困境。许多善良的人进行捐赠来帮助他们。捐赠的物品包括食物、衣服和钱。凭借这些捐赠，这个家庭的生活变得更好了。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in the forest. A friendly donkey appeared and carried the boy on its back to find the way home. The donkey was so brave and kind. Remember, donkey means a domestic animal related to the horse but smaller. **一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。一只友好的驴子出现了，驮着男孩找回家的路。驴子非常勇敢和善良。记住，donkey 意思是一种与马有关但较小的家畜。**

> A poor patient was in critical condition. Just when hope seemed lost, a kind-hearted stranger, the donor, appeared and donated his blood. The patient was saved. The donor\'s selfless act brought new life. **一位病重的患者情况危急。就在希望似乎破灭时，一位善良的陌生人，即捐赠者出现了并捐献了他的血液。患者得救了。这位捐赠者的无私行为带来了新生命。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to save his kingdom from doom. The evil wizard had cast a spell that threatened to destroy everything. The knight\'s determination was the only hope. In the end, he defeated the wizard and averted the doom. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项任务，要从厄运中拯救他的王国。邪恶的巫师施了一个威胁要摧毁一切的咒语。骑士的决心是唯一的希望。最终，他打败了巫师，避免了厄运。**

> A brave knight was on a dangerous quest. Despite his efforts, he was doomed because of a powerful curse. The curse made it impossible for him to succeed. Poor knight! **一位勇敢的骑士正在进行危险的探索。尽管他全力以赴，但他注定失败，因为一个强大的诅咒。这个诅咒让他不可能成功。可怜的骑士！**

> One night, a little mouse was looking for food. It came to a big house and saw a closed door. But it was so hungry that it decided to find a way in. Finally, it squeezed through a small gap under the door and got the food. **一天晚上，一只小老鼠正在找食物。它来到一座大房子前，看到一扇紧闭的门。但它太饿了，决定想办法进去。最后，它从门下的一个小缝隙挤了进去，找到了食物。**

> One day, a little girl was playing alone at home. Suddenly, she heard a ding-dong sound. It was the doorbell. She ran to the door excitedly and opened it to see who was there. **有一天，一个小女孩独自在家玩耍。突然，她听到了叮-咚的声音。这是门铃响了。她兴奋地跑向门口并打开，看看是谁在那里。**

> One day, a little boy was locked out of the house. He tried very hard to turn the doorknob, but it was stuck. Just when he was about to cry, his mom came and opened the door. The doorknob was finally turned! **有一天，一个小男孩被锁在了屋外。他非常努力地转动门把手，但它卡住了。就在他快要哭的时候，他的妈妈来了并打开了门。门把手终于被转动了！**

> One night, a thief tried to sneak into a building. But the doorman was very alert. He stopped the thief and protected everyone. The doorman is the guard at the door. **一天晚上，一个小偷试图潜入一栋大楼。但是门卫非常警觉。他拦住了小偷，保护了所有人。doorman 就是门口的守卫。**

> One day, a lost puppy was sitting on the doorstep of a house. The kind owner opened the door and found it. The doorstep became the place where a new friendship began. **一天，一只迷路的小狗坐在一户人家的门阶上。善良的主人打开门发现了它。门阶成为了一段新友谊开始的地方。**

> One night, a little mouse was looking for food. It saw a bright light shining through a doorway. Curious, it crept closer. When it reached the doorway, it found a big surprise waiting for it. **一天晚上，一只小老鼠正在寻找食物。它看到一道亮光从一个门道里透出来。出于好奇，它悄悄靠近。当它到达门道时，发现有一个大惊喜在等着它。**

> Imagine a scientist working hard in a lab. One day, he discovers a special chemical called \'dopamine\'. It\'s like a magic key that makes us feel happy and excited when we do things we love. This chemical is dopamine. **想象一位科学家在实验室努力工作。有一天，他发现了一种特殊的化学物质叫'多巴胺'。它就像一把神奇的钥匙，当我们做喜欢的事情时，它会让我们感到快乐和兴奋。这种化学物质就是多巴胺。**

> A detective was on a case. He found a strange liquid labeled \'dope\'. It turned out to be a key clue to solving the mystery. The detective knew \'dope\' could refer to drugs or information that helps solve a problem. **一位侦探在办案。他发现了一种标有"dope"的奇怪液体。结果这是解开谜团的关键线索。侦探知道"dope"可以指毒品或有助于解决问题的信息。**
> 想象一下，在学校里，有一个叫小明的学生，他每天结束课程后就会回到他的 dorM 休息。这个 dorM 虽然不大，但很温馨，有他的床和书桌。小明在这个 dorM 里度过了许多美好的时光。 **想象一下，在学校，有个叫小明的学生，每天课后回他的宿舍休息。这个宿舍虽小但温馨，有他的床和书桌。小明在这宿舍度过许多美好时光。**
> 想象一只熊在冬天钻进洞穴冬眠。它安静地躺着，一动不动，仿佛处于沉睡之中。这只熊此时的状态就是\'dormant\'，就像许多动植物在特定时期潜伏、休眠，等待合适时机再活跃起来。 **想象一只冬眠的熊来辅助记忆\'dormant\'这个单词，意思是休眠的；蛰伏的；暂停活动的**

> A group of students were very tired after a long day of study. They went back to their dormitory to rest. The dormitory was like a warm home for them, with beds and desks. It was a place for them to sleep and study. **一群学生在漫长的一天学习后非常疲惫。他们回到宿舍休息。宿舍对他们来说就像一个温暖的家，有床和书桌。这是他们睡觉和学习的地方。**

> A doctor was carefully calculating the dosage of medicine for a patient. The right dosage was crucial to ensure the patient\'s recovery. If the dosage was wrong, it could cause problems. So, he double-checked before prescribing. **一位医生正在仔细计算给病人的药物剂量。正确的剂量对于确保病人康复至关重要。如果剂量错误，可能会引起问题。所以，他在开药前反复检查。**

> A doctor was giving doses of medicine to patients. One patient was very nervous, but the doctor said, \'Don\'t worry, this dose will make you better soon.\' **一位医生正在给病人开药剂量。一个病人非常紧张，但医生说："别担心，这个剂量很快会让你好起来的。"**

> A little ant was walking on a piece of paper. Every step it took left a tiny dot. The dots formed a beautiful pattern. The ant was so happy to create these dots. **一只小蚂蚁在一张纸上行走。它走的每一步都留下一个小点点。这些点点形成了一个美丽的图案。蚂蚁很高兴创造出了这些点点。**

> A little ant was walking on a dotted path. It stopped at each dot, thinking they were special treasures. The dots were like stars guiding its way. Finally, it reached its home safely along the dotted line. **一只小蚂蚁走在一条有点状图案的小路上。它在每个点处都停下来，认为它们是特殊的宝藏。这些点就像星星一样为它指路。最后，它沿着这条有点的路线安全到家。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy had only one toy car. But on his birthday, he got another one exactly the same. Now he had double the fun! Double means two of the same thing or twice the amount. **从前，有个小男孩只有一辆玩具车。但在他生日时，他又得到了一辆一模一样的。现在他的快乐加倍了！Double 意思是两个相同的东西或者两倍的数量。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. It found a magic cave where everything was doubling. It saw doubling carrots and doubling flowers. This strange scene made it remember the word \'doubling\' which means to become twice as much or to multiply by two. **从前，有一只小兔子。它发现了一个神奇的洞穴，里面所有东西都在加倍。它看到加倍的胡萝卜和加倍的花朵。这个奇怪的场景让它记住了"doubling"这个词，意思是变成两倍或乘以二。**

> A little monkey wanted to double its bananas. It worked doubly hard to find more. Finally, it succeeded and was doubly happy. It learned that working doubly leads to great rewards. **一只小猴子想要使它的香蕉数量翻倍。它加倍努力地去寻找更多。最后，它成功了，并且加倍地开心。它明白了加倍努力会带来巨大的回报。**

> A detective was on a case. There was a suspect, but he had doubt. Was the evidence real or just a trick? Doubt filled his mind as he searched for the truth. **一位侦探在办案。有一个嫌疑人，但他心存疑虑。证据是真的还是只是一个骗局？在他寻找真相时，满心怀疑。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. The clues were confusing and he felt doubtful about the suspect\'s alibi. But with more evidence, he finally solved the mystery and removed his doubts. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。线索令人困惑，他对嫌疑人的不在场证明感到怀疑。但随着更多证据的出现，他最终解开了谜团，消除了疑虑。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. Everyone said he would succeed. Doubtless! Because he was always victorious in battles. His skills were beyond question. So, doubtless means without doubt or certainly. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了征途。大家都说他会成功。毫无疑问！因为他在战斗中总是胜利。他的技能无可置疑。所以，doubtless 意思是毫无疑问，肯定。**

> A baker was making bread. He mixed flour, water and yeast to form the dough. The dough was soft and sticky. After baking, it turned into delicious bread. Remember, dough is what you need before having bread! **一位面包师正在做面包。他把面粉、水和酵母混合在一起形成面团。面团又软又粘。烘焙之后，它就变成了美味的面包。记住，面团（dough）是在拥有面包之前所需要的东西！**

> A hungry bear was wandering in the forest. Suddenly, it smelled a sweet smell and found a doughnut on the ground. It happily ate the doughnut and felt full. From then on, whenever it thought of the doughnut, it remembered that happy moment. **一只饥饿的熊在森林里徘徊。突然，它闻到一股甜味，发现地上有一个甜甜圈。它高兴地吃了甜甜圈，感到饱饱的。从那以后，每当它想起甜甜圈，就会记得那个快乐的时刻。**

> A dour old man always sat alone in a dark corner. His stern face and serious look made everyone think he was hard to approach. But one day, a kind child\'s smile changed him. Now you know \'dour\' means gloomy and stern. **一个阴沉的老人总是独自坐在黑暗的角落里。他严厉的脸和严肃的表情让每个人都觉得他难以接近。但有一天，一个善良孩子的微笑改变了他。现在你知道'dour'意思是阴沉的、严厉的。**

> A fire broke out in the forest. The brave firefighters quickly doused the flames with water. They aimed the hoses and made the fire disappear. Remember, \'douse\' means to put out something, like a fire. **森林里起火了。勇敢的消防员迅速用水浇灭了火焰。他们瞄准水管，让火消失了。记住，\'douse\'意思是扑灭某物，比如火。**

> A girl was lost in the forest. Feeling scared, she suddenly saw a white dove. The dove led her to a safe place. The dove became her symbol of hope and peace. **一个女孩在森林里迷路了。感到害怕时，她突然看到一只白鸽。白鸽把她领到了安全的地方。白鸽成为了她希望与和平的象征。**

> A little bird was flying high in the sky. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and it was forced down to the ground. Poor bird! It had to rest and find a way to fly up again. **一只小鸟在天空中高高飞翔。突然，一阵强风吹来，它被迫向下落到地面。可怜的小鸟！它不得不休息并想办法再次飞起来。**
> The king\'s downfall began when he trusted the wrong advisor. His decisions led to chaos and the loss of his throne. It was a sad end. **国王的垮台始于他信任了错误的顾问。他的决策导致了混乱和王位的丧失。这是一个悲哀的结局。**

> A brave climber was on the top of the mountain. But due to bad weather, he had to downgrade his position and move to a lower and safer place. It was a hard decision but necessary for survival. **一位勇敢的登山者在山顶。但由于恶劣天气，他不得不降低自己的位置，移动到更低更安全的地方。这是一个艰难但必要的生存决定。**

> A brave biker was challenged to ride downhill. The path was steep and full of obstacles. But with courage, he sped down, feeling the wind. Downhill means going down a slope or mountain. **一位勇敢的自行车手接受了骑下山坡的挑战。道路陡峭且充满障碍。但他凭借勇气加速冲下，感受着风。downhill 意思是向山下，下坡。**

> One day, Tom was very excited because he found a wonderful game online. But he needed to download it to play. So he clicked the \'download\' button and patiently waited for it to finish. Finally, he could enjoy the game. **一天，汤姆非常兴奋，因为他在网上发现了一个很棒的游戏。但他需要下载才能玩。于是他点击了"下载"按钮，耐心等待下载完成。最后，他可以尽情享受游戏了。**

> A boss always downplays the achievements of his employees. But one day, when a big client praised the team\'s work, the boss couldn\'t deny it. Then he realized the harm of downplaying others\' efforts. **一位老板总是贬低员工的成就。但有一天，当一位大客户称赞团队的工作时，老板无法否认。然后他意识到贬低他人努力的危害。**

> One day, I was on a hiking trip. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and dark clouds gathered. Then came a downpour. I had to find a cave to hide. It was a crazy experience! **有一天，我在徒步旅行。突然，一阵强风吹过，乌云聚集。接着下起了倾盆大雨。我不得不找个山洞躲起来。这是一次疯狂的经历！**

> A little rabbit was lost in a forest. It was getting dark and cold. The situation was downright scary. But finally, it found its way home. The word \'downright\' here means completely or extremely. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。天越来越黑，越来越冷。情况简直可怕极了。但最后，它找到了回家的路。单词\'downright\'在这里表示完全地或极其。**
> 想象一只小鸟努力向上飞，但突然遇到一股强风把它吹了下来。小鸟下落的这一面就是 downside，意味着不利的一面、缺点。 **想象一只小鸟努力向上飞却被强风吹下的场景来理解 downside 这个词，它表示不利的一面、缺点。**

> A big company was facing financial problems. To solve them, they decided to downsize. They fired many workers and closed some departments. It was a sad but necessary step to make the company smaller and more manageable. **一家大公司面临财务问题。为了解决这些问题，他们决定裁员。他们解雇了许多工人，关闭了一些部门。这是悲伤但必要的一步，以使公司规模变小且更易于管理。**

> A big company was facing financial problems. So, they decided to do downsizing. They cut many jobs and made the teams smaller. It was a hard decision but they hoped to save the company. **一家大公司面临财务问题。所以，他们决定进行裁员。他们裁掉了很多工作岗位，让团队规模变小。这是一个艰难的决定，但他们希望能拯救公司。**

> One day, Tom was looking for his toy. He searched upstairs but couldn\'t find it. Then he went downstairs and finally found it under the sofa. Downstairs means the lower floor of a building. **有一天，汤姆在找他的玩具。他在楼上找但没找到。然后他去了楼下，最后在沙发下面找到了。downstairs 意思是建筑物的较低楼层。**

> A little fish was swimming happily. It decided to go downstream to explore new places. Along the way, it saw beautiful scenery. Finally, it reached a wonderful cave. \'Downstream\' means in the direction the water flows. **一条小鱼欢快地游着。它决定顺流而下探索新地方。一路上，它看到了美丽的景色。最后，它到达了一个奇妙的洞穴。\'downstream\'意思是顺流的方向。**
> 想象一家繁忙的工厂，机器日夜运转。突然，有一天机器出故障了，所有生产都停止，这就是 downtime。工人们得以休息，工厂安静下来。这段机器停止工作、人们休息的时间，就是 downtime。 **想象一家工厂中机器故障导致生产停止，工人休息的这段时间，就是 downtime，意思是（设备或系统的）停机时间，停歇时间，休息时间**

> A young man named Tom always got lost in the city. One day, his friend told him to go downtown to find a special store. Tom followed the main street and finally reached the busy downtown area with many shops and people. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是在城市里迷路。有一天，他的朋友告诉他去市中心找一家特别的商店。汤姆沿着主街走，终于到达了有很多商店和人的繁忙的市中心区域。**
> 想象一个经济繁荣的小镇，突然工厂关闭，商店生意冷清。人们失去工作，消费减少，这就是经济的 downturn。就好像一辆高速行驶的车突然减速，陷入低谷。 **想象一个经济繁荣的小镇突然陷入衰退的情景来辅助记忆downturn（衰退；下降；低迷时期）这个单词**

> A little bird was flying upward. But suddenly, a strong wind blew and it was forced to fly downward. It struggled but finally landed safely on the ground. **一只小鸟正在向上飞。但突然，一阵强风吹来，它被迫向下飞。它挣扎着，但最终安全地降落在地面上。**

> A brave pilot was flying. Suddenly, a strong wind blew. But he knew going downwind would make the flight easier. So, he followed the direction of the wind and landed safely. \'Downwind\' means in the direction the wind is blowing. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在飞行。突然，一阵强风吹来。但他知道顺风飞行会让这次飞行更轻松。于是，他顺着风的方向，安全着陆。'downwind'意思是顺风（风所吹的方向）。**

> A princess was sad as her kingdom could offer only a small dowry for her marriage. But the prince she loved didn\'t care, saying true love was more precious. The dowry here means the property or money a bride brings to her husband at marriage. **一位公主很伤心，因为她的王国只能为她的婚姻提供少量的嫁妆。但她爱的王子并不在意，说真爱更珍贵。这里的dowry指的是新娘在结婚时带给丈夫的财产或金钱。**

> One day, a tired worker decided to take a short break and doze off on a bench. Just as he was dozing, his boss came by and woke him up. Poor guy! Dozing made him almost get in trouble. **有一天，一个疲倦的工人决定在长椅上短暂休息并打瞌睡。就在他打瞌睡时，他的老板走过来把他叫醒了。可怜的家伙！打瞌睡差点让他惹上麻烦。**

> A baker needed to pack cookies. He had 12 boxes, and each box could hold a dozen cookies. So, he quickly filled the boxes. A dozen means 12, and now the baker had 12 dozen cookies ready to sell! **一位面包师需要包装饼干。他有 12 个盒子，每个盒子能装一打饼干。所以，他很快就装满了盒子。一打意味着 12 个，现在面包师有 12 打饼干准备出售！**

> A girl was feeling very drab when she wore an old and plain dress to the party. But then she changed into a colorful one and became lively. Drab means dull and lacking color or excitement. **一个女孩穿着老旧朴素的裙子去参加聚会时感到很单调乏味。但后来她换上了一件色彩鲜艳的裙子，变得活泼起来。drab 意思是单调的，无生气的，缺乏色彩或兴奋感。**

> In a distant kingdom, a cruel ruler implemented draconian laws. People were punished severely for minor mistakes. One brave citizen stood up and fought against these harsh rules. Remember, draconian means extremely harsh and severe. **在一个遥远的王国，一位残暴的统治者实施了严苛的法律。人们因小过错就会受到严厉惩罚。一位勇敢的公民站出来反抗这些苛刻的规定。记住，draconian 意思是极其严厉和苛刻的。**

> A farmer needed to DRAFT a letter to sell his cows. But he struggled as he wasn\'t good at writing. So, he made many drafts before getting it right. Finally, he sent the perfect letter and sold the cows. **一位农民需要起草（draft）一封信来卖他的牛。但他写得很艰难，因为他不擅长写作。所以，他打了很多草稿（drafts）才写好。最后，他寄出了完美的信并卖掉了牛。**

> A little mouse was trying to drag a big piece of cheese across the floor. It was so heavy, but the mouse didn\'t give up. Finally, it managed to drag the cheese to its hole. Here, \'drag\' means to pull something along with effort. **一只小老鼠正试图拖着一大块奶酪穿过地板。奶酪太重了，但老鼠没有放弃。最后，它成功地把奶酪拖到了它的洞里。这里，'drag'意思是费力地拉着某物。**

> Long ago, in a magical land, there was a fierce dragon. It had sharp teeth and could breathe fire. Everyone was scared of it. But one brave knight decided to face the dragon and protect the people. **很久以前，在一片神奇的土地上，有一只凶猛的龙。它有着锋利的牙齿，还能喷火。每个人都很害怕它。但有一位勇敢的骑士决定面对这只龙，并保护人民。**

> A little boy was playing in the garden and saw a beautiful creature. It had a long body like a dragon and wings like a fairy. His father told him it was a \'dragonfly\'. The boy never forgot. **一个小男孩在花园里玩耍，看到了一只美丽的生物。它有着像龙一样长长的身体和像仙女一样的翅膀。他的爸爸告诉他这是一只"蜻蜓"。小男孩永远记住了。**
> 想象一下，一个巨大的游泳池水满了。为了清理它，我们打开排水口（drain），水就哗哗地流走。水不断流走，就像能量或精力被耗尽一样。所以drain 有排水、流干、耗尽的意思。 **想象一个游泳池排水的场景来辅助记忆单词drain，它有排水、流干、耗尽的意思。**

> A king\'s castle was often flooded. So, the wise men designed a special system for drainage. They dug channels to lead the water away, saving the castle. Drainage means the process of removing water. **一位国王的城堡经常被水淹。于是，智者们设计了一个特殊的排水系统。他们挖掘渠道把水引走，拯救了城堡。Drainage 意思是排水的过程。**

> A young girl dreamed of being on the stage in a drama. One day, she got the chance and performed beautifully. The drama made her famous. She learned that in drama, every moment counts. **一个年轻女孩梦想着能登上戏剧的舞台。有一天，她得到了机会并且表演出色。这场戏剧让她成名。她明白了在戏剧中，每一刻都很重要。**

> A young actor was always seeking a dramatic role. One day, he got the chance in a play. His performance was so dramatic that the audience was deeply moved. It was a turning point in his career. **一位年轻的演员一直在寻求一个戏剧性的角色。有一天，他在一部剧中得到了机会。他的表演如此戏剧性，以至于观众深受感动。这是他职业生涯的一个转折点。**

> A poor actor was struggling. But one day, he got a great role and his life changed dramatically. He went from having no money to being rich and famous. It was like a magical transformation. **一位贫穷的演员一直在苦苦挣扎。但有一天，他得到了一个很棒的角色，他的生活发生了巨大的变化。他从身无分文变得富有和出名。这就像一场神奇的转变。**

> A director wants to dramatize a simple love story. He adds exciting scenes and intense dialogues to make it more attractive. Finally, the audience loves the dramatized version. **一位导演想要将一个简单的爱情故事戏剧化。他添加了令人兴奋的场景和激烈的对话让它更有吸引力。最终，观众喜欢上了这个戏剧化的版本。**

> A thief tried to drape himself with a large curtain to hide, but was easily caught. The curtain\'s hanging and covering action shows the meaning of \'drape\'. **一个小偷试图用一块大窗帘把自己遮盖起来以隐藏，但很容易就被抓住了。窗帘的悬挂和覆盖动作展现了\'drape\'（悬挂；披；覆盖）这个词的意思。**

> A princess was in a room filled with beautiful drapery. The soft and flowing fabric added elegance. She touched the drapery, imagining herself in a magical world. Remember, drapery means curtains or cloth hangings. **一位公主在一个满是漂亮帷幔的房间里。柔软飘逸的织物增添了优雅。她触摸着帷幔，想象自己身处一个神奇的世界。记住，drapery 意思是窗帘或布幔。**

> A doctor was dealing with a very serious disease. To cure the patients, he had to take drastic measures. He changed the treatment plan completely, which finally saved their lives. **一位医生正在处理一种非常严重的疾病。为了治愈病人，他不得不采取激烈的措施。他彻底改变了治疗方案，最终挽救了他们的生命。**

> A city was facing a severe water shortage. But after a new water treatment system was installed, the situation changed drastically. The taps flowed freely again, making everyone happy. **一个城市正面临严重的水资源短缺。但在安装了一套新的水处理系统后，情况发生了极大的改变。水龙头又能自由出水了，让每个人都很开心。**

> One day, Tom was in his room. He took a pen and started to draw a beautiful flower on the paper. After a while, a wonderful picture was drawn. He was so happy! **有一天，汤姆在他的房间里。他拿起一支笔，开始在纸上画一朵漂亮的花。过了一会儿，一幅很棒的画就画好了。他非常开心！**

> A king was very fond of drawing. But when he showed his works, people always pointed out flaws. These flaws became known as \'drawback\'. Later, it came to mean any disadvantage or problem. **一位国王非常喜欢画画。但当他展示作品时，人们总是指出缺陷。这些缺陷被称为"drawback"。后来，它就有了任何缺点或问题的意思。**

> One day, Tom was looking for his pencils. He opened a box and found them in a special place called a \'drawer\'. The drawer was like a hidden treasure chest for his stationery. **一天，汤姆在找他的铅笔。他打开一个盒子，发现它们在一个叫做'抽屉'的特殊地方。这个抽屉就像是存放他文具的隐藏宝箱。**

> One day, I was sitting in a quiet room, holding a pen and doing a drawing. I drew a beautiful garden with colorful flowers. The act of creating that drawing made me feel so happy and relaxed. **有一天，我坐在一个安静的房间里，拿着一支笔正在画画。我画了一个有着五颜六色花朵的美丽花园。创作这幅画的行为让我感到非常开心和放松。**

> A little boy was always drawling when he spoke. One day, his teacher said, \'Stop drawling and speak clearly!\' The boy then tried to change. Now you know \'drawl\' means to speak slowly and prolong the words. **一个小男孩说话总是拖长音。有一天，他的老师说：'别拖长音了，说清楚！'然后男孩努力改正。现在你知道'drawl'就是指说话慢且拉长单词。**

> A brave knight was about to enter a dark cave. He dreaded what might be inside, but his honor pushed him forward. The unknown horrors lurking in the cave made him feel dread. But he faced it anyway. **一位勇敢的骑士即将进入一个黑暗的洞穴。他害怕里面可能存在的东西，但他的荣誉驱使他前进。洞穴中潜藏的未知恐惧让他感到害怕。但无论如何他都面对了。**

> A brave knight was sent to a dark forest. There, he encountered a dreadful monster with sharp teeth and scary eyes. The monster\'s roar was so dreadful that the knight\'s heart trembled. But he gathered his courage and fought. **一位勇敢的骑士被派往一片黑暗的森林。在那里，他遇到了一只可怕的怪物，有着锋利的牙齿和吓人的眼睛。怪物的吼声非常可怕，以至于骑士的心都颤抖了。但他鼓起勇气战斗。**

> One night, I had a wonderful dream. I was flying in the sky like a bird. I saw beautiful mountains and rivers. When I woke up, I still remembered the feeling of freedom in that dream. It made me believe that dreams can take us to amazing places. **一天晚上，我做了一个美妙的梦。我像一只鸟在天空中飞翔。我看到了美丽的山川河流。当我醒来时，我仍然记得那个梦中的自由感觉。它让我相信梦想能带我们去神奇的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Lily. She was a dreamer. Every night, she had wonderful dreams of traveling the world and meeting amazing people. Her dreams gave her the courage to pursue her goals in real life. **从前，有一个叫莉莉的人。她是一个梦想家。每天晚上，她都会做美妙的梦，梦到环游世界和遇见很棒的人。她的梦给了她在现实生活中追求目标的勇气。**

> One night, I had a dreamy adventure. I flew through the clouds and saw beautiful castles. It was so wonderful and full of fantasy, just like the meaning of \'dreamy\'. **一天晚上，我有了一次梦幻般的冒险。我飞越云层，看到了美丽的城堡。它是如此美妙，充满幻想，就像'dreamy'这个词的意思。**

> A traveler got lost in a dreary forest. It was always cloudy and rainy. There were no colorful flowers or singing birds. Everything was dull and made him feel sad and tired. **一位旅行者在一片沉闷的森林里迷路了。那里总是阴云密布，阴雨连绵。没有五颜六色的花朵，也没有欢唱的鸟儿。一切都很单调，让他感到悲伤和疲惫。**

> A fisherman needed to dredge the river to find his lost precious ring. He used a special tool and worked hard. Finally, he succeeded and was very happy. **一位渔夫需要疏浚这条河来找到他丢失的珍贵戒指。他使用了一种特殊工具并且努力工作。最后，他成功了，非常高兴。**

> One rainy day, Tom was caught in a sudden downpour. He forgot his umbrella and was completely drenched. Water soaked through his clothes and shoes. Poor Tom! From then on, he always remembered to carry an umbrella. **在一个下雨天，汤姆遭遇了一场突如其来的倾盆大雨。他忘了带伞，全身都湿透了。雨水浸透了他的衣服和鞋子。可怜的汤姆！从那以后，他总是记得带伞。**

> A girl was very excited for a party. She opened her closet and chose a beautiful dress. It was pink with flowers. She wore it and became the star of the party. **一个女孩为一场聚会感到非常兴奋。她打开衣柜，选了一件漂亮的连衣裙。它是带有花朵的粉色裙子。她穿上它，成为了聚会的明星。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in her room. She opened the dresser and found many beautiful clothes. She put on a dress and felt like a princess. The dresser was like a magic box full of surprises. **一天，一个小女孩在她的房间里玩耍。她打开梳妆台，发现了许多漂亮的衣服。她穿上一件连衣裙，感觉自己像个公主。梳妆台就像一个充满惊喜的魔法盒子。**

> One day, a chef was carefully preparing the dressing for a salad. He mixed oil, vinegar, and various seasonings. The special dressing made the salad very delicious. People loved it! **一天，一位厨师正在精心准备沙拉的调料。他混合了油、醋和各种调味料。这种特别的调料让沙拉变得非常美味。人们都很喜欢！**

> The little baby was dribbling while playing with the ball. The saliva kept dripping from his mouth. But when he saw a candy, he stopped dribbling and smiled happily. **小宝宝玩球时流口水。唾液不停地从他嘴里滴下来。但当他看到一颗糖果时，就停止流口水，开心地笑了。**

> One day, Tom went to the market and saw some dried fruits. They looked wrinkled but still smelled sweet. He bought some and realized that dried food can be stored for a long time without spoiling. **一天，汤姆去市场看到了一些干水果。它们看起来皱巴巴的，但仍然闻起来香甜。他买了一些，意识到干制的食物可以长时间储存而不变质。**

> A boat was floating on the sea. The wind blew and it started to drift aimlessly. It had no control over where it was going, just moving along with the current. **一艘船在海面上漂浮着。风刮起来，它开始漫无目的地漂流。它无法控制自己的去向，只是随着水流移动。**

> A man was lost on a deserted island. One day, he found some driftwood floating on the sea. With it, he managed to build a shelter and survived. The driftwood became his savior. **一个男人被困在荒岛上。有一天，他发现一些漂浮在海上的浮木。用这些浮木，他成功搭建了一个庇护所并活了下来。这些浮木成了他的救星。**

> A soldier was practicing on the training ground. He held a drill and repeated the action over and over. The drill helped him become stronger and more skilled. **一名士兵在训练场上练习。他拿着一把钻，一遍又一遍地重复动作。这把钻帮助他变得更强壮、更熟练。**

> A team of workers was engaged in drilling deep into the earth. They were sweating but persistent, as the drilling operation was crucial for finding precious resources. The sound of drilling echoed loudly. **一组工人正在进行深入地下的钻探工作。他们汗流浃背但坚持不懈，因为钻探行动对于寻找珍贵资源至关重要。钻探的声音响亮地回荡着。**

> One hot day, a thirsty traveler was walking in the desert. He was extremely tired and needed something to drink. Finally, he found an oasis and happily drank the cool water. Now you know, \'drink\' means to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it. **在一个炎热的日子里，一位口渴的旅行者在沙漠中行走。他非常疲倦，需要喝点东西。最后，他找到了一片绿洲，开心地喝了凉水。现在你知道，\'drink\'意思是把液体喝进嘴里并咽下。**
