> A group of people were climbing a mountain. Only a few reached the top. They were called elitist because they were the select few with exceptional skills. But others didn\'t give up and kept trying to join them. **一群人在爬山。只有少数几个人到达了山顶。他们被称为精英主义者，因为他们是拥有非凡技能的少数精选之人。但其他人没有放弃，一直努力想要加入他们。**

> A brave adventurer was searching for the elixir of life. After many challenges, he found it in a hidden cave. Drinking it made him feel young and energetic forever. Remember, elixir is a magical or medicinal potion. **一位勇敢的冒险家一直在寻找长生不老药。历经重重挑战，他在一个隐蔽的洞穴里找到了它。喝下它后，他永远感到年轻和充满活力。记住，elixir 是神奇的或药用的药水。**

> One day, while hiking in the forest, I saw an elk. It was huge with strong antlers. It moved gracefully through the trees. I was so amazed by its beauty and size. Remember, elk is a large deer! **有一天，在森林里徒步时，我看到了一头麋鹿。它体型巨大，有着强壮的鹿角。它优雅地在树林间穿梭。我被它的美丽和体型所震撼。记住，elk 就是一种大鹿！**
> 想象一个外星人来到地球，他的飞船轨道是 elliptical（椭圆形的）。飞船一会儿靠近，一会儿远离，就像在椭圆轨道上运行。最后我们记住了这个形状奇怪的轨道叫 elliptical。 **想象一个外星人的飞船轨道是椭圆形的，以此记住 elliptical 这个单词意为椭圆形的。**

> Once upon a time, a little elf was lost in a forest full of elm trees. The elf climbed up an elm to look for the way home. Finally, with the help of the elm\'s branches, the elf found the right direction. **从前，有一个小精灵在长满榆树的森林里迷路了。小精灵爬上一棵榆树寻找回家的路。最后，在榆树树枝的帮助下，小精灵找到了正确的方向。**

> A poor speaker named Tom was always afraid to express himself. One day, he decided to change and practiced hard. Finally, Tom gained eloquence and could charm everyone with his words. Now, he was never afraid to speak up! **一个名叫汤姆的不善言辞的人总是害怕表达自己。有一天，他决定改变并努力练习。最终，汤姆获得了口才，能够用他的话语吸引每个人。现在，他再也不害怕发言了！**

> A young man was giving a speech. His words were so fluent and expressive that everyone was impressed. We called him eloquent. Later, he became a famous speaker. Remember, eloquent means fluent and persuasive in speech. **一个年轻人正在发表演讲。他的言辞如此流畅且富有表现力，每个人都印象深刻。我们称他为口才好的。后来，他成为了一位著名的演讲者。记住，eloquent 意思是言语流利且有说服力的。**

> A young lawyer was defending a client in court. He spoke eloquently, presenting the case clearly and convincingly. His words were so powerful that the jury was persuaded easily. The way he expressed himself was truly eloquent. **一位年轻的律师在法庭上为客户辩护。他雄辩地发言，清晰且令人信服地陈述案件。他的言辞如此有力，以至于陪审团轻易被说服。他表达自己的方式真的很有口才。**

> One day, Tom was choosing a present. He saw a book and a pen. But he didn\'t want them. He thought, \'I need something else.\' Finally, he found a nice toy car. **一天，汤姆在挑选礼物。他看到了一本书和一支笔。但他不想要。他想，'我需要别的东西。'最后，他找到了一辆漂亮的玩具车。**

> A little rabbit was lost in the forest. It searched everywhere but couldn\'t find its home. Then it thought maybe its home was elsewhere and started to look in a new direction. Finally, it found its way. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。它到处找但都找不到家。然后它想也许它的家在别处，于是开始朝新的方向寻找。最后，它找到了回家的路。**

> A detective was trying to elucidate a mysterious case. He collected clues, interviewed witnesses, and finally made everything clear. Just like explaining difficult things, that\'s what \'elucidate\' means. **一位侦探试图阐明一起神秘的案件。他收集线索，询问证人，最终让一切都清晰明了。就像解释困难的事情，这就是'elucidate'的意思。**

> A thief was trying to elude the police. He ran through alleys and hid in dark corners, but the police were determined. Finally, they caught him. \'Elude\' means to escape or avoid by being tricky. **一个小偷试图躲避警察。他穿过小巷，躲在黑暗的角落，但警察很坚决。最后，他们抓住了他。\'elude\'意思是通过巧妙的方式逃脱或避开。**

> A thief was always elusive in the city. The police tried many times to catch him but failed. He seemed to disappear like a ghost. Finally, they found a clue and caught the elusive thief. **一个小偷在城市里总是难以捉摸。警察多次试图抓住他但都失败了。他似乎像幽灵一样消失。最后，他们找到了线索并抓住了这个难以捉摸的小偷。**
> 想象一下，一只小蚂蚁（ant）在努力地搬运食物，它累得气喘吁吁，'em'，这声音就像它的喘气声。所以，看到'em'，就想到那只努力的小蚂蚁。 **想象一只蚂蚁喘气的情景来辅助记忆单词'em'**
> 想象一个神秘的能量源，它不断地向外散发着光芒和温暖，这些光芒和温暖就像 \'emanate\' 这个词所表达的那样，从这个源头不断地流出。就好像是爱从我们的心中流出，温暖着周围的人。 **想象一个神秘能量源不断向外散发光芒和温暖来辅助记忆'emanate'，意为散发；发出；起源**

> A slave named Lily dreamed of emancipation. One day, a kind man helped her fight for freedom. Finally, Lily achieved emancipation and could live a life she chose. **一个名叫莉莉的奴隶梦想着解放。有一天，一个善良的人帮助她争取自由。最终，莉莉获得了解放，可以过上自己选择的生活。**

> A man was lost in a storm. He desperately needed a safe place. Luckily, he found an embankment and took shelter behind it. The embankment protected him from the strong wind and rain. **一个男人在暴风雨中迷路了。他急切地需要一个安全的地方。幸运的是，他找到了一个堤岸，并在它后面躲避。堤岸保护他免受强风和大雨的侵袭。**

> A small country was facing an economic crisis. A powerful nation imposed an embargo, stopping all trade. The small country struggled, showing how an embargo can be a powerful tool to restrict and control. **一个小国正面临经济危机。一个强大的国家实施了禁运，停止了所有贸易。这个小国苦苦挣扎，这表明禁运是一种强大的限制和控制手段。**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的探险家站在一艘大船的甲板上。他深吸一口气，embark 了他的冒险之旅。他满怀期待，因为这一旅程将带他去探索未知的世界。 **想象一位勇敢的探险家站在大船甲板上，深吸一口气，开始了他的冒险之旅。这里的 embark 就是开始、着手的意思。**

> A man was invited to a fancy party. But when he accidentally spilled wine on the host\'s dress, he felt so embarrassed. His face turned red and he didn\'t know what to do. **一个男人被邀请去参加一个豪华派对。但当他不小心把红酒洒在主人的裙子上时，他感到非常尴尬。他的脸变红了，不知道该怎么办。**

> One day, I wore the wrong clothes to a party and everyone stared at me. I felt a deep sense of embarrassment. It was like a spotlight shining on my mistake and I just wanted to hide. **有一天，我穿错衣服去参加聚会，每个人都盯着我看。我感到极度的尴尬。就好像聚光灯照在我的错误上，我只想躲起来。**

> A young man was lost in a foreign country. He found help at the embassy. The friendly staff there guided him and solved his problems. The embassy became his savior. **一个年轻人在国外迷路了。他在大使馆得到了帮助。那里友好的工作人员为他指引并解决了他的问题。大使馆成了他的救星。**

> A precious gem was carefully embed in a beautiful ring. The jeweler worked meticulously to ensure it was secure and would shine forever. It was like embedding a piece of beauty into a lasting memory. **一颗珍贵的宝石被小心翼翼地镶嵌在一枚漂亮的戒指里。珠宝匠精心工作以确保它稳固，且能永远闪耀。就像把一份美丽嵌入永恒的记忆中。**

> A little ant was embedded in a big piece of cake. It struggled but couldn\'t get out. Just like something being firmly fixed or placed within another thing. Remember, \'embedded\' means fixed or placed firmly within. **一只小蚂蚁被嵌在一大块蛋糕里。它挣扎着但出不来。就像某物被牢牢地固定或放置在另一物之中。记住，\'embedded\'意思是固定或深深地嵌入。**

> A poor artist was struggling to sell his paintings. One day, he decided to embellish them with shiny gems and colorful feathers. Suddenly, the paintings became so attractive and were sold quickly. **一位贫穷的艺术家一直很难卖出他的画。有一天，他决定用闪亮的宝石和彩色的羽毛来装饰它们。突然，这些画变得非常吸引人，很快就卖出去了。**

> A poor painter was always sad about his plain works. One day, he discovered the magic of embellishment. By adding some beautiful details and colors, his paintings became wonderful and attracted many people. Now you know, embellishment means making something more beautiful. **一个贫穷的画家总是为他平淡的作品感到难过。有一天，他发现了装饰美化的魔力。通过添加一些美丽的细节和色彩，他的画变得精彩并吸引了很多人。现在你知道了，embellishment 意思是装饰，美化。**

> A forest fire was put out. But there were still some embers glowing under the ashes. A little bird was very careful and used water to cool them down. The embers were the last remains of the fire. **一场森林大火被扑灭了。但灰烬下仍有一些余烬在发光。一只小鸟非常小心，用水把它们浇凉。余烬就是火的最后残余。**

> In a magical forest, a brave knight emblazoned his shield with a unique symbol to show his identity. It made him stand out and be easily recognized. The act of emblazoning made his shield shine bright. **在一个神奇的森林里，一位勇敢的骑士在他的盾牌上绘制了一个独特的符号来表明他的身份。这让他脱颖而出，很容易被认出。绘制这个动作就是\'emblazon\'。**
> 在一个古老的王国，国王的盾牌上有一个独特的图案，这个图案象征着王国的荣耀和力量，人们称其为 emblem。每当战士们看到这个 emblem，就充满勇气去战斗。 **在一个古老的王国，国王盾牌上象征着王国荣耀和力量的独特图案被人们称为"徽章；象征"。每当战士们看到这个"徽章；象征"，就充满勇气去战斗。**

> A king had a special emblem on his robe. This emblem was so unique that whenever people saw it, they knew it was the king. So, the emblem became emblematic of the king\'s power and authority. **一位国王的长袍上有一个特殊的徽章。这个徽章非常独特，每当人们看到它，就知道是国王。所以，这个徽章成为了国王权力和权威的象征。**

> A magical spirit was looking for a way to exist in the real world. Finally, it found a human body and entered it. This human became the embodiment of the spirit, showing all its powers and traits. **一个神奇的精灵正在寻找在现实世界存在的方式。最终，它找到了一个人类身体并进入其中。这个人就成了精灵的化身，展现出精灵所有的力量和特质。**

> A group of artists decided to create a sculpture. They worked hard to embody the spirit of freedom in it. Every detail was carefully designed to show the essence. Finally, the sculpture perfectly embodied their idea. **一群艺术家决定创作一个雕塑。他们努力将自由的精神体现在其中。每一个细节都经过精心设计以展现其本质。最终，这个雕塑完美地体现了他们的想法。**

> A timid mouse was always scared in the dark corner. One day, it found a magical gem that emboldened it. With newfound courage, it explored the unknown world fearlessly. **一只胆小的老鼠总是在黑暗的角落里害怕。有一天，它发现了一颗神奇的宝石，这使它变得大胆起来。带着新获得的勇气，它无畏地探索未知的世界。**

> A lost traveler was cold and scared. But when he was found by a kind village, they gave him a warm embrace. It made him feel safe and loved. Remember, embrace means to hold someone tightly in your arms with love. **一个迷路的旅行者又冷又害怕。但当他被一个善良的村庄发现时，他们给了他一个温暖的拥抱。这让他感到安全和被爱。记住，embrace 意思是怀着爱意紧紧地抱住某人。**

> Once upon a time, a girl was very passionate. She spent hours embroidering beautiful patterns on a cloth. Her skill made the plain cloth turn into a wonderful work of art. Remember, \'embroider\' means to decorate with needle and thread. **从前，有个女孩充满热情。她花了好几个小时在一块布上刺绣精美的图案。她的技艺让这块普通的布变成了一件美妙的艺术品。记住，\'embroider\'意思是用针线装饰。**

> A princess was fond of embroidery. She spent hours creating beautiful patterns on cloth. One day, her exquisite embroidery won praise from everyone at the palace. Remember, \'embroidery\' is the art of decorating fabric with needle and thread. **一位公主喜欢刺绣。她花了好几个小时在布上绣出美丽的图案。有一天，她精美的刺绣赢得了宫殿里所有人的称赞。记住，\'embroidery\'就是用针和线装饰织物的艺术。**

> A king\'s two advisers were constantly arguing. One day, their disputes embroiled the entire court. The king was very angry. Now you know \'embroil\' means to involve someone or something in a confusing or troubled situation. **一位国王的两个顾问一直在争论。有一天，他们的争执把整个宫廷都卷入了。国王非常生气。现在你知道\'embroil\'意思是使某人或某事卷入混乱或麻烦的情况。**

> Imagine a tiny seed. It\'s hidden in the soil, just beginning to grow. That\'s like an embryo. It has the potential to become a beautiful flower or a strong tree. The embryo is the start of life\'s journey. **想象一颗小小的种子。它藏在土壤里，刚刚开始生长。这就像一个胚胎。它有潜力成为一朵美丽的花或一棵强壮的树。胚胎是生命旅程的开始。**

> Imagine a tiny embryo growing inside an egg. It\'s in the embryonic stage, just beginning to develop. It\'s like a secret world hidden within, full of potential and waiting to unfold. This is the idea of \'embryonic\'. **想象一个小小的胚胎在蛋里面生长。它处于胚胎阶段，刚刚开始发育。就像一个隐藏在内的神秘世界，充满潜力并等待展开。这就是"embryonic（胚胎的；萌芽期的）"的意思。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. In a hidden cave, he found a chest filled with jewels. Among them was a stunning emerald, shining bright green. It was so beautiful that he could never forget. **一位勇敢的骑士在探险。在一个隐藏的洞穴里，他发现了一个装满珠宝的箱子。其中有一颗令人惊叹的祖母绿，闪耀着明亮的绿色。它是如此美丽，以至于他永远忘不了。**
> 想象一只小蝴蝶在茧里努力挣扎。终于，它成功打破束缚，emerged 出来，展开美丽的翅膀飞向天空。小蝴蝶从茧中出现的过程，就像 emerge 这个词所表达的'出现；浮现'的意思。 **想象一只小蝴蝶在茧里努力挣扎。终于，它成功打破束缚，出现出来，展开美丽的翅膀飞向天空。小蝴蝶从茧中出现的过程，就像 emerge 这个词所表达的'出现；浮现'的意思。**

> Imagine a caterpillar trapped in a cocoon. One day, it struggles and finally breaks free. This moment of it coming out and showing up is the emergence. It\'s a new beginning, a birth of something wonderful. **想象一只毛毛虫被困在茧里。有一天，它努力挣扎，最终破茧而出。这个它出来和现身的时刻就是 emergence（出现；浮现）。这是一个新的开始，一个美妙事物的诞生。**

> One day, Tom was playing in the park. Suddenly, a man fell off his bike and was seriously injured. It was an emergency. Tom quickly called 120 for help. **有一天，汤姆正在公园玩耍。突然，一个男人从自行车上摔下来，伤得很重。这是一个紧急情况。汤姆迅速拨打了 120 求助。**

> A man was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, he saw an emergent light. It was a lantern carried by a kind rescuer. The light gave him hope and showed him the way out. \'Emergent\' means appearing suddenly and unexpectedly. **一个男人在黑暗的森林里迷路了。突然，他看到了一道出现的光。那是一个善良的救援者拿着的灯笼。这道光给了他希望，并为他指明了出路。\'emergent\'意思是突然意外地出现。**
> 一位资深教授退休后，被授予 emeritus 称号。大家都尊敬他，因为他虽退休，但其知识和经验仍熠熠生辉。就像这个单词，代表着荣誉退休但仍受敬重。 **一位退休后仍保留荣誉头衔的人，尤指退休的大学教授**
> 想象一个人，他渴望在新的土地上开启更好的生活，于是离开了家乡。这个人就是 emigrant ，就像勇敢的冒险者，为了梦想远走他乡。 **想象一个渴望在新土地开启更好生活而离开家乡的人，这就是'移民（移出本国）'的意思**

> A brave man decided to emigrate. He left his homeland, saying goodbye to familiar scenes. He packed his bags, full of dreams and hopes, to start a new life in a foreign land. **一位勇敢的人决定移民。他离开了自己的祖国，告别了熟悉的景象。他收拾好行李，怀揣着梦想和希望，去异国他乡开始新的生活。**

> A group of people were very unhappy in their hometown. They decided to leave and find a better place to live. This act of leaving their country to live elsewhere is called emigration. **有一群人在他们的家乡过得很不开心。他们决定离开，去寻找更好的生活之地。这种离开自己的国家去其他地方生活的行为就叫做移民出境。**

> A talented artist, feeling oppressed in his homeland, decided to become an emigre. He packed his bags, left with hope, and sought a new life abroad, where he could freely pursue his art. **一位有才华的艺术家，在祖国感到压抑，决定成为一名移居国外者。他收拾行囊，满怀希望地离开，到国外寻求新生活，在那里他可以自由地追求自己的艺术。**

> A famous scientist was invited to give a speech. Everyone knew he was eminent in his field. His research had made great contributions. He stood out among others, just like a bright star. **一位著名的科学家被邀请发表演讲。每个人都知道他在自己的领域很杰出。他的研究做出了巨大贡献。他在其他人中脱颖而出，就像一颗明亮的星星。**
> 想象一下，在古代两个王国之间，有一个神秘的人物总是在夜间穿梭。他肩负着重要的使命，传递着秘密信息，这个人就是 \'emissary\'（使者），是双方沟通的桥梁。 **想象在古代两个王国之间，有个总是在夜间穿梭的神秘人物，肩负重要使命传递秘密信息，这个人就是"使者"，是双方沟通的桥梁。**
> 想象一下，一辆老旧的汽车，屁股后面冒出一股黑烟。这股黑烟就是'emission'，它代表着汽车排放出来的物质。就像工厂排放废气一样，'emission'就是这种物质的排放行为。 **想象一辆汽车冒黑烟来辅助理解'emission'（排放；排放物）这个单词**
> 想象一只小蜜蜂在花丛中忙碌，它的尾部不断地 emit（发出）甜甜的蜂蜜，这些蜂蜜散发着诱人的香气。小蜜蜂发出蜂蜜的动作，就像 emit 这个单词所表达的'发出、射出'的意思。 **想象一只小蜜蜂不断发出蜂蜜来辅助记忆 emit 这个单词，意为'发出、射出'。**

> A little girl saw a rainbow after the rain. The colors made her feel various emotions. She was happy, excited, and a bit amazed. These feelings together are called \'emotion\'. **一个小女孩在雨后看到了彩虹。这些色彩让她产生了各种各样的感受。她感到开心、兴奋，还有点惊奇。这些感受加在一起就叫做'情感；情绪'。**

> A girl named Lily was always easily moved by touching movies. She cried and laughed a lot, showing her emotional side. One day, she saw a film about friendship and was deeply emotional. This shows how emotional she was. **一个叫莉莉的女孩总是很容易被感人的电影打动。她经常又哭又笑，展现出她情感丰富的一面。有一天，她看了一部关于友谊的电影，变得非常情绪化。这表明她是多么容易动情。**

> A girl was always emotionally unstable when facing exams. She cried and laughed easily. But with time and effort, she learned to control her emotions and became calm. Remember, \'emotionally\' means related to emotions. **一个女孩在面对考试时总是情绪不稳定。她很容易哭和笑。但随着时间和努力，她学会了控制自己的情绪，变得冷静。记住，\'emotionally\'意思是与情绪有关。**

> One day, when Tom saw his friend crying, he didn\'t just walk away. Instead, he put himself in his friend\'s shoes, felt the sadness deeply and tried to comfort. This shows that Tom is empathetic. **有一天，当汤姆看到他的朋友在哭，他没有走开。相反，他设身处地为朋友着想，深切地感受到悲伤并试图安慰。这表明汤姆是有同理心的。**

> One day, my friend was very sad. I tried to put myself in his shoes and understand his feelings. That\'s when I realized I was empathizing with him. I felt his pain and offered comfort. **有一天，我的朋友非常伤心。我试着设身处地去理解他的感受。就在那时，我意识到我在与他共情。我感受到了他的痛苦，并给予了安慰。**

> Once, there was a girl who could truly understand others\' feelings. When her friend was sad, she felt the same pain. This ability to feel what others feel is called empathy. It\'s like having a magic connection to people\'s hearts. **曾经，有一个女孩能够真正理解他人的感受。当她的朋友伤心时，她也能感受到同样的痛苦。这种能够感受他人感受的能力就叫做同理心。就像是与人的心灵有神奇的连接。**

> Once upon a time, there was a powerful man ruling a vast land. Everyone respected him and called him \'emperor\'. He wore splendid robes and made important decisions for his people. The word \'emperor\' represents this supreme ruler. **从前，有一个强大的人统治着一片广袤的土地。每个人都尊敬他，称他为"皇帝"。他穿着华丽的长袍，为他的人民做重要的决定。"emperor"这个单词代表着这位至高无上的统治者。**

> A king was giving a speech. To make his point clear, he kept repeating and stressing certain words. That stress and importance he gave was the emphasis. It made everyone understand his key ideas. **一位国王正在发表演讲。为了把观点讲清楚，他不断重复和强调某些词。他所给予的这种强调和重视就是'emphasis'。这让每个人都明白了他的关键想法。**

> A teacher always emphasizes the importance of studying hard. One day, a student didn\'t listen and failed the exam. Then the student realized the teacher\'s emphasizing was for their good. **一位老师总是强调努力学习的重要性。有一天，一个学生没听进去，考试不及格。然后这个学生意识到老师的强调是为了他们好。**

> A king was giving a speech. He was very emphatic, emphasizing every point loudly and clearly. \'We must protect our land!\' His strong voice made everyone pay attention. **一位国王正在发表演讲。他非常坚决有力，大声且清晰地强调每一点。"我们必须保护我们的土地！"他强有力的声音让每个人都集中了注意力。**
> A detective was solving a case. He pointed at the evidence emphatically and said, \'This is the key!\' Everyone understood his strong emphasis. **一位侦探正在破案。他着重地指着证据说道：'这就是关键！'每个人都明白了他强烈的强调。**

> A man named Tom always felt short of breath. The doctor diagnosed him with emphysema. Tom learned that it was a lung disease causing air to get trapped. He decided to take better care of his health. **一个叫汤姆的人总是感到呼吸急促。医生诊断他患有肺气肿。汤姆了解到这是一种导致空气滞留肺部的疾病。他决定更好地照顾自己的健康。**

> In a faraway land, a powerful king built a huge territory with many cities and people. This territory was called an empire. The king ruled over it with wisdom and strength. **在一个遥远的地方，一位强大的国王建立了一个有着许多城市和人民的巨大领地。这个领地被称为帝国。国王凭借智慧和力量统治着它。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments. Every result he got was based on actual observations and experiences. This was empirical evidence. It proved his theory was right. Empirical means relying on practical experience and observation. **一位科学家正在进行实验。他得到的每一个结果都基于实际的观察和经验。这就是经验性的证据。它证明了他的理论是正确的。Empirical 意思是依靠实际经验和观察。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments. He collected data empirically, meaning through direct observation and experience. Every result was based on real facts, not just theories. This helped him make accurate conclusions. **一位科学家正在进行实验。他通过经验主义地收集数据，这意味着通过直接观察和经验。每个结果都基于真实的事实，而不仅仅是理论。这帮助他得出了准确的结论。**

> A boss was in a hurry to find workers for his new factory. He needed to employ many people. Finally, he found suitable ones and his business ran smoothly. **一位老板着急为他的新工厂找工人。他需要雇用很多人。最终，他找到了合适的人选，他的生意顺利运转。**

> Imagine a big company. There\'s a person named Tom who works there every day, follows the boss\'s orders, and gets paid. Tom is an employee. He\'s not the boss but a valuable part of the team. **想象一家大公司。有一个叫汤姆的人，他每天在那里工作，听从老板的命令，并获得报酬。汤姆就是一名员工。他不是老板，而是团队中有价值的一部分。**

> Once upon a time, Tom was looking for a job. He met Mr. Smith, who had a big company and needed workers. Mr. Smith was the employer. He decided to hire Tom. So, an employer is the one who gives jobs to others. **从前，汤姆在找工作。他遇到了史密斯先生，史密斯先生有一家大公司并且需要工人。史密斯先生就是雇主。他决定雇用汤姆。所以，雇主就是给别人提供工作的人。**

> Once upon a time, Tom was seeking employment. After many efforts, he finally got a great job. It was a moment of joy as he started this new phase of employment. **从前，汤姆一直在找工作。经过许多努力，他终于得到了一份很棒的工作。当他开始这个新的工作阶段时，这是一个欢乐的时刻。**

> A young artist felt weak and lost. But a wise mentor came and gave him special skills and confidence, saying \'I empower you to create amazing art!\' With this new power, the artist became famous. Empower means to give someone the power or authority to do something. **一位年轻的艺术家感到虚弱和迷茫。但一位睿智的导师出现了，给了他特殊的技能和信心，说道：'我赋予你力量去创作惊人的艺术！'有了这种新力量，艺术家成名了。empower 意思是赋予某人权力或权威去做某事。**

> A traveler wandered in a vast desert, feeling a sense of emptiness. There was nothing but sand as far as the eye could see. The lack of water and company made him understand the true meaning of \'emptiness\'. **一位旅行者在广袤的沙漠中徘徊，感到一种空虚感。目之所及只有沙子。缺水和无人陪伴让他明白了\'emptiness（空虚）\'的真正含义。**

> One day, Tom entered an empty room. There was nothing inside, not even a chair. It felt so quiet and lonely. Tom realized \'empty\' means having nothing or no one inside. **一天，汤姆走进了一个空荡荡的房间。里面什么都没有，甚至连一把椅子都没有。房间里感觉非常安静和孤独。汤姆意识到\'empty\'意思是里面什么都没有或无人。**
> 小明一直很崇拜他的科学家叔叔，想要像叔叔一样成功。于是他努力学习，不断尝试新的实验，以 emulate 叔叔的成就。最终，小明在自己的领域取得了不错的成绩。 **小明一直想要效仿他的科学家叔叔并努力学习和尝试，最终取得成绩，以此来辅助记忆单词'emulate'，意为'效仿；努力赶上'**

> Once upon a time, there was a magic key. Whoever held it could enable all the locked doors to open. It gave the power to make things possible, just like the word \'enable\' means to give the ability or make something feasible. **从前，有一把神奇的钥匙。无论谁拿着它，都能使所有锁着的门打开。它赋予了让事情成为可能的力量，就像单词\'enable\'意味着给予能力或使某事可行。**

> A king wanted to enact a new law to protect his people. He gathered his advisers and discussed carefully. Finally, the law was enacted and everyone was happy. **一位国王想要制定一项新的法律来保护他的人民。他召集了顾问并仔细讨论。最终，这项法律被制定出来，每个人都很开心。**

> A king was very worried about the chaos in his kingdom. So, he decided to enact new laws for a better order. The process of making and implementing these laws was called enactment. **一位国王对他王国的混乱状况非常担忧。于是，他决定制定新的法律以建立更好的秩序。制定和实施这些法律的过程就被称为'制定、颁布'。**

> A painter was working on a beautiful art piece. He used special enamel paint to create shiny and smooth surfaces. The enamel made the painting look more vivid and attractive. **一位画家正在创作一幅美丽的艺术品。他使用了特殊的瓷漆来创造出有光泽且光滑的表面。这种瓷漆让这幅画看起来更加生动和吸引人。**

> A prince was traveling and met a beautiful maiden. Her charm and kindness immediately enamored him. He couldn\'t stop thinking about her and wanted to be with her forever. **一位王子在旅行中遇到了一位美丽的少女。她的魅力和善良立刻让他倾心。他不停地想着她，想要永远和她在一起。**

> A group of adventurers was lost in the forest. They decided to make an encampment near a river. They set up tents, built a fire, and felt safe. The encampment became their temporary home. **一群冒险家在森林里迷路了。他们决定在一条河边扎营。他们支起帐篷，生起篝火，感到很安全。这个营地成了他们的临时住所。**

> Imagine a scientist trying to protect a precious chemical formula. He puts it into a special capsule. This act of putting something precious into a capsule is like \'encapsulate\'. **想象一位科学家试图保护一个珍贵的化学配方。他把它放进一个特殊的胶囊里。这种把珍贵的东西放进胶囊的行为就像是'encapsulate（封装，概括）'。**

> A brave knight was on a dangerous mission. To protect his precious map, he encased it in a metal box. The box ensured the map was safe from any harm. So, encase means to enclose or cover something for protection. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项危险的任务。为了保护他珍贵的地图，他把它装进了一个金属盒子里。这个盒子确保了地图不受任何伤害。所以，encase 意思是把某物包住或盖住以进行保护。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical forest, a fairy had the power to enchant everything. She could make the flowers bloom brighter and the birds sing sweeter. The word \'enchant\' means to cast a magical spell or charm over something. **从前，在一个神奇的森林里，有一个仙女拥有迷人的魔力。她能让花朵开得更鲜艳，鸟儿歌声更甜美。'enchant'这个单词意思是对某物施魔法或使其着迷。**

> Once upon a time, I was walking in a forest. The beautiful scenery was enchanting. The colorful flowers and singing birds made me feel like I was in a fairy tale world. It was so charming and magical. **从前，我在森林里散步。美丽的景色令人陶醉。五颜六色的花朵和歌唱的鸟儿让我感觉仿佛置身于一个童话世界。它是如此迷人而神奇。**

> A young wizard discovered a hidden cave filled with mysterious crystals. When he touched them, a powerful force of enchantment surrounded him, making him feel like he could do anything magical. **一位年轻的巫师发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面充满了神秘的水晶。当他触摸它们时，一股强大的魔力围绕着他，让他觉得自己可以施展任何魔法。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. He needed to protect a magical gem. To keep it safe, he encircled it with a ring of fire, preventing any enemies from getting close. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项任务。他需要保护一颗魔法宝石。为了确保其安全，他用火圈将宝石环绕起来，阻止任何敌人靠近。**
> 想象一个被高山环绕的小村落，它与外界隔绝，自成一体。这个村落就像一个'enclave'，是在大环境中的一个独特且封闭的区域。村民们在里面过着与众不同的生活。 **想象一个被环绕、封闭的独特区域来辅助记忆'enclave'这个单词，意思是飞地；被包围的领土**

> Once upon a time, a king wanted to enclose his precious garden to keep it safe. So, he built a high wall around it. \'Enclose\' means to surround something to make it within a particular space. **从前，有个国王想要围住他珍贵的花园以保证其安全。于是，他在花园周围建了一堵高墙。'enclose'意思是围住某物使其处于特定空间内。**
> 想象一个神秘的城堡，四周被高墙 enclosed。勇敢的探险家试图找到入口，却发现每一处都被严密守护。最终，他在城堡的角落发现了一扇隐藏的小门。这里的'enclosed'就是被围住、封闭的意思。 **想象一个被高墙围住的城堡，来理解'enclosed'表示被围住、封闭的意思。**

> A little rabbit was playing happily outside the enclosure. But suddenly, a big storm came. It had to run back into the enclosure to stay safe. The enclosure protected the rabbit from the bad weather. **一只小兔子正在围栏外面开心地玩耍。但突然，一场大风暴来了。它不得不跑回围栏里以保证安全。围栏保护小兔子免受恶劣天气的影响。**

> A spy needed to encode the secret message. He used a special code to hide the true meaning. It was like turning ordinary words into a mysterious language that only his allies could understand. **一名间谍需要对秘密信息进行编码。他使用特殊的代码来隐藏真实含义。这就像把普通的文字变成只有他的盟友才能理解的神秘语言。**

> Imagine a brave knight on a quest. His journey encompasses mountains, rivers, and mysterious forests. No matter how hard, he covers all the places to achieve his goal. Just like \'encompass\' means to include or cover everything. **想象一位勇敢的骑士在探索。他的旅程涵盖了高山、河流和神秘的森林。无论多么艰难，他走遍所有地方以实现目标。就像'encompass'意思是包含或涵盖一切。**
> 在一场精彩的音乐会上，歌手表演完后观众们大喊\'encore\'，意思是'再唱一首'，歌手被热情打动，又回来唱了一首。所以\'encore\'就是要求再演或再唱的意思。 **在一场音乐会上，观众大喊\'encore\'要求歌手再唱一首，所以\'encore\'意为再演、再唱。**

> One day, while hiking in the forest, I encountered a wild bear. I was so scared but managed to stay calm and slowly back away. The unexpected encounter made me realize the importance of being prepared for surprises in life. **有一天，在森林里徒步时，我遇到了一只野熊。我非常害怕，但设法保持冷静，慢慢后退。这次意外的遭遇让我意识到为生活中的意外做好准备的重要性。**

> Once upon a time, a little bird was afraid to fly high. But its friend constantly gave it praise and support, which encouraged the little bird to take the leap. Finally, the bird soared freely in the sky. **从前，一只小鸟害怕飞得高。但它的朋友不断地给它称赞和支持，这鼓励了小鸟勇敢一跃。最终，小鸟在天空中自由翱翔。**

> One day, I was very nervous before a speech. My friend gave me a big smile and said some kind words. That was the encouragement I needed to go on stage bravely. **有一天，在演讲前我非常紧张。我的朋友给了我一个大大的微笑并说了一些鼓励的话。那就是我勇敢走上台所需要的鼓励。**

> A student was very nervous before the exam. The teacher gave an encouraging smile and said, \'You can do it!\' The student felt confident and did well. Encouraging means giving someone support and confidence. **一名学生在考试前非常紧张。老师给了一个鼓励的微笑并说：'你能行！'学生感到自信并且考得很好。encouraging 意思是给某人支持和信心。**

> A little mouse wanted to encroach on the cat\'s territory to find cheese. But as it stepped in, the cat woke up angrily. The mouse quickly ran away, knowing it shouldn\'t have invaded the cat\'s space. **一只小老鼠想要侵占猫的领地去找奶酪。但它一踏入，猫就生气地醒了。老鼠赶紧跑开，知道自己不应该侵犯猫的空间。**

> A little rabbit\'s garden was facing encroachment by a naughty bear. The bear kept stepping into the garden, taking away the rabbit\'s carrots. The rabbit had to be brave to stop this encroachment. **一只小兔子的花园正面临着一只顽皮熊的侵占。这只熊不断地踏入花园，拿走兔子的胡萝卜。兔子不得不勇敢地阻止这种侵占。**

> Once upon a time, a curious child wanted to know everything. So, a wise elder gave him an \'encyclopedia\' as a key to unlock the world\'s knowledge. With it, the child could explore all kinds of subjects and satisfy his curiosity. **从前，有一个好奇的孩子想知道一切。于是，一位睿智的长者给了他一本"百科全书"作为开启世界知识的钥匙。有了它，孩子可以探索各种学科并满足他的好奇心。**

> A brave knight was on a long journey. After facing many challenges, he finally reached the end of the road. There, he found a beautiful castle and knew his adventure was over. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了漫长的旅程。在面对诸多挑战后，他终于走到了路的尽头。在那里，他发现了一座美丽的城堡，知道自己的冒险结束了。**

> A brave explorer was in a deep forest. He accidentally stepped on a rare plant, not knowing it was endangered. When he learned the truth, he felt very sorry and decided to protect such precious species. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片幽深的森林里。他不小心踩到了一株稀有的植物，当时并不知道它处于濒危状态。当他了解真相后，感到非常抱歉，并决定保护这类珍贵的物种。**

> In a deep forest, there were rare animals. Hunters came and their lives were threatened. These animals became endangered. We must protect them to prevent their extinction. **在一片幽深的森林里，有一些珍稀动物。猎人来了，它们的生命受到威胁。这些动物变得濒危了。我们必须保护它们以防灭绝。**

> A poor little puppy was lost and alone. But when a kind girl found and cared for it, her kindness endeared her to the puppy. The puppy became very attached to her. So, \'endear\' means to make someone or something beloved. **一只可怜的小狗迷路了，孤孤单单。但当一个善良的女孩发现并照顾它时，她的善良使她深受小狗喜爱。小狗变得非常依恋她。所以，'endear'意思是使某人或某物受人喜爱。**

> A little puppy was always following its owner around, its innocent eyes and wagging tail were so endearing. The owner couldn\'t help but love it deeply. The puppy\'s charm made the owner feel warm and happy. **一只小狗总是跟着它的主人到处跑，它天真的眼睛和摇摆的尾巴十分惹人喜爱。主人情不自禁深深地喜欢上了它。小狗的魅力让主人感到温暖和快乐。**

> A brave astronaut endeavored to explore a mysterious planet. Despite many difficulties, he never gave up. His strong will and effort made his endeavor successful. **一位勇敢的宇航员努力去探索一颗神秘的行星。尽管困难重重，他从未放弃。他坚强的意志和努力使他的努力获得了成功。**

> In a small island, a strange disease was always present. It was not brought from outside but was endemic, meaning it was native and constantly existed within that specific area. People had to find ways to deal with this local problem. **在一个小岛上，有一种奇怪的疾病一直存在。它不是从外面带来的，而是地方性的，这意味着它是当地固有的，并且一直在那个特定区域持续存在。人们不得不设法解决这个本地问题。**

> A brave knight was on a long journey. After facing many challenges, he finally reached the destination. The moment he stopped was the ending of his adventure. But it was also a new beginning for something else. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了漫长的旅程。在面对诸多挑战后，他终于抵达了目的地。他停下的那一刻就是他冒险的结局。但这也是其他事情的新开端。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a cave. The tunnel seemed endless. He walked and walked, never finding the exit. But he didn\'t give up, believing there was an end eventually. **一位勇敢的冒险家在一个洞穴中迷路了。这个隧道似乎没有尽头。他不停地走啊走，始终找不到出口。但他没有放弃，相信最终会有尽头。**

> A little ant was on a long journey. It kept walking endlessly, never stopping. It faced many difficulties but still moved forward with determination. Finally, it reached a beautiful new place. **一只小蚂蚁正在长途旅行。它不停地走啊走，永不停歇。它面临许多困难，但仍然坚定地前进。最终，它到达了一个美丽的新地方。**

> A famous singer was asked to endorse a new brand of headphones. She tried them and loved the sound quality, so she publicly supported and recommended them. That\'s how we remember \'endorse\' means to give approval or support publicly. **一位著名歌手被要求为一个新品牌的耳机背书。她试了试，喜欢其音质，于是公开支持并推荐了它们。这就是我们记住'endorse'表示公开支持、认可的方式。**

> A famous singer gave an endorsement for a new music app. Her public support made many people trust and download the app. The singer\'s name and words became the endorsement that made the app popular. **一位著名歌手为一款新的音乐应用程序做了背书。她的公开支持使得很多人信任并下载了这个应用程序。这位歌手的名字和话语就成了使这个应用程序流行起来的背书。**
> 想象一下，有个小探险家进入了一个神秘洞穴。他拿着特殊的工具，这个工具能让他从洞穴的尽头(end)看清里面的情况，就像有双眼睛在观察(scopic)，这种工具就叫 endoscopic 内窥镜。 **想象小探险家拿着能从尽头看清洞穴的工具来辅助记忆 endoscopic 内窥镜这个单词**
> 一位富有的老人决定 endow 一大笔钱给学校。他希望这笔捐赠能帮助学生们获得更好的教育，开启他们美好的未来。就像赋予学校神奇的力量一样。 **一位富有的老人决定捐赠一大笔钱给学校。他希望这笔捐赠能帮助学生们获得更好的教育，开启他们美好的未来。就像赋予学校神奇的力量一样。**

> A brave explorer was in the jungle. Suddenly, he got into an entanglement of vines. Struggling hard, he finally broke free. The entanglement was like a trap but he overcame it. **一位勇敢的探险家在丛林中。突然，他陷入了藤蔓的纠缠之中。经过努力挣扎，他最终挣脱了。这种纠缠就像一个陷阱，但他克服了。**
> A little mouse wanted to enter a big house to find food. It found a small hole and bravely went in. Finally, it entered the house successfully. **一只小老鼠想要进入一个大房子找食物。它发现了一个小洞，勇敢地走了进去。最后，它成功地进入了房子。**

> A brave young man decided to start an enterprise. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. With hard work and smart decisions, his enterprise became very successful. Now you know, enterprise means a business or project! **一位勇敢的年轻人决定创办一家企业。他面临许多困难，但从未放弃。通过努力工作和明智的决策，他的企业变得非常成功。现在你知道了，enterprise 意思是企业、事业。**

> A young man named Tom was very enterprising. He saw an opportunity to start a new business in his town. Despite many difficulties, he was brave and worked hard. Finally, his business succeeded. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人非常有进取心。他看到在他的镇上开展新业务的机会。尽管面临许多困难，他勇敢且努力工作。最终，他的生意成功了。**
> A group of friends came to my house. I prepared delicious food and played funny games to entertain them. We had a great time together. **一群朋友来到我家。我准备了美味的食物，还玩了有趣的游戏来款待他们。我们一起度过了一段美好的时光。**

> Once upon a time, there was an entertainer who could sing, dance and tell jokes. Everyone loved him because he made them happy and forget their troubles. The entertainer\'s job was to bring joy and entertainment to people. **从前，有一个艺人，他能唱歌、跳舞和讲笑话。每个人都喜欢他，因为他让他们开心，忘记烦恼。这个艺人的工作就是给人们带来欢乐和娱乐。**

> One day, I went to a party. There were funny clowns, amazing magic shows and delicious food. It was an entertaining event that made everyone happy and forget their troubles. **有一天，我去参加了一个聚会。那里有滑稽的小丑、精彩的魔术表演和美味的食物。这是一场有趣的活动，让每个人都很开心，忘记了烦恼。**

> A group of friends decided to have a party for entertainment. They played games, sang songs, and shared funny stories. Everyone had a great time and the party was full of joy and laughter. **一群朋友决定举办一个聚会来娱乐。他们玩游戏、唱歌、分享有趣的故事。每个人都玩得很开心，聚会充满了欢乐和笑声。**

> One day, a passionate scientist was giving a presentation about a new discovery. His energy and excitement made everyone in the room enthuse. They were all filled with enthusiasm and eagerness to learn more. **一天，一位充满激情的科学家正在做一个关于新发现的报告。他的活力和兴奋让房间里的每个人都充满热情。他们都充满了热情和渴望去了解更多。**

> One day, Tom was invited to a party. He showed great enthusiasm, dancing and chatting happily. His positive energy made everyone enjoy the party. Enthusiasm means a strong excitement and eagerness. **有一天，汤姆被邀请参加一个聚会。他表现出极大的热情，欢快地跳舞和聊天。他的积极能量让每个人都享受了聚会。enthusiasm 意思是强烈的兴奋和渴望。**

> One day, I met a person at a sports event. He was jumping and cheering loudly for his favorite team. Later I learned he was an enthusiast. He had such passion and energy that it was impossible to forget him. **有一天，我在一个体育赛事上遇到一个人。他为自己喜欢的队伍又蹦又跳大声欢呼。后来我知道他是个热心爱好者。他有着如此的热情和活力，让人难以忘怀。**

> One day, Tom was invited to a party. He was enthusiastic about it. He prepared carefully, wore his best clothes, and arrived early. His enthusiasm made the party more enjoyable. **有一天，汤姆被邀请参加一个聚会。他对此充满热情。他认真准备，穿上了他最好的衣服，并早早到达。他的热情让聚会更加愉快。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved football enthusiastically. He practiced every day, rain or shine. His enthusiasm made him a great player. Enthusiastically means with great excitement and eagerness. **从前，有个小男孩非常热情地热爱足球。他每天都练习，风雨无阻。他的热情使他成为了一名出色的球员。enthusiastically 意思是以极大的兴奋和渴望。**

> A hungry mouse was enticed by the smell of cheese in a trap. It thought it would have a delicious meal but ended up getting caught. Remember, entice means to attract or tempt someone with something appealing. **一只饥饿的老鼠被陷阱里奶酪的气味所引诱。它以为会有一顿美味的大餐，结果却被抓住了。记住，entice 意思是用吸引人的东西吸引或诱惑某人。**

> A fairy appeared in a forest, waving a magic wand. With a twinkle, she showed an enticing box full of jewels. Everyone was attracted and wanted to get it. But the fairy said only the kind-hearted could have it. **一位仙女出现在森林里，挥动着魔法棒。闪耀之间，她展示出一个诱人的装满珠宝的盒子。每个人都被吸引了，想要得到它。但仙女说只有心地善良的人才能拥有它。**

> A king wanted to give a reward to the entire kingdom. He announced that everyone would get a special gift. The word \'entire\' here means all, without any part left out. **一位国王想要给整个王国赏赐。他宣布每个人都会得到一份特别的礼物。这里的'entire'这个单词意思是全部的，没有任何部分被遗漏。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a huge forest. He searched everywhere but couldn\'t find the exit. Finally, he realized he was entirely alone. There was no one to help him. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片巨大的森林中迷路了。他到处寻找但找不到出口。最后，他意识到自己完全是独自一人。没有人能帮助他。**

> Once upon a time, a king wanted to know the entirety of his kingdom. So he sent his men to explore every corner. Finally, he got a complete picture and understood his kingdom in its entirety. **从前，有个国王想了解他王国的整体情况。于是他派手下探索每个角落。最终，他得到了完整的画面，完全了解了他的王国。**

> A king was very generous and he wanted to entitle every hardworking citizen to a piece of land. So, he gave them the right to own it. Entitle means to give the right to. **一位国王非常慷慨，他想要赋予每个勤劳的公民一块土地。所以，他给予他们拥有的权利。entitle 意思是给予权利。**

> Imagine a magical world where there\'s a hidden cave. In this cave, there\'s a unique box. This box is an entity that holds all the secrets of the world. No one can touch or move it, as it exists independently. **想象一个神奇的世界，那里有一个隐藏的洞穴。在这个洞穴里，有一个独特的盒子。这个盒子就是一个实体，它承载着世界所有的秘密。没有人能够触摸或移动它，因为它是独立存在的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a curious person named Tom. He loved studying insects so much that he became an entomologist. He spent days observing and researching them, uncovering their secrets. Tom\'s passion made him an expert in the world of insects. **从前，有个叫汤姆的好奇的人。他非常喜欢研究昆虫，以至于成为了一名昆虫学家。他花了很多天观察和研究它们，揭开它们的秘密。汤姆的热情使他成为昆虫世界的专家。**

> A famous singer was always surrounded by her entourage of managers, assistants, and bodyguards. They helped her deal with various matters and protected her. Remember, \'entourage\' means a group of people accompanying an important person. **一位著名歌手总是被她的随从人员，包括经理、助理和保镖所围绕。他们帮助她处理各种事务并保护她。记住，\'entourage\'意思是（要人或著名人物的）随从，随行人员。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a mysterious forest. After days of searching, he finally found an entrance to a hidden cave. It was the key to his escape and new adventures. **一位勇敢的探险家在神秘森林中迷路了。经过数日的寻找，他终于找到了一个通往隐藏洞穴的入口。这是他逃生和开启新冒险的关键。**
> 想象一个盛大的比赛，门口有很多人等待入场。其中一个充满激情和决心的年轻人就是 entrant 。他紧张又兴奋，期待在比赛中展现自己。这个年轻人就是参赛者、新加入者。 **想象一个关于'entrant（参赛者、新加入者）'的比赛入场场景的故事来辅助记忆**

> Once upon a time, a hungry traveler arrived at a restaurant. The waiter recommended the \'entree\' dish, which was a delicious main course. The traveler enjoyed it very much and remembered the word \'entree\' for its special meaning. **从前，有一个饥饿的旅行者来到一家餐馆。服务员推荐了'entree'这道菜，这是一道美味的主菜。旅行者非常喜欢，也记住了'entree'这个有特殊含义的单词。**

> A soldier was trying to entrench himself in the battlefield. He dug a deep hole to protect himself from the enemy\'s attack. The act of digging and making a secure position is like \'entrench\'. **一名士兵在战场上努力为自己挖战壕。他挖了一个很深的洞来保护自己免受敌人的攻击。这种挖掘并建立稳固位置的行为就像是\'entrench\'（使处于牢固地位；牢固确立）。**

> A young person named Tom always had big dreams. He wasn\'t afraid of risks and loved creating new things. One day, he decided to start his own business. Tom became an entrepreneur, making his ideas come true and creating jobs for others. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是有远大的梦想。他不怕风险，喜欢创造新事物。有一天，他决定自己创业。汤姆成为了一名企业家，实现了自己的想法，并为他人创造了工作机会。**

> A king was going on a long journey. He entrusted his precious treasure to a trusted knight, believing that the knight would keep it safe. \'Entrust\' means to give something valuable or important to someone for them to take care of. **一位国王要去长途旅行。他把珍贵的财宝托付给了一位信任的骑士，相信骑士会保管好它。"entrust"意思是把有价值或重要的东西交给某人让其照顾。**

> A brave explorer was looking for a hidden treasure. The only way to find it was through a mysterious ENTRY. After much effort, he finally found the right ENTRY and discovered the precious treasure inside. **一位勇敢的探险家正在寻找一处隐藏的宝藏。找到它的唯一途径是通过一个神秘的入口。经过大量努力，他终于找到了正确的入口，并在里面发现了珍贵的宝藏。**

> A young artist was lost. But when she saw a beautiful entryway with a warm light, she knew she had found the right place for inspiration. The entryway led her to a world of creativity. **一位年轻的艺术家迷路了。但当她看到一个有着温暖灯光的漂亮入口通道时，她知道自己找到了获取灵感的正确地方。这个入口通道引领她进入了一个充满创造力的世界。**

> A prince and a princess were in a beautiful garden. Vines entwined the pillars. The prince entwined his fingers with the princess\'s, promising eternal love. It was a scene of love and unity, just like the meaning of \'entwine\'. **一位王子和一位公主在一个美丽的花园里。藤蔓缠绕着柱子。王子与公主十指相扣，许下永恒的爱。这是一个爱与团结的场景，就像"entwine"的意思。**
> 想象你是一位探险家，在神秘的岛屿上发现了很多珍贵的物品。为了清楚记录，你把它们一一列举出来，这个过程就是\'enumerate\'，就像在仔细点数宝贝。 **想象一位探险家在岛屿上列举物品的过程来记忆'enumerate'（列举；枚举）这个单词**

> A little bird was singing in the forest. It enunciated each note clearly and beautifully. People passing by could understand its song easily. Just like speaking clearly, this is what \'enunciate\' means. **一只小鸟在森林里唱歌。它清晰而美妙地发出每个音符。路过的人都能轻易听懂它的歌声。就像清晰地说话一样，这就是'enunciate'的意思。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. Suddenly, a dark magic fog enveloped him. But he didn\'t panic and used his sword to cut through it. The fog here is like the meaning of \'envelop\' - to cover or surround completely. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。突然，一团黑暗的魔法雾气将他笼罩。但他没有惊慌，用剑劈开了雾气。这里的雾气就像'envelop'的意思------完全覆盖或包围。**

> One day, Eve was very nervous. She had a secret letter to send and needed an ENVELOPE to protect it. She carefully put the letter in the envelope and sealed it, making sure the secret was safe inside. **有一天，伊芙非常紧张。她有一封秘密信件要寄，需要一个信封来保护它。她小心地把信放进信封并封好，确保秘密安全地在里面。**

> A poor boy always dreamt of having an enviable life like a rich man. One day, he saw a rich man\'s big house and nice car, and understood what an enviable life meant. **一个贫穷的男孩总是梦想着拥有像富人那样令人羡慕的生活。有一天，他看到富人的大房子和漂亮的汽车，明白了令人羡慕的生活是什么样子。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor girl who was always envious of her rich neighbor\'s beautiful clothes and toys. But when she realized that happiness doesn\'t come from possessions, she stopped being envious. **从前，有个穷女孩总是羡慕她富有的邻居漂亮的衣服和玩具。但当她意识到幸福并非来自于拥有的物品时，她不再嫉妒了。**

> A little fairy was sent to protect the environment. She made the polluted river clean, grew green trees everywhere, and made the air fresh. With her efforts, the environment became beautiful and peaceful. **一个小仙女被派去保护环境。她让被污染的河流变干净，到处种上绿树，让空气变得清新。在她的努力下，环境变得美丽又宁静。**

> Imagine a beautiful forest. The clear rivers, the green trees, and the fresh air. All these make up the environmental scene. We must protect it to keep our world beautiful and healthy. Environmental means related to the surroundings. **想象一个美丽的森林。清澈的河流、绿色的树木和清新的空气。所有这些构成了环境景象。我们必须保护它，以保持我们的世界美丽和健康。Environmental 意思是与环境有关的。**

> A group of friends decided to protect the beautiful forest near their town. They picked up trash, planted trees, and advocated for saving resources. This action was all part of environmentalism, which means caring for the environment and working to protect it. **一群朋友决定保护他们城镇附近美丽的森林。他们捡垃圾、种树，并倡导节约资源。这种行动都是环境保护主义的一部分，环境保护主义指的是关心环境并努力保护它。**

> A brave explorer was lost in the wild. He wandered around, trying to find his way. Finally, he realized he was in the environs of a mysterious cave. But he didn\'t know if it was safe to enter. **一位勇敢的探险家在野外迷路了。他四处徘徊，试图找到出路。最后，他意识到自己身处一个神秘洞穴的周边。但他不知道是否安全进入。**

> Imagine a traveler who envisages a beautiful destination before setting off. He pictures the clear blue sky, sandy beaches, and warm sunshine. Envisage means to form a mental image or conception of something. **想象一位旅行者在出发前设想一个美丽的目的地。他描绘出湛蓝的天空、沙滩和温暖的阳光。envisage 意思是想象；设想；展望**

> Imagine a young artist. He closes his eyes and can clearly envision a beautiful landscape in his mind. He sees the mountains, the rivers, and the colorful flowers. That\'s the power of envision - to picture clearly in your mind. **想象一位年轻的艺术家。他闭上眼睛，能清晰地在脑海中构想一幅美丽的风景。他看到了山峦、河流和五颜六色的花朵。这就是envision的力量------在你的脑海中清晰地描绘。**
> 国王派遣了一位聪明勇敢的使者（envoy）去邻国商讨重要事务。使者克服重重困难，成功完成使命，为两国带来和平。记住这位肩负重任的使者，就能记住 envoy 这个单词啦。 **国王派遣去邻国的聪明勇敢的使者。记住这个使者的使命，就能记住 envoy 这个单词，意思是使者、使节。**

> There was a poor boy who always envied the rich kids. One day, he saw them having a big party and felt very sad. But then he realized envy wouldn\'t change his situation. So he worked hard and finally had a better life. **有一个贫穷的男孩总是羡慕富有的孩子。有一天，他看到他们举办盛大的派对，感到非常难过。但随后他意识到羡慕改变不了他的状况。于是他努力工作，最终过上了更好的生活。**

> Imagine a tiny factory inside your body. Workers in this factory are called enzymes. They work very hard to speed up chemical reactions and keep everything running smoothly. Just like special helpers, enzymes make important processes happen! **想象你身体里有一个小工厂。这个工厂里的工人被称为酶。他们非常努力地工作以加快化学反应，让一切顺利进行。就像特殊的帮手一样，酶促使重要的过程发生！**
> 想象一下，一个古老的巫师守护着一个神秘的时间宝盒，里面记录着无数的岁月。每过一个漫长的'eon'（纪元），宝盒就会闪耀一次光芒。这个纪元无比漫长，仿佛没有尽头。 **想象一个巫师守护时间宝盒来辅助记忆单词'eon'（纪元），表示极漫长的时期**

> A beautiful butterfly lived for only a short time. Its life was ephemeral, like a shooting star in the night sky. It showed us that some things are wonderful but don\'t last long. **一只美丽的蝴蝶只存活了很短的时间。它的生命是短暂的，就像夜空中的流星。这向我们展示了有些事物很美好但却不长久。**

> A brave knight embarked on an epic journey. He crossed mountains and rivers, facing many dangers. His adventure was like a grand story, full of excitement and challenges. This is what \'epic\' means - a long and heroic story or event. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了一段史诗般的旅程。他翻山越岭，面对诸多危险。他的冒险就像一个宏大的故事，充满了刺激和挑战。这就是\'epic\'的含义------一部长篇的、英勇的故事或事件。**
> 想象一场大地震，人们都在寻找震动最强烈的地方，那就是震中（epicenter）。救援人员朝着这个中心区域跑去，因为那里的破坏最严重，需要紧急救助。 **想象一场地震，人们寻找震动最强烈的震中，救援人员朝那里跑去，因为破坏最严重，需要救助。**
> 想象一个小镇，突然很多人生病了，疾病快速传播，就像一场风暴。这种疾病快速且大范围传播的情况就是\'epidemic\'。人们都很害怕，努力想办法阻止它。 **想象一个小镇爆发疾病快速传播的情况来辅助记忆\'epidemic\'这个表示（疾病等的）流行，泛滥的单词。**

> Imagine a brave hero named epi. He studies diseases and how they spread. One day, he decides to become an expert and adds \'demio\' and \'logist\' to his name, thus becoming an epidemiologist to save the world from disease outbreaks. **想象有个勇敢的英雄叫 epi。他研究疾病以及它们如何传播。有一天，他决定成为专家，在名字里加上\'demio\'和\'logist\'，于是成为了一名流行病学家来拯救世界免受疾病爆发的危害。**

> In a small town, a strange disease spread rapidly. Scientists used epidemiology to study how it spread, looking at patterns of infection. They found the source and stopped the outbreak. Epidemiology helps us understand and control diseases. **在一个小镇上，一种奇怪的疾病迅速传播。科学家们运用流行病学研究它的传播方式，查看感染模式。他们找到了源头并阻止了疫情爆发。流行病学帮助我们了解和控制疾病。**

> One day, a person suddenly had strange convulsions and lost consciousness. The doctor diagnosed it as epilepsy. It\'s a disorder that causes such unexpected and uncontrollable symptoms. Remember, epilepsy can be managed with proper treatment. **有一天，一个人突然出现奇怪的抽搐并失去意识。医生诊断为癫痫。这是一种会导致这种意外和无法控制症状的疾病。记住，癫痫通过适当治疗是可以控制的。**

> One day, Tom was lost in thought. Suddenly, while looking at a beautiful sunset, he had an epiphany - a sudden realization of how to solve a difficult problem at work. It was like a light bulb went on in his mind. **有一天，汤姆陷入沉思。突然，在欣赏美丽的日落时，他有了顿悟------突然意识到如何解决工作中的一个难题。就像他的脑海中亮起了一盏灯泡。**

> Imagine a TV series. Each time a main character has a thrilling adventure, like getting lost in a mysterious forest, that\'s an episode. It\'s a distinct part of the whole story. **想象一部电视剧。每次主角有一次惊险的冒险，比如在神秘森林中迷路，这就是一集。它是整个故事的一个独特部分。**

> Imagine a TV show where the adventures of the hero come in separate, disconnected chunks. That\'s episodic. Each episode has its own story, not always tied closely to the ones before. > Once upon a time, there was a person who loved to express thoughts through writing. This person was known as an essayist. They spent days crafting beautiful essays, sharing wisdom and experiences. Eventually, their works became famous. **从前，有一个人喜欢通过写作来表达想法。这个人被称为散文家。他们花了很多天精心创作优美的散文，分享智慧和经历。最终，他们的作品出名了。**

> A fairy had a magic bottle. The liquid inside was the essence of life. Whoever drank it would become young and healthy. But the fairy protected it carefully, as it was too precious. **一位仙女有一个魔法瓶子。里面的液体是生命的精华。无论谁喝了它都会变得年轻健康。但仙女小心地保护着它，因为它太珍贵了。**
> 想象你在沙漠中迷路，没有水和食物。这时，找到水源就变得 ESSENTIAL 了，因为它是生存必不可少的。没有水，就无法活下去。所以 essential 就是指极其重要、必不可少的东西。 **想象你在沙漠中迷路，没有水和食物。这时，找到水源就变得极其重要、必不可少了，因为它是生存所必需的。没有水，就无法活下去。所以 essential 就是指极其重要、必不可少的东西。**

> Once upon a time, a wise old man was asked about the secret of life. He said, \'Essentially, it\'s about kindness and love.\' This means fundamentally or basically, life is about these qualities. **从前，有位智慧的老人被问及生命的秘诀。他说："从根本上说，在于善良和爱。" 这里的 essentially 意思是根本上、本质上，生命就是由这些品质构成的。**

> A group of brave pioneers wanted to create a new settlement. They worked hard to establish houses, roads, and a farm. Finally, they built a wonderful community. They truly established a new home. **一群勇敢的开拓者想要创建一个新的定居点。他们努力建造房屋、道路和农场。最终，他们建立了一个很棒的社区。他们真的成功建立了一个新家。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to establish a unique coffee shop. After many efforts and overcoming difficulties, his dream was established. The shop became popular and he felt proud. **一位年轻的企业家想要建立一家独特的咖啡店。经过许多努力和克服困难，他的梦想得以确立。这家店变得受欢迎，他感到很自豪。**

> A young entrepreneur had a dream to create an establishment. He worked hard, overcame many difficulties, and finally built a successful company. The establishment became a symbol of his perseverance and innovation. **一位年轻的企业家有一个创建机构的梦想。他努力工作，克服了许多困难，最终建立了一家成功的公司。这个机构成为了他坚持不懈和创新的象征。**

> A poor man dreamed of having an estate. One day, he found a magical key that led him to a huge estate with a beautiful garden and a big house. He became the owner and lived happily ever after. **一个穷人梦想拥有一处房产。有一天，他发现了一把神奇的钥匙，这把钥匙带他找到了一个有着美丽花园和大房子的巨大房产。他成为了主人，从此过上了幸福的生活。**

> Imagine a young artist who constantly doubts his skills. But one day, a famous critic praises his work highly, giving him esteem. The artist realizes his worth and starts believing in himself. From then on, he holds his art in high esteem. **想象一位年轻艺术家一直怀疑自己的技能。但有一天，一位著名评论家高度赞扬他的作品，给予他尊重。这位艺术家意识到自己的价值，开始相信自己。从那时起，他非常尊重自己的艺术。**

> One day, a builder needed to estimate the cost of a new house. He looked at the materials and the size of the land. With careful thinking and calculation, he gave an estimate that was close to the final price. **有一天，一位建筑商需要估算一座新房子的成本。他查看了材料和土地的大小。经过仔细思考和计算，他给出了一个接近最终价格的估算。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment. People were waiting for the result with anticipation. Finally, the scientist gave an estimation based on the data. It was an important step towards the truth. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验。人们满怀期待地等待结果。最后，科学家根据数据给出了一个估计。这是迈向真相的重要一步。**

> A man was once very close with his family. But after a big fight, he became estranged from them. He felt lonely and sad, realizing how far apart they had grown. **一个男人曾经和他的家人非常亲密。但在一次大争吵后，他和他们变得疏远了。他感到孤独和悲伤，意识到他们之间的距离变得有多远。**

> A man was once close with his friends. But due to misunderstandings and lack of communication, they grew apart. This distance and unfamiliarity was the estrangement that changed their relationship. **一个男人曾经和他的朋友们关系亲密。但由于误解和缺乏交流，他们逐渐疏远。这种距离和陌生感就是使他们关系改变的隔阂。**

> A fairy named Estrogen had the magic power to control the growth and changes in girls. With her touch, girls developed beautiful curves and soft skin. Her presence was like the secret essence of femininity. **一位名叫雌激素的仙女拥有控制女孩成长和变化的魔力。在她的触碰下，女孩们拥有了美丽的曲线和柔软的皮肤。她的存在就像女性气质的神秘精华。**

> A little fish was lost in a big place. It swam and swam until it reached the estuary. There, the water was a mix of fresh and salt. It was a special place where rivers met the sea. The little fish finally found its way home. **一条小鱼在一个大地方迷路了。它游啊游，直到到达河口。在那里，水是淡水和盐水的混合。这是河流与大海交汇的特殊地方。小鱼终于找到了回家的路。**
> 在一次奇妙的冒险中，小伙伴们准备了很多东西，有苹果、香蕉、橙子 etc 。这里的 etc 就像一个神秘的魔法词，代表着还有其他未列举完的各种物品。 **在一次奇妙的冒险中，小伙伴们准备了很多东西，有苹果、香蕉、橙子等等。这里的等等就像一个神秘的魔法词，代表着还有其他未列举完的各种物品。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist wanted to etch his masterpiece on a metal plate. He carefully used a sharp tool to create beautiful lines and patterns. Finally, his etch work was highly praised. **从前，有一位年轻的艺术家想在金属板上蚀刻他的杰作。他小心翼翼地用锋利的工具刻画出美丽的线条和图案。最终，他的蚀刻作品受到了高度赞扬。**
> 有一天，画家 Tom 在一块金属板上精心创作，他用特殊的工具进行刻画，这一过程就像\'etching\'。他的作品最终展现出细腻的线条和独特的图案，让人惊叹不已。 **有一天，画家汤姆在一块金属板上精心创作刻画，这一过程就像'蚀刻'。他的作品最终展现出细腻的线条和独特的图案，让人惊叹不已。**

> A young couple promised eternal love. They faced many difficulties but always held hands. Their love lasted forever, like the eternal stars in the sky. Remember, eternal means lasting forever. **一对年轻的情侣承诺永恒的爱。他们面对许多困难但始终手牵手。他们的爱永远持续，就像天空中永恒的星星。记住，eternal 意思是永远持续。**

> A young couple vowed to love each other eternally. They faced many challenges but their hearts remained true. Just like their love, the word \'eternally\' means lasting forever, without end. **一对年轻的夫妇发誓要永远相爱。他们面临许多挑战，但他们的心始终不变。就像他们的爱一样，单词\'eternally\'的意思是永远，没有尽头。**

> A brave knight sought the key to eternity. After many trials, he found a magical cave. Inside, a wise old wizard told him that true eternity lies in the love and kindness we share. The knight understood and spread love ever after. **一位勇敢的骑士寻找永恒的钥匙。经过多次考验，他发现了一个神奇的洞穴。在里面，一位睿智的老巫师告诉他，真正的永恒在于我们分享的爱和善良。骑士明白了，并从此传播爱。**

> A scientist was working in the lab and needed a special liquid. He found ethanol, which was like a magic potion that could power machines and make reactions happen. With ethanol, his experiments went smoothly. **一位科学家在实验室工作，需要一种特殊的液体。他找到了乙醇，它就像一种神奇的药水，可以为机器提供动力并促成反应。有了乙醇，他的实验进展顺利。**

> A brave astronaut was lost in space. He floated in the ether, feeling alone and scared. But he didn\'t give up and finally found his way back. The ether was like a mysterious and vast ocean. **一位勇敢的宇航员在太空迷失了。他漂浮在以太中，感到孤独和害怕。但他没有放弃，最终找到了回去的路。以太就像一片神秘而广阔的海洋。**

> A fairy was floating in the sky, her presence was so light and delicate, like an ethereal being. Her beauty was beyond the ordinary, as if she belonged to a different, dreamlike world. It made me understand the meaning of \'ethereal\' - extremely delicate and light, almost spiritual. **一位仙女在空中飘浮，她的存在是如此轻盈和微妙，就像一个空灵的存在。她的美超凡脱俗，仿佛她属于一个不同的、梦幻般的世界。这让我理解了\'ethereal\'这个词------极其精致轻盈，近乎空灵。**

> A young journalist was confused about whether to expose a big company\'s secrets. Remembering the ethic of honesty and justice, he finally made the right choice. Ethic means moral principles that govern a person\'s behavior or the conduct of an activity. **一位年轻的记者对是否揭露一家大公司的秘密感到困惑。想起诚实和正义的道德原则，他最终做出了正确的选择。Ethic 意思是支配个人行为或一项活动的道德原则。**

> A doctor was faced with a difficult choice. To prescribe a cheaper but less effective drug for profit or an expensive but ethical one for the patient\'s well-being. He chose the ethical option, showing his integrity. **一位医生面临着艰难的抉择。是为了盈利开一种便宜但效果较差的药，还是开一种昂贵但合乎道德的药以保障患者的健康。他选择了合乎道德的选项，展现了他的正直。**

> A young entrepreneur was confused about his business decisions. Then a wise mentor guided him to act ethically, always considering fairness and morality. By doing so, his business thrived. Remember, to act ethically is to do the right thing. **一位年轻的企业家对他的商业决策感到困惑。然后一位睿智的导师指导他要合乎道德地行事，始终考虑公平和道德。正因如此，他的生意蓬勃发展。记住，合乎道德地行事就是做正确的事。**

> A scientist was facing a dilemma. Should he publish his research that might have negative impacts? Remembering ethics, he chose to be honest and consider the greater good. Ethics guided him to do the right thing. **一位科学家面临困境。他应该发表可能有负面影响的研究成果吗？想起道德规范，他选择诚实并考虑更大的利益。道德指引他做正确的事。**

> A group of friends from different ethnic backgrounds went on a trip. They shared their unique cultures and had a wonderful time. \'Ethnic\' means relating to a particular racial, national, or cultural group. **一群来自不同民族背景的朋友去旅行。他们分享各自独特的文化，度过了美好时光。\'ethnic\'意思是与特定的种族、民族或文化群体有关。**

> In a diverse country, people are treated ethnically. Different ethnic groups respect each other\'s customs. We should understand and embrace these differences ethnically to build a harmonious society. **在一个多元化的国家，人们在种族方面受到对待。不同的族群相互尊重各自的习俗。我们应该从种族方面去理解和接纳这些差异，以构建一个和谐的社会。**

> A group of friends were discussing their different backgrounds. One said, \'Our ethnicity makes us unique, like the colors of a rainbow.\' It helped them understand that ethnicity refers to the characteristics that make a group of people distinct. **一群朋友在讨论他们不同的背景。其中一个说："我们的种族特点让我们独一无二，就像彩虹的颜色。"这帮助他们理解了 ethnicity 指的是使一群人与众不同的特征。**
> 想象一下，有个勇敢的探险家叫艾利克斯，他热爱研究不同民族的文化，总是拿着笔记本记录，他就是一位 ethnographer（民族志学者），专门深入了解和描述各种民族的特点和生活方式。 **想象有个叫艾利克斯的探险家是民族志学者，专门研究记录不同民族文化，以此辅助记忆 ethnographer 这个单词**

> A young anthropologist was passionate about ethnography. He traveled to remote tribes, observing their customs and documenting them. Through this journey, he truly understood the essence of ethnography - the study of different cultures. **一位年轻的人类学家对民族志学充满热情。他前往偏远部落，观察他们的习俗并记录下来。通过这次旅程，他真正理解了民族志学------对不同文化的研究的本质。**
> 想象一个古老的部落，他们有着独特的精神和价值观，这种共同的精神气质就是他们的 ethos。它指引着部落成员的行为和决策，比如尊重长辈、勇敢面对困难。这就是 ethos 的含义------精神特质、气质。 **想象一个古老部落的独特精神和价值观，它指引成员行为决策，这就是"ethos"（精神特质、气质）的含义**

> A detective was trying to solve a mysterious disease case. He focused on the etiology, the cause of the illness. Finally, he found the root cause and saved many lives. Remember, etiology means the cause or origin of a disease or problem. **一位侦探试图解决一个神秘的疾病案件。他专注于病因学，即疾病的成因。最终，他找到了根本原因并拯救了许多生命。记住，etiology 意思是疾病或问题的原因或起源。**

> A young man named Tom was always getting into trouble for bad behavior. One day, a wise old man taught him about etiquette. Tom learned to say \'please\' and \'thank you\', hold doors for others, and follow social rules. From then on, he was known for his good etiquette. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是因为不良行为惹上麻烦。有一天，一位睿智的老人教他礼仪。汤姆学会了说'请'和'谢谢'，为他人扶门，并遵循社会规则。从那以后，他因良好的礼仪而闻名。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a special ceremony. The priest used the word \'eucharistic\' to describe the sacred bread and wine. Everyone felt a deep connection. Remember this scene and you\'ll remember \'eucharistic\' means related to the Christian sacrament of Holy Communion. **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有一个特别的仪式。牧师用'eucharistic'这个词来形容神圣的面包和酒。每个人都感受到了深深的联结。记住这个场景，你就会记住'eucharistic'意思是与基督教圣餐有关的。**

> A king passed away. Everyone was sad. A wise man stood up and gave a eulogy. He praised the king\'s kindness and wisdom. People listened carefully and remembered the good things about the king. **一位国王去世了。大家都很悲伤。一位智者站起来发表了颂词。他称赞国王的善良和智慧。人们认真聆听，记住了国王的美好。**

> One day, Tom was criticized at work. His boss used \'room for improvement\' instead of \'you did poorly\', which was a euphemism. It made Tom less frustrated. Remember, euphemism means a mild or pleasant way of saying something unpleasant. **一天，汤姆在工作中受到批评。他的老板用'有提升空间'而不是'你做得很差'，这就是一种委婉语。这让汤姆没那么沮丧。记住，euphemism 意思是委婉的说法。**

> A young artist struggled for years. One day, her painting was highly praised and sold at a high price. The sudden success filled her with euphoria, a feeling of extreme happiness and excitement. **一位年轻的艺术家多年来一直苦苦挣扎。有一天，她的画受到高度赞扬并以高价售出。这突如其来的成功让她充满了欣快，一种极度幸福和兴奋的感觉。**
> 一位科学家在实验室里日夜钻研，历经无数次失败。终于，在一次实验中获得重大突破，他兴奋地大喊\'Eureka\'。意思是'我发现了，我找到了'，表达成功时的惊喜。 **一位科学家在实验室成功后大喊'我发现了，我找到了'，以此辅助理解'eureka'表达发现、找到时的惊喜之意。**

> A traveler went to Europe and needed euros to buy souvenirs. He exchanged his money and got a stack of colorful euros. With these euros, he had a great shopping spree. **一位旅行者去欧洲，需要欧元来买纪念品。他兑换了货币，得到一叠五颜六色的欧元。凭借这些欧元，他尽情地购物。**

> A terminally ill patient was in extreme pain. The doctor, facing the dilemma, considered euthanasia. It means intentionally ending a person\'s life to relieve suffering. But the decision was not easy. **一位身患绝症的病人处于极度的痛苦之中。医生面对这个困境，考虑到了安乐死。它指的是有意结束一个人的生命以减轻其痛苦。但这个决定并不容易。**

> A fire broke out in the building. People were in panic. Luckily, the firefighters came and shouted \'Evacuate!\' loudly. Everyone followed the instructions and left the building safely. **一座大楼里发生了火灾。人们惊慌失措。幸运的是，消防员来了并大声喊"疏散！"。每个人都听从指示，安全离开了大楼。**

> In a dangerous situation, a fire broke out in the building. Everyone had to do the evacuation quickly. They followed the signs and moved orderly to a safe place. **在一个危险的情况下，大楼里发生了火灾。每个人都必须迅速进行疏散。他们依照指示，有序地转移到了一个安全的地方。**

> In a disaster-stricken area, people were forced to leave their homes. Among them was a little girl named Lily. Lily was an evacuee. She was scared but hopeful for a safe place. Remember, an evacuee is someone who is evacuated. **在一个受灾地区，人们被迫离开家园。其中有个叫莉莉的小女孩。莉莉就是一名被疏散人员。她很害怕，但仍期待能去到安全的地方。记住，evacuee 就是被疏散的人。**

> A thief was trying to evade the police. He ran through narrow alleys and hid behind big boxes, but the smart police finally caught him. \'Evade\' means to escape or avoid something, especially in a tricky way. **一个小偷试图逃避警察。他跑过狭窄的小巷，躲在大箱子后面，但聪明的警察最终还是抓住了他。\'evade\'意思是逃避或躲开某物，尤指以狡猾的方式。**

> A king wanted to evaluate the skills of his knights. So, he set up a series of challenges. The knights\' performance in these tests would determine their worth. \'Evaluate\' means to judge or assess the value or quality. **一位国王想要评估他骑士们的技能。于是，他设置了一系列挑战。骑士们在这些测试中的表现将决定他们的价值。'evaluate'意思是判断或评定价值或质量。**

> A student was very nervous about the evaluation of his project. But when he got positive feedback, he realized that evaluation is not scary but a helpful way to improve. **一名学生对他项目的评估感到非常紧张。但当他得到积极的反馈时，他意识到评估并不可怕，而是一种有助于改进的方式。**

> A detective was on an evaluative mission to find the culprit. He carefully examined every clue, evaluated all the suspects, and finally solved the case. This shows the meaning of \'evaluative\' - related to the process of evaluation. **一位侦探正在执行评估任务以找出罪犯。他仔细检查每一条线索，评估所有嫌疑人，最终破了案。这体现了\'evaluative\'的意思------与评估的过程有关。**

> The evaluator was like a detective in a big competition. He had to carefully observe and analyze every detail to give fair scores. Remember, an evaluator is someone who judges and assesses! **评估员就像一场大型比赛中的侦探。他必须仔细观察和分析每个细节以给出公平的分数。记住，evaluator 就是评判和评估的人！**
> 想象一下，有一个传教士，他非常热情积极地传播福音（evangel）。他的态度真诚而充满激情，大家称他为 \'evangelical\' 。他努力让更多人听到并相信福音，这种积极传播的精神就是 \'evangelical\' 的含义。 **想象一位积极传播福音的传教士，他的这种积极热情的态度被称为 \'evangelical\' ，意思是 \'福音的；福音派的；热衷于传道的\' 。**
> 想象一个热情的传教士（evangelist）在一个小村庄里，他每天带着圣经，挨家挨户地传播福音，用真诚和热情感染着每一个人，让他们感受到信仰的力量。 **想象一位传教士在村庄传播福音来辅助记忆\'evangelist\'这个单词，意思是传教士、福音传道者**

> In a hot desert, a pot of water was left under the burning sun. Gradually, the water molecules became so active that they flew away into the air. This process was called \'evaporate\'. **在炎热的沙漠中，一锅水被留在烈日下。渐渐地，水分子变得非常活跃，它们飞到空气中。这个过程被称为'蒸发'。**

> Imagine a hot summer day. A pool of water is exposed to the sun. The water slowly turns into vapor and disappears. This process of the water changing into vapor is called evaporation. **想象一个炎热的夏日。一滩水暴露在阳光下。水慢慢地变成蒸汽并消失。水变成蒸汽的这个过程就叫做蒸发。**

> A thief was always good at evasion. He could sneak away from the police easily. But one day, he was finally caught. \'Evasion\' means avoiding or escaping something, especially in a tricky or dishonest way. **一个小偷总是很擅长逃避。他能轻易地从警察那里溜走。但有一天，他最终被抓住了。\'evasion\'意思是躲避或逃避某事，尤指以狡猾或不诚实的方式。**

> A thief was being questioned by the police. But he gave evasive answers, avoiding telling the truth. He kept changing the topic and was very tricky. Finally, the police saw through his evasive tactics. **一个小偷正在接受警察的询问。但他给出了含糊其辞的回答，避免说出真相。他不断改变话题，非常狡猾。最后，警察看穿了他的逃避策略。**

> On the eve of the important exam, Eve was very nervous. She stayed up late to review and hoped to get a good result. The next day, she felt confident and did well. **在重要考试的前夕，伊芙非常紧张。她熬夜复习并希望能取得好成绩。第二天，她感到自信并且表现出色。**

> One day, Tom was walking on a very uneven road. But he managed to keep his balance and walk smoothly. Later, he realized that even in difficult situations, one can stay calm and steady. **一天，汤姆走在一条非常不平坦的路上。但他设法保持平衡，走得很平稳。后来，他意识到即使在困难的情况下，人也能保持冷静和稳定。**

> One evening, a little girl was walking home. The sky was getting darker, and the stars started to twinkle. She knew it was the time when people finished their work and gathered with families. That\'s the magic of evening. **一天晚上，一个小女孩正走回家。天空越来越暗，星星开始闪烁。她知道这是人们完成工作并与家人相聚的时候。这就是夜晚的魅力。**

> A group of kids were sharing candies evenly. Each got the same number. It was fair and smooth. Just like \'evenly\' means in an equal and smooth way. **一群孩子在平均分糖果。每个人得到的数量都一样。这很公平、平稳。就像\'evenly\'表示平等、平稳地**

> One day, I was planning to go for a picnic. But suddenly, it rained heavily. This unexpected rain was an event that changed my plan. I had to stay at home instead. **有一天，我正计划去野餐。但突然，下起了大雨。这场意外的雨是一个事件，改变了我的计划。我不得不待在家里。**

> A brave adventurer set out on a long journey. After facing many challenges and detours, he finally reached his destination. This final outcome was his eventual success. **一位勇敢的冒险家踏上了漫长的旅程。在面对许多挑战和弯路之后，他最终到达了目的地。这个最终的结果就是他最终的成功。**

> Once upon a time, a little ant was constantly climbing a tall mountain. It faced many difficulties but never gave up. Eventually, it reached the top and saw the beautiful view. Eventually means in the end, after a long time or series of events. **从前，一只小蚂蚁一直在爬一座高山。它面临许多困难但从未放弃。最终，它到达了山顶并看到了美丽的景色。eventually 意思是最终，经过很长时间或一系列事件之后。**

> A brave knight was on a long journey. No matter how hard the road was, he asked himself \'Ever will I give up?\' The answer was always \'Never!\' Meaning he would always keep going. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上漫长旅程。无论道路多么艰难，他都问自己'我曾经会放弃吗？'答案总是'从不！'这意味着他永远会坚持下去。**
> 在一个神秘的森林里，有一棵特别的树，它四季常绿，从不凋零。人们称它为 evergreen。无论春夏秋冬，它始终保持着生机与活力，就像永恒的绿色希望。 **在一个神秘森林里，有一棵四季常绿从不凋零的特别的树被称为常青树。无论季节如何，它都像永恒的绿色希望。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical flower that had an everlasting life. It never withered or died, always remaining beautiful and fresh. This flower symbolized eternal love and hope. Remember, \'everlasting\' means lasting forever. **从前，有一朵神奇的花，它拥有永恒的生命。它从不凋谢或死亡，始终保持美丽和鲜活。这朵花象征着永恒的爱和希望。记住，\'everlasting\'意思是永远持续的。**

> There was a magic box that could grant a wish every time you opened it. One day, a little girl opened it and got her favorite toy. \'Every\' means all, each, and any time. **有一个神奇的盒子，每次你打开它，它都能实现一个愿望。有一天，一个小女孩打开它并得到了她最喜欢的玩具。\'every\'意思是所有的、每个、任何时候。**

> One day, a big party was held. Everybody was invited. People from all walks of life came. They danced, sang and had a great time. It was a celebration where everybody felt happy and included. **有一天，举办了一场盛大的派对。每个人都受到了邀请。各行各业的人都来了。他们跳舞、唱歌，度过了一段美好的时光。这是一场每个人都感到快乐和融入其中的庆祝活动。**

> Every day, a little girl named Lily wakes up, brushes her teeth, gets dressed, and goes to school. \'Everyday\' means the things that happen regularly, like Lily\'s daily routine. **每天，一个叫莉莉的小女孩都会醒来，刷牙，穿衣服，然后去上学。'everyday'指的是有规律发生的事情，就像莉莉的日常。**

> Once upon a time, at a big party, there were many people. But the host said, \'Everyone, please enjoy the food and have fun!\' It meant all the people there. So, remember, everyone means all the persons. **从前，在一个大型聚会上，有很多人。但是主人说：'各位，请享用美食，玩得开心！'这里的各位就是指那里所有的人。所以，记住，everyone 意思是所有人。**

> Once upon a time, a little fairy had a magic bag. No matter what you asked for, she could find it in the bag. Because in that bag, there was everything you could imagine. From toys to candies, it had all! **从前，有一个小仙女有一个魔法袋。无论你要什么，她都能从袋子里找到。因为在那个袋子里，有你能想象到的一切东西。从玩具到糖果，应有尽有！**

> One day, a little puppy was lost. Its owner looked everywhere for it. In the park, on the street, and even in the supermarket. Finally, they found the puppy playing happily in a garden. \'Everywhere\' means in all places. **一天，一只小狗走丢了。它的主人到处找它。在公园，在街上，甚至在超市。最后，他们在一个花园里发现小狗正开心地玩耍着。\'everywhere\'意思是到处，处处。**

> A poor tenant failed to pay the rent on time. The landlord had no choice but to evict him. The tenant had to leave the house with his belongings. Poor guy! **一个可怜的租户未能按时交租。房东别无选择，只能把他驱逐出去。租户不得不带着他的东西离开房子。可怜的家伙！**

> A poor family was facing eviction from their rented house. The landlord was cruel and gave them no mercy. They had to leave with tears. Remember, eviction means being forced to leave a place, especially a rented one. **一个贫困的家庭面临着被从他们租的房子里驱逐出去的困境。房东很残忍，毫不留情。他们含着泪不得不离开。记住，eviction 意思是被迫离开一个地方，尤其是租用的地方。**

> A detective was looking for evidence in a dark room. He found a letter that proved the suspect\'s crime. The letter was the key evidence that helped solve the mystery. **一位侦探在一个黑暗的房间里寻找证据。他发现了一封信，这封信证明了嫌疑人的罪行。这封信就是帮助解开谜团的关键证据。**

> One day, a thief broke into a house. The broken window and scattered items were evident signs of the burglary. The police easily understood what had happened based on these evident clues. **一天，一个小偷闯入了一所房子。破碎的窗户和散落的物品是入室盗窃的明显迹象。警察根据这些明显的线索很容易就明白了发生了什么。**

> One day, a detective was solving a case. The clues were all over the place, but evidently, the culprit left a footprint. The detective followed this obvious sign and finally caught the criminal. **有一天，一位侦探在破案。线索到处都是，但显然，罪犯留下了一个脚印。侦探顺着这个明显的迹象，最终抓住了罪犯。**

> Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there was an EVIL witch. She had a mean look and always did bad things to the villagers. Everyone was afraid of her. Remember, \'evil\' means bad and harmful. **从前，在一片黑暗的森林里，有一个邪恶的女巫。她面容凶恶，总是对村民做坏事。每个人都害怕她。记住，\'evil\'意思是坏的、有害的。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. When he found a hidden letter, it evinced that the butler was the culprit. The letter clearly showed or proved the butler\'s guilt. **一位侦探正在努力侦破一起谜团。当他发现一封隐藏的信件时，这表明（evince）了管家是罪魁祸首。这封信清楚地显示或证明了管家的罪行。**

> A young artist was seeking inspiration. One day, a beautiful landscape gave him an evocation. It sparked his creativity and he started painting a masterpiece. The evocation was like a key that unlocked his talent. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻求灵感。有一天，一处美丽的风景给他带来了唤起、引发。它激发了他的创造力，于是他开始创作一幅杰作。这种唤起就像一把打开他天赋的钥匙。**

> A painter\'s work was so evocative that it took viewers back to their childhood. The colors and scenes triggered vivid memories. It made people feel as if they were in the past again. **一位画家的作品非常引人回忆，它将观众带回到他们的童年。那些色彩和场景引发了生动的记忆。让人感觉仿佛再次置身于过去。**

> A painter\'s masterpiece evoked strong emotions in the viewers. The beautiful colors and unique style brought back memories of their childhood. Just like this, \'evoke\' means to bring out or call forth something, like feelings or memories. **一位画家的杰作唤起了观众强烈的情感。美丽的色彩和独特的风格勾起了他们童年的回忆。就像这样，'evoke'意思是引出或唤起某物，比如情感或记忆。**
> 想象远古时期，生物们在神秘的世界里生活。随着时间推移，它们不断变化和适应环境。这种从简单到复杂、从低级到高级的逐渐改变过程，就是\'evolution\'（进化）。 **想象远古时期，生物在神秘世界中生活。随着时间，它们不断变化适应环境，这种逐渐改变的过程就是"进化"。**

> A monkey was evolving gradually. It learned new skills and changed its behaviors, showing an evolutionary process. This process made it better adapt to the environment. Remember, \'evolutionary\' means related to evolution. **一只猴子在逐渐进化。它学会了新技能，改变了行为，展现出一个进化的过程。这个过程使它能更好地适应环境。记住，\'evolutionary\'意思是与进化有关的。**
> 一只小猴子在森林中不断探索和学习，它的行为和思维慢慢变化。从最初的懵懂，到后来能够熟练地寻找食物和躲避危险，这就是 evolve（进化、演变）的过程。 **一只小猴子在森林中的变化过程就是'进化、演变'**
> 想象一只小猴子，最初什么都不会。但它不断学习，从简单跳跃到灵活攀爬，它的技能在不断变化和发展。这就像单词 evolving 所表达的，是'不断进化、发展'的意思。 **想象一只小猴子不断学习，技能不断变化发展，以此来辅助记忆 evolving 表示'不断进化、发展'的意思**

> A man\'s bad temper exacerbated the conflict at the party. He shouted loudly and made the situation worse. Remember, \'exacerbate\' means to make something worse or more intense. **一个男人的坏脾气加剧了派对上的冲突。他大声喊叫，让情况变得更糟。记住，'exacerbate'意思是使某事变得更糟或更激烈。**

> Once upon a time, a detective was trying to find the exact location of a hidden treasure. He examined every clue precisely and finally got it. Remember, \'exact\' means precise and accurate. **从前，有个侦探试图找到隐藏宝藏的确切位置。他精确地检查每一条线索，最终找到了。记住，'exact'意思是精确的、准确的。**

> A scientist was conducting an exacting experiment. Every detail had to be perfect. He spent hours adjusting the equipment, showing how demanding and precise the task was. Just like the meaning of \'exacting\'. **一位科学家正在进行一项严格的实验。每个细节都必须完美。他花了数小时调整设备，展示了这项任务是多么苛刻和精确。这就像\'exacting\'这个词的意思。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. Every clue had to be exactly right. Finally, when he found the exactly matching evidence, he cracked the case. It means being precise and correct. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。每个线索都必须完全正确。最后，当他找到完全匹配的证据时，他破了案。这个故事表明exactly意思是精确地、确切地、正是。**

> A boy always exaggerated his achievements when telling stories to his friends. One day, he said he caught a fish as big as a car. But his friends didn\'t believe him. They knew he was exaggerating. **一个男孩在给朋友们讲故事时总是夸大他的成就。有一天，他说他抓到了一条和汽车一样大的鱼。但他的朋友们不相信他。他们知道他在夸张。**

> One day, a boy described his fishing experience exaggeratedly. He said the fish he caught was as big as a whale. But everyone knew he was exaggerating. Remember, \'exaggerated\' means overstated or made larger than it really is. **有一天，一个男孩夸张地描述他的钓鱼经历。他说他钓到的鱼像鲸鱼那么大。但大家都知道他在夸大其词。记住，\'exaggerated\'意思是夸张的、言过其实的。**

> One day, Tom told his friends he caught a fish as big as a car. His friends knew it was an exaggeration. They laughed and said, \'Tom, you really love to make things seem much bigger than they are!\' **有一天，汤姆告诉他的朋友们他钓到了一条和汽车一样大的鱼。他的朋友们知道这是夸张。他们笑着说：'汤姆，你真的很喜欢把事情说得比实际大很多！'**

> A poor boy worked extremely hard and finally achieved great success. His deeds were known to all, and people exalted him as a hero. This made him feel very proud and happy. **一个贫穷的男孩极其努力地工作，最终取得了巨大的成功。他的事迹众人皆知，人们把他尊崇为英雄。这让他感到非常自豪和开心。**

> A young artist\'s painting was chosen for a famous exhibition. People praised his work highly and he felt exalted. It was a moment of great honor and pride for him. **一位年轻艺术家的画作被选入一个著名的展览。人们对他的作品高度赞扬，他感到备受尊崇。这对他来说是一个充满荣耀和自豪的时刻。**

> A student was very nervous before the exam. He studied hard but still worried. When he got the exam paper, he took a deep breath and thought of all he had learned. Finally, he did well. **一个学生在考试前非常紧张。他努力学习但仍很担心。当他拿到试卷时，他深吸一口气，想起了所学的所有知识。最后，他考得很好。**
> 小明为了即将到来的 examination 拼命复习。考试那天，他紧张地走进教室，面对一道道难题，努力回想所学知识。最终，他成功通过了这次重要的 examination。 **小明为了即将到来的考试拼命复习。考试那天，他紧张地走进教室，面对一道道难题，努力回想所学知识。最终，他成功通过了这次重要的考试。**

> A detective was assigned to examine a mysterious crime scene. He carefully looked at every detail, just like we need to do when we \'examine\' something to understand it fully. **一位侦探被指派去审查一个神秘的犯罪现场。他仔细查看每一个细节，就像我们需要做的那样，当我们"审查"某样东西以完全理解它时。**

> A brave student was very nervous before meeting the examiner. But when he saw the examiner\'s friendly smile, he felt at ease. The examiner was fair and patient, making the exam a pleasant experience. **一个勇敢的学生在见主考人之前非常紧张。但当他看到主考人友好的微笑时，他感到轻松了。主考人公平且有耐心，使考试成为一次愉快的经历。**

> A young artist was struggling to create. But when the teacher showed an example of a beautiful painting, the artist was inspired. The example gave a clear path to follow and create wonderful art. **一位年轻的艺术家正在苦苦创作。但当老师展示了一幅美丽画作的范例时，这位艺术家受到了启发。这个范例提供了一条清晰的道路去追随和创作精彩的艺术。**

> A man was constantly late for work. His boss\'s patience wore thin. Each time, it exasperated the boss more. Finally, the boss couldn\'t take it anymore. Here, \'exasperate\' means to irritate or annoy greatly. **一个男人总是上班迟到。他老板的耐心逐渐消失。每次这样，都让老板更加恼怒。最后，老板再也受不了了。这里，'exasperate'意思是使恼怒；激怒；触怒。**

> One day, Tom was constantly facing problems at work. The endless delays and mistakes made him feel extremely frustrated. This feeling of extreme frustration was his exasperation. **有一天，汤姆在工作中不断地遇到问题。没完没了的延误和错误让他感到极度沮丧。这种极度沮丧的感觉就是他的恼怒。**

> A group of archaeologists came to an ancient site. They needed to excavate the ground to find precious relics. With tools in hand, they carefully dug and discovered amazing treasures hidden beneath the soil. **一群考古学家来到一个古老的遗址。他们需要挖掘地面来寻找珍贵的文物。手持工具，他们仔细挖掘，发现了藏在土壤下令人惊叹的宝藏。**

> A team of archaeologists was on an excavation mission. They dug deep into the ground, looking for ancient treasures. The process of digging and uncovering was called excavation. **一组考古学家正在执行挖掘任务。他们在地下深挖，寻找古代的宝藏。这种挖掘和揭开的过程就叫做 excavation。**
> 想象一个跑步比赛，小明一直拼命跑。其他人都在规定的距离内停下，只有小明不停，跑过了终点好多。他跑的距离'exceed'了规定，意思就是超过、超出。 **想象一个关于小明跑步超出规定距离从而理解'exceed'（超过、超出）含义的故事**

> A young athlete aimed to run exceedingly fast. He trained hard every day, exceeding his previous limits. Finally, he achieved a record that was exceedingly remarkable. **一位年轻的运动员立志跑得极其快。他每天刻苦训练，超越了之前的极限。最终，他取得了极其出色的成绩。**
> 小明在学校的各项比赛中总是努力 excel，他不仅学习成绩优异，体育也很出色。每次竞赛他都超越自我，最终 excel 成为全校的明星学生。 **小明在学校的各项比赛中总是努力表现出色，他不仅学习成绩优异，体育也很出色。每次竞赛他都超越自我，最终成为全校的杰出学生。**

> A young athlete strived for excellence every day. He trained hard, overcame difficulties, and finally won the championship. His spirit of pursuing excellence made him a hero. **一位年轻的运动员每天都为追求卓越而努力。他刻苦训练，克服困难，最终赢得了冠军。他追求卓越的精神使他成为了英雄。**

> Once upon a time, a student got an \'excellent\' score on a very difficult exam. Everyone was amazed. This word means being extremely good and outstanding. It\'s like being the best among the best. **从前，有个学生在一场非常难的考试中取得了"优秀"的成绩。大家都很惊讶。这个单词意思是极其出色和杰出。就像是在最好的当中也是最好的。**

> One day, all the students in the class went on a trip except Tom. Because he was sick. So \'except\' means leaving out or excluding someone or something. **一天，班上所有的学生都去旅行了，除了汤姆。因为他生病了。所以'except'意思是把某人或某物排除在外。**

> A brave knight was always following the rules of the kingdom. But one day, he broke a rule to save a child. This was an exception because his motive was pure. The king forgave him. **一位勇敢的骑士一直遵守王国的规则。但有一天，他为了救一个孩子违反了一条规则。这是个例外，因为他的动机是纯粹的。国王原谅了他。**

> Once upon a time, in a normal town, everyone was ordinary. But there was one person who stood out. This person had exceptional skills and could solve problems no one else could. That\'s what \'exceptional\' means - being extraordinary and outstanding. **从前，在一个普通的小镇上，每个人都很平凡。但有一个人脱颖而出。这个人有非凡的技能，能解决别人解决不了的问题。这就是'exceptional'的意思------特别出色、杰出。**

> A brave explorer found an ancient book. In it, there was an excerpt about a hidden treasure. The explorer followed the clues in the excerpt and finally discovered the precious jewels. **一位勇敢的探险家发现了一本古书。书中有一段关于隐藏宝藏的摘录。探险家依照摘录中的线索，最终发现了珍贵的珠宝。**

> A king had so much treasure that it was in excess. It filled many rooms and caused problems. He finally realized having too much of something isn\'t always good. **一位国王拥有太多的财宝，多到过剩。这些财宝堆满了许多房间，还带来了麻烦。他最终意识到拥有过多的东西并不总是好事。**

> A king was so fond of collecting jewels that he kept buying them in excessive amounts. His treasury was filled to the brim, causing problems for his kingdom. Eventually, he realized his excessive passion was harmful. **一位国王非常喜欢收集珠宝，以至于他不断地大量购买。他的宝库被填得满满的，给他的王国带来了问题。最终，他意识到自己过度的热情是有害的。**

> A king had so much gold that it filled his treasury excessively. His greed for more led to problems. People said he was spending money excessively. Finally, he learned to be moderate. **一位国王拥有过多的黄金，以至于堆满了他的金库。他对更多黄金的贪婪导致了问题。人们说他花钱太过分。最后，他学会了适度。**

> John went to a foreign country. He needed to exchange his money for the local currency. But he was confused at first. Finally, with the help of a kind staff, he successfully made the exchange and could enjoy his trip. **约翰去了一个外国。他需要把他的钱兑换成当地货币。但一开始他很困惑。最后，在一位好心的工作人员帮助下，他成功地进行了兑换，能够享受他的旅行。**

> A customs officer was very strict in excising illegal goods. One day, he found a box full of contraband and took it away promptly. \'Excise\' means to remove or get rid of something officially. **一位海关官员在查缴非法货物时非常严格。有一天，他发现了一个装满违禁品的箱子并迅速将其带走。'excise'意思是正式地去除或除掉某物。**

> A brave doctor performed an excision on a patient. A tumor was removed precisely, like cutting out a bad part. The doctor\'s skillful excision saved the patient\'s life. **一位勇敢的医生为一位病人进行了切除手术。精准地移除了一个肿瘤，就像切掉一个坏的部分。医生熟练的切除手术挽救了病人的生命。**

> A little monkey saw a big bunch of bananas in the forest. This sight excited the monkey a lot. It jumped up and down with joy, eager to taste those delicious bananas. **一只小猴子在森林里看到了一大串香蕉。这景象让猴子非常兴奋。它高兴得又蹦又跳，急切地想要尝尝那些美味的香蕉。**

> One day, I got a letter saying I won a trip to my dream place. I was so excited that I jumped up and down. My heart was beating fast and I couldn\'t wait to start the journey. **有一天，我收到一封信，说我赢得了去梦想之地的旅行。我兴奋极了，高兴得蹦蹦跳跳。我的心跳很快，迫不及待地想要开启旅程。**

> One day, Tom found a lost puppy. He was so excited and shouted excitedly to his friends to come and see. They all shared the joy and excitement together. **有一天，汤姆发现了一只走丢的小狗。他非常兴奋，兴奋地向他的朋友们大喊让他们过来看。他们一起分享了这份喜悦和激动。**

> One day, I went to an amusement park. The rides, the music, and the people\'s laughter filled the air. I felt a rush of excitement. It was like a magic that made my heart race and my face light up with joy. **有一天，我去了一个游乐园。游乐设施、音乐和人们的笑声弥漫在空中。我感到一阵兴奋。这就像一种魔力，让我的心跳加速，脸上洋溢着喜悦。**

> One day, I went to an amusement park. There were thrilling roller coasters and amazing shows. Everything was so exciting! I couldn\'t stop smiling and having fun. It was a day full of excitement. **有一天，我去了一个游乐园。那里有刺激的过山车和精彩的表演。一切都如此令人兴奋！我笑得停不下来，玩得很开心。这是充满兴奋的一天。**
> One day, when Tom saw a big snake in the garden, he was so shocked that he couldn\'t help exclaiming loudly. His shout scared the snake away. **一天，当汤姆在花园里看到一条大蛇时，他非常震惊，忍不住大声惊叫起来。他的呼喊把蛇吓跑了。**

> One day, when Tom was walking in the forest, he suddenly saw a big snake. He shouted in fear, making an exclamation. His shout scared the snake away. From then on, he remembered the word \'exclamation\' as a loud cry out of surprise or fear. **有一天，当汤姆在森林里散步时，他突然看到一条大蛇。他惊恐地大喊，发出了惊叫。他的呼喊把蛇吓跑了。从那以后，他记住了\'exclamation\'这个词，表示因惊讶或恐惧而发出的大声呼喊。**

> Imagine a club that has strict rules. They exclude people who don\'t follow those rules. For example, if you don\'t wear the right clothes, they won\'t let you in. \'Exclude\' means to keep someone or something out. **想象一个有严格规则的俱乐部。他们把不遵守那些规则的人排除在外。比如，如果你没穿对衣服，他们就不让你进去。\'exclude\'意思是把某人或某物排除在外。**

> A king had a secret garden. To protect it, he set up strict rules for exclusion. Only those with special permission could enter. Anyone else was kept out. This shows the meaning of exclusion - keeping someone or something out. **一位国王有一个秘密花园。为了保护它，他制定了严格的排斥规则。只有获得特别许可的人才能进入。其他人都被拒之门外。这体现了'exclusion'（排斥、排除）的含义------将某人或某物拒之门外。**
> 有一天，小明参加了一个高级派对，门口保安说这是 exclusive 的，只有受到特别邀请的人才能进入。小明拿出邀请函，顺利进入，享受了专属的服务和体验。原来 exclusive 就是排他的、独有的意思。 **有一天，小明参加了一个只有受到特别邀请才能进入的高级派对，小明凭借邀请函顺利进入并享受专属服务，以此体现 exclusive 排他的、独有的含义。**

> A prince had a secret garden. Only he could enter it. The word \'exclusively\' means just for him alone. No one else was allowed. It was his exclusively owned place. **一位王子有一个秘密花园。只有他能进入。单词"exclusively"意味着只为他一个人。没有其他人被允许。这是他独有的地方。**

> I was climbing a mountain and got injured. The pain was excruciating. It felt like thousands of needles were stabbing me. I couldn\'t move and had to wait for help. **我在爬山时受伤了。疼痛是极度的。感觉就像有成千上万根针在刺我。我无法移动，只能等待救援。**

> A group of friends decided to go on an excursion. They packed their bags and set off. They explored new places, had fun and made wonderful memories. The excursion was an exciting adventure. **一群朋友决定去远足。他们收拾好行李就出发了。他们探索新地方，玩得很开心，并留下了美好的回忆。这次远足是一次令人兴奋的冒险。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. When the teacher asked him why, he said, \'Excuse me, teacher. My bike broke down on the way.\' The teacher accepted his excuse. **一天，汤姆上学迟到了。当老师问他为什么时，他说："对不起，老师。我的自行车在路上坏了。"老师接受了他的借口。**
> Imagine an executive in a big company. He\'s always busy making important decisions and giving orders. We call such a person an \'exec\'. **想象一家大公司里的一位高管。他总是忙于做重要决定和下达命令。我们称这样的人是'exec（主管；经理）'。**

> A brave knight was given the order to execute the evil dragon. He drew his sword, charged forward, and with all his might, fulfilled the task. Remember, \'execute\' means to carry out a task or an order. **一位勇敢的骑士接到命令去处决邪恶的巨龙。他拔出剑，向前冲去，用尽全力完成了任务。记住，\'execute\'意思是执行任务或命令。**
