> A king ordered the execution of a criminal. But before the execution, the criminal revealed a secret that saved the kingdom. The act of carrying out this order was called \'execution\'. **一位国王下令处决一名罪犯。但在处决前，罪犯透露了一个拯救王国的秘密。执行这个命令的行为就被称为'execution（处决；执行）'。**

> Once upon a time, in a dark castle, there was an evil executioner. He was always ready with his sharp axe to carry out cruel punishments. But in the end, justice prevailed and he was punished for his evil deeds. **从前，在一座黑暗的城堡里，有一个邪恶的刽子手。他总是拿着锋利的斧头准备执行残酷的惩罚。但最终，正义获胜，他因恶行受到了惩罚。**
> 想象一位名叫 Exec 的年轻人，他总是行动力超强，能迅速执行各种任务。他被大家称为 Executive，因为他具备出色的执行能力，总能让计划完美落地。 **想象一位叫Exec的年轻人因出色执行能力被称为高管，来辅助记忆executive（行政的；高管）这个单词**

> A young artist was striving to be exemplary. He spent hours painting, never giving up. His works became models for others, showing that with determination, one can be exemplary. Eventually, he achieved great success. **一位年轻的艺术家努力做到堪称楷模。他花数小时绘画，从不放弃。他的作品成为了他人的典范，表明只要有决心，就能做到杰出。最终，他取得了巨大成功。**

> A famous artist was asked to exemplify the beauty of nature. So, he painted a wonderful landscape, showing exactly how nature\'s charm could be captured. This action clearly exemplifies the meaning of the word. **一位著名的艺术家被要求举例说明自然之美。于是，他画了一幅美妙的风景画，确切地展现了如何捕捉自然的魅力。这个行为清楚地例证了\'exemplify\'这个词的意思。**

> A brave soldier was exempt from the dangerous mission because of his previous heroic deeds. He was spared and not required to face the peril. Remember, \'exempt\' means to be free from or excused from something. **一位勇敢的士兵因其先前的英勇事迹而被免除危险任务。他被放过，无需面对危险。记住，\'exempt\'意思是免除或豁免某事。**

> A poor student was worried about tuition fees. But then he got an exemption. It meant he didn\'t have to pay and could focus on his studies. The exemption was like a magic key that opened the door to his dreams. **一个贫困的学生正为学费发愁。但后来他获得了豁免。这意味着他不用交钱，可以专心学习。这个豁免就像一把神奇的钥匙，打开了他梦想的大门。**

> One day, Tom was very tired. But he knew he needed to do exercise to stay healthy. So he went for a run and did some push-ups. After that, he felt great. Exercise made him strong and energetic! **有一天，汤姆非常累。但他知道他需要锻炼来保持健康。所以他去跑步并且做了一些俯卧撑。在那之后，他感觉很棒。锻炼让他变得强壮且充满活力！**
> 想象一下，大力士在举重比赛中，用尽全力（exert）去举起杠铃。他肌肉紧绷，汗流浃背，把自己所有的力量都发挥出来，只为赢得比赛。这就是 exert ，表示尽力、发挥、运用。 **想象大力士在举重比赛中尽力发挥力量的情景来辅助记忆单词 exert，意为尽力、发挥、运用**

> A tired athlete was on the track. Despite the pain, he made a huge exertion to cross the finish line. His determination and effort showed what exertion truly means - using all your strength and energy. **一位疲惫的运动员在跑道上。尽管疼痛，他还是竭尽全力冲过了终点线。他的决心和努力展现了'exertion'的真正含义------用尽所有的力量和精力。**

> A man was trapped in a small room. Feeling suffocated, he desperately pushed the door to exhale the stale air and inhale fresh oxygen. Finally, he felt relieved. **一个男人被困在一个小房间里。感到窒息，他拼命地推开门，呼出污浊的空气，吸入新鲜的氧气。最后，他感到轻松了。**
> 想象一辆赛车在赛道上疯狂疾驰，跑了无数圈。它的引擎不断工作，最终不堪重负。这个引擎就像被\'exhaust\'了，消耗殆尽，没有力气再跑了。 **想象一辆赛车过度使用，引擎消耗殆尽，来辅助理解'exhaust'有使精疲力竭；耗尽的意思。**

> A hardworking athlete ran many miles in a race. After crossing the finish line, he was completely exhausted. He could hardly move and needed to lie down to rest. **一位勤奋的运动员在一场比赛中跑了很多英里。冲过终点线后，他完全精疲力竭了。他几乎动弹不得，需要躺下来休息。**

> A brave explorer was constantly on the move. After days of non-stop adventures, he felt extreme tiredness. This state was called exhaustion. He had used up all his energy and needed a long rest. **一位勇敢的探险家一直在行动。经过数天不停歇的冒险后，他感到极度疲倦。这种状态被称为精疲力竭。他已经耗尽了所有的能量，需要长时间的休息。**
> 想象一位探险家在沙漠中寻找宝藏，他翻遍了每一个沙丘，检查了每一处洞穴，用尽了所有可能的方法，这种全面彻底的探索就是\'exhaustive\'。 **想象一位探险家在沙漠中全面彻底的寻找宝藏，以此来辅助记忆\'exhaustive\'（详尽的；彻底的）这个单词。**

> A talented artist decided to exhibit her beautiful paintings in a big gallery. People came from everywhere to see and admire them. The exhibit was a huge success! **一位有才华的艺术家决定在一个大画廊展出她美丽的画作。人们从各地赶来观看和欣赏。这次展览取得了巨大的成功！**

> A group of artists were preparing for an exhibition. They worked hard to display their wonderful paintings. Finally, the exhibition attracted many people and was a great success. **一群艺术家正在为一场展览做准备。他们努力工作来展示他们精彩的画作。最后，这场展览吸引了很多人，取得了巨大成功。**

> A young artist wanted to show his paintings. But he needed an exhibitor. Finally, he found one who helped him display the art in a big hall. The exhibitor made his dream come true. **一位年轻的艺术家想要展示他的画作。但他需要一个展出者。最后，他找到了一个在一个大展厅帮他展出作品的展出者。这个展出者让他的梦想成真了。**

> One day, I went on a thrilling roller coaster ride. The wind blew in my face and the speed was amazing. That experience was truly exhilarating. It made me feel so alive and excited. **有一天，我去坐了一次惊险的过山车。风刮在我的脸上，速度惊人。那次经历真的令人兴奋。它让我感觉充满活力和激动。**

> A young man went on a thrilling adventure. He climbed mountains, crossed rivers, and felt a rush of joy and excitement. This feeling was called exhilaration. It made him want to keep exploring and having fun. **一个年轻人去进行了一场惊险刺激的冒险。他爬山、过河，并感受到了一阵喜悦和兴奋。这种感觉就叫做兴奋。这让他想要不断探索并享受快乐。**

> A brave leader exhort his soldiers before the battle, saying, \'Fight with all your might!\'. Here, \'exhort\' means to strongly encourage or urge someone to do something. **一位勇敢的领导在战斗前劝诫他的士兵，说道：'用尽全力战斗！'。这里，'exhort'意思是强烈地鼓励或敦促某人做某事。**

> A brave leader gave an exhortation to his soldiers before the battle. He passionately encouraged them to be courageous and fight for victory. The soldiers were deeply moved and filled with determination. **一位勇敢的领导在战斗前向他的士兵们发出劝勉。他热情地鼓励他们要勇敢，为胜利而战。士兵们深受感动，充满了决心。**

> A brave prince was wrongly accused and forced into exile. He had to leave his kingdom and wander alone. But with his determination, he finally proved his innocence and returned home. Remember, exile means to force someone to leave their home. **一位勇敢的王子被冤枉并被迫流放。他不得不离开自己的王国，独自流浪。但凭借他的决心，他最终证明了自己的清白并回家。记住，exile 意思是迫使某人离开家乡。**

> A brave king was wrongly accused and exiled. He had to leave his kingdom and face many difficulties. But he never gave up and finally proved his innocence and returned. **一位勇敢的国王被错误地指控并遭到流放。他不得不离开自己的王国，面临诸多困难。但他从未放弃，最终证明了自己的清白并归来。**

> Imagine a magical world where only a few special creatures can EXIST. These creatures have unique powers and are very rare. The word \'exist\' means to be real or to have actual presence, just like those special creatures in the magical world. **想象一个神奇的世界，只有一些特殊的生物能够存在。这些生物具有独特的力量并且非常罕见。单词\'exist\'意思是真实的，实际存在的，就像那个神奇世界中的特殊生物一样。**

> Imagine a little explorer in a vast forest. He keeps looking for signs of life, like animals and plants. This search for life and all that is around it is like the meaning of \'existence\'. **想象一个小探险家在广阔的森林里。他不断寻找生命的迹象，比如动物和植物。这种对生命以及周围一切的寻找就像是\'existence\'的含义。**

> A philosopher was always lost in deep thoughts about existential questions like the meaning of life and human existence. One day, he had a sudden realization and shouted, \'Existential means related to existence!\' **一位哲学家总是陷入关于存在主义问题，如生命的意义和人类的存在等的深度思考中。有一天，他突然顿悟并大喊：\'Existential 意思是与存在有关的！\'**

> Imagine a magical forest where only existing trees have special powers. A young explorer discovers this and realizes the importance of these existing trees. They are not new, but have always been there, just like the meaning of \'existing\'. **想象一个神奇的森林，只有现存的树木才有特殊的力量。一位年轻的探险家发现了这一点，并意识到这些现存树木的重要性。它们不是新出现的，而是一直都在那里，就像\'existing\'这个词的意思。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a mysterious cave. After hours of searching, he finally saw a sign that said \'EXIT\' and followed it to safety. The exit was his hope and salvation. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个神秘的洞穴中迷路了。经过数小时的寻找，他终于看到一个写着\'EXIT（出口）\'的标志，并顺着它到达了安全地带。这个出口是他的希望和救赎。**

> A man was wrongly accused of a crime. But new evidence emerged to exonerate him. It proved he was not at the scene and had nothing to do with it. Finally, justice was served and he was freed. **一个男人被错误地指控犯罪。但新的证据出现为他洗清了罪名。这证明他当时不在现场，与案件毫无关系。最终，正义得到伸张，他被释放了。**

> A poor man needed a new bike. But the price in the store was exorbitant. It was like a crazy dream. He had to save for ages. Finally, he found a better deal. **一个穷人需要一辆新自行车。但商店里的价格高得离谱。就像一个疯狂的梦。他不得不攒钱很久。最后，他找到了更划算的。**

> A traveler went to a faraway land and saw many exotic plants and animals. The colorful birds, strange fruits, and unique flowers were all so fascinating. These things were very different from what he was used to at home. **一位旅行者去了一个遥远的地方，看到了许多奇异的植物和动物。色彩斑斓的鸟儿、奇怪的水果和独特的花朵都非常迷人。这些东西都与他在家乡习惯见到的大不相同。**
> 想象一下，一个小小的气球被不断地吹气。它从很小开始，体积逐渐变大，表面也在向外伸展。这个气球就像在 \'expand\' ，不断地扩张、变大。 **想象一个不断吹气而扩张的气球来记住 expand 这个表示扩张、变大的单词**

> A little boy was playing with a balloon. As he blew into it, the balloon was expanding. It grew bigger and bigger, just like our knowledge and experiences should be constantly expanding. **一个小男孩正在玩气球。当他往里面吹气时，气球在膨胀。它变得越来越大，就像我们的知识和经验应该不断扩展一样。**

> A brave astronaut was floating in space, looking at the vast expanse. He felt tiny but was amazed by the endless expanse of stars and galaxies. It was a sight that made him realize the enormity of the universe. **一位勇敢的宇航员在太空中漂浮，望着广阔的区域。他感到自己很渺小，但被无尽的星星和星系所构成的广阔区域所震撼。这景象让他意识到宇宙的浩瀚。**

> A king wanted to expand his kingdom. He sent his army far and wide. With each new territory, his power grew. This was the expansion he desired. **一位国王想要扩张他的王国。他派遣他的军队到各地。随着每一块新领土的获得，他的权力也在增长。这就是他所渴望的扩张。**

> A man was exploring a new land. The area was expansive, with wide fields and no boundaries. He felt free and full of hope. He wanted to expand his knowledge and experience in this wonderful place. **一个男人正在探索一片新土地。这个地区很广阔，有着宽广的田野且没有边界。他感到自由并充满希望。他想在这个美妙的地方拓展自己的知识和经验。**

> A scientist was forced to expatriate from his homeland due to political reasons. He left with a heavy heart, seeking a new life abroad. But he always missed his home. Remember, expatriate means to leave one\'s country. **一位科学家因政治原因被迫离开祖国成为侨民。他怀着沉重的心情离开，在国外寻求新生活。但他总是思念家乡。记住，expatriate 意思是移居国外；放逐。**

> One day, Tom was waiting for his friend at the train station. He expected his friend to arrive at 3 p.m., but his friend was late. Tom was a little worried. Finally, his friend came and Tom was happy. **一天，汤姆在火车站等他的朋友。他期望他的朋友下午 3 点到达，但是他的朋友迟到了。汤姆有点担心。最后，他的朋友来了，汤姆很高兴。**

> A young athlete trained hard every day with expectancy of winning the championship. He believed his efforts would lead to success. Finally, his dream came true. **一位年轻的运动员每天刻苦训练，怀着赢得冠军的期望。他相信自己的努力会带来成功。最终，他的梦想成真了。**

> A woman stands at the hospital door, her face filled with hope and anticipation. She is expectant, waiting for the arrival of her new baby. This moment of waiting and looking forward is what \'expectant\' means. **一位女士站在医院门口，脸上充满希望和期待。她满怀期待，等待着新生命的降临。这种等待和期盼的时刻就是'expectant'的含义。**

> One day, Tom was waiting for his birthday gift expectantly. He stood by the door, eyes shining, hoping to get the toy car he had been longing for. His heart was filled with anticipation. **一天，汤姆满心期待地等着他的生日礼物。他站在门边，眼睛发亮，希望能得到他一直渴望的玩具汽车。他的心中充满了期待。**

> A young boy had an expectation of getting a bike on his birthday. He imagined riding it freely. But when the day came, there was no bike. His expectation was not met. **一个小男孩期待在生日时能得到一辆自行车。他想象着能自由地骑行。但当生日那天到来时，却没有自行车。他的期望落空了。**

> A group of explorers were in a hurry to reach the top of the mountain. They needed to expedite their journey. So they chose the shortest and fastest route. Finally, they made it. **一群探险家急于到达山顶。他们需要加快行程。所以他们选择了最短最快的路线。最后，他们成功了。**

> A group of brave adventurers set out on an expedition to the mysterious jungle. They faced many challenges but were determined to reach their destination. The expedition was full of excitement and unknowns. **一群勇敢的冒险家出发去神秘的丛林探险。他们面临许多挑战，但决心到达目的地。这次探险充满了刺激和未知。**

> A naughty student was constantly making trouble in class. The teacher had no choice but to expel him. This means the teacher forced the student to leave the school. **一个顽皮的学生在课堂上不断惹麻烦。老师别无选择，只能将他开除。这意味着老师迫使这个学生离开学校。**

> A brave adventurer was on a long journey. He had to expend all his energy and resources to cross the dangerous mountains. But his determination made him keep going, knowing that the effort would lead to great rewards. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在长途旅行。他不得不耗费自己所有的精力和资源来穿越危险的山脉。但他的决心使他继续前进，因为他知道这番努力会带来巨大的回报。**

> In a dangerous mission, the team had some expendable members. They were seen as easily sacrificed for the greater goal. But one of them refused to be treated as such and proved his worth. Expendable means capable of being sacrificed or used up. **在一次危险的任务中，团队有一些可牺牲的成员。他们被视为为了更大的目标容易被舍弃的。但其中一人拒绝被这样对待，并证明了自己的价值。Expendable 意思是可牺牲的；可消耗的。**

> A poor student had to carefully manage his expenditure. He spent money only on necessary things like textbooks. But one day, he accidentally overspent on a party. Now he realizes the importance of controlling expenditure. **一个贫困的学生不得不小心管理他的开支。他只把钱花在像教科书这样的必需品上。但有一天，他不小心在一个聚会上超支了。现在他意识到控制开支的重要性。**

> A poor student was always worried about expense. One day, he found a part-time job to cover his living expenses. With hard work, he managed to balance his expenses and live a better life. **一个贫困的学生总是为开销担忧。有一天，他找了一份兼职工作来支付生活费用。通过努力工作，他设法平衡了自己的开支，过上了更好的生活。**

> One day, I wanted to buy a beautiful dress. But when I saw the price tag, it was so expensive that I had to give up. I realized \'expensive\' means costing a lot of money. **有一天，我想买一条漂亮的裙子。但当我看到价格标签时，它太贵了，以至于我不得不放弃。我意识到\'expensive\'意思是价格很高，花费很多钱。**

> One day, Tom decided to travel alone. He faced many challenges but also gained wonderful memories. This journey was Tom\'s experience, teaching him to be brave and independent. **一天，汤姆决定独自旅行。他面临许多挑战，但也获得了美好的回忆。这次旅行就是汤姆的经历，教会他勇敢和独立。**

> A young chef wanted to become experienced. He cooked every day, faced many challenges, but never gave up. Finally, he became an experienced chef, loved by all. **一位年轻的厨师想要变得经验丰富。他每天做饭，面临许多挑战，但从未放弃。最终，他成为了一位经验丰富的厨师，受到所有人的喜爱。**

> A young scientist was always seeking experiential knowledge. One day, he went on an adventure and faced many challenges. Through these experiences, he gained valuable insights. Now, whenever he hears \'experiential\', he remembers his adventure. **一位年轻的科学家总是在寻求经验性的知识。有一天，他去冒险，面临了许多挑战。通过这些经历，他获得了宝贵的见解。现在，每当他听到\' experiential \'这个词，就会想起他的那次冒险。**

> A scientist was very passionate about his experiment. He spent days and nights in the lab, trying different combinations. Finally, his experiment succeeded and brought great benefits to society. **一位科学家对他的实验充满热情。他在实验室里日夜钻研，尝试不同的组合。最终，他的实验成功了，并为社会带来了巨大的益处。**

> A scientist was conducting an experimental project. He mixed various chemicals, observed their reactions, and recorded the data carefully. Through this risky but exciting experiment, he hoped to make a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一个实验性的项目。他混合了各种化学物质，观察它们的反应，并仔细记录数据。通过这个有风险但令人兴奋的实验，他希望能有重大发现。**

> A scientist was always working experimentally in the lab. One day, he mixed some chemicals experimentally and made an amazing discovery. This showed that working experimentally can lead to great achievements. **一位科学家总是在实验室里进行实验性地工作。有一天，他实验性地混合了一些化学物质，并有了惊人的发现。这表明实验性地工作能够带来巨大的成就。**

> A scientist was always passionate about experimentation. One day, he tried various mixtures in his lab. Through continuous experimentation, he finally discovered a new formula. It was all about the process of trying and testing! **一位科学家一直热衷于实验。有一天，他在实验室里尝试了各种混合物。通过不断的实验，他终于发现了一个新配方。这都是关于尝试和测试的过程！**

> A brave experimenter was in a laboratory. He wore a white coat and held test tubes. He was passionate about trying new experiments to discover unknown truths. His efforts made great contributions to science. **一位勇敢的实验员在实验室里。他穿着白大褂，手持试管。他热衷于尝试新实验以发现未知的真相。他的努力为科学做出了巨大贡献。**

> One day, a big problem occurred in the city. Everyone was worried. But an expert came. He knew exactly what to do and solved the problem easily. People were amazed by his knowledge and skills. **一天，城市里出现了一个大问题。大家都很担心。但一位专家来了。他确切地知道该怎么做，并轻松解决了问题。人们对他的知识和技能感到惊讶。**

> A young scientist was eager to gain expertise in a complex field. He spent years studying and conducting experiments. Finally, his hard work paid off, and he became an expert, known for his deep expertise and valuable contributions. **一位年轻的科学家渴望在一个复杂的领域获得专业知识。他花了数年时间学习和做实验。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他成为了一名专家，以其深厚的专业知识和宝贵的贡献而闻名。**

> A young chef was cooking. At first, he was clumsy. But with practice, he expertly handled the knife and ingredients, creating delicious dishes. Everyone praised his expertly cooking skills. **一位年轻的厨师正在烹饪。起初，他笨手笨脚。但通过练习，他熟练地操刀和处理食材，做出了美味的菜肴。大家都称赞他熟练的烹饪技巧。**

> A spy was on a mission, but he knew there was an expiration date. If he didn\'t complete it before that, all would be lost. The expiration was like a ticking time bomb, adding tension to his task. **一名间谍正在执行一项任务，但他知道有个截止日期。如果他不能在此之前完成，一切都将前功尽弃。这个截止日期就像一颗定时炸弹，给他的任务增添了紧张感。**

> A detective was chasing a criminal. The criminal\'s visa was about to expire. If it did, he would be caught easily. But the detective caught him just in time before the visa expired. **一位侦探正在追捕一名罪犯。罪犯的签证即将到期。如果到期，他会很容易被抓住。但侦探恰好在签证到期前及时抓住了他。**

> One day, Tom made a mistake. His teacher asked him to explain what happened. Tom carefully described the whole process and reasons. Finally, the teacher understood. \'Explain\' means to make something clear and understandable. **一天，汤姆犯了个错。他的老师让他解释发生了什么。汤姆仔细地描述了整个过程和原因。最后，老师明白了。\'explain\'意思是使某事清晰易懂。**

> One day, a student asked the teacher a difficult question. The teacher gave a detailed and clear explanation. With patience and examples, the student finally understood. The teacher\'s explanation was like a key that unlocked the student\'s confusion. **一天，一个学生问了老师一个难题。老师给出了详细清晰的解释。老师耐心地举例，学生终于明白了。老师的解释就像一把钥匙，解开了学生的困惑。**

> One day, a student had many questions. The teacher gave explanatory notes to make everything clear. The student finally understood thanks to the teacher\'s explanatory words. **有一天，一个学生有很多问题。老师给出了解释性的注释以使一切清晰。多亏了老师解释性的话语，学生终于明白了。**

> A man was very angry at a meeting. He shouted some expletives like \'Damn!\' and \'Hell!\' Everyone was shocked. Later, he regretted his bad language. Remember, expletive means a swear word or an oath. **一个男人在会议上非常生气。他喊出了一些像'该死！'和'见鬼！'这样的咒骂语。每个人都很震惊。后来，他后悔自己的粗言秽语。记住，expletive 指的是咒骂语或誓言。**

> A thief was caught and the police demanded an explicit confession. The thief finally detailed all his crimes clearly. With this scene in mind, you\'ll remember \'explicit\' means clear and definite. **一个小偷被抓住了，警察要求一个明确的供认。小偷最终清楚地详述了他所有的罪行。记住这个场景，你就会记住'explicit'意思是清晰明确的。**

> A detective was solving a case. The criminal explicitly confessed his crime in a letter. The detective was surprised because it was so rare for someone to be this openly and clearly admitting their wrongdoings. **一位侦探正在破案。罪犯在一封信中明确地坦白了他的罪行。侦探很惊讶，因为很少有人会如此公开和清晰地承认自己的过错。**

> A crazy scientist was working in his lab. He mixed some strange chemicals and suddenly, everything explode. The room was filled with smoke and debris. Poor scientist! **一位疯狂的科学家在他的实验室工作。他混合了一些奇怪的化学物质，突然，一切都爆炸了。房间里充满了烟雾和碎片。可怜的科学家！**

> A brave adventurer found a hidden cave filled with precious gems. But a villain wanted to exploit this discovery for personal gain. The adventurer stopped the villain and used the gems for the good of all. **一位勇敢的探险家发现了一个藏满宝石的隐秘洞穴。但一个坏蛋想利用这个发现谋取私利。探险家阻止了坏蛋，并将宝石用于造福大家。**

> A brave explorer found a hidden cave filled with precious gems. But a greedy man came and started exploitation, taking all the gems without caring for the cave\'s balance. The explorer stopped him to protect the cave. **一位勇敢的探险家发现了一个藏满珍贵宝石的洞穴。但一个贪婪的人来了，开始进行剥削，拿走了所有宝石，丝毫不顾洞穴的平衡。探险家阻止了他以保护洞穴。**

> A brave adventurer set out on an exploration. He crossed mountains and rivers, facing many challenges. His goal was to discover new lands and unknown secrets. Through this journey, he understood the meaning of exploration. **一位勇敢的探险家出发去探险。他翻山越岭，面对许多挑战。他的目标是发现新的土地和未知的秘密。通过这次旅程，他明白了"exploration（探险）"的意义。**

> A brave adventurer set out on an exploratory journey. He had no map but was full of curiosity. He explored unknown caves and mysterious forests, seeking new discoveries. His spirit was like the meaning of \'exploratory\'. **一位勇敢的探险家踏上了探索之旅。他没有地图，但充满了好奇心。他探索未知的洞穴和神秘的森林，寻求新的发现。他的精神就像\'探索性的\'这个词的含义。**

> One day, a brave adventurer decided to explore a mysterious island. He walked through the thick forest, climbed over huge rocks, and discovered many unknown things. The word \'explore\' means to search and discover new places or things. **有一天，一位勇敢的探险家决定探索一座神秘的岛屿。他穿过茂密的森林，爬过巨大的岩石，发现了许多未知的事物。单词'explore'的意思是探索、探寻新的地方或事物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a brave person named Tom. He loved adventure and was always the first to go into unknown places. Tom was an explorer, seeking new lands and uncovering hidden secrets. **从前，有一个勇敢的人叫汤姆。他热爱冒险，总是第一个走进未知的地方。汤姆是一位探险家，寻找新的土地并揭开隐藏的秘密。**

> One day, a scientist was conducting an experiment in the lab. Suddenly, there was a loud noise and a bright flash. It was an explosion! The force was so strong that everything was thrown into the air. **有一天，一位科学家正在实验室里做实验。突然，传来一声巨响和一道亮光。这是一场爆炸！力量非常强大，一切都被抛到了空中。**

> A crazy scientist was working in his lab. He mixed some chemicals carelessly and created an explosive substance. The explosion was so powerful that it shook the whole building. Remember, explosive means likely to explode. **一位疯狂的科学家在他的实验室工作。他不小心混合了一些化学物质，制造出了一种爆炸性的物质。爆炸威力巨大，震动了整座大楼。记住，explosive 意思是会爆炸的。**

> Imagine a scientist studying a virus outbreak. The number of infections grows very rapidly. This fast-growing pattern is described as \'exponential\'. It means increasing at an extremely fast rate, like the spread of the virus. **想象一位科学家在研究一场病毒爆发。感染人数增长得非常迅速。这种快速增长的模式被描述为"指数级的"。它意味着以极快的速度增加，就像病毒的传播一样。**

> A factory was in trouble because it couldn\'t export its products. But one smart worker found a way and they successfully sent the goods abroad. \'Export\' means to send goods or services to another country. **一家工厂陷入困境，因为无法出口其产品。但一位聪明的工人找到了办法，他们成功地将货物运往国外。'export'意思是将货物或服务运往另一个国家。**

> A brave journalist decided to expose the illegal activities of a powerful company. He risked his life to collect evidence and finally made the truth known to the public. The word \'expose\' means to reveal or make something visible that was hidden or secret. **一位勇敢的记者决定揭露一家强大公司的非法活动。他冒着生命危险收集证据，最终将真相公之于众。单词\'expose\'意思是揭示、使隐藏或秘密的事物显露出来。**

> A brave explorer was climbing a mountain. When he reached the top, he found himself exposed to strong winds and harsh sunlight. But he didn\'t give up and still enjoyed the magnificent view. **一位勇敢的探险家正在爬山。当他到达山顶时，他发现自己暴露在强风和烈日下。但他没有放弃，仍然欣赏着壮丽的景色。**
> 在一个古老的小镇，每年都会举办一场大型的 exposition（展览会）。人们从四面八方赶来，展示他们的奇珍异宝。小明第一次来，被眼前的丰富展品惊到，深深记住了这个代表展示、阐述的单词。 **在一个古老小镇举办的展览会让小明记住了【exposition】这个表示展示、阐述的单词。**

> A brave photographer went to a high mountain for the perfect shot. Despite the danger of exposure to harsh weather, he persisted. Finally, he got a stunning image that made his efforts worthwhile. **一位勇敢的摄影师为了完美的拍摄去了一座高山。尽管有暴露在恶劣天气中的危险，他仍坚持不懈。最终，他得到了一张令人惊叹的照片，使他的努力没有白费。**

> A wise professor expounded complex theories to the students. He used simple examples and clear explanations, making the difficult knowledge easy to understand. The students were enlightened and gained a lot. **一位睿智的教授向学生们阐述复杂的理论。他用简单的例子和清晰的解释，使难懂的知识变得容易理解。学生们受到启发，收获颇丰。**

> A young artist wanted to express her love for nature. So, she painted a beautiful landscape quickly and precisely. The way she showed her feelings through the painting was like the meaning of \'express\'. **一位年轻的艺术家想要表达她对大自然的热爱。于是，她快速且精准地画了一幅美丽的风景画。她通过这幅画展现自己感受的方式就如同'express'这个单词的意思。**
> 有一天，小明去参加一个聚会，看到一个人坐在角落里，脸上没有任何表情，目光呆滞，仿佛失去了灵魂。这个人就是 expressionless 的最好写照，毫无表情的。 **有一天，小明参加聚会看到一个毫无表情、目光呆滞仿佛失去灵魂的人，这就是"毫无表情的"的最好写照。**

> One day, a painter was creating a masterpiece. His strokes on the canvas were so expressive that they seemed to tell a vivid story. Everyone who saw the painting could feel the emotions he wanted to convey. Expressive - full of expression. **有一天，一位画家正在创作一幅杰作。他在画布上的笔触极具表现力，似乎在讲述一个生动的故事。每个看到这幅画的人都能感受到他想要传达的情感。expressive - 富有表现力的**

> A messenger was expressly sent to deliver an important letter. The king commanded him to reach the destination quickly and without any delay. \'Expressly\' here means clearly and specifically. **一名信使被专门派去送一封重要的信件。国王命令他迅速到达目的地，不得有任何延误。"expressly"在这里表示明确地、特意地。**

> A naughty student was constantly causing trouble in the school. Finally, his bad behavior led to his expulsion. The principal had no choice but to send him away from the school. **一个顽皮的学生在学校不断惹麻烦。最终，他的不良行为导致了他被开除。校长别无选择，只能把他从学校赶走。**

> A prince was searching for an exquisite gem for his princess. He traveled far and wide until he found one in a hidden cave. The gem was so beautiful and rare, just like the meaning of \'exquisite\'. **一位王子为他的公主寻找一颗精美的宝石。他四处跋涉，最终在一个隐蔽的洞穴里找到了一颗。这颗宝石如此美丽且罕见，就像\'exquisite\'这个词的意思。**

> A fairy in the forest was dressed exquisitely. Her gown was made of the finest silk, and every stitch was perfect. The jewels on her crown sparkled exquisitely, making her the most beautiful sight. **森林里的一位仙女穿着精美。她的长袍由最优质的丝绸制成，每一针都完美无缺。她皇冠上的珠宝精美地闪耀着，使她成为最美丽的景象。**

> Imagine a lost city. Everyone thought all its treasures were gone. But you, a brave explorer, find one precious gem still extant. It\'s the only thing that survived and remained in existence. So, \'extant\' means still existing or surviving. **想象一座失落的城市。大家都以为它所有的珍宝都没了。但勇敢的你，一位探险家，发现了一颗珍贵的宝石仍然存在。它是唯一留存下来的东西。所以，\'extant\'意思是仍然存在的或留存下来的。**
> 一只小猴子想伸手 extend 去够树上的香蕉，它努力伸直胳膊，不断延伸身体，终于摘到了香蕉。这就像 extend 这个词，有伸展、延长的意思。 **一只小猴子努力伸手去够香蕉来体现 extend 有伸展、延长的意思的故事。**

> A brave explorer embarked on an extended journey. He walked for days and nights, facing many challenges. The word \'extended\' here means a journey that lasts for a long time and covers a great distance. **一位勇敢的探险家开始了一次漫长的旅程。他日夜行走，面临诸多挑战。单词\'extended\'在这里指的是持续很长时间、覆盖很长距离的旅程。**

> A man needed an extension for his project deadline. He pleaded with his boss and finally got it. The extension gave him more time to perfect his work. **一个男人需要延长他项目的截止日期。他向老板恳求，最终得到了。这个延长给他更多时间来完善他的工作。**

> A farmer had an extensive farm. It was so large that it took him days to walk around. He had many crops and animals. The word \'extensive\' means covering a large area or having a wide range. **一位农民有一个广阔的农场。它非常大，以至于他要花好几天才能绕一圈。他有很多庄稼和动物。'extensive'这个单词的意思是广阔的，范围大的。**

> A brave explorer traveled extensively. He crossed vast deserts, climbed high mountains, and sailed through endless seas. His journey covered many places, showing the meaning of \'extensively\' - widely and in great detail. **一位勇敢的探险家广泛地旅行。他穿越了广阔的沙漠，攀登了高山，还航行过无尽的海洋。他的旅程涵盖了很多地方，展示了'extensively'广泛地、大量地这个意思。**

> A brave explorer set out to discover an unknown land. After days of journey, he finally knew the extent of the territory - from the wide river to the tall mountains. It was a vast and wonderful place. **一位勇敢的探险家出发去探索一片未知的土地。经过几天的旅程，他终于了解了这片领土的范围------从宽阔的河流到高耸的山脉。这是一个广阔而美妙的地方。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a jungle. When he finally found a way out, he saw the exterior of a beautiful castle. It was a wonderful sight that he would never forget. The exterior means the outer surface or appearance. **一位勇敢的探险家在丛林中迷路了。当他最终找到出路时，他看到了一座美丽城堡的外观。那是他永远不会忘记的美妙景象。exterior 意思是外部的表面或外观。**

> Imagine a world overrun by evil rats. A brave hero decides to exterminate them all. He uses powerful tools and strategies to get rid of every single rat. Just like that, \'exterminate\' means to destroy completely. **想象一个被邪恶老鼠肆虐的世界。一位勇敢的英雄决定将它们全部消灭。他使用强大的工具和策略来除掉每一只老鼠。就像这样，'exterminate'意思是彻底消灭。**

> In a dark forest, a group of brave warriors were on a mission to stop the evil monsters. Their goal was extermination, meaning to completely get rid of all the monsters and bring peace to the land. **在一片黑暗的森林里，一群勇敢的战士肩负着一项使命，那就是阻止邪恶的怪物。他们的目标是消灭，意思是彻底除掉所有的怪物，给这片土地带来和平。**

> A little bird was trapped in a cage. It longed for the external world, where there were blue skies and green trees. Finally, it broke free and experienced the beauty outside. \'External\' means outside or relating to the outside. **一只小鸟被困在笼子里。它渴望笼子外的世界，那里有蓝天和绿树。最终，它挣脱了束缚，体验到了外面的美好。'external'意思是外面的；外部的。**
> 想象一个工厂，它排放的废气影响了周边居民的健康，这种工厂活动对外部造成的影响就是 externality 。就像一个调皮的孩子在外面捣乱，给别人带来麻烦。 **想象一个工厂排放废气影响周边居民健康的情景来理解【externality】这个词，意思是外部性；外在因素**

> A scientist was constantly trying to externalize his inner thoughts and theories. He wrote them down and shared them with the world. By doing this, he externalize d what was once only in his mind. **一位科学家一直在努力将他内心的想法和理论外在化。他把它们写下来并与世界分享。通过这样做，他将曾经只在他脑海中的东西外在化了。**

> A little bird was injured externally. But with the help of kind people, it recovered. \'Externally\' means related to the outside or surface. Just like the bird\'s visible injury. **一只小鸟外部受伤了。但在好心人的帮助下，它康复了。\'externally\'意思是与外部或表面有关。就像小鸟能看到的伤。**

> A long time ago, there were many dinosaurs. But because of some big changes in the world, they couldn\'t survive and all became extinct. Now, we can only see their fossils in museums. **很久以前，有很多恐龙。但由于世界上的一些巨大变化，它们无法生存，全都灭绝了。现在，我们只能在博物馆里看到它们的化石。**

> Once upon a time, a group of rare animals faced a big disaster. Their numbers kept decreasing until they reached extinction. It was a sad ending. People should protect them to avoid such tragedies. **从前，一群珍稀动物面临一场大灾难。它们的数量不断减少，直至灭绝。这是个悲伤的结局。人们应该保护它们以避免这样的悲剧。**

> A huge fire was burning in the forest. Firefighters worked hard to extinguish it. They used water and special tools to put out the flames and make the area safe again. **森林里燃起了一场大火。消防员们努力工作来扑灭它。他们用水和特殊工具扑灭火焰，让这个区域再次安全。**

> One day, there was a big fire. Everyone was in panic. But a brave firefighter came with an extinguisher. He pointed it at the fire and soon the flames were gone. The extinguisher saved the day! **有一天，发生了一场大火。每个人都很恐慌。但一位勇敢的消防员带着一个灭火器来了。他把灭火器对准火，很快火焰就熄灭了。灭火器拯救了这一天！**

> A poor artist was always ignored. But one day, a critic came and extol his work highly in public. The artist was so happy. From then on, he worked even harder. **一位贫穷的艺术家总是被忽视。但有一天，一位评论家来了，并在公众面前高度赞扬了他的作品。这位艺术家非常高兴。从那以后，他工作更努力了。**

> One day, a bad guy threatened a shop owner, demanding a large amount of money. This act of forcing someone to give money through threats was called extortion. The shop owner was very scared but finally called the police. **有一天，一个坏人威胁一家店主，索要一大笔钱。这种通过威胁迫使他人给钱的行为就叫做敲诈勒索。店主非常害怕，但最终报了警。**

> One day, Tom needed an extra pen for his exam. But he couldn\'t find it. Just when he was about to give up, he saw an extra pen in his friend\'s bag. He borrowed it and did well in the exam. **一天，汤姆考试需要一支额外的笔。但他找不到。就在他要放弃时，他看到朋友包里有一支额外的笔。他借了过来，考试考得很好。**

> A brave miner was in a deep cave. He used special tools to extract precious gems. The gems were hidden and hard to get, but his efforts paid off. He successfully extracted them. **一位勇敢的矿工在一个很深的洞穴里。他使用特殊工具来提取珍贵的宝石。宝石被藏起来且很难获取，但他的努力得到了回报。他成功地提取了它们。**

> A brave miner was in the deep mine for the extraction of precious gems. He worked hard to pull out those shining jewels, and the process was called extraction. **一位勇敢的矿工在深矿中为了提取珍贵的宝石。他努力工作把那些闪闪发光的宝石弄出来，这个过程就叫做提取。**
> 想象一下，学校放学后，小明没有直接回家，而是参加了各种课外活动（extracurricular activities），比如足球、绘画。这些活动丰富了他的生活，让他学到了书本外的知识和技能。 **想象小明放学后参加丰富生活、学习课外知识和技能的各种活动来记住'extracurricular'表示'课外的；业余的'**

> A criminal tried to escape justice by fleeing to another country. But the legal process of extradition was initiated. Eventually, he was brought back to face the law. Remember, extradition means the act of sending someone accused or convicted of a crime to another jurisdiction. **一名罪犯试图逃往他国逃避法律制裁。但引渡程序启动了。最终，他被带回接受法律审判。记住，extradition 指的是将被指控或被判有罪的人送回另一司法管辖区的行为。**

> A man was always secretive about his activities. One day, his wife discovered he had extramarital affairs. It was a shock. \'Extramarital\' means related to sex or a relationship outside marriage. **一个男人总是对自己的活动遮遮掩掩。有一天，他的妻子发现他有婚外情。这令人震惊。\'extramarital\'意思是与婚外的性或关系有关。**

> A detective was solving a case. There were many clues, but some were extraneous. They led him in the wrong direction. Finally, he focused on the relevant ones and caught the criminal. **一位侦探在破案。有很多线索，但有些是无关紧要的。它们把他引向了错误的方向。最后，他专注于相关的线索并抓住了罪犯。**

> One day, a little girl found an extraordinarily beautiful flower in a hidden corner of the forest. It was so unique and rare that it stood out among all others. \'Extraordinarily\' means very unusually or exceptionally. **有一天，一个小女孩在森林的一个隐蔽角落里发现了一朵非常美丽的花。它是如此独特和罕见，在其他花中脱颖而出。'extraordinarily'意思是极其不寻常地；特别地。**

> A young artist was always ignored. But one day, he showed an extraordinary painting that amazed everyone. It was so unique and wonderful that people couldn\'t stop praising. From then on, he became famous. **一位年轻的艺术家总是被忽视。但有一天，他展示了一幅非凡的画作，令所有人惊叹。这幅画如此独特和精彩，人们赞不绝口。从那时起，他出名了。**

> A scientist was studying a group of rabbits. Based on the data of a few rabbits, he tried to extrapolate and predict the behavior of all rabbits. This means he used the known information to make guesses about the unknown. **一位科学家正在研究一群兔子。基于几只兔子的数据，他试图进行外推并预测所有兔子的行为。这意味着他利用已知的信息对未知进行猜测。**

> One day, a boy was looking at the starry sky and wondered if there were extraterrestrial beings out there. Suddenly, a strange light appeared, making him think of creatures from beyond Earth. Maybe they were friendly and wanted to visit us! **有一天，一个男孩望着星空，好奇是否存在外星生物。突然，一道奇异的光出现，让他想到了来自地球之外的生物。也许他们很友好，想来拜访我们！**

> A rich man always spent money without thinking. He bought fancy cars and huge mansions. This wasteful behavior was an extravagance. His friends warned him, but he didn\'t listen. Eventually, he ran out of money. **一个富人总是不假思索地花钱。他买豪车和大别墅。这种浪费的行为就是奢侈。他的朋友警告他，但他不听。最终，他花光了钱。**

> A king was always extravagant. He spent money freely on huge parties and precious jewels. But one day, the kingdom faced a crisis and he realized his wasteful ways. From then on, he learned to be thrifty. **一位国王总是很奢侈。他随意地把钱花在大型派对和珍贵珠宝上。但有一天，王国面临危机，他意识到了自己挥霍的方式。从那以后，他学会了节俭。**

> A rich man decided to throw an extravaganza party. He spent a lot of money on decorations, food, and entertainment. Everyone was amazed by the grand and excessive celebration. Remember, extravaganza means a lavish and spectacular event. **一个富人决定举办一场盛大奢华的派对。他在装饰、食物和娱乐上花了很多钱。每个人都对这场盛大且铺张的庆祝活动感到惊讶。记住，extravaganza 意思是盛大铺张的表演或活动。**

> A brave explorer was on a journey. He faced extreme weather - fierce storms and scorching heat. But with determination, he overcame all the extreme challenges and reached his destination. **一位勇敢的探险家在旅途中。他遭遇了极端的天气------狂风暴雨和酷热难耐。但凭借决心，他克服了所有极端的挑战，到达了目的地。**
> One day, I was extremely thirsty. I searched everywhere for water. Finally, I found a well and drank a lot. It was an extremely satisfying moment. **有一天，我极度口渴。我到处找水。最后，我找到了一口井，喝了很多。那是一个极其令人满足的时刻。**

> A group of people always held extreme views and took radical actions. They were called extremism. Their behavior caused a lot of trouble and made others feel scared. We should avoid such extremism and seek balance. **一群人总是持有极端的观点并采取激进的行动。他们被称为极端主义。他们的行为造成了很多麻烦，让其他人感到害怕。我们应该避免这种极端主义，寻求平衡。**

> In a chaotic city, an extremist was always trying to cause trouble. He had extreme ideas and was willing to do anything to achieve his goals. People were scared of him. But finally, the police caught him. **在一个混乱的城市里，有一个极端主义者总是试图制造麻烦。他有极端的想法，并愿意做任何事来达成他的目标。人们都很怕他。但最终，警察抓住了他。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a wild forest. He walked to the extremity of the forest, where he found a hidden cave. With no way back, he had to face the unknown. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片野生森林中迷路了。他走到森林的尽头，在那里他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴。无路可退，他不得不面对未知。**

> A man was seeking treasure. But the clues he got from outside, extrinsic ones, led him to dead ends. Finally, he realized true value lies within. Remember, extrinsic means coming from outside, not from within. **一个男人在寻找宝藏。但他从外界得到的线索，外在的那些，让他走入死胡同。最后，他意识到真正的价值在于内心。记住，extrinsic 意思是来自外部的，而非内部的。**

> A little girl named Lily showed exuberance when she entered a colorful garden. She ran around, laughing and jumping with joy, full of energy and excitement. Her exuberance made the garden more lively. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩走进一个色彩斑斓的花园时，表现出了旺盛的精力。她到处跑，欢笑着跳跃着，充满了能量和兴奋。她的旺盛精力让花园更有生气了。**

> A group of kids were playing in the garden, full of energy and joy. Their laughter and enthusiasm made the scene exuberant. It was like a lively party, showing great vitality and liveliness. **一群孩子在花园里玩耍，充满能量和欢乐。他们的笑声和热情让这个场景充满生气。就像一场热闹的派对，展现出极大的活力和活泼。**

> A bee was gathering nectar. As it flew back to the hive, it exuded a sweet smell. The smell spread around, making the garden fragrant. Just like the bee, things that exude often give off something noticeable. **一只蜜蜂正在采集花蜜。当它飞回蜂巢时，散发出一股甜美的气味。这气味四处传播，让花园充满芳香。就像这只蜜蜂一样，exude 表示散发、流出通常是指散发出明显的东西。**

> One day, a little monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, it hurt its \'eye\' when a branch hit it. It cried and its friends came to help. They carefully took care of its injured \'eye\'. **一天，一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。突然，一根树枝打到了它的'眼睛'，它受伤哭了起来。它的朋友们都过来帮忙，仔细照料它受伤的'眼睛'。**

> One day, a little monster wanted to see the world. So, it decided to use its big, round EYEBALLS to look around. Its eyeballs were so special that they could see everything clearly. **有一天，一只小怪兽想要看看这个世界。于是，它决定用它又大又圆的眼球到处看。它的眼球非常特别，能把一切都看得清清楚楚。**

> One day, a little girl was drawing. She drew a big face but forgot the eyebrows. Then her mom reminded her, \'You need to add eyebrows to make the face look complete.\' From then on, the girl always remembered the word \'eyebrow\'. **有一天，一个小女孩在画画。她画了一张大脸但忘了画眉毛。然后她妈妈提醒她，'你需要加上眉毛才能让这张脸看起来完整。'从那以后，小女孩总是记住了'eyebrow'这个单词。**

> One day, Tom lost his eyeglass. He couldn\'t see clearly and was very worried. Finally, he found it under the sofa. With the eyeglass on, he could see the world clearly again. **有一天，汤姆弄丢了他的眼镜。他看不清楚，非常担心。最后，他在沙发下面找到了它。戴上眼镜后，他又能清楚地看世界了。**

> A fairy had very beautiful eyelashes. One day, she lost an eyelash while flying. She searched everywhere and finally found it under a magic tree. The eyelash shone with magic light. **一个仙女有着非常美丽的睫毛。有一天，她在飞行时掉了一根睫毛。她到处寻找，最后在一棵魔法树下找到了它。这根睫毛闪耀着神奇的光芒。**

> One day, a little bug landed on my eyelid. It tickled and made my eye blink rapidly. I had to be careful to remove the bug gently. Remember, eyelid is the part that protects our eyes! **有一天，一只小虫子落在了我的眼皮上。它弄得痒痒的，让我的眼睛快速眨动。我得小心地轻轻把虫子弄掉。记住，eyelid 就是保护我们眼睛的那个部分！**

> One day, a little scientist was looking through a telescope. The part he put close to his eye to see clearly was called the eyepiece. It was like a magic window that helped him explore the stars. **有一天，一位小科学家正在通过望远镜观察。他靠近眼睛用来清晰观看的那个部分被称为目镜。它就像一个神奇的窗口，帮助他探索星星。**

> One day, Tom was reading a book in a dim room. His mother warned him that it was bad for his eyesight. Tom realized the importance of protecting his eyesight and moved to a brighter place. **一天，汤姆在昏暗的房间里看书。他的妈妈警告他这对他的视力不好。汤姆意识到保护视力的重要性，然后搬到了更亮的地方。**

> One day, a robbery happened in a busy street. Luckily, Tom was there and saw everything clearly. He became the eyewitness and was able to describe the criminals precisely to the police. **有一天，一条繁忙的街道上发生了一起抢劫案。幸运的是，汤姆当时在那里，看得一清二楚。他成了目击证人，并能够向警方准确地描述罪犯。**

> A fairy was building a magical house. She used the most FAB materials, like shiny crystals and soft feathers. The house was so amazing and everyone loved it. Remember, \'fab\' means wonderful or excellent. **一个仙女正在建造一座神奇的房子。她使用了最绝妙的材料，比如闪亮的水晶和柔软的羽毛。这座房子太棒了，每个人都喜欢它。记住，\'fab\'意思是极好的、绝妙的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved listening to stories. His grandpa always told him fables about talking animals and magical adventures. These fables taught the boy many lessons and made him happy. **从前，有个小男孩喜欢听故事。他爷爷总是给他讲关于会说话的动物和神奇冒险的寓言。这些寓言给男孩上了很多课，也让他很开心。**

> Long ago, there was a fabled city that was said to have unlimited wealth. Everyone wanted to find it. But it was so mysterious that no one could ever reach it. This made the city even more fabled. **很久以前，有一个传说中的城市，据说拥有无限的财富。每个人都想找到它。但它是如此神秘，以至于没有人能够到达。这使得这座城市更加富有传奇色彩。**

> A tailor was working hard with different fabrics. One day, a special fabric with a beautiful pattern caught his eye. It was so fine and smooth. From then on, he always remembered this amazing fabric. **一位裁缝正在努力处理各种织物。有一天，一块有着漂亮图案的特殊织物吸引了他的目光。它如此精美光滑。从那以后，他总是记得这块令人惊叹的织物。**

> A factory worker named Jack was accused of fabricating parts. But he insisted he was innocent. Later, it was found that someone else had done it. Jack was relieved as the truth came out and his name was cleared. **一位名叫杰克的工厂工人被指控伪造零件。但他坚称自己是无辜的。后来，发现是别人干的。随着真相大白，杰克松了一口气，他的名声也得以恢复。**

> A factory worker was accused of fabrication. He claimed to have made high-quality products but in fact, he was just lying. His false claims led to big problems. Remember, fabrication means making up false things. **一位工厂工人被指控造假。他声称制造了高质量的产品，但实际上他在撒谎。他的虚假声称导致了大问题。记住，fabrication 意思是编造虚假的事物。**

> A fairy had a fabulous magic wand. With it, she could create wonderful things. One day, she used it to make a beautiful garden full of colorful flowers. The scene was just fabulous. **一位仙女有一根神奇的魔杖。凭借它，她能创造出奇妙的东西。有一天，她用它打造了一座满是五颜六色花朵的美丽花园。这景象简直太美妙了。**
> 想象一个古老的城堡，城堡的正面（facade）非常华丽壮观，吸引了众多游客。但其实内部有些破败。这个华丽的正面就像facade，只是表面的样子，不一定代表真实的全部。 **想象一座古老城堡的正面很华丽壮观，但内部破败，借此理解facade意为表面、外观**

> One day, a little monkey saw a big mirror. When it looked into the mirror, the first thing it saw was its own face. It made funny expressions and the face in the mirror did the same. The monkey was so happy to see its face. **一天，一只小猴子看到了一面大镜子。当它看向镜子时，首先看到的就是自己的脸。它做了有趣的表情，镜子里的脸也做了同样的动作。猴子看到自己的脸非常高兴。**

> In a big city, a detective was chasing a criminal who wore a mask, making him seem faceless. The detective was determined to uncover the identity behind that faceless mask. Finally, justice prevailed. **在一个大城市里，一名侦探正在追捕一个戴着面具的罪犯，使他看起来没有脸。侦探决心揭开那无脸面具背后的身份。最终，正义获胜。**
> 想象一个宝石，它有很多个闪耀的面。其中一个面就是 \'facet\' 。就像我们看问题，也有不同的方面，这一个个方面就如同宝石的一个个 \'facet\' 。 **想象宝石的面来理解单词\'facet\'，表示方面、部分的意思**

> A girl had a wonderful dream. In it, she was given a magic mirror that could do facial recognition and show her the most beautiful facial expressions. When she woke up, she remembered the word \'facial\'. **一个女孩做了一个奇妙的梦。在梦里，她得到了一面能进行面部识别并展示最美丽面部表情的魔镜。当她醒来时，她记住了'facial'这个单词。**

> Once upon a time, a kind fairy had the power to facilitate people\'s dreams. She made difficult wishes come true easily, just like the meaning of \'facilitate\' - to make something easier or help it happen smoothly. **从前，有一个善良的仙女拥有促成人们梦想的力量。她能让困难的愿望轻易实现，就像'facilitate'这个词的意思------使某事变得更容易或帮助其顺利发生。**

> A scientist was working in a special facility. It had all the advanced tools and equipment needed for experiments. The facility made his research much easier and more efficient. **一位科学家在一个特殊的设施里工作。这里有实验所需的所有先进工具和设备。这个设施使他的研究变得容易且高效得多。**

> A scientist found an ancient document. But it was too fragile to handle. So, he made a facsimile of it. The facsimile looked exactly the same and could be studied easily. **一位科学家发现了一份古老的文件。但它太脆弱无法直接处理。于是，他制作了一份传真件。这份传真件看起来完全一样，并且能够轻松地进行研究。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. Every clue he found was a fact. These facts led him to the truth and finally he caught the criminal. Remember, fact is the truth that helps us understand things. **一位侦探在侦破一起谜团。他发现的每条线索都是一个事实。这些事实引领他找到了真相，最终他抓住了罪犯。记住，fact 就是帮助我们了解事物的真相。**
> 在一个古老的王国，不同的群体为了争夺权力形成了多个 faction。其中一个 faction 主张和平，另一个则热衷于战争。最终，和平的 faction 获得了胜利，带来了安宁。 **在一个古老的王国，不同的团体为了争夺权力形成了多个派别。其中一个派别主张和平，另一个则热衷于战争。最终，和平的派别获得了胜利，带来了安宁。**

> A factory owner was facing problems. He realized that many factors, like low worker morale and poor machine maintenance, were affecting production. He needed to address these factors to improve the situation. **一位工厂老板正面临问题。他意识到很多因素，如工人士气低落和机器维护不善，都在影响生产。他需要解决这些因素来改善状况。**

> One day, a little ant was lost. It wandered around and finally found a big building with many machines and workers. It was a factory. The ant was amazed by all the production going on inside. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁迷路了。它四处游荡，最后发现了一个有很多机器和工人的大建筑。这是一个工厂。蚂蚁对里面正在进行的所有生产活动感到惊讶。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He only relied on factual evidence. No guesses or assumptions. Just the hard facts. With these factual details, he finally caught the criminal. **一位侦探正在破解一个谜团。他只依靠事实性的证据。没有猜测或假设。只有确凿的事实。凭借这些事实性的细节，他最终抓住了罪犯。**

> A group of students were lost in a forest. Luckily, a wise old man with the faculty of navigation led them out. The faculty here means an ability or power. **一群学生在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，一位有着导航能力的睿智老人带他们走了出来。这里的faculty指的是能力或才能。**

> A young artist was always chasing after fads. One day, he realized that true art comes from within, not from following trends. The word \'fad\' reminds us of these short-lived and passing crazes. **一位年轻的艺术家总是追逐时尚潮流。有一天，他意识到真正的艺术来自内心，而非追随短暂的流行。单词\'fad\'让我们想起这些短暂而即逝的狂热。**

> A beautiful flower was blooming in the garden. But as time passed, it started to fade. The color became pale and it lost its freshness. Just like the flower, the meaning of \'fade\' is to lose color or vigor gradually. **花园里有一朵美丽的花正在绽放。但随着时间的推移，它开始凋谢。颜色变得苍白，失去了新鲜感。就像这朵花一样，\'fade\'这个词的意思是逐渐失去颜色或活力。**

> A beautiful flower was once bright and colorful. But as time passed, it was exposed to strong sunlight and bad weather. Eventually, its color faded. It became pale and lost its former charm. **一朵美丽的花曾经鲜艳夺目。但随着时间的流逝，它暴露在强烈的阳光和恶劣的天气下。最终，它的颜色褪色了。变得苍白，失去了昔日的魅力。**

> In a magical garden, flowers were once bright and beautiful. But as time passed, their colors were fading. It was like their magic was slowly disappearing. This shows what \'fading\' means - gradually losing color or intensity. **在一个神奇的花园里，花朵曾经鲜艳美丽。但随着时间的流逝，它们的颜色在逐渐褪去。就好像它们的魔力在慢慢消失。这展示了'fading'的意思------逐渐失去颜色或强度。**

> Once there was a student who always studied carelessly. When it came to the exam, he didn\'t review well and failed. This made him realize that not working hard would lead to fail. **曾经有个学生总是学习很粗心。考试的时候，他没有好好复习，结果不及格。这让他明白不努力就会失败。**

> A student was always worried about his failing grades. But he didn\'t give up. He studied hard and finally improved. The failing became a motivation for him to strive harder. **一个学生总是为他不及格的成绩担忧。但他没有放弃。他努力学习，最终提高了成绩。不及格成为了他更加努力的动力。**

> A scientist tried countless experiments for a new invention. But each time, something went wrong. These unsuccessful attempts were all called failures. However, he didn\'t give up and finally succeeded. **一位科学家为了一项新发明尝试了无数次实验。但每次都出了问题。这些不成功的尝试都被称为失败。然而，他没有放弃，最终成功了。**

> A brave knight was in a fierce battle. After hours of fighting, he felt faint and could hardly stand. But he gathered his strength and continued. Remember, \'faint\' means weak or dizzy. **一位勇敢的骑士正在激烈的战斗中。几个小时的战斗后，他感到虚弱头晕，几乎站不住。但他积攒力量继续战斗。记住，\'faint\'意思是虚弱的或头晕的。**

> A little mouse was exploring a big house. It smelled a piece of cheese faintly. It followed the weak smell and finally found the delicious cheese in a corner. The smell was so faintly that it almost missed it. **一只小老鼠正在探索一个大房子。它隐约闻到了一块奶酪的味道。它顺着微弱的气味，最终在一个角落里找到了美味的奶酪。那味道是如此微弱，它差点就错过了。**
> There was a fair in the town. Many people came to enjoy it. There were games, rides and all kinds of nice food. It was a fair and wonderful day. **镇里有一场集市。很多人来享受它。有游戏、游乐设施和各种各样的美食。这是公平又美好的一天。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl entered a fair. She found the games there were fairly easy and had a great time. \'Fairly\' here means to a certain degree, not completely but somewhat. **从前，有个小女孩进入了一个集市。她发现那里的游戏相当容易，并度过了美好的时光。这里的'fairly'意思是在一定程度上，不是完全而是有点儿。**

> In a village fair, everyone was arguing. But a wise old man came and said, \'Let\'s have fairness. Share the prizes equally.\' And so, peace returned. Fairness means treating everyone equally and justly. **在一个乡村集市上，大家都在争吵。但一位智慧的老人来了并说：'让我们保持公平。平等地分享奖品。'于是，和平回归。公平意味着平等且公正地对待每个人。**

> A golfer was lost on the course. But when he found the fairway, he was so happy. The fairway was wide and smooth, leading him straight to the hole. It was a path of hope and success. **一位高尔夫球手在球场上迷路了。但当他找到球道时，他非常高兴。球道又宽又平坦，直接通向球洞。这是一条充满希望和成功的道路。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical forest, a little girl met a fairy with shiny wings. The fairy granted her a wish and brought joy. Remember, a fairy is like a magical being that brings wonders. **从前，在一个神奇的森林里，一个小女孩遇到了一个有着闪亮翅膀的仙女。仙女满足了她的一个愿望并带来了欢乐。记住，fairy（仙女）就像是带来奇迹的神奇存在。**

> A young man was lost in a dark forest. He had no map or compass but had faith that he would find the way out. With this belief, he kept walking and finally emerged from the forest. Faith gave him the strength to persevere. **一个年轻人在黑暗的森林中迷路了。他既没有地图也没有指南针，但他坚信自己能找到出路。带着这份信念，他不断前行，最终走出了森林。信念给了他坚持下去的力量。**

> A dog was always by its owner\'s side, through happy times and sad. It never left, always waiting patiently. This dog was truly faithful to its owner. **一只狗总是陪在它主人身边，无论是快乐时光还是悲伤时刻。它从不离开，总是耐心等待。这只狗对它的主人真的很忠诚。**

> A puppy always follows its owner faithfully. No matter where they go, the puppy is there, never leaving. Just like the meaning of \'faithfully\', showing loyalty and constancy. **一只小狗总是忠实地跟着它的主人。无论他们去哪里，小狗都在那里，从不离开。就像\'faithfully\'这个词的意思，表现出忠诚和始终如一。**

> A thief was trying to sell a precious painting as real, but the expert easily discovered it was a fake. The thief\'s lie was exposed, and he was caught. Remember, fake means not real or counterfeit. **一个小偷试图把一幅珍贵的画当作真的出售，但专家轻易地发现它是假的。小偷的谎言被揭穿，他被抓住了。记住，fake 意思是不真实的或伪造的。**

> One day, a brave knight was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a falcon appeared and guided him out. The falcon\'s sharp eyes and swift flight left a deep impression. The knight was grateful for the falcon\'s help. **有一天，一位勇敢的骑士在森林里迷路了。突然，一只猎鹰出现并引导他走了出去。猎鹰敏锐的眼睛和敏捷的飞行给他留下了深刻的印象。骑士很感激猎鹰的帮助。**

> One day, a little monkey was playing on a tree branch. Suddenly, it lost its balance and fell to the ground. But it was okay and learned to be more careful. The word \'fall\' means to drop or go down. **有一天，一只小猴子正在树枝上玩耍。突然，它失去平衡摔到了地上。但它没事，也学会了更小心。单词\'fall\'意思是掉落或下降。**

> A detective was solving a case. The main suspect claimed an alibi, but the detective soon realized it was a fallacy. The suspect\'s story had many holes and didn\'t match the facts. Finally, the truth was revealed. **一位侦探正在侦破一个案件。主要嫌疑人声称有不在场证明，但侦探很快意识到这是个谬论。嫌疑人的说法有很多漏洞，与事实不符。最终，真相大白。**

> A brave knight was fighting a fierce dragon. But unfortunately, he was knocked down and fallen from his horse. However, with his strong will, he stood up and finally defeated the dragon. **一位勇敢的骑士正在与一条凶猛的龙战斗。但不幸的是，他被击倒并从马上摔了下来。然而，凭借着坚强的意志，他站了起来并最终打败了龙。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I saw an apple falling from a tree. It hit the ground with a soft thud. I realized that \'falling\' means something moving downwards under the force of gravity. **有一天，当我在森林里散步时，我看到一个苹果从树上掉落。它轻轻地砰一声砸在地上。我明白了'falling'意思是在重力作用下向下移动。**
> 在一个宁静的小镇，突然有颗流星坠落（fall）。巨大的冲击引发了一系列可怕的后果，尘土飞扬，辐射扩散。人们把这种后续的不良影响称为 fallout。 **在流星坠落引发一系列不良影响的场景中记住\'fallout\'这个单词，意思是（核爆炸后的）放射性坠尘；后果；余波**

> A farmer had a field that was fallow. It lay unused for a season. But then, with proper care and planning, it became fertile again and produced a bountiful harvest. Remember, fallow means land left uncultivated to regain fertility. **一位农民有一块休耕的田地。它有一季未被耕种。但随后，经过适当的照料和规划，它再次变得肥沃，并产出了丰硕的收成。记住，fallow 意思是休耕的。**

> A thief was caught by the police. He claimed he was in the wrong place by accident, but it was FALSE. The evidence proved he was lying and he was finally punished. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。他声称自己在错误的地方是偶然的，但这是假的。证据证明他在撒谎，最终他受到了惩罚。**

> A liar was constantly spreading falsehoods. One day, people discovered the truth and realized all his words were false. From then on, they learned to be cautious of such falsehood. **一个骗子总是在散布谎言。有一天，人们发现了真相，意识到他所有的话都是假的。从那以后，他们学会了对这样的假话保持警惕。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. One suspect falsely claimed to be at home at the time of the incident. But the detective found evidence that proved the suspect was lying. **一位侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。一名嫌疑人谎称案发时自己在家。但侦探找到了证据，证明嫌疑人在说谎。**

> A scientist was accused of falsify the research data. He tried to make the results look better than they really were, but was eventually found out. This shows that falsify means to change something to be false. **一位科学家被指控篡改研究数据。他试图让结果看起来比实际更好，但最终被发现。这表明falsify意思是伪造、篡改。**

> A brave knight was charging into battle but started to falter when he saw the huge enemy army. His steps became unsteady and his courage wavered. Just as he was about to give up, he remembered his mission and found strength to move forward. **一位勇敢的骑士正在冲向战场，但当他看到庞大的敌军时开始动摇。他的脚步变得不稳，勇气也开始动摇。就在他即将放弃的时候，他想起了自己的使命，重新找到了前进的力量。**

> A young athlete was running in a race. His steps were faltering as he got tired. But with determination, he pushed himself and overcame the difficulty. \'Faltering\' here means unsteady or hesitant. **一位年轻的运动员正在赛跑。他跑累了，步伐变得蹒跚。但凭借决心，他努力克服了困难。'faltering'在这里指的是不稳定或犹豫的。**

> A poor musician played on the street every day. One day, a famous director heard him and invited him to a big show. His wonderful performance made him gain fame. Now everyone knows him and loves his music. **一个贫穷的音乐家每天在街上演奏。有一天，一位著名的导演听到了他的演奏，并邀请他参加一场大型演出。他精彩的表演让他获得了声誉。现在每个人都知道他并且喜欢他的音乐。**

> Once upon a time, there was a small town. A painter lived there and his paintings were so wonderful that he became famed. Everyone came to see his works. His fame spread far and wide. **从前，有个小镇。一位画家住在那里，他的画非常出色，以至于他变得有名。每个人都来看他的作品。他的名声广泛传播。**

> A man named Tom always had warm gatherings with his family. Every moment shared was a sign of familial love. One day, he realized that \'familial\' means related to family and the bonds within it. **一个叫汤姆的男人总是和家人有温馨的聚会。每一个共享的时刻都是家庭之爱的标志。有一天，他明白了\'familial\'这个词意味着与家庭及家庭内部的关系有关。**

> Once upon a time, there was a cat. It was familiar with every corner of the house. It knew where the food was and where to sleep comfortably. So, \'familiar\' means well-known and recognized. **从前，有一只猫。它对房子的每个角落都很熟悉。它知道食物在哪里，也知道在哪里能舒服地睡觉。所以，'familiar'意思是熟悉的，熟知的。**

> One day, a traveler entered a strange town. But he felt no fear because of the familiarity of the friendly smiles and warm greetings from the locals. Soon, he became familiar with the place. **一天，一位旅行者进入了一个陌生的城镇。但他并不害怕，因为当地人友好的微笑和热情的问候让他感到熟悉。很快，他就熟悉了这个地方。**

> A new student came to the school. The teacher wanted to familiarize him with the campus. So, they walked around and saw classrooms, libraries, and playgrounds. Soon, the student felt at home. **一个新学生来到学校。老师想让他熟悉校园。所以，他们四处走走，看到了教室、图书馆和操场。很快，这个学生就感觉自在了。**

> A father, a mother, and their lovely children live together. They share happiness and sadness. This group of people is called a family. They love and care for each other always. **一位父亲、一位母亲和他们可爱的孩子们生活在一起。他们分享快乐和悲伤。这群人被称为家庭。他们永远彼此关爱。**

> In a distant land, crops failed for years. People had no food, and chaos spread. This horrible situation was called \'famine\'. It was a time of great hunger and suffering. **在一片遥远的土地上，庄稼连年歉收。人们没有食物，混乱蔓延。这种可怕的情况被称为"饥荒"。那是一段极度饥饿和痛苦的时期。**

> Once upon a time, a small town had a singer. Her songs were loved by everyone. People from far away came to hear her. She became famous. Soon, the whole world knew her name. **从前，一个小镇上有一位歌手。她的歌受到每个人的喜爱。来自远方的人们都来听她唱歌。她变得出名了。很快，全世界都知道了她的名字。**

> A famous actor was always praised for his acting skills. But once, he performed poorly. Surprisingly, he recovered and became even more famous. People said he handled the situation famously, meaning in an outstanding and remarkable way. **一位著名的演员一直因其演技而备受称赞。但有一次，他表现不佳。令人惊讶的是，他恢复了状态并且变得更出名了。人们说他出色地处理了这种情况，famously 意思是以杰出和非凡的方式。**

> One hot summer day, I was sweating a lot. Suddenly, a gentle wind blew, driven by a fan. The fan was like a hero, bringing coolness and making me feel comfortable. It was such a relief! **在一个炎热的夏日，我汗流浃背。突然，一阵微风拂来，是由一个风扇驱动的。风扇就像一个英雄，带来了凉爽，让我感到舒适。真是一种解脱！**

> A man was so passionate about collecting stamps that he spent all his time and money on it. His friends called him a fanatic. He didn\'t care and kept pursuing his stamp collection dream. **一个男人对集邮非常狂热，他把所有的时间和金钱都花在上面。他的朋友称他为狂热分子。他不在乎，继续追求他的集邮梦想。**

> A crazy scientist was fanatical about inventing a time machine. He spent every day and night in his lab, ignoring everything else. His fanatical pursuit finally led to a breakthrough. **一位疯狂的科学家痴迷于发明时光机。他整日整夜待在实验室，忽略了其他一切。他的狂热追求最终取得了突破。**

> A group of people were obsessed with finding a lost treasure. Their extreme enthusiasm and insistence, ignoring all difficulties, was called fanaticism. They were so fanatical that they forgot everything else. **一群人痴迷于寻找一件丢失的宝藏。他们那种极度的热情和坚持，不顾所有困难，被称为狂热。他们是如此的狂热，以至于忘记了其他一切。**

> A little girl had a fanciful dream. She imagined flying to a magical land with unicorns and fairies. In her dream, everything was colorful and full of surprises. This dream showed how fanciful her imagination was. **一个小女孩做了一个幻想的梦。她想象自己飞到一个有独角兽和仙女的神奇之地。在她的梦里，一切都是多彩的，充满了惊喜。这个梦展示了她的想象是多么的幻想。**

> One day, I saw a very fancy dress in a shop. It had beautiful colors and patterns. I immediately fancied it and decided to buy it for a special occasion. It made me feel like a princess. **有一天，我在一家商店看到了一件非常别致的连衣裙。它有着美丽的颜色和图案。我立刻喜欢上了它，并决定为一个特殊场合买下它。它让我感觉自己像个公主。**

> A king was going to have a big celebration. Before it started, there was a fanfare of trumpets to announce his arrival. The loud and exciting sound of the fanfare made everyone excited. **一位国王将要举行一场盛大的庆典。在开始之前，有一阵喇叭的响亮吹奏声（fanfare）来宣告他的到来。这响亮而令人兴奋的喇叭声让每个人都激动起来。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, a venomous snake appeared from a fang-shaped cave. The adventurer was scared but managed to escape. Remember, \'fang\' means a sharp tooth of an animal. **一位勇敢的冒险家在黑暗的森林中迷路了。突然，一条毒蛇从一个獠牙形状的洞穴中出现。冒险家很害怕，但设法逃脱了。记住，'fang'意思是动物的尖牙。**

> A little boy always fantasizes about having a magic wand. With it, he can fly to the moon, play with stars, and have countless adventures. One day, he dreams that his wish comes true. **一个小男孩总是幻想拥有一根魔法棒。有了它，他可以飞到月球，和星星玩耍，还有无数的冒险。有一天，他梦到自己的愿望实现了。**

> A little girl had a fantastic dream. She flew to a magical land where everything was colorful and wonderful. When she woke up, she still felt the joy of that fantastic adventure. **一个小女孩做了一个奇妙的梦。她飞到了一个神奇的地方，那里的一切都是色彩斑斓和美妙的。当她醒来时，她仍然感受到那次奇妙冒险的快乐。**

> A young artist always had a fantasy of creating a magical world in his paintings. One day, his dream came true. In this world, everything was so wonderful and beyond imagination. **一位年轻的艺术家总是幻想在他的画作中创造一个神奇的世界。有一天，他的梦想成真了。在这个世界里，一切都如此美妙，超乎想象。**

> A little bird wanted to find a beautiful flower. It flew far and far, passing many mountains and rivers. Finally, it saw the most wonderful flower in a distant garden. **一只小鸟想要找到一朵美丽的花。它飞得很远很远，穿过了许多山川河流。最后，它在一个遥远的花园里看到了最美的花。**

> A little boy dreamed of a faraway land where there were huge castles and colorful rainbows. He decided to set off on a journey to find this magical place. Finally, he reached the faraway land and his dream came true. **一个小男孩梦想着一个遥远的地方，那里有巨大的城堡和五颜六色的彩虹。他决定出发去寻找这个神奇的地方。最终，他到达了这个遥远的地方，梦想成真。**

> A funny man was performing in a theater. His act was full of crazy and absurd scenes, like people running around in strange clothes. It was a total farce! Everyone laughed loudly. **一个有趣的人在剧院表演。他的表演充满了疯狂和荒诞的场景，比如人们穿着奇怪的衣服到处跑。这完全是一场闹剧！每个人都大笑起来。**

> A poor student had very little money for the fare of the bus. But he worked hard and finally saved enough to travel easily. The word \'fare\' means the money paid for a journey. **一个贫困的学生没有多少钱支付公交车费。但他努力工作，最终攒够了钱轻松出行。单词\'fare\'指的是旅行的费用。**

> A group of friends were at the port to say farewell to one who was leaving on a long journey. They hugged, tears in their eyes, knowing it would be a while before they met again. \'Farewell\' was the word filled with sadness and hope. **一群朋友在港口向即将踏上长途旅行的人告别。他们拥抱，眼中含泪，知道再次相见还需时日。'farewell'这个词充满了悲伤和希望。**

> A long time ago, a boy named Tom lived on a big farm. There were cows, sheep and many crops. Tom helped his parents take care of them every day. He loved his farm life very much. **很久以前，一个叫汤姆的男孩住在一个大农场里。那里有奶牛、绵羊和许多庄稼。汤姆每天帮助他的父母照顾它们。他非常喜欢他的农场生活。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big field. A kind farmer found him and took him home. The farmer had a big smile and wore a straw hat. He worked hard every day to grow food for everyone. **有一天，一个小男孩在一大片田野里迷路了。一位善良的农民发现了他并把他带回了家。这位农民笑容满面，戴着一顶草帽。他每天都辛勤劳作，为大家种植粮食。**

> One day, a little boy got lost and ended up at a farmhouse. The farmhouse was surrounded by beautiful fields. There was a kind farmer who welcomed him and gave him food. The boy always remembered this warm farmhouse. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了，最后来到了一个农舍。农舍被美丽的田野环绕着。有一位善良的农夫欢迎他，并给他食物。这个男孩永远记住了这个温暖的农舍。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He loved farming. Every day, he worked hard in the fields, planting seeds and caring for the crops. His farming brought a bountiful harvest and made him very happy. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他热爱农耕。每天，他在田间辛勤劳作，播种并照料庄稼。他的农耕带来了丰硕的收成，让他非常开心。**

> Once upon a time, a young farmer was very happy on his farmland. He grew various crops and raised lovely animals. The farmland was his world of hope and dreams. **从前，有个年轻的农夫在他的农田里非常开心。他种了各种各样的庄稼，还养了可爱的动物。这片农田是他充满希望和梦想的世界。**

> One day, Tom was in a quiet library. Suddenly, a loud \'fart\' sound broke the silence. Everyone looked around, and Tom\'s face turned red. It was so embarrassing! **有一天，汤姆在安静的图书馆里。突然，一声响亮的"屁"声打破了寂静。每个人都四处张望，汤姆的脸变红了。太尴尬了！**

> A little girl was walking in a forest. Suddenly, she saw a beautiful butterfly with colorful wings. The butterfly\'s charm fascinated her. She forgot everything and just stared, completely drawn in by its beauty. **一个小女孩在森林里散步。突然，她看到一只翅膀色彩斑斓的美丽蝴蝶。蝴蝶的魅力使她着迷。她忘记了一切，只是盯着看，完全被它的美丽吸引住了。**

> One day, I went to a magic show. The magician\'s tricks were fascinating. Everyone was completely drawn in by his amazing performance. It was so wonderful that I couldn\'t take my eyes off the stage. **有一天，我去看了一场魔术表演。魔术师的戏法令人着迷。每个人都完全被他精彩的表演吸引住了。太精彩了，我眼睛都无法从舞台上移开。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist was deeply attracted by the beauty of a mysterious old castle. The charm and mystery of the castle filled him with fascination. He spent days exploring it, unable to resist its allure. **从前，一位年轻的艺术家被一座神秘的古老城堡的美丽深深吸引。城堡的魅力和神秘让他充满了着迷。他花了好几天探索它，无法抗拒它的诱惑。**

> A long time ago, in a kingdom, a cruel leader emerged. He imposed strict rules, controlled people\'s thoughts, and suppressed opposition. This leader\'s way was called fascism, which brought great pain and disaster to the people. **很久以前，在一个王国，出现了一位残暴的领导者。他施行严格的规则，控制人们的思想，打压反对意见。这位领导者的这种方式被称为法西斯主义，给人民带来了巨大的痛苦和灾难。**

> A group of people were being oppressed by a powerful leader. This leader was a fascist, who was cruel and only cared about his own power. The people fought hard to get rid of this fascist and regain their freedom. **一群人正受到一位强大领导人的压迫。这位领导人是个法西斯主义者，他残忍且只在乎自己的权力。人们奋力抗争以摆脱这个法西斯主义者并重新获得自由。**

> A girl named Lily loved to create her own unique style. She spent hours choosing clothes and accessories, always following the latest trends. Her passion for this was her way of expressing \'fashion\', which means the popular style at a particular time. **一个叫莉莉的女孩喜欢创造自己独特的风格。她花数小时挑选衣服和配饰，总是追随最新潮流。她对此的热情就是她表达"时尚"的方式，"时尚"指的是特定时期的流行风格。**

> One day, Lily went to a party. Everyone was dressed in fashionable clothes. She noticed a girl wearing a unique dress and realized that being fashionable means standing out with style. From then on, Lily tried to be fashionable too. **有一天，莉莉去参加一个派对。每个人都穿着时髦的衣服。她注意到一个女孩穿着独特的裙子，并意识到时髦意味着以独特的风格脱颖而出。从那以后，莉莉也努力变得时髦起来。**

> A hungry rabbit was running very fast to reach the carrot field. It wanted to eat as soon as possible. But it was so fast that it almost missed the field. \'Fast\' means moving at a high speed. **一只饥饿的兔子跑得非常快，想要尽快到达胡萝卜地。它速度太快，差点错过那块地。'fast'意思是快速移动。**

> The pitcher threw a fastball so fast that it looked like a blur. The batter was caught off guard. But with practice, he learned to hit the fastball. Fastball means a baseball pitch thrown at high speed. **投手投出了一个快速球，快得看起来像一道模糊的影子。击球手措手不及。但通过练习，他学会了击打快速球。fastball 意思是（棒球中的）快速直球。**

> One day, Tom was on a boat trip. The wind was strong and the waves were high. To stay safe, he had to fasten his seat belt tightly. With the belt fastened, he felt secure and could enjoy the ride. **一天，汤姆在乘船旅行。风很大，浪很高。为了保证安全，他必须紧紧系好安全带。安全带系好后，他感到很安全，并能享受这次旅程。**

> A little monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, its hat flew off. Luckily, it found a fastener to fix the hat. The fastener was like a magic helper, keeping the hat in place. **一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。突然，它的帽子飞掉了。幸运的是，它找到了一个扣件来固定帽子。这个扣件就像一个神奇的帮手，让帽子固定住了。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a race. Tom ran very hard, but Jerry was faster. Jerry reached the finish line first and won the game. Tom learned that being faster can lead to victory. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞进行赛跑。汤姆跑得很努力，但杰瑞更快。杰瑞第一个到达终点线并赢得了比赛。汤姆明白了更快才能获胜。**

> One day, a little monkey saw a big fat bear eating honey. The monkey thought the bear was so fat because it ate too much sweet honey. But the bear said it was just naturally big and fat and happy like this. **一天，一只小猴子看到一只大胖熊在吃蜂蜜。猴子认为熊这么胖是因为吃了太多甜甜的蜂蜜。但熊说它只是天生就又大又胖，还很喜欢这样。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious cave. Unknowingly, he stepped on a hidden trap. This one step proved fatal as the cave started to collapse. Luckily, he was rescued at the last moment. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。不知不觉中，他踩到了一个隐藏的陷阱。这一步被证明是致命的，因为洞穴开始崩塌。幸运的是，他在最后一刻获救了。**

> One day, a car accident happened. A man was seriously injured. Unfortunately, despite the efforts of the doctors, his injuries proved fatal and he passed away. This incident made everyone realize the fatality of such accidents. **一天，发生了一场车祸。一名男子受了重伤。不幸的是，尽管医生尽力了，他的伤还是致命的，他去世了。这件事让每个人都意识到这类事故的致命性。**

> A brave detective was chasing a criminal. Unfortunately, he was shot fatally. But his spirit remained, inspiring others to fight for justice. The word \'fatally\' means causing death or having a deadly effect. **一位勇敢的侦探在追捕罪犯。不幸的是，他受到了致命的枪击。但他的精神留存下来，激励着其他人去为正义而战。单词\'fatally\'意思是致命地；灾难性地**

> A brave knight was on a journey. He faced many challenges, but he believed that fate would lead him to victory. Eventually, he found a magical sword and saved the kingdom. His story shows that fate can bring unexpected rewards. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了旅程。他面临诸多挑战，但他坚信命运会引领他走向胜利。最终，他找到了一把神奇的剑并拯救了王国。他的故事表明命运能带来意想不到的回报。**

> A young adventurer was lost in the forest. One fateful night, he saw a bright star and followed it, leading him to a safe village. This night changed his life forever. \'Fateful\' means having an important, often decisive effect. **一位年轻的冒险家在森林里迷路了。在一个决定性的夜晚，他看到了一颗明亮的星星并跟随它，这把他带到了一个安全的村庄。这个夜晚永远地改变了他的生活。\'fateful\'意思是具有重要的、通常是决定性的影响。**

> A little boy was lost in a big forest. He was scared and cried. Then a strong man came and held his hand. The man was his father. Father means the one who protects and loves you always. **一个小男孩在大森林里迷路了。他很害怕并哭了起来。然后一个强壮的男人来了，握住他的手。这个男人就是他的父亲。父亲意味着永远保护和爱你的那个人。**

> A young man always dreamt of being a great father. One day, he held his newborn baby and felt the true meaning of fatherhood. It was not just about providing but also giving love and guidance. **一个年轻人总是梦想成为一个伟大的父亲。有一天，他抱着自己刚出生的孩子，感受到了为人父的真正意义。这不仅是提供物质，更是给予爱和引导。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. He tried to fathom the depth to find a way out. He threw a rope with knots and measured. Finally, he understood the situation and was saved. **一位水手在海上迷路了。他试图测量水深来寻找出路。他扔出带有绳结的绳子进行测量。最终，他弄明白了状况并得救了。**

> A hardworking ant carried heavy food all day, feeling extreme fatigue. It struggled to move but kept going. Finally, it reached the nest, knowing its effort was worth it despite the fatigue. **一只勤劳的蚂蚁一整天都搬运着沉重的食物，感到极度疲劳。它艰难地移动但仍坚持着。最后，它到达了巢穴，尽管疲劳但知道自己的努力是值得的。**

> The little pig was very thin. But the farmer wanted to fatten it up. So he gave the pig lots of delicious food every day. Soon, the pig became fat and strong. **小猪原本很瘦。但是农夫想要把它养肥。所以他每天都给小猪很多美味的食物。很快，小猪就变得又胖又壮。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to eat junk food. As a result, he became very fatty. His friends laughed at him, and then he decided to change his diet and do exercise to be healthy. **从前，有一个小男孩特别喜欢吃垃圾食品。结果，他变得非常胖。他的朋友们都嘲笑他，于是他决定改变饮食并做运动来保持健康。**

> One day, I was very thirsty. I opened the faucet in the kitchen, and clear water flowed out. With the help of this faucet, I quickly filled my glass and quenched my thirst. The faucet is like a magic key to water. **有一天，我非常口渴。我打开厨房的水龙头，清澈的水流出。借助这个水龙头，我很快装满了杯子，解了渴。水龙头就像获取水的神奇钥匙。**

> A brave explorer was climbing a mountain. When he reached the top, he found a crack in the rock, which was the fault. It made him realize that even in the toughest journey, there could be unseen flaws. **一位勇敢的探险家正在爬山。当他到达山顶时，发现岩石上有一条裂缝，这就是断层。这让他意识到，即使在最艰难的旅程中，也可能存在看不见的缺陷。**

> A factory was producing toys. But one day, many customers complained. The reason was that some toys were faulty. They had broken parts and couldn\'t work properly. The factory owner realized they had a big problem. **一家工厂正在生产玩具。但有一天，许多顾客投诉。原因是有些玩具是有缺陷的。它们有破损的部件，不能正常工作。工厂老板意识到他们有个大问题。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的森林里，住着各种奇妙的动物。有兔子、狐狸、鸟儿等等。这些动物组成的群体就叫 \'fauna\' 。它们一起构成了森林独特的动物世界。 **想象在神秘森林中，由兔子、狐狸、鸟儿等组成的动物群体被称为\'fauna\'，即动物群。**

> One day, I lost my way in a strange city. A kind man gave me directions and helped me find my destination. I was so grateful. His act was a great favor to me. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。一位善良的男士给我指路并帮我找到了目的地。我非常感激。他的行为对我来说是个极大的帮助。**

> Once upon a time, a student did extremely well in an exam. The teacher gave him a favorable comment, meaning approving and positive. This made the student very happy and more confident. **从前，有个学生在一次考试中考得非常好。老师给了他一个有利的评价，意思是赞同和积极的。这让这个学生非常高兴并且更有自信。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl did a good deed. Everyone responded favorably, praising her kindness. This made her very happy. \'Favorably\' means in a positive or approving way. **从前，有个小女孩做了一件好事。每个人都积极回应，称赞她的善良。这让她非常开心。'favorably'意思是以积极或赞同的方式。**

> Once upon a time, there was a king who favored a brave knight. The knight always got special rewards and privileges because of the king\'s favor. So, \'favored\' means being liked or preferred by someone important. **从前，有一位国王偏爱一位勇敢的骑士。由于国王的偏爱，这位骑士总是得到特殊的奖励和特权。所以，\'favored\'意思是被重要的人喜欢或偏爱。**

> One day, I went to a store. There were many toys. But a cute teddy bear was my favorite. I took it home happily. It became my best friend. **有一天，我去了一家商店。那里有很多玩具。但一只可爱的泰迪熊是我的最爱。我开心地把它带回家。它成了我最好的朋友。**

> The king\'s favoritism towards his youngest son caused chaos in the kingdom. Everyone was jealous and fought. But in the end, the king realized his mistake and tried to be fair. Favoritism means giving unfair preferential treatment to someone. **国王对他小儿子的偏袒在王国里引起了混乱。每个人都嫉妒并争斗。但最后，国王意识到了他的错误并试图做到公平。favoritism 意思是对某人给予不公平的偏袒。**

> One day, in the forest, a little deer was born. It was a fawn. It had big eyes and soft fur. Everyone loved its cute look. The fawn was shy but friendly, hopping around joyfully. **有一天，在森林里，一只小鹿出生了。它是一只幼鹿。它有着大大的眼睛和柔软的皮毛。每个人都喜欢它可爱的模样。这只幼鹿很害羞但很友好，欢快地蹦蹦跳跳。**

> One day, the boss was in a hurry and needed to send an important document immediately. He used the fax machine to quickly transmit the pages and solve the problem. The fax made communication efficient! **一天，老板很着急，需要立即发送一份重要文件。他用传真机快速传输了文件页，解决了问题。传真让沟通变得高效！**

> One night, Tom was walking alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, strange noises surrounded him. His heart pounded fast. He felt a great FEAR. But he took a deep breath and found his way out. Fear can be overcome! **一天晚上，汤姆独自走在黑暗的森林里。突然，奇怪的声音包围了他。他的心跳得很快。他感到非常害怕。但他深吸一口气，找到了出去的路。恐惧是可以克服的！**

> One night, Tom was walking alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, he heard strange noises. His heart pounded and he felt fearful. He didn\'t know what was lurking in the shadows. **一天晚上，汤姆独自走在黑暗的森林里。突然，他听到了奇怪的声音。他的心怦怦直跳，感到很害怕。他不知道阴影里潜伏着什么。**

> A brave knight named Arthur was always fearless. He faced countless monsters and never backed down. His fearless spirit made him a hero. Remember Arthur to remember \'fearless\' means having no fear. **一位名叫亚瑟的勇敢骑士总是无所畏惧。他面对无数的怪物，从不退缩。他无畏的精神使他成为英雄。记住亚瑟就能记住\'fearless\'意为无所畏惧。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. In a dark cave, he encountered a fearsome dragon. Its sharp teeth and fierce roar were terrifying. But the knight faced it without fear. Remember, \'fearsome\' means causing fear or very frightening. **一位勇敢的骑士正在探险。在一个黑暗的洞穴里，他遇到了一只可怕的龙。它锋利的牙齿和凶猛的吼声令人恐惧。但骑士毫不畏惧地面对它。记住，'fearsome'意思是令人害怕的或非常可怕的。**

> A scientist was working on a new project. Everyone doubted its success, but he kept researching. Finally, he proved the feasibility of his idea and made a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一个新项目。每个人都怀疑其能否成功，但他不断研究。最终，他证明了自己想法的可行性，并取得了重大发现。**

> A scientist was working on a project. Everyone doubted it, but he insisted. Finally, he found a feasible way to solve the problem and made it a success. It means possible to do easily and likely to be successful. **一位科学家正在进行一个项目。所有人都怀疑，但他坚持。最终，他找到了可行的方法解决了问题并取得成功。这个词意思是容易做到且可能成功的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor village. One day, a kind rich man provided a big feast for everyone. There were delicious foods and people enjoyed it very much. From then on, they remembered the word \'feast\' as a happy gathering with lots of food. **从前，有一个贫穷的村庄。有一天，一位善良的富人给每个人提供了一场盛大的宴会。有美味的食物，人们非常享受。从那以后，他们记住了\'feast\'这个词，把它当作有很多食物的欢乐聚会。**

> A brave knight performed a remarkable feat. He single-handedly defeated a huge dragon and saved the princess. This action was considered a great feat, showing his courage and skill. **一位勇敢的骑士完成了一项非凡的功绩。他单枪匹马地打败了一条巨龙并拯救了公主。这个行动被认为是一项伟大的功绩，展现了他的勇气和技艺。**

> A little bird lost its feather in a strong wind. It was very sad. But a kind girl found the feather and returned it to the bird. The bird was happy and flew away with its precious feather. **一只小鸟在大风中丢了它的羽毛。它非常伤心。但一个善良的女孩找到了羽毛并归还给了小鸟。小鸟很高兴，带着它珍贵的羽毛飞走了。**

> A little bird was lost. It had beautiful feathered wings. But it couldn\'t fly home. Then a kind girl helped it. When the bird spread its feathered wings again, it flew happily. **一只小鸟迷路了。它有着美丽的有羽毛的翅膀。但它飞不回家。然后一个善良的女孩帮助了它。当小鸟再次展开它那长满羽毛的翅膀时，它快乐地飞走了。**

> One day, I saw a strange bird with a FEATHERY tail. It was so soft and light that it seemed to float in the air. The feathers were like a fluffy cloud. Remembering this scene helps me recall the word \'feathery\' meaning soft and like feathers. **有一天，我看到一只奇怪的鸟，它有一条毛茸茸的尾巴。它是如此柔软轻盈，似乎在空中飘浮。那些羽毛就像一朵蓬松的云。记住这个场景有助于我回忆起\'feathery\'这个词，意思是柔软的、像羽毛的。**
> 想象一个神奇的工厂，里面的机器都有独特的\'feature\'（特征）。有的机器手臂很长，有的机器声音特别大。这些\'feature\'让每台机器都与众不同，就像人的特点让我们彼此区分一样。 **想象一个神奇的工厂，其中的机器都有独特的特征。有的机器手臂很长，有的机器声音很大。这些特征让每台机器都不一样，就像人的特点使我们相互区分。**

> A famous actor was featured in a new movie. Everyone was excited to see his outstanding performance. The word \'featured\' here means to have someone or something as a main part or attraction. **一位著名演员在一部新电影中担任主演。每个人都很兴奋能看到他出色的表演。单词\'featured\'在这里指让某人或某物成为主要部分或吸引人的点。**

> One day, a scientist was studying samples in the laboratory. He found some strange substances and labeled them as \'fecal\'. Later, he realized these fecal matters could provide important clues for his research. **一天，一位科学家在实验室研究样本。他发现了一些奇怪的物质，并将其标记为"粪便的"。后来，他意识到这些粪便物质可以为他的研究提供重要线索。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the park and saw a dog leaving feces on the grass. He quickly found a cleaner to deal with it. Feces are the waste matter that comes out of our bodies. **有一天，汤姆在公园散步，看到一只狗在草地上留下粪便。他很快找来了清洁工来处理。feces 就是从我们身体排出的废物。**

> A hungry bird was sitting in the tree. Suddenly, a kind person came and FED it with delicious worms. The bird chirped happily. Now you remember \'fed\' means to give food to someone or something. **一只饥饿的鸟坐在树上。突然，一个善良的人来了，给它喂了美味的虫子。鸟欢快地鸣叫。现在你记住"fed"意思是给某人或某物提供食物。**
> 想象一个国家面临巨大危机，这时出现了一支团结有力的队伍，他们来自各个地区，为了共同的目标联合起来。这种联合的力量就像\'federal\'所代表的联邦制，将分散的部分凝聚成一个强大整体。 **想象一个国家面临危机时出现的联合力量来辅助理解\'federal（联邦的；联邦制的）\'这个单词**

> A group of friends decided to build a new community. They discussed how to manage it and agreed on federalism. They would have a central authority but also give some power to local areas. This way, everyone\'s voice could be heard. **一群朋友决定建立一个新的社区。他们讨论如何管理它，并同意采用联邦制。他们会有一个中央权威，但也会给一些地方权力。这样，每个人的声音都能被听到。**

> A young man dreamed of a fair and unified country. He worked hard to ensure laws were enforced federally, making sure everyone had equal rights and opportunities. Finally, his efforts led to a more harmonious nation. **一个年轻人梦想着有一个公平统一的国家。他努力确保法律在联邦层面得到执行，以保证每个人都有平等的权利和机会。最终，他的努力造就了一个更和谐的国家。**

> Once upon a time, there were many small kingdoms. They decided to unite and form a federation to be stronger. They shared resources and worked together for a common goal. Federation means a group of states or organizations united for a common purpose. **从前，有许多小王国。他们决定联合起来组成一个联盟以变得更强大。他们共享资源，为了一个共同的目标而共同努力。federation 意思是为了共同目的而联合在一起的一组国家或组织。**

> A poor student was worried about the fee for a special course. But when he got a part-time job and earned enough money, he happily paid the fee and learned a lot. **一个贫困的学生为一门特殊课程的费用发愁。但当他找到一份兼职工作并赚够了钱，他高兴地支付了费用并学到了很多。**

> Once upon a time, there was a feeble old man who could hardly walk. His steps were weak and unsteady. Everyone worried about him. \'Feeble\' means weak and lacking strength, just like this old man. **从前，有一个虚弱的老人，几乎走不了路。他的步伐虚弱且不稳。每个人都为他担心。\'feeble\'意思是虚弱的，缺乏力量的，就像这个老人一样。**

> One day, a little boy went to the farm. He saw a farmer FEED the chickens. The farmer threw grains to the chickens, and they ate happily. The boy learned that \'feed\' means giving food to someone or something. **有一天，一个小男孩去了农场。他看到一个农夫喂鸡。农夫把谷物扔给鸡，它们吃得很开心。小男孩知道了'feed'意思是给某人或某物食物。**

> A student gave a presentation. Afterward, his classmates gave him feedback. They said nice things and pointed out where he could improve. This made the student know how to do better next time. **一名学生做了一场展示。之后，他的同学们给了他反馈。他们说了些好话，也指出了他可以改进的地方。这让这名学生知道下次如何做得更好。**

> A little bird was very hungry. It looked everywhere for food. Finally, it found a feeder full of grains. It happily ate and thanked the kind person who set up the feeder. **一只小鸟非常饿。它到处找食物。最后，它发现了一个装满谷物的喂食器。它开心地吃着，并感谢设置这个喂食器的好心人。**

> A little bird was hungry. It couldn\'t find food. But then a kind girl came and started the feeding. She gave the bird seeds and watched it eat happily. **一只小鸟很饿。它找不到食物。但后来一个善良的女孩来了，开始喂食。她给小鸟种子，看着它开心地吃。**

> One day, I walked into a dark room and couldn\'t see anything. I reached out my hand and touched the wall. The sensation I got from touching it made me FEEL the texture and temperature. That\'s how I knew it was a cold and rough surface. **有一天，我走进一个黑暗的房间，什么也看不见。我伸出手摸到了墙。触摸它给我的感觉让我体会到了质地和温度。这就是我如何感觉到它是冰冷且粗糙的表面。**

> One day, when I was alone in the park, a gentle breeze blew. Suddenly, I had a strange FEELING. It was like a warm hug from an old friend. I realized it was the FEELING of peace and joy. **有一天，当我独自在公园时，一阵微风拂过。突然，我有一种奇特的感觉。就像是来自老朋友的温暖拥抱。我意识到这就是平静和快乐的感觉。**

> A thief was caught by the police. To avoid punishment, he feigned illness and pretended to be very weak. But the smart police saw through his trick. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。为了逃避惩罚，他假装生病，装作非常虚弱。但聪明的警察看穿了他的诡计。**

> One day, a little dog was feisty. It barked loudly and fiercely at a big dog. It showed its strong and lively spirit. No matter how big the opponent was, it wasn\'t afraid. That\'s what \'feisty\' means. **有一天，一只小狗很勇猛好斗。它对着一只大狗大声又凶猛地叫。它展现出了强大且活泼的精神。不管对手多大，它都不害怕。这就是\'feisty\'的意思。**

> Once upon a time, a brave lumberjack was in the forest. He used his axe to fell a huge tree. It was a tough job, but he succeeded. Remember, \'fell\' means to cut down a tree. **从前，有一个勇敢的伐木工在森林里。他用斧头砍倒了一棵大树。这是一项艰巨的工作，但他成功了。记住，\'fell\'的意思是砍倒（树木）。**

> A fella was lost in a big forest. He was very scared. But he kept calm and finally found his way out. The fella learned to be brave in difficult situations. **一个家伙在一片大森林里迷路了。他非常害怕。但他保持冷静，最终找到了出路。这个家伙学会了在困难的情况下勇敢起来。**

> A fellow was lost in a forest. He was very scared. But then he found a map and followed it to safety. Remember, a \'fellow\' can be a person, just like this lost one. **一个家伙在森林里迷路了。他非常害怕。但后来他找到了一张地图，并跟着它到达了安全的地方。记住，\'fellow\'可以指一个人，就像这个迷路的人。**

> Once upon a time, a group of fellows went on an adventure together. They shared food, helped each other, and formed a strong fellowship. It means a friendly relationship and a sense of unity among a group of people. **从前，一群伙伴一起去冒险。他们分享食物，互相帮助，并形成了深厚的情谊。这个词意味着一群人之间友好的关系和团结感。**
> A felon once broke into a bank. The police caught him quickly. He was sent to prison for his crime. Remember, a felon is a serious criminal. **有一个重罪犯曾经闯入一家银行。警察很快就抓住了他。他因犯罪被送进了监狱。记住，felon 就是重罪罪犯。**

> A thief was caught stealing a huge amount of money. This serious crime was considered a felony. The judge was very angry and sentenced the thief severely. Remember, such a bad act is a felony. **一个小偷被抓到偷了一大笔钱。这种严重的罪行被认为是重罪。法官非常生气，并对小偷进行了严厉的判决。记住，这样的恶劣行为就是重罪。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl made a beautiful flower with felt. It was soft and colorful. She was so happy because the felt creation made her room more lovely. **从前，一个小女孩用毛毡做了一朵漂亮的花。它柔软且色彩鲜艳。她非常高兴，因为毛毡做的花让她的房间更可爱了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical land. All the fairies were called \'female\'. They were beautiful and kind. They had long hair and wore colorful dresses.
