In this land, \'female\' meant the gentle and charming creatures. **从前，有一个神奇的国度。所有的仙女都被称为'female'。她们美丽又善良。有着长长的头发，穿着五颜六色的裙子。在这个国度里，'female'指的是那些温柔迷人的生物。**

> A brave knight was lost in a forest. A feminine fairy appeared and guided him out with her gentle and kind nature. The knight was amazed by her soft voice and caring ways, remembering the word \'feminine\' for its charm. **一位勇敢的骑士在森林中迷路了。一位女性化的仙女出现了，以她温柔善良的天性引导他走出森林。骑士对她轻柔的声音和关怀的方式感到惊讶，记住了\'feminine\'这个表示女性特质的词。**

> A young girl always dreamt of embodying femininity. She wore beautiful dresses, had a gentle smile, and cared for others with kindness. One day, she realized that femininity was not just about appearance but also about the inner strength and compassion she showed. **一个年轻女孩一直梦想体现女性气质。她穿着漂亮的裙子，有着温柔的微笑，并且善良地关心他人。有一天，她意识到女性气质不仅在于外表，还在于她所展现出的内在力量和同情心。**

> A brave girl named Lily always fought for equal rights. She believed in feminism, which means the belief that women should have the same rights and opportunities as men. Lily\'s efforts made people understand the importance of feminism. **一个名叫莉莉的勇敢女孩总是为平等权利而斗争。她信奉女权主义，也就是认为女性应该拥有和男性一样的权利和机会。莉莉的努力让人们明白了女权主义的重要性。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She always fought for women\'s rights and equality. People called her a feminist. She believed that women should have the same opportunities as men in all aspects of life. **从前，有个叫莉莉的女孩。她总是为女性的权利和平等而斗争。人们称她为女权主义者。她认为女性在生活的各个方面都应该和男性有相同的机会。**

> A brave knight was injured in a battle. The doctor examined him and said the problem was in his femur. The knight was worried but finally recovered after a long treatment. Remember, femur is the thigh bone! **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中受伤了。医生给他检查后说问题出在他的股骨上。骑士很担心，但经过长时间的治疗最终康复了。记住，femur 就是股骨！**

> A thief wanted to steal from a house. But there was a tall fence around it. He tried to climb over but got stuck. The fence protected the house well. **一个小偷想从一所房子里偷东西。但是房子周围有一个高高的栅栏。他试图爬过去但被卡住了。这个栅栏很好地保护了房子。**

> One day, a little boy was very interested in a sport. He saw people wearing masks and holding swords. It was fencing. They moved quickly and gracefully. The boy decided to learn fencing too. **有一天，一个小男孩对一项运动很感兴趣。他看到人们戴着面具，拿着剑。这就是击剑。他们动作迅速而优雅。这个男孩也决定学习击剑。**

> A poor little cat had to fend for itself in the wild. It learned to hunt for food and avoid dangers all by itself. \'Fend\' means to take care of and defend oneself. **一只可怜的小猫不得不在野外自谋生路。它学会了自己寻找食物和躲避危险。'fend'这个单词意思是照料，保护自己。**

> One day, my car hit a curb and damaged the fender. I was so worried. But the mechanic fixed the fender quickly, and my car looked good as new. Remember, a fender protects the side of a vehicle. **有一天，我的车撞到路边，弄坏了挡泥板。我很担心。但修理工很快修好了挡泥板，我的车看起来焕然一新。记住，fender 是车辆的挡泥板。**

> One day, a little rabbit was lost in a forest. Suddenly, it smelled a special aroma and followed it. It found a plant called fennel. The fennel guided the rabbit home. Since then, the rabbit always remembers the helpful fennel. **有一天，一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。突然，它闻到一股特别的香气并顺着味道走。它发现了一种叫茴香的植物。茴香引导小兔子回了家。从此，小兔子总是记得有帮助的茴香。**

> A man was lost in the forest and encountered a feral cat. The cat\'s wild eyes and fierce behavior scared him. He realized \'feral\' means wild and untamed, like this cat. **一个男人在森林里迷路了，遇到了一只野生猫。这只猫狂野的眼睛和凶猛的行为吓到了他。他明白了\'feral\'意思是野生的、未驯服的，就像这只猫。**

> A group of scientists were doing an experiment. They put some fruits in a sealed container. Days passed, and the fruits started to ferment, giving off a strange smell. This process of change and transformation is what \'ferment\' means. **一群科学家正在做实验。他们把一些水果放在一个密封的容器里。几天过去了，水果开始发酵，散发出一股奇怪的气味。这种变化和转化的过程就是\'ferment\'的意思。**

> In a deep forest, a little fairy was hiding among the ferns. She used the ferns as her secret cover. Every time she peeked out, the ferns\' fronds gently swayed. One day, a brave adventurer found her by following the ferns. **在一片幽深的森林里，一个小仙女藏在蕨类植物中间。她把蕨类当作她的秘密掩护。每次她探出头，蕨类的叶子就轻轻摇曳。有一天，一个勇敢的冒险家顺着蕨类植物找到了她。**

> A brave hunter was in the forest. Suddenly, he encountered a ferocious tiger. The tiger showed its sharp teeth and roared loudly. The hunter was scared but still managed to escape. Remember, \'ferocious\' means extremely fierce and violent. **一位勇敢的猎人在森林里。突然，他遇到了一只凶猛的老虎。老虎露出锋利的牙齿大声咆哮。猎人很害怕但还是设法逃脱了。记住，'ferocious'意思是极其凶猛和残暴的。**

> A fierce lion showed its ferocity in the jungle. It roared loudly and attacked other animals with great force. Its wild and intense behavior made all the creatures tremble. **一只凶猛的狮子在丛林中展现出它的凶猛。它大声咆哮，并以巨大的力量攻击其他动物。它狂野和激烈的行为让所有生物都颤抖。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to cross the river. Luckily, a ferry came and took him safely to the other side. The ferry was like a magic boat that solved his problem. **一天，汤姆着急过河。幸运的是，一艘渡船来了，把他安全地带到了河对岸。渡船就像一艘神奇的船，解决了他的问题。**

> A farmer was very worried because his land was not fertile. One day, a magic fairy came and cast a spell. Suddenly, the land became fertile, and the farmer grew a lot of crops. He was so happy! **一位农民非常担心，因为他的土地不肥沃。有一天，一个魔法仙女来了并施了魔法。突然，土地变得肥沃了，农民种出了很多庄稼。他非常高兴！**

> Once upon a time, a farmer was worried about the fertility of his land. But after using special fertilizers, the crops grew well. Fertility means the ability to produce and support growth, like fertile land for good harvests. **从前，有个农民担心他土地的肥力。但使用特殊肥料后，庄稼长得很好。fertility 意思是产生和支持生长的能力，就像肥沃的土地能有好收成。**

> A farmer was very worried because his land lacked fertilization. But one day, he found a magic potion that provided the necessary nutrients for fertilization. Soon, his crops grew vigorously. **一位农民非常担忧，因为他的土地缺乏施肥。但有一天，他发现了一种神奇的药水，为土地提供了必要的施肥养分。很快，他的庄稼茁壮成长。**

> A farmer was worried about his barren land. Then he learned to fertilize it. He spread special substances, and soon, the land became rich and could grow plenty of crops. Fertilize means to make the land productive. **一位农民为他贫瘠的土地发愁。然后他学会了施肥。他撒播特殊的物质，很快，土地变得肥沃，能够长出大量的庄稼。fertilize 意思是使土地肥沃、施肥。**

> A farmer was very worried because his crops weren\'t growing well. Then he discovered the magic of fertilizer. With it, the crops grew strong and healthy. Fertilizer became his secret weapon for a great harvest. **一位农民非常担心，因为他的庄稼长得不好。然后他发现了肥料的神奇之处。有了它，庄稼长得又壮又好。肥料成了他丰收的秘密武器。**

> A young artist had a fervent love for painting. Every day, he spent hours creating masterpieces with great passion. His fervent dedication made him successful. **一位年轻的艺术家对绘画有着炽热的爱。每天，他都会花数小时满怀激情地创作杰作。他的炽热奉献使他获得成功。**

> A man was fervently praying for his sick friend\'s recovery. His eyes closed tightly, and his heart was filled with intense hope and sincerity. The word \'fervently\' shows his passionate and earnest devotion. **一个男人在热切地为他生病的朋友祈求康复。他紧闭双眼，心中充满了强烈的希望和真诚。'fervently'这个词展现了他充满激情和诚挚的投入。**

> A young artist was painting with great fervor. His passion and energy made his work come alive. The fire in his eyes and the intensity in his strokes showed his fervor for art. **一位年轻的艺术家正在充满热情地作画。他的激情和能量让他的作品栩栩如生。他眼中的火焰和笔触中的力度都展现了他对艺术的热情。**

> A long time ago, people were always very happy during the festival. They wore beautiful clothes, ate delicious food, and had fun together. The festival was like a big party for everyone. **很久以前，人们在节日期间总是非常开心。他们穿着漂亮的衣服，吃着美味的食物，一起快乐玩耍。节日对每个人来说就像一个盛大的派对。**

> During Christmas, the town was filled with festive lights and decorations. Everyone wore colorful clothes and sang joyfully. The smell of delicious food filled the air. It was a truly festive scene. **在圣诞节期间，小镇布满了喜庆的灯光和装饰。每个人都穿着彩色的衣服，欢快地歌唱。空气中弥漫着美食的香气。这是一个真正充满节日气氛的场景。**

> A group of friends decided to have a big party for the festivity. They decorated the place, cooked delicious food, and danced all night. It was a wonderful celebration full of joy and laughter. **一群朋友决定为庆祝活动举办一个盛大的派对。他们装饰了场地，烹饪了美味的食物，整夜跳舞。这是一场充满欢乐和笑声的精彩庆祝活动。**

> A group of kids decided to festoon the classroom for the party. They hung colorful balloons and streamers everywhere. The room looked so beautiful and festive. It was like a wonderland. **一群孩子决定为聚会装饰教室。他们到处挂着彩色的气球和彩带。教室看起来如此美丽和喜庆。就像一个仙境。**

> A pregnant woman was very worried about her fetal baby. She went to the doctor often. The doctor assured her that the fetal development was normal and healthy. This made the woman feel relieved. **一位孕妇非常担心她肚子里胎儿的情况。她经常去看医生。医生向她保证胎儿的发育正常且健康。这让这位女士松了一口气。**

> A dog was sent by its owner to fetch a stick. It ran happily, found the stick, and brought it back. The action of the dog going, getting and returning is like \'fetch\'. **一只狗被主人派去取一根棍子。它欢快地跑过去，找到了棍子，并把它带了回来。狗去、拿到然后返回的这个动作就像\'fetch\'的意思。**

> A man was always carrying a strange stone. He believed it had magical powers and couldn\'t live without it. This odd behavior showed his fetish for the stone. Later, he realized it was just his imagination. **一个男人总是带着一块奇怪的石头。他相信它有魔力，没有它就活不下去。这种奇怪的行为显示出他对这块石头的迷恋。后来，他意识到这只是他的想象。**

> A pregnant woman went for a check-up. The doctor said, \'The fetus in your womb is growing well.\' The woman was so happy to hear that. Fetus means an unborn baby developing in the mother\'s body. **一位孕妇去做检查。医生说：'你子宫里的胎儿发育得很好。' 这位女士听到后非常高兴。fetus 意思是在母亲体内发育的未出生的婴儿。**

> In a small village, two families had a feud. They argued and fought over a piece of land. The feud lasted for years, making everyone unhappy. But finally, they decided to talk and solve the problem peacefully. **在一个小村庄里，两个家庭有世仇。他们为了一块土地争吵和打斗。这场世仇持续了多年，让每个人都不开心。但最后，他们决定谈谈，和平解决问题。**

> In a distant land, a powerful lord ruled over many peasants. This lord owned vast lands and controlled people\'s lives. This system where the lord had such great power was called \'feudal\'. **在一片遥远的土地上，一个强大的领主统治着许多农民。这个领主拥有大片土地，并控制着人们的生活。这种领主拥有巨大权力的制度被称为"封建的"。**

> One day, Tom felt very weak and his body was hot. He went to the doctor and was told that he had a fever. The doctor gave him some medicine and told him to rest well. Soon, Tom recovered from the fever. **有一天，汤姆感觉非常虚弱，身体发烫。他去看医生，被告知发烧了。医生给他开了些药，并让他好好休息。很快，汤姆就从发烧中恢复了。**

> A little girl was running around the playground. Her face was red and she felt very tired. It turned out she was feverish. But she still insisted on playing because she was having so much fun. **一个小女孩在操场跑来跑去。她的脸红红的，感觉非常疲倦。原来她发烧了。但她因为玩得太开心，仍然坚持在玩。**

> A scientist was working feverishly in the lab to find a cure for a mysterious disease. He was so passionate and intense, not stopping for a moment, showing the meaning of \'feverishly\' which means in an excited and intense way. **一位科学家在实验室里狂热地工作，以寻找一种神秘疾病的治疗方法。他如此热情和专注，一刻也不停歇，展现了"feverishly"这个词兴奋且强烈的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a big party. But only a few people showed up. They were so lonely. It made everyone understand that \'few\' means a small number. **从前有一个盛大的聚会。但只有几个人到场了。他们非常孤独。这让每个人都明白'few'意思是少量的。**

> A king had many apples. But one day, some apples were lost. Now he had fewer apples than before. He was sad and decided to find out why. Fewer means a smaller number. **一位国王有很多苹果。但是有一天，一些苹果丢失了。现在他拥有的苹果比以前更少了。他很伤心并决定找出原因。fewer 意思是数量更少。**

> A girl was very excited as her boyfriend proposed and became her fiance. She imagined their future together, filled with love and happiness. From that day on, she always called him her fiance with a big smile. **一个女孩非常兴奋，因为她的男朋友求婚了，成为了她的未婚夫。她想象着他们充满爱和幸福的未来。从那天起，她总是面带微笑地称他为未婚夫。**
> 想象一下，一位厨师准备了一场盛大的晚宴，结果所有的菜都烧焦了，客人非常不满。这场晚宴成了一个彻底的失败，这就是 fiasco 。就像这场糟糕的晚宴，fiasco 表示惨败、彻底的失败。 **想象一位厨师准备晚宴失败的场景来辅助记忆 fiasco 这个表示惨败、彻底失败的单词**

> A king issued a fiat that all citizens must plant trees to make the kingdom greener. The word fiat here means an authoritative order. So, remember fiat as the king\'s powerful command. **一位国王颁布了一道命令，要求所有公民都必须种树以使王国更绿。这里的fiat指的是权威性的命令。所以，记住fiat就是国王强有力的指令。**

> A superhero named Fiber had the power to strengthen anything by shooting out special fibers. One day, he saved a crumbling bridge by covering it with his powerful fibers, making it stable again. **一位名叫 Fiber 的超级英雄拥有通过射出特殊纤维来强化任何东西的能力。有一天，他用强大的纤维覆盖了一座摇摇欲坠的桥，使其再次稳固。**

> One day, a scientist was working in the lab. He needed a strong and lightweight material. Suddenly, he thought of fiberglass and used it to create an amazing invention. Fiberglass made everything possible! **有一天，一位科学家在实验室工作。他需要一种坚固且轻质的材料。突然，他想到了玻璃纤维，并使用它创造了一个惊人的发明。玻璃纤维让一切成为可能！**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的工厂里，纤维们生病了，它们变得僵硬、混乱，不再像以前那样灵活有序。这种纤维的病变就叫做\'fibrosis\'。 **想象纤维发生病变的情景来辅助记忆\'fibrosis\'（纤维化）这个单词。**

> A brave knight was exploring a mysterious cave. He found some strange fibrous plants that looked like ropes. He used them to climb out of the cave safely. The plants\' fibrous texture was key to his escape. **一位勇敢的骑士正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。他发现了一些奇怪的像绳索一样的纤维植物。他用它们安全地爬出了洞穴。这些植物的纤维质地是他逃脱的关键。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. Her love was fickle. One day she loved chocolate, but the next day she hated it. Just like her changing feelings, \'fickle\' means changing often and not reliable. **从前，有个叫莉莉的女孩。她的喜好很善变。今天她喜欢巧克力，明天就讨厌了。就像她不断变化的喜好一样，'fickle'意思是经常变化且不可靠。**

> A boy loved to tell stories. One day, he made up a tale about a magic land. His friends were amazed. But he said, \'This is fiction, not real!\' It means imaginary things. **一个男孩喜欢讲故事。有一天，他编了一个关于魔法之地的故事。他的朋友们很惊讶。但他说：'这是虚构，不是真的！'意思是想象出来的东西。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical land full of fictional creatures like unicorns and fairies. These beings only existed in the imagination. \'Fictional\' means not real, made up by imagination. **从前，有一个神奇的地方，充满了像独角兽和仙女这样虚构的生物。这些生物只存在于想象中。\'fictional\'意思是不真实的，由想象创造出来的。**

> A writer created a fictitious world where people could fly like birds. But it was all made up in his imagination. This made us understand that \'fictitious\' means not real or imagined. **一位作家创造了一个虚构的世界，在那里人们能像鸟儿一样飞翔。但这一切都只是他想象出来的。这让我们明白'fictitious'意思是不真实的、虚构的。**

> One day, a little mouse was playing a fiddle in the forest. Its beautiful music attracted many animals. The mouse was so happy and kept fiddling. Remember, \'fiddle\' means to play the violin in a casual or unskilled way. **有一天，一只小老鼠在森林里拉小提琴。它美妙的音乐吸引了许多动物。老鼠非常开心，一直拉着。记住，\'fiddle\'意思是以随意或不熟练的方式拉小提琴。**

> A dog named Max always stayed by its owner\'s side, showing unwavering fidelity. No matter how hard the situation was, Max never left. Its loyalty was a perfect example of \'fidelity\'. **一只叫麦克斯的狗总是待在主人身边，展现出坚定不移的忠诚。无论情况多么艰难，麦克斯都不离不弃。它的忠心是\'fidelity（忠诚；忠实）\'的完美范例。**

> One day, Tom was in a meeting. But he kept fidgeting, moving his hands and feet restlessly. His boss noticed and said, \'Stop fidgeting, Tom!\' It means Tom couldn\'t stay still or be calm. **有一天，汤姆在开会。但他一直坐立不安，手脚不停地动。他的老板注意到并说：'别乱动，汤姆！'这意味着汤姆无法保持静止或平静。**

> One sunny day, I went to a large field. There were colorful flowers and cute rabbits. I ran and played in the field, feeling so happy and free. The field was like a big playground for me. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我去了一大片田野。那里有五颜六色的花和可爱的兔子。我在田野里奔跑玩耍，感到非常开心和自由。这片田野对我来说就像一个大操场。**

> In the baseball game, there was a player named Tom. He was a fielder. He ran fast to catch the ball and prevent the opponents from scoring. His excellent fielding skills made the team win. **在棒球比赛中，有个叫汤姆的球员。他是个外野手。他跑得很快去接球，防止对手得分。他出色的守备技能让球队获胜。**

> One day, a scientist went to a beautiful field to do fieldwork. He observed plants, took notes, and collected samples. It was hard but interesting work that helped him learn a lot about nature. **有一天，一位科学家去一片美丽的田野做实地考察工作。他观察植物、做笔记并收集样本。这是一项辛苦但有趣的工作，让他对大自然了解了很多。**

> A fierce lion was guarding its territory. It roared loudly and showed its sharp teeth. Anyone who dared to approach would face its fierce attack. It was so fierce that all other animals were scared of it. **一只凶猛的狮子正在守卫它的领地。它大声咆哮着，并露出锋利的牙齿。任何胆敢靠近的人都会面临它凶猛的攻击。它是如此凶猛，以至于所有其他动物都害怕它。**

> A little tiger was fiercely defending its territory from other animals. It showed great courage and strength, roaring fiercely to scare them away. The word \'fiercely\' describes how intense and passionate the tiger was. **一只小老虎在凶猛捍卫它的领地，不让其他动物靠近。它展现出巨大的勇气和力量，凶猛咆哮着把它们吓跑。单词\'fiercely\'描述的就是小老虎这种强烈和激烈的状态。**

> A dragon was breathing fiery flames. Its eyes were also fiery, showing its anger. People were scared and ran away. The word \'fiery\' means full of fire or intense heat and passion. **一条龙正在喷着炽热的火焰。它的眼睛也是炽热的，显示出它的愤怒。人们很害怕，纷纷逃跑。单词\'fiery\'意思是充满火焰的或强烈的热度和激情。**
> 想象一下，在一个阳光明媚的小镇上，人们正在举办一场盛大的庆祝活动，有欢快的音乐、美味的食物和热情的舞蹈。这场充满欢乐的聚会就叫做 fiesta，大家都沉浸在喜悦中。 **想象在小镇举办的欢乐庆祝活动来记住'fiesta'这个表示节日、聚会的单词**

> One day, a little boy was celebrating his fifteenth birthday. He got fifteen colorful balloons and fifteen pieces of delicious cake. It was such a wonderful day for him. **一天，一个小男孩正在庆祝他的十五岁生日。他得到了十五个彩色气球和十五块美味的蛋糕。对他来说这是非常美好的一天。**

> The king\'s birthday was on the fifteenth of the month. Everyone prepared gifts. A poor boy had no money but made a beautiful card. When he presented it, the king was very happy. **国王的生日在这个月的第十五天。每个人都准备了礼物。一个贫穷的男孩没有钱，但制作了一张漂亮的卡片。当他呈上时，国王非常高兴。**

> A little mouse was trying to find its way home. It passed four doors and finally reached the fifth one, which was its home. The fifth door was special and colorful, and the mouse was so happy. **一只小老鼠正在努力找回家的路。它经过了四扇门，最后到达了第五扇门，那就是它的家。第五扇门很特别，色彩鲜艳，老鼠非常高兴。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to buy fifty bananas. But when he got to the store, there were only forty. He was so sad. But then the storekeeper found ten more and the monkey was happy. **一天，一只小猴子想要买五十根香蕉。但当他到商店时，只有四十根。他很伤心。但随后店主又找到了十根，猴子就高兴了。**
> A hungry monkey climbed up the tree and found some fresh figs. It was so happy and ate them quickly. The figs were sweet and juicy. **一只饥饿的猴子爬上树，发现了一些新鲜的无花果。它非常高兴，迅速地吃了起来。这些无花果又甜又多汁。**

> One day, a brave knight was on his way home when he saw a monster attacking a village. Without hesitation, he decided to fight the monster. With his strong skills and courage, he finally defeated it and saved the villagers. **有一天，一位勇敢的骑士在回家的路上看到一只怪物正在攻击一个村庄。他毫不犹豫地决定与怪物战斗。凭借他强大的技能和勇气，他最终打败了它，拯救了村民。**

> In a fierce battle, a brave hero named Tom emerged. He was a fighter, never backing down. He fought against the evil forces with all his might, protecting his homeland. Tom\'s spirit as a fighter inspired everyone. **在一场激烈的战斗中，一位名叫汤姆的勇敢英雄出现了。他是一名战士，从不退缩。他竭尽全力与邪恶势力战斗，保护他的家园。汤姆作为战士的精神鼓舞了每个人。**

> A brave soldier was in a fierce battle. Despite the danger, he kept shouting \'fighting\' to encourage himself and his comrades. It means to strive and be courageous in the face of difficulties. **一位勇敢的士兵身处激烈的战斗中。尽管危险重重，他不停地高喊\'fighting\'来鼓舞自己和战友。这个词意味着在困难面前努力和勇敢。**

> A painter was always criticized for using too many literal images. One day, he decided to change and used figurative expressions in his art. People were amazed and loved his new style. Now you know \'figurative\' means not literal but using figures of speech. **一位画家总是因使用太多写实的图像而受到批评。有一天，他决定改变，在他的艺术中使用比喻性的表达。人们感到惊讶并喜欢上了他的新风格。现在你知道\'figurative\'意思是比喻的，非写实的。**

> Once upon a time, a painter used colors Figuratively to express emotions. Instead of depicting real scenes, he used abstract forms. This showed that Figuratively means not literally but in a way that uses figures of speech or symbolic representation. **从前，有一位画家运用色彩以比喻的方式来表达情感。他并非描绘真实的场景，而是使用抽象的形式。这表明figuratively意为不是字面上的，而是以使用修辞或象征表示的方式。**

> Once upon a time, I visited a museum and saw a beautiful figurine. It was a small statue of a fairy, so delicate and charming. The figurine made me remember this word forever. **从前，我参观了一个博物馆，看到了一个漂亮的小雕像。它是一个仙女的小塑像，如此精致迷人。这个小雕像让我永远记住了figurine这个单词。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的实验室里，有一根像头发丝一样细的线，它能发出神秘的光芒。科学家们称它为 \'filament\' ，它是灯泡里的关键部分，负责让灯泡亮起来。 **想象在古老实验室里，有一根如发丝细且能发光的线被科学家称为\'filament\'，它是灯泡关键部件。**

> A detective was working on a case. He found a file full of important clues. The file was like a key to solving the mystery. Without it, the truth would remain hidden. **一位侦探正在处理一个案子。他发现了一个装满重要线索的文件夹。这个文件夹就像解开谜团的钥匙。没有它，真相就会被隐藏。**
> 想象一下，一位厨师正在精心处理一块肉，他要把肉切成薄薄的一片，这个过程就像是在塑造一个完美的\'filet\'（鱼片；肉片）。最后，这美味的 filet 摆在了餐桌上，让人垂涎欲滴。 **想象一位厨师处理肉并切成肉片的过程来辅助记忆 filet 这个单词，意思是鱼片；肉片**
> 想象在一场重要的会议中，有个狡猾的人一直不停地讲话，试图阻碍会议进程，大家都拿他没办法。这个人的行为就叫 filibuster。 **想象在会议中有人一直讲话阻碍进程的行为就是\'阻挠议事\'这个单词的含义。**

> A detective was working on a case. He spent hours in the filing room, looking through countless documents. The filing system was a mess, but he finally found the crucial clue he needed. **一位侦探正在处理一个案子。他在档案室花了好几个小时，翻阅了无数的文件。档案系统一团糟，但他最终找到了他需要的关键线索。**
> A little girl had an empty vase. She went to the garden and picked many beautiful flowers to fill the vase. Now the vase was full of colors and joy. **一个小女孩有一个空花瓶。她去花园摘了许多漂亮的花来填满花瓶。现在花瓶充满了色彩和欢乐。**

> A little bird was building its nest. It needed something to fill the gaps. It found some soft grass as filler. With the filler, the nest became cozy and warm. **一只小鸟正在筑巢。它需要一些东西来填补缝隙。它找到了一些柔软的草作为填充物。有了这些填充物，鸟巢变得舒适又温暖。**

> A chef was cutting a big fish. He carefully removed the bones and cut the meat into a smooth and tender fillet. The fillet looked so delicious that everyone wanted to taste it. **一位厨师正在处理一条大鱼。他小心翼翼地剔去骨头，把鱼肉切成了一块光滑鲜嫩的鱼片。这片鱼片看起来太美味了，每个人都想尝尝。**

> One day, I went to a bakery. The baker was busy with filling cream into the cakes. The filling made the cakes look so delicious. I couldn\'t wait to taste them. **有一天，我去了一家面包店。面包师正忙着把奶油填进蛋糕里。这些馅料让蛋糕看起来十分美味。我迫不及待想尝尝。**

> A boy dreams of making a wonderful film. He works hard, shooting scenes and editing. Finally, his film is shown in theaters and everyone loves it. The boy realizes his dream through this film. **一个男孩梦想制作一部精彩的电影。他努力工作，拍摄场景并进行剪辑。最终，他的电影在影院上映，大家都很喜欢。这个男孩通过这部电影实现了他的梦想。**

> A passionate young person dreams of becoming a filmmaker. He shoots scenes every day, edits them carefully, and finally makes wonderful films. His efforts turn him into a successful filmmaker. **一位充满激情的年轻人梦想成为一名电影制作人。他每天拍摄场景，仔细剪辑，最终制作出精彩的影片。他的努力使他成为了一名成功的电影制作人。**

> A scientist was working in the lab. He needed to filter the dirty water to make it clean. He used a special device to catch all the impurities. Finally, the water was pure. Filter means to remove impurities. **一位科学家在实验室工作。他需要过滤脏水使其变干净。他用了一个特殊的装置来捕捉所有杂质。最后，水变纯净了。Filter 意思是过滤、筛选。**

> A poor man was forced to live in a house full of filth. There were dirty clothes, rotten food, and dusty corners everywhere. One day, he decided to clean it all up and get rid of the filth. **一个可怜的人被迫住在一个满是污秽的房子里。到处都是脏衣服、腐烂的食物和布满灰尘的角落。有一天，他决定把这一切都清理干净，摆脱这些污秽。**

> A man entered a room that was filthy. There was garbage everywhere and the smell was unbearable. He realized that \'filthy\' means extremely dirty and messy. **一个男人走进一个房间，房间里非常脏。到处都是垃圾，气味难以忍受。他意识到'filthy'意思是极其肮脏和凌乱。**
> 想象一个工厂，污水横流。但有一台神奇的机器，它就像一个超级英雄，把污水吸入，经过层层过滤（filtration），最终排出清澈干净的水。这个过程就是filtration，过滤的意思。 **想象一个工厂中污水经过层层过滤最终变清澈的过程来记忆filtration这个单词，意思是过滤**

> A little fish was swimming happily in the sea. Suddenly, it saw a big shark approaching. The little fish used its strong fin to swim away quickly and escape the danger. **一条小鱼在海里快乐地游着。突然，它看到一条大鲨鱼靠近。小鱼用它强壮的鳍快速游走，逃离了危险。**

> A brave athlete was in the final race. He trained hard and gave his all. In the end, he crossed the finish line first. The final result was that he won the championship. **一位勇敢的运动员参加了决赛。他刻苦训练，全力以赴。最终，他第一个冲过终点线。最后的结果是他赢得了冠军。**

> One day, my bike was broken. I was very worried. But my father came and said he could fix it. He spent some time and finally made my bike work again. I was so happy! **有一天，我的自行车坏了。我很担心。但我爸爸过来说他能修好它。他花了一些时间，最终让我的自行车又能骑了。我非常开心！**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was fixated on a toy car. He couldn\'t take his eyes off it. His mind was completely focused on getting that car. \'Fixate\' means to focus one\'s attention firmly and fixedly. **从前，有个小男孩专注于一辆玩具车。他的目光无法从它身上移开。他的心思完全集中在得到那辆车上面。'fixate'意思是使（目光、心思等）固定于某物**

> A little mouse had a fixation on finding the biggest cheese. It kept looking everywhere and wouldn\'t give up. Finally, it found the cheese in a hidden corner. The mouse\'s fixation paid off. **一只小老鼠一心想要找到最大的奶酪。它不停地到处找，不肯放弃。最后，它在一个隐蔽的角落找到了奶酪。老鼠的执着有了回报。**

> A little mouse was trapped in a fixed cage. It tried very hard but couldn\'t escape. Finally, a kind boy opened the cage and set the mouse free. The cage was firmly fixed and couldn\'t be moved. **一只小老鼠被困在一个固定的笼子里。它非常努力地尝试，但无法逃脱。最后，一个善良的男孩打开笼子，放走了老鼠。这个笼子被牢牢固定住，无法移动。**

> One day, my bike was broken. I spent the whole afternoon fixing it. Finally, it was as good as new. Fixing things can be challenging but rewarding. **有一天，我的自行车坏了。我花了整个下午修理它。最后，它完好如新。修理东西可能具有挑战性但也很有收获。**
> 想象一个足球比赛，赛前大家都在讨论场地的固定设施，比如球门、角旗等，这些固定不变的设施就是 \'fixture\' 。它们是比赛中不可或缺的一部分，就像这个单词在某些场景中表示固定的设备或固定的事物一样。 **想象足球比赛中的固定设施来理解'fixture'这个单词，表示固定设备或固定事物**
> 想象一下，你正在参加一场盛大的烟花表演，期待着烟花绽放的绚烂时刻。然而，当烟花被点燃后，只发出了微弱的嘶嘶声（fizzle），然后就熄灭了，没有出现预期的璀璨光芒，让人感到失望。 **想象烟花表演中烟花只发出微弱嘶嘶声后熄灭，来记单词 fizzle （发嘶嘶声；失败；夭折）**

> A brave soldier was on a mission. He saw a flag waving in the distance. It was the flag of his country, a symbol of hope and victory. Remember, the flag is a sign that gives direction and inspires. **一位勇敢的士兵在执行任务。他看到远处飘扬着一面旗帜。那是他国家的旗帜，是希望和胜利的象征。记住，旗帜是给予方向和鼓舞的标志。**

> A thief was stealing jewels in a store in a flagrant way. Everyone saw him but he didn\'t care. The police came and caught him easily. Flagrant means blatant and very obvious. **一个小偷在一家商店里明目张胆地偷珠宝。每个人都看到了，但他不在乎。警察来了，轻松地抓住了他。Flagrant 意思是明目张胆的，非常明显的。**

> Imagine a huge navy fleet. The biggest, most powerful and important ship that leads the others is called the flagship. It has the best equipment and everyone looks up to it. Just like that, flagship means the most important or best product or service. **想象一下一支庞大的海军舰队。其中最大、最强大且最重要的引领其他船只的那艘船被称为旗舰。它拥有最好的装备，每个人都敬仰它。就像这样，旗舰意味着最重要或最好的产品或服务。**

> A farmer was in the field. His tool, a flail, got stuck. He struggled to free it, swinging it wildly. The flail was like a wild arm, out of control. Finally, he fixed it and continued working. **一位农民在田地里。他的工具，连枷，卡住了。他费力地想要弄出来，疯狂地挥动着它。连枷就像失控的狂野手臂。最终，他修好了它并继续劳作。**
> 有一天，小画家 Alice 展现出独特的绘画天赋，她对色彩和线条的运用有一种天然的'flair'，能轻松创作出令人惊叹的作品，大家都称赞她的这种天赋和才能。 **有一天，小画家爱丽丝展现出独特的天赋，她对色彩和线条的运用有一种天然的'才华；天资；天赋'，能轻松创作出令人惊叹的作品，大家都称赞她的这种才能。**

> In the war, the soldiers were constantly under flak. One brave soldier named Jack found a way to avoid it. He led his team to safety. Flak here means intense criticism or strong attack. **在战争中，士兵们一直遭受着高射炮火的攻击。一位勇敢的士兵杰克找到了躲避的方法，他带领他的队伍到达了安全地带。这里的flak意思是强烈的批评或猛烈的攻击。**

> A snow flake was dancing in the cold wind. It was so light and beautiful. But as it landed on the ground, it broke into tiny pieces. Just like a flake that is easily broken or comes apart. **一片雪花在寒风中飞舞。它是如此轻盈美丽。但当它落地时，就碎成了小碎片。就像flake这个词，表示薄片，容易破碎或散开。**

> Once upon a time, there was a baker. His pie crusts were always flaky, breaking into pieces easily. But people loved them because of the unique texture. So, \'flaky\' means easily breaking into small thin pieces. **从前，有个面包师。他做的馅饼皮总是很酥脆，容易碎成小片。但人们喜欢这种独特的口感。所以，'flaky'意思是容易碎成薄的小片。**

> A prince wore a flamboyant outfit with bright colors and fancy patterns. Everyone was amazed by his showy look. The prince\'s flamboyant style made him stand out in the crowd. **一位王子穿着一套华丽的服装，色彩鲜艳，图案精美。每个人都对他那炫耀的样子感到惊讶。王子华丽的风格使他在人群中脱颖而出。**

> A brave firefighter rushed into a burning house. The fire\'s flames were fierce, but he was not afraid. He fought hard and finally put out the flame. The people were safe. **一位勇敢的消防员冲进了着火的房子。火的火焰很凶猛，但他并不害怕。他努力扑救，最终扑灭了火焰。人们安全了。**

> A flaming fire was burning in the forest. A brave firefighter rushed to put it out. The flames were so bright and hot. Remember \'flaming\' as the bright and hot fire. **森林里燃起了熊熊大火。一位勇敢的消防员冲过去灭火。火焰是如此明亮和炽热。记住\'flaming\'就是明亮炽热的火。**
> 想象一下，在一个黑暗的仓库里，有一堆物品标着\'flammable\'。突然，一个小火苗出现，瞬间点燃了这些东西，火光冲天。因为\'flammable\'就是指容易燃烧的，所以要小心这些物品。 **想象在仓库中，标有\'flammable\'的物品被小火苗瞬间点燃，说明\'flammable\'意为容易燃烧的，要小心。**

> A soldier was assigned to guard the flank of the army. One night, he was so alert that he noticed the enemy approaching from the side. Thanks to him, the army was safe. \'Flank\' means the side of something. **一名士兵被指派守卫军队的侧翼。一天晚上，他非常警觉，注意到敌人从侧面靠近。多亏了他，军队才安全。\'flank\'意思是某物的侧面。**

> One cold winter day, I wore a warm flannel shirt. The soft fabric felt so cozy. It was like a hug from a friend, keeping me warm and comfortable. Remember, flannel is that soft and warm fabric! **在一个寒冷的冬日，我穿了一件温暖的法兰绒衬衫。柔软的面料感觉非常舒适。它就像朋友的拥抱，让我温暖又惬意。记住，flannel 就是那种柔软温暖的面料！**

> A bird was flying in the sky. Its wings were flapping rapidly. Suddenly, a strong wind came and made the bird flap its wings even harder to stay in the air. The movement of its wings was called \'flap\'. **一只鸟在天空飞翔。它的翅膀快速扇动。突然，一阵强风袭来，使得这只鸟更加用力地扇动翅膀以停留在空中。翅膀的这种动作就叫做'flap'。**
> 想象一下，在漆黑的夜晚，一个孤独的灯塔突然发出强烈的光芒（flare），照亮了周围的海面。这道光芒就像信号弹一样，引人注目，让远处的船只都能看到并找到方向。 **想象在夜晚灯塔发出强光帮助记忆单词'flare'（闪耀、突然烧旺、突然发怒）的故事**

> A thief was running in the dark. Suddenly, a flash of light from a police car appeared and caught him. The thief was scared and stopped. The flash helped the police catch the criminal. **一个小偷在黑暗中奔跑。突然，一辆警车的一道闪光出现并抓住了他。小偷被吓到并停了下来。这道闪光帮助警察抓住了罪犯。**

> A soldier was on a peaceful walk when suddenly a flashback of the war hit him. Images of the battlefield and the sounds of gunfire filled his mind. The flashback brought back all the terrifying memories. **一名士兵正在平静地散步，突然战争的闪回击中了他。战场上的画面和枪炮声充斥着他的脑海。这次闪回带回了所有可怕的记忆。**

> A thief was running in the dark night, with a flashing light behind him. It was the police car chasing him. The thief\'s heart was pounding as the flashing light got closer and closer. **一个小偷在黑夜里奔跑，他身后有一道闪烁的光。那是追他的警车。随着闪烁的光越来越近，小偷的心砰砰直跳。**

> One night, Tom was in a dark forest. Suddenly, the power went out. Luckily, he had a flashlight. With its bright light, he found his way out. The flashlight was his savior. **一天晚上，汤姆在一片黑暗的森林里。突然，停电了。幸运的是，他有一个手电筒。凭借其明亮的光线，他找到了出路。手电筒成了他的救星。**

> A peacock was showing off its flashy feathers in the zoo. Everyone was attracted by its bright and showy colors. It was so flashy that it stood out among all the other birds. **一只孔雀在动物园里炫耀它艳丽的羽毛。每个人都被它鲜艳和浮华的颜色所吸引。它是如此艳丽夺目，在所有其他鸟类中脱颖而出。**
> 想象一下，一位疯狂的科学家在实验室里忙碌。他手中拿着一个形状奇特的容器，这个容器就是\'flask\'（烧瓶），里面装着神秘的液体，准备进行一场惊世骇俗的实验。 **想象一位疯狂科学家拿着烧瓶准备实验来辅助记忆\'flask（烧瓶）\'这个单词**

> A young artist was looking for a place to paint. He found a flat with big windows and good light. The flat was simple but perfect for his art. It made him happy and inspired. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻找一个地方作画。他找到了一个带有大窗户和良好光线的公寓。这个公寓很简单，但对他的艺术创作来说很完美。这让他感到开心和备受鼓舞。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. When asked if he could find his way back, he flatly said no. He had no confidence at all. It helps us remember that \'flatly\' means in an absolute and definite way. **一位勇敢的探险家在陌生的土地上迷路了。当被问到他能否找到回去的路时，他断然说不能。他一点信心都没有。这有助于我们记住'flatly'意思是以绝对、明确的方式。**

> A strong wind came and tried to flatten the little house. But the house was very strong and resisted the wind. Finally, the wind gave up and the house remained standing. Remember, \'flatten\' means to make something flat or level. **一阵强风袭来，试图吹平小房子。但房子很坚固，抵御住了风。最后，风放弃了，房子依然矗立着。记住，\'flatten\'意思是使某物变平或变扁。**
> 有一天，小明参加了一场聚会。聚会上，一位新朋友对小明说了很多赞美之词，小明感到很开心。但后来他发现这位朋友只是为了讨好他以获取好处，这让小明明白这种过分的赞美就是flatter。 **有一天，小明参加聚会，新朋友对他说了很多赞美的话，小明后来发现这只是为讨好他获取好处，这就是'奉承；谄媚；使高兴'的flatter。**

> A girl wore a new dress and everyone said she looked beautiful. But she knew some of the compliments were just flattering. They didn\'t truly mean it. It made her realize that not all nice words are sincere. **一个女孩穿了新裙子，每个人都说她漂亮。但她知道有些称赞只是奉承。他们并非真心。这让她明白不是所有好听的话都是真诚的。**

> A young artist was often given flattery by people who wanted his paintings for free. But he knew it was not true praise. He focused on improving his skills instead of being swayed by the false flattery. **一位年轻的艺术家经常受到那些想免费得到他画作的人的奉承。但他知道这不是真正的赞扬。他专注于提高自己的技能，而不是被虚假的奉承所左右。**
> 有一只孔雀总是在森林里到处走动，向其他动物flaunt它那美丽的羽毛。小动物们都觉得它太爱炫耀了。后来大家都不愿意和它一起玩，孔雀这才知道不能过分flaunt自己的优势。 **有一只孔雀总是在森林里到处走动，向其他动物炫耀它那美丽的羽毛。小动物们都觉得它太爱炫耀了。后来大家都不愿意和它一起玩，孔雀这才知道不能过分炫耀自己的优势。**

> One day, I was at an ice cream shop. I tried a new type of ice cream and its special taste, or \'flavor\', was amazing. It was a mix of chocolate and vanilla. I\'ll never forget that wonderful flavor. **有一天，我在一家冰淇淋店。我尝试了一种新的冰淇淋，它特别的味道，即"风味"，令人惊叹。它是巧克力和香草的混合。我永远不会忘记那种美妙的风味。**

> One day, I went to a bakery. I tasted a cake that was extremely flavorful. It had rich chocolate and fresh strawberry flavors. The wonderful taste made me remember the word \'flavorful\' forever. **有一天，我去了一家面包店。我尝了一块极其美味的蛋糕。它有着浓郁的巧克力和新鲜的草莓味道。这种美妙的滋味让我永远记住了'flavorful'这个词。**

> A jeweler was inspecting a precious diamond. Suddenly, he noticed a flaw in it. It was a tiny crack that affected the diamond\'s value. This flaw made the jeweler very disappointed. **一位珠宝商正在检查一颗珍贵的钻石。突然，他注意到上面有一个瑕疵。那是一个微小的裂缝，影响了钻石的价值。这个瑕疵让珠宝商非常失望。**

> A princess was known for her flawless beauty. Her skin was smooth, her smile charming, and her behavior perfect. Everyone admired her flawlessness. It means having no flaws or being perfect. **一位公主以其完美无瑕的美貌而闻名。她的皮肤光滑，笑容迷人，举止完美。每个人都钦佩她的完美无瑕。这个词意味着没有缺陷或完美。**

> A little mouse was sleeping peacefully in its hole. Suddenly, a flea jumped onto it and started biting. The mouse was very angry and tried to catch the flea, but the flea was too fast and tiny. Poor mouse! **一只小老鼠正在洞里安静地睡觉。突然，一只跳蚤跳了上去并开始叮咬它。老鼠非常生气，试图抓住跳蚤，但跳蚤又快又小。可怜的老鼠！**

> A young artist was painting a beautiful landscape. Suddenly, a fleck of paint dropped on the canvas, but she turned it into a shiny star. The fleck, though small, added a special charm to the painting. **一位年轻的艺术家正在画一幅美丽的风景画。突然，一滴颜料斑点落在了画布上，但她把它变成了一颗闪亮的星星。这个斑点虽小，却为这幅画增添了特殊的魅力。**

> A little bird was a fledgling, learning to fly. It kept falling but never gave up. Finally, it soared high in the sky. Remember, a fledgling is a young and inexperienced creature learning new skills. **一只小鸟还是一只羽翼未丰的雏鸟，正在学习飞翔。它不断掉落但从不放弃。最后，它在天空中高高翱翔。记住，fledgling 指的是年轻且缺乏经验、正在学习新技能的生物。**

> A thief was stealing in a house. When the owner came back, the thief was so scared that he decided to flee. He ran as fast as he could, hoping not to be caught. **一个小偷正在一间房子里偷东西。当主人回来时，小偷非常害怕，决定逃跑。他尽可能快地跑，希望不被抓住。**

> One day, a little lamb was happily playing in the field. Suddenly, a wolf appeared and wanted to fleece the lamb for its warm wool. But the lamb was smart and ran away quickly to avoid being fleeced. **一天，一只小羊羔在田野里快乐地玩耍。突然，一只狼出现了，想要薅掉小羊的羊毛。但小羊很聪明，迅速跑开避免被薅毛。**
> 想象一下，有一支舰队（fleet）在海上航行。它们速度很快，像闪电一样。舰队里的船只排列整齐，一起朝着目标前进。这支舰队展现出强大的力量和团结，让人印象深刻。 **想象有一支舰队在海上快速且整齐地航行，展现强大力量和团结，以此记住单词"fleet（舰队）"**

> A brave hunter went deep into the forest. When he caught a wild animal, he cut open its body and saw the fresh flesh. He knew this was the source of life and energy for the animal. **一位勇敢的猎人深入森林。当他捕获一只野生动物时，他切开其身体，看到了新鲜的肉。他知道这是动物生命和能量的来源。**

> A monster had a fleshy body. It was soft and plump. But its fleshy appearance made it move slowly. One day, it decided to exercise to become stronger and less fleshy. **一只怪物有着多肉的身体。它又软又胖。但它多肉的外形使它行动缓慢。有一天，它决定锻炼来变得更强壮、不那么多肉。**

> A strong man was showing off his flex muscles in the gym. He could flex them easily and everyone was amazed. It means to bend or move something easily and powerfully. **一个强壮的男人在健身房展示他弯曲的肌肉。他能轻松地弯曲它们，每个人都很惊讶。这个单词意思是轻松有力地弯曲或移动某物。**

> A gymnast needed flexibility to perform amazing stunts. She practiced every day, bending and stretching. Her flexibility allowed her to win competitions. Remember, flexibility means the ability to bend and move easily. **一位体操运动员需要柔韧性来完成惊人的特技。她每天练习，弯曲和伸展。她的柔韧性使她赢得比赛。记住，flexibility 意思是容易弯曲和移动的能力。**

> A gymnast was very flexible. She could bend and twist her body easily. Her flexible moves won her many awards. Remember, \'flexible\' means being able to bend or change easily, like the gymnast! **一位体操运动员非常灵活。她能轻松地弯曲和扭转身体。她灵活的动作使她赢得了许多奖项。记住，\'flexible\'意思是能够容易地弯曲或改变，就像这位体操运动员！**

> A flexible gymnast was showing amazing flexion in her performance. She could bend and twist her body easily, demonstrating perfect control. The audience was impressed by her remarkable flexion skills. **一位柔韧性很好的体操运动员在表演中展示了惊人的弯曲动作。她能轻松地弯曲和扭转身体，展现出完美的控制能力。观众对她出色的弯曲技巧印象深刻。**
> A little mouse was in a dark cave. It flicked its tail to scare away the spiders. Suddenly, it saw a light and flicked towards it happily. **一只小老鼠在黑暗的洞穴里。它甩动尾巴来吓走蜘蛛。突然，它看到一束光，欢快地朝它闪去。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的城堡里，烛光在风中 flicker（闪烁）。火苗忽明忽暗，仿佛在和黑暗中的神秘力量捉迷藏。这就是 flicker，像烛光不稳定地闪烁。 **想象在古老城堡中，烛光在风中闪烁，火苗忽明忽暗，仿佛在和神秘力量捉迷藏，这就是\'闪烁\'的 flicker。**

> In a dark cave, a small lantern was flickering. The light was unstable, sometimes bright and sometimes dim, as if it was struggling to stay alive. This unstable and wavering light is like the meaning of \'flickering\'. **在一个黑暗的洞穴里，一盏小灯笼在闪烁。灯光不稳定，时而明亮时而昏暗，仿佛在努力维持着。这种不稳定、摇曳的光就像\'flickering\'的意思。**

> A brave flier named Jack was determined to break the world record. He flew through storms and over mountains. His spirit of adventure made him a legend. Remember, a flier is someone who flies, like Jack! **一位勇敢的飞行员杰克决心打破世界纪录。他穿越风暴，飞越山脉。他的冒险精神使他成为一个传奇。记住，flier 就是飞行的人，比如杰克！**

> A brave bird was on a long flight. It flew over mountains and rivers, facing strong winds. But its determination kept it going. Finally, it reached its destination safely. > A brave adventurer was lost in a cave. When he was in despair, he found a piece of flint and used it to strike a spark, lighting up the darkness and finding his way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在洞穴中迷路了。当他绝望时，他发现了一块打火石，并用它擦出火花，照亮了黑暗，找到了出路。**

> A monkey was playing in the forest. It found a coin and flipped it in the air joyfully. The coin kept turning over and over. This action made the monkey very excited. **一只猴子在森林里玩耍。它发现了一枚硬币，开心地把它抛向空中。硬币不停地翻转。这个动作让猴子非常兴奋。**

> A dolphin was showing off its flipper to the crowd. It used the flipper to swim gracefully and playfully. Everyone was amazed by how the dolphin controlled its flipper. **一只海豚向人群展示它的鳍状肢。它用鳍状肢优雅且欢快地游动。每个人都对海豚如何控制它的鳍状肢感到惊奇。**

> I was at a fair and saw a guy doing flipping amazing stunts on a trampoline. The flipping action made everyone cheer. It means extremely or very. **我在集市上看到一个人在蹦床上做着极其惊人的翻转动作。这个'翻转'的动作让每个人都欢呼起来。它意思是极其，非常。**

> 有一天，小明在公园里看到一个女孩，他忍不住和她眉来眼去，这种短暂而轻松的相互吸引就是 flirtation。小明知道这只是小小的调情，并非认真的感情。 **有一天，小明在公园和女孩眉来眼去的这种短暂轻松的相互吸引就是"调情，短暂的风流韵事"。小明知道这并非认真感情。**

> One day, I went to a park and saw many beautiful balloons floating in the sky. They looked so free and happy. Just like these balloons, the word \'floating\' means moving freely in the air or on water. **有一天，我去公园看到很多漂亮的气球在空中漂浮。它们看起来如此自由和快乐。就像这些气球一样，'floating'这个单词意味着在空中或水上自由移动。**
> 想象一下，在一片绿色的草原上，有很多洁白的绵羊。它们像云朵一样聚集在一起，这一大群绵羊就是一个 flock。突然，一只牧羊犬跑来，绵羊们乖乖地跟着移动，整个 flock 都在行动。 **想象在草原上很多绵羊聚集在一起形成的一大群就是'flock'，还描述了羊群受牧羊犬影响一起行动。**

> One day, a small village was hit by heavy rain. The river burst its banks and water was everywhere. The villagers called this situation \'flooding\'. They had to move to higher ground to stay safe. **有一天，一个小村庄遭遇了暴雨。河水决堤，到处都是水。村民们把这种情况称为"洪水泛滥"。他们不得不搬到更高的地方以确保安全。**

> Once upon a time, a village was located on a flat area near a river. One day, a heavy flood came and covered this flat area. From then on, people called this area a floodplain. **从前，有个村庄位于河边的一块平坦区域。有一天，一场大洪水袭来，淹没了这块平坦的区域。从那以后，人们就把这个区域叫做洪泛平原。**

> A little mouse was running around in a big house. It was very scared and wanted to find a safe place. Finally, it found a quiet corner on the floor and felt relieved. **一只小老鼠在一个大房子里跑来跑去。它非常害怕，想要找一个安全的地方。最后，它在地板上找到了一个安静的角落，松了一口气。**

> 想象一只小兔子，它有一对 floppy 的耳朵，总是软软地耷拉着。每次它跑起来，那 floppy 的耳朵就会晃来晃去，特别可爱。这对 floppy 的耳朵让它看起来更加呆萌。 **想象一只小兔子，它有一对松软下垂的耳朵，总是软软地耷拉着。每次它跑起来，那松软下垂的耳朵就会晃来晃去，特别可爱。这对松软下垂的耳朵让它看起来更加呆萌。**

> In a magical forest, the fairies were naming all the plants. They decided to call the collection of all the plants \'flora\'. > A girl named Flora loved flowers. One day, she wore a dress with a FLORAL pattern and went to a garden. The beautiful FLORAL scene made her very happy. **一个叫弗洛拉的女孩喜欢花。有一天，她穿着一件有花卉图案的连衣裙去了花园。美丽的花卉场景让她非常开心。**

> One day, Lily wanted to buy some beautiful flowers. So she went to a shop where a friendly person named Tom was. Tom, the florist, knew all about different flowers and helped Lily choose the perfect ones. **有一天，莉莉想买一些漂亮的花。于是她去了一家店，店里有个友好的人叫汤姆。汤姆，这位花商，熟知各种不同的花，并帮助莉莉挑选了最完美的花。**
> 想象一下，一条小鱼在浑浊的水里挣扎游动（flounder），它左冲右撞，想要找到出路。就像我们在困难中努力寻找方向，那种迷茫和不知所措的样子，就是\'flounder\'所表达的。 **想象一条小鱼在水中挣扎游动来辅助记忆\'flounder\'这个单词，意为挣扎、不知所措**

> A baker was making bread. He opened a big bag of white flour and started to mix it. The flour flew in the air like magic powder. With the flour, he made delicious bread for everyone. **一位面包师正在做面包。他打开一大袋白色的面粉，然后开始搅拌。面粉像神奇的粉末在空中飞扬。凭借着这些面粉，他为大家做出了美味的面包。**

> In a magical garden, beautiful flowers flourish. They dance in the wind, showing their vibrant colors. The word \'flourish\' means to grow or develop in a healthy and vigorous way, just like these blooming flowers. **在一个神奇的花园里，美丽的花朵茂盛生长。它们在风中舞动，展现出鲜艳的色彩。单词\'flourish\'意思是健康、旺盛地成长或发展，就像这些盛开的花朵。**

> In a magical garden, every plant was flourishing. The flowers were bright and the grass was thick. It was a scene of great vitality and growth, showing the meaning of being prosperous and thriving. **在一个神奇的花园里，每株植物都繁茂生长。花朵明艳，草地茂密。这是一片充满生机和成长的景象，展现了繁荣、兴旺的含义。**
> A river flows smoothly from the mountains. The water keeps moving, like a dancer. It flows and flows, bringing life to everything along its way. **一条河流从山间顺畅地流淌。水不停地流动，就像一位舞者。它不停地流淌，为沿途的一切带来生机。**

> 想象一下，在一个黑暗的洞穴里，探险家拿着特殊的手电筒，灯光呈现出明亮的、会闪烁的光芒，这种光芒就像是\'fluorescent\'（荧光的）。它让黑暗的角落都变得清晰可见，给人带来惊喜和希望。 **想象在黑暗洞穴中探险家手电筒的荧光光芒，辅助记忆\'fluorescent（荧光的）\'这个单词**

> One day, I was walking in the park when a sudden flurry of snowflakes started to fall. They came quickly and filled the air, making everything look magical. The flurry was short but beautiful. **有一天，我正在公园散步，突然一阵雪花纷飞而下。它们迅速落下，弥漫在空中，让一切看起来都很神奇。这场纷飞很短暂但很美丽。**

> A fairy was playing a beautiful flute in the forest. The sound was so charming that all the animals stopped to listen. The flute\'s melody spread far and wide, making the forest a magical place. **一位仙女在森林里吹奏着一支漂亮的长笛。那声音如此迷人，所有的动物都停下来倾听。长笛的旋律传得很远很广，让森林变成了一个神奇的地方。**

> A little bee wanted to fly to the beautiful garden. It practiced hard and finally could fly freely among the flowers. It felt so happy and proud. **一只小蜜蜂想要飞去美丽的花园。它努力练习，最后能够在花丛中自由地飞翔。它感到非常开心和自豪。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. The only clue was a focal mark on a window. It was the key to solving the mystery. This mark became the focal point of the investigation. **一位侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。唯一的线索是窗户上的一个焦点标记。它成了解决谜团的关键。这个标记成了调查的焦点。**

> A photographer was shooting in a busy street. But the pictures were blurry. Then he remembered to focus the camera, and finally got clear and beautiful shots. Focus means to pay attention to one thing clearly. **一位摄影师在繁忙的街道上拍摄。但照片很模糊。然后他记得聚焦相机，最终得到了清晰美丽的照片。Focus 意思是清晰地关注一件事。**

> A farmer was always worried about having enough fodder for his cows in winter. One day, he stored a large amount of hay as fodder. When winter came, the cows had plenty to eat and were happy. The farmer was relieved. **一位农民总是担心冬天没有足够的饲料给他的奶牛。有一天，他储存了大量的干草作为饲料。当冬天来临时，奶牛有充足的食物吃，很开心。农民也松了一口气。**

> In a magical forest, a brave knight encountered a fierce dragon. The dragon was the knight\'s foe. They fought fiercely. The knight finally defeated the foe and saved the forest. **在一个神奇的森林里，一位勇敢的骑士遇到了一只凶猛的龙。这只龙是骑士的敌人。他们激烈地战斗。骑士最终打败了敌人并拯救了森林。**

> One day, I was driving in the countryside. Suddenly, a thick fog came. I could hardly see the road ahead. It was like a white blanket covering everything. I had to slow down carefully. The fog was so mysterious and confusing. **有一天，我在乡村开车。突然，一场浓雾袭来。我几乎看不清前方的路。它就像一张白色的毯子覆盖了一切。我不得不小心地减速。这雾是如此神秘又令人迷惑。**

> One day, Tom went for a walk in the forest. It was foggy and he could hardly see the path. He got lost but finally found his way out when the fog lifted. Remember, \'foggy\' means full of fog. **有一天，汤姆去森林里散步。天气雾蒙蒙的，他几乎看不清道路。他迷路了，但当雾气消散时终于找到了出去的路。记住，\'foggy\'意思是有雾的。**

> A thief tried to steal jewels, but the security guard\'s quick action was the foil. The guard stopped the thief and protected the jewels. \'Foil\' here means to prevent something bad from happening. **一个小偷试图偷珠宝，但保安的迅速行动起到了阻止作用。保安阻止了小偷并保护了珠宝。这里'foil'意思是阻止某事不好的事情发生。**

> One day, a little rabbit was playing with a piece of paper. It folded the paper again and again to make a cute little boat. The act of folding made the paper change its shape and become something new. **一天，一只小兔子在玩一张纸。它一次又一次地折叠这张纸，做成了一只可爱的小船。折叠这个动作让纸改变了形状，变成了新的东西。**

> Imagine you have a big box filled with important papers. This box has a special name - folder. It keeps your papers organized and neat, just like a magic container for your stuff. **想象一下你有一个装满重要文件的大盒子。这个盒子有一个特别的名字------文件夹。它让你的文件整齐有序，就像一个存放你东西的神奇容器。**

> One day, I was at a fair and saw a man doing amazing folding tricks with paper. He could turn a flat sheet into various shapes like a bird or a flower. The act of folding was so fascinating! **有一天，我在集市上看到一个人用纸做令人惊叹的折叠技巧。他能把一张平纸折成各种形状，像鸟或花。折叠这个动作太迷人了！**

> A little monkey climbed up a tall tree and was surrounded by beautiful foliage. The green leaves and branches formed a wonderful scene. The monkey happily played among the foliage. **一只小猴子爬上一棵高高的树，被美丽的树叶所环绕。绿色的叶子和树枝构成了一幅美妙的景象。猴子在树叶中愉快地玩耍。**

> Once upon a time, in a small village, there were many kind folk. They always helped each other. One day, a traveler got lost and the folk guided him home. They were known for their warmth and friendliness. **从前，在一个小村庄里，有许多善良的人们。他们总是互相帮助。有一天，一个旅行者迷路了，这些人们给他指路回家。他们以热情友好而闻名。**

> Once upon a time, in a small village, people passed down tales of heroes and magic. These tales, shared by word of mouth, were the essence of \'folklore\'. It was the wisdom and imagination of the community, keeping their history and spirit alive. **从前，在一个小村庄里，人们口口相传英雄和魔法的故事。这些故事就是"民间传说"的本质。它是社区的智慧和想象力，让他们的历史和精神得以延续。**

> One day, a little puppy was following its owner on a walk. It kept close behind, never straying away. The puppy\'s action of staying close and going after its owner is like the meaning of \'follow\'. **有一天，一只小狗在散步时跟着它的主人。它紧紧跟在后面，从不偏离。小狗紧跟主人的行为就像'follow'这个单词的意思。**

> One day, a famous singer was giving a concert. There were many people in the audience. Among them, Tom was a passionate follower. He knew every song and sang along loudly. The singer was deeply touched by Tom\'s enthusiasm. **一天，一位著名的歌手正在举办演唱会。观众中有很多人。其中，汤姆是一位热情的追随者。他知道每一首歌并且大声跟着唱。歌手被汤姆的热情深深打动了。**

> A little rabbit was lost in the forest. It followed a strange path, hoping to find its way home. The following adventure was full of surprises. Finally, it succeeded! **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。它沿着一条奇怪的小路走，希望能找到回家的路。接下来的冒险充满了惊喜。最后，它成功了！**

> A rich man decided to build a huge and unnecessary tower. Everyone told him it was a folly. But he didn\'t listen. In the end, he wasted all his money. The tower became a symbol of his foolish decision. **一个有钱人决定建造一座巨大且没必要的塔。每个人都告诉他这是愚蠢的行为。但他不听。最后，他浪费了所有的钱。这座塔成了他愚蠢决定的象征。**

> A boy was very fond of a puppy. He spent all his time playing with it. The puppy\'s love made him feel happy. His fondness for the puppy was obvious. **一个男孩非常喜欢一只小狗。他把所有时间都花在和它玩耍上。小狗的爱让他感到开心。他对小狗的喜爱是显而易见的。**

> A little girl was lost and crying. A kind lady found her and fondled her head gently to comfort her. The girl felt safe and stopped crying. \'Fondle\' means to touch or stroke lovingly and gently. **一个小女孩迷路了在哭。一位善良的女士发现了她，轻轻地抚摸她的头来安慰她。小女孩感到安全并停止了哭泣。\'fondle\'意思是充满爱意地、轻柔地抚摸或触摸。**

> A boy fondly remembered the days spent with his dog. They played together, and the dog always waited for him after school. The boy\'s fond memories made him smile whenever he thought of them. **一个男孩深情地回忆起和他的狗一起度过的日子。他们一起玩耍，狗总是在放学后等他。男孩的美好回忆让他每当想起时都会微笑。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl who had a great fondness for cats. Every day, she would play with them and give them love. Her fondness made her the favorite among the cats. **从前，有个女孩非常喜欢猫。每天，她都会和它们一起玩并给予它们关爱。她的喜爱使她成为猫群中最受欢迎的人。**

> Once upon a time, a little monk was assigned to clean the ancient font in the temple. He worked hard to make the font shiny. From then on, he always remembered the word \'font\' and its meaning. **从前，有个小和尚被指派去清洁寺庙里古老的洗礼盆。他努力工作把洗礼盆擦得闪闪发亮。从那以后，他总是记住了\'font\'这个单词及其含义。**

> One day, a hungry little bear was looking for food everywhere. He found some apples, bananas and bread. He ate happily and felt full. Food is what gives us energy and makes us strong. **一天，一只饥饿的小熊到处寻找食物。他找到了一些苹果、香蕉和面包。他吃得很开心，并且感到饱了。食物是给予我们能量并让我们强壮的东西。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for foodstuff. It found grains, fruits, and vegetables. It was so happy and carried the foodstuff back to its hole. Now it had enough to eat for a long time. **有一天，一只小老鼠在寻找食物原料。它找到了谷物、水果和蔬菜。它非常高兴，把这些食物原料搬回了自己的洞。现在它有足够的食物吃很长时间了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who always did silly things. People called him a fool. One day, he tried to catch the moon in a bucket. Everyone laughed at him. But he didn\'t understand why. **从前，有一个人总是做傻事。人们称他为傻瓜。有一天，他试图用桶去抓月亮。每个人都嘲笑他，但他不明白为什么。**

> Once upon a time, a man did very foolish things. He tried to catch the moon in a lake. Everyone laughed at him. His actions showed how foolish he was. **从前，有一个人做了非常愚蠢的事。他试图在湖里抓住月亮。每个人都嘲笑他。他的行为表明他是多么的愚蠢。**

> A man foolishly decided to climb a tall tree without any safety equipment. He slipped and fell, hurting himself. This shows that acting foolishly can lead to bad consequences. **一个男人愚蠢地决定在没有任何安全设备的情况下爬一棵高大的树。他滑倒并摔了下来，伤到了自己。这表明愚蠢地行事会导致不良后果。**

> A scientist was working on a new invention. He wanted it to be foolproof, meaning no one, not even a fool, could make a mistake using it. So he tested it over and over until it was truly simple and safe for everyone. **一位科学家正在研究一项新发明。他希望它是万无一失的，也就是说，即使是傻瓜使用它也不会出错。所以他一遍又一遍地测试，直到它对每个人来说都真正简单和安全。**

> One day, a little ant was walking on a person\'s foot. It felt the warmth and softness. But suddenly, the foot moved and the ant had to run away quickly. The ant learned that a foot can bring both comfort and danger. **一天，一只小蚂蚁在一个人的脚上行走。它感觉到了温暖和柔软。但突然，脚动了，蚂蚁不得不迅速跑开。蚂蚁知道了脚既能带来舒适也能带来危险。**

> A filmmaker was very worried because he lost some important footage of a beautiful landscape. But luckily, he found it under his foot at the last moment. The \'footage\' was saved! **一位电影制作人非常担心，因为他丢失了一些美丽风景的重要镜头片段。但幸运的是，他在最后一刻在脚下找到了它。这些"镜头片段"得救了！**

> One day, Tom and his friends went to a big field. They had a wonderful time playing football. They ran, kicked the ball, and scored goals. It was so much fun and they all loved this sport. **有一天，汤姆和他的朋友们去了一个大场地。他们踢足球玩得非常开心。他们奔跑、踢球、射门。太有趣了，他们都热爱这项运动。**

> A young adventurer was lost in the mountains. When he was exhausted, he found a foothill. It was not very high but provided a place to rest and regain strength. Finally, he continued his journey with new hope. **一位年轻的冒险家在山里迷路了。当他精疲力竭时，他发现了一座山麓。它不是很高，但提供了一个休息和恢复体力的地方。最后，他带着新的希望继续他的旅程。**

> A brave climber was trying to reach the top of a mountain. He struggled until he found a small crack where he could place his foot. That tiny spot became his foothold and gave him the support to continue his ascent. **一位勇敢的登山者试图登顶一座山峰。他努力攀登，直到发现一个小裂缝，能把脚放进去。那个小地方成了他的立足点，给了他继续攀登的支撑。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the forest and suddenly lost his footing. He slipped and fell down a slope. But he got up quickly and continued his journey, remembering to be more careful. \'Footing\' means a stable position or base for one\'s feet. **有一天，汤姆在森林里走着，突然失去了立足点。他滑倒并从斜坡上摔了下去。但他很快站起来继续前行，记住要更小心。'footing'意思是脚的稳定位置或基础。**
> 想象一位学者在写一本重要的书籍，每到关键观点，他都会在页面底部用小小的字体写下注释，这些注释就像小小的脚印（foot），这就是footnotes，帮助读者更好理解。 **想象一位学者写书时在页面底部写下的注释像小脚印，以此记住footnote是脚注的意思**

> A detective was following a mysterious footprint in the forest. The footprint led him to a hidden cave, where he found important clues. The footprint was like a key that unlocked the mystery. **一位侦探在森林里追踪着一个神秘的脚印。这个脚印将他引向一个隐藏的洞穴，在那里他找到了重要的线索。这个脚印就像一把解开谜团的钥匙。**

> One night, I heard strange footstep sounds outside my house. I was scared and thought it might be a thief. But when I opened the door, it was just a lost cat. The footstep mystery was solved! **一天晚上，我听到屋外有奇怪的脚步声。我很害怕，以为是小偷。但当我打开门，只是一只迷路的猫。脚步声的谜团解开了！**

> One day, Tom lost his way in a forest. His feet hurt because he didn\'t have proper footwear. Then he found a pair of comfortable shoes and continued his journey happily. Remember, footwear is what protects our feet. **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。他的脚很疼，因为他没有合适的鞋类。然后他找到了一双舒适的鞋子，开心地继续他的旅程。记住，footwear 就是保护我们脚的东西。**

> A little boy was very hungry. He went to the kitchen and found some cookies. His mom said, \'These are for you.\' The word \'for\' here means intended to be given to or used by someone. **一个小男孩非常饿。他去厨房发现了一些饼干。他妈妈说：'这些是给你的。'这里的'for'表示打算给某人或供某人使用。**

> A hungry rabbit had to forage in the forest to find food. It searched everywhere, looking for fresh grass and carrots. Finally, its hard work paid off and it found enough to eat. Remember, forage means to search for food. **一只饥饿的兔子不得不在森林里觅食以寻找食物。它到处搜寻，寻找新鲜的草和胡萝卜。最终，它的努力得到了回报，找到了足够的食物吃。记住，forage 意思是搜寻食物。**

> A brave knight made a foray into the dark forest. He was seeking treasure but faced many dangers. The foray was risky but he was determined. Finally, he found a precious gem. **一位勇敢的骑士深入黑暗森林进行突袭。他在寻找宝藏，但面临诸多危险。这次突袭很冒险，但他意志坚定。最终，他找到了一颗珍贵的宝石。**

> A king strictly forbids his subjects from entering a secret garden. Anyone who disobeys will face severe punishment. So, \'forbid\' means to not allow something, to prohibit. **一位国王严厉禁止他的臣民进入一个秘密花园。任何违抗的人都将面临严厉的惩罚。所以，\'forbid\'意思是不允许某事，禁止。**

> In a magical forest, there was a hidden cave. A powerful spell made it forbidden to enter. One brave adventurer ignored the warning and faced dangerous magic. Remember, \'forbidden\' means not allowed or prohibited. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一个隐藏的洞穴。一个强大的咒语使其禁止进入。一位勇敢的冒险家无视警告，遭遇了危险的魔法。记住，\'forbidden\'意思是不被允许或禁止。**

> A traveler came to a castle. The gatekeeper had a forbidding look, making the traveler feel unwelcome. The traveler understood that entering was strictly prohibited. But later, with persuasion, the gatekeeper changed and let him in. **一位旅行者来到一座城堡。看门人表情冷峻令人望而生畏，让旅行者觉得不受欢迎。旅行者明白进入是严格禁止的。但后来经过劝说，看门人改变了态度让他进去。**
> One day, a strong wind was blowing. It was so powerful that it forced the little boat to change its direction. The force of the wind was undeniable. **一天，一阵强风在吹。它是如此强大，以至于迫使小船改变了方向。风的力量不容置疑。**

> A brave astronaut was forced to land on a strange planet. He had no choice but to face the unknown challenges. Later, he found a way to get back safely. **一位勇敢的宇航员被迫降落在一个陌生的星球上。他别无选择，只能面对未知的挑战。后来，他找到了安全返回的方法。**

> A strong wind was blowing. It was so forceful that it pushed over the small trees. Just like a powerful athlete, the wind showed its forceful nature. **一阵强风在吹。它非常有力，以至于把小树都吹倒了。就像一个强大的运动员，这风展现出了它强有力的特质。**

> A brave knight forcefully pushed open the heavy gate to rescue the princess trapped inside. His powerful and determined action showed his forcefully nature. **一位勇敢的骑士用力推开沉重的大门去营救被困在里面的公主。他强大且坚定的行动展现了他强有力的特质。**

> A thief forcibly entered the house. The owner was scared but called the police quickly. The thief was caught and taken away. \'Forcibly\' means using force or against someone\'s will. **一个小偷强行进入房子。主人很害怕但很快报了警。小偷被抓住带走了。'forcibly'意思是使用武力或违背某人的意愿。**

> In a forest, a little bird was always at the fore of the flock. It led the way, showing others where to find the best food. \'Fore\' here means at or towards the front. **在一片森林里，一只小鸟总是在鸟群的前端。它带路，给其他鸟展示哪里能找到最好的食物。'fore'在这里表示在前面或朝向前面。**

> One day, a brave knight was in a fierce battle. His enemy aimed a sword at his forearm. But the knight protected his forearm and won the fight. Remember, forearm is the part from the elbow to the wrist. **有一天，一位勇敢的骑士在激烈的战斗中。他的敌人将剑刺向他的前臂。但骑士保护住了他的前臂并赢得了战斗。记住，forearm 就是从肘部到手腕的部分。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a wise old man. People called him the forebear. He passed down valuable knowledge and wisdom to the younger generation, becoming a respected ancestor. Remember him and you\'ll remember \'forebear\'! **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有一位睿智的老人。人们称他为先祖。他把宝贵的知识和智慧传给了年轻一代，成为了一位受人尊敬的祖先。记住他，你就会记住\'forebear\'这个词！**

> A man was walking alone in a dark forest. A sudden gust of wind and strange noises filled him with foreboding. He felt as if something bad was about to happen. His heart raced with fear and unease. **一个男人独自在黑暗的森林中行走。突然一阵狂风和奇怪的声音让他充满了不祥的预感。他觉得好像有什么不好的事情即将发生。他的心因恐惧和不安而急速跳动。**

> A brave sailor was on a ship. Before setting sail, he used all his knowledge and tools to forecast the weather. With this prediction, they prepared well and had a safe journey. **一位勇敢的水手在船上。在启航前，他运用自己所有的知识和工具来预测天气。有了这个预报，他们做好了充分准备，有了一次安全的旅程。**

> One day, a wise old man was known as the forecaster. He could predict the weather accurately. People always came to him for advice before going on trips. His forecasts helped them prepare well. **有一天，一位睿智的老人被称为预报员。他能准确地预测天气。人们在旅行前总是来找他寻求建议。他的预报帮助他们做好准备。**
> 想象一个银行，它总是在房子主人不能按时还钱时，强行提前终止贷款并收回房子，这就是\'foreclose\'。就好像银行关闭了主人拥有房子的大门。 **（因抵押人未如期还贷）取消（抵押人的）赎回权；排除；阻止**

> A man was always in debt. The bank decided on foreclosure of his house. He lost his home and felt very sad. Remember, foreclosure means taking away property due to unpaid debts. **一个男人总是负债。银行决定对他的房子进行止赎。他失去了房子，非常伤心。记住，foreclosure 意思是因未偿还债务而夺走财产。**

> 很久很久以前，有个部落面临巨大危机。关键时刻，一位智慧勇敢的先人站了出来，带领大家度过难关。这位先人就是部落的 forefather，他的事迹被后人传颂。后来，forefather 就用来指代祖先、前辈。 **很久很久以前，有个部落面临巨大危机。关键时刻，一位智慧勇敢的先人站了出来，带领大家度过难关。这位先人就是部落的祖先、前辈，他的事迹被后人传颂。后来，forefather 就用来指代祖先、前辈。**

> One day, a little boy was pointing at a beautiful butterfly with his forefinger. He was so excited and wanted to show it to his friends. The forefinger was like a magic wand, guiding their attention. **有一天，一个小男孩用他的食指指着一只漂亮的蝴蝶。他非常兴奋，想要指给他的朋友们看。食指就像一根魔法棒，引导着他们的注意力。**
> 在一场激烈的科技竞赛中，小明总是站在最前方（forefront），引领团队探索未知。他就像勇敢的先锋，冲在前沿，为大家开辟道路，最终带领团队取得成功。 **在一场科技竞赛中，小明总是处于最前沿，引领团队并最终成功。**

> A brave explorer decided to forego the easy path and take on the challenging one in the jungle. He gave up the comfort to seek greater adventure. \'Forego\' means to go before or do without. **一位勇敢的探险家决定放弃容易的道路，在丛林中选择具有挑战性的那条。他舍弃了舒适去寻求更大的冒险。\'forego\'意思是走在前面；放弃**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He found a letter with the foregoing paragraphs that pointed to the culprit. The word \'foregoing\' means the previous or just mentioned. So, the detective focused on those earlier parts to crack the case. **一位侦探正在侦破一个谜团。他发现了一封信，其中前面的段落指出了罪犯。单词\'foregoing\'意思是前面的、上述的。所以，侦探专注于那些前面的部分来破案。**
> 想象你在拍照，镜头前那鲜明突出、一眼就能看到的美丽花朵就是 foreground（前景）。而远处的背景则被虚化，前景的花朵格外引人注目，就像这个单词所表达的处于显眼位置的部分。 **想象拍照时镜头前显眼的部分就是\'前景\'，帮助理解这个单词**

> A brave knight was in a fierce battle. An enemy\'s sword swung towards him, but he ducked just in time. The sword grazed his forehead. Luckily, he survived with just a scratch on his forehead. **一位勇敢的骑士正在激烈的战斗中。一个敌人的剑朝他挥来，但他及时低头。剑擦过了他的额头。幸运的是，他额头只是擦伤，活了下来。**

> A little boy named Tom was very curious. One day, he saw a strange car with foreign license plates. He wondered where it came from. Later, he learned that \'foreign\' means from another country. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩很好奇。有一天，他看到一辆有外国车牌的奇怪汽车。他想知道它来自哪里。后来，他知道了\'foreign\'意思是来自别的国家。**

> One day, I met a person in the park. He didn\'t look familiar and had a different accent. I realized he was a foreigner. He was lost and needed help to find his way. I was happy to assist him. **有一天，我在公园遇到一个人。他看起来很陌生，口音也不同。我意识到他是个外国人。他迷路了，需要帮助找到路。我很乐意帮助他。**

> In the construction site, the foreman was always in charge. He directed the workers and made sure everything was on track. One day, a problem occurred, but the foreman solved it quickly and kept the project going smoothly. **在建筑工地上，领班总是负责指挥。他指导工人，并确保一切都在正轨上。有一天，出现了一个问题，但领班迅速解决了，使项目顺利进行。**

> A brave knight was always at the forefront of the battle. He was the foremost warrior, leading the charge fearlessly. His courage made him stand out among all. Remember, foremost means leading or most important. **一位勇敢的骑士总是在战斗的最前方。他是最重要的战士，无所畏惧地带头冲锋。他的勇气使他脱颖而出。记住，foremost 意思是领先的或最重要的。**

> A detective was working on a forensic case. He carefully examined the crime scene, looking for forensic evidence like fingerprints and DNA. With these clues, he was able to solve the mystery and catch the criminal. **一位侦探正在处理一个法医案件。他仔细检查犯罪现场，寻找指纹和 DNA 等法医证据。凭借这些线索，他得以解开谜团并抓住罪犯。**
> 想象一下，在一场马拉松比赛中，有一个人总是跑在最前面，为后面的选手开辟道路，这个人就是 forerunner。他就像一个勇敢的开拓者，引领着大家前进。 **想象在马拉松比赛中跑在最前面为其他人开辟道路的人就是\'先驱；先行者；预兆\'。**

> A wise old owl was always able to foresee the coming of bad weather. It would prepare its nest early. \'Foresee\' means to have the ability to know or predict something before it happens, just like the owl knew the storm was coming. **一只聪明的老猫头鹰总是能够预见坏天气的来临。它会早早准备好自己的巢。\'foresee\'意思是在事情发生之前就有知道或预测某事的能力，就像猫头鹰知道暴风雨要来了一样。**

> In a future world, a smart scientist could foreseeable all the problems and prepared solutions in advance. \'Foreseeable\' means something that can be seen or anticipated before it happens. **在未来世界，一位聪明的科学家能够预见所有的问题，并提前准备好解决方案。\'foreseeable\'意思是在事情发生之前能够被看到或预料到的。**

> A detective was solving a case. In the beginning, a strange symbol foreshadowed a big conspiracy. Later, as expected, a series of mysterious events occurred. The detective finally uncovered the truth based on that early clue. **一位侦探正在破案。一开始，一个奇怪的符号预示着一个巨大的阴谋。后来，不出所料，一系列神秘事件发生了。侦探最终根据那个早期的线索揭开了真相。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a forest. But he had foresight and brought a map and compass. With them, he found his way out. Foresight means the ability to predict and plan for the future. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林中迷路了。但他有先见之明，带了地图和指南针。凭借这些，他找到了出路。foresight 意思是预见和为未来做计划的能力。**

> A little bear got lost in the forest. It was dark and scary. But with the help of friendly birds, it finally found its way home. The forest has many tall trees and hidden paths. **一只小熊在森林里迷路了。森林又黑又可怕。但在友好的鸟儿的帮助下，它最终找到了回家的路。森林里有许多高大的树木和隐藏的小路。**

> A merchant was always worried about his rivals. To prevent them from getting the best goods first, he would rise early every morning to forestall them. This way, he could secure the best deals and stay ahead in business. **一位商人总是担心他的竞争对手。为了阻止他们先得到最好的货物，他每天早上都会早起抢先一步。这样，他就能确保获得最好的交易，并在生意上保持领先。**

> Once upon a time, a little rabbit got lost in a forested area. There were tall trees everywhere. It took a long time for the rabbit to find its way out. Remember, \'forested\' means full of forests. **从前，一只小兔子在一个森林繁茂的地方迷路了。到处都是高大的树木。小兔子花了很长时间才找到出路。记住，'forested'意思是森林覆盖的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Forest. He loved trees so much that he became a forester. Every day, he walked in the forest, protecting and taking care of the trees. His job was to ensure the forest\'s health and beauty. **从前，有个叫福雷斯特的人。他非常喜欢树木，于是成为了一名林务员。每天，他在森林里漫步，保护和照顾树木。他的工作是确保森林的健康和美丽。**

> A young adventurer named Lily loved exploring the wild. One day, she discovered a beautiful area filled with trees and learned it was managed by something called \'forestry\'. It was all about taking care of the forests and making them thrive. **一位名叫莉莉的年轻冒险家喜欢探索野外。有一天，她发现了一个树木繁茂的美丽区域，并了解到这是由被称为"林业"的东西在管理。它关乎着对森林的照料并让它们茁壮成长。**

> A prince and a princess promised to love each other forever. They overcame many difficulties and never gave up. Their love lasted through time, just like the meaning of \'forever\'. **一位王子和一位公主承诺永远彼此相爱。他们克服了许多困难，从未放弃。他们的爱经久不衰，就像'forever'这个词的意思一样。**

> A gambler was so confident but lost the bet. As a result, he had to forfeit all his money. It was a painful lesson. He realized that overconfidence could lead to such a big loss. **一个赌徒非常自信但输了赌局。结果，他不得不没收/丧失了他所有的钱。这是一个痛苦的教训。他意识到过度自信会导致如此大的损失。**

> A blacksmith was working hard in his forge. He heated the metal and hammered it to create a beautiful sword. The forge was hot and noisy, but the blacksmith never gave up. Remember, \'forge\' means to make or create by shaping metal. **一位铁匠在他的锻造车间努力工作。他加热金属并用锤子打造出一把漂亮的剑。锻造车间又热又吵，但铁匠从不放弃。记住，\'forge\'意思是通过塑造金属来制造或创造。**

> One day, a thief was caught trying to sell a valuable painting. It turned out to be a forgery. He had copied the original masterpiece poorly, thinking no one would notice. But the experts saw through his trick. **一天，一个小偷在试图出售一幅珍贵的画时被抓住了。原来这是一幅赝品。他拙劣地复制了原作，以为没人会注意到。但专家识破了他的诡计。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. He left his favorite toy there but forgot to take it home. When he remembered later, it was too late. The toy was gone. Poor boy! Let\'s not forget important things like him. **有一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。他把最喜欢的玩具落在那里，却忘记带回家。等他后来想起来时，已经太晚了。玩具不见了。可怜的孩子！咱们可别像他一样忘记重要的东西。**

> One day, Tom made a big mistake and hurt his friend Mary. But Mary was very kind and decided to forgive him. She said, \'I choose to forget the bad and forgive you, Tom.\' **有一天，汤姆犯了一个大错并伤害了他的朋友玛丽。但玛丽非常善良，决定原谅他。她说：'我选择忘记不好的，原谅你，汤姆。'**

> One day, Tom made a big mistake and hurt his friend. But his friend showed forgiveness and said, \'I know you didn\'t mean it.\' Tom was very grateful and learned the meaning of forgiveness. **有一天，汤姆犯了个大错并伤害了他的朋友。但他的朋友表示了宽恕并说：'我知道你不是故意的。'汤姆非常感激，并明白了宽恕的含义。**

> One day, Tom accidentally broke Mary\'s favorite vase. But Mary was forgiving. She didn\'t get angry and said it was okay. Tom was very grateful for Mary\'s forgiving nature. **有一天，汤姆不小心打碎了玛丽最喜欢的花瓶。但玛丽很宽容。她没有生气并说没关系。汤姆非常感激玛丽宽容的天性。**

> A poor man had to forgo his dream of buying a new car because he needed to save money for his family\'s medical expenses. He made a difficult choice but knew it was for the best. **一个贫穷的男人不得不放弃购买新车的梦想，因为他需要为家人的医疗费用省钱。他做出了艰难的选择，但知道这是最好的决定。**

> One day, Tom was so busy that he forgotten to feed his pet dog. When he got home, the poor dog was starving. This made Tom realize that he should be more careful and not forgotten important things. **一天，汤姆太忙了以至于他忘记喂他的宠物狗。当他回到家，可怜的狗狗正在挨饿。这让汤姆意识到他应该更小心，不能忘记重要的事。**

> One day, a hungry little rabbit was looking for food. Suddenly, it saw a shiny fork on the ground. It wondered how this fork could help it get delicious carrots. Then it realized it could use the fork to dig and find carrots. **一天，一只饥饿的小兔子正在找食物。突然，它看到地上有一把闪亮的叉子。它好奇这把叉子怎么能帮它弄到美味的胡萝卜。然后它意识到可以用叉子挖地找胡萝卜。**

> A traveler was lost in a vast desert, feeling forlorn. With no sign of help in sight, he was alone and desolate. But then he found an oasis, realizing that forlorn times don\'t last forever. **一位旅行者在广袤的沙漠中迷路了，感到孤独凄凉。看不到任何救援的迹象，他独自一人，十分孤寂。但后来他找到了一片绿洲，明白了孤独凄凉的时刻不会永远持续。**

> A little ant was trying to form a line to carry food. But it was hard. Finally, they managed to form a nice and orderly line. They were so happy! **一只小蚂蚁试图排成一行来搬运食物。但这很难。最后，它们成功地形成了一条漂亮且有序的队伍。它们非常开心！**

> A boy always wore a suit and tie to parties. Everyone said he was too formal. But when he changed to casual clothes, people realized that being formal sometimes limits fun. **一个男孩总是穿着西装打着领带去参加聚会。大家都说他太正式了。但当他换上休闲装，人们才意识到太正式有时会限制乐趣。**

> A young man went to a formal party. But he wore casual clothes and was stopped at the door because of not following the formality. He learned that formality means the correct and expected way of doing things in a particular situation. **一个年轻人去参加一个正式的聚会。但他穿着休闲服，因未遵循礼节而被拦在门口。他明白了formality指在特定情况下正确和预期的做事方式。**

> A scientist wanted to formalize his wild ideas. He spent days writing and organizing, making them clear and structured. Finally, his ideas were formalized and ready to be shared with the world. **一位科学家想要使他那些天马行空的想法正式化。他花了好几天时间书写和整理，让它们清晰且有条理。最终，他的想法被正式化，准备好与世界分享。**

> A young artist was invited to a grand event. He dressed up formally. But he was so nervous that he forgot to bow formally. Later, he learned the importance of behaving formally in such occasions. **一位年轻的艺术家被邀请参加一个盛大的活动。他穿着正式。但他太紧张了，以至于没有正式地鞠躬。后来，他明白了在这种场合正式表现的重要性。**

> A group of friends decided to format a party. They carefully planned every detail, from the decoration to the food. Just like formatting a computer disk to make it perfect, they aimed to make the party flawless and enjoyable for everyone. **一群朋友决定策划一个派对。他们仔细规划每个细节，从装饰到食物。就像格式化电脑磁盘使其完美一样，他们旨在让派对毫无瑕疵，让每个人都开心。**

> A group of little birds was flying in the sky. They formed a beautiful formation, like a heart. This special arrangement was called a formation. It means the way things are arranged or organized. **一群小鸟在天空中飞翔。它们组成了一个美丽的队形，像一颗心。这种特殊的排列被称为formation。它的意思是事物的排列或组织方式。**
> 想象一个小雕塑家，他不断塑造（form）泥土，这个塑造的过程（formative）对他成为大师至关重要。在这个过程中，他学会了各种技巧，就像我们在成长中经历的那些塑造性的阶段一样。 **想象小雕塑家塑造泥土的过程来辅助记忆formative（形成的；塑造的；影响发展的）这个单词**

> Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was the former champion of the race, but he lost his title later. The other was always trying to become as good. \'Former\' here means having held a position or title before. **从前，有两个朋友。一个是之前的赛跑冠军，但后来失去了头衔。另一个一直努力变得同样出色。这里的'former'意思是以前的，先前的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a small town. It was formerly peaceful and quiet. But then a factory was built, and everything changed. \'Formerly\' here means in the past or before. **从前，有一个小镇。它以前宁静祥和。但后来建了一家工厂，一切都变了。这里的'formerly'意思是在过去，以前。**

> A brave knight faced a formidable dragon. The dragon was huge and had sharp teeth, but the knight didn\'t back down. \'Formidable\' means very powerful and difficult to deal with, just like this scary dragon. **一位勇敢的骑士面对了一条强大可怕的龙。这条龙体型巨大，牙齿锋利，但骑士没有退缩。'formidable'意思是强大得令人畏惧的、难以对付的，就像这条可怕的龙。**

> A young scientist was struggling to create a new medicine. One night, in a dream, an angel gave him a formula written on a shining paper. When he woke up, he followed that formula and made the amazing medicine. **一位年轻的科学家一直努力研发一种新药物。一天晚上，在梦中，一位天使给了他一张写着配方的发光的纸。当他醒来，他依照那个配方制成了神奇的药物。**

> A scientist spent days in the lab to formulate a new medicine. He mixed different substances, observed reactions, and finally created a successful formula. \'Formulate\' means to create or develop carefully. **一位科学家在实验室里花了好几天来配制一种新药。他混合不同的物质，观察反应，最终创造出了成功的配方。'formulate'意思是精心创造或制定。**

> A scientist spent days in the lab, carefully combining elements and noting down every step. Finally, he achieved the perfect formulation of a new medicine. It was a complex but rewarding process. **一位科学家在实验室里花了好几天时间，仔细地组合元素并记录每一步。最终，他成功地完成了一种新药的配方。这是一个复杂但有收获的过程。**

> A brave knight was once devoted to his kingdom. But when faced with great temptation, he forsook his oath and left his people in danger. Later, he realized his mistake and tried to make amends. **一位勇敢的骑士曾忠于他的王国。但当面对巨大的诱惑时，他背弃了自己的誓言，将他的人民置于危险之中。后来，他意识到了自己的错误并试图弥补。**

> In ancient times, a brave general led his soldiers to a strong fort. The fort protected them from enemy attacks. It had high walls and enough food. They felt safe inside the fort. **在古代，一位勇敢的将军带领他的士兵来到一座坚固的堡垒。这座堡垒保护他们免受敌人的攻击。它有高高的城墙和充足的食物。在堡垒内他们感到很安全。**

> A brave knight set forth on a journey to save the princess. He rode forth through the forest and across the mountains. The word \'forth\' means forward or onward, just like the knight\'s brave advance. **一位勇敢的骑士出发去拯救公主。他骑马向前，穿过森林，越过山脉。单词\'forth\'意思是向前、前进，就像骑士勇敢的前行。**

> A scientist was working hard on a new discovery. When asked about the results, he said they would be forthcoming soon. It means something is about to happen or be made available. **一位科学家正在努力研究一项新发现。当被问及结果时，他说很快就会出来。这意味着某事即将发生或可得。**

> A brave knight was always forthright in battle. He would charge forthright towards the enemy without hesitation. His forthright attitude made him a hero. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中总是直率的。他会毫不犹豫地径直冲向敌人。他直率的态度使他成为了英雄。**

> In ancient times, a small village was constantly under threat. So, the villagers built strong walls and towers for protection. This act of building these defences was called \'fortification\', making the village safe from enemies. **在古代，一个小村庄经常受到威胁。于是，村民们建造了坚固的城墙和塔楼来进行保护。这种建造防御工事的行为被称为'fortification'，使村庄免受敌人侵害。**

> A brave soldier was defending a weak castle. To make it stronger, they fortified the walls by adding more stones and building higher towers. With these efforts, the castle could better resist enemy attacks. **一位勇敢的士兵正在守卫一座脆弱的城堡。为了使其更坚固，他们通过添加更多石头和建造更高的塔楼来加固城墙。通过这些努力，城堡能够更好地抵御敌人的攻击。**

> In a war-torn land, the king ordered to fortify the castle. Workers added more stones and built higher walls to make it strong and safe. \'Fortify\' means to make something stronger and protect it. **在一个战乱之地，国王下令加固城堡。工人们添加了更多石头，砌起更高的城墙，以使它坚固和安全。\'fortify\'意思是使某物更坚固并加以保护。**

> A soldier was injured in battle but showed fortitude. He endured the pain and continued to fight. His strong will and courage were like a shield, helping him overcome difficulties. **一名士兵在战斗中受伤，但展现出了坚韧不拔的精神。他忍受着疼痛继续战斗。他坚强的意志和勇气就像一面盾牌，帮助他克服困难。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to find the lost fortress. After many adventures, he finally reached it. The fortress was huge and strong, protecting precious treasures inside. Remember, fortress means a large and strong building for defense. **一位勇敢的骑士正在寻找失落的堡垒。经过多次冒险，他终于到达了。这座堡垒又大又坚固，里面保护着珍贵的宝藏。记住，fortress 意思是大型坚固的防御建筑。**

> A poor boy was always dreaming of a better life. One day, he found a magic lamp and a genie appeared. The genie granted him many wishes and made him fortunate. From then on, he had everything he wanted. **一个贫穷的男孩总是梦想着更好的生活。有一天，他发现了一盏神灯，一个精灵出现了。精灵满足了他的许多愿望，让他变得幸运。从那以后，他想要的一切都有了。**

> A man was lost in a forest. He had no food or water. Fortunately, a rescue team found him just in time. The word \'fortunately\' here means luckily, showing a positive outcome in a difficult situation. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。他没有食物和水。幸运的是，一支救援队及时找到了他。单词'fortunately'在这里的意思是幸运地，表明在困难的情况下有一个积极的结果。**

> A poor man was always dreaming of fortune. One day, he found a magic lamp and a genie granted him great wealth. Finally, his dream of fortune came true. **一个穷人总是梦想着财富。有一天，他发现了一盏神灯，一个精灵给了他大量的财富。最终，他的财富梦成真了。**

> One day, a little monkey was trying to count apples. It counted and counted, and finally it shouted, \'I have forty apples!\' It was so happy because it had a big harvest. **一天，一只小猴子在数苹果。它数啊数，最后喊道：'我有四十个苹果！'它非常高兴，因为收获很大。**

> In ancient Rome, people gathered in a special place called the \'forum\' to discuss politics and share ideas. It was like a big meeting hall. Imagine you are there, listening and speaking freely. So, \'forum\' means a place for public discussion. **在古罗马，人们在一个叫做'forum（论坛；公共讨论场所）'的特殊地方聚集，讨论政治并分享想法。它就像一个大的会议厅。想象你在那里，自由地倾听和发言。所以，'forum'指的是公共讨论的场所。**

> A brave soldier was always ready to move forward in the battle. No matter how dangerous it was, he never stepped backward. His determination to go forward made him a hero. **一位勇敢的士兵在战斗中总是准备向前冲。无论多么危险，他从不后退。他向前的决心使他成为了英雄。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a forest. He wanted to go home. A kind bird told him to walk forwards. So he did and finally found his way out. **一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他想回家。一只善良的鸟告诉他向前走。于是他照做了，最终找到了出去的路。**

> A long time ago, a brave scientist was exploring a cave. Suddenly, he found a strange stone. Later, he realized it was a fossil, a remnant of a creature from ancient times. It was like a key to the past. **很久之前，一位勇敢的科学家在探索一个洞穴。突然，他发现了一块奇怪的石头。后来，他意识到这是一块化石，是远古生物的遗迹。它就像通往过去的一把钥匙。**

> A little girl was lost and felt scared. But a kind couple came and fostered her with love and care. They gave her a warm home and made her happy again. \'Foster\' means to help and care for someone. **一个小女孩迷路了，感到很害怕。但一对善良的夫妇出现了，关爱并抚养她。他们给了她一个温暖的家，让她再次开心起来。'foster'意思是养育、抚育、培养。**

> A football player was running fast on the field. Suddenly, he made a foul move and pushed another player hard. The referee blew the whistle and gave him a penalty. It was a foul that cost his team. **一名足球运动员在球场上快速奔跑。突然，他做出了犯规动作，狠狠地推了另一名球员。裁判吹响了哨子，并判给他一个点球。这是一次让他的球队付出代价的犯规。**

> A lost puppy was wandering in the street. Luckily, a kind girl found it and took it home. She gave it food and a warm bed. The puppy was so happy to be found. **一只迷路的小狗在街上徘徊。幸运的是，一个善良的女孩发现了它，并把它带回了家。她给它食物和温暖的床。小狗很高兴被发现。**

> A poor boy dreamed of building a big house. With hard work and savings, he bought the first brick. That brick was like the foundation. Step by step, he finally built his dream house. The start, the foundation, is crucial like in everything. **一个贫穷的男孩梦想建造一座大房子。通过努力工作和储蓄，他买了第一块砖。那块砖就像基础。一步一步，他终于建成了梦想中的房子。开始，基础，在任何事情中都至关重要。**
> 想象一个勇敢的创业者，他满怀激情地创办了一家公司。然而，市场变化莫测，困难重重，最终他的公司没能挺住，倒闭了。这个创业者就像单词founder一样，遭遇了失败、沉没。 **想象一位勇敢的创业者，因公司倒闭就像单词founder所表示的失败、沉没，来辅助记忆这个词**

> A long time ago, a smart man named Tom wanted to start a business. He chose to build a foundry where he could melt metals and create wonderful things like bells and statues. With hard work, his foundry became famous. **很久以前，一个叫汤姆的聪明人想要创业。他选择建一个铸造厂，在那里他可以熔化金属并制造像铃铛和雕像这样的好东西。通过努力，他的铸造厂出名了。**

> One day, I was lost in a big park. Suddenly, I saw a beautiful fountain. The water was spraying high up in the air like a magical dance. It was so charming that I\'ll never forget it. **有一天，我在一个大公园里迷路了。突然，我看到了一个漂亮的喷泉。水高高地喷向空中，就像一场神奇的舞蹈。它太迷人了，让我永远难以忘怀。**

> One day, a little monkey was looking for food. It found four big bananas. It was so happy and took them home. The number four made the monkey\'s day! **一天，一只小猴子在找食物。它发现了四根大香蕉。它非常高兴，把它们带回了家。数字四让猴子度过了美好的一天！**

> Four friends decided to play golf together. They formed a foursome and had a great time on the course. They laughed, competed, and enjoyed each other\'s company. The foursome became a symbol of their friendship and fun. **四个朋友决定一起打高尔夫球。他们组成了一组四人赛，在球场上度过了愉快的时光。他们欢笑、竞争，并享受彼此的陪伴。这个四人组成为了他们友谊和欢乐的象征。**

> One day, a little girl was celebrating her fourteenth birthday. She had fourteen candles on her cake and received fourteen gifts. It was a wonderful day for her to remember being fourteen. **一天，一个小女孩正在庆祝她的十四岁生日。她的蛋糕上有十四根蜡烛，并且收到了十四份礼物。对她来说，这是记住自己十四岁的美好一天。**

> One day, a little mouse was trying to find its way home. It passed by thirteen houses and finally reached the fourteenth one, which was its home. The number fourteen was thus engraved in its mind. **有一天，一只小老鼠正在努力找回家的路。它路过了十三座房子，最后到达了第十四座，那就是它的家。于是，数字十四就印在了它的脑海里。**

> One day, a little rabbit was in a race. It ran very hard and crossed the finish line fourth. It was a bit sad but still proud of its effort. Remember, fourth means coming after the third. **一天，一只小兔子参加赛跑。它跑得很努力，冲过终点线时是第四名。它有点伤心但仍为自己的努力感到骄傲。记住，fourth 意思是第四（个）。**

> One day, a little boy went to the farm and saw many fowl. They were chickens, ducks and geese. The fowl were running and playing freely. The boy was very happy to see them. **有一天，一个小男孩去农场看到了很多家禽。有鸡、鸭和鹅。这些家禽在自由地奔跑和玩耍。小男孩看到它们非常高兴。**

> One day, a little rabbit was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a fox appeared. The fox had a sly smile and sharp eyes. It wanted to catch the rabbit. But the smart rabbit ran away quickly. **有一天，一只小兔子正在森林里玩耍。突然，一只狐狸出现了。狐狸有着狡黠的笑容和锐利的眼睛。它想要抓住兔子。但聪明的兔子很快跑掉了。**
> 想象你走进一座宏伟的剧院，首先踏入的那个宽敞明亮的大厅就是 foyer。一位优雅的女士在 foyer 迎接你，带你走向座位。这里是人们聚集、交流、等待开场的地方。 **想象你走进剧院，首先踏入的那个大厅就是\'foyer\'，它是指（剧院、旅馆等的）门厅，大厅。**

> A king divided his treasure into many parts. Each part was a fraction of the whole. The smallest fraction was hard to notice, but still important. **一位国王把他的财宝分成很多部分。每一部分都是整体的一个分数。最小的分数很难被注意到，但仍然很重要。**

> A brave explorer was climbing a mountain. Suddenly, a rock slipped and hit his leg, causing a fracture. He had to stop and seek help. The fracture made his journey difficult but also taught him the importance of caution. **一位勇敢的探险家正在爬山。突然，一块石头滑落砸到了他的腿，导致骨折。他不得不停下来寻求帮助。这次骨折让他的旅程变得艰难，但也让他明白了谨慎的重要性。**

> A little bird was carrying a fragile egg carefully. But suddenly, a strong wind blew, and the egg almost fell. The bird had to hold it tighter. \'Fragile\' means easily broken or damaged, just like this egg. **一只小鸟小心翼翼地带着一颗易碎的蛋。但突然，一阵强风吹来，蛋差点掉落。小鸟不得不把它抓得更紧。'fragile'意思是易碎的，易损坏的，就像这颗蛋一样。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful vase. But it had fragility. One day, it was accidentally knocked over and broke into pieces. This showed how easily it could be damaged. **从前，有一个漂亮的花瓶。但它具有脆弱性。有一天，它不小心被撞倒并碎成了片。这表明它是多么容易被损坏。**

> A precious vase was dropped and broke into many fragments. The fragments were scattered everywhere. It was a sad scene. Remember, fragment means a small part broken off from something larger. **一个珍贵的花瓶掉落并碎成了很多碎片。这些碎片到处都是。这是一个悲伤的场景。记住，fragment 意思是从较大物体上掉落的小部分。**

> A detective was looking for clues in a crime scene. He found only fragmentary evidence, like a broken piece of glass and a torn paper. It was a challenging case as these pieces were hard to put together. **一位侦探在犯罪现场寻找线索。他只发现了零碎的证据，比如一块碎玻璃和一张撕破的纸。这是一个具有挑战性的案子，因为这些碎片很难拼凑起来。**

> Imagine a beautiful vase falling to the ground and breaking into many small pieces. This process of the vase breaking into numerous fragments is called \'fragmentation\'. **想象一个美丽的花瓶掉到地上并碎成许多小块。花瓶碎成众多碎片的这个过程就叫做'fragmentation'（分裂；破碎）。**

> Once upon a time, a beautiful vase was accidentally dropped and broke into many small fragments. The scene was fragmented and messy. From then on, I remembered the word \'fragmented\' meaning broken into pieces. **从前，一个漂亮的花瓶不小心被摔碎，变成了许多小碎片。这个场景是破碎的、零散的。从那以后，我记住了'fragmented'这个单词，意思是破碎成碎片的。**

> A fairy was walking in a beautiful garden. The flowers gave off a wonderful fragrance. The fairy loved the sweet smell and decided to use it to make a magic perfume. The word \'fragrance\' means the pleasant smell. **一个仙女正在一个美丽的花园里散步。花朵散发出美妙的香气。仙女喜欢这种甜美的味道，并决定用它来制作魔法香水。单词\'fragrance\'意思是香气、芳香。**
