> A young man was in trouble. A mysterious old man appeared and helped him. Later, the young man found out the old man was a godfather, a powerful and respected figure. The godfather had the ability to solve any problem. **一个年轻人陷入了困境。一位神秘的老人出现并帮助了他。后来，年轻人发现这位老人是教父，一个强大且受人尊敬的人物。教父有能力解决任何问题。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost and scared. Then a kind woman appeared and helped her. The girl called the woman her godmother. The godmother took care of her and made her feel safe and loved. **从前，有个小女孩迷路了很害怕。然后一位善良的女士出现并帮助了她。小女孩称这位女士为教母。教母照顾她，让她感到安全和被爱。**

> One day, Tom was going to the park. He was very excited because he was going to play with his friends. On the way, he saw many beautiful flowers. Going to a place you like always makes you happy. **一天，汤姆正在去公园。他非常兴奋，因为他要和朋友们一起玩。在路上，他看到了许多漂亮的花。去一个你喜欢的地方总是会让你开心。**

> A poor miner worked hard every day in the mine. One lucky day, he finally found a huge piece of shiny gold. His life changed completely. He became rich and happy. **一个贫穷的矿工每天在矿井努力工作。幸运的一天，他终于发现了一大块闪闪发光的金子。他的生活彻底改变了。他变得富有和快乐。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical tree with golden apples. Everyone wanted them because they were so shiny and precious. The golden color made the apples stand out and be highly desired. **从前，有一棵神奇的树，上面长满了金苹果。每个人都想要它们，因为它们是如此闪亮和珍贵。金色让这些苹果格外引人注目，令人向往。**

> One day, a little girl went to the pet store and saw a beautiful goldfish. It had shiny golden scales and swam gracefully in the tank. The girl was so charmed and decided to take it home as her pet. **有一天，一个小女孩去宠物店，看到了一条漂亮的金鱼。它有着闪闪发光的金色鳞片，在鱼缸里优雅地游着。小女孩被迷住了，决定把它带回家当作宠物。**

> One day, a guy named George was feeling bored. Then his friend invited him to play a game called \'golf\'. They had so much fun hitting the balls on the beautiful grass. George loved it and never forgot the word \'golf\' since then. **有一天，一个叫乔治的人感到很无聊。然后他的朋友邀请他去玩一种叫做"高尔夫"的游戏。他们在美丽的草地上击球，玩得非常开心。乔治喜欢上了它，从那以后就再也没有忘记"golf"这个词。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young man named Tom. He loved sports and spent most of his time on the golf course. Day after day, he practiced hard and finally became a skilled golfer. Now, everyone knew him as the best golfer in town. **从前，有个叫汤姆的年轻人。他热爱运动，大部分时间都在高尔夫球场上。日复一日，他努力练习，最终成为了一名技术娴熟的高尔夫球手。现在，每个人都知道他是镇上最好的高尔夫球手。**

> Once upon a time, a couple took a romantic ride in a gondola on a beautiful river. The gondola, a long and narrow boat, gently glided through the water. They enjoyed the peaceful moment together. **从前，有一对情侣在一条美丽的河上乘着贡多拉进行了一次浪漫的旅行。贡多拉，这种又长又窄的船，轻轻地在水面滑行。他们一起享受了这宁静的时刻。**

> Once upon a time, a brave knight hit a gong to warn the villagers of an approaching danger. The loud sound of the gong echoed through the valley. With its unique ring, the word \'gong\' was easy to remember. **从前，一位勇敢的骑士敲响了一面锣来警告村民即将到来的危险。锣的响亮声音在山谷中回荡。凭借其独特的响声，单词\'gong\'很容易被记住。**

> One day, a little girl was playing with some strange stuff. She asked her mom what it was and her mom said, \'It\'s goo, a sticky and messy substance.\' The girl remembered the word easily. **一天，一个小女孩在玩一些奇怪的东西。她问妈妈这是什么，妈妈说："这是黏性的、乱糟糟的东西，叫 goo 。"小女孩轻松地记住了这个单词。**

> One day, a little boy lost his way. A kind man helped him find his home. The boy said, \'You are so good!\' The man smiled. Being good means being kind and helpful. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了。一位善良的男士帮助他找到了家。小男孩说：'您真好！'男士笑了。good 这个词意味着善良和乐于助人。**
> 有一天，小明要去远方旅行。他的朋友们都来送行，大家拥抱并微笑着说\'Goodbye\'，意思是希望小明一路平安，期待再次相见。小明也回应着\'Goodbye\'，带着美好的祝福踏上了旅程。 **有一天，小明要去远方旅行，朋友们送行时说的'Goodbye'，意思是希望小明一路平安，期待再次相见，小明也回应着这个词，然后踏上旅程。**

> One day, a little girl lost her way. But goodness was with her. A kind old man helped her find her home. The girl felt the warmth of goodness. Goodness means the quality of being good; kindness and moral excellence. **有一天，一个小女孩迷路了。但幸运的是，一位善良的老人帮她找到了家。小女孩感受到了善良。goodness 意思是善良；美德；仁慈**

> A poor man lost his job. But a kind boss showed goodwill by giving him a new chance. With hard work, the man succeeded and always remembered the boss\'s kindness. Goodwill means kindness and friendly intention. **一个穷人丢了工作。但一位善良的老板展现出善意，给了他一个新机会。通过努力工作，这个人成功了，并一直记得老板的善意。goodwill 意思是善意、友好的意向。**

> One day, I was baking a cake. When I cut it open, the inside was all gooey. It was so sticky and soft, just like a thick, sweet paste. Now I\'ll never forget the word \'gooey\'! **有一天，我在烤蛋糕。当我把它切开时，里面全是黏糊糊的。它是如此的黏稠和柔软，就像厚厚的、甜甜的糊状物。现在我永远不会忘记'gooey'这个词！**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to go to school. He goofed by wearing his shoes on the wrong feet. His classmates laughed, but he learned to be more careful next time. **一天，汤姆匆忙去上学。他犯傻把鞋子穿错了脚。同学们都笑了，但他学到了下次要更仔细。**

> Once upon a time, there was a clumsy and funny dog named Goofy. He always did silly things like running into walls and tripping over his own paws. Everyone laughed at his goofy behavior. **从前，有一只笨拙又有趣的狗叫高飞。他总是做一些傻乎乎的事情，比如撞墙和被自己的爪子绊倒。大家都因他滑稽的行为大笑。**

> A man was walking alone in the dark street. Suddenly, a goon jumped out and tried to rob him. The man was so scared. But luckily, the police came in time and caught the goon. **一个男人独自走在黑暗的街道上。突然，一个暴徒跳出来试图抢劫他。这个男人非常害怕。但幸运的是，警察及时赶到并抓住了这个暴徒。**

> A little girl was walking in the park and saw a goose. The goose was very beautiful with white feathers. It was swimming gracefully in the pond. The girl was so happy to see such a lovely goose. **一个小女孩在公园里散步，看到了一只鹅。这只鹅非常漂亮，有着白色的羽毛。它在池塘里优雅地游着。小女孩看到这么可爱的鹅非常高兴。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in the mountains. When he found a deep and narrow valley filled with ripe fruits, he was amazed. This place was like a gorge of treasures. He ate a lot and felt satisfied. The gorge became his salvation. **一位饥饿的旅行者在山中迷路。当他发现一个幽深狭窄、满是成熟水果的山谷时，他很惊讶。这个地方就像一个宝藏峡谷。他吃了很多，感到满足。这个峡谷成了他的救星。**

> A princess was wearing a GORGEOUS dress at the ball. Everyone was amazed by its beauty. The dress was shiny and colorful, making the princess stand out. \'Gorgeous\' means extremely beautiful and attractive. **一位公主在舞会上穿着一件华丽的裙子。每个人都对其美丽感到惊叹。裙子闪闪发光且色彩斑斓，让公主脱颖而出。\'gorgeous\'意思是极其美丽迷人的。**

> One day, I went to the zoo and saw a huge gorilla. It was beating its chest and looking very powerful. I was so scared but also amazed by its strength. Remember, gorilla is a big and strong ape. **有一天，我去动物园，看到了一只巨大的大猩猩。它捶打着自己的胸膛，看起来非常强大。我很害怕，但也对它的力量感到惊奇。记住，gorilla 是一种体型巨大且强壮的猿类。**

> A brave knight was in a gory battle. The enemy\'s blood splashed everywhere, making the scene very gory. But the knight didn\'t fear and fought bravely. Remember, \'gory\' means involving a lot of blood and violence. **一位勇敢的骑士身处一场血腥的战斗中。敌人的鲜血四溅，场面十分血腥。但骑士毫不畏惧，奋勇作战。记住，'gory'意思是血腥的；残暴的。**

> One day, when I was lost in the forest, I shouted \'Gosh! How can I find my way out?\' It expressed my surprise and anxiety. Later, I was lucky to be found. \'Gosh\' means an expression of surprise or amazement. **有一天，当我在森林里迷路时，我大喊'天哪！我怎么才能出去？' 它表达了我的惊讶和焦虑。后来，我幸运地被找到了。'gosh'意思是表示惊讶或惊奇。**

> A man was lost in a dark forest. Just when he felt hopeless, he heard a voice preaching the \'gospel\' of hope and light. It guided him out of the forest. The \'gospel\' was like a bright lantern in the darkness. **一个男人在黑暗的森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，他听到一个声音在宣扬希望和光明的"福音"。它引导他走出了森林。"福音"就像黑暗中的一盏明灯。**

> A group of friends were always chatting in a corner. They shared secrets and rumors about others. This chatting with rumors and unproven information was called gossip. **一群朋友总是在角落里聊天。他们分享关于其他人的秘密和谣言。这种带有谣言和未经证实信息的聊天就叫做八卦。**

> A traveler entered an old castle. Its architecture was Gothic. The pointed arches and dark interiors gave a mysterious feel. He felt as if time had stopped. Gothic style made a deep impression on him. **一位旅行者进入了一座古老的城堡。它的建筑是哥特式的。尖尖的拱门和昏暗的内部给人一种神秘的感觉。他觉得仿佛时间都停止了。哥特式风格给他留下了深刻的印象。**

> A thief tried to gouge a hole in the wall to steal the treasure. But the police came just in time and caught him. The act of making that hole with force is like what \'gouge\' means. **一个小偷试图在墙上凿一个洞来偷宝藏。但警察刚好及时赶到并抓住了他。那种用力凿洞的行为就像'gouge'这个单词所表达的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a farmer who grew many strange gourds. They were big and colorful. One day, a little girl saw them and was amazed. She asked the farmer about these gourds and learned a lot. **从前，有个农民种了许多奇怪的葫芦。它们又大又多彩。有一天，一个小女孩看到它们感到很惊奇。她向农民询问这些葫芦，并学到了很多。**

> A chef named Tom was known as a gourmet. He could tell the finest ingredients with one taste. His passion for exquisite food made him famous. People came from far to enjoy his gourmet dishes. **一位名叫汤姆的厨师被认为是美食家。他尝一口就能分辨出最优质的食材。他对精致美食的热爱使他出名。人们从远方赶来品尝他的美食佳肴。**

> Once upon a time, in a kingdom, there was a wise leader. His job was to govern the people and make sure everything was in order. He made fair rules and decisions to keep the kingdom peaceful and prosperous. **从前，在一个王国里，有一位明智的领导者。他的工作是治理人民，并确保一切井然有序。他制定公平的规则和决策，以保持王国的和平与繁荣。**

> Once upon a time, in a kingdom, the wise king established a set of rules and systems to manage the land and people. This process was called governance. It made everything orderly and prosperous. **从前，在一个王国里，睿智的国王建立了一套规则和制度来管理土地和人民。这个过程被称为治理。它让一切变得有序和繁荣。**
> 在一个古老的国度，有一群智慧的人组成了一个团队，他们制定规则、管理事务，保障人民的生活，这个团队就叫 government，就像我们的政府一样，为大家服务。 **在一个古老的国度，有一群智慧的人组成的保障人民生活、制定规则和管理事务的团队就叫政府**

> In a faraway land, there was a governmental meeting. The leaders discussed how to make people\'s lives better. They made decisions that affected everyone. Governmental means related to the government and its actions. **在一个遥远的国度，举行了一场政府会议。领导们讨论如何让人民生活得更好。他们做出影响每个人的决策。governmental 意思是与政府及其行为有关的。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, a wise and powerful man was chosen as the governor. He had to make many important decisions to keep the people safe and happy. The governor was like a captain steering the ship of the region. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，一个睿智且强大的人被选为州长。他必须做出许多重要决定来保障人民的安全和幸福。这位州长就像掌控地区之船的船长。**

> A brave man desired to obtain the governorship. He faced many challenges but with wisdom and kindness, he finally achieved it and led the region to prosperity. **一位勇敢的人渴望获得州长职位。他面临诸多挑战，但凭借智慧和善良，最终成功并带领该地区走向繁荣。**

> A beautiful princess was getting ready for a grand ball. Her maid brought her a stunning gown. It was long, flowing, and had shiny pearls. The princess wore the gown and looked like a fairy. **一位美丽的公主正在为一场盛大的舞会做准备。她的女仆给她带来了一件令人惊叹的长袍。它又长又飘逸，还有闪亮的珍珠。公主穿上这件长袍，看起来像个仙女。**

> A thief was running on the street. A brave man saw him and quickly grabbed his arm to stop him. The thief struggled but couldn\'t escape. Finally, the police came and caught the thief. **一个小偷在街上跑。一个勇敢的人看到他，迅速抓住他的胳膊阻止他。小偷挣扎但无法逃脱。最后，警察来了抓住了小偷。**

> Once upon a time, a clumsy dancer was always criticized. But with continuous practice and a positive attitude, she performed with grace and won everyone\'s hearts. Grace here means elegance and charm. **从前，有一个笨拙的舞者总是被批评。但通过不断练习和积极的态度，她优雅地表演并赢得了大家的心。这里的 grace 意思是优雅、魅力。**

> A beautiful swan was swimming in the lake. Its movements were so smooth and elegant that everyone called it graceful. It showed how to move with charm and poise, just like the meaning of the word graceful. **一只美丽的天鹅在湖中游泳。它的动作如此流畅优雅，每个人都称它为优美的。它展示了如何带着魅力和镇定移动，就像 graceful 这个词的意思一样。**

> A beautiful swan swam gracefully in the lake. Its every movement was so elegant and smooth, like a dancer. People were charmed by the swan\'s gracefully swimming posture. **一只美丽的天鹅在湖中优雅地游着。它的每个动作都如此优雅和平滑，像个舞者。人们都被天鹅优雅的游姿所吸引。**

> A king was always gracious to his subjects. When there was a shortage of food, he opened the royal granary. His kindness and courtesy made him a beloved leader. Gracious means kind, polite and showing goodwill. **一位国王总是对他的臣民亲切和蔼。当粮食短缺时，他打开皇家粮仓。他的善良和礼貌使他成为一位深受爱戴的领袖。gracious 意思是亲切的、有礼貌的、和善的。**

> The princess accepted the gift graciously. She smiled and thanked the giver politely, showing her elegance and kindness. Her behavior made everyone feel respected and loved. **公主优雅地接受了礼物。她微笑着礼貌地感谢送礼者，展现出她的优雅和善良。她的行为让每个人都感到被尊重和喜爱。**

> A student named Grad was climbing the steps of knowledge. Each step was a grade he achieved. With every step, he got closer to his goal. Grad worked hard, showing that progress comes with determination. **一个叫 Grad 的学生正在攀登知识的台阶。每一个台阶都是他取得的一个等级。每走一步，他就离目标更近一点。Grad 努力学习，表明进步来自决心。**

> A little monkey wants to climb up the grade of the mountain to get the delicious fruit on the top. It tries hard step by step. The grade here means a level or a stage of something. **一只小猴子想爬上山的斜坡去获取山顶上美味的水果。它一步一步努力攀爬。这里的 grade 意思是等级、阶段。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to know his level in school. So, he went to the grader, who was like a judge of knowledge. The grader carefully evaluated his work and gave him a fair score. **一天，一个小男孩想知道自己在学校的水平。于是，他去找了评分员，评分员就像知识的裁判。评分员仔细评估了他的作业，并给了他一个公平的分数。**

> A brave climber was ascending a mountain. As he went higher, the slope became steeper, showing a clear gradient. It reminded him that progress often comes with varying degrees of difficulty, just like the gradient of the mountain. **一位勇敢的登山者正在登山。当他爬得更高时，山坡变得更陡峭，呈现出明显的坡度。这让他想起进步往往伴随着不同程度的困难，就像山的坡度一样。**

> The students were nervous about the grading of their final exams. The teacher spent days carefully grading each paper, making sure the marks were fair. Finally, when the grades were announced, some were happy while others needed to work harder. **学生们对期末考试的评分感到紧张。老师花了几天时间仔细给每份试卷打分，确保分数公平。最后，当成绩公布时，有些人高兴，而有些人则需要更努力。**
> 想象一只小毛毛虫，它每天都在努力成长。一开始变化很小，但随着时间推移，它的成长变化越来越明显。这种慢慢的、逐步的变化，就像\'gradual\'所表达的，一点点地，循序渐进。 **想象一只小毛毛虫逐步成长的故事来辅助记忆\'gradual\'这个表示逐渐、逐步的单词**

> A little seed was planted. At first, it didn\'t change much. But day by day, gradually, it grew a sprout, then a stem, and finally became a beautiful flower. It showed that change happens slowly and steadily, just like \'gradually\'. **一颗小种子被种下。起初，它没什么变化。但日复一日，渐渐地，它长出了芽，然后是茎，最后变成了一朵美丽的花。这表明变化是缓慢且稳定地发生的，就像'gradually'这个词的意思。**

> A student worked very hard. After many years of study, he finally completed all the courses and exams. With joy, he graduated and threw his cap in the air. It was a moment of great achievement. **一名学生学习非常努力。经过多年的学习，他终于完成了所有的课程和考试。他满心欢喜地毕业了，并把毕业帽抛向空中。这是一个巨大成就的时刻。**

> A student named Lily was very nervous before graduation. But when she put on the graduation cap and received her diploma, all the hard work paid off. She knew it was a new beginning. **一个叫莉莉的学生在毕业前非常紧张。但当她戴上毕业帽并拿到毕业证书时，所有的努力都得到了回报。她知道这是一个新的开始。**

> A doctor was performing a difficult graft operation. He needed to carefully attach a new piece of tissue to the patient\'s body. The success of the graft would mean a healthy recovery. **一位医生正在进行一场艰难的移植手术。他需要小心地将新的组织片附着在患者的身体上。移植的成功将意味着患者的健康恢复。**

> A farmer was very happy because his grains were big and full. He carefully harvested them, knowing they would provide food for many. The grains were like golden treasures. **一位农民非常高兴，因为他的谷粒又大又饱满。他小心翼翼地收割它们，知道它们会为许多人提供食物。这些谷粒就像金色的宝藏。**

> A detective was looking at a grainy photo of a thief. The picture was so grainy that it was hard to make out the details. But with his sharp eyes, he finally found a clue. \'Grainy\' means having a rough texture like grains. **一位侦探正在查看一张小偷的模糊照片。这张照片非常粗糙，难以看清细节。但凭借他敏锐的眼睛，他最终找到了线索。\'grainy\'意思是像颗粒一样质地粗糙的。**

> One day, a little boy was confused about grammar when writing a story. A magic fairy appeared and taught him the rules clearly. With the help of the fairy, he mastered grammar and wrote a wonderful story. **有一天，一个小男孩在写故事时对语法感到困惑。一个神奇的仙女出现了，并清晰地教给他规则。在仙女的帮助下，他掌握了语法，写出了一篇精彩的故事。**

> One day, a little student was confused about grammatical rules. But with the help of a wise owl, he learned that \'grammatical\' means following the rules of language. Now he can write correctly and speak beautifully. **有一天，一个小学生对语法规则感到困惑。但在一只聪明的猫头鹰的帮助下，他了解到'grammatical'意味着遵循语言的规则。现在他能正确书写和漂亮地说话了。**

> A little girl was very excited when she saw the grand castle. It was so big and beautiful with tall towers. She felt like a princess in a fairy tale. The word \'grand\' means large and impressive. **一个小女孩看到宏伟的城堡时非常兴奋。它又大又漂亮，还有高高的塔楼。她感觉自己就像童话故事里的公主。单词\'grand\'意思是宏大的、令人印象深刻的。**

> A poor artist always dreamed of creating works that showed grandeur. One day, he finally painted a magnificent landscape, capturing the essence of grandeur. People were amazed by the beauty and scale of his art. **一位贫穷的艺术家一直梦想创作出展现宏伟壮丽的作品。有一天，他终于画了一幅宏伟的风景画，捕捉到了宏伟壮丽的精髓。人们对他作品的美丽和规模感到惊叹。**

> One day, I was lost in the park. A kind old man helped me find my way home. Later, I learned that he was my grandfather. I was so happy to have such a caring grandfather. **有一天，我在公园迷路了。一位和蔼的老人帮我找到了回家的路。后来，我得知他是我的祖父。能有这样一位关心我的祖父，我非常开心。**

> A king built a grandiose palace. It was huge with shiny gold decorations and tall towers. Everyone was amazed by its magnificence. > One day, I was lost and scared. Suddenly, my grandma appeared like an angel. She held my hand and led me home safely. Her smile and warmth made me feel loved. Grandma is always there for me. **有一天，我迷路了很害怕。突然，我的奶奶像天使一样出现了。她牵着我的手，安全地把我领回了家。她的微笑和温暖让我感受到了爱。奶奶总是在我身边。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost. A kind woman helped her find her way home. The girl later learned that the woman was her grandmother. She had big smiles and warm hugs. > One day, little Tom was lost in the park. He was scared until a kind old man came. The old man helped Tom find his way home. Tom later learned that the old man was his grandpa. **有一天，小汤姆在公园迷路了。他很害怕，直到一位和蔼的老人出现。老人帮助汤姆找到了回家的路。汤姆后来才知道这位老人就是他的爷爷。**

> One day, little Tom was asked to introduce his grandparent at school. He said, \'My grandparent is very kind. They always tell me interesting stories and give me big hugs.\' **有一天，小汤姆在学校被要求介绍他的祖父母。他说：'我的祖父母非常和蔼。他们总是给我讲有趣的故事并且给我大大的拥抱。'**

> One day, a grandpa was very happy because his grandson came to visit. The grandson brought a big smile to the grandpa\'s face. They spent a wonderful time together. Remember, grandson is the child of one\'s child. **有一天，一位爷爷非常开心，因为他的孙子来看望他。孙子给爷爷带来了大大的笑容。他们一起度过了美好的时光。记住，grandson 就是子女的孩子。**

> Once upon a time, a brave miner was digging deep in the mountain. He finally found a beautiful and hard material - granite. It was so strong that it could withstand any pressure, just like the miner\'s unwavering spirit. **从前，有一个勇敢的矿工在山里深挖。他最终发现了一种美丽且坚硬的物质------花岗岩。它非常坚固，能够承受任何压力，就像矿工坚定不移的精神。**

> One day, a little girl got lost. A kind granny appeared and helped her find her way home. The granny had a warm smile and held the girl\'s hand gently. The girl was so grateful to this nice granny. **有一天，一个小女孩迷路了。一位善良的老奶奶出现了，并帮助她找到了回家的路。老奶奶有着温暖的笑容，轻轻地牵着女孩的手。女孩非常感激这位好心的老奶奶。**

> A poor student was very worried about his tuition. Luckily, a kind donor granted him a scholarship. The student was so grateful. \'Grant\' means to give or allow something. **一个贫困的学生非常担心他的学费。幸运的是，一位善良的捐赠者给予了他一份奖学金。这个学生非常感激。'grant'意思是给予或允许某事。**

> A scientist was observing a special substance. It started to granulate, like tiny grains of sand coming together. The scientist was amazed and noted down every detail. **一位科学家正在观察一种特殊的物质。它开始颗粒化，就像细小的沙粒聚集在一起。科学家感到很惊讶，并记录下了每一个细节。**

> One day, a little monkey went to a vineyard. He saw many purple grapes hanging on the vine. The grapes looked so juicy and sweet that the monkey couldn\'t resist eating them. > One day, a little monkey was very hungry. It found a big fruit tree. The fruit looked like a combination of grapes and fruits. Later, it learned that this special fruit was called grapefruit. It was so delicious! **有一天，一只小猴子非常饿。它发现了一棵很大的果树。这个水果看起来像是葡萄和水果的结合体。后来，它得知这个特别的水果叫做葡萄柚。它太美味了！**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The key was in a graph hidden in an old book. The graph showed the connections between the suspects and finally led the detective to the criminal. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。关键在于一本旧书中隐藏的图表。这个图表展示了嫌疑人之间的联系，最终引导侦探找到了罪犯。**

> A graphic designer was working hard on a project. He used various tools to create beautiful and clear graphics. The graphics he made were so amazing that everyone loved them. > A brave knight was in a battle and had to grapple with a fierce dragon. He held on tightly, using all his strength to fight. Just like in life, we need to grapple with difficult situations and not give up easily. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中不得不与凶猛的龙搏斗。他紧紧抓住，用尽全身力气战斗。就像在生活中，我们需要努力应对困难的情况，不要轻易放弃。**

> A monkey wanted to grasp the bananas high up in the tree. It jumped and stretched its arms, finally managing to hold them tightly. > One sunny day, a little rabbit hopped happily in the grass. The grass was so green and soft, like a big green carpet. The rabbit enjoyed playing and eating the fresh grass. It was a wonderful day in the grassland. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一只小兔子在草地里欢快地蹦跳。草地又绿又软，像一张大大的绿色地毯。兔子开心地玩耍，吃着新鲜的草。这是在草地上美好的一天。**

> One sunny day, a little boy was playing in the grass. Suddenly, a grasshopper jumped onto his hand. The boy was amazed by its long legs and green color. He learned it was called a grasshopper and never forgot. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一个小男孩在草地上玩耍。突然，一只蚱蜢跳到他手上。男孩对它的长腿和绿色感到惊奇。他知道了这叫蚱蜢，并且永远不会忘记。**

> One day, a little lamb got lost in the grassland. It looked around, seeing endless grass and wildflowers. Finally, with the help of a kind shepherd, the lamb found its way home. > One sunny day, Tom went for a walk in the park. He saw a beautiful area full of grassy fields. The grass was so green and soft that it looked like a big green carpet. > A poor man was helped by a kind stranger. He received food and clothes. Gratefully, he expressed his deep thanks and promised to pay it forward. > A traveler was lost on a rough road full of gravel. The stones made his journey tough. But when he finally reached his destination, he never forgot the sound and feel of the gravel. Gravel means small stones. **一位旅行者在一条满是砾石的崎岖道路上迷路了。这些石头让他的旅程艰难。但当他最终到达目的地时，他永远不会忘记砾石的声音和感觉。gravel 意思是砾石。**

> 想象一下，你在太空中，周围有很多小行星。你会不由自主地被最大的那颗小行星吸引，就像物体总会 gravitate 向引力中心一样。这种被吸引的感觉就是 gravitate 的意思。 **想象在太空中，你会不由自主被最大的小行星吸引，这就像 gravitate 所表达的被吸引的意思。**

> One day, an astronaut was floating in space. He felt the gravitational pull of the Earth, which was like an invisible force trying to bring him back. This force is called \'gravitational\'. **有一天，一位宇航员在太空中漂浮。他感受到了地球的引力，这就像一种无形的力量试图把他拉回去。这种力量就叫做'引力的'。**

> One day, a little mouse was walking in a gray cave. It was very dark and the walls were all gray. The mouse was a bit scared but still kept going. Finally, it found a way out. > One day, the little sheep were happily playing in the meadow. They were not careful and grazed their legs on the sharp grass. But with the care of the shepherd, they soon recovered. **一天，小羊们在草地上快乐地玩耍。它们不小心，腿在锋利的草上擦伤了。但在牧羊人的照顾下，它们很快就康复了。**

> One sunny day, a group of cows were peacefully grazing in the green meadow. They munched on the fresh grass, enjoying the gentle breeze. The sight of them grazing was so calming. **在一个阳光明媚的日子里，一群奶牛在绿色的草地上安静地吃草。它们咀嚼着新鲜的草，享受着微风。它们吃草的景象如此宁静。**

> One day, Tom was working in a garage. His hands were covered with grease when he was repairing a car. The grease made his hands dirty but it helped the parts move smoothly. **一天，汤姆在一个车库工作。当他修理一辆汽车时，他的双手沾满了油脂。油脂让他的手变脏了，但它帮助零件顺利移动。**

> One day, I went to a small restaurant. The cook\'s apron was greasy. The table was greasy too. Even the food smelled greasy. I realized \'greasy\' means covered with or containing too much oil or fat. **有一天，我去了一家小餐馆。厨师的围裙是油腻的。桌子也是油腻的。甚至食物闻起来都很油腻。我意识到\'greasy\'意思是覆盖着或含有过多的油或脂肪。**

> Once upon a time, a little bird wanted to fly greatly high. It practiced every day and finally achieved its dream. \'Greatly\' here means to a large extent or degree, just like the bird\'s amazing progress. **从前，一只小鸟想要飞得非常高。它每天练习，最终实现了梦想。"greatly"在这里指在很大程度上，就像小鸟惊人的进步。**

> A young artist always dreamed of achieving greatness. He practiced every day, facing difficulties but never giving up. Finally, his works were loved by the world. His pursuit of greatness led to success. **一位年轻的艺术家一直梦想着取得伟大成就。他每天练习，面对困难从不放弃。最终，他的作品受到了全世界的喜爱。他对伟大的追求带来了成功。**

> A poor man found a magic lamp. The genie promised to fulfill his wishes. But the man\'s greed made him keep asking for more and more. Eventually, he lost everything. Remember, greed can lead to loss. **一个穷人发现了一盏神灯。精灵答应满足他的愿望。但这个人的贪婪让他不停地索要更多更多。最终，他失去了一切。记住，贪婪会导致失去。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was always very greedy. Whenever he saw candies, he wanted to take them all. Even when sharing with friends, he still tried to keep the most for himself. People said he was too greedy. **从前，有一个小男孩总是非常贪婪。每当他看到糖果，就想把它们全部拿走。即使和朋友分享时，他也试图为自己保留最多。人们说他太贪婪了。**

> A little girl was walking in the forest. She saw many green trees and beautiful green grass. She lay on the grass and felt so relaxed. Green means the color of nature and life. **一个小女孩在森林里散步。她看到许多绿色的树和漂亮的绿草。她躺在草地上，感到非常放松。green 意思是自然和生命的颜色。**

> A little girl loved to walk in the forest and enjoy the greenery. She saw green trees, green grass and beautiful green flowers. The greenery made her feel happy and peaceful. **一个小女孩喜欢在森林里散步，欣赏绿色植物。她看到绿树、绿草和美丽的绿花。绿色植物让她感到快乐和平静。**

> One day, a little girl named Lily visited a farm. She saw a special building called a \'greenhouse\'. It was filled with green plants and had a warm and cozy atmosphere. Lily learned that it was a place to protect and grow plants well. **有一天，一个叫莉莉的小女孩参观了一个农场。她看到了一个特别的建筑叫"温室"。里面满是绿色的植物，有着温暖舒适的氛围。莉莉了解到这是一个保护和培育植物的好地方。**

> One day, I saw a strange fish in the sea. It had a greenish color, not fully green but a shade close to it. It was so unique that I could never forget this greenish fish. **有一天，我在海里看到一条奇怪的鱼。它有一种带绿色的颜色，不是完全的绿色，而是接近绿色的色调。它太独特了，以至于我永远忘不了这条带绿色的鱼。**

> One day, when Tom was walking in the park, an old friend suddenly appeared and shouted \'Hello!\' to greet him. Tom was very happy to see his friend. The word \'greet\' means to say hello or give a friendly welcome. **一天，当汤姆在公园散步时，一位老朋友突然出现并大喊'你好！'来问候他。汤姆见到朋友非常高兴。单词'greet'的意思是打招呼或友好地欢迎。**

> One day, when Tom was walking on the street, a stranger came up and gave him a warm greeting. Tom felt very happy because of that friendly greeting. It made his day. **有一天，当汤姆走在街上时，一个陌生人走过来给他一个热情的问候。汤姆因为那个友好的问候感到非常开心。它让他这一天都很美好。**

> A lonely sheep was always sad. One day, it met a group of gregarious sheep who loved to play and talk together. The lonely sheep joined them and became happy. Gregarious means sociable and fond of company. **一只孤独的绵羊总是很悲伤。有一天，它遇到了一群喜欢一起玩耍和交流的合群的绵羊。这只孤独的绵羊加入了它们，变得快乐起来。gregarious 意思是爱社交的、合群的。**

> A soldier was in a dangerous battle. The enemy threw a grenade. But he was smart and quickly ducked. The grenade exploded, but he was safe. Remember, grenade means a small bomb that can cause big damage. **一名士兵身处危险的战斗中。敌人扔了一枚手榴弹。但他很聪明迅速蹲下。手榴弹爆炸了，但他安然无恙。记住，grenade 意思是能造成巨大破坏的小型炸弹。**

> Imagine a city in a blackout. People are lost because the power grid fails. The grid of wires and towers that usually bring light is now dark. It\'s like a maze without a way out. Remember, grid means a network of lines or a pattern of crossed lines. **想象一下城市停电。人们不知所措，因为电网故障。通常带来光明的电线和塔架组成的网格现在一片漆黑。就像一个没有出路的迷宫。记住，grid 意思是网格、格子**

> A man lost his beloved pet dog. The pain and sadness he felt was like a heavy cloud. This deep sorrow, this feeling of loss, was his grief. It was a hard emotion to bear. **一个男人失去了他心爱的宠物狗。他所感受到的痛苦和悲伤就像一片沉重的乌云。这种深深的悲痛，这种失落的感觉，就是他的悲伤。这是一种难以承受的情绪。**

> A poor worker was always overworked and underpaid. He felt a deep grievance. One day, he decided to talk to the boss to express his dissatisfaction. The word \'grievance\' represents his complaint and unhappiness. **一个可怜的工人总是工作过度且工资过低。他感到深深的委屈。有一天，他决定和老板谈谈来表达他的不满。单词\'grievance\'代表了他的抱怨和不快。**

> A little bird lost its way and couldn\'t find its home. It grieved, crying sadly. Just like when we feel deep sorrow and pain, that\'s what \'grieve\' means. **一只小鸟迷路了，找不到家。它很悲伤，伤心地哭泣。就像我们感到深深的悲痛和痛苦时，这就是'grieve'的意思。**

> A hungry bear came to a campsite and saw a grill. He thought there would be delicious food on it. But there was nothing. The bear was so disappointed. Remember, grill means a device for cooking food over an open fire. **一只饥饿的熊来到露营地，看到了一个烤架。它以为上面会有美味的食物。但什么都没有。熊非常失望。记住，grill 指的是在明火上烹饪食物的设备。**

> One day, a little mouse was trapped behind a grille. It tried hard to find a way out. Finally, with its wit, it squeezed through a small gap in the grille and escaped. The grille was like a big puzzle for the mouse. **一天，一只小老鼠被困在了一个格栅后面。它努力尝试寻找出路。最后，凭借它的机智，从格栅的一个小缝隙挤了出去并逃脱了。这个格栅对老鼠来说就像一个大谜题。**

> One day, I was very hungry. I went to a restaurant and ordered a grilled steak. The chef cooked the steak on the grill until it was perfectly browned and smelled delicious. That\'s how I remember \'grilled\' means cooked on a grill. **有一天，我非常饿。我去了一家餐厅并点了一份烤牛排。厨师在烤架上烹饪牛排，直到它变成完美的棕色并且闻起来很香。这就是我记住'grilled'表示在烤架上烤制的方式。**

> A brave knight was on a journey. He came to a village where everything was in a bad state. The people\'s faces were grim. They had no food and were full of fear. But the knight decided to help and change their situation. **一位勇敢的骑士正在旅途中。他来到一个村庄，那里的一切都很糟糕。人们的脸色阴沉。他们没有食物，充满恐惧。但骑士决定帮助并改变他们的处境。**

> A little monkey was eating a sour fruit and made a grimace. Its mouth twisted, eyes squinted, showing a very funny and uncomfortable expression. This made us all laugh. **一只小猴子在吃一个酸果子，然后做了个鬼脸。它嘴巴扭曲，眼睛眯起，露出一个非常滑稽又难受的表情。这让我们都大笑起来。**

> A brave cleaner was determined to remove the grime from the old castle. Every corner was covered with thick grime, but he didn\'t give up. Finally, the castle became shiny and clean. **一位勇敢的清洁工决心清除旧城堡上的污垢。每个角落都覆盖着厚厚的污垢，但他没有放弃。最终，城堡变得闪亮又干净。**

> A brave knight faced the dark forest grimly. The path was full of unknown dangers, but he held his sword tightly, determined not to show fear. His expression was grimly serious as he moved forward. **一位勇敢的骑士严峻地面对黑暗的森林。道路充满未知的危险，但他紧紧握住剑，决心不露出恐惧。他表情严峻，严肃地向前迈进。**

> A little mouse was lost in a grimy cave. The walls were covered with dirt and dust. It struggled to find its way out. Finally, it escaped and never wanted to go to such a grimy place again. **一只小老鼠在一个肮脏的洞穴里迷路了。洞壁布满了污垢和灰尘。它努力寻找出路。最后，它逃了出来，再也不想去这么肮脏的地方了。**

> A monkey in the zoo was very naughty. It climbed up a tree and showed a big grin when it saw people taking pictures of it. The wide smile on its face was just like a \'grin\'. **动物园里有一只猴子非常顽皮。它爬上一棵树，当看到人们给它拍照时，露出了大大的露齿笑。它脸上那大大的笑容就像是'grin'（露齿笑）。**

> A poor student had to grind hard every day to prepare for the exam. He sat at the desk for hours, grinding through piles of books and notes. Finally, his efforts paid off and he got a good grade. **一个贫困的学生每天都得刻苦学习来准备考试。他在书桌前一坐就是好几个小时，努力钻研成堆的书和笔记。最终，他的努力得到了回报，取得了好成绩。**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food in a dark corner. Suddenly, it found a grinder full of grains. It was so excited and started to eat. But the grinder was too big for it to move. **一只饥饿的老鼠在黑暗的角落里寻找食物。突然，它发现了一个装满谷物的研磨机。它非常兴奋并开始吃。但研磨机对它来说太大了，根本搬不动。**

> A little ant was on a long journey. It had to do grinding work every day, moving tiny grains of sand one by one. This hard and repetitive task was called grinding. **一只小蚂蚁正在长途旅行。它每天都得做辛苦的工作，一粒一粒地移动小沙粒。这种辛苦又重复的任务就叫做 grinding（折磨人的；繁重的）。**

> A climber was struggling to hold on. The strong wind made it hard to keep a grip on the rope. But with all his strength, he finally managed not to fall. Grip means to hold tightly. **一位登山者正在艰难地坚持着。强风使他很难紧紧抓住绳子。但他用尽全身力气，最终成功没有掉落。grip 意思是紧紧抓住。**

> A little mouse was always griping about the hard cheese in the hole. One day, it found a big piece of soft cheese and stopped griping. It learned that griping doesn\'t solve problems but finding solutions does. **一只小老鼠总是抱怨洞里的硬奶酪。有一天，它找到了一大块软奶酪，就不再抱怨了。它明白了抱怨不能解决问题，找到解决办法才行。**

> A detective was investigating a grisly crime scene. There was blood everywhere, and the body was in a horrible state. This scene made him feel very scared. Remember, grisly means causing horror or fear. **一位侦探正在调查一个可怕的犯罪现场。到处都是血，尸体状况惨不忍睹。这个场景让他感到非常恐惧。记住，grisly 意思是令人恐惧的、恐怖的。**

> A brave little ant was trying to cross a sandy path. Despite the rough sand and strong wind, it kept moving forward with grit. It showed that grit means determination and perseverance in the face of difficulties. **一只勇敢的小蚂蚁试图穿过一条满是沙子的小路。尽管沙子粗糙，风又大，它还是凭借着毅力不断前进。这表明了 grit 这个词意味着在困难面前的决心和坚持不懈。**

> A brave miner was working deep in the mine. The environment was gritty, filled with dust and small stones. But he didn\'t give up. Gritty here means having a rough and dirty quality. **一位勇敢的矿工在矿井深处工作。环境充满了砂砾，到处是灰尘和小石子。但他没有放弃。这里的gritty意思是有粗糙且脏的特质。**

> A brave hunter ventured into the forest and encountered a grizzly bear. The grizzly was huge and fierce, but the hunter remained calm. Remember, \'grizzly\' is the word for such a powerful and scary bear. **一位勇敢的猎人冒险进入森林，遇到了一只灰熊。这只灰熊体型巨大且凶猛，但猎人保持冷静。记住，\'grizzly\'就是这种强大又可怕的熊的单词。**

> One day, I was carrying a heavy box and could only groan. My friend heard my groan and came to help. The sound \'groan\' was like a painful expression when facing a difficult situation. **有一天，我搬着一个很重的箱子，只能呻吟。我的朋友听到我的呻吟声就过来帮忙。'groan'这个声音就像是面对困难处境时痛苦的表达。**

> A young man named Tom wanted to start a business. He decided to become a grocer. He worked hard to stock various goods. Finally, his grocery store was popular and he became a successful grocer. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人想要创业。他决定成为一名杂货商。他努力工作，储备各种商品。最后，他的杂货店很受欢迎，他成为了一名成功的杂货商。**

> One day, Tom was sent by his mom to the grocery to buy some eggs and bread. When he arrived, he saw all kinds of goods. Finally, he got what his mom wanted and went home happily. **一天，汤姆被妈妈派去杂货店买一些鸡蛋和面包。当他到达时，他看到了各种各样的商品。最后，他买到了妈妈想要的东西，开心地回家了。**

> One day, a man woke up feeling groggy. He had stayed up late the night before and now his head was heavy and his steps unsteady. It was as if he was moving in a fog. Remember, groggy means feeling weak and unsteady, especially when just waking up or after being ill. **有一天，一个男人醒来时感觉昏昏沉沉。他前一晚熬夜了，现在他的头很沉重，脚步也不稳。就好像在雾中行走。记住，groggy 意思是感到虚弱和不稳，尤其在刚睡醒或生病后。**

> One day, a football player got hurt in his groin during a fierce match. He felt extreme pain and had to leave the field. Remember, groin is the area where the thigh meets the abdomen. **有一天，一名足球运动员在一场激烈的比赛中腹股沟（groin）受伤了。他感到极度疼痛，不得不离开赛场。记住，groin 就是大腿与腹部相接的部位。**

> A prince was looking for a groom for his horse. One day, a young man carefully cleaned and prepared the horse, impressing the prince. The prince chose him as the groom. From then on, the young man took good care of the horse. **一位王子正在为他的马寻找马夫。有一天，一个年轻人仔细地清洁和准备这匹马，给王子留下了深刻印象。王子选他做了马夫。从此，这个年轻人把马照顾得很好。**

> A young musician was constantly practicing. One day, he found the perfect GROOVE in his playing that made everyone dance. The GROOVE was like a hidden path leading to joy. **一位年轻的音乐家一直在练习。有一天，他在演奏中找到了完美的节奏，让每个人都随之起舞。这个节奏就像一条通往快乐的隐秘路径。**

> A blind man was in a dark room. He had to grope around to find the door. He moved his hands slowly, feeling for something to guide him. Finally, he found the door handle. **一个盲人在一个黑暗的房间里。他不得不摸索着找门。他慢慢地移动双手，摸索着寻找能引导他的东西。最后，他找到了门把手。**

> A merchant sold a lot of fruits. But when he checked the inventory, he found the total weight was much larger than expected. This huge and unpleasant total amount was called \'gross\'. **一位商人卖了很多水果。但当他检查库存时，发现总重量比预期的大得多。这种巨大且令人不快的总量就被称为\'gross\'。**
> A man was grossly overweight and decided to change. He started exercising and eating healthy. Soon, he was no longer grossly out of shape. **一个男人体重严重超标，于是决定改变。他开始锻炼和健康饮食。很快，他就不再严重走样了。**

> A strange creature with a grotesque appearance appeared in the forest. It had a huge head, a tiny body, and limbs of different lengths. Everyone was scared when they saw it. **一只外貌怪异的生物出现在森林里。它有着巨大的脑袋、小小的身体和长短不一的四肢。大家看到它时都很害怕。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a forest and found a hidden grotto. It was dark inside but had beautiful stalactites. The explorer was amazed and never forgot this secret place. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林中迷路，发现了一个隐蔽的洞穴。里面很暗，但有着美丽的钟乳石。探险家感到很惊奇，永远忘不了这个秘密之地。**

> A little bird lost its way and fell to the ground. It was scared but soon found a friendly worm on the ground. The worm helped the bird stand up and fly again. The ground was not so scary after all. **一只小鸟迷路了，掉到了地上。它很害怕，但很快在地上发现了一只友好的虫子。虫子帮助小鸟站起来再次飞翔。毕竟地面也没那么可怕。**

> A little bird was lost in the sky. But with proper grounding, it found its way back to the ground and the familiar tree. Grounding here means a connection to the earth or a solid foundation. **一只小鸟在天空中迷路了。但通过恰当的落地，它找到了回到地面和熟悉的树上的路。这里的grounding意味着与地面的连接或坚实的基础。**

> A thirsty traveler was lost in the desert. Just when he felt hopeless, he found a hidden well. The water inside was groundwater, a precious resource that saved his life. It was hidden beneath the ground, waiting to be discovered. **一位口渴的旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，他发现了一口隐藏的井。里面的水是地下水，这一宝贵的资源救了他的命。它隐藏在地下，等待被发现。**
> 想象一下，在一片空旷的土地上，建筑工人正在努力施工。他们首先要做的就是打好基础，这基础工作就像是groundwork。没有坚实的groundwork，高楼大厦就无法稳固矗立。 **想象在空地上建筑工人施工，首先做的基础工作就像groundwork，没有它高楼无法稳固，辅助理解\'基础；根基\'之意**

> A group of little animals was lost in the forest. They were very scared. But they held together and finally found their way home. Here, \'group\' means a collection of things or people. **一群小动物在森林里迷路了。它们非常害怕。但它们团结在一起，最终找到了回家的路。这里，\'group\'意思是一群人或物的集合。**

> A group of friends were lost in a forest. They decided to do a grouping based on their skills. Some were good at finding food, some at building shelters. With this grouping, they finally found their way out. **一群朋友在森林里迷路了。他们决定根据各自的技能进行分组。一些擅长找食物，一些擅长搭建庇护所。通过这种分组，他们最终找到了出路。**

> A hunter went into the forest to hunt grouse. He searched for a long time but couldn\'t find any. Finally, he saw a group of grouse under a big tree. He was very happy. **一位猎人走进森林去猎松鸡。他找了很久都没找到。最后，他在一棵大树下看到了一群松鸡。他非常高兴。**

> A little girl got lost in a grove. She was scared but then saw a beautiful bird that led her out. The grove was full of tall trees and colorful flowers. **一个小女孩在小树林里迷路了。她很害怕，但随后看到一只漂亮的鸟带她走了出来。这片小树林里满是高大的树木和五颜六色的花。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little seed. Day by day, it got enough water and sunlight. It started to grow. Finally, it became a big and beautiful flower. Growing is the process of changing and becoming better. **从前，有一颗小种子。一天天过去，它获得了充足的水和阳光。它开始生长。最终，它变成了一朵又大又美的花。生长就是改变和变得更好的过程。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He loved plants and decided to become a grower. Every day, he carefully tended to his garden, watching the seeds grow into beautiful flowers and healthy vegetables. His hard work made him a successful grower. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他热爱植物并决定成为一名种植者。每天，他精心照料他的花园，看着种子长成美丽的花朵和健康的蔬菜。他的辛勤工作使他成为了一名成功的种植者。**

> In a small garden, a little seed was placed in the soil. Day by day, it was growing. It pushed through the ground, sprouted leaves, and became a beautiful plant. The growing process was full of hope and wonder. **在一个小花园里，一粒小种子被埋在土里。一天又一天，它在生长。它破土而出，长出叶子，变成了一株美丽的植物。生长的过程充满了希望和奇迹。**

> One day, I was walking in the forest and heard a strange sound. It was a fierce bear growling. Its low and threatening growl made me tremble. I realized that a growl is a deep and angry sound. **有一天，我在森林里散步，听到一个奇怪的声音。原来是一只凶猛的熊在咆哮。它低沉且具有威胁性的咆哮声让我颤抖。我明白了growl 就是低沉愤怒的声音。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little seed. With time and care, it grew and became a big plant. We say it has grown. Grown means to have developed and become larger or more mature. **从前，有一颗小种子。随着时间和照料，它生长并变成了一棵大植物。我们说它已经长大了。grown 意思是已经发展、变得更大或更成熟。**

> Once upon a time, a little seed was planted. With time and care, it began to sprout and grow. It pushed through the soil, reaching for the sun. This process of becoming bigger and stronger is called \'growth\'. **从前，有一颗小种子被种下。随着时间和悉心照料，它开始发芽生长。它从土壤中钻出，努力朝着太阳生长。这个变得更大更强的过程就叫做'growth'（成长；生长）。**

> A hungry ant was looking for food. It finally found some grubs under a big stone. The grubs were fat and juicy. The ant was so happy and took them back home. **一只饥饿的蚂蚁正在寻找食物。它最终在一块大石头下找到了一些幼虫。这些幼虫又肥又多汁。蚂蚁非常高兴，把它们带回了家。**

> A man held a grudge against his neighbor. Because the neighbor\'s dog always barked loudly and disturbed his sleep. But later, they talked and solved the problem. Now he no longer has this grudge. **一个男人对他的邻居心怀怨恨。因为邻居的狗总是大声叫，打扰他睡觉。但后来，他们交谈并解决了问题。现在他不再有这种怨恨了。**

> One day, Tom won a game easily. But his friend Jack gave him a grudging compliment. Jack was reluctant and unwilling to praise Tom sincerely. This shows the meaning of \'grudging\'. **有一天，汤姆轻松赢得了一场比赛。但他的朋友杰克不情愿地赞扬了他。杰克很勉强，并非真心地称赞汤姆。这体现了'grudging'不情愿的、勉强的意思。**

> A young athlete was training for a marathon. Every day, he had grueling workouts. Running long distances, doing countless push-ups. But his perseverance paid off. \'Grueling\' means extremely tiring and difficult. **一位年轻的运动员正在为马拉松训练。每天，他都有艰苦的锻炼。长跑，做无数的俯卧撑。但他的坚持得到了回报。"grueling"意思是极其累人和困难的。**

> A detective was investigating a crime scene. The sight was gruesome -- blood everywhere and mangled bodies. It was so terrifying that it haunted him for nights. Remember, \'gruesome\' means horrible and causing horror. **一位侦探在调查犯罪现场。那个景象很可怕------到处是血和残缺的尸体。这太恐怖了，以至于好几个晚上都萦绕在他心头。记住，\'gruesome\'意思是可怕的、令人毛骨悚然的。**

> A gruff bear lived in the forest. He always growled in a rough voice when other animals came near. But one day, a little rabbit got lost and was scared. The bear\'s gruff manner softened, and he helped the rabbit find its way home. **一只脾气粗暴的熊住在森林里。当其他动物靠近时，它总是用粗哑的声音咆哮。但有一天，一只小兔子迷路了很害怕。熊粗暴的态度变软了，它帮助兔子找到了回家的路。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry but the food was late. He started to grumble, saying \'Why is it taking so long?\'. His grumbling was like a low complaint. Finally, the food arrived and his grumbling stopped. **有一天，汤姆非常饿但食物迟迟不来。他开始嘟囔，说'怎么这么久？'。他的嘟囔就像是低声的抱怨。最后，食物来了，他的嘟囔也就停止了。**

> One day, a little bear was very grumpy. He didn\'t want to play with his friends because he didn\'t have enough honey. Everyone tried to cheer him up, but he just kept being grumpy. Finally, when given a big pot of honey, he became happy again. **一天，一只小熊心情非常不好，很暴躁。他不想和朋友们玩，因为他没有足够的蜂蜜。大家都试图让他高兴起来，但他一直很暴躁。最后，当给了他一大罐蜂蜜时，他又变得开心了。**

> A soldier was on a long march. He was very tired and could only grunt as he carried his heavy equipment. But he kept going, showing his determination. **一名士兵正在长途行军。他非常疲惫，扛着沉重的装备只能发出咕噜声。但他坚持前进，展现出决心。**

> A king promised to guarantee the safety of his people. He built a strong wall and stationed guards. With this guarantee, the people lived peacefully. The king\'s word was like a shield, protecting them all. **一位国王承诺保证他子民的安全。他修建了坚固的城墙并安排了守卫。有了这个保证，人民和平地生活着。国王的话就像一面盾牌，保护着他们所有人。**

> A thief tried to sneak into a house at night. But the brave guard was on duty. He caught the thief and protected the house. The guard was like a hero! **一个小偷在晚上试图潜入一所房子。但是勇敢的守卫正在值班。他抓住了小偷并保护了房子。这个守卫就像一个英雄！**

> A thief tried to enter the guarded castle. The guards were very alert and didn\'t let the thief in. The word \'guarded\' here means protected and watched carefully. **一个小偷试图进入有守卫的城堡。守卫们非常警觉，没让小偷进去。单词\'guarded\'在这里指的是受到保护和被仔细看守。**

> Once upon a time, a brave knight was the guardian of a precious treasure. He protected it day and night, never leaving his post. Just like this knight, a guardian is someone who watches over and protects something precious. **从前，有一位勇敢的骑士是一件珍贵宝物的守护者。他日夜守护，从不离开岗位。就像这位骑士一样，guardian 就是看守和保护珍贵事物的人。**
> 想象一个州长（governor）在选举期间，他的竞选团队为了让大家记住他，制作了一个特别的口号，里面包含了'gubernatorial'这个词，强调他的领导能力和治理（gubernatorial）理念。 **想象州长在选举时其团队用包含此词的口号强调其领导和治理理念来辅助记忆**

> A brave soldier was alone in the forest. He used smart tactics to fight against the enemy like a guerrilla. He hid, attacked suddenly, and then disappeared quickly. The enemy was always confused and couldn\'t catch him. **一位勇敢的士兵独自在森林里。他像游击队员一样运用聪明的战术对抗敌人。他隐藏起来，突然袭击，然后迅速消失。敌人总是困惑不已，抓不住他。**

> One day, I found a mystery box. Everyone was trying to guess what was inside. Some said toys, some said books. Finally, I opened it and it was a beautiful cake! We all laughed because no one guessed it right. **有一天，我发现了一个神秘的盒子。每个人都在努力猜测里面是什么。有人说玩具，有人说书。最后，我打开了它，原来是一个漂亮的蛋糕！我们都笑了，因为没人猜对。**

> A king invited many guests to his castle. One guest was a famous musician who played beautiful music. Everyone was happy to have such wonderful guests. **一位国王邀请了许多客人到他的城堡。其中一位客人是著名的音乐家，演奏了美妙的音乐。每个人都很高兴能有这样出色的客人。**

> A lost traveler was wandering in the forest. Just when he felt hopeless, an old wise man appeared and provided guidance. The traveler followed the directions and finally found his way out. The wise man\'s help was like the meaning of \'guidance\'. **一位迷路的旅行者在森林里徘徊。就在他感到绝望时，一位睿智的老人出现并给予了指导。旅行者遵循指示，最终找到了出路。老人的帮助就如同'guidance'这个词的含义。**

> A traveler was lost in a big forest. Just when he felt hopeless, a kind fairy appeared as a guide. The guide led him out of the forest safely. The traveler was very grateful. **一位旅行者在大森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，一位善良的仙女以向导的身份出现。这个向导带他安全地走出了森林。旅行者非常感激。**

> A tourist was lost in a strange city. Luckily, he found a guidebook that showed him the way to famous attractions. With the help of the guidebook, he had a wonderful trip. **一位游客在一个陌生的城市迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一本指南书，向他展示了去著名景点的路。在指南书的帮助下，他度过了一次美妙的旅行。**

> A lost traveler was in a forest. Just when he felt hopeless, he found a guideline tied between trees. It led him out safely. The guideline was like a rule or direction that saved him. **一位迷路的旅行者在森林里。就在他感到绝望时，他发现树木之间系着一条指引线。它引领他安全走出。这条指引线就像规则或方向拯救了他。**

> In a magical land, there was a Guild of Wizards. They worked together, sharing spells and wisdom. The Guild protected the people and was known for its unity and power. Remember, \'guild\' is like this group of powerful wizards. **在一个神奇的土地上，有一个巫师公会。他们一起工作，分享法术和智慧。这个公会保护着人民，并以其团结和力量而闻名。记住，\'guild\'就像这个强大的巫师团体。**

> A thief stole a precious necklace and felt extreme guilt. Every time he saw the police, his heart raced. He knew his action was wrong and the feeling of guilt haunted him. Eventually, he decided to return the necklace and confess. **一个小偷偷了一条珍贵的项链，感到极度内疚。每次看到警察，他的心就狂跳。他知道自己的行为是错误的，内疚感一直困扰着他。最终，他决定归还项链并坦白。**

> A thief was caught stealing. When asked, he looked down, feeling very guilty. His heart was heavy as he knew he had done wrong. Finally, he confessed and promised never to do it again. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓住了。当被询问时，他低下头，感到非常内疚。他心情沉重，因为他知道自己做错了。最后，他坦白了并承诺再也不这样做了。**

> A little girl went to a pet store and saw a cute guinea pig. She loved it so much and wanted to take it home. The guinea pig had soft fur and was very friendly. \'Guinea\' reminds us of this lovely pet. **一个小女孩去宠物店，看到一只可爱的豚鼠。她非常喜欢，想把它带回家。这只豚鼠有着柔软的毛，非常友好。'guinea'让我们想起这只可爱的宠物。**

> A thief came to the village under the guise of a traveling merchant. He wore nice clothes but had bad intentions. Later, people found out his true identity. Remember, guise means a false appearance or way of presenting oneself. **一个小偷以旅行商人的伪装来到村子里。他穿着好看的衣服但心怀不轨。后来，人们发现了他的真实身份。记住，guise 意思是伪装，虚假的外表或呈现自己的方式。**

> A young boy always dreamt of playing the guitar. One day, he found a magical guitar in the forest. When he touched it, beautiful music filled the air. From then on, he practiced hard and became a great guitarist. **一个小男孩一直梦想着弹吉他。有一天，他在森林里发现了一把神奇的吉他。当他触摸它时，美妙的音乐弥漫在空中。从那以后，他努力练习，成为了一名出色的吉他手。**

> One day, a young man was walking in the park. Suddenly, he heard beautiful music. He followed the sound and saw a guitarist playing a wonderful song. The guitarist\'s fingers moved nimbly on the guitar strings, creating a magical melody. **一天，一个年轻人在公园里散步。突然，他听到了美妙的音乐。他顺着声音望去，看到一位吉他手正在弹奏一首美妙的歌曲。吉他手的手指在琴弦上灵活地移动，创造出了神奇的旋律。**

> A brave sailor was lost at sea. He drifted between two huge land masses, separated by a deep and wide gulf. He struggled to find his way back, facing the vast unknown of the gulf. **一位勇敢的水手在海上迷失了。他在两块巨大的陆地之间漂流，这两块陆地被一个又深又宽的海湾隔开。他努力寻找回去的路，面对着海湾的广阔未知。**

> A boy was playing on the beach. Suddenly, a gull flew over and dropped a shiny pearl. The boy was amazed. He thought the gull was like a magical messenger. From then on, whenever he saw a gull, he remembered that magical moment. **一个男孩在海滩上玩耍。突然，一只海鸥飞过来并丢下一颗闪亮的珍珠。男孩很惊讶。他觉得这只海鸥就像一个神奇的信使。从那以后，每当他看到海鸥，就会想起那个神奇的时刻。**

> One day, while hiking in the mountains, I came across a deep gully. It was like a big crack in the earth. I had to be very careful not to fall into it. The gully was so impressive that I\'ll never forget it. **有一天，在山里徒步时，我遇到了一个很深的冲沟。它就像大地的一道大裂缝。我必须非常小心才不会掉进去。这个冲沟令人印象深刻，我永远不会忘记。**

> A hungry puppy saw a bowl of food and gulped it down quickly. It was so eager that it didn\'t even chew properly. Just like when we are really thirsty and gulp down water in a hurry. **一只饥饿的小狗看到一碗食物，很快就大口吞咽下去。它太急切了，甚至都没有好好咀嚼。就像我们非常口渴时匆忙大口喝水一样。**

> A girl was chewing gum while walking in the park. Suddenly, the gum got stuck on her shoe. She had to use a stick to remove it. Remember, gum can be sticky and cause trouble! **一个女孩在公园散步时嚼着口香糖。突然，口香糖粘在了她的鞋上。她不得不使用一根棍子把它弄掉。记住，口香糖可能会很粘并带来麻烦！**

> A traveler was lost in a strange town. He was hungry and found a local restaurant. The owner recommended gumbo, a special thick soup. The traveler loved it and always remembered the taste and the word \'gumbo\' during his journey. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他很饿，找到了一家当地餐馆。老板推荐了秋葵浓汤（gumbo），这是一种特别的浓汤。旅行者很喜欢，在他的旅程中总是记得这个味道和'gumbo'这个词。**

> One day, a thief broke into a house. The owner was very brave and quickly grabbed a GUN from the drawer. He pointed the gun at the thief and shouted, \'Don\'t move!\' The thief was scared and surrendered immediately. **有一天，一个小偷闯进了一所房子。主人非常勇敢，迅速从抽屉里抓起一把枪。他用枪指着小偷并大喊：\'不许动！\'小偷被吓到了，立刻投降。**

> In the dark forest, a brave soldier was on a mission. Suddenly, there was deafening gunfire. He had to stay calm and find cover. The continuous gunfire made his heart race, but he was determined to complete the task. **在黑暗的森林里，一位勇敢的士兵正在执行任务。突然，响起了震耳欲聋的枪炮声。他不得不保持冷静并寻找掩护。持续的枪炮声让他心跳加速，但他决心完成任务。**

> One dark night, a bank was attacked. The police quickly arrived and found a mysterious figure. They called him the gunman, as he was holding a gun and seemed ready to cause harm. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一家银行遭到了袭击。警察迅速赶到，发现了一个神秘的身影。他们称他为持枪歹徒，因为他手持一把枪，似乎准备造成伤害。**

> A brave soldier named Tom was a gunner. During a fierce battle, he accurately operated the big gun and protected his comrades. His precise shooting made the enemy tremble. Tom, the gunner, was a hero. **一位勇敢的士兵汤姆是一名炮手。在一场激烈的战斗中，他精准地操作着大炮，保护了战友。他精准的射击让敌人胆寒。汤姆，这位炮手，是个英雄。**

> A thief held a gun to the victim\'s head at gunpoint, demanding all the money. The victim was terrified. Remember, \'gunpoint\' means being threatened by a gun. **一个小偷用枪指着受害者的头进行威胁，索要所有的钱。受害者非常害怕。记住，\'gunpoint\'意思是在枪口的威胁下。**

> Long ago, a brave inventor was working in his lab. One day, he mixed some special substances and created a powerful thing - gunpowder. It could make a huge explosion and changed the way of war. **很久以前，一位勇敢的发明家在他的实验室里工作。有一天，他混合了一些特殊的物质，创造出了一种强大的东西 - 火药。它能产生巨大的爆炸，改变了战争的方式。**

> One night, in a quiet town, a sudden gunshot broke the silence. A thief was trying to rob a store. The police arrived quickly after hearing the gunshot. The loud and sharp sound of the gunshot was unforgettable. **一天晚上，在一个安静的小镇上，突然一声枪响打破了寂静。一个小偷正试图抢劫一家商店。听到枪声后警察迅速赶到。那响亮而尖锐的枪声令人难以忘怀。**

> A young man was lost in his career. One day, he met a wise old man, the guru. The guru gave him valuable advice and guided him to success. The young man was grateful and always remembered the guru\'s wisdom. **一个年轻人在职业生涯中迷失了方向。有一天，他遇到了一位睿智的老人，即宗师。宗师给了他宝贵的建议，并引导他走向成功。年轻人很感激，永远记住了宗师的智慧。**

> A fire hydrant was damaged, and water began to gush out. It was like a wild river, flowing rapidly and forcefully. People were shocked by the powerful and sudden flow. **一个消防栓被损坏了，水开始喷涌而出。就像一条狂野的河流，迅速而有力地流淌着。人们被这强大而突然的水流震惊了。**

> One day, I was walking in the park when a sudden gust of wind blew my hat away. I had to run after it. The strong gust made the trees sway. It was quite an adventure. **有一天，我正在公园里散步，突然一阵强风把我的帽子吹走了。我不得不去追它。这阵强风让树木摇晃。这真是一次冒险。**

> A hungry bear entered a forest with great gusto. It sniffed around, eager to find food. Its enthusiasm and excitement showed its gusto for the hunt. Soon, it found a beehive and enjoyed the sweet honey. **一只饥饿的熊满怀热情地走进了森林。它到处嗅着，急切地寻找食物。它的热情和兴奋展现出它对捕猎的兴致。很快，它找到了一个蜂巢，尽情享受着甜美的蜂蜜。**

> A brave mouse had to go through a long and dark gut to find food. It was narrow and scary, but the mouse was determined. Finally, it succeeded and got a big piece of cheese. The \'gut\' here means the inside passage of something. **一只勇敢的老鼠不得不穿过一条又长又黑的肠道去寻找食物。它狭窄又可怕，但老鼠很坚定。最后，它成功了，并得到了一大块奶酪。这里的"gut"指的是某物的内部通道。**

> A little cat was playing in the gutter. It got its paws dirty. But then a kind girl came and helped the cat clean up. The gutter here is like a narrow channel along the side of the road. **一只小猫在排水沟里玩耍。它把爪子弄脏了。但随后一个善良的女孩过来帮助小猫清理干净。这里的gutter就像是道路边上的狭窄通道。**

> One day, a little boy saw a strange guy in the park. The guy had a big hat and colorful clothes. The boy was curious and followed him. Later, he found out the guy was a clown performing for kids. **一天，一个小男孩在公园看到一个奇怪的家伙。这个家伙戴着一顶大帽子，穿着五颜六色的衣服。小男孩很好奇，就跟着他。后来，他发现这个家伙是个为孩子们表演的小丑。**

> One day, Tom felt very weak. So he decided to go to the \'gym\' to become strong. He exercised hard there, running, lifting weights. Finally, he became healthy and energetic. **一天，汤姆感觉很虚弱。所以他决定去"健身房"让自己变得强壮。他在那里努力锻炼，跑步、举重。最后，他变得健康且充满活力。**

> Once upon a time, a boy named Tom was always weak. So he decided to go to a big building called \'gymnasium\' every day to exercise and become strong. Finally, he achieved his goal. **从前，有个叫汤姆的男孩身体总是很虚弱。所以他决定每天去一个叫做'体育馆'的大房子里锻炼，变得强壮。最终，他实现了目标。**

> A gymnast dreams of winning the gold medal. Every day, she practices hard in the gym, doing flips and jumps. Her dedication makes her a great gymnast. **一位体操运动员梦想赢得金牌。每天，她都在体育馆努力练习，做翻转和跳跃动作。她的专注使她成为一名出色的体操运动员。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved gymnastics. He practiced every day, doing flips and jumps. Gymnastics made him strong and flexible. He dreamed of winning medals. Gymnastics became his passion! **从前，有一个小男孩热爱体操。他每天练习，做翻转和跳跃动作。体操让他变得强壮和灵活。他梦想着赢得奖牌。体操成为了他的热爱！**

> A young woman was very worried about her health. So, she went to see a gynecologist. The gynecologist was kind and patient, carefully examined her and gave her useful advice. **一位年轻女子非常担心自己的健康。于是，她去看了妇科医生。这位妇科医生和蔼且有耐心，仔细地为她做了检查并给了她有用的建议。**

> A gypsy was traveling through the forest. One day, he lost his precious map. But with his wisdom and luck, he found it under a big tree. The gypsy continued his journey happily. **一个吉普赛人正在森林里旅行。有一天，他弄丢了珍贵的地图。但凭借智慧和运气，他在一棵大树下找到了它。吉普赛人开心地继续他的旅程。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. When he finally found a way out, he shouted \'Ha!\' with joy. It was a moment of relief and celebration. Remember, \'ha\' is an expression of surprise or joy. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。当他终于找到出路时，他高兴地大喊'哈！'。这是放松和庆祝的时刻。记住，'ha'是表示惊讶或喜悦的表达。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He always got up early and read books. This became his regular action. We call this kind of regular action a \'habit\'. **从前，有一个小男孩。他总是早起读书。这成了他的常规行为。我们把这种常规行为称为'习惯'。**

> Imagine a group of explorers searching for a new planet. They finally find one that has clean air, water and suitable temperature. They shout, \'This planet is habitable!\' meaning it\'s suitable for living. **想象一群探险家寻找新的星球。他们最终找到一个有干净的空气、水和适宜温度的星球。他们大喊：'这个星球是可居住的！'意思是它适合居住。**

> A little bird was lost and couldn\'t find its habitat. It flew around, feeling very sad. Finally, with the help of other birds, it returned to its beautiful and comfortable habitat. The habitat is where it belongs. **一只小鸟迷路了，找不到它的栖息地。它到处飞，非常伤心。最后，在其他鸟儿的帮助下，它回到了美丽舒适的栖息地。栖息地就是它所属的地方。**

> A little bird was looking for a habitation. It flew over many places and finally found a cozy tree hole. It was so happy to have a safe and warm place to call home. **一只小鸟正在寻找栖息地。它飞过很多地方，最终找到了一个舒适的树洞。它很高兴拥有了一个安全温暖的家。**

> A monkey had a habitual behavior of climbing the same tree every morning. It did this so often that it became a usual part of its routine. This shows what \'habitual\' means - something done regularly and often. **一只猴子有个习惯性的行为，每天早上都爬同一棵树。它经常这样做，以至于这成了它日常的一部分。这就展示了'habitual'的意思------经常且有规律地做某事。**

> A little monkey always climbed the same tree to get fruits habitually. One day, the tree was gone. It realized its habitual behavior needed to change. **一只小猴子总是习惯性地爬上同一棵树去摘果子。有一天，那棵树没了。它意识到自己习惯性的行为需要改变。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was lost and found a beautiful hacienda. It was a large estate with many fields and a big house. The owner was kind and gave the traveler food and shelter. So, hacienda means a large estate or a ranch. **从前，有一位旅行者迷路了，发现了一个美丽的大庄园。这是一个有着许多田地和大房子的大地产。主人很善良，给了旅行者食物和住所。所以，hacienda 意思是大庄园或大牧场。**

> A brave knight was hacking through a thick forest to rescue the princess. He used his sharp sword to hack away the branches and vines. Finally, he reached the castle and saved her. **一位勇敢的骑士正在砍穿一片茂密的森林去营救公主。他用锋利的剑砍断树枝和藤蔓。最终，他到达城堡并救了她。**

> One day, a mysterious hacker broke into a company\'s computer system. He was very skilled and could bypass all the security measures. But in the end, he was caught by the smart IT experts. Remember, a hacker is someone who illegally accesses computer systems. **有一天，一个神秘的黑客闯入了一家公司的计算机系统。他技术高超，能够绕过所有的安全措施。但最终，他被聪明的 IT 专家抓住了。记住，黑客就是非法访问计算机系统的人。**

> A poor man went to the market to buy a coat. He kept haggle with the seller over the price. Finally, he got a good deal. He was happy because he saved some money. **一个穷人去市场买一件外套。他一直和卖家就价格讨价还价。最后，他得到了一个好价钱。他很高兴，因为他省了一些钱。**

> One day, when Tom was walking in the park, he suddenly heard a strange sound. \'Hah!\' It turned out to be a monkey playing tricks. Tom was amused by the monkey\'s funny expression and the unexpected sound. **有一天，当汤姆在公园散步时，他突然听到一个奇怪的声音。'哈！'原来是一只猴子在搞怪。汤姆被猴子有趣的表情和这意外的声音逗乐了。**

> A man was walking in a storm. Suddenly, ice balls started to fall from the sky. He shouted, \'It\'s hailing!\' Hail was hitting him hard. But he found shelter and was safe. Remember, hail means ice balls falling from the sky. **一个男人正在暴风雨中行走。突然，冰球开始从天上掉落。他大喊：'在下冰雹！'冰雹猛烈地砸向他。但他找到了庇护所，安全了。记住，hail 意思是从天上掉落的冰球。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in the garden. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and messed up her hair. She tried to fix it but it was all tangled. Poor girl! Hair is what grows on our heads and gives us different looks. **一天，一个小女孩在花园里玩耍。突然，一阵强风吹乱了她的头发。她试图整理，但头发都缠在一起了。可怜的女孩！头发是长在我们头上的东西，给我们不同的外观。**

> One day, Tom was very unhappy because his hair was too long. So he went to a barber shop and got a nice haircut. After that, he felt fresh and confident. **有一天，汤姆非常不开心，因为他的头发太长了。于是他去了一家理发店，剪了一个好看的发型。之后，他感觉清爽又自信。**

> One day, Mary went to a party. Before going, she spent a long time doing her hairdo. She styled her hair beautifully and got many compliments at the party. **有一天，玛丽去参加一个派对。在去之前，她花了很长时间做发型。她把头发弄得很漂亮，在派对上得到了很多称赞。**

> One day, I went to a shop. There was a person named Lily. She was very good at cutting and styling hair. She was a hairdresser. People loved her work because she made them look beautiful. **有一天，我去了一家店。有一个叫莉莉的人。她非常擅长剪发和做发型。她是一名理发师。人们喜欢她的工作，因为她能让他们看起来很漂亮。**

> One day, a little girl was very sad because she noticed her hairline was not as perfect as she wanted. But her mother told her that everyone\'s hairline is unique and beautiful in its own way. **有一天，一个小女孩非常伤心，因为她发现自己的发际线不像她想要的那么完美。但她的妈妈告诉她，每个人的发际线都有其独特和美丽之处。**

> One day, Lily went to a party. She had a new hairstyle that made her look like a princess. Everyone praised her beautiful hairstyle. It was long and curly. Lily was very happy. **一天，莉莉去参加一个聚会。她有了一个新发型，让她看起来像个公主。每个人都称赞她漂亮的发型。它又长又卷。莉莉非常高兴。**

> One day, I saw a strange creature in the forest. It was very hairy, with long and thick fur all over its body. Its hairy appearance made it look both mysterious and a little scary. **有一天，我在森林里看到一个奇怪的生物。它浑身长满了毛，长长的、厚厚的毛覆盖全身。它毛茸茸的样子看起来既神秘又有点吓人。**

> One day, Tom had a pizza. But he was not very hungry, so he ate only half of it. The other half was left for his friend. This shows that \'half\' means one of two equal parts. **有一天，汤姆有一个披萨。但他不是很饿，所以他只吃了一半。另一半留给了他的朋友。这表明'half'的意思是两个相等部分中的一个。**

> A little rabbit was running in a race. When it reached the halfway point, it was very tired but still didn\'t give up. It kept going and finally finished the race. \'Halfway\' means in the middle of a journey or process. **一只小兔子正在赛跑。当它到达中途时，它非常累但仍未放弃。它继续前进并最终完成了比赛。\'Halfway\'意思是在旅程或过程的中间。**

> A hungry fisherman went fishing. After a long wait, he finally caught a big halibut. It was so heavy that he needed help to pull it in. The halibut became a delicious meal for his family. **一个饥饿的渔夫去钓鱼。经过漫长的等待，他终于钓到了一条大比目鱼。它太重了，以至于他需要帮忙才能把它拉上来。这条比目鱼成了他家的一顿美味大餐。**

> One day, Tom got lost in a big building. He wandered around and finally found a wide and long passage called a hall. There were many doors along it. Tom was relieved as he knew he could find his way out through this hall. **一天，汤姆在一座大建筑里迷路了。他四处徘徊，最后发现了一个又宽又长的通道叫做大厅。沿着它有很多门。汤姆松了一口气，因为他知道可以通过这个大厅找到出去的路。**

> A thief broke into a hall. But he was caught because he left a unique hallmark on the wall. Later, people used \'hallmark\' to mean a distinctive feature. **一个小偷闯进了一个大厅。但他被抓住了，因为他在墙上留下了独特的印记。后来，人们用'hallmark'表示显著特征。**
> 在一个古老的小镇，有一座被视为神圣的(hallowed)寺庙。每年特定的日子，人们都会怀着敬畏之心前往朝拜。这座寺庙见证了无数的祈祷和希望，它的神圣不可侵犯。 **在一个古老的小镇，有一座被视为神圣的寺庙。每年特定的日子，人们都会怀着敬畏之心前往朝拜。这座寺庙见证了无数的祈祷和希望，它的神圣不可侵犯。**

> One night, after a very tiring day, Tom fell asleep. In his dream, he saw strange creatures and scenes that weren\'t real. It was like a hallucination. When he woke up, he realized it was all in his mind. **一天晚上，在非常疲惫的一天之后，汤姆睡着了。在他的梦里，他看到了不真实的奇怪生物和场景。这就像是一种幻觉。当他醒来时，他意识到这一切都在他的脑海里。**

> One day, Tom was running in the hallway of his school. He accidentally dropped his book but quickly picked it up. The hallway was long and full of students going to classes. **一天，汤姆在学校的走廊里跑。他不小心把书掉了，但很快捡了起来。走廊很长，满是去上课的学生。**
> 一个天使在天空中飞翔，她的头上有一个明亮的光环，这个光环就像 halo 一样散发着柔和的光芒。人们看到这个光环，就知道天使带来了希望和美好。 **一个天使头上有明亮的光环，像单词 halo 一样，人们看到光环知天使带来希望美好。**

> A group of travelers were walking in the forest. Suddenly, a huge bear appeared. \'Halt!\' shouted the leader. Everyone stopped immediately and stayed quiet. Thanks to this halt, they avoided danger. **一群旅行者正在森林里行走。突然，一只巨大的熊出现了。"停下！"领队喊道。所有人立刻停了下来并保持安静。多亏了这次停下，他们避免了危险。**

> A horse was running freely in the field. But to control it, the owner put a halter on its head. The halter helped keep the horse safe and guided its movements. **一匹马在田野里自由奔跑。但为了控制它，主人给它的头上套了一个笼头。笼头帮助保证马的安全并引导它的行动。**

> A little rabbit was running in the forest. But it was injured and its steps were halting. It moved slowly and unsteadily. Finally, it found a safe place to rest. **一只小兔子在森林里跑。但它受伤了，它的脚步蹒跚。它移动得缓慢且不稳。最后，它找到了一个安全的地方休息。**

> One day, I had a big pizza. But it was too much for me. So, I decided to halve it and share with my friend. We both enjoyed the delicious pizza happily. **一天，我有一个大披萨。但对我来说太多了。所以，我决定把它切成两半，和我的朋友分享。我们都开心地享用了美味的披萨。**

> Once upon a time, there was a hungry man. He found a big ham in the fridge. The ham was so delicious that he ate it all. From then on, whenever he thought of \'ham\', he remembered that wonderful taste. **从前，有个饥饿的人。他在冰箱里发现了一大块火腿。火腿太美味了，他全吃光了。从那以后，每当他想到'ham'这个单词，就会想起那美妙的味道。**

> A hungry boy named Tom was at a fair. He was so tired and wanted to eat. Then he saw a big and juicy hamburger. He took a bite and felt happy. The hamburger was his favorite food. **一个叫汤姆的饥饿男孩在集市上。他又累又想吃东西。然后他看到一个又大又多汁的汉堡包。他咬了一口，感到很开心。汉堡包是他最喜欢的食物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom who lived in a small hamlet. The hamlet was peaceful and beautiful. Everyone knew each other and helped one another. Tom loved his home in the hamlet. **从前，有个小男孩叫汤姆，他住在一个小村子里。这个村子宁静又美丽。大家都互相认识，互相帮助。汤姆喜欢他在这个村子里的家。**

> One day, a little boy saw a big hammer in his father\'s toolbox. He picked it up and tried to hit a nail. But it was too heavy. Finally, with his father\'s help, he learned how to use the hammer properly. **一天，一个小男孩在他父亲的工具箱里看到一把大锤子。他拿起它试图钉钉子。但它太重了。最后，在他父亲的帮助下，他学会了如何正确使用锤子。**

> One hot summer day, Tom was so tired. He found a hammock under a big tree. He lay in it and gently swayed. Soon, he fell asleep and had a wonderful dream. The hammock gave him a cozy and relaxing time. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆非常疲倦。他在一棵大树下发现了一个吊床。他躺在上面轻轻摇晃。很快，他就睡着了，做了一个美妙的梦。吊床给了他一段舒适和放松的时光。**

> A man was on a picnic and brought a big hamper filled with food. But the heavy hamper got stuck in the mud, hampering his plan to enjoy the picnic smoothly. **一个男人去野餐，带了一个装满食物的大篮子。但沉重的篮子陷进了泥里，妨碍了他顺利享受野餐的计划。**

> One day, a little boy saw a cute hamster in a pet store. The hamster had chubby cheeks and was running fast on a wheel. The boy was so happy and decided to take it home and become good friends with it. **有一天，一个小男孩在宠物店里看到一只可爱的仓鼠。这只仓鼠有着胖乎乎的脸颊，在轮子上跑得很快。小男孩非常高兴，决定把它带回家并和它成为好朋友。**
> 想象一个运动员在比赛前，被对手恶意伤害了后腿肌腱（hamstring），导致无法正常比赛。这让大家都记住了 hamstring 这个表示'后腿肌腱'的单词。 **想象一位运动员在赛前被对手恶意弄伤后腿肌腱，从而记住 hamstring 这个表示'后腿肌腱'的单词。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a forest. He was very scared. Suddenly, a kind fairy appeared and gave him a magic hand. With this hand, Tom could find his way home easily. **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。他非常害怕。突然，一个善良的仙女出现了，并给了他一只神奇的手。凭借这只手，汤姆轻松地找到了回家的路。**

> One day, Mary was in a hurry to go shopping. She forgot her handbag at home. When she realized it, she rushed back. In the handbag were her keys and wallet. Without it, she couldn\'t buy what she wanted. **有一天，玛丽匆忙去购物。她把她的手提包忘在家里了。当她意识到的时候，她急忙跑回去。手提包里有她的钥匙和钱包。没有它，她就买不了想要的东西。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange city. Luckily, he found a handbook that guided him through the streets and helped him discover all the wonderful places. The handbook was like a magic key! **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一本手册，这本手册引导他穿过街道，帮助他发现了所有美妙的地方。这本手册就像一把神奇的钥匙！**

> A thief was caught stealing in the market. The police quickly put handcuffs on his hands to prevent him from escaping. The handcuffs were strong and shiny, making it impossible for the thief to move freely. **一个小偷在市场偷东西被抓了。警察迅速给他的手戴上手铐以防他逃跑。手铐坚固又闪亮，让小偷无法自由活动。**
> One day, I was at a party and there were only a handful of people. I could count them easily on one hand. It was a small and cozy gathering. **有一天，我在一个聚会上，只有少数几个人。我一只手就能轻易地数过来。这是一个小型且温馨的聚会。**

> One night, a thief broke into a house. The owner was very brave and quickly grabbed a handgun from the drawer. With the handgun in hand, the owner scared the thief away and protected his family. **一天晚上，一个小偷闯进了一所房子。主人非常勇敢，迅速从抽屉里抓起一把手枪。拿着手枪，主人把小偷吓跑了，保护了他的家人。**

> A brave athlete didn\'t let his physical handicap stop him. He trained hard and finally won the race. The handicap was like a big rock, but he turned it into a stepping stone. **一位勇敢的运动员没有让身体上的障碍阻挡他。他刻苦训练，最终赢得了比赛。障碍就像一块大石头，但他把它变成了垫脚石。**

> A handicapped person named Tom struggled to walk. But with his strong will, he learned to use special tools and finally overcame difficulties. \'Handicapped\' means having a physical or mental disability that limits one\'s abilities. **有一个叫汤姆的残障人士，行走艰难。但凭借坚强的意志，他学会使用特殊工具，最终克服了困难。\'handicapped\'意思是有身体或精神上的残疾，限制了个人的能力。**

> A thief was trying to escape. But the police caught him handily. They were well-prepared and acted quickly. It shows that they did the job easily and skillfully. **一个小偷试图逃跑。但警察轻而易举地抓住了他。他们准备充分并且行动迅速。这表明他们轻松且熟练地完成了这项工作。**

> One day, a thief was caught. The police found the stolen goods and said, \'This is your handiwork.\' It means the things made or done by someone, especially bad things. The thief had to admit it was his fault. **一天，一个小偷被抓住了。警察发现了被盗物品并说：'这是你的手艺（作品，恶行）。' 它指某人所做的东西，尤指不好的事。小偷不得不承认是他的错。**

> One day, a man hurt his hand (hand) while working. His friend quickly gave him a piece of cloth to cover the wound. That cloth was like a kerchief. So, together, we have \'handkerchief\'! **有一天，一个男人工作时伤了手（hand）。他的朋友迅速给他一块布来包扎伤口。那块布就像头巾（kerchief）。所以，合起来，就有了\'手帕（handkerchief）\'这个词！**
> 想象一个大力士，他轻松地握住（handle）巨大的杠铃，掌控着它的方向和重量。就像我们在生活中要学会握住各种机会和困难，handle 就是掌控、处理的意思。 **想象一个大力士轻松握住杠铃，就像我们要学会掌控机会和处理困难，以此记住 handle 意为掌控、处理。**
> One day, Tom was riding a bike with strange handlebars. They were not like the normal ones. The unique handlebars made his ride very special. **一天，汤姆骑着一辆有着奇怪车把的自行车。它们不像正常的车把。独特的车把让他的骑行变得非常特别。**

> A monkey was trained as a handler to manage a group of little rabbits. It carefully took care of them, showing its handling skills. One day, it successfully led the rabbits to find fresh carrots. The monkey was a great handler! **一只猴子被训练成管理员来管理一群小兔子。它细心地照顾它们，展现出了管理能力。有一天，它成功地带领兔子们找到了新鲜的胡萝卜。这只猴子是个很棒的管理员！**

> One day, I was handling a fragile vase very carefully. But suddenly, a naughty cat jumped onto the table and almost knocked it over. I managed to hold the vase steady. Handling things requires attention and caution! **有一天，我正在非常小心地拿放一个易碎的花瓶。但突然，一只顽皮的猫跳上桌子差点把它打翻。我设法稳住了花瓶。拿放东西需要注意力和小心！**

> One day, I was walking in a market and saw a beautiful scarf. The seller told me it was handmade. It was made with care by a skilled artisan using their hands, not by machines. That made it very special. **有一天，我在市场上走着，看到一条漂亮的围巾。卖家告诉我这是手工制作的。它是由一位熟练的工匠用双手精心制作的，而不是机器。这使得它非常特别。**

> One day, a teacher was giving handouts to students in the classroom. The handouts had important knowledge for the exam. Students were happy to receive them and started to study. **有一天，一位老师在教室里给学生发讲义。这些讲义有考试的重要知识。学生们高兴地收到它们并开始学习。**

> One day, Tom lost his handset while running. He was very worried and searched everywhere. Finally, he found it under a bench. The handset was his precious tool for communication. **一天，汤姆在跑步时弄丢了他的手机。他非常担心，到处寻找。最后，他在一张长椅下找到了它。手机是他用于交流的珍贵工具。**

> One day, Tom went to a business meeting. When he met a new partner, they reached out their hands and firmly grasped each other\'s. This friendly gesture, the act of joining hands, was called a \'handshake\', showing respect and trust. **有一天，汤姆去参加一个商务会议。当他见到一个新伙伴时，他们伸出手并紧紧握住对方的手。这种友好的手势，手与手相握的动作，被称为"握手"，展现出尊重和信任。**

> One day, a prince was riding through the town. Everyone said he was handsome. He had a charming smile and nice clothes. His good looks made all the girls\' hearts flutter. From then on, whenever I see the word \'handsome\', I think of that prince. **有一天，一位王子骑马穿过城镇。每个人都说他英俊。他有着迷人的微笑和好看的衣服。他的美貌让所有女孩的心都为之荡漾。从那以后，每当我看到'handsome'这个单词，我就会想起那位王子。**

> A prince was always praised for behaving handsomely. He gave generously to the poor and treated everyone kindly. His handsomely done deeds made him beloved by all. **一位王子总是因表现得大方得体而受到称赞。他慷慨地给予穷人帮助，友善地对待每个人。他那些做得漂亮的事使他深受大家喜爱。**

> One day, Tom found a mysterious letter. The handwriting on it was so beautiful and unique that it caught his attention. He decided to learn such elegant handwriting to express himself better. **一天，汤姆发现了一封神秘的信。上面的笔迹如此美丽和独特，引起了他的注意。他决定学习这种优雅的笔迹来更好地表达自己。**

> One day, Tom received a mysterious letter. It was handwritten with beautiful cursive. The words seemed to carry a special warmth and sincerity. Tom was deeply touched by the effort someone put into writing it by hand. **一天，汤姆收到了一封神秘的信。它是手写的，有着漂亮的草书。这些字似乎带着一种特别的温暖和真诚。汤姆被某人亲手书写所付出的努力深深打动了。**

> One day, I was in a hurry to fix a broken chair. Luckily, I found a handy toolbox nearby. With the tools in it, I quickly completed the repair. \'Handy\' means convenient and useful, just like that toolbox was at that moment. **有一天，我着急修理一把坏椅子。幸运的是，我在旁边发现了一个方便的工具箱。用里面的工具，我很快就修好了。'handy'意思是方便的、有用的，就像当时那个工具箱一样。**

> A thief was caught and the judge decided to hang him. But at the last moment, a hero came and saved him. Now you know \'hang\' means to kill someone by putting a rope around their neck. **一个小偷被抓住了，法官决定绞死他。但在最后一刻，一位英雄出现救了他。现在你知道'hang'意思是用绳子套在某人脖子上处死。**

> A pilot was very worried because his plane had some problems and needed to be repaired in the hangar. But finally, the mechanics fixed it and the plane could fly again. **一位飞行员非常担心，因为他的飞机出了些问题，需要在飞机库（hangar）里维修。但最终，机械师修好了它，飞机又能飞了。**
> A poor little bird lost its way and needed a place to rest. It finally found a hanger in an empty room. The hanger became its temporary home. **一只可怜的小鸟迷路了，需要一个地方休息。它最终在一个空房间里找到了一个衣架。这个衣架成了它暂时的家。**

> A thief was caught and sentenced to hanging. Before the hanging, he regretted his deeds. People gathered to witness the hanging, a solemn scene. Remember, \'hanging\' means the act of suspending someone by a rope. **一个小偷被抓住并被判处绞刑。在绞刑前，他后悔自己的行为。人们聚集见证绞刑，这是一个庄严的场景。记住，\'hanging\'意思是用绳子把某人吊起的行为。**

> One day, Tom was looking for a place to relax. He found a cozy coffee shop which became his favorite hangout. Whenever he felt tired, he would go there to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and have a great time. **有一天，汤姆正在寻找一个放松的地方。他发现了一家舒适的咖啡店，这成了他最喜欢的常去之处。每当他感到疲惫时，他就会去那里享受宁静的氛围，度过美好时光。**
> 想象一下，昨晚你参加了一个疯狂派对，喝了太多酒。今天早上醒来，头痛欲裂，胃里翻江倒海，那种难受的感觉就是 \'hangover\' 。它就像一个恶魔缠着你，让你后悔昨晚的放纵。 **想象一下饮酒过量后第二天难受的宿醉感觉，这就是'hangover'，常指宿醉（酒后不适）**

> A man was looking for his keys in a haphazard way. He searched randomly in drawers and under the sofa. Finally, he found them by chance. This shows the meaning of doing things without order or plan. **一个男人在杂乱无章地找他的钥匙。他随意地在抽屉里和沙发下找。最后，他偶然找到了。这体现了做事没有秩序或计划的意思。**

> A young man was always having bad luck. One day, he lost his job and then his phone. We can say this young man is hapless. He seems to be followed by misfortune wherever he goes. **一个年轻人总是运气不好。有一天，他丢了工作，然后又丢了手机。我们可以说这个年轻人是不幸的。无论走到哪里，他似乎都被不幸所跟随。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a bird flew by and dropped a shiny feather. This unexpected event made the boy very happy. This is what \'happen\' means - something occurs without being planned. **有一天，一个小男孩正在公园里玩耍。突然，一只鸟飞过并掉落了一根闪亮的羽毛。这个意外的事件让小男孩非常开心。这就是\'happen\'的意思 - 某事未经计划地发生了。**

> One day, I was walking in the park and saw many interesting happenings. There was a music performance and a group of kids playing happily. It made me feel the joy of unexpected and wonderful events. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到了许多有趣的事情。有一场音乐表演，还有一群孩子开心地玩耍。这让我感受到了意外和美好事件带来的快乐。**

> One day, a little girl went to the park. She saw beautiful flowers and lovely birds. She played happily with her friends. They laughed and had a great time together. **有一天，一个小女孩去了公园。她看到了美丽的花朵和可爱的鸟儿。她和朋友们开心地玩耍。他们一起欢笑，度过了一段美好的时光。**

> One day, a little girl went to the park. The sun was shining, and she saw beautiful flowers. She played on the swing and laughed happily. At that moment, she felt truly happy. **有一天，一个小女孩去了公园。阳光明媚，她看到了美丽的花朵。她在秋千上玩耍并开心地大笑。在那一刻，她感到真正的快乐。**

> A mouse was constantly harassed by a cat. The cat would chase and pounce on the poor mouse, making its life miserable. \'Harass\' means to cause trouble or annoyance repeatedly to someone. **一只老鼠不断地受到一只猫的骚扰。猫会追逐并猛扑向可怜的老鼠，让它的生活很悲惨。\'harass\'意思是反复地给某人制造麻烦或烦恼。**

> A mouse was constantly being bothered by a cat\'s harassment. The mouse had no peace, always running away. Just like people, being harassed makes life difficult. Remember, harassment means disturbing or annoying someone repeatedly. **一只老鼠不断受到猫的骚扰。老鼠不得安宁，总是逃跑。就像人一样，被骚扰会让生活变得艰难。记住，harassment 意思是不断地打扰或烦扰某人。**

> A little bird was always seen before a big storm. People called it the harbinger. It signaled that bad weather was coming. So, remember, a harbinger is like that little bird, telling us something is ahead. **一只小鸟总是在大风暴来临前出现。人们称它为预兆使者。它预示着恶劣天气即将到来。所以，记住，harbinger 就像那只小鸟，告诉我们有事情即将发生。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. When he finally saw land, it was a beautiful harbor. He felt safe and grateful. The harbor became his refuge and hope. Remember, a harbor is a safe place for ships. **一位水手在海上迷失了方向。当他最终看到陆地时，那是一个美丽的港湾。他感到安全和感激。这个港湾成了他的避难所和希望。记住，harbor 就是船只的安全之地。**

> A little ant was trying to move a big stone. It was very hard, but the ant didn\'t give up. Finally, with great effort, it succeeded. \'Hard\' means difficult but possible with effort. **一只小蚂蚁试图搬动一块大石头。这非常艰难，但蚂蚁没有放弃。最终，通过巨大的努力，它成功了。\'hard\'意思是困难的，但通过努力是可能做到的。**

> A baseball player was struggling to play hardball. But with determination, he practiced every day. Finally, he could hit the hardball far and became a star. It shows that facing hardball situations requires effort and perseverance. **一位棒球运动员起初难以打好硬式棒球。但凭借决心，他每天练习。最终，他能把硬式棒球击打得很远，成为了明星。这表明面对困难的局面（像硬式棒球）需要努力和坚持。**

> Once upon a time, a poor writer spent days and nights creating a wonderful book. Finally, it was published as a hardcover edition, which was tough and durable, protecting the precious words inside. It became a bestseller. **从前，一位贫穷的作家日夜创作了一本精彩的书。最后，它以精装版出版，精装版坚固耐用，保护着里面珍贵的文字。它成了畅销书。**

> A young blacksmith was constantly heating and cooling the iron to harden it. He worked hard every day, making the metal strong and tough. Just like the iron, we need to go through challenges to harden our minds and spirits. **一位年轻的铁匠不断加热和冷却铁块来使其变硬。他每天努力工作，让金属变得坚固和坚韧。就像铁块一样，我们需要经历挑战来使我们的思想和精神变得坚强。**

> A brave soldier was constantly in battles. Through many tough experiences, his heart hardened. He no longer feared difficulties and remained strong in the face of challenges. **一位勇敢的士兵不断地参加战斗。经过许多艰难的经历，他的心变硬了。他不再惧怕困难，在挑战面前保持坚强。**

> Once upon a time, a student always thought the exam was easy. But when he saw the questions, he could hardly answer any. It means almost not or scarcely. He realized he needed to study harder next time. **从前，有个学生总觉得考试容易。但当他看到题目时，几乎一道都答不上来。hardly 意思是几乎不、几乎没有。他意识到下次得更努力学习了。**

> Once upon a time, a brave knight was trying to break a stone. But the stone showed great hardness and resisted all his efforts. Finally, the knight understood that hardness means the quality of being difficult to break or change. **从前，有一位勇敢的骑士试图打破一块石头。但这块石头展现出极大的硬度，抵抗了他所有的努力。最后，骑士明白了 hardness 指的是难以打破或改变的性质。**

> A poor student had to walk a long way to school every day, facing bad weather and having no money for lunch. These were his hardships. But he never gave up and finally succeeded. **一个贫困的学生每天都要走很长的路去上学，面临恶劣的天气，还没钱吃午饭。这些都是他的艰难困苦。但他从未放弃，最终成功了。**

> One day, a little robot was malfunctioning. The engineer found that the problem was in the \'hardware\' like its gears and circuits. He fixed them, and the robot worked well again. Hardware is the physical components of a machine! **有一天，一个小机器人出故障了。工程师发现问题出在像齿轮和电路这样的"硬件"上。他修好了它们，机器人又能正常工作了。硬件就是机器的物理组件！**

> A carpenter was in search of good wood. He found a tree with very hard wood. It was so tough that it took a lot of effort to cut. This hard wood was perfect for making strong furniture. So, he called it \'hardwood\'. **一位木匠正在寻找好木材。他发现了一棵有着非常坚硬木材的树。它太硬了，砍伐花费了很多力气。这种坚硬的木材非常适合制作坚固的家具。所以，他称其为'硬木'。**

> A brave adventurer named Hardy was always ready for tough challenges. No matter how hard the journey was, Hardy never gave up. His spirit showed what \'hardy\' means - strong and brave in difficult situations. **一位名叫哈迪的勇敢冒险家总是准备好迎接艰难的挑战。无论旅途多么艰辛，哈迪从不放弃。他的精神展现了\'hardy\'这个词的含义------在困难情况下坚强勇敢。**

> A hare was running fast in the forest. It was very alert as it knew there were many predators. One day, it outran a fox and felt so proud. Remember, \'hare\' is a fast and alert animal. **一只野兔在森林里跑得很快。它非常警觉，因为它知道有很多捕食者。有一天，它跑赢了一只狐狸，感到非常自豪。记住，\'hare\'就是这种快速且警觉的动物。**

> A king had a big harem with many beautiful women. But he was often tired of dealing with their quarrels. So, he realized a harem wasn\'t always as wonderful as it seemed. Harem means a group of women living with a man, especially in Muslim families. **一位国王有一个很大的后宫，里面有许多美丽的女子。但他经常疲于应对她们的争吵。所以，他意识到后宫并不总是像看起来那么美好。harem 意思是（尤指穆斯林家庭的）一群妻妾**

> A naughty monkey was playing in the forest. It accidentally broke a beehive and was stung many times. This caused harm to the monkey. From then on, it learned to be careful and not do things that could cause harm. **一只顽皮的猴子在森林里玩耍。它不小心弄破了一个蜂窝，被蜇了好多下。这给猴子造成了伤害。从那以后，它学会了小心，不做会造成伤害的事。**

> A little bee was flying happily. Suddenly, it encountered a harmful chemical spray in the garden. The spray made the bee feel very sick. We should avoid such harmful substances to protect our little friends. **一只小蜜蜂正开心地飞着。突然，它在花园里遭遇了有害的化学喷雾。这喷雾让蜜蜂感觉非常难受。我们应该避免这样有害的物质来保护我们的小伙伴。**

> Once upon a time, a little snake was found in the garden. Everyone was scared at first, but later they realized it was harmless. It just wanted to enjoy the sun and wouldn\'t hurt anyone. **从前，花园里发现了一条小蛇。一开始大家都很害怕，但后来他们意识到它是无害的。它只是想享受阳光，不会伤害任何人。**
> 在一个音乐世界里，有个小精灵叫 Harmonic，它的任务是让所有音符和谐共处，创造出美妙动听的旋律。只要它出现，杂乱的声音就会变得和谐，就像这个单词 harmonic 所代表的'和声的，和谐的'意思。 **在一个音乐世界中，小精灵 Harmonic 让音符和谐共处创造美妙旋律，体现'和声的，和谐的'含义。**

> One day, a little boy found a harmonica in a mysterious box. When he blew into it, beautiful melodies filled the air. The harmonica became his magic tool to bring joy to everyone. **有一天，一个小男孩在一个神秘的盒子里发现了一把口琴。当他向里面吹气时，美妙的旋律弥漫在空中。口琴成了他为大家带来欢乐的神奇工具。**

> In a magical forest, all the creatures lived together in a harmonious way. The birds sang beautifully, the rabbits hopped joyfully, and the trees swayed gently. Everyone got along well, creating a peaceful and pleasant atmosphere. **在一个神奇的森林里，所有的生物都和谐地生活在一起。鸟儿动听地歌唱，兔子欢快地跳跃，树木轻轻地摇曳。大家相处融洽，营造出和平、愉快的氛围。**

> A group of musicians were struggling to play together. But when they learned to harmonize their different instruments, the music became beautiful and enchanting. Just like this, \'harmonize\' means to make things in agreement and balance. **一群音乐家起初演奏配合得很糟糕。但当他们学会协调各自不同的乐器时，音乐变得美妙迷人。就像这样，\'harmonize\'意思是使事物协调一致、和谐平衡。**
