> A party was held. The hostess was very busy. She welcomed guests, arranged seats and made sure everyone had a good time. Her smile and kindness made the party a success. **举办了一场聚会。女主人非常忙碌。她欢迎客人，安排座位，并确保每个人都玩得开心。她的微笑和友善使聚会取得了成功。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange land. The locals were hostile. They stared angrily and refused to help. The traveler felt scared and alone. Remember, hostile means unfriendly and showing opposition. **一位旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。当地人怀有敌意。他们愤怒地盯着他，拒绝帮忙。旅行者感到害怕和孤独。记住，hostile 意思是不友好的、敌对的。**

> In a faraway land, two tribes had long shown hostility towards each other. They fought over resources, their faces filled with anger and hate. Finally, a wise elder came and taught them to live in peace. Hostility means unfriendly or aggressive feelings. **在一个遥远的地方，两个部落长期相互敌对。他们为了资源而争斗，脸上充满了愤怒和仇恨。最后，一位睿智的长者到来，教导他们和平相处。Hostility 意思是不友好或敌对的感情。**

> One hot summer day, I was walking on the street. The sun was shining brightly and it was so hot that I started sweating. I quickly bought an ice cream to cool down. \'Hot\' means having a high temperature and making you feel uncomfortable. **在一个炎热的夏日，我走在街上。太阳明晃晃地照着，天气热极了，我开始出汗。我赶紧买了个冰淇淋来降温。'hot'意思是温度高，让人感觉不舒服。**

> Imagine a garden where the temperature is always very high. It\'s a perfect place for plants to grow fast and strong. This warm and fertile place is like a \'hotbed\'. But in our word \'hotbed\', it means a place where bad things or activities easily develop, like a hotbed of crime. **想象一个花园，那里的温度总是很高。这是植物快速茁壮生长的完美之地。这个温暖肥沃的地方就像一个'温床'。但在'hotbed'这个单词中，它指的是坏事或活动容易滋生的地方，比如犯罪的温床。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange city. He was very tired and hungry. Luckily, he found a hotel. The hotel was warm and comfortable, and he had a good rest there. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城市迷路了。他又累又饿。幸运的是，他找到了一家旅馆。这家旅馆温暖又舒适，他在那里好好休息了一番。**

> In a desert race, the competitors were running hotly. One runner was so eager to win that he was sweating profusely. \'Hotly\' here shows the intensity and passion. **在一场沙漠赛跑中，参赛者们激烈地奔跑着。有一个选手非常渴望获胜，以至于大汗淋漓。'hotly'在这里体现了激烈和热情。**

> There was a young man in the office who was always called a hotshot. He was very confident and could solve difficult problems quickly. But one day, he faced a huge challenge and realized that being a hotshot also needed to keep learning. **办公室里有个年轻人总是被称为高手。他非常自信，能迅速解决难题。但有一天，他面临巨大挑战，意识到身为高手也需要不断学习。**

> A brave detective was on a case. The criminal was very tricky, but the detective\'s hound was smart. The hound followed the smell and led the detective to catch the criminal. So, remember \'hound\' as a helpful dog in detective work. **一位勇敢的侦探在办案。罪犯非常狡猾，但侦探的猎犬很聪明。猎犬循着气味带领侦探抓住了罪犯。所以，记住\'hound\'是侦探工作中有用的狗。**

> One day, a little boy was very excited because he had only one hour left to finish his favorite game. He kept looking at the clock, waiting for that precious hour to pass quickly. **一天，一个小男孩非常兴奋，因为他只剩一个小时来完成他最喜欢的游戏。他一直盯着时钟，等待那宝贵的一小时快快过去。**

> A hardworking bee visits flowers hourly. It works diligently, never missing a single hour to collect nectar. It shows us the meaning of \'hourly\', which means happening every hour. **一只勤劳的蜜蜂每小时都去访问花朵。它勤奋地工作，从不错过每一个小时去采集花蜜。这向我们展示了\'hourly\'的意思，即每小时发生一次。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for a safe place. It found a big house. The house had many rooms and a warm fireplace. The mouse was so happy and decided to make it its home. **一天，一只小老鼠在寻找一个安全的地方。它发现了一座大房子。房子有很多房间和一个温暖的壁炉。老鼠非常高兴，决定把它当作自己的家。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a big house. Everyone living in that house formed a household. They shared joy and sadness together. The word \'household\' means all the people living in a house. **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有一座大房子。住在那座房子里的所有人组成了一个家庭户。他们一起分享快乐和悲伤。单词"household"意思是住在一个房子里的所有人。**

> One day, a little girl got lost and entered a big house. There she met a kind woman who took care of everything in the house. The woman was a housekeeper. She made the house clean and comfortable. The little girl felt safe and happy. **有一天，一个小女孩迷路走进了一座大房子。在那里她遇到了一位善良的女人，这个女人照管房子里的一切。这个女人就是管家。她把房子打理得干净又舒适。小女孩感到安全又开心。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was assigned the task of housekeeping. She cleaned the rooms, did the laundry, and made the house neat and tidy. Housekeeping means taking care of a house and doing all the necessary chores. **从前，有个小女孩被分配了家务管理的任务。她打扫房间、洗衣服，把房子弄得整洁干净。housekeeping 意思是打理家务，做所有必要的家务杂事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a woman who spent most of her time in the house taking care of the family. She cooked, cleaned, and managed everything. So, people called her a housewife. **从前，有一个女人，她大部分时间都在家里照顾家人。她做饭、打扫、管理一切。所以，人们称她为家庭主妇。**

> One day, Tom was very tired because he had done a lot of housework. He swept the floor, washed the dishes, and cleaned the windows. But when he saw the tidy house, he felt happy. Housework made the house clean and comfortable. **一天，汤姆非常累，因为他做了很多家务。他扫地、洗碗和擦窗户。但当他看到整洁的房子时，他感到开心。家务让房子变得干净舒适。**

> One day, Tom was looking for a new place to live. He searched everywhere and finally found the perfect \'housing\' - a cozy apartment with a beautiful view. It made him very happy. **一天，汤姆正在寻找一个新的住处。他到处找，最后找到了完美的"住房"------一个有着美丽风景的舒适公寓。这让他非常开心。**

> A little bee was tired after flying for a long time. It hovered above a beautiful flower, deciding whether to land and take a rest. The bee\'s hovering made the flower look even more charming. **一只小蜜蜂飞了很久后累了。它在一朵美丽的花上方盘旋，决定是否降落休息。蜜蜂的盘旋让这朵花看起来更迷人了。**

> One day, a little boy was lost. He kept asking \'How can I find my way home?\' Everyone he met tried to help him by answering his question. Finally, with their guidance, he made it home safely. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了。他不停地问'我怎么才能找到回家的路？'他遇到的每个人都通过回答他的问题来帮助他。最后，在他们的指引下，他安全到家了。**

> A brave knight was always confident in battle. However, one day he faced a powerful dragon and felt scared. \'However\' here shows a contrast, like the sudden change in the knight\'s feelings. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中总是充满自信。然而，有一天他面对一只强大的龙时感到害怕。'however'在这里表示对比，就像骑士的感受突然发生了变化。**

> One night, a wolf was alone in the forest and it began to howl. Its howl was so loud and scary that it echoed through the trees. It seemed like the wolf was expressing its loneliness or warning others. **一天晚上，一只狼独自在森林里，它开始嚎叫。它的嚎叫声非常响亮和可怕，在树林中回荡。它似乎在表达它的孤独或警告其他人。**

> One night, I was walking in the forest. Suddenly, I heard a howling sound. It was so scary. I realized it was a wolf howling at the moon. The howling made my hair stand on end. **一天晚上，我在森林里散步。突然，我听到一阵嚎叫声。太可怕了。我意识到那是一只狼对着月亮嚎叫。这嚎叫声让我毛骨悚然。**

> In a busy city, there was a central place where all roads and transportation lines met. This place was like the heart of the city\'s movement, and it was called the \'hub\'. People and goods constantly flowed in and out of this important spot. **在一个繁忙的城市里，有一个所有道路和交通线路交汇的中心地方。这个地方就像城市运转的心脏，被称为"中心；枢纽"。人和货物不断地在这个重要地点进出。**

> A king always boasted about his power and wisdom with hubris. But his arrogance led to wrong decisions and finally his kingdom fell. Remember, hubris can cause disaster. **一位国王总是傲慢地吹嘘自己的权力和智慧。但他的自大导致了错误的决策，最终他的王国沦陷了。记住，傲慢自大（hubris）会招致灾难。**

> A group of friends were lost in the forest. It was cold and rainy. They huddled together for warmth, like a bunch of penguins. They held each other closely to protect themselves from the bad weather. **一群朋友在森林里迷路了。天气又冷又下雨。他们挤在一起取暖，就像一群企鹅。他们紧紧相拥以保护自己免受恶劣天气的影响。**

> A painter was struggling to mix the right hue for a beautiful sunset. He tried many times until he finally found the perfect hue - a blend of orange and pink. It made his painting come alive! **一位画家努力调配出合适的色调来描绘美丽的日落。他尝试了很多次，直到最后找到了完美的色调------橙色和粉色的混合。这让他的画栩栩如生！**
> A little rabbit was in a huff because his carrot was stolen. He stomped his feet and puffed out his cheeks. Huff means to be angry or annoyed. **一只小兔子很生气，因为它的胡萝卜被偷了。它跺着脚，鼓着腮帮子。huff 这个单词意思是生气或恼怒。**

> A little boy was lost in a forest. He was very scared until he saw a huge tree. Under the tree was a cave where he found a map to get home. The huge tree became his savior. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他非常害怕，直到他看到一棵巨大的树。在树下有一个洞穴，他在里面找到了回家的地图。这棵巨大的树成了他的救星。**

> A little boy was lost in a forest. He was scared until a huge bear appeared and gave him a hugely warm hug. The boy felt safe and no longer afraid. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他很害怕，直到一只巨大的熊出现，给了他一个大大的温暖的拥抱。男孩感到安全，不再害怕。**

> One day, Tom made a strange joke. When others didn\'t understand and asked \'What?\', Tom simply replied \'Huh\' with a confused expression. It seemed to say, \'I don\'t know what you mean.\', **一天，汤姆讲了一个奇怪的笑话。当其他人不明白并问'什么？'时，汤姆只是带着困惑的表情简单地回答'哼'。这似乎在说，'我不知道你什么意思。'**

> A thief was trying to break into a house. Suddenly, a hulking guard appeared. The thief was scared because the guard was so big and strong. The hulking figure of the guard protected the house. **一个小偷正试图闯入一所房子。突然，一个高大笨重的守卫出现了。小偷被吓到了，因为这个守卫又高大又强壮。这个高大笨重的守卫形象保护了房子。**

> A ship was sailing on the sea. Its hull was strong and shiny. One day, a huge wave hit it, but the hull protected everyone on board. The hull is like a shield for the ship. **一艘船在海上航行。它的船体坚固而闪亮。有一天，一个巨浪袭来，但船体保护了船上的每一个人。船体就像船的盾牌。**
> A bee was humming around the flowers. It made a soft hum that was so calming. The hum of the bee reminded me of the word \'hum\'. **一只蜜蜂在花丛周围嗡嗡叫。它发出轻柔的嗡嗡声，非常令人平静。蜜蜂的嗡嗡声让我想起了'hum'这个单词。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there was a strange creature. It had feelings, could think and create. It was called a human. Humans were different from other beings as they had wisdom and kindness. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，有一种奇特的生物。它有情感，能够思考和创造。它被称为人类。人类不同于其他生物，因为他们有智慧和善良。**

> A man was lost in the forest. Just when he felt hopeless, a kind and humane hunter found him and led him out safely. The hunter\'s humane act saved the man\'s life. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望的时候，一位善良且人道的猎人发现了他，并安全地把他带了出去。猎人的人道行为救了这个男人的命。**

> A long time ago, there was a group of wise people who cared deeply about humans. They believed in the value and dignity of every person. This idea was called humanism. It made people more kind and understanding. **很久以前，有一群睿智的人非常关心人类。他们深信每个人的价值和尊严。这种理念被称为人文主义。它让人们变得更加善良和理解他人。**

> A long time ago, there was a wise man who cared deeply about people\'s happiness and rights. He was called a humanist. He always tried to make the world better for humans, focusing on their needs and values. **很久以前，有一位智者，他非常关心人们的幸福和权利。他被称为人道主义者。他总是努力让世界对人类更美好，关注人们的需求和价值。**

> Once upon a time, a wise man was very concerned about human feelings and values. He was described as humanistic because he always put people first. His actions showed that he cared about the human side of everything. **从前，有一位智者非常关心人的情感和价值。他被形容为人道主义的，因为他总是把人放在首位。他的行为表明他关心一切事物中与人相关的方面。**

> A group of people were trapped in a disaster area. A man named Tom, known as a humanitarian, rushed to help. He provided food and shelter, showing kindness and care. Remember Tom to remember humanitarian. **一群人被困在灾区。一个叫汤姆的人，被称为人道主义者，急忙去帮忙。他提供食物和住所，展现出善良和关怀。记住汤姆就能记住 humanitarian 这个单词。**

> A group of friends decided to explore the humanities. They visited museums, read ancient books, and discussed philosophy. Through this adventure, they understood the importance of humanities in shaping our thoughts and society. **一群朋友决定探索人文学科。他们参观博物馆，阅读古籍，讨论哲学。通过这次冒险，他们明白了人文学科在塑造我们的思想和社会方面的重要性。**

> A group of aliens landed on Earth. They were amazed by the kindness and compassion shown by humans. They realized that this quality, which made humans care for each other, was called \'humanity\'. **一群外星人降落在地球。他们对人类表现出的善良和同情感到惊讶。他们意识到这种让人类彼此关爱的品质被称为"人性"。**

> Once upon a time, a cold robot was transformed. Scientists gave it emotions and kindness to humanize it. Now it could understand and care like a real human. **从前，有一个冰冷的机器人被改造。科学家赋予了它情感和善良来使其人性化。现在它能够像真正的人类一样理解和关心。**

> In a faraway land, all the people worked together to build a beautiful city. They were humankind, showing unity and kindness. Everyone had a role, creating a harmonious community. **在一个遥远的地方，所有人一起努力建造一座美丽的城市。他们就是人类，展现出团结和友善。每个人都有自己的角色，共同创建了一个和谐的社区。**

> Once upon a time, a human was lost in a forest. He tried to find his way out humanly, using his wisdom and courage. He believed that with human effort and thinking, he could overcome the difficulty. **从前，有个人在森林里迷路了。他试图凭借人的智慧和勇气以人道的方式走出森林。他相信凭借人的努力和思考，他能够克服困难。**

> Once there was a rich man. Despite his wealth, he remained humble. He didn\'t show off but used his money to help others. His humble attitude made him more respected. Remember, \'humble\' means not being proud or arrogant. **曾经有一个富人。尽管富有，但他依然谦逊。他不炫耀，还用自己的钱帮助别人。他谦逊的态度使他更受尊重。记住，'humble'意思是不骄傲或不自大。**

> Once, a proud athlete always thought he was the best. But in a crucial competition, he lost badly. This experience was humbling. It made him realize he wasn\'t as great as he thought and needed to keep improving. **曾经，一位骄傲的运动员总认为自己是最棒的。但在一场关键比赛中，他输得很惨。这次经历是令人自惭的。这让他意识到自己并非像想象中那么出色，需要不断进步。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor boy who always humbly asked for help when in trouble. He never boasted but remained humble. Eventually, his humbly attitude won him many friends and opportunities. **从前，有一个贫穷的男孩，遇到困难时总是谦卑地寻求帮助。他从不吹嘘，始终保持谦逊。最终，他谦逊的态度为他赢得了许多朋友和机会。**

> One hot summer day, I went for a walk in the forest. The air was so humid that my clothes stuck to my skin. It felt like breathing in a steam room. \'Humid\' means having a lot of moisture in the air. **一个炎热的夏日，我去森林散步。空气非常潮湿，我的衣服都粘在身上了。感觉就像在蒸汽房里呼吸。'humid'意思是空气中有大量的湿气。**

> In a hot summer, Tom felt very uncomfortable. The air was full of moisture, making him sweat a lot. This was because of the high humidity. Finally, he turned on the air conditioner to reduce the humidity and cool down. **在一个炎热的夏天，汤姆感到非常不舒服。空气中充满了湿气，让他大汗淋漓。这是因为湿度很高。最后，他打开空调来降低湿度并凉快下来。**

> A king was defeated in a battle and captured by the enemy. They made him wear funny clothes and walk in the street, which humiliated him greatly. Remember, \'humiliate\' means to make someone feel ashamed and lose dignity. **一位国王在一场战斗中被打败并被敌人俘虏。他们让他穿上滑稽的衣服走在街上，这使他感到极大的羞辱。记住，\'humiliate\'意思是使某人感到羞耻和失去尊严。**

> Once upon a time, a proud king was defeated in a battle and was forced to wear ragged clothes and walk through the streets. This experience was humiliating for him. It made him lose face and dignity. **从前，一位骄傲的国王在一场战斗中被打败，被迫穿着破烂的衣服穿过街道。这种经历对他来说是耻辱的。这让他丢了脸，失去了尊严。**

> A proud athlete lost the championship and faced the humiliation of being defeated. Everyone laughed at him. But he used this humiliation as motivation to train harder and finally won the next competition. **一位骄傲的运动员输掉了冠军赛，面临被击败的耻辱。每个人都嘲笑他。但他把这次耻辱当作动力，更加努力地训练，最终赢得了下一场比赛。**

> Once upon a time, there was a king. Despite his power, he showed humility. He listened to his people\'s advice and didn\'t act arrogantly. His kingdom flourished because of his humility. **从前，有一位国王。尽管他权力很大，但他表现出了谦逊。他倾听人民的建议，不傲慢行事。因为他的谦逊，他的王国繁荣昌盛。**

> One day, a little girl was in the garden. Suddenly, a fast-moving bird appeared. It made a humming sound as it flew. The girl was amazed and asked her mom what it was. Her mom said, \'It\'s a hummingbird.\' **有一天，一个小女孩在花园里。突然，出现了一只飞得很快的鸟。它飞的时候发出嗡嗡声。小女孩很惊讶，问妈妈这是什么。妈妈说：'这是一只蜂鸟。'**

> One day, a clown was performing on the street. His funny actions and expressions filled everyone with joy. This is the power of humor. It can make people forget their troubles and laugh happily. **有一天，一个小丑在街上表演。他滑稽的动作和表情让每个人都充满了欢乐。这就是幽默的力量。它能让人忘却烦恼，开心大笑。**

> One day, I met a clown in the circus. His every move and expression were so funny and made everyone laugh. I suddenly realized that this is what \'humorous\' means - being able to bring joy and laughter. **有一天，我在马戏团遇到一个小丑。他的一举一动和表情都非常有趣，让每个人都大笑。我突然意识到这就是'humorous（幽默的）'的意思------能够带来欢乐和笑声。**

> A little camel was sad because of its big hump. But one day, in a sandstorm, the hump stored water and saved its life. Then the camel knew the hump was a precious gift. **一只小骆驼因为它的大驼峰而难过。但有一天，在一场沙尘暴中，驼峰储存的水救了它的命。然后骆驼知道驼峰是一份珍贵的礼物。**

> One day, while walking in the park, I had a hunch that I would find a lost puppy. And guess what? I really did! My hunch led me to a corner where the poor little thing was hiding. **有一天，在公园散步时，我有一种预感，觉得自己会找到一只走失的小狗。你猜怎么着？我真的找到了！我的预感把我引到一个角落，那可怜的小家伙就藏在那里。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy wanted to count to a big number. He started from one and kept going. When he reached one hundred, he was so happy and shouted, \'I made it to a hundred!\' **从前，有个小男孩想要数到一个大数字。他从 1 开始一直数。当他数到 100 时，他非常高兴并大喊：'我数到 100 啦！'**

> A poor boy was always in hunger. One day, he found a magical bread tree. After eating the bread, his hunger vanished. But he learned to share to help others overcome hunger too. **一个贫穷的男孩总是处于饥饿状态。有一天，他发现了一棵神奇的面包树。吃了面包后，他的饥饿消失了。但他学会了分享，以帮助其他人也摆脱饥饿。**

> One day, Tom was playing outside and forgot to have lunch. As time passed, his stomach growled. He felt very hungry. He rushed home and ate a big meal. Now he knew the meaning of being hungry. **有一天，汤姆在外面玩耍，忘记吃午饭了。随着时间的推移，他的肚子咕咕叫。他感到非常饥饿。他冲回家吃了一顿大餐。现在他知道了hungry（饥饿）的意思。**

> A hungry bear was looking for food in the forest. Suddenly, it saw a hunk of honeycomb. The bear was so excited and forgot its hunger. It enjoyed the sweet treat. **一只饥饿的熊在森林里寻找食物。突然，它看到一大块蜂巢。熊非常兴奋，忘记了饥饿。它享受着这份甜蜜的美食。**

> A man was hunkering down in a cave to avoid the strong wind. He held his knees tightly, trying to stay warm. Finally, the wind stopped and he could stand up. Remember, \'hunker\' means to squat or crouch down. **一个男人为了躲避强风蹲在洞穴里。他紧紧地抱着膝盖，试图保持温暖。最后，风停了，他可以站起来了。记住，'hunker'意思是蹲下或蹲伏。**

> A brave hunter named Tom went into the forest to hunt. He followed the tracks and finally found a big deer. With his skills and patience, he successfully caught it. Hunting needs courage and wisdom. **一个勇敢的名叫汤姆的猎人走进森林去狩猎。他沿着足迹，最终发现了一只大鹿。凭借他的技能和耐心，他成功地捕获了它。狩猎需要勇气和智慧。**

> One day, a brave man named Tom decided to become a hunter. He went deep into the forest with his bow and arrow. After a long search, he finally caught a big deer. Tom was very happy and proud of his hunting skills. **一天，一个叫汤姆的勇敢男人决定成为一名猎人。他带着弓箭深入森林。经过长时间的搜寻，他终于捕获了一只大鹿。汤姆非常高兴，并为自己的狩猎技能感到骄傲。**

> A brave boy named Tom went hunting in the forest. He carried a bow and arrow, carefully looking for prey. After a long search, he finally found a deer and made a successful hunt. Hunting requires patience and skill. **一个勇敢的叫汤姆的男孩去森林里打猎。他带着弓箭，仔细寻找猎物。经过长时间的搜寻，他终于发现了一只鹿并成功捕获。打猎需要耐心和技巧。**
> 想象一下，一位运动员在赛道上面对一道道的栅栏（hurdle）。他必须鼓足勇气，跨越每一道障碍才能冲向终点。就像我们在生活中，要勇敢跨越困难的hurdle，不断前进。 **想象一位运动员面对一道道栅栏，就像我们在生活中面对困难。要勇敢跨越困难的'障碍、难关'，不断前进。**

> A strong athlete was in a competition. He was so angry when he lost that he hurl his shoes across the field. It means to throw something forcefully and angrily. **一位强壮的运动员在比赛中。他输了之后非常生气，以至于把他的鞋子用力地扔过场地。这个词的意思是用力、愤怒地投掷某物。**

> A brave sailor was on a voyage. Suddenly, a huge storm came. The wind howled and the waves crashed. It was a hurricane! The sailor struggled but finally survived. He would never forget this terrifying experience. **一位勇敢的水手正在航行。突然，一场巨大的风暴袭来。狂风呼啸，海浪汹涌。这是一场飓风！水手奋力挣扎，最终幸存下来。他永远不会忘记这次可怕的经历。**

> One day, Tom had a very important exam. He got up late and had to hurry to school. He ran as fast as he could, his heart beating fast. Finally, he arrived just in time. \'Hurry\' means to do something quickly because there\'s not much time. **有一天，汤姆有一场非常重要的考试。他起晚了，不得不匆忙赶往学校。他尽可能快地跑，心跳得很快。最后，他刚好及时赶到。\'hurried\'意思是因为时间不多而快速做某事。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. He got dressed hurriedly, grabbed his bag and ran out of the house. When he arrived at the classroom, he was out of breath. **一天，汤姆上学迟到了。他匆忙地穿好衣服，抓起书包就跑出了家门。当他到达教室时，已经气喘吁吁。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. He had to hurry. He ran as fast as he could, but his heart was beating fast. Finally, he made it just in time. Hurry means to do something quickly! **一天，汤姆上学要迟到了。他不得不赶快。他尽可能快地跑，但他的心跳得很快。最后，他刚好赶上。hurry 意思是快速做某事！**

> One day, Tom was playing football and accidentally hurt his leg. He felt very painful. But with the help of his friends, he soon recovered. Remember, \'hurt\' means to cause pain or injury. **有一天，汤姆在踢足球时不小心伤到了腿。他感觉非常疼。但在朋友们的帮助下，他很快就康复了。记住，'hurt'意思是造成疼痛或伤害。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mean boy who always said hurtful words to others. His words were like sharp arrows that pierced people\'s hearts. Everyone avoided him. Finally, he realized his mistake and changed. Remember, don\'t be hurtful like him! **从前，有个刻薄的男孩总是对别人说伤人的话。他的话像锋利的箭，刺痛人们的心。大家都避开他。最后，他意识到自己的错误并改变了。记住，别像他那样伤人！**
> 想象一下，一个巨大的陨石 hurtle 着冲向地球。它速度极快，呼啸而过，带着巨大的冲击力。就像这个陨石一样，hurtle 这个词表示猛冲、飞驰，充满力量和速度。 **想象一颗巨大的陨石猛冲向地球的情景来辅助记忆\'hurtle\'这个词，表示猛冲、飞驰**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who was very responsible for his family. People called him \'husband\', meaning the male partner in a marriage who takes care of his wife and children. He worked hard to make his family happy. **从前，有一个对家庭非常负责的男人。人们称他为"丈夫"，意思是婚姻中的男性伴侣，照顾他的妻子和孩子。他努力工作让家人幸福。**

> A baby was crying loudly in the room. The mother said \'Hush\' softly and gently rocked the baby until it fell asleep. The word \'hush\' here means to be quiet or stop making noise. **房间里一个婴儿在大声啼哭。母亲轻声说"嘘"，并轻轻摇晃着婴儿直到他入睡。这里'hush'这个单词的意思是安静或停止吵闹。**

> A little mouse was looking for food in a barn. It found some grains inside a husk. But the husk was hard to break. Finally, with great effort, the mouse got the grains. The husk protected the grains just like a shield. **一只小老鼠在谷仓里找食物。它发现一些谷粒在壳里。但壳很难打破。最后，费了很大的劲，老鼠得到了谷粒。壳就像盾牌一样保护着谷粒。**

> One day, I went to the North Pole and saw a team of huskies pulling a sled. They were strong and had thick fur. Their barks were loud but friendly. It was an amazing sight! **有一天，我去了北极，看到一队哈士奇在拉雪橇。它们很强壮，有着厚厚的皮毛。它们的叫声响亮但友好。那是令人惊叹的景象！**

> One day, Tom was in a big hurry to catch the train. He hustled through the crowded station, carrying his heavy bag. People were everywhere, but he pushed and ran, determined not to miss the train. **有一天，汤姆非常着急去赶火车。他带着沉重的包在拥挤的车站里匆忙奔走。到处都是人，但他推挤着跑，决心不错过火车。**

> A young man named Tom was always a hustler. He worked hard selling goods on the street, never giving up and constantly looking for new opportunities. His hustle spirit made him successful in the end. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人一直是个拼命三郎。他努力在街上卖货，从不放弃，不断寻找新机会。他的这种进取精神最终让他取得了成功。**

> A poor man was lost in the forest. Tired and hungry, he finally found a hut. It was small but gave him shelter from the rain. The hut became his safe haven in the wild. **一个可怜的人在森林里迷路了。又累又饿的他，终于找到了一间小屋。它很小，但为他遮风挡雨。这间小屋成了他在野外的避风港。**

> Once upon a time, there was a strange animal. It was a combination of a lion and a bird. People called it a \'hybrid\' because it had features from both. This word \'hybrid\' means a mixture of different things or types. **从前，有一只奇怪的动物。它是狮子和鸟的结合体。人们称它为"杂交种"，因为它兼具两者的特征。单词"hybrid"意思是不同事物或类型的混合体。**
> 想象一下，在一个大型工厂里，有一种神奇的力量能轻松推动巨大的机械，就像水的力量一样强大。这种力量就叫 hydraulic，它就像水一样流畅且有力，专门用于描述与水或液体有关的强大动力。 **想象在工厂中有一种像水一样强大的力量推动机械，此力量叫 hydraulic，用于描述与水或液体有关的强大动力。**

> Imagine a group of scientists exploring a mysterious cave. They discover a strange liquid that is a combination of hydrogen and carbon. They call it \'hydrocarbon\', which is like a hidden treasure in the cave. **想象一群科学家探索一个神秘的洞穴。他们发现了一种由氢和碳组成的奇怪液体。他们称之为"碳氢化合物"，它就像洞穴里隐藏的宝藏。**

> Imagine a huge waterfall. The powerful water rushes down and turns turbines. This process generates electricity. The word \'hydroelectric\' describes this way of making power using water. **想象一个巨大的瀑布。强大的水流冲下来并带动涡轮机。这个过程产生了电。单词\'hydroelectric\'描述的就是这种利用水来发电的方式。**

> In a faraway laboratory, a scientist was working hard. One day, he discovered a special gas that was very light and could make things float. He called it \'hydrogen\', meaning the gas that brings new possibilities and lightness. **在一个遥远的实验室里，一位科学家正在努力工作。有一天，他发现了一种特殊的气体，非常轻，可以让东西漂浮起来。他称之为"氢"，意思是带来新的可能性和轻盈的气体。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in the wild. At night, he heard strange laughter. It was a hyena! The hyena\'s creepy laugh made him shiver. But he stayed calm and finally escaped. **一位勇敢的探险家在野外迷路了。夜晚，他听到奇怪的笑声。那是一只鬣狗！鬣狗诡异的笑声让他瑟瑟发抖。但他保持冷静，最终逃脱了。**

> A doctor was explaining to a group of children about hygiene. He said, \'If you don\'t wash your hands often, germs will come. Hygiene means keeping clean and healthy to stay away from diseases.\', **一位医生正在向一群孩子解释卫生知识。他说：'如果你们不经常洗手，细菌就会来。卫生（hygiene）意味着保持清洁和健康以远离疾病。'**

> A group of friends went on a hike. When they reached the top of the mountain, they sang a beautiful hymn together to express their joy and gratitude. The hymn\'s melody echoed through the valley. **一群朋友去远足。当他们到达山顶时，一起唱了一首优美的赞美诗来表达他们的喜悦和感激之情。赞美诗的旋律在山谷中回荡。**

> A young musician was constantly surrounded by hype. Everyone said he was the next big star. But he remained calm and focused on his music, not getting carried away by all the excessive praise and excitement. **一位年轻的音乐家总是被大肆宣传。每个人都说他是下一个巨星。但他保持冷静，专注于自己的音乐，没有被所有过度的赞扬和兴奋冲昏头脑。**

> A little monkey was hyperactive in the zoo. It jumped around non-stop, climbed trees quickly and couldn\'t stay still for a moment. Everyone was amazed by its excessive energy. **一只小猴子在动物园里极度活跃。它不停地跳来跳去，迅速爬上树，一刻也停不下来。大家都对它过度的精力感到惊讶。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little monkey. It had so much energy and couldn\'t stay still. It was constantly jumping and running around, showing hyperactivity. This made other animals very tired. **从前，有一只小猴子。它精力特别旺盛，一刻也停不下来。它不停地跳来跳去，到处跑，表现出过度活跃。这让其他动物都很累。**

> A boy always exaggerated everything. One day, he said he caught a fish as big as a house. His friends knew it was hyperbole. They laughed and told him not to be so extreme. **一个男孩总是夸大其词。有一天，他说他抓到了一条和房子一样大的鱼。他的朋友们知道这是夸张手法。他们笑着告诉他别太过分了。**

> One day, Tom felt very uncomfortable and went to the doctor. The doctor told him he had hypertension. It means his blood pressure was too high. Tom needed to change his lifestyle to stay healthy. **一天，汤姆感觉很不舒服去看医生。医生告诉他患有高血压。这意味着他的血压过高。汤姆需要改变生活方式来保持健康。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark forest. A mysterious old man used hypnosis to calm his fears and guide him out. The adventurer felt a strange power making him relaxed and focused. **一位勇敢的冒险家在黑暗森林中迷路了。一位神秘的老人使用催眠术来平息他的恐惧并引导他走出。冒险家感受到一种奇怪的力量使他放松和专注。**

> A magician performed a hypnotic show. He waved a shiny pendant and people felt sleepy. They were like in a trance. The pendant had a strange power, making the scene very hypnotic. **一位魔术师表演了一场催眠秀。他挥动着一个闪亮的吊坠，人们感到困倦。他们就像恍惚了一样。这个吊坠有一种奇怪的力量，使得场面极具催眠效果。**

> One day, a magician wanted to show a special trick. He used a shiny crystal ball to hypnotize the audience. Everyone felt sleepy and their minds were controlled. That\'s how the power of \'hypnotize\' works. **有一天，一位魔术师想要展示一个特别的戏法。他用一个闪亮的水晶球来催眠观众。每个人都感到困倦，他们的思想被控制了。这就是'hypnotize'（催眠）的作用方式。**

> A politician promised to help the poor but spent money on luxury. People saw through his hypocrisy. He said one thing but did another, showing a lack of honesty. This is a clear example of \'hypocrisy\'. **一位政客承诺帮助穷人，却把钱花在奢侈品上。人们看穿了他的虚伪。他说一套做一套，表现出不诚实。这就是"虚伪"的一个明显例子。**

> Once there was a man who always preached about honesty. But one day, he was caught lying. People called him a hypocrite. He said one thing but did another, just like a fake and insincere person. **曾经有一个男人总是宣扬诚实。但有一天，他被抓到说谎。人们称他为伪君子。他说一套做一套，就像一个虚假和不真诚的人。**

> A politician promised to help the poor but spent money on luxury. People called him hypocritical. He said one thing but did another, showing a false image to gain votes. **一位政客承诺帮助穷人，却把钱花在奢侈品上。人们称他虚伪。他说一套做一套，展示虚假形象以获取选票。**

> One cold winter night, a hiker got lost. He shivered uncontrollably as his body temperature dropped. Later, he was diagnosed with hypothermia. Poor guy! It means a dangerously low body temperature. **一个寒冷的冬夜，一位徒步旅行者迷路了。他不停地颤抖，因为体温下降。后来，他被诊断出患有低温症。可怜的家伙！这个词意思是体温过低（危险的低体温状态）。**

> A scientist had a hypothesis that a new medicine could cure a rare disease. He spent months testing and observing. Finally, his hypothesis was proved right. The medicine worked! **一位科学家有一个假说，即一种新药可以治愈一种罕见疾病。他花了数月进行测试和观察。最终，他的假设被证明是正确的。这种药起作用了！**

> A scientist was constantly observing strange phenomena. He couldn\'t explain them with existing theories, so he had to hypothesize new ideas. Through experiments and research, he gradually proved his hypothesis. **一位科学家不断观察到奇怪的现象。他无法用现有的理论来解释，所以他不得不假设新的想法。通过实验和研究，他逐渐证明了他的假设。**

> Imagine a scientist creating a hypothetical creature that could fly and breathe underwater. But it\'s all just in the mind, not real. Hypothetical means based on guess or supposition. **想象一位科学家创造出一种假设的生物，既能飞又能在水下呼吸。但这都只是在想象中，并非真实的。Hypothetical 意思是基于猜测或假定的。**

> A woman was very worried because she needed a hysterectomy. But the doctor explained that it was a necessary operation to remove her uterus and solve her health problem. Finally, she bravely faced it. **一位女士非常担心，因为她需要做子宫切除术。但医生解释说这是一个必要的手术，用于切除她的子宫以解决健康问题。最后，她勇敢地面对了。**

> A girl was at a horror movie. The scary scenes made her so frightened that she became hysterical, laughing and crying uncontrollably. People around had to calm her down. **一个女孩在看恐怖电影。恐怖的场景把她吓得歇斯底里，失控地又笑又哭。周围的人不得不让她平静下来。**

> A girl was watching a horror movie. When the most terrifying scene came, she laughed hysterically. Everyone was confused. Later she explained she was so scared that she reacted in an odd way. **一个女孩正在看恐怖电影。当最恐怖的场景出现时，她歇斯底里地大笑。每个人都很困惑。后来她解释说她太害怕了，所以反应很奇怪。**

> One cold winter day, a little bear was very thirsty. It found a frozen lake. The thick ice on the lake looked like a big mirror. The bear broke the ice and got some water to drink. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一只小熊非常口渴。它发现了一个结冰的湖。湖面上厚厚的冰看起来像一面大镜子。小熊打破了冰，得到了一些水喝。**

> A ship was sailing on the sea. Suddenly, it hit something. It was an iceberg! Only the tip was visible above the water. The hidden part beneath was huge and dangerous. **一艘船在海上航行。突然，它撞到了什么东西。原来是一座冰山！只有顶端在水面上可见。水下隐藏的部分巨大且危险。**

> One hot summer day, I was so thirsty. I opened the fridge and found a bottle of iced water. It was so cold and refreshing. The ice cubes inside made it perfect to quench my thirst. **在一个炎热的夏日，我非常口渴。我打开冰箱，发现了一瓶冰镇的水。它非常冰冷和清爽。里面的冰块让它完美地解渴。**

> I was baking a cake. When I finished spreading the sweet and smooth icing on top, it looked so perfect. The icing made the cake even more delicious and inviting. **我正在烤蛋糕。当我把又甜又滑的糖霜涂在上面完成时，它看起来太完美了。糖霜让蛋糕变得更加美味和诱人。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的城堡里，有一扇神秘的门，门上有一个独特的符号（icon），它闪耀着光芒，指引着人们找到隐藏的宝藏。这个符号就是关键，代表着希望和财富。 **想象在古老城堡里，门上独特的代表希望和财富、指引找到宝藏的关键符号就是【icon（图标；象征）】**

> A young artist was always dreaming of creating an iconic painting. One day, he got inspiration and spent days working hard. Finally, his masterpiece became an iconic work known worldwide. **一位年轻的艺术家一直梦想着创作一幅标志性的画作。有一天，他获得了灵感，花了几天时间努力创作。最终，他的杰作成为了举世闻名的标志性作品。**

> A young artist was obsessed with iconography. He spent days studying ancient icons and their meanings. One day, he had a dream where the icons came alive and taught him their secrets. When he woke up, he understood iconography perfectly. **一位年轻的艺术家痴迷于图像学。他花了好几天研究古代的图像及其含义。有一天，他做了一个梦，图像都活了过来，并向他传授了它们的秘密。当他醒来时，他完全理解了图像学。**

> One cold winter day, I was walking on the street. Suddenly, I slipped and fell because the road was icy. It was so slippery that I had a hard time getting up. Remember, \'icy\' means very cold and slippery, like that road. **在一个寒冷的冬日，我走在街上。突然，我滑倒了，因为路面结了冰。冰面太滑了，我费了好大劲才站起来。记住，\'icy\'意思是冰冷且滑的，就像那条路。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a forest. He had no idea how to find his way home. Just when he was about to cry, he saw a bright light and followed it. It led him back home. The light was like a great idea that saved him. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他不知道怎么找到回家的路。就在他快要哭的时候，他看到了一束亮光并跟着它。这束光带他回了家。这束光就像一个很棒的主意拯救了他。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist had an ideal vision of a perfect painting in his mind. He worked hard to bring that ideal into reality. Finally, he created a masterpiece. The word \'ideal\' means a perfect or most suitable concept or standard. **从前，一位年轻的艺术家在脑海中有一幅完美画作的理想景象。他努力工作将那个理想变为现实。最后，他创作了一幅杰作。单词\'ideal\'意思是完美的或最合适的概念或标准。**

> A young artist always dreamed of creating perfect artworks, believing in the power of imagination and beauty. This pursuit of the perfect and the reliance on imagination is idealism. The artist never gave up, holding onto this idealism. **一位年轻的艺术家总是梦想着创作出完美的艺术作品，坚信想象和美的力量。这种对完美的追求和对想象的依赖就是理想主义。这位艺术家从未放弃，坚守着这种理想主义。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young man named Tom. He always dreamed of creating a perfect world, full of love and justice. Tom was an idealist, constantly striving for his ideals despite facing many difficulties. **从前，有个叫汤姆的年轻人。他总是梦想着创造一个充满爱和正义的完美世界。汤姆是个理想主义者，尽管面临诸多困难，仍不断为自己的理想而努力。**

> A young artist was idealistic. He dreamt of creating masterpieces that would change the world. Despite facing many difficulties, his idealistic spirit kept him going. He believed that art could make a difference. **一位年轻的艺术家很理想主义。他梦想创作出能改变世界的杰作。尽管面临诸多困难，他的理想主义精神支撑着他前行。他相信艺术能有所作为。**

> A young artist always idealize the beauty of nature in his mind. He dreams of painting the perfect landscape, but reality often brings challenges. However, his pursuit of the ideal never stops. **一位年轻的艺术家总是在脑海中把大自然的美理想化。他梦想画出完美的风景，但现实常常带来挑战。然而，他对理想的追求从未停止。**

> Imagine a world where everything works perfectly. In this ideal world, people are always happy and problems are solved easily. This is what \'ideally\' represents - a perfect or best possible situation. **想象一个一切都完美运作的世界。在这个理想的世界里，人们总是很快乐，问题也能轻易解决。这就是\'ideally\'所代表的------一种完美的或最理想的情况。**

> Once upon a time, there were two twins. They looked exactly the same in every way. Their features, clothes, and even smiles were identical. It was like they were mirror images of each other. **从前，有一对双胞胎。他们在各方面看起来都完全相同。他们的容貌、衣服甚至笑容都一模一样。就好像他们是彼此的镜像。**

> One day, a detective was looking for a criminal. The only clue was a footprint, but it was identifiable. With this clue, the detective finally caught the criminal. So, identifiable means capable of being recognized or identified. **有一天，一位侦探在寻找罪犯。唯一的线索是一个脚印，但它是可识别的。凭借这个线索，侦探最终抓住了罪犯。所以，identifiable 意思是可辨认的，可识别的。**

> One day, a thief was caught. The police needed identification to prove it was him. They used fingerprints and photos. Finally, they got the right identification and the thief couldn\'t deny it. **有一天，一个小偷被抓住了。警察需要身份鉴定来证明是他。他们使用了指纹和照片。最终，他们得到了正确的身份鉴定，小偷无法否认。**

> One day, a detective was trying to solve a mystery. He needed to identify the criminal. He carefully examined clues and finally found the key evidence to identify the culprit. **一天，一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。他需要辨认出罪犯。他仔细检查线索，最终找到了关键证据来确认罪犯。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The key was to find the identity of the thief. He looked for clues everywhere and finally discovered the true identity. It was the quiet neighbor! **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。关键是找出小偷的身份。他到处寻找线索，最终发现了真实身份。原来是那个安静的邻居！**

> A group of friends had a heated debate. One argued from an ideological perspective, believing in certain theories and values. But others focused on practical solutions. Finally, they understood the importance of both. Remember, ideological means related to ideas and beliefs. **一群朋友进行了激烈的辩论。一个人从意识形态的角度争论，信奉某些理论和价值观。但其他人关注实际的解决办法。最后，他们明白了两者的重要性。记住，ideological 意思是和思想、观念有关的。**

> A stubborn king was always insisting on his own ideas and never listened to others. People called him an ideologue. He refused to change even when his kingdom faced problems. Finally, his kingdom fell. **一个固执的国王总是坚持自己的想法，从不听取别人的意见。人们称他为空想家。即使他的王国面临问题，他也拒绝改变。最后，他的王国沦陷了。**

> Imagine a group of thinkers in a room, passionately discussing their beliefs and values about how society should be. This gathering represents \'ideology\', a set of ideas and beliefs that shape their view of the world. **想象一群思想家在一个房间里，热烈地讨论他们关于社会应该如何的信念和价值观。这种聚会就代表了"意识形态"，即塑造他们世界观的一套思想和信念。**

> A foreigner was confused when he heard people say \'It\'s raining cats and dogs\'. But later he learned that this is an idiom meaning heavy rain. He was so happy to understand this special way of expression. **一个外国人听到人们说'It\'s raining cats and dogs'时很困惑。但后来他知道了这是个习语，意思是下大雨。他很高兴理解了这种特殊的表达方式。**

> A famous artist had an idiosyncrasy. He always painted at midnight under the moonlight. This unique trait made his artworks stand out. His idiosyncrasy was his creative secret. **一位著名的艺术家有一个独特的癖好。他总是在午夜的月光下作画。这种独特的特质使他的艺术作品脱颖而出。他的独特性就是他的创作秘诀。**

> A strange artist had very idiosyncratic ways. He always painted at midnight and used only purple. This odd behavior showed his idiosyncratic style. **一位奇怪的艺术家有着非常独特的方式。他总是在午夜作画，而且只用紫色。这种古怪的行为展现了他独特的风格。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who always made the silliest decisions. He couldn\'t understand simple tasks and often caused trouble. Everyone called him an idiot. He never learned and continued to act foolishly. **从前，有一个人总是做最愚蠢的决定。他理解不了简单的任务，还经常惹麻烦。大家都叫他白痴。他从不吸取教训，继续愚蠢行事。**

> A man was walking in the street, wearing a funny hat and singing loudly. His behavior was so strange and unreasonable. People around him thought he was idiotic. Later, he realized his mistake and changed his ways. **一个男人走在街上，戴着滑稽的帽子大声唱歌。他的行为如此奇怪和不合理。周围的人都认为他愚蠢至极。后来，他意识到了自己的错误并改变了做法。**

> A man was always idle and did nothing productive. One day, he found himself with no money and no friends. Then he realized that being idle leads to nothing good. **一个男人总是无所事事，不做任何有成效的事。有一天，他发现自己既没钱也没朋友。然后他意识到游手好闲不会带来任何好处。**

> One day, Tom was sitting idly by the window, doing nothing. Just then, a bird flew by and reminded him that idleness leads to no progress. So, he decided to get up and do something meaningful. **一天，汤姆无所事事地坐在窗边。就在这时，一只鸟飞过，提醒他游手好闲不会有进步。于是，他决定起身去做些有意义的事。**

> Once upon a time, a young girl dreamed of meeting her idol. She saved money for a long time to attend a concert. Finally, she saw her idol on the stage and felt extremely happy. The idol was someone she admired and aspired to be like. **从前，一个年轻女孩梦想着见到她的偶像。她存了很长时间的钱去参加一场音乐会。最后，她在舞台上看到了她的偶像，感到非常开心。偶像就是她敬仰并渴望成为的那种人。**

> A young girl always went to every concert of her favorite singer. She collected all the albums and posters. She idolized the singer, seeing him as a perfect star and wanting to be like him one day. **一个年轻女孩总是去她最喜欢的歌手的每一场演唱会。她收集了所有的专辑和海报。她崇拜这位歌手，把他视为完美的明星，并希望有一天能像他一样。**

> A young artist traveled to a remote village. There, he found an idyllic scene: clear rivers, green meadows, and friendly villagers. The peaceful and charming place inspired his best paintings. **一位年轻的艺术家去了一个偏远的村庄。在那里，他发现了一幅田园诗般的景象：清澈的河流、绿色的草地和友好的村民。这个宁静迷人的地方激发了他最出色的画作。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She wondered if she could find the hidden treasure. She kept looking and finally, she did! The word \'if\' here shows uncertainty and possibility. **从前，有一个小女孩。她想知道自己是否能找到隐藏的宝藏。她不断寻找，最后，她找到了！这里的'if'表示不确定性和可能性。**

> One dark night, a brave adventurer found an ancient torch. With a strike of a match, he ignited the torch, and its light banished the darkness, showing the way forward. The fire from the torch ignite his courage to explore the unknown. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一位勇敢的冒险家找到了一个古老的火炬。他用一根火柴点燃了火炬，火焰驱散了黑暗，指明了前进的道路。火炬的火焰点燃了他探索未知的勇气。**

> A car thief broke into a car but couldn\'t start it because he didn\'t know the key to the ignition. Just then, the police arrived and caught him. The ignition is the system that starts the engine. **一个偷车贼闯入一辆车但无法启动，因为他不知道点火装置的钥匙。就在这时，警察赶到并抓住了他。ignition 指的是启动引擎的系统。**

> A young man was always making mistakes because of his ignorance. One day, he lost an important job opportunity. This made him realize that ignorance can lead to failure and he decided to learn and grow. **一个年轻人总是因为无知而犯错。有一天，他失去了一个重要的工作机会。这使他意识到无知会导致失败，于是他决定学习和成长。**

> One day, Tom was ignorant of the rules of the new game. He made many mistakes and lost. But after learning the rules carefully, he never made the same mistakes again. Ignorant means lacking knowledge or awareness. **有一天，汤姆对新游戏的规则一无所知。他犯了很多错误并输了。但在认真学习规则后，他再也没犯同样的错。ignorant 意思是缺乏知识或意识。**

> One day, Tom was talking loudly in class, but the teacher chose to ignore him. Tom thought it was okay to be naughty. But later, he realized that being ignored meant not getting attention and that it was not good. **有一天，汤姆在课堂上大声讲话，但老师选择忽视他。汤姆以为调皮没关系。但后来，他意识到被忽视意味着得不到关注，这并不好。**

> A brave boy was on an adventure in the jungle. Suddenly, he saw an iguana. It was green and had a long tail. The boy was amazed and remembered the word \'iguana\' easily because of this special encounter. **一个勇敢的男孩在丛林中冒险。突然，他看到一只鬣蜥。它是绿色的，有一条长长的尾巴。男孩很惊讶，并因为这次特别的相遇轻松记住了\'iguana\'这个单词。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was lost in a forest. She met a strange old man. The old man asked her if she knew the ilk of the plants around. The girl was confused. Later she learned that \'ilk\' means type or kind. **从前，有个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她遇到一个奇怪的老人。老人问她是否知道周围植物的种类。小女孩很困惑。后来她才知道'ilk'是类型或种类的意思。**
> 有一天，小明感觉身体不舒服（ill），他头疼得厉害，还一直咳嗽。妈妈带他去看医生，医生说他生病了。小明只能躺在床上休息，希望能快点好起来。 **有一天，小明感觉身体不适，头疼咳嗽，妈妈带他看医生，医生说他生病了，小明只能卧床休息，盼着康复。**

> One night, a thief was caught by the police. The thief\'s action of stealing was illegal. He broke the law and would face punishment. Remember, illegal means not allowed by law. **一天晚上，一个小偷被警察抓住了。这个小偷的偷窃行为是违法的。他触犯了法律并且将面临惩罚。记住，illegal 意思是不合法的。**

> A thief was caught stealing jewels illegally. The police said his actions were against the law and he would be punished. Remember, doing things illegally like this thief always leads to trouble. **一个小偷被抓到非法偷珠宝。警察说他的行为违法，他将受到惩罚。记住，像这个小偷这样非法做事总会带来麻烦。**

> A prince was accused of having an illegitimate child. The kingdom was in chaos as this was against the law. People were shocked and talked about it everywhere. Remember, illegitimate means not legal or not in accordance with the rules. **一位王子被指控有一个非婚生子女。王国因此陷入混乱，因为这是违法的。人们感到震惊，到处议论。记住，illegitimate 意思是不合法的或不符合规则的。**

> A thief was caught selling illicit goods in a dark alley. The police had been watching him for a long time. \'Illicit\' means not allowed by law or rules. So his actions were clearly wrong and illegal. **一个小偷在一条黑暗的小巷里售卖非法物品时被抓了。警察已经监视他很久了。\'illicit\'意思是不被法律或规则所允许的。所以他的行为显然是错误且违法的。**

> In a small village, many people suffered from illiteracy. They couldn\'t read or write and had trouble finding good jobs. One day, a teacher came and decided to change this. With hard work, more and more villagers learned to read and write, ending illiteracy. **在一个小村庄里，很多人饱受文盲之苦。他们不会读写，找好工作也困难。有一天，一位老师来了，决定改变这一状况。通过努力，越来越多的村民学会了读写，消除了文盲现象。**

> A man named Tom was illiterate. He couldn\'t read or write and always faced difficulties in finding jobs. One day, he decided to learn and changed his life. Now you know \'illiterate\' means unable to read and write. **有个叫汤姆的人是个文盲。他既不会读也不会写，找工作总是面临困难。有一天，他决定学习并改变了自己的生活。现在你知道\'illiterate\'意思是不会读写。**

> One day, Tom felt very weak and had a high fever. The doctor said it was an illness called flu. His friends were worried. But after taking medicine and resting well, Tom finally recovered. **有一天，汤姆感到非常虚弱并且高烧。医生说这是一种叫做流感的疾病。他的朋友们很担心。但在吃药和好好休息后，汤姆终于康复了。**

> A man insisted that cats could fly, which was illogical. Everyone tried to reason with him, but he wouldn\'t listen. His belief was completely against common sense and logic. **一个男人坚称猫会飞，这是不合逻辑的。每个人都试图跟他讲道理，但他不听。他的这种想法完全违背了常理和逻辑。**
> 在一个漆黑的夜晚，小明迷失在森林中。突然，一道神奇的光芒出现，illuminate 了前方的道路。原来是一位仙女拿着魔法棒，那光芒就像明灯，指引小明走出了困境。 **在一个漆黑的夜晚，小明在森林中迷路。突然，一道神奇的光照亮了前方的道路。原来是一位仙女拿着魔法棒，那光就像明灯，指引小明走出了困境。**

> One dark night, I was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a lantern appeared, illuminating the way ahead. Its light was like a guiding star. The word \'illuminating\' means giving light and making things clear, just like that lantern did in the darkness. **一个漆黑的夜晚，我在森林里迷路了。突然，一盏灯笼出现，照亮了前方的路。它的光就像一颗指路星。单词\'illuminating\'意思是照明，使事物清晰，就像那盏在黑暗中的灯笼一样。**

> In a dark cave, a lost adventurer was desperate. Suddenly, a magical light appeared, providing illumination. It was like a guiding star, showing the way out. The adventurer was saved by this wonderful illumination. **在一个黑暗的洞穴里，一位迷路的冒险家感到绝望。突然，一道神奇的光出现了，提供了照明。它就像一颗指路星，指明了出路。冒险家被这美妙的照明拯救了。**

> A man was walking in a desert and saw an oasis ahead. He rushed towards it, but when he got closer, it vanished. It was just an illusion, making him realize that what seemed real could be deceptive. **一个男人在沙漠中行走，看到前方有一片绿洲。他冲过去，但靠近时它消失了。这只是一种幻觉，让他明白看似真实的东西可能具有欺骗性。**

> One day, Alice was in a strange forest. She saw a beautiful castle that seemed real, but when she got closer, it vanished. It was illusory. She learned that not everything is as it appears. **有一天，爱丽丝在一个陌生的森林里。她看到一座美丽的城堡，看似真实，但当她走近时，城堡消失了。这是虚幻的。她明白了并非所有事物都如表面所见。**

> A poor little artist was always ignored. But one day, he decided to illustrate his dream with a beautiful painting. Everyone was amazed and finally saw his talent. The act of drawing that picture was to illustrate his inner world. **一个可怜的小艺术家总是被忽视。但有一天，他决定用一幅美丽的画来说明他的梦想。每个人都很惊讶，终于看到了他的才华。画那幅画的行为就是为了阐明他的内心世界。**

> Once upon a time, a little artist was creating an illustration of a magical forest. Every detail was carefully drawn to show the beauty. This picture was the perfect illustration of her imagination. **从前，有个小画家正在创作一幅神奇森林的插画。每一个细节都被精心绘制以展现其美丽。这幅画完美地诠释了她的想象。**

> A little artist was always drawing to be illustrative. One day, she showed her works and everyone understood her ideas clearly. Her pictures were so illustrative that they told stories without words. **一位小画家总是通过画画来进行说明。有一天，她展示了自己的作品，每个人都能清晰地理解她的想法。她的画非常具有说明性，无需言语就能讲故事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a talented person named Lily. She loved to draw and was known as an \'illustrator\'. Her illustrations could tell wonderful stories. People were always amazed by her creative works. **从前，有个叫莉莉的有才华的人。她喜欢画画，被称为"插画师"。她的插画能讲述精彩的故事。人们总是对她的创意作品感到惊讶。**

> A young artist dreamed of becoming illustrious. He worked hard day and night, creating amazing paintings. Finally, his works were shown in famous galleries, making him illustrious in the art world. **一位年轻的艺术家梦想变得杰出。他日夜努力，创作了令人惊叹的画作。最终，他的作品在著名的画廊展出，使他在艺术界声名显赫。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个神秘的房间，墙上挂满了各种美丽的画。这些画就像是'image'，它们是具体的形象，展现出不同的场景和人物，让你仿佛置身于另一个世界。 **想象一下，你走进一个神秘房间，墙上的画就像'image'这个单词所代表的具体形象，展现不同场景和人物，带你进入另一个世界。**

> Once upon a time, a painter was creating a masterpiece. He used various colors and shapes to form beautiful imagery. People were amazed by the vivid scenes he depicted. The imagery made them feel like they were in a different world. **从前，有一位画家正在创作一幅杰作。他使用各种颜色和形状来构成美丽的意象。人们对他描绘的生动场景感到惊讶。这些意象让他们感觉仿佛置身于另一个世界。**

> A little boy was lost in a forest. He used his imagination to think of all the imaginable ways to find his way home. Finally, he followed a stream and succeeded. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他运用想象力去想所有能想到的回家的办法。最后，他顺着一条小溪成功了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who had an imaginary friend. They went on adventures in a magical land. But no one else could see this friend. \'Imaginary\' means not real, existing only in the mind. **从前，有一个小男孩，他有一个想象中的朋友。他们在一个神奇的地方冒险。但其他人都看不到这个朋友。\'imaginary\'意思是想象的，不真实的，只存在于脑海中。**

> One day, a little boy was alone in his room. With his imagination, he turned a simple chair into a spaceship and flew to the moon. He saw strange creatures and beautiful stars. Imagination made his world wonderful. **有一天，一个小男孩独自在他的房间里。凭借他的想象力，他把一把简单的椅子变成了一艘宇宙飞船，飞到了月球。他看到了奇怪的生物和美丽的星星。想象力让他的世界变得精彩。**

> Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. He was very imaginative. He could imagine a magical world with flying horses and talking trees. His imaginative mind made his life full of wonder and adventure. **从前，有个叫汤姆的男孩。他非常富有想象力。他能想象出一个有飞马和会说话的树的神奇世界。他的想象力让他的生活充满了惊奇和冒险。**

> One day, I closed my eyes and tried to imagine a beautiful garden full of colorful flowers and singing birds. I saw it clearly in my mind. That\'s what imagine means - to form a mental picture or idea. **有一天，我闭上眼睛，努力想象一个满是五颜六色的花朵和歌唱的鸟儿的美丽花园。我在脑海中清晰地看到了它。这就是 imagine 的意思------在脑海中形成一幅画面或想法。**

> One day, I was lost in a foreign city. A kind imam came to my rescue. He guided me through the maze of streets and helped me find my way. The imam\'s wisdom and kindness left a deep impression on me. **有一天，我在一个外国城市迷路了。一位善良的伊玛目来救我。他引导我穿过迷宫般的街道，帮我找到了路。这位伊玛目的智慧和善良给我留下了深刻的印象。**

> Once upon a time, there was a balanced seesaw in a park. But one day, a heavy man sat on one side, causing an imbalance. The seesaw tipped and couldn\'t work properly. That\'s what \'imbalance\' means - a lack of balance. **从前，公园里有一个平衡的跷跷板。但有一天，一个很重的人坐在一边，导致了不平衡。跷跷板倾斜了，不能正常工作。这就是\'imbalance\'的意思------不平衡。**
> 想象一下，一位画家拥有神奇的画笔，每次作画时，他都能将自己对美的独特感受 imbue 到画布上，让每一笔色彩都充满了情感和灵魂。 **想象一位画家把自己对美的独特感受注入到画布上，以此来辅助记忆 imbue（使充满，灌输）这个单词。**

> One day, a little monkey saw a human dancing and it tried to imitate the movements. It jumped and twisted, making everyone laugh. The monkey was imitating the human\'s dance steps. **一天，一只小猴子看到一个人在跳舞，它试图模仿动作。它跳来跳去、扭来扭去，让大家都笑了。这只猴子正在模仿人类的舞步。**

> One day, a little monkey saw a human wearing a hat and decided to make an imitation. It found a similar hat and wore it, thinking it looked just as cool. But it soon realized it wasn\'t the same as being truly human. **一天，一只小猴子看到一个人戴着帽子，决定模仿。它找了一顶相似的帽子戴上，觉得自己看起来也很酷。但很快它就意识到这和真正成为人类是不一样的。**
> 想象一下，在一个纯白的世界里，有一座崭新的城堡，城堡的墙壁没有一点污渍，地面一尘不染，一切都是那么完美无瑕，这就是 immaculate 的景象。 **想象在纯白世界中崭新城堡完美无瑕的景象来辅助记忆 immaculate 这个单词，意思是完美无瑕的；洁净的；无瑕疵的**

> A little bird always wanted to fly high before it grew strong feathers. Its eagerness showed it was immature. It needed more time to develop. Finally, it learned patience and grew mature. **一只小鸟总是在还没长出强壮的羽毛时就想飞得很高。它的急切表现出它的不成熟。它需要更多时间成长。最后，它学会了耐心，变得成熟了。**

> A young artist was seeking success. One day, he got an offer with immediacy. It meant he could showcase his work right away. No waiting, no delay. The immediacy of the opportunity changed his life. **一位年轻的艺术家正在寻求成功。有一天，他立即得到了一个机会。这意味着他可以马上展示他的作品。无需等待，没有延迟。这个立即到来的机会改变了他的一生。**

> A king needed an immediate solution to the enemy\'s attack. His advisor suggested a bold plan right away. \'Immediate\' means happening or done without delay, like the king needed a response right then. **一位国王需要对敌人的进攻立即拿出解决方案。他的顾问马上提出了一个大胆的计划。"immediate"意味着立即发生或完成，就像国王当时需要即刻的回应。**

> A little boy was playing outside. Suddenly, it started raining. His mom shouted \'Come in immediately!\' The boy rushed in right away. So, immediately means at once, without delay. **一个小男孩正在外面玩。突然，开始下雨了。他妈妈喊道：'马上进来！'小男孩立刻冲了进来。所以，immediately 意思是立即，毫不拖延。**

> A little ant was lost in an immense forest. It felt so tiny and helpless. But with its determination, it finally found a way out. The forest was just too big and vast, like the meaning of \'immense\'. **一只小蚂蚁在一片巨大的森林里迷路了。它感到自己如此渺小和无助。但凭借决心，它最终找到了出路。这片森林就是太大太广阔了，就像'immense'这个词所表达的意思。**

> A little ant wanted to cross a vast desert. It struggled but finally made it, realizing the desert was immensely large. But its perseverance paid off. The ant was happy. **一只小蚂蚁想要穿过一片广阔的沙漠。它艰难前行但最终成功了，意识到这片沙漠无比巨大。但它的坚持得到了回报，蚂蚁很开心。**

> A young artist wants to create a masterpiece. So, he decides to immerse himself completely in his work. He shuts out all distractions and focuses only on the canvas. Finally, his painting is amazing. **一位年轻的艺术家想要创作一幅杰作。于是，他决定让自己完全沉浸在工作中。他排除一切干扰，只专注于画布。最终，他的画作令人惊叹。**
> 想象一下，你完全沉浸在一个装满水的大泳池里，感受着水包围着你，这种全身心投入水中的状态就是\'immersion\'。就像学习语言时，全身心投入语言环境中一样。 **想象你完全沉浸在泳池里的情景来理解\'immersion\'，表示沉浸、浸没。就像全身心投入语言环境学习语言。**

> A poor family decided to become immigrants. They crossed the ocean, hoping for a better life. They were immigrants, seeking new opportunities and a brighter future in a strange land. **一个贫困的家庭决定成为移民。他们跨越海洋，希望过上更好的生活。他们是移民，在陌生的土地上寻求新的机会和更光明的未来。**

> A young couple decided to immigrate to a new country. They packed their bags, left their hometown, and started a new life full of hope and challenges. \'Immigrate\' means to come to a new country to live permanently. **一对年轻夫妇决定移民到一个新的国家。他们收拾好行李，离开家乡，开始了充满希望和挑战的新生活。\'immigrate\'意思是移居（入境）；移民**

> A brave adventurer named Tom decided to leave his homeland for a new start. His journey to a foreign country, seeking a better life, was called immigration. He faced many challenges but was hopeful for a brighter future. **一位勇敢的冒险家汤姆决定离开他的祖国去重新开始。他前往外国寻求更好生活的旅程被称为移民。他面临许多挑战，但对更美好的未来充满希望。**

> A brave firefighter was on duty. Suddenly, he saw a huge fire. The danger was imminent. But he stayed calm and was ready to fight. It means about to happen soon. **一位勇敢的消防员正在值班。突然，他看到了一场大火。危险迫在眉睫。但他保持冷静，准备战斗。这个单词意思是即将发生。**
> 想象一下，在一个暴风雪的夜晚，一辆汽车陷在雪地里，车轮无法转动，整个车身 immobile 动弹不得。无论司机怎么努力，车子就是不能移动分毫，就像被施了魔法定在那里一样。 **想象在暴风雪夜，一辆车陷雪地里动弹不得，以此辅助记忆 immobile 意为固定不动的、不能移动的**

> A thief was trying to escape, but the brave police used a special device to immobilize him. They made him unable to move, and finally caught him. Now you know, immobilize means to prevent from moving. **一个小偷正试图逃跑，但勇敢的警察使用了一个特殊的装置使他无法动弹。他们让他不能移动，最终抓住了他。现在你知道了，immobilize 意思是使不能移动**

> A thief broke into a house and stole precious jewels. His action was clearly immoral. He knew it was wrong but did it for his own gain. Remember, immoral means contrary to moral principles, like the thief\'s behavior. **一个小偷闯进一户人家并偷走了珍贵的珠宝。他的行为显然是不道德的。他明知是错的，但为了自己的利益还是这么做了。记住，immoral 意思是违背道德原则的，就像这个小偷的行为。**

> Once upon a time, there was a brave warrior who fought countless battles. Despite facing many dangers, he never died. People called him immortal. It means someone who will never die or be forgotten. **从前，有一位勇敢的战士，历经无数战斗。尽管面临诸多危险，他却从未死去。人们称他为不朽者。这个词意思是永远不会死或被遗忘的人。**

> A brave knight sought immortality. He journeyed through dark forests and climbed high mountains. Finally, he found a magical fountain said to grant immortality. But he realized true immortality lies in the deeds he leaves behind. **一位勇敢的骑士寻求永生。他穿越黑暗的森林，攀登高山。最后，他找到了据说能赐予永生的神奇喷泉。但他意识到真正的永生在于他留下的事迹。**

> A great artist wanted to immortalize the beauty of a moment. So, he painted a masterpiece that captured it perfectly. Through his art, that moment would live forever, just like the meaning of \'immortalize\' - to make something or someone last forever and never be forgotten. **一位伟大的艺术家想要使某个瞬间的美永垂不朽。于是，他画了一幅杰作完美地捕捉了它。通过他的艺术，那个瞬间将永远存在，这就像\' immortalize \'这个词的意思------使某物或某人永远存在且不被遗忘。**
> 想象一个超级英雄，他的身体具有特殊能力，任何病毒和细菌都无法伤害他。这种不会被侵害的能力就是\'immune\'。就像我们打了疫苗后对某些疾病有了\'immune\'（免疫）能力，不会轻易生病。 **想象超级英雄身体具有不会被病毒细菌侵害的能力来理解\'immune\'（免疫的；不受影响的）**

> A brave knight was always protected from enemies\' attacks. His special shield gave him immunity. No matter how fierce the battle was, he remained safe. This is how we remember \'immunity\' - the ability to be protected. **一位勇敢的骑士总是能免受敌人的攻击。他的特殊盾牌赋予了他免疫力。无论战斗多么激烈，他都安然无恙。这就是我们记住\'免疫力\'这个词的方式------受到保护的能力。**

> A brave doctor was giving immunization shots to children. The shots protected them from getting sick. With immunization, they could play freely and happily. It\'s like a magic shield against diseases! **一位勇敢的医生正在给孩子们打免疫针。这些针保护他们不生病。有了免疫接种，他们可以自由快乐地玩耍。这就像是抵御疾病的魔法盾牌！**

> A brave doctor was in a small village. He used special medicine to immunize all the children against diseases. With this protection, the kids could play happily and stay healthy. **一位勇敢的医生在一个小村庄里。他用特殊的药物给所有孩子进行免疫接种来预防疾病。有了这种保护，孩子们可以快乐地玩耍并保持健康。**
> 想象有一个古老的魔法图书馆，里面存放着一本神秘的法典，法典上的规则是 immutable 的，无论时间如何流逝，无论谁试图改变，它都永恒不变，如同刻在石头上的真理。 **想象有一个古老的魔法图书馆，里面存放着一本神秘的法典，法典上的规则是不可改变的，无论时间如何流逝，无论谁试图改变，它都永恒不变，如同刻在石头上的真理。**

> A meteor was speeding towards Earth. When it hit, it made a huge impact. The ground shook, and everything nearby was changed. Just like a strong event or idea can have a great impact on our lives. **一颗流星正朝地球疾驰而来。当它撞击时，产生了巨大的冲击力。地面震动，附近的一切都改变了。就像一个强大的事件或想法可以对我们的生活产生重大影响一样。**
> 想象一个工人在工厂里，不小心被掉落的重物砸到了脚，这一意外事件损害（impair）了他行走的能力。他原本能正常走路，现在却变得困难，这就是 impari 的意思。 **想象一个工人受伤的场景来辅助记忆 impari 这个单词，意思是损害、削弱**

> A brave knight was injured in a battle, resulting in an impairment of his vision. But he didn\'t give up and continued to fight with strong will. The impairment couldn\'t stop his determination. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场战斗中受伤，导致他的视力受损。但他没有放弃，凭借坚强的意志继续战斗。这种损伤无法阻挡他的决心。**

> A wise old teacher imparts valuable knowledge to her students. She shares her wisdom and experiences, making a big difference in their lives. \'Impart\' means to give or communicate something to others. **一位睿智的老教师向她的学生传授宝贵的知识。她分享自己的智慧和经验，给学生的生活带来很大的改变。\'impart\'意思是给予或传达某物给他人。**

> A king needed to judge a dispute. Two people argued fiercely. But the wise judge was impartial. He listened carefully and made a fair decision based on facts, not biases. So, impartial means being fair and not favoring any side. **一位国王需要裁决一场争端。两人激烈争论。但明智的法官是公正的。他仔细倾听，并依据事实而非偏见做出了公平的决定。所以，impartial 意思是公平的，不偏袒任何一方。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的城堡里，两位勇敢的骑士为了争夺宝藏，在一条狭窄的通道相遇，谁也无法前进或后退，陷入了僵局。这个场景就是\'impasse\'，意味着绝境、僵局。 **想象在城堡中两位骑士在狭窄通道相遇无法进退的场景来辅助理解\'impasse\'，意为绝境、僵局。**

> A young artist gave an impassioned speech about his love for art. His voice was full of passion and excitement, making everyone feel his deep emotions. The way he expressed himself was so intense that it was unforgettable. **一位年轻的艺术家发表了一篇充满激情的演讲，讲述他对艺术的热爱。他的声音充满了热情和兴奋，让每个人都感受到了他深刻的情感。他表达自己的方式如此强烈，令人难以忘怀。**
> 在一场激烈的辩论赛中，所有人都情绪激动，大声争论。唯有小明保持着impassive 的神情，仿佛外界的喧嚣与他无关。无论观点多么激烈，他都面无表情，冷静得让人惊讶。 **在一场辩论赛中，所有人都很激动，只有小明神情冷淡、面无表情，借此记住impassive意为冷淡的；无动于衷的；不动声色的**

> Once there was a king. He always got angry quickly when waiting for his servants. His impatience made everyone around him nervous. Finally, he realized his problem and tried to change. **从前有个国王。他在等仆人时总是很快就生气。他的不耐烦让周围的每个人都很紧张。最后，他意识到自己的问题并努力改变。**

> A king was very impatient. When his servants were a little slow, he got angry. One day, a wise man told him to be patient. The king learned his lesson and changed. Now he waits calmly and is happier. **一位国王非常没有耐心。当他的仆人动作稍慢时，他就会生气。有一天，一位智者告诉他要有耐心。国王吸取了教训并改变了。现在他能冷静等待，也更快乐了。**

> One day, Tom was waiting for the bus impatiently. The bus was late and he kept looking at his watch, stomping his feet. He just couldn\'t stand the delay any longer. **有一天，汤姆不耐烦地等公交车。公交车晚点了，他不停地看表，跺脚。他实在无法再忍受这拖延了。**

> A corrupt official was doing bad things. The people decided to impeach him. They collected evidence to prove his wrongdoings and finally got him removed from his position. **一个腐败的官员在做坏事。人们决定弹劾他。他们收集证据来证明他的错误行为，最终让他被免职。**

> A king was accused of serious crimes, and the process of holding him accountable was called impeachment. The people wanted justice, and impeachment was the way to seek it. **一位国王被指控犯了严重的罪行，对他进行问责的过程被称为弹劾。民众想要正义，弹劾就是寻求正义的方式。**

> A prince was known for his impeccable behavior. He never made mistakes in his manners or actions. Everyone admired him for being so perfect. \'Impeccable\' means without fault or mistake. **一位王子以其无可挑剔的行为而闻名。他在举止和行动上从未犯错。每个人都钦佩他如此完美。'impeccable'意思是没有过错或错误。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. But a huge fallen tree impeded his way. He had to use all his strength to move it. Just like obstacles can impede our progress, this tree stopped the knight. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。但一棵巨大的倒下的树挡住了他的路。他不得不使出全身力气去移开它。就像障碍会阻碍我们前进一样，这棵树拦住了骑士。**

> A brave adventurer was on a journey. But a huge fallen tree became an impediment. It blocked the path and made it hard for him to move forward. He had to find a way to overcome this obstacle. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在旅行。但一棵巨大的倒下的树成为了一个障碍。它挡住了道路，让他难以前进。他必须想办法克服这个阻碍。**
> 想象一个人站在悬崖边，后面有一股神秘的力量在推他（impel），让他不得不向前走。这股力量就像内心的强烈渴望或外界的巨大压力，驱使着他迈出那艰难的一步。 **想象一个人在悬崖边被一股力量驱使向前的情景来辅助记忆【impel】，意思是推动、驱使**

> A brave knight was on the battlefield. He sensed the impending danger when he saw the enemy\'s army approaching in the distance. He prepared himself for the coming battle. **一位勇敢的骑士在战场上。当他看到远处敌军逼近时，他感觉到了即将来临的危险。他为即将到来的战斗做好了准备。**

> A brave explorer tried to enter a mysterious forest. But the thick bushes and intertwined branches made it impenetrable. No matter how hard he tried, he just couldn\'t get through. **一位勇敢的探险家试图进入一片神秘的森林。但是浓密的灌木丛和交织的树枝使其难以进入。无论他怎么努力，就是无法穿过。**

> A king issued an imperative order to his soldiers. They must win the battle or face severe punishment. The order was so strong and necessary that it couldn\'t be ignored. **一位国王向他的士兵下达了紧急命令。他们必须赢得战斗，否则将面临严厉的惩罚。这个命令如此强硬且必要，不容忽视。**

> A little prince had an imperfect magic wand. It could sometimes work and sometimes not. This made him frustrated. Just like \'imperfect\' means not perfect, having flaws or faults. **一个小王子有一根不完美的魔法棒。它有时能起作用，有时不能。这让他很沮丧。就像\'imperfect\'这个词的意思是不完美的，有缺陷或错误。**

> Once upon a time, a potter was frustrated by the imperfection of a vase he made. It had a small crack. But he realized that imperfection made it unique. Imperfection means something not perfect, having flaws or faults. **从前，一位陶工对他制作的一个花瓶的不完美感到沮丧。它有一条小裂缝。但他意识到不完美使它独一无二。imperfection 意思是不完美，有缺陷或错误。**
> 从前有个国王，他住在一座宏伟的城堡里，追求着至高无上的权力。他的一切都彰显着 imperial 的风范，华丽的服饰、盛大的仪式，都在展示他的帝国权威。 **从前有个国王，他住在宏伟城堡里，追求至高权力。他的一切展现出"imperial（帝国的；皇帝的）"的风范，如华丽服饰、盛大仪式，都展示他的帝国权威。**

> In a faraway land, a powerful king wanted to expand his territory and control other nations. This aggressive act of seeking dominance and control was called imperialism. It brought suffering to many. **在一个遥远的国度，一位强大的国王想要扩张领土并控制其他国家。这种寻求统治和控制的侵略性行为被称为帝国主义。它给许多人带来了痛苦。**

> A long time ago, there was a powerful man. He wanted to control many lands and people. He was an imperialist, always seeking to expand his empire and rule over others with force and power. **很久以前，有一个有权势的人。他想要控制很多土地和人民。他是一个帝国主义者，总是企图用武力和权力去扩张他的帝国并统治其他人。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. But he made a mistake that imperiled the entire kingdom. The evil wizard took advantage of this and threatened to destroy everything. \'Imperil\' means to put something in danger. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。但他犯了一个错误，使整个王国陷入危险。邪恶的巫师趁机威胁要摧毁一切。\'imperil\'意思是使某物处于危险之中。**

> A king was very imperious. He always ordered people around without considering their feelings. One day, a brave knight challenged him and said, \'You can\'t be so imperious!\' The king finally realized his mistake. **一位国王非常专横傲慢。他总是随意指使他人，从不考虑他们的感受。有一天，一位勇敢的骑士向他挑战并说道：'你不能如此专横！'国王最终意识到了自己的错误。**
> 想象一个神秘的办公室，里面的交流都很冷淡，没有人情味。员工们之间的互动是 impersonal 的，只谈工作，毫无情感交流。这种冷漠、客观、没有个人情感的氛围就是 impersonal 的体现。 **想象一个没有人情味的办公室场景来体现'impersonal'（冷淡的；客观的；没有人情味的）这个词**

> One day, a talented actor was chosen to impersonate a famous king in a play. He studied the king\'s mannerisms and speech carefully, and perfectly impersonated the king on stage, making the audience believe he was the real one. **一天，一位有才华的演员被选中在一部剧中扮演一位著名的国王。他仔细研究国王的举止和讲话，在舞台上完美地模仿了国王，让观众以为他就是真的国王。**

> A brave knight wore a special armor that was impervious to enemy\'s arrows. No matter how hard the enemies shot, the arrows just bounced off. This armor was completely unaffected and protected the knight well. **一位勇敢的骑士穿着一套特殊的盔甲，它impervious（不受影响的、不能渗透的）敌人的箭。无论敌人怎么用力射，箭都弹开了。这套盔甲完全未受影响，很好地保护了骑士。**

> A young athlete was struggling to improve. One day, a coach\'s inspiring words gave him the impetus to train harder. With this newfound motivation, he achieved great success. The impetus was like a powerful force that pushed him forward. **一位年轻运动员一直努力提高但成效不佳。一天，教练鼓舞人心的话语给了他动力（impetus）去更努力地训练。有了这新的动力，他取得了巨大成功。动力就像一股强大的力量推动着他前进。**

> Imagine a tiny asteroid impinging on a planet. It hits forcefully, causing a big impact. Just like that, when something impinges, it strikes or has an effect on something else strongly. **想象一颗小行星撞击一颗行星。它强力地撞击，造成巨大的冲击。就像这样，当某物 impinge 时，它强烈地撞击或对其他事物产生影响。**

> A king was very angry and became implacable. No one could change his mind. Even his closest advisers failed. His wrath was unyielding, just like a storm that wouldn\'t stop. **一位国王非常生气，变得执拗不可缓和。没人能改变他的想法。就连他最亲近的顾问也没办法。他的愤怒坚定不移，就像一场不会停歇的风暴。**
> 想象一个科学家在实验室里，小心翼翼地将一颗微小的芯片植入一只猴子的大脑，这个植入的动作就是\'implant\'。芯片就像一个神秘的礼物，被放进了猴子的脑袋里。 **想象科学家将芯片植入猴子大脑的动作来记住\'implant\'这个单词，意思是植入、灌输**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的科学家正在进行一项伟大的实验。他小心翼翼地将一颗微小的芯片植入一只猴子的大脑，这个植入的过程就是 \'implantation\' 。最终猴子获得了新的能力。 **想象一位科学家将芯片植入猴子大脑的过程来辅助记忆\'implantation\'（植入，移植）这个单词**

> One day, a man claimed he could fly without any equipment. Everyone thought it was implausible. How could someone fly without wings or a plane? It just didn\'t make sense. **有一天，一个男人声称他可以在没有任何装备的情况下飞行。每个人都认为这是难以置信的。一个人怎么能没有翅膀或飞机就飞起来呢？这根本说不通。**
> 想象一个农场主，他有个伟大计划。为了实现高效生产，他买了新工具，如锄头和犁，这些都是他的\'implement\'。有了它们，农场越来越好。 **想象一个农场主，为实现高效生产而购买的新工具如锄头和犁都是他的"工具，器具；履行；实施"。**
> 想象一个国王想要实施（implementation）一项新政策来帮助穷人。他召集大臣们，详细讨论计划，最终成功推行。这个过程就是\'implementation\'，即实施、执行。 **想象国王实施新政策帮助穷人的过程来记住\'实施、执行\'这个意思**

> A detective was trying to solve a crime. He found a clue that implicated a rich businessman. The evidence clearly showed that the businessman was involved in the illegal activity. **一位侦探正在努力侦破一起犯罪案件。他发现了一条线索，这条线索表明一个富商有牵连。证据清楚地显示这个商人参与了非法活动。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. The small clue had an implication that the thief was someone from the victim\'s family. It meant there was a hidden connection. The detective had to figure it out. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。这个小线索暗示着小偷是受害者家人中的某个人。这意味着存在着隐藏的关联。侦探必须弄清楚。**

> A thief was caught stealing, but the detective found implicit clues that there was a partner. The clues were not obvious but hidden. \'Implicit\' means suggested but not directly expressed or stated. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓，但侦探发现了一些暗示有同伙的隐晦线索。这些线索不明显而是隐藏着的。\'implicit\'意思是暗示的、含蓄的、不直接表达的。**

> A brave knight implicitly trusted his horse to carry him safely through the dangerous forest. The horse knew the way without needing any explicit instructions. \'Implicitly\' means without being directly stated or expressed. **一位勇敢的骑士默默地信任他的马能安全地驮他穿过危险的森林。马知道路，不需要任何明确的指示。\'implicitly\'意思是含蓄地；暗中地；不直接表明地**

> A king gave a mysterious smile. Everyone wondered what was implied. Was it a promise of rewards or a hidden warning? The mystery kept them guessing. **一位国王露出了神秘的微笑。大家都想知道这暗示着什么。是奖励的承诺还是隐藏的警告？这个谜团让他们不断猜测。**
> 想象一个巨大的气球，里面充满了气体。突然，气球内部的压力失衡，它不是向外爆炸，而是向内 implode 了，也就是急剧收缩并向内坍塌。就像一个企业，内部出现严重问题，不是向外崩溃，而是从内部 implode 瓦解。 **想象一个气球因内部压力失衡而向内坍塌来记住 implode 这个词，意为（使）内爆，（使）向内坍塌，（使）突然崩溃**

> A poor man was in a desperate situation. He implored the rich merchant for help, begging with tears in his eyes, saying, \'Please have mercy on me and give me some food.\' **一个穷人陷入绝境。他恳求富有的商人帮忙，眼中含泪哀求道：'求求您可怜可怜我，给我点食物吧。'**

> A detective was investigating a crime scene. The clues at the scene imply that the thief entered through the window. But he needed more evidence to be sure. This shows how imply suggests or indicates something without stating it directly. **一位侦探在调查犯罪现场。现场的线索暗示小偷是从窗户进入的。但他还需要更多证据来确定。这表明 imply 是指暗示或表明某事但不直接说明。**
> 想象一个国家，自己生产的物品不够好，于是从外国 IMPORT 了很多优质的商品。这些商品的 IMPORT 让人们的生活变得更好。 **想象一个国家，自身生产的物品不佳，于是从外国引进了许多优质商品。这些商品的引进让人们的生活得以改善。**

> One day, a little bird was lost. All the animals in the forest realized the importance of teamwork. They worked together to find the bird. Finally, they succeeded and understood that importance means how significant and valuable something is. **有一天，一只小鸟迷路了。森林里所有的动物都意识到团队合作的重要性。他们一起努力找到了小鸟。最后，他们成功了，并明白了 importance 意味着某事有多重要和有价值。**

> One day, a little mouse was lost in a big forest. It needed to find the way home. A kind bird told it an important clue: follow the river. With this clue, the mouse finally returned safely. The clue was very important for the mouse. **有一天，一只小老鼠在大森林里迷路了。它需要找到回家的路。一只善良的小鸟告诉它一个重要的线索：沿着河流走。凭借这个线索，老鼠最终安全地回家了。这个线索对老鼠来说非常重要。**

> A merchant was very excited about the importation of rare jewels. He traveled far to bring them to his hometown, making a fortune. Remember, importation means the act of bringing goods or services from another country. **一位商人对进口稀有珠宝非常兴奋。他长途跋涉将它们带回自己的家乡，赚了大钱。记住，importation 意思是从另一个国家引进货物或服务的行为。**
> 想象一下，有个叫小明的商人，他总是从国外引进各种新奇的商品，大家都叫他 importer 小明。因为他把外国的好东西带进国内，所以 importer 就是进口商、进口者的意思。 **想象一下，有个叫小明的商人，他总是从国外引进各种新奇的商品，大家都叫他进口商小明。因为他把外国的好东西带进国内，所以 importer 就是进口商、进口者的意思。**
> 国王想强加（impose）高额税收给百姓，百姓们都很愤怒。但聪明的大臣劝说国王，这样做会引发混乱。最终国王放弃了这个想法。 **国王想要强行施加高额税收给百姓，大臣劝说后国王放弃。**
> 想象一下，有一座古老的城堡，高大的城墙和雄伟的塔楼让人感到震撼。这座城堡给人的印象就是 imposing 。它外表宏伟壮观，令人望而生畏，仿佛在展示着它的威严和力量。 **想象一座令人震撼、外表宏伟壮观、威严有力的城堡来辅助记忆'imposing'（壮观的；使人印象深刻的）这个单词**

> A king made an imposition on his people, demanding excessive taxes. The people were angry but had to obey. This shows how imposition means the act of forcing something unfair on others. **一位国王对他的子民强征税款，这是一种强加。子民们很愤怒但不得不服从。这体现出imposition指的是把不公平的事物强加给他人的行为。**

> One day, a brave adventurer was determined to achieve a seemingly \'impossibility\' - climbing to the top of the highest and most dangerous mountain. Despite all the difficulties and doubts, he refused to give up. **有一天，一位勇敢的冒险家决心要完成一项看似"不可能的事"------爬上最高且最危险的山峰。尽管困难重重、质疑不断，他都拒绝放弃。**
> 有一天，小明想要飞起来，但大家都告诉他这是 impossible 的。因为没有翅膀，违背了自然规律。小明最终明白，impossible 就是那些根本无法做到，没有可能性的事情。 **有一天，小明想要飞起来，但大家都告诉他这是不可能的。因为没有翅膀，违背了自然规律。小明最终明白，不可能就是那些根本无法做到，没有可能性的事情。**

> A brave adventurer was told it was impossibly to reach the hidden treasure. But he refused to believe and kept going. Finally, he found the treasure, proving that what seemed impossibly could be possible with determination. **一位勇敢的冒险家被告知不可能找到隐藏的宝藏。但他拒绝相信，继续前行。最终，他找到了宝藏，证明了看似不可能的事，只要有决心就能成为可能。**

> A king was worried about his impotence. He couldn\'t lead his army to victory. But then he found a magic potion that gave him strength. With newfound power, he became a great leader. Remember, \'impotence\' means inability or weakness. **一位国王为自己的无能为力（性无能）感到担忧。他无法带领军队取得胜利。但后来他找到了一瓶神奇的药水，给了他力量。有了新获得的力量，他成为了一位伟大的领袖。记住，\'impotence\'意思是无能或虚弱。**

> A king was impotent when it came to protecting his kingdom. He had no power or ability to fight off invaders. This made him feel very frustrated and helpless. Remember, \'impotent\' means powerless or unable. **一位国王在保护他的王国时无能为力。他没有力量或能力击退侵略者。这让他感到非常沮丧和无助。记住，\'impotent\'意思是无能为力的或无能力的。**

> A poor village was once prosperous. But a disaster hit and all resources were lost. The villagers became impoverished. They struggled to survive, having no money or food. **一个贫穷的村庄曾经繁荣。但一场灾难袭来，所有资源都丧失了。村民们变得贫困。他们艰难求生，既没钱也没食物。**

> A man had a wild idea of building a castle in the sky. Everyone said it was impractical. But he insisted. Eventually, he failed and realized his plan was not based on reality. **一个男人有个疯狂的想法，要在天空中建造一座城堡。每个人都说这是不切实际的。但他坚持。最终，他失败了，意识到他的计划不是基于现实的。**

> A scientist was working on a special experiment. He needed to impregnate a material with a new element to create a revolutionary substance. It was a complex but crucial process to achieve the desired result. **一位科学家正在进行一项特殊实验。他需要用一种新元素浸渍一种材料，以创造出一种革命性的物质。这是一个复杂但关键的过程，以达到预期的结果。**

> A young artist wanted to impress a famous gallery owner. So, he spent days painting a masterpiece. When the owner saw it, she was deeply impressed by his talent and creativity. The artist achieved his goal. **一位年轻的艺术家想给一位著名的画廊老板留下深刻印象。所以，他花了好几天画了一幅杰作。当老板看到时，她对他的才华和创造力印象深刻。这位艺术家达到了他的目标。**

> One day, I met a famous artist. He showed me his paintings and they left a deep impression on me. I could feel the emotions and stories within each stroke. The experience was like a mark on my heart. **有一天，我遇到了一位著名的艺术家。他向我展示了他的画作，它们给我留下了深刻的印象。我能感受到每一笔中的情感和故事。这次经历就像在我心中留下的一个印记。**

> A painter was always trying to capture the most vivid impressions. People called him an impressionist. He focused on showing the immediate and fleeting feelings, making his art unique and memorable. **一位画家总是试图捕捉最生动的印象。人们称他为印象派画家。他专注于展现即时和稍纵即逝的感觉，使他的艺术独特且令人难忘。**

> A young artist drew a beautiful landscape. Everyone who saw it was amazed. The painting was so impressive that it left a deep mark in people\'s hearts. It made them believe the artist had great talent. **一位年轻的艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。每个看到它的人都感到惊叹。这幅画是如此令人印象深刻，在人们心中留下了深刻的印记。这让他们相信这位艺术家极具天赋。**

> A young artist performed on the stage impressively. Everyone was deeply attracted by his wonderful show. His talent and confidence left a lasting impression. **一位年轻的艺术家在舞台上的表演令人印象深刻。每个人都被他精彩的演出深深吸引。他的才华和自信给人留下了持久的印象。**

> A little bird fell on a fresh piece of paper and left an imprint. The paper was like a blank canvas, and the imprint was a unique mark. It made us remember the moment when the bird touched it. **一只小鸟落在一张崭新的纸上并留下了印记。这张纸就像一张空白的画布，而这个印记是独特的标记。它让我们记住了小鸟触碰它的那一刻。**

> A brave detective was chasing a criminal. But the criminal was very smart and set a trap. The detective got caught and was imprisoned in a dark room. Poor detective! **一位勇敢的侦探在追捕一名罪犯。但罪犯非常聪明并设下了陷阱。侦探被抓住并被监禁在一个黑暗的房间里。可怜的侦探！**

> A brave detective was chasing a criminal. The criminal was finally caught and got imprisonment. But the detective didn\'t stop, he continued to protect the city from more crimes. Imprisonment means the state of being imprisoned. **一位勇敢的侦探正在追捕一名罪犯。罪犯最终被抓获并被监禁。但侦探并未停歇，继续守护城市免受更多犯罪侵害。Imprisonment 意思是监禁的状态。**

> One day, a man claimed he could fly to the moon by flapping his arms. Everyone thought it was improbable. But he insisted and tried. Of course, he failed. It shows something unlikely to happen. **有一天，一个男人声称他可以通过挥动双臂飞到月球。每个人都认为这是不大可能的。但他坚持并尝试了。当然，他失败了。这表明了不太可能发生的事情。**

> One day, a musician was suddenly invited to perform at a party. Without any preparation, he played an impromptu piece that amazed everyone. It means done without being planned or prepared in advance. **一天，一位音乐家突然受邀在一个聚会上表演。没有任何准备，他即兴演奏了一曲，令所有人惊叹。这个词意思是未经事先计划或准备而做的。**

> A king was very angry because his servants always did improper things. For example, they served food in a messy way. The king shouted, \'This is improper!\' meaning not correct or suitable. **一位国王非常生气，因为他的仆人总是做不恰当的事。比如，他们上菜的方式很杂乱。国王大喊：'这是不恰当的！'意思是不正确或不合适。**

> A naughty monkey was behaving improperly in the zoo. It climbed over the fences and disturbed other animals. The zookeeper scolded it and said, \'You should not act improperly!\' **一只顽皮的猴子在动物园里表现不当。它翻过围栏，打扰了其他动物。动物园管理员训斥它说：'你不应该行为不当！'**

> A company\'s boss found some impropriety in the financial reports. It turned out an employee had made mistakes in recording expenses. This incident made everyone realize the importance of accuracy and honesty. **一家公司的老板在财务报告中发现了一些不当行为。原来是一名员工在记录费用时犯了错误。这一事件让每个人都意识到了准确和诚实的重要性。**

> One day, Tom was always getting low grades. But he decided to improve. He studied hard every day, read many books, and asked teachers for help. Finally, his grades got better. **一天，汤姆总是成绩很差。但他决定去提高。他每天努力学习，读很多书，并向老师寻求帮助。最终，他的成绩变好了。**

> A poor student always got low grades. But he worked hard and changed his study methods. Finally, his grades improved. He became a top student and everyone was happy for him. **一个成绩差的学生总是得分很低。但他努力学习并改变了学习方法。最终，他的成绩提高了。他成为了优等生，大家都为他高兴。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy\'s grades were not good. But he worked hard every day and made many changes. Finally, his progress was obvious. This was an improvement that made his parents proud. **从前，有个小男孩成绩不好。但他每天努力学习，做出了很多改变。最终，他的进步很明显。这就是一种提升，让他的父母感到骄傲。**

> A musician was on stage and suddenly had to perform without any prepared sheet music. Through quick thinking and creativity, he delivered a wonderful improvisation that amazed the audience. **一位音乐家在舞台上，突然不得不进行没有任何准备乐谱的表演。通过快速思考和创造力，他呈现了一场精彩的即兴创作，令观众惊叹不已。**

> A musician was suddenly invited to perform but had no prepared sheet music. So, he had to improvise, creating beautiful melodies on the spot. It means to create or do something without preparation. **一位音乐家突然被邀请表演，但没有准备乐谱。于是，他不得不即兴发挥，当场创作出美妙的旋律。这个词意思是无准备地创作或做某事。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the street. Suddenly, he had an impulse to buy a guitar when he saw one in a store. This urge came out of nowhere and made him enter the store immediately. **一天，汤姆正在街上走着。突然，当他看到一家商店里的一把吉他时，他有一种冲动想买下来。这种突如其来的欲望使他立刻走进了商店。**

> One day, Tom was very impulsive. He saw a beautiful kite and immediately decided to buy it without thinking about the price. This behavior showed his impulsive nature. **有一天，汤姆非常冲动。他看到一个漂亮的风筝，想都没想价格就立刻决定买下来。这种行为展现了他冲动的天性。**

> A thief thought he could steal with impunity. But when the police caught him, he realized there was no such thing as getting away with crime without punishment. **一个小偷以为他能偷东西而不受惩罚。但当警察抓住他时，他意识到犯罪而不受惩罚这种事是不存在的。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments to purify a liquid. But there was a problem -- some impurity made the process difficult. Finally, after much effort, the impurity was identified and removed. **一位科学家正在进行净化一种液体的实验。但有个问题------一些杂质让这个过程变得困难。最终，经过诸多努力，杂质被识别并清除了。**

> Imagine a little ant trying to get in a big anthill. It squeezes through the entrance and finally is IN. So, \'in\' means to be inside or within something. **想象一只小蚂蚁试图进入一个大蚁丘。它从入口挤进去，最后就在里面了。所以，\'in\'意味着在某物的里面或内部。**

> A superhero was once faced with a powerful villain. Despite all his efforts, the superhero found himself in a situation of inability to defeat the villain. It was a very tough moment. **一位超级英雄曾面对一个强大的反派。尽管他全力以赴，但超级英雄发现自己无力击败这个反派。这是一个非常艰难的时刻。**

> A brave explorer tried to reach a hidden cave. But the path was blocked by fallen trees and huge rocks. The cave was inaccessible. No matter how hard he tried, he just couldn\'t get there. **一位勇敢的探险家试图到达一个隐藏的洞穴。但道路被倒下的树木和巨大的岩石阻塞。这个洞穴难以接近。无论他怎么努力，就是到不了那里。**

> A scientist was criticized for the inaccuracy in his research data. He had made a small mistake in measurement, which led to wrong conclusions. This incident taught him to be more careful and precise in his work. **一位科学家因其研究数据的不准确性而受到批评。他在测量中犯了一个小错误，导致了错误的结论。这件事教会他在工作中要更加小心和精确。**

> One day, a reporter wrote an article full of mistakes. The information was inaccurate. His boss was very angry and said, \'You must be accurate next time!\' So, inaccurate means not correct or exact. **有一天，一名记者写了一篇满是错误的文章。信息不准确。他的老板非常生气并说：'下次你必须准确！'所以，inaccurate 意思是不正确的、不精确的。**

> A superhero was very angry because the citizens\' inaction allowed the villain to cause more damage. He shouted, \'Your inaction is making things worse!\' Meaning they were not taking action to stop the bad situation. **一位超级英雄非常生气，因为市民们的不作为让反派造成了更多的破坏。他大喊：'你们的不作为让情况变得更糟！'意思是他们没有采取行动来阻止糟糕的局面。**
> 想象一个机器人，平时总是处于关机状态，一动不动，非常懒散。它的这种不活跃、静止的状态就是\'inactive\'。就好像它没电了，没法工作和行动。 **想象一个总是关机静止的机器人来理解\'inactive\'这个词，表示不活跃的、懒散的、静止的**

> Once upon a time, a lazy bear showed a lot of inactivity. It just lay in the cave all day, not hunting or playing. This made it weak. Remember, inactivity means not being active or doing nothing. **从前，有一只懒惰的熊表现出很多不活动的状态。它整天就躺在洞穴里，既不捕猎也不玩耍。这使它变得虚弱。记住，inactivity 意思是不活跃或什么都不做。**
> 想象一个厨师准备一场盛大的宴会，但是食材不足（inadequacy），导致很多菜品无法完成。客人都很失望，厨师也非常尴尬。这就是'不足，不够'的意思。 **想象一位厨师因食材不足导致宴会菜品缺失，客人失望，厨师尴尬，以此体现'不足，不够'的含义。**
> 想象一个厨师准备了一桌饭菜，但食材不足（inadequate）。客人都饿着肚子，因为饭菜的量完全不够。这就像 in 表示否定，adequate 是足够的，合起来就是不足够的。 **想象厨师准备的饭菜食材不足，解释 in 表否定，adequate 表足够，合起来就是不足够的**

> A young artist was criticized for inadequately preparing for an important exhibition. He had rushed through his works and didn\'t pay attention to details. This made him realize he needed to put in more effort and be more thorough next time. **一位年轻的艺术家因准备重要展览不充分而受到批评。他匆忙完成作品，不注重细节。这使他意识到下次需要投入更多努力，做得更周全。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the park and knocked over a flower pot inadvertently. He didn\'t mean to do it and felt very sorry. This shows that \'inadvertent\' means something done by accident or without intention. **一天，汤姆在公园散步，无意中碰倒了一个花盆。他并非有意这么做，感到非常抱歉。这表明'inadvertent'指的是意外地或无意地做某事。**

> One day, Tom was walking and thinking about his upcoming vacation. He inadvertently stepped on a flower bed because he was too lost in his thoughts. He realized his mistake immediately. **一天，汤姆正在走路并想着即将到来的假期。他不经意间踩到了花坛，因为他想得太入神了。他马上意识到了自己的错误。**

> In a magical forest, there was a strange cave. All the objects inside were inanimate. No living creatures, just still rocks and silent tools. It made the cave seem mysterious and lifeless. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一个奇怪的洞穴。里面所有的物体都是无生命的。没有生物，只有静止的岩石和沉默的工具。这让洞穴显得神秘而毫无生机。**
> 有一天，小明在图书馆大声喧哗，管理员告诉他这种行为是 inappropriate 的。因为图书馆是安静学习的地方，大声喧哗不合适。小明意识到了自己的错误。 **有一天，小明在图书馆大声喧哗，管理员告诉他这种行为是不合适的。因为图书馆是安静学习的地方，大声喧哗不合适。小明意识到了自己的错误。**

> One day, Tom dressed inappropriately for a formal party. He wore jeans and a T-shirt. Everyone was surprised. He realized his mistake and promised not to do it again. **有一天，汤姆参加正式派对时穿着不得体。他穿了牛仔裤和 T 恤。大家都很惊讶。他意识到自己的错误，并保证不再这样做。**

> In a magical forest, a fairy was as helpful as she could be. Inasmuch as she used her magic to solve problems, the forest was always peaceful. One day, a little elf understood that \'inasmuch\' meant to the extent that or because. **在一个神奇的森林里，一个仙女尽可能地提供帮助。因为她用魔法解决问题，森林总是很平静。有一天，一个小精灵明白了'inasmuch'意思是在某种程度上或因为。**

> A student was constantly scolded by the teacher for inattention in class. One day, while daydreaming, he missed an important exam question. From then on, he decided to focus and avoid inattention. **一名学生因在课堂上总是注意力不集中而被老师训斥。有一天，他在做白日梦时错过了一道重要的考题。从此，他决定集中注意力，不再注意力不集中。**

> A thief tried to sneak into a house quietly, but his footsteps were inaudible. The owner didn\'t hear a thing and was still sleeping peacefully. It means too quiet to be heard. **一个小偷试图悄悄地潜入一所房子，但他的脚步声听不见。主人什么也没听到，还在安静地睡着。这个词意思是听不见的。**

> The president\'s inaugural speech was highly anticipated. A young journalist named Lily was assigned to cover it. She was nervous but excited, knowing this was a crucial moment. \'Inaugural\' means marking the beginning of an important event. **总统的就职演说备受期待。一位名叫莉莉的年轻记者被派去报道。她既紧张又兴奋，知道这是一个关键的时刻。\'inaugural\'意思是标志着一个重要事件的开始。**
