> One day, a little monkey was very happy. It kept jumping around in the forest. It jumped from tree to tree, showing its excitement. The little monkey\'s jumping made the forest lively. **一天，一只小猴子非常高兴。它一直在森林里跳来跳去。它从一棵树跳到另一棵树，展现着它的兴奋。小猴子的跳跃让森林充满了生机。**

> A car was lost at a junction. It had to decide which way to go. Finally, it chose the right path and reached its destination. The junction was like a crossroad of choices. **一辆汽车在一个交叉路口迷路了。它必须决定走哪条路。最后，它选择了正确的道路并到达了目的地。这个交叉路口就像是选择的十字路口。**

> At a critical juncture in the race, the athlete tripped but quickly got up and continued. It was a decisive moment that determined the outcome. The word \'juncture\' means a particular point in time or a critical situation. **在比赛的关键时刻，运动员绊倒了，但很快站起来继续。这是一个决定结果的决定性时刻。单词'juncture'意思是特定的时间点或关键时刻。**

> A brave explorer got lost in the jungle. There were tall trees everywhere, and wild animals lurking. But he didn\'t panic. He followed a river and finally found his way out. The jungle was a big challenge but also an adventure. **一位勇敢的探险家在丛林中迷路了。到处都是高大的树木，还有野生动物潜伏。但他没有惊慌。他沿着一条河走，最终找到了出路。丛林是一个巨大的挑战，但也是一次冒险。**

> There was a junior student named Tom. He was always eager to learn and prove himself. One day, he got a chance to show his skills and everyone was impressed. \'Junior\' means younger or lower in rank. **有个叫汤姆的低年级学生。他总是渴望学习和证明自己。有一天，他得到了一个展示技能的机会，大家都对他印象深刻。\'junior\'意思是较年幼的或地位较低的。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was lost in a forest. A friendly fairy appeared and led him to a juniper tree. The tree\'s unique smell and beautiful berries helped him find his way home. Remember, juniper means a type of evergreen tree or shrub. **从前，有个小男孩在森林里迷路了。一位友好的仙女出现，把他带到了一棵杜松树前。这棵树独特的气味和美丽的浆果帮助他找到了回家的路。记住，juniper 意思是杜松这种常青树或灌木。**

> One day, Tom found a box full of junk in the attic. There were old toys, broken clocks, and useless stuff. He realized junk means things that are no longer useful or valuable. **一天，汤姆在阁楼发现了一个装满废品的盒子。里面有旧玩具、坏了的钟表和没用的东西。他明白了 junk 指的是不再有用或有价值的东西。**

> A man was always seeking pleasure by taking drugs. People called him a junkie. One day, he decided to change and get rid of this bad habit. Finally, he succeeded and lived a healthy life. **一个男人总是通过吸毒来寻求快乐，人们称他为瘾君子。有一天，他决定改变并摆脱这个坏习惯。最终，他成功了，过上了健康的生活。**

> One day, Tom got lost and ended up in a junkyard. There were old cars, broken machines, and all kinds of junk everywhere. It was a messy and chaotic place. Tom had a hard time finding his way out. **一天，汤姆迷路了，最后来到了一个废品场。那里到处都是旧汽车、坏机器和各种各样的废品。这是一个杂乱无章的地方。汤姆很难找到出去的路。**
> 想象在一个古老的小镇，有一群人秘密地聚集在一起，他们组成了一个名为\'junta\'的团体，试图掌控小镇的一切。他们的行为神秘而令人不安。 **想象在一个古老的小镇，有一群人秘密聚集组成的团体，叫"军政府；执政团"，他们的行为神秘且令人不安。**

> A brave detective was investigating a crime. But he needed to know the jurisdiction to proceed. Finally, he found out and solved the case. Jurisdiction means the power or authority to make legal decisions. **一位勇敢的侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。但他需要知道司法管辖权才能继续。最后，他弄清楚并破了案。Jurisdiction 意思是司法权；管辖权；审判权。**

> A young lawyer was passionate about jurisprudence. He spent days studying cases to understand the principles and rules. One day, he successfully applied his knowledge and won a difficult case, making him believe in the power of jurisprudence. **一位年轻的律师对法学充满热情。他花了很多天研究案例以理解其原则和规则。有一天，他成功运用所学知识赢得了一个棘手的案子，让他坚信了法学的力量。**

> Once upon a time, a wise man named John was known as a jurist. He spent his days studying laws and giving fair judgments. People trusted him because of his deep knowledge and justice. He was like a guiding star in the legal world. **从前，有个叫约翰的智者被称为法学家。他整天研究法律并作出公正的判决。人们信任他，因为他知识渊博且公正。他就像法律世界里的一颗启明星。**

> A juror was chosen to decide a big case. The juror was very nervous but determined to be fair. He listened carefully to all the evidence and finally made a wise decision. **一位陪审员被选中来裁决一个重大案件。这位陪审员非常紧张，但决心做到公平。他仔细聆听了所有的证据，最终做出了明智的决定。**

> A group of people were lost in a forest. They needed to decide which way to go. So they formed a jury to make the choice. Finally, they found the right path. The jury here means a group making a decision. **一群人在森林里迷路了。他们需要决定走哪条路。于是他们组成了一个陪审团来做选择。最后，他们找到了正确的路。这里的jury意思是做决定的一组人。**

> A judge was about to make a wrong decision. Just in time, a wise man provided evidence and the judge made a fair judgment. \'Just\' here means exactly at the right moment or fair and reasonable. **一位法官即将做出错误的裁决。就在关键时刻，一位智者提供了证据，法官做出了公正的判决。'Just'在这里表示恰好、正当时或者公平合理的。**

> A brave knight fought against injustice. He saved the villagers who were wrongly accused. His actions showed the true meaning of justice - fairness and righteousness. With justice, everyone got what they deserved. **一位勇敢的骑士与不公正作斗争。他拯救了被冤枉的村民。他的行为展现了正义的真正含义------公平和公正。有了正义，每个人都得到了应得的。**

> A thief was caught stealing food. But it turned out he was starving and had no other choice. His action was justifiable as it was for survival. Remember, \'justifiable\' means capable of being justified or defended. **一个小偷被抓到偷食物。但原来他正在挨饿且别无选择。他的行为是情有可原的，因为是为了生存。记住，\'justifiable\'意思是有理由的；可辩解的；情有可原的。**

> A thief was caught, but he tried to give a justification for his stealing. He said he was poor and needed money for his sick mother. However, no excuse could justify his crime. **一个小偷被抓住了，但他试图为他的偷窃行为找理由。他说他很穷，需要钱给他生病的母亲。然而，没有任何借口能证明他的罪行是正当的。**

> A criminal was trying to justify his crime, saying he had no choice. But the judge firmly said, \'No excuse can justify your wrongdoings!\' Remember, justify means to give a good reason for something. **一个罪犯试图为他的罪行辩解，说他别无选择。但法官坚决地说：'没有任何借口能为你的恶行开脱！'记住，justify 意思是为某事给出合理的理由。**

> A brave knight always acted justly. He distributed rewards and punishments fairly. When a poor farmer was wrongly accused, the knight justly defended him. This way, everyone knew justice was served. **一位勇敢的骑士总是公正地行事。他公平地分配奖励和惩罚。当一个贫穷的农民被错误地指控时，骑士公正地为他辩护。这样，每个人都知道正义得到了伸张。**

> A little boy was standing on the edge of a cliff. His nose jut out bravely as he looked down. He wanted to show he wasn\'t afraid. \'Jut\' means to stick out or project. **一个小男孩站在悬崖边。他勇敢地把鼻子伸出去往下看。他想表明自己不害怕。'jut'意思是伸出或突出。**

> A little boy was caught stealing candy. When the police came, they said, \'Don\'t do such juvenile things.\' It means behaving like a young and immature person. **一个小男孩偷糖果被抓了。警察来的时候说：'别做这种幼稚的事。' 这意味着像年轻不成熟的人那样行事。**

> A painter wanted to show the contrast of light and dark. So, he juxtaposed a bright sunflower next to a black crow. By placing them side by side, he made the differences stand out. Juxtapose means to place side by side for comparison. **一位画家想要展现光明与黑暗的对比。于是，他把一朵明亮的向日葵和一只黑色的乌鸦并置在一起。通过将它们并排摆放，他使差异凸显出来。juxtapose 意思是把...并列，把...并置，以作比较**

> A king and a peasant were placed side by side for a portrait. This act of putting them close together, showing their differences clearly, is like a \'juxtaposition\'. **一位国王和一个农民被并排放在一起画肖像。这种把他们放在一起，清晰地展现出他们差异的行为，就像是'并置，并列'。**

> A little rabbit was lost in a big garden. It was very hungry and found a strange green vegetable, which was kale. The rabbit ate it and felt full and happy. **一只小兔子在一个大花园里迷路了。它非常饿，然后发现了一种奇怪的绿色蔬菜，这就是羽衣甘蓝。小兔子吃了它，感觉饱饱的，很开心。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a kangaroo appeared and hopped towards him. The boy was scared at first, but then the kind kangaroo carried him back home. Remember, kangaroo, the friendly jumper! **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。突然，一只袋鼠出现并朝他跳过来。男孩起初很害怕，但随后这只善良的袋鼠把他驮回了家。记住，kangaroo，友好的跳跃者！**

> One day, a brave boy named Tom was walking in the street. Suddenly, a group of bad guys appeared and wanted to bully him. But Tom was not afraid. He used his karate skills and defeated the bad guys easily. Everyone cheered for him. **一天，一个叫汤姆的勇敢男孩正在街上走。突然，一群坏人出现想欺负他。但汤姆并不害怕。他用他的空手道技能轻松打败了坏人。大家都为他欢呼。**

> A man was always mean and selfish. But one day, he had an accident. People said it was his karma. Because bad actions lead to bad results. Karma means the sum of a person\'s actions in this and previous states of existence, influencing their future. **一个男人总是刻薄又自私。但有一天，他遭遇了一场事故。人们说这是他的业力。因为坏的行为导致坏的结果。karma 指的是一个人今生和前世的行为总和，会影响其未来。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he found a kayak by the river. He used the kayak to go down the river and finally reached safety. The kayak became his savior. **一位勇敢的冒险家在森林中迷路了。突然，他在河边发现了一艘皮艇。他用皮艇顺流而下，最终到达了安全地带。皮艇成了他的救星。**

> A pirate ship was sailing on the rough sea. But it didn\'t capsize because of its strong keel. The keel, like a hidden hero, kept the ship stable and upright. Remember, the keel is the backbone of a ship! **一艘海盗船在波涛汹涌的海面上航行。但它没有倾覆，因为它有坚固的龙骨。龙骨就像一个隐藏的英雄，保持着船的稳定和直立。记住，龙骨是船的脊梁！**

> A keen adventurer was always eager to explore new places. One day, he climbed a high mountain with a sharp mind and strong determination. His keen eyes saw the beautiful view at the top. Keen means having a strong interest or enthusiasm. **一位热衷的冒险家总是渴望探索新的地方。有一天，他凭借敏锐的头脑和坚定的决心爬上了一座高山。他敏锐的眼睛看到了山顶的美丽景色。Keen 意思是有强烈的兴趣或热情。**

> A detective was observing the crime scene keenly. He noticed every tiny detail, like a footprint and a broken hairpin. His sharp and intense observation helped solve the mystery. **一位侦探敏锐地观察着犯罪现场。他注意到每一个微小的细节，比如一个脚印和一个断了的发夹。他敏锐而强烈的观察帮助解开了谜团。**

> One day, a little monkey found a beautiful box and decided to keep it. He protected it carefully from others. Finally, he kept the box as his precious treasure. **有一天，一只小猴子发现了一个漂亮的盒子并决定保留它。他小心翼翼地保护它不被别人拿走。最终，他把这个盒子留存下来作为他珍贵的宝贝。**

> A zoo keeper was very tired after a long day. But when a little monkey got lost, the keeper found it and brought it back safely. The keeper\'s job is to take care and protect the animals. **一位动物园管理员在漫长的一天后非常疲惫。但是当一只小猴子走失时，管理员找到了它并将其安全带回。管理员的工作就是照顾和保护动物。**

> One day, a little monkey was responsible for keeping the bananas safe. It was a hard task, but it did it carefully. Keeping means to have or retain something. **一天，一只小猴子负责保管香蕉的安全。这是一项艰巨的任务，但它做得很仔细。keeping 意思是拥有或保留某物。**

> A poor little puppy was lost and found itself in a strange kennel. It was scared at first but then felt a bit safe. The kennel became its temporary home. **一只可怜的小狗迷路了，发现自己在一个陌生的狗舍里。一开始它很害怕，但后来觉得有点安全。这个狗舍成了它暂时的家。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个果园，看到一颗巨大的果树。在这颗果树上，有一个小小的核心部分，它是整个果实美味的关键，这就是'kernel'，就像果核是果实的核心一样。 **想象你走进果园，看到果树的核心部分即果核，来记住'kernel'这个单词，表示核心、要点、内核。**

> A traveler was lost in the desert. His lamp was running out of kerosene. Just when he was desperate, he found an abandoned hut with a can of kerosene, which saved his life. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。他的灯快没煤油（kerosene）了。就在他绝望的时候，他发现了一个废弃的小屋，里面有一罐煤油，这救了他的命。**
> 有个小朋友去餐厅吃饭，他特别喜欢把红色的番茄酱（ketchup）涂在薯条上。每次他都会说：'Ketchup 让薯条变得更美味啦！'久而久之，他就记住了这个单词。 **有个小朋友在餐厅通过涂番茄酱记住 ketchup 这个单词的故事**

> One day, I was very thirsty. I went to the kitchen and found a kettle. I boiled water in it to make a cup of tea. The kettle whistled loudly when the water was ready. It was so useful! **有一天，我非常口渴。我去厨房，发现了一个水壶。我用它烧水煮了一杯茶。当水烧开时，水壶大声地鸣叫起来。它太有用了！**

> One day, a little boy lost his key to the treasure box. He searched everywhere and was very worried. Finally, he found it under the bed. The key opened the box and brought him joy. **一天，一个小男孩弄丢了他宝箱的钥匙。他到处找，非常着急。最后，他在床底下找到了。这把钥匙打开了箱子，给他带来了快乐。**

> One day, a little monkey found a magic \'keyboard\' in the forest. When he touched the keys, beautiful music came out. He was so happy and realized this keyboard could bring joy and surprise. **有一天，一只小猴子在森林里发现了一个神奇的"键盘"。当它触摸按键时，美妙的音乐就出来了。它非常高兴，意识到这个键盘能带来快乐和惊喜。**
> 在一场重要的音乐会上，指挥家强调了一个特别的音符，称其为 keynote。这个音符就像一把钥匙，开启了整个美妙旋律的大门。大家记住这个关键音符，也就理解了音乐会的核心。 **在一场音乐会上，指挥家强调的特别音符被称为 keynote，像钥匙一样开启美妙旋律，借此记住这个单词表示关键、主旨。**

> Imagine a spy who needs to enter a secret code. The only way to do it is through a special keypad. It has numbers and symbols, and the spy must press the right keys quickly to gain access. **想象一个间谍需要输入一个秘密代码。唯一的办法就是通过一个特殊的小键盘。它有数字和符号，间谍必须快速按下正确的键才能进入。**

> A detective was searching for the keyword to solve a mysterious case. He spent days and nights looking through clues until he finally found the key word that unlocked the truth. **一位侦探正在寻找解开一个神秘案件的关键词。他日夜寻找线索，直到最终找到了那个揭开真相的关键词。**

> A soldier was on a mission in the desert. The sun was scorching, and his uniform was khaki. It helped him blend in with the sandy terrain. Thanks to the khaki color, he remained hidden from the enemy. **一名士兵在沙漠执行任务。太阳炽热，他的制服是卡其色的。这帮助他与沙地地形融为一体。多亏了卡其色，他得以躲避敌人。**

> One day, a football player was very angry during the game. He gave a powerful kick to the ball and scored a goal. The kick was so strong that everyone was amazed. **有一天，一名足球运动员在比赛中非常生气。他用力踢了球，进了一个球。这一踢非常有力，所有人都很惊讶。**

> A corrupt official expected a kickback from a contractor. But he was caught and punished. Remember, kickback means an illegal payment or bribe. **一位腐败官员期望从承包商那里得到回扣。但他被抓住并受到了惩罚。记住，kickback 意思是非法的酬金或贿赂。**

> There was a football game. The kicker was very nervous. But at the last moment, he made a powerful kick and won the game for the team. The kicker became a hero. **有一场足球比赛。这位踢球者非常紧张。但在最后一刻，他用力一踢，为球队赢得了比赛。这位踢球者成为了英雄。**

> A football game was about to start. The referee blew the whistle and made a powerful kickoff. The ball flew high and the teams rushed to chase it. This was the exciting kickoff of the match. **一场足球比赛即将开始。裁判吹响哨子，用力开球。球高高飞起，两队队员都冲过去追逐。这就是比赛令人兴奋的开球时刻。**

> One day, a little boy named Tom was playing in the park. His friends called him a \'kid\' because he was young and full of energy. Tom loved being called a kid and had a great time playing. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的小男孩在公园里玩耍。他的朋友们称他为"kid（小孩）"，因为他年纪小且充满活力。汤姆喜欢被叫做小孩，并玩得很开心。**

> One day, a bad guy saw a little kid playing alone. He had a bad idea and decided to kidnap the kid for money. But the police were smart and caught him quickly. Remember, \'kidnap\' means to take someone away illegally by force. **有一天，一个坏人看到一个小孩独自玩耍。他有了个坏主意，决定绑架这个小孩来要钱。但警察很聪明，很快就抓住了他。记住，'kidnap'意思是用暴力非法带走某人。**

> One night, a bad guy sneaked into a house. He grabbed a child and tried to run away. This evil person was a kidnapper. The police came quickly and caught him. **一天晚上，一个坏人潜入一所房子。他抓住一个孩子并试图逃跑。这个邪恶的人就是绑匪。警察很快赶来并抓住了他。**

> One night, a bad man was lurking in the dark. He saw a little girl and planned a kidnapping. He grabbed her and ran away. But the police were smart and caught him. Remember, kidnapping is a very bad crime! **一天晚上，一个坏人潜伏在黑暗中。他看到一个小女孩并计划了一起绑架。他抓住她跑了。但警察很聪明，抓住了他。记住，绑架是非常严重的罪行！**

> A little kid was very curious about the human body. One day, the doctor showed him a picture of a kidney and explained that it was like a special filter to clean our blood. The kid remembered it well. **一个小孩对人体很好奇。有一天，医生给他展示了一张肾脏的图片，并解释说它就像一个特殊的过滤器来清洁我们的血液。这个小孩记得很清楚。**

> One day, a fierce lion was chasing a little rabbit. The lion wanted to kill the rabbit for food. But at the last moment, the rabbit found a hole and hid safely. \'Kill\' here means to cause someone or something to die. **有一天，一只凶猛的狮子在追一只小兔子。狮子想要杀死兔子作为食物。但在最后一刻，兔子找到了一个洞并安全地躲了起来。\'Kill\'在这里的意思是致使某人或某物死亡。**

> A detective was hunting a mysterious killer. The killer was very smart and always left no clues. But the detective didn\'t give up. Finally, he found a key evidence and caught the killer. **一位侦探正在追捕一个神秘的杀手。这个杀手非常聪明，总是不留下任何线索。但侦探没有放弃。最终，他找到了关键证据并抓住了杀手。**

> A detective was on a mission to solve a mysterious killing. The victim was found in a dark alley. The detective had to find the culprit. It was a challenging case, but he was determined to solve this killing. **一位侦探正在执行一项任务，去侦破一起神秘的杀人案。受害者被发现于一条黑暗的小巷。侦探必须找出凶手。这是一个具有挑战性的案子，但他决心侦破这起杀人案。**

> A poor potter worked hard in his small workshop. The key to his success was the kiln. Every day, he carefully fired the clay in the kiln to create beautiful pottery. The kiln was like a magic box, transforming ordinary clay into wonderful works of art. **一个贫穷的陶工在他的小作坊里努力工作。他成功的关键是窑。每天，他都小心翼翼地在窑里烧制黏土，以创造出美丽的陶器。窑就像一个魔法盒子，将普通的黏土变成了精美的艺术品。**

> A girl named Lily traveled to Japan. One day, she went to a traditional store and saw a beautiful kimono. She was amazed by its elegance and decided to buy it as a souvenir. **一个叫莉莉的女孩去日本旅行。有一天，她去了一家传统商店，看到了一件漂亮的和服。她被它的优雅所惊艳，决定买下来作为纪念品。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost. She met a kind man who helped her find her kin. They were her family members. The girl was so happy to be reunited with her kin. **从前，有个小女孩迷路了。她遇到一个善良的男人，帮她找到了她的亲属。他们是她的家人。小女孩非常高兴能与她的亲属重聚。**

> One day, a little girl got lost. A kind man saw her crying and helped her find her way home. The girl was very grateful and said, \'You are so kind!\' **一天，一个小女孩迷路了。一位善良的男士看到她在哭，就帮助她找到了回家的路。小女孩非常感激，并说道：'您真是太善良了！'**

> One day, a foreigner was trying to describe something. He said, \'It\'s kinda nice.\' And his friend asked, \'What do you mean by kinda?\' He explained, \'Kinda means sort of or somewhat.\' **一天，一个外国人试图描述某事。他说：'这有点好。'他的朋友问：'你说 kinda 是什么意思？'他解释道：'kinda 意思是有点儿或者有几分。'**

> A little girl was very scared on her first day at kindergarten. But the kind teacher and friendly classmates made her feel happy. Now she loves kindergarten. It\'s a place full of kindness and fun. **一个小女孩第一天去幼儿园时非常害怕。但是和蔼的老师和友好的同学们让她感到开心。现在她喜欢幼儿园了。这是一个充满友善和乐趣的地方。**

> A poor boy had only a few old books. But when he saw a spark in the dark, it kindled his love for reading. The spark was like a magic key that unlocked his imagination. Now he knew the meaning of kindle - to light or arouse. **一个贫穷的男孩只有几本旧书。但当他在黑暗中看到一丝火花时，这激起了他对阅读的热爱。这火花就像一把神奇的钥匙，开启了他的想象。现在他知道了 kindle 这个词------点燃、激起的意思。**

> One day, a little girl got lost. A kindly old man helped her find her way home. His kind and friendly behavior made the girl feel safe and happy. Kindly here means in a kind and friendly way. **一天，一个小女孩迷路了。一位和蔼的老人帮她找到了回家的路。他友善的行为让小女孩感到安全和开心。这里的 kindly 意思是以友善亲切的方式。**

> One day, when I was lost and sad, a stranger showed me kindness. She helped me find my way home and gave me a warm smile. Her act of kindness made my day and I\'ll never forget it. **有一天，当我迷路且伤心时，一个陌生人向我展现了善意。她帮我找到了回家的路，并给了我一个温暖的微笑。她的善意之举让我开心了一整天，我永远不会忘记。**

> In a faraway village, there was a big family. They shared love and care, always helping each other. This family was kindred, meaning they were related by blood and had a deep connection. **在一个遥远的村庄，有一个大家庭。他们相互关爱，总是互相帮助。这个家庭是亲属关系的，意味着他们有血缘关系并且联系紧密。**

> A boy was playing with a kinetic toy car. The car moved fast and smoothly, showing its powerful kinetic energy. This made the boy understand that \'kinetic\' means related to movement and energy. **一个男孩正在玩一辆动能玩具车。这辆车快速且平稳地移动，展示出强大的动能。这让男孩明白了'kinetic'意味着与运动和能量有关。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there was a powerful man named King Arthur. He ruled the kingdom with wisdom and kindness. Everyone respected and obeyed him because he made the land prosperous and peaceful. **从前，在一个遥远的国度，有一个强大的人叫亚瑟王。他以智慧和仁慈统治着这个王国。每个人都尊敬和服从他，因为他让这片土地繁荣和平。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there was a powerful king. He ruled over a vast territory, and this territory was called the \'kingdom\'. Everyone in the kingdom respected and obeyed the king. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，有一位强大的国王。他统治着一片广阔的领土，这片领土被称为"王国"。王国里的每个人都尊敬和服从国王。**

> A little monkey was playing in the forest and got its tail kinked by a branch. It struggled to straighten it out. Remember, \'kink\' means a bend or twist in something. **一只小猴子在森林里玩耍，它的尾巴被一根树枝弄弯了。它努力把尾巴弄直。记住，\'kink\'意思是某物的弯曲或扭曲。**

> A young man was lost in a big city. Feeling lonely, he suddenly remembered the kinship back home. His parents and siblings always supported him. Kinship means the relationship among family members. **一个年轻人在大城市里迷路了。感到孤独时，他突然想起了家乡的亲情。他的父母和兄弟姐妹总是支持着他。kinship 意思是家庭成员之间的关系。**
> 想象一下，你在一个繁忙的街头迷路了，又渴又累。这时，你看到一个小小的 kiosk，里面有清凉的饮料和地图。这个 kiosk 就像救星一样，为你解决了难题。 **想象你在街头迷路又渴又累时看到一个像救星般的小售货亭，里面有饮料和地图。**

> A prince was lost in a forest. When he felt hopeless, a beautiful fairy appeared and gave him a kiss. Suddenly, the prince gained strength and found his way back. The kiss had magical power. **一位王子在森林中迷路了。当他感到绝望时，一位美丽的仙女出现并给了他一个吻。突然，王子获得了力量并找到了回去的路。这个吻有神奇的力量。**

> A little mouse was very excited because it found a kit full of treasures. There were shiny jewels and colorful candies. The mouse happily carried the kit home. **一只小老鼠非常兴奋，因为它发现了一个装满宝藏的工具包。里面有闪闪发光的珠宝和五颜六色的糖果。老鼠高兴地把工具包搬回了家。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a big house. She wandered around and finally found a room full of delicious smells. It was the kitchen, with shiny pots and pans. There was a big oven and a fridge full of food. **有一天，一个小女孩在一座大房子里迷路了。她四处徘徊，最后发现了一个充满美味香气的房间。这是厨房，有着闪亮的锅碗瓢盆。有一个大烤箱和装满食物的冰箱。**

> One sunny day, Tom saw a colorful kite flying high in the sky. It danced and twirled freely. Tom was so amazed and decided to make his own kite to enjoy the fun. Now when he sees \'kite\', he remembers that wonderful moment. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆看到一只色彩斑斓的风筝在天空高高飞翔。它自由地舞动和旋转。汤姆非常惊讶，并决定自己制作一个风筝来享受这份乐趣。现在当他看到\'kite\'这个单词，就会想起那个美妙的时刻。**

> A painter named Tom always created works that were overly sentimental and tacky. People called his art kitsch. One day, Tom realized and started to pursue true art. Now you know kitsch means cheap, vulgar, or sentimental art. **一位名叫汤姆的画家总是创作过度伤感和俗气的作品。人们称他的艺术为媚俗。有一天，汤姆意识到了并开始追求真正的艺术。现在你知道 kitsch 指的是廉价、庸俗或伤感的艺术。**

> One day, a little girl saw a cute kitten playing with a ball of yarn. The kitten was so tiny and fluffy. It meowed softly as if saying hello. The girl was charmed by the lovely kitten. **有一天，一个小女孩看到一只可爱的小猫正在玩一团毛线球。这只小猫非常小而且毛茸茸的。它轻轻地喵喵叫，好像在打招呼。小女孩被这只可爱的小猫迷住了。**

> There was a young man named Tom. He had a knack for finding lost keys. One day, in a crowded park, he quickly spotted a keychain under a bench. Everyone was amazed by his special ability. **有个叫汤姆的年轻人。他有找到丢失钥匙的诀窍。有一天，在一个拥挤的公园，他很快就在长椅下发现了一个钥匙链。大家都对他的特殊能力感到惊讶。**

> One day, Tom went hiking. He carried a knapsack filled with food and water. But the knapsack was so heavy that he had a hard time. Finally, he reached the top and enjoyed the beautiful view, knowing the knapsack was worth it. **一天，汤姆去远足。他背着一个装满食物和水的背包。但这个背包太重了，让他很吃力。最后，他到达了山顶，欣赏到了美丽的景色，知道这个背包是值得的。**

> A baker was kneading the dough with great effort. He pushed and pulled, shaping it into a perfect loaf. Remember, when you see \'knead\', think of the baker\'s hard work to make the dough nice and smooth. **一位面包师正在费力地揉面团。他推来拉去，将其塑造成一个完美的面包。记住，当你看到"knead"这个词时，就想想面包师为了让面团又好又光滑而付出的努力。**

> One day, when I was playing football, I accidentally fell and hurt my knee. It was very painful. But after a period of rest and treatment, my knee recovered. Remember, knee is the part of our body that bends in the middle of our leg. **有一天，我踢足球时不小心摔倒伤到了膝盖。非常疼。但经过一段时间的休息和治疗，我的膝盖恢复了。记住，knee 就是我们腿中间弯曲的那个部位。**

> A brave knight was in a dangerous battle. When facing the powerful enemy, he chose to kneel and pray for strength and protection. Finally, he won the battle with the help of his faith. **一位勇敢的骑士在一场危险的战斗中。当面对强大的敌人时，他选择跪下祈祷以获得力量和保护。最终，他在信念的帮助下赢得了战斗。**

> One day, a thief broke into a house. The owner woke up and grabbed a knife to defend himself. The shiny knife scared the thief away. Remember, \'knife\' is the tool that protected the owner. **有一天，一个小偷闯进了一所房子。主人醒了并抓起一把刀来自卫。闪闪发亮的刀把小偷吓跑了。记住，\'knife\'就是保护主人的那个工具。**

> Once upon a time, a brave warrior named Jack was fighting in a battle. He showed great courage and was later honored as a knight. With his shiny armor and a powerful sword, Knight Jack protected the kingdom and became a hero. **从前，有个勇敢的战士叫杰克，他在一场战斗中表现出极大的勇气，后来被授予骑士称号。骑士杰克身着闪亮的盔甲，手持强大的宝剑，保卫着王国，成为了英雄。**

> A little girl wanted to give her grandma a warm scarf. So she learned to knit. Day after day, with her careful knitting, a beautiful scarf was finally made. Knit means to make something by joining wool or thread together. **一个小女孩想给她的奶奶一条温暖的围巾。所以她学习编织。日复一日，通过她仔细的编织，一条漂亮的围巾终于织好了。knit 意思是通过把毛线或线连接在一起而制作某物。**

> One day, I saw my grandma sitting peacefully in the sunlight, doing knitting. She used colorful wool to create warm scarves. Knitting, like her magic, turned simple threads into beautiful works. **有一天，我看到奶奶安静地坐在阳光下织东西。她用五颜六色的毛线织出温暖的围巾。编织，就像她的魔法，把简单的线变成了美丽的作品。**

> One day, Tom was trying to open a mysterious door. But he couldn\'t until he noticed a knob on it. He turned the knob, and the door opened. The knob was the key to the unknown world. **一天，汤姆试图打开一扇神秘的门。但他一直打不开，直到他注意到门上有个球形把手。他转动把手，门开了。这个把手就是通往未知世界的钥匙。**

> One night, a thief tried to knock the door of a house. But the owner was awake and shouted loudly. The thief was scared and ran away. Remember, \'knock\' means hitting a surface to make a sound. **一天晚上，一个小偷试图敲门。但主人醒着并大声喊叫。小偷被吓到然后跑掉了。记住，'knock'意思是敲击表面发出声音。**

> One night, I was sleeping soundly when suddenly there was a loud knocking at the door. It woke me up and made my heart race. I wondered who could be knocking so late at night. **一天晚上，我正在熟睡，突然传来一阵响亮的敲门声。它把我吵醒了，让我的心跳加速。我想知道这么晚了谁会敲门。**

> In a boxing match, a powerful punch from the fighter knocked out his opponent. The opponent fell to the ground, unconscious. This is what \'knockout\' means - a sudden and decisive defeat. **在一场拳击比赛中，一位拳手的一记有力的拳将他的对手击倒在地。对手失去了意识倒下了。这就是'knockout'的意思------突然的、决定性的击败。**

> A little rabbit was hopping on a sunny day. It climbed up a knoll and saw a beautiful view. The grass was green and the flowers were blooming. The knoll was like a small stage for the rabbit to enjoy nature. **一只小兔子在一个阳光明媚的日子里蹦蹦跳跳。它爬上了一个小山丘，看到了美丽的景色。草是绿的，花在盛开。这个小山丘就像一个小舞台，让兔子享受大自然。**

> A sailor was tying ropes on the ship. He made many knots to secure the cargo. But one knot came loose and caused a problem. Remember, a knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of rope or string. **一位水手在船上系绳子。他打了很多结来固定货物。但有一个结松了，引发了问题。记住，knot 就是通过系一根绳子或线形成的紧固处。**

> Once upon a time, there was a rope that was all knotted. It took a lot of effort to untie it. The knotted rope made the task very difficult. Remember, \'knotted\' means having knots or being tied in knots. **从前，有一根全是结的绳子。解开它需要花费很大力气。这根打结的绳子让这个任务变得非常困难。记住，'knotted'意思是有结的或打成结的。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big forest. He didn\'t know which way to go. Just when he was very scared, a kind bird appeared and guided him out. From then on, the boy knew that asking for help was important. **有一天，一个小男孩在大森林里迷路了。他不知道该走哪条路。就在他非常害怕的时候，一只善良的鸟出现并引导他走了出去。从那以后，这个男孩知道了寻求帮助很重要。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. But he was knowing and remembered the way his father taught him to find the north star. With this knowledge, he finally found his way home safely. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。但他很机灵，记得父亲教他如何找到北极星。凭借这个知识，他最终安全地找到了回家的路。**

> A thief was caught stealing money. When asked, he admitted he did it knowingly. He knew it was wrong but still chose to do it. So, \'knowingly\' means doing something with full awareness. **一个小偷被抓到偷钱。当被询问时，他承认是故意这么做的。他知道这是错的，但还是选择去做。所以，'knowingly'意思是有意识地、故意地做某事。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big forest. But with his knowledge of directions and survival skills, he found his way home. Knowledge is like a guiding light in the darkness. **有一天，一个小男孩在大森林里迷路了。但凭借他对方向和生存技能的知识，他找到了回家的路。知识就像黑暗中的指路明灯。**

> One day, Tom met a very knowledgeable old man in the library. The old man knew everything about history, science and art. Tom was amazed and decided to become as knowledgeable as him by reading a lot of books. **一天，汤姆在图书馆遇到了一位知识渊博的老人。这位老人知晓历史、科学和艺术的一切。汤姆感到惊讶，并决定通过大量阅读书籍变得像他一样知识渊博。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a mysterious forest. But he was known for his excellent survival skills. Finally, he found his way out. People knew he would succeed because of his reputation. **一位勇敢的探险家在神秘森林中迷路了。但他以出色的生存技能而闻名。最终，他找到了出路。人们知道他会成功，因为他的名声。**

> A brave knight was fighting a dragon. The dragon bit his hand, but the knight hit the dragon\'s head with his knuckle. With great strength, he won the battle. Remember, a knuckle is the joint of a finger! **一位勇敢的骑士正在和一条龙战斗。龙咬了他的手，但骑士用指关节击打龙的头。凭借巨大的力量，他赢得了战斗。记住，指关节就是手指的关节！**

> One day, I went to a special restaurant. The waiter said all the food here was kosher. It means it follows strict Jewish dietary laws. So I knew the food was pure and proper. **有一天，我去了一家特别的餐厅。服务员说这里所有的食物都是符合犹太教饮食规定的。这意味着它遵循严格的犹太饮食律法。所以我知道这些食物是纯净和恰当的。**

> In a secret room of a big building, there was a special place called \'lab\'. Scientists in white coats were busy doing experiments there. They were trying to discover new things. The \'lab\' was full of strange tools and colorful liquids. **在一座大建筑的一个秘密房间里，有一个特殊的地方叫做'实验室'。穿着白大褂的科学家们在那里忙着做实验。他们试图发现新事物。这个'实验室'里摆满了奇怪的工具和五颜六色的液体。**

> One day, Tom found a mysterious box with no name. So, he decided to put a label on it saying \'Treasure Box\'. With this label, everyone knew what was inside. **一天，汤姆发现了一个没有名字的神秘盒子。于是，他决定在上面贴一个标签，写着'宝箱'。有了这个标签，大家都知道里面是什么了。**

> A hardworking ant was always in labor. It carried food, built its home, and never stopped. Just like us when we work hard, this is what \'labor\' means - hard work and effort. **一只勤劳的蚂蚁总是在劳作。它搬运食物、建造家园，从未停歇。就像我们努力工作时一样，这就是'labor'的意思------辛苦的工作和努力。**

> A scientist was working hard in the laboratory. He spent days and nights doing experiments, surrounded by test tubes and advanced equipment. His dedication led to a great discovery. **一位科学家在实验室里努力工作。他日夜不停地做实验，周围都是试管和先进的设备。他的专注促成了一项重大发现。**

> One day, a poor laborer named Tom was working hard on a construction site. He carried heavy bricks all day long, sweating and tired, but he kept going to earn a living for his family. **一天，一个叫汤姆的穷苦劳动者在建筑工地上努力工作。他一整天都搬运着重砖块，汗流浃背且疲惫不堪，但为了家人的生计他一直坚持着。**

> A little ant was carrying a huge leaf. The way was full of obstacles. It was a laborious task, but the ant didn\'t give up. Finally, it reached the nest. Remember, \'laborious\' means involving a lot of effort and hard work, just like the ant\'s journey. **一只小蚂蚁正驮着一片巨大的叶子。道路充满了障碍。这是一项艰巨的任务，但蚂蚁没有放弃。最后，它到达了巢穴。记住，\'laborious\'意思是费力的，艰苦的，就像蚂蚁的旅程。**

> A man was working hard in the factory every day, doing various tasks. This hard work was called labour. He sweated and was tired but persisted to earn a living. **一个男人每天在工厂努力工作，做着各种各样的任务。这种辛苦的工作就叫做劳动。他流汗且疲惫，但仍坚持以谋生。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a labyrinth. There were many confusing paths and dead ends. But with determination, he found the exit by remembering the pattern of the walls. The labyrinth was a tricky maze! **一位勇敢的探险家在一个迷宫里迷路了。里面有许多令人困惑的路径和死胡同。但凭借决心，他通过记住墙壁的图案找到了出口。这个迷宫真是个棘手的迷阵！**

> A princess was getting ready for a ball. She struggled to fasten the beautiful lace on her dress. But with patience, she finally made it and looked stunning. The lace added charm to her outfit. **一位公主正在为参加舞会做准备。她费力地系紧她裙子上漂亮的蕾丝。但凭借耐心，她最终成功了，看起来美极了。蕾丝为她的服装增添了魅力。**

> Once upon a time, a poor farmer always felt sad. Because his fields lacked good seeds and fertilizers. But later, with help, he got what he needed and had a bountiful harvest. **从前，有个贫穷的农民总是很伤心。因为他的田地缺乏好的种子和肥料。但后来，在帮助下，他得到了所需的东西，有了丰收。**

> A painter was known for his lackluster works. People didn\'t like them. But one day, he decided to change and used bright colors. His paintings became popular. Lackluster means dull or not shining. **一位画家以他暗淡无光的作品而闻名。人们不喜欢它们。但有一天，他决定改变，使用了明亮的色彩。他的画变得受欢迎。lackluster 意思是暗淡的、无光泽的。**

> A painter was working hard to apply lacquer on a beautiful wooden chair. The shiny lacquer made the chair look brand new. He was so proud of his work with this special coating. **一位画家正在努力给一把漂亮的木椅涂上漆。闪亮的漆让椅子焕然一新。他为自己用这种特殊的涂料所做的工作感到非常自豪。**
> 想象一下，在一个美丽的小镇上，有一群孩子在草地上欢快地玩着一种球类运动。他们手持长棍，追逐着球，这种运动就叫 lacrosse。球在棍间穿梭，孩子们尽情奔跑，享受着快乐时光。 **想象在小镇上孩子们玩长棍球（曲棍球）的场景来辅助记忆 lacrosse 这个单词**

> A little girl named Lily wore a lacy dress to the party. The lacy pattern on the dress was like a beautiful flower garden, making her look very charming. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩穿着一件带花边的裙子去参加聚会。裙子上的花边图案就像一个美丽的花园，让她看起来十分迷人。**

> A lad named Tom was always very active. One day, he climbed a tall tree to get a bird\'s egg but got stuck. His friends had to help him down. Remember, \'lad\' is a young boy. **一个叫汤姆的少年总是非常活跃。有一天，他爬上一棵大树去拿鸟蛋却被困住了。他的朋友们不得不把他弄下来。记住，'lad'就是年轻男孩的意思。**

> A brave firefighter was climbing a ladder to rescue a cat stuck on a roof. The ladder was his tool to reach the scared cat safely. With each step up the ladder, he got closer to the rescue. **一位勇敢的消防员正在爬梯子去救一只被困在屋顶的猫。梯子是他安全接近猫咪的工具。每爬上梯子一步，他就离救援更近一步。**
> 想象一辆大卡车，车上装满了沉重的货物，都快被压垮了。这些货物让卡车变得'laden'。'laden'就是形容像这辆卡车一样装满、负载沉重的样子。 **想象一辆装满沉重货物的卡车来理解'laden'这个词，意思是装满的、负载沉重的。**

> A poor boy was working in a kitchen. His main task was to use a ladle to serve soup. One day, he accidentally dropped the ladle and was very worried. But in the end, he found it and continued his work happily. **一个贫穷的男孩在厨房工作。他的主要任务是用长柄勺盛汤。有一天，他不小心把长柄勺弄掉了，非常担心。但最后，他找到了它，开心地继续工作。**

> A long time ago, in a big castle, there was a kind and beautiful woman. Everyone called her \'lady\'. She was always polite and helped others. She wore nice dresses and had a charming smile. **很久以前，在一座大城堡里，有一位善良美丽的女子。大家都称她为'女士'。她总是彬彬有礼，并帮助他人。她穿着漂亮的连衣裙，有着迷人的微笑。**
> 想象一只兔子和一只乌龟赛跑，兔子跑得很快，但它中途偷懒睡了一觉。乌龟一直坚持前进，兔子醒来发现乌龟已经领先了很多。兔子的速度在这里就'lag'了，最终乌龟赢得比赛。 **想象一只兔子和一只乌龟赛跑，兔子中途偷懒睡觉导致速度落后。这里的'lag'就是落后、滞后的意思，最终乌龟赢得比赛。**

> A man was lost in a desert and desperately needed water. Finally, he found a lagoon. It was like a hidden oasis, surrounded by palm trees and filled with clear, cool water. He was saved by this beautiful lagoon. **一个男人在沙漠中迷路了，极度需要水。最后，他发现了一个环礁湖。它就像一个隐藏的绿洲，周围环绕着棕榈树，里面充满了清澈、凉爽的水。他被这个美丽的环礁湖救了。**

> Once upon a time, in a small town, the laity were the ordinary people who were not part of the religious clergy. They lived their simple lives, working and having fun together. The laity were the heart of the community. **从前，在一个小镇上，laity 指的是那些不属于宗教神职人员的普通民众。他们过着简单的生活，一起工作和娱乐。laity 是这个社区的核心。**

> A little lamb was lost in the forest. It was very scared. But finally, a kind farmer found it and took it home. The lamb felt safe and happy. Remember, \'lamb\' is a young sheep. **一只小羊羔在森林里迷路了。它非常害怕。但最后，一位善良的农夫发现了它并把它带回了家。小羊羔感到安全又开心。记住，\'lamb\'就是小羊的意思。**
> 有一只小羊羔，它的腿受伤了，走起路来一瘸一拐的，大家都说它很 lame。后来经过治疗，小羊羔终于恢复正常，不再 lame 了。 **有一只小羊羔，它的腿受伤了，走起路来一瘸一拐的，大家都说它很瘸的。后来经过治疗，小羊羔终于恢复正常，不再瘸了。**

> A poet was deeply moved by the war. He saw the pain and loss, and composed a song to lament. The song expressed his sadness and longing for peace. People heard it and understood the meaning of lament. **一位诗人被战争深深触动。他目睹了痛苦和损失，创作了一首歌来哀悼。这首歌表达了他的悲伤以及对和平的渴望。人们听到后理解了lament的意思。**

> Imagine a carpenter working on a table. He carefully glues thin wooden sheets together to make a strong and smooth surface. This process of joining thin layers is like \'laminated\'. **想象一位木匠在制作一张桌子。他仔细地将薄木片胶合在一起，以形成坚固光滑的表面。这种将薄层连接在一起的过程就像'层压的；薄板状的'。**

> One dark night, I was lost in a forest. Suddenly, I saw a lamp shining in the distance. It was like a guiding star. I followed the light and finally found my way out. The lamp saved me! **一个漆黑的夜晚，我在森林里迷路了。突然，我看到远处有一盏灯在闪耀。它就像一颗指路星。我顺着灯光，最终找到了出路。这盏灯救了我！**

> A brave knight held a lance and charged towards the enemy. The lance was sharp and shiny, ready to strike. With one powerful thrust, the knight defeated the foes. Remember, lance is a long weapon used in battles. **一位勇敢的骑士手持长矛冲向敌人。长矛锋利且闪耀，准备出击。骑士猛地一刺，击败了敌人。记住，lance 是战斗中使用的长武器。**

> A brave adventurer was lost at sea. After many days, he finally saw land. He jumped for joy as it meant safety and a new beginning. Land was his hope and salvation. **一位勇敢的探险家在海上迷失了方向。许多天后，他终于看到了陆地。他高兴得跳了起来，因为陆地意味着安全和新的开始。陆地是他的希望和救赎。**

> A brave astronaut landed on a mysterious planet. After a long journey through space, he safely touched the ground. The moment he landed, he knew an amazing adventure was about to begin. **一位勇敢的宇航员在一个神秘的星球上着陆。经过漫长的太空之旅，他安全地触地。在他着陆的那一刻，他知道一场奇妙的冒险即将开始。**
> 想象一下，在遥远的星球上，有一个勇敢的探险家。他驾驶着特殊的飞船成功着陆，人们称他为\'lander\'。他的勇敢着陆为后续的探索开辟了道路。 **想象在星球上成功着陆的探险家被称为\'lander\'，他的着陆为探索开路**

> A brave sailor was on a long journey. After many days at sea, he finally saw land. The moment his ship touched the shore was the landfall. It was a moment of relief and joy for him. **一位勇敢的水手在进行漫长的旅程。在海上航行了许多天后，他终于看到了陆地。他的船触碰到岸边的那一刻就是landfall（着陆、登陆）。对他来说，这是一个解脱和喜悦的时刻。**

> A group of friends went to a landfill. They saw mountains of garbage. But one smart friend had an idea to recycle and make the landfill a clean place. Remember, landfill is a place for garbage. **一群朋友去了垃圾填埋场。他们看到堆积如山的垃圾。但一个聪明的朋友有了一个想法，要回收利用，把垃圾填埋场变成一个干净的地方。记住，landfill 就是垃圾填埋场。**

> A brave pilot was flying a plane. Due to bad weather, the landing was very difficult. But with his excellent skills, he finally made a safe landing on the runway. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在驾驶飞机。由于恶劣天气，着陆非常困难。但凭借他出色的技能，他最终在跑道上安全着陆。**

> A poor traveler was lost and tired. He knocked on a door and a kind woman opened it. She owned the house and was the landlady. She gave him a room and food. The traveler was grateful. **一个可怜的旅行者迷路又疲惫。他敲了一扇门，一位善良的女士开了门。她拥有这所房子，是女房东。她给了他一个房间和食物。旅行者很感激。**
> A man named Tom owned a big house and some land. He rented the rooms to others and collected money. So, Tom was a landlord. **一个叫汤姆的男人拥有一座大房子和一些土地。他把房间租给别人并收租金。所以，汤姆就是一个房东。**

> A traveler got lost in a strange place. But when he saw a big old tower, a landmark of the area, he knew he was on the right track. The tower guided him and made him find his way. **一位旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。但当他看到一座古老的大塔，这个地区的地标，他就知道自己走对路了。这座塔引导他并让他找到了方向。**

> Once upon a time, there was a rich man. He had a lot of land and was known as the landowner. People worked on his land and he collected rent. One day, he decided to build a big house on his land to show his wealth. **从前，有一个富人。他拥有很多土地，被称为地主。人们在他的土地上劳作，而他收取租金。有一天，他决定在他的土地上建一座大房子来彰显他的财富。**

> A traveler got lost in a strange place. When he climbed to the top of a mountain, he was amazed by the beautiful landscape. There were green fields, flowing rivers and distant mountains. This view made him forget his troubles. **一位旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。当他爬上山顶时，被美丽的风景所震撼。有绿色的田野、流淌的河流和远处的山峦。这景色让他忘却了烦恼。**

> A man loved nature and decided to start landscaping. He planted beautiful flowers, trimmed the grass, and placed rocks to create a charming garden. His hard work in landscaping made the place a paradise. **一个男人热爱大自然，决定开始搞景观美化。他种了美丽的花，修剪了草坪，放置了石头，打造出一个迷人的花园。他在景观美化方面的辛勤工作让这个地方变成了天堂。**

> A huge landslide occurred in a mountain village. The rocks and soil came crashing down like a wild beast. Many houses were buried. It was a terrifying scene. People had to run for their lives. **在一个山村发生了一场巨大的山体滑坡。岩石和泥土像野兽一样轰然崩塌。许多房屋被掩埋。这是一个可怕的场景。人们不得不逃命。**

> A little mouse was lost in a lane. It was narrow and full of twists and turns. But finally, with its perseverance, it found the exit. The lane became a memorable adventure for the mouse. **一只小老鼠在一条小巷里迷路了。它狭窄且充满曲折。但最终，凭借它的毅力，它找到了出口。这条小巷成为了老鼠难忘的一次冒险。**

> One day, a little alien landed on Earth. He was very confused because he couldn\'t understand the language people were speaking. But with patience and help, he finally learned and could communicate happily. **有一天，一个小外星人降落在地球上。他非常困惑，因为他听不懂人们说的语言。但在耐心和帮助下，他最终学会了并且能够愉快地交流。**

> A tired traveler was walking along a road in a hot summer day. His steps were slow and his movements were languid. He needed to find a place to rest and regain his energy. **在一个炎热的夏日，一位疲惫的旅行者沿着道路行走。他的步伐缓慢，动作无力，显得无精打采。他需要找个地方休息，恢复精力。**

> A beautiful flower was planted in a dark corner. Without sunlight and care, it began to languish. It lost its vitality and color, just like someone feeling weak and sad. **一朵美丽的花被种在黑暗的角落。由于没有阳光和照料，它开始变得憔悴。它失去了活力和颜色，就像某人感到虚弱和悲伤。**

> Once upon a time, there was a lanky giraffe. It had very long and thin legs. It could reach the highest leaves easily. People used \'lanky\' to describe its tall and thin figure. **从前，有一只瘦长的长颈鹿。它的腿又长又细。它能够轻松够到最高的树叶。人们用'lanky'来形容它又高又瘦的身形。**

> One night, I was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, I saw a bright lantern shining through the trees. It guided me out safely. The lantern was like a magical helper. Remember, lantern is the light in the darkness. **一天晚上，我在黑暗的森林里迷路了。突然，我看到一盏明亮的灯笼透过树林闪耀。它安全地引导我走了出来。灯笼就像一个神奇的帮手。记住，lantern 就是黑暗中的那盏明灯。**
> 想象一只可爱的小狗在你的腿上（lap）安静地趴着，它很享受这种温暖和舒适。你轻轻地抚摸着它，它闭着眼睛，就像在你的 lap 里找到了全世界最安心的角落。 **想象一只小狗趴在你的大腿上，以此来记住 lap 有大腿、膝部、一圈跑道等意思**

> A detective was chasing a thief. In the struggle, the thief\'s lapel of the coat got torn. The detective caught him by holding onto that damaged lapel. So, remember \'lapel\' as the part of a coat that can be crucial in a chase! **一位侦探正在追捕一个小偷。在争斗中，小偷外套的翻领被扯破了。侦探抓住他就是通过抓住那个破损的翻领。所以，记住\'lapel\'就是外套可能在追逐中起关键作用的那个部分！**

> A man was running a successful business. But due to his carelessness and inattentiveness, a lapse in judgment led him to make a wrong decision, causing his business to fail. \'Lapse\' here means a mistake or a failure. **一个男人经营着一家成功的企业。但由于他的粗心和疏忽，判断上的失误导致他做出了错误的决定，致使他的企业倒闭。这里的'lapse'意思是失误或过错。**

> One day, I was on a train and saw a man working efficiently on a portable computer. I asked what it was and he said, \'This is a laptop. It\'s like a small desk you can carry anywhere!\' **有一天，我在火车上看到一个人高效地在一台便携式电脑上工作。我问这是什么，他说：'这是一台笔记本电脑。它就像一个你可以随身携带的小桌子！'**
> A cook was making a cake. He needed to add lard to make it soft and tasty. But he accidentally spilled the lard all over the floor. What a mess! **一位厨师正在做蛋糕。他需要添加猪油以使蛋糕柔软可口。但他不小心把猪油洒了一地。真是一团糟！**

> A little mouse dreams of having a large piece of cheese. One day, it finds a huge cheese in a mysterious cave. The mouse is so happy because the cheese is really large. **一只小老鼠梦想拥有一大块奶酪。有一天，它在一个神秘的洞穴里发现了一块巨大的奶酪。老鼠非常高兴，因为这块奶酪真的很大。**

> A city\'s success is largely determined by its people\'s hard work. They build, innovate, and create. When we see the prosperous city, we know it\'s largely because of them. **一个城市的成功在很大程度上取决于其人民的辛勤工作。他们建设、创新和创造。当我们看到这个繁荣的城市，就知道这在很大程度上是因为他们。**

> One day, a little bird named Lark was singing happily in the sky. Its cheerful song made everyone smile. Lark flew freely, enjoying the beautiful view. Remember Lark, the happy and free little bird. **有一天，一只叫云雀的小鸟在天空中欢快地歌唱。它欢快的歌声让每个人都微笑。云雀自由地飞翔，享受着美丽的景色。记住云雀，这只快乐自由的小鸟。**

> Imagine a little bug in a forest. It\'s not a grown-up insect yet. This young form is called a larva. The larva crawls around, eating and growing, waiting to become a beautiful butterfly one day. **想象森林里有一只小虫子。它还不是成年的昆虫。这种幼小的形态就被称为幼虫。幼虫到处爬，吃吃长个，等待有一天变成美丽的蝴蝶。**

> A scientist was lost in a dark cave. Suddenly, a bright light like a magic wand appeared, guiding the way. It was a LASER! The scientist followed the laser and safely escaped. Remember, laser is like a magical guiding light. **一位科学家在黑暗的洞穴中迷路了。突然，一道像魔法棒一样的亮光出现，指引着道路。这就是激光！科学家跟着激光，安全地逃了出来。记住，激光就像神奇的引导之光。**

> A brave knight was riding his horse in a storm. The strong wind lashed at his face, but he held on tightly. Finally, he reached the castle safely. The lash of the wind made the journey difficult. **一位勇敢的骑士在暴风雨中骑马。强风猛烈地抽打在他脸上，但他紧紧抓着缰绳。最后，他安全抵达城堡。风的抽打让这趟旅程很艰难。**

> A brave knight was in a fierce battle. It seemed like it would never end, but at last, he emerged victorious. \'At last\' means finally or in the end. The knight\'s perseverance paid off at the conclusion of the fight. **一位勇敢的骑士正在进行一场激烈的战斗。这场战斗似乎永远不会结束，但最后，他取得了胜利。'at last'意思是最终或终于。骑士的坚持在战斗的结尾得到了回报。**

> A painter spent months creating a masterpiece. Years passed, and the painting remained beautiful and untouched. Its charm was lasting, just like a never-ending song. People always admired it. **一位画家花了数月创作了一幅杰作。多年过去了，这幅画依然美丽如初、完好无损。它的魅力是持久的，就像一首永不停息的歌。人们总是对它赞赏有加。**

> A group of friends were planning a trip. Firstly, they chose the destination. Secondly, they booked the tickets. Lastly, they packed their bags and set off happily. **一群朋友正在计划一次旅行。首先，他们选择了目的地。其次，他们订了票。最后，他们收拾好行李开心地出发了。**

> A little mouse was trying to find food in a barn. It saw a latch on a door. When it pushed the latch, the door opened and it happily entered. The latch was the key to get inside. **一只小老鼠在谷仓里找食物。它看到一扇门上有个门闩。当它推开门闩时，门开了，它高兴地进去了。门闩就是进去的关键。**
> 小明总是 late 上学。有一天，他又迟到了，老师很生气。小明保证以后不再 late ，早早起床。从那以后，小明再也没有因为晚到而被批评。 **小明总是上学迟到。有一天，他又迟到了，老师很生气。小明保证以后不再迟到，早早起床。从那以后，小明再也没有因为晚到而被批评。**

> Lately, a little bird was lost. It searched everywhere but couldn\'t find its way home. Finally, with the help of a kind girl, it returned safely. \'Lately\' means recently or in the recent past. **最近，一只小鸟迷路了。它到处寻找但都找不到回家的路。最后，在一个善良女孩的帮助下，它安全地回去了。'lately'意思是最近，近来。**
> 想象一个网络世界，数据像小信使在电线中奔跑。但有时小信使会在路上偷懒、磨蹭，这磨蹭的时间就是\'latency\'（延迟）。就好像你发消息给朋友，要等一会儿才能收到回复，这段等待的时间就是latency。 **想象网络中数据传输时的延迟情况来辅助记忆\'latency\'这个单词，意思是延迟**
> 想象有一个神秘的宝藏被埋在地下，一直未被发现。这个宝藏就处于 latent 状态，它有存在的潜力，但隐藏着等待被发掘。就像人的才能，有时未展现，却一直潜在着。 **想象有一个未被发现的神秘宝藏处于潜在状态，就像人的未展现的才能，以此来辅助记忆'latent（潜在的；潜伏的）'这个单词。**

> One day, Tom had a lot of work to do. He decided to relax first and said, \'I\'ll do it later.\' But as time passed, it became harder. Finally, he understood that \'later\' might mean trouble if not timely. **一天，汤姆有很多工作要做。他决定先放松一下并说，'我稍后做。'但随着时间流逝，事情变得更难了。最后，他明白'稍后'如果不及时可能意味着麻烦。**
> 想象一个人在走平衡木，他总是向侧面（lateral）移动来保持平衡。突然，一只小鸟从侧面飞过来，他差点失去平衡掉下去。记住这个场景，就能记住 lateral 表示侧面的、横向的意思。 **想象一个人在平衡木上向侧面移动，还有小鸟从侧面飞来的场景，来记住 lateral 表示侧面的、横向的意思。**
> 想象一下，一位科学家在实验室里忙碌到很晚（late），为了完成实验，他需要一种特殊的液体材料（X），于是就有了 latex 这种材料。 **想象一位科学家很晚还在实验室工作，需要特殊液体材料从而引出 latex 这个词**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. He had only a map showing the latitude lines to guide him. With determination, he followed them and finally found his way home. Remember, latitude helps us find our position! **一位勇敢的探险家在陌生的土地上迷路了。他只有一张标有纬度线的地图来指引方向。凭借决心，他沿着纬度线，最终找到了回家的路。记住，latitude（纬度）能帮我们确定位置！**
> 想象有两个盒子，一个标着 \'former\'（前者），一个标着 \'latter\'（后者）。你先打开了标有 \'former\' 的盒子，然后才打开标有 \'latter\' 的盒子，所以 \'latter\' 就是指后面的那个。 **想象有两个盒子，一个标着"前者"，一个标着"后者"。你先打开前者的盒子，再打开后者的盒子，所以"latter"指后面的那个。**

> A little bird was trapped in a lattice. It struggled to get out but the crisscross bars held it firmly. Finally, with the help of a kind girl, the bird escaped. The lattice here is like a grid or framework. **一只小鸟被困在一个格子结构里。它努力想出去，但纵横交错的栅栏把它牢牢困住。最后，在一个善良女孩的帮助下，小鸟逃脱了。这里的lattice就像一个网格或框架。**

> A king was very happy when his subjects loudly LAUDed his wise decisions. The praise filled the palace and made the king feel proud. Remember, \'laud\' means to praise highly. **一位国王在他的臣民大声赞扬他明智的决定时非常高兴。赞美之声充满了宫殿，让国王感到自豪。记住，\'laud\'意思是高度赞扬。**

> A young artist spent months creating a masterpiece. His hard work and dedication were truly laudable. People praised him for his excellent skills and the praiseworthy effort he put into his art. **一位年轻的艺术家花了数月创作了一幅杰作。他的努力和奉献精神真的值得称赞。人们称赞他出色的技艺和他在艺术中投入的值得赞扬的努力。**

> One day, a little monkey saw a funny show. It couldn\'t help laughing loudly and its laugh made all the animals around join in. The happy sound filled the forest. **有一天，一只小猴子看到了一场有趣的表演。它忍不住大声笑起来，它的笑声让周围所有的动物都跟着笑了。欢快的声音充满了森林。**

> A monkey was doing funny tricks in the circus. Its clumsy movements were so ridiculous that everyone found it laughable. The monkey\'s attempts to balance on a ball made the audience burst into laughter. **一只猴子在马戏团里表演滑稽的把戏。它笨拙的动作太可笑了，每个人都觉得很好笑。猴子试图在球上保持平衡的样子让观众哄堂大笑。**

> One day, I saw a monkey in the zoo. It was making funny faces and laughing loudly. Its laughing made all the visitors happy. The sound of its laughing was so contagious that I couldn\'t help joining in the joy. **有一天，我在动物园看到一只猴子。它正在做滑稽的鬼脸，大声笑着。它的笑声让所有游客都很开心。它的笑声极具感染力，我也忍不住跟着欢乐起来。**

> One day, I was feeling down. Then I went to a park and saw a group of kids playing and their laughter was so contagious. It made me forget my sadness and filled my heart with joy. Laughter truly has the power to brighten our days. **有一天，我心情低落。然后我去了公园，看到一群孩子在玩耍，他们的笑声极具感染力。这让我忘记了悲伤，心中充满了欢乐。笑声真的有照亮我们日子的力量。**
> 想象一下，在一个盛大的节日里，一艘崭新的火箭被放置在发射台上。随着倒计时结束，'砰'的一声巨响，火箭 launch 升空，冲向浩瀚宇宙。这激动人心的一幕，就是'发射、推出'的生动体现。 **想象在节日里火箭发射升空的场景来记住 launch 有'发射、推出'的意思**

> Imagine a brave astronaut standing by a powerful launcher. It\'s like a huge cannon that shoots the spaceship into the vast universe. With a big BOOM, the launcher sends the astronaut on an amazing adventure. **想象一位勇敢的宇航员站在一个强大的发射器旁。它就像一门巨大的火炮，将宇宙飞船射向浩瀚的宇宙。随着一声巨响，发射器把宇航员送上了奇妙的冒险之旅。**

> Imagine a huge spaceship on the launch pad. Scientists are making final checks. Then, with a burst of flames and a deafening roar, the launching begins. The spaceship soars into the sky, marking a new adventure. **想象一艘巨大的宇宙飞船在发射台上。科学家们正在做最后的检查。然后，随着一阵火焰和震耳欲聋的轰鸣声，发射开始了。宇宙飞船飞向天空，标志着一次新的冒险。**

> A thief stole a lot of money and was very worried. So he decided to launder the money by opening a fake laundry shop. Through this cover-up, he tried to make the stolen money seem legal. **一个小偷偷了很多钱，非常担心。于是他决定通过开一家假的洗衣店来洗钱。通过这种掩饰，他试图让偷来的钱看起来合法。**

> A thief was caught for laundering money. He thought he was smart, but the police were smarter. They followed the money trail and exposed his illegal act. Remember, laundering means cleaning dirty money to make it seem legal. **一个小偷因洗钱被抓。他以为自己聪明，但警察更聪明。他们顺着资金线索揭露了他的非法行为。记住，laundering 意思是把非法获得的钱通过各种手段变为合法的。**

> One day, Tom was very tired after a long week. He had a pile of dirty clothes, so he took them to the laundry. There, the machines washed and dried his clothes, making them clean and fresh again. **一天，汤姆在漫长的一周后非常疲惫。他有一堆脏衣服，所以他把它们带到洗衣房。在那里，机器清洗并烘干了他的衣服，让它们再次变得干净清新。**
> 想象一位勇敢的诗人，他在诗歌的世界里不断探索，最终凭借才华获得了桂冠。人们欢呼着称他为'laureate'。这个词就代表着因杰出成就而获得荣誉和称赞的人。 **想象一位诗人因才华获桂冠，人们称其为'laureate'，该词指获荣誉称赞之人。**

> A young athlete named Lily was determined to win the laurel in the race. She trained hard every day. Finally, she crossed the finish line first and was awarded the laurel wreath. It symbolized her victory and hard work. **一位名叫莉莉的年轻运动员决心在比赛中赢得桂冠。她每天刻苦训练。最终，她第一个冲过终点线，并被授予了月桂树花环。这象征着她的胜利和努力。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a volcano. Suddenly, hot lava started flowing. The red-hot lava moved like a wild river. The adventurer had to run fast to escape. Lava is the hot liquid that comes out of a volcano. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一座火山。突然，滚烫的岩浆开始流淌。炽热的岩浆像一条狂野的河流。探险家不得不快速奔跑逃离。lava 就是从火山中流出的炽热的液体。**

> A little girl was lost in a field full of lavender. The sweet smell of lavender comforted her. Finally, she followed the lavender path and found her way home. Lavender became her lucky charm. **一个小女孩在满是薰衣草的田野里迷路了。薰衣草甜甜的味道安慰了她。最后，她沿着薰衣草的小路找到了回家的路。薰衣草成了她的幸运符。**

> A king was very lavish. He spent money freely to build huge palaces and throw grand parties. But his people were poor. One day, a wise man told him to be more careful with his wealth. The king finally understood and changed. **一位国王非常奢华。他随意花钱建造巨大的宫殿，举办盛大的派对。但他的子民却很贫穷。一天，一位智者告诉他要更谨慎地对待财富。国王最终明白了并做出了改变。**

> A rich prince spent money lavishly. He threw grand parties, bought countless jewels, and never cared about the cost. His lavish spending made everyone amazed. **一位富有的王子花钱大手大脚。他举办盛大的派对，购买无数珠宝，从不在乎花费。他的挥霍无度让每个人都感到惊讶。**

> A thief was caught by the police. But he claimed that his actions were lawful because he thought he was just taking back what was owed to him. Of course, the law proved him wrong. Lawful means conforming to the law. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。但他声称他的行为是合法的，因为他认为他只是拿回属于他的东西。当然，法律证明他错了。Lawful 意思是合法的、守法的。**

> In a distant town, there was chaos and disorder. The streets were lawless. Bandits roamed freely, and no one followed the rules. It was a place where justice was absent. Eventually, a hero emerged to restore law and order. **在一个遥远的小镇，一片混乱无序。街道处于无法无天的状态。强盗肆意游荡，无人遵守规则。这是一个正义缺失的地方。最终，一位英雄出现，恢复了法律和秩序。**

> In a small town, a wise and just person was elected as a lawmaker. He spent days and nights working on fair laws to protect everyone. People trusted him because he knew how to make the town better through law. **在一个小镇上，一位睿智公正的人被选为立法者。他日夜致力于制定公平的法律来保护每个人。人们信任他，因为他知道如何通过法律让小镇变得更好。**

> One sunny day, I lay on the soft lawn in the garden. The grass was green and neat. I felt so relaxed and enjoyed the peaceful moment. The lawn was like a big green blanket. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我躺在花园里柔软的草坪上。草儿碧绿整齐。我感到十分放松，享受着这宁静的时刻。这片草坪就像一张大大的绿色毯子。**

> A poor man was wrongly accused and faced a lawsuit. He was very worried but found a smart lawyer to help. Finally, justice was served and he won the lawsuit. **一个可怜的人被错误地指控并面临诉讼。他非常担心，但找到了一位聪明的律师帮忙。最终，正义得到伸张，他赢得了诉讼。**

> One day, a poor man was in trouble and needed help. A smart and kind lawyer came to his aid. The lawyer used the law to protect him and finally got justice. The poor man was very grateful. **有一天，一个穷人遇到了麻烦，需要帮助。一位聪明善良的律师来帮助他。律师运用法律保护了他，最终获得了公正。穷人非常感激。**

> A man named Alex was very lax in his work. He often missed deadlines and made many mistakes. One day, his boss warned him: \'If you don\'t change, you\'ll lose your job!\' Alex finally realized he needed to be more serious. **一个叫亚历克斯的人在工作中非常松懈。他经常错过截止日期，还犯很多错误。有一天，他的老板警告他：'如果你不改变，你就会丢工作！'亚历克斯终于意识到他需要更认真些。**

> One day, a little bird lay its eggs in a cozy nest. It carefully prepared the place to ensure the safety of the future babies. \'Lay\' here means to put something down gently and carefully. **有一天，一只小鸟在一个舒适的巢里下蛋。它精心准备这个地方以确保未来宝宝的安全。这里的'lay'意思是轻轻地、小心地放下某物。**

> Imagine a big cake. Each slice of the cake is a layer. The top layer has strawberries, the middle layer has cream, and the bottom layer has chocolate. So, \'layer\' is like a slice or a level of something. **想象一个大蛋糕。蛋糕的每一片都是一层。顶层有草莓，中间层有奶油，底层有巧克力。所以，\'layer\'就像是某物的一层或一个层次。**

> Imagine a big cake. It has multiple layers of different flavors. The top layer is chocolate, the middle one is vanilla, and the bottom is strawberry. This cake is \'layered\', having distinct and separate layers. **想象一个大蛋糕。它有多层不同的口味。顶层是巧克力，中间一层是香草，底层是草莓。这个蛋糕是"分层的"，有明显且分开的层。**

> Once upon a time, a painter was doing layering on a canvas. First, a base color, then another, creating a beautiful and rich effect. It\'s like stacking different colors one by one. **从前，有一位画家在画布上进行分层绘制。先涂一层底色，然后再涂一层，创造出美丽而丰富的效果。就像一层一层地堆叠不同的颜色。**
> 想象一下，有个叫 Tom 的人，他不懂复杂的医学知识，被称为 layman。有次朋友生病，Tom 只能干着急，因为他这个门外汉不知道如何帮忙。所以 layman 就是指外行、门外汉。 **想象一下，有个叫汤姆的人，他不懂复杂的医学知识，被称为外行。有次朋友生病，汤姆只能干着急，因为他这个门外汉不知道如何帮忙。所以 layman 就是指外行、门外汉。**

> A company was in trouble. To save costs, it had to make layoffs. Poor Tom was one of them. He lost his job and felt very sad. But he didn\'t give up and started to look for a new one. **一家公司陷入困境。为节省成本，它不得不进行裁员。可怜的汤姆就是其中之一。他丢了工作，非常伤心。但他没有放弃，开始寻找新工作。**
> 想象一下，一位设计师在纸上精心规划一个房间的布局（layout），他仔细地画出家具的摆放位置，思考如何让空间利用最合理。这个精心规划的过程就是\'layout\'。 **想象一位设计师规划房间布局的过程来记住\'layout\'这个单词，意思是布局、安排、设计**

> One sunny day, a sloth was moving lazily in the tree. It took ages to reach a branch. Everyone else was busy, but the sloth just did things lazily. It shows how \'lazily\' means doing something slowly and without much effort. **在一个阳光明媚的日子里，一只树懒在树上懒洋洋地移动。它花了很长时间才到达一个树枝。其他人都很忙，但树懒只是懒洋洋地做事。这表明"lazily"意味着做事缓慢且不怎么费力。**

> One day, a little monkey was always avoiding work and just laying around. His friends called him out for his laziness. But the monkey didn\'t change and continued to be lazy. Eventually, he found no food when winter came. **有一天，一只小猴子总是逃避工作，只是躺着无所事事。他的朋友们指责他太懒。但猴子没有改变，继续懒惰。最后，冬天来临时，他找不到食物了。**

> There was a cat named Tom. He was very lazy. He always slept all day and never caught mice. One day, there were no more food. But Tom was still too lazy to find it. Finally, he was hungry. **有一只叫汤姆的猫。它非常懒。它总是整天睡觉，从不抓老鼠。有一天，没有食物了。但汤姆还是懒得去找。最后，它饿了。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的实验室里，有一种神奇的液体 leach 正在慢慢渗出容器，它就像一个神秘的精灵，悄悄地溜走。这个液体不断地过滤、渗透，仿佛在寻找新的出路。 **想象在古老实验室中，【leach】（渗出、过滤、渗透）这种神奇液体慢慢从容器中溜走，不断过滤和渗透，像在找新出路。**

> A brave leader led his team through a dark forest. They followed him because he knew the way. The leader\'s determination and wisdom led them to safety. Remember, \'lead\' means to guide or be in charge. **一位勇敢的领导者带领他的团队穿过黑暗的森林。他们跟随他，因为他知道路。这位领导者的决心和智慧引领他们到达安全之地。记住，'lead'意思是引导、领导。**

> A brave mouse was chosen as the leader of the animal group. It led them to find food and stay safe. The mouse\'s courage and wisdom made it a great leader. **一只勇敢的老鼠被选为动物群体的领导者。它带领它们寻找食物并保证安全。这只老鼠的勇气和智慧使它成为了一个出色的领导者。**

> A young man named Tom was always timid. But one day, he led a team to solve a big problem. Through this experience, Tom grew and became a person with great leadership, inspiring and guiding others to success. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是很胆小。但有一天，他带领一个团队解决了一个大问题。通过这次经历，汤姆成长为一个具有卓越领导力的人，激励并引导他人走向成功。**

> A young scientist was leading a team to explore a mysterious cave. They followed his lead and finally made a great discovery. The scientist\'s leading role was crucial for their success. **一位年轻的科学家带领着一个团队去探索一个神秘的洞穴。他们听从他的引领，最终有了重大发现。这位科学家的领导角色对他们的成功至关重要。**

> A little monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a leaf fell on its head. The monkey looked up and saw many beautiful leaves on the tree. The leaf was green and soft. It made the monkey very happy. **一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。突然，一片叶子落在它的头上。猴子抬头看，看到树上有许多漂亮的叶子。这片叶子是绿色的，很柔软。这让猴子非常高兴。**

> A little ant was lost in a forest. Suddenly, it saw a leaflet flying by. The leaflet had a map on it and helped the ant find its way home. The ant was so happy! **一只小蚂蚁在森林里迷路了。突然，它看到一张传单飞过。传单上有一张地图，帮助蚂蚁找到了回家的路。蚂蚁非常高兴！**

> A little rabbit was lost in a leafy forest. There were so many leaves everywhere that it was hard to find the way out. But with its perseverance, the rabbit finally found a path and returned home safely. \'Leafy\' means full of leaves. **一只小兔子在一个枝繁叶茂的森林里迷路了。到处都是很多的树叶，以至于很难找到出去的路。但凭借它的毅力，小兔子最终找到了一条路，安全回家了。\'leafy\'意思是长满叶子的，多叶的。**

> A group of friends decided to form a league to protect their neighborhood. They worked together, like a team, to keep it safe. The word \'league\' means a group or an association formed for a common purpose. **一群朋友决定组成一个联盟来保护他们的社区。他们像一个团队一样共同努力来确保其安全。单词\'league\'意思是为了共同目的而形成的团体或协会。**

> A brave knight joined a league to fight against evil. He trained hard every day and became a strong leaguer. With his fellow leaguers, they protected the kingdom and brought peace. **一位勇敢的骑士加入了一个联盟去对抗邪恶。他每天刻苦训练，成为了一名强大的盟员。和他的盟员同伴们一起，他们保护了王国并带来了和平。**

> A pipe in the old house started to leak. Water was dripping everywhere. The owner quickly called a plumber to fix the leak and stop the waste of water. **在那所老房子里，一根水管开始漏水。水到处滴。房主赶紧叫水管工来修补漏洞，阻止水的浪费。**
> 想象一下，一个巨大的水库，水从一个很小的裂缝慢慢渗出，这个渗出的水就像 leakage 。就像秘密从紧闭的门悄悄泄露一样。 **想象一个水库水从裂缝慢慢渗出的场景来理解'leakage'（泄漏、渗漏）这个单词，也可联想秘密的泄露。**

> One day, Tom found a leaky faucet in the bathroom. Water was dripping constantly. He had to call a plumber to fix it. The leaky faucet caused a lot of trouble. **一天，汤姆发现浴室里有一个漏水的水龙头。水不停地滴。他不得不叫水管工来修理。这个漏水的水龙头带来了很多麻烦。**

> A young athlete always leans against the wall after a long run to catch his breath. He leans there because he is too tired. One day, he realizes that leaning too much makes him lazy, so he decides to stand strong. **一位年轻的运动员在长跑后总是靠墙倾斜着身子喘气。他靠在那里是因为太累了。有一天，他意识到过度倾斜让自己变得懒惰，所以决定坚强站直。**

> A young boy was always leaning against the wall when waiting for his friends. One day, he realized that leaning too much made him look lazy. So, he decided to stand straight. \'Leaning\' means to rest against something at an angle. **一个小男孩在等朋友时总是倚靠着墙。有一天，他意识到过度倚靠让他看起来很懒。于是，他决定站直。\'leaning\'意思是倾斜着靠在某物上。**

> A frog wanted to reach a lily pad across the pond. With a big leap, it jumped over the water and landed safely. The frog\'s leap was amazing and showed its strength and agility. **一只青蛙想要到达池塘对面的睡莲叶子。它猛地一跳，越过水面，安全着陆。青蛙的这一跳令人惊叹，展现了它的力量和敏捷。**

> One day, a little monkey saw a bird singing beautifully. The monkey wanted to learn how to sing like the bird. So it listened carefully and practiced every day. Finally, it could sing well too. Learn means to acquire knowledge or skills by studying or practicing. **有一天，一只小猴子看到一只鸟唱歌很好听。猴子想要学习像鸟一样唱歌。于是它认真倾听并且每天练习。最后，它也能唱得很好。Learn 意思是通过学习或练习获得知识或技能。**

> A young boy named Tom was very curious. He spent hours reading books and asking questions. Through his efforts, he became learned and could answer many difficult problems. People were impressed by his knowledge. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩非常好奇。他花很多时间读书和提问。通过努力，他变得博学，能够回答许多难题。人们都对他的知识印象深刻。**

> One day, a little boy named Tom was very eager to learn how to ride a bike. He kept practicing and making mistakes. But he never gave up. Because Tom knew he was a learner and needed to keep trying. Finally, he succeeded. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的小男孩非常渴望学习如何骑自行车。他不断练习，不断犯错。但他从未放弃。因为汤姆知道自己是个学习者，需要不断尝试。最后，他成功了。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big forest. But he didn\'t panic. He used his learning about directions and nature to find his way home. Learning saved him! **有一天，一个小男孩在大森林里迷路了。但他没有惊慌。他运用所学的方向和自然知识找到了回家的路。学习救了他！**

> A poor farmer wanted to expand his land. Luckily, he got a lease from a kind landlord. With the lease, he could use the land for a certain period and finally had a good harvest. **一个贫穷的农民想要扩大他的土地。幸运的是，他从一位善良的地主那里得到了一份租约。凭借这份租约，他能够在一定时期内使用这块土地，最终获得了好收成。**

> One day, a dog was running freely in the park. But its owner quickly caught it with a leash. The leash kept the dog safe and under control. It showed how important a leash is for guiding and protecting our pets. **一天，一只狗在公园里自由奔跑。但它的主人很快用一根皮带抓住了它。皮带保证了狗的安全并能控制住它。这表明皮带对于引导和保护我们的宠物是多么重要。**
> 想象一下，有个年轻人想创业，但是没钱买设备。这时，一家公司出现，说可以把设备租给他使用，这种出租的行为就是leasing。年轻人通过leasing获得了成功。 **想象一个年轻人因没钱买设备，一家公司将设备出租给他的行为就是leasing，年轻人借此成功。**

> Once upon a time, in a kingdom of numbers, 1 was the smallest. But among all, 0 was the least. It had the lowest value and was often overlooked. Remember, \'least\' means the smallest or slightest. **从前，在数字王国里，1 是最小的。但在所有数字中，0 是最少的。它的值最低，常被忽视。记住，\'least\' 意思是最小的或最少的。**

> One day, a traveler was lost in a strange town. He found a shop selling various items made of leather, like shoes and bags. The smell of the leather reminded him of his adventurous journey. Leather became a symbol of his unforgettable experiences. **一天，一位旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他发现一家出售各种皮革制品的商店，像鞋子和包。皮革的气味让他想起了自己的冒险之旅。皮革成了他难忘经历的象征。**

> One day, I saw an old man with a leathery face. His skin looked like leather, tough and wrinkled. It reminded me of the word \'leathery\', which means having the qualities of leather, like being tough and hard. **有一天，我看到一个老人，他有一张皮革似的脸。他的皮肤看起来像皮革，坚韧且布满皱纹。这让我想起了\'leathery\'这个词，意思是具有皮革的特性，比如坚韧和坚硬。**

> A little bird wanted to leave its nest to explore the big world. It spread its wings and flew away, leaving the comfort of home behind. Leaving means to go away from a place or a person. **一只小鸟想要离开它的巢去探索大世界。它展开翅膀飞走了，离开了舒适的家。leave 意思是从一个地方或一个人那里走开。**

> A little bird was leaving its nest for the first time. It spread its wings and flew away bravely, ready to explore the big world. Leaving means to go away from a place. **一只小鸟第一次离开它的巢。它展开翅膀勇敢地飞走了，准备去探索这个大世界。Leaving 意思是从一个地方走开。**
> 一位老师在讲台上激情地进行演讲（lecture），台下的学生们聚精会神地听着。老师通过生动的例子和有趣的互动，让知识像清泉一样流淌进学生们的脑海。 **一位老师在讲台上激情地进行演讲，台下的学生们聚精会神地听着。老师通过生动的例子和有趣的互动，让知识像清泉一样流淌进学生们的脑海。**
> 想象一下，在一个大教室里，有一位知识渊博的人站在讲台上激情演讲，这个人就是 lecturer （讲师）。他用生动的语言传授知识，同学们都被深深吸引。 **想象在教室里一位激情演讲、传授知识的讲师，以此记住 lecturer 这个单词意思为讲师。**

> A brave climber was stuck on a ledge during a storm. He held on tightly, praying for rescue. The ledge was narrow but saved his life. Finally, he was saved. Remember, a ledge can be a lifesaver! **一位勇敢的登山者在暴风雨中被困在一个壁架上。他紧紧抓住，祈祷能获救。这个壁架很窄，但救了他的命。最后，他得救了。记住，壁架（ledge）可能是救命的！**

> A thief broke into a store at night. But all he found was a ledger with confusing records. He thought it was valuable but later realized it was just a book of accounts. Poor thief! **一个小偷在晚上闯进了一家商店。但他只发现了一本有着混乱记录的分类账。他以为很值钱，但后来才意识到这只是一本账本。可怜的小偷！**

> A man was swimming in a lake. Suddenly, he felt something sticking to his leg. It was a leech! He was so scared and tried hard to get it off. Finally, he succeeded and ran away quickly. **一个男人正在湖里游泳。突然，他感觉有东西粘在他腿上。那是一只水蛭！他非常害怕，努力把它弄掉。最后，他成功了，然后迅速跑开了。**

> A thief was always leery when stealing. One night, he saw a big dog and became very cautious. He moved slowly, looking around nervously. Finally, he decided to give up because he was too leery of being caught. **一个小偷在偷东西时总是很警惕。一天晚上，他看到一只大狗，变得非常小心。他慢慢地移动，紧张地四处张望。最后，他因为太担心被抓住而决定放弃。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. When he finally found his way back, he had some leeway to explain his delay. The captain understood that \'leeway\' meant room for maneuver or flexibility. **一位水手在海上迷失了方向。当他最终找到回去的路时，他有一些余地来解释他的延误。船长明白\'leeway\'意味着回旋的余地或灵活性。**

> One day, a little boy was lost. He stood at a crossroad and remembered that his home was on the left side. So he followed that direction and finally found his way back. The word \'left\' means the direction opposite of right. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了。他站在十字路口，记得他家在左边。于是他朝着那个方向走，最终找到了回家的路。单词\'left\'意思是"右边"的相反方向。**

> A group of people were marching. The ones on the left side were passionate and advocating for social change. They were called leftist. They were firm in their beliefs and worked hard for a fairer society. **一群人在游行。左边的那些人充满激情，倡导社会变革。他们被称为左派分子。他们坚定自己的信念，为更公平的社会而努力。**

> A hungry boy found some leftover pizza in the fridge. He was so happy because those leftovers saved him from hunger. The pizza that remained unused became his delicious treat. **一个饥饿的男孩在冰箱里发现了一些剩余的披萨。他非常高兴，因为这些剩余的食物让他免于挨饿。那些没用完而剩下的披萨成了他的美味大餐。**

> There was a baseball game. A player named Tom was known as a \'lefty\' because he always threw the ball with his left hand. This made him stand out and gave his team an advantage. **有一场棒球比赛。一个叫汤姆的球员被称为"左撇子"，因为他总是用左手投球。这使他脱颖而出，给球队带来了优势。**
> A thief was running away after stealing. A brave policeman chased him. But the thief tripped and hurt his leg. The policeman caught him easily. **一个小偷偷完东西后正在逃跑。一位勇敢的警察在追他。但是小偷绊倒了，伤到了腿。警察轻松地抓住了他。**

> A king left a great legacy to his son. It included not only treasures but also wisdom and courage. The son was determined to carry on this legacy and make the kingdom even better. **一位国王给他的儿子留下了一份伟大的遗产。它不仅包括财宝，还有智慧和勇气。儿子决心继承这份遗产，让王国变得更美好。**

> A thief was caught by the police. But his lawyer argued that the evidence was not legal. Finally, justice prevailed and the thief was punished. Remember, \'legal\' means conforming to the law. **一个小偷被警察抓住了。但他的律师辩称证据不合法。最终，正义获胜，小偷受到了惩罚。记住，\'legal\'意思是合法的。**

> A thief was caught and tried to defend himself by questioning the legality of the arrest. But the police showed clear evidence and proved that everything was legal. The thief had no way to escape the law. **一个小偷被抓住了，他试图质疑逮捕的合法性为自己辩护。但警察出示了明确的证据，证明一切都是合法的。这个小偷无法逃脱法律的制裁。**

> A king was considering the legalization of a new law. But his advisers were divided. Finally, after much debate, the law was legalized for the benefit of the people. **一位国王正在考虑一项新法律的合法化。但他的顾问们意见不一。最后，经过多次辩论，这项法律被合法化，造福了人民。**

> A king was worried about the chaos in his kingdom. So, he decided to legalize the previously forbidden activities to bring order. By doing this, everything became clear and regulated, and the kingdom thrived. **一位国王担心他的王国陷入混乱。于是，他决定将之前被禁止的活动合法化，以此带来秩序。通过这样做，一切都变得清晰且受到规范，王国繁荣起来。**

> A thief was caught but was released legally because of a lack of evidence. The police were frustrated but had to follow the law. Legally means in a way that is permitted by law. **一个小偷被抓住了，但由于缺乏证据被依法释放了。警察很沮丧但不得不遵循法律。Legally 意思是以法律允许的方式。**

> In a mysterious ancient land, there was a story passed down through generations. This story, full of heroic deeds and magical elements, was known as a legend. People loved to tell and retell it around the campfire. **在一片神秘的古老土地上，有一个代代相传的故事。这个充满英雄事迹和神奇元素的故事被称为传奇。人们喜欢在篝火旁讲述和复述它。**

> A brave knight was known throughout the land for his extraordinary deeds. His name became legendary. People told tales of his courage and kindness for generations. The word \'legendary\' means famous and very special in history or stories. **一位勇敢的骑士因其非凡的事迹而闻名整个地区。他的名字变得具有传奇色彩。世世代代的人们都讲述着他的勇气和善良的故事。\'legendary\'这个单词意为在历史或故事中著名且非常特别的。**

> One day, Lily was going for a run. But she forgot to wear her leggings. So, she felt very cold. Then she quickly went back home to put on the leggings and felt warm and comfortable. Legging means a close-fitting stretchy garment for the legs. **一天，莉莉准备去跑步。但她忘了穿她的紧身裤。所以，她觉得很冷。然后她迅速回家穿上紧身裤，感觉温暖又舒适。Legging 意思是紧身的有弹性的腿部衣物。**

> In ancient times, a brave general led a legion of soldiers into battle. The legion was so large and powerful that it was feared by the enemy. They fought bravely and won many victories. Remember, \'legion\' means a large group of soldiers. **在古代，一位勇敢的将军率领着一支军团投入战斗。这个军团规模庞大且强大，令敌人感到恐惧。他们英勇作战，赢得了许多胜利。记住，\'legion\'意思是大批的士兵。**

> A king needed to legislate new laws to make his kingdom peaceful. He sat on his throne, thinking hard. Finally, he made wise decisions that made everyone happy. Remember, \'legislate\' means to make laws! **一位国王需要制定新的法律以使他的王国和平。他坐在王座上，努力思考。最后，他做出了明智的决定，让每个人都很开心。记住，\'legislate\' 意思是立法！**

> A king wanted to make fair rules for his kingdom. So, he gathered wise men to create legislation. They spent days discussing and finally came up with good laws that made everyone happy. **一位国王想为他的王国制定公平的规则。于是，他召集了智者来制定立法。他们花了几天时间讨论，最终制定出了令大家都满意的好法律。**

> A king needed to make new laws for his kingdom. So, he called a group of wise people for the legislative task. They discussed and decided what was best for the people. Legislative means related to making laws. **一位国王需要为他的王国制定新的法律。于是，他召集了一群智者来承担立法任务。他们讨论并决定对人民最有利的事情。Legislative 意思是与立法有关的。**

> A legislator was like a superhero in a suit. He/she had the power to create and change laws to make the city a better place. One day, the legislator passed a law to protect the environment. People were happy and grateful. **一位立法者就像穿着西装的超级英雄。他/她有权制定和更改法律，以使城市变得更美好。有一天，这位立法者通过了一项保护环境的法律。人们既高兴又感激。**

> A group of wise people gathered in a big hall. They were the legislature. Their job was to make and pass laws to keep the country in order and protect people\'s rights. **一群睿智的人聚集在一个大厅里。他们就是立法机关。他们的工作是制定和通过法律以维持国家秩序和保护人民的权利。**

> A king\'s rule was questioned. But he proved his legitimacy by following fair laws and caring for his people. His actions showed that his power was rightful and accepted. Legitimacy means being lawful and accepted. **一位国王的统治受到了质疑。但他通过遵循公平的法律和关爱他的人民证明了他的合法性。他的行为表明他的权力是合法且被认可的。legitimacy 意思是合法（性）；正统（性）；合理性**

> A king needed to legitimate his claim to the throne. So, he showed the ancient scrolls that proved his rightful heritage. Finally, everyone accepted him as the legitimate ruler. **一位国王需要使他对王位的主张合法化。于是，他出示了证明其合法继承权的古老卷轴。最终，大家都认可他为合法的统治者。**

> A young detective was trying to prove a suspect\'s alibi legitimately. He collected all the evidence carefully and finally confirmed it was true. The word \'legitimately\' means in a way that is legal and proper. **一位年轻的侦探正试图合法地证明嫌疑人的不在场证明。他仔细收集了所有证据，最终确认这是真的。\'legitimately\'这个单词的意思是以合法且恰当的方式。**

> A king needed to legitimize his new law. So, he gathered all the wise men and explained his intentions. After much discussion, the law was accepted and legitimized. Thus, the kingdom was in order again. **一位国王需要使他的新法律合法化。于是，他召集了所有的智者并解释他的意图。经过大量讨论，该法律被接受并合法化。于是，王国再次恢复秩序。**

> A hungry rabbit was looking for food in the garden. It found many legumes, like peas and beans. The rabbit was so happy as it could have a big meal. Now you know legume means plants like peas and beans. **一只饥饿的兔子在花园里找食物。它发现了很多豆类，比如豌豆和豆子。兔子非常高兴，因为它可以饱餐一顿。现在你知道 legume 指的是像豌豆和豆子这样的植物。**

> A hardworking ant never has leisure time. It keeps working to store food. But a lazy grasshopper spends all its time in leisure, singing and playing. When winter comes, the ant has enough food, but the grasshopper has nothing. So, leisure means free time to relax. **一只勤劳的蚂蚁从来没有闲暇时间。它一直工作来储存食物。但是一只懒惰的蚂蚱把所有时间都用于休闲，唱歌和玩耍。当冬天来临，蚂蚁有足够的食物，但是蚂蚱一无所有。所以，leisure 意思是休闲的时间。**

> One sunny day, a traveler was strolling along the beach in a leisurely manner. He enjoyed the gentle breeze and the sound of the waves, taking his time to soak in the beautiful scenery. No rush, just a peaceful and relaxed moment. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一位旅行者悠闲地沿着海滩漫步。他享受着微风和海浪声，不紧不慢地沉浸在这美丽的景色中。没有匆忙，只有宁静和放松的时刻。**

> One day, I was very thirsty. I opened the fridge and found a lemon. I cut it and squeezed the juice into a glass of water. The sour taste made me feel refreshed. **有一天，我非常口渴。我打开冰箱发现了一个柠檬。我把它切开，把柠檬汁挤进一杯水里。酸酸的味道让我感到神清气爽。**

> One hot summer day, I was very thirsty. Then a kind girl came and gave me a glass of lemonade. It was so cool and sweet. The lemonade saved me from the heat. **在一个炎热的夏日，我非常口渴。然后一个善良的女孩过来给了我一杯柠檬水。它又冰又甜。柠檬水让我摆脱了炎热。**

> One day, my friend was in trouble and needed a pen. I kindly lent him my favorite pen. He was very grateful and promised to return it soon. Lend means to give something to someone for a period of time. **有一天，我的朋友遇到了麻烦，需要一支笔。我好心地把我最喜欢的笔借给他。他非常感激，并承诺很快归还。Lend 意思是把某物借给某人一段时间。**

> A poor man needed money desperately. He went to a kind lender. The lender trusted him and lent the money without hesitation. The poor man was very grateful. **一个穷人急需钱。他去找了一位好心的出借人。出借人信任他，毫不犹豫地把钱借了出去。穷人非常感激。**

> A poor student needed money for books. A kind teacher came to his aid by lending him the necessary funds. The student was grateful and promised to return it soon. Lending means giving something, usually money, to someone for a period of time. **一个贫困的学生需要钱买书。一位善良的老师通过借给他必要的资金来帮助他。学生很感激，并承诺很快归还。lending 意思是把某物，通常是钱，借给某人一段时间。**

> A little ant was trying to measure the length of a stick. It walked from one end to the other many times. Finally, it knew the exact length. The ant was so happy! **一只小蚂蚁试图测量一根棍子的长度。它从一端走到另一端很多次。最后，它知道了确切的长度。小蚂蚁非常高兴！**

> A little ant was walking on a short rope. But it wanted to go further, so it decided to lengthen the rope. It worked hard and finally made the rope longer to reach its destination. **一只小蚂蚁在一根短绳上行走。但它想走得更远，所以决定把绳子加长。它努力工作，最终把绳子变长，到达了目的地。**

> A little ant was trying to measure a long stick. It moved lengthwise along the stick but got confused. Then a wise bird told it to measure from one end to the other, that\'s what \'lengthwise\' means - in the direction of the length. **一只小蚂蚁试图测量一根长棍。它沿着棍子纵向移动，但感到困惑。然后一只聪明的鸟告诉它从一端量到另一端，这就是\'lengthwise\'的意思------纵向的方向。**

> A detective was working on a lengthy case. It took him many days and nights to find clues. The case was so long and complex that it felt like a never-ending journey. Finally, he solved it with persistence. **一位侦探正在处理一个冗长的案件。他花费了许多个日日夜夜去寻找线索。这个案子如此漫长和复杂，感觉就像一场永无止境的旅程。最终，他凭借着坚持解决了它。**

> A judge was always lenient when dealing with first-time offenders. He believed in giving them a second chance to correct their mistakes, showing kindness and understanding. So, lenient means being kind and not strict. **一位法官在处理初犯时总是很宽大。他相信给他们一个改正错误的机会，展现出仁慈和理解。所以，lenient 意思是宽大的；仁慈的；不严苛的。**

> A scientist was observing tiny creatures through a special lens. The lens was like a magic window that made the small world become clear. It helped the scientist discover many unknown secrets. **一位科学家正在通过一个特殊的透镜观察微小生物。这个透镜就像一扇神奇的窗户，让小小的世界变得清晰。它帮助科学家发现了许多未知的秘密。**

> A little monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a leopard jumped out. The monkey was so scared. But the leopard just passed by quickly. The monkey realized that the leopard was chasing its prey. **一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。突然，一只豹子跳了出来。猴子非常害怕。但豹子很快就过去了。猴子意识到豹子在追逐它的猎物。**

> In a small village, there was a mysterious figure named Tom. Everyone avoided him because he was a leper. One day, a kind doctor came and treated him, showing that love can overcome fear. Remember, a leper is a person with leprosy. **在一个小村庄里，有一个叫汤姆的神秘人物。大家都躲着他，因为他是个麻风病人。有一天，一位善良的医生来了并为他治疗，这表明爱可以战胜恐惧。记住，leper 是麻风病人的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She fell in love with another girl. People called this kind of love between girls \'lesbian\'. It means women having romantic and emotional attraction to other women. **从前，有个叫莉莉的女孩。她爱上了另一个女孩。人们把这种女孩之间的爱称为'女同性恋'。它指的是女性对其他女性有浪漫和情感上的吸引力。**

> A doctor was examining a patient and found a lesion on the skin. It looked strange and worried the doctor. But after careful tests, it turned out to be a minor lesion that could be easily treated. **一位医生在为病人检查时，在皮肤上发现了一处损伤。它看起来很奇怪，让医生很担心。但经过仔细检查，发现这只是一处轻微的损伤，很容易治疗。**

> Once upon a time, there were two cups of water. One was full and the other had less water. The one with less water needed to be filled more to be like the full one. So, \'less\' means a smaller amount or not as much. **从前，有两杯水。一杯是满的，另一杯的水更少。水更少的那杯需要再添加更多才能像满的那杯一样。所以，'less'意思是较少的数量或程度。**

> Once upon a time, there was a huge mountain. But as time passed and the wind blew, the size of the mountain lessened. It became smaller and smaller. Just like how \'lessen\' means to make something become less or smaller. **从前，有一座巨大的山。但随着时间的流逝和风的吹拂，山的大小减小了。它变得越来越小。这就像'lessen'这个词意味着使某物变少或变小。**

> Once upon a time, there were two mountains. One was huge and the other was lesser. The lesser mountain always envied the taller one. But in the end, both had their own beauty. **从前，有两座山。一座很大，另一座较小。较小的山总是羡慕大的那座。但最后，两座山都有各自的美。**

> One day, a little bird was lost. An old owl came and taught the bird a lesson: always remember the way home. The bird learned and never got lost again. So, \'lesson\' means something learned or taught. **有一天，一只小鸟迷路了。一只老猫头鹰过来给小鸟上了一课：永远记住回家的路。小鸟学会了，再也没有迷路。所以，\'lesson\'意思是学到的或教授的东西。**

> One day, a little bird was about to fly across a dangerous river. Its mother warned it, \'Be careful, lest you fall into the water.\' The little bird listened and flew safely. Here, \'lest\' means to avoid the possibility of something bad happening. **有一天，一只小鸟准备飞过一条危险的河。它的妈妈警告它：'小心点，以免掉进水里。' 在这里，'lest'意思是避免不好的事情发生的可能性。**

> One day, Tom wanted to go to the park. His mom said, \'Let him go.\' So, Tom happily went to enjoy his day. Here, \'let\' means to give permission or allow. **一天，汤姆想去公园。他妈妈说：'让他去。'所以，汤姆开心地去享受他的一天。这里，'let'意思是允许、让。**

> A brave detective was on a case. The criminal used a special poison which was lethal. But the detective found the antidote just in time. Lethal means causing or able to cause death. **一位勇敢的侦探在办案。罪犯使用了一种特殊的毒药，这毒药是致命的。但侦探及时找到了解药。lethal 意思是致命的；可致死的。**

> A little girl was very excited when she received a letter from her best friend. The letter was full of love and care. It made her day. Remember, a letter is a written message sent to someone. **一个小女孩收到她最好朋友的信时非常兴奋。这封信充满了爱和关怀。这让她开心了一整天。记住，letter 就是寄给某人的书面消息。**

> One day, a little artist was doing some lettering. She carefully drew each letter, making them beautiful. With her hard work, the lettering became a wonderful art piece that everyone loved. **有一天，一位小艺术家正在进行一些字体设计。她认真地画着每一个字母，把它们弄得很漂亮。通过她的努力，这些字体设计变成了一件人人喜爱的精彩艺术品。**

> A hungry rabbit was looking for food in the garden. It found a big patch of lettuce and happily munched on it. Lettuce became its favorite treat. Remember, \'lettuce\' is the green and fresh vegetable the rabbit loves! **一只饥饿的兔子在花园里找食物。它发现了一大片生菜，开心地吃了起来。生菜成了它最喜欢的美食。记住，\'lettuce\'就是兔子喜欢的这种绿色新鲜的蔬菜！**

> A brave knight named Leo was always weak and pale. The doctor found that he had leukemia. But Leo fought hard, believing he could overcome it. Remember Leo\'s fight when you think of leukemia. **一位名叫利奥的勇敢骑士总是虚弱且面色苍白。医生发现他患了白血病。但利奥奋力抗争，坚信自己能够战胜病魔。当你想到 leukemia 这个词时，就记住利奥的抗争。**

> A king was worried about the flood, so he ordered people to build a levee. Workers worked hard day and night. Finally, the levee was completed and protected the kingdom from the flood. The levee became a symbol of safety. **一位国王担心洪水，于是他下令人们建造堤岸。工人们日夜辛苦工作。最终，堤岸建成，保护了王国免受洪水侵袭。堤岸成为了安全的象征。**
> 想象一下，你正在建造一座房子，每一层都要保持平整（level）。工人拿着水平仪仔细测量，确保每一层的高度都相同，没有高低起伏，这就是\'level\'所代表的水平、平坦的意思。 **想象你在建造房子，通过工人测量确保每层平整来体现\'level\'表示水平、平坦的意思。**

> A brave mouse was trying to move a big cheese. It found a lever and used all its strength to push it. With the help of the lever, the mouse finally moved the cheese successfully. **一只勇敢的老鼠试图移动一块大奶酪。它发现了一个杠杆，并用尽全身力气去推它。在杠杆的帮助下，老鼠最终成功地移动了奶酪。**

> A small ant wanted to move a big stone. It found a stick and used it as leverage. With great effort, it finally moved the stone. The stick gave the ant the power to do what seemed impossible. **一只小蚂蚁想要移动一块大石头。它找到了一根棍子并把它当作杠杆。经过巨大的努力，它终于移动了石头。这根棍子给了蚂蚁完成看似不可能之事的力量。**

> A king needed money for his army. So he decided to levy a tax on his people. Everyone had to pay a portion of their wealth. This action was called a levy. **一位国王需要钱来供养他的军队。所以他决定向他的子民征税。每个人都得拿出一部分财富。这种行为就叫做征（税）。**

> A king was very angry when he saw a man making lewd gestures in the street. He ordered the guards to catch him. \'Lewd\' means vulgar and immoral. So don\'t be lewd in public. **一位国王看到一个男人在街上做出下流的手势时非常生气。他命令卫兵抓住他。"lewd"意思是粗俗的、不道德的。所以在公共场合不要下流。**

> A young writer was lost in a magical library. A wise old owl appeared and told him the \'lexicon\' was the key to unlock all the knowledge. With it, he could express any idea precisely. **一位年轻的作家在一个神奇的图书馆里迷路了。一只聪明的老猫头鹰出现并告诉他，"词典"是解锁所有知识的关键。有了它，他可以精确地表达任何想法。**

> A young entrepreneur started a business. But due to some mistakes, he faced many debts. These debts became his liability. He had to work hard to pay them off. **一位年轻的企业家开始创业。但由于一些错误，他面临许多债务。这些债务成了他的责任。他不得不努力工作来偿还。**

> A man was driving carelessly and was liable for the accident. He had to pay a lot of money because he was responsible for the damage. Now you know \'liable\' means likely to be responsible for something. **一个男人开车不小心，要对事故负责。他不得不支付很多钱，因为他要为损害负责。现在你知道liable意思是可能对某事负责。**
