> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. He found himself surrounded by tall trees with roots in the water. Later, he learned they were called mangroves. > A young boy dreams of achieving manhood. One day, he saves a kitten from a tree and helps an old lady cross the street. He realizes that acts of kindness and bravery define manhood. **一个小男孩梦想着成为男子汉。有一天，他从树上救下一只小猫，还帮助一位老太太过马路。他意识到善良和勇敢的行为定义了男子汉气概。**

> A criminal escaped from prison. The police launched a manhunt. They searched everywhere, questioned many people. Finally, they caught the criminal. It was a big success for the manhunt. **一名罪犯从监狱逃脱。警方展开了追捕行动。他们到处搜寻，询问了很多人。最终，他们抓住了罪犯。这次追捕行动取得了巨大成功。**

> A man was always extremely excited and passionate about collecting stamps. His friends thought he had a mania for stamps. He spent all his time and money on it, which showed his crazy love for stamps. **一个男人总是对集邮极度兴奋和充满热情。他的朋友们认为他对邮票有狂热症。他把所有的时间和金钱都花在上面，这显示了他对邮票的疯狂喜爱。**

> A man was always running around wildly and doing crazy things. People called him a maniac. One day, he climbed a tall tree and shouted loudly. Everyone was shocked by his maniac behavior. **有个人总是疯狂地跑来跑去，做些疯狂的事。人们称他为疯子。有一天，他爬上一棵大树并大声喊叫。每个人都被他疯狂的行为震惊了。**

> A man was always in a rush and hyperactive. His friends said he was like a manic wind. One day, he realized he needed to calm down. From then on, he learned to control his manic energy. **一个男人总是匆匆忙忙且极度活跃。他的朋友们说他就像一阵狂躁的风。有一天，他意识到自己需要冷静下来。从那以后，他学会了控制自己狂躁的精力。**

> A girl was very sad because her nails were in a mess. So she decided to go to a salon for a manicure. After that, her nails looked beautiful and she was happy. **一个女孩因为指甲乱糟糟的很伤心。所以她决定去沙龙做美甲。之后，她的指甲变得漂亮了，她也开心起来。**
> 想象一下，一艘装满货物的大船靠岸，货物清单清晰可见（manifest）。工作人员对照清单，所有的物品都明确展示出来。这就是\'manifest\'，表示清楚显示、表明。 **想象一艘装满货物的大船靠岸，货物清单清晰可见，以此表明\'manifest\'意为清楚显示、表明。**

> A group of explorers were lost in the forest. One day, they saw a strange light, which was the manifestation of a hidden cave. They found treasures inside, realizing it was a sign of good luck. **一群探险家在森林中迷路了。有一天，他们看到一束奇怪的光，这是一个隐藏洞穴的显现。他们在里面发现了宝藏，意识到这是好运的迹象。**

> A group of friends decided to create a manifesto to express their shared dreams for a better community. They wrote down all their plans and goals clearly. The manifesto became a guide for their future actions. **一群朋友决定创作一份宣言来表达他们对一个更美好社区的共同梦想。他们清晰地写下了所有的计划和目标。这份宣言成为了他们未来行动的指南。**

> A magician wanted to manipulate the cards to perform a wonderful trick. But he needed to practice hard to master the skill. Finally, he could control the cards perfectly. > A man was trying to fix a machine but struggled. Then, a skilled worker came and did some manipulation with ease. The man learned that manipulation means skillful handling or control. **一个男人试图修理一台机器但很吃力。然后，一位熟练的工人来了，轻松地进行了一些操作。这个男人了解到 manipulation 意味着熟练的处理或控制。**

> A thief was very manipulative. He could skillfully control the situation to steal without being noticed. But in the end, the police caught him because of his too obvious manipulative tricks. **一个小偷非常善于操纵。他能够巧妙地控制局面进行偷窃而不被注意到。但最终，警察因为他过于明显的操纵伎俩抓住了他。**

> Long ago, in a faraway land, all people, regardless of their looks or where they came from, were united as one. They called themselves mankind, meaning all of humanity. Everyone worked together for a better future. **很久以前，在一个遥远的地方，所有人，不论长相和来自何处，都团结为一体。他们称自己为mankind，意思是全人类。每个人都为更美好的未来共同努力。**

> A young boy was often bullied for being weak. One day, he decided to change and started doing tough exercises. Soon, he became strong and brave, showing a manly spirit. People praised his manly behavior. **一个小男孩因弱小常被欺负。一天，他决定改变，开始进行艰苦的锻炼。很快，他变得强壮勇敢，展现出男子汉气概。人们称赞他有男子气概的行为。**

> Imagine a spaceship. A brave astronaut is inside, controlling it. This spaceship is manned. It means there is a person operating it. So, \'manned\' means having a person or people on board to operate or control something. **想象一艘宇宙飞船。一位勇敢的宇航员在里面，控制着它。这艘宇宙飞船是有人驾驶的。这意味着有一个人在上面操作。所以，\'manned\'意思是有人员在上面操作或控制某物。**

> A young artist was struggling to draw. One day, he found a mannequin in an old store. It stood still, giving him the perfect model. From then on, he could create amazing art easily with the help of the mannequin. **一位年轻的艺术家画画很吃力。有一天，他在一家旧商店里发现了一个人体模型。它一动不动地站着，给他提供了完美的模特。从那以后，在人体模型的帮助下，他能轻松创作出令人惊叹的艺术作品。**

> A little girl was always polite and had good manners. When she met people, she would smile and say hello. At the dinner table, she ate neatly. Her good manner made everyone like her. **一个小女孩总是很有礼貌，举止得体。当她见到人时，会微笑打招呼。在餐桌上，她吃得很整齐。她的良好举止让每个人都喜欢她。**

> A painter named Tom had a unique mannerism. Every time he started a new painting, he would twirl his brush three times. This odd behavior was his mannerism. People recognized him by it. **一位名叫汤姆的画家有一个独特的习惯动作。每次他开始一幅新画时，都会转动他的画笔三次。这个奇怪的行为就是他的特殊习惯、风格。人们凭此认出他。**

> A young man was lost in a forest and found a mysterious manor. The manor was huge with beautiful gardens. He explored it and met an old but kind owner. Finally, he understood the charm of this special place called\'manor\'. **一个年轻人在森林里迷路了，发现了一座神秘的庄园。这座庄园很大，还有美丽的花园。他探索了一番，并见到了一位年老但和善的主人。最后，他明白了这个被称为"庄园"的特殊地方的魅力。**

> A factory owner was very worried because there was not enough manpower to finish the big order. But then, many strong men came to help, and finally they made it. \'Manpower\' means the power of men or the workers available. **一位工厂老板非常担心，因为没有足够的人力来完成大订单。但后来，来了很多强壮的人帮忙，最终他们成功了。\'manpower\'意思是人力或可用的工人。**

> A rich man was lost in a forest. When he was tired, he found a big and beautiful mansion. It had many rooms and a lovely garden. He felt so lucky and decided to stay there for a while. **一个富人在森林里迷路了。当他疲惫时，发现了一座又大又漂亮的宅邸。它有很多房间和一个可爱的花园。他觉得很幸运，决定在那待一会儿。**

> One night, a drunk driver hit a pedestrian by accident. But it wasn\'t intentional murder; it was manslaughter. The driver had to face the consequences of his irresponsible actions. **一天晚上，一个醉酒的司机意外撞到了一位行人。但这并非故意谋杀，而是过失杀人。这位司机不得不面对其不负责任行为的后果。**

> One day, Tom was cleaning the mantel in his living room. The mantel was covered with dust. As he wiped it clean, he thought of the warm fires that would soon light up the room. **有一天，汤姆正在清理他客厅里的壁炉架。壁炉架上布满了灰尘。当他把它擦干净时，他想到了很快就会照亮房间的温暖炉火。**
> 从前有个小魔法师，他总是穿着一件神奇的披风（mantle）。这件披风赋予他力量，能在困难时刻保护他。每当他披上披风，就感觉充满勇气和自信，去面对各种挑战。 **从前有个小魔法师，他常穿的那件赋予他力量、保护他并让他充满勇气自信去面对挑战的神奇披风叫\'mantle\'。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的工厂里，工人拿着操作手册（manual），按照上面的步骤一步一步地手工（manual）操作着机器。手册指引他们，就像明灯照亮道路。 **想象在古老工厂中工人依照操作手册手工操作机器的情景来辅助记忆manual（手册；手工的）这个单词**

> A young inventor was working on a machine. But it broke and needed fixing. Without any automatic tools, he had to do everything manually. He used his hands and skills to make it work again. **一位年轻的发明家正在研究一台机器。但它坏了需要修理。没有任何自动工具，他不得不手动做所有的事情。他用自己的双手和技能让它重新运转起来。**
> 从前有个魔法工厂（factory），里面的工人很忙碌。他们用手（hand）制造（manufacture）各种神奇的物品。这个过程需要很多材料（material）和工具。最终，精美的产品被制造出来。 **从前有个魔法工厂，里面的工人忙碌地用手制造各种物品，这个过程需要材料和工具，最终产品被制造出来。**
> 想象一个大工厂，里面的工人忙忙碌碌。有个聪明的老板掌控全局，他就是\'manufacturer\'，负责制造产品。就像汽车厂老板，指挥着生产出一辆辆汽车。 **想象一个大工厂中掌控生产的老板，以此记住\'manufacturer\'这个表示制造商、生产商的单词**
> 想象一个巨大的工厂，机器轰鸣，工人们忙碌地操作着。这里正在进行的就是\'manufacturing\'，也就是制造、生产的过程。从原材料到成品，每一步都充满了精心的规划和努力。 **想象一个工厂中制造、生产的场景来辅助记忆\'manufacturing\'这个单词，意思是制造、生产**

> A man was very tired after working all day in the field. But he still needed to handle the manure to fertilize the soil. He knew that manure, though smelly, was essential for a good harvest. **一个男人在田里劳作了一整天后非常疲惫。但他仍然需要处理肥料来给土壤施肥。他知道肥料虽然难闻，但对丰收至关重要。**
> 一位勇敢的冒险家 MAN ，在古老的城堡中发现了一份神秘的 SCRIPT（手稿）。这份 manuscript 记载着宝藏的秘密，他凭借它找到了无数的财富。 **一位勇敢的男子在城堡中发现记载宝藏秘密的手稿。**

> A little monkey went to a big fruit market. It saw many apples, many bananas and many oranges. It was so happy because there were so many choices. **一只小猴子去了一个大水果市场。它看到了很多苹果，很多香蕉和很多橙子。它非常高兴，因为有如此多的选择。**

> One day, Tom got lost in a forest. Luckily, he found a map in his bag. The map showed him the way out and led him safely home. Map is like a guide in unknown places. **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，他在包里发现了一张地图。这张地图给他指明了出路，引领他安全回家。地图就像是在未知地方的向导。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I saw a beautiful maple tree. Its red leaves were like flames. I thought, \'Maple\' must be the name given to this tree because of its unique and charming appearance. **有一天，在森林里散步时，我看到了一棵漂亮的枫树。它的红叶像火焰。我想，'maple'（枫树）这个名字一定是因为它独特迷人的外表而得来的。**

> A group of explorers were lost in a forest. But with the mapping skills of one smart member, they drew a detailed map and finally found their way out. The map they made is called mapping. **一群探险家在森林里迷路了。但凭借一位聪明成员的绘图技能，他们绘制了一张详细的地图，最终找到了出路。他们绘制的这个地图就叫做 mapping。**

> Once upon a time, a beautiful garden was marred by a sudden storm. The strong wind and rain damaged the flowers and plants. \'Mar\' means to spoil or damage something that was perfect before. **从前，有一个美丽的花园被一场突如其来的暴风雨破坏了。强风和大雨损坏了花草。'mar'的意思是损坏、破坏原本完美的东西。**

> A long time ago, a Greek soldier ran a very long distance to deliver important news. This long-distance running was like a never-ending journey. Later, people called such a long race a \'marathon\'. **很久以前，一位希腊士兵跑了很长的距离去传递重要消息。这种长距离的奔跑就像永无止境的旅程。后来，人们把这样的长距离赛跑称为'马拉松'。**

> A little boy was playing in the garden. He found a marble and it rolled into a mysterious cave. The marble shone like a star. He followed it and had an adventure. **一个小男孩在花园里玩耍。他发现了一颗弹珠，弹珠滚进了一个神秘的洞穴。弹珠像星星一样闪耀。他跟着它，展开了一场冒险。**
> 想象一下，一群勇敢的士兵在三月份（March）迈着整齐的步伐前进，他们目光坚定，口号响亮，向着目标英勇地行军。 **想象士兵在三月行军的场景来记住 march 这个单词，有三月、行军的意思**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost in a forest. She was very scared until she saw a mare. The mare gently led her out of the forest. The girl was so grateful for the mare\'s help. **从前，有个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她非常害怕，直到她看到一匹母马。母马温柔地带着她走出了森林。小女孩非常感激母马的帮助。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的花园里，有一朵神奇的花叫'margarine'。它的花瓣像奶油一样柔软，散发着独特的香味。人们发现用它能制作出美味又健康的替代品，就像我们现在用的人造黄油。 **想象在神秘花园中一朵叫'margarine'的花能制成像人造黄油的替代品**
> 想象一下，在一个美丽的海滩派对上，你手里拿着一杯清凉的饮品，它有着独特的味道，就像美丽的珍珠散发着光芒。这杯饮品就叫 margarita，是一种美味的玛格丽特鸡尾酒。 **想象在海滩派对上拿着像珍珠般独特美味的玛格丽特鸡尾酒，来记住 margarita 这个单词。**

> A student was always on the margin of passing the exam. But with hard work, he moved away from the margin and got excellent grades. Margin here means the edge or border. **一个学生总是处于考试及格的边缘。但通过努力，他摆脱了边缘，取得了优异的成绩。这里的margin指的是边缘、界限。**

> A poor artist was always on the marginal of the art world. His works were hardly noticed, just like being on the edge. But one day, a collector discovered him, and his status changed. \'Marginal\' means at the edge or border. **一位贫穷的艺术家总是处于艺术世界的边缘。他的作品几乎无人注意，就像处在边缘一样。但有一天，一位收藏家发现了他，他的地位改变了。'marginal'意思是处于边缘或边界。**

> A small company was constantly marginalized by big competitors. It was pushed to the edge of the market, just like being on the margin. But with hard work, it fought back and gained a place. **一家小公司不断被大竞争对手边缘化。它被推到了市场的边缘，就像处于边缘地带一样。但通过努力，它反击并获得了一席之地。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. Suddenly, she saw a bright marigold. It seemed to guide her home. The marigold\'s golden color was so charming. She followed it and found her way out. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。突然，她看到了一朵鲜艳的金盏花。它似乎在指引她回家。金盏花的金色是如此迷人。她跟着它，找到了出路。**

> A young man was curious about a mysterious plant called marijuana. One day, he tried it and got into big trouble. It affected his mind and life. Remember, marijuana is not a good thing! **一个年轻人对一种叫做大麻的神秘植物很好奇。有一天，他尝试了，然后陷入了大麻烦。它影响了他的心智和生活。记住，大麻不是好东西！**

> A young sailor was lost at sea. When he was about to give up, he saw a beautiful marina. It was like a haven, filled with hope. He rowed towards it and was saved. The marina became his symbol of rescue. **一个年轻的水手在海上迷失了方向。当他即将放弃时，他看到了一个美丽的码头。它就像一个避风港，充满了希望。他朝它划去并得救了。码头成了他的救命象征。**

> A chef was making a special dish. He put the meat in a special liquid called marinade to make it more delicious. The marinade had many flavors like soy sauce and herbs. It made the meat tender and full of taste. **一位厨师正在制作一道特别的菜肴。他把肉放在一种叫做腌泡汁的特殊液体里，让肉变得更美味。这种腌泡汁有很多味道，像酱油和香草。它让肉变得鲜嫩多汁，味道十足。**

> One day, Tom was marinating the chicken in a special sauce. He let it soak to make the meat more delicious. The process of soaking the chicken in the sauce is like \'marinate\'. **有一天，汤姆正在用一种特殊的酱汁腌制鸡肉。他让鸡肉浸泡在酱汁里，以使肉更加美味。把鸡肉浸泡在酱汁里的这个过程就像'marinate'（腌制，浸泡）。**

> A brave sailor was on a marine adventure. He saw colorful fish and huge waves. The sailor knew the marine world was full of wonders and mysteries. Remember, marine is related to the sea! **一位勇敢的水手正在进行海上冒险。他看到了五颜六色的鱼和巨大的海浪。水手知道海洋世界充满了奇迹和神秘。记住，marine 与海有关！**

> A man was always worried about his marital status. One day, he met a fairy who told him to be loyal and kind in marriage. From then on, he understood the importance of marital commitment and had a happy life. **一个男人总是担心他的婚姻状况。有一天，他遇到了一个仙女，仙女告诉他在婚姻中要忠诚和善良。从那以后，他明白了婚姻承诺的重要性，并过上了幸福的生活。**

> A sailor was lost at sea. He desperately needed to find land. Remembering his maritime training, he used the stars to navigate and finally reached safety. \'Maritime\' means related to the sea and ships. **一名水手在海上迷失了方向。他极度需要找到陆地。想起他的航海知识，他利用星星导航，最终安全抵达。\'maritime\'意思是与海洋和船只有关的。**

> One day, Tom was in a race. He ran very fast and crossed the finish line first. The judge made a mark on the paper to show that Tom was the winner. From then on, Tom always remembered the mark as a symbol of his success. **一天，汤姆参加赛跑。他跑得很快并第一个冲过终点线。裁判在纸上做了个标记表明汤姆是获胜者。从那以后，汤姆总是记得这个标记，把它当作自己成功的象征。**

> A thief broke into a house. But he was marked by a smart dog that left scratches on him. The police easily caught the thief because of these marked signs. **一个小偷闯进了一所房子。但是他被一只聪明的狗做了标记，狗在他身上留下了抓痕。警察因为这些显著的标记很容易就抓住了小偷。**

> A young artist\'s paintings were markedly different from others. At first, no one noticed. But as time went by, his unique style became very popular. \'Markedly\' here means noticeably or distinctively. **一位年轻艺术家的画作与其他人的明显不同。起初，无人注意。但随着时间推移，他独特的风格变得非常受欢迎。这里'markedly'意思是显著地、明显地。**

> One day, Tom lost his way in a forest. Luckily, he found a marker that pointed to the exit. The marker was like a guiding light, helping him get out safely. **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，他发现了一个指向出口的标记。这个标记就像一盏指路明灯，帮助他安全地走了出来。**

> One day, Tom went to a big market. There were many people selling and buying things. He saw colorful fruits, beautiful clothes and funny toys. It was a lively and busy place. **有一天，汤姆去了一个大市场。那里有很多人在买卖东西。他看到了五颜六色的水果、漂亮的衣服和有趣的玩具。这是一个热闹繁忙的地方。**

> A young entrepreneur had an idea for a unique product. But it wasn\'t marketable until he made some changes based on customer feedback. Finally, the improved product became highly marketable and sold well. **一位年轻的企业家有一个独特产品的想法。但在他根据客户反馈做出一些改变之前，它并不畅销。最后，改进后的产品变得非常有市场，销售良好。**

> A marketer was lost in a forest. To find the way out, he had to market his skills to get help. He used his charm and knowledge to convince others. Finally, he succeeded and got back home safe. **一位营销人员在森林里迷路了。为了找到出路，他不得不推销自己的技能以获得帮助。他用自己的魅力和知识说服别人。最终，他成功并安全回家。**

> Once upon a time, a small shop was struggling. Then, a smart guy came up with marketing ideas. He put up colorful signs and offered special deals. Soon, more people knew about the shop and it became popular. Marketing made the difference! **从前，一家小店经营困难。后来，一个聪明的人想出了营销的主意。他挂起了彩色的招牌，还提供特别的优惠。很快，更多的人知道了这家店，它变得受欢迎起来。营销带来了改变！**

> In a small town, there was a lively marketplace. Every day, people came here to buy and sell. One day, a little girl lost her toy in the marketplace. But with the help of kind sellers, she found it. This marketplace was full of surprises and warmth. **在一个小镇上，有一个热闹的市场。每天，人们来这里买卖。有一天，一个小女孩在市场里丢了她的玩具。但在善良的卖家帮助下，她找到了。这个市场充满了惊喜和温暖。**

> A student was marking his favorite books with colorful stickers. One day, he lost a book but found it easily because of the unique markings. The act of marking helped him a lot. **一名学生用彩色贴纸标记他最喜欢的书。有一天，他丢了一本书，但因为独特的标记很容易就找到了。标记这个行为帮了他大忙。**

> A brave adventurer was marooned on a deserted island. He had no way to leave and felt very lonely. But he didn\'t give up and finally found a way to survive. \'Maroon\' means to leave someone in a desolate place with no way to escape. **一位勇敢的探险家被困在一个荒岛上。他无路可走，感到非常孤独。但他没有放弃，最终找到了生存的方法。\'maroon\'意思是把某人困在一个荒僻的地方无法逃脱。**
> 想象一下，在一个盛大的派对上，有一个巨大的、华丽的帐篷（marquee），它非常引人注目。人们在帐篷下跳舞、欢笑，这个独特的帐篷成为了派对的焦点。 **想象在派对上有一个引人注目的大帐篷来辅助记忆\'marquee（大帐篷；华盖）\'这个单词**

> A prince and a princess fell in love. They had a big ceremony and promised to be together forever. This event was called marriage. It means the state of being united to a person as a partner for life. **一位王子和一位公主坠入爱河。他们举行了盛大的仪式，并承诺永远在一起。这个事件被称为婚姻。它指的是作为伴侣与某人终身结合的状态。**

> A prince and a princess fell in love and had a grand wedding. They became married and lived happily ever after. They shared joy and sorrow, always staying together. **一位王子和一位公主坠入爱河并举行了盛大的婚礼。他们结婚了，从此过上了幸福的生活。他们同甘共苦，永远在一起。**

> A brave mouse ventured into a deep cave and found a shiny crystal. It was said that the crystal held the essence of life, like the marrow inside our bones. The mouse took it and felt full of energy. **一只勇敢的老鼠冒险进入一个深洞，发现了一颗闪亮的水晶。据说这颗水晶蕴含着生命的精华，就像我们骨头里的骨髓。老鼠拿走了它，感觉充满了能量。**

> Once upon a time, there was a prince. He wanted to marry the beautiful princess. They held a grand wedding and lived happily ever after. The word\'marry\' means to unite two people in a legal and loving bond. **从前，有一位王子。他想娶美丽的公主。他们举办了盛大的婚礼，从此幸福地生活在一起。单词\'marry\'意思是在法律和爱情的约束下使两人结合。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange place. He found himself surrounded by water and soft, wet ground. It was a marsh! He struggled to move forward, but the marsh made it very difficult. Finally, he was rescued. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个陌生的地方迷路了。他发现自己被水和柔软、潮湿的地面包围着。这是一片沼泽！他艰难地向前走，但沼泽让这变得非常困难。最后，他获救了。**

> A brave general was marshalling his troops before a big battle. He shouted loudly, making sure everyone was in position. The word \'marshal\' means to organize and arrange effectively, just like the general did. **一位勇敢的将军在一场大战前正在整队他的军队。他大声呼喊，确保每个人都在自己的位置上。单词\'marshal\'意思是有效地组织和安排，就像这位将军所做的那样。**

> A witch had a magic pot. She could make potions of different powers. The size of the pot was medium. Not too big, not too small. It was just right for her special spells. **一个女巫有一个魔法锅。她可以制作不同效力的药水。这个锅的尺寸是中等的。不太大，也不太小。对她的特殊魔法来说刚刚好。**

> A runner participated in a race. Instead of running in a straight line, he ran through a medley of paths, including a forest trail, a sandy beach, and a grassy field. This showed the variety and mixture of routes, just like the meaning of\'medley\'. **一名跑步者参加了一场比赛。他没有直线奔跑，而是跑过了各种各样的路径，包括森林小径、沙滩和草地。这展示了路线的多样性和混合，就像\'medley\'这个词的意思。**
> 有一只小羊，性格特别 meek，从不和其他动物争抢食物。每次遇到比它强大的动物，它总是温顺地低下头。它的 meek 性格让大家都很喜欢它，也愿意保护它。 **有一只小羊，性格特别温顺，从不和其他动物争抢食物。每次遇到比它强大的动物，它总是温顺地低下头。它的温顺性格让大家都很喜欢它，也愿意保护它。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the park. Suddenly, he met his old friend Lily. They were so happy to see each other and had a great chat. The meeting made Tom\'s day. **一天，汤姆正在公园散步。突然，他遇见了他的老朋友莉莉。他们见到彼此非常高兴，并愉快地聊天。这次相遇让汤姆度过了美好的一天。**

> One day, Tom was very nervous because he had an important meeting. It was about a new project that could change his career. When he arrived at the meeting room, he took a deep breath and was ready to show his ideas. **一天，汤姆非常紧张，因为他有一个重要的会议。这是关于一个可能改变他职业生涯的新项目。当他到达会议室时，他深吸一口气，准备展示他的想法。**
> 想象一下，在未来世界，有一个超级英雄叫 Mega Man。他拥有巨大的力量，可以轻松击败任何敌人。他的力量来源就是他身上的 mega 能量核心，这让他无比强大。 **想象在未来，有个叫超级侠的超级英雄，他靠身上的mega能量核心变得强大无比。**
> 想象一下，有一个超级大的发电厂，里面有一台巨大的机器，它能产生超强的电力，每小时能输出一百万瓦的能量，这强大的能量单位就叫 megawatt。 **想象一个超级大的发电厂里有台每小时能输出一百万瓦能量的巨大机器，这个能量单位叫megawatt（兆瓦）。**
> 从前有个画家，每当他独自在昏暗的房间里作画时，心中就涌起一种忧伤的情绪，这种情绪就像他笔下的阴影，挥之不去，这就是\'melancholy\'。 **从前有个画家，每当他独自在昏暗的房间里作画时，心中就涌起一种忧伤的情绪，这种情绪就像他笔下的阴影，挥之不去，这就是"忧郁；悲哀；愁思"。**
> 想象一个黑暗的洞穴里，有一只神秘的怪物，它身上的黑斑（melan）不断变化，形成了一个巨大的肿块（oma）。这可怕的黑斑肿块就是 melanoma（黑素瘤）。 **想象在黑暗洞穴中，怪物身上变化的黑斑形成肿块，代表黑素瘤**

> Once upon a time, two metals were heated and combined. They melded together perfectly, forming a new and stronger material. This shows how \'meld\' means to combine or blend smoothly. **从前，两种金属被加热并结合在一起。它们完美地融合了，形成了一种新的更坚固的材料。这展示了\'meld\'这个词表示平滑地合并或融合的意思。**

> In a fantasy world, a brave knight found himself in a melee. Surrounded by enemies, he fought bravely. The melee was chaotic, but he held his ground. Finally, he emerged victorious. **在一个幻想世界里，一位勇敢的骑士发现自己身处一场混战之中。被敌人包围，他英勇作战。这场混战十分混乱，但他坚守阵地。最终，他取得了胜利。**

> A young musician was always tense. But one day, he played in a peaceful garden and felt the warm sunlight. Suddenly, his music became mellow, like a soft breeze. He realized that mellow means soft and smooth. **一位年轻的音乐家总是很紧张。但有一天，他在一个宁静的花园里演奏，感受到了温暖的阳光。突然，他的音乐变得柔和了，就像轻柔的微风。他意识到 mellow 意味着柔和、圆润。**

> A little bird with a melodic voice flew into a forest. Its singing was so beautiful that all the animals stopped to listen. The sweet and charming sound was just like the meaning of\'melodic\'. **一只嗓音悦耳动听的小鸟飞进了森林。它的歌声如此美妙，所有动物都停下来倾听。这甜美迷人的声音就如同\'melodic\'这个词的意思。**

> A young actor was always chosen for melodrama roles. One day, he got lost in a big theater. When found, he was singing a sad song, just like in a melodrama. That\'s how he remembered the word - meaning an exaggerated, emotional drama. **一位年轻演员总是被选去演情节剧。有一天，他在一个大剧院里迷路了。被找到时，他正在唱一首悲伤的歌，就像在情节剧中一样。这就是他记住这个词的方式 - 意思是夸张的、情感丰富的戏剧。**

> A young actor always gave very melodramatic performances. One day, in a play about love and loss, he exaggerated his emotions so much that the audience laughed. Later, he learned to be more natural. Remember, melodramatic means overly dramatic and exaggerated. **一位年轻演员总是表演得很夸张。有一天，在一场关于爱与失去的戏剧中，他的情感表现得太过了，观众都笑了。后来，他学会了更自然些。记住，melodramatic 意思是过于戏剧化和夸张的。**

> A little bird always sang a beautiful melody near my window. One day, I followed its song and found a secret garden. The bird\'s melody was like a key that opened this wonderful place. **一只小鸟总是在我的窗边唱着美妙的旋律。有一天，我跟着它的歌声，发现了一个秘密花园。小鸟的旋律就像一把钥匙，打开了这个奇妙的地方。**

> One hot summer day, I was very thirsty. Then I saw a big melon in the market. It was green and looked so juicy. I bought it and ate it. The sweet taste made me feel cool and happy. **在一个炎热的夏日，我非常口渴。然后我在市场看到一个大甜瓜。它是绿色的，看起来汁水很多。我买了它并吃了。甜甜的味道让我感到凉爽和开心。**

> In a cold winter, a snowman stood outside. But as the sun came out and shone warmly, the snowman started to melt. Its body became smaller and smaller until it finally turned into a puddle of water. **在一个寒冷的冬天，有一个雪人站在外面。但当太阳出来并温暖地照耀时，雪人开始融化。它的身体变得越来越小，直到最后变成了一滩水。**

> In a hot summer, an ice cream was placed outside. The sun was so strong that the ice cream started melting. Its shape changed, and drops of sweet liquid fell to the ground. Poor ice cream! **在一个炎热的夏天，一支冰淇淋被放在外面。太阳太强烈了，冰淇淋开始融化。它的形状改变了，甜甜的液滴掉到了地上。可怜的冰淇淋！**

> A team is like a big family. Each person in the team is a member. Imagine a football team. The players are all members. They work together to win. Just like in a family, every member has a role to play. **一个团队就像一个大家庭。团队中的每个人都是成员。想象一下一支足球队。球员们都是成员。他们共同努力去赢得比赛。就像在一个家庭中，每个成员都有自己的角色要扮演。**

> A group of friends decided to form a club. To be part of it, you needed to pay a fee and get a membership card. With the membership, you could enjoy special activities and privileges. It made them feel like a special community. **一群朋友决定成立一个俱乐部。要成为其中一员，你需要支付费用并获得一张会员卡。有了会员资格，你可以享受特别的活动和特权。这让他们感觉像一个特殊的团体。**
> 想象一下，有一个神秘的城堡，它的墙壁就像一层薄薄的 membrane（膜），保护着城堡里的秘密。这层膜很薄但很坚固，就像细胞膜一样，阻挡着外界的危险。 **想象有个城堡，其墙壁如一层膜，这层膜薄却坚固，像细胞膜阻挡危险，以此记住membrane（膜）**

> A man was on a long journey. Before leaving, his wife gave him a small keychain as a memento. Whenever he felt lonely, looking at the keychain reminded him of her love and made him brave. **一个男人正在长途旅行。临行前，他的妻子给了他一个小钥匙链作为纪念品。每当他感到孤独时，看着这个钥匙链就会想起她的爱，让他变得勇敢。**
> 有一天，老板让小明写一份重要的备忘录（memo），小明认真完成后交给了老板。老板看后很满意，夸小明的 memo 条理清晰。从此，小明记住了 memo 这个单词。 **有一天，老板让小明写一份重要的备忘录，小明完成后老板很满意，小明借此记住了这个单词。**

> A famous writer was struggling to remember his past experiences. Then he decided to write them down in a memoir. As he did, the memories became clear and he shared his wonderful life journey with the world. **一位著名作家努力回忆他过去的经历。然后他决定把它们写在一本回忆录里。当他这样做时，记忆变得清晰，他与世界分享了他精彩的人生旅程。**

> A famous singer held a huge concert. After the show, fans collected all kinds of items related to the event, like signed posters and special T-shirts. These items were called memorabilia, things worth remembering and keeping. **一位著名歌手举办了一场盛大的演唱会。演出结束后，歌迷们收集了各种与该活动相关的物品，比如签名海报和特别的 T 恤。这些物品被称为纪念品，是值得记住和保留的东西。**

> A long time ago, I had a memorable trip. I saw beautiful mountains and clear rivers. The scenery was so wonderful that I can never forget it. That experience made me understand the meaning of\'memorable\' - worth remembering. **很久以前，我有一次难忘的旅行。我看到了美丽的山川和清澈的河流。景色如此美妙，以至于我永远忘不了。那次经历让我明白了\'memorable\'这个词的意思 - 值得记住的。**
> 小明在公司接到一个重要任务，老板让他写一份备忘录（memorandum），提醒大家会议的关键内容。小明认真完成，这份备忘录帮助同事们都记住了要点。 **小明写备忘录帮助同事记住要点的故事**

> A king passed away. The people built a special place as a memorial. It was filled with pictures and writings about the king\'s great deeds. This place helped them remember and honor the king forever. **一位国王去世了。人们建造了一个特别的地方作为纪念。那里满是关于国王伟大事迹的图片和文字。这个地方帮助他们永远铭记和尊敬国王。**

> A famous artist decided to memorialize his hometown by painting a beautiful landscape. He wanted to make sure people would always remember its charm. Memorialize means to preserve the memory of something or someone. **一位著名的艺术家决定通过画一幅美丽的风景画来纪念他的家乡。他想确保人们永远记住它的魅力。memorialize 意思是纪念，缅怀。**

> One day, Tom had a big exam. To pass it, he needed to memorize a lot of knowledge. He spent hours reading and repeating, imagining the information as pictures in his mind. Finally, he successfully memorized everything and did well in the exam. **有一天，汤姆有一场大考。为了通过考试，他需要记住大量的知识。他花了几个小时阅读和重复，在脑海中把信息想象成图片。最终，他成功记住了所有内容，并在考试中表现出色。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy lost his toy. But with his strong memory, he remembered where he left it and found it again. Memory helps us keep precious moments and find what we\'ve lost. **从前，有个小男孩弄丢了他的玩具。但凭借他强大的记忆力，他记起了把玩具落在哪里，然后又找到了它。记忆力帮助我们保存珍贵的时刻并找回我们失去的东西。**

> One dark night, a strange figure emerged in the alley. His menacing look and threatening steps made everyone tremble. It felt like a menace was lurking, ready to strike. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一条小巷里出现了一个奇怪的身影。他那凶恶的表情和威胁性的步伐让每个人都颤抖。感觉有一种威胁潜伏着，随时准备攻击。**

> One day, my bike was broken. I decided to mend it. I spent hours finding the problem and fixing it. Finally, my bike was as good as new. Now I know that \'mend\' means to repair or fix something that is broken or damaged. **有一天，我的自行车坏了。我决定修理它。我花了几个小时找出问题并修好它。最后，我的自行车完好如新。现在我知道'mend'意思是修理或修复损坏的东西。**
> 想象一下，有个叫小明的人，总是做着琐碎又辛苦的工作，比如扫地、洗碗，被人看作是 menial 劳工。他感到很沮丧，但最终通过努力改变了命运。menial 就是指这种卑微、琐碎的工作或劳工。 **想象一个人做着卑微琐碎工作的情景来辅助记忆【menial】，意思是卑微的；仆人的；乏味的**
> 想象一个人在森林里迷路了（men），不小心撞到了一棵有炎症（itis）的大树，结果脑袋（-ing）受伤，引发了脑膜炎（meningitis）。 **想象一个人在森林迷路后受伤引发脑膜炎的故事来辅助记忆meningitis这个单词**

> A woman named Mary was very worried about her changing body. One day, a doctor told her it was because of menopause. Mary learned it was a natural stage when a woman\'s body stops having monthly periods. **一位名叫玛丽的女士对自己身体的变化感到非常担忧。有一天，一位医生告诉她这是因为绝经。玛丽了解到绝经是女性身体停止每月月经的一个自然阶段。**

> A girl was very worried during her menstrual period. But her friend told her it\'s a normal monthly process for women\'s bodies. So, she felt better and learned to take care of herself during this time. **一个女孩在她的经期非常担心。但她的朋友告诉她这是女性身体每月正常的过程。所以，她感觉好多了，并学会在这段时间照顾自己。**

> A crazy scientist was doing mental experiments all day. He was so focused that he forgot to eat. His mind was fully occupied with these strange thoughts. Finally, he made a great discovery. Mental means related to the mind or thinking. **一位疯狂的科学家整天都在做脑力实验。他太专注以至于忘了吃饭。他的头脑完全被这些奇怪的想法占据。最后，他有了重大发现。mental 意思是心理的；精神的；思考的。**

> A young artist struggled to create masterpieces due to a fixed mentality. But one day, he decided to change, opening his mind. Finally, he achieved great success. Mentality here means the way of thinking or attitude. **一位年轻的艺术家由于固定的思维方式而难以创作出杰作。但有一天，他决定改变，敞开思想。最终，他取得了巨大的成功。这里 Mentality 指的是思维方式或态度。**

> A brave astronaut was mentally prepared for the tough space mission. Despite facing many challenges, he stayed strong in his mind. Mentally means related to the mind or thinking process. **一位勇敢的宇航员在精神上为艰难的太空任务做好了准备。尽管面临许多挑战，他在思想上保持坚强。Mentally 意思是与精神或思维过程有关。**

> One day, Tom was having a party. When his friend asked who was coming, Tom mentioned several names, like Mary and John. His friend understood clearly. Mention means to refer to or talk about someone or something briefly. **一天，汤姆在举办派对。当他的朋友问谁会来时，汤姆提到了几个名字，像玛丽和约翰。他的朋友就清楚明白了。mention 意思是简要地提及或谈论某人或某事。**

> Once upon a time, a young man was lost in his career. Then he met a wise and experienced person called Mentor. Mentor guided him, shared knowledge and experiences, helping the young man find the right path. **从前，一个年轻人在职业生涯中感到迷茫。然后他遇到了一个睿智且经验丰富的人，叫做导师。导师引导他，分享知识和经验，帮助年轻人找到了正确的道路。**

> One day, I was very hungry and entered a restaurant. The waiter handed me a menu. I carefully looked at the menu to choose my favorite dishes. Finally, I had a delicious meal. **有一天，我非常饿，走进了一家餐馆。服务员递给我一份菜单。我仔细查看菜单来选择我最喜欢的菜肴。最后，我享用了一顿美味的餐食。**

> A brave knight was wrongly accused and lost his honor. To survive, he became a mercenary. He fought for money, not for justice. But in the end, he realized the emptiness of such a life and sought redemption. **一位勇敢的骑士被冤枉并失去了荣誉。为了生存，他成为了雇佣兵。他为钱而战，而非正义。但最终，他意识到这种生活的空虚并寻求救赎。**

> A merchant was very worried because his merchandise, like beautiful clothes and shiny jewels, wasn\'t selling well. But then he had a smart idea and decorated his store, and soon all the merchandise was sold out. **一位商人非常担心，因为他的商品，像漂亮的衣服和闪亮的珠宝，卖得不好。但后来他有了一个聪明的主意，装饰了他的商店，很快所有的商品都卖光了。**

> A merchant was on a long journey to sell his precious goods. He faced many challenges but never gave up. Finally, he made a great profit and became famous. Remember, a merchant is someone who buys and sells things. **一位商人踏上了漫长的旅程去售卖他珍贵的货物。他面临诸多挑战但从不放弃。最终，他获得了巨大的利润并出名了。记住，商人就是买卖东西的人。**

> A traveler got lost in a wild forest. Just when he was about to give up, a merciful fairy appeared. She guided him out safely. The fairy\'s kindness showed what\'merciful\' means - having or showing mercy. **一位旅行者在野外森林迷路了。就在他即将放弃时，一位仁慈的仙女出现了。她引导他安全走出。仙女的善良展现了\'merciful\'的意思 - 有或表现出仁慈。**

> A traveler was lost in a harsh desert. Mercifully, a kind nomad appeared and led him to safety. The traveler was extremely grateful for this merciful act that saved his life. **一位旅行者在恶劣的沙漠中迷路了。幸运的是，一位善良的游牧民出现并把他带到了安全的地方。旅行者非常感激这种仁慈的行为救了他的命。**

> A brave knight was captured by a cruel enemy. The enemy showed no mercy and was merciless. They tortured the knight without any pity. Remember, merciless means having no mercy or compassion. **一位勇敢的骑士被残忍的敌人俘虏了。敌人毫无怜悯之心，冷酷无情。他们毫不留情地折磨着骑士。记住，merciless 意思是无情的；残忍的；毫无怜悯之心的。**

> In a magical land, there was a speedy messenger named Mercury. He could run as fast as the wind and deliver important news. One day, he brought a secret that changed everything. Remember, Mercury is fast and important, just like this messenger! **在一个神奇的国度，有一个名叫水星的快速信使。他能跑得跟风一样快并传递重要的消息。有一天，他带来了一个改变一切的秘密。记住，mercury 是快速且重要的，就像这个信使！**

> A poor thief was caught stealing. The kind king showed mercy and let him go. The thief was very grateful and promised never to steal again. \'Mercy\' means kindness and forgiveness when punishing someone. **一个可怜的小偷在行窃时被抓住。善良的国王仁慈地放了他。小偷非常感激，并承诺再也不偷了。'mercy'这个词意思是在惩罚某人时表现出的仁慈和宽恕。**

> A traveler was lost in a vast desert. After days of walking, he came across a mere puddle of water. It was so small, but to him, it was a precious find. \'Mere\' means small or insignificant. **一位旅行者在广袤的沙漠中迷路了。走了几天后，他遇到了仅仅一滩水。水很少，但对他来说，这是珍贵的发现。\'mere\'意思是少的或微不足道的。**

> A little mouse merely wanted a piece of cheese, but it had to go through many obstacles. Finally, it got the cheese and realized that sometimes getting what you merely desire takes a lot of effort. **一只小老鼠仅仅想要一块奶酪，但是它不得不穿过许多障碍。最后，它得到了奶酪并意识到有时候得到你仅仅渴望的东西需要付出很多努力。**
> 想象一下，有两条小溪欢快地流淌着。一条叫 A，一条叫 B。突然，它们在一个地方交汇，合二为一，成为了一条更大的溪流。这就像单词 merge，意思就是合并、融合。 **想象两条小溪交汇融合来记住 merge 这个表示合并、融合的单词**

> A small company was struggling to survive. But then came a merger with a big one. It was like two rivers joining together, becoming stronger and flowing smoothly. The small company got new resources and opportunities. Now you know, this is \'merger\'! **一家小公司生存艰难。但随后与一家大公司合并。这就像两条河流汇聚在一起，变得更强大，流淌得更顺畅。小公司获得了新的资源和机会。现在你知道了，这就是'merger'（合并）！**

> A poor student named Tom worked very hard and achieved excellent grades. His efforts were recognized as having merit. Eventually, he received a scholarship for his outstanding performance. **一个叫汤姆的穷学生学习非常努力并取得了优异的成绩。他的努力被认为是有价值的。最终，他因出色的表现获得了奖学金。**

> A long time ago, in a beautiful ocean, there was a mysterious mermaid. She had a shiny tail and a kind heart. One day, she saved a drowning sailor and became a legend. Remember, a mermaid is a female creature half human and half fish. **很久之前，在一片美丽的海洋里，有一只神秘的美人鱼。她有着闪亮的尾巴和善良的心。有一天，她救了一名溺水的水手，成为了一个传说。记住，美人鱼是一种半人半鱼的女性生物。**

> A little girl was skating merrily on the ice rink. She laughed and sang, enjoying the moment without a care. Her joy was infectious, making everyone around her smile. **一个小女孩在溜冰场欢快地滑着冰。她笑着唱着，无忧无虑地享受着这一刻。她的快乐富有感染力，让周围的每个人都笑了。**
> 圣诞老人骑着驯鹿，带着满袋礼物，欢快地穿梭在雪夜。孩子们看到他，脸上洋溢着欢乐的笑容。这个充满欢乐的场景，就像\'merry\'所代表的愉快、欢乐。 **圣诞老人在雪夜带来欢乐，就像\'merry\'这个词代表的愉快、欢乐的意思。**

> Imagine you are lost in a desert. You are very thirsty and tired. Suddenly, you see a high and flat land, like a big table. That\'s a mesa. It provides a bit of shade and hope for you. **想象一下你在沙漠中迷路了。你又渴又累。突然，你看到一块又高又平的陆地，像一张大桌子。那就是台地（mesa）。它为你提供了一点阴凉和希望。**
> 想象一只小蜘蛛在努力织网，它吐出的丝相互交织，形成了密密麻麻的网格。这些网格就像单词\'mesh\'所描述的那样，相互交错、紧密相连。最终，一张完美的网织成了，这就是\'mesh\'的形象展现。 **想象一只小蜘蛛织网来辅助记忆\'mesh\'（网；网状物；网状结构；啮合）这个单词**

> A magician was performing on the stage. His charming tricks and expressions mesmerized the audience. Everyone was so focused and couldn\'t take their eyes off him. **一位魔术师在舞台上表演。他迷人的戏法和表情让观众着迷。每个人都如此专注，眼睛无法从他身上移开。**

> A traveler got lost in the desert and was very thirsty. Suddenly, he saw a mesquite tree. He knew mesquite could provide some shade and its roots might hold water. Thanks to the mesquite, he survived. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了，非常口渴。突然，他看到了一棵牧豆树。他知道牧豆树能提供一些阴凉，其根部可能存有水分。多亏了这棵牧豆树，他才得以存活。**

> One day, Tom\'s room was in a mess. His clothes were everywhere, and books were scattered on the floor. His mom was angry and said, \'Tom, you should tidy up this mess!\' **一天，汤姆的房间一团糟。他的衣服到处都是，书也散落在地板上。他妈妈生气地说：'汤姆，你应该收拾这一团乱！'**

> One day, a little bird was sent by its owner to deliver a message to a friend far away. The bird flew carefully, holding the important message in its beak. Finally, it reached the destination successfully and delivered the message. **有一天，一只小鸟被它的主人派去给远方的朋友传递一个消息。小鸟小心翼翼地飞着，嘴里衔着重要的消息。最后，它成功到达目的地并传递了消息。**

> One day, a little bird was chosen as the messenger to deliver an important message. It flew through the forest and over the mountains, finally reaching its destination successfully. The bird was a reliable messenger. **有一天，一只小鸟被选为信使去传递一个重要的消息。它飞过森林和高山，最终成功到达目的地。这只鸟是一个可靠的信使。**

> A man claiming to have a messianic mission to save the world was traveling everywhere. But people were skeptical. Later, he proved his worth with real actions. \'Messianic\' means having the nature of a savior or deliverer. **一个自称肩负拯救世界的救世主使命的人四处游历。但人们都持怀疑态度。后来，他用实际行动证明了自己的价值。\'messianic\'意思是具有救世主或拯救者的性质。**

> One day, Tom\'s room was very messy. His clothes were everywhere, and books were scattered on the floor. His mother was angry and said, \'This is such a messy room! Clean it up now!\' **一天，汤姆的房间非常凌乱。他的衣服到处都是，书也散落在地板上。他妈妈生气地说：'这房间太乱了！现在就收拾干净！'**
> 想象一下，有一个超级工厂，里面的机器不停地运转，进行各种物质的转换和能量的产生。这个工厂的运转过程就像是\'metabolic\'（新陈代谢的），不断地变化和更新，让工厂保持活力。 **想象一个超级工厂的运转过程来理解\'metabolic\'（新陈代谢的）这个词，指不断变化和更新以保持活力。**
> 想象一个小怪兽，它每天吃很多食物，然后身体内部就像一个神奇工厂，把食物转化成能量和新物质，这个小怪兽身体内部的这种神奇变化过程就叫\'metabolism\'。 **想象一个小怪兽进食后身体内部发生的神奇变化过程就叫\'新陈代谢\'。**

> A brave miner was digging deep in the cave. One day, he found a shiny object. It was a piece of precious metal. His discovery made him very happy and rich. **一位勇敢的矿工在洞穴深处挖掘。有一天，他发现了一个闪亮的东西。那是一块珍贵的金属。他的发现让他非常高兴并且变得富有。**

> A brave astronaut was exploring a strange planet. He found a shiny object that looked metallic. When he touched it, it felt cold and hard, just like metal. Later, he learned it was a precious metallic mineral. **一位勇敢的宇航员正在探索一个陌生的星球。他发现了一个看起来有金属质感的闪亮物体。当他触摸它时，感觉又冷又硬，就像金属一样。后来，他得知这是一种珍贵的金属矿物质。**

> A caterpillar dreams of a big change. One day, it enters a cocoon. After a long wait, it undergoes metamorphosis and emerges as a beautiful butterfly. The process is magical and full of surprises. **一只毛毛虫梦想着巨大的改变。有一天，它进入了一个茧。经过漫长的等待，它经历了变态发育，变成了一只美丽的蝴蝶。这个过程神奇又充满惊喜。**

> A poet was writing a poem. He wanted to describe love but couldn\'t find the right words. Then he had an idea and used a\'metaphor\' by comparing love to a blooming flower. This made his poem beautiful and touching. **一位诗人正在写诗。他想描述爱情但找不到合适的词。然后他有了个主意，用了一个'隐喻'，把爱情比作盛开的花朵。这让他的诗变得美丽动人。**

> A poet was struggling to describe a beautiful sunset. Instead of using normal words, he chose metaphorical expressions like \'The sun is a golden painter.\' This helped him convey the magic more vividly. Remember, metaphorical means using metaphors. **一位诗人努力描绘美丽的日落。他没有使用平常的词汇，而是选择了隐喻性的表达，比如'太阳是一位金色的画家。'这帮助他更生动地传达出那种神奇。记住，metaphorical 意思是隐喻性的。**

> Once upon a time, a philosopher was deeply engaged in thinking about the metaphysical world. He wondered about things beyond the physical, like the nature of existence and the meaning of life. This exploration led him to understand the concept of\'metaphysical\'. **从前，有一位哲学家深深地思考着形而上的世界。他对超越物质的事物感到好奇，比如存在的本质和生命的意义。这种探索让他理解了"形而上的"这个概念。**

> A young philosopher was always puzzled by the mysterious world beyond physics. One day, in a dream, a wise spirit introduced him to \'metaphysics\', saying it\'s the study of what lies beyond the physical. When he woke up, he never forgot this profound term. **一位年轻的哲学家总是对物理学之外的神秘世界感到困惑。有一天，在梦中，一个智慧的精灵向他介绍了"形而上学"，说这是对物理世界之外的东西的研究。当他醒来时，他永远不会忘记这个深奥的术语。**

> A brave doctor was studying a strange disease. He found that the cancer cells could spread and change locations, which he called \'metastasis\'. It was like tiny invaders moving to new places in the body. **一位勇敢的医生在研究一种奇怪的疾病。他发现癌细胞能够扩散并改变位置，他把这称为'转移'。这就像微小的侵略者在身体里转移到新的地方。**

> A king wanted to mete out rewards and punishments fairly. He measured the achievements of his subjects precisely. The word \'mete\' means to distribute or allot. **一位国王想要公平地分配奖赏和惩罚。他精确地衡量臣民的功绩。单词\'mete\'意思是分配或给予。**

> One night, while I was looking up at the sky, a bright object suddenly streaked across. It was a meteor! It burned brightly for a moment and then vanished. What a magical sight! **一天晚上，当我仰望天空时，一个明亮的物体突然划过。那是一颗流星！它闪耀了一会儿然后消失了。多么神奇的景象！**

> One night, a huge fireball streaked across the sky and crashed into a field. When people went to check, they found a strange rock. It turned out to be a meteorite. It was so special and came from far away in space. **一天晚上，一个巨大的火球划过天空并坠入一片田野。当人们去查看时，他们发现了一块奇怪的石头。原来这是一块陨石。它非常特别，来自遥远的太空。**

> One day, a little boy was very curious about the weather. He met a smart person named Mr. Smith, who was a meteorologist. Mr. Smith could predict the weather accurately and told the boy many secrets about the sky. The boy was amazed. **有一天，一个小男孩对天气很好奇。他遇到了一个聪明的人叫史密斯先生，他是一位气象学家。史密斯先生能准确地预测天气，并告诉小男孩许多关于天空的秘密。小男孩感到很惊讶。**

> One day, a little boy was running in a race. The judge used a meter to measure the distance he ran. The boy was very curious about this tool and learned that it was called a\'meter\'. **一天，一个小男孩在赛跑。裁判用一个米尺来测量他跑的距离。小男孩对这个工具很好奇，然后知道了它叫'米尺'。**

> A detective was hunting for a criminal who was dealing in methamphetamine. He followed clues and finally caught the culprit. Remember, methamphetamine is a dangerous drug! **一位侦探正在追捕一个贩卖冰毒（methamphetamine）的罪犯。他顺着线索，最终抓住了罪犯。记住，冰毒是一种危险的毒品！**

> One day, a scientist was studying a special gas. He called it\'methane\'. It\'s like a hidden power in swamps and comes from decomposed things. Now you remember\'methane\' as this mysterious gas! **有一天，一位科学家在研究一种特殊的气体。他称之为"甲烷"。它就像沼泽里隐藏的力量，来自分解的东西。现在你记住"甲烷"就是这种神秘的气体！**

> A detective was solving a case. He tried many ways, but nothing worked. Finally, he found a special method. It was like finding a key to unlock the mystery. With this method, he caught the criminal. **一位侦探在侦破一个案件。他尝试了很多办法，但都没用。最后，他找到了一个特别的方法。这就像找到了一把解开谜团的钥匙。凭借这个方法，他抓住了罪犯。**

> A detective was solving a case in a methodical way. He carefully collected evidence, made detailed notes, and followed a strict plan. His methodical approach finally led to the capture of the criminal. **一位侦探正在有条不紊地侦破一个案件。他仔细收集证据，做详细笔记，并遵循严格的计划。他这种有条不紊的方法最终使罪犯落网。**

> A detective was solving a case methodically. He first collected all the clues, then analyzed them one by one. His careful and orderly approach helped him catch the criminal. Remember, methodically means in a systematic and orderly way. **一位侦探正在有条不紊地侦破一起案件。他首先收集了所有线索，然后逐一分析。他这种仔细有序的方法帮助他抓住了罪犯。记住，methodically 意思是以系统和有序的方式。**

> A scientist was working on a complex project. He was very methodological, carefully planning each step. First, he did research. Then, he analyzed data. His methodological approach led to a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一个复杂的项目。他非常有条理，认真规划每一步。首先，他做研究。然后，他分析数据。他的有条理的方法带来了重大发现。**

> A scientist was lost in his research. Then he found a secret book on methodology. It guided him to success. With the right methods, he solved problems easily and made great discoveries. **一位科学家在研究中迷失了方向。然后他发现了一本关于方法论的秘密书籍。它引导他走向成功。有了正确的方法，他轻松地解决了问题并取得了重大发现。**

> A detective was known for being meticulous. He carefully examined every clue, noting even the tiniest details. His meticulousness helped solve many difficult cases. Just like him, being meticulous means being very careful and paying attention to details. **一位侦探以细致入微而闻名。他仔细检查每一条线索，甚至注意到最微小的细节。他的一丝不苟帮助解决了许多疑难案件。就像他一样，meticulous 意味着非常小心，注重细节。**

> A curious student was exploring a mysterious cave. He found a strange stone with metric markings. Later he learned that metric is about measurement and standards. It was an exciting discovery! **一个好奇的学生正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。他发现了一块带有公制标记的奇怪石头。后来他了解到 metric 是关于测量和标准的。这是一个令人兴奋的发现！**

> A little mouse wanted to explore the big city. It entered the metro station and saw many people coming and going. It followed them and had an exciting adventure. Finally, it understood that metro is a fast way for people to travel in the city. **一只小老鼠想要探索大城市。它进入了地铁站，看到很多人来来往往。它跟着他们，进行了一场刺激的冒险。最后，它明白了metro就是人们在城市中快速出行的方式。**

> Once upon a time, a young adventurer traveled to a huge city. People called it a metropolis. It had tall buildings, busy streets, and countless opportunities. The adventurer was amazed by the grandeur and diversity of this metropolis. **从前，有一位年轻的冒险家去到一个巨大的城市。人们称其为大都市。那里有高楼大厦、繁忙的街道和无数的机会。这位冒险家对这个大都市的宏伟和多样性感到惊叹。**

> A young man moved from a small town to a big city. He was amazed by the metropolitan life. There were tall buildings, busy streets, and diverse cultures. He realized that\'metropolitan\' means a big and busy city. **一个年轻人从小镇搬到大城市。他对大都市的生活感到惊奇。有高楼大厦、繁忙的街道和多样的文化。他明白了\'metropolitan\'意思是大都市的。**
> 想象在一个微小的实验室里，有个极小的生物在显微镜下跳舞。它太小了，我们几乎看不到，这个小小的生物就是\'microbe\'（微生物）。 **想象在一个微小的实验室里，有个极小的生物在显微镜下跳舞。它太小了，我们几乎看不到，这个小小的生物就是\'微生物\'。**

> Imagine a tiny world where microscopic creatures are having a party. These little beings are called microbial. They are so small that you need a powerful microscope to see them. They play and live in every corner of our world. **想象一个微小的世界，里面有微观生物正在举行派对。这些小小的生物被称为微生物。它们非常小，以至于你需要强大的显微镜才能看到它们。它们在我们世界的每个角落玩耍和生活。**

> A tiny mouse was lost in a big factory. Workers found it and put a microchip on it to track and help it find its way home. The microchip was so small but very useful. **一只小老鼠在一个大工厂里迷路了。工人们发现了它，并在它身上放了一个微芯片来追踪并帮助它找到回家的路。这个微芯片非常小但很有用。**

> Imagine a tiny village. Everyone and everything in it represents a larger society. This village is like a microcosm, showing all the elements and relationships of a big city in a small scale. It\'s a micro world within a larger one. **想象一个小村庄。村里的每个人和每件事都代表着一个更大的社会。这个村庄就像是一个微观世界，以小见大展现了大城市的所有元素和关系。它是大环境中的一个小世界。**

> A scientist was studying tiny particles. He called them microns. These microns were so small that they could only be seen under a powerful microscope. One day, he discovered a new property of microns that changed his research. **一位科学家正在研究微小的粒子。他称它们为微米。这些微米非常小，只有在强大的显微镜下才能看到。有一天，他发现了微米的一个新特性，改变了他的研究。**

> Imagine a tiny world. In it, there are very small creatures that we can\'t see easily. These little beings are called microorganisms. They are so small but play important roles in our lives. **想象一个微小的世界。在其中，有一些我们不容易看到的非常小的生物。这些小生物被称为微生物。它们虽然很小，但在我们的生活中起着重要作用。**

> A mouse was singing on the stage but no one could hear. So a kind fairy gave it a microphone. With the microphone, the mouse\'s voice was heard clearly. \'Microphone\' helps us hear tiny voices. **一只老鼠在舞台上唱歌，但没人能听见。于是一位善良的仙女给了它一个麦克风。有了麦克风，老鼠的声音能被清晰听见了。'microphone'（麦克风）帮助我们听见微小的声音。**

> Imagine a tiny world where a super-small hero called \'Micro\' is in charge of processing all the important tasks. This hero is the \'microprocessor\', handling everything with speed and precision. **想象一个微小的世界，有一个超级小的英雄叫"微"，负责处理所有重要的任务。这个英雄就是"微处理器"，快速且精确地处理一切。**

> One day, a scientist was very excited because he found a new MICROSCOPE. With it, he could observe tiny creatures that were invisible to the naked eye. It was like opening a door to a mysterious micro world. **有一天，一位科学家非常兴奋，因为他发现了一个新的显微镜。有了它，他能够观察到肉眼看不见的微小生物。这就像打开了通往神秘微观世界的大门。**
> 想象一下，你有一个超级迷你的显微镜。通过它，你能看到极小的、肉眼几乎看不见的东西，比如细菌。这种能看到微小细节的能力就像\'microscopic\'这个词，表示极其微小的、用显微镜才能看清的。 **想象通过超级迷你显微镜看到极小东西来理解表示极其微小的\'microscopic\'这个词**

> One day, I was very hungry. I put a pizza in the microwave to heat it quickly. The microwave made a buzzing sound and soon my pizza was warm and ready to eat. **有一天，我非常饿。我把一个披萨放进微波炉里快速加热。微波炉发出嗡嗡声，很快我的披萨就热好了可以吃了。**

> In the middle of a vast forest, a little bird was lost. It kept flying mid the tall trees, trying to find its way home. Finally, it saw a bright light and found its way out. \'Mid\' means in the middle. **在一片广阔的森林中间，一只小鸟迷路了。它一直在高大的树木中间飞，试图找到回家的路。最后，它看到了一道亮光，找到了出路。\'mid\'意思是在中间。**

> One sunny day, a little ant was very busy until midday. It needed to find food before the hottest time. Finally, it found some grains at midday and happily went back home. **在一个阳光明媚的日子里，一只小蚂蚁一直忙到中午。它需要在最热的时候之前找到食物。最后，在中午时分它找到了一些谷粒，开心地回家了。**

> In a big race, all the runners were running fast. But one runner was always in the middle of the group. No matter how hard he tried, he stayed in the middle. Finally, he understood that \'middle\' means neither at the front nor at the back. **在一场大型比赛中，所有的赛跑者都跑得很快。但有一个赛跑者总是在队伍的中间。不管他怎么努力，他都停留在中间。最后，他明白了'middle'意味着既不在前面也不在后面。**

> A midget once entered a magic forest. He was very small but had a big heart. He faced many challenges but overcame them with his wisdom. Remember, a midget is a very small person. **曾经有个侏儒走进了一片神奇的森林。他身材非常矮小，但内心强大。他面临诸多挑战，却凭借智慧克服了它们。记住，midget 指的是身材非常矮小的人。**

> One night, a brave adventurer was on a journey. When the clock struck twelve and the world was darkest, that was midnight. The adventurer had to be extra careful as strange sounds filled the air. **一天晚上，一位勇敢的冒险家正在旅途中。当钟敲响十二点，世界最黑暗的时候，那就是午夜。冒险家必须格外小心，因为空气中充满了奇怪的声音。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a vast forest. He walked and walked until he reached the midpoint. There, he found a hidden cave that led him to safety. The midpoint was his turning point. **一位勇敢的探险家在广袤的森林中迷路了。他一直走，直到走到中点。在那里，他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，这让他得以安全。中点成了他的转折点。**

> In the midst of a dark forest, a little girl was lost. She searched everywhere but couldn\'t find her way out. \'Midst\' here means the middle or center of something. Just like the girl was in the middle of the forest. **在一片黑暗的森林中，一个小女孩迷路了。她到处寻找，但找不到出路。"midst"在这里指的是某物的中间或中心。就像小女孩处于森林的中间。**

> Imagine a student studying hard for an exam in the middle of the term. This important test, the midterm, decides half of his grade. He\'s nervous but determined to do well. **想象一个学生在学期中期为一场考试努力学习。这场重要的考试，即期中考，决定他一半的成绩。他很紧张但决心要考好。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl got lost in the middle of the town. She was scared but soon found her way home. Remember, \'midtown\' means the central part of a town. **从前，有个小女孩在城镇的中部迷路了。她很害怕，但很快就找到了回家的路。记住，\'midtown\'意思是城镇的中心部分。**

> One day, I was on a long journey. When I was midway, I felt very tired but still decided to keep going. Finally, I reached my destination. Remember, \'midway\' is the middle point of a journey or process. **有一天，我在一次长途旅行中。当我走到中途（midway）时，我感到非常累，但仍然决定继续前进。最后，我到达了目的地。记住，'midway'是旅程或过程的中间点。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a woman named Mary. She was always in the middle of helping other women give birth. So, people called her \'midwife\', meaning a person who assists in childbirth. **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有个叫玛丽的女人。她总是在帮助其他妇女生孩子的过程中。所以，人们称她为"助产士"，意思是协助分娩的人。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse thought it might find cheese in a big cave. But it was not sure. \'Might\' here shows possibility. So the mouse was just considering the chance of getting cheese. **从前，一只小老鼠觉得它可能会在一个大洞穴里找到奶酪。但它不确定。这里的'might'表示可能性。所以这只老鼠只是在考虑得到奶酪的机会。**

> Once upon a time, a small ant was trying to move a big rock mightily. Everyone thought it was impossible, but the ant never gave up. Finally, with its mightily efforts, it moved the rock. **从前，一只小蚂蚁在非常用力地试图搬动一块大石头。大家都认为这不可能，但蚂蚁从未放弃。最终，凭借它强大的努力，它搬动了石头。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mighty warrior. He was so strong that he could lift a huge rock easily. His might made him a hero in people\'s hearts. The word \'mighty\' means very powerful and strong. **从前，有一个强大的战士。他非常强壮，能轻松举起一块巨大的石头。他的强大使他成为人们心中的英雄。单词\'mighty\'意思是非常强大的、强有力的。**

> A girl named Mary always got a severe headache when she saw bright lights. This headache was so bad that it felt like a monster attacking her brain. We call this kind of headache\'migraine\'. **一个叫玛丽的女孩每次看到强光就会剧烈头痛。这种头痛非常严重，就像有个怪物在攻击她的大脑。我们把这种头痛叫做'偏头痛'。**

> A migrant bird flew a long distance. It left its original home to find a better place. Just like people who are migrants, they move to seek new opportunities and a better life. **一只候鸟飞了很长的距离。它离开了原来的家去寻找更好的地方。就像那些移民者一样，他们迁移去寻求新的机会和更好的生活。**

> A group of birds decided to migrate to a warmer place. They flew long distances, leaving their old home. The journey was tough but they knew it was for a better life. **一群鸟决定迁徙到一个更温暖的地方。它们长途飞行，离开旧居。旅途艰难，但它们知道这是为了更好的生活。**

> A group of birds decided to make a migration. They flew a long distance to find a warmer place. They faced many challenges but kept going. Finally, they reached their destination. Migration means moving from one place to another. **一群鸟儿决定迁徙。它们长途飞行去寻找更温暖的地方。它们面临诸多挑战但仍继续前行。最终，它们到达了目的地。migration 意思是从一个地方迁移到另一个地方。**

> A group of migratory birds flew a long distance. They left their old home to find a warmer place. Their migratory journey was full of challenges but also hope for a better life. **一群候鸟飞了很长的距离。它们离开旧家去寻找更温暖的地方。它们的迁徙之旅充满挑战，但也充满对更好生活的希望。**

> One day, Mike was lost in a forest. He shouted loudly for help. Luckily, a kind hunter heard him and led him out. From then on, Mike learned to be more careful when exploring. **有一天，迈克在森林里迷路了。他大声呼救。幸运的是，一位善良的猎人听到了他的呼喊并带他走了出来。从那以后，迈克学会了在探索时要更加小心。**

> A mild winter came. The sun was gentle and the wind was soft. People wore light jackets and enjoyed the pleasant weather. It was not too cold, just mild, making everyone feel comfortable and happy. **一个温和的冬天来临了。太阳很柔和，风也很轻柔。人们穿着轻便的夹克，享受着宜人的天气。天气不太冷，只是温和的，让每个人都感到舒适和快乐。**

> One day, Tom found some strange spots on his favorite book. He realized it was mildew. The mildew grew because the book was left in a damp corner. He quickly moved the book to a dry place to prevent more damage. **一天，汤姆在他最喜欢的书上发现了一些奇怪的斑点。他意识到这是霉菌。霉菌生长是因为书被留在了潮湿的角落。他迅速把书移到干燥的地方以防止更多的损坏。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a forest. A kind old man found her and mildly said, \'Don\'t worry, I\'ll help you find your way home.\' His gentle tone made the girl feel safe. **有一天，一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。一位善良的老人发现了她，并温和地说：'别担心，我会帮你找到回家的路。'他温柔的语气让小女孩感到安全。**

> A traveler was very proud of his mileage. He had traveled many miles and recorded every journey. The more miles he covered, the higher his mileage became. It was a sign of his adventures. **一位旅行者对他的里程数感到非常自豪。他已经旅行了很多英里，并记录了每一次旅程。他走过的英里数越多，他的里程数就越高。这是他冒险的标志。**

> A young entrepreneur was working hard on his startup. When he finally signed a big contract, it was a milestone. It marked a significant step forward in his business journey, showing that his efforts were paying off. **一位年轻的企业家努力经营他的创业公司。当他最终签下一份大合同时，这是一个里程碑。它标志着他的商业之旅向前迈出了重要的一步，表明他的努力得到了回报。**

> A little mouse was lost in a strange milieu. It was a new and unfamiliar place with many paths. But finally, it found its way home. The milieu was like a maze but the mouse was brave. **一只小老鼠在一个陌生的环境中迷路了。这是一个新的、不熟悉的地方，有很多条路。但最后，它找到了回家的路。这个环境就像一个迷宫，但老鼠很勇敢。**

> A brave soldier was known for his militancy. He always showed great courage and determination in battles. His militancy inspired others to fight fearlessly. One day, he led a successful attack and became a hero. **一位勇敢的士兵以他的战斗精神而闻名。他在战斗中总是展现出巨大的勇气和决心。他的战斗精神激励着其他人无畏地战斗。有一天，他领导了一次成功的进攻并成为了英雄。**

> A group of militants were planning to attack the city. But a brave soldier found out their plan and stopped them. The word \'militant\' means someone who is aggressive and ready to fight. **一群好战分子正计划袭击这座城市。但一位勇敢的士兵发现了他们的计划并阻止了他们。单词\'militant\'意思是好斗的、激进的、好战的人。**

> A young soldier was lost in the forest. He had to find his way back militarily, using his training and strategies. He remained calm and finally reached the camp successfully. **一位年轻的士兵在森林中迷路了。他不得不以军事的方式，运用他的训练和策略找到回去的路。他保持冷静，最终成功回到了营地。**

> A brave soldier named Mike was in the military. He trained hard every day to protect his country. One day, he led his team to victory in a dangerous battle. His military skills and courage were amazing. **一位名叫迈克的勇敢士兵在军队里。他每天刻苦训练以保卫他的国家。有一天，他带领他的团队在一场危险的战斗中取得了胜利。他的军事技能和勇气令人惊叹。**

> A young man was forced to join the militia. But he was scared. One night, he decided to escape. Finally, he found freedom. Remember, militia means an army of ordinary citizens. **一个年轻人被迫加入民兵组织。但他很害怕。一天晚上，他决定逃跑。最终，他获得了自由。记住，militia 意思是民兵组织。**

> A brave young man was always passionate about protecting his hometown. One day, when danger came, he joined the local militia and became a militiaman. With his courage and skills, he safeguarded the community. **一位勇敢的年轻人一直热衷于保护他的家乡。有一天，当危险来临时，他加入了当地的民兵组织，成为了一名民兵。凭借他的勇气和技能，他保卫了社区。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little cow. Its milk was so fresh and white, just like a milky river. People loved to drink the milky liquid it produced. So, when you see \'milky\', think of that lovely cow and its white milk. **从前，有一只小奶牛。它的牛奶新鲜又洁白，就像一条乳白色的河流。人们喜欢喝它产出的牛奶。所以，当你看到\'milky\'这个词，就想想那只可爱的奶牛和它白色的牛奶。**

> Once upon a time, there was an old mill by a river. The mill\'s wheel turned constantly, grinding grains into fine flour. It was the heart of the village, providing food for everyone. > In a distant future, people are celebrating the arrival of the millennium. They gather together, filled with hope and joy. Fireworks light up the sky, marking this special moment of a thousand years. **在遥远的未来，人们正在庆祝千禧年的到来。他们聚集在一起，充满希望和欢乐。烟花照亮了天空，标志着这一千年一遇的特殊时刻。**

> A little ant was walking along a ruler. It stopped at a mark and said, \'Wow, this is one millimeter!\' It was so tiny but still measurable. Remember, millimeter is a very small unit of length. **一只小蚂蚁沿着尺子走。它在一个刻度处停下说：'哇，这是一毫米！'它非常小，但仍然可以测量。记住，毫米是很小的长度单位。**

> A group of workers were busy milling in the factory. They were grinding grains into fine powder. The sound of the milling machines was loud, but they kept working hard to produce high-quality products. **一群工人在工厂里忙着铣削。他们正在把谷物磨成细粉。铣削机器的声音很大，但他们一直努力工作以生产高质量的产品。**

> Once upon a time, a poor boy dreamed of becoming a millionaire. He worked hard, saved money, and finally made it. With millions in his bank account, he lived a happy life. > 想象一下，一只小蚂蚁在赛跑，它每迈出一小步都只花费了一毫秒（millisecond）。就在这极短的时间里，它已经领先了其他小伙伴。一毫秒虽短暂，却能决定小蚂蚁的胜负。 **想象一只小蚂蚁赛跑，每步花费一毫秒，虽短却能定胜负的故事**

> A monkey saw a human dancing and was very interested. It tried to imitate the human\'s moves, showing its mimetic ability. The monkey\'s actions were just like a copycat, trying to be exactly like the human dancer. **一只猴子看到人类跳舞，非常感兴趣。它试图模仿人类的动作，展示了它的模仿能力。猴子的行为就像个模仿者，努力和人类舞者一模一样。**

> One day, I was lost in thought. My friend asked me what was on my mind. I said I was thinking about how to solve a difficult problem. \'Mind\' means the thoughts and ideas in your head. **有一天，我陷入沉思。我的朋友问我在想什么。我说我在思考如何解决一个难题。'mind'指的是头脑中的想法和念头。**

> A mindless robot was just following orders without thinking. It did repetitive tasks all day long, never using its mind. This shows what \'mindless\' means - lacking thought or awareness. **一个无脑的机器人只是在不加思考地听从命令。它整天做着重复的任务，从不用脑子。这展示了\'mindless\'的意思 - 缺乏思考或意识。**
> A brave miner was working deep in the mine. One day, he found a shiny gem and said, \'This is mine!\' meaning it belonged to him. **一位勇敢的矿工在矿井深处工作。有一天，他发现了一颗闪亮的宝石，并说：'这是我的！'意思是它属于他。**

> One day, while exploring a cave, Tom found some shiny objects. An expert told him they were minerals. These minerals were like hidden treasures in the dark cave, waiting to be discovered. **有一天，汤姆在探索一个洞穴时，发现了一些闪闪发光的东西。一位专家告诉他，这些是矿物质。这些矿物质就像隐藏在黑暗洞穴中的宝藏，等待着被发现。**
> 在一个盛大的派对上，人们来自不同的地方。音乐响起，大家开始跳舞，欢声笑语。这时，小明也走进了派对，很快就与其他人 MINGLE（混合、交往）在一起，度过了愉快的时光。 **在一个派对上，小明很快与其他人混合、交往在一起，愉快地度过时光**
> 想象一下，有一个小小的外星人来到地球，它的名字叫 Mini。Mini 身材迷你，只有手掌那么大。它到处探索，因为它的迷你身形能去到很多人类去不了的小角落。 **想象一个叫 Mini 的小外星人因身材迷你能去很多小角落来辅助记忆单词 mini（迷你，小的）**

> A little girl was given a miniature house as a gift. It was so tiny but had all the details of a real one. She loved playing with it and remembered the word\'miniature\' for its meaning of very small and detailed. **一个小女孩收到了一个微型房子作为礼物。它非常小但有着真实房子的所有细节。她喜欢玩它，并记住了\'miniature\'这个词，因为它表示非常小且精致的意思。**
> 想象一下，在一个极简的世界里，只有最基本的物品存在。这个世界里的一切都是 minimal 的，没有多余和繁杂。就像一张只有几笔线条的简笔画，以最简单的形式呈现核心。 **想象在极简世界中只有最基本物品存在的情景来辅助记忆'minimal（极小的；极少的）'这个单词**
> A designer always追求极简，他被称为minimalist。他的作品没有多余装饰，一切从简。简单的线条，少量的色彩，却创造出独特魅力。他坚信，少即是多，极简带来纯粹与美好。 **一位设计师总是追求极简，他被称为极简主义者。他的作品没有多余的装饰，一切从简。简单的线条，少量的色彩，却创造出独特的魅力。他坚信，少即是多，极简带来纯粹与美好。**

> A little mouse was exploring a big maze. It moved minimally, just a few steps at a time, afraid to get lost. But with its minimally cautious steps, it finally found the exit. **一只小老鼠正在探索一个大迷宫。它移动得极少，每次只走几步，害怕迷路。但凭借着它极其谨慎的小步移动，它最终找到了出口。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to minimize the damage caused by a dark magic. He used his wisdom and skills to find the source and stop it. With his efforts, the negative effects were greatly reduced. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了征程，要将黑暗魔法造成的损害最小化。他运用智慧和技能找到了源头并阻止了它。通过他的努力，负面影响被大大降低了。**

> A little ant was looking for food. It wanted to find the minimum amount needed to survive. It finally found just enough grains. The ant was happy as it met the minimum requirement. **一只小蚂蚁在寻找食物。它想找到生存所需的最少数量。它最终找到了刚刚好的谷粒。这只蚂蚁很高兴，因为它达到了最低要求。**

> A young man dreamed of holding a ministerial position. He worked hard, learned a lot, and finally achieved his goal. \'Ministerial\' refers to relating to a minister or a high position in the government. **一个年轻人梦想担任部长级职位。他努力工作，学习了很多，最终实现了目标。'ministerial'指的是与部长或政府中的高级职位有关的。**

> A young man dreams of working in the ministry. One day, he gets the chance and starts to serve the people. He feels proud and fulfilled in this important position. **一个年轻人梦想在政府部门工作。有一天，他得到了机会并开始为人民服务。在这个重要的职位上，他感到骄傲和满足。**

> One day, a family was going on a trip. They needed a vehicle that was not too big but could fit everyone. So, they chose a minivan. It was just right for their journey, with enough space and comfort. **有一天，一家人要去旅行。他们需要一辆不太大但能容纳所有人的车。于是，他们选择了一辆小型厢式车。它正好适合他们的旅程，有足够的空间和舒适性。**

> One day, a little girl went to a zoo and saw a cute animal. The zookeeper said it was a mink. The mink had shiny fur and was very lively. The girl was so impressed by the mink and remembered the word easily. **有一天，一个小女孩去动物园看到了一只可爱的动物。动物园管理员说这是一只水貂。水貂有着闪亮的皮毛，非常活泼。小女孩对这只水貂印象深刻，轻松记住了这个单词。**

> A little fish named Minnow was always ignored by the big fish in the pond. But Minnow was brave and learned many skills. Finally, it became a strong and confident fish. Remember, Minnow is a small freshwater fish. **一条叫米诺的小鱼总是被池塘里的大鱼忽视。但米诺很勇敢，学会了很多技能。最后，它变成了一条强壮且自信的鱼。记住，minnow 是指鲦鱼，一种小型淡水鱼。**

> A minor student was very nervous when facing a small test. But he realized that minor difficulties can be overcome with effort. Later, he did well. Minor here means lesser in importance or size. **一个未成年的学生在面对一场小测试时非常紧张。但他意识到较小的困难通过努力是可以克服的。后来，他考得不错。这里的minor意思是不重要的或规模小的。**

> In a small village, the minority of people had a unique skill of making beautiful pottery. They were few but their craftsmanship was highly valued. The rest of the villagers were the majority. Remember, minority means a smaller part or number. **在一个小村庄里，少数人拥有制作精美陶器的独特技能。他们人数很少，但他们的手艺备受重视。其余的村民是多数。记住，minority 意思是少数；少数派。**

> There was a little girl who loved to collect coins. One day, she found a special coin with a mint mark. It was shiny and new, just like freshly made candy. She realized that \'mint\' means something freshly made or in perfect condition. **有一个小女孩喜欢收集硬币。有一天，她发现了一枚带有铸币厂标记的特殊硬币。它闪闪发光，崭新如初，就像刚做出来的糖果。她明白了\'mint\'意味着新制造的或完美的状态。**

> A brave explorer was on a journey. He faced many difficulties. The temperature was minus 10 degrees. But he didn\'t give up. Minus here means less than zero, showing a negative value. **一位勇敢的探险家在旅途中。他遭遇了许多困难。温度是零下 10 度。但他没有放弃。这里的 minus 意思是小于零，呈现负值。**
> 想象一下，有一只极小的蚂蚁，它的身体非常 minuscule，小到几乎看不见。它努力搬运着一粒比自己大好多倍的米粒，虽然身躯 minuscule，但它的力量却让人惊叹。 **想象一下，有一只极小的蚂蚁，它的身体非常微小，小到几乎看不见。它努力搬运着一粒比自己大好多倍的米粒，虽然身躯微小，但它的力量却让人惊叹。**
> 想象一下，一只小蚂蚁正在努力爬向它的蚁巢，每一步都很微小（minute）。它花费了好多好多分钟（minute）才到达。小蚂蚁的微小步伐和漫长时间，就是\'minute\'的含义。 **想象一只小蚂蚁努力爬向蚁巢的情景，体现minute有微小和分钟的意思**

> A detective was solving a case and paid great attention to every minutia. Even a tiny scratch on the wall or a misplaced object was crucial. Finally, he caught the criminal based on these small details. **一位侦探在破案时，对每一个细节都极为关注。哪怕墙上的一道小划痕，或是一个放错位置的物品都至关重要。最终，他依据这些细微之处抓住了罪犯。**

> One day, I was lost in a deep forest. Just when I felt hopeless, a sudden light led me out. It was a miracle! I realized that miracles can happen when we least expect them. **有一天，我在一个幽深的森林里迷路了。就在我感到绝望的时候，突然一道光引领我走了出来。这是一个奇迹！我意识到奇迹会在我们最意想不到的时候发生。**

> A poor man was lost in the forest. Just when he felt hopeless, a miraculous light guided him out. It was like a magical force saving him. He was so grateful for this unexpected and wonderful help. **一个穷人在森林里迷路了。就在他感到绝望的时候，一道神奇的光引导他走了出来。就像是一股神奇的力量拯救了他。他非常感激这意想不到的奇妙帮助。**

> In the hot desert, a thirsty traveler saw what seemed like a clear lake ahead - a mirage. But as he got closer, it vanished. It was just an illusion caused by the heat. Remember, a mirage is a false image. **在炎热的沙漠中，一位口渴的旅行者看到前方似乎有一个清澈的湖泊------这是海市蜃楼。但当他走近时，它消失了。这只是由炎热造成的幻觉。记住，mirage 就是虚幻的景象。**

> A traveler was walking in the forest and suddenly got stuck in the mire. He struggled hard but couldn\'t move. Just when he was about to give up, a kind woodcutter came and pulled him out. **一位旅行者在森林里行走，突然陷入了泥潭。他拼命挣扎却无法动弹。就在他快要放弃的时候，一位好心的樵夫过来把他拉了出来。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was very sad because she couldn\'t see her beautiful face. Then she found a magic mirror that showed her how lovely she was. The mirror made her happy. Remember, this is a mirror! **从前，有个小女孩因为看不到自己美丽的脸蛋而非常伤心。然后她发现了一面神奇的镜子，镜子向她展示了她有多么可爱。这面镜子让她开心起来。记住，这就是镜子！**

> Once upon a time, there was a naughty monkey in the zoo. It climbed the trees when it wasn\'t supposed to and threw bananas at visitors. This monkey misbehaved and caused a lot of trouble. **从前，动物园里有一只顽皮的猴子。它在不该爬树的时候爬树，还向游客扔香蕉。这只猴子行为不端，惹了很多麻烦。**

> One day, Tom was caught for misbehavior at school. He threw a paper ball in the classroom and disturbed the class. His teacher was very angry and punished him. From then on, Tom decided to correct his misbehavior. **有一天，汤姆在学校因行为不当被抓住。他在教室里扔纸球扰乱了课堂。他的老师非常生气并惩罚了他。从那以后，汤姆决定改正他的不当行为。**

> One day, a scientist made a miscalculation in his experiment. He thought the chemical reaction would happen in a certain way, but it didn\'t. This miscalculation led to unexpected results and taught him to be more careful in the future. **有一天，一位科学家在他的实验中算错了。他以为化学反应会以某种方式发生，但事实并非如此。这次的错误计算导致了意想不到的结果，并让他以后更加小心。**

> A woman was very sad because of a miscarriage. She had expected a new life but lost it. This painful experience made the word\'miscarriage\' deeply engraved in her mind. **一位女士因流产非常伤心。她曾期待新生命的到来却失去了。这个痛苦的经历让"miscarriage（流产）"这个词深深地刻在了她的脑海里。**

> One day, Tom was in a miscellaneous store. There were all kinds of items, from toys to books. It was so confusing! But he finally found what he wanted. Remember, miscellaneous means consisting of a mixture of various kinds. **一天，汤姆在一家杂货店里。那里有各种各样的物品，从玩具到书籍。太杂乱了！但他最终还是找到了他想要的。记住，miscellaneous 意思是各种各样的混合。**

> A naughty monkey was always up to mischief in the zoo. It would steal visitors\' hats and play tricks on other animals. One day, it got itself into trouble but learned its lesson. \'Mischief\' means naughty or harmful behavior. **一只顽皮的猴子在动物园里总是调皮捣蛋。它会偷游客的帽子，还捉弄其他动物。有一天，它给自己惹了麻烦，但也得到了教训。\'mischief\'意思是顽皮的或有害的行为。**

> Once upon a time, there was a monkey who was always mischievous. It would steal fruits from the market and play tricks on other animals. Everyone knew this monkey was full of mischief. **从前，有一只猴子总是很顽皮。它会从市场偷水果，还会对其他动物搞恶作剧。大家都知道这只猴子充满了顽皮捣蛋的行为。**

> A student always thought that all birds could fly. But when he saw a penguin, he realized it was a misconception. Not all birds have the ability to fly. This made him understand the meaning of misconception. **一个学生一直认为所有的鸟都会飞。但当他看到企鹅时，他意识到这是一个错误的观念。并非所有的鸟都有飞行的能力。这让他明白了misconception（错误观念）的意思。**

> A scientist was accused of misconduct. He misused the research funds and conducted experiments wrongly. This led to serious consequences. Remember, misconduct means bad behavior, especially by someone in a position of responsibility. **一位科学家被指控行为不当。他滥用研究资金并且错误地进行实验。这导致了严重的后果。记住，misconduct 意思是不当行为，尤指处于负责地位的人的不良行为。**

> One night, Tom saw a thief stealing. But instead of stopping him, Tom just watched. Later, he realized this was a misdeed. He should have acted to prevent the crime. **一天晚上，汤姆看到一个小偷在行窃。但他只是看着，没有阻止。后来，他意识到这是一种恶行。他应该采取行动来阻止犯罪。**

> A thief was caught stealing a small amount of money. The judge said it was a misdemeanor, not a serious crime. But still, the thief had to face some punishment for this wrong act. **一个小偷被抓到偷了少量的钱。法官说这是轻罪，不是严重的罪行。但即便如此，这个小偷仍要为这一错误行为面临一些惩罚。**

> A poor man was lost in a stormy night. He had no shelter, no food, and felt extremely cold. His situation was miserable. He wished for a warm bed and a hot meal. **一个穷人在一个暴风雨的夜晚迷路了。他没有庇护所，没有食物，感到极度寒冷。他的处境悲惨。他渴望一张温暖的床和一顿热饭。**

> A poor man was lost in a stormy night. He had no shelter and was miserably cold and hungry. Later, he was found by kind people and finally got help. **一个穷人在一个暴风雨的夜晚迷路了。他没有遮蔽处，又冷又饿，悲惨极了。后来，他被好心人发现，最终得到了帮助。**

> Once upon a time, there was a robot named Misfit. It didn\'t fit in with other robots because it had unique ideas. But in the end, its uniqueness saved the day. So, misfit means someone or something that doesn\'t fit in. **从前，有一个叫 Misfit 的机器人。它和其他机器人合不来，因为它有独特的想法。但最后，它的独特性拯救了局面。所以，misfit 指不合群的人或物。**

> A poor man was always facing difficulties. One day, he lost his job and then got sick. This series of unlucky events was his misfortune. But he didn\'t give up and finally found a way out. **一个可怜的人总是面临困境。有一天，他丢了工作，然后又生病了。这一系列不幸的事就是他的厄运。但他没有放弃，最终找到了出路。**

> A young man had misgivings about going on a solo trip. But he overcame his fears and had an amazing adventure. The misgivings vanished as he discovered new places. **一个年轻人对独自旅行心存疑虑。但他克服了恐惧，有了一次奇妙的冒险。当他发现新地方时，这些疑虑消失了。**

> A man decided to take a shortcut through a dark forest, thinking it would save time. But it was a misguided choice. He got lost and faced many dangers. Finally, he realized his mistake. \'Misguided\' means wrongly directed or based on a wrong idea. **一个男人决定穿过一片黑暗的森林走捷径，以为这样能节省时间。但这是个错误的选择。他迷路了，还面临许多危险。最后，他意识到了自己的错误。\'misguided\'意思是被错误引导的或基于错误想法的。**

> A clumsy worker mishandled the precious vase, causing it to fall and break. He didn\'t handle the situation with care and ruined a valuable item. Remember, mishandle means to handle something wrongly or carelessly. **一个笨拙的工人错误地处理了珍贵的花瓶，导致它掉落并破碎。他没有小心处理这个情况，毁掉了一件贵重物品。记住，mishandle 意思是错误地或粗心地处理。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to catch a train. He ran and accidentally tripped, dropping all his luggage. This unexpected accident was a mishap. But luckily, he still made it to the train on time. **有一天，汤姆匆忙赶火车。他跑着跑着意外绊倒了，行李都掉了。这个意想不到的意外就是不幸之事。但幸运的是，他还是按时赶上了火车。**

> A detective was on a case. The criminal spread misinformation to confuse him. But the detective was smart and saw through the lies. Finally, he found the truth. Misinformation means wrong or false information. **一位侦探在办案。罪犯散布错误信息来迷惑他。但侦探很聪明，识破了谎言。最后，他找到了真相。misinformation 意思是错误的或虚假的信息。**

> One day, Tom sent a message to Mary, but Mary misinterpreted it. She thought Tom was angry when actually he was joking. This caused a big misunderstanding. **有一天，汤姆给玛丽发了一条消息，但玛丽误解了它。她以为汤姆生气了，而实际上他是在开玩笑。这造成了很大的误会。**

> One day, Tom misjudged the distance when he tried to jump over a small ditch. He thought it was shorter than it actually was and ended up falling in. Misjudge means to judge wrongly or inaccurately. **有一天，汤姆在试图跳过一个小沟渠时误判了距离。他以为比实际距离短，结果掉进去了。misjudge 意思是错误地判断或不准确地判断。**

> One day, a little rabbit was lost in the forest. A tricky fox came and mislead the rabbit, making it go in the wrong direction. Poor rabbit! \'Mislead\' means to give wrong information and lead someone in the wrong way. **一天，一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。一只狡猾的狐狸过来误导了小兔子，让它走错了方向。可怜的小兔子！'mislead'意思是提供错误的信息，把某人引向错误的道路。**

> A traveler was given misleading directions. He was told to turn left when it should be right. As a result, he got lost. This shows how misleading information can cause problems. **一位旅行者得到了错误的指引。他被告知向左转，而实际上应该向右转。结果，他迷路了。这表明了误导性的信息会造成问题。**

> A company was on the verge of collapse due to mismanagement. The managers made wrong decisions, wasted resources, and ignored important issues. This led to chaos and losses. Remember, mismanagement can ruin everything! **一家公司由于管理不善而濒临倒闭。经理们做出错误的决策，浪费资源并且忽视重要问题。这导致了混乱和损失。记住，管理不善会毁掉一切！**

> There was a big game. The coach found a mismatch in the players\' heights. The tall players were on one team, and the short ones on the other. This imbalance made it hard to play fairly. **有一场大型比赛。教练发现球员身高不匹配。高个子球员在一队，矮个子球员在另一队。这种不平衡让比赛很难公平进行。**

> One day, Tom misplace his favorite toy car. He looked everywhere but couldn\'t find it. Finally, he found it under the sofa. It taught him to be more careful with his things. **有一天，汤姆放错了他最喜欢的玩具汽车。他到处找但都找不到。最后，他在沙发下面找到了。这教会他要更小心地对待自己的东西。**

> One day, Tom misread the time on the ticket and arrived at the cinema late. He thought it was 7 pm, but actually it was 6 pm. This mistake made him miss the beginning of the movie. **有一天，汤姆误读了电影票上的时间，到电影院迟到了。他以为是晚上 7 点，但实际上是 6 点。这个错误让他错过了电影的开头。**

> A politician was accused of misrepresenting the facts. He said the new policy would create thousands of jobs, but it turned out to be a lie. People were angry because his words misled them. **一位政治家被指控歪曲事实。他说新政策会创造数千个工作岗位，但结果这是个谎言。人们很生气，因为他的话误导了他们。**

> A businessman was accused of misrepresentation. He claimed his product was made of pure gold, but it wasn\'t. His false description caused a lot of trouble. People lost trust in him. **一位商人被指控歪曲事实。他声称他的产品是纯金制成的，但事实并非如此。他的错误描述带来了很多麻烦。人们不再信任他。**

> A girl named Lily was waiting for her friend at the station. But her friend didn\'t show up. Lily missed her friend very much. She thought maybe her friend got lost. \'Miss\' here means to feel sad because someone or something is not present. **一个叫莉莉的女孩在车站等她的朋友。但她的朋友没有出现。莉莉非常想念她的朋友。她想也许她的朋友迷路了。这里的'miss'意思是因某人或某物不在场而感到难过。**

> A mouse was in a big cave. Suddenly, it saw a strange object that looked like a missile. It was shiny and pointed. The mouse was scared and ran away quickly. Later, it learned that the missile was a powerful weapon. **一只老鼠在一个大洞穴里。突然，它看到一个看起来像导弹的奇怪物体。它闪闪发光且尖尖的。老鼠很害怕，迅速跑开了。后来，它得知导弹是一种强大的武器。**

> One day, Tom found his favorite toy car was missing. He looked everywhere but couldn\'t find it. Later, he discovered his little sister had hidden it under the bed. Poor Tom was so worried before finding it. **有一天，汤姆发现他最喜欢的玩具车不见了。他到处找都找不到。后来，他发现是他的小妹妹把它藏在了床底下。在找到之前，可怜的汤姆好担心。**

> A brave astronaut was given a mission to explore a distant planet. He was determined to complete it successfully. The mission was full of challenges, but he never gave up. **一位勇敢的宇航员接到了探索一颗遥远行星的任务。他决心成功完成它。这个任务充满了挑战，但他从未放弃。**

> A young man decided to become a missionary. He traveled far to a poor village. There, he taught kids and helped build houses. His mission was to bring hope and love. **一个年轻人决定成为一名传教士。他长途跋涉去到一个贫困的村庄。在那里，他教孩子们并帮忙建房。他的使命就是带来希望和爱。**

> One day, a climber was on a difficult mountain path. A misstep made him lose his balance and almost fall. Luckily, he caught a branch in time. This misstep taught him to be more careful. **有一天，一位登山者在艰难的山路上。一个失足让他失去平衡，差点摔倒。幸运的是，他及时抓住了一根树枝。这次失足教会他要更加小心。**

> One day, I went for a walk in the forest. Suddenly, a thick mist appeared and everything around me became hazy. I couldn\'t see clearly. It was like being in a mysterious world. **有一天，我去森林里散步。突然，一层浓雾出现了，我周围的一切都变得朦胧。我看不清楚。就好像身处一个神秘的世界。**
> One day, Tom thought the cat was in the box, but it wasn\'t. He was mistaken. Later, he realized his mistake and learned to be more careful. **有一天，汤姆以为猫在盒子里，但其实不在。他弄错了。后来，他意识到自己的错误并学会更仔细。**

> One day, Tom mistakenly took his sister\'s bag to school. When he realized it, he rushed home to change. This made him late for class. But he learned to be more careful next time. **一天，汤姆错误地拿了他妹妹的书包去学校。当他意识到的时候，他冲回家去换。这让他上课迟到了。但他学会了下次要更小心。**

> One day, a little boy was lost. A kind man came and helped him. The boy asked, \'Mister, how can I thank you?\' The man just smiled. \'Mister\' here means a man, especially one who is respected. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了。一位善良的男士走过来帮助了他。小男孩问道：'先生，我该怎么感谢您？'这里的'mister'指的是男士，尤其是受人尊敬的男士。**

> One day, a poor puppy was mistreated by its cruel owner. The owner didn\'t give it enough food or care. But luckily, a kind girl found it and saved the puppy from such bad treatment. Remember, \'mistreat\' means to treat someone or something badly. **有一天，一只可怜的小狗被它残忍的主人虐待。主人不给它足够的食物和照顾。但幸运的是，一个善良的女孩发现了它，并把小狗从这种恶劣的对待中解救了出来。记住，\'mistreat\'意思是恶劣地对待某人或某物。**

> A poor little rabbit was constantly subjected to mistreatment by a mean farmer. It was starved and beaten. But finally, the rabbit was rescued and the farmer was punished. Remember, mistreatment is bad behavior! **一只可怜的小兔子不断遭受一个刻薄农民的虐待。它挨饿又挨打。但最后，兔子被救了，农民受到了惩罚。记住，mistreatment 就是恶劣的对待！**

> A young man fell in love with a mysterious woman. But he later discovered she was the mistress of a rich man. He was heartbroken. Remember, \'mistress\' means a woman having an extramarital relationship with a married man. **一个年轻男子爱上了一位神秘女子。但后来他发现她是一个有钱人的情妇。他心碎了。记住，\'mistress\'意思是情妇，与已婚男人有婚外情的女人。**

> Once upon a time, Tom always suspected others\' motives, showing a lot of mistrust. One day, he realized his mistake and started to trust people. From then on, his life became happier. **从前，汤姆总是怀疑别人的动机，表现出很多的不信任。有一天，他意识到了自己的错误并开始信任别人。从那以后，他的生活变得更快乐了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little ant called Mite. It was very tiny but worked very hard. Despite its small size, Mite made a big difference in the anthill. Remember, mite means a very small creature or a tiny amount. **从前，有一只小蚂蚁叫米特。它非常小但工作非常努力。尽管它体型很小，米特在蚁巢中发挥了很大的作用。记住，mite 意思是非常小的生物或极少量。**

> A king was very worried about the damage caused by a flood. His wise advisor suggested some measures that could mitigate the disaster. Finally, the negative effects were reduced. **一位国王对洪水造成的破坏非常担忧。他聪明的顾问提出了一些能够减轻这场灾难的措施。最终，负面影响被降低了。**

> One day, a little boy lost his mitt while playing in the snow. He was very sad. But luckily, his kind sister found it for him. The mitt protected his hand from the cold. **有一天，一个小男孩在雪地里玩的时候弄丢了他的手套。他非常伤心。但幸运的是，他善良的姐姐帮他找到了。这只手套保护了他的手免受寒冷。**

> One day, the chef needed to make a special cake. He had to mix flour, eggs, sugar and milk together carefully. After that, a delicious cake was made. The process of combining these ingredients is like \'mix\'. **一天，厨师需要做一个特别的蛋糕。他得把面粉、鸡蛋、糖和牛奶仔细地混合在一起。之后，做出了美味的蛋糕。把这些食材组合的过程就像是'mix（混合）'。**

> One day, I went to a party. There were various drinks, some were juice, some were soda. They were all mixed together in a big bowl. It was a mixed drink that tasted amazing! **有一天，我去参加一个聚会。那里有各种各样的饮料，有些是果汁，有些是苏打水。它们都混合在一个大碗里。这是一种混合饮料，味道好极了！**

> One day, I was at a party. The DJ was using a mixer to blend different music tracks and create a wonderful atmosphere. The mixer was like a magic tool that made the party more exciting! **有一天，我在一个派对上。DJ 正在使用一个混音器来混合不同的音乐曲目，并营造出美妙的氛围。这个混音器就像一个神奇的工具，让派对更加令人兴奋！**

> One day, a chef was making a special dish. He combined eggs, flour, milk and sugar. This combination was a mixture. It was neither just eggs nor only flour. > One day, a little girl saw two cute kittens meowing \'mm\'. She thought they were saying \'more milk\' as they were hungry. So she gave them some milk and they purred happily. **有一天，一个小女孩看到两只可爱的小猫喵喵叫着'mm'。她以为它们在说'更多牛奶'，因为它们饿了。于是她给了它们一些牛奶，它们开心地咕噜咕噜叫。**

> A man was injured in an accident. He lay on the bed, constantly moan ing in pain. His moans made everyone around him feel worried. **一个男人在事故中受伤了。他躺在床上，不停地痛苦呻吟。他的呻吟声让周围的每个人都感到担心。**

> 想象一下，在一个黑暗的夜晚，一群暴徒（mob）突然出现在街头，他们大声喧哗，行为粗暴。警察迅速赶到，试图控制这混乱的局面。这些暴徒毫无秩序，给人们带来了恐慌。 **想象在夜晚一群暴徒出现制造混乱，警察赶来控制局面，以此辅助记忆\'mob\'（暴徒；乌合之众）这个单词。**

> A young man dreamed of having the mobility to travel the world. One day, he got a job that allowed him to move freely. With this newfound mobility, he explored many beautiful places. **一个年轻人梦想着拥有四处旅行的移动能力。有一天，他得到了一份能让他自由行动的工作。凭借这种新获得的移动性，他探索了许多美丽的地方。**

> In a small town, a disaster was coming. The mayor quickly mobilized all the people to prepare for it. They moved resources and got ready to face the challenge together. **在一个小镇上，一场灾难即将来临。市长迅速动员所有人为其做准备。他们调动资源，共同准备迎接挑战。**

> A mouse always mocked a big cat. But one day, when the cat was really angry, the mouse was scared. It learned that mocking others is not good. **一只老鼠总是嘲笑一只大猫。但有一天，当猫真的生气时，老鼠害怕了。它明白了嘲笑别人是不好的。**
