> A young man named Tom set off on a long journey. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. He was a pilgrim, seeking truth and wisdom. Finally, he found what he was looking for and returned home fulfilled. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人踏上了漫长的旅程。他面临许多困难但从未放弃。他是一位朝圣者，寻求真理和智慧。最后，他找到了他所追寻的东西，心满意足地回家了。**

> A young man set off on a pilgrimage. He walked a long way, facing many difficulties, but his faith kept him going. Finally, he reached the sacred place, feeling fulfilled. Pilgrimage means a journey to a holy place. **一个年轻人踏上了朝圣之旅。他走了很长的路，面临诸多困难，但他的信念让他坚持下去。最终，他到达了圣地，感到心满意足。pilgrimage 意思是朝圣之旅。**

> A sick man was in great pain. The doctor gave him a pill and said, \'Take this pill and you\'ll feel better soon.\' The man took the pill and indeed recovered. **一个生病的人非常痛苦。医生给了他一粒药丸并说：'吃了这粒药丸，你很快就会好起来。'这个人吃了药丸，确实康复了。**

> A brave knight was trapped in a dark cave. He found a pillar with a secret map engraved on it. The map led him out. The pillar became his savior. Remember, pillar can be a key to safety. **一位勇敢的骑士被困在一个黑暗的洞穴中。他发现了一根刻有秘密地图的柱子。这张地图带他出去了。这根柱子成了他的救星。记住，pillar（柱子）可能是安全的关键。**

> One night, a little girl had a sweet dream while lying on her soft pillow. The pillow was like a cloud, giving her a comfortable sleep. When she woke up, she hugged the pillow and said, \'Thank you for making my sleep so nice!\' **一天晚上，一个小女孩躺在她柔软的枕头上做了一个甜甜的梦。枕头就像一朵云，让她睡得很舒服。当她醒来时，她抱住枕头说：'谢谢你让我睡得这么好！'**

> One night, I had a strange dream. I saw a magical pillowcase that could talk. It told me its name was \'pillowcase\' and its job was to protect the pillow. When I woke up, I never forgot the word \'pillowcase\'. **一天晚上，我做了一个奇怪的梦。我看到一个会说话的神奇枕套，它告诉我它叫"pillowcase"，它的工作是保护枕头。当我醒来时，我永远不会忘记"pillowcase"这个词。**

> A young man always dreamed of flying. One day, he trained hard and finally became a pilot. He flew through the blue sky, guiding the plane safely. The word \'pilot\' means the person who operates the aircraft. **一个年轻人一直梦想着飞行。有一天，他努力训练，最终成为了一名飞行员。他在蓝天中飞行，安全地引导着飞机。单词\'pilot\'意思是驾驶飞机的人。**

> A man named Tom was known as a pimp. He made money by exploiting young women and forcing them into prostitution. But in the end, he was caught by the police. Remember, being a pimp is illegal and immoral. **一个叫汤姆的男人是个皮条客。他靠剥削年轻女性并强迫她们卖淫赚钱。但最终，他被警察抓住了。记住，做皮条客是违法且不道德的。**

> One day, Tom found a pimple on his face. It was red and annoying. He was so worried and tried every way to get rid of it. Finally, with proper care, the pimple disappeared. **有一天，汤姆发现自己脸上长了个痘痘。它又红又烦人。他非常担心，尝试了各种方法来除掉它。最后，经过适当的护理，痘痘消失了。**

> A thief wanted to steal a precious necklace. But when he tried to open the jewelry box, a sharp pin pricked his finger. Ouch! That pin stopped his bad plan. **一个小偷想要偷一条珍贵的项链。但是当他试图打开珠宝盒时，一根尖锐的大头针刺痛了他的手指。哎哟！那根大头针阻止了他的坏计划。**

> A thief was trying to steal a golden ring. But the ring was too small and it pinched his finger hard. He had to give up. Remember, \'pinch\' means to squeeze or press something tightly. **一个小偷试图偷一枚金戒指。但戒指太小了，紧紧地夹住了他的手指。他不得不放弃。记住，\'pinch\'意思是捏；掐；夹**

> A little squirrel was lost in the forest. It pined for its home and friends. It climbed up a pine tree, hoping to find the way back. Finally, it succeeded and felt happy. **一只小松鼠在森林里迷路了。它渴望着自己的家和朋友。它爬上了一棵松树，希望能找到回去的路。最后，它成功了，感到很开心。**

> A long time ago, people found a fruit that looked like a pine cone and tasted sweet. They named it \'pineapple\' because it combined the features of a pine cone and an apple. So, whenever you see pineapple, remember this unique mix. **很久以前，人们发现一种水果，看起来像松果，尝起来很甜。他们把它命名为"pineapple"，因为它结合了松果和苹果的特点。所以，每当你看到菠萝，就记住这种独特的组合。**

> A little girl wore a pink dress and went to a garden full of pink flowers. She was so happy and danced among the pink beauty. The color pink made her day magical. **一个小女孩穿着粉色的连衣裙去了一个满是粉色花朵的花园。她非常开心，在粉色的美景中跳舞。粉色让她的这一天充满魔力。**

> A brave climber struggled to reach the pinnacle of the mountain. After many challenges, he finally stood at the top, feeling the ultimate achievement. The pinnacle was the highest and most glorious point. **一位勇敢的登山者努力攀登到达山顶。经过许多挑战，他终于站在了山顶，感受到了最终的成就。山顶就是最高、最辉煌的点。**

> A detective was trying to solve a crime. The only clue was a tiny pin on the floor. He used it to pinpoint the exact location where the crime happened and caught the criminal. **一位侦探试图侦破一起犯罪案件。唯一的线索是地板上的一根小针。他用它精确地指出了犯罪发生的准确位置，并抓住了罪犯。**

> A long time ago, in a wild forest, there was a brave person named Tom. He was the first to explore the unknown area and build a path. Tom was a pioneer, leading others to a new and wonderful place. **很久以前，在一片荒野森林里，有一个勇敢的人叫汤姆。他是第一个探索未知区域并开辟道路的人。汤姆就是一位先驱者，带领其他人去到一个新的美妙之地。**

> A young man named Tom was always pious. He went to church every Sunday, prayed earnestly, and helped the poor. His pious heart made him a beloved figure in the community. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是很虔诚。他每个星期天都去教堂，真诚地祈祷，并帮助穷人。他的虔诚之心使他成为社区里深受喜爱的人物。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for food in a big house. Suddenly, it saw a pipe on the wall. It thought there might be something good inside. So, it climbed up the pipe to explore. **一天，一只小老鼠在一个大房子里找食物。突然，它看到墙上有一根管子。它想里面可能有好东西。于是，它爬上管子去探索。**
> 想象一下，有一条长长的管道（pipeline），像一条巨龙蜿蜒在地下。它不停地运输着珍贵的石油，从遥远的油田一直到工厂。这条管道一刻不停，为我们的生活提供能源。 **想象一条长长的管道，像巨龙般运输石油，为生活供能，以辅助记忆单词\'pipeline\'（管道；输油管）**

> A little bird was singing happily near the piping of a house. The piping was shiny and new. Suddenly, a strong wind blew, but the piping stayed firm. It was like a brave soldier protecting the house. **一只小鸟在房子的管道附近欢快地歌唱。管道闪闪发亮且崭新。突然，一阵强风吹来，但管道依然稳固。它就像一名勇敢的士兵守护着房子。**

> A girl\'s curiosity was piqued when she saw a mysterious box. She was so interested that she couldn\'t resist opening it. The feeling of intense interest and curiosity is what \'pique\' means. **一个女孩看到一个神秘的盒子，她的好奇心被激起。她兴趣如此浓厚，以至于忍不住打开了它。这种强烈的兴趣和好奇的感觉就是\'pique\'的意思。**

> A brave sailor was sailing alone. One day, he encountered a group of bad guys stealing treasures from other ships. This act of stealing at sea was called piracy. The sailor decided to fight against them and protect the ships. **一位勇敢的水手独自航行。有一天，他遇到一群坏人从其他船上偷取财宝。这种在海上的偷窃行为被称为海盗行为。水手决定与他们战斗并保护船只。**

> Once upon a time, a brave sailor was on a ship. Suddenly, a group of bad guys with black masks and sharp swords attacked. They were pirates! They stole the treasures and made everyone scared. Remember, pirate means those who rob at sea. **从前，一位勇敢的水手在船上。突然，一群戴着黑面具、拿着锋利剑的坏人袭击了。他们是海盗！他们偷走了财宝，让所有人害怕。记住，pirate 就是指在海上抢劫的人。**

> One day, when Tom was in the forest, he needed to relieve himself. So, he did what we call \'piss\'. It means to urinate. Just imagine Tom in that situation and you\'ll remember the word \'piss\'. **有一天，汤姆在森林里，他需要解手。所以，他做了我们所说的'piss'这个动作。这个词意思是小便。想象一下汤姆当时的情景，你就会记住'piss'这个单词。**

> One day, Tom was really angry because his friend broke his favorite toy. He shouted, \'I\'m so pissed!\' It means he was extremely annoyed. **一天，汤姆非常生气，因为他的朋友弄坏了他最喜欢的玩具。他大喊：'我太生气了！'这里'pissed'意思就是极其恼怒。**

> A little monkey was very hungry. It found a strange nut called \'pistachio\'. It cracked the hard shell and enjoyed the delicious green kernel inside. From then on, it always remembered the taste of pistachio. **一只小猴子非常饿。它发现了一种奇怪的坚果叫'开心果'。它敲开坚硬的外壳，享受里面美味的绿色果仁。从那以后，它总是记得开心果的味道。**

> A thief was running away with a stolen bag. A brave police officer pointed a pistol at him and shouted, \'Stop!\' The thief was so scared and surrendered immediately. **一个小偷正带着偷来的包逃跑。一位勇敢的警察用手枪指着他并大喊："站住！"小偷非常害怕，立刻就投降了。**
> 想象一下，有个超级英雄叫 Piston 侠，他的力量来自于手臂里的神奇活塞。每次他一握拳，活塞就快速运动，产生巨大能量，帮助他打败坏人。所以，piston 就是活塞的意思。 **想象有个叫 Piston 侠的超级英雄，其力量源于手臂中的神奇活塞，握拳时活塞运动产生能量助其打败坏人，所以 piston 意为活塞。**

> A brave miner was working in a deep pit. One day, he lost his lamp but didn\'t give up. Finally, he found his way out. Remember, \'pit\' is a deep hole or cavity in the ground. **一位勇敢的矿工在一个深坑里工作。有一天，他丢了灯但没有放弃。最后，他找到了出去的路。记住，\'pit\'是地面上的深洞或凹处。**

> A baseball player was on the field, ready to pitch the ball. He focused hard, wound up his arm, and threw the ball with all his strength. The pitch was perfect, making the batter miss. **一位棒球运动员在球场上，准备投球。他全神贯注，挥动手臂，用尽全力投出球。这次投球非常完美，让击球手没击中。**

> A thirsty traveler was lost in the desert. Just when he was about to give up, he found an old pitcher filled with water. It was a lifesaving pitcher that gave him hope and strength to continue his journey. **一位口渴的旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。就在他快要放弃的时候，他发现了一个旧水罐，里面装满了水。正是这个救命的水罐给了他继续旅程的希望和力量。**

> A baseball player was excellent at pitching. He practiced hard every day, throwing the ball with perfect aim and force. His pitching skills led the team to many victories. Remember, pitching is about throwing in a sport! **一位棒球运动员很擅长投球。他每天刻苦练习，以完美的准头和力量投出球。他的投球技巧让球队赢得了很多胜利。记住，pitching 在体育中是投球的意思！**

> A young adventurer was exploring a forest. He came across a deep pit that was hidden by leaves. It was a pitfall! He almost fell in. Remember, a \'pitfall\' is a hidden danger or problem. **一位年轻的冒险家正在探索森林。他遇到一个被树叶掩盖的深坑。这是一个陷阱！他差点掉进去。记住，'pitfall'就是隐藏的危险或问题。**

> A little puppy was lost and alone on the street, shivering in the cold. Its eyes were full of sadness and helplessness. It was a pitiful sight. People passing by felt sorry for it and decided to help. **一只小狗迷路了，独自在街上，在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖。它的眼睛里充满了悲伤和无助。这是一幅可怜的景象。路过的人们为它感到难过并决定帮助它。**

> One day, a little bird was injured. A kind girl saw it and felt pity. She took care of the bird until it recovered. The girl\'s compassion showed what pity means - a feeling of sadness and sympathy for someone\'s suffering. **有一天，一只小鸟受伤了。一个善良的女孩看到了，感到很怜悯。她照顾小鸟直到它康复。女孩的这种同情展现了'pity'的意思------对他人痛苦的悲伤和同情之感。**

> A gymnast was performing on the balance beam. The key point of her perfect routine was the precise pivot on one foot. It was like a magical moment that made her stand out. **一位体操运动员在平衡木上表演。她完美动作的关键在于一只脚精准的枢轴转动。这就像一个神奇的时刻，让她脱颖而出。**

> A young adventurer was lost in a forest. He found a pivotal stone that could rotate and led him to the exit. The stone was so important in guiding him. Just like \'pivotal\', meaning crucial or decisive. **一位年轻的冒险家在森林里迷路了。他发现了一块能转动的关键石头，带他找到了出口。这块石头在指引他时非常重要。就像\'pivotal\'这个词，意思是关键的或决定性的。**

> Imagine a magical world where every image is made up of tiny building blocks. These blocks are called pixels. Just like a jigsaw puzzle, pixels come together to form a clear picture on your computer or phone screen. **想象一个神奇的世界，在那里每张图像都是由微小的积木块组成的。这些积木块就叫做像素。像素就像拼图一样，在你的电脑或手机屏幕上拼凑出清晰的画面。**
> 有一天，小明特别饿，他走进一家餐厅，大声说：\'我要一份 pizza！\' 服务员很快端来一个有着丰富馅料、香气扑鼻的圆形大饼。小明吃得非常开心，从此记住了 pizza 这个美味食物的名字。 **有一天，小明很饿，走进餐厅要了一份披萨，吃得开心从而记住这个单词。**

> A group of protesters were holding placards with powerful slogans. One placard read \'Save Our Environment\'. It was a visible sign of their determination. **一群抗议者举着写有有力标语的布告牌。其中一个布告牌上写着\'拯救我们的环境\'。这是他们决心的明显标志。**

> A naughty monkey caused chaos in the zoo. The zookeeper brought it some bananas to placate it. The monkey calmed down and became friendly. So, remember, placate means to calm or soothe someone who is angry or upset. **一只顽皮的猴子在动物园里捣乱。动物园管理员给它拿了一些香蕉来安抚它。猴子平静下来并变得友好。所以，记住，placate 意思是安抚或平息生气或不安的人。**

> A little mouse was lost and needed a place to hide. It searched everywhere and finally found a cozy hole. The hole became its safe place. Now you know, \'place\' means a location or position. **一只小老鼠迷路了，需要一个地方藏身。它到处找，最后找到了一个舒适的洞。这个洞成了它安全的地方。现在你知道了，\'place\'意思是地点或位置。**

> A patient was very ill. The doctor gave him a placebo, telling him it was a powerful medicine. Surprisingly, he felt better just because he believed in it. The placebo shows the power of belief. **一位病人病得很重。医生给他开了安慰剂，告诉他这是强效药。令人惊讶的是，仅仅因为他相信，他感觉好多了。安慰剂显示了信念的力量。**

> A student was very worried about his placement in the new school. But he studied hard and finally got a good placement in the class. He was happy and felt all his efforts were worth it. **一名学生非常担心他在新学校的安置。但他努力学习，最终在班级里获得了好的安置。他很高兴，觉得所有的努力都值得。**

> A placid lake was surrounded by peaceful mountains. A little girl rowed a boat on it, enjoying the calm and stillness. The scene was so placid that it made her forget all her troubles. **一个平静的湖被宁静的山峦环绕。一个小女孩在湖上划船，享受着这份安宁与平静。这场景如此宁静，让她忘却了所有烦恼。**

> A student named Tom was accused of plagiarism. He copied others\' work in the exam and got a zero. This made him realize that plagiarism is a serious mistake and will lead to bad consequences. **一个叫汤姆的学生被指控抄袭。他在考试中抄袭他人的作业得了零分。这让他意识到抄袭是一个严重的错误，会导致不良后果。**
> 在一个古老的小镇，一场可怕的瘟疫（plague）突然爆发。人们纷纷生病，医生们日夜忙碌。勇敢的骑士决定寻找解药，最终拯救了小镇。记住这个故事，就记住了plague这个表示瘟疫、灾祸的单词。 **在一个古老的小镇，一场可怕的瘟疫突然爆发。人们纷纷生病，医生们日夜忙碌。勇敢的骑士决定寻找解药，最终拯救了小镇。记住这个故事，就记住了表示瘟疫、灾祸的plague这个单词。**

> A brave knight wore a plaid cape on his adventures. The cape had colorful stripes, making him stand out. Every time he saw the plaid pattern, he remembered his heroic deeds. **一位勇敢的骑士在冒险时穿着一件格子披风。披风有着彩色的条纹，使他格外引人注目。每次他看到格子图案，就会想起自己的英勇事迹。**

> A traveler got lost in a forest. After walking for a long time, he finally reached a plain. There were no trees or hills, just a wide and flat area. The plain was so simple and clear that he could see far away. **一位旅行者在森林中迷路了。走了很久之后，他终于到达了一片平原。那里没有树木和山丘，只有一片宽广平坦的区域。这片平原如此简单清晰，他可以看得很远。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a forest. A kind old man found him and plainly pointed out the way home. The boy followed the direction and safely returned. Plainly here means clearly and straightforwardly. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。一位善良的老人发现了他，并清楚直白地指出了回家的路。男孩顺着这个方向，安全地回去了。这里的plainly意思是清楚地，直截了当地。**

> In a courtroom drama, a poor man was harmed by a big company. He decided to fight for justice and became the plaintiff. With courage, he presented his case, hoping for a fair outcome. **在一场法庭剧中，一个穷人被一家大公司伤害。他决定为正义而战，并成为了原告。他鼓起勇气陈述自己的案子，期望得到公平的结果。**

> A little bird was lost in a big forest. It sang a plaintive song, as if crying for help. Its voice was full of sadness and longing. Finally, a kind girl heard it and helped the bird find its way home. **一只小鸟在大森林里迷路了。它唱起了哀怨的歌，仿佛在呼救。它的声音充满了悲伤和渴望。最后，一个善良的女孩听到了，帮助小鸟找到了回家的路。**

> One day, Tom had a big plan. He wanted to build a treehouse in the backyard. He made a detailed plan, drew a blueprint, and gathered all the materials needed. With his careful plan, he was sure the treehouse would be amazing. **一天，汤姆有个大计划。他想在后院建一个树屋。他制定了详细的计划，画了蓝图，并收集了所需的所有材料。凭借他精心的计划，他确信树屋会很棒。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a plane flew across the sky. The boy looked up excitedly and shouted, \'Look, a plane!\' The plane was so big and fast. **一天，一个小男孩在公园里玩耍。突然，一架飞机飞过天空。男孩兴奋地抬头喊道："看，一架飞机！"这架飞机又大又快。**

> One day, a little alien was lost in the universe. He searched everywhere and finally found a beautiful planet. It was blue and green, with white clouds. The alien was so happy and decided to call it his new home. **有一天，一个小外星人在宇宙中迷路了。他到处寻找，终于发现了一颗美丽的行星。它是蓝色和绿色的，还有白色的云朵。外星人非常高兴，并决定称它为自己的新家。**
> 想象一下，宇航员在太空旅行，迷路后意外发现一个神奇的地方，那里展示着各种星球的奥秘，这个地方就叫 planetarium （天文馆），是探索宇宙的奇妙场所。 **想象宇航员在太空迷路后发现展示星球奥秘的天文馆来辅助记忆 planetarium 这个单词**

> Imagine a group of brave astronauts on a planetary adventure. They travel from one planet to another, exploring and discovering. \'Planetary\' means related to planets, just like their exciting journey through the universe. **想象一群勇敢的宇航员进行行星冒险。他们从一颗行星旅行到另一颗行星，探索和发现。\'planetary\'意思是与行星有关的，就像他们在宇宙中的精彩旅程。**

> A man was doing a plank exercise on the beach. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and he fell onto a wooden plank. The plank was long and thick, just like the position he was holding. From then on, he always remembered the word \'plank\' for this funny experience. **一个男人正在沙滩上做平板支撑练习。突然，一阵强风吹来，他摔倒在一块木板上。这块木板又长又厚，就像他支撑的姿势。从那以后，因为这次有趣的经历，他总是记住了'plank'这个单词。**

> A little girl planned a surprise party for her mom. She made a list, bought balloons and a cake. Her careful planning made the party a great success. **一个小女孩为她的妈妈计划了一场惊喜派对。她列了清单，买了气球和蛋糕。她精心的计划让派对取得了巨大成功。**

> One day, a city was in chaos. But the planner came up with a brilliant plan. He organized everything neatly, from traffic to buildings. Finally, the city became beautiful and orderly thanks to the wise planner. **有一天，一座城市陷入混乱。但规划师想出了一个绝妙的计划。他把从交通到建筑的一切都安排得井井有条。最后，多亏了这位睿智的规划师，城市变得美丽又有序。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a forest. To find his way out, he started planning carefully. He made a map in his mind, marked possible routes, and finally succeeded. Planning is the key to success! **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。为了走出去，他开始仔细规划。他在脑海中绘制地图，标记可能的路线，最后成功了。规划是成功的关键！**

> One day, a little girl went to a garden. She saw many beautiful flowers and green grass. A kind gardener told her that all these were grown from plants. The little girl understood that plant means living things that grow in the ground. **有一天，一个小女孩去了花园。她看到许多漂亮的花和绿草。一位善良的园丁告诉她，所有这些都是从植物生长而来的。小女孩明白了 plant 这个单词指的是在地里生长的生物。**

> A traveler was lost in a jungle. Feeling hungry, he found a strange fruit. A local told him it was a plantain. Eating it gave him energy to continue his journey. **一位旅行者在丛林中迷路了。感到饥饿时，他发现了一种奇怪的水果。一位当地人告诉他这是大蕉。吃了它让他有了继续旅程的能量。**

> A long time ago, a rich man had a large area of land. He decided to plant many trees and crops on it. This big land full of plants became a plantation. And people worked there happily. **很久以前，一个富人有一大片土地。他决定在上面种很多树和庄稼。这片种满植物的大片土地就成了种植园。人们在那里愉快地劳作。**

> Once upon a time, there was a smart farmer. He was known as a great planter. Every spring, he carefully chose the seeds and planned where to plant them. His fields were always full of thriving crops because of his excellent planting skills. **从前，有一个聪明的农民。他被称为杰出的种植者。每年春天，他都精心挑选种子，并规划在哪里种植。因为他出色的种植技能，他的田地总是长满了茁壮成长的庄稼。**

> One sunny day, Tom went to the farm. He saw many workers busy with planting. They put seeds into the soil carefully, hoping for a rich harvest in the future. Tom learned that planting is the start of a wonderful journey to get delicious fruits and grains. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆去了农场。他看到许多工人正忙着种植。他们小心地把种子放进土里，期望未来有个大丰收。汤姆了解到种植是获得美味水果和谷物的美妙旅程的开始。**

> One day, a scientist was studying a strange substance on a wall. He called it \'plaque\'. It looked like a hard layer, and he found it was related to bacteria. Later, he discovered ways to clean and prevent this plaque. **有一天，一位科学家正在研究墙上的一种奇怪物质。他称其为"牌匾；牙斑"。它看起来像一层硬壳，并且他发现它与细菌有关。后来，他找到了清洁和预防这种牙斑的方法。**
> 想象一下，在一个未来实验室里，科学家们正在研究一种神秘的物质，它像流动的液体，又具有神奇的能量，这就是 plasma。它就像宇宙中的神秘力量，充满未知和可能。 **想象在未来实验室中，科学家研究的像流动液体且具神奇能量的神秘物质就是血浆（或等离子体），像宇宙神秘力量充满未知可能。**

> One day, Tom had a bad fall and hurt his leg. The doctor quickly applied plaster to his wound to protect and heal it. The plaster felt a bit heavy but it would help Tom recover soon. **一天，汤姆摔得很严重伤到了腿。医生迅速给他的伤口敷上了石膏来保护和治疗。石膏感觉有点重，但它会帮助汤姆很快恢复。**

> One day, I went to a store and saw a beautiful plastic flower. It looked so real but wasn\'t natural. I realized that \'plastic\' can be used to describe something artificial and not genuine, like that flower. **有一天，我去一家商店，看到了一朵漂亮的塑料花。它看起来很逼真但不是天然的。我意识到\'plastic\'这个词可以用来形容像那朵花一样人造的、不真实的东西。**

> One day, I was very hungry. I went to a restaurant and ordered a big meal. The waiter brought it on a shiny plate. The plate was so beautiful that I remembered the word \'plate\' easily. **有一天，我非常饿。我去了一家餐馆并点了一顿大餐。服务员用一个闪亮的盘子把餐食端了上来。这个盘子太漂亮了，以至于我很容易就记住了'plate'这个单词。**

> A traveler was climbing a mountain. After a long and tough ascent, he finally reached a wide and flat area - a plateau. There, he could rest and enjoy the beautiful view. The plateau was like a peaceful haven after the struggle. **一位旅行者正在爬山。经过漫长而艰难的攀登，他终于到达了一个宽阔平坦的区域------高原。在那里，他可以休息并欣赏美丽的景色。高原就像是历经艰难后的宁静港湾。**
> 想象一下，你正在一家医院的实验室里。科学家们正在研究一种小小的圆盘状物体，它们像盘子（plate）一样，但非常小，这些小东西被称为 platelet，它们在人体血液中起着重要的凝血作用。 **想象在医院实验室，科学家研究像小盘子的物体叫血小板，它们有凝血作用。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. He finally found a stable platform on a cliff, which was like a savior. Standing on it, he could see the way home clearly. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片陌生的土地上迷路了。他最终在悬崖上找到了一个稳固的平台，这就像救星一样。站在上面，他能清晰地看到回家的路。**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的探险家在深山中寻找宝藏，最终发现了一种极其稀有、闪耀着独特光芒的金属，它就是 platinum（白金），因其珍贵和独特，成为了众人追捧的宝贝。 **想象一下，一位勇敢的探险家在深山中寻找宝藏，最终发现了一种极其稀有、闪耀着独特光芒的金属，它就是白金，因其珍贵和独特，成为了众人追捧的宝贝。**

> Once there was a philosopher named Plato. He talked about a kind of love that was pure and not based on physical attraction. This love was called Platonic love. So, when you see the word \'platonic\', think of Plato\'s idea of pure, non-physical love. **从前有位叫柏拉图的哲学家。他谈到一种纯粹的、并非基于肉体吸引的爱。这种爱被称为柏拉图式的爱。所以当你看到'platonic'这个词，就想到柏拉图关于纯粹的、非肉体的爱的理念。**

> A platoon of soldiers was on a mission. They walked in a整齐 line, ready for any challenge. The leader shouted orders to keep the platoon united. They were brave and determined. **一排士兵正在执行任务。他们整齐地走着，准备迎接任何挑战。长官大声下达命令以保持这一排士兵团结一致。他们勇敢且坚定。**

> Once upon a time, at a big party, a waiter carried a huge platter filled with delicious fruits. Everyone was attracted by the platter. It was like a magic plate bringing joy. **从前，在一个盛大的聚会上，一个服务员端着一个巨大的盘子，里面装满了美味的水果。每个人都被这个大浅盘吸引。它就像一个带来欢乐的神奇盘子。**

> A detective was investigating a case. The suspect had a plausible excuse for being at the crime scene, but the detective wasn\'t convinced. Later, evidence proved the excuse was a lie. Plausible means seeming reasonable but not necessarily true. **一位侦探在调查一个案件。嫌疑人对出现在犯罪现场有一个看似合理的借口，但侦探并不相信。后来，证据证明这个借口是个谎言。plausible 意思是看似合理但不一定真实。**

> One sunny day, a group of kids were in the park. They decided to play football. They ran, kicked, and had so much fun. Playing made them happy and forget all their worries. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一群孩子在公园。他们决定踢足球。他们跑着、踢着，玩得非常开心。玩耍让他们快乐并忘却了所有烦恼。**

> One day, I recorded a beautiful song and wanted to listen to it. So, I pressed the playback button and enjoyed the wonderful moment again. Playback means the act of playing something again, like a recording. **有一天，我录制了一首美妙的歌曲并想要听它。于是，我按下了回放按钮，再次享受了那个美妙的时刻。Playback 意思是再次播放，比如录音的回放。**

> One day, in a big game, a talented person named Tom was the key player. He showed amazing skills and led the team to victory. Everyone cheered for this outstanding player. **有一天，在一场大型比赛中，一个叫汤姆的有才华的人是关键球员。他展示了惊人的技能，并带领团队取得胜利。每个人都为这位杰出的球员欢呼。**

> One day, I saw a monkey in the zoo. It was very playful. It jumped around, played with toys, and made funny faces. Its playful behavior made everyone laugh. **有一天，我在动物园看到一只猴子。它非常顽皮。它到处跳，玩玩具，还做鬼脸。它顽皮的行为让每个人都大笑。**

> One day, a little monkey was jumping around playfully in the forest. It climbed trees and chased butterflies, having so much fun. Its actions showed that it was doing things in a light-hearted and fun way, just like the meaning of \'playfully\'. **有一天，一只小猴子在森林里欢快地蹦蹦跳跳。它爬树、追蝴蝶，玩得非常开心。它的行为表明它是以轻松有趣的方式在做事，就像\'playfully\'这个词的意思。**

> One sunny day, kids happily ran to the playground. They played various games like tag and hide-and-seek. The playground was filled with laughter and joy. It was a place for fun and friendship. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，孩子们高兴地跑到操场。他们玩各种游戏，比如捉人游戏和捉迷藏。操场上充满了欢声笑语。这是一个充满欢乐和友谊的地方。**

> One day, little Tom was very sad because he lost his playmate. But then, he found a new friend at the park and they had so much fun playing together. \'Playmate\' means a friend with whom one plays. **有一天，小汤姆非常伤心，因为他失去了玩伴。但后来，他在公园找到了一个新朋友，他们一起玩得非常开心。\'playmate\'意思是一起玩耍的朋友。**

> A young boy loved to play and had a wild imagination. One day, he decided to write down all the fun stories in his mind. As he grew up, he became a great playwright. His plays made people laugh and cry. **一个小男孩喜欢玩耍并且有着丰富的想象力。有一天，他决定把脑海中所有有趣的故事写下来。长大后，他成为了一位伟大的剧作家。他的戏剧让人们欢笑和哭泣。**

> A young artist was lost in a big city. When tired, he found a beautiful PLAZA. There were fountains and people having fun. He sat there, inspired and decided to paint the scene. The PLAZA became his source of creativity. **一位年轻的艺术家在大城市里迷路了。当他疲惫时，发现了一个美丽的广场。那里有喷泉，人们在愉快地玩耍。他坐在那里，受到启发并决定画下这一幕。这个广场成为了他的创作源泉。**

> A criminal was in court. He made a plea for mercy, saying he was sorry for his crime and promised to change. The judge listened carefully to his plea. **一名罪犯在法庭上。他恳求宽恕，说他对自己的罪行感到抱歉，并承诺会改变。法官仔细聆听了他的请求。**

> A man was wrongly accused of a crime. In court, he pleaded desperately, saying, \'I\'m innocent! Please believe me!\' His sincere plead finally convinced the jury. **一个男人被错误地指控犯罪。在法庭上，他拼命恳求，说道：'我是无辜的！请相信我！'他真诚的恳求最终说服了陪审团。**

> One sunny day, I went for a walk in a beautiful garden. The flowers were blooming, the birds were singing. It was a pleasant scene that made me feel happy and relaxed. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我去一个美丽的花园散步。花儿绽放，鸟儿歌唱。这是令人愉快的场景，让我感到开心和放松。**

> A little boy was lost in a big supermarket. He was very scared. A kind lady helped him and asked, \'Please tell me your name and your parents\' phone number.\' The boy felt relieved and answered. **一个小男孩在一家大超市里迷路了。他非常害怕。一位善良的女士帮助他并问道：'请告诉我你的名字和你父母的电话号码。'男孩感到安心并回答了。**

> One day, I got a high score in the exam. My parents were pleased. They gave me a big hug and said I did a great job. It made me feel happy and proud. **有一天，我在考试中取得了高分。我的父母很高兴。他们给了我一个大大的拥抱，并说我做得很棒。这让我感到开心和自豪。**

> A little girl was drawing a rainbow. The colors were so bright and the picture was pleasing. Everyone who saw it smiled. It made her happy to bring such pleasing joy to others. **一个小女孩正在画彩虹。颜色非常鲜艳，这幅画令人愉悦。每个看到它的人都笑了。能给别人带来这样令人愉快的快乐让她很开心。**

> One day, I went on a picnic. The sunny weather, delicious food and good company made it a pleasurable experience. I felt so happy and relaxed, enjoying every moment. **有一天，我去野餐。晴朗的天气、美味的食物和好伙伴让这成为了一次愉快的经历。我感到非常开心和放松，享受着每一刻。**

> One day, I went on a picnic and enjoyed the beautiful scenery. The warm sun, fresh air and delicious food gave me great pleasure. It was a wonderful time that made me feel happy and relaxed. **有一天，我去野餐，欣赏美丽的风景。温暖的阳光、清新的空气和美味的食物给了我极大的快乐。那是一段美妙的时光，让我感到开心和放松。**

> A poor student needed money for books. A kind teacher gave him some and asked him to make a pledge to study hard. The student promised and kept his word. \'Pledge\' means a serious promise or commitment. **一个贫困的学生需要钱买书。一位善良的老师给了他一些钱，并要求他作出保证要努力学习。这个学生答应了并信守承诺。'pledge'意思是郑重的承诺或保证。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical garden, there were plentiful flowers of all colors. The bees were so happy because there was more than enough nectar. \'Plentiful\' means having a large amount or supply, just like those countless beautiful flowers. **从前，在一个神奇的花园里，有大量五颜六色的花。蜜蜂们非常高兴，因为有充足的花蜜。'plentiful'意思是有大量的数量或供应，就像那些数不清的美丽花朵。**

> A poor farmer always worried about having not enough food. One day, he found a magical field that produced plenty of grains. From then on, he and his family never went hungry. **一个贫穷的农民总是担心没有足够的食物。有一天，他发现了一块神奇的田地，产出了大量的谷物。从那以后，他和他的家人再也没有挨过饿。**
> 想象一下，一个国王拥有一个巨大的宝库，里面的宝石多得超乎想象，简直是 a plethora 。但这么多宝石让他眼花缭乱，难以管理。这就是 plethora 所代表的过多、过量。 **想象一个国王拥有大量难以管理的宝石来体现'plethora'过多、过量的意思**

> One day, Tom was trying to fix a broken chair. He needed pliers to hold and bend the metal parts. But he couldn\'t find them. Finally, he borrowed pliers from his neighbor and fixed the chair successfully. **一天，汤姆正试图修理一把坏掉的椅子。他需要钳子来握住并弯曲金属部件。但他找不到。最后，他从邻居那里借了钳子，成功地修好了椅子。**

> A bird was in a plight. It got lost in a storm and couldn\'t find its way home. It was trapped and felt very sad. But finally, with help, it got out of the difficult situation. The word \'plight\' means a difficult and dangerous situation. **一只鸟陷入了困境。它在暴风雨中迷路了，找不到回家的路。它被困住了，感到非常悲伤。但最终，在帮助下，它摆脱了艰难的处境。单词\'plight\'意思是艰难危险的处境。**

> A little snail was plodding along a long road. It moved slowly but steadily, never giving up. Just like the snail, when you plod, you keep going steadily despite difficulties. **一只小蜗牛在一条长长的路上缓慢地行进。它移动得很慢但很稳定，从不放弃。就像这只蜗牛一样，当你 plod 时，你尽管有困难但仍稳步前进。**

> One day, I was sitting by the lake and threw a stone into the water. It made a \'plop\' sound as it hit the surface. The \'plop\' was so distinct that I\'ll never forget it. **一天，我坐在湖边，向水里扔了一块石头。石头碰到水面时发出了"扑通"一声。这"扑通"声如此清晰，我永远都忘不了。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The key was in the plot of land behind an old house. There, he found hidden clues. The plot of this story is full of surprises! **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。关键就在一座老房子后面的那块小块土地上。在那里，他发现了隐藏的线索。这个故事的情节充满了惊喜！**

> In a secret mission, the plotter was planning to steal the precious jewels. But his evil plot was exposed by a brave detective. The plotter was finally caught and punished. **在一次秘密任务中，阴谋家正计划偷取珍贵的珠宝。但他的邪恶阴谋被一位勇敢的侦探揭露了。这个阴谋家最终被抓住并受到了惩罚。**

> A farmer was working hard in the field. He used a plow to break the hard soil and make it ready for planting. The plow moved smoothly, creating nice furrows. With the plow\'s help, the farmer expected a great harvest. **一位农民在田地里辛勤劳作。他用犁来破开坚硬的土壤，为播种做好准备。犁顺利地移动，划出漂亮的犁沟。在犁的帮助下，农民期待着大丰收。**

> A spy was sent on a ploy to gather secret information. He pretended to be a lost tourist but was actually on a mission. The ploy was risky but might bring valuable intelligence. **一名间谍被派去执行一项策略以收集秘密情报。他假装是迷路的游客，但实际上是在执行任务。这个策略有风险，但可能会带来有价值的情报。**

> A brave chicken plucked up the courage to face a big dog. It showed great pluck. The chicken used its beak to pluck at the dog\'s fur, not giving in. \'Pluck\' means to pull out or show courage. **一只勇敢的鸡鼓起勇气面对一只大狗。它展现了极大的勇气。这只鸡用它的喙去啄狗的毛，毫不退缩。\'pluck\'有拔出或鼓起勇气的意思。**

> One day, my computer suddenly stopped working. I found that the power plug was loose. I quickly plugged it in tightly, and the computer came back to life. **有一天，我的电脑突然停止工作了。我发现电源插头松了。我迅速把它紧紧插上，电脑就恢复正常了。**

> One day, a little girl was very hungry. She found a plum tree. The plums on the tree were big and purple. She picked one and ate it. It was so sweet. She was very happy. **有一天，一个小女孩非常饿。她发现了一棵李子树。树上的李子又大又紫。她摘了一个吃了。非常甜。她很开心。**

> A plumber was called to fix a leak. He used a plumb line to make sure the pipe was straight. After working hard, the leak was fixed. The plumb line helped him do the job perfectly! **一位水管工被叫来修理漏水。他用铅垂线确保管道笔直。经过努力，漏水修好了。铅垂线帮他完美地完成了工作！**

> One day, the pipes in my house were leaking. A man named Tom came to fix them. Tom was a plumber. He had all the tools and knew exactly how to solve the problem. I was so relieved when the pipes were fixed. **有一天，我家的水管漏水了。一个叫汤姆的人来修理。汤姆是个水管工。他有所有的工具，并且确切地知道如何解决问题。当水管修好时，我松了一口气。**

> One day, Tom\'s house had a plumbing problem. Water was leaking everywhere. A professional plumber came and fixed all the pipes. Tom learned that plumbing is all about the pipes and systems that carry water in a building. **有一天，汤姆的房子出现了管道问题。水到处泄漏。一位专业的水管工人来了，修好了所有的管道。汤姆了解到 plumbing 就是关于建筑物中输送水的管道和系统。**
> 一只小鸟在森林里快乐地飞翔，它的羽毛（plume）五彩斑斓，像彩虹一样美丽。突然，一阵大风吹来，小鸟的一根羽毛飘落，它努力地寻找着那根珍贵的羽毛。 **一只小鸟的羽毛在森林里飘落，努力寻找羽毛的故事，帮助记忆'plume（羽毛）'这个单词。**

> A brave skydiver was in the air. Suddenly, his parachute failed and he plummeted towards the ground. It was a terrifying moment. Luckily, he survived. \'Plummet\' means to fall rapidly and straight down. **一位勇敢的跳伞者在空中。突然，他的降落伞失灵，他直直地快速坠落向地面。这是可怕的一刻。幸运的是，他活了下来。\'plummet\'意思是快速垂直下落。**

> One day, I saw a plump bird sitting on a branch. It had a round body and looked very cute. The plump bird was eating seeds and its feathers were fluffy. I thought it must have eaten a lot to become so plump. **一天，我看到一只丰满的鸟坐在树枝上。它身体圆圆的，看起来非常可爱。这只丰满的鸟正在吃种子，它的羽毛蓬松。我想它一定吃了很多才变得这么丰满。**

> A group of pirates set out to plunder a treasure island. They ransacked every corner, taking away all the precious jewels and gold. The word \'plunder\' means to rob or take valuable things by force. **一群海盗出发去掠夺一个宝岛。他们洗劫了每个角落，带走了所有珍贵的珠宝和黄金。\'plunder\'这个单词的意思是强行抢劫或拿走有价值的东西。**

> A brave diver decided to take a plunge into the deep ocean. He jumped without hesitation, experiencing the thrill and unknown. Just like this diver\'s bold act, \'plunge\' means to jump or dive forcefully. **一位勇敢的潜水员决定一头扎进深海。他毫不犹豫地跳了下去，体验着刺激和未知。就像这位潜水员的大胆举动一样，'plunge'意思是猛跳或猛扎。**

> One day, I was playing the piano. Suddenly, a key made a \'plunk\' sound. It was a deep and distinct note. I realized \'plunk\' is the sound when something is dropped or played forcefully. **有一天，我正在弹钢琴。突然，一个琴键发出了"扑通"一声。这是一个深沉而清晰的音符。我意识到"plunk"就是东西掉落或被用力弹奏时发出的声音。**

> A king had many cats. But when he wanted to count them, he was confused. His advisor said, \'You need to use the plural form, not just one cat.\' So the king learned that plural means more than one. **一位国王有很多只猫。但当他想要数猫时，他很困惑。他的顾问说：'您需要用复数形式，而不只是一只猫。'于是国王明白了 plural 表示不止一个。**

> A king ruled a land where everyone had only one way of thinking. But a wise man advocated pluralism, saying different ideas could make the kingdom stronger. The king listened and the land flourished. **一位国王统治着一个所有人都只有一种思维方式的国家。但一位智者提倡多元论，说不同的想法能让王国更强大。国王听从了，国家繁荣起来。**

> A king wanted to rule a pluralistic kingdom, where people of different cultures and beliefs lived together peacefully. He learned to respect and embrace the diversity, making his kingdom prosperous. \'Pluralistic\' means consisting of many different elements. **一位国王想要统治一个多元化的王国，那里不同文化和信仰的人们和平共处。他学会尊重和接纳多样性，使他的王国繁荣昌盛。'pluralistic'意思是由许多不同元素组成的。**

> A king wanted to choose a successor. Many candidates competed. In the end, there was no clear winner. It was a situation of plurality, with several having almost equal chances. **一位国王想要挑选继承人。许多候选人竞争。最后，没有明确的获胜者。这是一种多元化的情况，有几个人机会几乎均等。**
> One day, Tom had 5 apples. Then his friend gave him 3 more apples. So now Tom has 5 plus 3 equals 8 apples. He was very happy. **一天，汤姆有 5 个苹果。然后他的朋友又给了他 3 个苹果。所以现在汤姆有 5 加 3 等于 8 个苹果。他非常高兴。**

> A little girl went to a toy store and saw a very soft and cute teddy bear. She asked her mom, \'What kind of material is this bear made of?\' Her mom said, \'It\'s made of plush.\' The girl loved the plush bear so much. **一个小女孩去玩具店，看到一只非常柔软可爱的泰迪熊。她问妈妈：'这只熊是用什么材料做的？'她妈妈说：'是用长毛绒做的。'小女孩非常喜欢这只长毛绒熊。**

> A carpenter was using a saw to ply the wood. He worked hard, making the wood into useful shapes. Every time he plyed the saw, he thought of creating beautiful furniture. **一位木匠正在用锯子加工木材。他努力工作，把木材加工成有用的形状。每次他拉锯时，他都想着制作出漂亮的家具。**

> A carpenter was building a house. He needed a strong material and found plywood. It was made by layering thin wood sheets together, making it very durable. With plywood, the house became stable and beautiful. **一位木匠正在建造房屋。他需要一种坚固的材料，然后找到了胶合板。它是由多层薄木板叠加而成，非常耐用。有了胶合板，房子变得稳固又美观。**
> 想象一下，有一个巨大的气球工厂，里面的气球都是靠一种神奇的气体动力来充气的，这种气体动力就叫 \'pneumatic\' 。工人们熟练地操作着设备，利用 \'pneumatic\' 力量让气球变得饱满。 **想象在气球工厂中，靠神奇的气体动力充气的情景来记 \'pneumatic\' （气动的；充气的）这个单词。**
> 有个小朋友叫小明，他总喜欢在充满灰尘的地方玩耍。一天，他呼吸不畅，咳嗽不停，去医院检查，医生说他得了 pneumonia（肺炎），是肺部被细菌入侵啦。 **有个小朋友小明在灰尘多的地方玩后呼吸不畅、咳嗽，去医院被诊断得了肺炎。**

> A hungry bear decided to poach fish from a river. It sneaked quietly to the water\'s edge, hoping to catch some without being noticed. But the fish were too smart and swam away. Poor bear! Now you know poach means to catch or take illegally. **一只饥饿的熊决定从河里偷捕鱼。它悄悄地溜到水边，希望不被注意地抓到一些。但鱼太聪明游走了。可怜的熊！现在你知道 poach 意思是非法捕捞或获取。**

> A man was walking in the forest at night. Suddenly, he saw someone with a flashlight and a net. It was a poacher trying to catch wild animals illegally. The police came and caught the poacher. **一个男人在夜晚的森林里行走。突然，他看到有人拿着手电筒和网。那是一个偷猎者在非法捕捉野生动物。警察来了并抓住了这个偷猎者。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the street and felt something in his pocket. He reached in and found a key. It was the key to a secret room that led to a treasure chest. The pocket held the key to his adventure. **一天，汤姆走在街上，感觉到口袋里有东西。他伸手进去，发现了一把钥匙。这是一个秘密房间的钥匙，通向一个宝箱。口袋里装着他冒险的钥匙。**

> One day, I lost my pocketbook which contained all my money and important cards. I was very worried and searched everywhere. Finally, I found it in my jacket pocket. What a relief! **有一天，我弄丢了我的钱包，里面装着我所有的钱和重要的卡。我非常担心，到处找。最后，我在夹克口袋里找到了它。真是松了一口气！**

> Imagine a group of aliens in a spaceship. They have a special container called a pod. It\'s like a small room where they store precious things. One day, they lost the key to the pod and had a big problem! **想象一群外星人在宇宙飞船里。他们有一个特殊的容器叫做荚舱。它就像一个小房间，用来存放珍贵的东西。有一天，他们丢了荚舱的钥匙，遇到了大麻烦！**

> A young athlete dreamt of standing on the podium. He trained hard every day. Finally, his efforts paid off and he achieved his goal. The podium became a symbol of his success and hard work. **一位年轻的运动员梦想着站在领奖台上。他每天刻苦训练。最终，他的努力得到了回报，实现了目标。领奖台成为了他成功和努力的象征。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a forest. Suddenly, she heard a beautiful voice reciting a POEM. She followed the voice and found her way home. The poem was like a guiding light for her. **有一天，一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。突然，她听到一个美妙的声音在朗诵一首诗。她跟着这个声音，找到了回家的路。这首诗对她来说就像一盏指路明灯。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Peter. He loved writing beautiful words and expressing his thoughts. People called him a \'poet\' because of his amazing talent for creating wonderful poems. **从前，有一个叫彼得的人。他喜欢写优美的文字和表达自己的想法。由于他创作美妙诗歌的惊人天赋，人们称他为'诗人'。**

> A poet was walking in a beautiful garden. The flowers and the singing birds inspired him. He wrote a wonderful poem, showing his poetic talent. The scene was full of poetic charm. **一位诗人在美丽的花园中散步。花朵和歌唱的鸟儿给了他灵感。他写了一首美妙的诗，展现了他的诗意才华。这个场景充满了诗意的魅力。**

> A poet named Alice was passionate about sharing the beauty of poetics. She wrote amazing poems to show how words can create magic and emotions. People were deeply touched by her works and understood the charm of poetics. **一位名叫爱丽丝的诗人热衷于分享诗学的美。她写了令人惊叹的诗歌来展示文字如何创造魔力和情感。人们被她的作品深深打动，理解了诗学的魅力。**

> A poet was walking in a beautiful garden. The flowers and birds inspired him to write poetry. He felt the magic of words and expressed his feelings through poetry. That\'s the charm of poetry! **一位诗人在一个美丽的花园中散步。花朵和鸟儿激发了他创作诗歌。他感受到了文字的魔力，并通过诗歌表达自己的情感。这就是诗歌的魅力！**

> A poor little girl was lost in the big city. Her tearful eyes and helpless look were poignant. People passing by were deeply touched and decided to help her find her way home. **一个可怜的小女孩在大城市里迷路了。她含泪的眼睛和无助的神情令人心酸。路过的人们深受触动，决定帮她找到回家的路。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The only clue was a mark on the wall, a point. He realized that this point was the key to finding the criminal. It led him to the right direction. **一位侦探正在努力侦破一个谜团。唯一的线索是墙上的一个标记，一个点。他意识到这个点是找到罪犯的关键。它引领他走向了正确的方向。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little arrow. It had a very sharp and pointed tip. When it flew, it could easily pierce through things. The pointed tip made it special and powerful. **从前，有一支小箭。它有一个非常尖锐和突出的箭头。当它飞的时候，能够轻易地刺穿东西。突出的箭头让它变得特别且强大。**

> A girl was angry at her friend. When they met, she looked at him pointedly and said nothing. It was obvious that she wanted him to know she was upset. **一个女孩生她朋友的气。当他们见面时，她尖锐地看着他，什么也没说。很明显，她想让他知道她很不高兴。**

> A little mouse was lost in a big maze. A kind pointer appeared and guided the mouse to the exit. The pointer was like a helpful friend, showing the right way. Remember, a pointer shows the direction! **一只小老鼠在一个大迷宫里迷路了。一个善良的指针出现了，并引导老鼠走向出口。指针就像一个乐于助人的朋友，指明正确的方向。记住，指针指明方向！**

> A man was constantly walking in circles, not knowing where he was going. When asked, he said he had no destination. This aimless behavior was truly pointless. **一个男人不停地绕圈走，不知道要去哪里。当被问及时，他说他没有目的地。这种毫无目的的行为真的是毫无意义的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little witch with a pointy hat. The hat was so pointy that it could easily touch the stars. People always recognized her by this special pointy hat. **从前，有一个小女巫戴着一顶尖尖的帽子。这顶帽子非常尖，尖得能够轻易触碰到星星。人们总是通过这顶特别尖尖的帽子认出她。**

> A little bird was learning to fly. It needed poise to balance in the air. At first, it struggled, but with practice, it gained the poise and flew gracefully. **一只小鸟正在学习飞翔。它需要平衡来在空中保持稳定。起初，它很挣扎，但通过练习，它获得了平衡，优雅地飞了起来。**

> A king was very afraid of being poisoned. One day, a strange man offered him a drink. The king suspected it was poison. But his brave guard tasted it first and proved it safe. From then on, the king knew to be cautious of unknown substances. **一位国王非常害怕中毒。有一天，一个陌生的人给他一杯饮品。国王怀疑这是毒药。但他勇敢的侍卫先尝了一口，证明它是安全的。从那以后，国王知道要对未知的物质保持警惕。**

> A curious cat was exploring the kitchen and knocked over a bottle labeled \'poison\'. It licked a bit of the liquid and soon started feeling sick. Poor cat! This is what we call poisoning. **一只好奇的猫在厨房探索，打翻了一瓶标有'毒药'的瓶子。它舔了一点液体，很快就开始感到不适。可怜的猫！这就是我们所说的中毒。**

> Once upon a time, in a deep forest, there was a strange flower. It looked beautiful but was poisonous. A little rabbit didn\'t know and touched it. Soon, the rabbit felt very sick. Remember, beautiful doesn\'t mean safe. \'Poisonous\' means can cause harm or death. **从前，在一片幽深的森林里，有一朵奇特的花。它看起来很美但却是有毒的。一只小兔子不知道，触摸了它。很快，兔子就感到非常不适。记住，美丽并不意味着安全。'poisonous'意思是能够造成伤害或死亡。**

> One day, a curious monkey used a stick to poke a beehive. As a result, the bees flew out angrily. The monkey learned that poking something carelessly can lead to trouble. **一天，一只好奇的猴子用一根棍子去戳蜂窝。结果，蜜蜂生气地飞了出来。猴子知道了随意戳东西可能会带来麻烦。**

> One night, a group of friends gathered around a table to play poker. They had chips and cards, and the tension was high. The winner was the one who could best predict and strategize. Poker is all about fun and challenge! **一天晚上，一群朋友围坐在一张桌子旁玩扑克。他们有筹码和牌，气氛紧张。赢家是那个能最好地预测和制定策略的人。扑克就是关于乐趣和挑战！**

> In the icy polar region, a brave explorer found a polar bear. The bear\'s white fur was like a symbol of the extreme cold. The explorer realized that \'polar\' means related to the poles, where everything is harsh and special. **在冰冷的极地地区，一位勇敢的探险家发现了一只北极熊。熊的白色皮毛就像是极端寒冷的象征。探险家明白了'polar'意思是与极地有关，那里的一切都严酷又特别。**

> In a strange world, there was a magical magnet. One end attracted everything, and the other repelled. This contrast showed the polarity. It was like a hidden secret that controlled the magnet\'s power. **在一个奇异的世界里，有一块神奇的磁铁。一端吸引一切，另一端排斥一切。这种对比展现出了极性。它就像一个控制着磁铁力量的隐藏秘密。**

> In a faraway land, people had different opinions on a big issue. This led to a split and a strong division, which was called polarization. It was like a big magnet pulling everyone to opposite sides. **在一个遥远的地方，人们对一个重大问题有不同的看法。这导致了分裂和强烈的分歧，这就被称为两极分化。就像一块大磁铁把每个人都拉向相反的方向。**
> 在寒冷的极地，人们的观点就像磁极一样 polarize 分化。探险队中对于继续前行还是返回产生了激烈争论，最终团队分裂成两派。 **在寒冷的极地，人们的观点像磁极一样极化。探险队中对于继续前行还是返回产生激烈争论，最终团队分裂成两派。**

> A brave adventurer was trying to reach the North Pole. He carried a long pole to test the depth of the ice. With the pole as his tool and his determination as his guide, he finally made it. **一位勇敢的冒险家试图到达北极。他带着一根长长的杆子来测试冰层的深度。凭借这根杆子作为工具和他的决心作为指引，他最终成功了。**

> A philosopher engaged in a passionate polemic with another scholar. They argued fiercely over different theories, like two warriors on a battlefield. The debate was intense but stimulating. **一位哲学家与另一位学者进行了激烈的争论。他们就不同的理论激烈争吵，就像战场上的两名战士。这场辩论激烈但很有启发性。**

> One night, a thief broke into a house. The police arrived quickly with sirens blaring. They caught the thief and protected the people. The police are our heroes who keep us safe. **一天晚上，一个小偷闯入一所房子。警察迅速赶到，警笛声大作。他们抓住了小偷，保护了人们。警察是保护我们安全的英雄。**

> One day, a thief was running away. A brave policeman saw it and chased after him quickly. Finally, the policeman caught the thief and protected people\'s property. Remember, \'policeman\' is the hero who keeps us safe. **一天，一个小偷在逃跑。一位勇敢的警察看到了，迅速追了上去。最后，警察抓住了小偷，保护了人们的财产。记住，\'policeman\'就是保护我们安全的英雄。**

> A thief was caught stealing. The police decided to make a new policy to prevent such crimes. They increased patrols and installed more cameras. With this policy, the town became safer. **一个小偷被抓住偷窃。警察决定制定一项新政策来防止此类犯罪。他们增加了巡逻并安装了更多摄像头。有了这项政策，这个城镇变得更安全了。**

> A policymaker was lost in a big city. He needed to find the right way to make policies for the people. But it was so confusing! Finally, with wisdom and courage, he made good decisions. **一位政策制定者在一个大城市里迷失了。他需要为人民找到制定政策的正确方法。但这太令人困惑了！最终，凭借智慧和勇气，他做出了好的决策。**

> A little girl wanted to shine her shoes. She used a special liquid and a cloth to make them clean and shiny. This process was called \'polish\'. **一个小女孩想要擦亮她的鞋子。她用了一种特殊的液体和一块布让鞋子变得干净又闪亮。这个过程就叫做\'擦亮，磨光\'。**

> A clumsy boy was always making mistakes. But he practiced hard and finally became polished. He could handle any situation smoothly, like a shiny gem without flaws. **一个笨手笨脚的男孩总是犯错。但他努力练习，最终变得优雅完美。他能顺利处理任何情况，就像一颗没有瑕疵的闪亮宝石。**

> One day, Tom was at a party. When he wanted a drink, he said \'May I have a glass of water, please?\' His polite words made everyone like him. Being polite like Tom can bring more friendship. **一天，汤姆在一个聚会上。当他想要一杯水时，他说：'请问我可以要一杯水吗？'他有礼貌的话语让每个人都喜欢他。像汤姆一样有礼貌能带来更多的友谊。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange city. When he asked for directions, a kind lady answered him politely. Her gentle and respectful tone made Tom feel very comfortable. From then on, Tom remembered the word \'politely\' meaning behaving in a courteous manner. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城市迷路了。当他问路时，一位善良的女士礼貌地回答了他。她温和且尊重的语气让汤姆感到非常舒服。从那以后，汤姆记住了'politely'这个词，意思是以有礼貌的方式行事。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange city. A kind lady showed him the way with politeness. Her gentle words and smiles made Tom feel warm. Tom learned that politeness can bring joy to others. **有一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城市迷路了。一位善良的女士礼貌地给他指路。她温和的话语和微笑让汤姆感到温暖。汤姆明白了礼貌能给他人带来快乐。**

> A king wanted to make political changes. He gathered wise men to discuss. They talked about laws and policies to make the country better. Finally, they found the right way. Remember, \'political\' is about these matters of the state and governance. **一位国王想要进行政治变革。他召集了智者来讨论。他们谈论法律和政策以使国家变得更好。最后，他们找到了正确的方法。记住，\'political\'就是关于国家和治理的这些事务。**

> A young politician was always cautious when expressing opinions politically. One day, he made a wise decision that won people\'s hearts. He learned that being politically smart means considering all aspects. **一位年轻的政治家在政治上发表意见时总是很谨慎。有一天，他做出了一个明智的决定，赢得了人们的心。他明白了在政治上明智意味着要考虑到各个方面。**

> A traveler was lost in a forest. Luckily, he found a portable lamp that could be carried easily. With the light of the portable lamp, he found his way out. The lamp was so useful because it was portable. **一位旅行者在森林中迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一个便于携带的手提灯。凭借这个便携式的灯发出的光，他找到了出路。这个灯很有用，因为它是便携式的。**

> Imagine a magical world. There is a special door, the portal. When you step through it, you can travel to different wonderful places. It\'s like a key to new adventures and discoveries. **想象一个神奇的世界。有一扇特殊的门，即入口。当你穿过它，你就能去到不同的奇妙之地。它就像开启新冒险和发现的钥匙。**
> 在一个古老的港口，每次乌云密布，狂风呼啸，海浪汹涌，都似乎 portend 着一场巨大的风暴即将来临。人们看到这些迹象，就赶紧做好防范准备。 **在一个古老的港口，每次出现的恶劣天气迹象似乎都预示着一场巨大的风暴即将来临，人们看到后就赶紧做好防范准备。**

> A tired traveler arrived at a big hotel. The porter quickly came to help with the luggage. The traveler was grateful for the porter\'s assistance. With a smile, the porter made the traveler feel welcome. **一位疲惫的旅行者到达一家大旅馆。行李员迅速过来帮忙拿行李。旅行者很感激行李员的协助。行李员面带微笑，让旅行者感到受欢迎。**
> 想象一下，一位艺术家精心整理他的作品，把绘画、雕塑等放进一个大文件夹。这个文件夹就像他的 portfolio ，里面装满了他的成果和心血。它代表着他的作品集、投资组合。 **想象一位艺术家整理作品的场景来记住 portfolio 这个词，表示作品集、投资组合**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food. Finally, it found a big cheese and divided it into several portions. Each portion was just enough for it to have a satisfying meal. **一只饥饿的老鼠在寻找食物。最后，它找到了一块大奶酪，并把它分成了几份。每一份都刚好够它美餐一顿。**

> A painter was asked to draw a portrait of a famous actor. He spent days observing every detail, from the actor\'s smile to the twinkle in his eyes. Finally, the beautiful portrait was completed and everyone loved it. **一位画家被要求为一位著名演员画一幅肖像。他花了好几天时间观察每一个细节，从演员的微笑到他眼睛里的光芒。最后，这幅美丽的肖像画完成了，每个人都很喜欢。**

> A famous artist was known for his amazing portraiture. He could capture the essence of a person\'s soul in each painting. One day, a mysterious woman asked for a portrait, and his work made her beauty eternal. **一位著名的艺术家以其出色的肖像画而闻名。他能在每一幅画中捕捉到一个人灵魂的本质。有一天，一位神秘的女子要求画一幅肖像，他的作品让她的美丽永恒。**

> A famous painter was asked to portray the beauty of a secret garden. He spent days observing and finally created a wonderful painting that captured every detail. Thus, \'portray\' means to describe or show something through art or words. **一位著名的画家被要求描绘一个秘密花园的美丽。他花了几天时间观察，最终创作了一幅精彩的画作，捕捉到了每一个细节。因此，'portray'意思是通过艺术或文字来描述或展示某物。**

> A painter was asked to make a portrayal of a beautiful garden. He spent days observing every detail, from the colorful flowers to the winding paths. Finally, his painting showed the garden perfectly. Remember, portrayal is like this painter\'s creation, a detailed description or representation. **一位画家被要求描绘一个美丽的花园。他花了好几天观察每个细节，从五颜六色的花朵到蜿蜒的小路。最后，他的画完美地展现了花园。记住，portrayal 就像这位画家的创作，是一种详细的描述或表现。**

> A model was asked to pose in different ways for a photo shoot. She stood still, changed her expressions and postures, making each pose look perfect. **一位模特被要求以不同的方式摆姿势进行拍照。她站着不动，改变表情和姿态，让每个姿势看起来都很完美。**
> 有一天，小明参加了一个豪华派对，看到了很多穿着时尚、举止优雅的人。他感叹道：\'These people are so posh!\'（这些人太时髦优雅了！）后来他就记住了 posh 这个表示时髦优雅、豪华的单词。 **有一天，小明参加豪华派对，看到时髦优雅的人，感叹这些人很 posh，记住了这个表示时髦优雅、豪华的单词**

> Imagine a scientist who posits a new theory. He firmly places this idea forward, insisting it could change the world. Just like he does, to posit is to put forward or suggest something as a fact or possibility. **想象一位科学家提出一个新理论。他坚定地将这个想法摆出来，坚称它可能改变世界。就像他这样，posit 就是提出或表明某事作为事实或可能性。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a mysterious forest. To find his way out, he needed to determine his position. He used the stars and a map to figure it out and finally reached safety. **一位勇敢的冒险家在神秘的森林中迷路了。为了走出去，他需要确定自己的位置。他利用星星和地图弄清楚了，最终到达了安全地带。**

> A young artist always faced rejections. But he held a positive attitude. He kept painting and finally got recognized. His positive spirit led to his success. **一位年轻的艺术家总是遭遇拒绝。但他保持积极的态度。他坚持作画，最终得到认可。他的积极精神促成了他的成功。**

> In a wild west town, a brave sheriff gathered a posse of citizens to chase after the bandits. The posse worked together to protect the town. They were a determined group, ready for action! **在一个西部荒野小镇，一位勇敢的警长召集了一群市民组成民防团去追捕强盗。这个民防团齐心协力保护小镇。他们是一群坚定的人，随时准备行动！**

> A brave knight was on a quest. He found a magical sword that could possess the power to defeat all evil. With this possession, he became the hero of the land. The sword was his most valuable asset. **一位勇敢的骑士正在进行探索。他发现了一把有魔力的剑，这把剑能够拥有打败所有邪恶的力量。拥有了这把剑，他成为了这片土地的英雄。这把剑是他最宝贵的财产。**

> A thief broke into a house, looking for valuable possessions. But the owner had hidden them well. The thief was caught and all the possessions were returned. Remember, possession means something owned or controlled. **一个小偷闯入一所房子，寻找贵重的财物。但主人把它们藏得很好。小偷被抓住了，所有的财物都被归还。记住，possession 意思是拥有或控制的东西。**

> One day, a little boy dreamed of traveling around the world. His parents told him it was a possibility if he worked hard and saved money. With this hope in mind, he started to plan for his future adventure. **有一天，一个小男孩梦想着环游世界。他的父母告诉他，如果他努力工作并存钱，这是有可能的。怀着这个希望，他开始为未来的冒险做计划。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to fly like a bird. Everyone said it was impossible. But he kept trying and found a possible way with a homemade glider. It showed that with effort, the impossible can become possible. **有一天，一个小男孩想像鸟一样飞翔。大家都说这不可能。但他不断尝试，并用自制的滑翔机找到了一种可能的方法。这表明，只要努力，不可能也能变为可能。**

> One day, Tom was asked if he could finish the project on time. He answered, \'Possibly, but I need more resources.\' It means there was a chance he could do it. **一天，汤姆被问到是否能按时完成项目。他回答："可能吧，但我需要更多的资源。" 这意味着他有完成的机会。**

> One day, Tom sent a letter to his friend. But at the post office, he needed to pay for the cost of sending it, which was called \'postage\'. Finally, he paid the postage and the letter was on its way. **一天，汤姆给他的朋友寄了一封信。但在邮局，他需要支付寄信的费用，这个费用就被称为'邮资'。最后，他付了邮资，信就寄出去了。**

> A little mouse wanted to send a letter to its friend. So it went to the postal office. There, it saw many people sending and receiving packages. The mouse finally sent its letter happily. **一只小老鼠想给它的朋友寄一封信。于是它去了邮局。在那里，它看到很多人在寄收包裹。小老鼠最终开心地寄出了它的信。**

> One day, Tom was on vacation. He wrote his feelings and experiences on a card and sent it through the post. That card was a postcard, carrying his joy and memories to his friends far away. **有一天，汤姆在度假。他在一张卡片上写下了自己的感受和经历，并通过邮局寄了出去。那张卡片就是一张明信片，把他的快乐和回忆带给了远方的朋友。**

> One day, I was walking on the street and saw a big colorful poster on the wall. It was advertising a new movie. The poster was so attractive that I couldn\'t help stopping to look at it. **有一天，我走在街上，看到墙上有一张大大的彩色海报。它在为一部新电影做广告。这张海报太吸引人了，以至于我忍不住停下来看。**
> 想象一下，你在邮寄信件（post），但是你把地址写错了，结果信件被送到了后面（posterior）的地址。这让你记住 posterior 有后面的、后部的意思。 **想象你邮寄信件时写错地址导致信件被送到后面的地址，以此记住 posterior 表示后面的、后部的意思。**

> A king was very worried about the future of his kingdom. So, he worked hard to make it prosperous for the posterity. He wanted to leave a great legacy for the generations to come. **一位国王非常担心他王国的未来。所以，他努力工作以使它为子孙后代繁荣昌盛。他想为未来的世代留下伟大的遗产。**

> A famous writer passed away. But to everyone\'s surprise, his most brilliant work was published posthumously. It became a huge hit, making his name shine even after his death. People were amazed by this posthumous masterpiece. **一位著名作家去世了。但令所有人惊讶的是，他最杰出的作品在他死后出版了。它大获成功，使他的名字在死后依旧闪耀。人们对这部死后出版的杰作感到惊叹。**

> A young man was excited about his new job. His main task was posting letters every day. He carefully sorted and sent them, making sure each one reached the right destination. **一个年轻人对他的新工作感到兴奋。他的主要任务是每天寄信。他仔细分类并寄出它们，确保每一封信都能到达正确的目的地。**

> A patient was very worried about the postoperative period. But the doctor assured him that with proper care, he would recover soon. \'Postoperative\' means the time after a surgery. **一位病人对术后阶段非常担忧。但医生向他保证，只要护理得当，他很快就会康复。'postoperative'意思是手术后的。**

> A new mother was very tired in the postpartum period. But with the care of her family, she gradually recovered and adapted to her new role. \'Postpartum\' refers to the time after giving birth. **一位新妈妈在产后时期非常疲惫。但在家人的照顾下，她逐渐恢复并适应了新角色。'postpartum'指的是分娩后的时期。**

> A student had a big exam but was not ready. So, he asked the teacher to postpone it. The teacher agreed and set a new date. \'Postpone\' means to delay or put off something to a later time. **一名学生有一场大考但还没准备好。于是，他请求老师推迟考试。老师同意了并设定了新的日期。'postpone'意思是延迟或把某事推迟到更晚的时间。**

> A scientist postulated a new theory. He imagined a world where all objects could float without gravity. This bold assumption was his postulate, which needed lots of experiments to prove. **一位科学家提出了一个新理论。他设想了一个所有物体都能在没有重力的情况下漂浮的世界。这个大胆的设想就是他的假定，这需要大量实验来证明。**

> A soldier was always praised for his perfect posture. Standing straight and tall, he showed great discipline. One day, a new recruit asked him how to maintain such a good posture. The soldier replied, \'It\'s all about focus and strength.\' **一名士兵因其完美的姿势总是受到称赞。他站得笔直高大，展现出极强的纪律性。有一天，一名新兵问他如何保持这么好的姿势。士兵回答：'这全在于专注和力量。'**

> A poor little rabbit was very hungry. It found a pot in the forest. When it opened the pot, there was a big carrot inside. How lucky the rabbit was! **一只可怜的小兔子非常饿。它在森林里发现了一个锅。当它打开锅时，里面有一根大胡萝卜。这只兔子多么幸运啊！**
> 想象一个巨大的罐子（pot）里面装满了亮晶晶的宝石（ium），这些宝石能释放神奇的能量，就像钾（potassium）在化学反应中释放能量一样。 **想象一个装满宝石的罐子来记住单词 potassium（钾）**

> One day, a little mouse was very hungry. It found a big potato in the field. The potato was so big and round. The mouse was very happy and took it home to have a delicious meal. **一天，一只小老鼠非常饿。它在田地里发现了一个大土豆。这个土豆又大又圆。老鼠非常高兴，把它带回家美餐了一顿。**

> A young wizard was learning magic. The key to his success was the potency of the magic potion. The stronger the potency, the more powerful the spells he could cast. One day, he discovered a rare potion with extreme potency and became the greatest wizard. **一位年轻的巫师正在学习魔法。他成功的关键在于魔法药水的效力。效力越强，他能施展的法术就越强大。有一天，他发现了一瓶效力极强的稀有药水，然后成为了最伟大的巫师。**

> A king had a potent magic staff. With it, he could solve any problem and protect his kingdom. The staff was so powerful that no enemy dared to attack. \'Potent\' means having great power or strength. **一位国王有一根强大的魔法权杖。凭借它，国王能够解决任何问题并保护他的王国。这根权杖威力巨大，没有敌人敢来进犯。\'potent\'意思是有强大的力量或效力。**

> A young scientist was exploring a cave. He found a strange crystal that had the potential to generate unlimited energy. This discovery could change the world. **一位年轻的科学家正在探索一个洞穴。他发现了一块奇特的水晶，它有产生无限能量的潜力。这个发现可能会改变世界。**

> A young scientist was working on a new experiment. The result could potentially change the world. But there were many challenges ahead. He needed to stay focused and keep trying. **一位年轻的科学家正在进行一项新实验。其结果有可能改变世界。但前方有许多挑战。他需要保持专注并不断尝试。**

> One day, I was riding my bike. Suddenly, the wheel got stuck in a pothole. I fell off and hurt myself. A pothole is like a big hole in the road that can cause problems for traffic and people. **有一天，我正在骑自行车。突然，车轮卡在了一个坑洞里。我摔了下来并受伤了。坑洞就像是道路上的大洞，会给交通和行人带来麻烦。**

> A brave knight was injured in a battle. A wise old wizard gave him a special liquid called potion. When the knight drank it, his wounds healed quickly. The potion was a magical cure. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中受伤了。一位睿智的老巫师给了他一种特殊的液体，叫做药水。当骑士喝下它时，他的伤口很快就愈合了。这种药水是神奇的治疗剂。**

> A little girl was very happy to receive a potted flower as a gift. She carefully watered it every day. The potted flower grew beautifully. \'Potted\' means placed in a pot. **一个小女孩非常高兴地收到了一盆花作为礼物。她每天都仔细浇水。这盆花长得很美。\'potted\'意思是盆栽的；种在盆里的。**

> One day, a little boy named Tom was playing in the garden. He saw a potter making beautiful pots. The potter was very skillful and Tom was amazed. From then on, Tom remembered the word \'potter\' which means a person who makes pots. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的小男孩在花园里玩耍。他看到一个陶工正在制作漂亮的罐子。这个陶工技艺精湛，汤姆感到很惊讶。从那以后，汤姆记住了'potter'这个词，意思是制作罐子的人。**

> A long time ago, a little boy loved to play in the clay. One day, he decided to shape the clay into beautiful bowls and vases. His creations were called pottery. From then on, he became a master of pottery. **很久以前，一个小男孩喜欢玩黏土。有一天，他决定把黏土塑造成漂亮的碗和花瓶。他的这些创作被称为陶器。从那以后，他成为了陶器大师。**

> One day, a kangaroo was jumping happily. Its pouch was like a magic bag, carrying its baby safely. The pouch was soft and warm, protecting the little one. Remember the kangaroo\'s pouch and you\'ll remember the word \'pouch\'. **有一天，一只袋鼠快乐地跳着。它的育儿袋就像一个神奇的袋子，安全地带着它的宝宝。这个育儿袋柔软又温暖，保护着小宝宝。记住袋鼠的育儿袋，你就会记住"pouch"这个单词。**

> One day, a little girl went to a farm. She saw many chickens, ducks and geese. Her father told her these are all called poultry. The little girl remembered this word easily. **有一天，一个小女孩去了农场。她看到很多鸡、鸭和鹅。她的父亲告诉她这些都叫做家禽。小女孩轻松地记住了这个单词。**
> 一只小猫咪看到一只老鼠从洞口窜出，它立刻 pounce 过去，猛地一扑，成功抓住了老鼠。这里的 pounce 就是猛扑、突袭的意思，就像小猫咪快速而突然的动作一样。 **一只小猫咪看到老鼠后立刻猛扑过去抓住它，以此解释'pounce'（猛扑、突袭）这个单词**

> A lost puppy was found in the pound. It was weak and scared. A kind girl came and took it out, giving it love and care. \'Pound\' can mean a place where stray animals are kept. **一只迷路的小狗被发现在收容所里。它又虚弱又害怕。一个善良的女孩来了，把它带了出去，给它关爱。\'pound\'可以表示动物收容所。**

> One day, it was raining heavily. Tom was at home and saw water pouring from the roof. He quickly took a bucket to catch the pouring water. It was quite a scene! **一天，雨下得很大。汤姆在家看到水从屋顶倾泻而下。他迅速拿了个桶去接倾泻的水。真是一番景象！**

> A little girl was pouting because her parents didn\'t buy her the toy she wanted. She stood there with her lips pushed out, looking very unhappy. This shows what \'pout\' means - to push out one\'s lips in an angry or sulky way. **一个小女孩正在撅嘴，因为她的父母没有给她买她想要的玩具。她站在那里，嘴唇向外突出，看起来非常不高兴。这就展示了'pout'的意思------生气或不高兴地撅嘴。**

> A poor boy named Tom lived in a small village. He had no nice clothes or enough food. His life was full of hardship, which showed the meaning of \'poverty\'. **一个叫汤姆的穷孩子住在一个小村庄里。他没有漂亮的衣服，也没有足够的食物。他的生活充满了艰难，这体现了'poverty（贫困）'的含义。**

> One day, a little girl was playing in the room. She opened a box and found a lot of fine white powder. She didn\'t know it was face powder and smeared it all over her face. Later, her mother came and laughed. **一天，一个小女孩在房间里玩耍。她打开一个盒子，发现了很多细腻的白色粉末。她不知道这是粉底，把它涂满了脸。后来，她妈妈进来看到后笑了。**

> A fairy was making magic powder. She powdered the flowers and they became colorful. Then she powdered the trees and they grew taller. The fairy\'s powdered magic made everything wonderful. **一位仙女正在制作魔法粉末。她给花朵撒上粉末，花朵变得五颜六色。然后她给树木撒上粉末，树木长得更高了。仙女的粉末魔法让一切都变得奇妙。**

> One day, I opened an old box and found some powdery substance inside. I wondered what it was. Later, I learned it was a special powder used for making art. Powdery things can be mysterious and interesting. **有一天，我打开一个旧盒子，发现里面有一些粉状的物质。我很好奇这是什么。后来，我得知这是一种用于制作艺术品的特殊粉末。粉状的东西可能神秘又有趣。**

> A king had great power. He could decide the fate of his people. But with power comes responsibility. He used his power wisely to make the kingdom prosperous and happy. **一位国王拥有强大的权力。他能决定他子民的命运。但权力也伴随着责任。他明智地运用权力让王国繁荣幸福。**

> Once upon a time, a small car had a powerful engine. It could run very fast and climb steep hills easily. With this powerful engine, the car became a hero on the road. **从前，有一辆小汽车有一个强大的发动机。它能跑得非常快，轻松爬上陡峭的山坡。凭借这个强大的发动机，这辆车成了路上的英雄。**

> A small ant wanted to move a big stone. It tried powerfully again and again. Finally, with its strong will and powerful efforts, it succeeded. The ant showed us the meaning of \'powerfully\'. **一只小蚂蚁想要搬动一块大石头。它一次又一次强有力地尝试。最终，凭借着坚强的意志和强大的努力，它成功了。这只蚂蚁向我们展示了'powerfully'的含义。**

> A small town had an old factory. Once, it was weak. But a smart engineer came and made changes. Now it\'s a powerhouse, making lots of products and giving power to the town\'s economy. **一个小镇有一个旧工厂。曾经，它很弱小。但一位聪明的工程师来了并做出改变。现在它成了一个动力源，生产大量产品，为小镇的经济提供动力。**

> Once upon a time, a little ant wanted to move a big rock but found itself powerless. No matter how hard it tried, it couldn\'t make the rock budge. Just like when we have no power to do something. **从前，一只小蚂蚁想要搬动一块大石头，却发现自己无能为力。无论它怎么努力，石头都纹丝不动。就像我们没有能力做某事时一样。**
> 从前有个小村庄，突然爆发了一种奇怪的疾病，人们的皮肤上长满了斑点。大家都很害怕，称其为\'pox\'。后来一位勇敢的医生找到了治疗方法，拯救了村子。 **从前有个小村庄爆发了一种被称为'痘疹、瘟疫'的奇怪疾病，一位勇敢的医生拯救了村子。**

> One day, Tom needed to fix a broken chair. He didn\'t just think about it but took practical actions. He found tools, measured, and nailed. His practical skills made the chair good as new. **有一天，汤姆需要修理一把坏掉的椅子。他没有只是想想而已，而是采取了实际的行动。他找到工具，测量，钉钉。他的实际技能让椅子焕然一新。**

> A young inventor wanted to create a flying machine. But his friends doubted its practicality. He worked hard, proved it could work, and showed that practicality comes from determination and effort. **一位年轻的发明家想要制造一架飞行器。但他的朋友怀疑其实用性。他努力工作，证明它可以运行，展示了实用性来自决心和努力。**

> One day, I needed to fix my bike. Practically all the tools were missing. But I found a way and practically finished the repair. It means almost or nearly. **有一天，我需要修我的自行车。几乎所有的工具都不见了。但我找到了办法，差不多修好了。这个单词意思是几乎；差不多；实际上**

> A young musician wanted to become a master. Every day, he spent hours practicing his instrument. Through continuous practice, he finally achieved his dream on the big stage. Remember, practice makes perfect! **一位年轻的音乐家想要成为大师。每天，他都花数小时练习他的乐器。通过持续的练习，他最终在大舞台上实现了梦想。记住，熟能生巧！**

> One day, a musician practiced playing the piano for hours. He was very practiced and could play beautifully. His hard work showed that practice makes perfect. **有一天，一位音乐家练习弹钢琴好几个小时。他非常熟练，能够弹得很美妙。他的努力表明了熟能生巧。**

> One day, Tom was practicing playing the guitar in his room. He was very focused and kept repeating the chords. His hard practicing paid off when he could play a beautiful song. **有一天，汤姆正在他的房间里练习弹吉他。他非常专注，不停地重复和弦。他的努力练习得到了回报，他能够弹奏出一首美妙的歌曲。**

> A student was nervous about the practicum. But when they started, it was like a fun adventure. They did practical tasks and learned a lot. Now they know a practicum is a practical course for learning! **一名学生对实习课程感到紧张。但当他们开始时，这就像一场有趣的冒险。他们做了实际的任务并学到了很多。现在他们知道 practicum 是一门用于学习的实践课程！**

> A doctor is a practitioner of medicine. One day, a young doctor was very nervous on his first day of work. But with practice and experience, he became a confident practitioner. Remember, a practitioner is someone who actively practices a profession. **一位医生是医学的从业者。有一天，一位年轻的医生在他工作的第一天非常紧张。但通过实践和经验，他成为了一位自信的从业者。记住，从业者就是积极从事某个职业的人。**

> A young entrepreneur was often criticized for being too idealistic. But after many failures, he became pragmatic. He focused on practical solutions and finally made his business successful. Now he knows being pragmatic means dealing with things realistically. **一位年轻的企业家经常因过于理想化而受到批评。但在经历多次失败后，他变得务实了。他专注于实际的解决方案，最终使他的业务取得成功。现在他知道务实意味着现实地处理事情。**

> A young entrepreneur faced many challenges. Instead of relying on theories, he adopted pragmatism. He focused on practical solutions, tested different methods, and eventually achieved success. His story shows that pragmatism leads to real results. **一位年轻的企业家面临许多挑战。他没有依赖理论，而是采用了实用主义。他专注于实际的解决方案，测试不同的方法，最终取得了成功。他的故事表明实用主义会带来实际的成果。**

> Once upon a time, there was a leader named Tom. He always made decisions based on practical situations and solutions. He was a true pragmatist, focusing on what worked best in reality. People trusted him for his sensible choices. **从前，有一位名叫汤姆的领导。他总是根据实际情况和解决方案做决定。他是一个真正的实用主义者，专注于在现实中最有效的方法。人们因为他明智的选择而信任他。**

> One day, a little rabbit was running joyfully on the prairie. The prairie was vast and green, with colorful flowers everywhere. The rabbit felt so free and happy. **有一天，一只小兔子在大草原上欢快地奔跑。草原广阔又碧绿，到处都是五颜六色的花朵。小兔子感到无比自由和快乐。**

> One day, Tom did a very good job in the school play. The teacher and classmates gave him praise. They said, \'Tom, you are amazing!\' This made Tom feel very happy. Praise means expressing approval or admiration. **有一天，汤姆在学校的戏剧表演中表现得非常出色。老师和同学们都给予了他赞扬。他们说：'汤姆，你太棒了！'这让汤姆感到非常开心。praise 意思是表扬；称赞；赞美**

> One day, Tom decided to play a prank on his sister. He put a fake spider in her bed. When she saw it, she screamed loudly. But Tom just laughed and said it was just for fun. **一天，汤姆决定对他妹妹搞个恶作剧。他在她床上放了一只假蜘蛛。当她看到时，她大声尖叫。但汤姆只是笑着说只是为了好玩。**

> A poor man was in great trouble. Every day, he would go to a quiet place and pray to God for help. Finally, his sincerity was answered. \'Pray\' means to address a deity or express a hope earnestly. **一个穷人陷入了巨大的困境。每天，他都会去一个安静的地方向上帝祈祷求助。最终，他的真诚得到了回应。'pray'意思是向神祈求或真诚地表达希望。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. She was very scared. So she closed her eyes and said a prayer, asking for help. Finally, she was found safely. Prayer can give us hope and strength in difficult times. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她非常害怕。于是她闭上眼睛做了一个祈祷，请求帮助。最后，她被安全找到了。祈祷在困难时期能给我们带来希望和力量。**

> A priest always stands in the church to preach. He tells people to be kind and do good deeds. One day, a little boy was deeply touched and decided to follow the teachings. \'Preach\' means to give a religious or moral talk publicly. **一位牧师总是站在教堂里讲道。他告诉人们要善良，多做好事。有一天，一个小男孩深受触动并决定遵循教诲。\'preach\'意思是公开进行宗教或道德的说教。**

> One day, a man named Tom was standing on a stage. He was passionate and persuasive, preaching to the crowd about love and kindness. People were moved by his words. Tom was a true preacher. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的人站在舞台上。他充满激情且极具说服力，向人群宣讲爱与善良。人们被他的话语所打动。汤姆是一位真正的传教士。**
> 想象一下，你要参加一场重要的比赛，在开始前，主持人发表了一段开场白（preamble），讲述比赛的规则和目的。这段开场白就像一把钥匙，为比赛的顺利进行打开了大门。 **想象你参加比赛前主持人的开场白，帮助记住 preamble 这个词，意思是开场白、序言**

> A man was walking on a narrow and unstable rope bridge. The situation was precarious. He held his breath and moved forward carefully, fearing a fall at any moment. **一个人走在狭窄且不稳定的绳索桥上。这种情况是危险的。他屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地向前移动，害怕随时掉落。**

> A brave explorer was about to enter a dangerous cave. Before going in, he took many precautions, like checking his equipment and studying the cave map. These careful actions helped him avoid potential dangers. Remember, \'precaution\' means a careful action taken in advance to prevent something bad. **一位勇敢的探险家即将进入一个危险的洞穴。在进去之前，他采取了很多预防措施，比如检查装备和研究洞穴地图。这些谨慎的行动帮助他避免了潜在的危险。记住，\'precaution\'意思是为预防不好的事情而提前采取的谨慎行动。**
> 想象一个盛大的游行队伍，前面有一辆华丽的花车引领（precede）着整个队伍前进。花车总是走在所有参与者之前，就像单词precede所表达的'在...之前'的意思。 **想象一个游行队伍中花车在前面引领的场景来辅助记忆precede（在...之前）这个单词**

> A king was deciding which of his two advisors had precedence in giving advice. The one with more wisdom and experience was given precedence. Remember, \'precedence\' means the condition of being considered more important than someone or something else. **一位国王要决定他的两位顾问中谁在提建议方面具有优先权。那位更有智慧和经验的顾问被赋予了优先权。记住，\'precedence\'意思是比其他人或事物更重要的地位。**

> A king was about to make a new law. But his wise advisor reminded him to look at the precedent laws. They found that a similar situation had been dealt with before. So, they followed that earlier example. Precedent means an earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or rule to be followed. **一位国王即将制定新法律。但他聪明的顾问提醒他查看先例法律。他们发现之前有过类似情况的处理。所以，他们遵循了那个早期的例子。precedent 意思是被视为可遵循的范例或规则的先前事件或行动。**
> 想象你在参加一场跑步比赛，你前面的选手（preceding runner）一直在你前面跑，他们就是preceding的，也就是先于你、在你之前的。 **想象在跑步比赛中，前面的选手就是\'preceding\'，表示先于、在\...之前的**

> A wise old owl gave a precept to the little birds: \'Always be kind and share.\' The little birds remembered this rule and lived happily. So, precept means a rule or principle that guides behavior. **一只聪明的老猫头鹰给小鸟们一条训诫：'永远要善良和分享。'小鸟们记住了这条规则，快乐地生活着。所以，precept 意思是指导行为的规则或原则。**

> In a small town, the precinct was like a special area. A thief tried to escape here but was caught by the vigilant police. The precinct was well-protected and safe. **在一个小镇上，管辖区就像一个特殊的区域。一个小偷试图逃到这里，但被警惕的警察抓住了。这个管辖区受到了很好的保护，很安全。**

> A poor girl lost her precious necklace given by her mother. She searched everywhere and finally found it. The necklace was not valuable in money but was precious because of love. **一个贫穷的女孩弄丢了妈妈给她的珍贵项链。她到处寻找，最终找到了。这条项链不是金钱上的贵重，而是因为爱而珍贵。**

> A brave adventurer was climbing a mountain. As he reached the edge, he saw a terrifying precipice. One wrong step and he would fall. It made him realize the danger and be cautious. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在爬山。当他到达边缘时，看到了一个可怕的悬崖。只要走错一步，他就会掉下去。这让他意识到了危险并变得谨慎。**

> A brave scientist was conducting an experiment. A sudden mistake precipitated a dangerous reaction. But he remained calm and managed to control the situation. \'Precipitate\' here means cause something to happen suddenly and unexpectedly. **一位勇敢的科学家正在做实验。一个突然的错误引发了危险的反应。但他保持冷静并设法控制住了局面。\'precipitate\'在这里指突然意外地导致某事发生。**
> 想象一下，天空中乌云密布，突然大量的雨滴和雪花快速落下，就像有人急匆匆地往下扔东西。这急匆匆落下的雨和雪就是\'precipitation\'（降水、降雨量）。 **想象天空中乌云导致大量雨滴和雪花快速落下的情景来辅助记忆\'precipitation\'这个表示降水、降雨量的单词。**

> A brave climber was on a precipitous mountain path. One wrong step and he could fall. The path was very steep and dangerous, just like the meaning of \'precipitous\'. **一位勇敢的登山者走在一条陡峭的山路上。一步走错，他就可能坠落。这条路非常险峻，就像'precipitous'这个词所表达的那样。**

> One day, a scientist needed precise measurements for his experiment. He was very careful and used the most accurate tools. Finally, he got the precise data he wanted. It means exact and accurate. **一天，一位科学家的实验需要精确的测量。他非常小心，使用了最精准的工具。最终，他得到了想要的精确数据。这个单词意思是精确的、准确的。**

> A detective was looking for a criminal precisely. He checked every detail and followed every clue precisely. Finally, he caught the criminal precisely as he expected. **一位侦探正在精确地寻找一名罪犯。他精确地检查每一个细节，精确地追踪每一条线索。最终，正如他所料，精确地抓住了罪犯。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment and needed extreme PRECISION. Every measurement, every calculation had to be perfect. Without it, the entire project would fail. He focused intently to achieve this PRECISION. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验，需要极高的精准度。每一次测量，每一次计算都必须完美。没有它，整个项目就会失败。他全神贯注以达到这种精准。**
> 想象一下，你正在准备一场重要的考试，但是你忘记带笔了，这就预先排除（preclude）了你顺利答题的可能性。没有笔，你无法正常考试，就像某些条件会预先阻止一件事情的发生。 **想象准备考试忘带笔预先排除顺利答题的可能，来说明preclude（阻止；排除；妨碍）的意思**

> A little girl named Lily was very precocious. She could solve complex math problems at a young age and had a deep understanding of art. Her precocious talents amazed everyone around her. **有个叫莉莉的小女孩非常早熟。她年纪很小就能解决复杂的数学问题，对艺术也有很深的理解。她早熟的天赋让周围的人都感到惊讶。**

> A young scientist had a preconception that all experiments would fail. But one day, a surprising result proved her wrong. It taught her to let go of preconceived ideas and explore with an open mind. **一位年轻的科学家原本有先入为主的观念，认为所有实验都会失败。但有一天，一个令人惊讶的结果证明她错了。这教会她放下先入之见，以开放的心态去探索。**
> 想象一个探险家要进入神秘洞穴，出发前必须确保带齐装备，这就是一个'precondition'。没有这些准备条件，探险就会充满危险。就像考试前复习是取得好成绩的'precondition'一样。 **想象探险家进洞前的准备是'前提；先决条件'，如同考试前复习是取得好成绩的'前提；先决条件'**
> 想象一位勇敢的探险家，每次出发前都会仔细研究前人留下的地图和笔记，这些前人的成果就是他探险之旅的 precursor 。就好像是先头部队，为他指明了方向。 **想象一位勇敢的探险家，每次出发前都会仔细研究前人留下的地图和笔记，这些前人的成果就是他探险之旅的先驱、前身。就好像是先头部队，为他指明了方向。**
> 想象一下，在远古时代，有一种凶猛的野兽总是在其他动物进食之前（pre）就抢先捕食（date），所以 predate 就是'在...之前存在；先于'的意思。 **想象在远古时代，有一种凶猛野兽总是抢先捕食的故事来辅助记忆 predate 意为'在...之前存在；先于'**

> In the deep forest, a fierce lion was lurking. It was a predator, always on the hunt for its next meal. One day, it quietly stalked a deer, ready to pounce. The lion was the master of the hunt, a true predator. **在幽深的森林里，一只凶猛的狮子潜伏着。它是一个捕食者，总是在寻觅下一顿美餐。有一天，它悄悄地跟踪一只鹿，准备猛扑过去。这头狮子是狩猎的高手，一个真正的捕食者。**

> A wolf was lurking in the forest, showing a predatory look. It eyed the weak deer, ready to pounce. This wolf\'s behavior is typical of being predatory - aggressive and seeking to hunt for prey. **一只狼在森林里潜伏着，露出掠夺性的神情。它盯着弱小的鹿，准备猛扑过去。这只狼的行为就是典型的掠夺性------具有攻击性并且寻求捕猎猎物。**
> 想象一个古老的王国，国王退位了。新国王上任，而之前的那位国王就是新国王的 predecessor（前任）。他留下了许多经验和教训，新国王从他的作为中学习和借鉴。 **想象一个古老王国中，新国王的前任国王留下经验和教训，帮助理解 predecessor 这个词意为前任、前辈**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a deep forest. He had no food or water and didn\'t know the way out. This situation was his predicament. But he didn\'t give up and finally found a way home. **一位勇敢的冒险家在一片幽深的森林里迷路了。他没有食物和水，也不知道出去的路。这种状况就是他的困境。但他没有放弃，最终找到了回家的路。**
> 想象一只聪明的猫，它总是能准确地预测（predicate）老鼠的行动。每次它都根据观察和经验做出判断，然后成功抓住老鼠。predicate 就是做出断言、断定、表明的意思。 **想象一只猫预测老鼠行动来辅助记忆单词 predicate，意思是做出断言、断定、表明。**

> A fortune teller claims to predict the future. One day, a young man visited. The teller predicted he would meet his true love soon. But in the end, it was just a guess. Remember, predict means to say what will happen before it occurs. **一位算命师声称能预测未来。有一天，一个年轻人前来。算命师预测他很快会遇到真爱。但最后，这只是猜测。记住，predict 意思是在事情发生之前说出将会发生什么。**

> One day, a fortune teller claimed to have the power of predictability. But when asked about a surprise party, he failed. It shows that true predictability is hard to achieve. **有一天，一个算命先生声称拥有预测能力。但当被问到一个惊喜派对时，他失败了。这表明真正的可预测性是很难实现的。**

> A magician always performed the same tricks, making his shows completely predictable. People could guess exactly what would happen next. It was so boring! The word \'predictable\' means able to be predicted or expected. **一位魔术师总是表演同样的把戏，使得他的表演完全可预测。人们能准确猜到接下来会发生什么。太无聊了！单词\'predictable\'意思是可预测的；可预料的。**

> One day, a scientist made a prediction that there would be a big storm. Everyone was worried. But his prediction came true and they were prepared. So, prediction means saying what will happen in the future. **有一天，一位科学家做出了将会有一场大风暴的预测。每个人都很担心。但他的预测成真了，而且他们有所准备。所以，prediction 意思是对未来将会发生什么的预言。**

> A fortune teller claims to have predictive powers. He can supposedly predict the future. But we should be skeptical of such predictive claims. After all, true predictions are hard to come by. **一位算命先生声称有预测能力。他据称能够预测未来。但我们应该对这种预测性的说法持怀疑态度。毕竟，真正的预测很难实现。**

> A predictor is like a smart detective. Imagine a scientist who studies the weather. By looking at clouds and wind patterns, he can predict if it will rain. This scientist is a predictor. He uses clues to tell what will happen next. **预测器就像一个聪明的侦探。想象一位研究天气的科学家，通过观察云和风的模式，他能预测是否会下雨。这位科学家就是一个预测器。他利用线索来告知接下来会发生什么。**

> A prince had a predilection for collecting rare jewels. One day, he found a unique gem that made his collection even more special. His love for these jewels showed his clear preference. **一位王子有偏爱收集稀有珠宝的喜好。有一天，他发现了一颗独特的宝石，使他的收藏更加特别。他对这些珠宝的喜爱显示了他明显的偏爱。**

> A little girl was often exposed to sweet treats, which predisposed her to have a toothache. Later, she learned that such habits could cause problems. Predispose means to make someone likely to have a particular condition or behave in a particular way. **一个小女孩经常接触甜食，这使她容易牙疼。后来，她明白了这样的习惯会导致问题。predispose 意思是使某人倾向于有某种状况或以某种方式行事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little mouse with a predisposition to love cheese. Whenever it smelled cheese, it couldn\'t resist. This predisposition made it always search for cheese. So, predisposition means a tendency or inclination that exists before. **从前，有一只小老鼠有喜欢奶酪的倾向。每当它闻到奶酪的味道，就无法抗拒。这种倾向使它总是寻找奶酪。所以，predisposition 意思是倾向；癖性；（易患某种病的）体质。**
