> One sunny day, little Tom went to the orchard. He saw green apples on the trees. Days passed, and with the warm sun and gentle wind, the apples gradually changed color and became sweet and juicy. They were ripening. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，小汤姆去了果园。他看到树上的青苹果。日子一天天过去，在温暖的阳光和微风下，苹果逐渐变色，变得香甜多汁。它们正在成熟。**

> Imagine a strong athlete. He works out every day and has very muscular arms and legs. His muscles look so defined that you can say he is ripped. It means having well-developed and visible muscles. **想象一个强壮的运动员。他每天锻炼，有着非常结实的胳膊和腿。他的肌肉看起来轮廓分明，这时你就可以说他是 ripped。这个词意思是有发达且明显的肌肉。**

> A little duck swam in the lake. Its movement caused ripples on the water surface. The ripples spread out in circles, making the lake look so lively. **一只小鸭子在湖里游。它的游动在水面引起了涟漪。涟漪一圈圈地扩散开来，让湖面看起来十分生动。**
> 想象一下，你站在宁静的湖边，突然一阵微风吹过，水面上出现了一道道美丽的 rippling（波纹），它们就像小精灵在跳舞，一圈圈地向外扩散，让整个湖面变得生动起来。 **想象你站在湖边，微风吹过，水面出现像小精灵跳舞般向外扩散的美丽波纹。**
> The sun rises in the east every morning. A little bird also rises from its nest to start a new day. It shows the action of going up or emerging. **每天早晨太阳从东方升起。一只小鸟也从它的巢中升起，开始新的一天。这展示了上升或出现的动作。**

> There was a little boy named Tom. One day, he was climbing a mountain. He was a riser, determined to reach the top. Despite the difficulties, he kept going. Finally, he succeeded and saw the beautiful view. **有个小男孩叫汤姆。有一天，他在爬山。他是个奋进者，决心要到达山顶。尽管困难重重，他一直前进。最后，他成功了，看到了美丽的景色。**

> A little bird was trying to fly high. It kept flapping its wings, rising slowly into the blue sky. It was so determined and finally reached a new height. The bird\'s rising journey was amazing! **一只小鸟努力高飞。它不停地扇动翅膀，慢慢地升向蓝天。它如此坚定，最终到达了新的高度。小鸟的上升之旅令人惊叹！**

> One day, a brave adventurer decided to climb a tall mountain. His friends warned him of the risks, like slippery paths and bad weather. But he was determined. Finally, he reached the top safely, showing that risks can lead to great rewards if faced bravely. **一天，一位勇敢的冒险家决定攀登一座高山。他的朋友警告他存在风险，比如湿滑的道路和恶劣的天气。但他决心已定。最后，他安全到达山顶，表明如果勇敢面对，风险可能会带来巨大的回报。**

> One day, Tom decided to climb a very tall and unstable tree. His friends warned him it was risky. But Tom didn\'t listen. Eventually, he slipped and got hurt. This shows that doing dangerous things without thinking is risky. **有一天，汤姆决定爬上一棵很高且不稳的树。他的朋友们警告他这很冒险。但汤姆不听。最终，他滑倒受伤了。这表明不加思考地做危险的事是有风险的。**

> A chef was making risotto. He carefully chose the best rice and added rich ingredients. The smell of the risotto filled the kitchen. People couldn\'t wait to taste this delicious dish. **一位厨师正在做意大利调味饭。他精心挑选了最好的大米，并添加了丰富的食材。意大利调味饭的香味充满了厨房。人们迫不及待地想品尝这道美味佳肴。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. When she found a path, she felt it was a rite of passage to get back home safely. Finally, she succeeded and was very happy. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。当她找到一条小路时，她觉得这是安全回家的必经之路。最后，她成功了，非常开心。**

> A young man was lost in a mysterious forest. Every night, he saw a strange group performing a ritual around a fire. They chanted and danced in a fixed pattern. The ritual seemed to hold some secret power. **一个年轻人在神秘的森林中迷路了。每天晚上，他都看到一群奇怪的人在篝火旁举行一种仪式。他们按照固定的模式吟唱和跳舞。这个仪式似乎蕴含着某种神秘的力量。**

> In a small town, there were two shops selling the same goods. The owners were always competing to attract more customers. They were rivals, constantly trying to outdo each other. **在一个小镇上，有两家卖同样商品的商店。店主们总是在竞争以吸引更多的顾客。他们是竞争对手，不断试图超越对方。**

> Two companies always competed fiercely for the same market. Their battle, filled with strategies and tricks, was a classic example of rivalry. Each wanted to outdo the other and gain the most customers. **两家公司总是为了同一个市场激烈竞争。他们的争斗，充满了策略和手段，是竞争对抗的典型例子。双方都想超越对方，获得最多的客户。**

> A little boy named Tom was lost. He followed a path and finally saw a river. The flowing water of the river gave him hope. He followed the river and found his way home. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩迷路了。他沿着一条小路走，最后看到了一条河。河流流淌的水给了他希望。他沿着河走，找到了回家的路。**

> One day, a little boy was playing by the river. He saw a beautiful butterfly near the riverbank. He wanted to catch it but was careful not to fall into the river. The riverbank was his safe boundary. **有一天，一个小男孩在河边玩耍。他在河岸附近看到一只漂亮的蝴蝶。他想抓住它，但小心不落入河中。河岸是他的安全边界。**

> One day, a little boy was playing by the river. Suddenly, he saw a beautiful riverboat passing by. The boat was colorful and had many people on it. They were all having fun. The boy was very excited. **一天，一个小男孩在河边玩耍。突然，他看到一艘漂亮的河船驶过。这艘船色彩斑斓，上面有很多人。他们都玩得很开心。小男孩非常兴奋。**

> A brave blacksmith was working hard. He heated the metal and then used a rivet to firmly join two pieces of iron together. The rivet was like a hero, making the connection strong and unbreakable. **一位勇敢的铁匠正在努力工作。他加热金属，然后用铆钉将两块铁牢牢地连接在一起。铆钉就像英雄一样，使连接坚固且牢不可破。**

> A man was fishing by the river. Suddenly, he saw a roach jumping out of the water. He was so excited because it was a big and shiny roach. He caught it and took it home for dinner. **一个男人在河边钓鱼。突然，他看到一只蟑螂从水里跳出来。他非常兴奋，因为这是一只又大又亮的蟑螂。他抓住它并把它带回家当晚餐。**

> One day, a little boy got lost on a long road. He was scared but kept walking, hoping to find his way home. Finally, with the help of kind people, he reached his home safely. The road was full of challenges but also hope. **有一天，一个小男孩在一条长长的路上迷路了。他很害怕但一直走，希望能找到回家的路。最后，在好心人的帮助下，他安全到家了。这条路充满了挑战但也有希望。**

> One day, I was driving on a road. Suddenly, a big tree fell and became a roadblock. I had to stop and find another way. It made me understand the meaning of \'roadblock\' clearly - something that blocks the road. **有一天，我在路上开车。突然，一棵大树倒了，变成了路障。我不得不停下来另寻他路。这让我清楚地明白了'roadblock'的意思------挡路的东西。**

> One day, while walking along the road, Tom saw a beautiful flower by the roadside. He stopped to smell it and felt very happy. The roadside was full of surprises. **有一天，汤姆沿着路走，在路边看到一朵漂亮的花。他停下来闻了闻，感到非常开心。路边充满了惊喜。**

> One day, a little ant was lost on the roadway. It was confused and didn\'t know which way to go. But finally, with the help of a kind bird, the ant found its way home. The roadway was long and wide. **一天，一只小蚂蚁在道路上迷路了。它很困惑，不知道该走哪条路。但最后，在一只善良的鸟的帮助下，蚂蚁找到了回家的路。这条道路又长又宽。**

> A little sheep named Romy loved to roam freely in the big meadow. One day, it roamed far away and saw a beautiful rainbow. Romy was so happy during its roam. **一只叫罗米的小羊喜欢在大草地上自由漫步。有一天，它漫步得很远，看到了一道美丽的彩虹。罗米在漫步的时候非常开心。**

> A lion was sleeping in the forest. Suddenly, a hunter appeared and disturbed it. The angry lion let out a powerful roar that echoed through the trees. The roar was so loud that it scared the hunter away. **一只狮子正在森林里睡觉。突然，一个猎人出现并打扰了它。愤怒的狮子发出了强大的吼声，在树林中回荡。这吼声如此响亮，把猎人吓跑了。**

> A lion was roaring loudly in the forest. Its powerful voice made all the other animals tremble. The roaring sound showed its strength and dominance. **一只狮子在森林里大声咆哮。它强有力的声音让所有其他动物都颤抖。这咆哮声显示出了它的力量和统治地位。**

> A hungry bear went to the forest to roast some fish. It found a nice spot, made a fire, and carefully put the fish on the stick. The smell of the roasting fish was so good. Finally, the bear had a delicious meal. **一只饥饿的熊去森林里烤一些鱼。它找了个好地方，生了火，小心地把鱼放在棍子上。烤鱼的味道太好了。最后，熊美餐了一顿。**

> One night, a thief sneaked into a house to rob. But the owner was awake and called the police. The thief was caught and sent to prison. Remember, rob means to take something illegally from someone. **一天晚上，一个小偷潜入一所房子行窃。但主人醒着并报了警。小偷被抓住送进了监狱。记住，rob 意思是非法从某人那里拿走某物。**

> One night, a man wearing a mask broke into a house. He took away valuable things. This man was a robber. The owner called the police to catch him. **一天晚上，一个戴着面具的男人闯进了一所房子。他拿走了贵重的东西。这个男人是个强盗。房子的主人报了警要抓住他。**

> One night, a thief broke into a store. He took money and valuable things forcefully. This act of stealing with violence was a robbery. The police came quickly to catch him. **一天晚上，一个小偷闯进了一家商店。他强行拿走了钱和贵重物品。这种用暴力进行偷窃的行为就是抢劫。警察很快赶来抓他。**

> A king was very proud of his beautiful robe. One day, it got torn in the garden. But with the help of a wise tailor, it was restored. The king wore it again and felt happy. Remember, \'robe\' means a long, loose garment. **一位国王为他漂亮的长袍感到非常自豪。有一天，它在花园里被撕破了。但在一位聪明的裁缝的帮助下，它被修复了。国王再次穿上它，感到很高兴。记住，\'robe\'意思是长袍。**
> Robin 是一只聪明的知更鸟，它每天都会在森林里寻找最美味的虫子。有一天，它迷路了，但凭借着出色的方向感，最终找到了回家的路。 **罗宾是一只聪明的知更鸟，它每天在森林找美味虫子，某天迷路，靠出色方向感最终回家。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a strange city. Suddenly, a robot appeared and guided him home. The robot had a shiny body and could talk and move freely. The boy was so happy to have met this helpful robot. **有一天，一个小男孩在陌生的城市迷路了。突然，一个机器人出现并引导他回家。这个机器人有着闪亮的身体，能说话和自由移动。小男孩很高兴遇到了这个乐于助人的机器人。**

> In a future world, a young scientist was passionate about robotics. He spent days and nights in his lab, building amazing robots that could help people. His work in robotics made a huge difference in everyone\'s life. **在一个未来世界，一位年轻的科学家对机器人技术充满热情。他在实验室里日夜钻研，制造出了能帮助人们的神奇机器人。他在机器人技术方面的工作给每个人的生活带来了巨大的改变。**
> 想象一个强壮的机器人，它能承受各种攻击和恶劣环境，依然稳定运行。这个机器人就代表了\'robust\'的含义，健壮、坚固。就像我们需要有robust的身体去应对生活中的挑战一样。 **想象一个强壮的机器人，它能承受各种攻击和恶劣环境，依然稳定运行。这个机器人就代表了"健壮、坚固"的含义。就像我们需要有健壮的身体去应对生活中的挑战一样。**

> A brave climber was trying to reach the top of a mountain. Suddenly, a big rock rolled down towards him. But he was smart and moved away quickly. The rock was huge and heavy. **一位勇敢的登山者正努力登顶。突然，一块大石头朝他滚下来。但他很聪明，迅速躲开了。这块石头又大又重。**

> One day, I saw a man sitting on a rocker and gently swinging back and forth. He looked so relaxed, as if all his troubles were left behind. The rocker moved smoothly, making a creaking sound. **有一天，我看到一个男人坐在摇椅上轻轻前后摇晃。他看起来非常放松，仿佛把所有的烦恼都抛在了脑后。摇椅平稳地移动，发出嘎吱嘎吱的声音。**

> One day, a little boy saw a strange object flying in the sky. It was a rocket! The rocket was so fast and shiny. It went up high and disappeared into space. The boy was amazed and never forgot this exciting moment. **有一天，一个小男孩看到天空中有一个奇怪的物体在飞。那是一枚火箭！火箭速度很快，闪闪发光。它高高飞起，消失在太空中。小男孩很惊讶，永远忘不了这激动人心的时刻。**

> A fisherman went fishing and caught a strange fish. It had a hard body like a rock. Later, he learned it was called a \'rockfish\'. From then on, whenever he saw a rockfish, he remembered that special fishing day. **一位渔夫去钓鱼，钓到了一条奇怪的鱼。它的身体坚硬得像石头。后来，他得知这叫"岩鱼"。从此，每当他看到岩鱼，就会想起那个特别的钓鱼日。**

> One day, I was on a boat. The waves were big and the boat was rocking. I felt very scared. But then I saw a beautiful rainbow and forgot my fear. Rocking here means moving back and forth or side to side. **有一天，我在一艘船上。海浪很大，船在摇晃。我感到非常害怕。但随后我看到了一道美丽的彩虹，忘记了恐惧。这里的 rocking 意思是来回或左右移动。**

> A brave climber was trying to reach the top of a mountain. The path was rocky and full of challenges. But he didn\'t give up and finally made it. Rocky means full of rocks or uneven. **一位勇敢的登山者试图到达山顶。道路崎岖不平，充满挑战。但他没有放弃，最终成功了。rocky 意思是多岩石的；崎岖不平的。**

> A fisherman lost his rod while fishing. He searched everywhere but couldn\'t find it. Later, he saw a light and found his rod under a big rock. The rod helped him catch many fish. **一位渔夫在钓鱼时弄丢了他的鱼竿。他到处找都没找到。后来，他看到一束光，在一块大石头下找到了他的鱼竿。这根鱼竿帮他钓到了很多鱼。**

> One day, a little mouse was running around in the house. The mouse is a kind of rodent. It has sharp teeth and can move quickly. Remember, a rodent like this mouse is a gnawing mammal. **有一天，一只小老鼠在房子里跑来跑去。老鼠是一种啮齿动物。它有锋利的牙齿并且移动迅速。记住，像这只老鼠一样的啮齿动物是一种啃咬的哺乳动物。**

> One day, Tom went to a rodeo. He saw cowboys riding wild horses and doing amazing tricks. The excitement of the rodeo made him never forget this word. **有一天，汤姆去了一个牛仔竞技表演。他看到牛仔们骑着野马并表演惊人的特技。牛仔竞技的兴奋让他永远记住了rodeo这个词。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. One day, he encountered a mysterious figure. It was a rogue, stealing from villagers. The knight fought the rogue and restored justice. Remember, a rogue is a dishonest or bad person. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行任务。有一天，他遇到了一个神秘的人物。这是一个流氓，从村民那里偷东西。骑士与流氓战斗并恢复了正义。记住，rogue 指的是不诚实或坏的人。**
> 想象一下，在一个平静的池塘边，有个调皮的孩子不断扔石头，搅动（roil）了池水，让原本清澈平静的水面变得浑浊混乱。就像这个场景一样，roil 就是指搅乱、使动荡。 **想象孩子扔石头搅乱池塘的场景来记住 roil 表示搅乱、使动荡的意思**

> A young actor was very nervous before his first performance. But when he remembered his role as a brave hero, he gained confidence and gave a wonderful show. The role defined his actions and made him shine. **一位年轻的演员在他的首次表演前非常紧张。但当他想起自己作为勇敢英雄的角色时，他获得了信心并带来了精彩的演出。这个角色决定了他的行为并让他大放异彩。**

> A little mouse was playing in the field. Suddenly, it found a big round apple. It decided to roll the apple home. The mouse pushed and rolled the apple along the path. Finally, it successfully rolled the apple to its hole. **一只小老鼠在田野里玩耍。突然，它发现了一个大大的圆苹果。它决定把苹果滚回家。老鼠推着苹果沿着小路滚。最后，它成功地把苹果滚到了自己的洞里。**

> A little mouse rolled a big apple along the road. It was so funny to see the apple rolled and rolled. Finally, the mouse got the apple home safely. **一只小老鼠在路上滚动一个大苹果。看到苹果滚啊滚真是太有趣了。最后，老鼠把苹果安全地滚回了家。**

> One day, I went to an amusement park. I saw a big roller coaster. It moved up and down like a huge roller. People screamed with excitement. The roller made the ride thrilling! **有一天，我去了一个游乐园。我看到一个巨大的过山车。它像一个巨大的滚轴一样上下移动。人们兴奋地尖叫。滚轴让这次旅程变得惊险刺激！**

> A little monkey was rolling down a hill, laughing happily. It kept rolling and rolling until it reached the bottom. The monkey\'s rolling adventure was so funny! **一只小猴子正从山上滚下来，开心地笑着。它不停地滚啊滚，一直滚到了山底。猴子的滚动冒险太有趣啦！**

> A prince went on a long journey to find romance. He met a beautiful princess and they shared many adventures. Their love story was full of passion and surprises. Finally, they lived happily ever after. **一位王子踏上了寻找浪漫的漫长旅程。他遇到了一位美丽的公主，他们一起经历了许多冒险。他们的爱情故事充满了激情和惊喜。最后，他们永远幸福地生活在一起。**

> A young artist was always painting beautiful sunsets. One day, he met a girl under a starry sky and gave her a flower. They shared dreams and had many magical moments. This is a romantic story. **一位年轻的艺术家总是画美丽的日落。有一天，他在繁星满天的夜空下遇到了一个女孩，并给了她一朵花。他们分享梦想，拥有了许多神奇的时刻。这是一个浪漫的故事。**

> A young couple went on a trip. They held hands and enjoyed the beautiful scenery. They talked and laughed romantically. The moonlight shone on them, making the moment even more magical. **一对年轻的情侣去旅行。他们手牵着手，欣赏美丽的风景。他们浪漫地谈笑。月光洒在他们身上，让这一刻更加神奇。**

> A painter was always drawn to nature\'s beauty. He loved painting sunsets and starry nights, expressing intense emotions. This passion for the ideal and the emotional was his romanticism. It made his art alive and touching. **一位画家总是被大自然的美所吸引。他喜欢画日落和繁星点点的夜晚，表达强烈的情感。这种对理想和情感的热情就是他的浪漫主义。这让他的艺术作品充满生机且动人。**

> A young artist always romanticize her simple life. She imagines beautiful scenes and adds charming details. One day, she realizes this habit is called \'romanticize\'. **一位年轻的艺术家总是将她简单的生活浪漫化。她想象出美丽的场景并添加迷人的细节。有一天，她意识到这种习惯就叫做'romanticize'。**

> One day, a little monkey climbed onto the roof of a house. It looked around and saw a beautiful view. But it had to be careful not to fall. The roof was the top part of the house that protected everyone inside. **有一天，一只小猴子爬上了一座房子的屋顶。它四处张望，看到了美丽的景色。但它得小心别掉下去。屋顶就是房子的顶部，保护着里面的每一个人。**

> One day, a little bird was looking for a safe place. It flew over many houses and noticed the roofing. The colorful and strong roofing protected people from rain and wind. The bird thought it was amazing. **有一天，一只小鸟在寻找安全的地方。它飞过许多房子，注意到了屋顶。色彩鲜艳且坚固的屋顶为人们遮风挡雨。小鸟觉得这太神奇了。**

> A brave cat climbed to the rooftop to catch a bird. It looked around, enjoying the view. But then it got scared as it realized how high it was. Finally, with some help, it came down safely. **一只勇敢的猫爬到屋顶去抓鸟。它四处张望，欣赏风景。但随后它意识到自己所处的高度，感到害怕了。最后，在一些帮助下，它安全地下来了。**

> A young man named Tom joined a basketball team. He was a rookie and had no experience. But with hard training, he became a star. Remember, \'rookie\' is like Tom, a beginner in a field. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人加入了一支篮球队。他是个新手，没有经验。但通过刻苦训练，他成为了明星。记住，'rookie'就像汤姆，是某个领域的初学者。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for a safe place. It found a room with a big bed and a warm blanket. The mouse was very happy and said, \'This room is my perfect hideout!\' **有一天，一只小老鼠正在寻找一个安全的地方。它发现了一个房间，里面有一张大床和一条温暖的毯子。小老鼠非常高兴，说：'这个房间是我完美的藏身之处！'**

> One day, I moved into a new dormitory. I was worried about my roommate. But when I met him, he was very friendly. We shared the room and had a great time together. Now I know a roommate is someone you share a room with. **有一天，我搬进了新宿舍。我很担心我的室友。但当我见到他时，他非常友好。我们共用一个房间，一起度过了美好的时光。现在我知道室友就是和你共住一个房间的人。**

> One day, Tom was looking for a new car. He wanted a car that was not cramped but roomy. Finally, he found one with a large interior space and was very happy. Roomy means having plenty of space. **一天，汤姆在找新车。他想要一辆不狭窄而是宽敞的车。最后，他找到了一辆内部空间很大的车，非常高兴。roomy 意思是宽敞的，空间大的。**

> One night, a little chicken was looking for a roost to sleep. It finally found a warm and safe place on a branch. From then on, it knew that a roost was a special place for it to rest. **一天晚上，一只小鸡正在寻找栖息处睡觉。它最终在一根树枝上找到了一个温暖又安全的地方。从那以后，它知道了栖息处就是它休息的特殊地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a proud rooster. Every morning, it would stand on a high rock and crow loudly to wake up the whole farm. Its colorful feathers and strong voice made it the king of the farm. **从前，有一只骄傲的公鸡。每天早上，它都会站在高高的石头上大声打鸣来叫醒整个农场。它五彩的羽毛和响亮的声音使它成为农场之王。**

> A little seed was planted in the soil. It grew a root deep underground, seeking water and nutrients. The root was like a hidden hero, supporting the growth of the plant. With a strong root, the plant could stand firm and thrive. **一颗小种子被种在土里。它在地下长出了根，去寻找水分和养分。根就像一个隐藏的英雄，支撑着植物的生长。有了强壮的根，植物才能站稳并茁壮成长。**

> A little tree was rooted in the forest. It grew strong and stable because its roots went deep into the ground. Just like the tree, when we are rooted in our beliefs and values, we can stand firm in any situation. **一棵小树扎根在森林里。它长得强壮又稳固，因为它的根深深地扎进了土里。就像这棵树一样，当我们扎根于自己的信仰和价值观时，在任何情况下都能坚定不移。**

> A thief wanted to steal from a tall building. But he needed a rope. So, he found a long rope and climbed up. Unfortunately, the rope broke and he fell. Poor thief! Remember, rope is the thing that can help or cause trouble. **一个小偷想要从一座高楼偷东西。但是他需要一根绳子。于是，他找到了一根长绳子并爬了上去。不幸的是，绳子断了，他掉了下来。可怜的小偷！记住，rope 就是那种能帮忙也能惹麻烦的东西。**

> A girl lost her way in a forest. Feeling scared, she held the rosary tightly, praying for help. Suddenly, a kind old man appeared and guided her out. The rosary seemed to have magical power. **一个女孩在森林里迷路了。感到害怕的她紧紧握着念珠，祈求帮助。突然，一位善良的老人出现并引导她走出森林。这串念珠似乎有着神奇的力量。**

> A girl named Rose was lost in a beautiful garden. She saw many colorful flowers, but the roses stood out the most. They were so charming and fragrant. Finally, she found her way out with the help of a rose\'s gentle guidance. **一个叫罗丝的女孩在一个美丽的花园里迷路了。她看到了许多五颜六色的花，但玫瑰最为突出。它们如此迷人且芳香。最后，她在一朵玫瑰的温柔指引下找到了出路。**

> One day, Mary was lost in a rose garden. The fragrant roses and the peaceful atmosphere made her feel calm. She named this wonderful experience \'rosemary\'. **有一天，玛丽在一个玫瑰园里迷路了。芬芳的玫瑰和宁静的氛围让她感到平静。她把这段美妙的经历命名为'迷迭香'。**
> 想象一下，在一个足球队里，教练拿着一张写满球员名字的清单（roster），上面详细记录着每个球员的位置和号码。这张清单就像一个神奇的指南，让教练清楚地知道谁该上场。 **想象足球队教练拿着记录球员名字的清单，以此辅助记忆单词\'roster\'，意思是名单、登记表**

> A girl was walking in a garden full of roses. The color of the roses was so beautiful and it made her face look rosy. She felt very happy and the scene was like a rosy dream. **一个女孩在满是玫瑰的花园里散步。玫瑰的颜色如此美丽，让她的脸看起来红润。她感到非常开心，这场景就像一个美好的玫瑰色的梦。**

> The king\'s food was left in the cellar and started to rot. The smell was so bad that everyone covered their noses. Remember, \'rot\' means to decay or spoil. **国王的食物被留在了地窖里，开始腐烂。那股气味太难闻了，所有人都捂住了鼻子。记住，\'rot\'意思是腐烂、变质。**
> 想象一个圆形的旋转木马（carousel），它不停地转呀转。这个旋转木马就代表着\'rotary\'，意思是旋转的。比如，rotary movement 就是旋转运动。 **想象一个圆形的旋转木马，它不停地转动，代表着'rotary'（旋转的）这个词。例如，'rotary movement'就是旋转运动。**
> 想象一个巨大的摩天轮（Ferris wheel），它不停地转动（rotate）。每个座舱都沿着圆形轨道移动，就像指针在表盘上旋转一样。人们坐在里面，随着摩天轮的转动欣赏着不同的风景。 **想象一个巨大的摩天轮不停地转动。每个座舱都沿着圆形轨道移动，人们坐在里面欣赏风景来辅助记忆 rotate 这个单词**

> Imagine a big carousel in an amusement park. The movement of the carousel as it goes round and round is called \'rotation\'. It\'s like a continuous circular dance. **想象一下游乐园里的一个大旋转木马。旋转木马一圈又一圈的运动就被称为\'rotation\'。这就像一场持续的圆周舞蹈。**

> A student was always learning math formulas by rote. But during the exam, he couldn\'t solve the new problems. He realized that understanding is more important than just memorizing by rote. **一个学生总是死记硬背数学公式。但在考试中，他解不出新的问题。他意识到理解比死记硬背更重要。**

> A young inventor was working on a flying machine. The key part was the rotor. It spun fast, like a magic wheel, giving the machine the power to fly. The rotor was the heart of the invention. **一位年轻的发明家正在研究一架飞行器。关键部分是旋翼。它快速旋转，就像一个神奇的轮子，赋予飞行器飞行的力量。旋翼是这项发明的核心。**

> One day, Tom went to an old house. He opened a cupboard and found some apples. But they smelled terrible. They were rotten. Tom quickly threw them away. **有一天，汤姆去了一间老房子。他打开一个橱柜，发现了一些苹果。但它们闻起来很糟糕。它们都腐烂了。汤姆赶紧把它们扔掉了。**

> A brave adventurer was hiking in a rough terrain. There were sharp rocks and thorny bushes everywhere. But he didn\'t give up and finally reached the destination. The rough journey made him stronger. **一位勇敢的冒险家在崎岖不平的地形中徒步旅行。到处都是尖锐的岩石和多刺的灌木丛。但他没有放弃，最终到达了目的地。这段艰难的旅程使他变得更强大。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was lost in a forest. The path was roughly marked, making it hard for him to find the right way. But finally, with perseverance, he got out. Remember, \'roughly\' means approximately or not precisely. **从前，有一位旅行者在森林里迷路了。道路标记得很粗略，这让他很难找到正确的路。但最终，凭借毅力，他走了出来。记住，'roughly'意思是大约、大致、粗略地。**

> A gambler was obsessed with roulette. One night, he dreamt of a big win but woke up to reality. Remember, roulette is a game of chance. Don\'t get too addicted! **一个赌徒痴迷于轮盘赌。一天晚上，他梦到了大赢，但醒来却回到现实。记住，轮盘赌是一种靠运气的游戏。别太沉迷！**

> A little mouse was running round and round in a circle in the maze. It was looking for the exit but kept going in rounds. Finally, it found the way out. **一只小老鼠在迷宫里一圈又一圈地跑。它在寻找出口，但一直在兜圈子。最后，它找到了出去的路。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little ball. It had a perfectly rounded shape. Everyone loved to play with it because it rolled smoothly. The word \'rounded\' means having a smooth, curved shape like this ball. **从前，有一个小球。它的形状非常圆润。每个人都喜欢玩它，因为它能平滑地滚动。单词'rounded'意思是像这个球一样具有平滑的、弯曲的形状。**

> In the wild west, the sheriff organized a roundup of the bandits. Cowboys rode in a circle to catch them all. The roundup was successful and peace returned. **在狂野的西部，警长组织了对土匪的围捕。牛仔们围成一圈去抓捕他们所有人。这次围捕很成功，和平回归了。**

> One day, a sleeping lion was roused by the loud noise of hunters. It woke up angrily and showed its power. The hunters ran away in fear. Remember, \'rouse\' means to wake up or stir up. **一天，一只沉睡的狮子被猎人的巨大声响惊醒。它愤怒地醒来并展现出它的力量。猎人们惊恐地跑开了。记住，'rouse'意思是唤醒或激起。**

> In a sleepy town, a marching band started playing a rousing melody. Everyone woke up, filled with energy and excitement. The music was so powerful that it made the whole town come alive. Now you know, \'rousing\' means exciting and energetic. **在一个昏昏欲睡的小镇上，一支游行乐队开始演奏激昂的旋律。每个人都醒了过来，充满了活力和兴奋。这音乐如此有力，让整个小镇都活跃起来。现在你知道，'rousing'意味着令人兴奋和充满活力的。**
> 在古代的战场上，敌军来袭，我方士兵陷入混乱。最终被打得大败，这是一场彻底的rout（溃败）。大家丢盔弃甲，四处逃窜。 **在古代战场，敌军让我方遭遇彻底的溃败，士兵丢盔弃甲逃窜。**

> One day, a traveler got lost. But he found a map marked with different routes. He chose the right route and finally reached his destination happily. Route means a way or path to go somewhere. **有一天，一位旅行者迷路了。但他找到了一张标有不同路线的地图。他选择了正确的路线，最终愉快地到达了目的地。Route 意思是去某地的路或路径。**
> 想象一下，你在一个迷宫般的大房子里迷路了。突然，出现了一个神奇的小机器人，它像个向导一样，带着你在房间之间穿梭，找到出口。这个小机器人就是\'router\'，意思是路由器，就像为数据指引路径。 **想象你在大房子迷路，出现像向导的小机器人带你找出口，这个小机器人就是意为路由器的\'router\'，为数据指引路径。**
> 小明每天早上都遵循同样的 routine。他先起床，然后刷牙洗脸，接着做早餐、吃早餐，最后出门去上班。这种固定的流程让他的生活很有规律。 **小明每天都遵循同样的常规流程。他先起床，然后洗漱、做早餐、吃早餐，最后出门上班。这种固定的流程让他生活规律。**

> A brave detective routinely patrolled the dark streets at night. He was so familiar with the routine that he could catch any criminal easily. One day, he found a thief routinely lurking in a corner. **一位勇敢的侦探在夜间例行巡逻黑暗的街道。他对这种例行公事非常熟悉，以至于能轻松抓住任何罪犯。有一天，他发现一个小偷例行地潜伏在一个角落。**

> A young adventurer loved to rove around the world. One day, he roved into a mysterious forest and discovered a hidden treasure. The excitement of constantly moving and exploring made him understand the meaning of \'rove\'. **一位年轻的冒险家喜欢在世界各地漫游。有一天，他漫游到一个神秘的森林，发现了一个隐藏的宝藏。不断移动和探索的兴奋让他明白了'rove'的含义。**

> A brave astronaut was on a mission as a rover. He explored the unknown planet, facing many challenges but never giving up. The rover\'s journey was full of adventure and discovery. **一位勇敢的宇航员作为漫游者执行任务。他探索未知的星球，面临许多挑战但从不放弃。这个漫游者的旅程充满了冒险和发现。**

> A young artist was always on the roving, carrying his paints and brushes. He went from town to town, seeking inspiration. His roving life was full of adventures and surprises, which made his artworks unique. **一位年轻的艺术家总是在流浪，带着他的颜料和画笔。他从一个城镇走到另一个城镇，寻求灵感。他的流浪生活充满了冒险和惊喜，这使他的作品独具特色。**

> A group of friends were on a boat. They sat in a row and enjoyed the view. Suddenly, a big wave came and they held on tight. The word \'row\' here means a line of people or things. **一群朋友在船上。他们坐成一排欣赏风景。突然，一个大浪袭来，他们紧紧抓住。这里'row'这个单词意思是一排人或物。**

> A group of rowdy kids were playing in the park. They were shouting loudly and running around chaotically. The parents had a hard time calming them down. Remember, \'rowdy\' means noisy and disorderly. **一群吵闹的孩子正在公园里玩耍。他们大声喊叫，到处乱跑。家长们很难让他们安静下来。记住，\'rowdy\'意思是吵闹的、混乱无序的。**

> One sunny day, Tom went to a beautiful lake. He saw many people rowing boats on the water. The oars moved smoothly, and the boats glided forward. Tom thought, \'Rowing looks so fun!\' **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆去了一个美丽的湖。他看到许多人在水上划船。船桨平稳地移动，船向前滑行。汤姆想：'划船看起来太有趣了！'**

> Once upon a time, a prince lived in a royal palace. The palace was magnificent, with golden roofs and shiny jewels. The prince was proud of his royal heritage and the privileges it brought. **从前，一位王子住在一座皇家宫殿里。这座宫殿宏伟壮观，有着金色的屋顶和闪闪发光的珠宝。王子为他的皇家血统和所带来的特权感到骄傲。**

> A poor boy dreamed of meeting royalty. One day, he accidentally entered a grand palace and saw the king and queen. Their noble and elegant demeanor left a deep impression on him. From then on, he knew the meaning of \'royalty\'. **一个贫穷的男孩梦想着见到皇室成员。有一天，他意外地进入了一座宏伟的宫殿，看到了国王和王后。他们高贵优雅的举止给他留下了深刻的印象。从那时起，他明白了\'royalty（皇室；王权；版税）\'的意思。**

> One day, I was injured and my friend gently rubbed my wound to relieve the pain. The action of rubbing made me feel better. Remember, \'rub\' means to press and move something against a surface repeatedly. **有一天，我受伤了，朋友轻轻地揉我的伤口来缓解疼痛。这个揉的动作让我感觉好多了。记住，\'rub\'意思是反复按压并移动某物在一个表面上。**

> One day, a student was drawing with a rubber. He made a mistake and used the rubber to erase it easily. The rubber was like a magic tool that could fix errors. **一天，一个学生正在用橡皮画画。他犯了个错误，然后用橡皮轻松地擦掉了。橡皮就像一个神奇的工具，可以修正错误。**

> A man was walking in a forest and found a strange fruit. When he touched it, he felt it was rubbery. It was neither hard nor soft, just like rubber. He had never seen such a rubbery fruit before. **一个男人在森林里散步，发现了一个奇怪的水果。当他触摸它时，感觉它是有弹性的。它既不硬也不软，就像橡胶一样。他以前从未见过这样有弹性的水果。**

> One day, Tom was walking along the street and saw a big pile of rubbish. It smelled bad and was full of old cans and papers. Tom realized that we should keep the environment clean and not throw rubbish everywhere. **一天，汤姆走在街上，看到了一大堆垃圾。它散发着难闻的气味，满是旧罐子和纸张。汤姆意识到我们应该保持环境清洁，不要到处扔垃圾。**

> A powerful earthquake struck the town. When the dust settled, all that remained were piles of rubble. Tom was trapped but luckily was rescued. The rubble reminded everyone of the disaster\'s destructive force. **一场强烈的地震袭击了这个城镇。当尘埃落定，剩下的只有一堆堆的瓦砾。汤姆被困住了，但幸运的是被救了出来。这些瓦砾让每个人都想起了这场灾难的破坏力。**

> A student was confused about the rubric for an art project. The teacher explained that the rubric was like a map guiding what was needed for a top score. With this, the student understood and followed the rules to succeed. **一名学生对一个艺术项目的评分标准感到困惑。老师解释说，评分标准就像一张地图，指引着获得高分所需的条件。有了这个解释，学生明白了并遵循规则取得了成功。**

> One day, I was walking in a forest and found a shiny red stone. It was as beautiful as a ruby. I took it home and put it in my treasure box. Every time I saw it, I remembered the wonderful adventure in the forest. **有一天，我在森林里散步，发现了一块闪闪发光的红色石头。它像红宝石一样美丽。我把它带回家，放进了我的宝箱。每次看到它，我就会想起在森林里的奇妙冒险。**

> A brave sailor was lost at sea. Just when he felt hopeless, he saw a rudder floating nearby. Grabbing it, he steered the boat safely home. The rudder became his savior. **一位勇敢的水手在海上迷失了方向。就在他感到绝望时，他看到附近漂浮着一个舵。抓住它，他驾驶着船安全回家。这个舵成了他的救星。**

> A man was climbing a mountain and his face became ruddy due to the strenuous exercise and high altitude. It was easy to tell he was exerting a lot of effort. **一个男人正在爬山，由于剧烈运动和高海拔，他的脸变得通红。很容易看出他正在付出很大的努力。**

> One day, I was on the bus. A man pushed past me rudely without saying sorry. His behavior was so rude that everyone around was shocked. It made me understand the meaning of \'rude\' clearly - being impolite and rough. **有一天，我在公交车上。一个男人粗鲁地从我身边挤过去，连句抱歉都没说。他的行为非常粗鲁，周围的每个人都很震惊。这让我清楚地明白了\'rude\'这个词的意思------不礼貌和粗暴。**

> One day, Tom was asking for directions. But the person responded rudely, saying \'I don\'t have time for you!\' This made Tom very unhappy. Remember, rudely means being impolite and having bad manners. **一天，汤姆在问路。但那个人很粗鲁地回答说：'我没时间理你！'这让汤姆非常不高兴。记住，rudely 意思是不礼貌，态度恶劣。**
> 想象一个原始部落，人们只有最基础的工具。他们的房屋简陋，知识也处于 rudimentary 阶段，仅能满足生存的基本需求。就像这个部落，rudimentary 表示初步的、基本的。 **想象一个原始部落的场景来辅助记忆 rudimentary 这个单词，意思是初步的、基本的**

> One day, Tom failed his exam. He looked at the score ruefully, thinking about all the time he wasted. He regretted not studying hard and vowed to do better next time. **一天，汤姆考试不及格。他懊悔地看着分数，想着自己浪费的所有时间。他后悔没有努力学习，并发誓下次要做得更好。**
> 公主参加舞会，她的裙摆（ruffle）被调皮的猫咪弄乱了。公主很生气，但很快就调整好心情，因为她知道美丽不只是裙摆的整齐。后来，她凭借优雅的举止赢得众人称赞。 **公主参加舞会，她的褶边（ruffle）被调皮的猫咪弄乱了。公主很生气，但很快就调整好心情，因为她知道美丽不只是褶边的整齐。后来，她凭借优雅的举止赢得众人称赞。**

> One day, I walked into a room and saw a colorful rug on the floor. It was so soft that when I stepped on it, it felt like walking on a cloud. The rug had beautiful patterns and made the room look warm and cozy. **有一天，我走进一个房间，看到地板上有一块色彩斑斓的小地毯。它非常柔软，当我踩上去时，感觉就像走在云朵上。这块地毯有着美丽的图案，让房间看起来温馨又舒适。**

> One day, Tom went to watch a sports game. He saw two teams fiercely competing on the field. The players were running, passing, and tacklinging. He asked what it was and was told it was rugby. From then on, he remembered this exciting sport. **一天，汤姆去看体育比赛。他看到两队在场上激烈角逐。球员们奔跑、传球和阻截。他问这是什么，被告知这是橄榄球。从那以后，他记住了这项激动人心的运动。**

> A brave hiker was climbing a mountain. The path was rugged, full of rocks and uneven terrain. But he didn\'t give up and finally reached the top. Remember, \'rugged\' means rough and uneven. **一位勇敢的徒步旅行者正在爬山。这条路崎岖不平，布满了岩石和高低不平的地形。但他没有放弃，最终到达了山顶。记住，'rugged'意思是粗糙不平的。**
> 从前有一座美丽的城堡，人们在里面快乐地生活。但一场可怕的战争来临，城堡被摧毁。城堡变得破败不堪，这就是 ruin 的模样，从美好到破败。 **从前有一座美丽的城堡，人们在里面快乐地生活。但一场可怕的战争来临，城堡被摧毁。城堡变得破败不堪，这就是"毁灭、毁坏、废墟"的模样**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful castle. But a fierce storm came and destroyed everything. The castle was ruined. People were very sad to see it in such a bad state. **从前，有一座美丽的城堡。但一场猛烈的风暴袭来，摧毁了一切。城堡被毁坏了。人们看到它处于如此糟糕的状态非常伤心。**

> The king had many rules. One rule was that everyone must bow before him. But a brave girl questioned this rule and made the king think. In the end, some unfair rules were changed. **国王有很多规则。其中一条规则是每个人都必须在他面前鞠躬。但一个勇敢的女孩质疑了这条规则，让国王思考。最后，一些不公平的规则被改变了。**

> The king held a shiny ruler in his hand. With it, he measured the land and marked the boundaries. The ruler was not just a tool but a symbol of his power and authority. **国王手中握着一把闪亮的尺子。用它来测量土地并标记边界。这把尺子不仅是一个工具，更是他权力和权威的象征。**

> The king\'s ruling was that everyone must plant a tree. But a brave girl suggested a better idea, and the king changed his ruling. Finally, the kingdom became beautiful. **国王的裁决是每个人都必须种一棵树。但是一个勇敢的女孩提出了一个更好的主意，国王改变了他的裁决。最后，王国变得美丽了。**

> A pirate was on a treasure hunt. In a hidden cave, he found a bottle labeled \'RUM\'. When he drank it, he felt strong and brave. Now, whenever he saw the word \'rum\', he remembered that adventurous moment. **一个海盗在寻宝。在一个隐藏的洞穴里，他发现了一瓶标有\'朗姆酒\'的瓶子。当他喝下它，感觉强大且勇敢。现在，每当他看到\'rum\'这个单词，就会想起那个冒险的时刻。**

> A big bear was rumbling in the forest. Its heavy steps and low growls made a rumble that scared all the little animals. They knew it was a sign of the bear\'s power and presence. **一只大熊在森林里轰隆作响。它沉重的脚步和低沉的吼声发出轰隆声，把所有小动物都吓到了。他们知道这是熊力量和存在的标志。**

> In a deep forest, a huge bear was walking, causing a rumbling sound. The ground shook, and all the little animals were scared. They knew it was the rumbling of the bear\'s heavy steps. **在一片幽深的森林里，一只巨大的熊在行走，发出一阵隆隆声。地面震动，所有的小动物都很害怕。他们知道这是熊沉重脚步的隆隆声。**
> A thief rummaged through the room, looking for valuable things. He was in a hurry and made a mess. Finally, he was caught by the police. **一个小偷在房间里翻找，寻找值钱的东西。他很匆忙，把房间弄得一团糟。最后，他被警察抓住了。**

> One day, Tom heard a rumor that there was a hidden treasure in an old house. Everyone was talking about it, but no one knew if it was true. Tom decided to investigate and find out if the rumor was just a fantasy or a real possibility. **一天，汤姆听到一个谣言，说在一个老房子里有隐藏的宝藏。每个人都在谈论它，但没人知道这是不是真的。汤姆决定去调查，看看这个谣言究竟是幻想还是真有可能。**

> A farmer had a funny cow named Rump. One day, Rump got stuck in a narrow gap and its big rump was the main problem. The farmer had to push hard to get Rump out. Remember, rump means the hind part of an animal. **一位农民有一头有趣的牛叫 Rump。有一天，Rump 卡在了一个狭窄的缝隙里，它大大的臀部成了主要问题。农民不得不使劲推才能把 Rump 弄出来。记住，rump 意思是动物的臀部。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. So he had to run very fast. When he finally reached the classroom, he was out of breath. \'Run\' means to move quickly by using your legs. **一天，汤姆上学迟到了。所以他不得不跑得非常快。当他终于到达教室时，他气喘吁吁。\'run\'的意思是用腿快速移动。**

> Once upon a time, there was a horse. It always ran away from its stable. People called it a runaway horse. It was hard to catch. But finally, with patience, they did. Runaway means to escape or flee. **从前，有一匹马。它总是从马厩跑走。人们称它为逃跑的马。很难抓住它。但最终，凭借耐心，人们做到了。runaway 意思是逃跑、逃走。**
> 想象一个勇敢的登山者努力攀登高山，每踏上一级阶梯就像踏上一个 rung。他紧紧抓住这些 rung 一步步向上，最终成功登顶，这些 rung 就是阶梯的横木，帮助他实现了目标。 **想象一个登山者攀登时依靠的横木，以此记住 rung 意为'横档；梯级'**

> One day, Tom was running in the park. Suddenly, he saw a man in a hurry. The man shouted, \'I\'m a runner and I\'m late for the race!\' Tom understood and wished him good luck. **一天，汤姆正在公园里跑步。突然，他看到一个匆忙的男人。男人喊道：'我是一名赛跑者，比赛要迟到了！'汤姆明白了并祝他好运。**

> One day, Tom was running in the park. He was sweating a lot but felt so energetic. He kept running and running, determined to reach his fitness goal. **一天，汤姆正在公园里跑步。他出了很多汗，但感觉精力充沛。他不停地跑啊跑，决心达到他的健身目标。**

> One day, I was making an omelette. But the eggs I cracked were runny and kept flowing everywhere. It was a messy situation! I had to clean up quickly. **有一天，我正在做煎蛋卷。但我敲开的鸡蛋是稀的，不停地到处流。真是一团糟！我不得不赶紧清理。**

> A heavy rain caused a huge runoff. The water rushed down the mountain, carrying away small stones and branches. It was like a wild race. Finally, the runoff reached the river and joined the flow. **一场大雨导致了大量的径流。水从山上冲下来，带走了小石块和树枝。这就像一场疯狂的赛跑。最后，径流到达了河流并汇入其中。**

> A pilot was very nervous before taking off. He kept looking at the long and narrow runway, thinking about the smooth flight ahead. Finally, he successfully flew into the sky from the runway. **一位飞行员在起飞前非常紧张。他一直看着又长又窄的跑道，想着前方的平稳飞行。最终，他成功地从跑道飞上了天空。**

> A man was working hard to repair a water pipe. Suddenly, the pipe ruptured, and water burst out everywhere. He had to rush to stop the disaster. The rupture caused a big mess. **一个男人正在努力修理水管。突然，水管破裂了，水到处喷溅。他不得不赶紧去阻止这场灾难。这次破裂造成了一片混乱。**

> A boy named Tom lived in a rural area. He enjoyed the fresh air, vast fields, and peaceful life. Every day, he could see cows and sheep. Rural life made him happy and carefree. **一个叫汤姆的男孩住在农村地区。他享受着新鲜的空气、广阔的田野和平静的生活。每天，他都能看到牛羊。农村生活让他快乐又无忧无虑。**

> A thief planned a ruse to steal the jewels. He pretended to be a repairman but was caught in the end. Remember, a ruse is a trick or a deception to achieve a bad aim. **一个小偷计划了一个计谋去偷珠宝。他假装成修理工，但最终被抓住了。记住，ruse 是为达不良目的而使用的诡计或欺骗手段。**

> One day, I was in a big hurry to catch the train. I rushed to the station, running as fast as I could. My heart was pounding. Finally, I made it just in time. \'Rush\' means to move or act quickly and with great speed. **有一天，我急着赶火车。我冲向火车站，尽可能快地跑。我的心砰砰直跳。最后，我刚好赶上。\'rush\'意思是快速移动或行动。**

> I was in a hurry to catch the train. The sound of rushing feet filled the station. People were rushing around, and I had to rush too or I would miss it. **我急着赶火车。车站里满是匆忙的脚步声。人们到处匆忙奔走，我也不得不赶紧，否则就会错过。**

> A shiny new bike was left outside for a long time. The rain and wind made it rust. Its color changed, and it became hard to ride. Poor bike! Remember, rust can damage nice things. **一辆崭新的自行车长时间被放在外面。风和雨使它生锈了。它的颜色变了，骑起来也变得困难。可怜的自行车！记住，锈会损坏好东西。**

> A young artist went to a rustic village. The houses were simple, and the roads were unpaved. He was charmed by the natural and unpretentious life there. Rustic means having a simple, rural, and often charming quality. **一位年轻的艺术家去了一个乡村。房子很简单，道路未铺设。他被那里自然、朴实的生活所吸引。rustic 意思是具有简单、乡村且往往迷人的特质。**

> One night in the forest, I heard a rustle. I was scared. But when I looked closely, it was just a little squirrel moving through the dry leaves. The sound of the leaves rubbing together was the rustle I heard. **一天晚上在森林里，我听到一阵沙沙声。我很害怕。但当我仔细看时，只是一只小松鼠在干树叶中穿梭。树叶相互摩擦发出的声音就是我听到的沙沙声。**

> A knight found an old sword in a cave. The sword was rusty and looked weak. But when he polished it, the rusty layer came off and the sword shone bright again. Remember, \'rusty\' means covered with rust and in bad condition. **一位骑士在一个洞穴里发现了一把旧剑。这把剑生锈了，看起来很脆弱。但当他把它擦亮时，生锈的那层脱落了，剑又重新闪耀起来。记住，\'rusty\'意思是生锈的，状况不佳的。**

> A deer was always following the same rut in the forest. One day, it decided to break free and explore new paths. The rut here represents a fixed and boring pattern. **一只鹿总是在森林里沿着同一条车辙走。有一天，它决定挣脱出来，去探索新的路径。这里的rut代表着固定、枯燥的模式。**

> A king was known for being ruthless. He didn\'t care about his people\'s feelings and took everything he wanted by force. His actions showed no mercy or kindness, making everyone fear and hate him. **一位国王以冷酷无情著称。他不在乎子民的感受，用武力夺取他想要的一切。他的行为毫无怜悯和仁慈，让所有人都既害怕又憎恨他。**

> A cruel king ruled the land ruthlessly. He showed no mercy to his people, taking away their food and homes. But in the end, the people rose up and overthrew him. Remember, \'ruthlessly\' means without mercy or compassion. **一个残暴的国王无情地统治着这片土地。他对他的人民毫无怜悯之心，夺走了他们的食物和家园。但最终，人民奋起反抗并推翻了他。记住，\'ruthlessly\'意思是无情地；残忍地；毫不留情地**

> Once upon a time, a farmer harvested a lot of rye. He was so happy because rye could be made into delicious bread. The rye was golden and full of grains. It was a symbol of a good harvest. **从前，有个农民收获了很多黑麦。他非常高兴，因为黑麦可以被做成美味的面包。黑麦金黄，颗粒饱满。它是丰收的象征。**

> A professor decided to take a sabbatical. He left the busy campus and traveled to a peaceful village. There, he had time to think, read, and relax. When he returned, he was full of new ideas. **一位教授决定休假。他离开繁忙的校园，前往一个宁静的村庄。在那里，他有时间思考、阅读和放松。当他回来时，他充满了新的想法。**

> A brave knight holds a shining saber in his hand. He uses it to fight against the evil dragon, protecting the people. The saber is sharp and powerful, just like its name. **一位勇敢的骑士手中握着一把闪亮的军刀。他用它来对抗邪恶的巨龙，保护人民。这把军刀锋利且强大，正如它的名字一样。**

> A spy was sent to sabotage the enemy\'s factory. He sneaked in at night and damaged the machines. Sabotage means deliberately destroying or spoiling something to prevent it from working properly. **一名间谍被派去破坏敌人的工厂。他在晚上潜入并损坏了机器。sabotage 意思是蓄意破坏或损坏某物以使其无法正常运转。**

> A brave knight found a mysterious SAC in a cave. It was filled with magical potions. But he knew it was a sac of great power and needed to be used wisely. **一位勇敢的骑士在一个洞穴里发现了一个神秘的囊。里面装满了神奇的药水。但他知道这是一个充满巨大力量的囊，需要明智地使用。**

> A thief broke into a house and filled his sack with valuable things. But the owner woke up and caught him. The sack was the container for the stolen goods. **一个小偷闯进一所房子，把值钱的东西装进他的袋子。但主人醒了并抓住了他。这个袋子就是装赃物的容器。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a special ceremony. Everyone believed it was a sacred moment, a sacrament. It brought people together and made them feel connected to something greater. **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有一个特别的仪式。每个人都认为这是一个神圣的时刻，一个圣礼。它让人们聚集在一起，让他们感觉与更伟大的事物相连。**

> A priest was performing a sacred ritual. The items used in the ritual were called sacramental. They held special spiritual power and significance. Remember, sacramental means related to sacred religious ceremonies. **一位牧师正在举行一场神圣的仪式。仪式中使用的物品被称为圣事用品。它们具有特殊的精神力量和意义。记住，sacramental 意思是与神圣的宗教仪式有关的。**

> A long time ago, in a faraway village, there was a special tree. Everyone believed it had magical powers and was protected. This tree was considered sacred. It was a place where people found peace and hope. **很久以前，在一个遥远的村庄，有一棵特别的树。每个人都相信它有神奇的力量并受到保护。这棵树被认为是神圣的。它是人们找到和平与希望的地方。**

> A brave knight was willing to sacrifice his life to protect the kingdom. He fought against the evil dragon without hesitation. His sacrifice made the people remember him forever. **一位勇敢的骑士愿意牺牲自己的生命来保护王国。他毫不犹豫地与恶龙战斗。他的牺牲让人们永远铭记他。**

> A brave knight made a sacrificial choice to protect the kingdom. He gave up his own life, showing that being sacrificial means giving up something valuable for a greater cause. **一位勇敢的骑士做出了牺牲性的选择来保护王国。他献出了自己的生命，这表明"sacrificial"意味着为了更伟大的事业放弃有价值的东西。**
> Once upon a time, there was a little puppy. It lost its way and couldn\'t find its owner. It felt very sad and cried all alone. Poor puppy! **从前，有一只小狗。它迷路了，找不到它的主人。它感到非常悲伤，独自哭泣。可怜的小狗！**

> A little girl loved her beautiful garden. But one day, a storm came and destroyed all the flowers. This made the girl very sad. The feeling of her heart being heavy is like \'sadden\'. **一个小女孩很喜欢她美丽的花园。但有一天，一场暴风雨来临，摧毁了所有的花。这让小女孩非常伤心。她内心沉重的这种感觉就像"sadden（使悲伤）"。**

> One day, a little boy saw a beautiful horse with a shiny saddle. He dreamed of riding the horse and feeling the wind. The saddle made the ride comfortable and safe. Now, whenever he sees the word \'saddle\', he remembers that wonderful scene. **有一天，一个小男孩看到一匹漂亮的马，马背上有一个闪亮的马鞍。他梦想着骑上这匹马，感受风。马鞍让骑行变得舒适又安全。现在，每当他看到"saddle"这个词，就会想起那美妙的场景。**

> A detective was chasing a criminal. The criminal showed a sadistic smile when he hurt an innocent person. The detective knew this sadistic behavior was very evil. **一位侦探正在追捕一名罪犯。罪犯在伤害一个无辜的人时露出了施虐狂般的笑容。侦探知道这种施虐的行为非常邪恶。**

> A little girl lost her favorite toy. She sat on the bench sadly. Tears rolled down her cheeks. But then a kind fairy appeared and helped her find the toy. The girl was happy again. **一个小女孩弄丢了她最喜欢的玩具。她悲伤地坐在长椅上。眼泪从她的脸颊滚落。但随后一个善良的仙女出现，帮她找到了玩具。小女孩又开心了起来。**

> A little girl lost her favorite toy. Tears filled her eyes and a heavy feeling came over her. This feeling was sadness. She felt so down as if the world had lost its color. **一个小女孩丢失了她最喜欢的玩具。泪水充满了她的眼睛，一种沉重的感觉笼罩着她。这种感觉就是悲伤。她情绪非常低落，仿佛世界失去了色彩。**

> A group of friends went on a safari. They saw many wild animals like lions and giraffes. It was an exciting adventure. They took pictures and had a great time in the natural world. **一群朋友去了一次游猎。他们看到了很多野生动物，比如狮子和长颈鹿。这是一次令人兴奋的冒险。他们拍照留念，在自然世界里度过了美好时光。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big city. He was very scared. But finally, he found a safe place - a police station. The police helped him and he felt safe and happy. **有一天，一个小男孩在大城市里迷路了。他非常害怕。但最后，他找到了一个安全的地方------警察局。警察帮助了他，他感到安全又开心。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a forest. But a brave knight appeared and used his shield and sword to safeguard her from all dangers. Finally, they safely returned home. **有一天，一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。但一位勇敢的骑士出现了，用他的盾牌和剑保护她免受一切危险。最后，他们安全地回家了。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a dog ran towards him. But don\'t worry! The boy moved safely away because he was careful. \'Safely\' means without danger or harm. **有一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，一只狗朝他跑过来。但是别担心！男孩小心地安全离开了。\'safely\'意思是没有危险或伤害地。**

> One day, a little boy was playing in the park. Suddenly, a car came speeding. But luckily, the boy remembered the safety rules and stopped in time. Safety means being protected from danger. **有一天，一个小男孩在公园玩耍。突然，一辆汽车疾驰而来。但幸运的是，男孩记得安全规则并及时停住了。Safety 这个单词意思是免受危险。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, a chef was looking for a special spice. Finally, he found saffron, a precious and fragrant ingredient that made his dishes incredibly delicious. Saffron became the secret to his success. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，一位厨师正在寻找一种特殊的香料。最后，他找到了藏红花，一种珍贵且芳香的食材，使他的菜肴变得极其美味。藏红花成了他成功的秘诀。**
> 想象一下，有一根绳子悬挂着重物，时间久了，绳子中间就会向下弯曲，这就是\'sag\'。就像老旧的沙发，坐久了中间就会 sag 下去，变得不再平整。 **想象一根悬挂重物的绳子因重力而弯曲，或老旧沙发中间下陷的情景来辅助记忆\'sag\'（下陷；下垂； sag 作动词有（中间）下陷、（身体某部位）下垂等意思）**

> A long time ago, in a faraway land, there was a hero\'s journey. His adventures and challenges formed a saga. People passed down this tale for generations, remembering his bravery and wisdom. **很久以前，在一个遥远的地方，有一位英雄的旅程。他的冒险和挑战构成了一部传奇。人们世世代代传颂这个故事，铭记他的勇敢和智慧。**
> 从前有个智者，他的智慧如同古老的 sage 树一样深厚。人们遇到难题总会找他，因为他总能给出明智的建议。他的思考深邃，判断准确，就像 sage 这个词所代表的睿智的人。 **从前有个充满智慧的人，他像 sage 这个词所表示的圣人、智者一样，能为人们解决难题，给出明智建议，展现出深刻的思考和准确的判断。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in the desert. When he was about to give up, he saw a sagebrush. It was like a guide, showing him the way to find water. The sagebrush became his hope and saved his life. **一位勇敢的探险家在沙漠中迷路了。当他即将放弃时，他看到了一棵山艾树。它就像一个向导，为他指明了找到水源的路。山艾树成了他的希望并救了他的命。**

> One day, a little boy SAID to his mom, \'I love you.\' His mom was very happy. The word \'said\' here shows the action of speaking. It means to express something in words. **有一天，一个小男孩对他妈妈说：'我爱你。'他妈妈非常高兴。这里的'said'这个单词展示了说话的动作。它的意思是用言语表达某事。**

> A brave sailor set off on a journey. He raised the sail and let the wind carry his ship forward. The sail was like a big wing, guiding him to unknown places and new adventures. **一位勇敢的水手出发踏上旅程。他升起了帆，让风推动他的船前行。那帆就像一只大翅膀，引领他去往未知的地方和新的冒险。**

> One sunny day, a little boy saw a beautiful sailboat on the sea. The white sails were like big wings. The boat moved smoothly, as if dancing on the waves. It was a magical sailboat, bringing joy and adventure. **在一个阳光明媚的日子里，一个小男孩看到海上有一艘漂亮的帆船。白色的帆就像大大的翅膀。船平稳地移动，仿佛在波浪上跳舞。这是一艘神奇的帆船，带来了欢乐和冒险。**

> One sunny day, Tom decided to go sailing. He hoisted the sails, felt the wind in his face, and enjoyed the peaceful journey on the sea. The boat moved smoothly, and Tom had a wonderful time sailing. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆决定去航海。他升起了船帆，感受着风吹拂脸庞，享受着在海上的平静旅程。船平稳地移动，汤姆度过了一段美妙的航海时光。**

> One day, a young man decided to become a sailor. He loved the sea and the wind. He learned to handle the sails and navigate the waves. Finally, he became a brave and skilled sailor. **有一天，一个年轻人决定成为一名水手。他热爱大海和风。他学会了操控船帆和驾驭海浪。最终，他成为了一名勇敢且技艺娴熟的水手。**

> A poor man was always kind and helpful. Despite facing many difficulties, he never stopped doing good deeds. Eventually, people recognized him as a saint. His story spread far and wide, inspiring others to follow his example. **一个穷人总是善良且乐于助人。尽管面临诸多困难，他从未停止做好事。最终，人们认为他是一位圣人。他的故事广泛传播，激励着其他人效仿。**

> A brave knight fought in many battles for the sake of protecting his kingdom and its people. He never gave up, knowing his efforts were for a noble cause. The word \'sake\' here means purpose or reason. **一位勇敢的骑士参加了许多战斗，是为了保护他的王国和人民。他从不放弃，因为知道自己的努力是为了一个崇高的目标。这里"sake"这个词的意思是目的或原因。**

> One day, a hungry rabbit found a big bowl of salad. It had fresh vegetables and fruits. The rabbit ate it happily and felt full. Salad became its favorite food. **有一天，一只饥饿的兔子发现了一大碗沙拉。里面有新鲜的蔬菜和水果。兔子开心地吃了起来，并且觉得饱饱的。沙拉成了它最爱的食物。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a forest. Suddenly, he saw a salamander. It was colorful and moved gracefully. The adventurer was amazed and remembered this unique creature. Later, he easily recalled the word \'salamander\' when needed. **一位勇敢的冒险家在森林中迷路了。突然，他看到一只蝾螈。它色彩斑斓，动作优雅。冒险家很惊讶，并记住了这个独特的生物。后来，他需要时很容易就想起了"蝾螈"这个词。**

> One day, I went to a picnic. My friend brought some salami. It looked like long, thick sticks. We cut it and enjoyed the delicious taste. Salami is a kind of sausage, usually made from pork or beef. **有一天，我去野餐。我的朋友带了一些意大利香肠。它看起来像又长又粗的棍子。我们把它切开，享受了美味。意大利香肠是一种香肠，通常由猪肉或牛肉制成。**

> A young man dreamed of having a salaried job. One day, he got an offer. With a fixed salary, he could buy what he wanted and plan his life better. Now he is happy and stable in his salaried position. **一个年轻人梦想有一份领薪水的工作。有一天，他得到了一个机会。有了固定的薪水，他可以买自己想要的东西，更好地规划生活。现在他在这份有薪水的职位上开心又稳定。**

> A man worked hard every day. At the end of each month, the company gave him a sum of money called salary. With this salary, he could buy food and pay the rent. It was the reward for his efforts. **一个男人每天努力工作。在每个月的月底，公司给他一笔钱，叫做薪水。有了这份薪水，他可以买食物和付房租。这是对他努力的回报。**

> One day, I went to a store. There was a big sign that said \'SALE\'. Many products had reduced prices. I was so happy and bought a lot of things I needed. It was a great shopping day! **有一天，我去了一家商店。那里有个大大的牌子写着'打折销售'。很多商品都降价了。我特别高兴，买了好多需要的东西。真是很棒的购物日！**

> One day, a young man named Tom decided to become a salesman. He worked hard, learned to talk to people, and understood their needs. Finally, he became a successful salesman, selling many products. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的年轻人决定成为一名推销员。他努力工作，学会与人交谈，并了解他们的需求。最后，他成为了一名成功的推销员，卖出了很多产品。**

> Imagine a big store. There are many friendly salespeople. They wear nice uniforms and always have smiles. They help customers find what they need and answer all the questions. These salespeople make shopping a pleasant experience. **想象一家大商店。有许多友好的售货员。他们穿着漂亮的制服，总是面带微笑。他们帮助顾客找到他们需要的东西并回答所有问题。这些售货员让购物成为一种愉快的体验。**

> One day, a young man named Tom decided to become a salesperson. He learned how to talk to customers, show products, and close deals. With his hard work and skills, Tom became a successful salesperson and made many people happy with the things they bought. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的年轻人决定成为一名销售人员。他学习如何与客户交谈、展示产品和达成交易。通过他的努力和技巧，汤姆成为了一名成功的销售人员，并让许多购买东西的人感到开心。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. The salience of a footprint at the scene caught his attention. It stood out clearly and led him to an important clue. The distinctness of that footprint was the salience. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。现场一个脚印的显著特征引起了他的注意。它清晰地凸显出来，为他提供了重要线索。那个脚印的明显之处就是'salience'（显著、突出）。**

> A soldier was on a mission. He noticed a salient feature of the enemy\'s camp - a big flag. This突出的 flag helped him find the key point for attack. \'Salient\' means standing out clearly and importantly. **一名士兵在执行任务。他注意到敌人营地的一个显著特征------一面大旗。这突出的旗帜帮助他找到了攻击的关键点。\'salient\'意思是突出的、显著的。**

> A traveler was lost in the desert. He was extremely thirsty. Luckily, he found a hidden cave with a pool of saline water. Though not ideal for drinking, it reminded him of the word \'saline\', meaning salty. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。他极度口渴。幸运的是，他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面有一池盐水。虽然不适合饮用，但这让他记住了\'saline\'这个词，意思是含盐的、咸的。**

> In a distant ocean, a scientist was studying the water. He found that the amount of salt in it, called salinity, affected the lives of many sea creatures. High salinity made it hard for some to survive, but others adapted. Remember, salinity is all about salt in water! **在遥远的海洋中，一位科学家正在研究海水。他发现其中盐的含量，即盐度（salinity），影响着许多海洋生物的生活。高盐度使一些生物难以生存，但另一些生物适应了。记住，盐度就是关于水中盐的含量！**

> One day, Tom was eating a very spicy meal. His mouth produced a lot of liquid to cool down the heat. This liquid was called saliva. It helped him deal with the spicy taste. **有一天，汤姆正在吃非常辣的一餐。他的嘴里产生了很多液体来缓解辣味。这种液体被称为唾液。它帮助他应对辣味。**

> A little fish named Sam wanted to be special. So, it swam hard and turned into a beautiful salmon. It had shiny scales and was loved by all. Remember, Sam the fish became a salmon! **一条叫山姆的小鱼想变得特别。于是，它努力地游，变成了一条漂亮的鲑鱼。它有着闪亮的鳞片，受到了大家的喜爱。记住，小鱼山姆变成了鲑鱼！**
> 想象一下，在一个热闹的海鲜市场，有一群调皮的小鱼叫 Salmon（三文鱼），它们不小心感染了一种叫 Ella 的细菌，于是就有了 salmonella（沙门氏菌）。 **想象在海鲜市场，三文鱼感染了叫 Ella 的细菌，形成了沙门氏菌的故事**
> 在一个小镇上，有一家名为\'Salon\'的小店。它不是普通的店铺，而是能让人变美的魔法之地。女士们在这做头发、美容，男士们也来修剪胡须。这里充满了欢声笑语，是大家追求美的沙龙。 **在一个小镇上有一家叫\'Salon\'的店，是让人变美的地方，女士美容男士修剪胡须，充满欢乐，是追求美的沙龙。**

> A cowboy was thirsty after a long ride. He entered a saloon, where he found a bar and many people chatting and drinking. He ordered a cold drink and relaxed. The saloon was a lively place. **一个牛仔长途骑行后感到口渴。他走进一家沙龙，在那里他看到一个吧台和许多人在聊天喝酒。他点了一杯冷饮然后放松下来。这个沙龙是个热闹的地方。**

> Once upon a time, a chef lost his salt while cooking. He searched everywhere and was very worried. Finally, he found it and the dish was delicious. Remember, salt is very important for food! **从前，有个厨师做饭时弄丢了他的盐。他到处找，非常着急。最后，他找到了，菜变得很美味。记住，盐对食物很重要！**

> Once upon a time, there was a chef who needed to prepare some special dishes. He carefully used salted meat to add a rich flavor. The salted meat was so delicious that everyone loved it. Now you know\'salted\' means having salt added. **从前，有个厨师需要准备一些特别的菜肴。他精心使用了腌制的肉来增添浓郁的味道。腌制的肉非常美味，大家都很喜欢。现在你知道了\'salted\' 意思是加了盐的，腌制的。**

> A brave sailor was lost at sea. He was thirsty but had only saltwater to drink. It tasted bad and made him sick. Remember, saltwater is not for drinking! **一位勇敢的水手在海上迷路了。他很渴，但只有海水能喝。海水味道很差，还让他生病了。记住，海水不能喝！**

> One day, a little mouse went to the kitchen and found a bag of salt. He tasted it and said, \'Oh, this is so salty!\' From then on, whenever he saw salt, he remembered that salty taste. **有一天，一只小老鼠跑到厨房，发现了一袋盐。它尝了尝然后说：'哦，这太咸了！'从那以后，每当它看到盐，就会想起那种咸咸的味道。**

> A soldier was standing in the rain. A little girl came and saluted him. The soldier smiled and saluted back. The act of saluting showed respect and honor. **一名士兵正站在雨中。一个小女孩走过来向他敬礼。士兵微笑着回敬了礼。敬礼这个动作展现了尊重和敬意。**

> A ship was sinking, but the brave sailors worked hard to salvage the valuable cargo. They risked their lives to save as much as they could. Finally, they succeeded and the salvaged goods were safe. **一艘船正在沉没，但勇敢的水手们努力抢救有价值的货物。他们冒着生命危险尽可能多地挽救。最终，他们成功了，抢救出的货物安全了。**

> A man was lost in a dark forest, feeling hopeless. But when he saw a light in the distance, he knew it was his salvation. The light guided him out of the forest and to safety. Salvation means being saved from danger or difficulty. **一个男人在黑暗的森林中迷路了，感到绝望。但当他看到远处的一束光，他知道那是他的救赎。这束光引导他走出森林，到达安全之地。salvation 意思是从危险或困境中得救。**

> Once upon a time, there were two cats. They had the same color, the same size, and even the same pattern. It was easy to see they were exactly alike. So, we use \'same\' to describe such a situation. **从前，有两只猫。它们有着相同的颜色、相同的大小，甚至相同的图案。很容易看出它们完全一样。所以，我们用'same'来描述这样的情况。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical forest, all the trees had the exact same shape and color. This state of being exactly alike was called \'sameness\'. It made the forest look strange and lacking variety. **从前，在一个神奇的森林里，所有的树都有着完全相同的形状和颜色。这种完全一样的状态就被称为"sameness"。这让森林看起来很奇怪并且缺乏多样性。**

> A scientist needed a sample of a rare plant for research. He searched far and wide. Finally, he found a small sample in a hidden forest. It was like finding a precious treasure. **一位科学家需要一份稀有植物的样本用于研究。他四处寻找。最终，他在一片隐蔽的森林里找到了一小份样本。这就像找到了珍贵的宝藏。**

> A scientist was working on a new project and needed a sampler to collect various samples. But the sampler was lost. After a long search, it was finally found under a table. With it, the project could proceed smoothly. **一位科学家正在进行一个新项目，需要一个采样器来收集各种样本。但采样器不见了。经过长时间的寻找，最终在一张桌子下面找到了。有了它，项目得以顺利进行。**

> A scientist was doing sampling in a forest. He collected various leaves and soil to study. The act of taking these small parts for research was called sampling. **一位科学家在森林里进行采样。他收集了各种各样的树叶和土壤用于研究。这种抽取这些小部分用于研究的行为被称为采样。**

> A country violated international rules, but other countries couldn\'t decide whether to apply sanctions. Finally, they agreed to impose strict sanctions to stop the wrong behavior. **一个国家违反了国际规则，但其他国家无法决定是否实施制裁。最后，他们同意施加严厉的制裁来制止这种错误行为。**

> A monk devoted his life to maintaining the sanctity of the ancient temple. He prayed every day, protected its relics, and kept away intruders. His dedication showed the true meaning of sanctity - the state of being holy and sacred. **一位僧侣一生致力于维护古老寺庙的神圣性。他每天祈祷，保护其遗物，并赶走入侵者。他的奉献展现了sanctity（神圣性）的真正含义------神圣和庄严的状态。**

> A wounded bird flew into a peaceful forest. This forest was like a sanctuary for it, providing safety and a place to heal. The bird felt protected and calm there. **一只受伤的鸟飞进了一片宁静的森林。这片森林对它来说就像一个避难所，为它提供了安全和疗伤的地方。这只鸟在那里感到受到了保护和平静。**
> A little crab was walking on the sand. It left many footprints. A child came and built a sandcastle. The sand was soft and warm under the sun. **一只小螃蟹在沙子上行走。它留下了许多脚印。一个孩子过来建了一座沙堡。在太阳下，沙子又软又暖。**

> One hot summer day, a girl was walking on the beach. Her feet hurt because of the hot sand. Then she put on her comfortable sandals and felt so relieved. The sandals protected her feet and made her walk easily. **在一个炎热的夏日，一个女孩在海滩上行走。她的脚被热沙烫得难受。然后她穿上了舒适的凉鞋，感到轻松多了。凉鞋保护了她的脚，让她行走自如。**

> In a flood-stricken area, people were busy filling sand into bags to build a protective barrier. The sandbags were heavy, but they were the key to keeping the water away. \'Sandbag\' thus represents these protective items filled with sand. **在一个洪水泛滥的地区，人们忙着把沙子装进袋子里以建造防护屏障。沙袋很重，但它们是阻挡洪水的关键。'sandbag'因此代表这些装满沙子的防护物品。**

> A child was playing in the sandbox. He built castles and dug holes. The sandbox was his little world of fun and imagination. It was filled with soft sand that felt nice to touch. **一个孩子正在沙箱里玩耍。他建造城堡和挖洞。沙箱是他充满乐趣和想象的小世界。里面装满了摸起来很舒服的柔软沙子。**

> One day, Tom was building a wooden chair. But the surface was rough. So he took out some sandpaper to make it smooth. The sandpaper did the magic and the chair was perfect. **有一天，汤姆正在制作一把木椅子。但表面很粗糙。于是他拿出一些砂纸来把它磨光滑。砂纸发挥了神奇的作用，椅子变得完美了。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a desert. He found a strange rock. It was sandstone! The grains of sand were tightly stuck together. He knew it was formed over time and took a piece as a souvenir. **一位勇敢的探险家在沙漠中迷路了。他发现了一块奇怪的岩石。这是砂岩！沙粒紧紧地粘在一起。他知道它是经过时间形成的，并拿了一块作为纪念品。**

> A long time ago, there was an English nobleman named Sandwich. He was so busy playing cards that he asked his servants to bring him some food between two slices of bread. And this way of eating was named after him - sandwich. **很久以前，有一位名叫三明治的英国贵族。他忙于打牌，让仆人把一些食物夹在两片面包之间给他。这种吃法就以他的名字命名 - 三明治。**

> Sandy was a little girl who loved playing on the sandy beach. Every time she stepped on the soft, golden sand, she felt happy. One day, she even built a big sandcastle. The sand beneath her feet was warm and inviting. **桑迪是个喜欢在沙滩上玩耍的小女孩。每次她踩在柔软的金色沙子上，都感到很开心。有一天，她甚至建了一座大沙堡。她脚下的沙子温暖又诱人。**

> A crazy scientist was conducting dangerous experiments. But one of his assistants, named Sam, remained sane and stopped the scientist from causing a disaster. Sam\'s sanity saved the day. **一位疯狂的科学家正在进行危险的实验。但他的一个助手，叫山姆，保持着理智，阻止了科学家造成灾难。山姆的理智拯救了这一天。**
> 从前有个画家，无论面对怎样的困境，都能乐观作画。他的血液里仿佛流淌着乐观，人们称他为\'sanguine\'先生。因为\'sanguine\'意思就是乐观的、满怀希望的。 **从前有个画家，无论面对怎样的困境，都能乐观作画。他的血液里仿佛流淌着乐观，人们称他为'乐观的、满怀希望的'先生。**

> One day, Tom was sent to a special place called a sanitary station. There, everything was clean and safe to prevent diseases. \'Sanitary\' means clean and healthy, keeping us away from germs. **有一天，汤姆被送到一个叫做卫生站的特殊地方。在那里，一切都干净且安全以预防疾病。\'sanitary\'意思是清洁的、卫生的，让我们远离细菌。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange town. He was relieved to find a sign saying \'Sanitation Station\' as he was very thirsty. There, he got clean water and knew sanitation means keeping things clean and healthy. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他很欣慰地看到一个写着'卫生站'的标志，因为他非常口渴。在那里，他得到了干净的水，并知道了 sanitation 意味着保持事物干净和健康。**

> 想象一下，你参加了一场考试，成绩出来后，虽然不是特别优秀，但也足够让你满意。这种既不是顶尖但又还不错的感觉，就像\'satisfactory\'，意味着令人满意的、符合要求的。 **想象你参加考试的情况来理解\'satisfactory\'这个单词，它表示令人满意的、符合要求的。**

> One day, a little boy was very curious about the world. He asked many questions and wanted to find answers. His mom told him that\'science\' can help him.
