> Once upon a time, a brave hero had a loyal friend named Jack. Jack was always by the hero\'s side, helping and supporting. People called Jack the hero\'s sidekick. Just like that, sidekick means a close companion or assistant. **从前，有一位勇敢的英雄，他有一个忠诚的朋友叫杰克。杰克总是在英雄身边，帮助和支持他。人们称杰克为英雄的助手。就这样，sidekick 意思是亲密的伙伴或助手。**

> A football player was injured and had to stay on the sideline. He watched his teammates play with a worried look. The sideline was where he could only wait and hope to recover soon. **一名足球运动员受伤了，不得不待在边线外。他一脸担忧地看着队友比赛。边线就是他只能等待并期望尽快恢复的地方。**
> 在一个热闹的集市上，主舞台的表演精彩纷呈，而旁边的 sideshow 区域也毫不逊色。有杂耍艺人、魔术表演等。这个 sideshow 虽小却也吸引了众多观众，给大家带来了别样的欢乐。 **在集市等场所的旁边的小型表演、附带活动或次要事件**

> A thief was running away. To avoid the police, he tried to sidestep by quickly moving to the side and hiding behind a big tree. But the police were smart and caught him. **一个小偷正在逃跑。为了避开警察，他试图侧步躲开，快速移动到一边并躲在一棵大树后面。但警察很聪明，抓住了他。**

> One day, a little girl was walking on the sidewalk with her ice cream. Suddenly, a bird landed beside her. She was so happy and shared a bit of her ice cream with the bird on the sidewalk. **有一天，一个小女孩拿着冰淇淋走在人行道上。突然，一只鸟落在她旁边。她非常开心，在人行道上和这只鸟分享了一点她的冰淇淋。**

> One day, a little monkey was walking sideways along a narrow path. It was funny and had to be careful not to fall. \'Sideways\' means moving or directed to the side. **有一天，一只小猴子沿着一条狭窄的小路侧身走着。它样子很滑稽，还得小心别摔倒。\'sideways\'意思是向侧面的；侧身的。**

> One day, a train was speeding along the track. When it reached a junction, it smoothly moved onto a siding to let another train pass. The siding here is like a special path for trains to wait or change directions. **有一天，一辆火车在轨道上疾驰。当它到达一个交叉点时，它平稳地驶入一条侧线，让另一辆火车通过。这里的侧线就像是火车等待或改变方向的特殊路径。**
> 想象一下，在一个热闹的派对上，有个害羞的人不想引起注意，于是悄悄地侧身（sidle）贴着墙走，试图找到一个安静的角落。他的动作小心翼翼，生怕被别人发现。 **想象在派对上，害羞之人侧身贴着墙走，以解释 sidle （侧身走；悄悄地走）这个单词**

> In a medieval town, the enemy surrounded it and began a long siege. People inside were worried, but they held on. The siege meant a tight and persistent surrounding to force surrender. **在一个中世纪的城镇，敌人将其包围并开始了长期的围攻。里面的人很担心，但他们坚守着。siege 这个词意味着紧紧且持续的包围以迫使投降。**

> A detective was looking for clues in a crime scene. He used a sieve to filter the sand, hoping to find tiny pieces of evidence. Just like the sieve separates fine particles, it helps us filter out what we need. **一位侦探在犯罪现场寻找线索。他用筛子过滤沙子，希望能找到微小的证据。就像筛子分离细小颗粒一样，它帮助我们筛选出我们需要的东西。**

> A detective was sifting through a pile of evidence to find the crucial clue. He carefully separated and examined each piece, just like sifting flour to get the finest part. **一位侦探正在仔细筛查一堆证据以找到关键线索。他认真地分拣和检查每一件，就像筛面粉以获取最精细的部分一样。**

> A girl was standing by the window, looking at the rainy sky. She felt very sad because she failed the exam. Then she let out a long sigh. The sigh was like a wind blowing away her disappointment. **一个女孩站在窗边，望着下雨的天空。她因为考试不及格感到非常难过。然后她长叹一口气。这叹气就像一阵风，吹走了她的失望。**

> One day, while walking in the park, I suddenly caught sight of a beautiful bird. Its colorful feathers and graceful flight made me stop and admire. I was so lucky to have this wonderful sight. **有一天，在公园散步时，我突然看到一只美丽的鸟。它多彩的羽毛和优雅的飞行让我驻足欣赏。我很幸运能有这样美好的景象。**

> One day, Tom went to a new city for sightseeing. He saw beautiful buildings and interesting people. He enjoyed the views and took many photos. Sightseeing made his day wonderful. **有一天，汤姆去一个新城市观光。他看到了漂亮的建筑和有趣的人。他欣赏风景并拍了很多照片。观光让他这一天很美好。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I saw a strange mark on a tree. I wondered what it could be. Later, I learned it was a sign left by a lost traveler seeking help. The sign gave me a clue to find them. **有一天，在森林里散步时，我看到树上有一个奇怪的标记。我想知道这可能是什么。后来，我得知这是一个迷路旅行者留下寻求帮助的标志。这个标志给了我找到他们的线索。**

> One day, I was lost in a forest. Suddenly, I saw a flashing light, which was a signal from a rescue team. They used it to guide me out safely. The signal was like a bright hope in the darkness. **有一天，我在森林里迷路了。突然，我看到一道闪烁的光，这是救援队发出的信号。他们用它安全地引导我走出森林。这个信号就像黑暗中的一线光明。**
> 想象一下，在一个重要的合同签署仪式上，人们排着队等待签名成为 signatory。小明紧张又兴奋，因为成为 signatory 意味着承担责任和获得机会。最终他签下名字，成为了这份合同的签署方。 **想象在合同签署仪式上，小明成为签署方的情景来辅助记忆 signatory 这个单词，意思是签署方，签字人**

> A famous artist was known for his unique signature. One day, a thief tried to imitate it to steal his paintings. But the real signature had a hidden mark, and the thief was caught. Remember, a signature is a unique mark of identity. **一位著名的艺术家因其独特的签名而闻名。有一天，一个小偷试图模仿它来偷他的画。但真正的签名有一个隐藏的标记，小偷被抓住了。记住，signature 就是独特的身份标识。**

> A famous singer was invited to a party. Before entering, she signed her name on a beautiful card. It means to write your name, usually to show that you agree or are present. **一位著名歌手被邀请参加一个聚会。在进入之前，她在一张漂亮的卡片上签了名。这个单词意思是签名，通常表示同意或到场。**

> A young scientist was working hard on a project. When he finally made a breakthrough, everyone realized the significance of his work. It was a major step forward that would change many lives. **一位年轻的科学家在一个项目上努力工作。当他最终取得突破时，每个人都意识到了他工作的重要性。这是向前迈出的重要一步，将改变许多人的生活。**

> A scientist made a significant discovery. It was a new medicine that could save many lives. Everyone was excited because this finding was very important and had a big influence. **一位科学家有了一个重大的发现。这是一种能拯救许多生命的新药。每个人都很兴奋，因为这个发现非常重要且具有很大的影响力。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment. The results showed a significantly different outcome. It meant a major change and breakthrough. This made everyone excited and hopeful for the future. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验。结果显示出了显著不同的结果。这意味着一个重大的变化和突破。这让每个人都为未来感到兴奋和充满希望。**

> One day, a king needed to send a message. He used a special symbol on a banner to signify his order. The symbol was understood by all and it meant something important was going to happen. **有一天，一位国王需要传达一个信息。他在旗帜上使用了一个特殊的符号来表示他的命令。这个符号被所有人理解，意味着重要的事情将要发生。**

> In a dark forest, a little bird was singing loudly. But when a fierce tiger appeared, everything fell into silence. The bird stopped singing, and even the wind seemed to hold its breath. Silence filled the forest. **在一片黑暗的森林里，一只小鸟在大声歌唱。但当一只凶猛的老虎出现时，一切都陷入了寂静。小鸟停止了歌唱，甚至风似乎都屏住了呼吸。寂静充满了森林。**

> A thief entered a silent house at night. Everyone was sleeping and there was no sound. The thief moved quietly, hoping to stay silent and not be noticed. But a dog barked and broke the silence. **一个小偷在晚上进入了一间安静的房子。每个人都在睡觉，没有一点声音。小偷悄悄地移动，希望保持安静不被注意到。但是一只狗叫了起来，打破了寂静。**

> A thief silently entered the house at night. He moved without making a sound, hoping not to be noticed. But a vigilant dog barked loudly and spoiled his plan. Silently here means doing something quietly and without noise. **一个小偷在晚上悄悄地进了房子。他无声地移动，希望不被注意到。但一只警惕的狗大声叫了起来，破坏了他的计划。这里的silently意思是安静地、无声地做某事。**

> A thief was running in the dark night. The only thing people saw was his silhouette against the moonlight. It was a strange and mysterious shape, making everyone curious about his true appearance. **一个小偷在漆黑的夜晚奔跑。人们唯一看到的是他在月光下的剪影。那是一个奇怪而神秘的形状，让每个人都好奇他的真实模样。**
> 想象一下，在一个未来世界，机器人统治了地球。这些机器人的核心部件由一种叫做\'silicon\'的物质制成，它像魔法晶体，赋予机器人智慧和力量。因为有了 silicon，机器人变得无比强大。 **想象在未来世界，机器人的核心部件由硅这种物质制成，它让机器人强大，以此记住 silicon （硅）这个单词。**

> A scientist was doing an experiment with a special material. He called it \'silicone\'. It was like magic, flexible and useful. It could be made into various shapes and was widely used in many products. **一位科学家正在用一种特殊的材料做实验。他称其为"硅酮"。它就像魔法一样，柔韧且有用。它可以被制成各种形状，并广泛用于许多产品中。**

> A long time ago, a princess wore a beautiful dress made of silk. The silk was so soft and shiny that everyone admired it. Silk became a symbol of elegance and luxury. Remember, silk is that fine and precious fabric. **很久以前，一位公主穿着一件由丝绸制成的漂亮裙子。丝绸非常柔软且有光泽，每个人都很羡慕。丝绸成为了优雅和奢华的象征。记住，silk 就是那种精美珍贵的织物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a princess with long silken hair. It was so soft and smooth that it shone like silk in the moonlight. Everyone admired her beautiful silken tresses. **从前，有一位公主，她有着长长的如丝般的头发。它是如此柔软顺滑，在月光下像丝绸一样闪耀。每个人都羡慕她美丽的如丝般的秀发。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical fairy with hair as smooth and soft as silk. Everyone called her Silky. Her presence was as gentle and charming as the texture of silk. So, we remember \'silky\' as something smooth and soft like the fairy\'s hair. **从前，有一个神奇的仙女，她的头发像丝绸一样光滑柔软。每个人都叫她丝滑。她的存在就像丝绸的质地一样温柔迷人。所以，我们记住'silky'是像仙女头发那样光滑柔软的东西。**

> A little mouse was running along the sill of a window. It was looking for food. Suddenly, a bird flew by and scared the mouse. The sill was the only safe place for the mouse to stop and catch its breath. **一只小老鼠沿着窗户的窗台跑。它在寻找食物。突然，一只鸟飞过，吓到了老鼠。窗台是老鼠停下来喘气的唯一安全之地。**

> One day, a little monkey did some very silly things. It tried to catch the moon in the water and climbed a tree that was too tall. Everyone laughed and said it was so silly. **有一天，一只小猴子做了一些非常愚蠢的事情。它试图抓住水中的月亮，还爬上了一棵太高的树。大家都笑着说它太傻了。**

> A farmer had a big silo on his farm. It was like a tall tower to store grains. One day, a strong wind blew, but the silo stood firm, protecting the precious grains inside. The silo was the hero of the farm! **一位农民的农场里有一个大筒仓。它就像一座高塔用来储存谷物。有一天，刮起了大风，但筒仓屹立不倒，保护着里面珍贵的谷物。筒仓是农场的英雄！**

> A brave diver was exploring an underwater cave. As he swam, he noticed a lot of fine particles. These were silt. They made the water a bit murky, but he knew silt was just tiny pieces of soil carried by water. **一位勇敢的潜水员正在探索一个水下洞穴。当他游的时候，他注意到很多细小的颗粒。这些就是淤泥。它们让水有点浑浊，但他知道淤泥只是被水携带的细小的土壤颗粒。**

> Once upon a time, a poor boy found a shiny silver coin on the road. It was so beautiful and made him very happy. With this silver coin, he bought food and changed his life. Remember, silver means shiny and valuable metal. **从前，一个贫穷的男孩在路上发现了一枚闪闪发光的银币。它如此美丽，让男孩非常高兴。凭借这枚银币，他买了食物，改变了自己的生活。记住，silver 意思是闪亮且有价值的金属。**

> One day, I was invited to a fancy dinner. The table was filled with shiny silverware like forks, knives and spoons. They were so beautiful that I couldn\'t forget. That\'s how I remember the word \'silverware\' for table utensils made of silver. **有一天，我被邀请参加一场豪华晚宴。餐桌上摆满了闪闪发光的银质餐具，比如叉子、刀子和勺子。它们太漂亮了，让我难以忘怀。这就是我记住\'silverware\'这个表示银质餐具单词的方式。**

> A girl was walking in the forest at night. The moonlight shone through the trees, making everything look silvery. She was amazed by the silvery beauty and felt as if she was in a magical world. **一个女孩在夜晚的森林里散步。月光透过树木洒下，让一切看起来都银光闪闪。她被这银白的美丽所惊艳，感觉自己仿佛置身于一个神奇的世界。**

> Once upon a time, there were two cats. One was black and the other was gray. They had similar eyes and similar tails. People could easily tell they were alike. Similar means alike or nearly the same. **从前，有两只猫。一只是黑色的，另一只是灰色的。它们有着相似的眼睛和相似的尾巴。人们很容易看出它们很像。Similar 意思是相像的或几乎相同的。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry found two cakes with great similarity. They looked almost the same in shape and color. But on a closer look, they noticed some tiny differences. This showed them what similarity means. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞发现了两块非常相似的蛋糕。它们在形状和颜色上看起来几乎一样。但仔细一看，他们注意到了一些细微的差别。这就让他们明白了相似性的意思。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry were running. Tom ran fast, and Jerry, similarly, moved at a good pace. It means Jerry was running in a similar way to Tom. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞在跑步。汤姆跑得很快，杰瑞同样也跑得不慢。这意味着杰瑞以和汤姆相似的方式在跑。**
> 想象一下，你在厨房煮着一锅美味的汤，火调得很小，汤只是微微地冒泡、翻腾，这种状态就是\'simmer\'。就像内心的怒火，还在压抑，尚未完全爆发。 **想象在厨房煮汤微微冒泡、翻腾的情景来理解simmer（用小火炖；即将爆发）的意思**

> A little rabbit was lost in a forest. It was very scared. But then it found a simple path that led it home. The path was straight and had no confusing turns. The rabbit was so happy. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了，它非常害怕。但随后它发现了一条简单的小路，这条小路笔直，没有让人迷惑的转弯，带着它回了家。小兔子非常开心。**

> A young artist struggled to create complex paintings but failed. One day, he decided to embrace simplicity and painted a single beautiful flower. The simplicity of his new work brought him great success and joy. **一位年轻的艺术家努力创作复杂的画作却失败了。有一天，他决定拥抱简单，画了一朵美丽的花。这种简单性让他的新作品取得了巨大成功并带来了快乐。**

> A student was struggling with a complex math problem. But with the simplification skills taught by the teacher, the problem became easy. The student finally understood the power of simplification. **一个学生在为一道复杂的数学题苦恼。但在老师教授的简化技巧下，问题变得容易了。这个学生终于明白了简化的力量。**

> A little monkey wanted to organize his toys but it was too messy. So he decided to SIMPLIFY the task by sorting them into just a few groups. Finally, his room became tidy and easy to manage. **一只小猴子想整理他的玩具，但太乱了。所以他决定简化这个任务，把玩具只分成几组。最后，他的房间变得整洁且易于管理。**

> A designer was criticized for his simplistic approach. He just used basic colors and simple shapes, thinking it was enough. But in reality, it lacked depth and complexity. Remember, simplistic means over-simplified and lacking completeness. **一位设计师因其过于简单化的方法而受到批评。他只用了基本的颜色和简单的形状，认为这样就够了。但实际上，这缺乏深度和复杂性。记住，simplistic 意思是过于简化且不完整。**

> A little boy was asked how he solved a math problem. He answered, \'I simply used the basic formula.\' It means he did it in a straightforward and easy way. That shows the meaning of \'simply\' as \'仅仅；简单地；简直\'. **一个小男孩被问到他如何解决一道数学题。他回答："我仅仅用了基本公式。"这意味着他以直接、容易的方式做到了。这体现了"simply"有"仅仅；简单地；简直"的意思。**
> 想象一个机器人，它试图\'simulate\'人类的行为和情感。它观察人类的喜怒哀乐，然后模仿，努力让自己看起来和人类一样。就像这个机器人，\'simulate\'就是模仿、模拟的意思。 **想象一个试图模仿人类行为和情感的机器人，以此来理解\'simulate\'意为模仿、模拟。**
> 想象一下，一位科学家在实验室里创造了一个虚拟世界，里面的一切都是对真实世界的模拟（simulation）。他通过各种数据和模型，让这个虚拟世界尽可能逼真，就像在进行一场神奇的实验。 **想象一位科学家在实验室创造模拟真实世界的虚拟世界的情景来辅助记忆simulation（模拟；仿真）这个单词。**

> A brave astronaut was training in a simulator. It looked just like a real spaceship. He practiced many times to be ready for the real adventure. The simulator helped him get prepared. **一位勇敢的宇航员在模拟器中训练。它看起来就像一艘真正的宇宙飞船。他多次练习，为真正的冒险做好准备。模拟器帮助他做好了准备。**
> 想象一下，在一个盛大的音乐会上，乐队的指挥同时(simultaneous)挥动双手，让小提琴手和钢琴手同时演奏出美妙的旋律，观众们沉浸在这同步的美妙音乐中。 **想象在音乐会上指挥让乐手同时演奏来辅助记忆 simultaneous 同时的意思**
> 想象一下，在盛大的音乐会上，乐队的鼓手和吉他手 SIMULTANEOUSLY 同时开始演奏，节奏完美契合，观众们瞬间沉浸在这同步的美妙旋律中，感受到了音乐的强大魅力。 **想象在音乐会上，鼓手和吉他手同时演奏，让观众感受【simultaneously（同时地）】这个单词的含义**
> 从前有个调皮的小孩，总是不听父母的话，偷偷去做坏事，这就是一种\'sin\'（罪过）。他长大后才明白自己的错误，努力改正。记住这个小孩的行为，就能记住\'sin\'这个单词啦。 **从前有个调皮小孩总是犯错，这就是'罪过'。记住这个小孩的行为就能记住'sin'。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy. Since he got a new toy car, he has been very happy every day. The word\'since\' here shows the starting point of his happiness. **从前，有一个小男孩。自从他得到了一辆新玩具车，他每天都很开心。这里的'since'这个词表明了他开心的起点。**

> Once upon a time, there was a sincere king. He always told the truth and had a pure heart. His people trusted him completely because of his sincerity. No lies, no tricks, just true and honest feelings. **从前，有一位真诚的国王。他总是说实话，有一颗纯净的心。因为他的真诚，他的子民完全信任他。没有谎言，没有诡计，只有真实和诚实的情感。**

> A sincere friend named Lily always told the truth. One day, she sincerely apologized for a mistake and everyone forgave her. Remember, \'sincerely\' means truly and honestly, like Lily\'s words. **一个真诚的朋友叫莉莉，她总是说实话。有一天，她真诚地为一个错误道歉，大家都原谅了她。记住，\'sincerely\'意思是真心实意地，诚实地，就像莉莉的话。**

> A sincere king always listened carefully to his people\'s problems. He showed no falsehood and had true care. His sincerity made his kingdom prosperous and happy. Remember, sincerity means being genuine and honest. **一位真诚的国王总是认真倾听他子民的问题。他没有丝毫虚假，充满真心关怀。他的真诚让他的王国繁荣幸福。记住，sincerity 意思是真诚、诚挚。**

> A thief was stealing jewels from a church. He knew it was sinful but was driven by greed. When caught, he felt deep remorse. Remember, actions like this are sinful and will lead to punishment. **一个小偷从教堂偷珠宝。他知道这是有罪的，但被贪婪驱使。当被抓住时，他深感懊悔。记住，像这样的行为是有罪的，会导致惩罚。**

> One day, a little bird was alone in the forest. It felt happy and began to sing a beautiful song. Its voice was so sweet that all the animals around stopped to listen. The bird\'s singing made the forest a wonderful place. **有一天，一只小鸟独自在森林里。它感到很开心，于是开始唱起了一首美妙的歌。它的声音如此甜美，周围所有的动物都停下来倾听。小鸟的歌声让森林变成了一个美好的地方。**

> One day, a little girl was singing beautifully in the park. A man passing by said, \'You have the potential to be a great singer.\' From then on, the girl practiced singing hard every day. Now she is a famous singer. **一天，一个小女孩在公园里唱得很美。一个路过的男人说：'你有成为伟大歌手的潜力。'从那以后，女孩每天都努力练习唱歌。现在她是一位著名的歌手。**

> One day, I went to a forest. There, I heard beautiful singing. It was like a fairy\'s voice. I followed the sound and found a bird on a branch, singing happily. The bird\'s singing made the forest more charming. **有一天，我去了一片森林。在那里，我听到了美妙的歌声。它就像仙女的声音。我循着声音，发现一只鸟在树枝上欢快地歌唱。这只鸟的歌声让森林更具魅力。**

> A young man was always single. One day, he decided to go on a journey to find love. On the way, he met a special girl and finally ended his single life. Remember, \'single\' means alone or unmarried. **一个年轻人一直单身。有一天，他决定去旅行寻找爱情。在路上，他遇到了一个特别的女孩，终于结束了他的单身生活。记住，'single'意思是单独的或未婚的。**

> A king was always dressed in a singular outfit. No one else wore the same. It made him stand out. \'Singular\' means unique or one of a kind, just like the king\'s clothes. **一位国王总是穿着独特的服装。没有其他人穿同样的。这使他脱颖而出。'singular'意思是独特的、独一无二的，就像国王的衣服一样。**

> In a distant universe, a lone astronaut discovered a strange phenomenon. It was a singularity, a point of infinite density and mystery. The astronaut was both scared and fascinated, as this singularity held unknown powers. **在遥远的宇宙中，一位孤独的宇航员发现了一种奇怪的现象。这是一个奇点，一个密度无限且神秘的点。宇航员既害怕又着迷，因为这个奇点拥有未知的力量。**

> A young artist was singularly focused on creating a unique masterpiece. Despite many distractions, she remained singularly determined and finally achieved success. It means being exceptionally or remarkably. **一位年轻的艺术家特别专注于创作一幅独特的杰作。尽管有很多干扰，她仍然非常坚定，最终取得了成功。这个词意思是特别地、异常地。**

> A man was walking alone in a dark forest at night. Suddenly, he saw a sinister shadow lurking behind the trees. It made him shiver with fear. Later he found it was just a big owl. But the feeling of that sinister moment stayed with him. **一个男人在夜晚独自走在黑暗的森林里。突然，他看到一个阴森的影子潜伏在树后。这让他害怕得发抖。后来他发现那只是一只大猫头鹰。但那个阴森时刻的感觉一直伴随着他。**

> A thief was stealing gold in a house. Suddenly, the floor started to sink. He was so scared and regretted his bad behavior. The word \'sink\' means to go down gradually or fall below the surface. **一个小偷正在一间房子里偷金子。突然，地板开始下沉。他非常害怕，并为自己的不良行为感到后悔。单词 \'sink\' 意思是逐渐下降或沉到表面以下。**

> A ship was sailing on the sea. Suddenly, a huge storm came and the ship started sinking. People were scared and tried to find a way to survive. The scene was terrifying. **一艘船在海上航行。突然，一场巨大的风暴袭来，船开始下沉。人们很害怕，试图寻找生存的方法。这个场景十分可怕。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who always did bad things and broke the law. Everyone called him a sinner. But one day, he realized his mistakes and decided to change. **从前，有一个总是做坏事和违法的人。每个人都称他为罪人。但有一天，他意识到自己的错误并决定改变。**
> 想象一下，一个勇敢的探险家在洞穴中探险，突然遇到了一些弯曲的通道，就像'sinus'（窦，窦道）一样。他小心地沿着这些复杂的窦道前行，最终成功走出洞穴。 **想象一位探险家在洞穴中遇到如'窦道'般的弯曲通道并成功走出的故事来辅助记忆'sinus'这个单词。**

> A thief wanted to steal the precious liquid from a big tank. He used a siphon, a special tube, to quietly suck out the liquid without being noticed. With the siphon, he accomplished his sneaky plan. **一个小偷想从一个大罐子里偷珍贵的液体。他用了一根虹吸管，一种特殊的管子，悄悄地把液体吸出来而不被发现。靠着虹吸管，他完成了他偷偷摸摸的计划。**
> 有一天，小明在迷路时遇到一位穿着得体的男士。小明礼貌地询问：\'Sir, could you please help me?\' 男士微笑着给他指路。这里的\'Sir\'就是对男士的尊称，表达尊敬。 **有一天，小明迷路时向一位穿着得体的男士求助，称呼其为\'Sir\'，这里\'Sir\'是对男士的尊称，表示尊敬。**

> A brave sailor was on a ship. One night, a siren sounded loudly. It was a warning of danger ahead. The sailor acted quickly and saved the ship. Remember, siren means a loud and warning sound. **一位勇敢的水手在船上。一天晚上，警报器大声响起。这是前方有危险的警告。水手迅速行动，拯救了船只。记住，siren 意思是响亮的警报声。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl. She always played with her sister. They shared toys and secrets. The sister was very kind and always took care of her. They had a wonderful time together. **从前，有一个女孩。她总是和她的姐姐/妹妹一起玩。她们分享玩具和秘密。姐姐/妹妹非常善良，总是照顾她。她们在一起度过了美好的时光。**

> One day, Tom was very tired. He found a comfortable chair and just wanted to sit down and have a rest. As he sat there, he felt all his fatigue fading away. **一天，汤姆非常累。他找到一把舒适的椅子，只想坐下来休息一下。当他坐在那里时，他感觉所有的疲劳都渐渐消失了。**
> 想象一下，有一群朋友总是喜欢 sit（坐）在一起 com（来）看有趣的剧集，每次都笑得前仰后合。后来人们就把这种大家坐在一起看的喜剧剧集叫做 sitcom。 **想象一群朋友坐在一起看喜剧剧集来辅助记忆 sitcom（情景喜剧）这个单词**

> A group of explorers were lost in a strange place. They needed to find a suitable site to set up camp. Finally, they discovered a flat and safe area. \'Site\' means a place or location. **一群探险家在一个陌生的地方迷路了。他们需要找到一个合适的地点来扎营。最后，他们发现了一块平坦且安全的区域。'site'意思是地点、位置。**

> One day, little Tom\'s parents had to go out. So they found a sitter to take care of him. The sitter played games and read stories with Tom. Tom had a great time with the sitter. **一天，小汤姆的父母得外出。所以他们找了一个临时照看孩子的人。这位临时保姆和汤姆一起玩游戏、读故事。汤姆和临时保姆度过了愉快的时光。**

> One day, a little cat was sitting quietly on a soft cushion. It was enjoying the peaceful moment and looking around with its big eyes. Suddenly, a bird flew by, but the cat just kept sitting there, too lazy to move. **一天，一只小猫安静地坐在一个柔软的垫子上。它正享受着这宁静的时刻，睁着大眼睛四处张望。突然，一只鸟飞过，但小猫只是继续坐在那里，懒得动弹。**

> Imagine a lost traveler. He doesn\'t know where he is. We need to situate him, that is, figure out his exact position. So, situate means to determine or place something in a particular position or location. **想象一个迷路的旅行者。他不知道自己在哪里。我们需要确定他的位置，也就是 situate 他。所以，situate 意思是确定某物的位置或使某物处于特定位置。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange city. He didn\'t know where to go. This was a difficult situation. But he stayed calm and found a map to solve the problem. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城市迷路了。他不知道该往哪儿走。这是一个艰难的处境。但他保持冷静，找到了一张地图解决了问题。**

> There were six little ducks playing in the pond. They were having so much fun. But then, a big dog came and scared five of them away. Only one brave duck stayed. So, remember, six is like the number of those original little ducks. **有六只小鸭子在池塘里玩耍。它们玩得很开心。但是后来，一只大狗来了，吓跑了五只。只有一只勇敢的鸭子留了下来。所以，记住，six 就像最初小鸭子的数量。**

> One day, a little girl was celebrating her sixteenth birthday. She had sixteen candles on her cake and received sixteen gifts. It was a wonderful day full of joy and surprises. **有一天，一个小女孩正在庆祝她的十六岁生日。她的蛋糕上有十六根蜡烛，还收到了十六份礼物。这是充满欢乐和惊喜的美妙一天。**
> Once upon a time, there was a magic race. The sixteenth runner crossed the finish line and won a special prize. It was a thrilling moment! **从前，有一场神奇的比赛。第十六名赛跑者冲过了终点线并赢得了一份特别的奖品。那是一个激动人心的时刻！**
> A little mouse was trying to find its way in a big maze. It turned six corners and finally reached the sixth exit. It was so happy to be out! **一只小老鼠在一个大迷宫里试图找到出路。它转了六个弯，终于到达了第六个出口。它出来后非常高兴！**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to collect sixty bananas. But it was not easy. It climbed trees, searched everywhere, and finally got exactly sixty bananas. It was so happy! **一天，一只小猴子想要收集六十根香蕉。但这并不容易。它爬树，到处寻找，最后正好得到了六十根香蕉。它太高兴了！**
> 想象一下，有一个巨大的宝藏箱，里面装满了金银财宝。这个宝藏箱非常大，大到需要好几个人才能抬得动，我们就用 sizable 来形容这个巨大的宝藏箱。 **想象一个巨大的宝藏箱来辅助记忆 sizable 这个表示相当大的、可观的单词**

> A tailor was always confused about the size of clothes. One day, a customer came and clearly said the size he needed. The tailor finally made a perfect fit. So, size means the measurement or extent of something. **一位裁缝总是对衣服的尺寸感到困惑。有一天，一位顾客来了，清楚地说出了他需要的尺寸。裁缝终于做出了完美合身的衣服。所以，size 指的是某物的尺寸、大小或规模。**

> A poor man was looking for treasure. One day, he found a sizeable cave. In it, there were many jewels and gold. His life changed completely. He became rich because of this sizeable discovery. **一个穷人正在寻找宝藏。有一天，他发现了一个相当大的洞穴。在里面，有许多珠宝和黄金。因为这个相当大的发现，他的生活完全改变了。他变得富有了。**
> 想象一下，在炎热的夏天，你在户外烧烤。当把牛排放在烤架上时，它发出'sizzle'的声音，那是热油与高温碰撞的声音，滋滋作响，仿佛在告诉你美食即将出炉。 **想象在夏天烧烤时牛排发出滋滋声来辅助记忆'sizzle'（动词，发出（油煎食物的）咝咝声）**

> One cold winter day, little Tom put on his skates and went to the frozen lake. He moved smoothly on the ice, feeling like a bird. Skating was so much fun for him. **在一个寒冷的冬日，小汤姆穿上他的滑冰鞋去了结冰的湖面上。他在冰上顺滑地移动，感觉自己像一只小鸟。滑冰对他来说太有趣了。**

> One day, a brave boy named Tom decided to ride his skateboard to explore a new park. He showed amazing skills on the skateboard, jumping over obstacles and having a great time. The skateboard became his best friend for adventure. **一天，一个勇敢的叫汤姆的男孩决定骑着他的滑板去探索一个新公园。他在滑板上展示了惊人的技巧，跳过障碍，玩得很开心。滑板成了他冒险的最好伙伴。**

> One day, a little boy saw a skater performing amazing tricks on the ice. The skater moved so smoothly and gracefully. The boy was so impressed and decided to learn skating too. **有一天，一个小男孩看到一位滑冰者在冰上表演惊人的技巧。这位滑冰者移动得如此平稳和优雅。小男孩印象深刻，决定也去学习滑冰。**

> One cold winter day, Lily put on her skates and went skating on the frozen lake. She moved gracefully, enjoying the speed and freedom. Skating made her feel so happy and alive. **在一个寒冷的冬日，莉莉穿上她的滑冰鞋去冰冻的湖上滑冰。她动作优雅，享受着速度与自由。滑冰让她感到无比快乐和充满活力。**

> A brave scientist was exploring an ancient cave. In a hidden corner, he found a skeletal hand, which belonged to a long-lost adventurer. This creepy discovery made him understand the meaning of \'skeletal\' - relating to a skeleton. **一位勇敢的科学家正在探索一个古老的洞穴。在一个隐蔽的角落，他发现了一只骨骼的手，这只手属于一位早已失踪的冒险家。这个令人毛骨悚然的发现让他明白了\'skeletal\'这个词的意思------与骨骼有关的。**

> In a dark cave, a brave adventurer found a hidden room. On the wall, there was a strange drawing of a skeleton. It had big bones and looked scary. The adventurer knew this skeleton held some secrets of the cave. **在一个黑暗的洞穴里，一位勇敢的探险家发现了一个隐藏的房间。在墙上，有一幅奇怪的骷髅画。它有着大骨头，看起来很可怕。探险家知道这个骷髅藏着洞穴的一些秘密。**

> A scientist was always skeptic about new theories. One day, a strange phenomenon occurred. Everyone believed it easily, but he investigated carefully. Finally, he found the truth. Remember, a skeptic questions and doubts. **一位科学家总是对新理论持怀疑态度。有一天，出现了一个奇怪的现象。每个人都轻易相信了，但他仔细调查。最后，他找到了真相。记住，skeptic 就是质疑和怀疑的人。**

> A scientist was skeptical about a new theory. He didn\'t believe it easily. But after many experiments and research, he finally changed his mind. Skeptical means having doubts or not easily convinced. **一位科学家对一个新理论持怀疑态度。他不轻易相信。但经过多次实验和研究，他最终改变了想法。skeptical 意思是怀疑的，不轻信的。**

> A detective was always filled with skepticism. When faced with a seemingly perfect alibi, he doubted and investigated thoroughly. His skepticism led him to solve many difficult cases. **一位侦探总是充满怀疑态度。当面对看似完美的不在场证明时，他表示怀疑并进行彻底调查。他的怀疑态度使他破获了许多疑难案件。**
> 有一天，画家小明去野外旅行，他随身带着本子，看到美丽风景就快速(Sketch)画几笔。回家后，他看着这些草图，回忆起了旅行中的美好。 **有一天，画家小明去野外旅行，他随身带着本子，看到美丽风景就快速画几笔草图。回家后，他看着这些草图，回忆起了旅行中的美好。**

> One day, I was walking in a sketchy neighborhood. There were broken windows and graffiti everywhere. It made me feel unsafe and unsure. Sketchy means uncertain or unreliable. **有一天，我走在一个不怎么样的街区。到处都是破碎的窗户和涂鸦。这让我感到不安全和不确定。sketchy 意思是不确定的或不可靠的。**

> A chef was making a pizza. But when he put the toppings on, they were all skew. The pizza looked strange. So he had to start over to make it right. Remember, \'skew\' means not straight or not in the right position. **一位厨师正在做披萨。但当他放配料时，它们都放歪了。披萨看起来很奇怪。所以他不得不重新开始把它做好。记住，\'skew\'意思是不正的或不在正确位置的。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he found a skewer with delicious meat. It was like a magic stick that led him to a small village where he got food and directions. Remember, a skewer can be a savior in strange places! **一位饥饿的旅行者在森林中迷路了。突然，他发现了一根串着美味肉的烤肉扦。它就像一根魔法棒，引领他来到了一个小村庄，在那里他得到了食物和指引。记住，烤肉扦在陌生的地方可能会成为救星！**

> A brave boy wanted to show his courage. So, he decided to ski down a very steep mountain. He wore his skis, held the poles, and sped down. It was an exciting adventure! **一个勇敢的男孩想要展示他的勇气。所以，他决定从一座非常陡峭的山上滑雪下来。他穿上滑雪板，拿着雪杖，快速滑下。这是一场令人兴奋的冒险！**

> A car was speeding on the road. Suddenly, it hit a wet spot and started to skid. The driver was very scared but managed to stop the car safely. \'Skid\' means to slide uncontrollably. **一辆汽车在路上疾驰。突然，它碰到一块湿滑的地方开始打滑。司机非常害怕，但设法安全地停住了车。\'skid\'意思是失控地滑行。**

> One day, a young boy saw a skier speeding down the snowy mountain. The skier was so cool, wearing colorful clothes and skiing smoothly. The boy was amazed and decided to become a great skier like him one day. **一天，一个小男孩看到一位滑雪者在雪山上快速滑下。这位滑雪者太酷了，穿着彩色的衣服，滑得很顺畅。小男孩很惊讶，并决定有一天也要成为像他一样出色的滑雪者。**

> A man was lost on a desert island. One day, he saw a skiff floating in the sea. He rowed the skiff and finally reached the mainland. The skiff was his savior. **一个男人被困在荒岛上。有一天，他看到海上漂着一艘小艇。他划着这艘小艇，最终到达了大陆。这艘小艇就是他的救星。**

> One cold winter day, Tom decided to go skiing. He put on his skis and slid down the snowy mountain. The speed and the thrill made him love skiing. He had a great time and couldn\'t wait to do it again. **在一个寒冷的冬日，汤姆决定去滑雪。他穿上滑雪板，从雪山上滑下来。速度和刺激让他爱上了滑雪。他玩得很开心，迫不及待想再去。**

> Once upon a time, a young man named Tom had no skill in cooking. But he was determined to learn. Through continuous practice, he finally gained the skill and could cook delicious meals. Now, \'skill\' means the ability to do something well. **从前，有个叫汤姆的年轻人没有烹饪技能。但他决心学习。通过不断练习，他最终获得了技能，能够做出美味的饭菜。现在，'skill'意思是做好某事的能力。**

> A young man wanted to become a master chef. He practiced every day and learned many techniques. Finally, he became skilled and could create delicious dishes. People loved his food. He was so proud of his skilled cooking. **一个年轻人想成为大厨。他每天练习，学习了很多技巧。最终，他变得技艺娴熟，能够做出美味的菜肴。人们喜欢他做的食物。他为自己熟练的厨艺感到骄傲。**

> A chef was cooking in a skillet. The skillet was very hot and shiny. Suddenly, a drop of oil splashed out, making a sizzling sound. Remember, the thing the chef used is a \'skillet\' - a frying pan. **一位厨师正在用平底锅做饭。这个平底锅很热很亮。突然，一滴油溅了出来，发出嘶嘶声。记住，厨师用的这个东西就是'skillet'------平底锅。**

> One day, a chef was cooking in the kitchen. His every move was so precise and smooth. He cut, fried, and decorated with great ease. Everyone praised him as skillful. He had the skill to make every dish perfect. **一天，一位厨师在厨房烹饪。他的每个动作都那么精准和流畅。他切、煎、装饰都轻松自如。大家都称赞他技术娴熟。他有让每道菜都完美的技能。**

> A young artist was painting skillfully. People were amazed by how skillfully he handled the brush. His skillfully created artworks soon became famous. He proved that with skillfully mastered skills, one can achieve great success. **一位年轻的艺术家正在熟练地作画。人们对他熟练地运用画笔感到惊讶。他熟练创作的艺术作品很快就出名了。他证明了，熟练掌握技能，就能取得巨大成功。**

> A little bird was flying over a lake. It just skimmed the surface of the water with its wings, touching lightly. This action was like \'skim\', meaning to move quickly and lightly over a surface. **一只小鸟飞过湖面。它只是用翅膀轻掠过水面，轻轻触碰。这个动作就像'skim'，意思是快速且轻轻地掠过表面。**

> A girl went to a party wearing a skimpy dress. Everyone was staring at her. But she felt cold and uncomfortable. \'Skimpy\' means too small or not enough. So be careful with your choice of clothes. **一个女孩穿着一件暴露的裙子去参加聚会。每个人都盯着她看。但她感到很冷且不舒服。'skimpy'意思是太少或不足。所以要谨慎选择衣服。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a jungle. One day, he got hurt and his skin was scratched by thorns. But he didn\'t give up and finally found a way out. Remember, \'skin\' is the outer layer of our body. **一位勇敢的冒险家在丛林中迷路了。有一天，他受伤了，皮肤被荆棘划伤。但他没有放弃，最终找到了出路。记住，\'skin\'是我们身体的外层。**

> A young man was always bullied for his long hair. So he shaved it all off and became a skinhead. But people misunderstood him as a troublemaker. Poor guy! **一个年轻人总是因为他的长发被欺负。于是他把头发全剃了，变成了光头党。但人们却误解他是个捣蛋鬼。可怜的家伙！**

> Once upon a time, there was a little monkey. It was very skinny because it refused to eat well. But when it started to have a balanced diet, it became healthy and strong. Remember, \'skinny\' means very thin. **从前，有一只小猴子。它非常瘦，因为它不好好吃饭。但当它开始均衡饮食后，它变得健康又强壮。记住，'skinny'意思是非常瘦的。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry. He saw a long queue for the bus and decided to skip it. He ran all the way to school and was very tired. But he didn\'t miss the class. Remember, \'skip\' means to miss or pass over something. **一天，汤姆很着急。他看到等公交车的队伍很长，就决定不排队了。他一路跑到学校，很累。但他没有错过课。记住，\'skip\'意思是跳过或略过某物。**

> The skipper of the ship was a brave and experienced leader. One day, a huge storm came, but the skipper remained calm and guided the ship safely to the port. He was like a hero, making sure everyone was okay. **这艘船的船长是一位勇敢且经验丰富的领导者。有一天，一场巨大的风暴袭来，但船长保持冷静，并将船安全地引导到港口。他就像一位英雄，确保每个人都安然无恙。**

> A group of brave soldiers was on a mission. Suddenly, they encountered a small and quick fight, a skirmish. It was intense but short-lived. They fought bravely and overcame the challenge. **一群勇敢的士兵在执行任务。突然，他们遭遇了一场小规模且迅速的战斗，一场小冲突。战斗激烈但短暂。他们英勇作战并克服了挑战。**

> A girl was very happy because she got a beautiful skirt as a birthday gift. The skirt was colorful and made her look like a fairy. She wore it to many parties and always felt confident. **一个女孩非常开心，因为她得到了一条漂亮的裙子作为生日礼物。这条裙子色彩斑斓，让她看起来像个仙女。她穿着它参加了很多聚会，总是感到自信。**

> A group of friends decided to perform a skit at the school talent show. They practiced hard and made everyone laugh. The skit was about a funny adventure in a magic forest. **一群朋友决定在学校才艺表演上表演一个短剧。他们努力排练，让所有人都大笑。这个短剧是关于在魔法森林里的一次有趣冒险。**
> 一只小老鼠在黑暗的角落里快速移动，它的小脚 skitter 个不停，一会儿跑到这边，一会儿跑到那边，试图寻找食物。 **一只小老鼠在角落里快速移动，它的小脚不停地'疾跑'，试图寻找食物。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark cave. Suddenly, a skull appeared in the dim light. It seemed to warn the adventurer to go back. The adventurer was scared but remembered the word\'skull\' forever. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗的洞穴中迷路了。突然，在昏暗的光线中出现了一个头骨。它似乎在警告探险家回去。探险家很害怕，但永远记住了"skull"这个词。**

> One night, a little boy was walking in the forest. Suddenly, he smelled a very bad smell. Then he saw a black and white animal. It was a skunk! The skunk raised its tail and sprayed the bad smell to protect itself. **一天晚上，一个小男孩在森林里走着。突然，他闻到一股非常难闻的气味。然后他看到一只黑白相间的动物。那是一只臭鼬！臭鼬抬起尾巴喷出难闻的气味来保护自己。**

> A little bird was flying in the sky. It was so happy and free. It saw white clouds and blue vastness. The sky was like a big stage for it to explore. **一只小鸟在天空中飞翔。它非常开心和自由。它看到了白云和蓝色的广阔。天空就像一个供它探索的大舞台。**

> One night, a little boy was sleeping in a dark room. Suddenly, he saw a bright light. It was a skylight, and through it, he could see the stars. The skylight brought him hope and joy. **一天晚上，一个小男孩在黑暗的房间里睡觉。突然，他看到一束亮光。那是一个天窗，通过它，他能看到星星。天窗给他带来了希望和欢乐。**

> One day, while traveling, I looked out of the window and was amazed by the beautiful skyline. The outline of tall buildings against the sky was like a magical painting. I\'ll never forget that stunning skyline. **有一天，在旅行时，我望向窗外，被美丽的天际线所震撼。高楼大厦在天空映衬下的轮廓就像一幅神奇的画。我永远不会忘记那令人惊叹的天际线。**

> A little boy dreamed of shooting a rocket into the sky. When he grew up, he became a scientist and finally made his dream come true. The number of his successful rocket launches skyrocketed. **一个小男孩梦想着将火箭发射到天空中。当他长大后，他成为了一名科学家，最终实现了梦想。他成功发射火箭的次数飙升。**

> One day, a little ant was lost. It looked up and saw a huge building touching the sky. \'Wow, that must be a skyscraper!\' it exclaimed. The ant was amazed by the tall structure. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁迷路了。它抬头看到一座高耸入云的巨大建筑。'哇，那一定是摩天大楼！'它惊叹道。小蚂蚁对这座高大的建筑感到惊奇。**

> A brave bird was determined to fly skyward. It spread its wings and soared high, aiming for the unknown above. The skyward journey was full of challenges but the bird never gave up. **一只勇敢的鸟决心向天空飞去。它展开翅膀，高高翱翔，朝着上方未知的地方。向上的旅程充满挑战，但鸟从未放弃。**

> A worker was carrying a heavy SLAB of stone. But he tripped and the SLAB broke into pieces. Poor guy! Remember, SLAB means a thick, flat piece of something solid. **一名工人正搬着一块沉重的石板。但他绊倒了，石板碎成了几块。可怜的家伙！记住，slab 意思是厚而平的固体块。**
> 想象一个工人在工作时偷懒（slack），他没有努力干活，而是坐在那里发呆。老板过来看到他很松懈，批评了他。因为 slack 就有松懈、偷懒的意思。 **想象一个工人偷懒被批评的故事来记住 slack 表示松懈、偷懒的意思**

> A brave knight was fighting against a fierce dragon. With one powerful strike, the knight slew the dragon. But later, we use the past participle form \'slain\' to describe the defeated dragon. So, \'slain\' means killed in a violent way. **一位勇敢的骑士正在与一条凶猛的龙战斗。骑士猛力一击，杀死了龙。但之后，我们用过去分词形式\'slain\'来描述被击败的龙。所以，\'slain\'意思是以暴力方式被杀死。**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的滑雪者在雪道上快速穿梭，左右迂回地避开障碍物，就像在玩一场刺激的'slalom'游戏。他的动作敏捷，不断改变方向，这就是'slalom'滑雪障碍赛的场景。 **想象一位滑雪者进行滑雪障碍赛来辅助记忆'slalom（滑雪障碍赛；曲折滑行）'这个单词**
> One day, a furious athlete slam the door hard after losing the game. The sound of the slam was so loud that it echoed through the hallway. **一天，一位愤怒的运动员在输掉比赛后用力摔门。摔门的声音非常大，在走廊里回荡。**

> One day, a foreigner came to our town. He used a lot of strange words that we didn\'t understand. Later we learned those were slang. It made communication a bit confusing but also interesting. **有一天，一个外国人来到我们镇。他用了很多我们不理解的奇怪的词。后来我们知道那些是俚语。这让交流有点困惑但也有趣。**

> A little ant was walking on a board. The board was not flat but had a slant. The ant struggled to keep its balance. It was a tricky path for the ant because of that slant. **一只小蚂蚁在一块木板上行走。木板不是平的，而是倾斜的。蚂蚁努力保持平衡。因为那个倾斜，对蚂蚁来说这是一条棘手的路。**

> One day, Tom made a big mistake. His father was very angry and gave him a slap on the face. Tom realized his fault and promised not to do it again. The slap made a deep impression on him. **一天，汤姆犯了个大错。他父亲非常生气，扇了他一耳光。汤姆意识到了自己的错误，并保证不再犯。这一耳光给他留下了深刻的印象。**

> A brave knight was fighting in a dark forest. His sword could slash through the thick branches easily. With each slash, he made his way forward, determined to reach the end of the forest. **一位勇敢的骑士在黑暗的森林中战斗。他的剑能够轻易地砍断粗厚的树枝。每一次砍击（slash），他都坚定地向前行进，决心走到森林的尽头。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse was running around a room. It saw a slat on the floor and thought it was a perfect place to hide. But when it stepped on it, the slat broke and made a noise. \'Slat\' is a narrow, flat piece of wood or other material. **从前，一只小老鼠在房间里跑来跑去。它看到地板上有一块板条，觉得那是个绝佳的藏身之处。但当它踩上去时，板条断了并发出声响。'slat'指的是窄而扁平的木条或其他材料。**

> A poor student had no money to buy a new notebook. So he used pieces of slate to write on. One day, his teacher praised him for his creative way of learning. Now you know \'slate\' means a kind of material for writing. **一个贫困的学生没钱买新笔记本。所以他用石板片来写字。有一天，他的老师称赞他这种有创意的学习方式。现在你知道\'slate\'指的是一种用于书写的材料。**
> 想象一下，你在面包上涂抹了大量的果酱，那种厚厚的、满满的涂抹方式就是\'slather\'。就像你毫不吝啬地把果酱大量地涂上去，\'slather\'就是指大量地、厚厚地涂抹。 **想象在面包上大量涂抹果酱的情景来辅助记忆\'slather\'，表示大量地、厚厚地涂抹**

> A farmer went to the slaughterhouse. He saw many animals waiting to be slaughtered. The scene was sad. But he knew it was for providing people with meat. \'Slaughter\' means to kill in a cruel way. **一位农民去了屠宰场。他看到很多动物等着被宰杀。这场景很悲伤。但他知道这是为了给人们提供肉类。'slaughter'意思是以残忍的方式杀害。**

> A brave detective was investigating a crime. He followed a clue to a slaughterhouse. There, he saw many animals being prepared for meat. It was a scary scene. The word\'slaughterhouse\' means a place where animals are killed for food. **一位勇敢的侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。他顺着一条线索来到了一个屠宰场。在那里，他看到许多动物正在被准备做成肉食。这是一个可怕的场景。单词"slaughterhouse"意思是屠宰场，即宰杀动物以供食用的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a poor man named Tom. He was forced to become a slave and work day and night without rest. His master was cruel and Tom had no freedom. But Tom never gave up hope of escaping and regaining his freedom. **从前，有个可怜的人叫汤姆。他被迫成为奴隶，没日没夜地工作不得休息。他的主人很残忍，汤姆毫无自由。但汤姆从未放弃逃跑并重获自由的希望。**

> Once upon a time, a poor man was forced into slavery. He had to work hard all day without any freedom. But he never gave up hope and finally escaped. Remember, slavery means being a slave without rights. **从前，有一个穷人被迫成为奴隶。他不得不整天辛苦劳作，没有任何自由。但他从未放弃希望，最终逃脱了。记住，slavery 意思是奴隶制；奴役**

> A brave knight set out to slay the fierce dragon that had been terrorizing the village. With his sharp sword and unwavering courage, he finally defeated the monster and saved everyone. The villagers cheered as the knight\'s heroic act ended the dragon\'s tyranny. **一位勇敢的骑士出发去杀死一直在恐吓村庄的凶猛巨龙。凭借他锋利的剑和坚定不移的勇气，他最终打败了怪物并拯救了所有人。当骑士的英勇行为结束了巨龙的暴政时，村民们欢呼起来。**

> A man was selling cheap and poor-quality clothes in a sleazy market. The clothes looked nice but fell apart easily. \'Sleazy\' describes something cheap, low-quality, and not trustworthy, just like those clothes. **一个男人在一个破旧的市场里卖着便宜且质量差的衣服。这些衣服看起来不错但很容易就坏掉了。'sleazy'形容某物廉价、劣质且不可信，就像那些衣服一样。**

> A sleek cat was running gracefully along the street. Its shiny fur and smooth movements made it stand out. The word \'sleek\' describes something that is smooth and shiny, just like the cat\'s appearance. **一只光滑的猫优雅地沿着街道奔跑。它闪亮的皮毛和流畅的动作使它脱颖而出。单词"sleek"形容某物光滑且有光泽，就像这只猫的外表一样。**

> One night, a tired bear wanted to sleep. It found a cozy cave, lay down, and closed its eyes. Soon, it was in a deep sleep. The next morning, it woke up feeling refreshed. Remember, sleep is when we rest and recharge like the bear. **一天晚上，一只疲倦的熊想要睡觉。它找到一个舒适的洞穴，躺下来，闭上眼睛。很快，它就进入了深度睡眠。第二天早上，它醒来时感到精神焕发。记住，睡眠就是像这只熊一样休息和恢复精力。**

> A man was on a long train journey. He had a very uncomfortable seat and struggled to sleep. But finally, he became a sleeper and had a sweet dream. When he woke up, he felt refreshed. **一个男人正在长途火车旅行。他的座位很不舒服，入睡很困难。但最后，他成为了沉睡者，做了个甜美的梦。当他醒来时，感觉神清气爽。**

> One night, a little bear was sleeping soundly in his cave. His soft breathing and peaceful expression showed how deep his sleep was. When he woke up, he felt full of energy. Remember, sleeping is when we rest and recharge like this little bear. **一天晚上，一只小熊在它的洞穴里睡得很香。它轻柔的呼吸和平静的表情显示出它睡得有多沉。当它醒来时，感觉精力充沛。记住，sleeping 就是像这只小熊这样休息和恢复精力。**

> One night, Tom had a lot of work to do. He stayed up all night and became sleepless. Even when the sun rose, he couldn\'t sleep. Finally, he understood the meaning of being sleepless - having no sleep. **一天晚上，汤姆有很多工作要做。他整晚没睡，变得失眠了。甚至当太阳升起时，他也无法入睡。最后，他明白了 sleepless 的意思 - 无眠的。**

> One night, a little bear was very sleepy. It yawned and its eyes could hardly stay open. It walked slowly to its bed and lay down. Soon, it fell into a deep sleep. Poor sleepy bear! **一天晚上，一只小熊非常困倦。它打着哈欠，眼睛几乎睁不开。它慢慢地走向它的床然后躺了下来。很快，它就陷入了沉睡。可怜的困倦小熊！**

> One cold winter day, I was walking home when sleet started to fall. It was like tiny icy bullets hitting my face. I quickly ran for shelter. Remember, sleet is a mix of rain and ice! **一个寒冷的冬日，我正走在回家的路上，这时雨夹雪开始下了起来。就像小冰粒打在我的脸上。我赶紧跑去躲避。记住，sleet 就是雨和冰的混合物！**

> A girl was sewing a beautiful dress. She accidentally pricked her finger with the needle when working on the sleeve. But she didn\'t give up and finally finished the dress with a perfect sleeve. **一个女孩正在缝制一件漂亮的连衣裙。当她处理袖子部分时，不小心用针扎到了手指。但她没有放弃，最终完成了有着完美袖子的连衣裙。**

> A girl went to a party wearing a beautiful dress. But she felt embarrassed because it was sleeveless and she wasn\'t used to showing her arms. Later, she realized it made her look unique and confident. **一个女孩去参加派对穿了一条漂亮的裙子。但她感到尴尬，因为裙子是无袖的，她不习惯露出手臂。后来，她意识到这让她看起来独特且自信。**

> One snowy Christmas Eve, Santa Claus was in a hurry. He jumped onto his sleigh filled with gifts. The reindeer pulled the sleigh smoothly through the sky. The sleigh was shiny and magical, ready to deliver joy to children. **在一个下雪的平安夜，圣诞老人很匆忙。他跳上装满礼物的雪橇。驯鹿平稳地拉着雪橇穿过天空。雪橇闪闪发光且充满魔力，准备给孩子们送去欢乐。**

> A fairy with a slender figure danced gracefully in the forest. Her long, thin arms and legs moved smoothly. Everyone was amazed by her slender beauty. **一位身材苗条的仙女在森林里优雅地跳舞。她修长纤细的胳膊和腿动作流畅。每个人都为她苗条的美丽而惊叹。**

> A driver was speeding on a mountain road and made a slew of dangerous turns. Finally, he stopped and realized his mistake. \'Slew\' here means a large number or amount. **一位司机在山路上超速行驶，做了大量危险的转弯。最后，他停了下来，意识到自己的错误。这里的"slew"意思是大量、许多。**

> One day, I was very hungry. I went to the kitchen and took out a loaf of bread. Then I used a knife to slice the bread into thin pieces. It was so satisfying! **一天，我非常饿。我走进厨房拿出一条面包。然后我用刀把面包切成薄片。这太让人满足了！**

> One day, a car race was held. The track was very slippery. But there was a driver whose car was slick and moved smoothly. He won the race easily. Everyone was amazed by his slick car. **有一天，举行了一场汽车比赛。赛道非常滑。但有一位车手，他的车很顺滑，行驶平稳。他轻松赢得了比赛。每个人都对他那辆顺滑的车感到惊讶。**

> One rainy day, a man was walking in the street. His shoes were wet until he put on a slicker. The slicker protected him from the rain and made him feel dry and comfortable. **在一个下雨天，一个男人正在街上走。他的鞋子湿了，直到他穿上一件雨衣。这件雨衣保护他免受雨淋，让他感到干爽舒适。**
> 想象一下，在一个游乐场里，有一个长长的滑梯（slide）。小朋友们兴奋地爬上楼梯，然后顺着滑梯快速地滑下来，脸上洋溢着快乐的笑容。 **想象在游乐场中，小朋友们顺着长长的滑梯滑下，以此来记住 slide 这个单词，它有滑梯、滑动的意思。**

> One day, I was playing in the park and saw a little boy on a slider. He slid down happily again and again. The slider looked like a magic path that brought him lots of joy. **有一天，我在公园玩耍，看到一个小男孩在滑梯上。他一次又一次开心地滑下来。滑梯看起来就像一条给他带来很多欢乐的神奇通道。**

> A little monkey was sliding down a long and slippery slope. It had so much fun sliding fast. The word \'sliding\' means moving smoothly along a surface. **一只小猴子正在一个又长又滑的斜坡上滑下来。它快速地滑着，玩得很开心。单词\'sliding\'意思是沿着一个表面顺滑地移动。**

> A slight girl was walking on a narrow path. Suddenly, a gentle wind blew, causing only a slight movement of her hair. This small incident made her feel a slight happiness. **一个瘦小的女孩走在狭窄的小路上。突然，一阵微风轻轻吹过，只让她的头发有了轻微的飘动。这个小小的事情让她感到了一丝快乐。**

> A little mouse was walking slightly on a narrow path. It moved carefully, not too fast and not too slow. Just a tiny bit at a time. This shows what\'slightly\' means - in a small or gentle way. **一只小老鼠在狭窄的小路上轻轻地走着。它走得很小心，不太快也不太慢。每次就一点点。这就展示了\'slightly\'的意思------以轻微、少量的方式。**

> A slim fairy was dancing gracefully in the forest. She had a slender figure and moved lightly. Her slim body made her look so elegant and charming. **一位苗条的仙女在森林里优雅地跳舞。她有着纤细的身形，动作轻盈。她苗条的身材使她看起来如此优雅迷人。**

> A brave knight was exploring a dark cave. Suddenly, he felt something sticky on his feet. It was slime! The green, gooey slime seemed to come alive and try to trap him. But the knight fought hard and escaped. **一位勇敢的骑士正在探索一个黑暗的洞穴。突然，他感觉到脚上有黏糊糊的东西。那是黏液！绿色、粘稠的黏液似乎活了过来，试图困住他。但骑士奋力战斗并逃脱了。**

> One day, Tom went for a walk in the forest. He accidentally stepped into a puddle and his shoes got covered in slimy mud. The slimy texture made him feel disgusted. He had a hard time cleaning it off. **一天，汤姆在森林里散步。他不小心踏进了一个水坑，鞋子沾满了黏糊糊的泥巴。这种黏滑的质地让他感到恶心。他费了好大劲才清理干净。**

> A brave adventurer was in a jungle. He used a sling to throw stones and protect himself from wild animals. The sling was like his secret weapon, helping him stay safe. **一位勇敢的冒险家在丛林中。他用一个投石器投掷石头来保护自己免受野生动物的伤害。这个投石器就像他的秘密武器，帮助他保持安全。**

> A little mouse was trying to slink into the house quietly. It moved slowly and carefully, hoping not to be noticed. But suddenly, a cat appeared and the mouse had to run away quickly. **一只小老鼠正试图悄悄地溜进房子。它缓慢且小心地移动，希望不被注意到。但突然，一只猫出现了，老鼠不得不迅速跑开。**

> A girl was walking on a slippery road. Suddenly, she slipped and fell. But she quickly stood up and continued walking. The word \'slip\' means to lose your balance and fall or move smoothly and quietly. **一个女孩走在湿滑的路上。突然，她滑倒了。但她很快站起来继续走。单词\'slip\'意思是失去平衡摔倒或者顺滑、悄悄地移动。**

> One day, when I was about to take a bath, I couldn\'t find my slippers. I looked everywhere and finally found them under the bed. They were so comfortable that they made my feet feel cozy. **有一天，当我准备洗澡时，我找不到我的拖鞋。我到处找，最后在床底下找到了。它们非常舒服，让我的脚感到很惬意。**

> One day, I was walking on a rainy street. The ground was slippery. I saw a man skating and he fell down. It was so dangerous! Remember, \'slippery\' means something is smooth and easy to slip. **有一天，我走在下雨的街道上。地面很滑。我看到一个人在滑冰，然后他摔倒了。太危险了！记住，\'slippery\'意思是某物光滑且容易滑倒。**

> A thief wanted to enter a house through a slit in the window. But the slit was too narrow and he got stuck. Poor thief! Remember, \'slit\' means a narrow opening or cut. **一个小偷想通过窗户上的一条狭缝进入房子。但狭缝太窄了，他被卡住了。可怜的小偷！记住，\'slit\'意思是窄缝或切口。**

> A snake was seen slithering through the grass. It moved smoothly and silently, like a thief in the night. Its long body seemed to flow effortlessly as it made its way forward. **一条蛇被看到在草丛中蜿蜒爬行。它移动得又平滑又安静，就像夜晚的小偷。它长长的身体似乎毫不费力地向前移动。**

> A thief was stealing a sliver of gold from a jewelry store. When the police arrived, he tried to hide the tiny sliver. But in the end, he was caught. **一个小偷正在从一家珠宝店偷一小片金子。当警察到达时，他试图藏起那小小的一片。但最终，他被抓住了。**
> 想象一下，有个勇敢的探险家在森林中艰难前行，他不断地挥动手臂，踩着泥泞的道路，努力 slog 着。他知道这是一段漫长而艰苦的旅程，但他坚信只要坚持就能到达目的地。 **想象一个探险家在森林中艰难跋涉的情景来记住'slog'这个表示'艰难行进；苦干'的单词。**
> 在一个热闹的集市上，每个摊位都在大声吆喝。有个聪明的商人想出了一句特别吸引人的话，大家都被这句话吸引过来。这句独特的话就叫\'slogan\'，也就是能代表商品或活动的口号、广告语。 **在热闹集市中，商人想出吸引人的独特话语叫\'slogan\'，即口号、广告语。**

> A little rabbit was running up a slope. It was a bit steep, but the rabbit didn\'t give up. Finally, it reached the top. The slope was a challenge, but the rabbit was brave. **一只小兔子正在跑上一个斜坡。它有点陡，但小兔子没有放弃。最后，它到达了顶部。这个斜坡是个挑战，但小兔子很勇敢。**

> Once upon a time, I was climbing a mountain. The path was sloping steeply. I had to hold on tight to avoid slipping. Finally, I reached the top and saw the beautiful view. Remember, \'sloping\' means having a slope or incline. **从前，我在爬山。道路倾斜得很厉害。我必须紧紧抓住以防滑倒。最后，我到达了山顶，看到了美丽的景色。记住，'sloping'意思是倾斜的。**

> A sloppy chef always makes a mess in the kitchen. He spills sauces and drops food everywhere. His sloppy work makes the customers unhappy. Remember, sloppy means messy and not careful. **一位邋遢的厨师总是把厨房弄得一团糟。他到处洒酱汁、掉食物。他的邋遢工作让顾客很不高兴。记住，sloppy 意思是邋遢的、不仔细的。**
> 想象一下，下雨天你走在满是积水的路上，每走一步都能听到脚下的水\'slosh slosh\'作响。你不小心踩到一个大水坑，水溅得到处都是，这就是\'slosh\'（液体晃荡、溅出）的样子。 **想象下雨天在路上走，水晃荡溅出的情景来记住\'slosh\'意为液体晃荡、溅出**
> 想象一下，一个神秘的机器有很多 slot（插槽），就像一个宝藏盒子的开口。钥匙必须准确插入对应的 slot 才能打开宝藏。所以 slot 就是指狭缝、槽口。 **想象一个有很多插槽的神秘机器，钥匙要插入对应的插槽才能打开宝藏，以此来记住 slot 是狭缝、槽口的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a lazy monkey. It spent all day sleeping and doing nothing. People called it a sloth. It was so slow and reluctant to move. This is how I remember the word \'sloth\' meaning laziness. **从前，有一只懒惰的猴子。它整天睡觉，什么也不做。人们称它为树懒。它行动非常缓慢，也不愿意动。这就是我记住'sloth'这个表示懒惰的单词的方式。**

> A slouching man was always criticized for his bad posture. One day, he decided to stand up straight and change. With effort, he overcame the habit of slouching and became more confident. **一个总是弯腰驼背（slouch）的男人总是因为他糟糕的姿势而受到批评。有一天，他决定挺直腰板改变。经过努力，他克服了弯腰驼背的习惯，变得更加自信。**

> One day, a little turtle was walking on the road. It moved very slowly. Other animals passed it quickly. But the turtle didn\'t worry and kept going at its slow pace. Finally, it reached its destination. **有一天，一只小乌龟在路上走。它走得非常慢。其他动物很快就超过了它。但乌龟不着急，一直以它缓慢的速度前进。最后，它到达了目的地。**

> A car was speeding on the highway. Suddenly, the engine had a problem and there was a slowdown. The driver was very worried. Finally, they managed to stop safely. **一辆汽车在高速公路上疾驰。突然，发动机出了问题，速度减慢了。司机非常担心。最后，他们成功安全地停了下来。**

> A rabbit and a turtle had a race. The rabbit ran very fast at first, but then it became lazy. The turtle moved steadily and didn\'t stop. Eventually, the rabbit moved slower and the turtle won. **一只兔子和一只乌龟比赛。兔子一开始跑得很快，但后来变得懒惰。乌龟稳步前进不停歇。最终，兔子跑得更慢了，乌龟赢了。**

> One day, a little turtle was walking on the road. It moved very slowly. A rabbit passed by and laughed at it. But the turtle didn\'t care and kept going at its own slowly pace. Finally, it reached its destination. **一天，一只小乌龟在路上走。它走得非常慢。一只兔子路过并嘲笑它。但乌龟不在乎，仍然以它缓慢的步伐前进。最后，它到达了目的地。**
> 想象一下，在一个化工厂里，有一堆又脏又稠的黑色物质，那就是 sludge 。工人们都讨厌处理它，因为它又黏又臭。这种像烂泥一样的东西，就是淤泥、残渣的意思。 **想象在化工厂里有又脏又稠又黏又臭的黑色物质，那就是淤泥、残渣，以此来辅助记忆单词sludge的意思。**

> A slug was slowly crawling across the garden path. It was so lazy and moved at a snail\'s pace. Suddenly, a bird flew down and almost ate the slug. Poor slug! Remember, \'slug\' means a slow-moving creature like this one. **一只鼻涕虫正在花园的小径上缓慢爬行。它非常懒，移动速度像蜗牛一样慢。突然，一只鸟飞下来，差点吃掉这只鼻涕虫。可怜的鼻涕虫！记住，\'slug\'就是指像这样行动缓慢的生物。**
> 想象一下，在棒球场上，有一个强壮的选手，每次挥棒都力量十足，能把球打得老远。大家都叫他\'Slugger\'，因为他击球的威力就像炮弹一样强大。他是球队的得分主力，总是能为队伍赢得胜利。 **想象在棒球场上有个强力击球手被称为\'Slugger\'，因其击球威力大，是得分主力能赢比赛。**
> 想象一只乌龟在夏日午后的池塘里游动，它的动作缓慢而沉重。每一次划水都显得很吃力，这就是 sluggish 的样子。就像经济增长缓慢，市场表现不佳。 **想象一只乌龟在池塘里缓慢游动来辅助记忆【sluggish】这个表示缓慢的、迟缓的、不活跃的单词。**

> A poor boy named Tom lived in a slum. The slum was dirty and crowded. But Tom never gave up and finally moved to a better place. Remember, slum means a poor and crowded area. **一个叫汤姆的穷孩子住在一个贫民窟。贫民窟又脏又拥挤。但汤姆从未放弃，最终搬到了一个更好的地方。记住，slum 意思是贫民窟。**

> A little bear was very tired after playing all day. It found a warm cave and lay down to slumber. In its sweet slumber, it dreamed of honey and beautiful flowers. When it woke up, it felt full of energy. **一只小熊玩了一整天后非常累。它找了一个温暖的洞穴躺下来睡觉。在它香甜的睡眠中，它梦到了蜂蜜和美丽的花朵。当它醒来时，感觉充满了能量。**

> A young athlete was doing great, but then suddenly slump. He lost his form and couldn\'t perform well. It was like he fell into a deep hole. But with hard work, he came out of the slump and became amazing again. **一位年轻的运动员原本表现出色，但突然陷入低迷。他状态不佳，表现糟糕，就像掉进了一个深洞。但通过努力，他走出了低谷，再次变得出色。**

> A singer was accused of slurring her words during a performance. The audience was disappointed. But later, it was found that she had a throat problem. \'Slur\' means to speak unclearly or indistinctly. **一位歌手在演出时被指责吐字不清。观众很失望。但后来发现她喉咙有问题。'slur'意思是说话含糊不清。**
> 想象一下，在寒冷的冬天，你走在街头，脚下是一堆堆未完全融化的雪和泥水混合物，这就是 slush 。它让你的鞋子湿透，走路变得艰难。 **想象在冬天街头未完全融化的雪和泥水混合物，来辅助记忆 slush 这个单词，意思是雪泥、烂泥。**

> A girl named Lily was always dressed sloppily and had a bad reputation. People called her a slut. But later, she changed her ways, dressed neatly and regained respect. Remember, don\'t judge someone by appearance or rumors. **有个叫莉莉的女孩总是穿着邋遢，名声不好，人们叫她荡妇。但后来，她改变了自己，穿着整洁，重新获得了尊重。记住，不要根据外表或谣言来评判一个人。**

> A sly fox was always looking for ways to steal food from the farm. One night, it quietly sneaked in and got a big meal. But the farmer was smart and set up a trap. The fox had to be very careful to avoid being caught. **一只狡猾的狐狸总是寻找办法从农场偷食物。一天晚上，它悄悄地潜入并饱餐了一顿。但农夫很聪明，设了一个陷阱。狐狸不得不非常小心以避免被抓住。**

> A hungry bear was walking in the forest and smacked its lips when it smelled honey. It followed the sweet smell and finally found the beehive. \'Smack\' here means to make a smacking sound with the lips. **一只饥饿的熊在森林里走着，当它闻到蜂蜜时咂了咂嘴。它顺着甜味最终找到了蜂巢。\'smack\'在这里指的是用嘴唇发出咂嘴声。**

> One day, a little mouse was looking for food. It was very small but very cute. It could fit into small holes easily. It showed us what \'small\' means. **有一天，一只小老鼠在寻找食物。它非常小但是很可爱。它能轻易地钻进小洞里。这向我们展示了'small'（小的）的意思。**
> A small fish with a small mouth was swimming in the river. It struggled to eat big food because of its smallmouth. But it was still happy and free. **一条嘴巴小小的鱼在河里游着。由于它的小嘴，它很难吃到大的食物。但它仍然快乐又自由。**

> In a small village, a strange disease appeared. People got red spots all over their bodies. Later, a doctor found out it was smallpox. With efforts, a cure was found and the village was saved. **在一个小村庄，一种奇怪的疾病出现了。人们身上长满了红斑。后来，一位医生发现这是天花。经过努力，找到了治疗方法，村庄得救了。**

> A little mouse was always able to find the best food in the maze. Everyone said it was smart. Because it used its brain and was quick to make the right choices. Smart means being clever and intelligent. **一只小老鼠总是能在迷宫里找到最好的食物。大家都说它聪明。因为它动脑子，能很快做出正确的选择。Smart 意思是聪明的、机智的。**

> One day, a little boy was dressed smartly and went to a party. Everyone praised him for looking so good. He walked and behaved smartly, making a great impression. **一天，一个小男孩穿着得体漂亮地去参加派对。每个人都称赞他看起来很好。他走路和举止都很潇洒，给人留下了深刻的印象。**

> One day, a thief tried to smash the window of a jewelry store to steal. But the alarm went off and he was caught. \'Smash\' here means to break something violently and noisily. **一天，一个小偷试图猛砸珠宝店的窗户去偷窃。但警报响了，他被抓住了。'smash'在这里指猛烈地、嘈杂地打破某物。**

> One night, a drunk driver smashed his car into a tree. The impact was so strong that the front of the car was completely destroyed. \'Smashed\' here means hitting something with great force and causing damage. **一天晚上，一个醉酒的司机把他的车猛地撞在了一棵树上。撞击力非常大，以至于汽车的前部完全毁坏了。'smashed'在这里指用力撞击某物并造成损坏。**

> A thief was trying to break into a house. But the owner caught him and gave him a smashing punch. The thief was defeated completely. \'Smashing\' here means very powerful and impressive. **一个小偷试图闯入一所房子。但主人抓住了他，并给了他一记猛拳。小偷被彻底打败了。'smashing'在这里表示强有力的、令人印象深刻的。**
> 想象一下，有个好奇的小孩，对各种知识都只是略知一二，像懂一点魔法，一点科学，一点历史。这种一知半解的状态就是\'smattering\'。就像他对每个领域都只是有少量的、肤浅的了解。 **想象一个小孩对各种知识一知半解的状态来辅助记忆\'smattering\'这个表示少量、肤浅的了解的单词**

> A naughty monkey smeared paint all over the wall. The colorful smears made the wall look very messy. Poor owner had to clean it up. Remember, smear means to spread or daub something messily. **一只顽皮的猴子把颜料涂得到处都是。这些五颜六色的涂抹让墙看起来非常凌乱。可怜的主人不得不清理。记住，smear 意思是胡乱涂抹。**

> One day, a little girl entered a flower garden. The sweet smell of the flowers made her smile. But then she smelled something strange. It was a rotten apple. She learned that smell can tell us many things. **一天，一个小女孩走进一个花园。花的香甜气味让她微笑。但接着她闻到了一些奇怪的味道。是一个烂苹果。她知道了气味能告诉我们很多东西。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the park and passed by a garbage bin. The smell was so bad. He said, \'This bin is really smelly!\' From then on, whenever he saw something with a bad smell, he remembered the word\'smelly\'. **有一天，汤姆在公园散步，路过一个垃圾桶。气味太难闻了。他说：'这个垃圾桶真臭！'从那以后，每当他看到有难闻气味的东西，他就想起了'smelly'这个单词。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. She was scared but when she saw a friendly rabbit smile at her, she felt brave. The smile gave her hope and she found her way home. Remember, a smile can bring magic. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她很害怕，但当她看到一只友好的兔子对她微笑时，她感到勇敢了。这个微笑给了她希望，她找到了回家的路。记住，微笑能带来魔力。**

> One day, I was feeling down. Then I saw a little girl smiling at me. Her smile was like a bright sun, warming my heart. From that moment, I understood the power of a smiling face. **有一天，我心情低落。然后我看到一个小女孩对我微笑。她的微笑就像一轮明亮的太阳，温暖了我的心。从那一刻起，我明白了微笑的力量。**

> A thief was caught stealing, but instead of showing remorse, he had a smirk on his face. The smirk was a self-satisfied and somewhat mocking expression, as if he thought he could get away with it. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓住了，但他没有表现出懊悔，脸上反而带着一丝假笑。这个假笑是一种自鸣得意且略带嘲弄的表情，好像他认为自己能逃脱惩罚。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. One day, he encountered a fierce dragon. With all his might and courage, he smote the dragon with his powerful sword. The dragon fell, defeated by the knight\'s strong strike. **一位勇敢的骑士在执行任务。有一天，他遇到了一只凶猛的龙。他用尽全力和勇气，用他强大的剑猛击了龙。龙倒下了，被骑士强有力的击打打败。**

> A painter always wore a smock when creating art. One day, he accidentally spilled paint on his smock, but it protected his clothes underneath. The smock became a symbol of his creative journey. **一位画家在创作艺术时总是穿着罩衫。有一天，他不小心把颜料洒在了罩衫上，但罩衫保护了他里面的衣服。这件罩衫成为了他创作之旅的象征。**

> A city was covered in a thick layer of smog. People couldn\'t see clearly and had trouble breathing. One day, a scientist found a way to clear the smog and make the city beautiful again. **一座城市被厚厚的烟雾笼罩着。人们看不清东西，呼吸困难。有一天，一位科学家找到了清除烟雾的方法，让城市再次变得美丽。**

> One day, a little boy saw thick smoke coming out of a house. He quickly called the firemen. The firemen arrived and put out the fire. The smoke made everyone cough. Remember, smoke can be dangerous! **有一天，一个小男孩看到一所房子冒出浓烟。他迅速打电话给消防员。消防员赶到并扑灭了火。烟让每个人都咳嗽起来。记住，烟可能是危险的！**

> A factory owner was very worried because the smokestack was emitting too much smoke. Workers had to fix it quickly to protect the environment. The tall smokestack was the focus of everyone\'s attention. **一位工厂老板非常担心，因为烟囱冒出了太多烟。工人们不得不迅速修理它以保护环境。那高高的烟囱是每个人关注的焦点。**

> One day, Tom saw a man standing in a corner, smoking. The smoke curled up and made the air hazy. Tom thought, \'Smoking is bad for health.\' From then on, he remembered the word \'smoking\' means the act of emitting smoke by burning something. **有一天，汤姆看到一个男人站在角落里抽烟。烟雾袅袅升起，让空气变得朦胧。汤姆想，'抽烟对健康有害。'从那以后，他记住了'smoking'这个词指的是通过燃烧某物而冒烟的行为。**

> A brave firefighter named Tom was in a building that was smoky. He couldn\'t see clearly but still bravely searched for people. Remember, \'smoky\' means full of smoke, just like that building. **一位勇敢的名叫汤姆的消防员在一栋烟雾弥漫的大楼里。他看不清楚，但仍然勇敢地搜寻着人们。记住，'smoky'意思是充满烟雾的，就像那栋大楼一样。**

> A fire started in the forest. At first, it just smoldered under the fallen leaves. The smoke rose slowly, but the heat was building up. It was a quiet but dangerous start. **森林里起了火。起初，火只是在落叶下闷烧。烟缓缓升起，但热量在不断积聚。这是一个安静却危险的开端。**
> One day, I was skating on a smooth ice rink. There was no bump or roughness. I skated freely and smoothly. It was such a wonderful experience! **一天，我在一个光滑的溜冰场滑冰。那里没有凸起或粗糙的地方。我自由且顺畅地滑着。这是一次美妙的体验！**
> One day, I was riding a bike. The road was smooth and I pedaled smoothly. There were no bumps or obstacles. It was such a pleasant ride. **有一天，我在骑自行车。道路很平坦，我骑得很顺畅。没有颠簸或障碍。这是一次非常愉快的骑行。**

> A fairy was flying smoothly over a lake. But suddenly, she encountered some rough air. She used her magic to turn the air into smoothness and continued her journey happily. **一位仙女正在湖面上平稳地飞行。但突然，她遇到了一些颠簸的气流。她用魔法将气流变得平滑，然后愉快地继续她的旅程。**

> A man was trapped in a small room and felt very hot. The air was thick, as if trying to smother him. It was like being covered by a heavy blanket that made breathing difficult. **一个男人被困在一个小房间里，感觉非常热。空气很闷，好像要把他闷死。就像被一条厚重的毯子盖住，让他呼吸困难。**

> One day, Tom was painting. He accidentally got some paint on his hand and made a smudge. He tried to wipe it off but the smudge remained. It looked like a funny mark. **有一天，汤姆在画画。他不小心手上沾了些颜料，弄出了一块污渍。他试图擦掉，但污渍还在。它看起来像一个有趣的记号。**

> A smug cat always thought it was the smartest and most beautiful in the town. It walked around with a proud look. But one day, it got lost and realized its overconfidence was wrong. \'Smug\' means having too much pride in oneself. **一只自鸣得意的猫总认为自己是镇上最聪明、最漂亮的。它到处走着，一脸骄傲。但有一天，它迷路了，意识到自己的过度自信是错误的。\'smug\'意思是自满的、沾沾自喜的。**

> A thief wanted to smuggle jewels across the border. He hid them in his bag, thinking he could avoid being caught. But the customs officers were smart and found the jewels. Now he faces serious punishment. **一个小偷想走私珠宝越过边境。他把珠宝藏在包里，以为能逃过被抓。但海关官员很聪明，发现了珠宝。现在他面临着严重的惩罚。**

> A man named Jack always wore a big coat. One night, he was seen sneaking around the port with the coat bulging. Turns out, Jack was a smuggler, hiding illegal goods in his coat to avoid being caught. **有个叫杰克的人总是穿着一件大外套。一天晚上，有人看到他在港口鬼鬼祟祟，外套鼓鼓的。原来，杰克是个走私犯，把非法货物藏在他的外套里以免被抓。**

> One night, Jack saw a group of people secretly loading goods onto a ship. They were doing it quietly and nervously. Later, he learned they were involved in smuggling. It was illegal and they could be punished. **一天晚上，杰克看到一群人悄悄地把货物装上一艘船。他们做得既安静又紧张。后来，他得知他们在从事走私活动。这是违法的，他们会受到惩罚。**

> One day, when I was very hungry, I searched everywhere for food. Finally, I found some snacks like chips and cookies. They were small but delicious and satisfied my hunger. Remember, snack means a small amount of food eaten between meals. **有一天，我非常饿的时候，到处找吃的。最后，我找到了一些零食，像薯片和饼干。它们量少但美味，满足了我的饥饿感。记住，snack 指的是在正餐之间吃的少量食物。**

> A man was fishing in the river. Suddenly, his hook got snagged on a hidden branch underwater. He struggled to free it, realizing that a snag could cause big trouble. **一个男人在河里钓鱼。突然，他的鱼钩被水下一个隐藏的树枝卡住了。他费力地想把它弄出来，意识到障碍物会带来大麻烦。**

> A little boy was walking in the garden and saw a snail slowly moving along a leaf. He watched carefully as the snail left a shiny trail behind. The snail was so small but persistent in its journey. **一个小男孩在花园里散步，看到一只蜗牛沿着一片叶子慢慢移动。他仔细观察，蜗牛身后留下了一条闪亮的痕迹。这只蜗牛虽然小，但在它的旅程中坚持不懈。**

> A brave boy was walking in the forest. Suddenly, he saw a snake. The snake was long and slippery. It moved quickly. The boy was scared but stayed calm and slowly backed away. **一个勇敢的男孩在森林里走着。突然，他看到了一条蛇。这条蛇又长又滑。它移动得很快。男孩很害怕，但保持冷静，慢慢地往后退。**

> One day, I was walking in the park and saw a branch snap. It made a loud noise. Just then, a squirrel snapped at a nut and ran away. I realized \'snap\' means to break suddenly or to make a sharp sound. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到一根树枝突然折断。发出很大的声响。就在这时，一只松鼠猛地咬了一口坚果然后跑开了。我明白了\'snap\'有突然折断或发出尖锐声响的意思。**

> A fisherman went fishing and caught a big snapper. It struggled hard but the fisherman held on tight. The snapper\'s bright colors and sharp teeth made it stand out. Finally, the fisherman took it home for a delicious meal. **一位渔夫去钓鱼，钓到了一条大鲷鱼。它拼命挣扎，但渔夫紧紧抓住。鲷鱼鲜艳的颜色和锋利的牙齿使它格外显眼。最后，渔夫把它带回家美餐了一顿。**

> A snappy turtle was swimming in the river. It moved quickly and had a sharp look. One day, it snapped at a fish and caught it easily. Its actions were so snappy and impressive. **一只活泼敏捷的乌龟在河里游着。它动作迅速，眼神锐利。有一天，它猛地咬住一条鱼，轻松地抓住了。它的动作是如此迅速和令人印象深刻。**

> One day, I was on a trip and saw a beautiful scene. I quickly took a snapshot to freeze that moment. The snapshot captured the essence of the place. It was like a magic moment saved forever. **有一天，我在旅行中看到一处美丽的风景。我迅速拍了一张快照来定格那一刻。这张快照捕捉到了那个地方的精髓。它就像一个被永远保存的神奇时刻。**

> A brave hunter was in the forest. He set a snare to catch a wild rabbit. But the rabbit was smart and avoided the snare. The hunter had to think of another way. **一位勇敢的猎人在森林里。他设了一个陷阱来抓野兔。但兔子很聪明，避开了陷阱。猎人不得不另想办法。**
> 一只凶猛的大狗在路上对着行人 snarl（咆哮），它露出尖锐的牙齿，样子十分可怕。行人小心翼翼地绕开，生怕被它攻击。 **一只凶猛的大狗在路上对着行人咆哮，它露出尖锐的牙齿，样子十分可怕。行人小心翼翼地绕开，生怕被它攻击。**

> A thief was lurking in the dark. When a lady walked by with her precious bag, the thief suddenly jumped out and snatched the bag. The lady was shocked and screamed for help. **一个小偷潜伏在黑暗中。当一位女士带着她珍贵的包走过时，小偷突然跳出来抢走了包。女士很震惊并大声呼救。**

> One day, Tom wanted to play a prank on his friend. He decided to sneak into his friend\'s room quietly when he was not looking. He moved very carefully, trying not to make any noise. Finally, he succeeded and gave his friend a big surprise! **一天，汤姆想对他的朋友搞个恶作剧。他决定趁朋友不注意悄悄溜进他的房间。他非常小心地移动，尽量不发出任何声音。最后，他成功了，给了朋友一个大大的惊喜！**

> One night, while Tom was sleeping, a sneaky mouse quietly stole the cheese on the table. Tom woke up but couldn\'t catch the mouse because it was too sneaky and moved silently. **一天晚上，当汤姆在睡觉时，一只鬼鬼祟祟的老鼠悄悄地偷走了桌上的奶酪。汤姆醒了，但抓不到老鼠，因为它太鬼鬼祟祟了，而且悄无声息地移动。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mean person. Whenever he saw someone less fortunate, he would sneer, showing a contemptuous expression. His sneer made others feel very uncomfortable. Remember, to sneer is to show such a scornful look. **从前，有个刻薄的人。每当他看到境遇不如他的人，就会嗤笑，露出轻蔑的表情。他的嗤笑让别人很不舒服。记住，sneer 就是露出这样轻蔑的神情。**

> One day, Tom was in a dusty room and suddenly felt itchy in his nose. \'Achoo!\' He sneezed loudly. His sneeze made everyone around look at him. Now you remember, when you have that sudden nose explosion, it\'s a sneeze! **有一天，汤姆在一个满是灰尘的房间里，突然鼻子发痒。'阿嚏！'他大声打了个喷嚏。他的喷嚏让周围的人都看向了他。现在你记住了，当你鼻子突然爆发那种情况，就是打喷嚏（sneeze）！**

> One day, Tom saw Jerry stealing a piece of cheese and couldn\'t help but snicker. Jerry heard the snicker and got angry. Tom quickly hid, still chuckling to himself. **一天，汤姆看到杰瑞在偷一块奶酪，忍不住偷笑。杰瑞听到了这偷笑，生气了。汤姆赶紧躲起来，还在自顾自地咯咯笑。**

> A little dog was walking in the park. Suddenly, it stopped and sniffed the air. It smelled something delicious. It followed the smell and found a picnic basket. It was sniffing around the basket excitedly. **一只小狗正在公园里走着。突然，它停下来嗅了嗅空气。它闻到了一些美味的东西。它顺着气味找到了一个野餐篮。它正兴奋地在篮子周围嗅来嗅去。**

> A tailor was working hard. He used scissors to snip the fabric precisely. Every snip was important to create a perfect dress. With each snip, the dress was getting closer to completion. **一位裁缝正在努力工作。他用剪刀精准地剪布料。每一次剪（snip）都对制作一件完美的裙子很重要。每一次剪，裙子都离完成更近一步。**

> A soldier was in the forest. Suddenly, he saw a snipe. He aimed carefully and shot it. The snipe was a tricky bird, but the soldier was smart and patient. **一名士兵在森林里。突然，他看到一只沙锥鸟。他仔细瞄准并射击。沙锥鸟是一种狡猾的鸟，但士兵聪明又有耐心。**

> In the war, a soldier named Tom was a brilliant sniper. He hid in the shadows, patiently waiting for the enemy. With one precise shot, he took down the enemy leader. His skills as a sniper made him a hero. **在战争中，有个叫汤姆的士兵是一位出色的狙击手。他隐藏在阴影中，耐心等待敌人。凭借精准的一枪，他击毙了敌方首领。他作为狙击手的技能使他成为了英雄。**

> A programmer was working hard and often used small snippets of code to solve complex problems. These snippets were like magic keys that opened the door to success. One day, he realized that snippets could save a lot of time and effort. **一位程序员努力工作，经常使用小段的代码来解决复杂的问题。这些代码片段就像神奇的钥匙，打开了成功的大门。有一天，他意识到代码片段能节省大量的时间和精力。**

> Once there was a man who always looked down on others and thought he was superior. Everyone called him a snob. He wouldn\'t talk to people he considered beneath him. But in the end, he had no real friends. **从前有一个男人总是瞧不起别人，自认为高人一等。大家都叫他势利眼。他不和他认为地位低的人说话。但最后，他没有真正的朋友。**

> One day, a curious detective named Tom was constantly snoop ing around the crime scene, trying to find crucial clues. He moved stealthily, peering into every corner. Just like Tom, \'snoop\' means to investigate secretly or pry curiously. **有一天，一位名叫汤姆的好奇侦探一直在犯罪现场窥探，试图找到关键线索。他悄悄地移动，窥视着每个角落。就像汤姆的行为一样，'snoop'意思是暗中调查或好奇地窥探。**

> One night, Tom was sleeping soundly and started to snore loudly. His snoring was like a thunder, waking up everyone in the room. Poor Tom had no idea about the commotion he caused with his snoring. **一天晚上，汤姆睡得很香，开始大声打鼾。他的鼾声像打雷一样，把房间里的每个人都吵醒了。可怜的汤姆不知道他的鼾声引起了骚乱。**

> One day, a little pig was sleeping soundly. Suddenly, it was awakened by a loud noise and found it was a horse snorting angrily. The pig was scared and ran away quickly. The snort of the horse was so powerful! **一天，一只小猪正在熟睡。突然，它被一声巨响吵醒，发现是一匹马在生气地喷鼻息。小猪被吓到，赶紧跑开了。这匹马的喷鼻息太有力了！**
> The little pig had a funny snout. It was always sniffing around for food. One day, it used its snout to dig up a big carrot. How happy it was! **小猪有个有趣的鼻子。它总是用鼻子到处嗅找食物。有一天，它用鼻子挖出了一根大胡萝卜。它多开心啊！**

> One winter day, a little girl opened the door and saw a world covered in white. It was snow everywhere. She made a snowman and had a great time playing in the snow. The snow was so beautiful and magical. **在一个冬日，一个小女孩打开门，看到一个被白色覆盖的世界。到处都是雪。她堆了个雪人，在雪中玩得很开心。雪是如此美丽和神奇。**

> In winter, a little boy made a small snowball. He rolled it on the ground and it grew bigger and bigger, like a magic ball. Finally, it became a huge snowball. The snowball was so big that it was hard to move. **在冬天，一个小男孩做了一个小雪球。他在地上滚它，它变得越来越大，像一个魔法球。最后，它变成了一个巨大的雪球。这个雪球太大了，以至于很难移动。**

> One winter day, I was walking in the forest. Suddenly, a heavy snowfall started. The white snowflakes were like feathers falling from the sky. It was a magical and beautiful scene. I was completely amazed by the snowfall. **一个冬日，我正在森林里散步。突然，一场大雪降临。洁白的雪花就像羽毛从天空飘落。那是神奇又美丽的景象。我完全被这场降雪惊呆了。**

> One cold winter day, a little girl was looking out of the window. Suddenly, a beautiful snowflake landed on her nose. It was so unique, like a tiny crystal. The girl was amazed by the magic of the snowflake. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一个小女孩正望着窗外。突然，一片美丽的雪花落在了她的鼻子上。它是如此独特，像一颗小小的水晶。小女孩对雪花的神奇感到惊奇。**

> One cold winter day, a child made a snowman in the yard. The snowman had a big smile and a carrot nose. It wore a hat and a scarf. The child was so happy to have this new friend named snowman. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一个孩子在院子里堆了个雪人。这个雪人有着大大的笑容和胡萝卜鼻子。它戴着帽子和围巾。孩子很高兴有了这个叫雪人的新朋友。**

> One day, in a snowy world, a brave adventurer was lost. Suddenly, a snowmobile appeared like a savior. It moved fast on the snow, helping the adventurer find the way home. The snowmobile was a hero in the cold. **有一天，在一个雪的世界里，一位勇敢的冒险家迷路了。突然，一辆雪地摩托像救星一样出现了。它在雪地上快速移动，帮助冒险家找到了回家的路。雪地摩托在寒冷中是个英雄。**

> One cold winter day, Tom got lost in the forest. Luckily, he found a pair of snowshoes. With them, he could walk easily on the deep snow and finally found his way home. The snowshoes were his savior. **在一个寒冷的冬日，汤姆在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一双雪鞋。有了它们，他能够轻松地在厚厚的雪地上行走，最终找到了回家的路。雪鞋成了他的救星。**

> One day, I was walking in the forest. Suddenly, a snowstorm came. Heavy snow was swirling everywhere. I struggled to find my way home. It was a scary but unforgettable experience. **有一天，我正在森林里散步。突然，一场暴风雪袭来。大雪四处纷飞。我艰难地寻找回家的路。这是一次可怕但难忘的经历。**

> One winter day, it was very cold. When I opened the window, I saw a snowy world. The ground was covered with white snow. Children were happily making snowmen and having snowball fights. It was such a snowy and wonderful scene. **一个冬天的日子，天气很冷。当我打开窗户，我看到了一个白雪皑皑的世界。地面被白雪覆盖。孩子们正开心地堆雪人和打雪仗。这是如此多雪且美妙的场景。**

> A king was very angry when a peasant snubbed him by not bowing. The king punished the peasant. Remember, to snub means to treat someone rudely and ignore them. **一位国王非常生气，因为一个农民没有向他鞠躬从而冷落了他。国王惩罚了这个农民。记住，snub 这个词的意思是粗鲁地对待某人并忽视他们。**

> A thief was trying to snuff out the candle in the dark room to hide his presence. But the sudden wind blew it out instead. Here, \'snuff\' means to extinguish or put out something like a candle. **一个小偷试图在黑暗的房间里熄灭蜡烛来隐藏自己的存在。但突然一阵风把它吹灭了。在这里，'snuff'意思是熄灭或扑灭像蜡烛之类的东西。**

> A little mouse found a snug hole in the wall. It was warm and safe inside. The mouse felt so comfortable and happy. It thought this snug place was its perfect home. **一只小老鼠在墙上发现了一个舒适的洞。洞里面温暖又安全。老鼠感到非常舒适和开心。它觉得这个舒适的地方就是它完美的家。**

> One cold winter night, a little bear was feeling very chilly. It found a warm blanket and snuggled up in it. The feeling of being close and comfortable made it happy. Snuggle means to lie close and comfortably. **在一个寒冷的冬夜，一只小熊感觉非常冷。它找到了一条温暖的毯子，紧紧地依偎在里面。这种靠近且舒适的感觉让它很开心。snuggle 意思是舒适地贴身躺、依偎。**

> A little bear found a snugly cave to sleep in during the cold winter. The cave protected it from the wind and snow, making the bear feel warm and safe. \'Snugly\' means comfortably and warmly, just like the bear in the cave. **一只小熊在寒冷的冬天找到了一个舒适温暖的洞穴来睡觉。这个洞穴为它阻挡了风雪，让小熊感到温暖又安全。'snugly'意思是舒适地、温暖地，就像洞穴里的小熊。**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. He was very scared and didn\'t know what to do. So, he decided to stay in one place and wait for help. Finally, he was found. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他非常害怕，不知道该怎么办。于是，他决定待在一个地方等待救援。最后，他被找到了。**

> One day, I accidentally dropped my clothes into a bucket of water. They had to soak in it for a long time. Later, I realized \'soak\' means to let something stay in liquid for a while. **有一天，我不小心把衣服掉进了一桶水里。它们在里面泡了很长时间。后来，我明白了'soak'就是指让某物在液体里停留一段时间。**

> One day, I was caught in a sudden rainstorm and got soaked. My clothes were dripping wet as if I had fallen into a pool. It was a memorable experience of being completely wet through. **有一天，我遭遇了一场突如其来的暴雨，浑身湿透了。我的衣服不停地滴水，仿佛我掉进了水池里。这是一次完全被浸湿的难忘经历。**

> One day, I was very dirty after playing outside. My mom handed me a bar of soap and said, \'Use this to clean yourself.\' With the soap, I became clean and fresh. Soap is really magical! **有一天，我在外面玩得浑身脏兮兮的。妈妈递给我一块肥皂说：'用这个把自己洗干净。' 用了肥皂后，我变得干净又清爽。肥皂真神奇！**

> One day, I was walking on the street and saw a man selling soapy water. The water was full of bubbles and looked very interesting. I thought it would be great to use this soapy water to clean my dirty hands. **一天，我走在街上看到一个人在卖肥皂水。水充满了泡泡，看起来非常有趣。我想，用这肥皂水来清洗我脏兮兮的手会很棒。**

> A drunk man was lost in the street. But after a cold shower, he became sober. He could think clearly and find his way home. Remember, \'sober\' means not drunk or clear-headed. **一个醉汉在街上迷路了。但冲了个冷水澡后，他清醒了。他能够清晰地思考并找到回家的路。记住，\'sober\'意思是未喝醉的或头脑清醒的。**

> One night, Tom got drunk and made a lot of mistakes. The next day, he realized the importance of sobriety. He decided to stay away from alcohol and keep a clear mind to face life\'s challenges. **一天晚上，汤姆喝醉了并犯了很多错误。第二天，他意识到清醒的重要性。他决定远离酒精，保持头脑清醒以面对生活的挑战。**

> One sunny day, Tom and his friends went to the playground. They decided to play soccer. Tom was very excited. He kicked the ball hard and scored a goal. Everyone cheered. Playing soccer made them so happy! **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆和他的朋友们去了操场。他们决定踢足球。汤姆非常兴奋。他用力踢球并进了一球。大家都欢呼起来。踢足球让他们非常开心！**

> A young man was very shy and had few friends. But when he joined social activities, he met many nice people and became confident. Social means relating to society and the way people interact. **一个年轻人非常害羞，朋友很少。但当他参加社交活动时，他遇到了很多友好的人，并变得自信起来。Social 意思是与社会和人们互动的方式有关。**

> A group of friends decided to build a community where everyone shared resources and worked for the common good. This idea was the essence of socialism, aiming for fairness and equality for all. **一群朋友决定建立一个社区，在那里每个人共享资源，为共同利益工作。这个想法就是社会主义的本质，旨在为所有人谋求公平和平等。**

> A young man was passionate about fairness and equality. He joined groups, advocated for the poor, and worked hard to build a better society. > A socialite named Lily always attended fancy parties. She was known for chatting and laughing with everyone, making many friends. Her social skills made her a star in the social circle. **一位名叫莉莉的社交名流总是参加豪华派对。她以与每个人聊天和欢笑而闻名，结交了很多朋友。她的社交技能使她成为社交圈的明星。**

> In a small town, children gathered to play and share. Through these activities, they learned how to interact and communicate, which was a process of socialization. It helped them fit into the community. **在一个小镇上，孩子们聚在一起玩耍和分享。通过这些活动，他们学会了如何互动和交流，这就是社会化的过程。它帮助他们融入社区。**

> One day, Tom was invited to a party. There, he had to socialize with many strangers. He was nervous at first but soon found it fun to talk and share. Socializing made him have a great time. **有一天，汤姆被邀请去参加一个聚会。在那里，他不得不和许多陌生人交往。起初他很紧张，但很快就发现交谈和分享很有趣。社交让他度过了愉快的时光。**

> A shy girl was afraid to talk in public. But she decided to change and started joining social activities. Gradually, she became socially active and made many friends. **一个害羞的女孩害怕在公众场合讲话。但她决定改变，开始参加社交活动。渐渐地，她在社交方面变得活跃，并交了很多朋友。**

> In a faraway land, people faced many problems. But they worked together to solve them for the betterment of societal life. They understood that societal progress relied on everyone\'s efforts. **在一个遥远的国度，人们面临许多问题。但他们共同努力去解决，以改善社会生活。他们明白社会的进步依赖于每个人的努力。**

> In a faraway land, people of all kinds lived together, sharing joys and sorrows. They formed a group where everyone had a role. This group was called a society, where they worked and grew together. **在一个遥远的地方，各种各样的人生活在一起，同甘共苦。他们形成了一个群体，每个人都有自己的角色。这个群体被称为社会，他们在其中共同工作和成长。**

> A young detective was solving a crime. To understand the suspects\' behaviors, he needed sociological knowledge. He studied how society influenced them. Finally, he cracked the case using this sociological wisdom. **一位年轻的侦探正在侦破一起犯罪案件。为了理解嫌疑人的行为，他需要社会学知识。他研究社会是如何影响他们的。最终，他运用这种社会学智慧破了案。**

> A sociologist named Tom was always passionate about understanding how people interact in groups. He spent days observing and analyzing, trying to solve the mysteries of society. Finally, his research made a big difference. **一位名叫汤姆的社会学家总是热衷于了解人们在群体中如何互动。他花了很多天观察和分析，试图解开社会的奥秘。最终，他的研究产生了重大影响。**

> 想象一个古老的城堡，夜晚灯火昏暗。骑士寻找着能点亮油灯的地方，终于发现了墙上的一个特殊孔洞------socket，它就像一个神奇的插座，能让油灯稳稳地插进去，带来光明。 **想象一个关于古老城堡中骑士找插座的故事来辅助记忆【socket】这个单词，意思是插座、插孔**

> A man was walking in the field and suddenly stepped on a sod. It was soft and green. He realized that a sod is a piece of grass-covered ground. Now he\'ll never forget the word \'sod\'. **一个男人正在田野里走着，突然踩到了一块草皮。它又软又绿。他意识到 sod 就是一块长满草的地面。现在他永远不会忘记 sod 这个单词了。**

> One hot day, I was extremely thirsty. I rushed to a store and asked for a drink. The clerk handed me a cold soda, which fizzed and bubbled. With one gulp, it quenched my thirst and made me feel refreshed. **在一个炎热的日子里，我极度口渴。我冲进一家商店要喝的。店员递给我一瓶冰冷的苏打水，它嘶嘶冒泡。一口喝下，它解了我的渴，让我感到神清气爽。**

> Imagine a scientist in a lab working with a special substance. He calls it\'sodium\' and explains that it\'s a key element found in salt and has important roles in our bodies. > One day, a tired little bear came home and immediately threw himself onto the sofa. The sofa was so soft and comfortable that it made the little bear forget all his troubles and fall asleep quickly. **有一天，一只疲倦的小熊回到家，立刻扑到沙发上。沙发是如此柔软舒适，让小熊忘记了所有烦恼，很快就睡着了。**

> One night, a little mouse moved softly in the dark. It didn\'t want to make any noise and wake up the sleeping cat. The mouse walked softly to find some food. **一天晚上，一只小老鼠在黑暗中轻轻地移动。它不想发出任何声音吵醒熟睡的猫。老鼠轻轻地走着去寻找一些食物。**

> One rainy day, I went for a walk and stepped on the grass. My shoes got all soggy. It felt like they were soaking in water. Soggy means something is very wet and soft, like that grass. **在一个下雨天，我去散步并踩到了草地。我的鞋子变得湿漉漉的。感觉就像泡在水里一样。soggy 这个单词指的是某物非常潮湿且发软，就像那片草地。**

> A little ant was working hard in the soil. It dug and carried tiny grains to build its home. The soil was like a treasure chest full of surprises and possibilities for the ant. **一只小蚂蚁在土壤里努力工作。它挖掘并搬运着微小的颗粒来建造自己的家。对于蚂蚁来说，土壤就像一个充满惊喜和可能性的百宝箱。**

> A young adventurer decided to sojourn in a mysterious forest. He spent several days there, experiencing both wonders and challenges. The time of his stay was a sojourn that changed him forever. **一位年轻的冒险家决定在一片神秘的森林中逗留。他在那里度过了几天，经历了奇妙和挑战。他停留的这段时间就是一次逗留，永远地改变了他。**

> 想象一下，在一个遥远的星球上，有一座神奇的城堡，城堡的能源全部来自太阳。这个城堡被称为\'solar castle\'，因为\'solar\'就是太阳的、与太阳有关的。所以当你看到\'solar\'，就想起那个充满阳光能源的城堡。 **想象在遥远星球上有座能源全来自太阳的神奇城堡叫\'solar castle\'，帮助记住\'solar\'是太阳的、与太阳有关的意思。**

> A detective was investigating a case of solicitation. A suspect was constantly asking people for illegal favors on the street. The detective caught him and stopped this bad solicitation. **一位侦探正在调查一起教唆案件。一名嫌疑人在街上不停地向人们寻求非法好处。侦探抓住了他，制止了这种不良的教唆行为。**

> A young man dreamed of becoming a solicitor. He studied hard, helped people solve legal problems, and finally achieved his dream. A solicitor is like a legal hero, fighting for justice. **一个年轻人梦想成为一名律师。他努力学习，帮助人们解决法律问题，最终实现了梦想。律师就像法律界的英雄，为正义而战。**

> A little ant was walking in the forest. It found a solid rock and tried to push it, but the rock didn\'t move at all. The ant realized that\'solid\' means very firm and hard to change. **一只小蚂蚁在森林里走着。它发现了一块坚固的石头并试图推动它，但石头根本不动。蚂蚁意识到\'solid\'意味着非常坚固且难以改变。**

> Imagine a pot of liquid chocolate. When we lower the temperature, the chocolate gradually changes and becomes solid. This process is like \'solidify\'. It means turning from a liquid or soft state into a solid one. **想象有一锅液态巧克力。当我们降低温度时，巧克力逐渐发生变化并变得坚固。这个过程就像"solidify"。它意味着从液态或柔软的状态变成固态。**
> 想象一下，有一座坚固的城堡，城墙 solidly 矗立着，没有丝毫的晃动。敌人发起一次次攻击，可这城墙 solidly 抵御住了，坚不可摧。它就代表着稳固、扎实地。 **想象坚固的城堡城墙扎实地矗立抵御攻击，代表稳固、扎实地**

> A man was on a solitary journey in the forest. He walked alone, enjoying the quiet and peaceful time. No one was with him. > A brave adventurer was lost in the deep forest. He spent days alone, experiencing solitude. But he used the time to think and grow. Finally, he found his way out, stronger than before. **一位勇敢的冒险家在深林中迷路了。他独自度过了好些天，体验着孤独。但他利用这段时间思考和成长。最终，他找到了出路，比以前更强大了。**
