> 想象一个大的水果篮子，里面有各种水果。苹果和香蕉组成的部分就是一个 subset 。它就像是从大整体中挑出的一小部分。比如数学里，一些数字组成的小组也是 subset 。 **想象一个水果篮，其中苹果和香蕉组成的部分就是子集。就像数学中一些数字组成的小组，这有助于理解 subset 这个表示子集、小部分的单词。**
> 想象一下，洪水汹涌而来，人们非常恐慌。但慢慢地，洪水的力量减弱(subside)了，水位下降，危险解除，大家都松了一口气。 **想象洪水力量减弱、水位下降的情景来辅助记忆 subside 这个单词，意思是减退、平息、下沉**

> A big company had many small parts. One of these parts was called a subsidiary. It was like a younger sister who needed the support and help of the big sister company to grow and succeed. **一家大公司有很多小的部分。其中一个部分被称为子公司。它就像小妹妹，需要大姐姐公司的支持和帮助才能成长和成功。**

> A poor farmer was struggling to grow crops. Luckily, the government subsidized him with money and resources. This support helped him buy better seeds and tools, and eventually he had a great harvest. **一个贫穷的农民在种植庄稼时举步维艰。幸运的是，政府给他提供了资金和资源的补贴。这种支持帮助他购买了更好的种子和工具，最终他获得了大丰收。**

> A poor farmer was struggling to keep his farm. One day, a kind government official gave him a subsidy. With this money, he bought new seeds and tools, and his farm thrived. The subsidy was his savior. **一个贫穷的农民在努力维持他的农场。有一天，一位好心的政府官员给了他一笔补贴。有了这笔钱，他买了新的种子和工具，他的农场繁荣起来。这笔补贴成了他的救星。**

> A poor man had to subsist on very little food. He struggled every day but managed to survive. Subsist means to stay alive, especially with the minimum resources needed. **一个穷人只能靠极少的食物维持生计。他每天都很艰难，但还是设法活了下来。subsist 意思是生存，尤指依靠最少的资源。**
> 想象一个贫困的家庭，仅靠微薄的收入维持生计（subsistence）。每天为了填饱肚子而努力，没有多余的享受。这种艰难的生存状态就是 subsistence 的体现。 **想象一个贫困家庭靠微薄收入艰难维持生存的情景，以此来理解 subsistence 这个单词，意思是生存，生计。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments to discover a new substance. After many trials, he finally found a special liquid that had unique properties. This liquid was the key substance for a revolutionary invention. **一位科学家正在进行实验以发现一种新物质。经过多次试验，他终于找到了一种具有独特性质的特殊液体。这种液体是一项革命性发明的关键物质。**

> A factory was producing goods, but some of them were substandard. The boss was angry and said: \'These substandard products will not make our customers happy!\' It means they were below the usual standard of quality. **一家工厂正在生产商品，但其中一些是不达标的。老板很生气并说：'这些不达标的产品不会让我们的客户满意！'这意味着它们低于通常的质量标准。**

> A hungry traveler was searching for food. Finally, he found a substantial meal at an old inn. It was a big plate of delicious dishes that filled his stomach completely. **一位饥饿的旅行者一直在寻找食物。最后，他在一家老旧的客栈里找到了一顿丰盛的饭菜。那是一大盘美味的菜肴，完全填饱了他的肚子。**

> A poor man was struggling to survive. But after he got a job that paid substantially high, his life changed completely. He could afford nice food and a comfortable house. **一个穷人在艰难求生。但在他得到一份薪水相当高的工作后，他的生活彻底改变了。他能买得起美味的食物和舒适的房子。**

> A detective was trying to substantiate a suspect\'s alibi. He collected evidence, interviewed witnesses, and finally proved the alibi was real. \'Substantiate\' means to provide evidence to support and prove something. **一位侦探试图证实一名嫌疑人的不在场证明。他收集证据，询问证人，最终证明了不在场证明是真实的。'substantiate'意思是提供证据来支持和证明某事。**

> A detective was looking for substantive evidence to solve a mysterious case. He found a key document that provided real and important information, which was the substantive clue. Finally, he cracked the case. **一位侦探正在寻找实质性的证据来解决一个神秘的案件。他找到了一份提供真实且重要信息的关键文件，这就是实质性的线索。最终，他破获了此案。**

> A football player got injured. So, a new player came as a substitute. He was nervous but did well and helped the team win. Remember, \'substitute\' means someone or something used to replace another. **一名足球运动员受伤了。于是，一名新球员作为替补上场。他很紧张但表现出色，帮助球队获胜。记住，'substitute'意思是代替他人或某物的人或物。**

> A football player got injured. So, a substitute player came in. The substitution was timely and saved the game. It means replacing one person or thing with another. **一名足球运动员受伤了。于是，一名替补球员上场了。这次替换很及时，挽救了比赛。它的意思是用一个人或物代替另一个。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的实验室里，有一种特殊的材料，它就像一个基础的平台，所有的实验反应都在它上面进行，这个平台就是\'substrate\'。 **想象在实验室里，有一种像基础平台一样供实验反应进行的特殊材料，这就是'底物；底层'**
> 想象一个大图书馆，里面有各种小书架。管理员把小书架都放进一个大的分类系统中，这个'放入'的动作就像 subsume。就好像小类别被包含在大类别中一样。 **想象图书馆中把小书架放入大分类系统的动作来理解 subsume 表示包含、归入的意思**
> 想象一个大工厂，里面有很多不同的部分。其中有一部分专门负责生产特定的零件，这一部分就像是一个\'subsystem\'，是大系统中的一个小分支、子系统。 **想象一个大工厂里负责特定生产的部分来理解子系统这个单词**

> A brave explorer was on a quest to find a lost treasure. He followed a mysterious map and ended up in a subterranean cave. It was dark and full of unknown dangers, but he persisted. **一位勇敢的探险家正在寻找失落的宝藏。他根据一张神秘的地图，最终来到了一个地下洞穴。那里黑暗且充满未知的危险，但他坚持不懈。**

> A young director was very worried about the subtitles of his new film. He worked hard to make them perfect. Finally, the clear and accurate subtitles made the film more understandable and popular. **一位年轻的导演非常担心他新电影的字幕。他努力工作以使它们完美。最终，清晰准确的字幕让这部电影更容易理解和受欢迎。**
> A spy needed to be subtle. He had to move quietly and blend in. One wrong step could expose him. Being subtle was the key to his survival. **一名间谍需要很微妙。他必须安静地行动并融入其中。一个错误的步骤可能会暴露他。微妙行事是他生存的关键。**

> A spy needed to handle a mission with subtlety. He had to sneak in unnoticed, using small and delicate moves. Every step was a test of his ability to be subtle. Only then could he complete the task successfully. **一名间谍需要巧妙地处理一项任务。他必须不被注意地潜入，使用细微和谨慎的动作。每一步都是对他巧妙行事能力的考验。只有这样他才能成功完成任务。**

> A spy was trying to gather information subtly. He dressed like an ordinary person and spoke softly, avoiding drawing attention. But a detective noticed his subtly strange behavior and caught him. **一名间谍试图巧妙地收集信息。他穿着像普通人，轻声说话，避免引起注意。但一名侦探注意到他微妙奇怪的行为并抓住了他。**

> One day, in math class, the teacher asked students to subtract the smaller number 5 from the larger number 10. Everyone concentrated and found the answer was 5. Remember, subtract means to take away or reduce. **有一天，在数学课上，老师让学生们用较大的数 10 减去较小的数 5。每个人都全神贯注，算出答案是 5。记住，subtract 意思是减去、扣除。**

> A young man moved from the busy city center to a quiet suburb. There, he found peace and beautiful gardens. He enjoyed the slower pace and friendly neighbors. Now he never wants to leave the suburb. **一个年轻人从繁忙的市中心搬到了一个安静的郊区。在那里，他找到了宁静和美丽的花园。他喜欢那里较慢的生活节奏和友好的邻居。现在他再也不想离开这个郊区了。**

> A man named Tom always dreamed of leaving the busy city. One day, he moved to a suburban area. There, he enjoyed the peaceful life, with green gardens and less noise. Finally, he found the tranquility he desired in the suburban place. **一个叫汤姆的男人一直梦想着离开繁忙的城市。有一天，他搬到了郊区。在那里，他享受着平静的生活，有绿色的花园和更少的噪音。最终，他在郊区找到了他渴望的宁静。**

> A young couple moved to suburbia. They found it peaceful and full of greenery. But commuting to the city for work was a bit tiring. However, they still loved the quiet life in suburbia. **一对年轻夫妇搬到了郊区。他们发现那里宁静且到处是绿植。但通勤去城里工作有点累。不过，他们仍然喜爱郊区的安静生活。**

> A spy was sent to our country with a subversive plan. He tried to undermine the government and cause chaos. But our security forces were vigilant and caught him. Remember, subversive means causing the overthrow or destruction. **一名间谍带着颠覆计划被派到我国。他试图破坏政府并制造混乱。但我们的安全部队很警惕，抓住了他。记住，subversive 意思是造成推翻或破坏。**

> A group of spies planned to subvert the government. They spread false information and caused chaos. But in the end, their evil plot was exposed and they were punished. Remember, subvert means to overthrow or undermine. **一群间谍计划颠覆政府。他们散布虚假信息并制造混乱。但最终，他们的邪恶阴谋被揭露并受到惩罚。记住，subvert 意思是推翻或破坏。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. He had to take the subway to get there quickly. The subway was like a big snake running underground. It took him to school on time. **有一天，汤姆上学要迟到了。他不得不乘地铁快速到达那里。地铁就像一条在地下跑的大蛇。它把他准时带到了学校。**

> A young man had a dream to succeed in business. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. Finally, his hard work paid off and he achieved great success. Now you know succeed means to achieve the desired aim. **一个年轻人梦想在商业上取得成功。他面临诸多困难但从不放弃。最终，他的努力得到了回报，获得了巨大成功。现在你知道 succeed 意思是达成期望的目标。**

> A young artist struggled for years. Despite facing many rejections, he kept working hard. Finally, his artworks were widely praised and sold well. This was his success. It came from perseverance and passion. **一位年轻的艺术家努力了多年。尽管面临多次拒绝，他仍坚持努力。最终，他的艺术作品广受赞誉并且畅销。这就是他的成功。成功源于坚持和热情。**

> A poor boy had a dream to be successful. He worked hard every day, never gave up. Finally, he became a famous scientist. His success came from his persistence and hard work. **一个贫穷的男孩有一个成功的梦想。他每天努力工作，从不放弃。最终，他成为了一位著名的科学家。他的成功源于他的坚持和努力。**

> A young athlete trained hard every day. In the big competition, he ran fast and jumped high. Finally, he successfully won the championship. His smile was bright as he achieved this great success. **一位年轻的运动员每天刻苦训练。在大型比赛中，他跑得飞快，跳得很高。最终，他成功地赢得了冠军。当他取得这一巨大成功时，他的笑容灿烂。**

> A king was worried about the succession of his throne. He had many sons, but couldn\'t decide who would be the next. Finally, the most wise and brave son got the succession. **一位国王为王位的继承感到担忧。他有很多儿子，但无法决定谁是下一任。最终，最睿智勇敢的儿子获得了继承权。**

> A king wanted to build successive castles to protect his kingdom. But each time, there were new challenges. Finally, with perseverance, he achieved successive victories and his kingdom was safe. Remember,\'successive\' means following one after another. **一位国王想要建造一个接一个的城堡来保护他的王国。但每次都有新的挑战。最终，凭借毅力，他取得了接连不断的胜利，他的王国安全了。记住，'successive'意思是接连的，连续的。**

> A king was very ill. He needed to find a successor. Many people wanted the position. Finally, a wise and brave prince was chosen as the successor. The kingdom had hope again. **一位国王病重。他需要找一位继任者。很多人都想要这个位置。最终，一位睿智勇敢的王子被选为继任者。这个王国又有了希望。**

> A detective was presenting a case succinctly. He cut through the complexity and delivered the key points clearly and precisely. Everyone understood easily. **一位侦探简洁明了地陈述一个案件。他摒弃了复杂的部分，清晰准确地传达了关键要点。每个人都很容易理解。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in the desert. Just when he felt hopeless, he found a succulent fruit tree. The juicy fruits saved his life. Remember, \'succulent\' means juicy and tender. **一个饥饿的旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，他发现了一棵多汁的果树。多汁的水果救了他的命。记住，\'succulent\'意思是多汁且鲜嫩的。**

> A brave knight was fighting a fierce dragon. Despite his efforts, he was too exhausted and finally succumbed to the dragon\'s power. It means to give way or yield under pressure or temptation. **一位勇敢的骑士在与凶猛的巨龙战斗。尽管他全力以赴，但他太过疲惫，最终屈服于巨龙的力量。这个词意味着在压力或诱惑下让步或屈服。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magic box. Everyone wondered what was inside. When it opened, such beautiful jewels appeared! It was a surprise no one expected. \'Such\' here means of a particular type or degree. **从前，有一个魔法盒子。每个人都好奇里面有什么。当它打开时，出现了如此美丽的珠宝！这是一个没人预料到的惊喜。这里的'such'表示某一特定类型或程度。**

> A little bee was flying around. It got too close to a vacuum cleaner and was sucked in. Poor bee! Remember, \'suck\' means to draw in by force. **一只小蜜蜂正在飞来飞去。它离吸尘器太近了，被吸了进去。可怜的蜜蜂！记住，\'suck\'意思是用力吸进去。**

> A little fish was swimming happily in the ocean. One day, it saw a shiny object and thought it was food. But when it bit, it realized it was a sucker and got stuck. Poor little fish! **一条小鱼在海洋里快乐地游着。有一天，它看到一个闪闪发光的东西，以为是食物。但当它咬上去时，才发现那是个吸盘，然后就被卡住了。可怜的小鱼！**

> A little bug was stuck in the mud. A kind fairy used suction magic to pull it out. The bug was saved. Suction means the act of drawing something in by creating a vacuum. **一只小虫子被困在泥里。一位善良的仙女用吸力魔法把它拉了出来。小虫子得救了。Suction 意思是通过制造真空来吸入某物的行为。**

> One day, I was walking peacefully in the park. Suddenly, a big dog ran towards me. I was so scared. The unexpected appearance of the dog made it a sudden shock. **有一天，我正在公园里平静地散步。突然，一只大狗朝我跑来。我非常害怕。这只狗的意外出现造成了突然的惊吓。**
> One day, I was walking peacefully in the park. Suddenly, a big dog ran towards me and barked loudly. It scared me a lot. **有一天，我正在公园里平静地散步。突然，一只大狗朝我跑过来并且大声叫。它把我吓了一大跳。**

> A girl named Sue was always very brave. One day, she saw someone stealing and decided to sue the thief in court. With her determination, justice was served. Sue means to take legal action against someone. **一个叫苏的女孩总是非常勇敢。有一天，她看到有人偷东西，决定在法庭上起诉这个小偷。凭借她的决心，正义得到了伸张。sue 意思是起诉，控告。**

> A brave knight was always in battles. He suffered many injuries but still fought on. His determination showed that to suffer means to endure pain or hardship. **一位勇敢的骑士总是身处战斗之中。他遭受了许多伤痛，但仍继续战斗。他的决心表明，suffer 意味着忍受痛苦或艰难。**

> A poor man was constantly in pain and facing difficulties. He was a sufferer. But he never gave up, always trying to find a way out of his hardships. **一个可怜的男人总是处于痛苦之中，面临重重困难。他就是一个受难者。但他从不放弃，总是试图找到摆脱困境的方法。**

> A brave soldier was captured by the enemy. He endured countless days of suffering in the dark prison, but his spirit never broke. Finally, he was rescued and his suffering came to an end. **一位勇敢的士兵被敌人俘虏了。他在黑暗的监狱里忍受了无数天的痛苦，但他的精神从未崩溃。最后，他被解救了，他的苦难结束了。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in the forest. He found only a few berries. They didn\'t look much, but they sufficed to give him some energy to keep going. \'Suffice\' means to be enough or adequate. **一位饥饿的旅行者在森林中迷路了。他只找到了几颗浆果。它们看起来不多，但足以给他一些能量继续前行。'suffice'意思是足够或充足。**

> A poor man was always hungry. One day, he found a magic bag that could provide sufficient food. With enough to eat, he was happy and no longer suffered. Sufficient means enough to meet the needs. **一个穷人总是挨饿。有一天，他发现了一个神奇的袋子，能提供充足的食物。有了足够吃的，他很开心，不再受苦。Sufficient 意思是足够的，能满足需求的。**

> A traveler was lost in a desert. He had only a little water. But luckily, he found a hidden cave with sufficient water stored in it. He drank sufficiently and survived. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。他只有一点水。但幸运的是，他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面储存了足够的水。他喝得足够多，活了下来。**

> A man was trapped in a small room with no windows. The air was stale and he began to suffocate. He struggled to breathe, feeling his chest tighten as if a heavy weight was pressing on it. **一个男人被困在一个没有窗户的小房间里。空气污浊，他开始窒息。他挣扎着呼吸，感觉胸口像被重物压着一样收紧。**

> 想象一个画家在创作一幅美丽的风景画，他将颜料均匀地涂抹在画布上，色彩逐渐充满整个画面。这种色彩充满的过程就像\'suffuse\'，颜料\'suffuse\'了画布。 **想象画家作画，颜料均匀充满画布的过程来理解 suffuse 充满、弥漫的意思**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was very sad. Her mother gave her a spoonful of sugar and said, \'This sugar will make you happy.\' The girl tasted it and smiled. Sugar is something sweet that brings joy. **从前，有个小女孩非常伤心。她的妈妈给了她一勺糖，并说：'这糖会让你开心。'女孩尝了尝然后笑了。糖是带来快乐的甜甜的东西。**

> One day, I went to a candy store. There were all kinds of candies, which were very sugary. I ate one and felt so sweet. But too much sugary food is not good for health. **有一天，我去了一家糖果店。那里有各种各样的糖果，都非常甜。我吃了一颗，感觉特别甜。但太多含糖的食物对健康不好。**

> One day, my friend was confused about what to eat. I suggested pizza. He thought it was a good idea. \'Suggest\' means to put forward an idea or option for consideration. **有一天，我的朋友不知道吃什么。我建议吃披萨。他觉得这是个好主意。\'suggest\' 意思是提出一个想法或选择以供考虑。**

> One day, Tom was confused about what gift to buy for his friend\'s birthday. His sister gave him a suggestion: a nice book. Tom followed the suggestion and his friend was very happy. **一天，汤姆不知道给他朋友的生日买什么礼物。他姐姐给他一个建议：一本好书。汤姆听从了这个建议，他朋友非常高兴。**

> A man was in deep pain and felt there was no hope. One dark night, he decided to take his own life, which is called suicide. But remember, life is precious and there\'s always a way out. **一个男人深陷痛苦，觉得毫无希望。在一个漆黑的夜晚，他决定结束自己的生命，这就叫做自杀。但要记住，生命宝贵，总有出路。**

> A man went to a party. He had many clothes in his closet. But only one suit fit the theme of the party perfectly. So he wore that suit and had a great time. **一个男人去参加聚会。他的衣橱里有很多衣服。但只有一套西装完全符合聚会的主题。所以他穿上了那套西装，度过了一段美好的时光。**

> Once upon a time, a prince was looking for a suitable partner. He met many girls but none were just right. Finally, he found a kind and smart girl who was truly suitable for him. They lived happily ever after. **从前，一位王子在寻找合适的伴侣。他见了很多女孩，但都不合适。最后，他找到了一个善良聪明的女孩，她对他来说真的是合适的。他们从此过上了幸福的生活。**

> A young designer was looking for the suitably styled fabric for a new dress. After much search, she finally found it and created a masterpiece. \'Suitably\' means in a suitable or appropriate way. **一位年轻的设计师正在为一件新裙子寻找款式合适的布料。经过大量寻找，她终于找到了，并创作出了杰作。\'suitably\'意思是以合适或恰当的方式。**

> A little boy was punished by his parents and became sullen. He sat in the corner, with a gloomy face and refused to talk. Later, when his parents comforted him and explained the reason for the punishment, he gradually cheered up. **一个小男孩被父母惩罚后变得闷闷不乐。他坐在角落里，脸色阴沉，不肯说话。后来，当父母安慰他并解释惩罚的原因时，他逐渐高兴起来。**

> 在一个炎热的夏日，小明走在街头，天气 sultry 得让人难以忍受。他汗流浃背，仿佛置身于一个巨大的蒸笼中。这时，他看到一家冷饮店，迫不及待地冲进去享受片刻的清凉。 **在一个炎热的夏日，小明走在街头，天气闷热得让人难以忍受。他汗流浃背，仿佛置身于一个巨大的蒸笼中。这时，他看到一家冷饮店，迫不及待地冲进去享受片刻的清凉。**

> A student was very busy and had many tasks. But before the exam, she made a summary of all the key points. With this summary, she passed the exam easily. **一名学生非常忙碌，有很多任务。但在考试前，她对所有重点做了一个总结。凭借这个总结，她轻松通过了考试。**

> A math genius was challenged to find the summation of a long series of numbers. After hours of thinking, he finally cracked the code and got the total. The summation was the key to solving the mystery! **一位数学天才被要求求出一长串数字的总和。经过数小时的思考，他终于破解了密码并得出了总数。总和就是解开谜团的关键！**

> Imagine a magical artist who can superimpose beautiful patterns on a plain canvas. He takes one image and places it precisely over another, creating a new and unique work. That\'s like what \'superimpose\' means! **想象一位神奇的艺术家，他能在一张空白的画布上叠加美丽的图案。他把一个图像精准地放置在另一个上面，创造出全新独特的作品。这就像\'superimpose\'这个单词的意思！**
> 想象一个超级英雄，他负责管理整个城市的秩序，大家都称他为 superintendent。他拥有超强的智慧和能力，确保城市的安全与和谐。 **想象一个负责管理整个城市秩序的超级英雄被称为主管**
> 在古代的一场战斗中，一位将领展现出卓越的才能，他的战术和领导能力远超其他对手，士兵们都称赞他为\'superior\'。最终他们取得了胜利。这位将领就是优秀的、胜过他人的存在。 **在古代的一场战斗中，一位将领展现出卓越的才能，他的战术和领导能力远远超过其他对手，士兵们都称赞他为"优越的；更好的；上级的"。最终他们取得了胜利。这位将领就是优秀的、胜过他人的存在。**

> A small ant always thought it was inferior. But one day, it discovered its ability to carry heavy food, realizing its superiority over other weak insects. It understood that superiority doesn\'t mean being the biggest, but having unique skills. **一只小蚂蚁总觉得自己低人一等。但有一天，它发现自己能搬运很重的食物，意识到自己比其他弱小的昆虫有优势。它明白了优势不意味着体型最大，而是拥有独特的技能。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He went to a big place called \'supermarket\' to buy food. There were many kinds of things. He found what he wanted and was very happy. **一天，汤姆非常饿。他去了一个叫做'超市'的大地方买食物。那里有很多种类的东西。他找到了想要的，非常开心。**

> One night, Tom was walking in the forest. Suddenly, he saw strange lights and heard mysterious voices. It was a supernatural experience that he couldn\'t explain. Later, he realized it was beyond the normal world. **一天晚上，汤姆在森林里散步。突然，他看到奇怪的光，听到神秘的声音。这是一次他无法解释的超自然的经历。后来，他意识到这超出了正常世界。**

> In a distant galaxy, a massive star exploded with a brilliant light. This colossal explosion was called a supernova. It was so powerful that its light could be seen across the universe. A supernova is like a cosmic fireworks show! **在一个遥远的星系中，一颗巨大的恒星爆发，闪耀出璀璨的光芒。这种巨大的爆炸被称为超新星。它威力巨大，其光芒能在整个宇宙中被看到。超新星就像一场宇宙烟花秀！**

> Once upon a time, there was a country with amazing abilities. It could solve any problem easily. This country was known as a superpower, having great strength and influence over others. **从前，有一个国家具有惊人的能力。它能轻松解决任何问题。这个国家被称为超级大国，拥有强大的力量和对其他国家的影响力。**

> A young scientist invented a new method that supersede the old one. His discovery made the previous approach obsolete. Now you know supersede means to take the place of something older or less effective. **一位年轻的科学家发明了一种新方法，取代了旧方法。他的发现使之前的方法过时了。现在你知道 supersede 意思是取代较旧或较无效的东西。**

> A brave pilot was flying a supersonic jet. It was so fast that it left a sonic boom behind. People on the ground were amazed by the speed. The pilot felt proud to control this supersonic wonder. **一位勇敢的飞行员正在驾驶一架超音速飞机。它速度极快，身后留下了音爆。地面上的人们对其速度感到惊叹。飞行员为能操控这架超音速的神奇飞机而感到自豪。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a dark forest. He believed in a superstition that if he found a four-leaf clover, he would be safe. After a long search, he finally found it and found his way out. **有一天，汤姆在一片黑暗的森林里迷路了。他相信一个迷信说法，如果他能找到一片四叶草，他就会安全。经过长时间的寻找，他终于找到了，并走出了森林。**

> One night, Tom was walking in a dark forest. He heard strange noises and felt scared. Later, he realized it was just his superstitious mind playing tricks. Superstitious means having or showing a belief in superstitions. **一天晚上，汤姆在黑暗的森林里散步。他听到奇怪的声音，感到害怕。后来，他意识到这只是他迷信的头脑在作祟。Superstitious 意思是有迷信或表现出迷信。**

> A young manager was assigned to supervise a team. He had to watch over every detail, making sure everything was done correctly. It was a big responsibility, but he did it well. \'Supervise\' means to watch over and direct. **一位年轻的经理被指派监督一个团队。他必须关注每一个细节，确保一切都正确完成。这是一项重大责任，但他做得很好。\'supervise\'意思是监督、管理。**

> A young detective was under the supervision of a veteran. The veteran guided him carefully, making sure he did everything right. \'Supervision\' means close observation and direction to ensure something is done properly. **一位年轻的侦探在一位老手的监督之下。老手仔细地引导他，确保他做的一切都是正确的。\'supervision\'意思是密切的观察和指导以确保事情正确完成。**

> A young employee was always nervous when facing the supervisor. One day, he made a mistake. But the supervisor was kind and helped him fix it. From then on, he knew a supervisor is not just for checking but also for guiding. **一位年轻员工面对主管时总是很紧张。有一天，他犯了个错误。但主管很友善，帮他改正了。从那以后，他知道主管不仅是检查工作，还会指导工作。**

> A young man aspired to a supervisory position. He worked hard, overseeing every detail. Finally, his excellent supervisory skills got him promoted. Now he supervises the team effectively. **一个年轻人渴望获得管理职位。他努力工作，监督每一个细节。最终，他出色的监督技能使他得到晋升。现在他有效地管理着团队。**

> One day, a little boy was very hungry after playing outside. When he came home, his mother prepared a delicious meal for him. This meal in the evening was called supper. The boy enjoyed it very much. **有一天，一个小男孩在外面玩耍后非常饿。当他回家时，他的妈妈为他准备了一顿美味的饭。这顿晚上的饭被称为晚餐。小男孩吃得非常开心。**

> In a magical forest, an old oak tree was supplanted by a young and vibrant pine. The oak had been there for ages but the pine grew stronger and took its place. \'Supplant\' means to take the place of something or someone. **在一个神奇的森林里，一棵古老的橡树被一棵年轻而充满活力的松树所取代。这棵橡树在那里已经很久了，但松树长得更强壮，取代了它的位置。'supplant'意思是取代某物或某人。**
> 想象一下，一个舞者在舞台上展现出极其柔韧的身姿，她的身体就像柳枝一样 supple。她轻松地弯曲、伸展，每一个动作都如此流畅优美，这种柔韧性就是 supple 的体现。 **想象一个舞者展现出柔韧的身姿来体现'supple'（柔软的；灵活的；易弯曲的）这个单词**
> 想象一个探险家在荒野中，食物快没了。幸运的是，他找到了一个神秘的包裹，里面是各种补充品（supplement），有能量棒和水，让他得以继续前行。 **想象一个探险家在荒野中食物短缺，幸运地找到补充品得以继续前行的故事**

> A traveler was lost in a strange city. Just when he was worried, he found a supplemental map that guided him to his destination. The map was an extra help, just like the meaning of\'supplemental\'. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。就在他忧心忡忡时，他发现了一张补充地图，引导他到达了目的地。这张地图是额外的帮助，就像\'supplemental\'这个词的意思。**

> A student was struggling with math. The teacher gave him supplementary materials to help. These materials were like extra keys that opened the door to better understanding. Supplementary means providing additional support or help. **一个学生数学学得很吃力。老师给了他补充材料来帮忙。这些材料就像额外的钥匙，打开了更好理解的大门。supplementary 意思是补充的；追加的**

> A poor man was weak and often ill. A doctor suggested supplementation. So he started taking vitamins and minerals. Gradually, he became stronger and healthier. **一个穷人身体虚弱且经常生病。一位医生建议补充营养。于是他开始服用维生素和矿物质。渐渐地，他变得更强壮、更健康了。**

> A factory was in trouble because its supplier failed to deliver materials on time. The boss was very angry and decided to find a new, reliable supplier. So, remember, a supplier is someone who provides goods or services. **一家工厂陷入了困境，因为它的供应商未能按时交付材料。老板非常生气，决定找一个新的、可靠的供应商。所以，记住，supplier 就是提供货物或服务的人。**

> A merchant was in a hurry to supply goods to a faraway town. But the road was blocked. Finally, with great effort, he found another way and successfully completed the supply. **一位商人着急给一个遥远的城镇供应货物。但道路被堵塞了。最终，经过巨大努力，他找到了另一条路，并成功完成了供应。**

> One day, Tom was climbing a mountain. It was very difficult and he felt tired. Just when he wanted to give up, his friends came and gave him support. They held his hands and helped him reach the top. **一天，汤姆正在爬山。这非常困难，他感到很累。就在他想要放弃的时候，他的朋友们来了并且给他支持。他们握住他的手，帮助他到达了山顶。**
> 想象一场激烈的足球比赛，小明在观众席上疯狂呐喊助威，他就是球队的supporter。他挥舞着旗帜，为球员们加油，给予他们精神上的支持，坚信球队会获胜。 **想象一场足球赛，小明在观众席疯狂呐喊助威，他就是球队的支持者。他挥舞旗帜加油，给予精神支持，坚信球队会赢。**

> Suppose you are lost in a forest. You have no map or phone. You have to suppose which way is the right one to get out. It means to imagine or think something might be true. **假设你在森林里迷路了。你既没有地图也没有手机。你不得不假设哪条路是出去的正确道路。这意味着想象或认为某事可能是真的。**

> Imagine a detective who is supposed to solve a mystery. But everyone assumes he will succeed easily. However, the case turns out to be very complex. \'Supposed\' here means expected or assumed to be the case. **想象一个侦探本应该解开一个谜团。但每个人都认为他会轻松成功。然而，这个案子结果非常复杂。\'supposed\'在这里表示被期望或被认为是这样。**

> A detective was investigating a supposedly perfect crime. Everyone thought it was impossible to solve, but the detective didn\'t give up. Finally, he found the key clue and proved that it wasn\'t as perfect as supposed. **一位侦探正在调查一起据说是完美的犯罪。每个人都认为这无法解决，但侦探没有放弃。最后，他找到了关键线索，证明它并不像所认为的那样完美。**

> A detective was working on a case. He had a supposition that the thief entered the house through the window. But he needed more evidence to prove it. **一位侦探正在处理一个案子。他有一个推测，即小偷是通过窗户进入房子的。但他需要更多证据来证明。**

> A brave journalist tried to expose a big company\'s illegal acts. But the powerful company used all its resources to suppress his reports. They didn\'t want the truth to come out. **一位勇敢的记者试图揭露一家大公司的违法行为。但这家强大的公司用尽所有资源去压制他的报道。他们不想让真相曝光。**

> In a magical forest, a powerful wizard used a special spell for suppression. It stopped the evil goblins\' wild magic, making the forest peaceful again. Suppression means to stop or prevent something forcefully. **在一个神奇的森林里，一位强大的巫师使用了一种特殊的压制魔法。它阻止了邪恶小妖精们的狂野魔法，让森林再次恢复平静。suppression 意思是强力阻止或制止某事。**

> A group of bad guys called themselves supremacists. They thought they were better than everyone else and wanted to rule the world. But in the end, justice prevailed and their evil plan failed. **一群坏人自称为至上主义者。他们认为自己比其他人都优越，还想统治世界。但最终，正义获胜，他们的邪恶计划失败了。**

> In a faraway kingdom, there was a fierce battle for supremacy. Two powerful lords fought hard, but in the end, one emerged victorious, achieving absolute supremacy and ruling the land peacefully. **在一个遥远的王国，有一场争夺霸权的激烈战斗。两位强大的领主奋力战斗，但最终，一人胜出，获得了绝对的霸权，和平地统治着这片土地。**

> A young artist strived to create the supreme painting. He faced many difficulties but remained supremely confident. Finally, his masterpiece amazed everyone. **一位年轻的艺术家努力创作一幅顶级的画作。他面临许多困难，但仍然极度自信。最终，他的杰作令所有人惊叹。**

> A customer was very angry when he found a surcharge on his bill for an extra service he didn\'t ask for. The company had added this surcharge without telling him. It means an additional charge or fee. **一位顾客发现账单上有一项他未要求的额外服务的附加费，非常生气。公司在未告知他的情况下添加了这项附加费。这个词意思是额外收费或附加费。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a forest. But he was sure he could find the way out because he had a map. Finally, he did it. Being sure gives you confidence and leads to success. **一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。但他确信自己能找到出路，因为他有一张地图。最后，他做到了。确信能给你信心并带来成功。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost in a forest. She was surely scared. But with her courage and a map, she surely found her way home. The word\'surely\' here means definitely or without doubt. **从前，有个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她当然很害怕。但凭借着勇气和一张地图，她肯定找到了回家的路。这里的"surely"意思是肯定地，无疑地。**

> A surfer was very excited to ride the waves. He got up early, grabbed his surfboard, and rushed to the beach. He surfed skillfully and enjoyed the thrill of the ocean. **一位冲浪者非常兴奋地去驾驭海浪。他早早起床，抓起冲浪板，冲向海滩。他熟练地冲浪，享受着大海带来的刺激。**
> 想象一下，你在深海潜水，周围一片黑暗。突然，你向上游，看到了光明，那就是海洋的\'surface\'（表面）。你终于浮出水面，呼吸到新鲜的空气。 **想象一下，你在深海潜水，周围一片黑暗。突然，你向上游，看到了光明，那就是海洋的"表面"。你终于浮出水面，呼吸到新鲜的空气。**

> One day, a surfer named Tom was excited to ride the big waves. He paddled out, caught the perfect wave, and showed amazing skills. Surfing made him feel free and happy. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的冲浪者很兴奋地去驾驭巨浪。他划出去，抓住了完美的浪，展示了惊人的技巧。冲浪让他感到自由和快乐。**

> A surfer was riding the waves. Suddenly, a huge wave surged towards him. It was so powerful and fast. The surfer had to hold tight to stay on the board. The surging wave was like a wild beast. **一位冲浪者正在驾驭海浪。突然，一股巨大的浪涛向他汹涌而来。它是如此强大和迅速。冲浪者不得不紧紧抓住板子。这汹涌的浪涛就像一头野兽。**

> A surgeon is like a superhero in the operating room. One day, a surgeon named Sam had to perform a very difficult operation. With his skills and courage, he saved the patient\'s life. Sam is a great surgeon! **一位外科医生就像手术室里的超级英雄。有一天，一位叫山姆的外科医生不得不进行一场非常困难的手术。凭借他的技能和勇气，他挽救了病人的生命。山姆是一位伟大的外科医生！**

> One day, Tom had a serious accident and needed surgery. He was very scared, but the doctor assured him it would fix his problem. After the surgery, Tom recovered well. Remember, surgery can save lives! **有一天，汤姆遭遇了一场严重的事故，需要做手术。他非常害怕，但医生向他保证手术会解决他的问题。手术后，汤姆恢复得很好。记住，手术可以拯救生命！**

> A doctor was performing a surgical operation. He wore a surgical mask and used surgical tools carefully. The surgical procedure was successful. Everyone was relieved. **一位医生正在进行外科手术。他戴着外科口罩，小心地使用外科工具。外科手术过程很成功。每个人都松了一口气。**

> A doctor was operating surgically on a patient. The surgery required precise skills. With every move made surgically, the doctor aimed to save the patient\'s life. It was a tense but crucial moment. **一位医生正在为一位病人进行外科手术。这场手术需要精准的技巧。每一个外科操作，医生都旨在拯救病人的生命。这是一个紧张但关键的时刻。**

> A surly bear was guarding its cave. No one dared to approach. One brave adventurer tried to get close, but the bear growled angrily. It was so surly! Remember, surly means bad-tempered and unfriendly. **一只脾气暴躁的熊在守护它的洞穴。没人敢靠近。一位勇敢的探险家试图靠近，但熊愤怒地咆哮。它真是脾气坏又不友好！记住，surly 意思是脾气坏的和不友好的。**

> A detective was working on a case. He had few clues but made a surmise that the thief was someone familiar. His surmise was based on a small footprint found at the scene. **一位侦探正在处理一个案子。他线索很少，但猜测小偷是某个熟人。他的猜测是基于现场发现的一个小脚印。**
> 想象一下，一位勇敢的登山者面对一座高耸的山峰。山峰难以跨越，但他毫不退缩，最终成功地 surmount 了它。这意味着他战胜并越过了这个巨大的障碍。 **想象一位勇敢的登山者成功战胜并越过了难以跨越的高山，以此来理解surmount（战胜，克服，越过）这个单词**

> A young man named Tom was confused when filling a form. He didn\'t know what \'surname\' meant. His friend told him it was the family name. So Tom wrote down \'Smith\', which was his family\'s surname. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人在填写表格时感到困惑。他不知道"surname"是什么意思。他的朋友告诉他这是姓氏。所以汤姆写下了"史密斯"，这是他家的姓氏。**

> A young athlete was determined to surpass all the records. He trained hard every day. Finally, at the big competition, he outran everyone and surpassed all previous best times. His hard work paid off! **一位年轻的运动员决心超越所有纪录。他每天刻苦训练。最终，在大型比赛中，他超过了所有人，超越了之前所有的最好成绩。他的努力得到了回报！**

> A farmer had a surplus of apples. He was worried as they would go bad. But then he had an idea. He made apple pies and sold them, making good use of the surplus. **一位农民有多余的苹果。他很担心它们会坏掉。但随后他有了个主意。他做了苹果派并出售，很好地利用了这些剩余的苹果。**

> One day, I was having a normal day. Suddenly, my friends showed up at my door with a big cake. It was a total surprise! I never expected them to come and celebrate my birthday. **有一天，我正过着平常的日子。突然，我的朋友们出现在我家门口，还带着一个大蛋糕。这完全是个惊喜！我从没想到他们会来给我庆祝生日。**

> One day, Tom came home earlier than usual. His parents were surprised because they didn\'t expect him. They thought he was still at school. This unexpected event made them feel surprised. **一天，汤姆比平常回家早。他的父母很惊讶，因为他们没想到他会回来。他们以为他还在学校。这个意外事件让他们感到惊讶。**

> One day, I was walking in the park. Suddenly, a monkey jumped out from behind a tree. It was surprising! I never expected to see a monkey there. The unexpected event made my day. **有一天，我在公园里散步。突然，一只猴子从一棵树后面跳了出来。这太令人惊讶了！我从没想到会在那里看到一只猴子。这个意外的事件让我这一天都很特别。**

> One day, I expected a normal party. Surprisingly, my best friend showed up with a big cake and a special gift. It was a wonderful surprise that made my day. **有一天，我期待着一个普通的聚会。令人惊讶的是，我最好的朋友带着一个大蛋糕和一份特别的礼物出现了。这是一个美妙的惊喜，让我度过了美好的一天。**

> A brave soldier was in a fierce battle. Surrounded by enemies, he had no choice but to surrender. He laid down his weapon, showing that he gave up the fight. **一位勇敢的士兵身处激烈的战斗中。被敌人包围，他别无选择只能投降。他放下武器，表明他放弃战斗。**

> A thief was moving surreptitiously in the dark. He tried to steal jewels without being noticed. But the police caught him because of a small noise he made. \'Surreptitiously\' means secretly and stealthily. **一个小偷在黑暗中偷偷摸摸地移动。他试图偷珠宝而不被发现。但警察因为他发出的一点小声响抓住了他。\'surreptitiously\'意思是秘密地、偷偷摸摸地。**

> A couple couldn\'t have a baby. So they found a surrogate mother. This woman agreed to carry and give birth to their child. \'Surrogate\' means a substitute or stand-in. **一对夫妇无法生育。于是他们找了一位代孕母亲。这位女士同意为他们怀胎并生下孩子。'surrogate'意思是替代品或替身。**

> A brave knight was in a forest. Suddenly, he found himself surrounded by fierce wolves. But he stayed calm and fought back. \'Surround\' means to be all around something or someone. **一位勇敢的骑士在森林里。突然，他发现自己被凶猛的狼包围了。但他保持冷静并反击。'surround'意思是围绕某物或某人。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a forest. He felt scared as unknown sounds surrounded him. But he stayed calm and found his way out by observing the surrounding trees and paths. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林里迷路了。未知的声音环绕着他，他感到害怕。但他保持冷静，通过观察周围的树木和路径找到了出路。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange place. He looked around and noticed the beautiful mountains, rivers and forests that surrounded him. These elements together formed the surroundings. Tom finally found his way home by observing the unique features of his surroundings. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的地方迷路了。他环顾四周，注意到环绕着他的美丽的山、河和森林。这些元素共同构成了环境。汤姆最终通过观察周围环境的独特特征找到了回家的路。**

> A spy was assigned the task of surveillance. He had to secretly watch and monitor the movements of a criminal gang. Every day, he hid and observed carefully. Finally, his surveillance helped catch the criminals. **一名间谍被指派了监视的任务。他必须秘密观察和监控一个犯罪团伙的行动。每天，他都隐藏起来仔细观察。最终，他的监视帮助抓住了罪犯。**

> One day, a team of scientists decided to survey a mysterious forest. They walked carefully, noting everything they saw. It was a challenging but interesting task to get a full picture of the area. **一天，一组科学家决定对一片神秘的森林进行调查。他们小心翼翼地走着，记录下所看到的一切。要全面了解这个区域是一项具有挑战性但有趣的任务。**

> A young man named Tom dreamed of becoming a surveyor. One day, he climbed mountains and crossed rivers with his tools to measure and map the land. Finally, his hard work paid off and he became a famous surveyor. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人梦想成为一名测量员。有一天，他带着工具爬山过河去测量和绘制土地。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他成为了一位著名的测量员。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in the jungle. With no food or water, he struggled to survive. Every decision was crucial. Finally, his determination led to his survival. He learned that survival means staying alive in difficult situations. **一位勇敢的冒险家在丛林中迷路了。没有食物和水，他努力求生。每一个决定都至关重要。最终，他的决心使他活了下来。他明白了 survival 意味着在艰难的情况下活下去。**

> A brave explorer was lost in the jungle. With no food and facing many dangers, he used all his skills to survive. Finally, he found his way out and lived to tell the tale. **一位勇敢的探险家在丛林中迷路了。没有食物并且面临诸多危险，他运用所有技能以求生存。最终，他找到了出路并活下来讲述这段经历。**

> A plane crashed on a deserted island. Everyone was in panic. But one brave person managed to find food and water. Through many difficulties, this person was the survivor. Finally, he was rescued. **一架飞机在荒岛上坠毁了。每个人都很恐慌。但有一个勇敢的人设法找到了食物和水。历经重重困难，这个人成为了幸存者。最终，他获救了。**

> A scientist was studying a special plant. He found that this plant had a high susceptibility to a certain virus. It easily got infected. This made him understand the plant\'s weakness. **一位科学家在研究一种特殊的植物。他发现这种植物对某种病毒有很高的易感性。它很容易被感染。这让他明白了这种植物的弱点。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment. Some substances were susceptible to heat and changed quickly. But others remained stable. The scientist noted which ones were susceptible to record the results. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验。一些物质容易受热并迅速发生变化。但其他的则保持稳定。科学家记录下哪些是易受热的以记录结果。**

> A detective was on a case. He saw a man acting strangely and suspected him. Later, it turned out the suspect was indeed the thief. The detective\'s suspicion was correct! **一位侦探在办案。他看到一个男人行为古怪，就怀疑他。后来，事实证明这个嫌疑人确实是小偷。侦探的怀疑是正确的！**

> A naughty monkey was playing on a rope. But the zoo keeper had to suspend the monkey\'s playtime because it was too dangerous. The word\'suspend\' here means to stop or pause something temporarily. **一只顽皮的猴子正在绳子上玩耍。但动物园管理员不得不暂停猴子的玩耍时间，因为太危险了。这里\'suspend\'这个单词意思是暂时停止或中止某事。**

> A detective was on a case full of suspense. The clues were hidden, and everyone waited nervously. Just when it seemed hopeless, a key piece of evidence emerged, ending the suspense. Remember, \'suspense\' means excitement and uncertainty. **一位侦探在处理一个充满悬念的案子。线索被隐藏起来，每个人都紧张地等待着。就在看似无望的时候，一个关键证据出现了，结束了悬念。记住，\'suspense\'意思是兴奋和不确定。**

> A thief was caught and put in suspension. He was hanging in mid-air, waiting for the final judgment. This scene of suspension made everyone nervous. **一个小偷被抓住并处于悬浮状态。他被吊在半空中，等待最终的判决。这种悬浮的场景让每个人都很紧张。**

> One day, a valuable necklace disappeared. Everyone was a suspect. Tom had a strange look, which raised suspicion. But in the end, it was found that a cat had knocked the necklace under the sofa. **有一天，一条贵重的项链不见了。每个人都是嫌疑人。汤姆神色奇怪，引起了怀疑。但最后发现是一只猫把项链撞到沙发下面了。**

> A detective was on a case. Every move of the suspect seemed suspicious. The way he looked around, the nervous answers. It made the detective believe he was hiding something. **一位侦探在办案。嫌疑人的每一个举动看起来都很可疑。他四处张望的方式，紧张的回答。这让侦探认为他在隐瞒什么。**

> A detective was observing a man suspiciously. The man was behaving strangely, looking around nervously and walking suspiciously. The detective knew something was wrong. **一位侦探正怀疑地观察着一个男人。这个男人行为古怪，紧张地四处张望，走路的样子也很可疑。侦探知道有问题。**

> A brave athlete was running a long-distance race. Despite facing many difficulties, he sustained his pace and energy. Finally, he crossed the finish line successfully. This shows the meaning of \'sustain\' - to keep going and maintain. **一位勇敢的运动员正在参加长跑比赛。尽管面临诸多困难，他保持着自己的速度和能量。最终，他成功地冲过了终点线。这体现了"sustain"的意思------保持，维持。**

> Imagine a city where everything is built to last. The energy comes from clean sources, buildings are eco-friendly, and resources are used carefully. This city is sustainable, meaning it can continue like this for a long time. **想象一个城市，一切都是为了持久存在而建造的。能源来自清洁能源，建筑是环保的，资源被谨慎使用。这个城市是可持续的，意味着它能够长久地保持这样的状态。**

> A brave climber was on a mountain expedition. Despite facing strong winds and harsh conditions, he showed sustained effort and never gave up. Finally, he reached the summit. \'Sustained\' here means lasting and continuous. **一位勇敢的登山者在进行登山探险。尽管面临强风和恶劣条件，他展现出持续不断的努力且从未放弃。最终，他到达了山顶。'sustained'在这里表示持久的、连续不断的。**

> A traveler was lost in the desert. Feeling weak and hungry, he desperately needed sustenance. Just when he was about to give up, he found an oasis with fruits and water, providing the sustenance to keep him alive. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。感到虚弱和饥饿，他极度需要食物和营养。就在他要放弃的时候，他发现了一个有水果和水的绿洲，为他提供了维持生命的营养。**

> A doctor needed to collect a sample from a patient. So, he used a swab to gently take the needed material. The swab was like a magic stick that helped find out the problem. **一位医生需要从病人身上采集样本。于是，他用拭子轻轻地获取所需的物质。这个拭子就像一根魔法棒，帮助找出问题。**

> A small mouse always wanted to swagger like a lion. One day, it tried to walk with a big stride but ended up tripping. It learned that swaggering without real power is just a show. **一只小老鼠总是想像狮子一样大摇大摆。有一天，它试着迈大步走，但最终绊倒了。它明白了没有真正的力量而大摇大摆只是作秀。**

> A little bird was very hungry. It found a big worm and swallowed it quickly. Then it flew happily. Remember, \'swallow\' means to take something into your mouth and down your throat. **一只小鸟非常饿。它发现了一只大虫子并迅速吞了下去。然后它快乐地飞走了。记住，'swallow'意思是把某物放进嘴里并咽下去。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a forest. Suddenly, he found himself in a swamp. The water was deep and the ground was soft. He struggled hard to get out. Remember, swamp means a wetland area full of water and mud. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林中迷路了。突然，他发现自己身处一片沼泽。水很深，地面很软。他艰难地挣扎着出去。记住，swamp 指的是充满水和泥的湿地。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. Suddenly, she saw a beautiful swan. The swan led her out of the forest. The girl was so happy and always remembered the kind swan. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。突然，她看到一只美丽的天鹅。天鹅带她走出了森林。小女孩非常开心，永远记住了这只善良的天鹅。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry decided to swap their toys. Tom gave his toy car to Jerry, and Jerry gave his toy plane to Tom. They were both very happy with the swap. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞决定交换他们的玩具。汤姆把他的玩具车给了杰瑞，杰瑞把他的玩具飞机给了汤姆。他们对这次交换都非常高兴。**
> 想象一下，在一个美丽的花园里，突然出现了一大群蜜蜂。它们密密麻麻，像一片黑云一样飞过来。这些蜜蜂就形成了一个\'swarm\'（蜂群）。 **想象在花园中突然出现一大群像黑云般飞来的蜜蜂，它们形成的群体就是\'swarm\'（蜂群）**

> In a faraway ancient village, people discovered strange patterns on the walls. These patterns, called swastikas, were believed to bring good luck and protection. However, later, this symbol was wrongly used by some bad groups. **在一个遥远的古代村庄，人们在墙上发现了奇怪的图案。这些被称为"swastika（卐字）"的图案，被认为会带来好运和保护。然而，后来这个符号被一些不良团体错误使用。**

> A fly was buzzing around. The angry man took a swatter and SWAT! He hit the fly hard. It shows the forceful action of hitting something quickly and sharply, like swatting an insect. **一只苍蝇嗡嗡乱飞。愤怒的男人拿起苍蝇拍，啪！他用力地打苍蝇。这展示了快速、有力地击打某物的动作，就像拍打昆虫一样。**
> A farmer was cutting the wheat and creating a wide swath of harvested land. The swath was like a path of success, showing his hard work. **一位农民正在收割小麦，创造出了一大片收割过的区域。这片区域就像一条成功之路，展现了他的辛勤劳作。**

> A strong wind came and started to sway the big tree. The branches were moving left and right. It looked like the tree was dancing in the wind. Remember, when something moves like that, it\'s swaying. **一阵强风刮来，开始摇晃那棵大树。树枝左右摆动。看起来这棵树像是在风中跳舞。记住，当某物像这样移动时，就是在 sway（摇晃）。**

> A brave knight was captured by the enemy. To protect his kingdom\'s secrets, he swore to keep silent even under torture. His determination to honor his swear made him a hero. **一位勇敢的骑士被敌人俘虏。为了保护王国的秘密，他发誓即使遭受酷刑也保持沉默。他坚守誓言的决心使他成为了英雄。**

> One hot summer day, Tom was working hard in the field. His face was red and he felt very uncomfortable. Soon, beads of sweat started dripping down his forehead. \'Sweat\', it\'s the liquid our body makes when we work hard or feel hot. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆在田里努力干活。他的脸通红，感觉很不舒服。很快，汗珠开始从他的额头滴落。"sweat"，就是当我们努力工作或感到热时身体产生的液体。**

> One cold winter day, Tom was shivering. His mom quickly took out a warm sweater and put it on him. Tom felt cozy immediately. The sweater protected him from the cold wind. Now, whenever he sees a sweater, he remembers that warm moment. **在一个寒冷的冬日，汤姆冻得发抖。他妈妈迅速拿出一件温暖的毛衣给他穿上。汤姆立刻感到舒适温暖。这件毛衣保护他免受寒风侵袭。现在，每当他看到毛衣，就会想起那个温暖的时刻。**

> A poor girl named Lily worked in a sweatshop. She had to work long hours in a hot and crowded room, sewing clothes with no breaks. It was a place where workers were exploited and had a hard life. **一个叫莉莉的可怜女孩在一家血汗工厂工作。她不得不在又热又拥挤的房间里长时间工作，不停地缝衣服，没有休息。这是一个工人被剥削、生活艰难的地方。**

> One hot summer day, I went for a run and came back very sweaty. My shirt was soaked, and my face was dripping with perspiration. \'Sweaty\' means covered with or producing sweat. **在一个炎热的夏日，我去跑步，回来时浑身是汗。我的衬衫湿透了，脸上汗水直淌。\'sweaty\'意思是满是汗的或出汗的。**

> A brave knight was fighting in a battle. With his mighty sword, he would sweep the enemies away like a wind. Every swing was a sweep, clearing the path before him. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗。他用他强大的剑，像风一样把敌人扫开。每一次挥剑都是一次清扫，在他面前清出道路。**

> A brave knight was on a mission. He used a sweeping movement with his sword to clear the path filled with obstacles. The wide and forceful motion was like the meaning of \'sweeping\'. **一位勇敢的骑士在执行任务。他用剑做出了一个大幅度的挥扫动作来清除满是障碍的道路。这种宽广而有力的动作就像'sweeping'这个词的意思。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. Feeling scared and tired, she suddenly smelled a sweet scent. Following it, she found a house with a grandma baking sweet cookies. The smell of those cookies was the sweet smell. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她感到害怕和疲惫，突然闻到一股甜甜的气味。顺着气味，她发现了一座房子，里面有一位老奶奶在烤香甜的饼干。那些饼干的味道就是甜甜的气味。**

> A girl was making a cake. The cake tasted bad at first. But when she added some sugar and honey to sweeten it, the cake became delicious and everyone loved it. **一个女孩正在做蛋糕。起初蛋糕味道不好。但当她加了一些糖和蜂蜜来使它变甜时，蛋糕变得美味可口，每个人都喜欢它。**

> One day, I was drinking coffee and found it too bitter. So, I added some sweetener to make it taste better. The sweetener magically transformed the coffee into a sweet treat. **有一天，我在喝咖啡，觉得太苦了。于是，我加了一些甜味剂让它更好喝。甜味剂神奇地把咖啡变成了一种甜蜜的享受。**

> Once upon a time, a boy gave a girl a box of chocolates and said, \'You are my sweetheart.\' The girl blushed and felt so happy. From then on, whenever the boy saw the girl, he would call her sweetheart. **从前，有个男孩给了女孩一盒巧克力并说：'你是我的甜心。'女孩脸红了，感到非常开心。从那以后，每当男孩见到女孩，他都会叫她甜心。**

> One day, when I was feeling sad, a little girl came to me and said, \'Don\'t be sad. Here\'s a candy for you, sweetie.\' Her kind words and the candy made me happy. From then on, I remember the word sweetie as a term of endearment. **有一天，当我感到悲伤时，一个小女孩走到我面前说：'别伤心。给你一颗糖果，亲爱的。'她亲切的话语和糖果让我开心起来。从那以后，我记住了 sweetie 这个表示亲爱的称呼的单词。**

> A little girl was singing sweetly in the garden. The birds stopped chirping to listen. Her voice was as pleasant as the smell of flowers. Everyone was charmed by her sweetly sung song. **一个小女孩在花园里甜美地唱歌。鸟儿们停止了鸣叫来倾听。她的声音像花香一样令人愉快。每个人都被她甜美的歌声所吸引。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. Tired and hungry, she found a hidden cave with a pot of honey. The taste of the honey filled her with sweetness. It gave her the strength to find her way home. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。又累又饿时，她发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面有一罐蜂蜜。蜂蜜的味道让她感受到了甜蜜。这给了她找到回家路的力量。**

> One day, I went to the beach. The waves were huge and they would swell up and crash onto the shore. It was an amazing sight. The word\'swell\' means to increase in size or volume, just like those growing waves. **有一天，我去了海滩。海浪非常大，它们会涌起然后拍打在岸边。这是一个惊人的景象。单词\'swell\'意思是（体积或数量）增大，就像那些不断涌起的海浪。**

> One day, Tom fell and hurt his knee. Soon, there was a swelling on his knee. It looked like a small mountain. But after some rest and treatment, the swelling gradually went down. **有一天，汤姆摔倒了并伤到了膝盖。很快，他的膝盖上有了一个肿块。它看起来像一座小山。但经过一些休息和治疗，肿块逐渐消退了。**

> In a sweltering summer, Tom was on a hiking trip. The sun was fierce, and the heat made him feel like he was in an oven. He was sweating profusely and struggling to breathe. \'Sweltering\' indeed describes such a hot and uncomfortable situation. **在一个酷热的夏天，汤姆正在徒步旅行。太阳很毒，炎热让他感觉像在烤箱里。他大汗淋漓，呼吸困难。"sweltering"确实描述了这样炎热又难受的情形。**

> One day, I was riding my bike. Suddenly, a dog ran in front of me. I had to swerve quickly to avoid hitting it. It was a close call, but thanks to my quick swerve, I was safe. **有一天，我正在骑自行车。突然，一只狗跑到我面前。我不得不迅速转弯以避免撞到它。真是千钧一发，但多亏了我快速的转弯，我才安然无恙。**
> 一只受伤的小鸟想要尽快回家，它拼命挥动翅膀，飞行速度非常 swift。突然，一阵强风袭来，它依然坚定地向前，以这种迅速的姿态，很快就回到了温暖的巢中。 **一只受伤的小鸟飞行速度非常迅速。突然，一阵强风袭来，它依然坚定地向前，很快就回到了巢中。**

> A little rabbit was running swiftly in the forest to escape from a hungry wolf. It moved so fast that it soon found a safe cave. The rabbit\'s swift movement saved its life. **一只小兔子在森林里飞快地跑着躲避一只饥饿的狼。它跑得如此之快，很快就找到了一个安全的洞穴。兔子的快速移动救了它的命。**
> A thirsty traveler was walking in the desert. When he found an oasis, he took a big SWIG of water. The cool water refreshed him immediately. **一位口渴的旅行者在沙漠中行走。当他发现一片绿洲时，他大口地喝了一口水。清凉的水立刻让他精神一振。**

> One hot summer day, Tom was very bored. So he decided to go to the river and swim. He jumped into the cool water and swam happily. Swimming made him feel so refreshed and energetic. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆感到很无聊。于是他决定去河边游泳。他跳进凉爽的水中，欢快地游着。游泳让他感到神清气爽、充满活力。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to cross a river. But he was afraid because he couldn\'t swim. Then a swimmer came and easily crossed the river. The boy was amazed and decided to learn swimming too. **有一天，一个小男孩想要过河。但他很害怕，因为他不会游泳。然后一个游泳者来了，轻松地过了河。小男孩很惊讶，并决定也要学游泳。**

> One hot summer day, Tom felt very bored. So he decided to go swimming in the cool river. He put on his swimming trunks and jumped into the water. He had a great time swimming and forgot all his troubles. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆感到非常无聊。于是他决定去凉爽的河里游泳。他穿上泳裤跳进水里。他游泳游得很开心，忘记了所有的烦恼。**

> One hot summer day, Tom went to the beach. Before going into the water, he put on his favorite swimsuit. It was blue and made him look very cool. With the swimsuit, he had a great time swimming in the sea. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆去了海滩。下水之前，他穿上了他最喜欢的泳衣。它是蓝色的，让他看起来非常酷。穿着这件泳衣，他在海里游得很开心。**

> A knight went on a quest, but drank from a poisoned well. The poison taint ed his strength and made him weak. Remember, taint means to spoil or contaminate something good. **一位骑士去探险，但喝了一口有毒的井水。毒药污染了他的力量，使他变得虚弱。记住，taint 意思是玷污或污染美好的事物。**

> One day, Tom needed to take a book from the library. He went there and carefully took the book he wanted. It was an important book for his study. **一天，汤姆需要从图书馆拿一本书。他去了那里，小心翼翼地拿走了他想要的书。这是一本对他学习很重要的书。**
> One day, I was taking a walk in the park. Suddenly, I saw a bird taking a bath in the pond. It was an interesting scene. **有一天，我正在公园里散步。突然，我看到一只鸟正在池塘里洗澡。这是一个有趣的场景。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl loved listening to her grandma tell tales. Every tale was like a magic journey. One day, she decided to share these tales with her friends. And that\'s how tales brought joy to everyone. **从前，有一个小女孩喜欢听她奶奶讲故事。每个故事都像一次神奇的旅行。有一天，她决定和朋友们分享这些故事。这就是故事给大家带来欢乐的方式。**

> A young girl named Lily had a special talent for playing the piano. Whenever she sat at the piano, her fingers danced beautifully on the keys. Her talent made her stand out and brought joy to everyone. **一个叫莉莉的年轻女孩有弹钢琴的特殊天赋。每当她坐在钢琴前，她的手指就在琴键上优美地舞动。她的天赋使她脱颖而出，给每个人都带来了欢乐。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a talk. They sat in the garden, sharing their thoughts and feelings. Tom talked about his new toy, and Jerry talked about his adventure. It was a nice and friendly talk. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞进行了一次谈话。他们坐在花园里，分享着各自的想法和感受。汤姆谈论了他的新玩具，杰瑞谈论了他的冒险经历。这是一次美好而友好的交谈。**

> One day, Tom met a very talkative parrot. The parrot kept chattering non-stop. Tom realized that \'talkative\' means someone who talks a lot, just like this parrot. **一天，汤姆遇到了一只非常健谈的鹦鹉。这只鹦鹉不停地叽叽喳喳。汤姆意识到'talkative'就是指像这只鹦鹉一样话很多的人。**

> One day, in a busy market, there was a talker. This person was constantly chatting and sharing stories with everyone. People were attracted by his lively words and expressions. > One day, I was in a park and saw two birds on a branch, constantly talking to each other. It seemed they were sharing secrets of the forest. The way they were talking was so lively and interesting. **有一天，我在公园看到两只鸟在树枝上，不停地相互交谈。它们似乎在分享森林的秘密。它们交谈的方式是如此生动有趣。**

> A pilot landed the plane smoothly on the tarmac. After the flight, a little girl asked her dad what \'tarmac\' was. Dad explained that it\'s the special surface where planes stop and move. > A long time ago, a man in a small town needed to send an urgent message to his friend in a faraway place. He used the telegraph, which sent electrical signals through wires, to communicate quickly. The telegraph saved the day! **很久以前，一个小镇上的男人需要给他在远方的朋友发送紧急消息。他使用了通过电线发送电信号的电报，从而快速地进行了交流。电报解决了问题！**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big city. He was very scared. Luckily, he found a TELEPHONE booth and called his parents. With the help of the TELEPHONE, he was reunited with his family. **有一天，一个小男孩在大城市里迷路了。他非常害怕。幸运的是，他找到了一个电话亭并给他的父母打了电话。在电话的帮助下，他和家人团聚了。**

> One day, a little boy was looking at the stars and wished he could see them closer. Then, he found a telescope and through it, he could view the distant stars clearly. The telescope made the faraway things seem near. **有一天，一个小男孩望着星星，希望能更近距离地看到它们。然后，他找到了一个望远镜，通过它，他能清晰地看到遥远的星星。望远镜让遥远的东西看起来很近。**

> One day, a little boy was playing with a telescope. He looked through it and saw things far away become clear and close. The telescope had a telescopic feature that made distant objects seem near. That\'s how he learned about \'telescopic\'. **有一天，一个小男孩在玩望远镜。他通过它看，远处的东西变得清晰又靠近。这个望远镜有伸缩的特性，能让远处的物体看起来很近。这就是他如何认识"telescopic（可伸缩的）"这个词的。**

> One day, Tom was very excited because he was going to be on TV. The process of broadcasting his appearance was called \'televise\'. It means to broadcast by television. So, whenever Tom thought of this experience, he remembered the word \'televise\'. **有一天，汤姆非常兴奋，因为他要上电视了。他上电视这个播出过程被称为'televise'。这个词意思是通过电视播放。所以，每当汤姆想到这次经历，他就记住了'televise'这个词。**

> A boy was very lonely at home. One day, a magic fairy appeared and gave him a \'television\'. With it, he could see many wonderful things and no longer felt alone. The television became his good friend. **一个男孩独自在家非常孤独。有一天，一个神奇的仙女出现并给了他一台"电视机"。有了它，他能看到许多精彩的事物，不再感到孤单。电视机成了他的好朋友。**

> One day, Tom found a lost puppy. He decided to tell the owner about it. He went to the nearby houses and finally found the worried owner. The owner was so happy and thanked Tom. Tom felt great for telling the truth. **有一天，汤姆发现了一只走丢的小狗。他决定把这件事告诉狗的主人。他去了附近的房子，最终找到了忧心忡忡的主人。主人非常高兴并感谢了汤姆。汤姆因为讲出了实情而感觉很棒。**

> A thief entered the bank. The teller was very brave and pressed the alarm button secretly. The police came quickly and caught the thief. The teller protected the money and everyone praised her. **一个小偷进入了银行。柜员非常勇敢，悄悄按下了警报按钮。警察很快赶来抓住了小偷。这位柜员保护了钱，大家都称赞她。**

> One day, Tom was lost in the forest. A kind bird kept telling him the right way out. With the bird\'s telling, Tom finally found his way home safely. **一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。一只善良的鸟不停地告诉他正确的出路。在鸟的告知下，汤姆最终安全地找到了回家的路。**

> A thief broke into a house. But a telltale footprint on the floor exposed him. The footprint was like a sign that told the story of his crime. It was a clear telltale sign. **一个小偷闯进了一所房子。但是地板上一个显眼的脚印暴露了他。这个脚印就像是讲述他罪行的标志。这是一个明显的泄密迹象。**

> Once there was a blacksmith named Tom. His job was to temper the steel to make it strong. But one day, he lost his temper when the fire went out. So, \'temper\' can mean to make something tough or to be in a bad mood. **从前有个叫汤姆的铁匠。他的工作是锤炼钢铁使其坚固。但有一天，火灭了，他发脾气了。所以，'temper'可以指使某物坚韧或发脾气。**

> Once there was a painter. His works showed a unique style, reflecting his special temperament. Whether it was the choice of colors or the way of strokes, it all revealed his inner character and mood. This is what \'temperament\' means - a person\'s nature and mood. **从前有一位画家。他的作品展现出独特的风格，反映了他特殊的气质。无论是色彩的选择还是笔触的方式，都透露着他的内在性格和情绪。这就是'temperament'的意思------人的性情和气质。**

> Once there was a musician who was very temperamental. One day, he got angry easily during a performance because of a small mistake. His mood swings showed his temperamental nature. Remember, temperamental means having an unstable or easily changing mood. **曾经有一位音乐家，他非常情绪化。有一天，在一场演出中因为一个小错误他就轻易地生气了。他的情绪波动展现了他喜怒无常的性格。记住，temperamental 意思是情绪不稳定或容易变化的。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange land. The weather was temperate, neither too hot nor too cold. It made the journey pleasant. The traveler remembered \'temperate\' as the perfect climate for a comfortable adventure. **一位旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。天气温和，既不太热也不太冷。这让旅程很愉快。旅行者记住'temperate'就是这种舒适冒险的完美气候。**

> One hot summer day, I was sweating a lot. I checked the thermometer and saw the high number, which was the temperature. It showed how hot it was and made me understand that temperature tells us how warm or cold it is. **在一个炎热的夏日，我汗流浃背。我查看了温度计，看到了那个高数字，那就是温度。它表明了天气有多热，让我明白了温度告诉我们天气是暖还是冷。**
> 想象一个建筑师，他总是拿着一块特别的板子，板子上有房屋的基本框架，这就是\'template\'。每次建房子，他都依照这个板子来，它就像一个标准模型，引导着整个建造过程。 **想象建筑师拿着的房屋基本框架板子代表'模板，样板'，以此辅助记忆单词\'template\'。**

> A tourist was lost in a strange city. When feeling tired, he found a temple. The peaceful and beautiful temple gave him a sense of calm. He decided to rest there for a while. **一位游客在一个陌生的城市迷路了。当感到疲惫时，他发现了一座寺庙。这座宁静而美丽的寺庙给了他一种平静的感觉。他决定在那里休息一会儿。**

> A musician was struggling to find the right tempo for a new song. After many tries, he finally got it when he thought about the pace of his heartbeat. The perfect tempo made the song a hit! **一位音乐家为一首新歌找不到合适的节奏而苦恼。经过多次尝试，当他想到自己的心跳节奏时，终于找到了。完美的节奏让这首歌大获成功！**

> A time traveler was lost in a strange world. He struggled to find his way back, realizing the importance of temporal order. Without it, he couldn\'t return home. \'Temporal\' here refers to relating to time. **一位时间旅行者在一个陌生的世界里迷路了。他努力寻找回去的路，意识到时间顺序的重要性。没有它，他就回不了家。这里的'temporal'指的是与时间有关的。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange town. Fortunately, he was temporarily helped by a kind local who showed him the way. \'Temporarily\' here means for a short time, like the traveler\'s brief assistance. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。幸运的是，他暂时得到了一位善良当地人的帮助，给他指了路。"Temporarily"在这里表示短时间，就像旅行者得到的短暂帮助。**
> 想象一个工人被临时（temporary）叫去帮忙修建一座桥。他知道这只是暂时的工作，完工后他就会回到原来的岗位。这个临时的任务让他有些紧张但也充满期待。 **想象一个工人被临时叫去帮忙修建一座桥的故事，来辅助记忆 temporary 这个单词，表示暂时的、临时的**

> A poor boy was very hungry. A rich man showed him a big cake to tempt him. But the boy resisted, knowing it was wrong to take without earning. Remember, \'tempt\' means to attract or persuade someone to do something, especially something wrong or unwise. **一个贫穷的男孩非常饥饿。一个富人给他展示了一个大蛋糕来诱惑他。但男孩抵制住了，知道不劳而获是不对的。记住，'tempt'意思是吸引或劝说某人做某事，尤指错误或不明智的事。**

> A poor boy was constantly facing the temptation of stealing food to satisfy his hunger. But his strong will helped him resist. Temptation means something that attracts you to do wrong or unwise things. **一个贫穷的男孩不断面临偷食物来充饥的诱惑。但他坚强的意志帮助他抵制住了。temptation 指吸引你去做错误或不明智之事的事物。**

> One day, I was walking on the street and saw a tempting cake in the window of a bakery. I really wanted to buy it, but I remembered my diet plan. The cake was so attractive that it was hard to resist the temptation. **一天，我走在街上，看到一家面包店橱窗里有一个诱人的蛋糕。我真的很想买，但想起了我的节食计划。那个蛋糕太吸引人了，让人很难抗拒这种诱惑。**

> There are ten little ducks. They are playing in the pond happily. But one of them gets lost. The other nine ducks look for it everywhere. Finally, they find it. They are all so excited. **有十只小鸭子。它们正在池塘里开心地玩耍。但是其中一只走丢了。其他九只鸭子到处找它。最后，它们找到了。它们都非常兴奋。**

> A little mouse was trying to get the cheese on a high shelf. It was very tenacious. It kept jumping and climbing, never giving up. Finally, it got the cheese. 一只小老鼠努力去够高架子上的奶酪。它非常顽强。它不停地跳和爬，从不放弃。最终，它得到了奶酪。 **一只小老鼠努力获取奶酪的故事来辅助记忆 tenacious 这个单词，意思是顽强的、坚持不懈的**

> A little ant showed tenacity. It kept trying to climb a big wall despite falling many times. It never gave up and finally reached the top. This shows what tenacity means - the quality of being very determined and not giving up easily. **一只小蚂蚁展现出了坚韧不拔的精神。它多次从大墙上掉落，但仍不断尝试攀爬。它从不放弃，最终到达了顶端。这体现了 tenacity 的含义------坚定不移、不轻易放弃的品质。**
> 想象一下，有个租客 tenant 叫 Tom，他租了一间漂亮的房子。每月按时交租，对房子也很爱护。房东很喜欢他，因为他是个守规矩的 tenant。 **想象一下，有个租客 tenant 叫 Tom，他租了一间漂亮的房子。每月按时交租，对房子也很爱护。房东很喜欢他，因为他是个守规矩的租客。**

> One day, I was in a beautiful garden. A gardener was tending the flowers carefully. He was always inclined to make the garden perfect. So, \'tend\' means to take care of or be inclined to. **有一天，我在一个美丽的花园里。一位园丁正在精心照料花朵。他总是倾向于把花园弄得完美。所以，'tend'意思是照料或倾向于。**

> Once upon a time, there was a scientist who observed a group of animals. He noticed a tendency for them to gather near the river at sunset. This regular behavior pattern was called a tendency. **从前，有一位科学家观察一群动物。他注意到它们有在日落时靠近河边的倾向。这种规律性的行为模式就被称为倾向。**

> A little girl was very tender. She carefully took care of a wounded bird, showing her gentle and kind heart. The bird felt safe in her tender care. **一个小女孩非常温柔。她小心翼翼地照顾一只受伤的鸟，展现出她温柔善良的心。这只鸟在她温柔的照料下感到安全。**

> A hungry chef was looking for the best part of the meat. He found the tenderloin, which was so tender and delicious. It was the most precious and sought-after cut. **一位饥饿的厨师正在寻找肉中最好的部分。他找到了里脊，它非常嫩且美味。这是最珍贵和受欢迎的切块。**

> A little girl hurt her knee. Her father tended to the wound tenderly, speaking soft words to comfort her. His gentle touch and caring gaze showed his tender love. **一个小女孩伤到了膝盖。她的父亲温柔地照料伤口，轻声说着安慰的话。他轻柔的抚摸和关切的目光显示出了他的温柔关爱。**

> A little girl hurt her knee. Her mother showed tenderness by gently cleaning the wound and giving her a warm hug. The mother\'s care and love were full of tenderness. **一个小女孩伤到了膝盖。她的妈妈表现出温柔，轻轻地清理伤口并给了她一个温暖的拥抱。妈妈的关心和爱充满了温柔。**
> 想象一下，大力士在拉绳子比赛中，他用力过猛，手臂上暴起的那根像绳子一样的东西就是\'tendon\'（肌腱），它连接着肌肉和骨头，帮助大力士发挥强大的力量。 **想象大力士比赛中手臂上暴起的像绳子的肌腱，帮助理解\'tendon\'（肌腱）这个单词**

> A little monkey was climbing in the forest. It grabbed the tendril of a vine to swing from tree to tree. The tendril was thin but strong, helping the monkey move freely. **一只小猴子在森林里攀爬。它抓住一根藤蔓的卷须从一棵树荡到另一棵树。卷须又细又结实，帮助猴子自由移动。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的城镇里，有一排破旧的房子，人们称之为 tenement。这些房子又小又挤，住着许多贫困的家庭。一位画家路过，被这独特的景象吸引，把它们画了下来，取名为'Tenement 之景'。 **想象在古老城镇中，有一排被称为 tenement 的破旧拥挤、住着贫困家庭的房子，一位画家为其作画并取名。**

> A young philosopher was seeking the truth. One day, he discovered a hidden book that revealed the \'tenet\' of life: always be kind and helpful. This simple rule became his guiding principle. **一位年轻的哲学家一直在探寻真理。有一天，他发现了一本隐藏的书，书中揭示了生活的'信条'：永远善良且乐于助人。这个简单的规则成了他的指导原则。**

> One sunny day, Tom and his friends decided to play a game. They chose tennis. They hit the ball back and forth on the court, having a great time. Tennis made them happy and active. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，汤姆和他的朋友们决定玩个游戏。他们选择了网球。他们在球场上把球打来打去，玩得很开心。网球让他们快乐又充满活力。**
> A tenor singer was invited to a big party. He had a beautiful voice. Everyone was charmed by his tenor. It was a wonderful night. **一位男高音歌手被邀请参加一个大型聚会。他有着美妙的嗓音。每个人都被他的男高音所吸引。那是一个美妙的夜晚。**

> A thief was tense when stealing. He was afraid of being caught. Every muscle was tense. But in the end, he was still caught. \'Tense\' means nervous and not relaxed. **一个小偷在行窃时很紧张。他害怕被抓住。每一块肌肉都紧绷着。但最后，他还是被抓住了。\'tense\'意思是紧张的，不放松的。**

> A tightrope walker was performing high above. The rope was under great tension. Everyone held their breath, fearing it might snap. The tension in the air was palpable as we watched, waiting for the thrilling end. **一位走钢丝的人在高空表演。钢丝承受着巨大的拉力。每个人都屏住呼吸，担心它会断裂。当我们观看时，空气中的紧张气氛是显而易见的，等待着激动人心的结局。**

> A traveler was lost in the forest. Luckily, he found a tent and spent the night safely. The tent protected him from the wild animals and the cold. Remember, tent is a place for safety and rest. **一位旅行者在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一顶帐篷，并在里面安全地度过了一晚。帐篷保护他免受野生动物和寒冷的侵袭。记住，tent 就是这样一个提供安全和休息的地方。**

> A brave diver was exploring the deep sea. Suddenly, a huge octopus appeared and its long tentacles reached out to catch the diver. But the diver was smart and swam away quickly. **一位勇敢的潜水员正在深海探索。突然，一只巨大的章鱼出现了，它长长的触手伸出来想要抓住潜水员。但潜水员很聪明，迅速游走了。**

> A young scientist made a tentative plan to explore a mysterious cave. He was unsure if it would work, but was willing to take the first step. The word \'tentative\' here shows his cautious and experimental approach. **一位年轻的科学家制定了一个初步的计划去探索一个神秘的洞穴。他不确定这个计划是否可行，但愿意迈出第一步。这里'tentative'这个词体现了他谨慎和尝试性的做法。**

> A scientist was working on a new experiment. He tentatively proposed a hypothesis and started to test it. He was cautious and not fully sure, but was willing to explore. This showed his tentatively approach to the unknown. **一位科学家正在进行一项新实验。他暂时提出了一个假设并开始测试。他很谨慎，不是完全确定，但愿意去探索。这显示了他对未知事物的试探性态度。**

> One day, a little rabbit was running in a race. It was very determined to reach the finish line. Finally, it crossed and found out it came in tenth place. It was still happy as it did its best. **一天，一只小兔子在赛跑。它下定决心冲向终点。最后，它冲过终点线，发现自己排在第十名。但它依然很开心，因为它已经尽力了。**

> A man was trying to hold a very thin and fragile thread. It was so tenuous that it seemed it could break at any moment. He struggled to keep it intact, showing how weak and insubstantial the thread was. **一个男人试图握住一根非常细且脆弱的线。它是如此的纤细，似乎随时都会断掉。他努力保持它不断，展现出这根线是多么的薄弱和不坚固。**

> A young professor worked hard for years to gain tenure at the university. Finally, his excellent research and teaching made it happen. Tenure meant job security and the freedom to pursue his academic passions. **一位年轻的教授多年努力工作，以求在大学里获得终身教职。最终，他出色的研究和教学成果使他成功了。终身教职意味着工作保障和追求学术热情的自由。**

> One hot summer day, Tom went swimming. But the water in the pool was not cold or hot, just tepid. It made him feel a bit disappointed. He expected a refreshing or warm bath, not this lukewarm experience. **在一个炎热的夏日，汤姆去游泳。但泳池里的水不冷也不热，只是温热的。这让他感到有点失望。他期待的是清凉或温暖的水，而不是这种不冷不热的体验。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in the desert. When he was about to give up, he found an old hut with a bottle of tequila. Drinking it gave him the strength to continue and finally find his way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在沙漠中迷路了。当他即将放弃时，他发现了一个旧茅屋，里面有一瓶龙舌兰酒。喝了它让他有了继续前进的力量，最终找到了出路。**
> 在学校的期末考试（term exam）中，小明努力学习，因为他知道这一学期（term）的表现就看这次了。最终他取得了好成绩，明白了每个学期都是成长的重要阶段（term）。 **在学校的期末考试中，小明努力学习，因为他知道这一学期的表现就看这次了。最终他取得了好成绩，明白了每个学期都是成长的重要阶段。**
> 想象一下，你在一个巨大的机场，寻找着登机口。终于，你来到了尽头的那个登机口，它就是terminal。这个登机口标志着你旅程的起点或终点，就像terminal这个单词，有终点、终端的意思。 **想象在机场尽头的登机口，代表着单词terminal（终点、终端）的含义**

> A terminally ill patient was given the best care and love. Despite the terminal stage of the disease, he remained positive. \'Terminally\' here means at the end stage or fatally. **一位身患绝症的病人得到了最好的照顾和关爱。尽管处于疾病的末期，他仍然保持乐观。'terminally'在这里表示处于末期或致命地。**
> 想象一个机器人的任务被设定了一个终点。当它到达那个终点时，它的程序就会发出\'terminate\'的指令，意味着它的工作结束了。就像比赛有终点线，到达就终止，这就是\'terminate\'。 **想象一个机器人的任务有终点，到达终点时程序发出终止指令，就像比赛有终点线，到达就终止，这就是"terminate"（终止；结束）的意思。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to stop the termination of a magical forest. But the evil wizard planned to end it. The knight fought hard and finally saved the forest from this termination. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项任务，阻止一片神奇森林的终止。但邪恶的巫师计划终结它。骑士奋力战斗，最终使森林免遭这种终止。**

> A scientist was always confused by various terms in his research. One day, he decided to organize and classify them, and called this collection \'terminology\'. Now he could understand and explain his work clearly. **一位科学家在研究中总是被各种术语搞得晕头转向。有一天，他决定把它们整理分类，并把这个集合称为'术语'。现在他能够清晰地理解和解释他的工作了。**

> A king was very angry because termites damaged his beautiful palace. He ordered his soldiers to find a way to get rid of them. Finally, they found a special powder to kill all the termites. **一位国王非常生气，因为白蚁损坏了他美丽的宫殿。他命令士兵们想办法除掉它们。最后，他们找到了一种特殊的粉末来消灭所有的白蚁。**

> A tern was flying over the vast sea. It was looking for a place to rest. Suddenly, it saw a small island and landed there happily. The tern finally found its peaceful spot. **一只燕鸥在广阔的海面上飞翔。它正在寻找一个休息的地方。突然，它看到了一个小岛，高兴地降落了。这只燕鸥终于找到了它宁静的栖息之地。**

> A young artist loved to paint on the terrace of his house. Every day, he would stand there, enjoying the view and creating beautiful art. The terrace became his special place of inspiration. **一位年轻的艺术家喜欢在他家的露台上作画。每天，他都会站在那里，欣赏风景并创作美丽的艺术。露台成了他特别的灵感之地。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange terrain. There were mountains, valleys and thick forests. But with his map and compass, he finally understood the layout of this difficult terrain and found his way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片陌生的地形中迷路了。那里有山脉、山谷和茂密的森林。但凭借他的地图和指南针，他最终弄明白了这片艰难地形的布局并找到了出路。**

> Imagine a brave astronaut landing on a strange planet. He looks around and realizes it\'s a terrestrial planet, with solid ground and mountains. He says, \'This terrestrial place is so different from space!\' **想象一位勇敢的宇航员降落在一个陌生的星球上。他环顾四周，意识到这是一个类地行星，有坚实的地面和山脉。他说：'这个陆地般的地方和太空太不一样了！'**

> One day, I was walking in a dark forest. Suddenly, a terrible storm came. The wind was howling and the rain was pouring. I was so scared and felt it was the most terrifying moment ever. **有一天，我正在一片黑暗的森林里散步。突然，一场可怕的暴风雨来临了。狂风呼啸，大雨倾盆。我非常害怕，觉得这是有史以来最可怕的时刻。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a dark forest. He was terribly scared. He shouted for help loudly but no one came. Finally, he found his way out and never forgot that terrifying experience. **有一天，一个小男孩在黑暗的森林里迷路了。他非常害怕。他大声呼救但没人来。最后，他找到了出路，永远忘不了那次可怕的经历。**

> Once upon a time, there was a brave little terrier. It was always energetic and not afraid of any difficulties. It protected its home and owner with great loyalty. This little terrier became a hero in the neighborhood. **从前，有一只勇敢的小梗犬。它总是精力充沛，不怕任何困难。它非常忠诚地保护着它的家和主人。这只小梗犬成了邻里的英雄。**

> One day, I went on a terrific adventure. I saw a beautiful rainbow and climbed a tall mountain. The view was so amazing that I shouted, \'This is terrific!\' **有一天，我进行了一次很棒的冒险。我看到了美丽的彩虹，还爬上了一座高山。景色如此迷人，以至于我大喊：'这太棒了！'**

> One night, I was walking alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, a strange sound came from behind me. I was terrified and my heart was pounding. I ran as fast as I could until I reached a safe place. **一天晚上，我独自走在一片黑暗的森林里。突然，身后传来一阵奇怪的声音。我被吓坏了，心砰砰直跳。我拼命跑，直到到达一个安全的地方。**

> One dark night, a huge monster suddenly appeared and its terrifying appearance made everyone scream. Its sharp teeth and glowing eyes were so scary that it was the embodiment of \'terrify\'. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一只巨大的怪物突然出现，它可怕的外表让每个人都尖叫起来。它锋利的牙齿和发光的眼睛非常吓人，这就是'terrify（使恐怖；使惊吓）'的体现。**

> One night, I was walking alone in a dark forest. Suddenly, a terrifying monster appeared. Its sharp teeth and scary eyes made me tremble with fear. I ran as fast as I could. The experience was truly terrifying. **一天晚上，我独自走在黑暗的森林里。突然，一只可怕的怪物出现了。它锋利的牙齿和吓人的眼睛让我害怕得发抖。我尽可能快地跑开了。这次经历真的太可怕了。**

> A brave lion guards its territorial. It roars loudly to warn others not to enter. This territory is where it hunts and protects its family. The lion is very territorial and won\'t let any intruders in. **一只勇敢的狮子守护着它的领地。它大声吼叫以警告别人不要进入。这片领地是它捕猎和保护家人的地方。这只狮子非常有领地意识，不会让任何入侵者进入。**

> A brave explorer named Tom was on a journey. One day, he entered a new land. This land was unknown and had no owner. Tom claimed it as his territory. He built a house and started a new life there. **一位名叫汤姆的勇敢探险家正在旅行。有一天，他进入了一片新的土地。这片土地无人知晓且没有主人。汤姆将其宣称为自己的领地。他在那里建了房子，开始了新生活。**

> One dark night, a little boy was alone in a forest. Suddenly, a strange shadow appeared. It made scary noises, filling the boy with terror. He couldn\'t move or scream. Later, he found it was just a prank by his friends. **在一个漆黑的夜晚，一个小男孩独自在森林里。突然，一个奇怪的影子出现了。它发出可怕的声音，让小男孩充满了恐惧。他动弹不得，也叫不出声。后来，他发现这只是朋友们的恶作剧。**

> A group of bad guys planned to cause chaos and fear in the city through bombings and shootings. Their evil actions, known as terrorism, brought great harm and panic to people\'s lives. **一群坏人计划通过爆炸和枪击在城市制造混乱和恐惧。他们的这种邪恶行为，被称为恐怖主义，给人们的生活带来了极大的危害和恐慌。**

> A terrorist was lurking in the dark corner of the city. He planned to cause chaos and fear. But the brave police caught him before he could act. Remember, a terrorist is someone who brings terror and danger. **一个恐怖分子潜伏在城市的黑暗角落里。他计划制造混乱和恐惧。但勇敢的警察在他行动之前抓住了他。记住，恐怖分子就是带来恐怖和危险的人。**

> A gang of villains terrorized the small town. They broke into houses at night, making people scream in terror. But finally, the brave police caught them and ended the terrorizing. **一群恶棍恐吓着这个小镇。他们在晚上闯入民宅，让人们惊恐尖叫。但最终，勇敢的警察抓住了他们，结束了这场恐吓。**

> A boss was always terse when giving instructions. One day, an employee misunderstood and made a mistake. The boss said sharply, \'Be clear and terse to avoid confusion!\' It means being brief and to the point. **一位老板在下达指示时总是很简洁。有一天，一名员工误解并犯了错。老板严厉地说：\'要清晰、简洁，避免混淆！\' 这个词意思是简短扼要的。**

> A student was confused about his future. He didn\'t know if he should go for primary or secondary education. Then a wise teacher told him about the tertiary education, which opened his mind to new possibilities like college and university. **一名学生对自己的未来感到困惑。他不知道该选择初等教育还是中等教育。然后一位睿智的老师给他讲了高等教育，这让他看到了像大学这样的新可能。**

> A student was very nervous before the test. He studied hard but still worried. When he got the test paper, he took a deep breath and started. Finally, he did well because of his preparation. **一名学生在考试前非常紧张。他努力学习但仍很担心。当他拿到试卷时，深吸一口气然后开始答题。最终，由于他的准备充分，考得很好。**

> A long time ago, a king wrote a very important letter. This letter was like a promise and a proof of his love for his people. We call this letter a \'testament\'. It was a record of his words and intentions. **很久以前，一位国王写了一封非常重要的信。这封信就像是一个承诺，也是他对人民爱的证明。我们把这封信称为'遗嘱'。它是他话语和意图的记录。**

> One day, a mysterious box arrived. Everyone was curious. A brave person stepped forward and said, \'I\'ll be the tester.\' He opened the box carefully and discovered wonderful gifts inside. The tester made everyone happy. **有一天，一个神秘的盒子到了。大家都很好奇。一个勇敢的人站出来说：'我来当测试员。'他小心地打开盒子，发现里面有很棒的礼物。这个测试员让大家都很开心。**

> A man was very worried about his testicles. He went to the doctor and asked for a test. The doctor assured him that his testicles were fine. Remember, testicle means one of the two male reproductive glands. **一个男人非常担心他的睾丸。他去看医生并要求检查。医生向他保证他的睾丸没问题。记住，testicle 意思是两个男性生殖腺中的一个。**

> A brave witness was in court. The judge asked if he could testify. The witness took a deep breath and said truthfully what he saw. His words were powerful and helped find justice. Remember, to testify is to give evidence in court. **一位勇敢的证人在法庭上。法官问他是否能够作证。证人深吸一口气，如实说出他所看到的。他的话很有力量，帮助找到了正义。记住，testify 就是在法庭上提供证据。**

> A famous scientist received a testimonial from his students. They praised his amazing discoveries and thanked him for his guidance. The scientist was very touched by this testimonial of appreciation. **一位著名的科学家收到了他学生的一份证明书。他们称赞他惊人的发现，并感谢他的指导。这位科学家被这份表示赞赏的证明书深深打动了。**

> A brave detective was on a difficult case. The only key to solve it was the testimony of a witness. The witness was scared but finally spoke the truth. That testimony helped the detective catch the criminal. **一位勇敢的侦探在处理一个棘手的案件。解决它的唯一关键是一位证人的证词。证人很害怕，但最终说出了真相。那份证词帮助侦探抓住了罪犯。**

> A scientist was constantly doing testing in the lab. One day, during a crucial testing of a new medicine, he finally got the expected result. This testing changed everything. **一位科学家一直在实验室里不断进行测试。有一天，在对一种新药的关键测试中，他终于得到了预期的结果。这次测试改变了一切。**

> A strong athlete was always full of energy. The secret? It was the testosterone in his body, making him powerful and competitive. Testosterone is like a magic fuel that gives him the edge in sports. **一位强壮的运动员总是精力充沛。秘诀是什么？是他体内的睾酮。睾酮就像神奇的燃料，让他在体育运动中更具优势。**

> A brave astronaut was on a spacewalk. Suddenly, his safety line, or tether, got tangled. But luckily, he managed to untangle it and return safely. The tether saved his life! **一位勇敢的宇航员正在进行太空行走。突然，他的安全绳，也就是'tether'，缠在了一起。但幸运的是，他设法解开并安全返回。这根'tether'救了他的命！**

> One day, a student was struggling to understand a complex book. The teacher said, \'Read the text carefully, and you\'ll find the answers.\' The student did as told and finally understood. Here, \'text\' means the written words in a book or document. **一天，一个学生正在努力理解一本复杂的书。老师说：'仔细阅读文本，你会找到答案。'学生照做，最终理解了。这里，'text'指的是书或文件中的书面文字。**

> One day, Tom was looking for a useful book. He found a thick one filled with texts and exercises. It was a textbook that helped him learn a lot. With it, Tom improved his knowledge greatly. **有一天，汤姆在找一本有用的书。他发现了一本厚厚的，充满了文字和练习的书。这是一本教科书，帮助他学到了很多。有了它，汤姆极大地提高了他的知识。**

> A little mouse was lost in a big textile factory. It ran around among the colorful fabrics and threads. Finally, it found its way out and learned that \'textile\' means materials and products made of fabrics and threads. **一只小老鼠在一个大的纺织厂里迷路了。它在五颜六色的布料和丝线之间跑来跑去。最后，它找到了出路，并知道了\'textile\'意思是由布料和丝线制成的材料和产品。**

> Once upon a time, a student was confused by a textual exam. But with careful reading and analysis of the textual questions, he finally understood and passed. Textual means related to written or printed matter. **从前，有个学生对一场文字考试感到困惑。但通过仔细阅读和分析文字问题，他最终明白了并通过了考试。Textual 意思是与书面或印刷材料有关的。**

> A brave explorer was in a cave. He touched the wall and felt a strange texture. It was rough and bumpy. He realized this texture could help him find the way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个洞穴里。他触摸墙壁，感觉到一种奇怪的质地。它粗糙且凹凸不平。他意识到这种质地可以帮助他找到出路。**

> One day, I was painting a picture. I wanted to show the textured surface of a fruit. So, I carefully chose different brushstrokes to create that special effect. Finally, the textured fruit looked so real! **有一天，我在画画。我想展现一个水果的纹理表面。所以，我仔细地选择不同的笔触来创造那种特殊效果。最后，有纹理的水果看起来如此逼真！**

> There was a race between Tom and Jerry. Tom ran faster than Jerry. Jerry was sad but learned that \'than\' shows a comparison. It tells us who or what is more or less in a certain way. **有一场汤姆和杰瑞之间的赛跑。汤姆跑得比杰瑞快。杰瑞很伤心，但明白了'than'表示比较。它告诉我们在某种程度上谁或什么更多或更少。**

> One day, when I was lost in a strange city, a kind man showed me the way. I was so grateful and said \'Thank you\' to him. His smile made me understand that a simple thank can bring warmth. **有一天，当我在一个陌生的城市迷路时，一位善良的男士给我指了路。我非常感激，并对他说'谢谢你'。他的微笑让我明白，一句简单的谢谢能带来温暖。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a forest. Luckily, a kind man helped him find his way out. Tom was so thankful that he gave the man a big hug. He realized being thankful makes the world a better place. **一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，一个善良的人帮他找到了出路。汤姆非常感激，给了那个人一个大大的拥抱。他意识到心怀感激会让世界变得更美好。**

> One day, I lost my wallet. Thankfully, a kind person found it and returned it to me. I was so grateful. \'Thankfully\' means expressing gratitude or relief. **有一天，我丢了钱包。谢天谢地，一个好心人捡到并归还给了我。我非常感激。'thankfully'意思是表达感激或欣慰。**

> One day, when I was lost in a strange city, a kind person showed me the way. I said \'thanks\' to express my gratitude. It\'s a simple word that carries our appreciation when someone helps us. **有一天，当我在一个陌生的城市迷路时，一位好心人给我指了路。我说了'thanks'来表达我的感激之情。这是一个当有人帮助我们时，用来承载我们感谢之意的简单单词。**
> 想象一下，你在黑暗中迷路了，非常害怕。突然，你看到远处有一束光，你指着那束光说 \'That is my hope!\' 意思就是'那是我的希望！' 这里的 that 就用来指代远处的那束光。 **想象一下，你在黑暗中迷路，非常害怕。突然，你看到远处有一束光，你指着那束光说'那是我的希望！' 这里的 that 就用来指代远处的那束光。**
> 在寒冷的冬天，小河被冰封了。春天来了，天气渐渐变暖，太阳公公使劲地照射着。终于，冰开始融化，这就是 thaw 的过程，小河又能欢快地流淌啦。 **在寒冷的冬天，小河被冰封。春天天气变暖，太阳照射使冰融化的过程，就是'thaw'，意思是解冻、融化。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical land, there was a special key called \'the\'. This key could open any door and reveal the most precious things. It was like a magic word that pointed to specific and important things. **从前，在一个神奇的地方，有一把特殊的钥匙叫'the'。这把钥匙可以打开任何一扇门，并揭示出最珍贵的东西。它就像是一个神奇的词，指向特定且重要的事物。**

> One day, I was lost in a big city. Suddenly, I saw a sign that said \'theater\'. I followed it and found a wonderful place full of music and drama. It was a magical experience. **有一天，我在一个大城市里迷路了。突然，我看到一个写着'剧院'的标志。我跟着它，发现了一个充满音乐和戏剧的美妙地方。这是一次神奇的经历。**

> A young actor was very theatrical. He always exaggerated his expressions and movements on the stage. But his theatrical performance finally won him the lead role. **一个年轻的演员非常戏剧化。他在舞台上总是夸张他的表情和动作。但他戏剧化的表演最终为他赢得了主角。**
> 在一个古老的小镇，一位诗人对着心爱的姑娘深情吟唱：\'Thee, my dear, are the light of my life.\' 意思就是'你，亲爱的，是我生命中的光。'这里的thee就是'你'的意思，是一种比较古老或诗意的表达。 **在一个古老的小镇，一位诗人对着心爱的姑娘表达，这里的thee就是'你'的意思，是一种古老或诗意的表达。**

> One night, a thief sneaked into a house. He quietly opened the drawer, took away valuable jewels. But the owner heard a noise and called the police. The thief was caught and punished for his theft. **一天晚上，一个小偷潜入一所房子。他悄悄地打开抽屉，拿走了贵重的珠宝。但主人听到了响声并报了警。小偷因盗窃被抓住并受到了惩罚。**

> There was a big party. Three friends came and brought gifts. But we didn\'t know whose gifts they were. Then someone shouted, \'They are their gifts!\' Now you remember \'their\' means belonging to them. **有一个盛大的派对。三个朋友来了并带来了礼物。但我们不知道这些礼物是谁的。然后有人喊道：'它们是他们的礼物！'现在你记住'their'意思是属于他们的。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry found a box of treasures. Tom said it was his, but Jerry insisted it was hers. Then they realized it belonged to neither of them. It was theirs - shared by both of them. **一天，汤姆和杰瑞发现了一箱宝藏。汤姆说这是他的，但杰瑞坚称是她的。然后他们意识到这既不属于汤姆也不属于杰瑞。这是他们的 - 由他们俩共同拥有。**

> One day, Tom was looking for his toys. He found them under the bed. He was very happy. The toys were not lost. \'Them\' refers to the toys in this story. **有一天，汤姆在找他的玩具。他在床底下找到了它们。他非常高兴。玩具没有丢。在这个故事中，'them'指的就是那些玩具。**
> 想象一个探险家在神秘的森林中寻找宝藏，他的地图上有各种主题标记，如河流、山峰等。这些主题标记（thematic marks）帮助他规划路线，最终找到了宝藏。所以\'thematic\'就是与主题相关的意思。 **想象一位探险家在森林中依靠主题标记寻找宝藏来理解\'thematic\'意为与主题相关的**

> Imagine a big party. Everyone is dressed in the same color and style. That common color and style are the \'theme\' of the party. It ties everything together and makes the party special. **想象一个盛大的派对。每个人都穿着相同的颜色和款式。那种共同的颜色和款式就是派对的"主题"。它将一切联系在一起，使派对变得特别。**

> A group of friends went hiking. They got lost but managed to find their way back by themselves. It means they did it without any help from others. **一群朋友去远足。他们迷路了，但靠他们自己找到了回来的路。这意味着他们在没有其他人帮助的情况下做到了。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. I didn\'t know where to go. Then, a kind policeman showed up and helped me find my way. \'Then\' here means at that time or next. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。我不知道该往哪儿走。然后，一位善良的警察出现了，帮我找到了路。这里的\'then\'意思是在那时或接下来。**

> A young man was lost in thought about the meaning of life and the existence of God. He read countless books and debated with many. Eventually, he became a renowned theologian, seeking answers to profound spiritual questions. **一个年轻人陷入了对生命意义和上帝存在的思考。他读了无数的书，并与许多人辩论。最终，他成为了一位著名的神学家，寻求深刻的精神问题的答案。**

> A young student was lost in a big library. He found a mysterious book labeled \'Theological Secrets\'. Opening it, he discovered a world of deep religious and spiritual thoughts. From then on, he understood the meaning of \'theological\'. **一个年轻的学生在一个大图书馆里迷路了。他发现了一本标有'神学秘密'的神秘书籍。打开它，他发现了一个充满深刻宗教和精神思想的世界。从那时起，他明白了'神学的'这个词的意思。**

> A young priest was studying hard to understand religious doctrines theologically. He spent days and nights reading sacred texts, trying to grasp the profound meaning. Finally, he became an expert in this field. **一位年轻的牧师努力从神学角度去理解宗教教义。他日夜研读宗教经典，试图领会其深奥的含义。最终，他成为了这个领域的专家。**

> Once upon a time, a wise man spent all his time studying the nature of God and religious beliefs. This study was called \'theology\'. It\'s like a key to understanding the mysteries of faith. **从前，有一位智者把所有时间都用于研究上帝的本质和宗教信仰。这种研究被称为"神学"。它就像是理解信仰奥秘的一把钥匙。**

> A brilliant scientist was constantly working in his lab. One day, he discovered a new THEOREM that would change the world. It was like finding a hidden key to unlock many mysteries. **一位杰出的科学家一直在他的实验室工作。有一天，他发现了一个新的定理，这个定理将会改变世界。这就像找到了一把隐藏的钥匙来解开许多谜团。**

> A young scientist was always lost in theoretical books. One day, he had a dream where ideas flew around like birds. When he woke up, he understood that theoretical knowledge needed to be combined with practice to create real change. **一位年轻的科学家总是沉浸在理论书籍中。有一天，他做了个梦，梦里想法像鸟儿一样飞来飞去。当他醒来，他明白了理论知识需要与实践相结合才能带来真正的改变。**

> A scientist was always discussing ideas theoretically. One day, he decided to turn his theoretical thoughts into practical experiments and made amazing discoveries.
