> A king was worried about giving undue power to a new general. He thought it might cause chaos. But in the end, he made a wise decision and avoided the undue risk. **一位国王担心赋予新将军过多的权力。他认为这可能会导致混乱。但最终，他做出了明智的决定，避免了这种不当的风险。**

> A student was unduly worried about a test. He studied hard but thought the difficulty was too high. Later, he found it wasn\'t that bad. Remember, unduly means excessively or unjustifiably. **一个学生过分地担心一场考试。他努力学习但觉得难度太高。后来，他发现没那么糟。记住，unduly 意思是过度地或不恰当地。**

> A brave archaeologist spent years searching. Finally, he managed to unearth an ancient treasure chest hidden deep underground. It was like uncovering a long-lost secret. **一位勇敢的考古学家花费数年寻找。最终，他成功挖掘出深埋地下的一个古老的宝箱。这就像是揭开了一个被遗忘已久的秘密。**

> A little mouse was lost in a big maze. It felt uneasiness as it couldn\'t find the way out. Every step was filled with fear and uncertainty. The mouse\'s heart kept beating fast, showing its uneasiness. **一只小老鼠在一个大迷宫里迷路了。它感到不安，因为找不到出去的路。每一步都充满了恐惧和不确定。老鼠的心跳得很快，显示出它的不安。**
> A man was walking in a dark forest alone at night. He felt uneasy as he heard strange noises around him. He didn\'t know what might happen next. **一个男人在夜晚独自走在黑暗的森林里。他听到周围奇怪的声音，感到不安。他不知道接下来会发生什么。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who had no chance to go to school and was uneducated. But he was very eager to learn. Finally, through his own efforts, he gained knowledge and changed his life. **从前，有一个人没有机会上学，没有受过教育。但他非常渴望学习。最终，通过自己的努力，他获得了知识并改变了自己的生活。**

> A man named Tom was unemployed. He sent resumes everywhere but got no replies. One day, he decided to learn new skills to increase his chances. Finally, he found a great job. > Once upon a time, in a small town, many people were facing unemployment. They had no jobs and struggled to make ends meet. But with effort and new opportunities, some finally found work and escaped the trap of unemployment. **从前，在一个小镇上，很多人面临着失业。他们没有工作，难以维持生计。但通过努力和新的机会，一些人最终找到了工作，摆脱了失业的困境。**

> A brave knight embarked on a journey. He faced countless challenges but never gave up. His quest seemed unending. Just like this knight\'s adventure, unending means having no end, going on and on forever. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了旅程。他面临无数挑战但从未放弃。他的探索似乎永无止境。就像这位骑士的冒险一样，unending 意思是没有尽头，永远持续下去。**

> In a distant kingdom, there were two paths. One was smooth and wide, the other was narrow and full of obstacles. These paths were unequal, showing a clear difference in quality and ease of travel. **在一个遥远的王国里，有两条路。一条平坦宽阔，另一条狭窄且布满障碍。这两条路是不平等的，在质量和通行的便利性上有明显的差异。**

> A detective was looking for unequivocal evidence to solve a mysterious case. Every clue was confusing until he found a key piece that was clear and definite, just like the meaning of \'unequivocal\'. **一位侦探正在寻找明确无误的证据来解决一起神秘案件。每条线索都令人困惑，直到他找到了关键的、清晰明确的那一条，就像\'unequivocal\'这个词的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a road. It was uneven. Some parts were high, and some were low. People had a hard time walking on it. So, \'uneven\' means not smooth or level. **从前，有一条路。它是不平坦的。有些地方高，有些地方低。人们走在上面很艰难。所以，'uneven'意思是不平坦的、不平整的。**
> A group of friends were walking on a road. The surface was unevenly paved. Some steps were high, some were low. It made their walk quite challenging. **一群朋友走在路上。路面铺设得高低不平。有的地方高，有的地方低。这让他们的行走颇具挑战。**

> One day, I was walking in the park. Suddenly, it started raining heavily, which was unexpected. I had no umbrella and got completely wet. This unexpected rain made my day quite chaotic. **有一天，我正在公园里散步。突然，下起了大雨，这完全出乎意料。我没带伞，全身都湿透了。这场意想不到的雨让我的这一天变得十分混乱。**
> One day, I was walking in the park. Unexpectedly, a bird landed on my shoulder. I was so surprised because I never thought this would happen. **有一天，我正在公园里散步。出乎意料地，一只鸟落在了我的肩膀上。我非常惊讶，因为我从未想过会发生这种事。**

> In a race, Tom ran very fast but was wrongly judged as the loser. This was so unfair. He deserved the victory but was treated unjustly. Poor Tom! **在一场比赛中，汤姆跑得很快但却被错误地判定为输家。这太不公平了。他理应获胜却受到了不公正的对待。可怜的汤姆！**

> A man was always late for dates and didn\'t keep his promises to his girlfriend. She realized he was unfaithful when she saw him with another woman. Unfaithful means not loyal or trustworthy. **一个男人约会总是迟到，也不遵守对女友的承诺。当她看到他和另一个女人在一起时，她意识到他不忠。unfaithful 意思是不忠诚的、不可信赖的。**

> One day, I found myself in an unfamiliar city. I didn\'t know the roads or the people. It felt strange and a bit scary. But I decided to explore and get familiar with it. **有一天，我发现自己身处一个陌生的城市。我不知道道路也不认识这里的人。感觉很奇怪还有点害怕。但我决定去探索并熟悉它。**

> A brave diver explored a deep cave. The depth and mystery inside were unfathomable. No matter how hard he tried to understand, the secrets remained hidden. > A young athlete was very sad because the weather on the competition day was unfavorable. It was rainy and windy, making it hard for him to perform well. But he didn\'t give up. Unfavorable means not good or not helpful. **一位年轻的运动员非常伤心，因为比赛当天的天气不利。又下雨又刮风，这让他很难发挥出色。但他没有放弃。unfavorable 意思是不好的，不利的。**

> A bird was trapped in a cage, feeling very sad. One day, the cage was opened and it became unfettered. It flew freely in the sky, enjoying the boundless freedom. > A little rabbit was making a beautiful house. But it was not completed before nightfall. So the house remained unfinished. The poor rabbit had to sleep outside. **一只小兔子正在建造一座漂亮的房子。但在夜幕降临前还没有完工。所以房子仍然未完成。可怜的兔子不得不睡在外面。**

> A man always ate junk food and never exercised. As a result, he became unfit and couldn\'t run fast or do heavy work. His doctor said he needed to change his lifestyle. **一个男人总是吃垃圾食品且从不锻炼。结果，他变得不健康，跑不快也做不了重活。他的医生说他需要改变生活方式。**

> A little bird was trapped in a box. When the box was opened, its wings unfolded and it flew freely to the sky. Unfold means to open or spread out something that was folded or closed. **一只小鸟被困在盒子里。当盒子被打开时，它的翅膀展开了，它自由地飞向天空。unfold 意思是打开或展开原本折叠或关闭的东西。**

> A man made a small mistake at work and expected understanding. But his boss was unforgiving and fired him immediately. This shows that \'unforgiving\' means not willing to excuse or pardon. **一个男人在工作中犯了一个小错误，并期望得到理解。但他的老板毫不宽容，立即解雇了他。这表明\'unforgiving\'意思是不愿意原谅或宽恕。**

> A man was going to have an important job interview. But unfortunately, he got lost on the way and missed the chance. This made him very sad and frustrated. **一个男人正要去参加一个重要的工作面试。但不幸的是，他在路上迷路了，错过了机会。这让他非常伤心和沮丧。**

> A brave explorer set out on a journey. Unfortunately, a sudden storm hit and damaged his boat. He had to struggle to survive. But he didn\'t give up hope. **一位勇敢的探险家出发去旅行。不幸的是，一场突如其来的风暴袭击并损坏了他的船。他不得不努力求生。但他没有放弃希望。**

> A brave sailor was on a ship. When the wind blew strongly, he unfurled the sail to catch the wind and let the ship move faster. It means to open or spread out something, like the sail. **一位勇敢的水手在船上。当强风吹来时，他展开船帆以借助风力，让船行驶得更快。这意味着打开或展开某物，比如船帆。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She performed poorly in the exam and unhappily returned home. Her parents comforted her and told her to keep trying. **从前，有一个小女孩。她考试成绩不好，不开心地回到家。她的父母安慰她并告诉她继续努力。**

> A little rabbit was unhappy because it lost its favorite carrot. It looked so sad. But then a kind bird found the carrot and gave it back. The rabbit became happy again. Remember, \'unhappy\' means not happy. **一只小兔子不开心，因为它弄丢了最喜欢的胡萝卜。它看起来非常难过。但后来一只善良的小鸟找到了胡萝卜并还给了它。小兔子又变得开心了。记住，'unhappy'意思是不开心。**

> In a dark forest, there was an unholy place. A witch lived there, performing evil spells. Everyone was afraid to go near. It was a place full of dark and terrifying magic. **在一片黑暗的森林里，有一个邪恶的地方。一个女巫住在那里，施展着邪恶的法术。每个人都害怕靠近。那是一个充满黑暗和恐怖魔法的地方。**

> In a mysterious forest, there was a strange creature. No one could tell what it was. It remained unidentified. People were curious but couldn\'t figure it out. Finally, they decided to keep exploring to solve the mystery. **在一个神秘的森林里，有一个奇怪的生物。没人能说出它是什么。它一直未被识别。人们很好奇但弄不清楚。最后，他们决定继续探索来解开这个谜团。**

> Once upon a time, there were many small kingdoms. But a wise leader worked hard to bring them together. This process was called \'unification\'. It means making separate things become one whole. **从前，有许多小王国。但一位睿智的领袖努力将它们聚集在一起。这个过程被称为"统一"。它意味着使分离的事物成为一个整体。**

> A group of soldiers was preparing for a parade. They all wore the same style and color of uniform, showing perfect uniformity. This scene made people feel their unity and discipline. **一群士兵正在为阅兵做准备。他们都穿着相同款式和颜色的制服，展现出了完美的一致性。这个场景让人感受到了他们的团结和纪律。**

> A group of soldiers were marching uniformly. They wore the same uniforms and moved at the same pace. It was a perfect display of uniformly. **一群士兵正在整齐划一地行进。他们穿着相同的制服，以相同的步伐移动。这是对'uniformly'（一致地；统一地；均匀地）完美的展示。**

> Once upon a time, there were many small kingdoms. A wise leader came and wanted to \'unify\' them. He made everyone work together, shared resources, and finally created a big and peaceful country. **从前，有许多小王国。一位睿智的领袖出现了，想要"统一"它们。他让大家一起努力，共享资源，最终创建了一个大而和平的国家。**

> One day, Tom accidentally broke a vase. But it was unintentional. He didn\'t mean to do it. His mom understood and forgave him. **一天，汤姆意外地打碎了一个花瓶。但这是无意的。他并非有意这么做。他的妈妈理解并原谅了他。**

> A student was asked to read a boring book. He showed no enthusiasm and was uninterested. His mind wandered elsewhere. It was clear he had no desire to engage with the book at all. **一个学生被要求读一本无聊的书。他毫无热情，表现得毫无兴趣。他的心思飘到了别处。很明显他根本不想读这本书。**

> A brave explorer was on a long journey in the forest. He had uninterrupted days of walking, without any breaks or disturbances. Finally, he reached his destination safely. **一位勇敢的探险家在森林里进行长途旅行。他有连续不断的行走的日子，没有任何停歇或干扰。最终，他安全到达了目的地。**

> A party was going on. Suddenly, a strange man showed up. Everyone was surprised because he was uninvited. He just walked in without being asked to come. Poor guy, he didn\'t know he wasn\'t welcome! **一场聚会正在进行。突然，一个陌生男人出现了。每个人都很惊讶，因为他是不请自来的。他就这么走进来，没人邀请他。可怜的家伙，他不知道自己不受欢迎！**

> A king wanted to unite his divided kingdom. So, he called all the people together and formed a UNION. They worked together and the kingdom became strong and prosperous. **一位国王想要统一他分裂的王国。于是，他把所有人召集在一起，组成了一个联盟。他们共同努力，王国变得强大且繁荣。**

> A prince was seeking a unique gem for his beloved princess. He searched far and wide until he found one that no one else had. This gem was truly unique, just like their love. **一位王子为他心爱的公主寻找一颗独特的宝石。他四处寻觅，直到找到一颗无人拥有的宝石。这颗宝石真的很独特，就像他们的爱情一样。**

> A young artist was struggling to find her style. One day, she had a dream where a magical fairy told her to paint uniquely. She woke up, followed the advice, and became famous for her unique paintings. **一位年轻的艺术家一直在努力寻找自己的风格。有一天，她做了一个梦，梦里一个神奇的仙女告诉她要独特地绘画。她醒来后，听从了建议，因其独特的画作而出名。**
> 想象一下，在一个盛大的音乐会上，所有的音乐家都心有灵犀，同时奏响乐器，发出整齐和谐的声音。这种同时发生、整齐一致的状态就是\'unison\'。就像大家齐心协力，为了同一个美妙的旋律而努力。 **想象在音乐会中，音乐家们同时奏响乐器呈现整齐一致的状态来理解\'unison\'，意思是一致，齐唱，齐奏**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的城堡里，每个房间都是一个独立的 unit（单元）。有卧室单元、厨房单元、书房单元等。它们虽独立，但共同构成了城堡这个整体。就像 unit 是构成整体的独立部分。 **想象在城堡中，每个房间作为独立的单元，以此来理解 unit 是构成整体的独立部分的意思**

> In a faraway kingdom, there was a unique law. Everything was managed in a unitary way, meaning there was only one system and no alternatives. This made the kingdom very orderly and unified. **在一个遥远的王国，有一项独特的法律。所有事物都以单一的方式被管理，意味着只有一种制度，没有其他选择。这使得这个王国非常有序且统一。**

> In a magical forest, different animal groups were always in conflict. But one day, a wise owl suggested they \'unite\' to face a common enemy. When they did, they found strength and peace. \'Unite\' means to come together as one. **在一个神奇的森林里，不同的动物群体总是有冲突。但有一天，一只聪明的猫头鹰建议它们'团结'起来面对共同的敌人。当它们这样做时，它们找到了力量与和平。'unite'意思是联合，团结。**

> A group of friends were lost in a forest. They faced many difficulties but worked together. Eventually, they found their way out. This shows the power of unity. It means being together and working as one. **一群朋友在森林里迷路了。他们面临许多困难，但一起努力。最终，他们找到了出路。这展示了团结的力量。【unity】这个单词意为团结一致。**

> In a distant universe, all beings shared a universal language. It was a code that everyone understood, allowing for seamless communication and connection. This language was the key to solving problems and building harmony across the cosmos. **在一个遥远的宇宙中，所有生物都共享一种通用语言。这是一种每个人都能理解的代码，允许无缝交流和联系。这种语言是解决问题和在整个宇宙中建立和谐的关键。**

> In a magical world, all creatures sought the \'universality\' gem. It held the power to unite everyone. Whoever found it would bring harmony and understanding to all. With this gem, differences vanished, and a universal connection was formed. **在一个神奇的世界里，所有生物都在寻找"普遍性"宝石。它拥有团结所有人的力量。无论谁找到它，都会给所有人带来和谐与理解。有了这颗宝石，差异消失了，形成了一种普遍的联系。**

> In a magical land, everyone agreed that the flower was beautiful. This agreement was universal. It meant universally, without any exception. So, universally means accepted or true everywhere. **在一个神奇的国度，每个人都认为那朵花很美。这种认同是普遍的。这意味着universally（普遍地），没有任何例外。所以，universally 意思是在各处都被接受或真实的。**

> In a faraway land, a little boy dreamed of exploring the unknown. One night, he saw a magical star and followed it. It led him to understand that the entire space, with all its planets and mysteries, is called the \'universe\'. **在一个遥远的地方，一个小男孩梦想着探索未知。一天晚上，他看到一颗神奇的星星并跟着它。这让他明白，包含所有行星和奥秘的整个空间被称为"宇宙"。**

> A young boy dreamed of going to a big place full of knowledge and friends. One day, he found \'university\' and knew that was the place. There, he would learn many things and have a wonderful time. **一个小男孩梦想着去一个充满知识和朋友的大地方。有一天，他发现了"university（大学）"这个词，知道那就是他想去的地方。在那里，他会学到很多东西，度过美好时光。**

> In a kingdom, the king\'s decisions were often unjust. He punished the innocent and favored the rich. One brave citizen stood up and exposed these unjust acts, making everyone realize the unfairness. **在一个王国里，国王的决定常常是不公正的。他惩罚无辜者，偏袒富人。一位勇敢的公民站出来揭露了这些不公正的行为，让大家都意识到了不公平。**

> Once upon a time, there was a boy who always said unkind words to his friends. When they needed help, he refused and was mean. His friends were sad. Finally, he realized his mistake and changed. **从前，有个男孩总是对他的朋友们说不友善的话。当朋友们需要帮助时，他拒绝并很刻薄。他的朋友们很伤心。最后，他意识到自己的错误并改变了。**

> One day, Tom unknowingly walked into a mysterious forest. He didn\'t realize the danger until it was too late. Luckily, he found his way out eventually. Unknowingly means doing something without realizing or being aware. **有一天，汤姆不知不觉地走进了一片神秘的森林。直到很晚他才意识到危险。幸运的是，他最终找到了出路。unknowingly 意思是在没有意识到或不知情的情况下做某事。**

> In a mysterious forest, there was a hidden path. No one knew where it led. It was an unknown destination. But a brave adventurer decided to explore it. Finally, he discovered a beautiful secret garden. **在一个神秘的森林里，有一条隐藏的小路。没人知道它通向哪里。这是一个未知的目的地。但一位勇敢的冒险家决定去探索。最终，他发现了一个美丽的秘密花园。**

> A thief was caught stealing jewels. When asked why, he said it was for money. But this act was unlawful. The police came and took him away. Remember, doing bad things against the law is unlawful. **一个小偷被抓到偷珠宝。当被问为什么时，他说为了钱。但这种行为是不合法的。警察来了并把他带走了。记住，违背法律做坏事是不合法的。**

> A brave warrior was trapped in a cage. One day, he found the key and used it to unleash himself. He could finally fight freely for justice. Remember, \'unleash\' means to set free or release something powerful. **一位勇敢的战士被困在笼子里。有一天，他找到了钥匙并用它释放了自己。他终于能够自由地为正义而战。记住，\'unleash\'意思是释放、放开强大的东西。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to play outside. His mom said he couldn\'t go unless he finished his homework. So, the boy quickly did his homework to enjoy the outside. \'Unless\' means except if. **有一天，一个小男孩想出去玩。他妈妈说他不能出去，除非他完成作业。于是，男孩迅速完成作业去享受户外时光。'unless'意思是除非，如果不**

> One day, a man was caught driving an unlicensed car. The police stopped him and said, \'You can\'t drive without a license!\' Unlicensed means without the necessary official permission or license. **有一天，一个男人被抓到开着一辆无证的车。警察拦住他说：'你不能无证驾驶！'unlicensed 意思是没有必要的官方许可或执照。**

> Once upon a time, there were two apples. One was red and shiny, the other was green and small. The red one was like all the other beautiful apples, but the green one was unlike them. It was special in its own way. **从前，有两个苹果。一个又红又亮，另一个又绿又小。红苹果和其他漂亮的苹果相似，但绿苹果和它们不同。它有自己独特的地方。**

> A brave knight set out on a quest. Everyone thought it was unlikely he would succeed as the journey was full of dangers. But with his determination, he proved them wrong. \'Unlikely\' means not likely to happen or be true. **一位勇敢的骑士踏上了征程。大家都认为他不太可能成功，因为旅途充满危险。但凭借他的决心，他证明了大家是错的。'unlikely'意思是不大可能发生或真实的。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy had a dream of having unlimited candies. No matter how many he ate, there were always more. Just like his imagination, it was unlimited. He could think of countless sweet scenarios. **从前，有个小男孩梦想拥有无限的糖果。无论他吃了多少，总是还有更多。就像他的想象力一样，是无限的。他能想到无数甜蜜的场景。**

> A truck driver was in a hurry to unload the goods at the warehouse. He opened the back of the truck and started taking out the boxes one by one. Finally, the truck was empty and the unloading was done. **一位卡车司机着急在仓库卸下货物。他打开卡车的后部，开始一个一个地拿出箱子。最后，卡车空了，卸货完成了。**

> One day, I lost the key to my room. I was very worried. But suddenly, I remembered a magic word - \'unlock\'. When I said it loudly, the door opened magically. It turned out it was just a dream, but I learned the word \'unlock\' forever. **有一天，我弄丢了房间的钥匙，非常担心。但突然，我想起了一个神奇的单词------\'unlock\'。当我大声说出它时，门神奇地开了。原来这只是一个梦，但我永远记住了\'unlock\'这个单词。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. Every time he tried to do something good, something bad happened. He was always in the wrong place at the wrong time. Poor Tom was so unlucky. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。每次他想做好事，坏事就会发生。他总是在错误的时间出现在错误的地方。可怜的汤姆太倒霉了。**

> Imagine a spaceship exploring a distant planet. There\'s no human inside controlling it. This spaceship is unmanned. It travels and collects data all by itself. So, unmanned means without a person to operate or control. **想象一艘宇宙飞船正在探索一个遥远的星球。里面没有人在控制它。这艘宇宙飞船是无人驾驶的。它完全靠自己飞行和收集数据。所以，unmanned 意思是无人操作或控制的。**

> One day, I was in a forest and saw many trees. Some had marks on them, but others were unmarked. It was easy to notice the difference. The unmarked trees looked so plain and normal. **有一天，我在森林里看到很多树。有些树上有标记，但另一些是没有标记的。很容易注意到这种差别。没有标记的树看起来如此普通和平凡。**

> A prince named Jack was unmarried. Many princesses wanted to marry him, but he preferred his freedom. One day, he realized being unmarried also meant being lonely. So, he decided to look for true love. **有一位叫杰克的王子尚未结婚。许多公主都想嫁给他，但他更喜欢自由。有一天，他意识到未婚也意味着孤独。于是，他决定去寻找真爱。**

> In a mysterious castle, a villain wore a mask to hide his true identity. But a brave detective was determined to unmask him. Finally, the detective exposed the villain\'s face and revealed the truth. **在一座神秘的城堡里，一个坏蛋戴着面具隐藏他的真实身份。但一位勇敢的侦探决心揭开他的面具。最终，侦探揭露了坏蛋的面容，揭示了真相。**

> In a fierce competition, all the teams showed their skills. But one team stood out with its unparalleled performance. Their strategies and teamwork were unmatched. No other team could compare to them. **在一场激烈的比赛中，所有的队伍都展示了他们的技能。但有一个队伍因其无与伦比的表现脱颖而出。他们的策略和团队合作是无可匹敌的。没有其他队伍能与之相比。**

> One day, I was lost in a big city. But when I saw the unmistakable landmark - a huge tower, I knew exactly where I was. The tower was so unique and distinct that there was no way to mistake it. **有一天，我在一个大城市里迷路了。但当我看到那个不会弄错的地标------一座巨大的塔时，我就确切地知道自己在哪里了。那座塔是如此独特和显眼，绝对不会弄错。**

> A detective was looking for a criminal. Every clue pointed unmistakably to one person. It was so clear that there was no mistake. The detective caught the criminal easily. **一位侦探正在寻找罪犯。每个线索都毫无疑问地指向一个人。这非常明确，没有错误。侦探轻松地抓住了罪犯。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments to create artificial life. The results were unnatural, like creatures with strange features. People were shocked and feared these abnormal creations. This shows what \'unnatural\' means - not normal or not in accordance with nature. **一位科学家正在进行实验以创造人造生命。结果是不自然的，比如有着奇怪特征的生物。人们感到震惊并害怕这些反常的创造物。这展示了'unnatural'的意思------不正常的或不符合自然规律的。**

> One day, Tom was criticized for doing something unnecessarily. He bought an expensive pen just to show off, but it was not needed at all. This made him realize that he shouldn\'t act unnecessarily in the future. **一天，汤姆因做了一些不必要的事而受到批评。他买了一支昂贵的笔只是为了炫耀，但这完全没有必要。这让他意识到以后不应该做不必要的事。**

> One day, Tom bought a lot of pencils, but he already had many at home. His mom said this purchase was unnecessary. It means not needed or not essential. **一天，汤姆买了很多铅笔，但他家里已经有很多了。他妈妈说这次购买是不必要的。它的意思是不需要的或非必要的。**

> A brave knight was about to enter a dark cave. Suddenly, a strange sound unnerve him. His hands trembled and his heart raced. It made him lose his courage and confidence. **一位勇敢的骑士正要进入一个黑暗的洞穴。突然，一阵奇怪的声音使他感到不安。他的手颤抖起来，心跳加速。这让他失去了勇气和信心。**

> One day, a small puppy was playing in the corner of the park, but its cute actions went unnoticed. No one stopped to appreciate it. Poor puppy! It felt so lonely. **有一天，一只小狗在公园的角落里玩耍，但它可爱的举动未被注意到。没有人停下来欣赏它。可怜的小狗！它感到非常孤独。**

> In a quiet town, there was a big house that was unoccupied. No one lived there. One day, a traveler passed by and was surprised to see the empty and unoccupied house. It stood alone, waiting for someone to come and fill it with life. **在一个安静的小镇上，有一座大房子无人居住。没人住在那里。有一天，一个旅行者路过，惊讶地看到这座空荡荡无人占用的房子。它孤零零地矗立着，等待着有人来赋予它生机。**

> A journalist was reporting on a secret meeting. But his coverage was unofficial as he wasn\'t authorized. Later, he faced trouble for sharing this unofficial information. **一名记者在报道一场秘密会议。但他的报道是非官方的，因为他未获授权。后来，他因分享这些非官方信息而陷入麻烦。**

> Imagine a treasure chest that remains unopened. Everyone is curious about what\'s inside, but it stays sealed. Just like this chest, \'unopened\' means not having been opened, still in a closed state. **想象一个仍未被打开的宝箱。每个人都好奇里面有什么，但它一直处于密封状态。就像这个宝箱一样，'unopened'意思是未被打开的，仍处于关闭的状态。**

> A young artist named Lily was considered unorthodox. She painted with her feet instead of brushes. Her unique way of creating art shocked many but also made her famous. Unorthodox means not following traditional or usual ways. **一位名叫莉莉的年轻艺术家被认为是离经叛道的。她用脚而不是画笔作画。她独特的创作方式震惊了许多人，也让她出名了。unorthodox 意思是不遵循传统或通常的方式。**

> I was very tired after moving to a new house. But I had to unpack all the boxes. It was a big job! First, I unpacked the clothes, then the books. Finally, my new home was tidy. **我搬新家后非常累。但我得把所有箱子都打开。这是个大工程！首先，我打开装衣服的箱子，然后是装书的。最后，我的新家变得整洁了。**

> A hardworking artist spent months creating beautiful paintings, but was left unpaid. The artist felt sad and frustrated. Remember, \'unpaid\' means not having received payment. **一位勤奋的艺术家花了几个月创作了精美的画作，但却没有得到报酬。艺术家感到悲伤和沮丧。记住，\'unpaid\'意思是未支付的、未偿付的。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist created a painting that was unparalleled. No other works could match its beauty and uniqueness. It was so special that it stood out among all. Just like this, \'unparalleled\' means having no equal; unique. **从前，有一位年轻的艺术家创作了一幅无与伦比的画。没有其他作品能与之媲美，它是如此特别，在所有作品中脱颖而出。就像这样，'unparalleled'意思是无可匹敌的；独特的。**

> One day, I had an unpleasant experience. I went to a park but it was crowded and noisy. The weather was bad, too. It made me feel really uncomfortable and unhappy. **有一天，我有了一次不愉快的经历。我去了一个公园，但那里又拥挤又嘈杂。天气也很糟糕。这让我感到非常不舒服和不开心。**

> There was a new restaurant in town. The food was bad and the service was poor. Soon, it became unpopular. No one wanted to go there. People preferred other places with better offerings. **镇上有一家新餐厅。食物难吃，服务也差。很快，它就变得不受欢迎了。没人想去那儿。人们更喜欢其他有更好菜品的地方。**

> In a faraway kingdom, there was a year with an unprecedentedsituation. No rain fell, and crops failed. This was a situation that had never happened before. People had to find new ways to survive. **在一个遥远的王国，有一年出现了前所未有的情况。没有降雨，庄稼歉收。这是以前从未发生过的状况。人们不得不寻找新的生存方法。**

> A wild monkey in the forest was unpredictable. One moment it was quiet, the next it jumped around crazily. You never knew what it would do next, just like the meaning of \'unpredictable\'. **森林里有一只野生猴子，它变幻莫测。一会儿安静，一会儿又疯狂地跳来跳去。你永远不知道它接下来会做什么，这就像\'unpredictable\'这个词的意思。**

> One day, Tom was supposed to give a presentation but was completely unprepared. He forgot to do his research and didn\'t organize his thoughts. As a result, he made a mess in front of the audience. **一天，汤姆本应做一个报告，但完全没有准备。他忘了做研究，也没整理思路。结果，他在观众面前出了丑。**

> A young artist was known for being unpretentious. Despite achieving fame, he remained simple and down-to-earth. He didn\'t show off but focused on creating genuine art. People loved his unpretentious nature. **一位年轻的艺术家以质朴谦逊著称。尽管成名了，他依然保持简单和脚踏实地。他不炫耀，而是专注于创作真诚的艺术。人们喜欢他这种质朴谦逊的品质。**

> A farmer worked hard every day but his land remained unproductive. No matter how much he watered and fertilized, the crops wouldn\'t grow well. He was very frustrated. **一位农民每天都辛勤劳作，但他的土地仍然没有生产力。无论他浇多少水、施多少肥，庄稼都长不好。他非常沮丧。**

> A businessman started a new venture, but it was unprofitable. He spent a lot of money but got few returns. This made him very frustrated. Finally, he decided to change the strategy to make it profitable. **一位商人开启了一项新的业务，但它无利可图。他投入了大量资金却回报甚少。这让他非常沮丧。最后，他决定改变策略以使其盈利。**

> A young doctor wanted to perform a complex surgery but was unqualified. His lack of proper training and experience prevented him from doing it. This shows that being unqualified means not having the necessary skills or meeting the required standards. **一位年轻的医生想进行一场复杂的手术，但他不合格。他缺乏适当的培训和经验，导致无法进行手术。这表明unqualified意味着没有必要的技能或不符合要求的标准。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a mysterious jungle. Despite facing many difficulties, his skills and determination were unquestionably outstanding. Eventually, he found his way out. Here, unquestionably means undoubtedly or without a doubt. **一位勇敢的探险家在神秘的丛林中迷路了。尽管面临诸多困难，但他的技能和决心无疑是出色的。最终，他找到了出路。这里，unquestionably 意思是毫无疑问地。**

> A king\'s authority was unquestioned. Everyone obeyed him without any doubt. But one brave knight questioned the king\'s unfair rule and brought changes. Now, \'unquestioned\' means accepted without being doubted or challenged. **一位国王的权威是毋庸置疑的。每个人都毫无疑问地服从他。但一位勇敢的骑士质疑了国王不公平的规则并带来了改变。现在，'unquestioned'意思是被毫无怀疑或挑战地接受。**

> A detective was trying to unravel a mysterious crime. The clues were all tangled like a ball of yarn. But with patience and sharp thinking, he finally managed to understand everything and solve the case. **一位侦探试图揭开一起神秘的犯罪案件。线索就像一团乱麻。但凭借耐心和敏锐的思考，他最终成功弄清楚一切并破了案。**

> In a magical land, there was a city that seemed perfect but was actually unreal. It had floating castles and talking animals. But when the sun rose, everything vanished. Just like dreams that seem real but are unreal. **在一个神奇的土地上，有一座看似完美实则虚幻的城市。它有漂浮的城堡和会说话的动物。但当太阳升起时，一切都消失了。就像看似真实实则虚幻的梦。**

> Once upon a time, a man had an unrealistic dream of flying to the moon by flapping his arms. Everyone laughed at him. But the word \'unrealistic\' reminds us of such impossible and not based on reality ideas. **从前，有个人有个不切实际的梦想，想通过挥动双臂飞到月球。大家都嘲笑他。但'unrealistic'这个词让我们想起这种不可能且不符合现实的想法。**

> Once there was a king who was always demanding impossible things from his subjects. His requests were so extreme and without reason. People called him unreasonable. He never listened to any sensible advice. **从前有个国王总是向他的臣民提出不可能的要求。他的要求非常极端且毫无道理。人们称他不讲道理。他从不听取任何合理的建议。**

> One day, a brilliant scientist made a ground-breaking discovery. But unfortunately, his work remained unrecognized by the mainstream scientific community. They just couldn\'t see its value. **有一天，一位杰出的科学家有了一个突破性的发现。但不幸的是，他的工作仍未被主流科学界认可。他们就是看不到其价值。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a desert. The sun was unrelenting, shining fiercely without any mercy. But the adventurer didn\'t give up, still looking for a way out. Finally, he was saved. Unrelenting means not giving up or showing no mercy. **一位勇敢的冒险家在沙漠中迷路了。太阳毫不留情，强烈地照射着。但冒险家没有放弃，仍在寻找出路。最后，他得救了。unrelenting 意思是不放弃或毫不留情。**

> One day, I needed to catch a train. I asked a man for the time, but he was unreliable. He gave me the wrong time and I almost missed my train. Unreliable means not able to be trusted or depended on. **有一天，我要赶火车。我问一个人时间，但他不可靠。他给了我错误的时间，我差点错过火车。unreliable 意思是不可信赖的；靠不住的。**

> A man was found lying unconscious on the street. People called for help, but he remained unresponsive. No matter how loudly they shouted or shook him, he showed no reaction. Finally, an ambulance arrived. **一个男人被发现昏迷地躺在街上。人们呼喊求助，但他毫无反应。无论他们喊得多大声，摇晃他多用力，他都没有回应。最后，救护车来了。**

> In a peaceful town, suddenly there was unrest. People were unhappy and started to protest. The reason? A factory\'s pollution. This chaos and dissatisfaction was what we call unrest. **在一个宁静的小镇，突然出现了动荡不安。人们很不高兴并开始抗议。原因？一家工厂的污染。这种混乱和不满就是我们所说的动荡不安。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a hidden cave. There were no limits or restrictions. He could go anywhere freely. This scene perfectly represents the meaning of \'unrestricted\'. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个隐藏的洞穴。这里没有任何限制。他可以自由地去任何地方。这个场景完美地体现了\'unrestricted\'（无限制的；不受约束的）的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was an unruly child who never listened to his parents. He always ran wild and caused trouble everywhere. His behavior was so unruly that no one could control him. **从前，有一个不守规矩的孩子，从不听父母的话。他总是到处乱跑，惹是生非。他的行为非常任性，没人能管得住他。**

> One day, Tom was walking in a dark alley. He saw a sign that said \'unsafe area\'. He was scared and decided to go back quickly. Remember, unsafe means not safe or dangerous. **有一天，汤姆走在一条黑暗的小巷里。他看到一个牌子写着"不安全区域"。他很害怕，决定赶紧回去。记住，unsafe 意思是不安全的或危险的。**

> One day, I went to a store and bought some nuts. But when I tasted them, I found they were unsalted. I was a little disappointed because I usually like the salty flavor. So I decided to add some salt myself. **有一天，我去商店买了一些坚果。但当我品尝时，发现它们是无盐的。我有点失望，因为我通常喜欢咸的味道。所以我决定自己加些盐。**

> A customer went to a restaurant. The food and service were both unsatisfactory. The steak was overcooked, and the waiter was slow. This made the customer very unhappy and decide not to come again. **一位顾客去了一家餐厅。那里的食物和服务都不令人满意。牛排煎过头了，服务员动作又慢。这让顾客很不高兴，决定不再来了。**

> One day, I went to a restaurant. The food there was unsavory. It tasted bad and smelled strange. I had a very unpleasant meal. From then on, I remember \'unsavory\' means not pleasant to taste or smell. **有一天，我去了一家餐厅。那里的食物令人倒胃口。味道糟糕，气味怪异。我吃了一顿非常不愉快的饭。从那以后，我记住了\'unsavory\'意思是味道或气味不好的。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a dangerous cave. Despite many obstacles and potential harms, he emerged unscathed. It means he came out without any injuries or damage. **一位勇敢的探险家在探索一个危险的洞穴。尽管有许多障碍和潜在的危险，他毫发无损地出来了。这意味着他出来时没有任何受伤或损坏。**

> One day, my bike\'s seat was loose. I needed to unscrew the bolts to fix it. I took a wrench and turned it counter-clockwise to remove the screws. Finally, the seat was stable again. **有一天，我的自行车座椅松了。我需要拧开螺栓来修理它。我拿了一个扳手，逆时针转动来卸下螺丝。最后，座椅又稳固了。**

> A businessman was always looking for ways to make money, not caring if it was legal or fair. He was unscrupulous. He would cheat customers and break rules. Eventually, his bad deeds caught up with him. **一个商人总是想方设法赚钱，不在乎是否合法或公平。他是肆无忌惮的。他会欺骗顾客并违反规则。最终，他的恶行让他自食其果。**

> In a wild horse race, the champion rider was unexpectedly unseated. The powerful horse threw him off, meaning to remove him from the saddle. \'Unseat\' means to force someone to leave a position, especially one of power or authority. **在一场激烈的赛马中，冠军骑手意外落马。那匹强壮的马把他甩了下来，这就意味着让他离开了马鞍。'unseat'意思是迫使某人离开某个职位，尤其是权力或权威的职位。**

> One day, Tom was exploring an old house. In a dark corner, he found a box labeled \'unseen treasures\'. When he opened it, he discovered rare coins and jewels that no one had ever seen before. **一天，汤姆在探索一座老房子。在一个黑暗的角落，他发现了一个标有"未见过的宝藏"的盒子。当他打开它时，他发现了以前从未有人见过的稀有硬币和珠宝。**

> Once upon a time, a peaceful village was suddenly visited by a strange storm. The strong wind and heavy rain unsettled everything. Houses were damaged, and people\'s hearts were filled with fear and anxiety. **从前，一个宁静的村庄突然遭遇了一场奇怪的风暴。强风和大雨使一切都变得混乱不安。房屋受损，人们心中充满了恐惧和焦虑。**

> A young adventurer set out on a journey. The weather was unsettled, sometimes sunny, sometimes stormy. He never knew what to expect next. This made his adventure full of surprises and challenges. **一位年轻的冒险家踏上了旅程。天气不稳定，时而晴朗，时而暴风雨。他永远不知道接下来会发生什么。这使他的冒险充满了惊喜和挑战。**

> Once upon a time, there was a worker named Tom. He was unskilled and struggled to complete tasks. But he was determined to learn and finally became skilled. Unskilled means lacking the necessary skills or training. **从前，有个叫汤姆的工人。他没有技能，完成任务很吃力。但他决心学习，最终变得有技能。unskilled 意思是缺乏必要的技能或训练。**

> One day, I received a package at my door. It was unsolicited. I had no idea who sent it or why. It made me confused. Later I found out it was a wrong delivery. **有一天，我在家门口收到一个包裹。它是未经请求的。我不知道是谁寄的，也不知道为什么。这让我很困惑。后来才发现是送错了。**

> A detective was faced with an unsolved mystery. A precious gem disappeared without a trace. Despite his efforts, the case remained unsolved. It frustrated him greatly, as he was determined to find the solution. **一位侦探面临着一个未解决的谜团。一颗珍贵的宝石消失得无影无踪。尽管他努力了，但这个案子仍然未解决。这让他非常沮丧，因为他决心找到解决办法。**

> A man found a mysterious box in an old house. When he opened it, he saw something unspeakable, like a strange creature. It was so terrifying that he couldn\'t even describe it to others. **一个男人在一座老房子里发现了一个神秘的盒子。当他打开它时，他看到了一些无法形容的东西，像是一个奇怪的生物。它太可怕了，以至于他甚至无法向别人描述。**

> A detective was looking for a criminal, but the location of the next crime was unspecified. It made the detective\'s job very difficult. They had no clear direction to start their investigation. **一位侦探正在寻找罪犯，但下一次犯罪的地点未指明。这使得侦探的工作非常困难。他们没有明确的方向开始调查。**

> In a quiet library, two friends had a silent understanding. They didn\'t need to speak to know each other\'s thoughts. This unspoken connection was stronger than words. It meant things that were not expressed but deeply felt. **在一个安静的图书馆里，两个朋友有一种无声的默契。他们无需言语就能知晓彼此的想法。这种未说出口的联系比言语更有力。它意味着那些没有表达出来但却深深感受到的东西。**

> A little monkey was trying to balance on a thin branch. The branch was unstable and kept shaking. The poor monkey struggled to hold on but finally fell. \'Unstable\' means not firm or likely to change or fall. **一只小猴子试图在一根细树枝上保持平衡。树枝不稳定，不停地摇晃。可怜的猴子努力抓住但最终还是掉了下来。\'unstable\'意思是不稳固的，可能改变或倒下的。**

> A little monkey tried to walk on a thin rope. It was unsteady and kept wobbling. It almost fell several times. Finally, it gave up and decided to find a more stable place to play. **一只小猴子试图在一根细绳子上走。它摇摇晃晃的，很不稳定。它好几次差点掉下来。最后，它放弃了，决定找一个更稳固的地方玩。**

> A brave entrepreneur tried to launch a new business, but faced many challenges. Despite all his efforts, the venture ended up being unsuccessful. He learned valuable lessons from this experience. **一位勇敢的企业家试图开展一项新业务，但面临诸多挑战。尽管他全力以赴，最终这次创业还是不成功。他从这次经历中学到了宝贵的经验。**

> A brave adventurer tried to find the hidden treasure unsuccessfully. He followed many clues and faced many difficulties, but in the end, he still couldn\'t get the treasure. Poor guy! **一位勇敢的冒险家试图寻找隐藏的宝藏，但未成功。他遵循了许多线索，面临了诸多困难，但最终，他还是没能得到宝藏。可怜的家伙！**

> Once there was a prince looking for a partner. A girl came, but she wore strange clothes and had bad manners. The prince thought she was unsuitable. Finally, he found a truly suitable princess. **从前有个王子在寻找伴侣。一个女孩来了，但她穿着奇怪，举止不佳。王子认为她不合适。最后，他找到了一位真正合适的公主。**

> One day, Tom was asked if he could finish the project on time. He felt unsure and hesitated. He didn\'t know whether he had enough time and resources. Finally, he decided to make more efforts to find out. **有一天，汤姆被问到他是否能按时完成这个项目。他感到不确定，犹豫了。他不知道自己是否有足够的时间和资源。最后，他决定更加努力去弄清楚。**

> A thief targeted an unsuspecting traveler. The traveler was happily walking, not suspecting anything. Suddenly, the thief snatched the traveler\'s bag. Poor unsuspecting person! **一个小偷盯上了一位毫无戒心的旅行者。这位旅行者正开心地走着，没有任何怀疑。突然，小偷抢走了旅行者的包。可怜的毫无戒心的人！**

> A little monkey got its tail tangled in a vine. It struggled hard but couldn\'t get free. Finally, with the help of its friends, it managed to untangle its tail and happily continued playing. **一只小猴子的尾巴被藤蔓缠住了。它拼命挣扎却无法挣脱。最后，在朋友们的帮助下，它成功解开了尾巴的缠绕，开心地继续玩耍。**
> 想象一个神秘的宝藏洞穴，里面充满了珍贵的宝石和黄金，但一直未被发现和开采。这个未被开采的洞穴就像\'untapped\'所表达的，意为未被开发利用的。 **想象一个充满宝藏但未被开发利用的洞穴来辅助记忆\'untapped\'，意思是未被开发利用的**

> A brave adventurer tried to defend an old castle, but the walls were crumbling and the defense system was in chaos. The situation was untenable. Finally, they had to give up. **一位勇敢的冒险家试图保卫一座古老的城堡，但城墙摇摇欲坠，防御系统一片混乱。这种状况难以维持。最后，他们不得不放弃。**

> In a magical land, everyone could think of any possibility. But one day, a dark curse made it unthinkable to imagine a peaceful future. The curse was so powerful that people\'s minds were blocked. **在一个神奇的国度，每个人都能想到任何可能性。但有一天，一个黑暗的诅咒让想象和平的未来变得不可想象。这个诅咒非常强大，阻塞了人们的思维。**

> One day, a little boy was trapped in a room with a tied rope. He struggled to untie the rope and finally succeeded. With the rope untied, he happily ran out of the room. **有一天，一个小男孩被困在一个房间里，有一根系着的绳子。他努力解开绳子，最终成功了。绳子解开后，他高兴地跑出了房间。**

> A little mouse was lost in a big maze. It kept running until it found the exit. It didn\'t stop before that. \'Until\' means up to a certain point in time. **一只小老鼠在一个大迷宫里迷路了。它一直跑，直到找到了出口。在此之前它都没有停下。'until'意思是直到某个时间点。**

> A young singer\'s death was untimely. She had just started to shine but was taken away too soon. Her talent was cut short, and it was a sad and unexpected end. \'Untimely\' means happening too soon or at the wrong time. **一位年轻歌手的离世是不合时宜的。她刚刚开始崭露头角却过早地离去了。她的才华被突然截断，这是一个悲伤且意外的结局。\'untimely\'意思是过早发生的或不合时宜的。**
> 想象一位画家完成了一幅很棒的作品，但还没来得及给它取名字，这幅作品就处于untitled（未命名的）状态。就像我们有时候写了一篇文章，还没想好标题一样。 **想象画家完成未命名作品的情景来辅助理解untitled（未命名的）这个单词**

> Once upon a time, a brave knight embarked on a journey unto a distant land to rescue a princess. He faced many challenges but never gave up. \'Unto\' here means towards or to that place. **从前，一位勇敢的骑士踏上了前往遥远之地的旅程，去营救一位公主。他面临诸多挑战但从未放弃。这里的'unto'意思是朝着或到那个地方。**

> In a faraway kingdom, there was an ancient library filled with untold secrets. One brave scholar ventured in, determined to uncover the hidden knowledge within. These secrets were countless and unknown, just like the meaning of \'untold\'. **在一个遥远的王国，有一个古老的图书馆，里面充满了数不清的秘密。一位勇敢的学者冒险进入，决心揭开其中隐藏的知识。这些秘密不计其数且不为人知，就像\'untold\'的意思一样。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mysterious treasure chest that was untouchable. No one could get close to it. It was protected by powerful magic. But one brave adventurer finally found the key to unlock its secrets. **从前，有一个神秘的宝箱是碰不得的。没人能接近它。它被强大的魔法保护着。但一位勇敢的冒险家最终找到了揭开其秘密的钥匙。**

> In a hidden forest, there was a magical cave. No one had ever entered it, and it remained untouched. It was like a secret world waiting to be discovered. The untouched cave was full of mystery and wonder. **在一片隐秘的森林里，有一个神奇的洞穴。从来没有人进去过，它一直未被触碰。它就像一个等待被发现的秘密世界。这个未被触碰的洞穴充满了神秘和奇妙。**

> A young man wanted to be a chef but was untrained. He faced many difficulties in the kitchen. However, with determination, he learned and practiced, and finally became an excellent chef. **一个年轻人想成为厨师但未经训练。他在厨房面临许多困难。然而，凭借决心，他学习和练习，最终成为了一名出色的厨师。**

> A man claimed to have found a treasure chest, but it turned out to be untrue. His story was just a made-up lie. People were disappointed when they discovered the truth. Remember, untrue means not true, false. **一个男人声称找到了一个宝箱，但结果是不真实的。他的故事只是编造的谎言。当人们发现真相时很失望。记住，untrue 意思是不真实的，假的。**

> In a big warehouse, there were many items that were never touched or used. They were all \'unused\'. The manager decided to sell them to make space. **在一个大仓库里，有许多物品从未被触碰或使用过。它们都是"未被使用的"。经理决定卖掉它们来腾出空间。**

> One day, I went to a park and saw a very unusual flower. It had strange colors and a unique shape. No one had seen such a flower before. This made me remember the word \'unusual\' which means not common or ordinary. **有一天，我去公园看到了一朵非常不寻常的花。它有着奇特的颜色和独特的形状。之前没人见过这样的花。这让我记住了\'unusual\'这个单词，意思是不常见的、特别的。**

> One day, I went to a park. Everyone was behaving normally. But there was a girl who danced unusually beautifully. Her moves were so unique and eye-catching. It made me remember \'unusually\' easily. **有一天，我去了一个公园。每个人表现都很正常。但有一个女孩跳舞异常地美。她的动作如此独特和引人注目。这让我轻松记住了\'unusually\'。**

> A famous artist was going to unveil her new masterpiece. Everyone was excited and gathered around. When the curtain was pulled away, the beautiful painting was revealed, just like uncovering a mystery. \'Unveil\' means to reveal or show something that was hidden. **一位著名的艺术家准备揭开她的新杰作的面纱。每个人都很兴奋，围聚在一起。当幕布被拉开时，美丽的画作展现了出来，就像揭开了一个谜团。\'unveil\'意思是揭示或展示隐藏的东西。**

> A poor puppy was wandering on the street, unwanted by anyone. It looked so sad and lonely. But finally, a kind girl adopted it and gave it a loving home. **一只可怜的小狗在街头流浪，无人想要。它看起来既悲伤又孤独。但最后，一个善良的女孩收养了它，给了它一个充满爱的家。**

> A detective was investigating a case. He found some evidence that seemed to point to a suspect, but later discovered it was unwarranted. The real criminal was someone else. It means not justified or having no good reason. **一位侦探在调查一个案子。他发现了一些似乎指向一名嫌疑人的证据，但后来发现这是没有根据的。真正的罪犯是其他人。这个词意思是无正当理由的、未经授权的。**

> A soldier was on a dangerous mission. Despite facing many difficulties and fears, his determination was unwavering. He never wavered in his commitment to complete the task and finally succeeded. **一名士兵在执行一项危险的任务。尽管面临诸多困难和恐惧，但他的决心坚定不移。他完成任务的信念从未动摇，最终成功了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl named Lily. But she was unwed. She was waiting for the right person to come. Finally, she found true love and got married happily. **从前，有个美丽的女孩叫莉莉。但她未婚。她一直在等待对的人出现。最终，她找到了真爱，幸福地结婚了。**

> One day, a strange man came to the village. Everyone felt his arrival was unwelcome. He was rude and caused trouble. No one wanted him to stay. So, unwelcome means not wanted or pleasant. **有一天，一个陌生男人来到了村子。每个人都觉得他的到来不受欢迎。他很粗鲁还惹麻烦。没人希望他留下来。所以，unwelcome 意思是不受欢迎的、不令人愉快的。**

> Imagine a huge, old-fashioned suit of armor. It\'s so heavy and hard to handle that you can barely move it. That\'s what \'unwieldy\' means. This armor is unwieldy. It\'s not easy to control or manage. **想象一套巨大的、老式的盔甲。它太重了，很难操控，你几乎无法移动它。这就是\'unwieldy\'的意思。这套盔甲是笨重难用的。不容易控制或管理。**

> A king was very rich but unwilling to share his wealth with the poor. One day, a wise man came and told him the importance of kindness. The king finally changed and became willing to help. **一位国王非常富有，但不愿意与穷人分享他的财富。一天，一位智者前来告诉他善良的重要性。国王最终改变了，变得愿意帮忙。**

> Once there was a king. He was faced with a difficult decision but showed unwillingness to make it. His subjects were confused. This unwillingness caused chaos in the kingdom. **从前有一位国王。他面临一个艰难的决定，但表现出不情愿去做。他的臣民们很困惑。这种不情愿在王国里引起了混乱。**

> Imagine a tightly wound spring. It\'s all tense and coiled up. But then, someone comes along and starts to unwind it. The spring becomes loose and relaxed. That\'s what \'unwind\' means - to become loose or relaxed. **想象一个紧紧缠绕的弹簧。它绷得很紧，盘绕在一起。但接着，有人过来开始解开它。弹簧变得松弛。这就是\'unwind\'的意思------变得松弛或放松。**

> Once there was a king. He made an unwise decision to go to war without proper preparation. As a result, his kingdom suffered greatly. \'Unwise\' here means not smart or sensible in making choices. **从前有个国王。他做了一个不明智的决定，在没有充分准备的情况下就去打仗。结果，他的王国遭受了巨大的损失。'unwise'在这里指的是做选择时不聪明或不明智。**

> A man was walking in the park, enjoying the beautiful scenery. Unwittingly, he stepped on a banana peel and fell. He didn\'t know it was there and was completely unwitting of the potential danger. **一个男人正在公园里散步，欣赏着美丽的风景。不知不觉中，他踩到了一块香蕉皮摔倒了。他并不知道香蕉皮在那里，完全没有意识到潜在的危险。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. A witness unwittingly provided a crucial clue by mentioning a detail she didn\'t realize was important. The detective followed this and solved the case. **一位侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。一位证人在不经意间提供了一条关键线索，她当时并未意识到这个细节的重要性。侦探顺着这条线索破了案。**

> A thief was caught stealing from a poor family. His actions were unworthy. He didn\'t deserve any respect because he took advantage of those in need. **一个小偷被抓到从一个贫困家庭偷东西。他的行为是不值得的。他不配得到任何尊重，因为他占了那些需要帮助的人的便宜。**

> One day, Tom received a mysterious gift wrapped tightly. With excitement, he started to unwrap it layer by layer, eager to discover what was inside. Finally, he saw a beautiful toy car! **一天，汤姆收到了一个包裹得严严实实的神秘礼物。怀着激动的心情，他开始一层一层地拆开它，急切地想知道里面是什么。最后，他看到了一辆漂亮的玩具车！**
> 想象一个古老的图书馆，里面有一本神秘的魔法书，它的内容是空白的，没有被书写过，即 unwritten。就像未被记录的秘密，等待着被揭示。 **想象一个古老图书馆里有本空白的魔法书，就像未被书写的秘密，以此来记 unwritten 这个单词**

> A warrior was in a fierce battle. Despite the enemy\'s strong attacks, he remained unyielding. He wouldn\'t give up or surrender, showing great determination. Just like this warrior, unyielding means being firm and not giving in easily. **一位战士身处激烈的战斗中。尽管敌人猛烈攻击，他依然坚定不移。他绝不放弃或投降，展现出极大的决心。就像这位战士一样，unyielding 意思是坚定的，不容易屈服。**

> One day, I received a mysterious package. It was zipped tightly. But I was eager to know what was inside, so I decided to unzip it. With great excitement, I opened it and found a wonderful surprise! **有一天，我收到了一个神秘的包裹。它被紧紧地拉上了拉链。但我急切地想知道里面是什么，所以我决定拉开拉链。怀着极大的兴奋，我打开了它，发现了一个美妙的惊喜！**

> A little boy wanted to fly a kite. But the kite was stuck in a tree. So he climbed up the tree to get it. With great effort, he finally reached up and grabbed the kite. He was so happy! **一个小男孩想放风筝。但是风筝卡在了树上。于是他爬上树去拿。费了好大劲，他终于够到并抓住了风筝。他非常高兴！**

> A musician was feeling down. But when he played an upbeat melody, his mood lifted. The fast and cheerful rhythm made everyone dance. Remember, \'upbeat\' means positive and cheerful, like that melody. **一位音乐家心情低落。但当他演奏起欢快的旋律时，他的心情好了起来。快速而欢快的节奏让每个人都跳起舞来。记住，'upbeat'意思是积极乐观的、欢快的，就像那旋律一样。**

> A little boy was lost in a big city. But his strong upbringing helped him stay calm and find his way home. His parents\' teachings and love made him brave and wise. **一个小男孩在大城市里迷路了。但他良好的教养帮助他保持冷静并找到了回家的路。他父母的教导和爱让他勇敢又聪明。**

> Imagine you are a runner waiting at the starting line. The upcoming race is very important to you. It means the coming, approaching event. So, remember \'upcoming\' means something that is going to happen soon. **想象一下你是一名在起跑线等待的赛跑者。即将到来的比赛对你非常重要。这意味着即将发生、临近的事件。所以，记住'upcoming'表示很快就要发生的事情。**
> 想象一个古老的图书馆，里面的书籍信息过时了。一位勤奋的管理员每天努力工作，将新的知识和信息添加到书籍中，这就是\'update\'，让图书馆的内容始终保持最新。 **想象一个古老图书馆，管理员努力添加新知识和信息以保持内容最新的过程，就是\'更新\'的意思。**

> A poor student had an old computer. But he worked hard and saved money to upgrade it. With the upgraded computer, his study became more efficient. **一个贫困的学生有一台旧电脑。但他努力工作存钱来升级它。有了升级后的电脑，他的学习变得更高效了。**

> Imagine a peaceful town. One day, a huge earthquake strikes, causing buildings to collapse and roads to break. This sudden and violent change is like an \'upheaval\'. It brings chaos and turns everything upside down. **想象一个宁静的小镇。有一天，一场巨大的地震来袭，导致建筑物倒塌，道路断裂。这种突然而剧烈的变化就像是'剧变；动乱'。它带来混乱，让一切都天翻地覆。**

> A little boy was on an uphill journey to the top of a mountain. He struggled but didn\'t give up. Finally, he reached the summit. Remember, \'uphill\' means going upwards, like his hard climb. **一个小男孩正在向山顶进行一段上坡的旅程。他努力挣扎但没有放弃。最后，他到达了山顶。记住，'uphill'意思是向上的，就像他艰难的攀爬。**

> A judge must uphold the law. Imagine a judge standing firm in court, holding up the heavy book of law, determined not to let it fall. That\'s how we remember \'uphold\' means to support or maintain. **一位法官必须维护法律。想象一位法官在法庭上坚定地站着，举起厚重的法典，决心不让它掉落。这就是我们记住'uphold'表示支持或维护的方式。**

> A king\'s throne was beautifully decorated with fine upholstery. The soft fabric and exquisite patterns made it very comfortable. Remember, upholstery means the materials used to cover furniture for decoration and comfort. **一位国王的王座用精美的室内装潢材料装饰得美轮美奂。柔软的织物和精致的图案让它非常舒适。记住，upholstery 意思是用于覆盖家具的装饰和舒适的材料。**
> 想象一个古老的城堡，主人很在意它的状况。为了保持城堡的良好，需要定期投入资金用于修缮和维护，这就是 \'upkeep\'，意味着维修、保养和维持。 **想象一个古老城堡的主人为保持其良好状况而进行的维修、保养和维持工作，以此来理解\'upkeep\'这个单词**

> A brave adventurer climbed the high mountains and reached the upland. There, he found beautiful flowers and a peaceful view. The upland was like a hidden paradise. **一位勇敢的冒险家爬上了高山，到达了高地。在那里，他发现了美丽的花朵和宁静的景色。高地就像一个隐藏的天堂。**

> A little bird was trapped in a deep hole. But with the help of a kind man\'s uplift, it flew freely again. The man\'s action of raising and supporting the bird was called uplift. **一只小鸟被困在深洞里。但在一位好心人的uplift（抬起，鼓舞）下，它又自由地飞了起来。这个人抬起并支持小鸟的行为就叫做uplift。**

> One day, Tom had many beautiful photos on his computer. He wanted to share them with his friends. So he used a special website to upload these photos. That way, everyone could see them. **一天，汤姆电脑里有很多漂亮的照片。他想和朋友们分享。于是他使用一个特殊的网站上传这些照片。这样，每个人都能看到了。**

> Once upon a time, a little bird landed upon a big branch. It looked around and saw a beautiful view. \'Upon\' here means on top of or onto something. **从前，一只小鸟落在一根大树枝上。它环顾四周，看到了美丽的景色。这里的'upon'意思是在......之上或到......上面。**

> A little monkey wanted to reach the upper branches of a tree to get the tastiest fruits. It climbed hard and finally got to the upper part. Now you know \'upper\' means at a higher position. **一只小猴子想要够到树的上部树枝去摘最美味的水果。它努力攀爬，终于到达了上部。现在你知道\'upper\'表示在较高的位置。**

> A little monkey was climbing a tree. It stood upright on a branch to reach a delicious fruit. It was so brave and steady. Remember, \'upright\' means standing straight and vertical. **一只小猴子正在爬树。它笔直地站在一根树枝上去够一个美味的水果。它是如此勇敢和稳当。记住，\'upright\'意思是笔直的、直立的。**

> In a small town, people were very unhappy with the bad ruler. One day, they decided to fight back. This collective action of standing up against injustice was called an uprising. Everyone joined hands to change their situation for the better. **在一个小镇上，人们对坏统治者非常不满。有一天，他们决定反击。这种集体对抗不公正的行动被称为起义。每个人都携手努力，让他们的处境变得更好。**

> A brave adventurer decided to go upriver to find a hidden treasure. He rowed his boat against the current, facing many challenges. Finally, he reached the destination upriver and discovered the precious jewels. **一位勇敢的冒险家决定逆流而上寻找隐藏的宝藏。他划着船逆着水流前行，面临诸多挑战。最终，他到达了河流上游的目的地，发现了珍贵的珠宝。**
> 在一个安静的小镇，突然传来一阵巨响，原来是一辆失控的卡车撞进了商店。瞬间，人们惊慌失措，现场陷入一片 uproar（喧嚣；骚动），大家都在呼喊和奔跑。 **在一个安静的小镇，突然传来一阵巨响，原来是一辆失控的卡车撞进了商店。瞬间，人们惊慌失措，现场陷入一片喧嚣、骚动，大家都在呼喊和奔跑。**

> A strong wind came and uprooted the old tree in the forest. The tree that had stood for years was suddenly pulled out of the ground. Poor tree! Now you know \'uproot\' means to pull something out of the ground completely. **一阵强风袭来，把森林里的那棵老树连根拔起。这棵屹立多年的树突然就被完全从地里拔了出来。可怜的树！现在你知道\'uproot\'意思是把某物从地里完全拔出。**

> A poor artist dreamed of having an upscale life. One day, he sold a masterpiece and moved to a fancy neighborhood. Now he lived an upscale life with fine art and elegant furniture. **一位贫穷的艺术家梦想过上高档的生活。有一天，他卖掉了一幅杰作，搬到了一个高档社区。现在他过上了拥有精美艺术品和优雅家具的高档生活。**
> 小明精心准备的生日派对因为下雨取消了，这让他感到非常 upset。他原本期待和朋友们一起快乐玩耍，结果计划泡汤，心情糟糕极了。 **小明精心准备的生日派对因雨取消，这使他非常心烦意乱。他原本期待与朋友们一起欢乐玩耍，结果计划落空，心情极差。**

> One day, I saw a little girl crying on the street. It was an upsetting scene. Her ice cream dropped and she was very sad. This event made me feel very uncomfortable. > 想象一下，有一场激烈的比赛，大家都在等待最终的结果。裁判宣布结果的那一刻就是 upshot，它代表着整个事情最重要、最关键的结果。 **想象一场比赛，裁判宣布结果的那一刻就是"upshot"，代表事情最重要的结果。**

> A little monkey was trying to reach a banana on a tree. It climbed up but fell. But then it saw the upside - a beautiful bird\'s nest it had never noticed before. Upside means the positive or favorable aspect. **一只小猴子试图够到树上的香蕉。它爬上去却摔了下来。但随后它看到了好的一面------一个它以前从未注意到的漂亮的鸟巢。upside 意思是积极或有利的方面。**

> One day, a little cat was playing downstairs. Suddenly, it heard a strange sound coming from upstairs. Curious, it climbed the stairs quickly to see what was going on. Finally, it found a bird singing upstairs. **有一天，一只小猫在楼下玩耍。突然，它听到从楼上传来奇怪的声音。出于好奇，它迅速爬上楼梯去看看是怎么回事。最后，它发现一只鸟在楼上唱歌。**
> 从前有个穷小子，通过努力突然变得富有和有权力，人们都觉得他是个 upstart。他的成功来得太快，让很多人嫉妒和不满。但他不在乎，继续努力证明自己。 **从前有个穷小子突然变得富有和有权力，人们觉得他是个暴发户。他的成功来得快，遭人嫉妒，但他不在乎，继续努力证明自己。**

> A man was lost in the city. A kind lady told him to go upstate to find a peaceful village. There, he found a beautiful lake and had a wonderful time. Remember, upstate means the northern or rural part of a state. **一个男人在城市里迷路了。一位善良的女士告诉他去北部或乡村地区能找到一个宁静的村庄。在那里，他发现了一个美丽的湖，度过了美好的时光。记住，upstate 指的是州的北部或农村地区。**

> A little fish was determined to swim upstream against the current. It struggled but never gave up. Finally, it reached a beautiful place. Remember, \'upstream\' means moving against the flow of water. **一条小鱼决心逆流而上。它奋力挣扎，从不放弃。最终，它到达了一个美丽的地方。记住，\'upstream\'意思是逆流，逆水而行。**
> 想象一个秋千，它原本静止不动，突然有人用力一推，它就开始向上摆动，这就是 upswing。就像经济原本低迷，突然开始繁荣向上，这就是经济的 upswing 时刻。 **想象秋千被推动向上摆动来理解'upswing'这个词，表示上升、增长、好转**
> 想象一个小机器人努力学习吸收新知识（uptake）。它的任务是快速理解并记住各种指令，就像我们吸收有用的信息一样。最终，它成功了，因为它有很强的uptake能力。 **想象一个小机器人努力学习吸收新知识（uptake）。它的任务是快速理解并记住各种指令，就像我们吸收有用的信息一样。最终，它成功了，因为它有很强的吸收能力。**

> A mouse was always uptight when crossing the road, fearing being hit by cars. One day, it learned to relax and crossed safely. \'Uptight\' means being nervous and unable to relax. **一只老鼠过马路时总是很紧张，害怕被车撞到。有一天，它学会放松，安全地过去了。\'uptight\'意思是紧张不安，无法放松。**

> A young man was lost in the city. He wanted to go to a quiet and nice place. A kind lady told him to go uptown. There he found a beautiful park and felt relaxed. **一个年轻人在城市里迷路了。他想去一个安静美好的地方。一位善良的女士告诉他去住宅区。在那里他发现了一个美丽的公园，感到很放松。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I saw an upturned boat. It was as if it had been tossed by a big wave. The bottom of the boat faced upwards, showing its worn-out surface. This strange sight made me remember the word \'upturned\'. **有一天，在森林里散步时，我看到一艘翻过来的船。就好像被大浪掀翻了一样。船底朝上，露出了它破旧的表面。这个奇怪的景象让我记住了"upturned（朝上的；翻转的）"这个单词。**

> A little bird wanted to reach the stars. It flew upward constantly, passing through clouds and facing strong winds. Finally, it got closer to its dream. Remember, \'upward\' means moving in an upward direction. **一只小鸟想要够到星星。它不断地向上飞，穿过云层，迎着强风。最终，它离梦想更近了。记住，\'upward\'意思是向上的方向。**

> A little bird wanted to reach the stars. It flew upwards and upwards, passing through the clouds. Finally, it got close to its dream. \'Upwards\' means moving in an upward direction. **一只小鸟想要够到星星。它向上飞啊飞，穿过云层。最终，它接近了梦想。'upwards'意思是向上的方向移动。**
> 想象一下，在一个神秘的实验室里，科学家们正在努力研究一种强大的物质。他们最终发现了一种能释放巨大能量的金属，它被命名为\'uranium\'（铀），就像宇宙中神秘而强大的力量。 **想象一下，在一个神秘的实验室里，科学家们正在努力研究一种强大的物质。他们最终发现了一种能释放巨大能量的金属，它被命名为"铀"，就像宇宙中神秘而强大的力量。**

> A little mouse named Jerry lived in an urban area. He always got lost among the tall buildings and busy streets. But he learned that \'urban\' means a place full of people and buildings. **一只叫杰瑞的小老鼠生活在城市地区。它总是在高楼大厦和繁忙的街道中迷路。但它知道了\'urban\'指的是充满人和建筑物的地方。**

> In a small village, people started building more houses and roads. Factories and shops appeared. This process of the village becoming like a city is called urbanization. **在一个小村庄里，人们开始建造更多的房屋和道路。工厂和商店出现了。这个村庄变得像城市的过程就叫做城市化。**

> A poor urchin was wandering in the cold street. He had messy hair and torn clothes. But his eyes shone with hope. One day, a kind lady helped him, changing his life. > A man was lost in the forest. He felt a strong urge to find the way out. He kept walking, driven by this urge, until he finally saw a path. The urge inside him saved his life. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。他有一种强烈的冲动想要找到出路。在这种冲动的驱使下，他一直走，直到最后看到了一条小路。他内心的冲动救了他的命。**

> A man was running in the street with urgency. He needed to catch the last train to see his sick mother. His heart was pounding, knowing time was of the essence. **一个男人急匆匆地在街上跑。他得赶上最后一班火车去看他生病的母亲。他的心怦怦直跳，深知时间紧迫。**

> One day, a man got a call saying his family member was in urgent need of medical help. He rushed to the hospital immediately. The word \'urgent\' means something that requires immediate action or attention. **有一天，一个男人接到电话说他的家庭成员急需医疗救助。他立刻冲向医院。单词"urgent"意思是需要立即行动或关注的事情。**

> One day, a little girl was lost in a big city. Her parents needed to find her urgently. They called the police and everyone started searching right away. \'Urgently\' means with great haste and importance. **有一天，一个小女孩在大城市里走失了。她的父母急需找到她。他们报了警，所有人立刻开始寻找。'urgently'意思是非常匆忙且重要地。**
> 想象一下，有个小怪兽总是在你的泌尿系统里捣乱，导致你出现 urinary 问题。你得赶紧打败小怪兽，才能让泌尿系统恢复正常。所以 urinary 就是和尿、泌尿有关的意思。 **想象一个有关泌尿系统的故事来辅助记忆'urinary'这个单词，意思是尿的；泌尿的**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry and needed to urinate. He looked everywhere for a toilet. Finally, he found one and felt relieved. Remember, \'urinate\' means to pass water or pee. **有一天，汤姆很着急，需要小便。他到处找厕所。最后，他找到了一个，感觉松了一口气。记住，'urinate'意思是排尿、小便。**

> A doctor was testing a patient\'s urine. The patient was nervous but the doctor said, \'Don\'t worry. Urine is just a liquid that tells us about your health.\' **一位医生正在检测一位病人的尿液。病人很紧张，但医生说：'别担心。尿液只是一种能告诉我们你健康状况的液体。'**

> In a mysterious old house, there was a beautiful urn placed on a high shelf. One day, a curious child climbed up and carefully examined the urn. It was an elegant container with a long history. **在一座神秘的老房子里，有一个漂亮的瓮放在高高的架子上。有一天，一个好奇的孩子爬上去仔细查看这个瓮。它是一个有着悠久历史的精美容器。**
> 想象我们（us）一起去旅行，在美丽的海边玩耍。我捡贝壳，你堆沙堡，大家都非常开心。这个'us'就是指'我们'，代表着一起参与的所有人。 **想象我们一起旅行，在海边玩耍的场景来记住'us'表示'我们'**

> Once upon a time, a traveler found a cave. Inside, there was a toolbox with some tools. To his delight, all the tools were usable and helped him build a shelter. He was very grateful for these usable items. **从前，一位旅行者发现了一个洞穴。在里面，有一个工具箱，里面有些工具。令他高兴的是，所有的工具都可用，帮助他建造了一个庇护所。他非常感激这些可用的物品。**

> One day, a little boy was confused about the \'usage\' of a new toy. His father patiently showed him how to play with it. The boy finally understood and had fun. \'Usage\' means the way something is used. **一天，一个小男孩对一个新玩具的"用法"感到困惑。他的父亲耐心地给他展示如何玩。男孩最终明白了并且玩得很开心。'usage'意思是某物的使用方式。**

> One day, a little boy wanted to draw. He found a pen and USED it to create a beautiful picture. He was so happy because he knew how to USE things to achieve his goal. **一天，一个小男孩想要画画。他找到了一支笔并使用它创作了一幅美丽的画。他非常高兴，因为他知道如何使用东西来达成自己的目标。**

> One day, I found an old bike in the garage. It was used by my father many years ago. He rode it to work every day. Now, although it\'s not new, it still holds precious memories. **有一天，我在车库里发现一辆旧自行车。它是我父亲多年前用过的。他每天骑着它去上班。现在，尽管它不新了，但仍承载着珍贵的回忆。**

> One day, Tom was lost in the forest. Luckily, he found a useful map that guided him out. The map was so helpful that it made his dangerous situation much easier. Without it, Tom might have been stuck there forever. **一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。幸运的是，他找到了一张有用的地图，指引他走了出来。这张地图非常有帮助，让他危险的处境轻松了许多。没有它，汤姆可能会永远被困在那里。**

> A man tried to fix his broken car all day but his efforts were useless. No matter what he did, the car still wouldn\'t start. It made him very frustrated. **一个男人一整天都试图修理他坏掉的汽车，但他的努力是无用的。无论他做什么，汽车仍然无法启动。这让他非常沮丧。**
> 想象一下，有一个神秘的世界，里面有各种各样的门。每扇门都需要一个特殊的'钥匙'才能打开，这个'钥匙'就是'user'。它代表着使用者，只有正确的使用者才能开启对应的门，获得里面的宝藏。 **想象有个神秘世界，门需要'user'即使用者这把特殊'钥匙'才能开，从而获得宝藏。**
> 在一个盛大的音乐会上，门口有一位尽职尽责的工作人员 usher，他热情地引导观众找到座位。他的工作就像灯塔，为人们指明方向，让大家顺利入场享受音乐。 **在音乐会上引导观众就座的工作人员；引导，领引**

> One day, Tom went to school as usual. But this time, he found a strange key on the way. It was not a usual thing for him. Usually, his way to school was quite normal. **一天，汤姆像往常一样去上学。但这次，他在路上发现了一把奇怪的钥匙。这对他来说不是寻常的事。通常，他上学的路都很平常。**

> One day, a little boy was always late for school. His teacher asked why. The boy said, \'I usually get up late.\' From then on, he tried to change and be on time. Usually means most of the time or habitually. **一天，一个小男孩总是上学迟到。他的老师问为什么。男孩说：'我通常起床晚。' 从那以后，他努力改变并准时。Usually 意思是大多数时候或习惯地。**

> Once upon a time, a bad king tried to usurp the throne that wasn\'t rightfully his. He used unfair means to take power. But in the end, justice prevailed and he was punished. Remember, usurp means to seize power illegally. **从前，有个坏国王试图篡夺不属于他的王位。他使用不公平的手段夺取权力。但最终，正义获胜，他受到了惩罚。记住，usurp 意思是非法篡夺。**

> One day, a little boy was helping his mom in the kitchen. He saw many tools like spoons, forks and knives. His mom told him these are all utensils. The boy remembered this word easily. **有一天，一个小男孩在厨房帮妈妈。他看到很多工具，像勺子、叉子和刀子。他妈妈告诉他这些都是餐具。这个男孩很容易就记住了'utensil'这个词。**

> A beautiful princess was often in pain. The doctor found the problem was in her uterine. It was like a hidden castle with troubles. Finally, with the right treatment, the princess felt better. **一位美丽的公主经常感到疼痛。医生发现问题出在她的子宫。它就像一座有麻烦的隐藏城堡。最后，经过正确的治疗，公主感觉好多了。**

> A woman was very worried about her health. The doctor told her to take care of her uterus. The uterus is like a special room in a woman\'s body where babies grow. So it\'s very important! **一位女士很担心自己的健康。医生告诉她要照顾好子宫。子宫就像女性身体里一个特殊的房间，宝宝在里面成长。所以它非常重要！**

> Imagine a city where everything is designed for maximum practical use. No fancy decorations, just simple and useful. This city represents the idea of \'utilitarian\'. > One day, a city suffered a power outage. But the utility company worked hard to restore power quickly. They showed their usefulness in providing essential services. \'Utility\' means something useful or serving a practical purpose. **有一天，一座城市停电了。但公用事业公司努力迅速恢复供电。他们展现了在提供基本服务方面的有用性。\'utility\'意思是有用的东西或有实际用途的。**

> A factory was in trouble because of low utilization of its machines. But a smart engineer found a way to improve it. Now the factory operates smoothly, making full utilization of resources. **一家工厂因为机器利用率低而陷入困境。但一位聪明的工程师找到了改进的方法。现在工厂运行顺畅，充分利用了资源。**

> A scientist was in a tough situation. But he utilized all the resources available to solve the problem and made a great discovery. Remember, utilize means to make use of something. **一位科学家陷入了艰难的境地。但他利用了所有可用的资源来解决问题，并取得了重大发现。记住，utilize 意思是利用某物。**

> A brave knight was on a quest to find the utmost treasure. He faced many challenges but never gave up. Finally, he reached the hidden cave and found the precious gem, which was of the greatest value. **一位勇敢的骑士在寻找最珍贵的宝藏。他面临诸多挑战但从未放弃。最终，他到达了隐藏的洞穴，找到了那颗价值极高的宝石。**
> 曾经有个冒险家，一直在寻找一个完美之地。历经千辛万苦，他终于发现了一个叫 utopia 的地方，那里没有纷争，人人幸福快乐。他感叹这就是他梦想中的理想国。 **曾经有个冒险家一直在寻找一个叫'乌托邦'的完美之地，那里没有纷争，人人幸福快乐，他感叹这就是他梦想中的理想国。**

> A group of friends decided to build a community. They had many beautiful and ideal plans, like no pollution and everyone being happy. But these ideas were too perfect and not practical. Their dream was utopian. **一群朋友决定建立一个社区。他们有很多美好且理想化的计划，比如没有污染且人人都快乐。但这些想法太完美而不切实际。他们的梦想是乌托邦式的。**
> 想象一下，在一个安静的图书馆里，突然有人大声'utter'（说出）了一个秘密，所有人都被惊到了。这个人完全没有保留，毫无顾忌地把秘密说了出来。 **想象在图书馆有人毫无保留地说出秘密来辅助记忆'utter'这个单词，意思是说出、表达**
> 想象一下，在一个魔法森林里，小精灵们每次开口说话，发出的声音都被称为 utterance。有一天，一个小精灵勇敢地做出了重要的 utterance，拯救了森林。 **想象在魔法森林中，小精灵们每次开口发声被称为 utterance。某天，一小精灵勇敢发声拯救了森林。**

> 想象一个空荡荡的房子，里面什么家具都没有，房间显得很空荡。这个空荡的房子就像单词\'vacant\'所表达的意思，没有被占用，是空的。 **想象一个空房子来辅助理解\'vacant\'（空的；未被占用的）这个单词**
> 想象一个租客接到通知，必须马上离开（vacate）他现在租的房子。因为房东要重新装修，所以租客赶紧收拾东西走人。 **想象一个租客接到通知必须离开他所租的房子的情景来辅助记忆【vacate】这个单词，意为腾出，空出，撤离**

> 想象一下，在一个古老的城堡里，所有的东西都被神秘力量吸走了，房间里形成了一片真空（vacuum）。没有灰尘，没有杂物，只有空荡荡的空间。这就是vacuum，真空、空白的意思。 **想象在古老城堡中，所有东西被吸走形成的真空状态，以此记住vacuum意为真空、空白。**

> 想象一个科学家在实验室里努力验证（validate）他的新理论。他进行了无数次实验，收集数据，最终成功证明了理论的正确性，得到了同行的认可。 **想象一位科学家努力验证他的新理论的故事**

> A scientist was working hard to prove the validity of a new theory. After many experiments and data analyses, he finally got the solid evidence, making his theory accepted. > A brave knight showed great valor when he single-handedly fought off a group of bandits to protect the villagers. His fearless act was a true display of valor. **一位勇敢的骑士在独自击退一群强盗以保护村民时展现出了巨大的英勇。他无畏的行为是英勇的真实展现。**

> A thief broke into a house but found nothing valuable. Just as he was about to leave, he saw a small box. To his disappointment, it only contained old photos, which had great sentimental value for the owner. **一个小偷闯进一所房子，但没发现任何有价值的东西。就在他准备离开时，他看到一个小盒子。令他失望的是，里面只有旧照片，而这些照片对主人有很大的情感价值。**

> A young entrepreneur was seeking a valuation for his startup. He was nervous but hopeful. The experts carefully analyzed and finally gave a fair valuation that made him jump with joy. > A poor man found a treasure chest. He knew the jewels inside had great value. But he didn\'t keep them for himself. Instead, he sold them and used the money to help others. **一个穷人发现了一个宝箱。他知道里面的珠宝有很大的价值。但他没有据为己有。相反，他卖掉了它们并用这笔钱去帮助别人。**

> Once upon a time, a poor artist\'s paintings were not valued. But one day, a collector discovered his talent and his works became highly valued. The artist finally felt recognized and happy. **从前，一位贫穷艺术家的画作不被重视。但有一天，一位收藏家发现了他的才华，他的作品变得备受珍视。艺术家终于感到被认可和开心。**

> One day, Tom was in a factory. He saw a strange device that controlled the flow of liquid. The worker told him it was a \'valve\'. By opening or closing the valve, the liquid flow could be managed. **有一天，汤姆在一家工厂里。他看到一个控制液体流动的奇怪装置。工人告诉他这是一个"阀门"。通过打开或关闭阀门，可以管理液体的流动。**

> A young adventurer climbed to the top of a mountain. Standing there, he had a vantage point and could see the beautiful landscape far away. It was a wonderful place that gave him a clear view. **一位年轻的冒险家爬上了山顶。站在那里，他有一个有利位置，能够看到远处美丽的风景。这是一个能让他视野清晰的绝妙之处。**

> A strange virus appeared, causing many variant symptoms. Some people had high fevers, while others experienced severe coughs. Scientists worked hard to study these variant effects to find a cure. **一种奇怪的病毒出现了，导致了许多变异的症状。有些人发高烧，而另一些人则经历了严重的咳嗽。科学家们努力研究这些变异的影响以找到治疗方法。**

> A king had many treasures. One day, he noticed a variation in the number of jewels. Some were missing. After an investigation, it was found that a thief had stolen them, causing this change. **一位国王拥有许多财宝。有一天，他注意到珠宝的数量有变化。一些不见了。经过调查，发现是一个小偷偷走了它们，导致了这种改变。**

> A young artist showed great versatility. He could paint beautiful landscapes, play various musical instruments, and even act in plays. His versatility made him stand out. **一位年轻的艺术家展现出了很强的多才多艺。他能够画出美丽的风景画，演奏各种乐器，甚至还能演戏。他的多才多艺使他脱颖而出。**

> A young detective was on a vigil outside the criminal\'s hideout. He stayed awake and alert all night, not missing a single movement. Finally, he caught the criminal. Remember, \'vigil\' means staying awake and watchful. **一位年轻的侦探在罪犯的藏身处外守夜。他整晚都保持清醒和警觉，不放过任何一个动静。最后，他抓住了罪犯。记住，\'vigil\'意思是守夜；监视**

> A spy needed constant vigilance. One night, while lurking in the shadows, he heard a strange noise. His vigilance made him hide deeper. Thanks to his alertness, he avoided being caught. **一名间谍需要时刻保持警惕。一天晚上，当他潜伏在阴影中时，听到了一个奇怪的声音。他的警惕性让他藏得更深了。多亏了他的警觉，他才避免被抓住。**

> One night, a thief tried to break into a house. But the owner was vigilant. He heard a strange sound and immediately called the police. Thanks to his vigilance, the thief was caught. **一天晚上，一个小偷试图闯入一所房子。但是房子的主人很警觉。他听到一个奇怪的声音，马上就报了警。多亏了他的警觉，小偷被抓住了。**

> One night, a thief broke into a house. But a mysterious figure, the vigilante, appeared. He was always on the lookout for crimes and protected the neighborhood. The vigilante caught the thief and brought peace back. **一天晚上，一个小偷闯入了一所房子。但出现了一个神秘人物，即治安维持者，他总是留意犯罪行为并保护着这片街区。这位治安维持者抓住了小偷，让这里恢复了平静。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的小镇，有一位画家坐在街边，专注地绘制着一幅小插画vignette。画面上是一个美丽的花园角落，充满了细腻的色彩和温馨的氛围，这小小的插画吸引了众多路人的目光。 **想象在古老小镇，画家绘制吸引人的小插画来辅助记忆 vignette（小插图；小花饰）**

> A tired athlete was struggling in a race. But when he drank a special potion, he felt full of vigor. He ran fast and won the game. Vigor means strength and energy! **一位疲惫的运动员在比赛中举步维艰。但当他喝了一种特殊的药水后，感到充满了活力。他跑得飞快并赢得了比赛。vigor 意思是精力；活力；元气**

> A young athlete was training vigorously every day. He ran, jumped and lifted weights with great energy. His vigorous efforts finally paid off when he won the championship. **一位年轻的运动员每天都在充满活力地训练。他跑步、跳跃、举重，精力充沛。他的有力努力最终得到了回报，他赢得了冠军。**

> A little rabbit was running vigorously in the forest to escape from a hungry wolf. It used all its strength and moved quickly. Finally, it found a safe cave and survived. **一只小兔子在森林里奋力地跑以躲避一只饥饿的狼。它用尽全身力气，快速移动。最终，它找到了一个安全的洞穴并活了下来。**

> A witch in a dark forest cast a vile spell. The smell was bad and the effect was horrible. It made everything around ugly and unpleasant. Remember, \'vile\' means extremely bad or unpleasant. **在一个黑暗的森林里，一个女巫施了一个邪恶的咒语。气味难闻，效果可怕。它让周围的一切都变得丑陋和令人不快。记住，\'vile\'意思是极其恶劣或令人不快的。**

> A mean witch would constantly vilify the kind princess in front of the villagers. The princess was sad but remained strong. Remember, to vilify means to say or write bad and false things about someone. **一个邪恶的女巫会不断地在村民面前诋毁善良的公主。公主很伤心但依然坚强。记住，vilify 意思是说或写关于某人的坏话和不实之词。**

> A rich man was tired of city life. So he bought a beautiful villa by the sea. There were colorful flowers and a big swimming pool. He enjoyed his peaceful time there. **一个富人厌倦了城市生活。于是他在海边买了一栋漂亮的别墅。那里有五颜六色的花和一个大游泳池。他在那里享受着宁静的时光。**

> A long time ago, a young man got lost in the forest. After walking for a while, he saw a village. The houses were cute and people were friendly. He felt so relieved and knew he was safe. **很久以前，一个年轻人在森林里迷路了。走了一会儿后，他看到了一个村庄。房子很可爱，人们很友好。他感到如释重负，知道自己安全了。**

> In a peaceful village, there was a kind villager named Tom. He always helped others with their farm work. One day, a storm came, and Tom helped everyone protect their houses. Everyone loved him. **在一个宁静的村庄里，有一个善良的村民叫汤姆。他总是帮助其他人干农活。有一天，一场暴风雨来临，汤姆帮助每个人保护他们的房子。每个人都爱他。**

> In a quiet village, a mysterious man appeared. He always caused trouble, stealing and bullying others. Everyone was afraid of him. Later, people found out he was the villain who had escaped from prison. **在一个宁静的村庄里，出现了一个神秘的人。他总是惹麻烦，偷窃和欺负别人。大家都很怕他。后来，人们发现他是从监狱逃出来的坏蛋。**

> A chef was making a special salad. He mixed vinegar and oil carefully to create a delicious vinaigrette. The vinaigrette made the salad taste amazing and everyone loved it. **一位厨师正在制作一份特别的沙拉。他仔细地将醋和油混合，制成了美味的油醋汁。这种油醋汁让沙拉味道绝佳，每个人都喜欢。**

> A detective was wrongly accused of a crime. But through his persistent efforts and gathering of evidence, he finally vindicated himself and proved his innocence. **一位侦探被错误地指控犯罪。但通过他坚持不懈的努力和证据收集，他最终为自己洗清了罪名，证明了自己的清白。**

> A detective was wrongly accused of a crime. But through his persistent efforts and gathering of evidence, he finally achieved vindication and proved his innocence. People began to believe in him again. **一位侦探被错误地指控犯罪。但通过他坚持不懈的努力和证据收集，他最终获得了辩白，证明了自己的清白。人们又开始相信他了。**

> A man was wrongly accused and fired from his job. He became vindictive and spent all his time planning revenge. But in the end, his hatred only hurt himself. **一个男人被错误指控并被解雇了。他变得心怀报复，把所有时间都花在策划复仇上。但最后，他的仇恨只伤害了自己。**

> Once upon a time, a little monkey climbed up a tall tree. It saw many beautiful vines hanging from the branches. The vines were like green ropes, twisting and turning. The monkey had a great time playing with the vines. **从前，一只小猴子爬上了一棵高大的树。它看到许多漂亮的藤条从树枝上垂下来。这些藤条就像绿色的绳子，弯弯曲曲。猴子和藤条玩得很开心。**

> One day, Tom was making a salad. But the taste was not right. Then he realized he forgot to add vinegar. With a few drops of vinegar, the salad became delicious. Remember, vinegar can make food better! **有一天，汤姆在做沙拉。但味道不对。然后他意识到自己忘了加醋。滴了几滴醋后，沙拉变得美味了。记住，醋能让食物更好！**

> A young couple decided to have a picnic in a beautiful vineyard. They walked among the rows of grapevines, breathing the sweet smell. The vineyard was full of hope and joy, just like their love. **一对年轻的夫妇决定在一个美丽的葡萄园里野餐。他们在一排排葡萄藤间漫步，呼吸着甜蜜的气息。这个葡萄园充满了希望和欢乐，就像他们的爱情一样。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个古老的酒窖，看到一瓶标注着\'Vintage\'的葡萄酒。这瓶酒来自特定的、优质的年份，代表着独特与珍贵。就像这个单词，形容优质、经典且有特定年份的东西。 **想象走进酒窖看到标有\'vintage\'的葡萄酒，代表特定优质年份的珍贵物品，以此辅助记忆\'vintage\'意为优质的、特定年份的、经典的**

> One day, I went to a music store and saw many records made of vinyl. I was curious and asked the clerk. He explained that vinyl is a special material used for making records to produce great sounds. > A thief violated the law by breaking into a house. The police caught him quickly. Remember, when you violate the rules, there will be consequences. **一个小偷闯入一所房子，违反了法律。警察很快抓住了他。记住，当你违反规则时，就会有后果。**

> One day, a man was driving too fast and got a ticket. His speeding was a violation of traffic rules. The police pointed out that such behavior could cause danger. Remember, violation means breaking a rule or law. **有一天，一个男人开车太快收到了一张罚单。他的超速行为违反了交通规则。警察指出这种行为可能会造成危险。记住，violation 意思是违反规则或法律。**

> One night, a thief sneaked into a house. He broke the law and was a violator. The police came quickly and caught him. Remember, a violator is someone who breaks the rules or the law. **一天晚上，一个小偷潜入一所房子。他违法了，是个违法者。警察很快赶来并抓住了他。记住，violator 就是违反规则或法律的人。**

> A thief broke into a house with violence. He kicked the door hard and scared the owner. But the police came quickly and stopped his violence. Remember, violence is bad and illegal. **一个小偷暴力闯入一所房子。他用力踢门，吓到了主人。但警察很快赶来并制止了他的暴力行为。记住，暴力是不好且违法的。**

> A thief broke into a house. He was very violent and started destroying things. The owner was scared but called the police in time. Finally, the violent thief was caught. **一个小偷闯进了一所房子。他非常暴力，开始破坏东西。房子的主人很害怕但及时报了警。最后，这个暴力的小偷被抓住了。**

> One day, a little boy saw a fierce storm. The wind blew violently, knocking down trees. The rain fell violently, making rivers rise. It was a very scary scene. **有一天，一个小男孩看到了一场猛烈的暴风雨。风猛烈地吹着，把树都吹倒了。雨猛烈地下着，使得河水上涨。这是一个非常可怕的场景。**
> 在一个神秘的花园里，有一朵独特的花，它的颜色深深吸引了人们。大家都不知道它叫什么，后来一位智者说这是 violet 花，它的紫色如此迷人，就像夜空中闪烁的神秘星光。 **在一个神秘的花园里，有一朵独特的被称为 violet 的花，它的紫色很迷人，像夜空中的神秘星光。**

> A little mouse dreamed of playing a beautiful violin. One day, it found a violin in a big house. It learned hard and finally played wonderful music. The mouse and the violin became good friends. **一只小老鼠梦想弹奏一把漂亮的小提琴。有一天，它在一个大房子里发现了一把小提琴。它努力学习，最终演奏出了美妙的音乐。小老鼠和小提琴成为了好朋友。**

> One day, a little girl saw a beautiful violin and decided to become a violinist. She practiced hard every day, facing difficulties but never giving up. Finally, her dream came true and she played wonderful music. **有一天，一个小女孩看到了一把漂亮的小提琴，决定成为一名小提琴手。她每天都刻苦练习，面对困难从不放弃。最终，她的梦想成真，演奏出了美妙的音乐。**

> One day, a funny video about a talking cat went viral on the Internet. Everyone was sharing it and it spread like a wildfire. The word \'viral\' means becoming very popular and spreading quickly. **有一天，一个关于会说话的猫的有趣视频在互联网上疯传。每个人都在分享它，就像野火一样蔓延开来。单词\'viral\'意思是变得非常流行并迅速传播。**

> A young girl dreams of exploring the world but remains a virgin to its wonders. One day, she takes a brave step and discovers new places. Virgin here means untouched or inexperienced. **一个年轻女孩梦想着探索世界，但对其奇妙之处仍一无所知。有一天，她勇敢地迈出一步，发现了新的地方。这里的virgin意思是未接触过的或没有经验的。**

> A brave knight always showed virtue in battles. He was kind to the weak, honest in his words, and brave in the face of danger. His virtue made him a hero. People praised his virtue and followed his example. **一位勇敢的骑士在战斗中总是展现出美德。他对弱者友善，言语诚实，面对危险勇敢。他的美德使他成为英雄。人们称赞他的美德并以他为榜样。**

> A young musician dreams of becoming a virtuoso. He practices day and night. Finally, at a grand concert, his amazing skills make everyone amazed. He truly becomes a master of music. **一位年轻的音乐家梦想成为一名艺术大师。他日夜练习。最终，在一场盛大的音乐会上，他惊人的技艺让所有人惊叹。他真正成为了音乐大师。**

> A young girl always helped the elderly and took care of stray animals. Everyone praised her as virtuous. She showed kindness and morality in every action, making the world a better place. **一个年轻女孩总是帮助老人和照顾流浪动物。大家都称赞她品德高尚。她在每一个行动中都展现出善良和道德，让世界变得更美好。**

> A scientist was studying a virus. It was so virulent that it could spread rapidly and cause severe illness. Just a tiny amount could make many people very sick. Remember, virulent means extremely harmful or infectious. **一位科学家正在研究一种病毒。它毒性很强，能够迅速传播并导致严重疾病。仅仅一点点就能让很多人生病。记住，virulent 意思是极其有害或具有传染性的。**

> One day, a little scientist was studying in the lab. Suddenly, he found a strange thing called \'virus\'. It was so tiny but could cause big problems. The virus was like a naughty monster, making people sick. **有一天，一位小科学家在实验室里研究。突然，他发现了一种叫做\'病毒\'的奇怪东西。它非常小，但却能引发大问题。病毒就像一个顽皮的怪物，让人患病。**
> 想象你要去一个美丽的外国旅行，但是没有 visa（签证）就无法入境。你焦急地在机场等待，直到拿到签证，才开心地开启了旅程。所以 visa 就是你出国的'通行证'。 **想象你要去国外旅行，没有签证无法入境，拿到签证才能开心启程，所以 visa 是签证，是出国的通行证。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. When he finally reached the mysterious castle, he saw a ghostly visage in the window. It was a pale and scary face that made his heart race. But he gathered his courage and moved on. **一位勇敢的骑士正在进行探索。当他最终到达神秘的城堡时，他在窗户里看到了一张幽灵般的面容。那是一张苍白可怕的脸，让他心跳加速。但他鼓起勇气继续前进。**

> A brave warrior felt a visceral fear when facing a huge monster. But his visceral courage made him charge forward. The feeling was deep inside, not just in his mind. **一位勇敢的战士在面对一只巨大的怪物时，感到了一种发自内心的恐惧。但他内心深处的勇气又使他向前冲去。这种感觉是发自肺腑的，而不仅仅停留在脑海中。**

> One day, a little bird was lost in the fog. It couldn\'t find its way home because of poor visibility. But when the fog cleared and visibility improved, it finally saw the familiar path and flew back happily. **有一天，一只小鸟在雾中迷路了。由于能见度差，它找不到回家的路。但当雾散去，能见度提高时，它终于看到了熟悉的道路，开心地飞了回去。**

> A thief tried to steal at night but was caught because the moonlight made him visible. The police easily saw him and arrested him. So, visible means able to be seen. **一个小偷试图在晚上行窃，但被抓住了，因为月光让他暴露无遗。警察很容易就看到了他并逮捕了他。所以，visible 意思是能被看见的。**

> A thief was stealing in the market. When the police showed up, he was visibly nervous. His hands were shaking and his eyes kept looking around. Visibly here means clearly and obviously seen. **一个小偷正在市场里偷东西。当警察出现时，他明显地很紧张。他的手在颤抖，眼睛不停地四处张望。这里的'visibly'意思是清晰可见地、明显地。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark cave. Just when he felt hopeless, he had a vision of a bright light guiding him out. The vision gave him hope and he finally found the exit. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗的洞穴中迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，他看到了一道明亮的光指引他出去的幻象。这个幻象给了他希望，最终他找到了出口。**

> A young artist had a visionary dream of creating a masterpiece that would change the art world. He saw vivid images in his mind and worked hard to make it real. His visionary idea made him famous. **一位年轻的艺术家做了一个有远见的梦，要创作一幅能改变艺术界的杰作。他在脑海中看到了生动的画面，并努力使之成为现实。他的远见卓识让他成名。**

> One day, a little girl named Lily was very happy because her friend Tom came to visit her. They played games and had a great time together. The word \'visit\' means to go and see someone or some place. **有一天，一个叫莉莉的小女孩非常开心，因为她的朋友汤姆来看望她了。他们一起玩游戏，度过了一段美好的时光。单词\'visit\'意思是去看望某人或某地。**

> One day, a king decided to make a visitation to a small village. When he arrived, everyone was excited. The king\'s visitation brought hope and joy. It was a memorable event for the villagers. **一天，一位国王决定去一个小村庄视察。当他到达时，每个人都很兴奋。国王的视察带来了希望和欢乐。对村民们来说，这是一个难忘的事件。**

> One day, a little girl was very excited because her grandparents were visiting. She cleaned the room and prepared snacks. When they arrived, it was a wonderful time of sharing and love. **一天，一个小女孩非常兴奋，因为她的祖父母要来拜访。她打扫房间并准备了零食。当他们到达时，这是一段充满分享和爱的美好时光。**

> One day, a strange man came to our town. Everyone was curious about him. Later we knew he was a visitor who traveled around to experience different places. He brought new stories and made our town more lively. **有一天，一个陌生的男人来到了我们的小镇。每个人都对他感到好奇。后来我们知道他是一个游客，到处旅行以体验不同的地方。他带来了新的故事，让我们的小镇更热闹了。**

> A knight was going to a battle. But the sun was too bright. Luckily, he found a visor in his bag and put it on his helmet to protect his eyes. With the visor, he could see clearly and fought bravely. **一位骑士正要去战斗。但阳光太刺眼了。幸运的是，他在包里找到了一个帽舌，并把它装在头盔上以保护眼睛。有了帽舌，他能看得清楚并英勇作战。**

> I was lost in the forest and felt hopeless. Suddenly, I caught a vista of a small village in the distance. It was like a ray of hope, guiding me out of the confusion. **我在森林里迷路了，感到很绝望。突然，我看到了远处一个小村庄的景色。这就像一束希望之光，指引我走出了困惑。**

> A painter was always seeking the perfect visual effect. One day, he saw a beautiful rainbow and was deeply inspired. He realized that \'visual\' means what we see and how it affects us. **一位画家总是在寻求完美的视觉效果。有一天，他看到了一道美丽的彩虹深受启发。他意识到\'visual\'这个词意味着我们所看到的以及它对我们的影响。**

> One day, a little artist was trying to create a beautiful picture in his mind. He imagined every detail, the colors, the shapes. This process was like \'visualization\', making what was in his mind visible. **有一天，一位小艺术家试图在脑海中创作一幅美丽的图画。他想象着每一个细节，颜色、形状。这个过程就像'形象化；可视化'，让脑海中的东西变得可见。**

> I closed my eyes and tried to visualize a beautiful beach. I saw the clear blue sky, the golden sand, and the waves crashing on the shore. With this image in my mind, I understood the meaning of \'visualize\' - to form a mental image. **我闭上眼睛，试图想象一个美丽的海滩。我看到了湛蓝的天空、金黄的沙子和拍打着海岸的海浪。通过脑海中的这幅画面，我理解了'visualize'这个词的意思------在脑海中形成一个图像。**

> A painter was visually impaired but still had a strong passion for art. He relied on touch and imagination to create amazing paintings. \'Visually\' here means related to seeing or by sight. **一位画家视力受损，但仍对艺术充满热情。他依靠触觉和想象创作出令人惊叹的画作。'visually'在这里指的是与看或视觉有关。**

> A doctor was in a race against time to save a patient\'s life. The vital medicine was stuck in traffic. But luckily, a kind driver delivered it just in time. Without it, the patient\'s life would be at risk. **一位医生在争分夺秒地挽救一位病人的生命。至关重要的药物却被堵在路上。但幸运的是，一位好心的司机及时送达了。没有它，病人的生命就会有危险。**

> A young athlete was constantly losing competitions. One day, a wise coach told him to find his inner vitality. The athlete started training with passion and energy, and finally won with his regained vitality. **一位年轻的运动员不断输掉比赛。有一天，一位睿智的教练告诉他要找到内心的活力。运动员带着激情和能量开始训练，最终凭借重新找回的活力赢得了比赛。**

> A man was lost in the desert and extremely thirsty. Just when he was about to give up, he found an oasis. Water there was vitally important for his survival. It saved his life. **一个人在沙漠中迷路了，极度口渴。就在他快要放弃的时候，他发现了一片绿洲。那里的水对他的生存至关重要。水救了他的命。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was always weak and ill. A doctor told him to take \'vitamin\' pills every day. After that, he became strong and healthy. So, vitamin is like a magic key to good health. **从前，有个小男孩总是体弱多病。一位医生告诉他每天服用"维生素"片。之后，他变得强壮又健康。所以，维生素就像是通往健康的神奇钥匙。**

> I once saw a vivid painting at an art exhibition. The colors were so bright and the scene was so real that it felt like the people in the painting could come alive. \'Vivid\' means full of life and bright, just like that painting. **我曾在一个艺术展览上看到一幅生动的画。颜色非常鲜艳，场景非常逼真，感觉画中的人都能活过来。'vivid'意思是充满生机和鲜艳的，就像那幅画一样。**
