> I was walking in the forest and saw a vividly colored butterfly. Its wings were so bright and beautiful that it left a deep impression on me. \'Vividly\' means in a very clear and bright way. **我在森林里散步，看到一只色彩鲜艳的蝴蝶。它的翅膀如此明亮美丽，给我留下了深刻的印象。\'vividly\'意思是以非常清晰和鲜明的方式。**
> 小明梦想成为作家，他知道丰富的词汇(vocabulary)是关键。于是每天努力背诵单词，积累词汇。终于，他的作品因用词精准优美而备受称赞。 **小明梦想成为作家，他明白丰富的词汇是关键。于是每天努力背单词积累词汇。最终他的作品因用词精准优美获赞。**

> A bird was singing vocal songs in the forest. Everyone was attracted by its beautiful and loud voice. The word \'vocal\' means relating to or produced by the voice. So when you hear a vocal performance, it\'s all about the voice. **一只鸟在森林里高声歌唱。大家都被它美妙响亮的声音吸引。单词\'vocal\'意思是和声音有关的或者由声音产生的。所以当你听到声乐表演时，这都和声音有关。**

> A young girl dreamed of becoming a great vocalist. She practiced singing every day. One day, she got a chance to perform on a big stage. Her beautiful voice made her a famous vocalist. **一个年轻女孩梦想成为一名伟大的歌手。她每天都练习唱歌。有一天，她得到了在一个大舞台上表演的机会。她美妙的嗓音使她成为了著名的歌手。**

> A young man was confused about his future. One day, he had a dream. In the dream, an angel told him to follow his heart and find his vocation. When he woke up, he started to explore different fields and finally found his true calling as a painter. **一个年轻人对自己的未来感到迷茫。有一天，他做了个梦。在梦里，一位天使告诉他要跟随自己的内心，找到自己的职业。当他醒来后，他开始探索不同的领域，最终发现自己真正的使命是成为一名画家。**

> Once upon a time, a student was confused about choosing a vocational path. But after visiting various vocational schools and talking to experts, he finally found his direction. Vocational means related to a particular occupation or job. **从前，有个学生对选择职业道路感到困惑。但在参观了各种职业学校并与专家交谈后，他终于找到了方向。vocational 意思是与特定职业或工作有关的。**

> One day, a traveler was very cold. A kind local gave him a glass of vodka to warm him up. The traveler felt the strong and special taste and never forgot this drink. Vodka became his unforgettable memory. **有一天，一位旅行者感到非常寒冷。一位善良的当地人给了他一杯伏特加让他暖和起来。旅行者感受到了其强烈而特别的味道，永远忘不了这种酒。伏特加成了他难忘的回忆。**

> A young designer dreams of creating a dress that catches the vogue. She works hard, using unique fabrics and styles. Finally, her dress becomes the trend and leads the vogue in the fashion world. **一位年轻的设计师梦想设计出一件引领时尚潮流的裙子。她努力工作，使用独特的面料和款式。最终，她的裙子成为了潮流，引领了时尚界的风尚。**

> One day, a little bird lost its voice. It couldn\'t sing beautifully anymore. But with the help of a kind fairy, it regained its voice and filled the forest with lovely songs again. **有一天，一只小鸟失去了它的声音。它再也不能美妙地歌唱了。但在一位善良仙女的帮助下，它重新获得了声音，再次让森林充满了动听的歌声。**
> 想象你在一个神秘的城堡中，发现了一间空荡荡的房间，什么都没有，这种'空无一物'的状态就是\'void\'。就好像你满心期待，打开门却发现里面是一片空白，什么都不存在。 **想象在城堡中发现空无一物的房间来理解\'void\'表示空的、无效的、缺乏的意思**
> 想象一个脾气不稳定的小精灵，它的情绪就像 volatile 这个词一样。一会儿开心地飞舞，一会儿愤怒地喷火。它的状态变化迅速且难以预测，就像 volatile 所表示的'不稳定的；易变的'。 **想象一个脾气不稳定的小精灵来辅助记忆'volatile（不稳定的；易变的）'这个单词**

> A wild horse, known for its volatility, would suddenly gallop away without warning. Just like the market\'s price changes, full of volatility. It means the state of being unstable and unpredictable. **一匹以反复无常著称的野马，会毫无预兆地突然飞奔而去。就像市场的价格变化，充满了波动。这个单词意思是不稳定和不可预测的状态。**

> A brave scientist was exploring a volcanic area. Suddenly, hot lava started flowing. But with his knowledge, he escaped safely. Volcanic means related to a volcano and its activities. **一位勇敢的科学家正在探索火山地区。突然，滚烫的岩浆开始流淌。但凭借他的知识，他安全逃脱了。volcanic 意思是与火山及其活动有关的。**

> One day, a brave explorer was hiking. Suddenly, he heard a loud rumble and saw smoke rising. It was a volcano! The lava was boiling inside, ready to burst. The explorer ran away quickly. **有一天，一位勇敢的探险家正在徒步旅行。突然，他听到一阵巨大的隆隆声，看到有烟升起。原来是一座火山！岩浆在里面沸腾，随时可能喷发。探险家迅速跑开了。**

> A vole was running in the field. It was small but very fast. One day, it found a big carrot and was so happy. Remember, vole is a kind of small animal like this. **一只田鼠在田野里奔跑。它很小但速度非常快。有一天，它找到了一个大胡萝卜，高兴极了。记住，vole 就是像这样的一种小动物。**

> In a football game, the striker made a powerful shot. The ball flew in the air like an arrow, and it was a perfect volley. The crowd cheered loudly. **在一场足球比赛中，前锋大力射门。球像箭一样在空中飞起，这是一记完美的凌空抽射。人群大声欢呼。**

> One day, I went to the beach and saw a group of people playing a fun game. They were hitting a ball over a net. It was volleyball! The players were jumping and having a great time. **有一天，我去海滩看到一群人在玩一个有趣的游戏。他们把球打过网。这就是排球！球员们跳来跳去，玩得很开心。**

> One day, a scientist was working on an experiment. The key to success was the \'voltage\' of the electricity. If it was too low or too high, the experiment would fail. Finally, he adjusted the voltage perfectly and achieved great results. **有一天，一位科学家正在进行一项实验。成功的关键在于电的"电压"。如果电压太低或太高，实验就会失败。最后，他完美地调整了电压，并取得了巨大的成果。**
> 想象一下，你走进一个巨大的图书馆，里面堆满了一本本厚厚的书。这些书的数量和厚度加起来就代表了'volume'，也就是体积、容量和数量。比如书架上满满的书，展现出了巨大的 volume。 **想象在图书馆中，书的数量和厚度代表'volume'，即体积、容量和数量。比如满架的书展现出很大的'volume'。**

> A princess wore a voluminous dress to the ball. The dress was so big and full that it filled the entire carriage. \'Voluminous\' means large in volume or size, like this huge dress. **一位公主穿着一件宽大的裙子去参加舞会。这条裙子非常大且饱满，以至于占满了整个马车。\'voluminous\'意思是体积大或尺寸大，就像这条巨大的裙子。**

> One day, Tom voluntarily offered to help his neighbor fix the broken fence. He did it without being asked because he wanted to be kind. Voluntarily means doing something of your own free will and not because you are forced or told to. **一天，汤姆自愿提出帮邻居修理坏掉的栅栏。他主动这么做，没人要求他，因为他想善良待人。Voluntarily 意思是出于自己的自由意志做某事，不是因为被迫或被要求。**

> A young man decided to do voluntary work in a remote village. He taught children for free, feeling happy and fulfilled. His choice was voluntary, out of pure kindness and a desire to help. **一个年轻人决定在一个偏远的村庄做志愿工作。他免费教孩子们，感到快乐和满足。他的选择是自愿的，出于纯粹的善良和帮助他人的愿望。**

> One day, in a small town, a fire broke out. Many people rushed to help. Among them, Tom was a volunteer. He didn\'t get paid but did it out of kindness. His action showed the spirit of volunteer. **有一天，在一个小镇上发生了火灾。许多人赶来帮忙。其中，汤姆是一名志愿者。他没有报酬，只是出于善良去做。他的行为展现了志愿者的精神。**

> A fairy in the forest was known for her voluptuous figure. She danced gracefully, and her curves were like the soft waves of a river. People were charmed by her beauty. Voluptuous means having large, shapely and attractive curves. **森林里有一个仙女，以她丰满迷人的身材而闻名。她优雅地跳舞，她的曲线就像河流的柔波。人们都被她的美丽所吸引。voluptuous 意思是具有丰满的、曲线优美迷人的身形。**

> One day, Tom ate too much junk food and felt very sick. Suddenly, he couldn\'t hold it anymore and began to vomit. The unpleasant scene made him realize the importance of a healthy diet. **有一天，汤姆吃了太多垃圾食品，感觉非常难受。突然，他忍不住开始呕吐。这令人不适的场景让他意识到健康饮食的重要性。**

> A traveler ventured into a mysterious jungle. There, he heard tales of voodoo magic. People said it could control minds. But he remained skeptical. Voodoo seemed like a strange and scary power. **一位旅行者冒险进入神秘的丛林。在那里，他听到了有关巫毒魔法的故事。人们说它可以控制思想。但他仍然持怀疑态度。巫毒似乎是一种奇怪又可怕的力量。**

> A hungry monster had a voracious appetite. It ate everything in sight, never getting full. Its voracious eating habits made people scared. But finally, it learned to control and became a friendly creature. **一只饥饿的怪兽有着贪婪的食欲。它看到什么就吃什么，永远吃不饱。它贪婪的饮食习惯让人们感到害怕。但最后，它学会了控制，变成了一只友好的生物。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, a powerful wind pulled him into a vortex. It was like a wild dance, swirling him around. But he held on and finally escaped. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗森林中迷路了。突然，一阵强风将他卷入一个漩涡。这就像一场疯狂的舞蹈，把他不停地旋转。但他坚持住，最终逃脱了。**

> In a small village, the mayor election was coming. Everyone was excited to vote. Tom carefully chose the candidate he thought could make the village better. Finally, the result was announced based on people\'s votes. **在一个小村庄，市长选举即将到来。每个人都兴奋地去投票。汤姆仔细地选择了他认为能让村庄变得更好的候选人。最后，根据人们的投票公布了结果。**

> One day, in a small town, there was an important election. Everyone was excited. Tom was a voter. He carefully thought and made his choice. His vote could change the town\'s future. **一天，在一个小镇上有一场重要的选举。每个人都很兴奋。汤姆是一名选民。他认真思考后做出了选择。他的选票可能会改变小镇的未来。**

> In a small town, the voting day arrived. Everyone was excited to choose their favorite candidate. People queued up at the polling stations, carefully marking their choices. The voting was a way to express their opinions and decide the future of the town. **在一个小镇上，投票日到了。每个人都很兴奋地选择他们最喜欢的候选人。人们在投票站排队，仔细地做出选择。投票是他们表达意见和决定小镇未来的一种方式。**

> One day, my friend vouched for me when I needed a loan. He guaranteed that I would pay it back. It was like he was giving a strong promise and taking responsibility for my credibility. So, to vouch means to give a guarantee or a promise. **有一天，当我需要贷款时，我的朋友为我担保。他保证我会还钱。这就像是他给出了一个强有力的承诺，并为我的信誉负责。所以，vouch 这个单词意思是担保、保证、证明。**

> A traveler was lost in a strange city. Luckily, he got a voucher from a kind local, which allowed him to stay in a nice hotel and have a delicious meal. The voucher was like a magic key to solve his problems. **一位旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。幸运的是，他从一位善良的当地人那里得到了一张代金券，这张券让他能够入住一家不错的酒店并享用美味的一餐。这张代金券就像一把神奇的钥匙，解决了他的难题。**

> A prince made a vow to rescue the princess from the evil witch. He promised to never give up and finally fulfilled his vow. The princess was saved and they lived happily ever after. **一位王子发誓要从邪恶的女巫手中救出公主。他承诺永不放弃，最终实现了他的誓言。公主得救了，他们从此过上了幸福的生活。**

> A little bird was singing a beautiful song. The special sounds it made were like vowels. These vowels made the song charming and easy to remember. Just like in our language, vowels give words their melody. **一只小鸟正在唱一首美妙的歌。它发出的特别声音就像元音。这些元音让这首歌富有魅力且容易记住。就像在我们的语言中，元音赋予单词旋律。**

> A brave sailor set off on a voyage. He faced strong winds and huge waves but never gave up. Finally, he reached a beautiful island. His voyage was full of challenges but also wonderful experiences. **一位勇敢的水手出发去航海。他遭遇了强风和巨浪，但从未放弃。最终，他到达了一个美丽的岛屿。他的航行充满了挑战，但也有美妙的经历。**

> In a fierce football match, Team A vs Team B. The players fought hard, and the score was close. \'vs\' here shows the confrontation and competition between the two teams. **在一场激烈的足球比赛中，A 队对阵 B 队。球员们奋力拼搏，比分接近。'vs'在这里表示两队之间的对抗和竞争。**

> A young artist was criticized for his vulgar paintings. People said they were too common and lacked elegance. But he didn\'t give up and finally changed his style to win praise. Remember, vulgar means lacking refinement or good taste. **一位年轻的艺术家因其粗俗的画作而受到批评。人们说它们太普通且缺乏高雅。但他没有放弃，最终改变风格赢得了赞誉。记住，vulgar 意思是缺乏优雅或良好品味。**

> A knight was on a quest but had a vulnerability - a weak spot in his armor. Enemies found it and he was in danger. This weakness is like \'vulnerability\', meaning the state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed. **一位骑士在执行任务，但他有一个弱点------盔甲上的薄弱点。敌人发现了，他陷入危险。这个弱点就像\'vulnerability\'，意思是处于可能受到攻击或伤害的状态。**

> A little bird with a broken wing was very vulnerable. It couldn\'t fly and was easily attacked by other animals. Just like someone who is weak and unprotected, this is what \'vulnerable\' means. **一只翅膀折断的小鸟非常脆弱。它无法飞翔，很容易受到其他动物的攻击。就像那些弱小且无保护的人，这就是'vulnerable'的意思。**

> In the vast desert, a traveler was lost and weak. Suddenly, a vulture appeared in the sky, circling above. It seemed to sense the traveler\'s vulnerability, waiting for a possible tragic end. But the traveler found his way out and the vulture flew away disappointed. **在广袤的沙漠中，一位旅行者迷路且虚弱。突然，一只秃鹫出现在天空中，盘旋在上空。它似乎感觉到旅行者的脆弱，等待着可能的悲惨结局。但旅行者找到了出路，秃鹫失望地飞走了。**

> One day, I saw a man wearing a wacky hat with colorful feathers. He danced in a strange way, making everyone laugh. His wacky style was unforgettable. **有一天，我看到一个男人戴着一顶有着彩色羽毛的古怪帽子。他以一种奇怪的方式跳舞，让每个人都大笑。他那古怪的风格令人难以忘怀。**

> Imagine a thief stuffing a lot of money into a small bag. The bag becomes a wad of cash. He holds it tightly, afraid someone will notice. Now you remember \'wad\' means a small compact mass or bundle. **想象一个小偷把很多钱塞进一个小袋子里。这个袋子就变成了一沓现金。他紧紧地握着它，害怕有人会注意到。现在你记住'wad'意思是一小团或一叠。**

> A duck named Lily was very cute. She always waddled when walking. One day, she waddled along the river and met a fish. The fish laughed at her funny way of walking. But Lily didn\'t care and kept waddling happily. **一只叫莉莉的鸭子非常可爱。她走路时总是摇摇摆摆。有一天，她沿着河边摇摇摆摆地走，遇到了一条鱼。鱼嘲笑她走路滑稽的样子。但莉莉不在乎，仍然快乐地摇摇摆摆走着。**
> 想象一下，一个勇敢的探险家在一条水流湍急的河中艰难前行，他努力地'wade'（跋涉），水没过了膝盖，但他毫不退缩。最终成功到达彼岸。 **想象一下，一个勇敢的探险家在水流中艰难地跋涉，水没过膝盖但他不退缩，最终成功到达对岸。**

> A little mouse was very hungry. It found a wafer in a corner of the kitchen. The wafer was so delicious that the mouse ate it quickly and felt very happy. **一只小老鼠非常饿。它在厨房的一个角落里发现了一块威化饼。这块威化饼太美味了，老鼠很快就把它吃了，感到非常开心。**

> One day, Tom was at a fair and saw a vendor selling waffles. The waffles looked so delicious with their square patterns. Tom bought one and enjoyed its sweet taste. From then on, whenever he thought of waffles, he remembered that happy day. **有一天，汤姆在集市上看到一个小贩在卖华夫饼。华夫饼有着方形的图案，看起来十分美味。汤姆买了一个，享受着它的香甜味道。从那以后，每当他想到华夫饼，就会想起那快乐的一天。**

> One day, I was sitting by the sea. A gentle breeze wafted the smell of flowers to me. It was like a magic hand carrying the fragrance. I closed my eyes and enjoyed the pleasant waft. **一天，我坐在海边。一阵微风把花的香味吹拂到我这里。它就像一只神奇的手带着香气。我闭上眼睛，享受着这宜人的吹拂。**
> A dog was wagging its tail happily when its owner came home. The wagging tail showed how excited the dog was to see its master. **一只狗在主人回家时欢快地摇着尾巴。摇着的尾巴显示出狗见到主人是多么兴奋。**

> A hardworking man named Tom was always concerned about his wage. One day, he got a raise and was very happy. He realized that his efforts finally paid off and his wage reflected his value. **一位名叫汤姆的勤奋男子总是很关心他的工资。有一天，他涨薪了，非常高兴。他意识到自己的努力终于有了回报，他的工资反映了他的价值。**

> One day, Tom saw a horse race and decided to make a wager. He bet all his savings on a horse named Lightning. Luckily, Lightning won and Tom got a big reward. From then on, he knew a wager could bring great risks or huge gains. **有一天，汤姆看到一场赛马，决定下注。他把所有的积蓄都押在了一匹叫闪电的马上。幸运的是，闪电赢了，汤姆得到了一大笔奖励。从那以后，他知道了打赌可能带来巨大风险或丰厚回报。**

> A poor farmer was pulling a heavy wagon full of fruits to the market. The wheels of the wagon creaked, but he kept going, hoping to sell the fruits for a good price. **一个贫穷的农民正拉着一辆装满水果的沉重货车去市场。货车的轮子嘎吱作响，但他继续前进，希望能把水果卖个好价钱。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. She wailed loudly for help. Her voice was full of fear and sadness. Finally, a kind hunter heard her wail and found her. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她大声哭号着求救。她的声音充满了恐惧和悲伤。最后，一位善良的猎人听到了她的哭号并找到了她。**

> A thief wanted to steal a precious belt. But the owner caught him by holding his waist. The thief struggled but couldn\'t escape. Remember, waist is the part around the middle of your body. **一个小偷想要偷一条珍贵的腰带。但是主人抓住了他的腰。小偷挣扎但无法逃脱。记住，waist 就是身体中部周围的部位。**

> One day, Tom was getting dressed and struggled to fasten his waistband. He realized it was too tight because he had eaten too many cakes. He decided to do more exercise to fit into it easily. **一天，汤姆在穿衣服时，系他的腰带很费劲。他意识到腰带太紧了，因为他吃了太多蛋糕。他决定多做运动，以便轻松系上它。**

> One day, Tom was at the bus stop. The bus was late. He had to wait for a long time. But he was patient and kept looking at his watch. Finally, the bus came and he could go home. **一天，汤姆在公交站。公交车晚点了。他不得不等很长时间。但他很有耐心，一直看着手表。最后，公交车来了，他可以回家了。**

> One day, I went to a restaurant. When I needed help, a friendly man came quickly. He was the waiter. He took my order and served me food with a smile. I remembered the word \'waiter\' because of his nice service. **有一天，我去了一家餐厅。当我需要帮助时，一个友好的人很快就来了。他就是服务员。他为我点菜，并微笑着为我上菜。因为他贴心的服务，我记住了'waiter'这个单词。**

> A little girl was waiting at the bus stop. She was very anxious because she was going to visit her grandma. After a long time, the bus finally came. The waiting was over and she happily got on the bus. **一个小女孩在公交站等待。她非常焦急，因为她要去看望奶奶。过了很久，公交车终于来了。等待结束，她开心地上了车。**

> One day, I went to a restaurant. A kind and friendly girl named Lily was our waitress. She was very patient, waiting on us and taking our orders. Her smile made our meal even better. Remember, waitress is the lady who serves in a restaurant. **有一天，我去了一家餐厅。一个友善的女孩叫莉莉，她是我们的女服务员。她非常有耐心，等着为我们服务并记录我们点的餐。她的微笑让我们这顿饭吃得更开心。记住，waitress 就是在餐厅服务的女士。**
> A poor student was unable to pay the tuition. The kind principal decided to waive the fee. The student was very grateful and promised to study hard. **一个贫困学生无法支付学费。善良的校长决定免除这笔费用。这个学生非常感激，并承诺努力学习。**

> A man was in a difficult situation and needed help. But he signed a waiver, giving up his right to certain benefits. Later, he regretted it. Remember, waiver means to give up a right or claim voluntarily. **一个男人处境艰难需要帮助。但他签署了弃权书，自愿放弃了某些权益。后来，他后悔了。记住，waiver 意思是自愿放弃权利或要求。**

> One day, a little bird was sleeping peacefully in its nest. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and woke it up. The bird opened its eyes, stretched its wings, and started a new day. Remember, \'wake\' means to stop sleeping. **有一天，一只小鸟在巢里安静地睡着。突然，一阵强风吹来把它弄醒了。小鸟睁开眼睛，伸展翅膀，开始了新的一天。记住，'wake'意思是醒来、弄醒。**

> One day, a little dog was very happy. It decided to walk around the park. It walked along the path, seeing beautiful flowers and friendly birds. The walk made the dog feel wonderful. **有一天，一只小狗非常开心。它决定去公园散步。它沿着小路走，看到了美丽的花朵和友好的鸟儿。这次散步让小狗感觉棒极了。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in the forest. A mysterious walker appeared and guided him safely back home. The walker wore a big hat and carried a stick, looking very experienced. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。一位神秘的步行者出现，并将他安全地引导回家。这位步行者戴着一顶大帽子，拿着一根手杖，看起来经验丰富。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a forest. He started walking and walking, hoping to find his way home. He walked through the tall trees and across the small streams. Finally, he saw a familiar path and was saved. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他开始不停地走啊走，希望能找到回家的路。他走过高大的树木，穿过小小的溪流。最后，他看到了一条熟悉的小路，得救了。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a big park. He found a special path called a walkway. It led him safely out. The walkway was like a friendly guide. From then on, Tom never forgot what a walkway was. **有一天，汤姆在一个大公园里迷路了。他发现了一条特殊的路径叫做步道。它引导他安全地走了出去。这条步道就像一位友好的向导。从那以后，汤姆再也没有忘记什么是步道。**

> A mouse was running along the wall. Suddenly, it saw a big cat on the other side. The mouse was scared and quickly hid. The wall protected the mouse from the cat. **一只老鼠沿着墙跑。突然，它看到墙另一边有一只大猫。老鼠很害怕，迅速躲起来。墙保护了老鼠免受猫的伤害。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to catch the bus. But when he reached into his pocket, he found his wallet was missing. He panicked and searched everywhere. Finally, he found it on the sofa at home. What a relief! **有一天，汤姆匆忙赶公交。但当他把手伸进口袋时，发现他的钱包不见了。他惊慌失措，到处找。最后，他在家里的沙发上找到了。真是松了一口气！**

> One day, Tom went fishing and caught a strange fish. Its eyes were very big and protruded, just like a wall. Later, he learned that this kind of fish was called a walleye. **一天，汤姆去钓鱼，钓到了一条奇怪的鱼。它的眼睛非常大且突出，就像一堵墙。后来，他得知这种鱼叫做 walleye（大眼鲥鱼）。**
> 一只小猪在泥坑里 wallow，滚来滚去，身上沾满了泥巴。它快乐地享受着，完全不在乎自己变得脏兮兮。后来它被主人发现，赶紧跑回了猪圈。 **一只小猪在泥坑中打滚、沉溺，这里的wallow就是（在泥水中）打滚、沉溺的意思。**

> One day, I was redecorating my room. I chose a beautiful pattern to be the wallpaper. It covered the walls and made the room look so nice. I was very happy with my choice of wallpaper. **有一天，我在重新装饰我的房间。我选了一个漂亮的图案当作壁纸。它覆盖了墙面，让房间看起来非常好看。我对自己选的壁纸非常满意。**

> One day, a little squirrel found a big walnut. It struggled to crack it open. Finally, it enjoyed the delicious walnut meat. Remember, walnut is this hard-shelled nut! **有一天，一只小松鼠发现了一个大核桃。它努力地想把它弄开。最后，它享用到了美味的核桃肉。记住，walnut 就是这种有硬壳的坚果！**
> A fairy named Wan had a pale face because she spent too much time in the dark cave. Her wan complexion made others worried. **有个叫婉的仙女，由于在黑暗洞穴里待太久，脸色苍白。她苍白的脸色让其他人很担心。**

> A young wizard was lost in a dark forest. Suddenly, a magic wand appeared in front of him. The wand glowed and led him out of the forest. With the wand, he could perform amazing spells. **一位年轻的巫师在黑暗的森林中迷路了。突然，一根魔法棒出现在他面前。这根魔杖发光并引领他走出了森林。有了这根魔杖，他能够施展神奇的法术。**

> A little boy named Tom loved to wander in the forest. One day, he got lost but kept walking aimlessly. Finally, with the help of a kind ranger, he found his way home. \'Wander\' means to walk around without a definite destination. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩喜欢在森林里闲逛。有一天，他迷路了，但仍漫无目的地走着。最后，在一位好心的护林员的帮助下，他找到了回家的路。\'wander\'意思是漫步，闲逛，没有明确的目的地。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who loved to walk aimlessly. He was a wanderer. He traveled through mountains and valleys, seeing different sceneries. His heart was full of curiosity and the desire for adventure. **从前，有一个喜欢漫无目的地行走的人。他是个流浪者。他穿越山川峡谷，见识不同的风景。他的心中充满了好奇和对冒险的渴望。**

> A lost boy was wandering in the forest. He didn\'t know where to go and felt very scared. But finally, he found a way out and was safe. Remember, wandering means moving around without a definite destination. **一个迷路的男孩在森林里徘徊。他不知道该往哪儿走，感到非常害怕。但最后，他找到了出路，安全了。记住，wandering 意思是没有明确目的地四处走动。**
> 月亮姑娘 waned 了，她原本圆润的脸蛋慢慢变小。就像我们的热情，如果不持续保持，也会像月亮一样 waned 减弱。 **月亮姑娘变亏了，她原本圆润的脸蛋慢慢变小。就像我们的热情，如果不持续保持，也会像月亮一样减弱。**

> One day, Tom saw a cool toy in a store. His eyes sparkled and he felt a strong desire. He knew he WANTED that toy very much. So, he saved his pocket money to buy it. **一天，汤姆在一家商店里看到了一个很酷的玩具。他的眼睛闪闪发光，他感到一种强烈的渴望。他知道自己非常想要那个玩具。于是，他攒起零花钱去买它。**

> A little boy was always wanting candies. But his mom said it\'s bad for teeth. So he had to control himself. \'Wanting\' means to have a desire or a lack of something. **一个小男孩总是想要糖果。但他妈妈说这对牙齿不好。所以他不得不控制自己。\'wanting\'意思是有欲望或缺少某物。**

> A naughty monkey was wanton in the zoo. It jumped around and messed up everything. The zookeeper had to scold it. Remember, \'wanton\' means naughty and unrestrained. **一只顽皮的猴子在动物园里肆意妄为。它到处乱跳，把一切都弄乱了。动物园管理员不得不训斥它。记住，\'wanton\'意思是顽皮和放肆的。**

> In a faraway land, two kingdoms were at war. Soldiers fought fiercely, with cannons booming and swords clashing. It was a terrifying scene of chaos and destruction. Remember, \'war\' means intense conflict and fighting. **在一片遥远的土地上，两个王国处于战争状态。士兵们激烈地战斗，大炮轰鸣，剑刃交锋。这是一片可怕的混乱和破坏的景象。记住，\'war\'意思是激烈的冲突和战斗。**

> A brave knight was assigned to guard a special ward in the castle. The ward was full of precious treasures. The knight stood firm, protecting it from any intruders. **一位勇敢的骑士被指派守卫城堡里的一个特殊区域。这个区域满是珍贵的财宝。骑士坚定地站岗，保护它免受任何入侵者的侵犯。**

> In a mysterious forest, there was a warden. He protected the animals and plants, making sure no one caused harm. One day, a lost traveler appeared, and the warden guided him safely out. The warden was a hero of the forest. **在一片神秘的森林里，有一位管理员。他保护着动植物，确保无人造成伤害。有一天，一位迷路的旅行者出现了，管理员将他安全地引导出去。管理员是这片森林的英雄。**

> One day, Alice was looking for her favorite dress in the wardrobe. She opened its big doors and found all kinds of clothes neatly placed. The wardrobe was like a magical closet full of surprises. **一天，爱丽丝在衣柜里找她最喜欢的裙子。她打开衣柜的大柜门，发现各种各样的衣服整齐摆放着。这个衣柜就像一个充满惊喜的神奇衣橱。**

> A thief wanted to steal valuable goods. He broke into a big building called a warehouse. But the security was too tight and he was caught. Remember, warehouse is where goods are stored safely. **一个小偷想偷贵重物品。他闯进了一个叫做仓库的大建筑。但安保太严，他被抓住了。记住，warehouse 就是安全存放货物的地方。**

> In a distant land, two kingdoms were constantly at warfare. Soldiers fought fiercely, using all kinds of weapons. The sound of battle and the smoke filled the air. \'Warfare\' means the activities and ways of fighting in a war. **在一片遥远的土地上，两个王国不断处于战争状态。士兵们激烈战斗，使用各种武器。战斗的声音和硝烟弥漫在空中。\'warfare\'意思是战争中的活动和作战方式。**

> In a fictional world, a brave soldier was on a mission to stop a missile. The key was to disable the warhead. He risked his life and finally succeeded, saving countless people. The warhead was the dangerous explosive part of the missile. **在一个虚构的世界里，一位勇敢的士兵执行阻止一枚导弹的任务。关键是使弹头失效。他冒着生命危险最终成功了，拯救了无数人。弹头是导弹中危险的爆炸部分。**

> A thief was warily approaching the house. He moved slowly and carefully, constantly looking around to make sure no one was watching. Finally, he entered the house warily. **一个小偷小心翼翼地靠近房子。他缓慢且谨慎地移动，不停地四处张望以确保没人在看。最后，他小心翼翼地进了房子。**

> In a distant land, there was a powerful man named Jack. He commanded a huge army and controlled many regions. People called him the warlord. He was feared but also respected for his military might. **在一片遥远的土地上，有个叫杰克的强大人物。他指挥着庞大的军队，控制着许多地区。人们称他为军阀。他因军事力量令人畏惧但也受人尊敬。**

> One cold winter day, a little bird was shivering. Then, the sun came out and shone brightly, making everything warm. The bird felt so happy and chirped joyfully. Now you know \'warm\' means not cold and giving a pleasant feeling. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一只小鸟冻得瑟瑟发抖。然后，太阳出来了，明亮地照耀着，让一切都变得温暖。小鸟感到非常开心，欢快地鸣叫着。现在你知道\'warm\'就是不冷并且给人愉快感觉的意思。**

> One cold winter day, I was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a kind old man found me and welcomed me warmly into his cabin. His smile and the warm fire made me feel so comfortable and safe. **在一个寒冷的冬日，我在森林里迷路了。突然，一位善良的老人发现了我，并热情地把我迎进他的小屋。他的笑容和温暖的炉火让我感到非常舒适和安全。**

> One cold winter night, I was lost in the forest. Suddenly, I found a small cabin with a fireplace. The fire gave off warmth that made me feel safe and cozy. I finally understood the meaning of \'warmth\' - it\'s the comforting heat in the cold. **一个寒冷的冬夜，我在森林里迷路了。突然，我发现了一个带有壁炉的小木屋。火散发的温暖让我感到安全和舒适。我终于明白了'warmth'的意思------它是寒冷中的令人安慰的热度。**

> One day, a little boy was about to touch a hot stove. His mother quickly came and warned him, \'Don\'t touch it, or you\'ll get hurt!\' The boy understood and stayed away. So, \'warn\' means to tell someone about possible danger. **一天，一个小男孩正要去摸一个热炉子。他妈妈迅速过来警告他：'别碰它，否则你会受伤的！'男孩明白了并远离了。所以，'warn'意思是告诉某人可能的危险。**

> One day, Tom was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a bird chirped loudly as a warning. It seemed to tell Tom that a storm was coming. Tom understood and quickly ran home. **一天，汤姆在森林里玩耍。突然，一只鸟大声鸣叫作为警告。它似乎在告诉汤姆暴风雨要来了。汤姆明白了，迅速跑回家。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. He found a magical portal that warped him to a strange land. There, time and space were distorted. But his courage didn\'t warp. He fought bravely and found his way back. **一位勇敢的骑士正在探险。他发现了一个神奇的传送门，这个传送门使他扭曲到了一个陌生的地方。在那里，时间和空间都扭曲了。但他的勇气没有扭曲。他勇敢战斗，找到了回去的路。**

> In a fierce battle, our soldiers were in danger. Suddenly, a warplane appeared in the sky. It was like a savior, ready to strike the enemy and protect us. The warplane was our hope and strength. **在一场激烈的战斗中，我们的士兵处于危险之中。突然，天空中出现了一架战机。它就像救星一样，准备打击敌人并保护我们。这架战机是我们的希望和力量。**

> A thief was caught stealing, but the police needed a warrant to search his house. Finally, they got the warrant and found the stolen goods. The warrant gave them the legal right to do the search. **一个小偷被抓到偷东西，但警察需要一张搜查令才能搜查他的房子。最后，他们拿到了搜查令并找到了赃物。搜查令给了他们进行搜查的合法权利。**

> One day, I bought a new computer. The seller promised a warranty for two years. If anything went wrong within that time, they would fix it for free. So, warranty means a guarantee or promise. **有一天，我买了一台新电脑。卖家承诺保修两年。在这段时间内如果出了任何问题，他们会免费维修。所以，warranty 意思是保证或承诺。**

> In a faraway land, there were two kingdoms constantly at war. The people were always in fear. This state of continuous fighting was described as \'warring\'. **在一个遥远的地方，有两个王国一直在打仗。人民总是处于恐惧之中。这种持续战斗的状态被描述为\'warring（交战的；敌对的）\'。**

> In a distant land, a brave warrior named Leo fought against evil forces. He wore strong armor and held a sharp sword, never backing down. His courage and skills made him a hero. Remember, a warrior is a brave fighter like Leo. **在一片遥远的土地上，有一位勇敢的战士叫利奥。他与邪恶势力战斗，身着坚固的盔甲，手持锋利的剑，从不退缩。他的勇气和技能使他成为英雄。记住，warrior 就是像利奥这样勇敢的战士。**

> In a fierce battle at sea, a brave captain commanded a powerful warship. The warship had huge cannons and was ready to defend the country. It was like a warrior on the waves, fearless and strong. **在一场激烈的海上战斗中，一位勇敢的船长指挥着一艘强大的军舰。这艘军舰有着巨大的火炮，准备保卫国家。它就像浪涛中的勇士，无畏且强大。**

> Once upon a time, a frog had a wart on its back. It was ugly and made the frog feel sad. But then a fairy came and removed the wart with her magic. The frog was happy again. Remember, \'wart\' is like that ugly bump. **从前，一只青蛙的背上长了一个疣。它很丑，让青蛙感到难过。但后来一位仙女来了，用她的魔法去除了疣。青蛙又开心了。记住，\'wart\' 就是那样的丑疙瘩。**

> In the wartime, a brave soldier named Tom was always ready to defend his country. He fought bravely and never gave up. His spirit inspired everyone. Remember, \'wartime\' means a period when a war is being fought. **在战时，一位名叫汤姆的勇敢士兵总是准备好保卫他的国家。他英勇作战，从不放弃。他的精神鼓舞了每个人。记住，'wartime'意思是战争正在进行的时期。**

> One day, a little rabbit was in the forest. It saw a strange shadow and became wary. It stopped moving and carefully observed. It was ready to run away if it was in danger. Finally, it found it was just a fallen tree branch and felt relieved. **一天，一只小兔子在森林里。它看到一个奇怪的影子，变得小心谨慎起来。它停止移动，仔细观察。如果有危险，它准备逃跑。最后，它发现只是一根倒下的树枝，松了口气。**

> One day, Tom was very dirty after playing in the mud. His mother said, \'Tom, go and wash yourself!\' So Tom went to the bathroom and turned on the tap to wash away the dirt. **一天，汤姆在泥地里玩后变得非常脏。他的妈妈说：'汤姆，去洗干净！'于是汤姆去了浴室，打开水龙头把身上的脏东西洗掉。**

> One day, little Tom was playing in the bathroom. He got his hands dirty and needed to clean them. So, he reached for the washcloth and used it to make his hands clean and fresh again. **一天，小汤姆在浴室里玩耍。他的手弄脏了，需要清洁。于是，他伸手拿了毛巾并使用它让自己的手再次变得干净和清爽。**
> One day, Tom was very tired after playing football. He took a bath and all his dirty clothes were washed. Now he felt clean and fresh. **一天，汤姆踢完足球后非常累。他洗了个澡，所有脏衣服都被洗了。现在他感觉干净又清爽。**
> One day, the sink was leaking. Tom found that the washer was broken. He quickly replaced it and stopped the leak. The washer saved the day! **有一天，水槽漏水了。汤姆发现垫圈坏了。他迅速更换了它，止住了漏水。垫圈解决了大问题！**

> One day, Tom was very tired after a long walk. When he got home, he saw a big pile of dirty clothes. So, he started the washing machine and did the washing. Soon, the clothes became clean and fresh. **一天，汤姆走了很长的路后非常累。当他到家时，他看到一大堆脏衣服。于是，他启动了洗衣机并洗衣服。很快，衣服变得干净又清新。**

> A king was very wasteful. He threw away a lot of food and wasted precious resources. One day, his kingdom faced a shortage. Then he realized the harm of waste. **一位国王非常浪费。他扔掉很多食物，浪费珍贵的资源。有一天，他的王国面临物资短缺。这时他才意识到浪费的危害。**

> A rich man always throws away good food and buys new things he doesn\'t need. His behavior is wasteful. People around him are not happy and tell him to change. **一个富人总是扔掉好的食物，买他不需要的新东西。他的行为是浪费的。他周围的人不高兴，并告诉他要改变。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a vast wasteland. There was nothing but dry sand and dead trees. He struggled to find water and food, realizing the harshness of this desolate place. **一位勇敢的冒险家迷失在一片广袤的荒原中。那里除了干燥的沙子和枯树什么都没有。他努力寻找水和食物，意识到了这个荒凉之地的严酷。**

> Once upon a time, a factory produced a lot of dirty water. This dirty water was called wastewater. It was harmful and needed special treatment. People worked hard to clean it and protect the environment. **从前，一家工厂产生了很多脏水。这种脏水被称为废水。它是有害的，需要特殊处理。人们努力去净化它以保护环境。**

> One day, I lost my way in a strange city. A kind man watched me looking confused and came to help. He watched as I followed his directions and finally found my destination. I\'ll always remember his watchful eyes. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。一个善良的人看到我一脸困惑，就过来帮忙。他看着我按照他的指示走，最后我找到了目的地。我会永远记得他警惕的目光。**

> A group of bad guys were planning to steal money. But a brave dog was always watching and guarding. People called this dog a \'watchdog\' because it protected them. So, \'watchdog\' means a person or thing that guards or monitors. **一群坏人正计划偷钱。但是一只勇敢的狗一直在看守和守卫。人们称这只狗为"watchdog"，因为它保护着他们。所以，"watchdog"意思是监督人或监督物。**

> One night, a thief sneaked into a house. But he didn\'t know there was a watcher hidden in the dark. The watcher saw everything and called the police. The thief was caught. So, a watcher is someone who keeps watch or observes carefully. **一天晚上，一个小偷潜入一所房子。但他不知道黑暗中有一个看守者。看守者看到了一切并报了警。小偷被抓住了。所以，watcher 就是看守、观察者的意思。**

> A thief was lurking around the neighborhood. But the watchful neighbors noticed his strange behavior and called the police. They were always watchful to keep the community safe. **一个小偷在小区附近潜伏。但是警惕的邻居们注意到了他奇怪的行为并报了警。他们总是保持警觉以维护社区的安全。**

> One hot day, a little boy was very thirsty. He ran to the tap and turned it on, and the clear water flowed out. He drank the water happily and felt refreshed. Water is so important for us! **在一个炎热的日子里，一个小男孩非常口渴。他跑到水龙头前打开它，清澈的水流出。他高兴地喝了水，感觉神清气爽。水对我们太重要了！**

> One day, I went to a park. There was an artist using water to mix colors and creating beautiful paintings. I asked what it was called. The artist said, \'This is watercolor.\' **有一天，我去了一个公园。有一位艺术家用水来混合颜料并创作美丽的画作。我问这叫什么。艺术家说：'这叫水彩画。'**

> One day, a little monkey was lost in the forest. Suddenly, he heard the sound of water and followed it. He found a beautiful waterfall. The water rushed down from the high cliff, which was very spectacular. **有一天，一只小猴子在森林里迷路了。突然，他听到了水的声音并跟着它。他发现了一个美丽的瀑布。水从高高的悬崖上冲下来，非常壮观。**

> One day, while walking along a river, I saw many beautiful waterfowl. They were swimming gracefully on the water. Some were ducks, some were geese. It was such a lovely scene. **有一天，当我沿着一条河散步时，我看到了许多漂亮的水鸟。它们在水面上优雅地游着。有些是鸭子，有些是鹅。这是如此可爱的一幕。**

> A young artist was always drawn to the waterfront. He loved painting the beautiful views of the water and the ships. One day, he had a great inspiration and created a masterpiece there. The waterfront became his lucky place. **一位年轻的艺术家总是被海滨吸引。他喜欢画水和船只的美丽景色。有一天，他在那里获得了巨大的灵感，并创作了一幅杰作。海滨成了他的幸运之地。**

> One hot summer day, a little boy was watering the plants in the garden. The water from the hose made the flowers and grass very happy. \'Watering\' means giving water to something to make it grow or stay alive. **在一个炎热的夏日，一个小男孩正在花园里给植物浇水。水管里的水让花和草都很开心。\'watering\'意思是给某物浇水，让其生长或保持存活。**

> One hot summer day, a little boy was very thirsty. His mom cut a big WATERMELON for him. The juicy red flesh and black seeds made him happy. He ate a lot and felt cool and refreshed. **在一个炎热的夏日，一个小男孩非常口渴。他的妈妈为他切了一个大西瓜。多汁的红色瓜瓤和黑色的籽让他很开心。他吃了很多，感到凉爽又精神。**

> One day, I went hiking in the mountains. It suddenly started raining heavily. But my jacket was waterproof, so I stayed dry. The water couldn\'t pass through it and I was protected. I was so glad I had this waterproof jacket! **有一天，我去山里徒步。突然下起了大雨。但我的夹克是防水的，所以我保持了干爽。水无法透过它，我受到了保护。我真高兴我有这件防水夹克！**

> A young hiker was lost in the mountains. When he finally reached a high point and saw the river divide into two branches, he knew it was a watershed moment. It marked the point where his journey changed and he found the right way home. **一位年轻的徒步旅行者在山中迷路了。当他最终到达一个高点，看到河流分成两条支流时，他知道这是一个分水岭时刻。它标志着他的旅程发生了改变，他找到了回家的正确道路。**

> A little boat was lost in a waterway. It struggled to find the right direction. But finally, with the help of the stars, it reached the safe harbor. The waterway was full of adventures and mysteries. **一艘小船在航道中迷路了。它努力寻找正确的方向。但最终，在星星的帮助下，它到达了安全的港湾。这条航道充满了冒险和神秘。**

> One day, I was on a boat trip. The sea was very rough and the waves were huge. I looked at the water and saw it was watery, not calm and clear like usual. It made me feel a little scared. **有一天，我在乘船旅行。大海波涛汹涌，海浪巨大。我看着海水，发现它是水汪汪的，不像往常那样平静清澈。这让我有点害怕。**
> A sailor was on the ship. The strong wind made the sea waves very big. He held the rope tightly and shouted, \'Look at these huge waves!\' **一位水手在船上。强风使海浪变得非常大。他紧紧抓住绳子并大喊：'看这些巨大的波浪！'**
> 想象一下，在一个充满神秘的科学实验室里，光线像波浪一样舞动。科学家们努力测量这些光的'wavelength'，就像测量波浪的长度一样，最终解开了光的秘密。 **想象在科学实验室中测量像波浪一样的光线的长度来理解'波长'这个单词**
> 有个勇敢的战士在战场上，面对敌人的攻击，他的决心开始 waver 了。他一会儿想冲锋，一会儿又想退缩，就像风中晃动的蜡烛火焰。这就是 waver，犹豫不决、动摇的意思。 **有个战士在战场，面对敌人攻击，决心开始动摇，一会儿想冲一会儿想退，像风中晃动的烛火。这体现了 waver 犹豫不决、动摇的意思。**

> One day, I was walking along the beach and saw the wavy sea. The waves were rising and falling, creating beautiful patterns. Just like the wavy hair of a model on the runway. Remember \'wavy\' as the moving waves! **一天，我在海滩散步，看到了波浪起伏的大海。海浪起起伏伏，形成了美丽的图案。就像模特在T台上的波浪卷发。记住\'wavy\'就是起伏的波浪！**

> One day, I found a box of wax in the attic. It was used to polish old furniture and make them shiny. The wax was soft and smooth, just like butter. Remember, wax can be a noun for this substance or a verb meaning to increase gradually. **有一天，我在阁楼里发现了一盒蜡。它被用来给旧家具抛光，让它们变得闪亮。这蜡又软又滑，就像黄油一样。记住，wax 可以是这种物质的名词，也可以作动词表示逐渐增加。**

> One day, a little boy got lost. He was very scared. But then he remembered the way home because he had marked some trees along the road. Finally, he reached home safely. **一天，一个小男孩迷路了。他非常害怕。但随后他想起了回家的路，因为他在路上给一些树做了标记。最后，他安全到家了。**

> A traveler was walking along a long road. Tired and thirsty, he sat down by the wayside. Suddenly, he found a hidden treasure there. The wayside became a lucky place for him. **一位旅行者正沿着一条长路行走。又累又渴，他在路边坐了下来。突然，他在路边发现了一处隐藏的宝藏。路边对他来说变成了一个幸运之地。**

> A wayward child always strayed from the path home. One day, lost in a forest, he finally realized the importance of following the right way. \'Wayward\' means difficult to control or predict, just like this child\'s behavior. **一个任性的孩子总是偏离回家的路。有一天，他在森林里迷路了，终于意识到走正确道路的重要性。\'wayward\'意思是难以控制或难以预测的，就像这个孩子的行为。**
> 想象一下，我们（we）是一群勇敢的探险家，在神秘的森林中前行。大家手拉手，互相帮助，共同面对困难。因为我们（we）团结一心，所以没有什么能阻挡我们前进的脚步。 **想象一下，'我们'是一群勇敢的探险家，在神秘森林中前行。大家手拉手互相帮助，共同面对困难。因为'我们'团结一心，所以没什么能阻挡前进脚步。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. It always got tired easily and couldn\'t run fast. Because it was weak. Other animals could do many things, but the little rabbit struggled. Poor weak little rabbit! **从前，有一只小兔子。它总是很容易感到疲倦，跑不快。因为它很虚弱。其他动物能做很多事，但小兔子却很吃力。可怜的虚弱的小兔子！**

> A strong warrior was injured in a battle. The wound made his body weaken. He could no longer fight as powerfully as before. But he didn\'t give up and tried to recover his strength. **一位强壮的战士在一场战斗中受伤了。伤口使他的身体变得虚弱。他再也不能像以前那样有力地战斗了。但他没有放弃，并努力恢复力量。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Weakly. It was always very tired and had no strength to run fast. Because it was weak, it needed to eat more carrots to become strong. So, \'weakly\' means in a weak manner. **从前，有一只叫 Weakly 的小兔子。它总是很累，没有力气跑得很快。因为它很虚弱，所以需要吃更多胡萝卜来变得强壮。所以，weakly 意思是以虚弱的方式。**

> Once upon a time, a warrior was captured by the enemy. The reason? His weakness was his fear of heights, which made him fail to climb the city wall for a surprise attack. This fear was his weakness that led to his defeat. **从前，有一位战士被敌人俘虏了。原因是什么？他的弱点是恐高，这使他未能爬上城墙进行突袭。这种恐惧就是他的弱点，导致了他的失败。**

> A poor man dreamed of finding a hidden treasure chest full of wealth. One day, he followed a mysterious map and discovered it. With this wealth, he built a big house and lived happily. Remember, wealth can bring great changes. **一个穷人梦想着找到装满财富的隐藏宝箱。有一天，他依照一张神秘的地图找到了它。凭借这笔财富，他建了一座大房子，过上了幸福的生活。记住，财富可以带来巨大的改变。**

> A poor man dreamed of finding a magic cave full of treasures. One day, he followed a strange light and discovered it. After that, he became wealthy and lived a happy life. **一个穷人梦想着找到一个装满宝藏的神奇洞穴。有一天，他跟着一道奇怪的光发现了它。从那以后，他变得富有，过上了幸福的生活。**

> A baby was always crying for milk. But the mother decided to wean the baby gradually. She first gave less milk each time and introduced other foods. Finally, the baby got used to it and was weaned successfully. **一个宝宝总是哭着要奶喝。但妈妈决定逐渐给宝宝断奶。她首先每次减少喂奶量，并引入其他食物。最终，宝宝习惯了，成功断奶。**

> In a dangerous forest, a brave adventurer was attacked. But he was smart and found a hidden weapon, a sharp sword. With it, he fought off the enemies and survived. Remember, \'weapon\' is what helps us in tough times. **在一个危险的森林里，一位勇敢的冒险家遭到了攻击。但他很聪明，找到了一件隐藏的武器，一把锋利的剑。凭借它，他击退了敌人并活了下来。记住，'weapon'就是在艰难时刻帮助我们的东西。**

> In a fantasy world, a brave warrior explored a hidden cave and discovered a room filled with all kinds of weaponry. Swords, bows, and axes - it was a treasure trove of combat tools. The warrior knew this weaponry would help defend the kingdom. **在一个幻想世界里，一位勇敢的战士探索一个隐藏的洞穴，发现了一个装满各种武器装备的房间。有剑、弓和斧头 - 这是一个战斗工具的宝库。战士知道这些武器装备将有助于保卫王国。**

> One day, Mary decided to go for a long walk. She wore a beautiful dress and comfortable shoes. But after a while, the shoes started to hurt her feet. She realized that not all that is worn is perfect. **一天，玛丽决定去长距离散步。她穿着一条漂亮的裙子和舒适的鞋子。但过了一会儿，鞋子开始磨她的脚。她意识到不是所有穿在身上的东西都是完美的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mysterious wearer of a black cloak. No one knew who was under that cloak. But one day, the wind blew it aside, revealing a kind face. The wearer was a friendly wizard helping people. **从前，有一个神秘的穿着黑色斗篷的人。没人知道斗篷下是谁。但有一天，风把斗篷吹开，露出一张友善的脸。这个穿着者是一位帮助人们的友好巫师。**

> A tired traveler was walking wearily along the long road. He had been on the journey for days and his steps were slow and heavy. But he kept going, hoping to reach his destination soon. **一位疲惫的旅行者拖着沉重的步伐，疲倦地沿着漫长的道路前行。他已经走了好几天，脚步缓慢而沉重。但他仍坚持前行，希望尽快到达目的地。**

> A traveler walked for days in the hot sun. His feet hurt and he felt extremely tired. This feeling of extreme tiredness is what we call \'weariness\'. **一位旅行者在烈日下走了好几天。他的脚很疼，感到极度疲倦。这种极度疲倦的感觉就是我们所说的"weariness（疲倦；疲劳）"。**

> One day, I was walking in the park and saw a man wearing a funny hat. He was attracting everyone\'s attention. It made me remember the word \'wearing\' which means having something on your body, like clothes or accessories. **有一天，我在公园散步，看到一个男人戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。他吸引了所有人的目光。这让我记住了'wearing'这个词，意思是身上穿着或戴着某物，比如衣服或配饰。**

> A brave knight had been fighting in countless battles. His armor was damaged and he felt very weary. But he still held on, knowing that rest would come. \'Weary\' means being extremely tired. **一位勇敢的骑士一直在无数的战斗中拼杀。他的盔甲破损，感到非常疲倦。但他仍在坚持，知道休息终会到来。\'weary\'意思是极其疲倦。**

> A weasel was running in the forest. It was very smart and could sneak into small holes easily. One day, it found a hidden treasure by using its quick and sly moves. Remember, weasel means a small, sly animal. **一只黄鼠狼在森林里奔跑。它非常聪明，能够轻易地钻进小洞里。有一天，它凭借敏捷和狡猾的动作找到了一个隐藏的宝藏。记住，weasel 意思是一种小型、狡猾的动物。**

> One day, a little bird was flying in the sky. It noticed the weather changing. Clouds gathered, and the wind blew stronger. It knew it was going to rain. So, it quickly flew back home. \'Weather\' is what tells us if it\'s sunny, rainy, or windy. **有一天，一只小鸟在天空中飞翔。它注意到天气在变化。乌云聚集，风刮得更猛了。它知道要下雨了。于是，它迅速飞回家。\'weather\'就是告诉我们是晴天、雨天还是刮风天的那个东西。**

> A spider was weaving a beautiful web. It moved its legs skillfully to weave the silk together. The web became stronger and stronger. Remember, \'weave\' means to make something by crossing threads or fibers. **一只蜘蛛正在织一张漂亮的网。它熟练地移动它的腿把丝织在一起。网变得越来越牢固。记住，\'weave\'意思是通过交叉线或纤维来制作某物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He was a weaver. Every day, he sat at his loom and wove beautiful cloth. His skill made people love his works. So, remember \'weaver\' as the one who weaves cloth like Tom. **从前，有一个叫汤姆的人。他是一名织工。每天，他坐在织布机前织出漂亮的布。他的技艺让人们喜爱他的作品。所以，记住\'weaver\'就是像汤姆那样织布的人。**
> 想象一只小蜘蛛在努力织网（web），它从这头跑到那头，吐出细丝，精心编织。终于，一张漂亮的网完成了，它就等着小飞虫自投罗网。这张网就像互联网一样，把各种信息连接起来。 **想象一只小蜘蛛织网的情景来辅助记忆单词'web（网）'，将网比作互联网，把信息相连。**

> One day, Tom was lost and needed directions. A kind lady told him to find the information he needed on a website. With that clue, Tom easily found his way home. **一天，汤姆迷路了并且需要指引。一位善良的女士告诉他在一个网站上能找到他需要的信息。凭借这个线索，汤姆轻松地回了家。**

> A prince and a princess had a beautiful wedding. They decided to wed and promised to love each other forever. The day they wed was full of joy and happiness. **一位王子和一位公主举行了一场美丽的婚礼。他们决定结婚，并承诺永远相爱。他们结婚的那天充满了欢乐和幸福。**

> A prince and a princess had a grand wedding. There were beautiful flowers everywhere. They exchanged rings and made a promise to love each other forever. Everyone was happy and celebrating. **一位王子和一位公主举行了盛大的婚礼。到处都是美丽的鲜花。他们交换了戒指，并承诺永远相爱。每个人都很开心，正在庆祝。**

> A woodcutter was splitting wood. He used a sharp wedge to drive into the log. With each hit of the hammer, the wedge went deeper, finally splitting the log. The wedge was the key to his success. **一位伐木工人正在劈柴。他用一个锋利的楔子楔入原木。随着锤子的每次敲击，楔子越进越深，最终劈开了原木。楔子是他成功的关键。**

> A prince and a princess got married and entered wedlock. They promised to love each other forever. Wedlock means the state of being married. So, remember, when two people are in wedlock, they are married and have special commitments to each other. **一位王子和一位公主结婚并进入了婚姻状态。他们承诺永远相爱。wedlock 意思是已婚的状态。所以，记住，当两个人处于 wedlock 时，他们就是结婚了并且对彼此有特殊的承诺。**

> A little mouse was always wee. One day, it found a big cheese but couldn\'t move it because it was too wee. So it called its friends to help. Finally, they enjoyed the cheese together. **一只小老鼠总是小小的。有一天，它发现了一块大奶酪，但因为它太小了搬不动。所以它叫它的朋友们来帮忙。最后，它们一起享用了奶酪。**

> A farmer was very tired of the weeds in his field. One day, he decided to pull out all the weeds. After a hard day\'s work, the field was finally clean. The word \'weed\' means a wild plant growing where it is not wanted. **一位农民对他田地里的杂草感到非常厌烦。有一天，他决定把所有的杂草都拔掉。经过一天的辛苦劳作，田地终于干净了。单词\'weed\'的意思是不受欢迎的野生植物。**
> 想象一下，一只小蜗牛在努力爬行，它从周一出发，经过周二、周三、周四、周五，爬得有点累了在周六休息，最后在周日到达了目的地。这就是一个完整的'week'（星期，周）。 **想象一只小蜗牛的一周行程来记住 week 这个表示星期、周的单词**

> One weekday, Tom woke up early and went to work. He was very busy but felt fulfilled. After work, he relaxed and realized weekdays can also be wonderful if you have the right attitude. **在一个工作日，汤姆早早醒来去工作。他非常忙碌但感到很充实。下班后，他放松下来并意识到，如果你有正确的态度，工作日也可以很美好。**

> On the weekend, Tom was very happy. He didn\'t have to go to school. He could play games, watch cartoons and sleep late. It was a relaxing time for him. **在周末，汤姆非常开心。他不用去上学。他可以玩游戏、看动画片并且睡懒觉。对他来说这是一段放松的时光。**

> There was a hardworking student who made a weekly plan to improve his grades. Every week, he followed the plan strictly and finally achieved excellent results. The word \'weekly\' means happening or done once a week. **有一个勤奋的学生制定了每周提高成绩的计划。每周，他都严格遵循这个计划，最终取得了优异的成绩。单词\'weekly\'意思是每周发生一次或每周做一次。**

> A little girl lost her favorite doll and began to weep. Tears rolled down her cheeks as she felt so sad. Her mom comforted her, saying everything would be okay. Remember, \'weep\' means to cry. **一个小女孩丢失了她最喜欢的玩偶，然后开始哭泣。眼泪顺着她的脸颊滚落，因为她感到非常伤心。她的妈妈安慰她，说一切都会好起来的。记住，\'weep\'的意思是哭泣。**

> A little girl was lost in the forest. She couldn\'t find her way home and started weeping. Her tears fell like raindrops. Weeping means crying with tears flowing down. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。她找不到回家的路，开始哭泣。她的眼泪像雨滴一样落下。weeping 意思是流着泪哭泣。**

> A little weevil was lost in a big forest. It struggled to find its way home. Finally, with its perseverance, it found a path and reunited with its friends. Remember, \'weevil\' is a kind of small beetle. **一只小象鼻虫在大森林里迷路了。它努力寻找回家的路。最后，凭借它的毅力，它找到了一条路，并与朋友们团聚了。记住，\'weevil\'是一种小甲虫。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to know the weight of a big fruit. So, it found a scale and put the fruit on it. The act of determining the fruit\'s mass was called \'weigh\'. **一天，一只小猴子想知道一个大水果的重量。于是，它找了一个秤，把水果放上去。确定水果质量的这个行为就叫做\'weigh（称重）\'。**

> A strong man was trying to lift a heavy box. He struggled because the box had a lot of weight. But he didn\'t give up and finally moved it. The weight was the measure of how heavy the box was. **一个强壮的男人试图抬起一个很重的箱子。他很吃力，因为箱子有很大的重量。但他没有放弃，最终搬动了它。重量就是衡量这个箱子有多重的指标。**

> Astronaut Tom felt weightless when he was in space. He floated freely, as if gravity had no hold on him. It was an amazing experience of being weightless and defying the normal pull of Earth. **宇航员汤姆在太空时感到失重。他自由地漂浮着，仿佛重力对他毫无作用。这是一次令人惊叹的失重体验，摆脱了地球的正常引力。**

> A little mouse was trying to move a weighty cheese. It struggled and struggled but couldn\'t. Finally, with the help of its friends, they moved the cheese together. \'Weighty\' means heavy and of great importance. **一只小老鼠试图移动一块沉重的奶酪。它努力又努力，但做不到。最后，在朋友们的帮助下，它们一起移动了奶酪。\'weighty\'意思是沉重的、重要的。**

> A girl was walking in the forest at night and saw a weird tree with glowing eyes. It was so strange and mysterious. She was scared but couldn\'t stop looking. Later she realized it was just her imagination. **一个女孩在夜晚的森林里散步，看到一棵有着发光眼睛的怪异的树。这太奇怪和神秘了。她很害怕但又忍不住去看。后来她意识到这只是她的想象。**

> One day, when I was lost in a strange town, a kind old man came to me and said, \'Welcome to our town. Let me help you.\' His warm words made me feel at ease. Welcome means to be kindly received or invited. **有一天，当我在一个陌生的城镇迷路时，一位和蔼的老人向我走来并说：'欢迎来到我们的城镇。让我帮助你。'他温暖的话语让我感到安心。Welcome 意思是被友好地接待或邀请。**

> A brave blacksmith was working hard to weld two pieces of metal together. The sparks flew as he heated and joined them, creating a strong bond. Remember, \'weld\' is like the action of the blacksmith joining metals. **一位勇敢的铁匠正在努力将两块金属焊接在一起。当他加热并连接它们时，火花飞溅，形成了牢固的结合。记住，'weld'就像铁匠连接金属的动作。**

> One day, a young man named Tom wanted to become a welder. He spent hours practicing, welding pieces of metal together. Finally, his hard work paid off, and he became an excellent welder, creating beautiful and strong structures. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的年轻人想成为一名焊工。他花了几个小时练习，把金属片焊接在一起。最后，他的努力得到了回报，他成为了一名出色的焊工，创造出了美观又坚固的结构。**
> 想象一个小镇，人们生活艰难。一位善良的女士站出来，为大家争取更好的生活条件，如医疗保障、教育机会等。她所做的一切都是为了小镇的 \'welfare\'（福利），让大家过上幸福的生活。 **想象一个小镇，人们生活艰难。一位善良的女士站出来，为大家争取更好的生活条件，如医疗保障、教育机会等。她所做的一切都是为了小镇的"福利"，让大家过上幸福的生活。**

> One day, a little rabbit fell into a deep hole. But luckily, there was a well of clear water at the bottom. The rabbit drank the water and felt better. The well saved the rabbit\'s life. **一天，一只小兔子掉进了一个深洞。但幸运的是，洞底有一口清澈的水井。兔子喝了水，感觉好多了。这口水井救了兔子的命。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious forest. Suddenly, he tripped and fell, getting a painful welt on his leg. It was a red and swollen mark. But he didn\'t give up and continued his journey. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索神秘的森林。突然，他绊倒了，腿上起了一个很疼的伤痕。那是一个红肿的印记。但他没有放弃，继续他的旅程。**

> A brave explorer set off on a journey. He walked and walked until he reached a place where the sun set. That direction was west. It was a beautiful and mysterious land. **一位勇敢的探险家踏上了旅程。他走啊走，直到到达太阳落下的地方。那个方向就是西方。那是一片美丽而神秘的土地。**

> A cowboy in the western part of the country rides his horse every day. He enjoys the wide prairies and beautiful sunsets. Western here means related to the west. **在这个国家的西部地区，一位牛仔每天都骑着他的马。他享受着广阔的草原和美丽的日落。这里的"western"意思是与西方有关的。**

> A brave explorer set off westward. He faced many challenges but was determined to reach the unknown land in the west. His journey showed the meaning of westward - moving towards the west. **一位勇敢的探险家向西出发。他面临许多挑战，但决心到达西边的未知之地。他的旅程展现了westward（向西）的含义------朝着西边移动。**

> One day, I went for a walk in the park. Suddenly, it started raining heavily. I didn\'t have an umbrella and got completely wet. My clothes and shoes were soaked through. It was a really wet experience! **一天，我去公园散步。突然，下起了大雨。我没带伞，全身都湿透了。我的衣服和鞋子都湿透了。这真是一次湿漉漉的经历！**

> One day, Tom got lost in a strange place. It was a wetland full of water and grass. He struggled to find his way out. Finally, he saw a sign that led him to safety. Remember, \'wetland\' is a place like this! **有一天，汤姆在一个陌生的地方迷路了。那是一片湿地，到处是水和草。他努力寻找出路。最后，他看到一个指示牌，带他到了安全的地方。记住，\'wetland\'就是这样的地方！**

> A thief tried to steal from a market. The owner saw it and gave the thief a whack with a stick. The whack was so strong that the thief fell down. Now you know \'whack\' means a powerful hit. **一个小偷试图从市场偷东西。店主看到了，用一根棍子猛击了小偷一下。这一击非常有力，小偷摔倒了。现在你知道'whack'是猛击的意思了。**

> A little boy went to the sea and saw a huge whale. The whale jumped out of the water and showed its big tail. The boy was so amazed and never forgot that moment. So when he learned the word \'whale\', he remembered this wonderful scene. **一个小男孩去海边看到了一只巨大的鲸鱼。鲸鱼跃出水面并展示了它的大尾巴。小男孩非常惊讶并且永远忘不了那一刻。所以当他学习\'whale\'这个单词时，就想起了这个美妙的场景。**

> A brave sailor named Jack went on a long journey for whaling. He faced huge waves but was determined. Finally, he caught a big whale and became a hero. Remember, whaling is the hunting of whales. **一位名叫杰克的勇敢水手踏上了捕鲸的漫长旅程。他面对巨浪但意志坚定。最终，他捕获了一头大鲸鱼并成为了英雄。记住，whaling 就是捕鲸。**
> 想象一下，你正在安静的房间里，突然，一个巨大的球猛地（wham）撞破了窗户。这巨大的声响和冲击，让你瞬间惊呆了。\'Wham\'就是这样一种突然而强烈的撞击声。 **想象一个球突然撞破窗户来辅助记忆\'wham\'这个表示突然强烈撞击声的单词**

> A man was lost at a wharf. He saw ships coming and going. But he couldn\'t find his way. Finally, with the help of a kind sailor, he knew where to go. Remember, a wharf is a place where ships stop. **一个男人在码头迷路了。他看到船只来来往往。但他找不到路。最后，在一位好心水手的帮助下，他知道了该往哪儿走。记住，码头就是船只停靠的地方。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a big forest. He kept asking \'What is this place? What should I do?\' He was very scared and confused. Finally, he found his way out by remembering the path he came in. **有一天，一个小男孩在大森林里迷路了。他不停地问'这是什么地方？我该怎么办？'他非常害怕和困惑。最后，他通过记住进来的路走了出去。**

> One day, a friend asked me what I wanted to do. I replied, \'Whatever. I don\'t have a specific plan.\' It means I didn\'t care or have no preference. So, remember, \'whatever\' shows indifference or lack of a definite choice. **有一天，一个朋友问我想做什么。我回答："随便。我没有具体的计划。" 这意味着我不在乎或者没有偏好。所以，记住，'whatever'表示无所谓或者没有明确的选择。**

> One day, a student was confused about a difficult math problem. The teacher said, \'You should not worry whatsoever. Just keep trying and you\'ll solve it.\' It means \'at all\' or \'in any way\'. **一天，一个学生对一道数学难题感到困惑。老师说：'你一点都不用担心。只要继续尝试，你会解决的。'这个单词意思是'丝毫；任何；无论什么'**

> A farmer was very happy because his field was full of wheat. The golden wheat danced in the wind. He worked hard and finally could sell the wheat for a good price. **一位农民非常高兴，因为他的田地里长满了小麦。金黄色的小麦在风中摇曳。他辛勤劳作，最终能以好价钱卖掉这些小麦。**

> A little mouse was running around in a big factory. Suddenly, it saw a huge wheel. It was so big that the mouse thought it was like a mountain. The wheel was turning and turning. **一只小老鼠在一个大工厂里跑来跑去。突然，它看到了一个巨大的轮子。它太大了，老鼠觉得它像一座山。轮子不停地转啊转。**

> One day, a farmer was using a wheelbarrow to carry heavy fruits. The wheel of the wheelbarrow turned smoothly, making the work much easier. It was like a helpful friend to the farmer. **有一天，一位农民正用独轮手推车搬运沉重的水果。独轮手推车的轮子转动得很顺滑，让工作轻松了许多。它就像农民的一位得力朋友。**

> One day, a man injured his leg and couldn\'t walk. His friend brought a special chair with wheels to help him move. This chair was called a \'wheelchair\'. It allowed the man to go around freely despite his injury. **有一天，一个男人伤到了腿无法行走。他的朋友带来了一把带有轮子的特殊椅子来帮助他移动。这把椅子被称为"轮椅"。它让受伤的男人能够自由走动。**
> 想象一下，一个小胖子跑得上气不接下气，不停地发出'wheeze wheeze'的声音，就像风箱在艰难地喘气。他太胖了，稍微一动就喘得厉害，这就是'wheeze'（喘息；喘息声）的生动体现。 **想象一个小胖子因跑动而喘息，以此来辅助记忆'wheeze'（喘息；喘息声）这个单词**

> One day, a little girl was lost. A kind policeman came and asked, \'When did you get lost?\' The girl answered tearfully. With this scene, it\'s easy to remember \'when\' means the time something happens. **有一天，一个小女孩迷路了。一位善良的警察过来问：'你什么时候迷路的？'小女孩含泪回答。通过这个场景，很容易记住'when'表示某事发生的时间。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a strange land. He wondered WHENCE he should go to find his way back. \'Whence\' means from where or from what place. So, he needed to figure out the starting point to get home. **一位勇敢的探险家在一片陌生的土地上迷路了。他思考着应该从何处（whence）出发才能找到回去的路。"whence"意思是从哪里，从什么地方。所以，他得弄清楚起始点才能回家。**

> One day, a little girl was lost. Her parents were very worried. Whenever they thought of her safety, they couldn\'t sleep. Finally, they found her. \'Whenever\' means at any time. **有一天，一个小女孩走丢了。她的父母非常担心。每当他们想到她的安全，就无法入睡。最后，他们找到了她。'whenever'意思是在任何时候。**

> One day, a little bear got lost. He kept asking \'Where am I?\' while looking around. But he couldn\'t figure it out. Finally, with the help of his friends, he found his way home. **有一天，一只小熊迷路了。他一直问'我在哪里？'同时四处张望。但他搞不清楚。最后，在朋友们的帮助下，他找到了回家的路。**

> A detective was trying to find the whereabouts of a missing person. He searched everywhere, asking people \'whereabouts could this person be?\' Finally, he discovered the clue and solved the mystery. **一位侦探试图找到一位失踪人员的下落。他到处搜寻，询问人们'这个人会在哪里？'最后，他发现了线索并解开了谜团。**

> Once upon a time, there were two roads. One led to a beautiful garden, the other to a dark forest. Whereas the first road was full of sunlight and joy, the second was full of mystery and danger. **从前，有两条路。一条通向美丽的花园，另一条通向黑暗的森林。然而，第一条路充满阳光和欢乐，第二条路则充满神秘和危险。**

> A detective was on a case, and he found a mysterious map, whereby he could track the criminal\'s hideout. The map was the key that showed him the way. **一位侦探正在办案，他发现了一张神秘的地图，凭借这张地图他能够追踪到罪犯的藏身之处。这张地图就是给他指明道路的关键。**

> A little girl was lost in a big forest. She kept asking herself, \'Wherein can I find the way out?\' Finally, with the help of a kind bird, she found the exit. Wherein means in what place or in which. **一个小女孩在大森林里迷路了。她不停地问自己：'我能从哪里找到出路？'最后，在一只善良的小鸟的帮助下，她找到了出口。wherein 意思是在什么里面；在哪一方面**

> A thief broke into a house. The owner shouted loudly, whereupon the thief ran away. The police came soon after. Here, \'whereupon\' means immediately after that or as a result of that. **一个小偷闯进了一所房子。主人大声喊叫，于是小偷跑掉了。警察随后很快就来了。在这里，\'whereupon\'意思是紧接着；于是**

> One day, a little bird was lost. It flew wherever it could to find its way home. It didn\'t care about the direction, just kept searching. Finally, it succeeded. \'Wherever\' means in or to any place. **有一天，一只小鸟迷路了。它到处飞，想要找到回家的路。它不在乎方向，只是不停地寻找。最后，它成功了。\'wherever\'意思是在任何地方；无论何处**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a cave. There were two paths ahead. He wondered whether to take the left one or the right one. It was a tough decision that would determine his fate. **一位勇敢的冒险家在洞穴中迷路了。前面有两条路。他想知道是走左边那条还是右边那条。这是一个艰难的决定，将决定他的命运。**

> A little rabbit was lost in a forest. There were many paths. It wondered, \'Which path should I take to go home?\' Finally, it chose the right one. \'Which\' helped the rabbit make a choice. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。有很多条路。它想：'我应该走哪条路回家呢？'最后，它选对了。'which'帮助兔子做出了选择。**

> A group of friends was choosing a movie to watch. They had many options. Whoever shouted \'whichever\' first got to decide. It meant no matter which one was picked. So, they ended up watching a comedy. **一群朋友在选电影看。他们有很多选择。谁先喊出"whichever"谁就做决定。这意味着不管选哪一个。所以，他们最后看了一部喜剧。**

> One day, while walking in the park, I caught a whiff of a delicious cake. It was such a pleasant smell that made me follow it. Finally, I found a bakery. The whiff led me to a treat! **有一天，在公园散步时，我闻到了一股美味蛋糕的气味。这股宜人的味道让我跟着它。最后，我找到了一家面包店。这股气味给我带来了享受！**

> One day, a little boy was waiting for his friend. While he was waiting, he read a book to pass the time. It was a long while before his friend finally came. **有一天，一个小男孩正在等他的朋友。当他在等待的时候，他读了一本书来打发时间。过了好长一段时间他的朋友才终于到来。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was lost whilst playing in the forest. He was very scared but finally found his way home. \'Whilst\' here means \'while\' or \'during the time that\'. **从前，有一个小男孩在森林里玩耍时迷路了。他非常害怕，但最终找到了回家的路。这里的'whilst'意思是'当\...\...的时候'或'在\...\...期间'。**

> One day, Tom decided to go on a trip on a whim. He didn\'t plan anything but just followed his sudden desire. This unexpected decision brought him many wonderful experiences. **有一天，汤姆心血来潮决定去旅行。他没有任何计划，只是跟随自己突然的想法。这个意外的决定给他带来了许多美妙的经历。**
> 一只小狗受伤后，躲在角落里，发出微弱的\'whimper\'声，像是在小声抽泣和呜咽。它的眼神充满了痛苦和无助，那可怜的\'whimper\'让人心疼。 **一只小狗受伤后躲在角落抽泣呜咽的故事**

> A little girl named Lily had a whimsical imagination. One day, she thought her teddy bear could fly and took it to the roof. This strange and fanciful idea showed her whimsical nature. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩有着异想天开的想象力。有一天，她认为她的泰迪熊能飞，并把它带到屋顶。这个奇怪和幻想的想法展现了她反复无常、异想天开的天性。**

> A little puppy was always whining when it was hungry. One day, its owner understood its whine and gave it food. The puppy stopped whining and became happy. **一只小狗总是在饿的时候呜呜叫。有一天，它的主人明白了它的呜呜声，给了它食物。小狗停止了呜呜叫，变得开心起来。**

> A monkey was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a hunter appeared and tried to catch it with a whip. The monkey was very scared and quickly climbed up the tree. Remember, \'whip\' is the tool the hunter used. **一只猴子正在森林里玩耍。突然，一个猎人出现并用鞭子试图抓住它。猴子非常害怕，迅速爬上了树。记住，\'whip\'就是猎人使用的那个工具------鞭子。**
> 想象一下，你身处一个古老的工厂，里面有很多巨大的风扇。当它们同时快速转动起来，发出的那种连续快速的嗡嗡声，\'whir\'，就像是一种神秘的魔法咒语。 **想象在古老工厂中风扇快速转动发出的连续嗡嗡声来记忆\'whir\'这个单词，表示（机器等）呼呼地飞转，发出嗡嗡声**

> A little girl was playing on a carousel. The carousel was moving fast in a whirl. She felt so excited and couldn\'t stop laughing. The whirl of the carousel made her day. **一个小女孩在旋转木马上玩耍。木马快速旋转着。她感到非常兴奋，笑个不停。旋转木马的旋转让她度过了美好的一天。**

> A brave adventurer was rowing a boat. Suddenly, the boat was caught in a powerful whirlpool. It spun around and around. The adventurer struggled but finally managed to escape. Remember, whirlpool means a powerful circular movement of water. **一位勇敢的探险家正在划船。突然，船被卷入了一个强大的漩涡。它不停地旋转。探险家奋力挣扎，最终成功逃脱。记住，whirlpool 意思是强大的水流漩涡。**

> A brave knight was caught in a whirlwind while on a quest. The wind spun him around and around. It was like a wild dance. But he held on tight and finally escaped. Remember, a whirlwind is a very strong and fast wind that spins. **一位勇敢的骑士在探险时陷入了旋风之中。风把他不停地旋转。这就像一场疯狂的舞蹈。但他紧紧抓住，最终逃脱了。记住，旋风是一种非常强大且快速旋转的风。**

> A little mouse was stealing cheese in the kitchen. The cook saw it and quickly took a whisk to chase the mouse away. The whisk moved so fast, like a magic wand. **一只小老鼠正在厨房偷奶酪。厨师看见了，迅速拿起打蛋器去追赶老鼠。打蛋器移动得很快，像一根魔法棒。**

> The cat was very cute. One day, it got lost. We found it by its long whiskers. The whiskers helped it sense and explore the world. Remember, whisker is like the cat\'s tool for adventure. **这只猫非常可爱。有一天，它走丢了。我们通过它长长的胡须找到了它。胡须帮助它感知和探索世界。记住，whisker（胡须）就像是猫冒险的工具。**

> A cowboy was lost in the desert. He was extremely thirsty. Suddenly, he found a bottle of whiskey. The whiskey gave him strength and he managed to find his way back. **一个牛仔在沙漠中迷路了。他极度口渴。突然，他发现了一瓶威士忌。威士忌给了他力量，他成功找到了回去的路。**
> 在一个寒冷的夜晚，一位疲惫的旅人走进一家酒吧。他点了一杯 WHISKY，当辛辣的液体滑过喉咙，瞬间带来温暖和放松。这杯 WHISKY 就像一位老友，陪伴他度过漫长的黑夜。 **在一个寒冷的夜晚，一位疲惫的旅人走进一家酒吧。他点了一杯威士忌，当辛辣的液体滑过喉咙，瞬间带来温暖和放松。这杯威士忌就像一位老友，陪伴他度过漫长的黑夜。**

> One night, in a quiet forest, a little mouse was afraid to speak loudly. So, it chose to whisper to its friend, \'Let\'s find some food quietly.\' This shows the meaning of \'whisper\' - to speak very softly and quietly. **一天晚上，在安静的森林里，一只小老鼠不敢大声说话。于是，它选择向它的朋友低声说：'咱们悄悄地找点食物。'这体现了'whisper'的意思------非常轻声、小声地说话。**

> A naughty monkey saw a whistle on the ground. It picked it up and blew hard. The whistle made a sharp sound that echoed through the forest. The monkey had so much fun with the whistle. **一只顽皮的猴子看到地上有一个口哨。它捡起来用力吹。口哨发出尖锐的声音，在森林中回荡。猴子玩这个口哨玩得很开心。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl wore a white dress and danced in a white flower field. The white clouds in the sky smiled at her. Everything was so pure and beautiful. **从前，有个小女孩穿着白色的连衣裙在白色的花田里跳舞。天空中的白云对着她微笑。一切都是那么纯净和美丽。**

> Once upon a time, in a snowy forest, everything was covered in whiteness. The pure white snow made the world look so peaceful and beautiful. It was a scene of perfect whiteness. **从前，在一个雪林中，一切都被白色所覆盖。纯净的白雪让世界看起来如此宁静和美丽。这是一片完美的洁白景象。**

> In the deep forest, a little deer was running freely. It had a beautiful white tail, which was like a bright flag. We call this kind of deer with a white tail \'whitetail\'. **在幽深的森林里，一只小鹿自由地奔跑着。它有一条漂亮的白色尾巴，就像一面明亮的旗帜。我们把这种有着白色尾巴的鹿叫做'whitetail'。**

> A woodcutter was constantly whittling a piece of wood to make a beautiful sculpture. He carefully cut and shaped it with his knife. \'Whittle\' means to carve or shape something by cutting small pieces off. **一位伐木工人不停地削一块木头，想要制作一个漂亮的雕塑。他用刀小心地切削和塑形。\'whittle\' 这个词意思是通过切掉小块来雕刻或塑造某物。**

> A little boy named Tom was a math whiz. He could solve complex problems in seconds. One day, in a math competition, he whizzed through all the questions and won the first prize. Everyone was amazed by his talent. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩是个数学天才。他能在几秒钟内解决复杂的问题。有一天，在一场数学竞赛中，他迅速做完了所有题目并获得了一等奖。每个人都对他的天赋感到惊讶。**

> A little boy was playing with a toy car. When he pushed it hard, the car made a \'whizz\' sound as it moved fast across the floor. It was like the car was a speedy hero making a special noise. **一个小男孩正在玩一辆玩具车。当他用力推它时，车子快速地在地板上移动，发出"嗖"的声音。就好像这辆车是个速度超快的英雄，发出了特别的声音。**
> 在一个神秘的森林里，小动物们都在好奇是谁（who）弄倒了大树。小松鼠、小兔子和小鸟们纷纷猜测，最后发现是调皮的小熊。大家都记住了这个代表'谁'的单词who。 **在一个神秘的森林里，小动物们都好奇是谁弄倒了大树。小松鼠、小兔子和小鸟们纷纷猜测，最后发现是调皮的小熊。大家都记住了代表'谁'的单词who。**

> One day, a little boy was riding a wild horse. The horse ran very fast and was out of control. The boy shouted \'Whoa!\' loudly to make the horse stop. Finally, the horse listened and came to a halt. **有一天，一个小男孩骑着一匹烈马。马跑得非常快，失控了。小男孩大声喊'whoa！'让马停下来。最后，马听话停了下来。**

> One day, a mysterious box appeared. Everyone wondered who could open it. Then a voice said, \'Whoever has the key can open it.\' Whoever means anyone who. So, the person with the key came forward and opened the box. **有一天，一个神秘的盒子出现了。每个人都想知道谁能打开它。然后一个声音说：'无论谁有钥匙都能打开它。'whoever 意思是任何一个......的人。于是，有钥匙的那个人走上前打开了盒子。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse wanted to eat a whole cake. But it was too big for him. So, he called his friends to help. Finally, they finished the whole cake together. **从前，一只小老鼠想吃一整个蛋糕。但对它来说太大了。于是，它叫朋友们来帮忙。最后，他们一起吃完了整个蛋糕。**

> A king was searching for the key to wholeness. One day, he found that it was not wealth or power but the love and unity among his people. When everyone was together, the kingdom achieved wholeness. **一位国王一直在寻找完整的关键。有一天，他发现不是财富或权力，而是他的子民之间的爱与团结。当每个人都在一起时，王国实现了完整。**

> A merchant was in trouble because his retail business wasn\'t doing well. Then he had a brilliant idea - to switch to wholesale. He bought goods in large quantities at low prices and sold them to other stores. Soon, his business thrived! **一位商人陷入困境，因为他的零售业务不佳。然后他有了一个绝妙的主意------转向批发。他以低价大量购买商品，并将其出售给其他商店。很快，他的生意兴旺起来！**

> A wholesaler named Tom was always busy. He bought goods in large quantities from factories and sold them to retailers. One day, he got a huge order and made a lot of money. Remember, a wholesaler is like Tom, dealing in bulk! **一个叫汤姆的批发商总是很忙。他从工厂大量购买商品然后卖给零售商。有一天，他接到一个大订单，赚了很多钱。记住，批发商就像汤姆，做大量交易！**

> A little girl named Lily always ate fruits and vegetables. Her diet was so balanced and good that everyone said it was \'wholesome\'. This made Lily healthy and happy. Remember, \'wholesome\' means good for your health! **一个叫莉莉的小女孩总是吃水果和蔬菜。她的饮食如此均衡和良好，每个人都说这是'有益健康的'。这让莉莉健康又快乐。记住，'wholesome'意思是有益于健康的！**

> Once upon a time, a king wanted to build a wholly new castle. But it was very difficult. Finally, with the efforts of all, a perfect new castle was built. Here, \'wholly\' means completely or entirely. **从前，有个国王想要建造一座全新的城堡。但这非常困难。最终，在所有人的努力下，一座完美的全新城堡建成了。这里，'wholly'意思是完全地，全部地。**

> One day, a little girl was lost. People asked, \'Whom are you looking for?\' She answered, \'I\'m looking for my mother.\' \'Whom\' here is used to ask about the person being sought. **有一天，一个小女孩迷路了。人们问：'你在找谁？' 她回答：'我在找我妈妈。' 这里的'whom'用于询问被寻找的人。**

> One day, a detective was looking for the culprit. \'I will find out whomever is behind this crime!\' he declared. It means no matter who the person is that he needs to find. **有一天，一位侦探正在寻找罪犯。"我会找出究竟是谁犯下了这桩罪行！"他宣称。这意味着不管那个人是谁他都要找到。**

> A group of kids were playing in the park. Suddenly, one of them fell and hurt himself. The others ran to help and there were whoops of concern. Later, when the kid was fine, they all let out whoops of joy. **一群孩子在公园玩耍。突然，其中一个摔倒受伤了。其他人跑去帮忙，发出了担心的呼喊声。后来，当这个孩子没事时，他们都高兴地欢呼起来。**

> A little boy was at the fair and saw a whopping big balloon. It was so huge that it took up most of the sky. He was amazed and shouted, \'Look at that whopping balloon!\' **一个小男孩在集市上看到一个巨大的气球。它是如此之大，占据了大部分天空。他惊讶地喊道："看那个巨大的气球！"**

> A man was walking in a dark alley. Suddenly, a woman dressed strangely approached him and asked for money in a seductive way. He realized she was a whore. **一个男人正在黑暗的小巷里走着。突然，一个穿着奇怪的女人以诱人的方式向他靠近并要钱。他意识到她是个妓女。**

> One day, Alice found a pen in the classroom. She wondered whose pen it was. Then a boy came and said it was his. Alice happily returned the pen to him. **一天，爱丽丝在教室里发现了一支笔。她想知道这是谁的笔。然后一个男孩过来并说这是他的。爱丽丝高兴地把笔还给他。**

> A little boy was always curious. One day, he saw a strange bird and asked his mom, \'Why does this bird look so different?\' His mom smiled and explained. From then on, he remembered \'why\' means to ask for a reason. **一个小男孩总是很好奇。有一天，他看到一只奇怪的鸟，问他妈妈："为什么这只鸟看起来这么不一样？"他妈妈微笑着解释。从那以后，他记住了"why"意思是询问原因。**

> Once upon a time, there was a small village. In the village, there was an old house with a wick in an oil lamp. The wick was very important as it helped the lamp give light in the dark. Without the wick, the lamp would be useless. **从前，有一个小村庄。在村子里，有一座老房子，里面有一盏油灯，油灯里有一根灯芯。灯芯非常重要，因为它能帮助油灯在黑暗中发光。没有灯芯，油灯就没用了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a witch with a wicked smile. She cast evil spells on the villagers. But in the end, the brave knight defeated her. Remember, \'wicked\' means evil or bad. **从前，有一个带着邪恶笑容的女巫。她对村民施了邪恶的咒语。但最后，勇敢的骑士打败了她。记住，'wicked'意思是邪恶的或坏的。**

> A little girl went to a picnic and saw a beautiful wicker basket. It was woven with thin and flexible branches. She loved it and remembered the word \'wicker\' which means something made of woven twigs or branches. **一个小女孩去野餐，看到了一个漂亮的柳条篮子。它是用又细又柔韧的树枝编织而成的。她很喜欢，并记住了 wicker 这个词，意思是由编织的细枝或树枝制成的东西。**

> One day, a little ant was walking on a wide road. It was so wide that the ant felt it would take forever to cross. But with determination, the ant finally reached the other side. The wide road taught the ant that big spaces can be challenging but possible to overcome. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁走在一条宽阔的路上。这条路太宽了，蚂蚁觉得永远都穿不过去。但凭借决心，蚂蚁最终到达了另一边。这条宽阔的路让蚂蚁明白，大的空间可能具有挑战性，但也是可以克服的。**

> A young scientist\'s discovery was widely recognized. At first, only a few knew. But as news spread, it was known far and wide. People from different places praised his work, making the word \'widely\' easy to remember as meaning extensively or in a large scope. **一位年轻科学家的发现得到了广泛认可。起初，只有少数人知道。但随着消息传播，它被广泛知晓。来自不同地方的人称赞他的工作，使'widely'这个词容易被记住，意思是广泛地、大范围地。**

> One day, a narrow path in the forest was causing trouble for everyone. So, workers came and used tools to widen it. Now, people and animals could pass through easily and happily. **一天，森林里的一条狭窄小路给大家带来了麻烦。于是，工人们来了，用工具把它拓宽。现在，人和动物都能轻松愉快地通过了。**
> A virus outbreak caused chaos. It spread quickly and widely. People in many cities got infected. This shows how widespread the virus was. **一场病毒爆发引发了混乱。它迅速且广泛地传播。许多城市的人们都被感染了。这展现出了病毒传播得有多么广泛。**

> Once upon a time, there was a woman whose husband died in a war. She became a widow. But with time and strength, she learned to live independently and happily again. **从前，有一个女人，她的丈夫在战争中去世了。她变成了寡妇。但随着时间推移和自身的坚强，她再次学会了独立且快乐地生活。**

> A widower was a man who lost his beloved wife. One day, he sat alone in their garden, remembering the happy times. But with time, he found the strength to move forward, knowing his wife would want him to be happy. **一位鳏夫失去了他心爱的妻子。有一天，他独自坐在他们的花园里，回忆着那些快乐的时光。但随着时间的推移，他找到了前进的力量，因为他知道妻子希望他快乐。**

> One day, a little ant was trying to cross a river. But the bridge was too narrow. It needed a wider one. Then it realized \'width\' means the measurement of how wide something is. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁试图过河。但桥太窄了。它需要更宽的桥。然后它意识到\'width\'指的是某物有多宽的度量。**

> A brave knight was able to wield his powerful sword with great skill. He used it to protect the kingdom and defeat the evil monsters. The way he held and controlled the sword was called \'wield\'. **一位勇敢的骑士能够熟练地挥舞他强大的剑。他用它来保护王国并击败邪恶的怪物。他握住和控制剑的方式就被称为\'挥舞\'。**

> A man was lost in a forest. He was very scared and hungry. But his wife never gave up looking for him. Finally, she found him and they hugged tightly. Wife means the woman you are married to. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。他又害怕又饥饿。但他的妻子从未放弃寻找他。最后，她找到了他，他们紧紧相拥。wife 意思是与你结婚的女人。**

> One day, a little worm was trying to move forward. It kept wiggling its body to pass through a narrow gap. Its wiggling motion was so funny and cute. **有一天，一只小虫子试图向前移动。它不停地扭动身体穿过一个狭窄的缝隙。它扭动的动作既有趣又可爱。**

> A wild tiger was running freely in the forest. It had sharp teeth and a fierce look. People were scared when they saw it. But the tiger was just being wild and living its own life. **一只野生老虎在森林里自由奔跑。它有着锋利的牙齿和凶猛的神情。人们看到它时都很害怕。但这只老虎只是天性狂野，过着自己的生活。**

> A brave explorer got lost in the wilderness. There were no roads or signs. But he didn\'t panic. He used his skills to find his way out. Finally, he saw a village and was saved. **一位勇敢的探险家在荒野中迷路了。那里没有道路和标志。但他没有惊慌。他运用自己的技能找到了出路。最后，他看到了一个村庄并得救了。**

> A group of adventurers was lost in the forest. Suddenly, they saw a wildfire approaching rapidly. They had to run for their lives. The wildfire was so fierce and spread widely. **一群冒险家在森林里迷路了。突然，他们看到一场野火迅速逼近。他们不得不逃命。这场野火非常凶猛，蔓延得很广。**

> In a wild forest, a little girl was lost. But then she saw a beautiful wildflower. Its colors were so bright that it guided her out. The wildflower was like a kind friend in the wild. **在一片野生森林里，一个小女孩迷路了。但随后她看到了一朵美丽的野花。它的颜色如此鲜艳，为她指引了出路。这朵野花就像是野外的一位友善朋友。**

> One day, while exploring the forest, I saw a group of rare animals. They were the precious wildlife. Deer were gracefully running, and birds were singing. It was a magical scene that made me realize the importance of protecting these wild creatures. **有一天，在探索森林时，我看到了一群珍稀动物。它们是珍贵的野生动物。鹿优雅地奔跑着，鸟儿在歌唱。这神奇的场景让我意识到保护这些野生生物的重要性。**

> One day, a monkey escaped from the zoo and ran wildly in the street. People were shocked but also found it funny. The monkey\'s wildly running behavior attracted a lot of attention. **一天，一只猴子从动物园逃了出来，在大街上疯狂地跑。人们很震惊但也觉得有趣。猴子疯狂奔跑的行为吸引了很多注意力。**

> A young boy named Tom was lost in a forest. He was scared but had the will to find his way out. He kept walking, believing in his determination. Finally, he succeeded. The will here means the determination to do something. **一个叫汤姆的小男孩在森林里迷路了。他很害怕，但有走出去的意愿。他一直走，相信自己的决心。最后，他成功了。这里的will指的是做某事的决心。**

> Once upon a time, there was a willful child. He always insisted on doing things his way, no matter how others advised. This caused him many troubles. But finally, he learned to listen and changed. \'Willful\' means determined to do what you want, even if it\'s not sensible. **从前，有一个任性的孩子。他总是坚持按自己的方式做事，不管别人怎么建议。这给他带来了很多麻烦。但最后，他学会了倾听并改变了。'willful'意思是固执地做自己想做的事，即使不明智。**

> A naughty monkey willfully climbed the tall tree, ignoring the warnings of its friends. It jumped around and caused branches to break. But in the end, it got stuck and needed help. \'Willfully\' means doing something deliberately and stubbornly. **一只顽皮的猴子故意地爬上了高高的树，无视朋友们的警告。它到处乱跳，导致树枝折断。但最后，它被困住了需要帮助。\'willfully\'意思是故意地、任性地做某事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a boy. Whenever his friends needed help, he was always willing to offer it. He never said no, because he had a kind heart. His willingness made him very popular among his friends. **从前，有一个男孩。每当他的朋友需要帮助时，他总是愿意提供帮助。他从不说不，因为他有一颗善良的心。他的乐意助人使他在朋友中很受欢迎。**

> One day, Tom was asked to help his friend move. Without hesitation, he did it willingly. He was happy to offer his assistance because he cared about his friend. **一天，汤姆被请求帮助朋友搬家。他毫不犹豫，心甘情愿地去做了。他很高兴提供帮助，因为他关心他的朋友。**

> A young man showed great willingness to help the old lady cross the busy street. Despite the rush of cars, his eagerness made him brave. His willingness was like a bright light in the chaos. **一个年轻人表现出极大的意愿帮助老太太穿过繁忙的街道。尽管车水马龙，他的热心使他勇敢。他的意愿就像混乱中的一束亮光。**

> Once upon a time, a fairy lived under a willow tree. The willow\'s branches were like her soft hair, gently swaying in the wind. The fairy loved the peaceful shade it provided. Remember the fairy and the willow to remember this word. **从前，有个仙女住在一棵柳树下。柳树的枝条就像她柔软的头发，在风中轻轻摇曳。仙女喜欢它提供的宁静树荫。记住仙女和柳树，就能记住这个单词。**

> A beautiful flower was blooming in the garden. But as the hot sun shone fiercely, it started to wilt. Its petals drooped and lost their vitality. Poor flower! \'Wilt\' means to become weak and droop. **一朵美丽的花在花园里盛开。但当烈日炎炎时，它开始枯萎。它的花瓣低垂，失去了活力。可怜的花！\'wilt\'意思是变得虚弱和低垂。**

> A wily fox was always outsmarting the hunters. It knew all the secret paths in the forest and could hide easily. One day, it tricked the hunters again and ran away laughing. Remember, \'wily\' means cunning and crafty like this fox. **一只狡猾的狐狸总是智胜猎人。它知道森林里所有的秘密小径，能轻易地躲藏起来。有一天，它又骗了猎人，笑着跑掉了。记住，\'wily\'意思是像这只狐狸一样狡猾、诡计多端。**

> One day, Tom participated in a running race. Despite facing strong opponents, he ran as fast as he could. Finally, he crossed the finish line first and won the championship. Everyone cheered for him. **一天，汤姆参加了一场跑步比赛。尽管面对强劲的对手，他尽全力奔跑。最终，他第一个冲过终点线，赢得了冠军。大家都为他欢呼。**

> A little mouse was stealing cheese. Suddenly, a big cat appeared and the mouse winced in fear. It means to shrink back or flinch involuntarily, like the mouse did when facing danger. **一只小老鼠正在偷奶酪。突然，一只大猫出现了，老鼠惊恐地退缩了一下。这个单词的意思是因疼痛、恐惧等不自觉地退缩或畏缩，就像这只老鼠面对危险时那样。**

> One day, I was walking in the forest. A strong wind blew, making the leaves dance. I struggled to move forward against the wind. Finally, when the wind stopped, everything became calm again. **有一天，我在森林里散步。一阵强风吹来，让树叶舞动。我费力地逆风前行。最后，风停了，一切又恢复了平静。**

> One day, while walking in the park, a strong wind blew. I was shivering until a kind man lent me his windbreaker. It protected me from the cold wind. So, I\'ll always remember \'windbreaker\' as a coat that saves from wind. **有一天，在公园散步时，一阵强风吹来。我冻得发抖，直到一位好心人借给我他的风衣。它让我免受冷风侵袭。所以，我会永远记住\'windbreaker\'是抵御风的外套。**

> One day, Tom was walking in the forest when a strong wind blew. Suddenly, a big fruit tree fell and many ripe fruits were on the ground. This unexpected gain was like a windfall for Tom. **一天，汤姆在森林里散步，一阵强风吹过。突然，一棵大果树倒下，地上有许多成熟的水果。这种意外的收获对汤姆来说就像是一笔意外之财。**

> A little mouse was lost in a winding maze. It kept running, turning left and right, but couldn\'t find the exit. Finally, with luck, it got out. The maze\'s paths were just like the meaning of \'winding\' - full of bends and curves. **一只小老鼠在一个蜿蜒的迷宫里迷路了。它不停地跑，左拐右拐，但找不到出口。最后，幸运的是，它出来了。迷宫的路径就像\'winding\'这个词的意思 - 充满了弯曲和曲折。**

> One day, a little boy was lost in a field. Suddenly, he saw a windmill. The big blades of the windmill were turning quickly in the wind. It was like a magical machine that led him home. **有一天，一个小男孩在田野里迷路了。突然，他看到了一个风车。风车的大叶片在风中快速转动。它就像一个神奇的机器，引领他回了家。**

> One day, Tom was looking out of the window. He saw a bird flying freely. The window framed the beautiful view outside. It made him feel happy and peaceful. **一天，汤姆正看向窗户外面。他看到一只鸟自由地飞翔。窗户框住了外面美丽的景色。这让他感到快乐和平静。**

> One day, a little bird landed on the windowsill. It chirped happily as if saying hello to the people inside the room. The windowsill became a special stage for the bird\'s performance. **有一天，一只小鸟落在了窗台上。它欢快地叽叽喳喳叫着，仿佛在向屋里的人打招呼。窗台成了小鸟表演的特殊舞台。**

> One day, I was driving fast when a bug hit the windshield. I realized the windshield protects me from wind and debris. It\'s like a shield for the wind. So, remember, windshield keeps us safe on the road. **有一天，我开车开得很快，一只虫子撞到了挡风玻璃上。我意识到挡风玻璃为我阻挡了风和杂物。它就像是风的盾牌。所以，记住，windshield 在道路上保障我们的安全。**

> One day, a little girl was walking on the beach. The strong wind blew her hair and dress. The scene was windswept. She felt both excited and a little scared. Later, she remembered this windswept moment forever. **有一天，一个小女孩在海滩上散步。强风吹乱了她的头发和裙子。这场景是被风吹拂的。她感到既兴奋又有点害怕。后来，她永远记住了这个被风吹拂的时刻。**

> One day, Tom went for a walk. The sky was cloudy and it was very windy. His hat kept flying away. He had to hold it tightly. Finally, he decided to go home because of the strong wind. **有一天，汤姆去散步。天空多云而且风很大。他的帽子一直被吹走。他不得不紧紧抓住它。最后，因为大风，他决定回家。**

> One day, a traveler was very thirsty. He found an old house and knocked on the door. The owner welcomed him and offered him a glass of delicious wine. The traveler felt refreshed and happy. **有一天，一位旅行者非常口渴。他发现了一座老房子并敲门。主人欢迎他，并给他提供了一杯美味的葡萄酒。旅行者感到神清气爽和开心。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange town. He followed a fragrant smell and found a winery. There were many big barrels of wine. He learned that a winery is a place where wine is made. **一天，汤姆在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他顺着一股芳香的气味，发现了一个酒庄。那里有很多大桶的酒。他了解到酒庄就是酿酒的地方。**

> One day, a little bird was learning to fly. Its wings were weak at first, but with practice, it could flap them strongly and soar through the sky. The wings were the key to its freedom and adventure. **有一天，一只小鸟正在学习飞翔。起初它的翅膀很柔弱，但经过练习，它能够有力地扇动翅膀并在天空翱翔。翅膀是它自由和冒险的关键。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little fairy with winged shoes. She could fly freely in the sky. The wings on her shoes made her very special. So, \'winged\' means having wings or something related to wings. **从前，有一个小仙女穿着有翅膀的鞋子。她能够在天空中自由飞翔。她鞋子上的翅膀让她很特别。所以，'winged'意思是有翅膀的或与翅膀有关的。**

> One night, I was walking alone in a dark alley. Suddenly, a mysterious figure appeared and gave me a wink. It was as if that wink was a secret signal, making me both curious and a little scared. **一天晚上，我独自走在一条黑暗的小巷里。突然，一个神秘的身影出现并向我眨了眨眼。仿佛那个眨眼是一个秘密信号，让我既好奇又有点害怕。**
> 在一场激烈的跑步比赛中，小明拼尽全力，第一个冲过终点线。大家都欢呼起来，因为小明成为了这场比赛的 winner（获胜者）。他的努力和坚持让他赢得了荣誉和奖励。 **在一场激烈的跑步比赛中，小明拼尽全力，第一个冲过终点线。大家都欢呼起来，因为小明成为了这场比赛的获胜者。他的努力和坚持让他赢得了荣誉和奖励。**
> 想象一下，在一场激烈的赛车比赛中，车手小明一路领先，冲过终点线，观众欢呼雀跃。因为小明的出色表现，他最终获得了 winning 的荣耀，也就是胜利、获胜。 **想象在赛车比赛中，车手小明领先冲线获得胜利来记住 winning 表示胜利、获胜**

> In winter, a little bear curls up in its cave to sleep. The world outside is covered with white snow. It\'s so cold that rivers freeze. But the bear is warm and safe, waiting for spring. **在冬天，一只小熊蜷缩在它的洞穴里睡觉。外面的世界被白雪覆盖。天气非常寒冷，河流都结冰了。但小熊温暖又安全，等待着春天。**

> One day in a wintry town, it was snowing heavily. People wore thick coats and scarves. The trees were bare and the ground was icy. It was a typical wintry scene. **有一天在一个寒冷的小镇，雪下得很大。人们穿着厚厚的外套和围巾。树木光秃秃的，地面结冰。这是一个典型的寒冬景象。**

> One day, Tom accidentally spilled juice on the table. He quickly took a cloth and wiped the table clean. With each wipe, the mess disappeared. Finally, the table was as good as new. **一天，汤姆不小心把果汁洒在了桌子上。他迅速拿了一块布，把桌子擦干净。每擦一下，污渍就消失一些。最后，桌子焕然一新。**

> One rainy day, my car\'s windshield was covered with water. I turned on the wipers to clear the view. The wiper moved back and forth quickly, making the road ahead visible again. **在一个下雨天，我的汽车挡风玻璃被水覆盖。我打开了雨刮器来清理视线。雨刮器快速地来回移动，让前方的道路再次清晰可见。**

> A thief wanted to break into a house. But when he touched the wire around the window, he got a shock. It was a wire used for security. Poor thief! **一个小偷想要闯入一所房子。但当他碰到窗户周围的电线时，他被电了一下。那是用于安保的电线。可怜的小偷！**
