> A young man was very tired after a long day of work. But when he got home and saw his new computer setup, he suddenly felt wired. The excitement of the new tech gave him a burst of energy. **一个年轻人工作了一整天后非常疲倦。但当他回到家看到他新的电脑设备时，他突然感到兴奋。新科技带来的兴奋给了他一股能量。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的小镇，有位发明家努力研究，想要摆脱电线的束缚。终于，他成功发明了一种无需电线就能传递信号的设备，人们欢呼雀跃，称其为\'wireless\'，即无线的。 **想象一下，在一个古老的小镇，有位发明家努力研究，想要摆脱电线的束缚。终于，他成功发明了一种无需电线就能传递信号的设备，人们欢呼雀跃，称其为'无线的'。**

> A spy was assigned to wiretap the conversations of a criminal gang. He had to secretly install wires and listen in. \'Wiretap\' means to eavesdrop using a wire connection. **一名间谍被指派去窃听一个犯罪团伙的对话。他必须偷偷安装线路并监听。\'wiretap\'意思是通过线路连接窃听。**

> Imagine a robot factory. Workers are busy doing the wiring. They are connecting wires carefully to make the robots work. The wiring is like a complex web that gives power and control. **想象一个机器人工厂。工人们正忙于布线。他们仔细地连接电线以使机器人工作。布线就像一个复杂的网，提供电力和控制。**

> A wiry athlete was training hard. Despite being thin and not very muscular, his wiry body was full of strength and endurance. He could run long distances and perform difficult tasks easily. **一位精瘦结实的运动员正在刻苦训练。尽管他身形瘦削，肌肉也不发达，但他那精瘦结实的身体充满了力量和耐力。他能够轻松地长跑和完成困难的任务。**

> Once upon a time, there was a wise old owl. It knew many secrets and could solve difficult problems. People called its knowledge and intelligence \'wisdom\'. With wisdom, the owl always made the right choices. **从前，有一只聪明的老猫头鹰。它知道很多秘密，能解决难题。人们把它的知识和才智称为"智慧"。凭借智慧，猫头鹰总是能做出正确的选择。**

> Once upon a time, a young man needed to make a difficult choice. An old and wise man gave him good advice that led him to success. The wise man knew exactly what to do because of his experience and knowledge. **从前，有个年轻人需要做出艰难的抉择。一位年长且睿智的人给了他很好的建议，让他取得了成功。这位智者之所以清楚该怎么做，是因为他的经验和知识。**

> One day, a little monkey needed to cross a river. It didn\'t rush but thought wisely and found a safe way. Finally, it reached the other side successfully. The monkey acted wisely and achieved its goal. **一天，一只小猴子需要过河。它没有匆忙行动，而是明智地思考，找到了一个安全的方法。最后，它成功地到达了对岸。这只猴子明智地行动并达成了目标。**

> A little girl named Lily always closes her eyes and makes a wish when she sees a shooting star. She wishes to have a big dollhouse. Her wish shows her longing and hope for something nice. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩，每当看到流星时总会闭上眼睛许愿。她希望能拥有一个大大的玩具屋。她的愿望展现了她对美好事物的渴望和期待。**

> A young girl named Lily was always wishful. She wished to have a magic wand to solve all problems. One day, she dreamt of getting it. But when she woke up, she knew it was just her wishful thinking. **一个叫莉莉的年轻女孩总是充满幻想。她希望拥有一根魔法棒来解决所有问题。有一天，她梦到得到了它。但当她醒来，她知道这只是她的一厢情愿。**
> A fairy was carrying a wisp of light in the forest. It was so beautiful and magical. The wisp looked like a thin thread of light, guiding the way. **一位仙女在森林里拿着一缕光。它是如此美丽和神奇。这缕光看起来像一条细细的光线，指引着道路。**

> A fairy was floating in the forest. Her dress was wispy, like the soft clouds. The wispy fabric moved gently with the wind. It was so beautiful that everyone who saw it was amazed. **一位仙女在森林中飘浮着。她的裙子是稀薄的，就像柔软的云朵。稀薄的布料随风轻轻飘动。它是如此美丽，以至于每个看到的人都感到惊讶。**

> A little girl stood by the window, looking out at the rain with a wistful expression. She wished she could go outside and play but the weather wouldn\'t allow it. Her longing and slightly sad look perfectly showed the meaning of \'wistful\'. **一个小女孩站在窗边，带着渴望的神情望着外面的雨。她希望能出去玩，但天气不允许。她那渴望又有点悲伤的神情完美地展现了\'wistful（伤感的；渴望的）\'这个词的意思。**

> A girl stood by the window, looking out wistfully. She longed for the days when she could play freely outside. Her eyes showed a mix of hope and sadness. Wistfully, she dreamed of a better time. **一个女孩站在窗边，神情渴望地向外望去。她渴望着能在外面自由玩耍的日子。她的眼睛里流露出希望和悲伤。她满怀渴望地梦想着更美好的时光。**

> Once upon a time, a wise old man was known for his sharp wit. When a tricky problem arose, he used his wit to solve it quickly and cleverly, impressing everyone. His wit made him a hero in the village. **从前，有一位睿智的老人以他的机智而闻名。当一个棘手的问题出现时，他用他的机智迅速而巧妙地解决了它，给每个人都留下了深刻的印象。他的机智使他成为村里的英雄。**

> In a dark forest, there was a witch. She had a pointed hat and a magic wand. One day, a brave boy found her cave. But the witch wasn\'t bad. She used her magic to help the boy find his way home. **在一个黑暗的森林里，有一个女巫。她戴着尖顶帽，拿着魔杖。有一天，一个勇敢的男孩发现了她的洞穴。但这个女巫并不坏。她用魔法帮助男孩找到了回家的路。**

> Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there was a mysterious woman practicing witchcraft. She could make things disappear and control the elements. But her power was discovered, and people were afraid. Remember, witchcraft is the magic of witches. **从前，在一片黑暗的森林里，有一个神秘的女人在施行巫术。她能让东西消失并控制元素。但她的力量被发现了，人们很害怕。记住，witchcraft 就是女巫的魔法。**

> One day, a little girl was walking in the forest WITH her puppy. They had a great time together. The puppy was always WITH her, never leaving her side. WITH means being together or accompanied by. **一天，一个小女孩和她的小狗在森林里散步。他们在一起度过了美好的时光。小狗总是和她在一起，从不离开她身边。with 意思是一起、伴随**

> A soldier was in a fierce battle. But the situation was too dangerous, so he decided to withdraw from the front line. He moved back carefully, away from the danger. Withdraw means to move back or pull out. **一名士兵正在激烈的战斗中。但局势太危险了，所以他决定从前线撤回。他小心翼翼地往后移动，远离危险。withdraw 意思是撤退；撤回**

> A thief was planning a withdrawal from the bank. But as he was about to leave, he had second thoughts. Withdrawal here means leaving or pulling back. **一个小偷正在计划从银行撤离。但当他即将离开时，他又犹豫了。这里的withdrawal意思是离开或撤回。**
> 在一个神秘的花园里，所有美丽的花朵都因缺水而逐渐wither。一朵玫瑰努力坚持，但最终还是没能抵抗住，花瓣干枯掉落。这让园丁明白，不悉心照料，美好也会消逝。 **在一个神秘的花园里，所有美丽的花朵都因缺水而逐渐枯萎。一朵玫瑰努力坚持，但最终还是没能抵抗住，花瓣干枯掉落。这让园丁明白，不悉心照料，美好也会消逝。**

> In a magical garden, the flowers were exposed to a strong wind. Their petals started to fall, showing a withering scene. It was as if they were losing their vitality and charm. Poor flowers! **在一个神奇的花园里，花朵们遭遇了一阵强风。它们的花瓣开始掉落，呈现出凋零的景象。仿佛它们正在失去活力和魅力。可怜的花朵！**

> A king had a precious gem. But he was afraid of losing it, so he decided to withhold it in a secret chamber. Only when he felt safe would he take it out. Withhold means to keep something back or refuse to give it. **一位国王有一颗珍贵的宝石。但他害怕失去它，所以决定把它扣留在一个秘密的房间里。只有当他觉得安全时才会拿出来。withhold 意思是保留，拒给。**

> A little mouse was lost within a big house. It searched everywhere but couldn\'t find the exit. Finally, it discovered a small hole and escaped. \'Within\' means inside or in the limits of. **一只小老鼠在一个大房子里迷路了。它到处找但找不到出口。最后，它发现了一个小洞并逃了出去。\'within\'意思是在\...\...里面或在\...\...范围内。**

> One day, Tom went hiking. He forgot to bring water without realizing it. Soon, he felt very thirsty. But there was no water around. This made him understand the meaning of \'without\' - lacking or not having something. **一天，汤姆去远足。他没意识到自己忘了带水。很快，他感到非常口渴。但周围没有水。这让他明白了\'without\'的意思------缺少或没有某物。**

> A brave knight was in a battle. The enemy attacked fiercely, but he was determined to withstand their assaults. He stood firm and didn\'t back down. Finally, he succeeded in defending himself and his land. **一位勇敢的骑士正在战斗。敌人猛烈攻击，但他决心抵御他们的攻击。他坚定地站着，没有退缩。最终，他成功地保卫了自己和他的土地。**

> A thief was stealing in the market. Luckily, Tom witnessed the whole process and bravely reported it to the police. With Tom as the witness, the thief was caught. **一个小偷正在市场里偷东西。幸运的是，汤姆目睹了整个过程，并勇敢地向警察报告。有了汤姆这个目击者，小偷被抓住了。**

> A witty monkey was playing in the forest. It could quickly come up with smart ideas to get fruits. Its witty tricks made all the other animals laugh. Just like this monkey, being witty means being smart and funny in a charming way. **一只机智的猴子在森林里玩耍。它能迅速想出聪明的主意来获取水果。它机智的小把戏让所有其他动物都大笑。就像这只猴子一样，witty 这个词意味着以迷人的方式聪明且有趣。**

> In a magical forest, there was a mysterious figure known as the wizard. He had a long beard and a pointed hat. With a wave of his wand, he could make amazing things happen. People came from far and wide to seek his magical help. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一个被称为巫师的神秘人物。他有长长的胡须和一顶尖帽子。他一挥魔杖，就能创造出神奇的事情。人们从四面八方赶来寻求他神奇的帮助。**

> A little duck was walking on a narrow bridge. Suddenly, it lost its balance and started to wobble. It struggled to stay upright but finally managed to reach the other side safely. The duck\'s wobble was quite a scare! **一只小鸭子走在狭窄的桥上。突然，它失去了平衡，开始摇晃起来。它努力保持直立，最后终于安全到达了另一边。鸭子的摇晃着实让人吓了一跳！**

> A little duck was walking on a wobbly log. It kept losing its balance and almost fell into the water. The wobbly log made the duck\'s walk very unstable. **一只小鸭子走在一根摇晃的圆木上。它一直失去平衡，差点掉进水里。摇晃的圆木让鸭子走得很不稳。**

> A knight was on a quest but woefully lost his way. He was woefully unprepared for the challenges ahead. Poor knight! \'Woefully\' here means in a sad and very bad way. **一位骑士正在执行任务，但可悲地迷路了。他可悲地对前方的挑战毫无准备。可怜的骑士！\'Woefully\'在这里表示悲哀地，糟糕地。**

> A little lamb was lost in the forest. Suddenly, a big bad wolf appeared. The wolf had sharp teeth and hungry eyes. The lamb was very scared. But luckily, a shepherd came and saved the lamb. **一只小羊羔在森林里迷路了。突然，一只大坏狼出现了。这只狼有着锋利的牙齿和饥饿的眼睛。小羊羔非常害怕。但幸运的是，一位牧羊人来了，救了小羊羔。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was lost. A kind woman helped him find his way home. The woman had a warm smile and was very patient. The boy was grateful and always remembered the nice woman. **从前，一个小男孩迷路了。一位善良的女士帮助他找到了回家的路。这位女士有着温暖的笑容并且非常有耐心。小男孩很感激，永远记住了这位好心的女士。**

> A young girl dreamed of entering womanhood. One day, she faced a big challenge but showed courage and wisdom. Through it, she understood the meaning of womanhood - strength and grace. Finally, she became a confident woman. **一个年轻女孩梦想着进入成年女性的阶段。有一天，她面临一个巨大的挑战，但展现出了勇气和智慧。通过这次经历，她明白了成年女性的意义------力量与优雅。最终，她成为了一个自信的女人。**

> A baby is growing in the warm and safe womb. It\'s like a hidden room where life begins. The mother protects and nourishes the baby until it\'s ready to come out. So, womb is the place where babies develop before birth. **一个宝宝在温暖且安全的子宫里成长。它就像一个隐藏的房间，是生命开始的地方。母亲保护和滋养着宝宝，直到宝宝准备出生。所以，womb 就是宝宝出生前发育的地方。**

> One day, a little boy was walking in the forest and saw a strange flower. He wondered what kind of flower it was and why it was there. This curiosity made him want to learn more. **有一天，一个小男孩在森林里散步，看到了一朵奇怪的花。他想知道这是哪种花以及为什么会在那里。这种好奇让他想要去了解更多。**

> One day, I went on a trip. The scenery was so beautiful that I shouted, \'This is wonderful!\' I saw clear blue sky, green mountains, and colorful flowers. Everything was perfect and made me feel happy. **有一天，我去旅行。景色美极了，以至于我大喊，'这太棒了！'我看到了湛蓝的天空、绿色的山脉和五颜六色的花朵。一切都很完美，让我感到开心。**

> One day, I went on a trip. The scenery was wonderful. The food was delicious. Everything was going wonderfully. I had a great time and felt extremely happy. **有一天，我去旅行。风景很棒。食物很美味。一切都进展得极好。我玩得很开心，感到非常快乐。**

> A little girl was lost in a forest. When she was about to give up, she saw a wondrous light. It led her home. The light was so amazing and magical, just like the meaning of \'wondrous\'. **一个小女孩在森林里迷路了。当她快要放弃时，她看到了一道奇妙的光。这道光引领她回了家。这道光如此令人惊叹和神奇，就像\'wondrous\'这个词的意思一样。**

> A prince was determined to woo the beautiful princess. He sent her countless gifts and wrote her love letters. Finally, his sincerity and efforts won her heart. **一位王子决心追求美丽的公主。他给她送了无数礼物，并给她写情书。最终，他的真诚和努力赢得了她的芳心。**

> One day, while walking in the forest, I got lost. I looked around and saw only wood everywhere. The tall trees and fallen branches formed a maze. I realized how important it is to know your way in this wood. **有一天，在森林里散步时，我迷路了。我环顾四周，只看到到处都是木材。高大的树木和倒下的树枝形成了一个迷宫。我意识到在这片树林里认路是多么重要。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler got lost in a wooded area. There were tall trees everywhere. He had to find his way out. The word \'wooded\' describes such a place full of trees. **从前，有一位旅行者在一个树木繁茂的地区迷路了。到处都是高大的树木。他不得不寻找出路。单词\'wooded\'描述的就是这样一个满是树木的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little carpenter. He made a chair, but it was very strange because it was all wooden. No soft cushions or fabric, just hard wood. So, we remember \'wooden\' means made of wood. **从前，有一个小木匠。他做了一把椅子，但很奇怪，因为它全是木制的。没有柔软的垫子或织物，只有坚硬的木头。所以，我们记住'wooden'意思是木制的。**

> Once upon a time, a little rabbit got lost in a beautiful woodland. There were tall trees and colorful flowers everywhere. It took a long time for the rabbit to find its way out. Remember, \'woodland\' is a forest area with many trees and plants. **从前，一只小兔子在一片美丽的林地中迷路了。那里到处都是高大的树木和五颜六色的花朵。小兔子花了很长时间才找到出路。记住，\'woodland\'就是有很多树木和植物的森林区域。**

> In the deep forest, a little bird was constantly pecking at the wood. It was so hardworking that it became known as the \'woodpecker\'. It uses its sharp beak to find food and make holes in the trees. **在幽深的森林里，有一只小鸟不停地啄着木头。它非常勤劳，因此被称为"啄木鸟"。它用锋利的喙寻找食物并在树上啄洞。**

> One day, Tom was repairing a chair in his workshop. The chair was made of wood, and he needed to do some woodwork. He carefully sanded and polished the wood until the chair looked perfect. **一天，汤姆在他的工作室里修理一把椅子。这把椅子是木制的，他需要做一些木工活。他仔细地打磨和抛光木头，直到椅子看起来完美。**

> A little rabbit was lost in a woody area. It was scared but kept looking for a way out. Finally, it found a path and returned home safely. Remember, \'woody\' means full of trees or like a forest. **一只小兔子在树木繁茂的地区迷路了。它很害怕，但一直在寻找出路。最后，它找到了一条小路并安全回家。记住，\'woody\'意思是树木繁茂的或像森林的。**

> One cold winter day, a little lamb was shivering. The farmer came and took its soft wool to make warm clothes. The wool protected people from the cold. Remember, wool is the soft hair of sheep used for making warm things. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一只小羊羔冻得发抖。农夫过来取走了它柔软的羊毛去制作温暖的衣物。羊毛保护人们抵御寒冷。记住，wool 就是羊身上用于制作温暖物品的柔软毛发。**

> One cold winter day, I wore a warm woolen sweater. It was so soft and cozy, protecting me from the chilly wind. The woolen fibers felt like a hug, making me feel loved and comfortable. **在一个寒冷的冬日，我穿了一件温暖的羊毛衫。它非常柔软舒适，帮我抵御了寒风。羊毛纤维就像一个拥抱，让我感到被爱和舒适。**

> A little lamb has a very woolly coat. It\'s so soft and fluffy that everyone wants to touch it. The woolly coat keeps the lamb warm in winter. Remember, \'woolly\' means covered with thick, soft hair like this lamb\'s coat. **一只小羊羔有一件非常毛茸茸的外套。它是如此柔软和蓬松，以至于每个人都想摸一摸。这件毛茸茸的外套让小羊在冬天保持温暖。记住，'woolly'意思是像这只小羊的外套一样覆盖着厚厚的、柔软的毛。**

> One day, a little boy was writing a letter. But he didn\'t know how to express himself. So he asked his mom, \'What should I do to make my meaning clear?\' His mom said, \'Use the right words!\' And that\'s how he learned the importance of \'word\'. **一天，一个小男孩正在写信。但他不知道如何表达自己。于是他问妈妈：'我该怎么做才能把意思表达清楚？'他妈妈说：'用恰当的词！'就这样他明白了'word（单词、话语）'的重要性。**

> A writer was struggling with the wording of a love letter. He spent hours choosing the perfect words to express his feelings. Finally, the right wording made the letter beautiful and touching. **一位作家正在为一封情书的措辞而苦苦挣扎。他花了几个小时来选择完美的词语来表达他的感受。最终，恰当的措辞让这封信变得美丽而动人。**

> One day, Tom got up early and went to work. He spent the whole day typing on the computer and meeting clients. It was a lot of work, but he felt fulfilled at the end of the day. **一天，汤姆早早起床去工作。他一整天都在电脑上打字和会见客户。工作很多，但一天结束时他感到很满足。**

> A young inventor was trying to create a new machine. After many attempts, he finally made a workable model. It functioned smoothly and could solve the problem he aimed for. Workable means capable of being worked or operated successfully. **一位年轻的发明家试图创造一台新机器。经过多次尝试，他终于做出了一个可行的模型。它运行顺畅，能够解决他想要解决的问题。Workable 意思是可行的；行得通的；可操作的。**

> One day, Tom was in his workshop. He needed to fix a broken chair, so he sat at the workbench and started working. With tools all around, he concentrated and finally fixed the chair. The workbench was his helper. **有一天，汤姆在他的工作室里。他需要修理一把坏掉的椅子，于是他坐在工作台前开始工作。周围都是工具，他全神贯注，最后修好了椅子。工作台是他的好帮手。**

> One day, Tom was very tired after a long workday. He had to finish many tasks at work. But he knew a hard workday would lead to success. So, he kept going. **有一天，汤姆在漫长的工作日后非常疲惫。他在工作中必须完成很多任务。但他知道努力工作的一天会带来成功。所以，他坚持下去。**

> One day, a little ant was working hard to carry food. It was a true worker, never stopping. It showed us that a worker is someone who works diligently to achieve a goal, just like this ant. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁正在努力搬运食物。它是一个真正的工作者，从未停歇。这向我们展示了工作者就是像这只蚂蚁一样勤奋工作以达成目标的人。**
> 想象一下，在一个繁忙的农场里，有一匹马总是不知疲倦地工作，驮运重物、拉犁耕田。这匹马就是农场的 workhorse，它是最可靠、最勤劳的劳动力。所以 workhorse 就是指吃苦耐劳、干活得力的人或物。 **想象在农场里有一匹不知疲倦工作的马，借此说明 workhorse 指吃苦耐劳、干活得力的人或物**

> One day, Tom was working hard in the office. He was typing on the computer and answering calls. His working state was so concentrated that he forgot the time. Finally, he finished the task successfully. **有一天，汤姆在办公室努力工作。他在电脑上打字和接听电话。他工作的状态非常专注以至于忘了时间。最终，他成功完成了任务。**

> A hardworking ant named Lily had a huge workload. She needed to carry food for the colony all day. But she never gave up, showing that a heavy workload can be managed with determination. **一只名叫莉莉的勤劳蚂蚁有巨大的工作量。她一整天都需要为蚁群搬运食物。但她从不放弃，这表明巨大的工作量凭借决心是可以应对的。**

> A workman was very tired after a long day of work. He fixed machines and built houses. But he was proud because his hard work made people\'s lives better. **一位工人在漫长的一天工作后非常疲惫。他修理机器和建造房屋。但他很自豪，因为他的辛勤工作让人们的生活更美好。**

> A young athlete was determined to have a great workout. He ran, lifted weights, and did yoga. After the intense session, he felt exhausted but accomplished. The workout made him stronger and fitter. **一位年轻的运动员决心进行一次出色的锻炼。他跑步、举重、做瑜伽。经过激烈的锻炼后，他感到筋疲力尽但很有成就感。这次锻炼让他更强壮、更健康。**

> A student was very worried about his worksheet. But when he started to do it carefully, step by step, he found it not that difficult. Finally, he finished the worksheet successfully and felt proud. **一个学生对他的作业单非常担心。但当他开始一步一步认真去做时，他发现并没有那么难。最后，他成功地完成了作业单，并感到很自豪。**

> One day, Tom was invited to a workshop. There, people were working hard to create beautiful handicrafts. Tom saw how they worked and learned a lot. He realized that a workshop is a place where people work and create. **一天，汤姆被邀请去一个工作室。在那里，人们正在努力制作精美的手工艺品。汤姆看到了他们的工作过程，学到了很多。他明白了工作室就是人们工作和创造的地方。**

> A young programmer was always excited to go to his workstation. There, he could turn his ideas into amazing software. His workstation was like a magic place where dreams became reality through hard work and creativity. **一位年轻的程序员总是很兴奋地去他的工作站。在那里，他能把自己的想法变成了不起的软件。他的工作站就像一个神奇的地方，通过努力和创造力梦想成真。**

> A brave astronaut traveled far in space. When looking out of the window, he saw a beautiful blue sphere. He knew it was our world, full of life and mystery. He vowed to protect it. **一位勇敢的宇航员在太空中远行。当他望向窗外时，看到了一个美丽的蓝色球体。他知道这就是我们的世界，充满了生命和神秘。他发誓要保护它。**

> A young monk left the monastery to explore the worldly life. He saw busy cities, people chasing wealth and pleasures. But in the end, he realized the emptiness of it all and returned to his spiritual path. \'Worldly\' here means concerned with material things and ordinary life. **一位年轻的僧侣离开寺院去探索世俗生活。他看到了繁忙的城市，人们追逐财富和享乐。但最后，他意识到这一切的空虚并回到了他的修行之路。\'worldly\'在这里指的是关心物质事物和普通生活。**

> A brave traveler set off on a journey to explore every corner of the world. He went through deserts, mountains, and oceans. His adventure showed that his experiences were worldwide. **一位勇敢的旅行者出发去探索世界的每一个角落。他穿越沙漠、高山和海洋。他的冒险表明他的经历是遍及全球的。**

> A little boy was playing in the garden and saw a worm. It was wiggling slowly. The boy was curious and watched it carefully. The worm seemed to be on a special journey. **一个小男孩在花园里玩耍，看到了一条虫子。它在慢慢地蠕动。男孩很好奇，仔细地看着它。这条虫子似乎在进行一场特别的旅行。**

> One day, Tom found an old shoe in the closet. The sole was worn and the upper part was full of scratches. It looked as if it had gone through many adventures. \'Worn\' means damaged or used a lot. **一天，汤姆在衣柜里发现一只旧鞋。鞋底磨损了，鞋面布满划痕。它看起来好像经历了许多冒险。"worn"意思是损坏的或大量使用过的。**

> One day, Tom was supposed to give a presentation at school. But he lost his notes. He was very worried. He thought he would fail. Finally, with the help of his friend, he did well and wasn\'t worried anymore. **有一天，汤姆应该在学校做一个报告。但他弄丢了笔记。他非常担心。他觉得自己会失败。最后，在朋友的帮助下，他表现出色，不再担心了。**

> A little rabbit was lost in a big forest. It couldn\'t find its way home and everything was worrisome. But finally, with the help of friendly birds, it returned safely. \'Worrisome\' means causing worry or anxiety. **一只小兔子在大森林里迷路了。它找不到回家的路，一切都令人担忧。但最后，在友好的鸟儿的帮助下，它安全地回家了。'worrisome'意思是令人担忧的、令人发愁的。**

> A little rabbit always worried about not finding enough carrots. One day, it found a big carrot field and realized worrying was unnecessary. So, \'worry\' means to feel anxious or troubled. **一只小兔子总是担心找不到足够的胡萝卜。有一天，它发现了一大片胡萝卜地，意识到担心是不必要的。所以，'worry'的意思是感到焦虑或烦恼。**

> One day, a little rabbit saw a dark cloud in the sky. It started worrying about whether it would rain and ruin its picnic. But then the sun came out, and the worrying was for nothing. The rabbit learned not to worry too much. **有一天，一只小兔子看到天空中有一朵乌云。它开始担心是否会下雨并破坏它的野餐。但随后太阳出来了，这种担心是多余的。小兔子学会了不要过分担心。**

> A little boy\'s illness started to worsen. He had a cold, but he didn\'t take care of himself. He played in the rain and ate lots of ice cream. As a result, his condition became much worse. **一个小男孩的病情开始恶化。他原本感冒了，但他没有照顾好自己。他在雨中玩耍还吃了很多冰淇淋。结果，他的状况变得更糟了。**

> A young artist always dreamed of having people worship his paintings. One day, his art exhibition was a huge success, and people came from far and wide to admire and praise his works. That was his moment of being worshipped. **一位年轻的艺术家一直梦想着人们崇拜他的画作。有一天，他的画展取得了巨大成功，人们从四面八方赶来欣赏和称赞他的作品。那是他被崇拜的时刻。**

> A worshiper was lost in a dark forest. He was so scared but kept praying to his god. Finally, he found his way out, believing it was because of the protection of the deity he worshipped. **一位崇拜者在黑暗的森林中迷路了。他非常害怕，但一直向他的神祈祷。最后，他找到了出路，认为这是因为他所崇拜的神的保护。**

> A poor man found a treasure chest. He was told it was worth a fortune. But he didn\'t know its true value and almost sold it cheaply. Later, he learned that worth means having a certain value or being deserving of something. **一个穷人发现了一个宝箱。有人告诉他它价值不菲。但他不知道其真正价值，差点贱卖。后来，他知道了worth意思是有一定价值或值得。**

> Once upon a time, a man found a treasure chest. But when he opened it, all he saw were broken and useless items. He realized the chest was worthless. It taught him not to be fooled by appearances. **从前，有个人发现了一个宝箱。但当他打开时，看到的都是破碎无用的东西。他意识到这个宝箱毫无价值。这让他明白不要被外表所迷惑。**

> A young artist struggled to decide whether to invest time in a new project. But when he saw the joy on people\'s faces after seeing his work, he knew it was worthwhile. It means being valuable and worth the effort. **一位年轻的艺术家纠结是否要在一个新项目上投入时间。但当他看到人们看到他作品后的喜悦，他知道这是值得的。这个词意思是有价值的、值得做的。**

> A poor boy worked hard and did many good deeds. His efforts were worthy of praise. Finally, he became a successful person. People said he was worthy of all the achievements. **一个贫穷的男孩努力工作并做了许多好事。他的努力值得称赞。最终，他成为了一个成功的人。人们说他配得上所有的成就。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy always said \'I would like to have a big cake.\' It means he had a wish or intention. So, \'would\' shows a kind of possibility or desire. **从前，有个小男孩总是说'我想要一个大蛋糕。'这意味着他有一个愿望或意向。所以，'would'表示一种可能性或愿望。**

> A brave soldier was fighting in the war. Unfortunately, he was hit by a bullet and got a wound. But his spirit remained strong. He endured the pain and continued to protect his comrades. **一位勇敢的士兵在战争中战斗。不幸的是，他被一颗子弹击中并受了伤。但他的精神依然坚强。他忍受着疼痛，继续保护他的战友。**

> A beautiful princess was given a woven scarf as a gift. The scarf was made of fine threads, intricately woven together. It was so soft and warm, just like a magical charm. The word \'woven\' means made by weaving. **一位美丽的公主收到了一条编织的围巾作为礼物。这条围巾由精细的线编织而成，交织得十分复杂。它柔软又温暖，就像一个神奇的符咒。\'woven\'这个单词的意思是通过编织制成的。**

> One day, when I opened a present, I couldn\'t help shouting \'Wow!\' because it was exactly what I had dreamed of. The wonderful gift gave me a big surprise. **有一天，当我打开一份礼物时，我忍不住大喊'哇！'，因为它正是我梦寐以求的。这份美妙的礼物给了我一个大大的惊喜。**

> A ship was sailing on the sea. Suddenly, a storm came and the ship was wracked. All the goods on it were scattered. Poor sailors had a hard time. Remember, wrack means to cause severe damage or destruction. **一艘船在海上航行。突然，一场风暴袭来，船被严重毁坏。船上所有的货物都散落了。可怜的水手们经历了艰难的时刻。记住，wrack 意思是造成严重破坏或毁坏。**

> One cold winter day, I decided to wrap myself in a thick blanket to keep warm. I carefully folded and covered my body, just like how we \'wrap\' a gift neatly. It made me feel cozy and protected. **在一个寒冷的冬日，我决定用一条厚毯子把自己包裹起来保暖。我仔细地折叠并覆盖住身体，就像我们整齐地'包裹'礼物一样。这让我感到舒适又有安全感。**

> Imagine a birthday party. The gift is beautifully covered with a colorful paper. This paper is the \'wrapper\'. It hides and protects the gift inside, making it a mystery and a surprise. **想象一个生日聚会。礼物被一张彩色的纸漂亮地包裹着。这张纸就是\'wrapper\'（包装纸；包装材料）。它隐藏并保护着里面的礼物，使其充满神秘和惊喜。**

> One day, I was giving a present to my friend. I spent a long time on wrapping it carefully with beautiful paper and ribbons. I wanted to make the wrapping as perfect as possible to show my sincerity. **有一天，我要送一个礼物给我的朋友。我花了很长时间用漂亮的纸和丝带仔细地包装它。我想把包装弄得尽可能完美来显示我的诚意。**

> A king was known for his wrath. Once, a servant broke a precious vase, and the king\'s wrath was unleashed. His face turned red, and he shouted loudly. Everyone feared his wrath. **一位国王以他的愤怒著称。有一次，一个仆人打碎了一个珍贵的花瓶，国王的愤怒被释放了出来。他的脸变红了，并且大声吼叫。每个人都害怕他的愤怒。**

> A powerful storm wreaked havoc on the small town. Many houses were damaged and trees were blown down. \'Wreak\' means to cause a lot of damage or trouble. So remember, when something bad causes chaos, it wreaks! **一场强大的风暴给这个小镇造成了严重破坏。许多房屋受损，树木被吹倒。'wreak'意思是造成大量的破坏或麻烦。所以记住，当不好的东西引起混乱时，就是在 wreak！**
> 圣诞节到了，小明在森林里迷路。突然，他看到前方有个神秘的小屋，门口挂着一个精美的 wreath（花环）。他知道，这一定是圣诞老人的住所，这个花环就是指引他的标志。 **圣诞节到了，小明在森林里迷路。突然，他看到前方有个神秘的小屋，门口挂着一个精美的花环。他知道，这一定是圣诞老人的住所，这个花环就是指引他的标志。**

> A ship was sailing on the sea. Suddenly, a huge storm hit and the ship was wrecked. All the goods and passengers fell into the water. It was a total disaster. **一艘船在海上航行。突然，一场巨大的风暴袭来，船被毁坏了。所有的货物和乘客都落入水中。这完全是一场灾难。**

> A ship was sailing in the stormy sea. Suddenly, it hit a huge rock and broke apart. The floating pieces and debris formed the wreckage. People searched for survivors among the wreckage. **一艘船在暴风雨的海面上航行。突然，它撞上了一块巨大的岩石并破裂了。漂浮的碎片和残骸形成了残骸。人们在残骸中搜寻幸存者。**

> A thief was trying to steal a bike. When he saw the owner coming, he used a wrench to quickly loosen the bolts but got caught. The wrench became the evidence of his crime. **一个小偷正试图偷一辆自行车。当他看到车主过来时，他用一把扳手快速拧松螺栓，但被抓住了。这把扳手成了他犯罪的证据。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的摔跤场上，两位勇士激烈搏斗。其中一人试图 wrest（夺取）对方手中的神秘宝剑，他拼尽全力，扭动身体，与对手僵持许久，最终成功夺得宝剑。 **想象在摔跤场上，一人努力夺取对方的宝剑，以此记住 wrest 有夺取、用力扭的意思**

> One day, Tom was at the fair and saw two strong men trying to wrestle each other to the ground. They struggled hard, using all their strength and skills. Finally, one of them won the wrestle match. **有一天，汤姆在集市上看到两个强壮的男人试图把对方摔倒在地。他们努力搏斗，用尽了所有的力量和技巧。最后，其中一人赢得了这场摔跤比赛。**

> One day, a strong man named Tom decided to become a wrestler. He trained hard every day, learning how to wrestle and defeat his opponents. Finally, he became a famous wrestler. **有一天，一个叫汤姆的强壮男人决定成为一名摔跤手。他每天刻苦训练，学习如何摔跤和击败对手。最终，他成为了一位著名的摔跤手。**

> One day, Tom and Jerry had a wrestling match. They struggled and fought hard. Tom tried to throw Jerry down, but Jerry was very flexible and resisted. Finally, it was a close call. Remember, this is wrestling! **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞进行了一场摔跤比赛。他们奋力搏斗。汤姆试图把杰瑞摔倒，但杰瑞非常灵活并抵抗着。最终，难分胜负。记住，这就是摔跤！**

> A poor man was living in a wretched hut. It was small and leaky. He felt very sad and hopeless. One day, a kind fairy came and transformed the hut into a beautiful house. The man\'s life became better. **一个可怜的人住在一间破旧的小屋里。它又小又漏雨。他感到非常悲伤和绝望。有一天，一位善良的仙女来了，把小屋变成了一座漂亮的房子。这个人的生活变好了。**

> A little worm was trying to cross the road. It wriggled left and right to avoid being stepped on. Finally, it made it safely to the other side. The worm\'s wriggling movement was so funny! **一只小虫子正努力过马路。它左右扭动以避免被踩到。最终，它安全地到达了另一边。这只虫子扭动的动作太有趣了！**

> A thief was caught stealing. The angry owner tried to wring the thief\'s neck. But in the end, he just wrung the thief\'s arm to teach him a lesson. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓住了。愤怒的主人试图拧断小偷的脖子。但最后，他只是拧了小偷的胳膊来教训他。**

> A fairy was flying in the sky. But when she met a strong wind, her beautiful face got wrinkles. She was very sad. Remember, \'wrinkle\' means a line or small fold in the skin. **一个仙女在天空中飞翔。但当她遇到一阵强风时，她美丽的脸出现了皱纹。她非常伤心。记住，\'wrinkle\'意思是皮肤上的线条或小褶皱。**

> One day, a thief tried to steal a watch. But as he reached out, the owner grabbed his wrist firmly. The thief couldn\'t escape. Remember \'wrist\' as the part that can be caught in such situations. **有一天，一个小偷试图偷一块手表。但当他伸手时，主人紧紧抓住了他的手腕。小偷无法逃脱。记住\'wrist\'就是在这种情况下能被抓住的部位。**

> One day, I was late for an important meeting. I looked at my wristwatch and realized I had only a few minutes left. I rushed out, thanks to my trusty wristwatch that kept me aware of the time. **有一天，我有一个重要会议要迟到了。我看了看我的腕表，意识到只剩下几分钟了。多亏了我可靠的腕表让我知道时间，我冲了出去。**
> A king sent a writ to his knights, commanding them to come to the castle immediately. The writ was a powerful order that must be obeyed. **一位国王给他的骑士们发送了一份令状，命令他们立即来到城堡。这份令状是一个必须遵守的强有力的命令。**

> One day, Tom was alone in his room. He had a wonderful idea and wanted to share it. So, he took a pen and started to write it down on a piece of paper. Writing helped him express his thoughts clearly. **一天，汤姆独自在他的房间里。他有一个很棒的想法并想要分享。于是，他拿起一支笔开始把它写在一张纸上。写帮助他清晰地表达了自己的想法。**

> One day, a little boy dreamt of becoming a great writer. He spent hours writing stories in his room. With hard work and imagination, he finally achieved his goal and became a famous writer. **有一天，一个小男孩梦想成为一名伟大的作家。他在自己的房间里花了好几个小时写作。通过努力和想象，他最终实现了目标，成为了一位著名的作家。**

> A snake writhed in the grass. It twisted and turned its body, making strange shapes. Seeing this, I remembered the word \'writhe\' which means to twist or squirm. **一条蛇在草丛中扭动。它的身体扭来扭去，形成奇怪的形状。看到这一幕，我记住了\'writhe\'这个词，它的意思是扭动、翻滚。**

> One day, Tom was sitting in a quiet garden, concentrating on his writing. He wanted to express his thoughts and feelings through words. The pen moved smoothly on the paper, and his writing became a wonderful story. **一天，汤姆坐在一个安静的花园里，专注于他的写作。他想通过文字表达自己的想法和感受。钢笔在纸上流畅地移动，他的写作变成了一个精彩的故事。**

> One day, Tom found a mysterious letter. It was beautifully written with elegant handwriting. He was so curious and spent a long time trying to figure out who had written it. Finally, he discovered it was from his best friend. **一天，汤姆发现了一封神秘的信。它被书写得很漂亮，笔迹优雅。他非常好奇，花了很长时间试图弄清楚是谁写的。最后，他发现是他最好的朋友写的。**

> One day, Tom took the wrong book to school. His teacher pointed out his mistake and said, \'This is wrong, Tom. You should bring the right one.\' Tom felt embarrassed and promised not to make the same mistake again. **有一天，汤姆带错了书去学校。他的老师指出了他的错误并说："这是错的，汤姆。你应该带对的那本。"汤姆感到很尴尬，并保证不再犯同样的错误。**

> One day, a thief was caught for his wrongdoing. He stole money from an old lady. But in the end, he realized his mistake and decided to change. Remember, wrongdoing leads to trouble. **有一天，一个小偷因其恶行被抓住了。他偷了一位老太太的钱。但最后，他意识到了自己的错误并决定改正。记住，恶行会带来麻烦。**

> A man was wrongly accused of stealing. It was a wrongful judgment. But finally, the truth came out and he was proved innocent. This shows how bad a wrongful accusation can be. **一个男人被错误地指控偷窃。这是一个错误的判决。但最后，真相大白，他被证明是无辜的。这显示了错误的指控是多么糟糕。**

> One day, Tom wrongly thought the exam was on Monday, but it was actually on Tuesday. So he didn\'t prepare well and got a bad grade. Poor Tom! He understood wrongly and paid the price. **一天，汤姆错误地认为考试在周一，但实际上是在周二。所以他没有准备好，成绩很差。可怜的汤姆！他理解错误并付出了代价。**

> A blacksmith wrought a beautiful sword. He heated the metal, hammered it, and shaped it with great care. The final product was a masterpiece. \'Wrought\' here means shaped or worked by hand. **一位铁匠打造了一把漂亮的剑。他加热金属，锤打它，并精心塑形。最终的成品是一件杰作。'wrought'在这里指的是手工塑造或加工。**

> A man was lost in the forest. When he finally found his way out, he gave a wry smile. His face showed both relief and self-mockery. \'What an adventure!\' he said. The wry smile meant a smile that was twisted, showing mixed feelings. **一个男人在森林里迷路了。当他最终找到出路时，他露出了一个苦笑。他的脸上既有解脱又有自嘲。'多么一场冒险啊！'他说。这个苦笑意味着扭曲的笑，显示出复杂的心情。**

> One day, Tom made a mistake and his friend looked at him wryly. It means his friend gave him a twisted and ironic smile. Tom understood that his friend was not really angry but teasing him in a funny way. **一天，汤姆犯了个错误，他的朋友嘲讽地看着他。这意味着他的朋友给了他一个扭曲且讽刺的微笑。汤姆明白他的朋友并非真生气，只是以一种有趣的方式逗他。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost and shouted \'Ya! Ya!\' to call for help. Finally, she was found. Remember, \'ya\' can express a cry or shout. **从前，有个小女孩迷路了，大喊'呀！呀！'来求助。最后，她被找到了。记住，'ya'可以表示叫喊。**

> A rich man was enjoying his vacation on a beautiful yacht. The yacht was shining white under the sun. He lay on the deck, feeling the gentle wind. Suddenly, a big wave came, but the yacht was stable and safe. **一位富人正在一艘漂亮的游艇上享受假期。游艇在阳光下闪耀着白色的光芒。他躺在甲板上，感受着微风。突然，一个大浪袭来，但游艇依然稳定且安全。**

> Once upon a time, a little monkey found a big yam in the forest. It was so heavy that the monkey had to use all its strength to carry it home. The yam became a delicious meal for the monkey and its friends. **从前，一只小猴子在森林里发现了一个大薯蓣。它太重了，猴子不得不使出浑身力气把它搬回家。这个薯蓣成了猴子和它朋友们的一顿美餐。**

> A naughty monkey yanked the banana from the tree. It pulled with all its strength and finally got the fruit. Remember, \'yank\' means to pull something suddenly and forcefully. **一只顽皮的猴子猛地从树上拽下香蕉。它用尽全力拉扯，最终得到了水果。记住，'yank'意思是突然用力地拉某物。**

> A little boy was lost in a big yard. He looked around and saw many flowers and a dog playing. He finally found the exit when he followed the fence of the yard. **一个小男孩在一个大院子里迷路了。他环顾四周，看到许多花和一只狗在玩耍。当他沿着院子的围栏走时，终于找到了出口。**

> A football player was very concerned about the yardage he gained. He practiced hard every day to increase it. One game, he ran many yards and became the hero. Remember, yardage is the distance measured in yards! **一位足球运动员非常在意他所获得的码数。他每天刻苦训练以增加码数。在一场比赛中，他跑了很多码，成为了英雄。记住，yardage 就是以码为单位测量的距离！**

> A carpenter was making furniture. He needed a yardstick to measure the wood precisely. With the yardstick, he could ensure each piece was the right size. So, the yardstick became his trusted tool. **一位木匠正在制作家具。他需要一把码尺来精确测量木材。有了码尺，他能确保每一块木材的尺寸都合适。所以，码尺成了他信赖的工具。**

> A sailor was on a long voyage. One day, his sweater got torn and he needed to fix it. Luckily, he found some yarn in a box and used it to mend the sweater. The yarn saved the day! **一位水手在长途航行中。有一天，他的毛衣破了，需要修补。幸运的是，他在一个盒子里找到了一些纱线，并用它修补了毛衣。纱线帮了大忙！**

> One night, when Tom was reading a boring book, he couldn\'t help but yawn. His mouth opened wide as he felt extremely sleepy. Just then, a magical fairy appeared and said, \'Your yawn shows it\'s time for bed!\' **一天晚上，当汤姆在读一本无聊的书时，他忍不住打了个哈欠。他的嘴张得大大的，因为他感到极其困倦。就在这时，一个神奇的仙女出现了，并说：'你的哈欠表明该睡觉了！'**

> In a magical forest, a little fairy named Ye was known for her ability to make beautiful flowers bloom with a wave of her wand. One day, Ye used her magic to bring joy to the whole forest. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一个叫叶的小仙女，她以挥动魔杖就能让美丽的花朵绽放而闻名。有一天，叶用她的魔法给整个森林带来了欢乐。**

> A king was asked to make a decision. When he said \'yea\', it meant yes and everyone was happy. It was a simple but important word that brought joy. Remember, when the king says \'yea\', it\'s a positive answer. **一位国王被要求做决定。当他说"yea"时，意思是同意，每个人都很开心。这是一个简单但重要的词，带来了喜悦。记住，当国王说"yea"，就是肯定的回答。**
> 有一天，小明在森林里迷路了，心情很沮丧。突然，一只会说话的小鸟飞过来，对他说\'Yeah，别担心，跟着我就能走出去！\'小明听了，瞬间充满希望，最终走出了森林。 **有一天，小明在森林迷路，一只会说话的小鸟说\'Yeah（是呀），别担心，跟着我能出去\'，小明因此有了希望并走出森林。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was very curious about time. His father told him that a year is like a long journey. It has four seasons, and after one year, we celebrate and start anew. The boy finally understood the meaning of year. **从前，有一个小男孩对时间很好奇。他的父亲告诉他，一年就像一次漫长的旅行。它有四个季节，一年过后，我们庆祝并重新开始。这个男孩终于明白了 year 的意思。**

> One year, our class decided to create a special yearbook. We collected photos and memories throughout the year. It was like a time capsule, showing our growth and joy. Remembering this made me never forget the word \'yearbook\'. **有一年，我们班决定制作一本特别的年鉴。我们收集了一整年的照片和回忆。它就像一个时间胶囊，展示着我们的成长和快乐。记住这件事让我永远不会忘记'yearbook'这个词。**

> A little rabbit decided to plant carrots yearly. Every year, it carefully prepared the soil and sowed the seeds. With its hard work, it always had a bountiful harvest. Yearly means happening once every year. **一只小兔子决定每年都种胡萝卜。每年，它都认真准备土壤并播种。通过努力，它每年都有大丰收。yearly 意思是每年发生一次。**

> A young boy was far from home. Every night, he looked at the stars and yearned to be back with his family. He felt a deep longing in his heart. Finally, he returned and hugged them tightly. **一个小男孩离家很远。每天晚上，他望着星星，渴望能回到家人身边。他内心感到深深的向往。最后，他回来了，紧紧地拥抱了他们。**

> A young artist had a yearning to paint the most beautiful landscape. Every day, he dreamt of it. This strong desire, this yearning, drove him to keep practicing. Eventually, he created a masterpiece. **一位年轻的艺术家渴望画出最美丽的风景。每天，他都梦想着。这种强烈的愿望，这种渴望，驱使他不断练习。最终，他创作了一幅杰作。**

> A baker was making bread. But the dough didn\'t rise. Then he remembered he forgot to add yeast. Yeast is like magic powder that makes the dough grow big and fluffy. With yeast, the bread became delicious! **一位面包师正在做面包。但面团没有发起来。然后他想起自己忘了加酵母。酵母就像神奇的粉末，能让面团变大变蓬松。有了酵母，面包变得美味可口！**

> One day, when I was walking in the park, a boy suddenly fell and hurt his knee. He began to yell loudly for help. His cries were so sharp that everyone nearby heard and rushed to him. **有一天，我在公园散步，一个男孩突然摔倒并伤到了膝盖。他开始大声喊叫求助。他的叫声如此尖锐，以至于附近的每个人都听到了并冲向他。**

> A little duck was lost. It saw a big yellow balloon floating in the sky. The balloon led it home. The duck was so happy and remembered the color yellow. **一只小鸭子迷路了。它看到一个大大的黄色气球在空中飘着。气球带着它回了家。小鸭子非常开心，并记住了黄色这个颜色。**

> A little bird was injured and its feathers turned yellowish. The children found it and tried to help. They saw the yellowish color and knew it needed care. Finally, the bird recovered and flew away. **一只小鸟受伤了，它的羽毛变得微黄。孩子们发现了它并试图帮忙。他们看到微黄的颜色就知道它需要照顾。最后，小鸟恢复并飞走了。**

> One day, a little dog was hurt and it yelped loudly. Its yelp attracted people\'s attention and they came to help. So, when you hear a sharp cry like that of the dog, you know it\'s a yelp. **有一天，一只小狗受伤了，它大声地叫了起来。它的叫声吸引了人们的注意，大家都过来帮忙。所以，当你听到像这只小狗那样尖锐的叫声，你就知道这是yelp（尖叫、叫喊）。**
> 小明一直梦想去日本旅行，他特别渴望能在那里尽情消费。每次想到能在日本用日元（yen）购物，他就充满动力努力工作赚钱。最终他实现了梦想，开心地在日本游玩。 **小明渴望用日元去日本旅行消费，最终实现梦想的故事，以辅助记忆yen（日元）这个单词。**
> 有一天，小明在课堂上回答老师的问题，老师问他是否明白了，他自信地大声说\'Yep \'，意思就是\'是的\'。老师对他的积极回应很满意。 **有一天，小明在课堂回答老师问题时自信地用\'Yep \'表示\'是的\'，老师很满意。**

> A little boy was asked if he wanted to go to the park. He shouted \'Yes\' excitedly because he loved playing on the swings there. It was a simple word that showed his eagerness and agreement. **一个小男孩被问到是否想去公园。他兴奋地大喊\'Yes\'，因为他喜欢在那里荡秋千。这个简单的单词表明了他的渴望和同意。**

> A little mouse was very happy yesterday. It found a big piece of cheese and had a wonderful feast. But today, it has to look for new food. Remember, yesterday was a special day for the mouse. **一只小老鼠昨天非常开心。它找到了一大块奶酪，并享用了一顿美餐。但今天，它得去寻找新的食物。记住，昨天对于老鼠来说是特别的一天。**
> A little boy was looking for his toy car. He searched everywhere but couldn\'t find it. His mom said, \'You haven\'t found it yet. Keep looking!\' **一个小男孩正在找他的玩具车。他到处找但都没找到。他妈妈说：'你还没找到呢。继续找！'**

> A farmer worked hard in the field. Despite the challenges, he was patient. Finally, his crops yielded a rich harvest. The word \'yield\' here means to produce or give a result. **一位农民在田地里辛勤劳作。尽管面临诸多挑战，他仍很有耐心。最终，他的庄稼获得了丰收。单词\'yield\'在这里指产生或给出结果。**

> A young man named Tom was always stressed. One day, a friend introduced him to yoga. Tom found peace and balance through the poses and breathing. Now, yoga is his favorite way to relax. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是压力很大。有一天，一个朋友给他介绍了瑜伽。汤姆通过体式和呼吸找到了平静和平衡。现在，瑜伽成了他最喜欢的放松方式。**

> A little girl named Lily loved yogurt. Every day after school, she would run to the fridge and enjoy a cup of sweet yogurt. It made her happy and gave her energy. So, whenever she thought of yogurt, she remembered her happy moments. **一个叫莉莉的小女孩喜欢酸奶。每天放学后，她都会跑到冰箱前享用一杯甜甜的酸奶。这让她开心并给她能量。所以，每当她想到酸奶，就会想起那些快乐的时刻。**
> 想象一下，在古代农场里，有两头强壮的牛被一根木制的横杠（yoke）连在一起，被迫共同拉犁耕田。它们无法挣脱这根横杠的束缚，只能一起劳作。 **想象古代农场中，两头牛被一根横杠连在一起被迫共同拉犁耕田，以此记住 yoke 有'轭；束缚；结合'的意思。**

> A chicken was very proud of the bright yellow yolk in its eggs. One day, it showed the yolk to all its friends, saying, \'Look at this precious yolk! It\'s the heart of my eggs.\' **一只鸡为它鸡蛋里那亮黄色的蛋黄感到非常自豪。有一天，它向所有朋友展示蛋黄，说：'看看这个珍贵的蛋黄！它是我鸡蛋的核心。'**
> 想象一下，你（you）在一个神秘的森林里迷路了，周围一片寂静。突然，一只会说话的小鸟飞过来，不停地叫着\'you，you\'，仿佛在提醒你不要害怕，它会帮助你找到出路。 **想象一下，你在一个神秘的森林里迷路了，周围一片寂静。突然，一只会说话的小鸟飞过来，不停地叫着\'你，你\'，仿佛在提醒你不要害怕，它会帮助你找到出路。**

> A young bird was learning to fly. It was brave and full of energy. It kept trying, not afraid of falling. Finally, it soared high in the sky. This shows the spirit of being young - full of courage and hope. **一只幼鸟正在学习飞翔。它勇敢且充满活力。它不断尝试，不害怕掉落。最终，它在天空中高高翱翔。这展现了年轻的精神 - 充满勇气和希望。**

> One day, a youngster named Tom was playing in the park. He was full of energy and curiosity, running around and exploring. His young age made him eager to learn and have fun. **一天，一个叫汤姆的年轻人正在公园里玩耍。他充满活力和好奇心，到处跑着探索。他的年轻让他渴望学习和玩乐。**

> One day, a little rabbit lost its way. It met a kind bird and asked, \'Can you help me find my home?\' The bird replied, \'Sure, but first you need to tell me whose home you are looking for. The rabbit said, \'Your home!\' The bird laughed and pointed the way. **有一天，一只小兔子迷路了。它遇到一只善良的小鸟并问道：'你能帮我找到我的家吗？'小鸟回答：'当然，但首先你得告诉我你在找谁家。小兔子说：'你的家！'小鸟笑了，并为它指了路。**

> One day, Tom lost his pen. But then he found a pen that was not his. His friend said, \'This pen is not yours.\' Tom understood and kept looking for his own pen. **一天，汤姆丢了他的钢笔。但后来他发现了一支不是他的钢笔。他的朋友说：'这支钢笔不是你的。'汤姆明白了，继续寻找他自己的钢笔。**

> One day, a little monkey was lost in the forest. It needed to find its way back home by itself. It kept telling itself, \'You can do it, yourself!\' Finally, it succeeded. **有一天，一只小猴子在森林里迷路了。它需要自己找到回家的路。它一直对自己说：'你能做到，你自己！'最后，它成功了。**

> A young boy named Tom was full of energy and dreams. His passion and curiosity during this period represent the essence of \'youth\'. He explored the world, facing challenges with courage, showing the vigor and potential of youth. **一个叫汤姆的年轻男孩充满活力和梦想。他在此期间的热情和好奇心代表了'youth（青春；青年时期）'的本质。他探索世界，勇敢面对挑战，展现了青春的活力和潜力。**

> A young man named Tom always had a youthful spirit. He loved running, playing and exploring new things. His energy and enthusiasm made everyone around him feel happy. His attitude showed what youthful means - full of vigor and vitality. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是有着青春的活力。他喜欢跑步、玩耍和探索新事物。他的精力和热情让他周围的每个人都感到开心。他的态度展现了 youthful 这个词的意思------充满生机和活力。**

> One day, I was very hungry. When I saw a big cake on the table, I took a bite and shouted, \'Yummy!\' It was so delicious. The word \'yummy\' means something tastes very good. **有一天，我非常饿。当我看到桌上有一个大蛋糕，我咬了一口并大喊，'好吃！' 它太美味了。单词'yummy'意思是某物尝起来非常好。**

> One day, when Tom was asked if he wanted to go for a picnic, he excitedly replied \'Yup!\' It was a simple but enthusiastic response that showed his eagerness. From then on, whenever Tom agreed happily, he would say \'Yup\'. **有一天，当汤姆被问到是否想去野餐时，他兴奋地回答"yup！" 这是一个简单但充满热情的回答，显示了他的渴望。从那以后，每当汤姆开心地同意时，他都会说"yup"。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young professional named Tom. He had a high-paying job, loved designer clothes, and dined at fancy restaurants. People called him a yuppie. A yuppie is a young urban professional with a good income and a trendy lifestyle. **从前，有个叫汤姆的年轻职场人。他有高薪工作，喜欢名牌服装，常在高级餐厅用餐。人们称他为雅皮士。雅皮士指的是有高收入和时髦生活方式的年轻城市职业人士。**

> One day, a little bug was happily crawling. Suddenly, a bolt of lightning zapped it. The bug was gone in an instant. Remember, \'zap\' means to strike or destroy suddenly and quickly, like that lightning. **有一天，一只小虫子正在开心地爬行。突然，一道闪电击中了它。小虫子瞬间就不见了。记住，'zap'意思是突然快速地击打或摧毁，就像那道闪电一样。**

> A young artist had a great zeal for painting. He spent hours every day, filled with passion and energy. His zeal made him keep improving and finally his works were widely praised. **一位年轻的艺术家对绘画充满热情。他每天都花费数小时，充满激情和活力。他的热忱使他不断进步，最终他的作品广受赞誉。**

> A zealot was on a long journey. He was so passionate and determined to reach his goal that he never gave up, even in the face of many difficulties. His zeal made him stand out. **一个狂热分子踏上了漫长的旅程。他如此热情且坚定地要达成目标，即便面对重重困难也从不放弃。他的狂热让他脱颖而出。**

> A zealous detective was determined to solve the mystery case. He worked day and night, never giving up. His zealous attitude finally led him to find the crucial clue. **一位热心的侦探决心侦破这起神秘案件。他日夜工作，从不放弃。他热忱的态度最终使他找到了关键线索。**

> A zebra was lost in a big forest. It had beautiful black and white stripes. One day, it met a friendly monkey who helped it find the way home. Remember, zebra has those special stripes! **一只斑马在大森林里迷路了。它有着漂亮的黑白条纹。有一天，它遇到了一只友好的猴子，猴子帮助它找到了回家的路。记住，斑马有着那些特别的条纹！**
> 想象一个勇敢的登山者，经过漫长而艰难的攀登，终于到达山顶。此时，他正站在天空与山峰交汇之处，这就是 zenith，意味着顶点、顶峰。就像他的成就达到了最高境界。 **想象一位登山者登顶的情景来记住 zenith 表示顶点、顶峰的意思**

> In a magical land, a brave adventurer was on a quest to find the hidden treasure. The only clue was a number - zero. It represented the starting point of the journey. With zero as the guide, the adventurer finally discovered the precious treasure. **在一片神奇的土地上，一位勇敢的冒险家正在寻找隐藏的宝藏。唯一的线索是一个数字 - 零。它代表着旅程的起点。以零为指引，冒险家最终发现了珍贵的宝藏。**
> 有一天，小明参加烹饪比赛，他往菜里加入了一种神秘的调料，瞬间让菜品充满了独特的风味，这种调料就是\'zest\'------热情和风味。小明凭借这道菜赢得了比赛，因为\'zest\'让他的菜与众不同。 **有一天，小明参加烹饪比赛，他往菜里加入了一种被称为"热情和风味"的神秘调料"zest"，瞬间让菜品充满独特风味，小明借此赢得比赛，因为"zest"让菜与众不同。**

> One day, a little ant was walking on a path. The path was not straight but went up and down like a \'zigzag\'. The ant had to change its direction many times to follow the path. Finally, it reached its destination. **一天，一只小蚂蚁在一条小路上行走。这条路不是笔直的，而是像'之字形'一样上下起伏。蚂蚁不得不多次改变方向来沿着这条路走。最后，它到达了目的地。**

> A brave miner was digging deep in the cave. Suddenly, he found a shiny metal. It was zinc! He knew zinc was very useful and could be used to make many strong things. **一位勇敢的矿工在洞穴深处挖掘。突然，他发现了一种闪亮的金属。这就是锌！他知道锌非常有用，可以用来制造许多坚固的东西。**
> A little monkey wanted to send a gift to his friend. So he put it in a bag and used a zip to close it tightly. Then he sent it off happily. **一只小猴子想给他的朋友送一份礼物。于是他把礼物放进一个袋子里，并用拉链紧紧地拉上。然后开心地把它寄出去了。**

> One day, Tom\'s pants zipper broke. He was in a hurry because he had an important meeting. Luckily, he found a tailor who fixed the zipper quickly. Tom was relieved and thanked the tailor. **一天，汤姆的裤子拉链坏了。他很着急，因为他有一个重要的会议。幸运的是，他找到了一个裁缝，很快就修好了拉链。汤姆松了一口气，并感谢了裁缝。**

> A scientist was conducting experiments in a secret lab. One night, a mistake happened and a dead body turned into a zombie. It started chasing everyone, scaring them to death. Remember, zombie means a walking dead creature! **一位科学家在一个秘密实验室做实验。一天晚上，出了差错，一具尸体变成了僵尸。它开始追逐每个人，把他们吓得要死。记住，zombie 意思是僵尸，行尸走肉！**

> Once upon a time, a brave explorer was lost in a strange place. But he found a map marked with different \'zones\'. Each zone had its own features. Finally, he used the map to find his way out. **从前，有一位勇敢的探险家在一个陌生的地方迷路了。但他发现了一张标有不同"区域"的地图。每个区域都有自己的特点。最后，他用这张地图找到了出路。**

> In a small town, the government was busy with zoning. They divided the land into different areas for houses, shops, and parks. This zoning made the town organized and functional. **在一个小镇上，政府忙于分区。他们把土地划分成不同的区域用于住宅、商店和公园。这种分区使小镇变得有条理且实用。**

> One day, Tom got lost. He wandered around and finally found a place with many animals. There were lions, tigers, and monkeys. It was a zoo! Tom was so excited to see all these lovely creatures. **一天，汤姆迷路了。他四处游荡，最后发现了一个有很多动物的地方。有狮子、老虎和猴子。这是一个动物园！汤姆看到这些可爱的生物非常兴奋。**

> A little ant was lost. Suddenly, a magic bird named Zoom came and flew the ant home quickly. The ant was so happy. Zoom means to move very fast. **一只小蚂蚁迷路了。突然，一只叫 Zoom 的神奇小鸟出现，很快地把蚂蚁送回了家。蚂蚁非常开心。Zoom 意思是快速移动。**

> One day, a little girl went to the farm and saw a strange green vegetable. Her mother told her it was a zucchini. The girl was curious and remembered it because of its unique shape and name. **有一天，一个小女孩去农场看到了一种奇怪的绿色蔬菜。她妈妈告诉她这是西葫芦。小女孩很好奇，并因为它独特的形状和名字记住了它。**

> A boy and a girl were standing under a beautiful cherry blossom tree. The boy gently held the girl\'s face and they started kissing. It was a sweet and romantic moment. **一个男孩和一个女孩站在一棵美丽的樱花树下。男孩轻轻地捧着女孩的脸，他们开始亲吻。这是一个甜蜜而浪漫的时刻。**

> In a magical garden, every flower had its own pairing partner. They danced together in the breeze. The pairing of these flowers was so beautiful and harmonious. It made the garden a wonderful place. **在一个神奇的花园里，每朵花都有自己的配对伙伴。它们一起在微风中跳舞。这些花的配对是如此美丽和谐。这使得花园成为一个美妙的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had no toys or candies, but when she helped an old man cross the street, she felt a warm feeling inside. That was happiness -- doing good and feeling great. **从前，有一个小女孩。她没有玩具和糖果，但当她帮助一位老人过马路时，她内心感到一种温暖的感觉。这就是幸福------做好事并感觉很棒。**

> One rainy day, I was feeling sad. Suddenly, a friend came and hugged me. Her words and presence were comforting. It was like a warm blanket on a cold day, making me feel better and giving me strength. **在一个下雨天，我心情低落。突然，一个朋友过来拥抱了我。她的话语和陪伴令人感到安慰。就像寒冷日子里的温暖毛毯，让我感觉好多了，给了我力量。**

> One day, I went to a magic show. The magician\'s wonderful tricks fascinated me completely. I couldn\'t take my eyes off the stage. His performance was so charming and made me feel like in a dreamy world. **有一天，我去看了一场魔术表演。魔术师精彩的戏法完全把我迷住了。我的眼睛一刻也无法从舞台上移开。他的表演太迷人了，让我仿佛置身于梦幻世界。**

> A group of friends were excited about touring a mysterious castle. They walked around, exploring every corner. The experience of touring made them feel like adventurers. **一群朋友对游览一座神秘的城堡感到兴奋。他们四处走动，探索每一个角落。游览的经历让他们觉得自己像冒险家。**

> A little fairy was sent to protect the environmentally friendly forest. She used her magic to keep the air clean and the rivers clear. \'Environmentally\' means related to the environment and how we protect it. **一个小仙女被派去保护环境友好型的森林。她用魔法保持空气清新和河流清澈。'environmentally'意思是与环境以及我们如何保护环境有关。**

> A brave scientist tested a new medicine. He was very nervous but still determined. After many experiments, it was finally tested to be effective and safe. The scientist was so happy! **一位勇敢的科学家测试了一种新药。他非常紧张但仍然坚定。经过多次实验，最终测试证明它是有效且安全的。这位科学家非常高兴！**

> One day, Tom was in a big store. He saw a nice toy car and had a strong desire to own it. So, he took out his money and was in the process of buying it. Finally, he got the toy and was very happy. **一天，汤姆在一家大商店里。他看到一辆漂亮的玩具车，非常渴望拥有它。于是，他拿出钱正在购买它。最后，他得到了玩具，非常开心。**

> Once upon a time, I was lost in a new town. But the people there were so welcoming. They smiled, offered help, and made me feel at home. Their warm attitude truly showed the meaning of \'welcoming\'. **从前，我在一个新城镇迷路了。但那里的人们非常热情好客。他们微笑着，提供帮助，让我有宾至如归的感觉。他们热情的态度真正展现了'welcoming（热情好客的）'的含义。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. But I found a connecting path that led me to a friendly local. With their help, I finally reached my destination. The path was like a bridge, connecting me to the right place. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。但我发现了一条连接的小路，它把我引向了一位友好的当地人。在他们的帮助下，我最终到达了目的地。这条小路就像一座桥梁，把我连接到了正确的地方。**

> A fairy was known for her amazing cosmetics. She used them to make everyone look beautiful. One day, a girl lost her confidence. The fairy gave her some cosmetics and transformed her. From then on, the girl understood the magic of cosmetics. **一位仙女以她神奇的化妆品而闻名。她用它们让每个人都看起来很漂亮。有一天，一个女孩失去了信心。仙女给了她一些化妆品并改变了她。从那时起，这个女孩明白了化妆品的魔力。**

> One day, Tom was constantly disturbed by a fly buzzing around him. He couldn\'t focus on his work and became very annoyed. Finally, he decided to catch the fly to get some peace. **有一天，汤姆不断地被一只在他周围嗡嗡叫的苍蝇打扰。他无法专心工作，变得非常恼怒。最后，他决定抓住这只苍蝇以求安宁。**

> One day, I was really hungry. I went to a restaurant and ordered some steamed dumplings. They were so delicious because they were cooked by steam. The steam made the dumplings soft and full of flavor. **有一天，我特别饿。我去了一家餐馆，点了一些蒸饺。它们非常美味，因为是用蒸汽蒸熟的。蒸汽让饺子变得柔软且味道十足。**

> A thief was trying to sneak into a house. When he looked through the window, he saw a bulging bag full of jewels. But suddenly, the alarm went off! \'Bulging\' here means sticking out or swelling. **一个小偷试图潜入一所房子。当他透过窗户看时，他看到一个鼓鼓的装满珠宝的袋子。但突然，警报响了！这里的'bulging'意思是突出或膨胀。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist wanted to paint real-life scenes. So, he went to the countryside and observed nature carefully. Finally, his paintings showed the true beauty of real-life. **从前，一位年轻的艺术家想要画真实生活的场景。于是，他去了乡村，仔细观察大自然。最终，他的画作展现了真实生活的美。**
> 想象一个古老的宝藏库，里面原本堆满了金银珠宝。但贪婪的盗贼一次次前来掠夺，最终宝藏库变得空空荡荡。这个被掠夺一空的宝藏库就像被\'depleted\'（耗尽、枯竭）的资源。 **想象一个古老的宝藏库被掠夺一空的故事来辅助记忆\'depleted\'，意思是耗尽、枯竭**

> One day, Tom and Jerry found a big cake. Instead of fighting over it, they decided on sharing. They cut the cake evenly and enjoyed it together, learning the joy of sharing. **有一天，汤姆和杰瑞发现了一个大蛋糕。他们没有争抢，而是决定分享。他们把蛋糕平均分好，一起享用，体会到了分享的快乐。**

> One sunny day, I was walking on the beach. The sun was so bright that it hurt my eyes. Then, a kind stranger gave me a pair of sunglasses. They protected my eyes and made everything look cooler. Now I always remember \'sunglasses\' as my savior from the bright sun. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我走在沙滩上。太阳太刺眼以至于伤了我的眼睛。然后，一个善良的陌生人给了我一副太阳镜。它们保护了我的眼睛，让一切看起来更酷。现在我总是把"太阳镜"当作是我免受烈日伤害的救星。**

> One sunny day, I saw a group of children playing happily in the park. They were playing various games like hide-and-seek and tag. The scene was full of joy and laughter. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我看到一群孩子在公园里开心地玩耍。他们在玩各种游戏，比如捉迷藏和追逐游戏。这个场景充满了欢乐和笑声。**

> I went to a concert. The venue was packed with people. I could hardly move. It was so crowded that it felt like everyone was tightly packed together like sardines in a can. **我去了一场音乐会。场地里挤满了人。我几乎动不了。人多得就像罐头里的沙丁鱼一样紧紧地挤在一起。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. The clues were all situational, depending on the specific place and time. He had to carefully observe the situation to catch the criminal. **一位侦探正在破解一个谜团。线索都是与情境相关的，取决于特定的地点和时间。他必须仔细观察情况才能抓住罪犯。**

> A brave adventurer set out to climb a tall mountain. After many days of effort, he finally reached the summit. His task was completed. It was a huge achievement! **一位勇敢的冒险家出发去攀登一座高山。经过许多天的努力，他终于到达了山顶。他的任务完成了。这是一项巨大的成就！**

> A little ant found a small piece of bread. It called its friends and they all worked together to enlarged the bread piece, making it big enough to share and take back to their home. **一只小蚂蚁发现了一小块面包。它叫来了它的朋友们，它们一起努力把面包块变大，使其大到足以分享并带回它们的家。**

> One night, a detective was on a mission to stop trafficking. He followed a suspicious car and found a group of criminals involved in illegal trafficking of precious jewels. With his courage and wisdom, he finally broke the trafficking ring. **一天晚上，一位侦探正在执行阻止非法交易的任务。他跟踪一辆可疑的汽车，发现了一群参与非法贩运珍贵珠宝的罪犯。凭借他的勇气和智慧，他最终打破了这个非法交易团伙。**

> One day, I was very tired after a long week of work. So, I decided to go to a beautiful beach. The gentle sea breeze and the warm sun made me feel relaxing. I lay on the sand and forgot all my troubles. **有一天，在漫长的一周工作后我非常疲惫。于是，我决定去一个美丽的海滩。轻柔的海风和温暖的阳光让我感到放松。我躺在沙滩上，忘却了所有烦恼。**

> One day, a little monkey was playing in the forest. It found many fruits, but it shared them with others. Because sharing made it and others happy. Remember, \'others\' means people or things besides yourself. **一天，一只小猴子在森林里玩耍。它发现了很多水果，但它和其他人分享了。因为分享让它和其他人都很开心。记住，\'others\'意思是除了你自己之外的人或事物。**

> Two friends went on a trip. They shared a tent to sleep in and shared the food they brought. Sharing made their journey more enjoyable and strengthened their friendship. **两个朋友去旅行。他们共用一个帐篷睡觉，还分享了带来的食物。分享让他们的旅程更愉快，也加深了他们的友谊。**

> A rich kid always got everything he wanted. But because of this, he became spoiled. He threw tantrums when he didn\'t get his way. Spoiled here means being ruined by too much indulgence. **一个富家小孩总是能得到他想要的一切。但正因如此，他被宠坏了。当事情不如他意时，他就大发脾气。这里的 spoiled 意思是被过度纵容而毁掉。**

> One day, a scientist was in the forest and observed a rare bird. He was very careful not to disturb it. Through his patient observation, he discovered many interesting things about the bird. **一天，一位科学家在森林里观察到了一只罕见的鸟。他非常小心不打扰它。通过他耐心的观察，他发现了关于这只鸟的许多有趣的事情。**

> A group of workers were building a pier. They were hammering the pilings deep into the seabed. The pilings were like strong pillars, holding up the structure. With the pilings in place, the pier would be stable and safe. **一群工人正在建造一个码头。他们将桩柱深深地打入海床。这些桩柱就像坚固的柱子，支撑着整个结构。有了这些桩柱在适当的位置，码头将会稳固又安全。**

> Once upon a time, a little mouse was constantly chased by a big cat. This experience was so stressful for the mouse. It had to run fast and hide everywhere. Just like us when facing too much pressure and difficulty, it\'s stressful. **从前，一只小老鼠一直被一只大猫追逐。这段经历对小老鼠来说压力太大了。它不得不快速奔跑并到处躲藏。就像我们面临太多压力和困难时，那就是'stressful（有压力的）'。**

> A young man dreamed of becoming a great athlete. So, he trained hard every day. He ran, jumped, and lifted weights. Finally, his trained body led him to victory. **一个年轻人梦想成为伟大的运动员。所以，他每天刻苦训练。他跑步、跳跃和举重。最终，他经过训练的身体带给他胜利。**

> One day, when Tom was crossing the road, he was very conscious of the speeding cars. He looked left and right carefully and safely crossed. Being conscious means being aware and alert. **一天，当汤姆过马路时，他非常留意那些疾驰的汽车。他仔细地左右看，然后安全地穿过了马路。conscious 这个词意味着有知觉的，意识到的，警觉的。**

> A young entrepreneur managed to turn his small startup into a successful company. Despite facing many challenges, his determination and smart decisions led to great achievements. **一位年轻的企业家成功地将他的小创业公司发展成为一家成功的企业。尽管面临诸多挑战，但他的决心和明智的决策带来了巨大的成就。**
> 想象一下，在一个贫困的小镇，食物供应总是不足。直到有一天，一辆装满物资的卡车到来，提供的食物刚好足够满足所有人的需求，这就是'adequate'，充足适当的。 **想象在贫困小镇食物供应不足，直到卡车带来刚好足够的食物，以此来辅助记忆'adequate'表示充足适当的意思。**

> A fairy was dancing in a forest. Her magic made the leaves swirling around her. The colorful leaves formed beautiful patterns as they moved in the air. It was a magical swirling scene. **一位仙女在森林里跳舞。她的魔法让树叶在她周围旋转。五颜六色的树叶在空中移动时形成了美丽的图案。这是一个神奇的旋转场景。**

> A girl was always alone and felt sad. One day, she met a kind boy who showed her love and care. She felt truly loved. From then on, she smiled every day. The love she received changed her life. **一个女孩总是独自一人，感到悲伤。有一天，她遇到了一个善良的男孩，男孩向她表达了爱和关心。她感受到了真正的被爱。从那以后，她每天都微笑。她所得到的爱改变了她的生活。**

> One day, Tom was assigned a task. He knew he had to act responsibly. So, he carefully planned and completed the task perfectly. His responsible behavior was praised by everyone. **有一天，汤姆被分配了一项任务。他知道自己必须负责任地行动。所以，他仔细规划并完美地完成了任务。他负责任的行为受到了大家的称赞。**

> One day, Tom was lost. A kind lady asked him where he needed to go. Tom said he was looking for the workplace. The lady pointed him to a big building and said, \'That\'s it!\' **一天，汤姆迷路了。一位善良的女士问他要去哪里。汤姆说他正在找工作场所。女士指向一座大楼说：'就是那儿！'**
> A sick person was very worried. But after being treated by the kind doctor, he recovered quickly. The treatment made him healthy and happy again. **一个生病的人非常担心。但在被善良的医生治疗后，他很快就康复了。这种治疗让他再次健康和快乐。**

> In a race, Tom was the fastest. He trained hard every day. When the starting gun fired, he ran like the wind and crossed the finish line first. Everyone cheered for him. **在一场比赛中，汤姆是最快的。他每天都刻苦训练。当发令枪响，他像风一样奔跑，并第一个冲过终点线。大家都为他欢呼。**

> A king was very strict about ordering his soldiers. One day, he lost his temper when the soldiers disobeyed his ordering. But later, they understood the importance of following the ordering and won the battle. **一位国王对命令他的士兵非常严格。有一天，当士兵们不服从他的命令时，他大发雷霆。但后来，他们明白了遵循命令的重要性，并赢得了战斗。**

> One day, a little boy was lost. A kind lady found him and asked his name. The boy said, \'I\'m Tom, but people called me Tommy.\' So, \'called\' here means to give a name or a title to someone. **有一天，一个小男孩迷路了。一位善良的女士发现了他并问他的名字。男孩说：'我叫汤姆，但人们叫我汤米。'所以，这里的'called'意思是给某人一个名字或称呼。**

> A little bird was lost and couldn\'t find its way home. But then a kind girl helped it and changed its situation. The bird was finally happy and flew freely. **一只小鸟迷路了找不到回家的路。但后来一个善良的女孩帮助了它，改变了它的处境。小鸟最终开心地自由飞翔了。**

> A student was very focused when preparing for an important exam. He ignored distractions and concentrated only on his books and notes. With such focus, he achieved excellent results. **一名学生在准备一场重要考试时非常专注。他忽略干扰，只专注于他的书本和笔记。凭借这种专注，他取得了优异的成绩。**

> One night, I was in a magical forest. Fairies were flying around, and I saw myself dreaming of becoming a fairy too. When I woke up, I realized that dreaming can take us to wonderful places. **一天晚上，我在一个神奇的森林里。仙女们到处飞，我看到自己梦想着也成为一个仙女。当我醒来，我意识到做梦能把我们带到奇妙的地方。**

> A scientist was working on a secret project. When he pushed a special button, it activated a powerful machine that could change the world. The word \'activate\' means to make something start working or become active. **一位科学家正在研究一个秘密项目。当他按下一个特殊按钮时，它激活了一台能够改变世界的强大机器。单词\'activate\'的意思是使某物开始工作或变得活跃。**

> A man was very happy because he finally got the imported chocolate he had been longing for. The imported chocolate was from a faraway country and had a unique taste. **一个男人非常高兴，因为他终于得到了他一直渴望的进口巧克力。这种进口巧克力来自一个遥远的国家，有着独特的味道。**

> One day, Tom accidentally burned his hand when lighting a campfire. The pain made him realize the danger of fire. From then on, he was always very careful when dealing with anything that could burn. **一天，汤姆在点篝火时不小心烧伤了自己的手。疼痛让他意识到火的危险。从那以后，他在处理任何可能燃烧的东西时总是非常小心。**

> A brave adventurer was climbing a mountain. Suddenly, a huge rock fell and hit his climbing gear. The gear shattered into pieces. The adventurer was in great danger but luckily was rescued. **一位勇敢的探险家正在爬山。突然，一块巨大的岩石掉落并击中了他的攀岩装备。装备碎成了碎片。探险家处境十分危险，但幸运的是被救了。**

> A small butterfly was trapped in a cocoon. It struggled hard and finally emerged as a beautiful creature. The process of it coming out and showing itself is like \'emerging\'. **一只小蝴蝶被困在茧里。它努力挣扎，最终破茧而出，成为一只美丽的生物。它出来并展现自己的这个过程就像是\'emerging\'（出现；新兴的）。**

> A car was merging onto the highway. It smoothly joined the fast-moving traffic. The driver was careful, making the merging process safe. Remember, \'merging\' is like this car joining another flow. **一辆汽车正在并入高速公路。它平稳地加入了快速行驶的车流。司机很小心，使得合并过程很安全。记住，'merging'就像这辆车加入另一种流动。**

> The king\'s palace was decorated with shiny jewels and beautiful paintings. Every corner was filled with elaborate designs, making it a wonderland. The word \'decorated\' means to make something look more attractive by adding ornaments or beautiful things. **国王的宫殿用闪亮的珠宝和美丽的画作装饰着。每个角落都布满了精美的设计，使其成为一个仙境。单词\'decorated\'意思是通过添加饰品或美丽的东西使某物看起来更具吸引力。**

> In a faraway land, a small village gradually transformed. New roads were built, houses expanded. It became a developed place with modern facilities. People lived a better life. Remember, \'developed\' means having advanced and improved. **在一个遥远的地方，有一个小村庄逐渐发生了变化。新的道路修建起来，房屋增多了。它变成了一个有着现代化设施的发达之地。人们过上了更好的生活。记住，'developed'意思是先进的、发达的、完善的。**

> A boy was very lonely. One day, he met a nice girl and they spent a lot of time together. Soon, she became his girlfriend and brought him joy and love. They had many happy memories. **一个男孩非常孤独。有一天，他遇到了一个好女孩，他们一起度过了很多时间。很快，她成了他的女朋友，给他带来了快乐和爱。他们有很多美好的回忆。**

> I had an embarrassing moment at the party. I tripped and spilled my drink all over the floor. Everyone stared at me, and I felt my face turn red. The situation was truly embarrassing. **我在聚会上有个尴尬的时刻。我绊了一跤，把饮料洒了一地。每个人都盯着我，我感觉脸都红了。这情况真的很令人尴尬。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met a friendly African. The African showed the traveler around, introducing local customs and beautiful scenery. The traveler was deeply impressed by the African\'s kindness and hospitality. **从前，有一位旅行者遇到了一位友好的非洲人。这位非洲人带着旅行者四处参观，介绍当地的风俗和美丽的风景。旅行者对这位非洲人的善良和好客印象深刻。**
> 想象一个超级英雄，他的任务是对抗一种叫 AIDS 的邪恶力量。AIDS 非常狡猾，总是试图伤害人们的健康。但超级英雄勇敢地与之斗争，提醒大家要小心防范它。 **想象一个超级英雄与被称为艾滋病的邪恶力量作斗争的故事，以帮助记住 AIDS 这个单词，同时提醒大家注意防范艾滋病。**

> A boy named Tom always dreamed of visiting the Statue of Liberty. One day, he finally went to New York and felt proud to be an American. He saw the beautiful landscapes and met friendly people. **一个叫汤姆的男孩一直梦想着去看自由女神像。有一天，他终于去了纽约，为自己是美国人而感到自豪。他看到了美丽的风景，还遇到了友好的人。**

> One day, a little ant was looking for food. It climbed over a big stone and found a piece of sweet candy. But it was too heavy for the ant to carry alone. So, it called its friends to help. Finally, they took the candy home together. **有一天，一只小蚂蚁正在寻找食物。它爬过一块大石头，发现了一块甜甜的糖果。但对这只蚂蚁来说，糖果太重了，它自己搬不动。于是，它叫来了朋友们帮忙。最后，它们一起把糖果搬回了家。**

> A brave adventurer set off for a journey to the Antarctic. He faced extreme cold and strong winds but was amazed by the unique beauty. Remember, the place he explored was the \'Antarctic\' - the southernmost and icy region. **一位勇敢的冒险家启程前往南极。他面临极度寒冷和强风，但对独特的美景感到惊叹。记住，他探索的这个地方就是\'南极\'------最南端且冰雪覆盖的地区。**

> I had an important appointment with a doctor. But I got lost on the way. Luckily, with the help of a kind stranger, I reached the hospital just in time. Appointment means a fixed arrangement to meet someone or do something. **我和医生有一个重要的预约。但我在路上迷路了。幸运的是，在一位好心陌生人的帮助下，我及时赶到了医院。Appointment 意思是与某人会面或做某事的固定安排。**
> 想象一下，在炎热的沙漠中，有一群骑着骆驼的人。他们头戴头巾，身穿长袍，这就是 Arab 阿拉伯人。他们勇敢地穿越沙丘，带着神秘和独特的文化。 **想象在炎热沙漠中一群具有独特文化的阿拉伯人的情景，帮助记住'Arab （阿拉伯人）'这个单词。**

> A traveler was lost in a desert. A kind local in Arabic clothing appeared and guided him out. The traveler was grateful for the help and learned some Arabic words to express his thanks. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。一位穿着阿拉伯服饰的善良当地人出现并引导他走出了沙漠。旅行者非常感激帮助，并学会了一些阿拉伯语单词来表达感谢。**

> A brave explorer set off for the Arctic. The cold was intense, but he saw beautiful auroras. He struggled but finally reached his destination. Remember, Arctic is the coldest place on Earth. **一位勇敢的探险家出发前往北极。那里寒冷至极，但他看到了美丽的极光。他历经艰难，最终到达了目的地。记住，Arctic 就是地球最寒冷的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Tom. He met a friendly Asian girl during his travel. She had beautiful black hair and wore a traditional dress. Tom was deeply impressed by her kindness and charm. **从前，有个人叫汤姆。他在旅行时遇到了一个友好的亚洲女孩。她有着漂亮的黑发，穿着传统服饰。汤姆对她的善良和魅力印象深刻。**

> Once upon a time, there was an Australian named Tom. He loved surfing and always showed the spirit of adventure. His smile and enthusiasm made him a typical representative of Australians. **从前，有一个叫汤姆的澳大利亚人。他喜欢冲浪，总是展现出冒险精神。他的笑容和热情使他成为澳大利亚人的典型代表。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to get a new hairstyle. He rushed into a place called \'barbershop\'. There, the barber gave him a cool look. Now, whenever Tom sees the word \'barbershop\', he remembers that wonderful day. **一天，汤姆急着要换个新发型。他冲进了一个叫'理发店'的地方。在那里，理发师给他做了个很酷的造型。现在，每当汤姆看到'barbershop'这个词，就会想起那美好的一天。**

> Once upon a time, a little robot had only basic functions. It could move forward and backward, but that was all. Later, it learned new skills and became very advanced. Remember, \'basic\' means simple and fundamental. **从前，有一个小机器人只有基本功能。它可以向前和向后移动，但仅此而已。后来，它学习了新技能变得非常先进。记住，'basic'意思是简单的、基础的。**

> One sunny day, a little girl was playing in the garden. Suddenly, she saw a bee flying around the flowers. The bee was busy collecting nectar. It buzzed happily as it worked. The girl was amazed by the hardworking bee. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，一个小女孩在花园里玩耍。突然，她看到一只蜜蜂在花丛中飞来飞去。这只蜜蜂正忙着采集花蜜。它工作时欢快地嗡嗡叫着。小女孩对这只勤劳的蜜蜂感到惊奇。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met a friendly man. The man said, \'I\'m British.\' The traveler understood that he was from the United Kingdom. Later, the traveler always remembered the word \'British\' when thinking of this encounter. **从前，有一位旅行者遇到了一个友好的人。这个人说：'我是英国人。'旅行者明白了他来自英国。后来，每当旅行者想起这次相遇，总是能记住'British'这个词。**

> A young traveler was lost in a strange land. A wise monk came and told him about the peace and wisdom of Buddhism. The traveler was deeply touched and decided to learn more about this path that brings inner calm. **一位年轻的旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。一位智慧的僧侣过来给他讲述了佛教的平和与智慧。旅行者深受触动，决定更多地了解这条带来内心平静的道路。**

> A young man was lost and confused. One day, he met a wise Buddhist monk. The monk shared teachings that enlightened him. The young man became a follower, finding peace and wisdom like the Buddhist way. **一个年轻人迷茫又困惑。有一天，他遇到了一位睿智的佛教僧侣。僧侣分享的教义启发了他。这个年轻人成为了追随者，像佛教徒那样找到了平静和智慧。**

> A Canadian boy named Tom loved hockey. He skated on frozen lakes every winter. His dream was to play for the Canadian national team. One day, his hard work paid off and he was selected. Tom was so proud to represent Canada. **一个叫汤姆的加拿大男孩喜欢曲棍球。他每个冬天都在结冰的湖上滑冰。他的梦想是为加拿大国家队效力。有一天，他的努力得到了回报，他被选中了。汤姆非常自豪能代表加拿大。**

> One day, a little girl was walking in the park. Suddenly, a cute cat jumped out from behind a tree. The cat had soft fur and big eyes. The girl was so happy to see it and wanted to play with the cat. **有一天，一个小女孩在公园里散步。突然，一只可爱的猫从一棵树后面跳了出来。这只猫有着柔软的毛和大大的眼睛。小女孩看到它非常高兴，想要和这只猫一起玩。**
