> A tourist was lost in a beautiful city. A kind Swiss person came to help. The Swiss showed the tourist around and introduced local specialties. The tourist was very grateful and remembered the friendly Swiss. **一位游客在一个美丽的城市迷路了。一位善良的瑞士人前来帮忙。这位瑞士人带着游客四处参观，并介绍当地的特色。游客非常感激，记住了这位友好的瑞士人。**

> A poor boy wanted to change his life. He learned to cut and sew clothes and became a tailor. With his hard work and skills, he made beautiful clothes for people and finally had a better life. **一个贫穷的男孩想要改变自己的生活。他学习裁剪和缝纫衣服，成为了一名裁缝。凭借他的努力和技能，他为人们制作了漂亮的衣服，最终过上了更好的生活。**

> One day, a little boy was very happy because he got a new toy car. It was shiny and had cool wheels. He played with it all day and took it everywhere. The toy made him so joyful. **有一天，一个小男孩非常高兴，因为他得到了一辆新的玩具车。它闪闪发光，还有很酷的轮子。他一整天都在玩它，走到哪里都带着。这个玩具让他非常快乐。**
> 想象一个大工厂，里面有各种忙碌的工人。他们有的在操作机器，有的在运输货物，这些工人整体就构成了 workforce。他们是工厂运转的关键力量，一起努力完成工作任务。 **想象一个大工厂里忙碌的工人整体构成了劳动力，他们是工厂运转的关键力量，一起努力完成工作任务。**

> A young artist spent days and nights in her studio. Her works, including beautiful paintings and sculptures, amazed everyone. Her hard work finally paid off and her works were shown in a famous gallery. **一位年轻的艺术家在她的工作室里日夜工作。她的作品，包括美丽的绘画和雕塑，令每个人都感到惊叹。她的努力最终得到了回报，她的作品在一家著名的画廊展出。**

> In the fierce battle, a brave soldier was shot and became wounded. His comrades rushed to help him. They carried the wounded soldier to safety and provided immediate medical care. **在激烈的战斗中，一位勇敢的士兵中枪受伤了。他的战友们冲过去帮助他。他们把受伤的士兵带到安全地带，并立即给予医疗照顾。**

> A man was lost in the jungle. Suddenly, an ape jumped out from behind a tree. The ape had a big mouth and long arms. It scared the man a lot. **一个男人在丛林里迷路了。突然，一只猿猴从一棵树后面跳了出来。这只猿猴有一张大嘴和长长的胳膊。它把这个男人吓了一大跳。**

> In a war, the enemy constantly bombard our city. They fired many bombs and shells, making loud noises and causing great damage. Remember, bombard means to attack heavily with bombs or shells. **在一场战争中，敌人不断轰炸我们的城市。他们发射了许多炸弹和炮弹，发出巨大声响并造成巨大破坏。记住，bombard 意思是用炸弹或炮弹猛烈攻击。**

> One day, a tall building was hit by a strong earthquake. Its structure weakened and eventually collapsed. People were shocked to see it fall down in pieces. **有一天，一座高楼被一场强烈的地震袭击。它的结构变弱，最终倒塌了。人们震惊地看到它碎成一片一片地倒下。**

> A detective was solving a case. The evidence seemed perfect at first, but later he found it was flawed. Some important clues were missing, leading him to a dead end. Poor detective! **一位侦探在侦破一个案件。起初证据看起来很完美，但后来他发现它是有缺陷的。一些重要的线索缺失了，致使他陷入僵局。可怜的侦探！**

> Imagine a hidden treasure chest. The value of the jewels inside is not because of the chest\'s appearance but is intrinsically within the jewels themselves. Intrinsically means essentially or inherently. **想象一个隐藏的宝箱。里面珠宝的价值不是因为宝箱的外表，而是本质上就在珠宝自身内部。intrinsically 意思是本质上；内在地。**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there was a group of people following the Islamic faith. They were kind and peaceful, praying and living by its teachings. The Islamic way guided them to do good deeds and show love to others. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，有一群人信奉伊斯兰宗教。他们善良且平和，依据其教义祈祷和生活。伊斯兰的方式引导他们做好事，关爱他人。**

> A poor man had a dream to pave a beautiful road for his village. He worked hard every day, carrying stones and laying them down. Finally, his dream came true and the road made people\'s lives better. **一个穷人梦想为他的村庄铺设一条美丽的道路。他每天努力工作，搬运石头并铺设它们。最终，他的梦想实现了，这条路让人们的生活变得更好。**
> 想象一个神奇的药厂，里面的工人都在忙碌地生产各种药品。这些药品能治疗各种疾病，让人们恢复健康。这个药厂就是\'pharmaceutical\'的世界。 **想象一个药厂，工人生产药品，来辅助记忆\'pharmaceutical\'（制药的；药品）这个单词**

> A brave astronaut was projected into space. He faced many challenges but was determined to complete his mission. The word \'projected\' here means sent or thrown forward forcefully. **一位勇敢的宇航员被投射到太空中。他面临许多挑战，但决心完成任务。单词\'projected\'在这里表示有力地发送或向前投掷。**
> 想象一下，有个调皮的小孩在玩拼图，怎么都拼不好一块像肋骨形状的拼图，他生气地说：\'这可恶的 rib 太难拼了！\' 后来他终于拼好了，开心极了。 **想象一个小孩拼肋骨形状的拼图来记住 rib（肋骨；排骨）这个单词**

> Imagine a big city where people from many different cultures live together. They have their own festivals, foods, and languages. This city is multicultural, full of diversity and rich experiences. **想象一个大城市，那里有来自许多不同文化的人们生活在一起。他们有自己的节日、食物和语言。这个城市是多元文化的，充满了多样性和丰富的经历。**

> The little cat was playing with a ball, using its soft paws to bat it around. Its paws were so cute and tiny, like little cushions. One paw accidentally hit the vase, making a loud noise. **小猫正在玩球，用它柔软的爪子把球拨来拨去。它的爪子那么可爱小巧，像小垫子一样。一只爪子不小心碰到了花瓶，发出很大的声响。**

> A fashion designer always strives to create up-to-date clothing. One day, she got an inspiration from a modern art exhibition and designed a collection that was completely in line with the latest trends. Her designs were truly up-to-date. **一位时装设计师总是努力创造最新的服装。有一天，她从一个现代艺术展览中获得灵感，设计了一系列完全符合最新潮流的作品。她的设计真的是最新的。**

> A young artist painted a beautiful picture. Everyone loved it and soon he became well-known. People from far and wide came to see his works. His name was known by all. **一位年轻的艺术家画了一幅美丽的画。大家都很喜欢，很快他就出名了。来自四面八方的人都来看他的作品。他的名字被所有人知晓。**
> A chap was walking in the forest. Suddenly, he tripped and his face got chapped. Poor chap! But he stood up and continued his journey. **一个家伙在森林里走着。突然，他绊倒了，脸皴裂了。可怜的家伙！但他站起来继续前行。**
> 想象一下，在古老的图书馆中，有一本神秘而神圣的书，它被无数人视为真理的指引，它的名字叫\'Bible\'。每当人们感到迷茫，就会翻开它寻找答案，它就像一盏明灯照亮人们前行的路。 **想象在古老图书馆中有一本被视为真理指引、叫\'Bible\'的神秘神圣之书，人们迷茫时会翻开它寻找答案，它像明灯照亮前路。**

> There was a man who always wore a so-called magic hat. Everyone believed it had powers, but in fact, it was just an ordinary hat. The term \'so-called\' here shows that it was wrongly named or not truly as claimed. **有一个男人总是戴着一顶所谓的魔法帽。每个人都认为它有魔力，但实际上，它只是一顶普通的帽子。这里的"所谓的"表明它被错误地命名或并非如所声称的那样。**

> Once upon a time, there was a young man who was passionate about social justice. He read Marx\'s works and became a firm Marxist, determined to fight for equality and fairness. His beliefs led him to make positive changes in society. **从前，有一个年轻人热衷于社会正义。他阅读了马克思的著作，成为了一名坚定的马克思主义者，决心为平等和公平而战。他的信念使他在社会中做出了积极的改变。**

> A thief was stealing goods in a market and then jumped into a van to escape. But the police caught him quickly. Remember, \'van\' is a vehicle for transportation or carrying things. **一个小偷在市场偷了东西然后跳进一辆厢式货车逃跑。但警察很快抓住了他。记住，\'van\'是用于运输或载货的车辆。**

> One day, a thief broke into a house and stole a mug. But he was so nervous that he dropped the mug and made a loud noise. The owner woke up and caught him. Remember, a mug is a cup, usually with a handle. **一天，一个小偷闯进一间房子偷了一个马克杯。但他太紧张了，把马克杯弄掉并发出很大的声响。主人醒了并抓住了他。记住，mug 就是杯子，通常有把手。**

> A young athlete was determined to succeed. After countless efforts and failures, he kept going. Finally, in the succeeding races, he won one after another. His hard work paid off. **一位年轻的运动员决心取得成功。经过无数次的努力和失败，他坚持不懈。最终，在接下来的比赛中，他接连获胜。他的努力得到了回报。**

> A poor man was always in misery. He had no job, no money, and lived in a small, cold room. One day, he found a way to change his life and finally escaped from this state of misery. **一个可怜的男人总是处于痛苦之中。他没有工作，没有钱，住在一个又小又冷的房间里。有一天，他找到了改变生活的方法，最终摆脱了这种痛苦的状态。**

> One day, Tom was taking a bath. When he got out, he found a big tub filled with colorful balls. He had so much fun playing with them in the tub. **一天，汤姆正在洗澡。当他出来时，他发现一个大浴盆里装满了五颜六色的球。他在浴盆里玩这些球玩得非常开心。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a hidden cave. He found a gem that shone with an intrinsic light, not because of any external source but because of its own nature. Just like this gem, \'intrinsic\' means belonging naturally to something. **一位勇敢的探险家在探索一个隐藏的洞穴。他发现了一颗散发着内在光芒的宝石，不是因为任何外部光源，而是因为其自身的特性。就像这颗宝石一样，'intrinsic'意思是某物固有的、内在的。**
> 想象一下，一个遥远的星球，人们通过神奇的电波（tele）进行交流（communication），这种跨越远距离的交流方式就是电信（telecommunications），让信息瞬间传递。 **想象在遥远星球，人们通过电波进行远距离交流的方式就是电信**

> In a strange world, a magical axis connected the sky and the earth. It was like a pillar of light, guiding everyone\'s direction. Without it, the world would be in chaos. Remember, \'axis\' means the central line or the main point. **在一个奇异的世界里，有一根神奇的轴连接着天空和大地。它就像一束光柱，指引着每个人的方向。没有它，世界将会陷入混乱。记住，\'axis\'意思是轴；中心线；坐标轴。**

> A young boy dreamt of meeting the pope. One day, he traveled far and finally saw the pope in a grand church. The pope\'s smile and kindness left a deep impression on him. From then on, he never forgot the word \'pope\'. **一个小男孩梦想见到教皇。有一天，他长途跋涉，终于在一座宏伟的教堂里见到了教皇。教皇的微笑和亲切给他留下了深刻的印象。从那以后，他再也忘不了'pope'这个词。**

> In a hot summer, Tom was sweating a lot. Then he entered a room with amazing air-conditioning. It was so cool and comfortable. The air-conditioning made the air fresh and pleasant, and Tom felt relaxed immediately. **在一个炎热的夏天，汤姆大汗淋漓。然后他走进一个有很棒空调的房间。房间里非常凉爽舒适。空调让空气清新宜人，汤姆立刻感到放松了。**

> One year, a family faced many difficulties but still had a warm meal together on Thanksgiving. They gave thanks for what they had and shared love. This made them stronger and happier. Remember, Thanksgiving is about gratitude and togetherness. **有一年，一个家庭面临诸多困难，但在感恩节仍一起享用了温暖的一餐。他们为所拥有的表示感恩并分享爱。这让他们更强大和快乐。记住，感恩节是关于感恩和团聚。**

> A little bird was very thirsty. It found a flower with nectar and took a small sip. The sweet taste made it happy. Remember, \'sip\' means to drink in small amounts. **一只小鸟非常口渴。它发现了一朵有花蜜的花，轻轻地啜饮了一小口。甜甜的味道让它很开心。记住，'sip'意思是小口喝。**

> A group of friends planned a party. They made sure the invitation was inclusive. Everyone, from the quiet ones to the lively ones, was invited. This showed that the party was for all, without leaving anyone out. **一群朋友计划举办一个聚会。他们确保邀请函具有包容性。从安静的人到活泼的人，每个人都受到了邀请。这表明这个聚会面向所有人，没有遗漏任何人。**

> In a war, a small kingdom was under attack. But the brave soldiers built a strong DEFENSE system. They used big walls and sharp weapons to protect their people and land. So, \'defense\' means to protect from harm or attack. **在一场战争中，一个小王国遭到攻击。但勇敢的士兵们建立了强大的防御系统。他们用高大的城墙和锋利的武器来保护他们的人民和土地。所以，\'defense\'意思是防御，保护免受伤害或攻击。**

> A young scientist was determined to innovate. He spent days and nights in the lab. Finally, he created a new device that changed the world. The word \'innovate\' means to introduce new ideas or methods. **一位年轻的科学家决心创新。他在实验室里日夜钻研。最终，他创造了一个改变世界的新设备。单词\'innovate\'的意思是引入新的想法或方法。**

> A tailor made a unique suit for each customer. The suits were individualized, meaning they were specially designed to fit the specific needs and preferences of every single person. This showed how \'individualized\' means made for each individual. **一位裁缝为每位顾客制作了独一无二的西装。这些西装是个性化的，这意味着它们是专门为每个人的特定需求和喜好而设计的。这展示了\'individualized\'是指为每个个体制作的。**

> A brave doctor was trying to save a patient with a tumor. The tumor was like a monster growing inside the body. But the doctor was determined to defeat it and bring health back. **一位勇敢的医生正努力救治一位患有肿瘤的病人。肿瘤就像身体里生长的怪物。但医生决心打败它，让病人恢复健康。**

> A young entrepreneur wanted to expand his business globally. He became an exporter, sending his high-quality products to different countries. With hard work, his exports grew, making him successful. Remember, exporter means someone who sends goods out of a country. **一位年轻的企业家想要将他的业务拓展到全球。他成为了一名出口商，把他的高质量产品发送到不同的国家。通过努力，他的出口业务增长，使他获得了成功。记住，exporter 意思是出口商，把货物从一个国家送出的人。**

> One day, Tom was playing baseball. But he always missed the ball because he was left-handed and the bat was designed for right-handed people. Finally, he got a special bat for left-handed players and did well. **有一天，汤姆在打棒球。但他总是接不到球，因为他是左撇子，而球棒是为右撇子设计的。最后，他得到了一个专门给左撇子用的球棒，表现得很好。**

> One day, I went to a market and found a beautiful watch. The seller told me it was second-hand. It meant it wasn\'t new but had been owned by someone else before. I still liked it and bought it. **一天，我去了一个市场，发现了一块漂亮的手表。卖家告诉我这是二手的。这意味着它不是新的，之前已经被别人拥有过。我仍然喜欢它并买了下来。**

> A young entrepreneur needed funds for a short-term project. He borrowed money, promising to repay quickly. The term was short, but the impact was big. It taught him the importance of planning for short-term goals. **一位年轻的企业家需要资金用于一个短期项目。他借了钱，并承诺很快偿还。这个期限很短，但影响很大。这教会了他规划短期目标的重要性。**

> One day, Tom was very motivated to learn English. He got up early and spent hours studying. Because he had a dream of traveling the world and communicating freely. His motivation pushed him forward. **有一天，汤姆学习英语的积极性非常高。他早早起床，花了好几个小时学习。因为他有一个环游世界并能自由交流的梦想。他的积极性推动着他前进。**

> Imagine a factory where robots work all by themselves. They move, assemble, and package without any human help. This factory is \'automated\', meaning everything is done automatically and mechanically. **想象一个工厂，里面的机器人独自工作。它们移动、组装和包装，无需任何人类帮助。这个工厂就是\'自动化的\'，意味着一切都是自动且机械地完成。**

> A lumberjack was in the forest. He had a clear-cut task: to cut down only the mature trees. With his sharp axe, he made clean and distinct cuts. Soon, the area was neatly cleared. So, remember \'clear-cut\' means definite and distinct. **一位伐木工在森林里。他有一个明确的任务：只砍伐成熟的树木。他用锋利的斧头，砍出干净清晰的切口。很快，这片区域就被整齐地清理了。所以，记住\'clear-cut\'意思是明确的、清晰的。**

> In a magical forest, animals held a race. Each one wanted to show their competitiveness. The rabbit ran fast, the monkey climbed high. They all tried their best to win. In the end, it was about who was more determined and skilled. **在一个神奇的森林里，动物们举行了一场比赛。每一个都想展现自己的竞争力。兔子跑得很快，猴子爬得很高。它们都尽全力去赢。最后，就看谁更坚定和有技巧。**

> I had a long day at work. I was constantly running around, dealing with difficult tasks. It was truly exhausting. I felt so tired that I could hardly move when I got home. **我工作了漫长的一天。我不停地跑来跑去，处理困难的任务。这真的令人精疲力竭。到家时我累得几乎动不了。**

> A little monkey wanted to give a representation of its daily life to its friends. It showed how it climbed trees, found food, and played. Through this, its friends understood its world better. **一只小猴子想向它的朋友们展示它日常生活的样子。它展示了如何爬树、找食物和玩耍。通过这个，它的朋友们更好地了解了它的世界。**

> A young author worked hard day and night. Finally, her book became a best-seller. Everyone loved it and couldn\'t put it down. It was the best among all the books sold. **一位年轻的作者日夜努力工作。最终，她的书成为了畅销书。每个人都喜欢它，爱不释手。这是所有售出的书中最好的。**

> Imagine a city with a big gap between the rich and the poor. But there is a group of people, not super rich nor poor. They have stable jobs and decent incomes. They are the middle-class, living a comfortable life in the middle of the social ladder. **想象一个城市，贫富差距巨大。但有一群人，既不是超级富豪也不是穷人。他们有稳定的工作和不错的收入。他们就是中产阶级，在社会阶梯的中间过着舒适的生活。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man who always wore clothes from decades ago. His style was considered old-fashioned. People laughed, but he didn\'t care. He loved the classic look and refused to follow modern trends. **从前，有一个男人总是穿着几十年前的衣服。他的风格被认为是过时的。人们嘲笑他，但他不在乎。他喜欢经典的样子，拒绝追随现代潮流。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl was lost in a forest. But when she found a clear well, she felt a sense of well-being. The well provided clean water, making her believe everything would be okay. **从前，有个小女孩在森林里迷路了。但当她找到一口清澈的水井时，她感到了一种幸福安康。这口井提供了干净的水，让她相信一切都会好起来。**

> A brave climber was scaling a mountain. Suddenly, a rock fell and hit his leg, causing a fractured bone. But with determination, he still managed to get help. Remember, \'fractured\' means broken or cracked. **一位勇敢的登山者正在攀登山峰。突然，一块石头掉落砸到了他的腿，导致骨头骨折。但凭借决心，他还是设法获得了帮助。记住，\'fractured\'意思是断裂的、破碎的。**

> A scientist was struggling to continue his research due to a lack of funding. But one day, a generous donor provided the necessary funds, enabling him to make a great discovery. Funding is the money provided for a particular purpose. **一位科学家因缺乏资金难以继续他的研究。但有一天，一位慷慨的捐赠者提供了必要的资金，使他能够有重大发现。Funding 指为特定目的提供的资金。**

> A painter was working in a muted room. The colors he chose were also muted, not bright. But when he opened the window, sunlight filled the room, and the colors became vivid. Muted means soft and not loud or bright. **一位画家在一间安静昏暗的房间里工作。他选用的颜色也很柔和暗淡，不鲜艳。但当他打开窗户，阳光充满房间，颜色变得鲜艳起来。muted 意思是柔和的，不响亮或不鲜艳的。**

> A group of friends decided to study concurrently for the exam. They sat together, sharing notes and helping each other. It was a great way to learn at the same time and achieve good results. **一群朋友决定同时为考试学习。他们坐在一起，分享笔记并互相帮助。这是一种同时学习并取得好成绩的好方法。**

> One day, Tom found a lot of plastic bottles. He knew they were recyclable. So he took them to the recycling station and made the environment better. **有一天，汤姆发现了很多塑料瓶。他知道它们是可回收的。所以他把它们带到了回收站，让环境变得更好。**

> In a small town, there was a wise old man. Everyone respected him. He gave good advice and was kind. People listened to him carefully. Because of his wisdom and kindness, he was highly respected. **在一个小镇上，有一位睿智的老人。每个人都尊敬他。他给出好的建议并且很友善。人们都认真聆听他的话。因为他的智慧和善良，他备受尊敬。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler named Tom. He met a kind priest in a village. The priest belonged to the Catholic Church and showed great love and compassion. Tom was deeply impressed by the Catholic\'s spirit of universal love. **从前，有个叫汤姆的旅行者。他在一个村庄遇到了一位善良的牧师。这位牧师属于天主教，展现出了极大的爱与慈悲。汤姆对天主教徒博爱的精神印象深刻。**

> A poor student was always worried about buying textbooks. One day, he found an affordable bookstore where the prices were so reasonable that he could easily afford all the books he needed. He was very happy. **一个贫困的学生总是为购买教科书而烦恼。有一天，他发现了一家价格实惠的书店，那里的价格非常合理，他能够轻松地买得起所有他需要的书。他非常高兴。**

> One day, I was very nervous before a big exam. My friend stood by my side, giving me encouraging words and practical help. His behavior was truly supportive, making me believe I could do well. **有一天，在一场重要考试前我非常紧张。我的朋友站在我身边，给我鼓励的话语和实际的帮助。他的行为真的是支持性的，让我相信我能做好。**

> One day, a little mouse was very hungry. It saw a big piece of cheese and decided to bite it. But as it bit, a trap was triggered! Poor mouse. Remember, \'bite\' means to use your teeth to cut into something. **有一天，一只小老鼠非常饿。它看到一大块奶酪，决定咬一口。但当它咬的时候，触发了一个陷阱！可怜的老鼠。记住，\'bite\'意思是用牙齿切入某物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a brave boy named Jack. He climbed up a tall tree to rescue a little bird. Everyone praised Jack for his courage. With this image in mind, remember the word \'jack\' meaning a person\'s name or a device for lifting. **从前，有一个勇敢的男孩叫杰克。他爬上一棵大树去救一只小鸟。大家都称赞杰克的勇敢。记住这个画面，来记住'jack'这个词，它指人的名字或起重装置。**

> One day, a student was confused about social theories. Then, a wise teacher introduced him to Marxism, explaining how it aims for a fair and equal society. The student was enlightened and began to explore this powerful idea. **有一天，一个学生对社会理论感到困惑。然后，一位睿智的老师向他介绍了马克思主义，解释它如何致力于一个公平和平等的社会。这个学生受到启发，开始探索这个强大的思想。**

> One hot summer day, I was sweating a lot. Then I saw an ice-cream truck. I bought an ice-cream. The cold and sweet taste made me feel so happy and refreshed. **在一个炎热的夏日，我汗流浃背。然后我看到一辆冰淇淋车。我买了一个冰淇淋。那冰凉又甜蜜的味道让我感到非常开心和神清气爽。**

> Once upon a time, people were isolated and had limited knowledge. But then came the Internet, like a magic bridge connecting everyone. With it, we can share, learn, and communicate easily, making the world smaller and more accessible. **从前，人们彼此孤立，知识有限。但后来出现了互联网，就像一座神奇的桥梁连接着每个人。有了它，我们可以轻松地分享、学习和交流，让世界变得更小、更容易接近。**

> One day, Tom was supposed to meet his friend at the park. But he went to the zoo by mistake. His friend was very angry. Tom realized his mistake and apologized sincerely. **一天，汤姆本该在公园见他的朋友。但他错去了动物园。他的朋友非常生气。汤姆意识到了自己的错误并真诚地道了歉。**

> One day, I was lost in the park. I felt scared and started crying. Then, mom appeared like a hero. She held my hand and took me home. Her smile and warmth made me feel safe. Mom is always there for me. **有一天，我在公园迷路了。我感到害怕并哭了起来。然后，妈妈像英雄一样出现了。她牵起我的手带我回家。她的微笑和温暖让我感到安全。妈妈总是在我身边。**
> 想象一下，小明有个伟大梦想，决定开启一家创新的科技公司。他勇敢地迈出第一步，这就是start-up。从无到有，充满希望和挑战。 **想象一下，小明决定开启一家创新的科技公司，这第一步就是'创业、启动'。**
> 想象一下，在一个未来世界，每个人都依靠神奇的电脑来解决问题。这些电脑不停地进行着计算（computing），快速处理大量的数据，帮助人们做出最佳决策。 **想象在未来世界，电脑不停进行计算处理数据帮助人们决策的情景。**
> 想象一个科学家在实验室里研究基因，他专注地探索着生物特征是如何从一代传递到下一代的。他口中不断念叨着\'genetically\'，意思就是'从基因方面；遗传地'。 **想象科学家研究基因的场景来记住genetically意为从基因方面；遗传地**

> A superhero consistently saves the city from villains. No matter how hard the battle, he shows up and acts bravely. \'Consistently\' here means always doing something in the same way and without changing. **一位超级英雄始终如一地从反派手中拯救城市。无论战斗多么艰难，他都会出现并勇敢行动。\'consistently\'在这里指总是以相同的方式做事且不改变。**

> A time traveler named Alice journeyed through different eras. She witnessed great events and noted that everything was \'historically\' significant. She realized that this word described events based on their place in the past. **一位名叫爱丽丝的时间旅行者穿越了不同的时代。她目睹了重大事件，并注意到一切都具有"历史上的"重要性。她意识到这个词描述了基于过去的事件。**

> A young couple was struggling with parenting. One day, they saw an old man teaching his grandchildren patiently. Inspired, they learned that parenting is about love, patience and guidance. Now they are great parents. **一对年轻夫妇在育儿方面很吃力。有一天，他们看到一位老人耐心地教导孙子孙女。受到启发，他们明白了育儿就是爱、耐心和引导。现在他们是很棒的父母。**

> A city was predominantly filled with tall buildings. But one small house stood out. It was predominantly different from the rest. It showed that \'predominantly\' means mainly or mostly. **一个城市主要都是高楼大厦。但有一个小房子很突出。它与其他的主要不同。这表明'predominantly'意思是主要地、多半地。**

> A little mouse was walking in the forest and met a big, fierce tiger. The tiger\'s fierce look was intimidating. The mouse was so scared that it ran away quickly. **一只小老鼠在森林里走着，遇到了一只又大又凶的老虎。老虎凶猛的样子令人胆怯。老鼠害怕极了，很快就跑掉了。**

> Imagine a patient with a serious illness but remains untreated. The doctor is away and no medicine is given. \'Untreated\' means not having received any treatment or care, just like this poor patient. **想象一个身患重病但未得到治疗的病人。医生不在，也没有给药。\'untreated\'意思是未接受任何治疗或照料，就像这个可怜的病人一样。**
> 想象一下，你是一位探险家，站在山顶俯瞰整个山谷。你看到了森林、河流、村庄，这就是一个 OVERVIEW（概览），让你对整个区域有了全面而宏观的了解。 **想象一位探险家站在山顶俯瞰山谷的情景来理解 overview 这个词，意思是概览、概述。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment. He made a mistake and got an unintended result. It was a surprise that wasn\'t planned. But this unintended outcome led to a new discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验。他犯了个错误，得到了一个意想不到的结果。这是一个未计划的意外。但这个意外的结果带来了新的发现。**

> In a magical forest, all kinds of creatures lived happily. From tiny insects to huge mammals, it showed the beauty of biodiversity. It means the variety of life on Earth, making our world rich and wonderful. **在一个神奇的森林里，各种各样的生物快乐地生活着。从微小的昆虫到巨大的哺乳动物，这展现了生物多样性的美。它指的是地球上生命的多样性，让我们的世界丰富多彩。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. Through hard work and perseverance, he finally became an achiever in school and was praised by everyone. **从前，有个小男孩叫汤姆。他面对许多困难但从不放弃。通过努力和坚持，他最终在学校成为了一个成功者，受到了大家的称赞。**

> A man was always talking about inconsequential things like the color of his socks. But when it came to important decisions, his words had no consequence. So, we learned \'inconsequential\' means not important or having no real effect. **一个男人总是谈论诸如他袜子的颜色之类无关紧要的事情。但在重要决策时，他的话没有任何影响。所以，我们知道了\'inconsequential\'意思是不重要的或没有实际影响的。**

> A little ant was trying to move a huge rock. It seemed impossible, but with the help of its friends, they worked massively and finally moved the rock. It shows that when we work massively together, even the hardest tasks can be accomplished. **一只小蚂蚁试图移动一块巨大的石头。这似乎不可能，但在朋友们的帮助下，它们大规模地努力，最终移动了石头。这表明当我们大规模地共同努力时，即使是最艰巨的任务也能完成。**

> A young entrepreneur had a brilliant idea. He worked hard to turn it into a product. With marketing and sales efforts, his idea achieved commercialization and became popular in the market, making him successful. **一位年轻的企业家有一个绝妙的想法。他努力将其转化为产品。通过营销和销售的努力，他的想法实现了商业化，并在市场上大受欢迎，使他获得成功。**

> Imagine a city where planners need to know details like age, gender and population. They call this set of information \'demographics\'. It helps them plan better services and facilities. So, demographics is all about these key population characteristics. **想象一个城市，规划者需要了解诸如年龄、性别和人口数量等细节。他们把这组信息称为"人口统计数据"。它帮助他们更好地规划服务和设施。所以，demographics 就是关于这些关键的人口特征。**

> A thief was notoriously known in the town. Everyone was afraid of him. But one day, the police caught him. Now, the town was safe and people no longer lived in fear. **一个小偷在镇上臭名昭著。每个人都怕他。但有一天，警察抓住了他。现在，镇子安全了，人们不再生活在恐惧中。**
> 从前有个勇敢的探险家，他在古老的图书馆中发现一本神秘的书籍，上面写满了 Latin 文字。他努力钻研，最终解开了书中隐藏的宝藏秘密。Latin 就像这神秘的文字，承载着古老的智慧和秘密。 **从前有个勇敢的探险家，他在古老的图书馆中发现一本满是拉丁语的神秘书籍。他努力钻研，最终解开了书中隐藏的宝藏秘密。拉丁语就像这神秘的文字，承载着古老的智慧和秘密。**

> One day, a little boy saw a tall man. He asked his mom, \'Who is that?\' Mom said, \'That\'s a grown-up. Grown-ups are older and more experienced.\' The boy understood that grown-ups are not kids anymore. **有一天，一个小男孩看到一个高个子男人。他问妈妈："那是谁？"妈妈说："那是个成年人。成年人年龄更大，更有经验。"男孩明白了成年人不再是孩子了。**

> A young designer decided to go freelance. She was free from the fixed schedule of a company and could choose projects she loved. With her skills and freedom, she became successful. freelance means working independently. **一位年轻的设计师决定成为自由职业者。她摆脱了公司固定的日程安排，可以选择自己喜欢的项目。凭借她的技能和自由，她取得了成功。freelance 意思是独立工作。**

> A detective was investigating a mysterious case. The proceedings of the investigation were complex. He had to follow many clues and interview many witnesses. Finally, he solved the case. **一位侦探正在调查一起神秘案件。调查的过程很复杂。他不得不追踪许多线索和询问许多证人。最终，他破了案。**

> A boy misplaced his favorite toy car. He looked everywhere but couldn\'t find it. Later, he found it in a wrong box. Misplaced means put something in the wrong place. **一个男孩把他最喜欢的玩具车放错了地方。他到处找但都找不到。后来，他在一个错误的盒子里找到了。misplaced 意思是把某物放错地方。**

> A factory was making toys. But along with the main toys, some strange little things were also made. These strange little things were not the main goal. They were the by-product. Just like unexpected extras. **一家工厂正在制造玩具。但随着主要的玩具，还生产出了一些奇怪的小东西。这些奇怪的小东西不是主要目标。它们就是副产品。就像意外的附加物。**

> Once upon a time, there was a kind woman. She spent all her time taking care of the sick and elderly. Everyone called her a caregiver. She gave love and care without expecting anything in return. **从前，有一位善良的女士。她把所有时间都用来照顾病人和老人。大家都称她为照料者。她给予关爱却不图回报。**
> 想象一下，有个科学家在一个充满神秘仪器的实验室里，专注研究生物与科技的结合。他的工作就是biotech，通过生物技术创造新的药物和治疗方法，为人类健康带来希望。 **想象一位科学家在实验室研究生物与科技结合，他的工作即生物技术，用于创造新药物和治疗方法，带来健康希望。**

> One day, when a fire broke out, Tom instinctively ran to save the children. Without thinking, he acted based on his inner nature. > A factory was in chaos until a wise manager came and standardized everything. Workers had clear rules, machines ran smoothly. Now the factory is efficient and successful. **一家工厂曾一片混乱，直到一位明智的经理到来，将一切标准化。工人们有了明确的规则，机器运行顺畅。现在工厂高效且成功。**

> A company was facing high costs and decided to outsource some of its work. They found a partner overseas who could do the tasks more efficiently and at a lower cost. Now they focus on core business and save money. **一家公司面临高额成本，决定将部分工作外包。他们在海外找到一个合作伙伴，能更高效且低成本地完成任务。现在他们专注于核心业务并节省了资金。**

> A young scientist was always positively thinking when facing challenges. He believed that every problem had a solution. His positive attitude led to many great discoveries. > Once upon a time, there were two families. One was full of musicians, the other of scientists. They had nothing in common. They were completely unrelated. > A small village was facing many problems. But a wise man came and taught them how to sustain their resources for the long term. This ability to keep going and not run out was called sustainability. **一个小村庄面临着许多问题。但一位智者前来教导他们如何长期维持资源。这种能够持续下去且不会耗尽的能力被称为可持续性。**

> A weatherman always predicts the weather predictably. But one day, his prediction was wrong and everyone was surprised. We learned that even when things seem predictably certain, there can be unexpected changes. **一位气象员总是可预测地预测天气。但有一天，他的预测错了，所有人都很惊讶。我们明白了，即使事情看似可预测地确定，也可能有意外的变化。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful garden. Its flowers and trees had a special charm, or attractiveness, that drew people from far and wide. The garden\'s attractiveness made it a favorite place for all. **从前，有一个美丽的花园。它的花和树有一种特殊的魅力，即吸引力，吸引着来自四面八方的人们。花园的吸引力使它成为所有人最喜欢的地方。**

> A young artist wanted to stand out. So, he specialized in painting unique landscapes. His specialized skills made his artworks highly sought-after. Soon, he became famous for his specialized style. **一位年轻的艺术家想要脱颖而出。于是，他专门从事独特风景的绘画。他的专业技能使他的艺术作品备受追捧。很快，他因其专业的风格而出名。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical forest, there was a special flower with a color and smell no other flower had. This flower\'s special quality was its uniqueness. It stood out among all the others. **从前，在一个神奇的森林里，有一朵特别的花，它的颜色和气味是其他花所没有的。这朵花的特别之处就在于它的独特性。它在其他花中脱颖而出。**

> A young artist wanted to break the stereotypical view that all paintings must be realistic. So, she created abstract works that amazed everyone. The word \'stereotypical\' means conforming to a fixed or conventional pattern. **一位年轻的艺术家想要打破那种认为所有绘画都必须写实的刻板印象。所以，她创作了令所有人惊叹的抽象作品。\'stereotypical\'这个单词的意思是符合固定或传统的模式。**

> A young artist had an idealized vision of a perfect garden. He imagined colorful flowers, clear fountains, and peaceful benches. This vision was so idealized that it was almost like a dream. But it inspired him to create beautiful art. **一位年轻的艺术家对一个完美的花园有着理想化的想象。他想象着五颜六色的花朵、清澈的喷泉和平静的长椅。这种想象是如此理想化，几乎像一场梦。但它激励他创作出美丽的艺术作品。**

> I was in a big library. The signs and book categories were all over the place, making me lost. It was so confusing! I had no idea where to find the book I wanted. **我在一个大图书馆里。标识和书籍分类到处都是，让我晕头转向。这太令人困惑了！我完全不知道去哪里找我想要的书。**
> 想象一下，有个神奇的花园，里面的花朵每天都在变化（vary）。有时颜色不同，有时形状不一。这种不断变化的（varying）景象让人惊叹不已。 **想象一个神奇花园里花朵不断变化的景象来辅助记忆varying（不同的；变化的；多种多样的）这个单词**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was lost and found a group of kind people. They followed Catholicism and showed him great love and care. Through their faith, he understood the essence of Catholicism, which is about universal love and kindness. **从前，有一个旅行者迷路了，遇到了一群善良的人。他们信奉天主教，向他展现了极大的爱与关怀。通过他们的信仰，他明白了天主教的本质，即普世的爱与善良。**

> A small village had disproportionately few resources compared to a big city. The villagers struggled, showing how \'disproportionately\' means in an unequal or unbalanced way. **一个小村庄与大城市相比，资源少得不成比例。村民们苦苦挣扎，这展现了'disproportionately'是指以不平等或不均衡的方式。**

> A young artist was obsessed with painting the perfect landscape. He spent every day thinking and working on it. His mind was fully occupied with this passion. Eventually, his obsession led to a masterpiece. **一位年轻的艺术家痴迷于画出完美的风景画。他每天都在思考和创作。他的心思完全被这份热情占据。最终，他的痴迷造就了一幅杰作。**

> A famous actor always appears in high-profile movies and events. Everyone knows him. He is always in the spotlight, just like the word \'high-profile\' which means attracting a lot of attention and publicity. **一位著名的演员总是出现在备受瞩目的电影和活动中。每个人都认识他。他总是处于聚光灯下，正如'high-profile'这个词，意思是引起大量关注和宣传。**

> One day, I wore the wrong clothes to a party and everyone stared at me. I felt so embarrassed. It was like being in a spotlight with no place to hide. My face turned red and I just wanted to disappear. **有一天，我穿错衣服去参加派对，每个人都盯着我看。我感到非常尴尬。就好像置身于聚光灯下无处可藏。我的脸变红了，只想消失。**

> A peaceful village was suddenly attacked by bandits. The villagers\' properties were stolen and some were even hurt. They felt outraged and decided to unite to fight back and protect their home. **一个宁静的村庄突然遭到土匪的袭击。村民们的财物被偷，甚至有人受伤。他们感到愤怒不已，决定团结起来反击并保护自己的家园。**

> One day, I went to a theme park. But it was overcrowded. There were too many people everywhere. I could hardly move. It was a chaotic and uncomfortable experience. **有一天，我去了一个主题公园。但那里过度拥挤。到处都是太多的人。我几乎无法移动。这是一次混乱又不舒服的经历。**

> In a race, the car broke down. But the driver didn\'t give up. The fans\' cheering was like a rallying call. It gave him the strength to fix the car and continue. Finally, he crossed the finish line. The word \'rallying\' means inspiring or uniting for a common purpose. **在一场比赛中，汽车坏了。但车手没有放弃。粉丝们的欢呼就像一种鼓舞的号召。这给了他修理汽车并继续的力量。最终，他冲过了终点线。"rallying"这个单词意为鼓舞的、召集的，为了一个共同的目的而激励或团结。**

> A brave knight showed aggressiveness when facing the evil dragon. He charged forward without fear, determined to protect the village. His aggressiveness was not bad but a force for justice. **一位勇敢的骑士在面对恶龙时展现出了攻击性。他毫不畏惧地向前冲，决心保护村庄。他的攻击性并非恶意，而是一种正义的力量。**

> A young man always had the dream of starting his own business. He faced many challenges but never gave up. Finally, his spirit of entrepreneurship led him to success. He became a role model for others. **一个年轻人一直有自己创业的梦想。他面临诸多挑战但从未放弃。最终，他的创业精神使他获得成功。他成为了其他人的榜样。**

> A king had a secret garden. To keep others out, he put up an exclusionary fence. Only he could enter. This shows what \'exclusionary\' means - keeping others away or excluding them. **一位国王有一个秘密花园。为了不让别人进入，他竖起了一道排他性的围栏。只有他能进去。这就展示了\'exclusionary\'的意思------把别人拒之门外或排斥他们。**

> One day, I received a letter. It wasn\'t a common one but a personalized one with my name and special greetings. It made me feel so unique and important, as if it was made just for me. **有一天，我收到了一封信。这不是一封普通的信，而是一封个性化的信，上面有我的名字和特别的问候。这让我觉得自己很独特、很重要，仿佛它就是专门为我而写的。**

> A brave firefighter was in the searing heat of a huge fire. The flames were so intense that it felt like his skin was burning. But he didn\'t give up and finally put out the fire. \'Searing\' means extremely hot or intense. **一位勇敢的消防员身处一场大火的灼热之中。火焰是如此强烈，感觉他的皮肤都在燃烧。但他没有放弃，最终扑灭了大火。'searing'意思是极其炎热或强烈的。**

> A prince showed insensitivity when his people were suffering. He didn\'t care about their hardships. But later, he learned to be sensitive and helped them. Remember, insensitivity means lack of concern or awareness. **一位王子在他的人民受苦时表现出了麻木不仁。他不在乎他们的艰难。但后来，他学会了关心并帮助他们。记住，insensitivity 意思是缺乏关心或意识。**

> A young girl was often underestimated. But one day, she received special training and knowledge, which was her empowerment. With this newfound strength, she achieved great success and proved her worth. **一个年轻女孩经常被低估。但有一天，她接受了特殊的训练和知识，这就是对她的赋权。凭借这新获得的力量，她取得了巨大的成功并证明了自己的价值。**

> A young artist was confused about his style. One day, he discovered postmodern art and was inspired. It combined old and new, breaking traditional rules. Now he understood postmodern as a revolutionary and diverse approach. **一位年轻的艺术家对自己的风格感到困惑。有一天，他发现了后现代艺术并受到启发。它融合了新旧元素，打破了传统规则。现在他明白了后现代是一种具有革命性和多样性的方法。**

> A young artist struggled to express her feelings meaningfully through her paintings. But with practice and passion, her works started to convey deep emotions, making people understand her inner world. **一位年轻的艺术家努力通过她的画作有意义地表达自己的感受。但通过练习和热情，她的作品开始传达深刻的情感，让人们理解她的内心世界。**

> A little ant was persistently trying to climb up a big wall. It fell down many times but still didn\'t give up. Finally, it reached the top. This shows what it means to do something persistently. **一只小蚂蚁坚持不懈地试图爬上一堵大墙。它多次跌落但仍不放弃。最终，它到达了顶部。这展现了 persistently 所表达的意思。**

> A young artist passionately painted every day. His passion for art made his works full of life and emotion. He pursued his dream passionately and finally became famous. **一位年轻的艺术家每天都充满激情地作画。他对艺术的热情使他的作品充满了生机和情感。他满怀激情地追寻自己的梦想，最终成名。**

> One day, a little rabbit was in a dangerous forest. To keep safe, it showed great avoidance skills. It hid from the big bad wolf and ran away from the scary traps. The rabbit\'s avoidance made it survive. **一天，一只小兔子在危险的森林里。为了保证安全，它展现出了出色的躲避技能。它躲开了大坏狼，逃离了可怕的陷阱。兔子的躲避让它活了下来。**

> One day, Tom saw a small scratch on his new car. He immediately shouted and jumped up in anger. His friend said, \'You are overreacting. It\'s just a tiny scratch.\' Tom then realized he had reacted too strongly. **一天，汤姆看到他的新车有一道小划痕。他立刻大喊大叫，愤怒地跳了起来。他的朋友说：'你反应过度了。这只是一个小划痕。'然后汤姆意识到自己反应太强烈了。**
> 想象一个工厂，货物堆得乱七八糟。这时，神奇的 conveyor 出现了，它就像一条长长的传送带，有条不紊地把货物从一个地方运到另一个地方，让整个工厂的运输变得轻松高效。 **想象在一个工厂中，货物杂乱无章。这时，神奇的'输送机'出现了，它如同一条长长的传送带，有序地把货物从一处运至另一处，使整个工厂的运输轻松且高效。**

> A young scientist had an untested theory. He was nervous but decided to present it. Everyone was skeptical at first. But after tests, it turned out to be revolutionary. The word \'untested\' means not having been tested. **一位年轻的科学家有一个未经测试的理论。他很紧张但还是决定展示出来。起初大家都持怀疑态度。但经过测试，它竟然是革命性的。单词\'untested\'意思是未经测试的。**

> A town was peaceful until one day, a strange noise occurred alarmingly. Everyone was scared. But a brave boy found it was just a prank. The frequency of such scary but false alarms was alarmingly high. **一个小镇原本很平静，直到有一天，一阵奇怪的噪音惊人地响起。大家都很害怕。但一个勇敢的男孩发现这只是个恶作剧。这种吓人但虚假的警报频率高得惊人。**

> A brave warrior was on a mission. No matter how many enemies came, he kept fighting. His determination was unstoppable. Just like a speeding train that nothing could stop. **一位勇敢的战士在执行任务。无论有多少敌人来袭，他都持续战斗。他的决心不可阻挡。就像一列飞驰的火车，没有什么能让其停下。**

> A picky shopper always selects goods selectively. He carefully examines each item, choosing only the ones that meet his high standards. This way, he gets exactly what he wants. **一个挑剔的购物者总是有选择性地挑选商品。他仔细检查每一件商品，只选择符合他高标准的。通过这种方式，他能得到他确切想要的东西。**

> A man claimed paradoxically that he was both rich and poor. He had a lot of money but was always unhappy, feeling poor in spirit. This strange statement helped us remember \'paradoxically\', meaning in a contradictory or seemingly illogical way. **一个男人自相矛盾地声称他既富有又贫穷。他有很多钱，但总是不开心，感觉精神上贫穷。这个奇怪的陈述帮助我们记住\'paradoxically\'，意思是以一种矛盾或看似不合逻辑的方式。**

> In a war-torn city, there was constant bombing. One day, a brave soldier named Tom witnessed the bombing and decided to protect his comrades. The bombing was terrifying, but Tom\'s courage never wavered. **在一个饱受战争蹂躏的城市，不断有轰炸。有一天，一位名叫汤姆的勇敢士兵目睹了轰炸，并决定保护他的战友。轰炸很可怕，但汤姆的勇气从未动摇。**

> One day, in a running competition, Tom was judged unfairly. He trained hard but was wrongly accused of cheating. This made him very sad. \'Unfairly\' means not in a fair way. **有一天，在一场跑步比赛中，汤姆受到了不公平的评判。他训练得很努力，却被错误地指责作弊。这让他非常伤心。'unfairly'意思是不公平地。**

> A poor student was always treated unfairly in the exam. The teacher\'s bias caused great unfairness. But the student didn\'t give up and fought for justice. Eventually, the unfairness was corrected. **一个贫困的学生在考试中总是受到不公平的对待。老师的偏见造成了极大的不公平。但这个学生没有放弃，为正义而斗争。最终，不公平被纠正了。**

> A butterfly\'s beauty is fleeting. It flutters by, charming us for a moment, and then disappears. Just like time that passes quickly. So, remember \'fleeting\' means passing quickly and briefly. **蝴蝶的美丽是短暂的。它翩翩飞来，让我们陶醉片刻，然后消失不见。就像快速流逝的时间。所以，记住'fleeting'意思是快速短暂地经过。**

> A brave detective was hunting for a criminal, but the mysterious mastermind behind the crime remained unnamed. The detective vowed to uncover the identity of this unnamed villain and bring justice. **一位勇敢的侦探正在追捕一名罪犯，但这起犯罪背后神秘的策划者仍然未被命名。侦探发誓要揭开这个未被命名的恶棍的身份并伸张正义。**

> A king felt a strong sense of entitlement. He believed everything in the kingdom belonged to him. But his arrogance led to people\'s dissatisfaction. Eventually, he learned that entitlement without responsibility was wrong. **一位国王有着强烈的权利感。他认为王国里的一切都属于他。但他的傲慢导致了人们的不满。最终，他明白了没有责任的权利是错误的。**

> In a faraway forest, all creatures lived ecologically. The birds built nests without harming trees, the animals shared resources peacefully. This harmony showed what it means to exist ecologically - in a way that\'s balanced and respects nature. **在一个遥远的森林里，所有生物都生态地生活着。鸟儿筑巢而不伤害树木，动物和平地共享资源。这种和谐展示了"ecologically（生态地）"的含义------以一种平衡且尊重自然的方式存在。**

> I was playing football and had a bruising encounter with another player. I fell hard and got bruises on my legs. It was a painful but memorable experience. Remember, \'bruising\' means causing or getting bruises. **我在踢足球时和另一名球员有了一次激烈碰撞。我重重摔倒，腿上有了瘀伤。这是一次痛苦但难忘的经历。记住，\'bruising\'意思是造成瘀伤或有瘀伤。**
> 想象一个画家，他的作品总是能准确地代表（represent）现实世界。人们称赞他的画具有很强的代表性（representational）。因为他的画，大家能清晰地看到真实的样子。 **想象一位画家的作品能很好地体现'representational（代表性的）'这个词，因其能准确代表现实**

> A brave scientist was working on a biomedical project. He combined biology and medicine to create a cure for a rare disease. His efforts showed the power of biomedical research to save lives. **一位勇敢的科学家正在从事一个生物医学项目。他将生物学和医学相结合，为一种罕见疾病创造了治疗方法。他的努力展示了生物医学研究拯救生命的力量。**

> Once upon a time, there was a knight who fought wholeheartedly for his kingdom. He put his entire heart and soul into the battle, showing no hesitation or doubt. His wholehearted dedication made him a hero. **从前，有一位骑士全心全意地为他的王国而战。他全身心地投入战斗，毫无犹豫和疑虑。他全心全意的奉献使他成为了英雄。**

> A king was worried about the constitutionality of his new law. A wise advisor explained that it must follow the fundamental rules of the country. The king understood and made sure the law was constitutional. **一位国王担心他新法律的合宪性。一位聪明的顾问解释说，它必须遵循国家的基本规则。国王明白了，并确保法律符合宪法。**

> Once upon a time, a curious traveler explored many places. Through these experiences, he formed his unique worldview. He saw different cultures, met various people, and understood that the world is diverse and complex. **从前，有一位好奇的旅行者探索了许多地方。通过这些经历，他形成了自己独特的世界观。他看到了不同的文化，遇到了各种各样的人，并明白了世界是多样且复杂的。**

> There was a hardworking man named Tom. He spent long hours every day working and learning new skills. Because of his efforts, he became a successful earner and could provide a good life for his family. **有一个勤奋的人叫汤姆。他每天花很长时间工作和学习新技能。由于他的努力，他成为了一个成功的挣钱者，能够为他的家庭提供良好的生活。**

> A prince and a princess from different kingdoms had an interrelationship. They faced many challenges but their connection grew stronger. It showed how their lives were closely linked and influenced each other. **一位王子和一位来自不同王国的公主有着相互关系。他们面临许多挑战，但他们的联系变得更紧密了。这表明他们的生活是如何紧密相连并相互影响的。**

> A young adventurer set out on a journey. The weather, paths, and encounters were full of unpredictability. One moment it was sunny, the next a storm. Sometimes the road was smooth, sometimes full of obstacles. This is what unpredictability means. **一位年轻的冒险家踏上旅程。天气、道路和遭遇都充满了不可预测性。一会儿阳光明媚，一会儿又狂风暴雨。有时道路平坦，有时又充满障碍。这就是不可预测性的含义。**

> A young man named Tom was always confused about his life. One day, he realized that his choices formed his lifestyle. He started making positive changes, like exercising regularly and reading books. Finally, he found a fulfilling lifestyle. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是对自己的生活感到困惑。有一天，他意识到自己的选择构成了他的生活方式。他开始做出积极的改变，比如经常锻炼和读书。最后，他找到了一种令人满足的生活方式。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She was well-educated. She read many books, learned various skills, and finally achieved great success. Her knowledge and wisdom made her stand out. **从前，有个叫莉莉的女孩。她受过良好的教育。她读了很多书，学习了各种技能，最终取得了巨大的成功。她的知识和智慧让她脱颖而出。**

> One day, Tom saw a lot of trash in the park. He decided to become an environmentalist. He started picking up the trash and telling others to protect the environment. With his efforts, the park became clean and beautiful. **有一天，汤姆在公园看到很多垃圾。他决定成为一名环保主义者。他开始捡垃圾并告诉其他人要保护环境。在他的努力下，公园变得干净又美丽。**

> One day, a driver\'s carelessness caused a serious car accident. He forgot to check the brakes, resulting in injuries. This incident showed how dangerous carelessness can be. **有一天，一位司机的粗心导致了一场严重的车祸。他忘记检查刹车，造成了人员受伤。这个事件表明了粗心是多么危险。**

> A poor child named Tom lived in a deprived area. He had no toys or nice clothes. But he was determined to change his situation. One day, he got a chance to study and finally escaped the deprived life. **一个叫汤姆的穷孩子生活在贫困地区。他没有玩具和漂亮衣服。但他决心改变自己的处境。有一天，他得到了一个学习的机会，最终摆脱了贫困的生活。**

> A brave traveler wanted to explore the world. He flew across continents and sailed through oceans. No matter where he went, he realized that problems and solutions were connected globally. Finally, he understood the meaning of \'globally\'. **一位勇敢的旅行者想要探索世界。他飞越大陆，穿越海洋。无论他去到哪里，他都意识到问题和解决方案在全球范围内是相互关联的。最终，他明白了\'globally\'的含义。**

> Two teams were on the field, facing each other with opposing strategies. One team wanted to attack quickly, while the other aimed for a slow and steady defense. The opposing forces made the game very exciting. **两支队伍在场上，有着相反的策略。一支队伍想快速进攻，而另一支旨在缓慢稳健地防守。相反的力量让比赛十分精彩。**

> One night, I was walking alone in an old house. Suddenly, a horrifying monster appeared in front of me. Its face was distorted and its roar was terrifying. I was so scared that I couldn\'t move. **一天晚上，我独自走在一座老房子里。突然，一个令人毛骨悚然的怪物出现在我面前。它的脸扭曲着，吼声令人恐惧。我吓得动弹不得。**

> A scientist was working on a top-secret project to create a robotic assistant. One night, the robotic figure came to life and started helping the scientist. The scientist named it Robo and they became great partners. **一位科学家正在从事一个绝密项目，以创造一个机器人助手。一天晚上，这个机器人形象活了过来，并开始帮助科学家。科学家给它取名为罗博，他们成为了很好的伙伴。**

> A group of scientists were working on a special project. They needed a strong bonding among them to succeed. They shared ideas, helped each other, and finally achieved their goal through this close connection and unity. **一群科学家正在进行一个特殊项目。他们需要彼此之间有很强的联结才能成功。他们分享想法，互相帮助，最终通过这种紧密的联系和团结实现了目标。**

> In a big company, there was a strict hierarchical system. The boss was at the top, then managers, and finally employees. It was like a pyramid, showing clearly the different levels. This is what \'hierarchical\' means. **在一家大公司里，有一个严格的等级制度。老板在顶端，然后是经理，最后是员工。它就像一个金字塔，清晰地展示了不同的层级。这就是\'hierarchical\'的意思。**

> A person was lost in a dark forest. The unknown and fear made them scream and run wildly. Everyone said this was hysteria. Later, they were found and calmed down. **一个人在黑暗的森林里迷路了。未知和恐惧让他们尖叫着疯狂奔跑。大家都说这是歇斯底里。后来，他们被找到并平静了下来。**

> In a small town, some people were marginalized. They were pushed to the edge, ignored by others. But one brave soul stood up and fought for their rights, showing that no one should be marginalized. **在一个小镇上，一些人被边缘化了。他们被推到边缘，被其他人忽视。但有一个勇敢的人站出来为他们的权利而战，表明任何人都不应被边缘化。**

> A time traveler was able to move instantaneously from one era to another. One moment he was in the past, and in the next, he was in the future. It happened so fast, just like the meaning of \'instantaneously\'. **一位时间旅行者能够瞬间从一个时代移动到另一个时代。前一刻他还在过去，下一刻就到了未来。发生得如此之快，就像\'instantaneously\'这个词的意思。**

> A robot was moving mechanically in the factory. It repeated the same tasks over and over, without any thinking or feeling. Just like a machine, doing things in a mechanical way. **一个机器人在工厂里机械地移动着。它一遍又一遍地重复着相同的任务，没有任何思考或感觉。就像机器一样，以机械的方式做事。**

> A young traveler named Tom was lost in an ancient city. He found inscriptions that said \'Roman\'. Later he learned that it meant related to the Romans, a powerful civilization in the past. **一个叫汤姆的年轻旅行者在一座古城迷路了。他发现了写着'Roman'的铭文。后来他了解到这个词意味着与罗马人有关，罗马人是过去一个强大的文明。**

> One day, a girl\'s skin became very dry. So, she went to the store and asked for something to help. The clerk gave her a bottle of \'moisturizer\' and said, \'This will make your skin moist and smooth.\' The girl was happy. **有一天，一个女孩的皮肤变得非常干燥。于是，她去商店寻求帮助。店员给了她一瓶"润肤霜"并说："这个会让你的皮肤湿润光滑。"女孩很高兴。**

> One day, Tom was very sick and needed to stay in the hospital for a long time. This process of being admitted and cared for in the hospital is called hospitalization. **一天，汤姆病得很重，需要在医院住很长时间。这种入住医院并接受照料的过程就叫做住院治疗。**
> 在一场科技大会上，人们都在热烈讨论着各种新的想法。突然，'buzzword'这个词频繁出现，就像一只忙碌的蜜蜂在耳边嗡嗡叫。它代表着那些流行但有时被过度使用的热门词汇。 **在一场科技大会上，人们热烈讨论时频繁出现'buzzword'这个词，它代表流行但有时被过度使用的热门词汇，像耳边嗡嗡叫的蜜蜂。**

> A brave knight was always confrontational. Whenever there was a monster threatening the village, he would confront it without fear. His confrontational spirit made him a hero. **一位勇敢的骑士总是具有对抗性。每当有怪物威胁村庄时，他都会毫不畏惧地与之对抗。他的对抗精神使他成为了英雄。**

> A little rabbit always doubted itself. One day, it found its own unique skills and began to believe in itself. It realized that this feeling of believing in and respecting oneself was called self-esteem. **一只小兔子总是怀疑自己。有一天，它发现了自己独特的技能，开始相信自己。它意识到这种相信和尊重自己的感觉就叫做自尊。**

> A scientist was sequencing the DNA of a mysterious plant. He spent days and nights in the lab, carefully arranging and analyzing the genetic code. Finally, he unlocked the secrets hidden in the sequencing process. **一位科学家正在对一种神秘植物的 DNA 进行测序。他在实验室里日夜工作，仔细排列和分析遗传密码。最终，他揭开了测序过程中隐藏的秘密。**

> A brave adventurer was lost in a strange land. He met an old wise man who spoke Hebrew. The adventurer struggled to understand but was determined to learn. Finally, he could communicate and found his way home. **一位勇敢的冒险家在一片陌生的土地上迷路了。他遇到了一位讲希伯来语的睿智老人。冒险家努力去理解但决心学习。最终，他能够交流并找到了回家的路。**

> A traveler was lost in a desert. Feeling desperate, he found an ancient cave with a book named \'Koran\'. Reading it, he gained wisdom and found his way out. The Koran became his guiding light. **一位旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。感到绝望时，他发现了一个古老的洞穴，里面有一本名为《古兰经》的书。阅读它后，他获得了智慧并找到了出路。《古兰经》成了他的指路明灯。**

> A doctor was prescribing unnecessary medicines just to make more money. This behavior was unethical. People were angry as it was against moral and fair principles. **一位医生为了赚更多钱而开不必要的药。这种行为是不道德的。人们很生气，因为这违背了道德和公平原则。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler met a mysterious person. The person had beautiful Persian rugs and introduced that they were from the Persian land. The traveler was amazed by the unique patterns. Persian means relating to Iran or its language. **从前，一位旅行者遇到一个神秘的人。这个人有漂亮的波斯地毯，并介绍说它们来自波斯之地。旅行者对独特的图案感到惊讶。Persian 意思是与伊朗或其语言有关的。**
> 想象一个小公司面临困境，这时一家大公司出现，就像英雄一样。大公司'take over'了小公司，带来新的管理和资源，让小公司重新焕发生机。意思就是接管、收购。 **想象一家大公司接管、收购面临困境的小公司，并带来新变化。解释为接管、收购。**

> One cold day, Tom was shivering. His mom gave him a sweatshirt. It was so warm and cozy. Tom wore it and felt happy. The sweatshirt protected him from the cold wind. Now he always remembers the word \'sweatshirt\' when he thinks of that day. **在一个寒冷的日子里，汤姆冻得发抖。他妈妈给了他一件运动衫。它非常温暖舒适。汤姆穿上它，感到很开心。这件运动衫保护他免受寒风侵袭。现在每当他想起那一天，就总会记得"sweatshirt"这个单词。**
> 想象一下，在寒冷的北欧，有一群来自斯堪的纳维亚（Scandinavian）的勇敢冒险家。他们穿越冰雪，探索未知，以其独特的勇气和智慧闻名。这个词就代表着他们和那片神秘的土地。 **想象在寒冷的北欧，有一群来自斯堪的纳维亚的勇敢冒险家，这个词代表他们和那片土地。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler met a friendly man in a village. The man said he was Welsh and proud of his heritage. The traveler was impressed by his enthusiasm. Remember, Welsh means relating to Wales or its people. **从前，一位旅行者在一个村庄里遇到一个友好的人。这个人说他是威尔士人，并为自己的传统感到自豪。旅行者被他的热情所打动。记住，Welsh 意思是与威尔士或威尔士人有关的。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He saw a colorful donut in a shop. It looked so delicious with its sweet glaze and sprinkles. Tom bought it and ate it happily. **有一天，汤姆非常饿。他在一家商店里看到了一个彩色的甜甜圈。它有着甜甜的糖衣和糖粒，看起来十分美味。汤姆买了它，开心地吃了起来。**

> A young traveler named Tom was lost in a foreign land. A kind local named Ali introduced him to Islam, telling him about its peaceful teachings and community. Tom was deeply moved and learned a lot. **一位名叫汤姆的年轻旅行者在异国他乡迷路了。一位善良的当地人阿里向他介绍了伊斯兰教，给他讲述了其和平的教义和社群。汤姆深受感动，学到了很多。**
> 想象一下，有个超级聪明的学者，花费多年深入研究各种难题。最终，他成功获得了 PhD，就像爬上了学术的高峰，成为众人敬仰的知识大师。 **想象有个聪明学者经过多年研究获得博士学位，像爬上学术高峰成为大师**

> One day, a little girl was very sad because she lost her hair. But then, her mother gave her a beautiful wig. She wore it and felt happy again. The wig became her favorite thing. **有一天，一个小女孩非常伤心，因为她掉了头发。但后来，她的妈妈给了她一顶漂亮的假发。她戴上它，又感到开心了。这顶假发成了她最喜欢的东西。**

> Once upon a time, there was a Dutch boy who was very good at painting. He used his talent to show the beauty of his homeland. People loved his works and remembered him as a symbol of Dutch art. **从前，有一个荷兰男孩非常擅长绘画。他用自己的天赋展现了祖国的美丽。人们喜欢他的作品，并把他视为荷兰艺术的象征。**

> A little girl was polishing her shoes carefully to make them shiny. She worked hard and finally the shoes looked perfect. Polish means to make something smooth and shiny by rubbing. **一个小女孩正在仔细地擦亮她的鞋子，想让它们闪闪发亮。她努力擦拭，最后鞋子看起来完美极了。Polish 这个单词的意思是通过擦拭使某物光滑且有光泽。**

> A Spaniard named Pedro loved traveling. One day, he went to a beautiful beach and met many new friends. He shared his Spanish culture and had a wonderful time. Remember, Pedro the Spaniard! **一个叫佩德罗的西班牙人喜欢旅行。有一天，他去了一个美丽的海滩，结识了很多新朋友。他分享了他的西班牙文化，度过了一段美好的时光。记住，西班牙人佩德罗！**

> In World War II, a group of cruel people called Nazis caused great harm. They were known for their evil acts and discrimination. Remember, Nazi represents evil and injustice. **在第二次世界大战中，有一群残忍的人被称为纳粹。他们以邪恶的行为和歧视而闻名。记住，Nazi 代表着邪恶和不公正。**

> Once upon a time, there was a kind Jew named David. He was known for his wisdom and kindness. People respected him for his good deeds. Remember, a Jew can refer to a person of the Jewish faith or ethnicity. **从前，有一个善良的犹太人叫大卫。他以智慧和善良而闻名。人们因他的善举而尊重他。记住，Jew 这个词可以指犹太教信仰或犹太民族的人。**
> 想象一下，在印度的一个小镇上，有一位名叫Hindu的智者，他熟知古老的宗教仪式和传统。人们都尊敬他，因为他代表着印度教的智慧和精神。Hindu这个词，就像这位智者一样，与印度教紧密相连。 **想象在印度小镇，名叫 Hindu 的智者代表着印度教，此故事辅助理解 Hindu 这个词与印度教的关联。**

> One day, Tom had to give a speech in front of a large crowd. His heart was pounding and he felt a sense of nervousness. His hands were shaking and his mind went blank. But he took a deep breath and overcame the nervousness. **一天，汤姆不得不当着一大群人的面演讲。他的心砰砰直跳，感到一阵紧张。他的手在颤抖，脑子一片空白。但他深吸一口气，克服了紧张情绪。**

> A Swede named Sven loved to travel. One day, he went to a beautiful beach and met many friendly people. He had a wonderful time and couldn\'t forget the experience. **一个叫斯文的瑞典人喜欢旅行。有一天，他去了一个美丽的海滩，遇到了很多友好的人。他度过了一段美好的时光，难以忘怀这段经历。**

> An Israeli traveler got lost in a strange city. But with the help of kind locals, he found his way. Israeli people are known for their intelligence and friendliness. **一位以色列旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。但在好心当地人的帮助下，他找到了路。以色列人以聪明和友好著称。**

> A poor boy dreams of becoming a VIP. One day, he saves a rich man\'s life. As a reward, he is invited to exclusive events and treated like a VIP. He realizes VIP means very important person and enjoys the special treatment. **一个穷小子梦想成为重要人物（VIP）。有一天，他救了一个富人的命。作为回报，他被邀请参加专属活动，并被当作重要人物对待。他明白了 VIP 意思是非常重要的人，并享受着特殊待遇。**

> A man was walking by the sea and saw a clam tightly closed. He tried to open it but the clam was very stubborn. Finally, he gave up. Remember, \'clam\' is this shellfish that refuses to open easily! **一个人在海边散步，看到一只蛤蜊紧紧闭着。他试图打开它，但蛤蜊非常顽固。最后，他放弃了。记住，\'clam\'就是这种不容易张开的贝类！**

> A little boy was playing in the garden when a wasp flew by. The wasp was yellow and black, and it buzzed loudly. The boy was scared but also curious. He watched as the wasp landed on a flower. **一个小男孩正在花园里玩耍，这时一只黄蜂飞了过来。这只黄蜂是黄黑相间的，嗡嗡声很大。小男孩很害怕但又很好奇。他看着黄蜂落在一朵花上。**

> Once upon a time, a sailor dreamed of crossing the Mediterranean Sea. He imagined the blue waves, warm sun, and beautiful coastlines. Finally, he achieved his dream and explored this magical sea. **从前，有个水手梦想穿越地中海。他想象着蓝色的海浪、温暖的阳光和美丽的海岸线。最终，他实现了梦想，探索了这片神奇的海洋。**

> A brave knight was chosen as the spokesperson for the kingdom. He had to speak for the king and convey important messages. One day, he spoke out bravely against invaders, saving the kingdom. Remember, spokesperson means someone who speaks for others! **一位勇敢的骑士被选为王国的发言人。他必须为国王发言并传达重要信息。有一天，他勇敢地对侵略者发声，拯救了王国。记住，spokesperson 就是为他人发言的人！**

> Once upon a time, a little squirrel was lost in a forest full of fir trees. It climbed up and down the firs, looking for its way home. Finally, it found a familiar path among the tall firs. **从前，一只小松鼠在满是冷杉树的森林里迷路了。它在冷杉树上爬上爬下，寻找回家的路。最后，它在高大的冷杉树间找到了熟悉的小路。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met a friendly chef. The chef offered him some delicious pastries and said, \'This is Danish cuisine.\' The traveler loved it and remembered the word \'Danish\' for the special food. **从前，有一位旅行者遇到了一位友好的厨师。厨师给他提供了一些美味的糕点，并说：'这是丹麦美食。'旅行者很喜欢，并记住了'Danish'这个代表丹麦的词。**

> One day, Tom went to a barbecue party. He saw a lot of food being smoked. The smell was so attractive. He realized that\'smoked\' means treated by smoke to give a special flavor. **有一天，汤姆去了一个烧烤派对。他看到很多食物正在被烟熏。那味道太诱人了。他明白了'smoked'意思是被烟处理以获得特殊风味。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was lost. A kind man who believed in Christianity helped him find his way home. The boy learned that Christianity is about love and kindness. **从前，有个小男孩迷路了。一位信仰基督教的好心人帮助他找到了回家的路。小男孩了解到基督教是关于爱和善良的。**

> One day, a little rabbit was very hungry. It found a barn full of oats. The oats looked so delicious. The rabbit ate them happily and felt full and strong. So, oats became its favorite food. **一天，一只小兔子非常饿。它发现了一个装满燕麦的谷仓。燕麦看起来十分美味。小兔子开心地吃了起来，感觉又饱又有力气。所以，燕麦成了它最爱的食物。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. He came across a magical potion labeled \'Scotch\'. When he drank it, he gained super strength. But he had to be careful not to rely on it too much. Remember, Scotch can be powerful and mysterious! **一位勇敢的骑士正在进行探索。他遇到了一瓶标有"Scotch（阻止；挫败）"的神奇药水。当他喝下它时，获得了超强的力量。但他必须小心，不能过度依赖它。记住，Scotch 可以是强大且神秘的！**

> A brave Zulu warrior was hunting in the jungle. He faced many challenges but used his skills and courage to survive. The Zulu people are known for their strength and bravery. **一位勇敢的祖鲁战士在丛林中狩猎。他面临诸多挑战，但凭借自身技能和勇气生存了下来。祖鲁人以其力量和勇敢著称。**

> A little boy always wanted to be macho. One day, he saw a strong man helping carry heavy things easily. The boy thought that was the meaning of macho. Later, he learned it means having strong and tough qualities. **一个小男孩总是想变得有男子气概。有一天，他看到一个强壮的男人轻松地搬重物。男孩认为这就是有男子气概。后来，他知道了macho意思是具有强壮和坚韧的特质。**

> One day, while hiking in the mountains, I had a rare sighting of a beautiful and colorful bird. It was a magical moment. I felt so lucky to have witnessed this special sight. **有一天，在山里徒步旅行时，我罕见地看到了一只美丽多彩的鸟。那是一个神奇的时刻。我觉得能目睹这样特别的景象真是太幸运了。**
> 从前有个旅人在荒野迷路，又饿又累。这时，一位名叫 Quaker 的善良农夫出现，给他食物和水，还指引他回家的路。旅人记住了 Quaker 的友善，记住了这个代表友善和助人的名字。 **从前有个旅人在荒野迷路，又饿又累。这时，一位名叫贵格会教徒的善良农夫出现，给他食物和水，还指引他回家的路。旅人记住了贵格会教徒的友善，记住了这个代表友善和助人的名字。**

> A man always thought others were spying on him. He suspected every move around him. This made him very paranoid. Eventually, he realized it was all in his mind. **一个男人总是认为别人在监视他。他怀疑身边的每一个举动。这让他变得非常偏执。最终，他意识到这都只是他的想象。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Jack who loved to tell stories. Everyone called him the \'narrator\' because he could make any tale come alive. He had the magic to draw people into his world of imagination. **从前，有一个叫杰克的人，他喜欢讲故事。大家都称他为"讲述者"，因为他能让任何故事变得生动。他有能把人们带入他想象世界的魔力。**

> In a sports tournament, the teams were fiercely competing. The final stage to decide the champion was called the \'playoff\'. It was the most exciting part, where only the best could win. **在一场体育锦标赛中，各队激烈竞争。决定冠军的最后阶段被称为"季后赛"。这是最激动人心的部分，只有最优秀的队伍才能获胜。**

> A princess was lost in a forest. When found, she was unkempt, with messy hair and dirty clothes. Her once tidy appearance was gone. \'Unkempt\' means not neat or tidy. **一位公主在森林里迷路了。当被找到时，她蓬头垢面，头发凌乱，衣服脏兮兮的。她曾经整洁的外表不见了。'unkempt'意思是不整洁的、凌乱的。**

> A person felt aggrieved when they were wrongly accused of stealing at work. Despite their innocence, no one believed them. They were deeply hurt and felt unfairly treated. **一个人在工作中被错误地指控偷窃时感到委屈。尽管他们是无辜的，但没人相信他们。他们深受伤害，觉得受到了不公正的对待。**

> In a faraway land, people faced many disasters. One day, a mysterious and powerful being appeared and saved them all. They believed this being was God, who had the power to protect and guide them. **在一个遥远的地方，人们面临许多灾难。有一天，一个神秘而强大的存在出现并拯救了他们所有人。他们相信这个存在就是上帝，拥有保护和指引他们的力量。**

> A brave doctor was fighting against a disease called polio. Many children were affected, but the doctor never gave up. Finally, a cure was found. Remember, polio is a serious illness! **一位勇敢的医生正在与一种叫做脊髓灰质炎（小儿麻痹症）的疾病作斗争。许多孩子受到了影响，但医生从未放弃。最终，找到了治疗方法。记住，polio 是一种严重的疾病！**
> 想象一下，有个疯狂的科学家在实验室里寻找一种超级强大的元素，最终他发现了一种叫 plutonium 的物质，它具有巨大的能量，但也非常危险。就像一颗隐藏的炸弹，处理不当就会引发灾难。 **想象一位疯狂科学家在实验室发现具有巨大能量但很危险、处理不当会引发灾难的叫钚（plutonium）的物质。**

> A scientist was studying a phenomenon. But as time went on, the data showed a strange movement backward. It was like a regression to an earlier state. > In a magical forest, fairies vie to be the most beautiful. They show off their shiny wings and charming smiles. The competition is fierce, but they all enjoy the vie for beauty. **在一个神奇的森林里，仙女们竞相成为最美丽的。她们展示着闪亮的翅膀和迷人的微笑。竞争很激烈，但她们都享受着这种争美的过程。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met a friendly Hispanic guy. The guy had a big smile and shared his wonderful culture. It made the traveler remember \'Hispanic\' as people with a warm and unique charm. **从前，有一位旅行者遇到了一个友好的西班牙裔人。这个人笑容满面，并分享了他精彩的文化。这让旅行者记住了'Hispanic'这个词，代表着有着温暖和独特魅力的人。**

> A Brazilian boy named Leo loved football. He practiced every day on the sandy beaches. One day, he got a chance to play for a big team and made his country proud. Leo showed the world the spirit of a Brazilian. **一个叫利奥的巴西男孩热爱足球。他每天都在沙滩上练习。有一天，他得到了为一支大球队效力的机会，并让他的国家感到骄傲。利奥向世界展示了巴西人的精神。**

> A little mouse was trapped in a net. It struggled hard to extricate itself. Finally, with its sharp teeth and strong will, it managed to free itself from the entanglement. **一只小老鼠被困在网里。它努力挣扎着要解脱自己。最后，凭借锋利的牙齿和坚强的意志，它成功地从纠缠中解脱了出来。**

> A group of young artists were very passionate. They sneaked out at night and used spray cans to create colorful graffiti on the walls of the old factory. Their works made the place look unique. **一群年轻的艺术家充满热情。他们在晚上偷偷溜出去，用喷雾罐在旧工厂的墙上创作了五颜六色的涂鸦。他们的作品让这个地方看起来别具一格。**

> One day, I was in a coffee shop. The music and the warm atmosphere gave me a special feeling. That\'s the \'vibe\' I want to remember. It\'s like a magic mood that makes you feel good. **有一天，我在一家咖啡店。音乐和温暖的氛围给了我一种特别的感觉。那就是我想要记住的"氛围、气氛"。它就像一种神奇的心情，让你感觉良好。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl. She had dark brown hair and was called a \'brunette\'. Everyone admired her unique charm. One day, she met her prince charming and lived happily ever after. **从前，有一个美丽的女孩。她有着深棕色的头发，被称为"深褐色头发的女子"。每个人都钦佩她独特的魅力。有一天，她遇到了她的白马王子，从此过上了幸福的生活。**

> Once upon a time, there was an Englishman named Tom. He loved traveling and exploring different cultures. One day, he went to a faraway land and shared stories about England. Everyone was impressed by his charm and knowledge. **从前，有一个叫汤姆的英国人。他喜欢旅行和探索不同的文化。有一天，他去了一个遥远的地方，并分享了关于英国的故事。每个人都对他的魅力和知识印象深刻。**
> 想象一下，有个贫困的家庭，他们生病了却没钱看病。这时，Medicaid 就像一位善良的天使出现，为他们支付医疗费用，帮助他们恢复健康。Medicaid 就是这样一个给人希望的医疗救助计划。 **想象一个贫困家庭生病没钱看病时，Medicaid 像天使出现支付费用助其康复，它是医疗救助计划。**

> One day, a little boy was very interested in the sky. He wanted to know why the weather changed. So he started to study meteorological knowledge. He learned about clouds, winds, and rains. Finally, he understood the mystery of nature. **有一天，一个小男孩对天空非常感兴趣。他想知道天气为什么会变化。于是他开始学习气象学知识。他了解了云、风和雨。最终，他明白了大自然的奥秘。**

> One day, Tom was assigned a complex project. To ensure everything went smoothly, he made a checklist. He ticked off each item as he completed it. Finally, with the help of the checklist, he successfully finished the project. **有一天，汤姆被分配了一个复杂的项目。为了确保一切顺利，他制作了一份清单。每完成一项，他就勾选一项。最后，在这份清单的帮助下，他成功地完成了项目。**

> A hungry lion was hunting in the forest. It was eager to find some delicious loin of other animals. But it had to be very careful and quiet, or else it would scare away its potential prey. **一只饥饿的狮子在森林里狩猎。它渴望找到其他动物美味的腰肉。但它必须非常小心和安静，否则会吓跑潜在的猎物。**

> A curious alien landed on Earth and spoke in a language that was incomprehensible to everyone. People tried hard to understand but couldn\'t make sense of it. It was like a mysterious code no one could crack. **一个好奇的外星人降落在地球上，说着一种所有人都无法理解的语言。人们努力尝试去理解，但就是弄不明白。这就像一个无人能破解的神秘密码。**

> In a distant land, people faced many hardships. One day, they decided to leave together in a huge group. This mass movement of people was called an exodus. They sought a better place to live. **在一片遥远的土地上，人们面临诸多艰难。有一天，他们决定一起大规模离开。这种人群的大规模迁移被称为'exodus（大批的离去）'。他们去寻找更好的生活之地。**

> A young student was confused about a complex subject. The wise teacher said, \'Let\'s go back to the basics. Imagine building a house -- first, you need a strong foundation. Basics are like that foundation, essential and simple.\' **一位年轻的学生对一个复杂的学科感到困惑。聪明的老师说：'让我们回到基础。想象建造一座房子 - 首先，你需要一个坚固的基础。基础就像那个基础，必不可少且简单。'**

> One day, a city was in chaos. People needed help urgently. Then, a special phone line, the hotline, was set up. Anyone could call it to get immediate assistance and solve problems. It became the lifeline of the city. **有一天，一座城市陷入混乱。人们急需帮助。于是，设立了一条特殊的电话线，即热线。任何人都可以拨打它来立即获得援助并解决问题。它成了这座城市的生命线。**

> One day, Tom was going to a party. But his pants were too big and kept falling down. Luckily, he found a pair of suspenders to hold them up. With the suspenders, he could dance freely and enjoy the party. **有一天，汤姆要去参加一个派对。但他的裤子太大了，一直往下掉。幸运的是，他找到了一副吊带裤背带把裤子提起来。有了背带，他就能自由跳舞，尽情享受派对了。**

> Imagine a soldier walking through a vast area. There are hidden explosives everywhere. This dangerous place is a minefield. One wrong step and BOOM! It\'s a scary but clear image of\'minefield\'. **想象一名士兵行走在广阔的区域。到处都隐藏着爆炸物。这个危险的地方就是雷区。走错一步就会'砰'！这是一个关于'minefield（雷区）'的可怕但清晰的画面。**

> A merchant was selling various wares at the market. There were beautiful clothes, shiny jewels, and useful tools. People came from far and wide to buy his wares. **一位商人在市场上出售各种各样的商品。有漂亮的衣服、闪亮的珠宝和有用的工具。人们从四面八方赶来购买他的商品。**

> In a small town, a group of bad people followed the ideology of Nazism. They were cruel and brought great harm. But the brave townspeople united and fought against this evil. Finally, they defeated Nazism and restored peace. **在一个小镇上，一群坏人遵循纳粹主义的思想。他们很残忍，带来了巨大的危害。但勇敢的镇民团结起来对抗这种邪恶。最终，他们打败了纳粹主义，恢复了和平。**
> 想象一个小离子（ion）在宇宙中旅行，它带着电荷，一路跳跃穿梭。它遇到了其他粒子，一起组成了奇妙的物质。这个小小的离子，充满了能量和神秘。 **想象一个小离子在宇宙中旅行，它带着电荷，一路跳跃穿梭。它遇到了其他粒子，一起组成了奇妙的物质。这个小小的离子，充满了能量和神秘。**

> One day, a little monkey was lost in the rainforest. It rained heavily. The monkey saw tall trees and many colorful flowers. It had to find its way out. Finally, it succeeded and learned that the rainforest is a magical but dangerous place. **有一天，一只小猴子在雨林中迷路了。雨下得很大。猴子看到了高大的树木和许多五颜六色的花。它必须找到出路。最后，它成功了，并了解到雨林是一个神奇但危险的地方。**

> A little pig was always lazy and didn\'t want to move. So the farmer had to prod it with a stick to make it walk. \'Prod\' here means to push or poke someone or something to make them move or act. **一只小猪总是很懒，不想动。所以农夫不得不用棍子戳它，让它走。\'prod\'在这里的意思是用手或东西推或戳某人或某物，使其移动或行动。**

> A group of friends went on a trip. Everyone was having fun, excluding Tom who got sick. They enjoyed the journey but constantly worried about Tom. So, \'excluding\' means leaving out or not including. **一群朋友去旅行。每个人都玩得很开心，除了生病的汤姆。他们享受旅程但一直担心着汤姆。所以，'excluding'意思是排除、不包括。**

> A poor man lost his job and his house. He felt deep woe. But then he found a new opportunity and overcame the woe. Woe means great sorrow or distress. **一个可怜的人失去了工作和房子。他感到极度痛苦。但后来他找到了新机会，克服了痛苦。woe 意思是巨大的悲伤或苦恼。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met an Arabian in the desert. The Arabian had a beautiful horse and wore colorful clothes. The traveler was amazed by the Arabian\'s charm and friendliness. **从前，有一位旅行者在沙漠中遇到了一位阿拉伯人。这位阿拉伯人有一匹漂亮的马，穿着色彩鲜艳的衣服。旅行者对这位阿拉伯人的魅力和友好感到惊讶。**

> A young traveler was lost and desperate. Then he found a place called Mecca, which was full of kind people and resources. It became his salvation. Mecca means a place that attracts many people, a destination of great importance. **一位年轻的旅行者迷路了，非常绝望。然后他发现了一个叫麦加的地方，那里充满了善良的人和资源。它成了他的救星。麦加指吸引很多人的地方，一个非常重要的目的地。**

> A Briton was lost in a foreign land. He missed the familiar tea and scones of his homeland. But with his strong spirit, he found his way back, carrying the pride of being a Briton. **一个英国人在异国他乡迷路了。他怀念家乡熟悉的茶和烤饼。但凭借坚强的精神，他找到了回去的路，带着作为英国人的骄傲。**

> A traveler named Jack was exploring the cold north. He met friendly people with unique customs. They called themselves Nordic. Jack was impressed by their strength and warmth in the harsh environment. **一位名叫杰克的旅行者正在寒冷的北方探险。他遇到了有着独特风俗的友好人群。他们称自己为北欧人。杰克对他们在恶劣环境中的力量和热情印象深刻。**

> A brave diver named Tom forgot his snorkel. But when he saw a beautiful coral reef, he quickly borrowed a snorkel from a friend. With the snorkel, he could breathe easily and enjoy the underwater view. **一位名叫汤姆的勇敢潜水员忘记了他的呼吸管。但当他看到美丽的珊瑚礁时，他迅速从朋友那里借了一个呼吸管。有了呼吸管，他能够轻松呼吸并欣赏水下景色。**

> One day, I was very hungry and decided to visit a deli. There, I found various delicious foods like sandwiches and salads. I bought a lot and enjoyed a wonderful meal. The deli became my favorite place for quick and tasty treats. **一天，我非常饿，决定去一家熟食店。在那里，我发现了各种各样美味的食物，比如三明治和沙拉。我买了很多，享受了一顿美妙的餐食。这家熟食店成了我快速享受美味的最爱之地。**

> A farmer was very proud of his leeks. One day, a thief came and tried to steal them. But the farmer caught the thief because the leeks were so distinctive. So remember, leek is a kind of vegetable. **一位农民为他的韭葱感到非常自豪。有一天，一个小偷来偷它们。但农民抓住了小偷，因为韭葱太独特了。所以记住，leek 是一种蔬菜。**

> On Halloween night, kids dress up in spooky costumes. They go from door to door saying \'Trick or treat!\' and get candies. There are pumpkins with scary faces everywhere. It\'s a fun and scary time! **在万圣节之夜，孩子们穿着吓人的服装。他们挨家挨户地说"不给糖就捣蛋！"然后得到糖果。到处都是有着恐怖面孔的南瓜。这是一个有趣又恐怖的时刻！**
> 在很久以前，有一群人对当时的宗教制度表示不满，他们大声提出抗议（protest），并逐渐形成了一个新的宗教群体，被称为Protestant。他们坚守自己的信仰，勇敢地追求真理。 **很久以前，一群对宗教制度不满并抗议的人形成的新宗教群体被称为新教徒。**

> A brave captain held the helm of the ship firmly during a fierce storm. The helm guided the ship safely through the waves. With the helm in control, they reached the harbor. **一位勇敢的船长在狂风暴雨中紧紧握住船舵。船舵引导船只安全地穿越海浪。在船舵的掌控下，他们抵达了港口。**

> A young man was committed to saving the endangered animals. He spent all his time and energy, never giving up. His commitment finally made a difference. **一个年轻人致力于拯救濒危动物。他投入了所有的时间和精力，从不放弃。他的执着最终产生了影响。**

> A brave knight was awarded a garland of beautiful flowers after winning a fierce battle. The garland was a symbol of his victory and honor. He wore it with pride and joy. **一位勇敢的骑士在赢得一场激烈的战斗后，被授予了一个由美丽花朵组成的花环。这个花环是他胜利和荣誉的象征。他自豪又高兴地戴着它。**

> A brave woodcutter named Tom was in the forest. He used his axe to hew down big trees. With each swing, he showed his determination and strength. Remember Tom\'s action and you\'ll remember \'hew\' means to chop or cut. **一位名叫汤姆的勇敢伐木工在森林里。他用斧头砍倒大树。每一次挥动，都展现出他的决心和力量。记住汤姆的动作，你就会记住'hew'意思是砍、劈。**

> A brave general led his embattled troops. They were surrounded by enemies on all sides, but they didn\'t give up. \'Embattled\' here means being in a difficult or challenging situation, like these soldiers. **一位勇敢的将军率领着他陷入困境的部队。他们被敌人四面包围，但他们没有放弃。'embattled'在这里意味着处于困难或具有挑战性的境地，就像这些士兵一样。**

> A man was walking in a forest and suddenly found a door to a strange world. Everything was mixed and illogical. It was a surreal scene that made him feel lost and amazed. **一个男人在森林里散步，突然发现一扇通往奇异世界的门。一切都混杂且不合逻辑。这是一个超现实的场景，让他感到迷茫又惊奇。**

> One day, Tom saw a lot of trash on the street. He thought about the importance of recycling. So he started to collect and sort the trash. Through his efforts, the recyclable materials were reused, making the environment better. **有一天，汤姆看到街上有很多垃圾。他想到了回收利用的重要性。于是他开始收集并分类垃圾。通过他的努力，可回收材料被重新利用，让环境变得更好。**

> A young architect dreamed of designing high-rise buildings. One day, he got a chance and created a magnificent high-rise that stood out in the city. Everyone admired his work. The high-rise became a symbol of his success. **一位年轻的建筑师梦想设计高层建筑。有一天，他得到机会并创造了一座在城市中脱颖而出的宏伟高楼。每个人都钦佩他的作品。这座高楼成为了他成功的象征。**

> Once upon a time, an old castle was damaged. But with the efforts of many people, it was restored to its former glory. It became beautiful and strong again, just like the meaning of\'restored\' - to return something to its original condition. **从前，一座古老的城堡遭到了破坏。但在许多人的努力下，它被修复到了原来的辉煌。它再次变得美丽和坚固，就像'restored'这个词的意思------使某物恢复到原来的状态。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy was playing with a toy car. The track of the car was curved. It looked like a big smile. The boy had so much fun on this curved track. **从前，有个小男孩在玩玩具车。车的轨道是弯曲的。它看起来像一个大大的微笑。小男孩在这条弯曲的轨道上玩得很开心。**

> One day, Tom was trapped in a building. He had to find a way out. Luckily, he discovered a stairwell that led him to safety. The stairwell was like a savior in the darkness. **有一天，汤姆被困在一栋大楼里。他必须找到出路。幸运的是，他发现了一个楼梯井，这个楼梯井带他到了安全的地方。楼梯井在黑暗中就像一个救星。**

> A brave climber was trying to reach the top of a mountain. When he looked up, he saw a huge rock overhanging the cliff. It was dangerous but also a thrilling challenge. **一位勇敢的登山者正努力登顶。当他抬头时，看到一块巨大的岩石悬在悬崖上。这很危险，但也是一个令人兴奋的挑战。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a forest. To find his way out, he used positioning skills. He observed the sun\'s position and marked key spots. Finally, he successfully determined his location and got back home. Positioning saved him! **一位勇敢的探险家在森林中迷路了。为了走出去，他运用定位技能。他观察太阳的位置并标记关键地点。最终，他成功确定了自己的位置并回家。定位救了他！**
> 想象一个机器人在工厂里忙碌地工作，它的身体各个部位有序运转，进行着生产操作。这个机器人正在 operating，也就是'操作；运转'，确保工厂的正常生产。 **想象一个机器人在工厂里忙碌工作，展现'operating（操作；运转）'的情景，以助记忆。**

> A scientist was working on a project. His data was old and incorrect. So, he spent days making it updated. With the updated information, he finally made a great discovery. **一位科学家正在进行一个项目。他的数据陈旧且不正确。所以，他花了几天时间使其更新。凭借更新后的信息，他终于有了重大发现。**

> A student was assigned a special task to find a hidden book in the library. The teacher said, \'You are assigned this because I trust you.\' So, assigned means given a particular job or task. **一名学生被分配了一项特殊任务，即在图书馆里找到一本隐藏的书。老师说：'你被分配这个是因为我信任你。'所以，assigned 意思是被分配，被指派特定的工作或任务。**

> Imagine a little robot constantly changing or \'switching\' its tasks. One moment it\'s cleaning, the next it\'s cooking. This shows how \'switching\' means changing from one thing to another. **想象一个小机器人不断地改变或'切换'它的任务。一会儿它在打扫，下一刻它在做饭。这展示了'switching'意味着从一件事转变到另一件事。**

> A car was sent to the factory. The workers modified it by changing the engine and adding new wheels. Now the car looks and runs much better. **一辆汽车被送去工厂。工人们对它进行了改造，更换了发动机，还加上了新轮子。现在这辆车看起来更好，跑得也更好了。**

> A couple was separated by a big storm. They couldn\'t find each other and were very sad. But finally, they met again when the storm ended. \'Separated\' means being apart or divided. **一对夫妇被一场大风暴分开了。他们找不到彼此，非常伤心。但最后风暴结束时他们又重逢了。'separated'意思是分开、分离。**

> A group of explorers were lost in the forest. Luckily, one area was designated as a safe zone with signs. They finally found it and were saved. \'Designated\' here means marked or chosen for a specific purpose. **一群探险家在森林中迷路了。幸运的是，有一块区域被指定为带有标志的安全区。他们最终找到了它并得救了。"designated"在这里指的是被标记或选定用于特定目的。**

> A little artist was always passionate about drawing. One day, he could express his ideas graphically so beautifully that everyone was amazed. It means in a clear and visual way, like his wonderful drawings. **一位小艺术家总是热衷于画画。有一天，他能够以非常形象的方式清晰地表达他的想法，让每个人都感到惊讶。这意味着以清晰和直观的方式，就像他精彩的画作。**
> 想象一个小小的微观世界，里面有微型的房子和微小的居民。一位科学家拿着显微镜仔细观察，发现了微生物在这个迷你世界里快乐生活。这个世界就是\'micro\'代表的微小世界。 **想象一个关于'micro'（微小）的微观世界的故事，有微型的房子、居民和微生物，科学家用显微镜观察，辅助理解'micro'表示微小的意思。**

> One day, Tom found a box labeled \'Treasure\'. He was so excited but couldn\'t open it. Later, he realized it was just a prank. The label was misleading. **有一天，汤姆发现了一个标有\'宝藏\'的盒子。他非常兴奋但打不开。后来，他意识到这只是个恶作剧。这个标签具有误导性。**

> One day, a thief was planning to steal jewels. To hide his face, he used a masking cloth. But the police were smart and caught him easily because of a small mark on the masking material. **有一天，一个小偷计划偷珠宝。为了遮住脸，他用了一块遮面罩布。但警察很聪明，因为遮面材料上的一个小记号轻松抓住了他。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little ant. It carried food every day without rest. It was so hard-working. People praised it for its effort. Just like this ant, hard-working people never stop striving for a better life. **从前，有一只小蚂蚁。它每天不停地搬运食物。它非常勤奋。人们称赞它的努力。就像这只蚂蚁一样，勤奋的人从不停止为更好的生活而努力。**
> 想象一下，你在葡萄牙旅行，遇到了一位热情的当地人，他向你介绍自己是 Portuguese（葡萄牙人）。他自豪地展示着葡萄牙的美景和文化，让你对 Portuguese 这个词印象深刻，记住它就是葡萄牙人的意思。 **想象一下，你在葡萄牙旅行，遇到一位热情的当地人，他自我介绍是葡萄牙人。他展示葡萄牙的美景和文化，让你记住 Portuguese 是葡萄牙人的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was a land where people worked together for a common goal. They called this land Soviet. It represented a group of people united and striving for a better future. **从前，有一片土地，那里的人们为了一个共同的目标而共同努力。他们把这片土地称为苏联。它代表着一群团结起来为更美好未来而奋斗的人们。**

> Once upon a time, a girl married a boy. The boy\'s father became the girl\'s father-in-law. He was a kind man who always cared for her as if she were his own daughter. **从前，一个女孩嫁给了一个男孩。男孩的父亲就成了女孩的公公。他是个善良的人，总是像对待自己女儿一样关心她。**

> One day, I entered a room and saw everything was upside-down. The chair was on the ceiling, and the books were scattered all over the floor. It was a crazy and confusing scene. **有一天，我走进一个房间，看到一切都是颠倒的。椅子在天花板上，书散落在地板上。这是一个疯狂又令人困惑的场景。**

> One day, a little boy was very bored at home. Suddenly, he turned on the TV and saw a wonderful cartoon. The colorful pictures and funny stories on TV made him happy and he forgot his boredom. **有一天，一个小男孩在家非常无聊。突然，他打开了电视，看到了一部精彩的动画片。电视上多彩的画面和有趣的故事让他开心起来，忘记了无聊。**
