Now, whenever I think of \'Korean\', I remember Kim and his wonderful stories. **有一天，我遇到了一个友好的人叫金。他告诉我他是韩国人，并给我展示了韩国美丽的图片。他还分享了美味的韩国食物。现在，每当我想到"韩国人；韩语；韩国的；朝鲜的；朝鲜人；朝鲜语"这个单词，我就会想起金和他精彩的故事。**

> Once upon a time, there was a tricky decision. We could choose option A and option B, or just one of them. That\'s when we used \'and/or\' to express this confusing choice. **从前，有一个棘手的决定。我们可以选择选项 A 和选项 B，或者只选其中一个。就在这时，我们用'and/or'来表达这种令人困惑的选择。**

> A little ant was on a long journey. It kept walking without stopping. This action of never-ending movement was called continuing. The ant\'s continuing effort finally led it to find food. **一只小蚂蚁正在长途旅行。它不停地走，没有停歇。这种永不停歇的行动就叫做continuing。蚂蚁持续不断的努力最终让它找到了食物。**
> 想象一下，小明在一家公司工作。他每天从早到晚都在公司，没有其他兼职。这种全身心投入、一整天都在工作的状态，就是 full-time 。就像他把所有时间都给了工作，没有空缺。 **想象小明全身心投入工作的状态来理解 full-time 这个表示全职的单词**
> 想象一下，有一个古老的大钟，每次指针指向整点的时候，它就会大声喊'o\'\'clock'，提醒大家时间到了整点。比如一点，它喊'one o\'\'clock'，两点就喊'two o\'\'clock'，是不是很好记呀？ **想象有个古老大钟，整点就喊'o\'\'clock'，如一点喊'one o\'\'clock'，两点喊'two o\'\'clock'，便于记忆**

> A Cuban man named Carlos loved to dance salsa. Every weekend, he would go to the local club and show off his amazing moves. His passion for salsa made him a well-known figure in the Cuban community. **一位名叫卡洛斯的古巴男子喜欢跳萨尔萨舞。每个周末，他都会去当地的俱乐部展示他惊人的舞步。他对萨尔萨舞的热情使他成为古巴社区的知名人物。**

> A man was waiting at the train station. He had expected the train to arrive at 3 pm, but it was delayed. He was very anxious. Finally, the train came at 5 pm. **一个男人在火车站等待。他原本预期火车下午 3 点到达，但火车晚点了。他非常焦虑。最终，火车在下午 5 点来了。**

> One day, Tom perceived a strange noise in the forest. He followed it and found a hidden cave. He perceived that it might hold some secrets. Later, he realized it was just the wind. Perceived here means to become aware of something through the senses. **一天，汤姆察觉到森林里有一种奇怪的声音。他跟着声音，发现了一个隐藏的洞穴。他觉得这里可能藏着一些秘密。后来，他意识到只是风声。这里的 perceived 意思是通过感官意识到某事。**

> Imagine a big pizza cut into three equal slices. You take two of those slices. That\'s two-thirds of the pizza! It shows how much you have out of the total. **想象一个大披萨被切成三等份。你拿走其中的两份。这就是三分之二！它展示了你在总数中所占的份额。**

> One day, Tom visited a factory. He saw many advanced machines and equipment. He was amazed and asked what they were. The guide said, \'These are high-tech products that make our work more efficient.\' **一天，汤姆参观了一家工厂。他看到了许多先进的机器和设备。他很惊讶并询问是什么。导游说：'这些是高科技产品，能让我们的工作更高效。'**

> Imagine a big pizza cut into three equal slices. You take only one of those slices. That one slice represents one-third of the whole pizza. So, one-third means one part out of three equal parts. **想象一个大披萨被切成三等份。你只拿其中的一份。那一份就代表整个披萨的三分之一。所以，one-third 意思是三个相等部分中的一个部分。**

> A brave woodcutter chopped the big tree into pieces. But suddenly, a fairy appeared and said, \'You should be careful when chopped!\' The woodcutter learned his lesson. **一位勇敢的伐木工把大树砍成了碎块。但突然，一个仙女出现并说：'当你砍伐的时候应该小心！'伐木工得到了教训。**

> One day, I wanted to record my birthday party. So, I used a videotape to capture all the happy moments. It was like a magic tape that saved our memories forever. **有一天，我想记录我的生日聚会。所以，我用了一盘录像带来捕捉所有快乐的时刻。它就像一条神奇的带子，永远保存了我们的记忆。**

> Once upon a time, there was a friendly Iranian named Ali. He had beautiful eyes and a warm smile. Ali loved sharing his culture with others. Remember, Iranian refers to a person from Iran. **从前，有一个友好的伊朗人名叫阿里。他有美丽的眼睛和温暖的笑容。阿里喜欢和别人分享他的文化。记住，Iranian 指的是来自伊朗的人。**
> 想象一下，一群人在举行盛大的 Party（派对），大家都很欢乐。突然有人喊 \'GOP\' ，原来是让大家 Go（去） Open（打开） Presents（礼物），因为惊喜时刻到啦！ **想象一群人在派对上听到\'GOP\'去打开礼物的故事**

> A singer was struggling to remember the lyrics of a new song. One night, she dreamed of the words written on stars. When she woke up, she could recall all the lyrics easily. **一位歌手努力想记住一首新歌的歌词。一天晚上，她梦到歌词写在星星上。当她醒来时，就能轻松地回忆起所有歌词。**

> One cold winter day, a little bird was shivering. But then, the sun came out and the warming rays made it feel so cozy. The bird chirped happily, enjoying the warming effect of the sunlight. **在一个寒冷的冬日，一只小鸟冻得瑟瑟发抖。但随后，太阳出来了，温暖的光线让它感到非常舒适。小鸟欢快地鸣叫着，享受着阳光的温暖。**

> One day, a little detective was assigned the task of monitoring a mysterious house. He had to watch carefully for any strange activities. The word \'monitoring\' means to keep watch over something closely. **有一天，一个小侦探被指派了监视一座神秘房子的任务。他必须仔细观察任何奇怪的活动。单词\'monitoring\'意思是密切注视某物。**
> Oscar 是一只可爱的小狗，它总是在奥斯卡颁奖典礼那天特别兴奋。因为它的主人会带着它一起看电视，它汪汪叫着，仿佛也在为获奖者欢呼。 **Oscar 是一只可爱的小狗，在奥斯卡颁奖典礼这天很兴奋，和主人一起看电视并欢呼。**
> 想象一下，小明白天在学校上课，晚上和周末去餐厅打工。他这种白天上学，部分时间打工的状态，就是 part-time 啦。 **想象小明白天上学，部分时间打工的状态来辅助记忆'兼职的；部分时间的'这个单词**

> One day, I needed twenty-five apples for a big party. I went to the store and counted carefully to make sure I got exactly twenty-five. It was a fun and challenging task! **有一天，我为一个大型聚会需要二十五个苹果。我去了商店，仔细地数着以确保我正好拿到二十五个。这是一项有趣又有挑战的任务！**

> One day, in a small town, people were choosing their leader. After a fair vote, a kind and wise man was elected. Everyone was happy because they believed he would do great things for the town. **有一天，在一个小镇上，人们正在选举他们的领导人。经过公平投票，一位善良且睿智的人被选上了。每个人都很高兴，因为他们相信他会为小镇做很多好事。**

> One day, I had a big project at work. My co-worker, Tom, and I worked together very hard. We shared ideas and solved problems. Finally, we finished the project successfully. A co-worker is someone you work with! **有一天，我在工作中有一个大项目。我的同事汤姆和我一起非常努力地工作。我们分享想法并解决问题。最后，我们成功完成了项目。同事就是和你一起工作的人！**

> A little bird was injured and couldn\'t fly. Many kind people came to its aid, providing food and a warm place. Their actions were like supporting beams, giving the bird hope and strength. This is what \'supporting\' means - giving help and strength. **一只小鸟受伤无法飞翔。许多善良的人前来帮助它，提供食物和温暖的地方。他们的行动就像支撑的梁柱，给小鸟带来希望和力量。这就是\'supporting\'的意思 - 给予帮助和支持。**

> A group of friends decided to take a vacation. They chose the Caribbean for its beautiful beaches and clear blue waters. They had a wonderful time snorkeling and enjoying the tropical sun. Remember, Caribbean means the area with amazing sea and fun. **一群朋友决定去度假。他们选择了加勒比地区，因为那里有美丽的海滩和清澈的蓝色海水。他们度过了愉快的时光，进行了浮潜并享受了热带的阳光。记住，Caribbean 指的是有着迷人海景和欢乐的地区。**

> Once upon a time, Tom traveled to a mysterious land. There, he met a friendly man who spoke Turkish. The man taught Tom some basic Turkish words and showed him the beauty of the Turkish culture. Tom was amazed! **从前，汤姆去了一个神秘的地方旅行。在那里，他遇到了一个友好的会说土耳其语的人。这个人教了汤姆一些基本的土耳其语单词，并向他展示了土耳其文化的美。汤姆感到很惊讶！**

> There was a big sports event. Many athletes were competing to win the gold medal. They ran as fast as they could, showing their best skills. It was an intense competing scene. **有一场大型体育赛事。许多运动员都在竞争以赢得金牌。他们尽可能快地奔跑，展示出自己最好的技能。这是一个激烈的竞争场景。**

> One day, Tom hurt his leg. The doctor used an x-ray machine to see inside his leg. It was like a magic eye that could go through the flesh and show the bones. With the x-ray, the doctor knew how to treat Tom. **一天，汤姆伤了腿。医生用 X 光机查看他的腿内部。它就像一只神奇的眼睛，可以穿透肉体并显示出骨头。借助 X 光，医生知道如何治疗汤姆了。**

> One day, I was lost in a strange city. I asked a local for the nearest hospital. He kindly pointed me in the right direction. With his help, I found it quickly. The word \'nearest\' reminds me of this helpful encounter. **有一天，我在一个陌生的城市迷路了。我问一个当地人最近的医院在哪。他友好地给我指明了正确的方向。在他的帮助下，我很快就找到了。'nearest'这个单词让我想起了这次有用的相遇。**
> 想象一下，你去越南旅行，遇到了友好的当地人，他们热情地跟你交流。你发现他们被称为 Vietnamese ，这个词就代表了越南的、越南人的、越南语的意思。 **想象你在越南旅行，遇到当地人，从而记住 Vietnamese 代表越南的、越南人的、越南语的**

> A Latino family moved to our neighborhood. They had colorful celebrations and delicious food. Their music and dance made us all happy. I learned a lot about their culture and now remember \'Latino\' easily. **一个拉丁裔家庭搬到了我们小区。他们有丰富多彩的庆祝活动和美味的食物。他们的音乐和舞蹈让我们都很开心。我了解了很多他们的文化，现在很容易就记住了\'Latino\'这个词。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler visited many places. He noticed that people behaved differently culturally. In one place, they ate with chopsticks; in another, with forks. This made him realize the diversity of cultures. **从前，有一位旅行者游览了许多地方。他注意到人们在文化方面的表现各不相同。在一个地方，他们用筷子吃饭；在另一个地方，用叉子。这使他意识到文化的多样性。**

> A young athlete was struggling in the race. But with the patient coaching of an experienced coach, he improved greatly. The coach\'s advice and encouragement were like guiding lights. **一位年轻运动员在比赛中表现挣扎。但在一位经验丰富的教练的耐心指导下，他进步巨大。教练的建议和鼓励就像指路明灯。**

> A young boy was lost in a forest. When he felt hopeless, a kind Reverend appeared and led him out safely. The Reverend\'s wisdom and kindness left a deep impression on the boy. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。当他感到绝望时，一位善良的牧师出现并安全地把他带了出来。这位牧师的智慧和善良给男孩留下了深刻的印象。**

> The mayor worked very hard for re-election. He promised to build more parks and improve schools. People were impressed and finally gave him the chance of re-election. **市长为了再次当选非常努力。他承诺修建更多公园和改善学校。人们被打动了，最终给了他再次当选的机会。**

> A student named Tom always worked hard but failed many tests. One day, he decided to change his study method. Finally, he succeeded. \'Failed\' means not achieving the desired result. **一个叫汤姆的学生总是很努力但多次考试失败。有一天，他决定改变学习方法。最终，他成功了。\'failed\'意思是没有达到期望的结果。**
> 有一天，小明向小红分享自己的冒险经历，每讲完一段，小红就会说\'uh-huh\'表示自己在认真听且感兴趣。小明知道小红的\'uh-huh\'是在回应他，让他继续讲下去。 **有一天，小明向小红分享经历，小红用\'uh-huh\'表示在认真听且感兴趣，小明明白这是让他继续讲的意思。**

> A group of students decided to organize a fun fair for fund-raising. They sold homemade cookies and toys. With their efforts, they successfully raised enough money to help build a new library for the school. **一群学生决定组织一场游乐会来筹款。他们出售自制的饼干和玩具。通过他们的努力，成功筹集到了足够的钱来为学校建一个新图书馆。**

> A king wanted to build a large-scale castle. He needed a lot of materials and workers. The project was so huge that it took years to finish. But in the end, the castle was magnificent. **一位国王想要建造一座大规模的城堡。他需要大量的材料和工人。这个工程如此浩大，花了好几年才完工。但最终，城堡非常宏伟。**

> In a magical basketball game, all the best players from different teams gathered. They formed an all-star team. Everyone was excited to see these stars shine together on the court. The all-star team was unbeatable! **在一场神奇的篮球比赛中，来自不同球队的所有最佳球员聚集在一起。他们组成了一支全明星队。每个人都兴奋地看到这些明星一起在球场上闪耀。这支全明星队战无不胜！**

> One day, Tom was assigned the task of cleaning the classroom. He swept the floor, wiped the desks, and made everything tidy. Through his hard work, the classroom became clean and shiny. Tom learned that cleaning can bring a pleasant environment. **一天，汤姆被分配了打扫教室的任务。他扫地、擦桌子，把一切都整理得井井有条。通过他的努力，教室变得干净又明亮。汤姆明白了打扫能带来宜人的环境。**

> Long ago, a brave group of seafarers known as Vikings set out on adventures. They were fierce warriors with strong ships. They raided and explored faraway lands. Remember, these were the Vikings! **很久以前，有一群勇敢的航海者被称为维京人，他们踏上了冒险之旅。他们是勇猛的战士，拥有坚固的船只。他们四处劫掠和探索遥远的土地。记住，这些就是维京人！**

> One day, a group of people were marching in the street. They were protesters who were unhappy with a new law. They held signs and shouted loudly to make their voices heard. Their goal was to bring about change. **一天，一群人在街上游行。他们是抗议者，对一项新法律感到不满。他们举着标语牌，大声呼喊，让自己的声音被听到。他们的目标是带来改变。**

> Once upon a time, there was a group of people called Sunni. They had their own beliefs and traditions. They were like a big family, united by their shared values. Remember, Sunni represents a specific religious group. **从前，有一群人被称为逊尼派。他们有自己的信仰和传统。他们就像一个大家庭，因共同的价值观而团结在一起。记住，逊尼派代表了一个特定的宗教群体。**
> I was trying to build a model airplane, but kept making mistakes. The pieces wouldn\'t fit together. It was so frustrating. I felt like giving up. **我当时试图组装一架飞机模型，但一直出错。零件都拼不到一起。这太令人沮丧了。我都想放弃了。**

> In a Victorian town, a young girl wore beautiful clothes with elaborate lace. The houses had ornate designs. It was a time of elegance and strict rules. People were polite and proper. Remember, Victorian means related to the period of Queen Victoria. **在一个维多利亚时代的小镇上，一个年轻女孩穿着带有精美蕾丝的漂亮衣服。房屋有着华丽的设计。那是一个优雅且规则严格的时代。人们彬彬有礼、举止得体。记住，Victorian 意思是与维多利亚女王时期有关的。**

> A journalist was always reported the truth. One day, he reported a big event accurately and became famous. People trusted his reported news. Remember, reported means gave an account of something. **一位记者总是报道真相。有一天，他准确地报道了一个大事件并出名了。人们信任他所报道的新闻。记住，reported 意思是给出关于某事的描述。**

> One day, Tom was always failing his tests. But he decided to change. He spent every night studying hard. Day by day, he was improving. Finally, he got excellent grades. **有一天，汤姆考试总是不及格。但他决定改变。他每晚都努力学习。一天天过去，他在不断进步。最终，他取得了优异的成绩。**

> A middle-aged man was always lost in thought. One day, he decided to change and started a new adventure. He found joy and meaning in the middle of his life. Middle-aged means being at the middle stage of age. **一位中年男子总是陷入沉思。有一天，他决定改变，开始了新的冒险。他在中年时期找到了快乐和意义。Middle-aged 意思是处于年龄的中间阶段。**
> 想象一下，有一只小恐龙，它的鳞片（scale）比其他同类小很多，处于次级（sub）的状态，所以我们叫它 subscale 小恐龙。 **想象一只鳞片处于次级状态的小恐龙来辅助记忆 subscale 这个单词，意思是'次级规模；分量不足；小型的'**

> A little prince was protected by a magical shield. The shield made sure no harm could come to him. Just like the prince, when something is \'protected\', it is safe and shielded from danger. **一个小王子被一个神奇的护盾保护着。这个护盾确保他不会受到任何伤害。就像小王子一样，当某物被\'protected\'时，它是安全的，免受危险。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little tree. It was a five-year-old tree, growing strong and tall. It had survived five years of wind and rain, showing its toughness. Remember, \'five-year\' means lasting for five years. **从前，有一棵小树。它是一棵五岁的树，长得又壮又高。它经历了五年的风雨，显示出了它的坚韧。记住，'five-year'意思是持续五年的。**

> A detective was working on a case. After the initial investigation, the follow-up was crucial. He spent days doing follow-up work to catch the criminal. **一位侦探正在处理一个案件。在初步调查之后，后续工作至关重要。他花了几天时间做后续工作来抓住罪犯。**

> A young traveler was lost in a forest. Just when he felt hopeless, a guiding light appeared. It was a lantern carried by an old man who led him out safely. The old man\'s presence was like the meaning of \'guiding\', showing the way. **一位年轻的旅行者在森林中迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，一道引导之光出现了。那是一位老人提着的灯笼，老人带领他安全地走了出去。老人的出现就像'guiding'这个词的意思，指明道路。**

> A soldier was excited for his first deployment. He packed his bags, ready to go to a new place and fulfill his duty. The deployment meant a new adventure and a chance to protect. **一名士兵对他的首次部署感到兴奋。他收拾好行李，准备前往新的地方履行职责。这次部署意味着一次新的冒险和一个保护的机会。**
> 想象在一个偏远的乡村，满地都是 grass（草）。村民们在基层努力生活，他们就是 grass-roots（基层民众）。大家虽平凡，却充满力量，为家乡默默付出。 **想象在一个偏远乡村，满地草。村民们在基层努力生活，他们就是基层民众。虽平凡却充满力量，为家乡默默付出。**

> A king had a long-standing throne that had been in his family for generations. It symbolized the long-lasting power and tradition. The word \'long-standing\' means having existed or continued for a long time. **一位国王拥有一个祖传已久的王座。它象征着长久的权力和传统。"long-standing"这个单词的意思是长期存在或持续很久。**

> Imagine a family struggling to make ends meet. They have a low income, which means they have little money to buy nice things or go on vacations. They have to be very careful with every penny. This is what \'low-income\' means. **想象一个家庭努力维持生计。他们收入低，这意味着他们几乎没有钱买好东西或去度假。他们必须对每一分钱都非常小心。这就是'low-income（低收入）'的意思。**

> A little rabbit had a two-year adventure. It traveled through forests and mountains. During these two years, it saw many beautiful scenes and made many friends. Two-year means lasting for two years. **一只小兔子有一个为期两年的冒险。它穿越森林和山脉。在这两年里，它看到了许多美丽的景色并结交了许多朋友。two-year 意思是持续两年的。**

> A brave diver went on an adventure. He swam to the deepest part of the ocean. There, he saw amazing creatures and beautiful corals. It was a thrilling experience that he would never forget. **一位勇敢的潜水员去探险。他游到了海洋的最深处。在那里，他看到了神奇的生物和美丽的珊瑚。这是一次他永远不会忘记的惊险经历。**

> In a wild storm, many perished, but a brave soul was surviving. He fought against hunger and cold, finding food and shelter. Finally, he made it through and lived to tell the tale. **在一场狂风暴雨中，许多人丧生，但有一个勇敢的灵魂幸存下来。他与饥饿和寒冷作斗争，寻找食物和住所。最终，他成功挺过并活下来讲述这个故事。**

> 想象一下，有个叫路德的人在森林里传教，他的追随者被称为 Lutheran。他们秉持着独特的信仰，像守护宝藏一样坚守教义。后来，Lutheran 就成了代表他们的专用词。 **想象一下，有个叫路德的人在森林传教，他的追随者被称为路德教派的信徒。他们坚守独特信仰，后来这个词就代表他们。**

> A young man was very hardworking. One day, he was HIRED by a big company. He was so excited because his efforts were finally recognized. From then on, he worked even harder in his new job. **一个年轻人非常勤奋。有一天，他被一家大公司雇用了。他非常兴奋，因为他的努力终于得到了认可。从那以后，他在新工作中更加努力了。**
> 想象一下，有一场盛大的选举，最终胜出的那个人还未正式上任，这个人就是 president-elect。就像小明在竞选成功后，等待就职的那段时间，他就是 president-elect，大家都期待着他正式履行职责。 **（尚未就职的）当选总统（或国家主席等）**

> One day, I was at the store and saw a price tag of thirty-five dollars on a beautiful dress. I thought it was a bit expensive but still considered buying it. It was a memorable number that day. **有一天，我在商店里看到一件漂亮的裙子标价三十五美元。我觉得有点贵，但还是考虑买它。那一天，这个数字让人难忘。**

> A young scientist anticipated a breakthrough in his research. He worked hard every day, imagining the moment when his discovery would change the world. Finally, his anticipation came true and he made a great achievement. **一位年轻的科学家期待着他的研究能有突破。他每天都努力工作，想象着他的发现改变世界的那一刻。最终，他的期待成真了，他取得了巨大的成就。**

> In a small town, there was a special party. Everyone noticed that all the couples were same-sex. It was a unique and different gathering. > A Navajo boy was lost in the desert. He used the stars to find his way home. The Navajo people are known for their wisdom and connection with nature. Remember, Navajo refers to this Native American tribe. **一个纳瓦霍族的男孩在沙漠中迷路了。他借助星星找到了回家的路。纳瓦霍人以他们的智慧和与自然的联系而闻名。记住，Navajo 指的就是这个美洲原住民部落。**

> Imagine a magical cube. It\'s not just a flat shape. It has length, width, and height. This cube is \'three-dimensional\'. It\'s real and you can touch it from all sides. That\'s what \'three-dimensional\' means! **想象一个神奇的立方体。它不只是一个平面的形状。它有长、宽和高。这个立方体就是"三维的"。它是真实的，你可以从各个方面触摸到它。这就是"三维的"的意思！**
> 想象一个长老（presbyter）在教堂里严肃地主持会议，他的形象代表着Presbyterian这个词所描述的长老会教派。大家都尊重他的权威和智慧。 **想象一位长老在教堂主持会议来辅助记忆Presbyterian（长老会教派）这个单词**

> A young artist was determined to show the beauty of inner-city life. He walked through narrow streets, painted colorful murals, and captured the hidden joy within. People started to notice and love their inner-city home again. **一位年轻的艺术家决心展现内城生活的美。他走过狭窄的街道，绘制色彩斑斓的壁画，捕捉到了内城深处隐藏的快乐。人们再次开始关注并热爱他们的内城家园。**

> One day, a brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious cave. He walked dangerously close to a deep pit. Just one wrong step and he could fall. But his caution saved him. Remember, \'dangerously\' means in a way that is full of danger. **有一天，一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。他危险地靠近一个深坑。只要走错一步，他就可能掉下去。但他的谨慎救了他。记住，\'dangerously\'意思是以充满危险的方式。**

> One day, I needed a tool to fix many things. I found an all-purpose wrench that could solve all kinds of problems. It was like a magic tool that worked for everything. With it, I fixed the chair, the table, and even the bike! **有一天，我需要一个工具来修理很多东西。我找到了一个万能扳手，它能解决各种各样的问题。它就像一个神奇的工具，适用于一切。用它，我修好了椅子、桌子，甚至自行车！**

> A young girl was going on a trip for the first-time. She was very nervous but also excited. When she arrived at the destination, she realized that first-time experiences can be wonderful and full of surprises. **一个年轻女孩第一次去旅行。她非常紧张但也很兴奋。当她到达目的地时，她意识到第一次的经历可以很美妙并且充满惊喜。**

> One day, I witnessed a car accident. The scene was so terrifying that I was stunned. I just stood there, unable to move or speak, as if time had stopped. **有一天，我目睹了一场车祸。那场景太可怕了，我被惊呆了。我就站在那儿，动弹不得也说不出话来，仿佛时间都停止了。**

> A young man dreamed of becoming a mogul. He started a small business and faced many challenges. But with hard work and smart decisions, he finally built a huge empire and became a true mogul in his field. **一个年轻人梦想成为大亨。他开始做小生意，面临诸多挑战。但凭借努力工作和明智决策，他最终建立了一个庞大的帝国，在他的领域成为了真正的大亨。**

> A detective was conducting an in-depth investigation. He spent days digging into every detail, not missing a single clue. Finally, he solved the mystery. This shows that \'in-depth\' means very detailed and thorough. **一位侦探正在进行深入的调查。他花了好几天深挖每个细节，不放过任何一条线索。最终，他解开了谜团。这表明'in-depth'意味着非常详细和彻底。**

> In a magical forest, there were two paths. One led to a beautiful garden, the other to a mysterious cave. They were differing in destination. People had to choose based on their courage and curiosity. **在一个神奇的森林里，有两条路。一条通向美丽的花园，另一条通向神秘的洞穴。它们的目的地不同。人们必须根据自己的勇气和好奇心来选择。**

> A brave adventurer was determined to explore a high-risk cave. Everyone warned him, but he was fearless. In the cave, he faced many dangers, but luckily, he survived. Remember, \'high-risk\' means involving a lot of danger. **一位勇敢的探险家决心探索一个高风险的洞穴。每个人都警告他，但他无所畏惧。在洞穴里，他面临许多危险，但幸运的是，他活了下来。记住，'high-risk'意思是涉及很多危险。**

> One day, Tom found a lot of old plastic bottles. He knew they could be recycled. So he sent them to the factory. The bottles were turned into new useful things. That\'s how recycled materials bring new life. **有一天，汤姆发现了很多旧塑料瓶。他知道它们可以被回收利用。所以他把它们送到了工厂。这些瓶子被变成了新的有用的东西。这就是回收物品获得新生的方式。**

> A brave athlete decided to take on a cross-country challenge. He ran through mountains, forests, and fields. Despite facing many difficulties, he kept going. Finally, he reached the finish line. Cross-country means going across the country. **一位勇敢的运动员决定接受越野挑战。他跑过山脉、森林和田野。尽管面临许多困难，他仍坚持前行。最终，他到达了终点线。cross-country 意思是越野的；横越全国的**

> A group of friends decided to start a business together. They chose to form a \'co-op\'. They shared the costs, risks, and profits equally. Through teamwork and mutual support, their co-op became successful. **一群朋友决定一起创业。他们选择成立一个'合作社'。他们平均分担成本、风险和利润。通过团队合作和相互支持，他们的合作社取得了成功。**

> A poor boy dreamed of having high-end clothes and shoes. One day, he won a lottery and bought them. But he realized true happiness wasn\'t just in material things. High-end means of high quality and expensive. **一个贫穷的男孩梦想拥有高端的衣服和鞋子。有一天，他中了彩票并买了它们。但他意识到真正的幸福不仅仅在于物质。high-end 意思是高质量且昂贵的。**

> A group of friends were invited to a party. Everyone was excited and actively participating. They danced, sang, and shared joy. \'Participating\' means taking part in an activity or event. **一群朋友被邀请参加一个聚会。每个人都很兴奋并且积极参与。他们跳舞、唱歌、分享快乐。'participating'意思是参加一个活动或事件。**

> A brave pilot was on a long-range flight. He flew across many countries and over vast oceans. Despite the long distance and challenges, he finally reached his destination safely. The word \'long-range\' means covering a great distance. **一位勇敢的飞行员进行了一次远程飞行。他飞越了许多国家和广阔的海洋。尽管距离很长且充满挑战，他最终安全抵达目的地。单词\'long-range\'意思是远距离的、远程的。**
> 有一天，小明和朋友们去森林探险，突然看到一只美丽的蝴蝶。大家都兴奋地喊 \'ooh\' ，表示惊喜和赞叹。这个声音就像他们内心的激动一下子爆发了出来。 **有一天，小明和朋友们在森林看到蝴蝶，大家喊\'哦\'表示惊喜和赞叹，以此辅助记忆单词\'ooh\'。**

> Once upon a time, a curious traveler met a wise elder. The elder explained that Judaism is an ancient religion with deep roots and rich traditions. It\'s a faith that has guided many through life. The traveler was enlightened. **从前，一位好奇的旅行者遇到了一位睿智的长者。长者解释说犹太教是一种有着深厚根基和丰富传统的古老宗教。它是一种引导许多人度过一生的信仰。旅行者受到了启发。**

> A traveler from the east was lost in the midwestern area. He met a kind farmer who showed him the way. The traveler was impressed by the wide fields and friendly people of the midwestern region. **一位来自东部的旅行者在中西部地区迷路了。他遇到了一位善良的农民给他指路。这位旅行者对中西部地区广阔的田野和友好的人们印象深刻。**

> Imagine a construction project. Workers are not working remotely but are physically present at the construction site. That\'s what \'on-site\' means - being at the actual place. For example, \'We need an on-site inspection.\' **想象一个建筑项目。工人们不是远程工作，而是实际出现在建筑工地。这就是'on-site'的意思------在实际的地点。例如，'我们需要一次现场检查。'**

> A young entrepreneur was worried about his new business. But a wise mentor guaranteed him success if he worked hard and stayed focused. With this guarantee, the entrepreneur was filled with confidence and worked diligently. **一位年轻的企业家对他的新业务感到担忧。但是一位睿智的导师向他保证，如果他努力工作并保持专注，就会成功。有了这个保证，这位企业家充满了信心并勤奋工作。**
> 想象你去看棒球比赛，走进一个大大的场地，这个场地就是\'ballpark\'。你在里面尽情享受比赛，记住这个充满欢乐的棒球场地，也就记住了\'ballpark\'这个表示\'棒球场；大致范围\'的单词。

> A little bird flew peacefully through the forest. It sang a sweet song and enjoyed the quiet and calm. No one disturbed it. It felt so peaceful and happy. **一只小鸟平静地飞过森林。它唱着甜美的歌，享受着安静和平静。没有人打扰它。它感到非常宁静和快乐。**

> A strong man was doing lifting in the gym. He lifted heavy weights with great effort. His goal was to become stronger and healthier. With each lift, he got closer to his dream. **一个强壮的男人正在健身房做举重。他费力地举起很重的杠铃。他的目标是变得更强壮更健康。每一次举起，他都离梦想更近一步。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little plant. It needed one-year to grow big and strong. During this one-year, it faced many challenges but never gave up. Finally, it became beautiful. **从前，有一株小植物。它需要一年的时间才能长大变强。在这一年里，它面临了许多挑战，但从未放弃。最终，它变得美丽了。**

> The boss gave me a last-minute task right before the deadline. I had to rush to finish it. It was so stressful! It means done or decided at the very end of a period of time. **老板在截止日期前的最后一刻给了我一项任务。我不得不匆忙完成。压力太大了！这个词意思是在一段时间的最后才完成或决定。**

> 想象一下，你在印度尼西亚旅行，遇到了一位友好的当地人，他自豪地说：\'I am an Indonesian.\' 他热情地向你介绍当地的美景和文化。这时，你就记住了 Indonesian 是印度尼西亚人的意思。 **想象一下，你在印度尼西亚旅行，遇到一位友好的当地人，他自豪地说：\'我是印度尼西亚人。\' 他热情地向你介绍当地美景和文化。这时，你就记住了 Indonesian 是印度尼西亚人的意思。**

> A brave explorer was on an open-ended journey. He had no fixed destination, ready to discover new places. Just like this journey, \'open-ended\' means having no definite limit or conclusion. **一位勇敢的探险家正在进行一次没有明确终点的旅程。他没有固定的目的地，准备去发现新的地方。就像这次旅程一样，\'open-ended\' 意味着没有确定的限制或结论。**

> Finn was a brave adventurer. One day, he lost his way in a deep forest. But with his wisdom and courage, Finn found the exit. Remember Finn, the brave one who overcame difficulties. **芬恩是一位勇敢的冒险家。有一天，他在一片幽深的森林里迷路了。但凭借着他的智慧和勇气，芬恩找到了出口。记住芬恩，这位克服困难的勇者。**

> Once upon a time, a young artist entered a competition. His work was so outstanding that it won many awards. From then on, people called him an \'award-winning\' artist. It means winning awards and being recognized for excellence. **从前，有一位年轻的艺术家参加了一场比赛。他的作品非常出色，赢得了很多奖项。从那以后，人们称他为"获奖的"艺术家。这个词的意思是赢得奖项并因出色而获得认可。**

> One day, a little boy dreamed of meeting a Martian. In his dream, the Martian had a big head and green eyes. It came from a faraway planet. When the boy woke up, he never forgot this strange dream. **有一天，一个小男孩梦到见到了火星人。在他的梦里，火星人有个大脑袋和绿色的眼睛。它来自遥远的星球。当男孩醒来，他永远忘不了这个奇怪的梦。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to count to twenty-two. It started from one, jumping and shouting each number. When it finally reached twenty-two, it was so happy and danced around. **有一天，一只小猴子想数到二十二。它从一开始，边跳边喊每个数字。当它终于数到二十二时，高兴得手舞足蹈。**

> A Haitian boy named Tom was lost in a big city. But with his courage and the help of kind people, he finally found his way home. The word \'Haitian\' refers to something or someone related to Haiti. **一个名叫汤姆的海地男孩在一个大城市里迷路了。但凭借他的勇气和好心人的帮助，他最终找到了回家的路。"Haitian"这个单词指的是与海地有关的事物或人。**

> A brave soldier was advancing steadily in the battlefield, ignoring the danger around. He moved forward step by step, determined to achieve victory. The advancing soldier showed great courage. **一位勇敢的士兵在战场上稳步前进，不顾周围的危险。他一步一步向前移动，决心取得胜利。这位前进中的士兵展现出了巨大的勇气。**

> John was very sad when he thought of his ex-wife. They used to be happy together, but then they had many fights and finally divorced. Now the word \'ex-wife\' always reminds him of that painful past. **约翰想到他的前妻时非常伤心。他们曾经在一起很幸福，但后来有了很多争吵并最终离婚。现在'ex-wife'这个词总是让他想起那段痛苦的过去。**

> A rich businessman was late for an important meeting. He rushed out and jumped into the limo waiting for him. The limo sped through the city, helping him arrive just in time. **一位富有的商人要去参加一个重要的会议却迟到了。他冲出去跳进正在等他的豪华轿车。豪华轿车飞速穿过城市，帮助他刚好及时赶到。**
> 想象一个小镇，起初很安静。突然，一家新工厂开业，带来很多工作机会。接着商店增多，人口增长，一切都在快速发展。这个快速发展的状态就是 burgeoning 。 **想象一个小镇起初安静，新工厂开业后带来诸多变化，一切快速发展的状态就是\'burgeoning\'，意思是迅速发展的、新兴的。**

> Imagine a world where only the best athletes compete. They are not just good but world-class. They shine on the global stage, representing the highest level. \'World-class\' means being among the best in the entire world. **想象一个只有最优秀运动员参加比赛的世界。他们不只是优秀，而是世界级的。他们在全球舞台上闪耀，代表着最高水平。'world-class'意思是世界级的，属于世界上最优秀的。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to buy 21 bananas. He counted them carefully, twenty and one more, that\'s twenty-one. He was so happy with his big bunch of bananas. **有一天，一只小猴子想买 21 根香蕉。他仔细地数着，二十根再加上一根，那就是二十一。他拿着这一大把香蕉可高兴了。**

> A scientist was working hard in the lab, trying to achieve cloning. One day, he finally succeeded and cloned a cute rabbit. The process of cloning was full of challenges, but his persistence paid off. **一位科学家在实验室里努力工作，试图实现克隆。有一天，他终于成功克隆了一只可爱的兔子。克隆的过程充满了挑战，但他的坚持得到了回报。**
> 想象一下，你参加了一个盛大的派对。在派对上，人们相互交流、分享信息，就像电脑通过线路连接形成网络一样。这就是 networking，是建立和维护人际关系网络的过程。 **想象参加派对中人们交流的情景来理解 networking 这个表示建立和维护人际关系网络的单词**

> Once upon a time, a Cherokee warrior bravely protected his tribe. He wore special feathers and rode a strong horse. The Cherokee people were known for their wisdom and unity. > One day, when I fell and hurt myself, my friend came to help. She showed great concern and took care of me. Her kind and attentive actions made me understand the meaning of \'caring\', which means being kind and attentive to others\' needs. **有一天，当我摔倒受伤时，我的朋友来帮忙。她表现出极大的关心，并照顾我。她友善且细心的举动让我明白了\'caring\'的意思，即对他人的需求友善和关注。**

> Once there was a little bird. It had the self-determination to fly high and explore the unknown. It didn\'t follow others but chose its own path. It showed great self-determination to achieve its dreams. **从前有一只小鸟。它有自我决定的能力，想要飞得很高去探索未知。它不跟随他人，而是选择自己的道路。它展现出了强大的自主决定力去实现自己的梦想。**

> One day, a little monkey wanted to share an apple. He cut it into two equal parts. Each part was one-half of the apple. So, one-half means half of something. **有一天，一只小猴子想要分享一个苹果。他把它切成了两等份。每一份就是这个苹果的一半。所以，one-half 意思是某物的一半。**
> 想象一个人总是在公共场合插队、对别人恶语相向，大家都非常讨厌他。这个人的行为就像个'asshole'，完全不顾及他人感受，只想着自己。 **想象一个总是表现恶劣、令人讨厌的人，以此来理解'asshole'这个表示混蛋、可恶家伙的词。**
> 想象一下你在一条狭窄的小道上，只能朝着一个方向前进，没有回头路。这就像\'one-way\'所表示的单程、单向。就像这条小道，one-way 的路线是固定且不可逆转的。 **想象在狭窄小道只能朝一个方向前进的情景来辅助理解\'one-way\'表示单程、单向的意思，路线固定不可逆转。**
> 想象一个科技公司，展示最新的产品，自豪地说这是 state-of-the-art 的。意思就是这些产品代表了最先进、最高水平的技术。就像走在科技前沿，引领潮流。 **想象一个科技公司展示最先进的产品并自豪宣称的情景，以此来理解\'最先进的；达到最高水平的\'这个含义**

> A long time ago, in a small village, people needed a special bridge. But there was no natural one. So, they used their skills and efforts to build one. > One night, a girl was walking alone in a dark alley. Suddenly, a strange man appeared. But she was prepared and used her skills for self-defense. She fought back and escaped safely. **一天晚上，一个女孩独自走在黑暗的小巷里。突然，一个陌生男人出现了。但她早有准备，运用自我防卫的技能。她反击并安全逃脱。**

> 想象一家公司，所有重要的工作都在自家大楼里完成，不用外包。这就是\'in-house\'，意思是内部的、机构内部的。比如：We have an in-house team for this project. （我们有一个负责这个项目的内部团队。） **想象一家公司，所有重要工作都在自家大楼完成，不用外包，这解释了\'in-house\'（内部的、机构内部的）的意思，例如：我们有一个负责这个项目的内部团队。**

> A selfish king always pursued self-interest. He cared only about his own wealth and power, ignoring the needs of his people. Eventually, his kingdom fell. Remember, self-interest can lead to downfall. **一个自私的国王总是追求自身利益。他只关心自己的财富和权力，忽略了人民的需求。最终，他的王国沦陷了。记住，自私自利会导致衰败。**

> One day, I was helping in the kitchen. I saw mom shredded the cabbage into thin strips. The shredded cabbage looked so fine and ready for a delicious salad. **有一天，我在厨房帮忙。我看到妈妈把卷心菜切成了细条。这些切碎的卷心菜看起来很棒，准备用来做美味的沙拉。**

> One day, Tom was in a big store. He saw many nice things and decided to do purchasing. He carefully chose what he needed and paid happily. Purchasing made him feel fulfilled. **一天，汤姆在一家大商店里。他看到很多漂亮的东西，决定进行采购。他仔细挑选了自己需要的东西，然后开心地付了钱。采购让他感到满足。**

> A Hungarian traveler got lost in a strange city. He couldn\'t understand the local language and struggled to find his way. But with the help of a kind local, he finally reached his destination. Remember, Hungarian means relating to Hungary or its people. **一位匈牙利旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。他不懂当地语言，艰难地寻找着路。但在一位好心当地人的帮助下，他最终到达了目的地。记住，Hungarian 意思是与匈牙利或其人民有关的。**

> One day, I went to the market and saw the butcher mincing the meat carefully. The minced meat was going to be used for making delicious dumplings. I learned that \'minced\' means cut into very small pieces. **有一天，我去市场，看到屠夫在仔细地把肉切碎。这些切碎的肉将被用来做美味的饺子。我了解到'minced'意思是切成很小的碎块。**

> In a small town, the mayor did a great job. So when the election came again, people decided to re-elect him. They trusted he would keep making the town better. **在一个小镇上，市长工作出色。所以当再次选举时，人们决定重新选举他。他们相信他会继续让小镇变得更好。**
> 有一天，小明走在路上，听到一阵动感的音乐，看到一群年轻人在自由地跳动。他好奇地问这是什么，旁人告诉他这是 hip-hop，是充满活力和个性的舞蹈与音乐。 **有一天，小明在路上看到年轻人跳的充满活力和个性的舞蹈与听到的音乐就是嘻哈（hip-hop）。**

> A small company was struggling to make profits. Then they found a new supplier whose products were cost-effective. With lower costs but good quality, the company thrived. It shows that being cost-effective means good value for money. **一家小公司一直在努力盈利。然后他们找到了一个新的供应商，其产品具有成本效益。成本低但质量好，公司蓬勃发展。这表明具有成本效益意味着物有所值。**

> Once upon a time, a little ant had a three-day adventure. It traveled far and wide, seeing many new things. After three days, it returned home with wonderful memories. The word \'three-day\' means lasting for three days. **从前，一只小蚂蚁有一场为期三天的冒险。它走了很远，看到了很多新事物。三天后，它带着美好的回忆回家了。单词"three-day"意思是持续三天的。**

> Imagine a Colombian dancer, twirling gracefully on a stage. Her colorful dress and passionate moves represent the vibrant spirit of Colombia. Remember this scene to think of \'Colombian\' as relating to people or things from Colombia. **想象一位哥伦比亚舞者，在舞台上优雅地旋转。她色彩斑斓的裙子和充满激情的动作代表了哥伦比亚充满活力的精神。记住这个场景来联想\'Colombian\'这个表示来自哥伦比亚的人或事物的单词。**

> A detective was facing an unresolved mystery. The case was full of confusing clues and no clear answers. It seemed as if the truth was hidden in a fog. Just like this, \'unresolved\' means not settled or not explained clearly. **一位侦探正面临着一个未解决的谜团。这个案子充满了令人困惑的线索，没有明确的答案。似乎真相隐藏在迷雾之中。就像这样，'unresolved'意思是未解决的、未解释清楚的。**

> In a sports competition, the first-round was like a gate to the next stage. Tom was nervous but gave his best. He knew passing the first-round was crucial for his dream of winning the championship. **在一场体育比赛中，首轮就像是通往下一阶段的大门。汤姆很紧张，但全力以赴。他知道通过首轮对他赢得冠军的梦想至关重要。**

> A city was destroyed by a big earthquake. But the people were determined. They started rebuilding their homes and lives. They worked hard day and night. Finally, the city was reborn. **一座城市被一场大地震摧毁。但人们意志坚定。他们开始重建家园和生活。他们日夜努力工作。最终，城市获得了新生。**

> A king had a disproportionate number of jewels compared to his subjects. The subjects worked hard but had few. This imbalance showed the meaning of \'disproportionate\' - not proportionate or unequal in size, amount, or degree. **一位国王拥有的珠宝数量与他的臣民不成比例。臣民辛勤劳作却所得甚少。这种不平衡体现了\'disproportionate\'的意思------不成比例的，不均衡的，在规模、数量或程度上不平等。**

> Once there was a basketball player. He was so excellent that he was called All-American. He could play well in every game and was loved by people all over the country. **从前有个篮球运动员，他非常出色，被称为全美明星。他在每场比赛中都表现出色，受到全国人民的喜爱。**

> Once upon a time, there was a special house. It had two floors. People called it a \'two-story\' house. The first floor was for living, and the second floor was for sleeping. It was a wonderful two-story place! **从前，有一个特别的房子。它有两层。人们称它为"两层的"房子。第一层用于生活，第二层用于睡觉。这是一个很棒的两层建筑！**

> One day, a traveler was very hungry. He went to a restaurant and asked for something special. The chef brought him tofu and said, \'This is our famous tofu, very delicious!\' The traveler loved it. **有一天，一位旅行者非常饿。他走进一家餐馆并要求来点特别的。厨师给他端来了豆腐并说：'这是我们有名的豆腐，非常美味！'旅行者很喜欢。**
> 想象有个坏蛋总是欺负弱小，大家都叫他 abuser。他对别人又打又骂，行为恶劣。人们都很讨厌他，因为他是滥用权力、欺负他人的人。 **想象有一个总是欺负他人的坏蛋，大家称呼他为'滥用者；虐待者'。他打骂别人，行为很差。人们都讨厌这个'滥用权力、欺负他人的人'。**

> One day, I met my sister\'s husband, my brother-in-law. He was tall and friendly. We had a great chat. I remember him clearly because he brought me a nice gift. Now I won\'t forget the word \'brother-in-law\'. **有一天，我见到了我姐姐的丈夫，我的姐夫。他又高又友善。我们聊得很愉快。我清楚地记得他，因为他给我带了一份很棒的礼物。现在我不会忘记\'brother-in-law\'这个词了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy. When people asked his age, he would say, \'I\'m eight-year-old.\' It was easy for everyone to understand. Year-old helps us clearly tell someone\'s age. **从前，有一个小男孩。当人们问他的年龄时，他会说，'我八岁了。'大家很容易就理解了。year-old 帮助我们清晰地表达某人的年龄。**

> Once upon a time, there was a secret treasure chest. Only the trusted friends of the owner knew the key. They were reliable and never betrayed the trust. So, \'trusted\' means being reliable and worthy of trust. **从前，有一个秘密的宝箱。只有主人信任的朋友知道钥匙。他们可靠，从不背叛信任。所以，'trusted'意思是可靠的、值得信任的。**

> A man was grieving after losing his beloved dog. He spent days in sadness, remembering all the happy times they shared. But gradually, he learned to cherish the memories and move on with a smile in his heart. **一个男人在失去他心爱的狗后十分悲痛。他沉浸在悲伤中数日，回忆着他们共度的所有欢乐时光。但渐渐地，他学会了珍惜回忆，带着心中的微笑继续前行。**

> A journalist was writing an important article. At the top of the page, he wrote a HEADNOTE to summarize the key points. It was like a guiding light for readers. The headnote made the article clear and easy to understand. **一位记者正在写一篇重要的文章。在页面顶部，他写了一个眉批来总结要点。它就像为读者指明方向的明灯。这个眉批让文章清晰易懂。**

> A Belgian traveler was lost in a strange city. He asked for directions and finally found his way with the help of friendly locals. The Belgian was so grateful for their kindness. **一位比利时旅行者在一个陌生的城市迷路了。他问路，最后在友好的当地人的帮助下找到了路。这位比利时人非常感激他们的友善。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a dark cave. As danger approached, his body released a special substance - adrenaline. It made his heart race and gave him the strength to run fast and find the exit. This substance is adrenaline. **一位勇敢的探险家在黑暗的洞穴中迷路了。当危险临近时，他的身体释放出一种特殊的物质------肾上腺素。它使他心跳加速，赋予他快速奔跑并找到出口的力量。这种物质就是肾上腺素。**

> In a present-day city, a time traveler arrives. People are busy with modern technologies. The traveler realizes that \'present-day\' means the current time, full of today\'s advancements and activities. **在一个当今的城市里，一位时间旅行者到达了。人们正忙于现代科技。旅行者意识到'present-day'意思是当下，充满了如今的进步和活动。**

> One sunny day, I went for a walk in the park. The flowers were blooming, and the birds were singing pleasantly. It made me feel so relaxed and happy. I enjoyed this wonderful moment. **在一个阳光明媚的日子，我去公园散步。花儿绽放，鸟儿欢快地歌唱。这令人愉悦的场景让我感到非常放松和开心。我享受着这美妙的时刻。**

> A Kuwaiti merchant was traveling in a foreign land. He carried precious goods and his traditional Kuwaiti clothing made him stand out. People were curious about his Kuwaiti background and culture. **一位科威特商人在异国旅行。他带着珍贵的货物，他传统的科威特服饰使他引人注目。人们对他的科威特背景和文化感到好奇。**

> A brave detective was on a mission to find a secret file. The clue led him to a mysterious building called the Pentagon. It had five sides and was full of puzzles. Finally, he solved the mystery inside the Pentagon. **一位勇敢的侦探在执行寻找一份秘密文件的任务。线索将他引向了一座名为五角大楼的神秘建筑。它有五个边，里面充满了谜题。最终，他在五角大楼里解开了谜团。**

> One day, I lost my cellphone. I was very worried and searched everywhere. Finally, I found it in the pocket of my jacket. It made me realize how important a cellphone is for communication. **有一天，我弄丢了我的手机。我非常担心，到处找。最后，我在我夹克的口袋里找到了它。这让我意识到手机对于交流是多么重要。**

> One day, Tom forgot to pay his dues for the club membership. As a result, he couldn\'t attend the special event. Later, he realized the importance of paying dues on time. **一天，汤姆忘记支付俱乐部会员费了。结果，他不能参加特别活动。后来，他意识到按时交费用的重要性。**

> An Austrian artist was painting a beautiful landscape. One day, he lost his brush but found it with the help of a friendly local. This showed the kindness of Austrians. **一位奥地利艺术家正在画一幅美丽的风景。有一天，他丢了画笔，但在一位友好的当地人的帮助下找到了。这展现了奥地利人的友善。**

> Once upon a time, a little bird found a piece of paper. It used its beak to fold the paper many times and finally got a neatly folded shape. The bird was so happy! **从前，一只小鸟发现了一张纸。它用喙多次折叠这张纸，最终得到了一个整齐的折叠形状。小鸟非常开心！**
> 想象一下灰姑娘参加舞会前的情景。仙女挥动魔法棒，给她进行了一场神奇的 makeover。灰姑娘穿上漂亮的裙子，梳了新发型，化了精致的妆，变成了美丽的公主。 **想象灰姑娘参加舞会前的大变样。仙女通过魔法让她在服装、发型、妆容等方面发生了巨大改变，这就是\'makeover\'，意思是彻底改变，改头换面。**

> Imagine a big land where people of the same nation live together and have their own government and rules. This land is a \'nation-state\', a place where the nation and the state are closely combined. **想象有一片广阔的土地，相同民族的人们生活在一起，并有自己的政府和规则。这片土地就是"民族国家"，一个民族和国家紧密结合的地方。**

> Once upon a time, there was an Ethiopian named Lily. She had beautiful black hair and big eyes. She loved to dance and sing, showing the unique charm of Ethiopians. **从前，有一个埃塞俄比亚人名叫莉莉。她有着漂亮的黑发和大眼睛。她喜欢唱歌跳舞，展现出埃塞俄比亚人的独特魅力。**

> In a modern-day city, a young girl was lost. But with the help of modern technology like GPS on her phone, she found her way home. \'Modern-day\' means of the present time. **在一个现代的城市里，一个年轻女孩迷路了。但借助手机上像 GPS 这样的现代技术，她找到了回家的路。\'modern-day\' 意思是当代的，现代的。**
> 想象一下，在一个工厂里，工人穿着蓝色的工作服辛勤劳作。他们就是blue-collar，从事体力劳动的蓝领工人。他们用汗水和力量为社会贡献，就像蓝色工作服一样朴实而坚韧。 **想象在工厂中，穿着蓝色工作服辛勤工作的工人就是蓝领工人。他们用汗水和力量做出贡献，蓝色工作服象征其朴实坚韧。**

> A tourist got lost in a strange city. The complex roads and unfamiliar signs bewildered him. He didn\'t know which way to go and felt very confused. **一位游客在一个陌生的城市迷路了。复杂的道路和不熟悉的标志让他感到不知所措。他不知道该走哪条路，感到非常困惑。**

> Once upon a time, in a small town, a group of bad people held an anti-semitism meeting. They spread hate and prejudice. But the townsfolk stood up against it, saying it was wrong and unjust. > A brave knight fought against a powerful dragon. But unfortunately, the knight was defeated. The dragon was too strong. However, the knight didn\'t give up and trained harder for the next battle. **一位勇敢的骑士与一只强大的龙战斗。但不幸的是，骑士被打败了。龙太强大了。然而，骑士没有放弃，为下一场战斗更努力地训练。**

> A spy needed to hide important documents. So, he used a special cloth to \'cover-up\' them. Later, when people found the hidden documents, they knew it was a \'cover-up\' operation. **一名间谍需要隐藏重要文件。于是，他用一块特殊的布来"掩盖"它们。后来，当人们发现被隐藏的文件时，他们知道这是一次"掩盖"行动。**

> Imagine a brave traveler journeying through the lands of Yugoslav. He meets friendly people, sees beautiful mountains and experiences unique cultures. The name Yugoslav sticks in his mind as a symbol of adventure and discovery. **想象一位勇敢的旅行者在南斯拉夫的土地上旅行。他遇到了友好的人们，看到了美丽的山脉，体验了独特的文化。南斯拉夫这个名字留在他的脑海中，成为冒险和发现的象征。**

> A Mormon missionary traveled far and wide to spread their beliefs. He faced many challenges but remained steadfast. His journey showed the dedication of Mormons. **一位摩门教传教士四处奔走传播他们的信仰。他面临诸多挑战但坚定不移。他的旅程展现了摩门教徒的奉献精神。**

> A young artist moved to a small-town. At first, he felt bored. But soon, he discovered the charm of the simple life. The friendly neighbors and peaceful streets made him love this small-town. **一位年轻的艺术家搬到了一个小镇。起初，他感到无聊。但很快，他发现了简单生活的魅力。友好的邻居和宁静的街道让他爱上了这个小镇。**

> One day, Tom decided to start investing. He saved his money and carefully chose a promising company. With hope and determination, he put his funds in, believing it would bring great returns in the future. **有一天，汤姆决定开始投资。他攒下自己的钱，并仔细挑选了一家有前途的公司。带着希望和决心，他投入了自己的资金，相信未来会带来巨大的回报。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a deep cave. Suddenly, he encountered a huge snake. Its venom was life-threatening. But luckily, he had the antidote and survived. Remember, life-threatening means causing danger to life. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个深洞。突然，他遇到了一条巨大的蛇。它的毒液有致命危险。但幸运的是，他有解毒剂并活了下来。记住，life-threatening 意思是威胁生命的。**

> Once upon a time, Tom was struggling with math. So, he started tutoring with a wise teacher. Every day after school, they sat together, and Tom\'s grades improved. Tutoring really helped him succeed! **从前，汤姆数学学得很吃力。于是，他开始接受一位睿智老师的辅导。每天放学后，他们坐在一起，汤姆的成绩提高了。辅导真的帮助他取得了成功！**

> Imagine a group of friendly Ukrainians having a big party. They are wearing traditional clothes, singing and dancing. \'Ukrainian\' is the word we use to describe people from Ukraine. **想象一群友好的乌克兰人在举行盛大的聚会。他们穿着传统服饰，唱歌跳舞。\'Ukrainian\' 这个单词就是用来形容来自乌克兰的人的。**

> A Peruvian adventurer named Luis traveled through the Andes. He faced many challenges but his spirit remained strong. His story made us understand the toughness and charm of Peruvian people. **一位名叫路易斯的秘鲁冒险家穿越了安第斯山脉。他面临诸多挑战，但精神始终强大。他的故事让我们了解到秘鲁人的坚韧和魅力。**

> A brave hiker got lost in the backcountry. It was a remote and wild area. But with his map and compass, he finally found his way back. The backcountry taught him to be prepared. **一位勇敢的徒步旅行者在偏远地区迷路了。那是一个偏僻且荒凉的地方。但凭借地图和指南针，他最终找到了回去的路。偏远地区教会他要做好准备。**
> Emmy 是一个可爱小女孩的名字。有一天，她在花园里玩耍，看到一只蝴蝶，兴奋地追着跑。她的笑声像银铃般清脆，大家都记住了这个快乐的 Emmy。

> One day, I went to the beach and saw many mussels. They were tightly attached to the rocks. I remembered the word \'mussels\' because of their unique shape and the beautiful seaside scene. **有一天，我去海滩看到了很多贻贝。它们紧紧地附着在岩石上。我因为它们独特的形状和美丽的海边场景记住了'mussels'这个单词。**

> A fairy was very sad because she had wrinkled wings. She couldn\'t fly freely. But with magic, she made them smooth again and happily soared through the sky. Remember, \'wrinkled\' means having lines or folds. **一个仙女非常伤心，因为她的翅膀起皱了。她不能自由飞翔。但通过魔法，她让翅膀再次变得光滑，并开心地在天空翱翔。记住，'wrinkled'意思是有皱纹或褶皱的。**

> A poor student was worried about his tuition. But one day, he got a notice saying his education was funded by a kind-hearted donor. He was so happy and grateful. **一个贫困学生为学费发愁。但有一天，他收到通知说他的教育得到了一位好心捐赠者的资助。他非常高兴和感激。**

> In the twentieth-century, a young adventurer traveled through time. He witnessed great changes, from the first flight to the digital age. This century was full of wonders and challenges. **在二十世纪，一位年轻的冒险家进行了时间旅行。他见证了从第一次飞行到数字时代的巨大变化。这个世纪充满了奇迹和挑战。**

> Imagine a little bird that always flies close to dangerous places, like near a hungry cat. We say this bird is at-risk. It means being in a situation where something bad might happen easily. **想象一只小鸟总是飞到危险的地方附近，比如靠近一只饥饿的猫。我们说这只鸟处于危险中。at-risk 这个词意思是处于可能容易发生不好事情的状况。**

> Once upon a time, a prince was looking for a new throne. But all the normal-sized ones were not good. Finally, he found an oversized throne that was perfect for him. It was so big and comfortable! **从前，有一位王子在寻找新的王座。但所有正常尺寸的都不好。最后，他找到了一个超大号的王座，对他来说太完美了。它又大又舒适！**

> A small town\'s public library was in trouble. But a smart entrepreneur decided to privatize it. With new funds and management, it became better. Now people understand what \'privatize\' means - making something private and under individual control. **一个小镇的公共图书馆陷入困境。但一位聪明的企业家决定将其私有化。有了新的资金和管理，它变得更好了。现在人们理解了\'privatize\'的意思------使某物私有化并处于个人控制之下。**

> Imagine a traveler named Jordan who loves exploring. One day, he decided to represent his country in an international event. People started calling him a Jordanian. It means someone from Jordan. **想象有个叫乔丹的旅行者，热爱探索。有一天，他决定代表自己的国家参加国际活动。人们开始称他为 Jordanian。这个词意思是来自约旦的人。**

> A detective was assigned to a case. The details of the crime scene were specified clearly. He had to follow these specified instructions to solve the mystery. **一位侦探被指派处理一个案件。犯罪现场的细节被清晰地指明。他必须依照这些指明的指示来解开谜团。**

> In a big movie production, there was a main actor. But another actor came along to play an equally important role. They were like two stars shining together. So, we call this second actor a \'co-star\'. **在一部大型电影制作中，有一个主要演员。但另一个演员出现并扮演了同样重要的角色。他们就像两颗一起闪耀的星星。所以，我们称这个第二个演员为"联合主演"。**

> A young man named Tom was deeply influenced by Islamist ideas. He traveled to many places to spread these beliefs. But later, he realized the importance of peace and changed his mind. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人深受伊斯兰主义者思想的影响。他去了很多地方传播这些信仰。但后来，他意识到和平的重要性并改变了想法。**

> Imagine a big company. It\'s growing fast and needs more people to work. The process of finding and hiring these new people is called staffing. Just like filling empty seats in a theater with the right actors. **想象一家大公司。它发展迅速，需要更多的人来工作。寻找和雇用这些新人的过程就叫做人员配备。就像在剧院里用合适的演员填满空座位一样。**
> 想象你在坐飞机，你买到了 first-class 舱位的票。在这个舱里，你最先享受到最好的服务，有宽敞的座位、美味的食物。First-class 就代表着最好的、一流的。 **想象你坐飞机买了头等舱票，最先享受最好服务，代表最好的、一流的**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to get money. He ran to the ATM, inserted his card, entered the password, and got the cash he needed. The ATM was like a magic box that helped him solve the problem quickly. **有一天，汤姆很着急用钱。他跑到自动取款机前，插入卡，输入密码，取到了他需要的现金。自动取款机就像一个神奇的盒子，迅速帮他解决了问题。**

> A small fire started in the forest. But due to the strong wind and dry weather, it kept escalating. Soon, the whole forest was in danger. The firefighters had to work hard to stop this escalating disaster. **森林里起了一场小火。但由于大风和干燥的天气，火势不断升级。很快，整个森林都陷入了危险。消防员不得不努力阻止这场不断升级的灾难。**

> A young scientist made a discovery that had far-reaching effects. It not only changed people\'s lives in the present but also had a huge impact on future generations. It was like a ripple that spread far and wide. **一位年轻的科学家有了一个发现，产生了深远的影响。它不仅改变了当下人们的生活，还对后代产生了巨大的影响。就像涟漪，远远地扩散开来。**

> A group of rabbits were happily playing in the forest. But as time went by, the number of rabbits was dwindling because of the hungry wolves. Eventually, only a few remained. **一群兔子在森林里快乐地玩耍。但随着时间的推移，兔子的数量在不断减少，因为有饥饿的狼。最终，只剩下几只了。**

> In a big race, there was a person always running at the front. Everyone called him the front-runner. He was leading the way and had a good chance of winning. This person was the front-runner. **在一场大型比赛中，有一个人总是跑在前面。大家都称他为领先者。他一路领先，很有获胜的机会。这个人就是领先者。**
> 想象一下，有一群记者组成了一个联盟（syndicate），他们共同努力收集和分享新闻。这些新闻被整合后，通过各种渠道分发出去，这就是 syndicated 所代表的联合、连锁的意思。 **想象一群记者组成联盟收集分享新闻并分发出去来辅助记忆 syndicated 联合、连锁的意思**

> A Nigerian artist traveled around the world to showcase his unique paintings. People were amazed by his talent and the rich culture of Nigeria he presented. **一位尼日利亚艺术家环游世界展示他独特的画作。人们对他的才华以及他所展现的尼日利亚丰富文化感到惊叹。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment and needed to ensure the specificity of the chemical reaction. Only when all the conditions were precise could the desired outcome be achieved. Specificity was the key to success. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验，需要确保化学反应的特异性。只有当所有条件都精确无误时，才能取得预期的结果。特异性是成功的关键。**

> A tourist was lost in Taiwan. A kind Taiwanese person came to help and showed the tourist around. The tourist was grateful for the friendly Taiwanese guide. **一位游客在台湾迷路了。一位善良的台湾人来帮忙，并带着游客四处参观。游客非常感激这位友好的台湾向导。**

> One day, a little girl named Lily went to a farm. She saw many plants and asked, \'What are these?\' The farmer smiled and said, \'These are veggies, like carrots and cabbages. They are good for your health.\' Lily learned a new word - veggie. **有一天，一个叫莉莉的小女孩去了农场。她看到很多植物并问："这些是什么？" 农夫笑着说："这些是蔬菜，像胡萝卜和卷心菜。它们对你的健康有益。" 莉莉学到了一个新单词 - 蔬菜（veggie）。**
> 想象一幅拼图画面，许多小块拼图相互交叠（overlapping）在一起。就像不同的颜色和图案部分重合，形成了一个复杂但有趣的整体。这就是 overlapping 所描绘的场景。 **想象一幅拼图中许多小块相互交叠的画面，以此来理解 overlapping 这个单词。**

> One hot summer day, I was walking on the street and saw a steaming pot of soup on a vendor\'s cart. The steam was rising vigorously, making the air around it very hot. That\'s how I remember the word \'steaming\' which means giving off steam. **一个炎热的夏日，我走在街上，看到小贩车上有一锅热气腾腾的汤。蒸汽强烈地上升，使得周围的空气非常热。这就是我记住'steaming'这个单词的方式，它的意思是散发蒸汽。**

> Once upon a time, I met a traveler from a faraway land. He told me he was from Argentine, a place known for its beautiful landscapes and passionate tango. I\'ll never forget the word \'Argentine\' since then. **从前，我遇到一位来自遥远地方的旅行者。他告诉我他来自阿根廷，一个以美丽风景和热情探戈而闻名的地方。从那以后，我就再也忘不了'Argentine'这个词了。**

> In a big city, people from various cultures live together. They celebrate different festivals, share unique foods, and respect each other\'s traditions. This harmonious scene is the perfect example of multiculturalism. **在一个大城市里，来自各种文化的人们生活在一起。他们庆祝不同的节日，分享独特的食物，并尊重彼此的传统。这种和谐的场景就是多元文化主义的完美范例。**

> A brave astronaut was training in a simulated space environment. He faced many challenges as if he were really in space. Through this simulated experience, he prepared well for the real mission. **一位勇敢的宇航员在模拟的太空环境中训练。他面临许多挑战，就好像真的在太空一样。通过这种模拟的体验，他为真正的任务做好了充分准备。**

> One day, Tom was sleeping deeply. But suddenly, the alarm clock rang loudly and woke him up. He opened his eyes slowly and realized it was time to start a new day. The sound of the alarm was like a magic call to wake-up. **有一天，汤姆正在沉睡。但突然，闹钟大声响起把他叫醒了。他缓缓睁开眼睛，意识到是时候开始新的一天了。闹钟的声音就像是叫醒他的神奇呼唤。**
> 想象一下，你在参加一场比赛，前两名已经确定。这时，出现了一个神秘的选手，他不属于前两名的队伍，被称为\'third-party\'，也就是第三方。他的出现让比赛充满了新的变数。 **想象你在比赛，前两名已定，出现不属于前两队的神秘选手，称为第三方，他让比赛有新变数。**

> A little monkey was always causing trouble. So, the zoo decided to institutionalize it, meaning they put it in a special place with rules and systems to control its behavior. **一只小猴子总是惹麻烦。所以，动物园决定把它收容安置，意思是把它安置在一个有规则和制度来控制其行为的特殊地方。**
> 想象一下，有一块神奇的海绵，每次放进水里就会变小，这个不断变小的过程就是\'shrinking\'。就像我们的衣服洗了会缩水，也是\'shrinking\'的表现。 **想象一块海绵不断变小的过程来理解\'shrinking\'，意思是收缩、缩小。**

> Once upon a time, there was a friendly Dane named Tom. He loved traveling and sharing his stories. One day, he met a group of people and introduced himself as a Dane. Everyone was impressed by his charm. **从前，有一个友好的丹麦人叫汤姆。他喜欢旅行并分享他的故事。有一天，他遇到一群人，并介绍自己是丹麦人。每个人都对他的魅力印象深刻。**

> One day, I went shopping and saw a beautiful dress. But when I checked the price tag, it was pricey. I had to save money for a long time to buy it. It taught me that pricey things often require more effort to obtain. **有一天，我去购物，看到一条漂亮的裙子。但当我查看价格标签时，它很贵。我不得不攒很长时间的钱才能买它。这让我明白昂贵的东西往往需要更多努力才能得到。**

> A journalist wrote a very critical article, but it was censored by the government. They didn\'t want the public to know the truth. So, \'censored\' means something is examined and parts are removed or suppressed. **一位记者写了一篇非常具有批判性的文章，但被政府审查了。他们不想让公众知道真相。所以，\'censored\'意思是某物被审查，部分内容被删除或压制。**

> In a small town, there was a project. It was community-based, meaning it relied on the efforts and resources of all the people living there. Everyone worked together to make it successful, showing the power of a united community. **在一个小镇上，有一个项目。它是以社区为基础的，这意味着它依靠那里所有居民的努力和资源。每个人都共同努力使其成功，展示了一个团结社区的力量。**

> A detective was investigating a mystery. He found some documents pertaining to the case. They held crucial clues that helped him solve the puzzle. Without those pertaining papers, he would have been lost. **一位侦探正在调查一个谜团。他发现了一些与这个案子有关的文件。它们包含着关键的线索，帮助他解开了谜团。要是没有那些相关的文件，他就会不知所措。**

> A writer spent years working on a novel but it remained unpublished. The reason? It needed more polishing. Finally, after much effort, it got published and became a bestseller. Remember, \'unpublished\' means not made public in print. **一位作家花了数年时间写一部小说，但它一直未出版。原因？它需要更多润色。最终，经过大量努力，它出版了并成为畅销书。记住，\'unpublished\'意思是未出版的。**

> A brave general decided to launch a full-scale attack to defend his kingdom. All soldiers were involved, and the battle was intense. Finally, they won and protected their homeland. \'Full-scale\' here means comprehensive and without any reservations. **一位勇敢的将军决定发动全面的攻击来保卫他的王国。所有士兵都参与其中，战斗激烈。最终，他们获胜并保卫了家园。这里的'full-scale'意思是全面的、毫无保留的。**

> Once upon a time, a poor man lost his home due to a disaster. He wandered the streets, experiencing the hardship of homelessness. No place to sleep, no roof over his head. This is the cruel reality of homelessness. **从前，有一个穷人因灾难失去了家。他在街头流浪，体验着无家可归的艰难。没有睡觉的地方，头上没有屋顶。这就是无家可归的残酷现实。**

> A traveler named Tom went to many countries. He experienced cross-cultural things, like different foods and customs. It was amazing but also confusing. But this made him understand the world better. **一位名叫汤姆的旅行者去了很多国家。他体验到了跨文化的事物，比如不同的食物和习俗。这很奇妙但也令人困惑。但这让他更好地了解了世界。**

> A little mouse had a two-day adventure. It spent the first day finding cheese and the next day playing with friends. The two-day journey was full of fun and surprises. **一只小老鼠有一个为期两天的冒险。它第一天找奶酪，第二天和朋友们玩耍。这两天的旅程充满了乐趣和惊喜。**

> A detective found some new clues and needed to re-examine the crime scene. He went back carefully, looking for overlooked details. This helped him solve the mystery. **一位侦探发现了一些新线索，需要重新检查犯罪现场。他仔细地回去，寻找被忽视的细节。这帮助他解开了谜团。**

> A Croatian artist was painting a beautiful landscape. He used unique colors to show the charm of his country. People were amazed by his work and it made them want to visit Croatia. **一位克罗地亚艺术家正在画一幅美丽的风景。他用独特的色彩展现了他的国家的魅力。人们对他的作品感到惊讶，这让他们想去克罗地亚游玩。**
> 从前有个叫 Anglo 的勇敢探险家，他独自穿越了神秘的森林。他的勇气和智慧让人们记住了他，后来 Anglo 这个名字就代表了勇敢和智慧。 **从前有个叫 Anglo 的勇敢探险家，他独自穿越神秘森林。他的勇气和智慧让人铭记，后来 Anglo 这个名字代表勇敢和智慧。**

> Imagine a baby turtle that takes exactly six months to grow strong enough to venture into the big ocean. This period of six months is very important for its survival. So, \'six-month\' means a period of six months. **想象一只小海龟，它需要整整六个月的时间才能长得足够强壮去探索广阔的海洋。这六个月的时期对它的生存非常重要。所以，\'six-month\'意思是六个月的时期。**

> Imagine a group of people passionately protecting the lives of unborn babies. They firmly believe in the value of every life from conception. This is the essence of being \'pro-life\', always advocating for the preservation of life. **想象有一群人热情地保护未出生婴儿的生命。他们坚信从受孕开始每一个生命的价值。这就是'pro-life'（反对堕胎；主张保护生命）的本质，总是倡导保护生命。**

> A woman was very sad when she thought of her ex-husband. They used to be a couple, but now they are apart. She still remembers the good and bad times they had together. **一位女士想起她的前夫时非常伤心。他们曾经是夫妻，但现在分开了。她仍然记得他们在一起的好时光和坏时光。**

> A little rabbit wanted to reach the carrot field quicker. So it ran as fast as it could. Finally, it got there quicker than usual and enjoyed the delicious carrots. **一只小兔子想要更快地到达胡萝卜地。所以它尽可能快地跑。最后，它比平常更快地到达那里，并享用了美味的胡萝卜。**
> 想象一下，有个神秘的代码世界，ASCII 就是这个世界的密码钥匙。它能将我们熟悉的字符变成独特的数字组合，就像魔法师的咒语，让计算机理解并处理信息。 **想象有个代码世界，ASCII 是其中的密码钥匙，能把字符变成数字组合，让计算机处理信息。**

> One day, I went to a store and saw a beautiful dress priced at seventy-five dollars. I really wanted to buy it, but I had to think twice because it was a bit expensive. Finally, I decided to save up and get it. **有一天，我去了一家商店，看到一件漂亮的裙子标价七十五美元。我真的很想买，但不得不三思，因为有点贵。最后，我决定存钱把它买下来。**
> One day after school, Tom was playing football with his friends. They had a great time. After-school activities like this make their lives fun. **有一天放学后，汤姆和他的朋友们在踢足球。他们玩得很开心。像这样的课后活动让他们的生活充满乐趣。**

> One night, I was walking alone in a dark alley. Suddenly, a figure with a menacing look appeared. His eyes glared and his fists clenched, as if ready to attack me. I was so scared and ran away as fast as I could. **一天晚上，我独自走在一条黑暗的小巷里。突然，一个面露凶相的身影出现了。他眼睛瞪着，拳头紧握，好像准备攻击我。我非常害怕，以最快的速度跑开了。**

> Imagine a superhero who was weakened by a mysterious ray. This ray had a debilitating effect on him, making him lose his strength and unable to fight. \'Debilitating\' means causing someone to become weak and lose strength. **想象一位超级英雄被一道神秘的光线削弱。这道光线对他产生了使人虚弱的影响，使他失去力量无法战斗。\'debilitating\'意思是使人虚弱，使人失去力量。**

> Once upon a time, there was a beautiful dress patterned with flowers. Everyone loved it because the pattern was so unique and charming. It made the dress stand out. **从前，有一件漂亮的连衣裙，上面印着花朵的图案。每个人都喜欢它，因为这个图案非常独特和迷人。它让这件连衣裙脱颖而出。**

> A spy was sent on a mission to steal the targeted documents. He had to be very careful not to be caught. Finally, he succeeded and brought the important information back. **一名间谍被派去执行窃取目标文件的任务。他必须非常小心以免被抓住。最后，他成功了并带回了重要信息。**

> Once upon a time, there was an old castle. Its walls were crumbling due to years of neglect. One day, a brave knight decided to repair it. The crumbling parts were finally fixed and the castle stood strong again. **从前，有一座古老的城堡。由于多年无人照管，它的墙壁正在崩塌。有一天，一位勇敢的骑士决定修缮它。崩塌的部分最终被修复，城堡再次屹立不倒。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person who loved music. He could write beautiful songs. People called him a songwriter. He spent days and nights creating melodies and lyrics. His songs made everyone happy. **从前，有一个热爱音乐的人。他能够创作优美的歌曲。人们称他为歌曲作者。他日夜不停地创作旋律和歌词。他的歌曲让每个人都感到快乐。**

> One day, a sleepy bear was having trouble waking up. It kept yawning and rubbing its eyes. But finally, the bright sunlight and the chirping of birds made it fully awake. Remember, \'waking\' is the process of coming out of sleep! **有一天，一只困倦的熊很难醒来。它不停地打哈欠和揉眼睛。但最后，明亮的阳光和鸟儿的鸣叫让它完全醒了。记住，'waking'就是从睡眠中醒来的过程！**

> One day, I was really hungry. I went to a bakery and saw some beautifully toasted bread. The golden color and the fragrant smell made me buy it immediately. It tasted so good! **有一天，我非常饿。我去了一家面包店，看到了一些烤得很漂亮的吐司面包。那金黄的颜色和香喷喷的气味让我立刻买了它。味道好极了！**

> Once upon a time, a small singer dreamed of performing on the big-time stage. After years of hard work, she finally made it. \'Big-time\' here means of the highest level or importance. **从前，有一个小歌手梦想在顶级舞台上表演。经过多年努力，她终于做到了。'big-time'在这里指的是最高水平或最重要的。**

> A young artist painted a masterpiece and showed it at an exhibition. Everyone praised and welcomed it. The artist was acclaimed for his amazing work. Soon, his name was known everywhere. **一位年轻的艺术家画了一幅杰作，并在展览中展出。每个人都称赞并欢迎它。这位艺术家因其惊人的作品而备受赞誉。很快，他的名字就家喻户晓了。**

> A tightrope walker was expertly balancing on a thin rope. He moved carefully, keeping his body steady. This scene showed the essence of \'balancing\' - maintaining equilibrium and stability. **一个走钢丝的人熟练地在一根细钢丝上保持平衡。他小心翼翼地移动，保持身体稳定。这个场景展示了"balancing"的本质------保持平衡和稳定。**

> Imagine a little kid entering school for the first time. They are so excited and nervous. We call this kid a \'first-year\' student. It means they are in their first year of school. **想象一个小孩子第一次进入学校。他们既兴奋又紧张。我们称这个孩子为'first-year（一年级）'学生。这意味着他们处于上学的第一年。**

> A prince entered a cave filled with jewels. The jewels were glittering so brightly that it almost blinded him. He knew these glittering treasures would bring great wealth and joy to his kingdom. **一位王子走进一个满是珠宝的洞穴。珠宝闪闪发光，亮得几乎让他睁不开眼。他知道这些闪闪发光的财宝会给他的王国带来巨大的财富和欢乐。**

> A factory worker named Tom was very tired. He worked hard to manufacture toys every day. But he knew his efforts made the manufactured toys bring joy to children. **一位名叫汤姆的工厂工人非常疲惫。他每天努力制造玩具。但他知道他的努力让制造出的玩具给孩子们带来了欢乐。**

> A Californian named Tom loved surfing. Every morning, he would ride the waves. His passion for the ocean made him a true representative of the Californian spirit. **一个叫汤姆的加利福尼亚人喜欢冲浪。每天早上，他都会去驾驭海浪。他对海洋的热爱使他成为了加利福尼亚精神的真正代表。**

> Imagine you are visiting a beautiful Georgian house. It has elegant columns and a charming garden. The owner, a friendly Georgian lady, welcomes you with a warm smile. You remember \'Georgian\' as the style of this lovely house and the people from Georgia. **想象一下你正在参观一座漂亮的格鲁吉亚风格的房子。它有优雅的柱子和迷人的花园。房子的主人，一位友好的格鲁吉亚女士，带着温暖的微笑欢迎你。你记住\'Georgian\'就是这种可爱房子的风格以及来自格鲁吉亚的人。**

> Imagine a traveler planning a two-week vacation. He marks the calendar, excited for 14 days of adventure. He packs carefully, knowing he\'ll be away for two full weeks. This helps remember \'two-week\' as a period of 14 days. **想象一位旅行者计划一个为期两周的假期。他在日历上做标记，为 14 天的冒险感到兴奋。他仔细打包，知道自己将离开整整两周。这有助于记住'two-week'表示 14 天的时间段。**

> A famous writer was asked to describe his life. He decided to write an autobiographical book. He shared all his experiences, from childhood to adulthood. This book was truly autobiographical, showing his real life journey. **一位著名的作家被要求描述他的生活。他决定写一本自传。他分享了从童年到成年的所有经历。这本书是真正的自传式的，展现了他真实的人生旅程。**
> 想象一个美丽的花园，起初花朵盛开。但随着时间推移，没人照顾，天气恶劣，花园逐渐变得糟糕。这种逐渐变糟的过程就是'deteriorating'，就像花园的状态在不断恶化。 **想象一个花园逐渐恶化的故事来辅助记忆'deteriorating'，意思是恶化、变坏**

> One day, a man was walking with a heavy head. Suddenly, he heard beautiful music. It was coming from a pair of headphones on a bench. He put them on and felt happy. Headphone - the thing that brings joy to your ears! **有一天，一个男人垂头丧气地走着。突然，他听到了美妙的音乐。声音是从长椅上的一副耳机传来的。他戴上耳机，感到很开心。耳机 - 给你的耳朵带来快乐的东西！**
> 想象一下，在一个黑暗的房间里，有一台神奇的设备，它的屏幕清晰明亮，显示着各种信息。这个屏幕就是 LCD ，它就像一个小精灵，用液体和晶体的魔法为我们带来精彩的画面。 **想象在黑暗房间中，有台设备的清晰明亮屏幕即 LCD ，像有魔法的小精灵用液体和晶体带来精彩画面。**

> In a magical garden, there were two types of flowers. One had bright red petals, and the other had soft blue ones. The colors were contrasting, making the garden look even more beautiful. **在一个神奇的花园里，有两种花。一种有着鲜艳的红色花瓣，另一种有着柔和的蓝色花瓣。颜色形成对比，让花园看起来更加美丽。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He went to a restaurant and saw many people enjoying sushi. The colorful sushi looked so delicious. Tom couldn\'t wait to taste it and fell in love with sushi at first bite. **有一天，汤姆非常饿。他去了一家餐馆，看到很多人在享用寿司。色彩缤纷的寿司看起来如此美味。汤姆迫不及待地尝了一口，一下子就爱上了寿司。**
> 想象一下，有个勇敢的冒险家在波罗的海（Baltic）航行。他看到了美丽的海景，感受到了海风的吹拂。这片海是如此独特，让他难以忘怀。记住这个冒险，也就记住了Baltic这个词。 **想象有个冒险家在波罗的海航行，借此记住Baltic这个单词，表示波罗的海的**

> One day, I visited a farm and saw workers doing composting. They mixed old leaves, food waste, and grass. It was like a magic process that turned these into rich soil. Composting helps the environment! **有一天，我参观了一个农场，看到工人们在做堆肥。他们把旧叶子、食物垃圾和草混合起来。这就像一个神奇的过程，把这些变成了肥沃的土壤。堆肥有助于环境！**

> Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there was a special group of people called Caucasian. They had distinct features and a unique culture. One day, a traveler met them and was amazed by their charm. **从前，在一个遥远的地方，有一个特殊的人群被称为高加索人。他们有独特的特征和独特的文化。有一天，一位旅行者遇到了他们，并对他们的魅力感到惊讶。**

> A traveler was lost. He had a map but couldn\'t figure out where to go geographically. Just when he was about to give up, he found a local who pointed out the right direction. Geographically, he was finally on the right track. **一位旅行者迷路了。他有地图但搞不清地理位置。就在他要放弃时，他遇到一位当地人指出了正确方向。从地理上讲，他终于走上了正轨。**

> A hungry mouse was looking for food in a garden. It found a plant with a special smell - oregano. The mouse loved the smell and decided to remember it. Later, when it told its friends, they all knew what oregano was. **一只饥饿的老鼠在花园里找食物。它发现了一株有特殊气味的植物------牛至。老鼠喜欢这个气味并决定记住它。后来，当它告诉朋友们时，它们都知道了牛至是什么。**
> 想象一个神秘的组织，首领被称为 secretary-general。这位首领掌握着组织的核心秘密，他坐在大大的办公桌后，处理着各种机密事务，就像掌控着组织的密码锁。 **想象一个关于"秘书长；总书记"这个词的故事，描述其掌控机密事务的形象**
> 想象一个小小的机器人，它的工作能力很有限，处于 low-level 状态。它只能做一些简单、基础的任务，就像打扫房间的角落。因为 low-level 就意味着低水平、初级的。 **想象一个能力有限，处于低水平、初级状态的小机器人，来辅助理解 low-level 这个单词，意思是低水平的、初级的**

> A little rabbit was playing in the forest. Suddenly, a big wolf appeared and threatened the rabbit, saying it would eat the rabbit. The rabbit was so scared. But luckily, it found a hole and hid in time. **一只小兔子正在森林里玩耍。突然，一只大狼出现并威胁小兔子，说要吃掉它。小兔子非常害怕。但幸运的是，它找到了一个洞并及时躲了进去。**
> 想象一下，在一个政治集会中，有一群人总是主张更多的社会福利和平等，他们站在左边的区域，被称为 left-wing 。他们就像左翼的飞鸟，追求公平和进步。 **想象在一个政治集会中，有一群总是主张更多社会福利和平等、站在左边区域被称为"左翼"的人。他们像左翼的飞鸟追求公平和进步。**

> One day, I was at a party. A friend asked me to guess a number. I thought hard and finally guessed twenty-six. Everyone was amazed because it was the correct number. I was so happy! **有一天，我在一个派对上。一个朋友让我猜一个数字。我苦思冥想，最后猜了二十六。大家都很惊讶，因为这是正确的数字。我太高兴了！**

> Imagine you are in a fantasy land. But one day, you decide to leave and enter the real-world. There, you face real jobs, real traffic, and real problems. That\'s what real-world means - the actual, practical world we live in. **想象一下你在一个幻想之地。但有一天，你决定离开并进入现实世界。在那里，你面临着真正的工作、真实的交通和实际的问题。这就是"real-world"的意思------我们生活的真实、实际的世界。**

> A small mouse decided to start a small-scale bakery. It made only a few cakes each day. But with its passion, the small-scale business grew. Soon, everyone in the town loved its cakes. **一只小老鼠决定开一家小规模的面包店。它每天只做几个蛋糕。但凭借热情，这个小规模的生意发展起来了。很快，镇上的每个人都喜欢上了它的蛋糕。**

> One day, a man was lost in a dangerous forest. Just when he thought all was lost, he miraculously found a way out. It was like a miracle had happened and saved him. **有一天，一个男人在危险的森林里迷路了。就在他觉得毫无希望的时候，他奇迹般地找到了出路。就好像奇迹发生救了他。**

> In a small town, schools were segregated. One day, a brave girl stood up and said it was unfair. People began to think and finally changed it. Segregated means separated based on race or other factors. **在一个小镇上，学校是隔离的。有一天，一个勇敢的女孩站出来说这不公平。人们开始思考，最终改变了这一状况。segregated 意思是基于种族或其他因素被隔离分开。**

> One day, Tom was dividing apples into equal parts. He cut them into thirds. But his friends still argued about the fairness. Finally, Tom found a better way to share and everyone was happy. **一天，汤姆在把苹果等分。他把它们切成了三等份。但他的朋友们仍在争论分配是否公平。最后，汤姆找到了更好的分享方式，大家都开心了。**

> A painter always preferred a low-key style. He didn\'t use bright colors but soft tones. People loved his quiet and understated art. It made them feel calm. Remember, \'low-key\' means quiet and not attracting much attention. **一位画家总是喜欢低调的风格。他不使用鲜艳的色彩，而是柔和的色调。人们喜欢他安静而低调的艺术。这让他们感到平静。记住，\'low-key\'意思是安静的，不引人注目的。**

> One day, Tom was in a big shopping mall and suddenly needed to go. He asked a staff member where he could find a place to relieve himself. The staff pointed him to the restroom. Tom was so relieved to know where to go. **有一天，汤姆在一个大型购物中心，突然内急。他问一名工作人员哪里可以方便。工作人员给他指了去洗手间的方向。汤姆知道去哪儿后，松了一口气。**

> One day, I was walking on the street feeling lost and alone. Suddenly, an iPod in a store window caught my eye. Its sleek design and promise of wonderful music made me smile. With the iPod, my mood lifted and I found my way back to happiness. **有一天，我走在街上感到迷茫和孤独。突然，商店橱窗里的一个 iPod 吸引了我的目光。它时尚的设计和美妙音乐的承诺让我微笑。有了 iPod，我的心情变好，找到了回归快乐的路。**

> One day, Tom fell off his bike and got bruised all over. His skin was purple and painful. But he was brave and didn\'t cry. Remember, \'bruised\' means injured and marked by a bruise. **有一天，汤姆从自行车上摔下来，浑身淤青。他的皮肤发紫且疼痛。但他很勇敢，没有哭。记住，\'bruised\'意思是受伤的、有淤青的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical plant that was the fastest-growing one in the forest. It grew so fast that everyone was amazed. It showed how powerful and special \'fastest-growing\' can be. **从前，在森林里有一株神奇的植物，它是生长最快的。它长得如此之快，让所有人都感到惊讶。这展示了'fastest-growing'（最快生长的）的强大和特别。**

> A Chilean artist was painting a beautiful landscape. He used bright colors to show the unique charm of his country. People were amazed by his work and praised his talent as a true Chilean master. **一位智利艺术家正在画一幅美丽的风景画。他用明亮的色彩展现了他的国家的独特魅力。人们对他的作品感到惊讶，并称赞他是一位真正的智利大师。**

> Once upon a time, there was a child named Lily. She showed great giftedness in music. She could play the piano beautifully at a young age. Her giftedness made her stand out. **从前，有个叫莉莉的孩子。她在音乐方面展现出了极大的天赋。她很小就能优美地弹钢琴。她的天赋让她脱颖而出。**

> A little preschooler named Lily was excited to go to her preschool every day. She played with toys, learned new songs, and made friends. Lily loved being a preschooler and having so much fun. **一个叫莉莉的学龄前儿童每天都很兴奋地去她的学前班。她玩玩具，学新歌，还交了朋友。莉莉喜欢当学龄前儿童，过得非常开心。**

> A politician was known for his hard-line stance. He never compromised, even when everyone else suggested a more flexible approach. It was like he was a stubborn rock, unmovable. This showed how \'hard-line\' means being strict and unyielding. **一位政客以其强硬立场而闻名。他从不妥协，即使其他人都建议采取更灵活的方法。就像他是一块顽固的石头，不可动摇。这展示了'hard-line'意思是强硬的、不妥协的。**

> A doctor was working clinically, carefully observing patients and making precise diagnoses. He always followed clinical procedures to ensure the best treatment. One day, he saved a critical patient through his clinically excellent skills. **一位医生在临床上工作，仔细观察病人并做出精确的诊断。他总是遵循临床程序以确保最佳的治疗。有一天，他凭借出色的临床技能挽救了一位危重病人。**

> One day, a little girl was playing with her toys. When it was time to go to bed, her mother said, \'Bye-bye, my dear. Have a sweet dream.\' The little girl knew it meant goodbye and happily replied, \'Bye-bye, Mommy.\', **一天，一个小女孩正在玩她的玩具。到了睡觉时间，她妈妈说："再见，亲爱的。做个甜甜的梦。"小女孩知道这意味着再见，开心地回答："再见，妈妈。"**

> Imagine a kingdom where the king and his wise advisors are gathered in a room. They are deeply engaged in discussions and decisions to create new rules for the land. This process is called policy-making. **想象一个王国，国王和他睿智的顾问们聚集在一个房间里。他们深入地讨论和决定为这片土地制定新的规则。这个过程就叫做政策制定。**

> Once upon a time, there was a weak little rabbit in the forest. Some big bad animals were constantly pushing and hitting it, which was called bullying. The little rabbit was very sad and scared. We should stop such bad behavior. **从前，森林里有一只弱小的小兔子。一些大坏动物不停地推搡和击打它，这就叫做霸凌。小兔子非常伤心和害怕。我们应该制止这种不良行为。**

> A mother was gently breast-feeding her baby. The baby was calm and content, drinking the nutritious milk. This scene showed the beauty and importance of breast-feeding for a baby\'s growth. **一位母亲正在轻轻地给她的宝宝喂奶。宝宝安静满足，喝着营养丰富的乳汁。这个场景展现了母乳喂养对于宝宝成长的美好和重要性。**

> A thief was running away. The police shouted, \'We wanted you to stop!\' It means someone desires or seeks a person. Here, the police desired to catch the thief. **一个小偷正在逃跑。警察喊道：'我们要你停下！'这个单词意思是某人想要或寻求某人。在这里，警察想要抓住小偷。**

> In a baseball game, the RBI is very important. The player who hits the ball and enables runners to score is the hero. RBI stands for Runs Batted In, meaning the number of runs a batter helps score. **在一场棒球比赛中，RBI 非常重要。击球并使跑垒员得分的球员就是英雄。RBI 代表击球得分，意思是击球手帮助得分的次数。**

> A little bird was flying in the sky. It was unprotected and had no shelter from the strong wind. Poor bird! It needed a safe place. Remember, \'unprotected\' means not having protection. **一只小鸟在天空中飞翔。它没有受到保护，也没有躲避强风的遮蔽处。可怜的小鸟！它需要一个安全的地方。记住，\'unprotected\'意思是未受保护的。**

> A businessman was in a tough situation. But he remained calm and negotiated skillfully with his partners. Finally, they reached a mutually beneficial agreement. **一位商人处境艰难。但他保持冷静，熟练地与合作伙伴进行谈判。最终，他们达成了一个互利的协议。**

> One night, I was walking in the forest. Suddenly, a figure appeared mysteriously. I couldn\'t see its face clearly. It vanished as quickly as it came, leaving me full of wonder and confusion. **一天晚上，我在森林里散步。突然，一个身影神秘地出现了。我看不清它的脸。它来得快去得也快，让我充满了惊奇和困惑。**
> One day, Tom left his house but forgot his keys. So he had to re-enter the house to get them. Re-enter means to enter again. **一天，汤姆离开了家但忘了带钥匙。所以他不得不再次进入房子去拿。re-enter 意思是再次进入。**

> One day, an Alaskan adventurer was lost in the snowy mountains. But with his strong will and knowledge of the land, he finally found his way home. The Alaskan landscape is both beautiful and challenging. **有一天，一位阿拉斯加的冒险家在雪山中迷路了。但凭借坚强的意志和对这片土地的了解，他最终找到了回家的路。阿拉斯加的风景既美丽又充满挑战。**

> A bird was trapped in a cage. One day, a kind girl opened the cage, setting the bird free. This act was liberating. The bird flew happily in the sky, feeling the joy of liberation. **一只鸟被困在笼子里。有一天，一个善良的女孩打开了笼子，让鸟获得了自由。这个行为是解放性的。鸟在天空中快乐地飞翔，感受着解放的喜悦。**

> One day, I met a friendly Tibetan guy. He wore beautiful traditional clothes and showed me around his hometown. I learned a lot about the unique Tibetan culture. Remember, \'Tibetan\' refers to people or things related to Tibet. **有一天，我遇到了一个友好的藏族人。他穿着漂亮的传统服饰，并带我参观了他的家乡。我了解了很多独特的藏族文化。记住，\'Tibetan\'指的是与西藏有关的人或事物。**

> A detective was meticulously searching for clues at the crime scene. He checked every corner, every object, not missing a single detail. Just like this detective, \'meticulously\' means to do something very carefully and with great attention to detail. **一位侦探在犯罪现场一丝不苟地寻找线索。他检查了每一个角落，每一个物品，不放过任何一个细节。就像这位侦探一样，\'meticulously\'意思是非常仔细、极其注重细节地做某事。**

> One day, a foreigner was visiting a small town in the South. Everyone kept saying \'Y\'all\' to him. He was confused at first but later learned that it means \'You all\' and is a friendly way to address a group. **有一天，一个外国人在南方的一个小镇游玩。每个人都对他说'Y\'all'。一开始他很困惑，但后来他了解到这意思是'你们大家'，是一种友好的称呼一群人的方式。**

> I taped a precious photo on the wall. It was a picture of my family having a picnic. The tape held the memory firmly. One day, the tape lost its stickiness, but the photo remained in my heart. **我把一张珍贵的照片用胶带贴在墙上。那是一张我们全家野餐的照片。胶带牢牢地固定住了这份回忆。有一天，胶带失去了粘性，但照片仍留在我心中。**

> A detective was investigating a mysterious case. In a dimly lit room, he noticed the culprit shuffling papers nervously, trying to hide evidence. The detective knew something was wrong by the culprit\'s shuffling movement. **一位侦探正在调查一起神秘案件。在一个灯光昏暗的房间里，他注意到罪犯紧张地来回摆弄文件，试图隐藏证据。侦探从罪犯来回摆弄的动作中知道有问题。**

> A company was contracting with many small suppliers. But the process was full of difficulties. Finally, they found a better way to manage the contracting and made a big success. **一家公司正在与许多小供应商签订合同。但这个过程充满了困难。最后，他们找到了管理合同签订的更好方法，并取得了巨大成功。**

> A person named Tom was looking for a job. He went to many companies for interviews. But all were just temporary positions. He hoped to find a stable one soon. **一个叫汤姆的人正在找工作。他去了很多公司面试。但都是临时职位。他希望很快能找到一个稳定的工作。**

> A Venetian artist was famous for his beautiful paintings. One day, he lost his brush in a canal. But with his determination, he found a unique way to create art and became even more renowned. Venetian means relating to Venice or its people. **一位威尼斯的艺术家以其美丽的画作而闻名。有一天，他把画笔掉进了运河。但凭借决心，他找到了独特的创作方式，变得更加出名。Venetian 意思是与威尼斯或其人民有关的。**

> One day, a knight was lost in a forest. Suddenly, he saw a bright light on his right-hand side. He followed it and found the way out. The right-hand side was his savior. **一天，一位骑士在森林里迷路了。突然，他看到右手边有一道亮光。他跟着它，找到了出路。右手边成了他的救星。**

> A chef processed many vegetables to make a delicious salad. He washed, cut, and mixed them carefully. The processed vegetables became the key to the wonderful taste. **一位厨师处理了许多蔬菜来制作一份美味的沙拉。他仔细地清洗、切割和混合它们。被处理过的蔬菜成为了美妙味道的关键。**

> A man was pumping water from a well. He was sweating but kept pumping hard because the water was needed for his thirsty plants. Finally, the bucket was full. The act of pumping water was tiring but rewarding. **一个男人正在从井里抽水。他汗流浃背，但仍努力抽水，因为他干渴的植物需要水。最后，水桶满了。抽水的行为很累但很值得。**

> A prisoner was held in a dark cell. One day, he heard a guard shout \'POW!\' which meant he had a chance to escape. With great courage, he seized the opportunity and broke free. **一名囚犯被关在黑暗的牢房里。有一天，他听到一名守卫大喊\'POW!\'，这意味着他有逃跑的机会。他鼓足勇气，抓住了这个机会并成功逃脱。**

> In a fierce battle, the brave soldiers were constantly defending their territory. They stood firm, facing the enemy\'s attacks without fear. The act of defending was their mission and responsibility. **在一场激烈的战斗中，勇敢的士兵们一直在保卫他们的领土。他们坚定不移，无惧敌人的攻击。保卫这个行为就是他们的使命和责任。**

> A group of people were oppressed by a cruel king. They had to work long hours with little food. But they never gave up fighting for their freedom. > One day, Tom lost his pen. But then, Mary found a pen and wasn\'t sure if it was his or her pen. So, she asked around to find the owner. **一天，汤姆丢了他的笔。但是随后，玛丽发现了一支笔，不确定这是他的笔还是她的笔。于是，她四处询问以找到笔的主人。**

> Imagine a big kingdom. The king decides that some important resources like precious jewels and vast lands should belong to the state. So, these resources become state-owned. > One day, I was counting my marbles. I had twenty-eight in total. They were all different colors. It was easy to remember the number twenty-eight because of those lovely marbles. **有一天，我在数我的弹珠。我总共有 28 个。它们都是不同的颜色。因为那些可爱的弹珠，记住 28 这个数字就很容易。**

> 想象一下，在阿尔巴尼亚的一个小镇上，有个叫小明的孩子。他热爱自己的国家，总是自豪地说：\'I am Albanian.\' （我是阿尔巴尼亚人） 这让大家都记住了\'Albanian\'这个词代表阿尔巴尼亚人。 **想象在阿尔巴尼亚的小镇，小明自豪称自己是阿尔巴尼亚人，帮助记住\'Albanian\'代表阿尔巴尼亚人。**

> A nuclear power plant was on the verge of meltdown. Workers were in a panic. But at the last moment, they managed to cool the reactors and prevent a disaster. \'Meltdown\' here means a disastrous breakdown or failure. **一座核电站濒临熔毁。工人们惊慌失措。但在最后一刻，他们成功冷却了反应堆，避免了一场灾难。这里的\'meltdown\'意思是灾难性的崩溃或故障。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler who met a friendly person. > One day, Tom spent the whole day playing video games and doing nothing productive. At the end of the day, he realized his time was wasted. He felt very regretful. **有一天，汤姆一整天都在玩电子游戏，没有做任何有成效的事。在一天结束时，他意识到自己的时间被浪费了。他感到非常后悔。**

> A little girl was weaving a beautiful scarf for her mother. She carefully chose the colors and threads, moving her hands skillfully. Her love was woven into every stitch. **一个小女孩正在为她的妈妈织一条漂亮的围巾。她仔细地挑选颜色和线，熟练地移动着双手。她的爱被织进了每一针里。**

> Once upon a time, in a big company, there was a high-ranking official. Everyone respected him. He had a lot of power and made important decisions. > A detective was looking for particulars about a mysterious case. Every small detail was like a piece of the puzzle. Finally, with all the particulars gathered, the case was solved. **一位侦探正在寻找一个神秘案件的细节。每一个小的细节都像是拼图的一块。最后，随着所有细节的收集，案件得以侦破。**

> I was standing by the window when it suddenly started pouring. The rain was like a waterfall, pouring down non-stop. I had to quickly close the window to keep the water out. **我正站在窗边，突然就下起了倾盆大雨。雨水像瀑布一样不停地倾泻而下。我不得不赶紧关上窗户以防雨水进来。**

> A group of smart scientists engineered a new robot. They used their knowledge and skills to design and build it perfectly. The engineered robot could do many difficult tasks and helped people a lot. **一群聪明的科学家设计制造了一个新机器人。他们运用自己的知识和技能将其完美地设计并制造出来。这个被设计制造出来的机器人能够完成许多困难的任务，并给人们提供了很多帮助。**

> A thief concealed precious jewels in a secret compartment. But the police were smart and found them. \'Concealed\' means hidden or kept secret, just like the jewels the thief tried to hide. **一个小偷把珍贵的珠宝藏在一个秘密的隔间里。但是警察很聪明，找到了它们。'concealed'意思是隐藏或保密，就像小偷试图藏起来的珠宝那样。**

> 想象一场激烈的跑步比赛，小明拼尽全力冲刺，最终获得了第二名。大家都称呼他为 runner-up。这就像在众多选手中，虽然不是冠军，但也是非常出色的亚军。 **想象一场跑步比赛中小明获得亚军的情景来辅助记忆 runner-up 这个表示亚军、第二名的单词**

> One day, Tom was waiting for his friend at the station. But his friend missed the train and Tom missed meeting him. Tom was very sad. **一天，汤姆在车站等他的朋友。但他的朋友错过了火车，汤姆也错过了和他见面。汤姆非常伤心。**

> A little ant was trying to cross a long and narrow bridge. The bridge was elongated and seemed endless. But the ant was determined and finally made it to the other side. **一只小蚂蚁试图穿过一座又长又窄的桥。这座桥是拉长的，看起来没有尽头。但蚂蚁下定决心，最终到达了另一边。**

> A group of travelers were on a boat. Suddenly, a storm hit and the boat broke. They were left stranded on a deserted island, waiting for rescue. Poor them! **一群旅行者在船上。突然，一场风暴袭来，船坏了。他们被困在一个荒岛上，等待救援。真可怜！**

> A chef was cooking a delicious meal. He needed scallions to add flavor. But he couldn\'t find them. So, he rushed to the market and finally got the scallions. With them, the dish was perfect! **一位厨师正在烹饪一道美味的菜肴。他需要葱来增添风味。但他找不到葱。于是，他急忙跑到市场，终于买到了葱。有了它们，这道菜变得完美了！**

> A group of soldiers were marching towards the battlefield. They moved in unison, their steps firm and determined. The sound of their marching feet was like a powerful drumbeat. **一群士兵正在朝着战场行进。他们步伐一致，脚步坚定。他们行进的脚步声就像有力的鼓点。**

> One day, a little artist was painting. He used colors and shapes creatively. Instead of following the rules, he made a unique and wonderful picture. That\'s how he showed his creatively. **有一天，一位小艺术家在画画。他创造性地使用颜色和形状。不遵循常规，他创作了一幅独特而精彩的画。这就是他展现创造性的方式。**
