> One hot summer day, I was running in the park. After a while, I was sweating a lot. My clothes were all wet. It made me realize that \'sweating\' means the liquid coming out from our body when we are hot or doing hard exercise. **在一个炎热的夏日，我在公园里跑步。过了一会儿，我出了很多汗。我的衣服都湿透了。这让我明白了'sweating'这个单词指的是当我们热或者进行剧烈运动时从身体里流出的液体。**

> Once upon a time, there was a big turtle. It was slow-moving. Every step it took was very slow. When other animals ran fast, it could only crawl slowly. So, we use \'slow-moving\' to describe something or someone that moves very slowly. **从前，有一只大乌龟。它行动迟缓。它走的每一步都非常慢。当其他动物跑得很快时，它只能缓慢地爬行。所以，我们用'slow-moving'来形容某物或某人移动得非常慢。**

> A hungry traveler was lost in a desert. Just when he felt hopeless, he found a pita bread. It was like a miracle that gave him the strength to keep going. **一位饥饿的旅行者在沙漠中迷路了。就在他感到绝望时，他发现了一块皮塔饼。这就像一个奇迹，给了他继续前行的力量。**

> A small village was constantly ignored and pushed to the margins. Its people faced marginalization, with no access to resources or opportunities. They felt left out and unimportant, just like the meaning of\'marginalization\'. **一个小村庄一直被忽视，被推到边缘。村里的人面临着边缘化，无法获得资源和机会。他们感到被遗忘和不重要，这就像"marginalization"这个词的意思。**

> A little girl was lost. The kind police did a door-to-door search and finally found her at the last house. They went from one door to another to make sure she was safe. **一个小女孩走丢了。善良的警察进行了挨家挨户的搜寻，最终在最后一户人家找到了她。他们一家门一家门地找，以确保她的安全。**

> One day, a psychologist was analyzing dreams using Freudian theories. A patient had a strange dream about a big snake. The psychologist explained it based on Freudian concepts of hidden desires and subconscious thoughts. **有一天，一位心理学家正在使用弗洛伊德的理论分析梦境。一位病人做了一个关于一条大蛇的奇怪的梦。心理学家根据弗洛伊德关于隐藏的欲望和潜意识思想的概念来解释它。**

> In ancient Greece, a young athlete trained hard to become an Olympian. He faced many challenges but never gave up. Finally, he won the gold medal at the Olympics and was regarded as a hero. The word \'Olympian\' represents those great athletes. **在古希腊，一位年轻的运动员努力训练想成为一名奥林匹亚人。他面临诸多挑战但从未放弃。最终，他在奥运会上赢得金牌，被视为英雄。"Olympian"这个词代表那些伟大的运动员。**

> A witch was brewing a magic potion in her cauldron. The potion was bubbling vigorously, making small bubbles that popped and released strange smells. The bubbling sound was both mysterious and exciting. **一位女巫正在她的大锅里熬制魔法药水。药水剧烈地冒着泡，产生小小的泡泡，爆开并释放出奇怪的气味。冒泡的声音既神秘又令人兴奋。**

> A young artist entered a competition but was dismayed when his masterpiece wasn\'t chosen. He felt very disappointed and sad. But he didn\'t give up and continued to create. Disappointed and sad is what \'dismayed\' means. **一位年轻的艺术家参加了一场比赛，但当他的杰作未被选中时，他感到很沮丧。他非常失望和难过。但他没有放弃，继续创作。失望和难过就是\'dismayed\'的意思。**

> A blacksmith was working hard in his forge. He heated the metal and forged a beautiful sword. The process was tough, but the final product was amazing. Remember, \'forged\' means made by shaping metal under heat and pressure. **一位铁匠在他的锻造坊努力工作。他加热金属并锻造出了一把漂亮的剑。这个过程很艰难，但最终的成品令人惊叹。记住，\'forged\'意思是通过加热和加压来塑造金属。**

> One day, Tom went to the supermarket and saw a man buying a six-pack of cola. He wondered why not just buy one or two. Then he realized a six-pack was a convenient choice for parties. **一天，汤姆去超市看到一个人买了六罐装的可乐。他好奇为什么不就买一两罐。然后他意识到六罐装对于聚会来说是个方便的选择。**

> Imagine a cheetah running in the wild. It\'s so fast that it seems like a blur. This cheetah represents \'fast-moving\', meaning moving quickly. Just like the cheetah, things that are fast-moving go at a high speed. **想象一只在野外奔跑的猎豹。它速度极快，看起来像一道模糊的影子。这只猎豹就代表着\'fast-moving\'，意思是快速移动。就像这只猎豹一样，快速移动的事物速度很快。**
> 想象一下，有个老旧的沙发，坐的人太多太久，它的坐垫开始 sagging（下陷、下垂）。就像疲惫不堪的人，再也支撑不住，无力地垮了下去。 **想象老旧沙发坐垫因使用过度而下陷的情景来辅助记忆单词 sagging 表示下陷、下垂的意思**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl who always heard strange noises from the next-door house. She was curious and wanted to know what was going on. Finally, she found it was just a friendly cat playing. \'Next-door\' means the place or person adjacent to you. **从前，有个小女孩总是听到隔壁房子传来奇怪的声音。她很好奇，想知道怎么回事。最后，她发现只是一只友好的猫在玩耍。"next-door"意思是隔壁的（地方或人）。**

> One day, I received a surprise gift from my best friend. I was thrilled! It was a book I had wanted for a long time. The feeling of excitement and joy made me feel like I was on top of the world. **有一天，我收到了最好朋友送的一份惊喜礼物。我非常激动！那是一本我渴望已久的书。这种兴奋和喜悦的感觉让我觉得自己仿佛置身世界之巅。**

> Once upon a time, there was a traveler named Frank. He was passionate about helping others and following simple ways of life. People called him a Franciscan because of his kind and humble nature. **从前，有个叫弗兰克的旅行者。他热衷于帮助他人，遵循简单的生活方式。由于他善良谦逊的天性，人们称他为方济各会士。**

> A young artist set a self-imposed goal to create a masterpiece in one month. She pushed herself hard because this was a task she chose and imposed on herself. It was a challenging but rewarding journey. **一位年轻的艺术家给自己设定了一个在一个月内创作出一幅杰作的目标。她努力推动自己，因为这是她自己选择并强加给自己的任务。这是一段充满挑战但有收获的旅程。**

> Once upon a time, a prince lived in an upper-class castle. He had everything luxurious. But he was lonely. Then he met a commoner and learned true friendship. \'Upper-class\' means belonging to the highest social class with great wealth and privilege. **从前，有一位王子住在一个上层阶级的城堡里。他拥有一切奢华的东西。但他很孤独。然后他遇到了一个平民，并学到了真正的友谊。\'upper-class\'意思是属于具有大量财富和特权的最高社会阶层。**

> One day, Tom was drawing. He used a special pen to create lines on the paper. The paper was completely lined with beautiful patterns. It made him very happy. **一天，汤姆在画画。他用一支特殊的笔在纸上画线条。这张纸完全布满了美丽的图案线条。这让他非常高兴。**
> One day, I was counting my steps. I walked exactly forty-three steps and found a hidden treasure chest. It was an amazing surprise! **有一天，我在数自己走的步数。我恰好走了四十三步，然后发现了一个隐藏的宝箱。这真是个惊人的惊喜！**

> In a small town, a group of angry people started rioting after a controversial decision. They were shouting and destroying things in the streets. The police had to come to stop the chaos. **在一个小镇上，一群愤怒的人在一个有争议的决定后开始闹事。他们在街上大喊大叫并破坏东西。警察不得不前来制止这场混乱。**

> A small village was in chaos. But with the institutionalization of rules and systems, order was restored. Schools, hospitals, and markets were properly organized. Now, the village thrived and everyone lived happily. **一个小村庄曾处于混乱之中。但随着规则和制度的制度化，秩序得以恢复。学校、医院和市场都被妥善组织起来。现在，村庄繁荣起来，每个人都幸福地生活着。**
> 想象一下，在一个古老的小镇，人们总是谈论过去。但有一天，一个勇敢的年轻人带来了新的想法和技术，大家称他为 latter-day 的英雄。因为他带来了现代的、当下的希望，改变了小镇。 **想象在古老小镇中，一个带来新希望的年轻人被称为现代的、当下的英雄，以此记住 latter-day 意为现代的、当下的。**

> A brave explorer was in a cave. Suddenly, the ceiling started collapsing. Stones and dirt fell all around. The explorer had to run fast to escape. \'Collapsing\' means falling down or breaking apart suddenly. **一位勇敢的探险家在洞穴里。突然，洞顶开始坍塌。石头和泥土四处掉落。探险家不得不快速逃跑。'collapsing'意思是突然倒下或破裂。**

> A powerful superhero named Enforcer always appears when justice is needed. He strictly enforces the law and punishes the villains. With his super strength, no one dares to break the rules in his presence. **一位强大的超级英雄名叫执法者，每当正义需要时他总会出现。他严格执行法律并惩罚坏人。凭借他的超强力量，在他面前无人敢违反规则。**

> One day, the actors were on stage but suddenly the script was lost. So, they had to improvise their performance. They made up the lines and actions as they went along and gave an amazing show. **有一天，演员们在舞台上但突然剧本丢了。所以，他们不得不即兴表演。他们边演边编台词和动作，并带来了一场精彩的演出。**

> A young man always dreamed of becoming a priest. One day, he was ordained and officially received the authority to conduct religious ceremonies. From then on, he devoted himself to serving the community and spreading love and hope. **一个年轻人一直梦想成为牧师。有一天，他被任命神职，正式获得了主持宗教仪式的权力。从此，他致力于服务社区，传播爱与希望。**
> 想象一场盛大的晚会，原本的主持人突然生病，这时来了一位新伙伴与他共同主持，这位新伙伴就是 co-host。他们配合默契，让晚会顺利进行。 **想象一场晚会中原本主持人病了，新加入共同主持的伙伴就是\'联合主持人\'。**

> In the mid-century, a time traveler found a hidden treasure chest. It was exactly at the middle point of that century. This adventure made the term \'mid-century\' unforgettable for him. **在世纪中叶，一位时间旅行者发现了一个隐藏的宝箱。就在那个世纪的中间点。这次冒险让他永远记住了'mid-century（世纪中叶）'这个词。**

> A car broke down on the road, causing a long tailback. All the vehicles behind had to wait patiently. The tailback grew longer and longer, like a snake. **一辆车在路上抛锚了，导致了长长的交通堵塞。后面所有的车辆都只能耐心等待。堵塞的队伍越来越长，就像一条蛇。**

> A brave soldier was actively campaigning in the war. He went from village to village, encouraging people to join the fight for justice. His passionate campaigning made a big difference. **一位勇敢的士兵在战争中积极地活动。他从一个村庄到另一个村庄，鼓励人们加入为正义而战的行列。他充满激情的活动产生了很大的影响。**

> A thief was caught withholding the stolen jewels. The police were determined to get the jewels back. Withholding something illegally will lead to trouble. Remember, don\'t be like that thief! **一个小偷被抓到藏匿偷来的珠宝。警察决心要拿回珠宝。非法藏匿东西会带来麻烦。记住，别像那个小偷！**

> Once upon a time, there was a ten-year-old boy. He was very smart and brave. One day, he found a lost puppy and helped it find its home. Everyone praised him for his kindness. The ten-year-old boy was happy. **从前，有一个十岁的男孩。他非常聪明勇敢。有一天，他发现了一只走失的小狗，并帮助它找到了家。每个人都称赞他的善良。这个十岁的男孩很开心。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. All clues pointed to something drug-related. He found mysterious powders and strange phone calls. Finally, he cracked the case and caught the drug-related criminals. **一位侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。所有线索都指向与毒品有关的事。他发现了神秘的粉末和奇怪的电话。最终，他破了案并抓住了与毒品有关的罪犯。**

> Imagine a family. The parents are the first ones to come to a new country. Their children are called first-generation. They face many challenges but also bring new hopes. **想象一个家庭。父母是第一批来到一个新国家的人。他们的孩子被称为第一代。他们面临许多挑战，但也带来新的希望。**

> One day, a brave boy saw the snow outside. He was eager to have fun and took his snowboard. He slid down the slope quickly and happily. The snowboard became his best friend in the snowy world. **有一天，一个勇敢的男孩看到外面的雪。他渴望玩耍，于是拿起了他的滑雪板。他快速而快乐地沿着斜坡滑下。在这个雪的世界里，滑雪板成了他最好的朋友。**

> A soldier was on a mission in a desert. The heat was intense, but his khakis kept him somewhat comfortable. The color of the khakis blended well with the sandy landscape, helping him stay hidden. **一名士兵在沙漠执行任务。天气酷热，但他的卡其裤让他稍微舒服些。卡其裤的颜色与沙地景观融合得很好，帮助他隐藏起来。**

> Once upon a time, there was a kind old man. He had white hair, which made him look very wise. Everyone in the village loved him and called him the white-haired grandpa. His white-haired appearance was a sign of his many years of experience. **从前，有一个善良的老人。他有一头白发，这使他看起来非常睿智。村里的每个人都喜欢他，并称呼他为白发爷爷。他的白发外表是他多年阅历的标志。**

> An Irishman was lost in a big city. He had a thick accent and a shamrock charm. People were curious about him. But with his wit and charm, he made many friends and found his way. **一个爱尔兰人在大城市里迷路了。他有着浓重的口音和一个三叶草护身符。人们对他很好奇。但凭借他的机智和魅力，他交了很多朋友并找到了路。**

> A brave general was chosen as the commander-in-chief. In a crucial battle, he led the troops with wisdom and courage, making decisive decisions that led to victory. His leadership was the key to success. **一位勇敢的将军被选为总司令。在一场关键的战斗中，他凭借智慧和勇气领导部队，做出果断决定并取得胜利。他的领导是成功的关键。**

> A scientist conducted an experiment and got the result in the first test. But to ensure accuracy, he did the test-retest. Finally, he was confident with the reliable data. **一位科学家进行了一项实验，并在第一次测试中得到了结果。但为了确保准确性，他进行了重测。最后，他对可靠的数据充满信心。**

> There was a small village where everyone knew each other well. Families were close-knit, always helping and sharing. It was like a big warm hug. One day, a stranger came and was amazed by this close connection. **有一个小村庄，那里的每个人都彼此熟悉。家庭关系紧密，总是互相帮助和分享。就像一个大大的温暖怀抱。一天，一个陌生人来了，对这种紧密的联系感到惊讶。**

> There was a race. A car with a red-hot engine zoomed past. It was so fast and powerful, like a burning flame. Everyone was amazed by its red-hot performance. **有一场比赛。一辆发动机炽热的汽车疾驰而过。它速度极快且动力强大，就像燃烧的火焰。每个人都对它炽热的表现感到惊讶。**

> In a magical forest, there was a special tree whose fruit was prohibited to be picked. A curious fairy tried to do it but was stopped by a wise owl. \'Prohibited\' means not allowed, just like picking those fruits. **在一个神奇的森林里，有一棵特别的树，它的果实被禁止采摘。一个好奇的仙女试图去摘，但被一只聪明的猫头鹰阻止了。'prohibited'意思是不被允许，就像不能摘那些果实一样。**

> One night, I was walking on the street. Suddenly, a car passed by very fast. It was a drive-by. The people in the car shouted something and disappeared. I was shocked. Later I knew it meant a quick and passing action. **一天晚上，我正在街上走。突然，一辆车飞速驶过。这就是'drive-by'。车里的人喊了些什么然后就消失了。我很震惊。后来我知道它指的是快速且短暂路过的行为。**

> One hot summer day, I was in a small room with no fan. The temperature kept rising and everything felt overheated. My face turned red and I was sweating a lot. Finally, I had to rush out to find some cool air. **在一个炎热的夏日，我在一个没有风扇的小房间里。温度持续上升，一切都感觉过热了。我的脸变红了，流了很多汗。最后，我不得不冲出去找些凉快的空气。**

> One day, I decided to bake a cake. I opened the cupboard and found the bag of flour. I carefully poured it onto the counter and it became a floured surface. Now I could start making my delicious cake! **有一天，我决定烤一个蛋糕。我打开橱柜，找到了那袋面粉。我小心地把它倒在台面上，台面就变成了撒上面粉的样子。现在我可以开始做美味的蛋糕啦！**

> One day, I was carrying a cup of coffee. Suddenly, I tripped and the coffee spilled all over the floor. It was a messy situation! The word\'spilled\' means liquid flowing out of a container accidentally. **有一天，我正端着一杯咖啡。突然，我绊了一跤，咖啡全都洒在了地上。真是一片狼藉！单词"spilled"意思是液体意外地从容器中流出。**
> 想象一个重要的会议，两位实力相当的人物共同承担主席的职责，他们相互协作，共同决策，被称为 co-chairman。就像双人驾驶一艘大船，引领着方向。 **想象一个重要会议中共同担任主席的两人，就像双人驾驶大船引领方向的故事来辅助记忆 co-chairman（联合主席）**
> 想象一个神秘的符号世界，有个特殊的角色叫 Signifier，它的任务是给各种事物赋予独特的标识。比如一朵花，Signifier 会给它一个代表美丽和温柔的标识。这样，Signifier 就成了赋予意义和标识的使者。 **想象在一个神秘的符号世界中，有个叫 Signifier 的角色负责给事物赋予独特标识，比如给花赋予代表美丽和温柔的标识，它是赋予意义和标识的使者。**

> Imagine a family. The parents are the first generation. Then their children, who have better opportunities and resources, are the second-generation. They grow up in a different and improved environment. **想象一个家庭。父母是第一代。然后他们的孩子，拥有更好的机会和资源，就是第二代。他们在一个不同且改进了的环境中成长。**

> A prince and a princess were lost in a forest. The prince\'s clothes were blue, and the princess\' were pink. This showed the gendered difference in their outfits. Gendered means relating to gender. **一位王子和一位公主在森林里迷路了。王子的衣服是蓝色的，公主的是粉色的。这显示出他们服装上与性别的相关差异。gendered 意思是与性别有关的。**

> A city was growing too fast. It used up all resources. The way it developed was unsustainable. People finally realized they needed to change to make it last. **一个城市发展得太快了。它耗尽了所有资源。它的这种发展方式是不可持续的。人们最终意识到他们需要改变才能让其长久。**
> 想象一下，有个超级聪明的会计师，大家都叫他 CPA 先生。他总能精准算出复杂的账目，帮助企业节省很多钱。因为他，CPA 这个称号变得令人敬仰。 **想象有个叫 CPA 先生的聪明会计师，能精准算账目并帮企业省钱，使 CPA 称号令人敬仰。**

> One day, Tom and his friends decided to go rafting. They got on the rafts and floated along the river, enjoying the beautiful scenery. It was an exciting adventure. They shouted and laughed all the way. **有一天，汤姆和他的朋友们决定去漂流。他们坐上了筏子，沿着河流漂流，欣赏着美丽的风景。这是一场刺激的冒险。他们一路上又喊又笑。**

> One day, Tom was trying to sneak into a restricted area. Unfortunately, he was caught and his plan was busted. The security guard said, \'You\'re busted!\' meaning he was discovered and caught in the act. **一天，汤姆试图潜入一个限制区域。不幸的是，他被抓住了，他的计划破产了。保安说：'你被抓住了！'意思是他被发现并当场抓获。**

> In a war-torn land, the enemy launched an airstrike. Planes roared in the sky and dropped bombs, causing chaos and destruction. But our brave soldiers were ready to defend. Remember \'airstrike\' as the terrifying attack from the air. **在一片战乱之地，敌人发动了空袭。飞机在天空轰鸣，投掷炸弹，造成混乱和破坏。但我们勇敢的士兵已准备好防御。把'airstrike'记为来自空中的可怕攻击。**

> Imagine you are in a race. The track is hour-long, meaning it takes exactly one hour to finish. You keep running, and when the hour is up, you reach the finish line. So, \'hour-long\' means lasting for one hour. **想象一下你在赛跑。赛道是一小时长的，这意味着跑完正好需要一个小时。你一直跑，当一小时结束时，你到达终点线。所以，\'hour-long\'意思是持续一小时。**

> Once upon a time, a scientist was working on a project. He needed a tool that was computer-based. It meant relying on the power of the computer to solve problems and get results. Finally, he succeeded with the help of this computer-based method. **从前，有一位科学家正在做一个项目。他需要一个基于计算机的工具。这意味着依靠计算机的力量来解决问题并获得结果。最终，他在这种基于计算机的方法的帮助下成功了。**

> One day, a farmer was spraying water on his crops to keep them healthy. The spraying action made a beautiful arc in the air. It was like a magic show. **有一天，一位农民正在给他的庄稼喷水以保持它们的健康。喷水的动作在空中形成了一道美丽的弧线。这就像一场魔术表演。**

> A thief broke into a house and stripped all the valuable things. The police came quickly and caught him. Stripped here means took away the outer covering or possessions. **一个小偷闯进了一所房子，拿走了所有值钱的东西。警察很快赶来并抓住了他。stripped 在这里指的是去掉外层覆盖物或拿走财产。**

> A little monkey was always full of restlessness. It couldn\'t stay still in the forest, constantly jumping around. One day, it realized that this restlessness was making it hard to enjoy the peaceful beauty of the forest. **一只小猴子总是充满了不安分。它在森林里总是坐不住，不停地跳来跳去。有一天，它意识到这种不安分让它难以享受森林的宁静之美。**
> One day, I was very tired after washing a lot of dishes. I rinsed them carefully to make them clean. Finally, the rinsed dishes sparkled. **有一天，我在洗了很多盘子后非常累。我仔细地冲洗它们以使其干净。最后，被冲洗过的盘子闪闪发光。**

> Once upon a time, there was a special oil. It was called extra-virgin. This means it\'s the purest and highest quality, like a precious gem among oils. It\'s untouched and perfect. **从前，有一种特殊的油。它被称为特级初榨。这意味着它是最纯净和最高质量的，就像油中的珍贵宝石。它未被加工且完美无瑕。**

> One day, I went to a park and saw many people playing a ballgame. They were running, passing the ball, and having so much fun. It was a lively scene of teamwork and competition. **有一天，我去公园看到很多人在玩球类比赛。他们奔跑着、传球，玩得非常开心。那是充满团队合作和竞争的热闹场景。**

> Imagine a store selling shoes. The rack labeled \'medium-low\' has shoes that are not too tall but also not too short. They are just right for those who want a height in between. So, \'medium-low\' means in the middle range but closer to the lower end. **想象一家卖鞋的商店。标有"medium-low"的架子上的鞋子不是很高，但也不是很低。它们正好适合那些想要中等但更接近低一点高度的人。所以，"medium-low"意思是处于中等范围但更接近低端。**

> Imagine a small town where many people work long hours but earn very little. They are stuck in low-wage jobs and struggle to make ends meet. This shows the meaning of \'low-wage\' - referring to jobs that pay poorly. **想象一个小镇，很多人长时间工作但赚得很少。他们被困在低工资的工作中，难以维持生计。这就体现了\'low-wage\'的意思 - 指工资很低的工作。**

> One day, I was walking and saw a sign with the number forty-four. It was on a special door. I wondered what was behind it. Maybe a treasure chest with forty-four jewels! That\'s how I remember the word forty-four. **有一天，我在散步，看到一个带有数字 forty-four 的标志。它在一扇特别的门上。我很好奇门后面是什么。也许是一个有四十四颗宝石的宝箱！这就是我记住 forty-four 这个词的方式。**
> 想象一下，有个叫 Likert 的科学家，他发明了一种特殊的问卷类型，大家就用他的名字来称呼，叫 Likert-type。这种类型的问卷能准确收集人们的想法和感受。 **想象有个叫利克特的科学家发明了一种特殊问卷类型，被称为利克特式问卷，用于收集想法和感受。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was at the school-age and was very excited to go to school every day. He learned many things and made lots of friends. The school-age is the wonderful time for learning and growing. **从前，有一个小男孩。他到了学龄，每天都很兴奋地去上学。他学到了很多东西，还交了很多朋友。学龄是学习和成长的美好时光。**

> A big truck was driving on the road. Its wheels and parts were all articulated perfectly, moving smoothly and without any problem. This made the truck run steadily and carry heavy goods easily. **一辆大卡车在路上行驶。它的车轮和部件都完美地铰接在一起，运行顺畅，没有任何问题。这使得卡车行驶平稳，轻松运载重物。**

> One day, a plane was flying through the sky. The pilot was feeling ill. Luckily, there was a co-pilot who took over and safely landed the plane. The co-pilot was the partner and helper of the main pilot. **有一天，一架飞机在空中飞行。飞行员感觉不舒服。幸运的是，有一位副驾驶接管并安全降落了飞机。副驾驶是主飞行员的搭档和助手。**

> In a hot summer, I was walking on the street. Suddenly, I heard a sizzling sound and saw a chef cooking steaks on a grill. The steaks were making that sizzling noise as they cooked perfectly. **在一个炎热的夏天，我走在街上。突然，我听到嘶嘶声，看到一位厨师在烤架上煎牛排。牛排煎得恰到好处，正发出嘶嘶的声音。**

> One day, a little boy had an all-day adventure. He played in the park in the morning, had lunch at a nice restaurant, visited a museum in the afternoon, and ended the day with a movie. All-day means lasting the entire day. **有一天，一个小男孩进行了一整天的冒险。他早上在公园玩耍，在一家不错的餐厅吃午餐，下午参观了博物馆，最后以看电影结束这一天。all-day 意思是一整天的。**

> A man was drowning in the river. Just when he was about to give up, a lifeguard came with a life-saving float and pulled him to safety. The float was truly life-saving. **一个男人在河里快要溺水了。就在他即将放弃的时候，一名救生员带着一个救生浮标来了，并把他拉到了安全地带。这个浮标真的是救命的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mysterious castle. It had withstood the test of time for centuries-old. People were amazed by its history and beauty. It became a legend passed down through generations. **从前，有一座神秘的城堡。它历经了数百年的时间考验。人们对它的历史和美丽感到惊叹。它成了代代相传的传说。**

> A little mouse was very hungry. It found a big piece of ricotta cheese in a corner of the kitchen. The cheese was so delicious that the mouse ate it happily and felt full. **一只小老鼠非常饿。它在厨房的一个角落里发现了一大块乳清干酪。奶酪太美味了，老鼠开心地吃了起来，感觉饱饱的。**

> A scientist was studying pressure and found a special unit called PSI. He used it to measure the force exerted on a small area. With PSI, his experiments became more accurate and his research was a big success. **一位科学家在研究压力时发现了一个特殊的单位叫 PSI。他用它来测量作用在小面积上的力。有了 PSI，他的实验变得更精确，研究取得了巨大成功。**

> A thief was trying to escape through a narrow gap, but the police were tightening the net around him. Just as he thought he could slip away, he found the gap was getting smaller, like the tightening of a noose. **一个小偷正试图从一个狭窄的缝隙逃跑，但警察正在收紧对他的包围网。就在他以为自己能溜走时，他发现缝隙变得越来越小，就像在收紧的绞索。**

> Once upon a time, there was a mean-spirited witch. She was always cruel and unkind to others. She never shared or helped, showing her mean and bad-hearted nature. Remember her to understand mean-spirited. **从前，有一个心胸狭窄的女巫。她总是对别人残忍和不友善。她从不分享或帮助，展现出她卑鄙和恶毒的心性。记住她就能理解 mean-spirited 这个词。**

> A brave climber was on a dangerous mountain peak. Suddenly, a rockfall hit him, and he became paralyzed. He couldn\'t move his legs but remained determined to survive. **一位勇敢的登山者在危险的山峰上。突然，一次落石砸中了他，他变得瘫痪了。他的腿无法动弹，但仍决心求生。**

> A little boy loved playing with clay. Every day, he spent hours shaping the clay into different figures. His creativity was shown through this shaping process. Eventually, he became a great artist. **一个小男孩喜欢玩黏土。每天，他都会花几个小时把黏土塑造成不同的形状。他的创造力通过这个塑造的过程展现了出来。最终，他成为了一位伟大的艺术家。**

> A thief was caught stealing. The police enforced the law and punished him severely. This made other potential thieves afraid to break the law. \'Enforced\' here means to make sure a rule or law is obeyed. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓。警察强制执法并严厉惩罚了他。这使得其他潜在的小偷不敢违法。'enforced'在这儿意思是确保规则或法律被遵守。**

> A group of friends were discussing a simple event, but one person kept trying to turn it into a political issue. This act of making something ordinary overly political was called politicization. **一群朋友在讨论一件简单的事，但有一个人一直试图把它变成政治问题。这种让普通事物变得过度政治化的行为就叫做politicization。**

> Once upon a time, there was an old path. It was well-worn because many people had walked on it. The path was smooth and full of footprints, showing it was frequently used. **从前，有一条老路。它被磨得很旧了，因为很多人从上面走过。这条路很平滑，满是脚印，表明它被频繁使用。**

> Once upon a time, a small town had a chef. His dishes were so delicious that people from all over the world came to taste. Soon, he became world-famous. Everyone knew his name and his amazing food. **从前，一个小镇上有一位厨师。他做的菜非常美味，以至于世界各地的人都来品尝。很快，他就举世闻名了。每个人都知道他的名字和他令人惊叹的美食。**

> Ponce was a brave adventurer. One day, he got lost in a mysterious forest but didn\'t give up. Finally, he found his way out. Remember Ponce as the persistent adventurer. **庞塞是一位勇敢的冒险家。有一天，他在一个神秘的森林里迷路了，但他没有放弃。最后，他找到了出路。记住庞塞是那个坚持不懈的冒险家。**
> 想象一下，在古老的南美洲，有一群神秘的人，他们被称为\'Inca\'。Inca 人拥有独特的文化和强大的帝国。他们建造了壮观的建筑，就像神秘的宝藏等待我们去探索。记住这个单词，就像记住那段神秘的历史。 **想象一下，在古老的南美洲，有一群被称为"印加人"的神秘人群。印加人拥有独特文化和强大帝国。他们建造壮观建筑，像神秘宝藏等我们探索。记住这个单词，如同记住那段神秘历史。**

> One day, a parent and a child went for a picnic. The parent cared for the child, sharing food and playing. This shows the special bond between a parent and a child. **有一天，一位家长和一个孩子去野餐。家长照顾孩子，分享食物并一起玩耍。这展现了家长与孩子之间特殊的联系。**

> A traveler named Jack went to Iceland. There, he met friendly Icelandic people. They wore traditional clothes and spoke the Icelandic language. Jack was fascinated by their unique culture. **一位名叫杰克的旅行者去了冰岛。在那里，他遇到了友好的冰岛人。他们穿着传统服装，说着冰岛语。杰克被他们独特的文化所吸引。**

> A director was filming a movie in a beautiful forest. The actors were giving their best performances. The filming process was full of excitement and challenges. Finally, they created a wonderful film. **一位导演正在一片美丽的森林里拍摄一部电影。演员们都在尽力表演。拍摄过程充满了兴奋和挑战。最终，他们创作出了一部精彩的影片。**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry and didn\'t make his bed. The sheets were rumpled. His mom came in and said, \'Look at these rumpled sheets! You should keep your bed tidy.\' **一天，汤姆很匆忙，没有整理床铺。床单变得皱巴巴的。他妈妈走进来说：'看看这些皱巴巴的床单！你应该保持床铺整洁。'**

> I went shopping and saw a beautiful dress. But when I checked the price tag, I was shocked. It was overpriced! I thought it should cost much less. So, I decided not to buy it. **我去购物，看到一条漂亮的裙子。但当我查看价格标签时，我震惊了。它的价格过高！我觉得它应该便宜得多。所以，我决定不买它。**

> A patient named Tom was very scared when he heard the word \'chemo\' for the first time. But the doctor explained that chemo was a treatment to help him fight cancer. With this understanding, Tom became more courageous. **一位名叫汤姆的患者第一次听到\'chemo（化疗）\'这个词时非常害怕。但医生解释说化疗是帮助他对抗癌症的一种治疗方法。有了这样的理解，汤姆变得更加勇敢了。**

> Once upon a time, there was a strong warrior. But after a long battle, his power was weakening. His muscles became less strong, and he found it harder to fight. This shows the meaning of \'weakening\' - becoming less strong or powerful. **从前，有一位强大的战士。但在一场漫长的战斗之后，他的力量在减弱。他的肌肉变得不那么强壮，战斗也愈发艰难。这体现了\'weakening\'的意思------变得不那么强壮或强大。**

> A fierce storm brought the ravages to the small town. Trees were uprooted, houses damaged. It looked like a monster had been here, leaving chaos everywhere. But people united to repair and recover from the ravages. **一场猛烈的风暴给这个小镇带来了破坏。树木被连根拔起，房屋受损。看起来就像有个怪物来过，到处一片混乱。但人们团结起来，从这些破坏中进行修复和恢复。**

> Imagine a long race. It lasts for four hours. Everyone is tired but keeps going. \'Four-hour\' here describes the duration of this challenging race. It\'s like a long journey that takes exactly four hours to complete. **想象一场长跑比赛。它持续了四个小时。每个人都很累但仍在坚持。\'four-hour\'在这里描述了这场具有挑战性的比赛的持续时间。它就像一段正好需要四个小时才能完成的漫长旅程。**

> A tourist was lost in a strange city. His adventure was unplanned. He had no map or guide, but luckily, he met kind locals who helped him find his way. It was an unexpected but exciting experience. **一位游客在一个陌生的城市迷路了。他的这次冒险是没有计划的。他既没有地图也没有向导，但幸运的是，他遇到了友善的当地人，帮他找到了路。这是一次意外但令人兴奋的经历。**

> One day, a little astronaut was lost in a strange world. He couldn\'t figure out where and when he was. This confusing situation was like being in the mysterious \'space-time\'. Finally, he found his way home by understanding the laws of space-time. **有一天，一个小宇航员在一个陌生的世界里迷路了。他搞不清楚自己在何处何时。这种令人困惑的情况就像是处于神秘的"时空"里。最后，他通过理解时空的规律找到了回家的路。**

> Once upon a time, there was a quiet mouse. But when it needed to protect its cheese, it showed assertiveness. It stood up firmly and loudly said no to other animals. That\'s what assertiveness means - being confident and forceful. **从前，有一只安静的老鼠。但当它需要保护自己的奶酪时，它表现出了自信和坚决。它坚定地站起来，大声对其他动物说不。这就是自信坚决的意思 - 有信心且强有力。**

> A man in a dark alley was a molester. He tried to touch a girl passing by. But brave people nearby stopped him. Remember, a molester is someone who does bad things like this. **一个男人在黑暗的小巷里是个性骚扰者。他试图触摸路过的一个女孩。但附近勇敢的人们阻止了他。记住，molester 就是这样做坏事的人。**

> A famous artist spent years creating his oeuvre. Each painting and sculpture was like a piece of his soul. Finally, his oeuvre was displayed in a grand museum, making people admire his talent and dedication. **一位著名的艺术家花费多年创作他的全部作品。每一幅画和每一座雕塑都像是他灵魂的一部分。最终，他的全部作品在一个大型博物馆展出，让人们钦佩他的才华和奉献精神。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a forest. He began to think deeply about himself and his abilities. This made him realize his self-awareness. He knew he had to stay calm and find a way out. **有一天，汤姆在森林里迷路了。他开始深入思考自己和自己的能力。这让他意识到了自我意识。他知道自己必须保持冷静并找到出路。**

> In a diverse city, there was a group labeled \'non-white\'. They faced challenges but united to show that color didn\'t define worth. They proved that everyone, regardless of being non-white, had unique talents and strengths. **在一个多元化的城市里，有一个被贴上"非白人"标签的群体。他们面临挑战，但团结起来表明肤色不能定义价值。他们证明了，无论是不是白人，每个人都有独特的才能和优势。**

> Two fierce warriors were engaged in a head-to-head battle. They stood face to face, ready to strike. It was a direct and intense confrontation. The word \'head-to-head\' means a direct and close competition or conflict. **两位勇猛的战士正在进行一场面对面的激烈战斗。他们面对面站着，准备出击。这是一场直接而激烈的对抗。单词"head-to-head"意思是直接的、近距离的竞争或冲突。**

> Once upon a time, there was a hotel. It was not just ordinary but offered \'full-service\'. It meant guests could enjoy everything from delicious food to comfortable rooms and excellent entertainment. So, \'full-service\' means providing a complete range of services. **从前有一家酒店。它不普通，提供"全方位服务"。这意味着客人可以享受从美食到舒适房间和精彩娱乐的一切。所以，"full-service"意思是提供全面的服务。**

> A little mouse was playing in a big box. It got boxed in and couldn\'t find a way out. It was very scared. But finally, with its wit, it pushed the box open and escaped. **一只小老鼠在一个大箱子里玩耍。它被困在里面出不来了。它非常害怕。但最后，凭借它的机智，它推开箱子逃了出去。**

> Imagine a brave knight who spent a quarter-century fighting for justice. Every year was a battle, but he never gave up. After 25 years, he finally brought peace. A quarter-century is 25 years. **想象一位勇敢的骑士为正义而战了四分之一个世纪。每年都是一场战斗，但他从未放弃。25年后，他终于带来了和平。quarter-century 就是 25 年。**

> One day, I was in the kitchen. I took an orange and peeled its skin carefully. The peeled orange looked so juicy and inviting. It made me feel happy and satisfied. **有一天，我在厨房。我拿了一个橙子，小心地剥掉它的皮。被剥了皮的橙子看起来多汁又诱人。这让我感到开心和满足。**

> A scientist worked hard for years and finally invented a special machine. He was so proud when he got the patented certificate. It meant his invention was unique and protected. **一位科学家努力多年，终于发明了一台特殊的机器。当他拿到专利证书时，他非常自豪。这意味着他的发明是独一无二且受到保护的。**

> In the eighth-grade, little Tom had a big dream. He wanted to become a scientist and worked hard every day. His eighth-grade journey was full of challenges but also hope. **在八年级的时候，小汤姆有一个大大的梦想。他想成为一名科学家，每天都努力学习。他的八年级之旅充满了挑战但也充满了希望。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a dark forest. Suddenly, he discovered a hidden cave which turned out to be the lair of a fierce monster. The adventurer had to be very cautious not to wake the monster up. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一片黑暗的森林。突然，他发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，原来是一只凶猛怪物的巢穴。探险家必须非常小心，以免吵醒怪物。**

> A thief was caught stealing and was admitting his crime. He said, \'I\'m admitting that I did wrong.\' This scene made people understand the meaning of admitting - acknowledging or confessing something. **一个小偷在行窃时被抓住了，正在承认他的罪行。他说：\'我正在承认我做错了。\' 这个场景让人们理解了\'admitting\'的意思 - 承认，供认某事。**

> A factory was in trouble. But then they found a way to make products with value-added features. Like adding special designs to clothes. This made the products more attractive and valuable, and the factory became successful. **一家工厂陷入困境。但后来他们找到了一种制造具有增值特性产品的方法。比如在衣服上添加特殊设计。这使得产品更具吸引力和价值，工厂也取得了成功。**

> A prince and a princess went on adventures. They faced many challenges and always found solutions that matched perfectly. Finally, they lived happily ever after. The word \'matched\' here means being suitable or corresponding. **一位王子和一位公主去冒险。他们面临许多挑战，总是能找到完美匹配的解决方案。最后，他们从此过上了幸福的生活。单词\'matched\'在这里的意思是合适的或对应的。**

> A group of marchers were on a long journey. They walked steadily, one step after another. Despite the tiredness, they kept marching forward with determination. They were like soldiers, never giving up. **一群游行者正在长途跋涉。他们稳步前行，一步接着一步。尽管疲惫，他们仍坚定地向前行进。他们就像战士，永不放弃。**

> A second-year student was very nervous on the first day of the new term. But soon, he made many friends and enjoyed the second-year life. It was a wonderful experience for him. **一个二年级的学生在新学期的第一天非常紧张。但很快，他交了很多朋友，享受了二年级的生活。这对他来说是一次美妙的经历。**

> One night, in a mysterious forest, a magical creature named Shifter appeared. It could shift its shape and size at will. Sometimes it was a small rabbit, sometimes a huge bear. It was truly amazing! **一天晚上，在一个神秘的森林里，出现了一个叫 Shifter 的神奇生物。它可以随意变换形状和大小。有时它是一只小兔子，有时是一只巨大的熊。真的太神奇了！**

> A detective was known as hard-boiled. He faced many tough cases but remained tough and unemotional. No matter how dangerous, he stayed calm and determined. His hard-boiled nature made him a legend in the police force. **一位侦探被认为是强硬的。他面对许多棘手的案件，但仍然坚韧且不动感情。无论多么危险，他都保持冷静和坚定。他强硬的性格使他在警队中成为了一个传奇。**

> Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a beautiful carriage. It was special because it was horse-drawn. The strong horse pulled the carriage smoothly along the road. People were amazed by this traditional and charming sight. **从前，在一个小村庄里，有一辆漂亮的马车。它很特别，因为它是由马拉的。强壮的马沿着道路平稳地拉着马车。人们对这传统而迷人的景象感到惊奇。**
> 想象一下，在远古时代，有一群英勇的战士，他们被称为 Aryan 。他们有着强壮的体魄和聪明的头脑，以勇敢和智慧闻名。他们守护着自己的家园，成为了人们心中的英雄。 **想象在远古，被称为雅利安人的一群英勇战士，以勇智闻名并守护家园成为英雄。**

> Once upon a time, a little bird was flying in the sky. It encountered a high-pressure air current that made it difficult to move forward. But with its strong will, it finally broke through. \'High-pressure\' means a situation with great force or stress. **从前，一只小鸟在天空中飞翔。它遇到了一股高压气流，让它难以前进。但凭借坚强的意志，它最终突破了。'high-pressure'意思是有巨大力量或压力的情况。**

> A detective was investigating a case. When asked about the clues, he gave a matter-of-fact reply, presenting the facts without any exaggeration or emotion, just like stating simple truths. **一位侦探正在调查一个案子。当被问及线索时，他给出了实事求是的回答，不带任何夸张和情绪，就像陈述简单的事实一样。**

> A girl always felt sad and had self-pity when facing difficulties. One day, she realized that this only made things worse. So, she decided to be brave and stop the self-pity. With effort, she overcame all the problems. **一个女孩在面对困难时总是感到悲伤并自怜。有一天，她意识到这只会让事情更糟。于是，她决定勇敢起来，不再自怜。通过努力，她克服了所有问题。**

> A brave adventurer set out to explore a mysterious land. But this place was unexplored. No one knew what was hidden there. It was full of unknowns and challenges. The adventurer was excited to be the first to discover its secrets. **一位勇敢的探险家出发去探索一片神秘的土地。但这个地方尚未被探索过。没人知道那里隐藏着什么。它充满了未知和挑战。这位探险家很兴奋能成为第一个发现其秘密的人。**

> One night, I was walking in a dark alley. Suddenly, a black-eyed cat jumped out. Its shiny black eyes scared me. Since then, whenever I think of \'black-eyed\', I remember that scary cat. **一天晚上，我在一条黑暗的小巷里走着。突然，一只黑眼睛的猫跳了出来。它闪亮的黑眼睛吓到了我。从那以后，每当我想到'black-eyed'，我就会想起那只吓人的猫。**

> A thief was stealing in a house. When the owner suddenly came back, the thief panicked. He didn\'t know where to hide and his heart was beating fast. **一个小偷正在房子里偷东西。当主人突然回来时，小偷惊慌失措。他不知道往哪里躲，心跳得很快。**

> Two farmers were constantly wrangling over the ownership of a piece of land. They argued loudly and fiercely, but finally, a wise old man came and helped them solve the problem. **两个农民一直在为一块土地的所有权而争吵不休。他们大声且激烈地争论，但最后，一位睿智的老人前来帮助他们解决了问题。**

> A jihadist was lost in a desert. He struggled to find his way, thinking his mission was noble. But in reality, his actions brought chaos. Eventually, he realized the error of his extremist path. **一名圣战分子在沙漠中迷路了。他努力寻找出路，认为自己的使命是崇高的。但实际上，他的行为带来了混乱。最终，他意识到了自己极端主义道路的错误。**

> A detective was investigating a crime. He found some incriminating evidence like a bloody knife and a torn letter. These items pointed to the suspect and made it clear that he was involved in the crime. **一位侦探在调查一起犯罪案件。他发现了一些定罪的证据，比如带血的刀和撕破的信件。这些物品指向了嫌疑人，清楚地表明他参与了犯罪。**

> A group of workers in a factory were treated unfairly. So, they decided to come together and form a union. After that, they became unionized and finally got better working conditions and pay. **一家工厂的一群工人受到了不公平的待遇。于是，他们决定团结起来组成一个工会。在那之后，他们成为了有工会组织的，并最终获得了更好的工作条件和薪酬。**

> Imagine a group of brave heroes called Sandinistas fighting for justice and equality. They faced many challenges but never gave up. Their spirit was like a bright light in the darkness. **想象有一群勇敢的英雄被称为桑地诺民族解放阵线成员，他们为正义和平等而战。他们面临诸多挑战但从未放弃。他们的精神就像黑暗中的一束亮光。**

> In the sixth-grade class, Tom was always excited to learn new things. One day, the teacher gave a difficult math problem, but Tom was the first to solve it. > A tourist was lost in Paris. Hungry and tired, he found a small bakery. There, he saw a long and delicious baguette. It looked so good that he bought it immediately and felt happy. **一位游客在巴黎迷路了。又饿又累的他发现了一家小面包店。在那里，他看到了一根长长的美味的法式长棍面包。它看起来太棒了，他立刻买了下来，感到很开心。**

> One day, a little monkey was very happy because it found thirty-nine bananas. But it had a hard time carrying them all. Finally, with the help of its friends, it took the bananas home safely. **一天，一只小猴子非常高兴，因为它找到了三十九根香蕉。但它很难把它们都搬走。最后，在朋友们的帮助下，它把香蕉安全地带回了家。**

> A brave detective justifiably accused the criminal. He had solid evidence, showing that his accusation was completely reasonable and fair. With justice on his side, he was confident and sure. **一位勇敢的侦探有充分理由地指控了罪犯。他有确凿的证据，表明他的指控是完全合理和公正的。正义在他这边，他充满自信和笃定。**

> A young artist was seeking recognition. One day, he met an esteemed master. The master praised his work, saying it was of high quality. > Once upon a time, there was a magic number. It was forty-seven. A little boy found a treasure chest with the number forty-seven on it. When he opened it, he got 47 candies. What a lucky number! **从前，有一个神奇的数字，它是四十七。一个小男孩发现了一个带有数字 Forty-seven 的宝箱。当他打开时，得到了 47 颗糖果。这是个多么幸运的数字！**

> A journalist was always looking for the most exciting soundbite. One day, she found a speaker who gave a powerful and short statement. That short but impactful statement was called a soundbite. **一位记者总是在寻找最精彩的原声摘要。有一天，她发现一位演讲者发表了一个有力且简短的陈述。那个简短但有影响力的陈述就被称为原声摘要。**

> In a factory, there was a special machine for filtering impurities from water. Workers carefully observed the filtering process to ensure the water was clean and safe. The filtering made the water pure and useful. **在一家工厂里，有一台专门从水中过滤杂质的机器。工人们仔细观察过滤过程，以确保水干净安全。这种过滤使水变得纯净且有用。**

> A small town had a local fair. Everyone was excited when a big-name singer came to perform. The singer\'s presence made the fair very special. \'Big-name\' means famous and important. **一个小镇举办了当地的集市。当一位大名鼎鼎的歌手前来表演时，每个人都很兴奋。这位歌手的到来让集市变得非常特别。'big-name'意思是著名的、重要的。**

> Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there was a mysterious cave that everyone feared. No one dared to go near it. But one brave soul decided to face the fear and explore. It turned out there was nothing to be feared inside. **从前，在一片黑暗的森林里，有一个神秘的洞穴，每个人都害怕它。没有人敢靠近它。但有一个勇敢的人决定面对恐惧去探索。结果发现里面没什么可怕的。**

> One day, Tom was too fat and decided to do sit-ups to get fit. He struggled at first but kept doing them. Finally, he became strong and healthy. Remember, sit-up is the exercise he did! **有一天，汤姆太胖了，决定做仰卧起坐来健身。一开始他很吃力，但一直坚持。最后，他变得强壮又健康。记住，sit-up 就是他做的那种运动！**

> One day, a little girl was asked to describe her great-grandmother. She said, \'My great-grandmother is like a warm sun. She has many wrinkles but her smile is so kind. She tells the best stories.\' **有一天，一个小女孩被要求描述她的曾祖母。她说：'我的曾祖母就像温暖的太阳。她有很多皱纹，但她的笑容非常和蔼。她讲的故事最棒了。'**
> 想象一下，小明有一张写满待办事项（to-do）的清单，比如做作业、打扫房间、买东西。他每完成一项，就从清单上划掉。这张清单就是他的 to-do list，提醒他还有哪些事情要做。 **想象小明有一张写满待办事项的清单，他每完成一项就划掉，这张清单提醒他还有哪些事要做**

> A group of friends went on a picnic. They brought blended juices. The juices were a mix of different fruits. So, \'blended\' means mixed together. They enjoyed the blended drinks in the beautiful park. **一群朋友去野餐。他们带来了混合果汁。这些果汁是由不同水果混合而成的。所以，\'blended\'意思是混合在一起。他们在美丽的公园里享受着混合饮料。**

> Once upon a time, there was a knight who was single-minded in his pursuit of rescuing the princess. He focused only on this goal, ignoring all distractions. His single-mindedness finally led him to success. **从前，有一位骑士，他一心一意地追求营救公主。他只专注于这个目标，忽略了所有的干扰。他的一心一意最终使他获得了成功。**

> One day, I went to a party. Everyone was laughing and dancing freely. The atmosphere was so light-hearted. There were no worries or stress. It was a time filled with pure joy and happiness. **有一天，我去参加一个派对。每个人都自由地笑着、跳着。气氛是如此轻松愉快。没有烦恼和压力。那是一段充满纯粹的欢乐和幸福的时光。**

> A man always believed he could fly like a bird. He jumped off a building, thinking it was possible. This man was delusional. He had false beliefs and lost his life. **一个男人总是认为自己能像鸟一样飞。他从一栋大楼上跳下去，认为这是可行的。这个男人是妄想的。他有错误的信念并失去了生命。**
> 想象一位音乐家在精心调整他的乐器，每一个音符都要经过 fine-tuning 才能达到完美的和谐。就像我们做事情，需要不断地精细调整才能达到最佳效果。 **想象一位音乐家精心调整乐器的情景来辅助理解'fine-tuning'（微调；精心调整）这个词，意味着对事物进行细致的、精准的调整以达到理想状态。**

> A brave diver went deep into the sea. He found a strange seat that was firmly fixed. This seat was so deep-seated that it seemed to have been there for ages. It represented something firmly established and hard to change. **一位勇敢的潜水员深入大海。他发现了一个固定得很牢固的奇怪座位。这个座位如此根深蒂固，似乎已经存在很久了。它代表着牢固确立且难以改变的东西。**

> One day, Tom was very excited because he e-mailed his best friend in another city and shared his happy news. The e-mail flew through the internet quickly, connecting their hearts. **有一天，汤姆非常兴奋，因为他给在另一个城市的最好的朋友发了电子邮件，并分享了他的好消息。这封电子邮件迅速通过网络传送，连接了他们的心。**

> A small school was underfunded. It lacked enough money for new books and equipment. The students had to share old textbooks. But they didn\'t give up, hoping for more funds one day. **一所小型学校资金不足。它没有足够的钱购买新书和设备。学生们不得不共用旧课本。但他们没有放弃，希望有一天能获得更多资金。**

> A young artist was painting a landscape. When she finished, everyone was stunned. The colors and details were stunningly beautiful. People couldn\'t believe how amazing it was. **一位年轻的艺术家正在画一幅风景画。当她完成时，每个人都惊呆了。颜色和细节美得令人惊叹。人们简直不敢相信它有多么惊人。**

> 想象一个老旧的房子，它的外观破旧不堪。有一天，工人们来了，给它重新粉刷墙面，更换门窗，这就像是给房子来了一次 face-lift，让它焕然一新。所以 face-lift 就是'翻新；改造；整容'的意思。 **想象一个老旧房子的翻新过程来理解 face-lift 这个词，表示翻新、改造、整容**

> In the fifth-grade classroom, little Tom was excited. It was a special year as they learned many new things. The teacher said, \'This is your fifth-grade journey!\' Tom knew it would be full of fun and challenges. **在五年级的教室里，小汤姆很兴奋。这是特别的一年，他们学习了很多新东西。老师说：'这是你们的五年级之旅！'汤姆知道这一年将充满乐趣和挑战。**

> A little boy was lost in a strange town. He was very scared until he found a tree-lined street. The rows of trees made him feel safe and he followed the street to find his way home. **一个小男孩在一个陌生的城镇迷路了。他非常害怕，直到他发现了一条绿树成荫的街道。一排排的树木让他感到安全，他沿着这条街找到了回家的路。**

> 想象一下，有个叫小明的人去旅行，在一个神秘的小镇上遇到一位会说 Yiddish 语的老人。老人用 Yiddish 给他讲述了很多有趣的故事。小明被这种独特的语言吸引，决定学习它。 **想象一下，有个人在旅行中遇到会说依地语（Yiddish）的老人，老人讲故事吸引人去学习这种语言。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved making cookies. One day, she made some special cookies that were heart-shaped. They looked so lovely, just like a symbol of love. > Once upon a time, there was a rare gem that everyone wanted. It was sought-after by many. Just like this gem, sought-after things are highly desired and chased by people. **从前，有一颗稀有的宝石，每个人都想要它。它被很多人所追寻。就像这颗宝石一样，sought-after 所指的东西是被人们高度渴望和追求的。**

> Imagine a race. There are many participants. When the race ends, we find that one person comes in the third-largest position.
