> A young artist was obsessively drawing every day. He couldn\'t stop thinking about creating new artworks. His passion made him spend all his time on it. Finally, his efforts paid off and he became famous. **一位年轻的艺术家每天痴迷地画画。他不停地想着创作新的艺术作品。他的热情使他把所有时间都花在这上面。最终，他的努力得到了回报，他成名了。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a desert. After days, his clothes became bleached by the intense sun. He was so thirsty but finally found an oasis. The bleached clothes reminded him of the harsh journey. **一位勇敢的探险家在沙漠中迷路了。几天后，他的衣服被强烈的阳光晒得褪色了。他口渴难耐，但最终找到了一片绿洲。褪色的衣服让他想起了这段艰难的旅程。**

> Once upon a time, there was a white wall. But over the years, it was exposed to the sun and rain, and gradually yellowed. This shows that \'yellowed\' means to become yellow or turn yellow. **从前，有一面白色的墙。但多年来，它经受着日晒雨淋，逐渐变黄了。这表明'yellowed'意思是变成黄色或发黄。**

> A little boy was playing with clay. He molded the clay into various shapes, like a cute dog and a beautiful flower. The act of shaping the clay is just like the meaning of\'molded\'. **一个小男孩正在玩黏土。他把黏土塑造成各种形状，像一只可爱的小狗和一朵美丽的花。塑造黏土的这个行为就像\'molded\'这个单词的意思。**

> Once upon a time, there was an old man. His hair was not black or brown but gray. People called him the gray-haired man. He was wise and kind. His gray hair showed his years of experience. **从前，有一位老人。他的头发不是黑色或棕色的，而是灰色的。人们称他为灰发老人。他睿智又善良。他的灰发显示出他多年的阅历。**

> A usually calm and collected person uncharacteristically lost their temper at the party. Everyone was shocked because it was so unlike their normal behavior. **一个通常冷静沉着的人在聚会上一反常态地发了脾气。每个人都很震惊，因为这与他们平常的行为太不一样了。**

> A ten-year-old boy named Tom was very brave. One day, he decided to take a ten-year journey to explore the world. After ten years, he returned home with wonderful memories. **一个叫汤姆的十岁男孩非常勇敢。有一天，他决定进行为期十年的旅程去探索世界。十年后，他带着美好的回忆回家了。**

> One day, a worker needed to do a messy job. So he wore special clothes called coveralls to protect himself completely from dirt and damage. These coveralls covered him from head to toe. **有一天，一个工人需要做一项很脏的工作。所以他穿上了被称为工作服的特殊衣服来完全保护自己免受污垢和损害。这些工作服从头到脚把他包裹起来。**
> 想象一辆汽车在陡峭的山坡上失控翻滚（roll），最后整个车身翻转过来（over），这就是 rollover 所描绘的场景。 **（使）翻滚，（使）翻转**

> A little boy was lost in the forest. He had no food or water. His heart was filled with fear. But an inner voice kept urging him to move on. Finally, he found his way home. The word \'urging\' here means to strongly encourage or push someone to do something. **一个小男孩在森林里迷路了。他没有食物和水，内心充满恐惧。但一个内在的声音不断催促他前进。最后，他找到了回家的路。单词\'urging\'在这里的意思是强烈鼓励或推动某人做某事。**

> Imagine a straight line. It only moves forward or backward. It has no width or depth, just length. This line is like the concept of \'one-dimensional\'. It\'s very simple and has only one direction. **想象一条直线。它只能向前或向后移动。它没有宽度或深度，只有长度。这条线就像\'one-dimensional（一维的）\'这个概念。它非常简单，只有一个方向。**

> One day, I was having a bad mood. But then I went for a walk in the park, felt the warm sunshine and gentle breeze. Suddenly, I had a feel-good moment and all my troubles vanished. **有一天，我心情很差。但之后我去公园散步，感受到了温暖的阳光和轻柔的微风。突然，我有了一个愉悦的时刻，所有的烦恼都消失了。**
> 想象一个小镇，工厂里都是些简单陈旧的设备，被称为 low-tech。这里没有先进的科技，只有基础的、技术含量低的工具在运作。人们努力工作，但效率不高，因为这些 low-tech 的东西限制了发展。 **想象一个小镇，工厂设备简单陈旧被称为技术含量低的。这里没有先进科技，只有基础工具在运作，人们工作努力但效率不高，因为这些技术含量低的东西限制了发展。**

> One day, I visited an old church. The sunlight shone through the stained-glass windows, creating beautiful colors and patterns. I was amazed by the artistry of these stained-glass works. **有一天，我参观了一座古老的教堂。阳光透过彩色玻璃窗照射进来，形成了美丽的颜色和图案。我对这些彩色玻璃作品的艺术性感到惊叹。**

> One day, a police officer was off-duty. He took off his uniform and went for a walk in the park. He enjoyed the peaceful time without the stress of work. \'Off-duty\' means not working or being on a break from work. **有一天，一位警察下班了。他脱下制服去公园散步。他享受着没有工作压力的平静时光。\'off-duty\'意思是下班或不在工作中，处于休息状态。**
> 想象一下，在哥伦布发现新大陆之前，有一群神秘的古人过着独特的生活。他们的文化和传统就是\'pre-columbian\'所代表的，即哥伦布发现美洲大陆以前的。 **想象在哥伦布发现美洲大陆前，存在的那些古人的情况来辅助理解哥伦布发现美洲大陆以前的这个意思**

> A poor man had a pair of shoes. After years of walking, they became worn-out. The soles were thin, and the fabric was torn. It showed that they had been used too much and were in a very bad condition. **一个穷人有一双鞋。经过多年的行走，它们变得破旧不堪。鞋底变薄了，布料也撕裂了。这表明它们被过度使用，状况非常糟糕。**

> One day, I went to a party. There was a special drink that had an intoxicating effect. After just a few sips, I felt light-headed and happy. It was such a powerful and charming experience. **有一天，我去参加一个聚会。那里有一种特别的饮料，具有令人陶醉的效果。仅仅喝了几口，我就感到头晕目眩并且很开心。这是一次如此强烈且迷人的体验。**

> A little girl got lost in the park and was crying. She shouted, \'Momma, where are you?\' Finally, her momma heard her and ran to her, giving her a big hug. Momma means mother and is a loving word. **一个小女孩在公园迷路了，正在哭泣。她喊道：'妈妈，你在哪里？'最后，她的妈妈听到了她的呼喊，跑向她，给了她一个大大的拥抱。momma 意思是母亲，是一个充满爱的词。**
> 想象一个小镇，银行给那些信用不太好的人发放贷款，这些贷款就被称为 subprime 贷款。后来很多人还不上钱，引发了经济危机。所以 subprime 就是指低于标准的、次优级的。 **想象一个关于次优级贷款的故事来辅助记忆 subprime 这个单词，意思是低于标准的、次优级的**

> A soldier was occupying a strategic position during the war. He was determined to hold it and not let the enemy pass. This act of occupying showed his bravery and commitment. **一位士兵在战争期间占领着一个战略要地。他决心坚守不让敌人通过。这种占领的行为展现了他的勇敢和决心。**

> Once upon a time, a little ant had a six-day adventure. It climbed six mountains and crossed six rivers. On the sixth day, it found a beautiful garden. The ant was so happy during this six-day journey. **从前，一只小蚂蚁有一次为期六天的冒险。它爬了六座山，穿过了六条河。在第六天，它发现了一个美丽的花园。这只蚂蚁在这六天的旅程中非常开心。**

> A girl named Lily was crazy about a famous band. She followed them everywhere and was always in the front row at their concerts. People called her a groupie. She was part of the band\'s fan group and devoted to them. **一个叫莉莉的女孩疯狂迷恋一个著名乐队。她到处追随他们，总是在他们演唱会的前排。人们称她为追星族。她是乐队粉丝群体的一员，并全心投入。**

> A couple was facing many challenges in child-rearing. They had to deal with tantrums, teach good manners, and ensure the kids were safe. But with love and patience, they managed to create a happy family. **一对夫妇在养育孩子方面面临着许多挑战。他们得应对孩子发脾气，教导良好的礼仪，并确保孩子的安全。但凭借爱和耐心，他们成功营造了一个幸福的家庭。**
> 想象一下，两位勇敢的创业者小明和小红，他们决定携手共同创办一家创新的科技公司。这个共同创办的动作就是\'co-found\'，他们一起努力，为实现梦想迈出了重要的第一步。 **想象两位创业者共同创办公司的情景来记住\'co-found\'（共同创办）这个单词**

> A brave adventurer was on a journey. One day, he saw a beautiful castle in the far-off distance. It was so far away that it seemed like a dream. But his curiosity led him to keep moving forward towards that mysterious place. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在旅行。有一天，他在遥远的地方看到了一座美丽的城堡。它是如此遥远，仿佛是一场梦。但他的好奇心促使他不断朝着那个神秘的地方前进。**

> One hot summer day, I opened the refrigerator and found the juice was still refreshing and cold. It was because the food inside was \'refrigerated\' and kept at a low temperature. That made me feel so comfortable. **在一个炎热的夏日，我打开冰箱，发现果汁依然清凉爽口。这是因为里面的食物被"冷藏"了，保持在低温状态。这让我感到非常舒适。**

> One day, Tom was at the airport. He had a small bag that he could take on the plane. It was a carry-on. He didn\'t need to check it in. With his carry-on, he had everything he needed for the flight. **一天，汤姆在机场。他有一个可以带上飞机的小包。这就是随身携带的行李。他不需要托运。带着他的随身行李，他为这次飞行准备了所需的一切。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was lost in a low-lying area. It was a place near the river where the land was flat and close to the water level. He had trouble finding his way out. Finally, he was rescued. **从前，有一位旅行者在低洼地区迷路了。那是靠近河流的一块地势平坦且接近水位的地方。他很难找到出路。最后，他被救了出来。**

> A detective was trying to solve a mystery. The clues seemed all tangled up, but with his sharp mind, he unraveled them one by one. Finally, he found the truth. \'Unraveled\' here means to solve or untangle something complicated. **一位侦探试图解开一个谜团。线索似乎全都缠在一起，但凭借他敏锐的头脑，他一个一个地解开了它们。最后，他找到了真相。"unraveled"在这里指解决或解开复杂的事物。**

> One day, a little boy was counting. He reached forty and then added one more. \'Forty-one!\' he shouted happily. It was his new record of counting. **一天，一个小男孩在数数。他数到了四十，然后又多了一个。"四十一！"他高兴地喊道。这是他数数的新纪录。**
> 有一天，小明听到了一个奇怪的声音\'heh\'，他四处寻找，发现是一只小猫在玩耍时发出的。小猫似乎在得意地表达自己的快乐，小明一下子就记住了这个有点特别的声音\'heh\'。 **有一天，小明听到一个奇怪声音"heh"，是小猫玩耍时发出，小明因此记住这个词。**
> 想象一个小镇，有一家特殊的商店，它不为盈利，not-for-profit。这家店把赚到的钱都用来帮助贫困家庭。人们都很喜欢它，因为它的目的不是赚钱，而是给大家带来温暖和帮助。 **想象一个小镇有一家非盈利的特殊商店，它把赚的钱用于帮助贫困家庭，人们喜欢它因其不以盈利为目的，而是带来温暖和帮助。**

> One day, when Tom was walking in the forest, he suddenly saw a snake. \'Ahh!\' he shouted in surprise and fear. This word expressed his sudden shock and panic at that moment. **一天，当汤姆在森林里散步时，他突然看到一条蛇。'啊！'他惊讶又害怕地大喊。这个单词表达了他当时突然的震惊和恐慌。**

> One day, while walking in the park, I heard a strange sound. Looking around, I found a boy whistling happily. His whistling was so beautiful that it attracted many birds. The sound of whistling filled the air and made the park more lively. **有一天，在公园散步时，我听到一个奇怪的声音。环顾四周，我发现一个男孩正欢快地吹着口哨。他的口哨声如此美妙，吸引了许多鸟儿。口哨声弥漫在空气中，让公园更加热闹。**

> A girl was lost in a foreign city. She was relieved when she found a Spanish-language bookstore. The friendly clerk helped her with directions. She was so grateful and learned that knowing Spanish-language could be a lifesaver. **一个女孩在异国他乡迷路了。当她发现一家西班牙语书店时，她松了一口气。友好的店员给她指了路。她非常感激，并明白了懂西班牙语可能会救命。**

> Imagine a factory where workers are busy putting labels on products. They are engaged in the task of \'labeling\'. The labels help identify and describe the items. This is how we remember the word \'labeling\' - the act of attaching labels. **想象一个工厂，工人们正忙着给产品贴标签。他们正在从事'labeling（贴标签）'的工作。标签有助于识别和描述物品。这就是我们记住'labeling'这个单词的方式------贴标签的行为。**
> 想象在一个古老的小镇，有一座名为 Alamo 的神秘城堡。城堡里藏着无数的宝藏，但有凶猛的野兽守护。勇敢的探险家们历经艰险，终于找到了进入城堡的秘密通道，成功获得宝藏。 **想象关于'Alamo'这个词的一个有宝藏和探险的故事，帮助记忆**

> Imagine a company considering a new project. They calculate the costs like materials and labor and the benefits like increased sales. This process of weighing the costs against the benefits is called \'cost-benefit\'. **想象一家公司在考虑一个新项目。他们计算像材料和劳动力这样的成本，以及像增加的销售额这样的收益。这种权衡成本和收益的过程就被称为'成本效益'。**

> In the sixteenth-century, a brave knight embarked on a quest. He crossed mountains and rivers, facing many challenges. This era was full of adventure and mystery. Remember, sixteenth-century means the 16th century. **在 16 世纪，一位勇敢的骑士踏上了征程。他翻山越岭，面临诸多挑战。这个时代充满了冒险和神秘。记住，sixteenth-century 意思是 16 世纪。**

> A little girl was making a sandcastle. But when the waves came, the castle crumbled. She was sad, but then she decided to build a stronger one. \'Crumble\' means to break or fall apart into small pieces. **一个小女孩正在堆沙堡。但是当海浪袭来时，城堡坍塌了。她很伤心，但随后决定建造一个更坚固的。'crumbled'意思是破碎或分解成小块。**

> A brave man was trapped in a house surrounded by floodwaters. He had to find a way to escape. The rising floodwaters were terrifying, but he finally got to safety. **一个勇敢的人被困在被洪水淹没的房子里。他不得不寻找逃生的办法。不断上涨的洪水很可怕，但他最终到达了安全地带。**

> A factory was in trouble because its products were not mass-produced. One day, a smart engineer came and designed a new system. Now, thousands of items were made quickly and easily. The factory became successful. **一家工厂陷入困境，因为其产品没有大规模生产。一天，一位聪明的工程师来了，设计了新系统。现在，成千上万的物品被快速且轻松地制造出来。工厂取得了成功。**

> Once upon a time, there was a blacksmith who was famous for his exquisite wrought-iron works. He heated and hammered the iron to create beautiful and strong items. People loved his wrought-iron creations. **从前，有一位铁匠，以其精美的熟铁制品而闻名。他加热并锤打熟铁来创造出美丽又坚固的物品。人们喜爱他的熟铁制品。**

> A foreign scientist worked hard and finally became naturalized. He was so happy as he could fully contribute to the new country\'s research. Now he felt truly at home. **一位外国科学家努力工作，最终入籍了。他非常高兴，因为他可以全力为新的国家做研究了。现在他感觉真正像在家一样。**

> A group of friends were discussing a simple event, but one person kept trying to turn it into a political issue. This made the event overly politicized. Everyone was frustrated as it was supposed to be just a fun gathering. **一群朋友在讨论一件简单的事，但是有一个人一直试图把它变成一个政治问题。这使得这件事过度政治化了。每个人都很沮丧，因为这本该只是一个有趣的聚会。**

> One day, I needed to buy eighty-five apples for a party. I kept counting and counting until I reached exactly eighty-five. It was a tiring but fun task! **有一天，我需要为一个聚会买八十五个苹果。我不停地数啊数，直到正好数到八十五个。这是一项累人但有趣的任务！**

> Once there was a prince named Tom. He always thought only about himself and never cared about others. He was so self-centered that he lost all his friends. Finally, he realized his mistake and changed. **从前有个叫汤姆的王子。他总是只考虑自己，从不关心别人。他非常以自我为中心，以至于失去了所有的朋友。最后，他意识到了自己的错误并做出了改变。**

> Imagine a little bird born in a foreign land. It faces challenges as it\'s different from the local birds. But it bravely explores and adapts. Just like someone foreign-born, finding their way in a new place. **想象一只小鸟出生在异国他乡。它面临着挑战，因为它和当地的鸟不同。但它勇敢地探索和适应。就像出生在外国的人，在新的地方寻找自己的路。**

> One day, Tom went to the cinema. He was excited to see the movie on the big-screen. The huge and clear image made him feel like he was in the story. Big-screen means a large screen for showing movies or other things. **有一天，汤姆去电影院。他很兴奋能在大屏幕上看电影。巨大且清晰的画面让他感觉自己仿佛置身于故事之中。big-screen 意思是用于放映电影或其他内容的大屏幕。**

> Once upon a time, a little girl dreamed of a house. She drew a picture of a big house with THREE-BEDROOM. One for her parents, one for herself, and one for guests. It was her perfect home. **从前，有一个小女孩梦想有一座房子。她画了一幅有三个卧室的大房子的画。一间给她父母，一间给自己，一间给客人。这就是她理想中的家。**

> A little girl was very happy because she got a pleated skirt. The pleats were so beautiful and made the skirt look unique. She wore it and danced around. **一个小女孩非常开心，因为她得到了一条百褶裙。这些褶子非常漂亮，让裙子看起来很独特。她穿上它欢快地跳舞。**

> Imagine a superhero who has the power of self-regulation. He can control his emotions and actions perfectly. When facing villains, he doesn\'t act rashly but uses his self-regulation skills to make smart decisions and save the day. **想象一个拥有自我调节能力的超级英雄。他能完美地控制自己的情绪和行动。面对坏人时，他不会鲁莽行事，而是运用自我调节技能做出明智决定并拯救世界。**

> One day, a little boy dreamed of traveling to space. He imagined a huge dome-shaped building called the \'Astrodome\' where he could learn about stars and planets. When he woke up, he never forgot the word \'Astrodome\'. **有一天，一个小男孩梦想着去太空旅行。他想象有一个巨大的圆顶形建筑叫做'Astrodome（天文馆）'，在那里他可以学习关于星星和行星的知识。当他醒来，他永远不会忘记'Astrodome'这个词。**

> One day, I received a gift box. But when I opened it, I found the present was unwrapped. I was a little disappointed. Later, my friend explained that it was a mistake and promised to give me a properly wrapped one next time. **有一天，我收到一个礼盒。但当我打开时，发现礼物是未包装的。我有点失望。后来，我的朋友解释这是个失误，并承诺下次给我一个包装好的。**
> 想象一个未来世界，人们努力阻止一种叫 CFC 的神秘物质破坏臭氧层。CFC 就像一个个小恶魔，从空调和冰箱中跑出来，伤害着地球的保护层。最后，科学家们找到了制服它们的方法。 **想象未来世界中人们阻止 CFC 破坏臭氧层的故事，帮助记忆 CFC 这个单词。**

> A brave athlete participated in a triathlon. First, he swam in the river. Then, he cycled on a long road. Finally, he ran to the finish line. The triathlon was a big challenge but he was determined! **一位勇敢的运动员参加了铁人三项比赛。首先，他在河里游泳。然后，他在长长的路上骑自行车。最后，他跑到了终点线。铁人三项是一项巨大的挑战，但他意志坚定！**

> One day, Tom saw a man in a black coat. He misperceptioned him as a thief. But actually, the man was just a normal passerby. Tom\'s wrong understanding caused a big misunderstanding. **一天，汤姆看到一个穿黑外套的男人。他错误地认为他是个小偷。但实际上，这个男人只是个普通的路人。汤姆的错误认知导致了很大的误会。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person who strictly followed the ideas and policies of Stalin. We call such a person a Stalinist. They were known for their strong beliefs and actions related to those beliefs. **从前，有一个人严格遵循斯大林的思想和政策。我们称这样的人为斯大林主义者。他们以其坚定的信念和与这些信念相关的行动而闻名。**

> One night, a little boy was very sleepy. His mother gently said, \'Goodnight, my dear.\' The boy felt warm and safe, and soon fell asleep. \'Goodnight\' means a sweet wish before sleep. **一天晚上，一个小男孩非常困倦。他的妈妈温柔地说："晚安，亲爱的。"男孩感到温暖和安全，很快就睡着了。"goodnight"意思是睡前的温馨祝愿。**

> A young man decided to work in long-term-care. He met many elderly people and learned to care for them patiently. Through this job, he understood the importance of long-term commitment and care. **一个年轻人决定从事长期护理工作。他见到了许多老年人，并学会耐心地照顾他们。通过这份工作，他明白了长期承诺和关爱的重要性。**

> Imagine a small village where there is only one group making all the decisions. That\'s like a one-party system. It means having only one political party in control. **想象一个小村庄，只有一个团体做所有的决定。这就像一党制。它意味着只有一个政党掌控。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved playing with a yo-yo. Every day, he would show off his tricks with the yo-yo to his friends. The yo-yo went up and down, just like his happy mood. **从前，有个小男孩喜欢玩溜溜球。每天，他都会向朋友们展示他玩溜溜球的技巧。溜溜球上下移动，就像他快乐的心情。**

> A little mouse was puffing hard as it ran in the maze. It was puffing because it was very tired but still wanted to find the exit. The puffing showed how much effort it was putting in. **一只小老鼠在迷宫里跑的时候用力地喘气。它在喘气是因为它非常累但仍然想找到出口。喘气显示出它付出了多少努力。**

> Imagine a big race. Everyone is running hard. But there\'s one person who always leads and finishes at the very front. That person is top-ranked. It means being at the highest position or having the best rank. **想象一场大型比赛。每个人都在拼命跑。但有一个人总是领先并最终跑在最前面。那个人就是顶级的。这个词意思是处于最高位置或拥有最好的排名。**

> Imagine a person who refuses to follow the basic values and laws of America. Such behavior is considered un-American. It means going against what is typically considered American, like disrespecting freedom and justice. **想象一个拒绝遵循美国基本价值观和法律的人。这种行为就被认为是'非美国式的'。它意味着违背通常被认为是美国式的东西，比如不尊重自由和正义。**

> One day, I met an old friend at the mall. But he had changed so much with a new hairstyle and strange clothes that he was unrecognizable. I almost passed by without noticing it was him! **有一天，我在商场遇到一位老朋友。但他变化太大了，新发型和奇怪的衣服让他完全无法辨认。我差点走过都没注意到那是他！**
> 小明总是坐不住，注意力很难集中，做事冲动。医生说他可能有 ADHD。原来这是一种会让人难以专注、多动和冲动的问题。大家都努力帮助小明应对，让他能更好地学习和生活。 **小明可能患有注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD），大家帮助他应对这一状况的故事。**

> One day, my friend asked me if I wanted to go for a walk in the park. I immediately said yes. It was a no-brainer because I love being outdoors. **有一天，我的朋友问我是否想去公园散步。我马上就答应了。这是一个无需用脑的决定，因为我喜欢待在户外。**

> Once upon a time, a man won a huge lottery and felt euphoric. His heart was filled with extreme joy and excitement. It was like he was on top of the world. This feeling of being euphoric was unforgettable. **从前，有个人中了巨额彩票，感到欣喜若狂。他的内心充满了极度的喜悦和兴奋，仿佛置身世界之巅。这种欣喜若狂的感觉令人难以忘怀。**

> Imagine being in a room full of mirrors that keep changing. It\'s so confusing and hard to understand. This crazy situation is like a mind-boggling experience. You just can\'t make sense of it all. **想象一下身处一个满是不断变换的镜子的房间。这太令人困惑和难以理解了。这种疯狂的情况就像是令人难以置信的体验。你就是搞不明白。**

> A group of friends was building a treehouse. They faced many difficulties but worked cooperatively. They shared tasks, listened to each other\'s ideas, and finally completed the wonderful treehouse. This shows the meaning of \'cooperatively\'. **一群朋友正在建造一个树屋。他们面临许多困难，但合作地工作。他们分担任务，倾听彼此的想法，最终完成了这个很棒的树屋。这体现了\'cooperatively\'的意思。**

> In a fierce battle, the brave warrior finally vanquished the evil dragon. The warrior\'s strength and determination were so great that the dragon had no chance to resist. After the victory, peace returned to the land. **在一场激烈的战斗中，勇敢的战士最终战胜了邪恶的巨龙。战士的力量和决心如此之大，以至于巨龙毫无抵抗之力。胜利之后，这片土地重归和平。**

> A detective was solving crimes case-by-case. Each case was unique and needed careful examination. Just like this, we should deal with problems one by one, carefully and specifically. **一位侦探在逐个案件地侦破犯罪。每个案件都是独特的，需要仔细审查。就像这样，我们应该一个一个地、仔细且具体地处理问题。**

> Once upon a time, two friends decided to start a business together. They shared profits and responsibilities equally. Their partnership was a win-win situation. Both achieved success and were happy. **从前，两个朋友决定一起创业。他们平均分配利润和责任。他们的合作是一种双赢的局面。两人都取得了成功并且很开心。**

> One day, I was really tired and needed a break. I walked into a coffeehouse. There was a cozy corner with soft music. I ordered a cup of coffee and felt so relaxed. The coffeehouse became my favorite place to unwind. **有一天，我非常累，需要休息一下。我走进一家咖啡馆。那里有个舒适的角落，放着轻柔的音乐。我点了一杯咖啡，感觉非常放松。这家咖啡馆成了我最喜欢的放松之地。**
> A big, strong policeman was always too forceful when dealing with small cases. People said he was heavy-handed. He needed to be more gentle. **一个高大强壮的警察在处理小案件时总是过于强硬。人们说他手段强硬。他需要更温和些。**

> The king was fiscally responsible. He carefully managed the kingdom\'s finances, ensuring no waste. He saved during good times to prepare for fiscally challenging ones. This made the kingdom prosperous. **国王在财政上很负责。他仔细管理王国的财政，确保没有浪费。他在繁荣时期节省，为财政困难时期做准备。这使得王国繁荣昌盛。**

> Once upon a time, a scientist was studying health problems. He found many issues were \'age-related\'. Like weak bones in old people. It means connected to a person\'s age. **从前，有位科学家在研究健康问题。他发现很多状况都是"与年龄相关的"。比如老年人骨骼脆弱。这个词意思是与某人的年龄有关。**

> In a war, the enemy planes were coming. But our soldiers had the powerful anti-aircraft guns. They aimed and fired to protect us from the air attack. Anti-aircraft means designed to stop or fight against aircraft. **在一场战争中，敌机来袭。但我们的士兵有强大的防空炮。他们瞄准并开火以保护我们免受空袭。anti-aircraft 意思是防空的；对付飞机的。**

> A brave detective was investigating a crime. The evil mastermind, fearing exposure, had the detective imprisoned. But the detective\'s spirit never broke, always waiting for a chance to escape and bring justice. **一位勇敢的侦探正在调查一起犯罪案件。邪恶的主谋害怕被揭露，就把侦探监禁了起来。但侦探的精神从未崩溃，一直等待着逃脱的机会并伸张正义。**

> A brave warrior was always in fierce battles. One day, a sharp sword left a deep mark on his face, making him scarred. But he wore the scar as a badge of honor, showing his strength and courage. **一位勇敢的战士总是身处激烈的战斗中。有一天，一把锋利的剑在他脸上留下了深深的痕迹，使他伤痕累累。但他把这道伤疤当作荣誉的徽章，展现着他的力量和勇气。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was lost and needed a place to stay. He found a five-star hotel. It had big rooms, delicious food, and friendly staff. He had a wonderful time and always remembered the five-star experience. **从前，一位旅行者迷路了需要找个地方住。他发现了一家五星级酒店。那里有大房间、美味的食物和友好的员工。他度过了一段美妙的时光，并永远记住了这五星级的体验。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a dark cave. Suddenly, a wild beast attacked him, leaving his body mutilated. But he didn\'t give up and managed to escape. Remember, \'mutilated\' means having body parts severely damaged. **一位勇敢的冒险家正在探索一个黑暗的洞穴。突然，一只野兽袭击了他，使他的身体残缺不全。但他没有放弃并设法逃脱了。记住，\'mutilated\'意思是身体部位严重受损。**

> One day, Tom was playing basketball. He jumped too high and landed awkwardly, spraining his ankle. It hurt a lot and he had to go to the hospital. Poor Tom! Remember, \'sprained\' means injured by twisting a joint. **有一天，汤姆在打篮球。他跳得太高，落地姿势不对，扭伤了脚踝。疼得厉害，他不得不去医院。可怜的汤姆！记住，'sprained'意思是因关节扭曲而受伤。**

> There was a young artist who always pursued new styles. But one day, he met an old-school painter. The painter insisted on traditional techniques and classic themes. This encounter made the artist understand the charm and value of the old ways. **有一位年轻的艺术家总是追求新的风格。但有一天，他遇到了一位守旧派的画家。这位画家坚持传统的技法和经典的主题。这次相遇让这位艺术家明白了旧方式的魅力和价值。**

> One hot summer day, I was very thirsty. Then I found a shop selling sorbet. The cold and sweet sorbet made me feel so refreshed. It was like a magic treat to cool me down. **在一个炎热的夏日，我非常口渴。然后我发现了一家卖冰沙的店。冰凉又香甜的冰沙让我感到神清气爽。它就像是神奇的消暑美食。**

> A thief botched his attempt to steal the jewels. He tripped and made a loud noise, alerting the guards. \'Botched\' here means messed up or done poorly. **一个小偷企图偷珠宝却搞砸了。他绊倒并弄出了很大的声响，惊动了守卫。"botched"在这里意味着搞糟或做得很差。**

> Imagine a race that lasts for six weeks. Everyone is training hard. At the end of the six-week period, the winner is announced. It\'s a long and challenging six-week journey. **想象一场持续六周的比赛。每个人都在努力训练。在这六周结束时，获胜者被宣布。这是一段漫长而具有挑战性的六周之旅。**

> Once upon a time, there was a family. They had a big house, nice cars, and enough money for everything. They were well-off. They could enjoy life without worrying about money. **从前，有一个家庭。他们有大房子、好车，有足够的钱满足一切需求。他们很富裕。他们能够享受生活，无需为钱担忧。**

> A king was distributing rewards indiscriminately. He didn\'t consider the efforts and merits of his subjects. As a result, his kingdom was in chaos. This shows that doing things indiscriminately leads to bad consequences. **一位国王在不加区分地分发奖赏。他不考虑臣民的努力和功绩。结果，他的王国陷入了混乱。这表明不加区分地做事会导致糟糕的后果。**

> A spy was on a secret mission and needed to be disguised. So, he wore a strange costume and changed his appearance. No one recognized him. With this disguise, he completed the mission successfully. **一名间谍在执行秘密任务，需要进行伪装。于是，他穿上了奇怪的服装，改变了自己的外貌。没人认出他。凭借这种伪装，他成功完成了任务。**

> A magician performed on the stage. He made a rabbit vanish in an instant. Everyone was shocked. Just like that, the rabbit completely disappeared, just like the meaning of \'vanished\'. **一位魔术师在舞台上表演。他瞬间让一只兔子消失了。所有人都很震惊。就那样，兔子完全不见了，就像\'vanished\'这个单词所表达的意思。**

> A tourist visited a famous landmark but was unimpressed. He expected it to be grander and more spectacular. However, the reality didn\'t meet his expectations and left him feeling rather indifferent. **一位游客参观了一个著名的地标，但他不为所动。他原本期待它更加宏伟壮观。然而，现实没有达到他的期望，让他感到相当冷漠。**

> Once upon a time, there was a little ant named Amp. It was very strong and could carry heavy things. People remembered it for its power. So, when they saw \'amp\', they thought of this powerful ant. **从前，有一只叫安普的小蚂蚁。它非常强壮，能搬很重的东西。人们因为它的力量记住了它。所以，当他们看到'amp'这个词，就会想起这只有力量的蚂蚁。**

> A brave detective was on a case. He found a cup of juice in the suspect\'s room. After testing, it was discovered to be poisoned. The detective realized the suspect was very dangerous. **一位勇敢的侦探在办案。他在嫌疑人的房间里发现了一杯果汁。经过检测，发现它被下了毒。侦探意识到嫌疑人非常危险。**

> A brave boy named Tom was very nervous before the circumcision. But he gathered courage, knowing it was for his health. Afterward, he felt relieved and stronger. **一个叫汤姆的勇敢男孩在环切手术前非常紧张。但他鼓起勇气，知道这是为了他的健康。之后，他感到如释重负并且更坚强了。**

> One day, a group of friends were playing in the park. When it was time to go home, one of them shouted \'You-all come with me!\' meaning everyone should follow. So, \'you-all\' means all of you. **有一天，一群朋友在公园玩耍。到回家的时候，其中一个人大喊'You-all 跟我来！'，意思是你们所有人都要跟着。所以，'you-all'意思是你们所有人。**

> One day, a detective was using a magnifying glass to search for clues. The magnifying made the tiny details on the crime scene become very clear, helping him solve the mystery. **有一天，一位侦探正在使用放大镜寻找线索。这个放大镜把犯罪现场的微小细节变得非常清晰，帮助他解开了谜团。**

> A brave climber was ascending a mountain. Suddenly, he lost his footing and fell precipitously. It was a terrifying moment. Luckily, he was saved by a rope. \'Precipitously\' here means very quickly and steeply. **一位勇敢的登山者正在登山。突然，他失足陡峭快速地跌落。这是可怕的一刻。幸运的是，一根绳子救了他。这里\'precipitously\'意思是快速陡峭地。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl in a fairy tale. She was very special because she had red-haired. Everyone in the village loved her unique look. Her red-haired shone like fire in the sun. **从前，在一个童话故事里，有一个女孩。她很特别，因为她有一头红发。村里的每个人都喜欢她独特的外表。她的红发在阳光下像火焰一样闪耀。**

> One day, Tom was feeling bored at home. Suddenly, he found a video-game console and started playing. He was completely immersed in the exciting world of the video-game, having a great time and forgetting all his troubles. **一天，汤姆在家感觉很无聊。突然，他发现了一个电子游戏机并开始玩。他完全沉浸在电子游戏令人兴奋的世界里，玩得很开心，忘记了所有烦恼。**

> One day, Tom was asked about the result of an experiment. He answered uncertainly, \'I\'m not sure. Maybe it will succeed, or maybe it will fail.\' This shows his lack of confidence and definite knowledge. **有一天，汤姆被问到一个实验的结果。他不确定地回答道："我不确定。也许会成功，也许会失败。"这显示出他缺乏信心和明确的认知。**

> Imagine a person who always doubts himself. One day, he decides to look inside and understand his true self. This process of looking within and knowing oneself is called self-perception. **想象一个总是自我怀疑的人。有一天，他决定审视内心并了解真正的自己。这种审视内心和了解自己的过程就叫做自我认知。**

> A sailor was on a ship. Suddenly, a huge storm hit and the ship was wrecked. The sailor struggled to survive and was very scared. \'Wrecked\' means damaged or destroyed completely. **一名水手在一艘船上。突然，一场巨大的风暴袭来，船被毁坏了。水手努力求生，非常害怕。\'wrecked\'意思是完全损坏或摧毁。**

> In a fictional land, a villain named Anti-Communist was always trying to undermine the fair and equal society that the communists were building. But in the end, his evil plans were exposed and defeated. **在一个虚构的国度，有个叫反共产主义者的坏蛋，总是企图破坏共产党人正在建设的公平和平等的社会。但最终，他的邪恶计划被曝光并被挫败。**
> 想象一下，一场电影拍摄中，主演突然生病，这时候有个和主演很像的人挺身而出，临时替代主演完成拍摄，这个人就是 stand-in，也就是替身。 **想象在电影拍摄中，主演生病时挺身而出临时替代主演的人就是【替身】**

> One day, Tom was in a hurry to get to work. He was running along the street and suddenly had a run-in with a delivery man. They almost collided, but luckily stopped in time. **一天，汤姆匆忙赶去上班。他沿着街道跑，突然和一个快递员发生了冲突。他们差点撞在一起，但幸运的是及时停住了。**

> A farmer was very happy because his crops were cropped successfully. The harvested grains filled the barn. Cropped here means harvested or cut short. **一位农民非常高兴，因为他的庄稼成功收割了。收获的谷物装满了谷仓。这里的cropped意思是收割或剪短。**

> A poor student spent countless nights studying hard. Finally, he got a high score. The money he earned from a scholarship was hard-earned. It was the result of his perseverance and effort. **一个贫困的学生花费了无数个夜晚努力学习。最终，他取得了高分。他从奖学金中获得的钱是来之不易的。这是他坚持不懈和努力的结果。**

> One day, a plane was in the sky. Suddenly, some bad guys broke into the cockpit and took control of the plane. This action was called hijacking. It was a terrifying and dangerous situation. **有一天，一架飞机在天上。突然，一些坏人闯进驾驶舱并控制了飞机。这种行为被称为劫持。这是一个可怕又危险的情况。**

> A spy was sent on a mission but got compromised. His cover was blown and he was in danger. \'Compromised\' here means exposed or put in a vulnerable position. The spy\'s secret was no longer safe. **一名间谍被派去执行任务，但身份暴露了。他的伪装被识破，陷入危险。"compromised"在这里指的是被揭露或处于易受攻击的境地。间谍的秘密不再安全。**
> 想象一下，一场精彩的足球比赛，比赛的第一个季度(first-quarter)，球员们精力充沛，积极进攻。观众们兴奋不已，期待着更多精彩瞬间。这就是 first-quarter，最初的四分之一时间。 **想象足球赛第一个四分之一时间的场景来辅助记忆 first-quarter 这个表示第一季度的单词**

> Once upon a time, there was a special book. It was divided into three parts. Each part had its own unique story. This book was called a \'three-part\' one. People loved it for its clear structure. **从前，有一本特别的书。它被分成了三个部分。每个部分都有自己独特的故事。这本书被称为"由三部分组成的"。人们喜欢它清晰的结构。**

> Once upon a time, a team spent a lot of time and effort to create a building. It was praised as well-designed because every detail was perfect, from the layout to the decoration. People loved it very much. **从前，一个团队花费了大量时间和精力建造了一座大楼。它被称赞为精心设计的，因为从布局到装饰，每个细节都很完美。人们非常喜欢它。**

> One day, Tom went to look for treasure. He searched everywhere but found nothing. Finally, he returned home empty-handed. It means having nothing in your hands when you expected to have something. **一天，汤姆去寻宝。他到处寻找但什么也没找到。最后，他空手而归。意思是当你期望有所收获时，手里却什么都没有。**

> A girl was flushed when she saw her idol. Her face turned red like a ripe apple because she was so excited and nervous. This is how we remember \'flushed\' means having a red face. **一个女孩看到她的偶像时脸红了。她的脸变得像一个熟透的苹果一样红，因为她非常兴奋和紧张。这就是我们记住\'flushed\'表示脸红的方式。**

> A blind man was always longing to be sighted. One day, a miracle happened and he could finally see the beautiful world. From then on, he cherished every sighted moment. **一个盲人一直渴望能看得见。有一天，奇迹发生了，他终于能看到美丽的世界。从此，他珍惜每一个能看见的时刻。**

> Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a trend of Americanization. People started wearing American-style clothes, eating American food, and even speaking English like Americans. This was the process of Americanization. **从前，在一个小镇上，出现了美国化的趋势。人们开始穿美式服装，吃美式食物，甚至像美国人一样说英语。这就是美国化的过程。**

> A little bird was standing on a branch, quivering in the cold wind. Its feathers were shaking, and it looked very scared. Just then, a kind girl came and covered it with a warm blanket. The bird stopped quivering and felt safe. **一只小鸟站在树枝上，在寒风中颤抖。它的羽毛抖动着，看起来非常害怕。就在这时，一个善良的女孩过来，用温暖的毯子盖住了它。小鸟不再颤抖，感到安全了。**

> In a sports competition, Tom was excited as it was the second-round. He trained hard, hoping to win this round and move forward. The second-round was a crucial step towards the championship. **在一场体育比赛中，汤姆很兴奋，因为这是第二轮。他努力训练，希望能赢得这一轮并继续前进。第二轮是迈向冠军的关键一步。**

> A brave climber was scaling a mountain. Suddenly, he saw a strong chain-link fence blocking his way. But with determination, he found a way around it and continued his adventure. The chain-link was like a challenge to overcome. **一位勇敢的登山者正在攀登一座山。突然，他看到一个坚固的链环围栏挡住了他的路。但凭借决心，他找到了绕过它的方法，并继续他的冒险。链环就像一个需要克服的挑战。**

> One day, a little boy was asked how old his grandpa was. He shouted, \'Ninety-nine!\' Everyone was amazed. Grandpa had lived such a long and wonderful life. Now you remember, ninety-nine means 99. **有一天，一个小男孩被问到他爷爷多大年纪了。他大喊："九十九！" 每个人都很惊讶。爷爷已经度过了如此漫长而美好的一生。现在你记住，ninety-nine 意思是 99。**

> One day, I was in a park and saw a strange vehicle. It had FOUR big wheels and looked very cool. I was so amazed by this FOUR-WHEEL thing. Later I learned it was a special kind of ATV. **有一天，我在公园看到一个奇怪的交通工具。它有四个大轮子，看起来非常酷。我对这个四轮的东西感到很惊讶。后来我才知道这是一种特殊的全地形车。**

> A hardworking doctor was always on duty. One day, he felt extremely tired and exhausted. His colleagues said he was burned-out. It means being completely worn out and lacking energy. **一位勤奋的医生总是值班。有一天，他感到极度疲倦和精疲力竭。他的同事说他累垮了。这个词意思是完全耗尽精力，毫无活力。**

> A dilapidated old house was renovated. Workers painted the walls, fixed the roof, and replaced the old furniture. Now it looks brand new and beautiful. **一座破旧的老房子被翻新了。工人们粉刷了墙壁，修好了屋顶，还更换了旧家具。现在它看起来崭新又漂亮。**

> There was a student named Lily. She was not only good at studies but also excelled in sports and art. Everyone said she was well-rounded. She could handle various tasks and challenges easily. **有个叫莉莉的学生。她不仅学习好，在体育和艺术方面也很出色。大家都说她是全能的。她能轻松应对各种任务和挑战。**

> One day, my car wouldn\'t start. But a kind mechanic came and used a special tool to jump-start the engine. It made the car run again. So, jump-start means to give something a sudden push to make it begin or work. **有一天，我的车发动不了。但一位好心的机械师来了，用一个特殊的工具来启动引擎。车又能跑了。所以，jump-start 意思是给某物一个突然的推动，使其开始或运转。**

> Once upon a time, there was a bird that was high-flying. It soared through the sky, higher and higher. It showed great ambition and success, just like a person with big dreams and achievements. **从前，有一只高飞的鸟。它在天空中翱翔，越飞越高。它展现出了极大的抱负和成功，就像一个有着远大梦想和成就的人。**

> A young artist was painting, but he was only half-hearted. He didn\'t put his full effort and passion. As a result, his painting was not good. This shows that being half-hearted leads to poor results. **一位年轻的艺术家在画画，但他只是半心半意。他没有投入全部的努力和热情。结果，他的画并不好。这表明半心半意会导致糟糕的结果。**

> A poor student wanted to buy a laptop but worried about affordability. Then he found a part-time job and saved money. Finally, he could afford the laptop he needed. **一个贫困的学生想买一台笔记本电脑，但担心支付能力。然后他找了一份兼职工作并攒钱。最终，他能够买得起他需要的笔记本电脑。**

> Once upon a time, there was a baker who was very proud of his whole-wheat bread. He told everyone that the whole-wheat made the bread healthier and more delicious. People loved his bread and always came back for more. **从前，有个面包师，他对自己的全麦面包非常自豪。他告诉每个人全麦让面包更健康更美味。人们喜欢他的面包，总是回头购买。**

> One day, I was walking and saw a sign with the number \'52\'. I wondered why it was so special. Then I realized it was \'fifty-two\' and thought of 52 weeks in a year. It made me remember this word easily. **有一天，我在散步时看到一个写着数字"52"的标志。我好奇为什么它如此特别。然后我意识到它是"五十二"，并想到了一年中的 52 周。这让我很容易就记住了这个单词。**

> One day, Tom was late for school. His teacher was angry and said, \'Why didn\'t you shave this morning?\' Tom replied, \'I was in a hurry and forgot.\' So, \'shaved\' means to remove hair from the face or body with a razor. **一天，汤姆上学迟到了。他的老师很生气地说：'你今早为什么不刮胡子？'汤姆回答：'我太着急了，忘了。'所以，'shaved'意思是用剃刀除去脸上或身上的毛发。**

> A thief unabashedly stole a bag in the market. But a brave policeman caught him quickly. The thief showed no shame at all, which is what \'unabashedly\' means - without shame or embarrassment. **一个小偷毫不羞愧地在市场里偷了一个包。但一位勇敢的警察很快抓住了他。这个小偷一点都不觉得难为情，这就是\'unabashedly\'的意思------毫无羞愧或尴尬。**

> One day, a little mouse was very hungry. It found a delicious croissant in a bakery. The croissant looked like a crescent moon and smelled so good. The mouse happily ate it and felt full. **一天，一只小老鼠非常饿。它在一家面包店发现了一个美味的羊角面包。这个羊角面包看起来像一弯新月，闻起来很香。老鼠开心地吃了它，感觉饱饱的。**

> One early-morning, when the sun was just peeking over the horizon, I woke up feeling fresh. I decided to go for a jog and enjoy the peaceful and beautiful scene. It was such a wonderful early-morning. **一天清晨，太阳刚刚从地平线探出头，我醒来感觉神清气爽。我决定去慢跑，享受这宁静而美丽的景色。这是一个如此美妙的清晨。**

> A young man named Tom was always in a rush. He lived in a fast-paced city, running from one meeting to another. His life was like a speeding train, never stopping. \'Fast-paced\' describes this kind of busy and rapid lifestyle. **一个叫汤姆的年轻人总是很匆忙。他生活在一个快节奏的城市里，从一个会议赶到另一个会议。他的生活就像一列飞驰的火车，从未停歇。'fast-paced'形容的就是这种忙碌快速的生活方式。**

> A man was searching for his long-lost sister. After years of efforts, he finally found her. The reunion was filled with joy and tears. They had been apart for so long but their bond was still strong. **一个男人一直在寻找他失散已久的妹妹。经过多年的努力，他终于找到了她。重逢充满了喜悦和泪水。他们分开了很久，但感情依旧深厚。**

> Once upon a time, a Euro-American traveler was exploring different cultures. He had the charm of Europe and the spirit of America. His journey showed the blend of these two great influences. **从前，有一位欧裔美国人旅行者正在探索不同的文化。他有着欧洲的魅力和美国的精神。他的旅程展示了这两种巨大影响的融合。**

> A teenaged boy named Tom was always dreaming of becoming a famous singer. One day, he got a chance to perform on stage. His teenaged passion and courage made him shine. **一个名叫汤姆的十几岁的男孩一直梦想成为一名著名的歌手。有一天，他得到了一个在舞台上表演的机会。他十几岁时的热情和勇气让他大放异彩。**

> One night, a man went to a party and drank too much. His staggering steps and slurred speech showed his drunkenness. He couldn\'t even stand still and had trouble remembering where he was. Poor guy! **一天晚上，一个男人去参加聚会，喝了太多酒。他蹒跚的脚步和含糊不清的话语显示出他的醉态。他甚至站不稳，也记不清自己在哪里。可怜的家伙！**

> A young climber showed gutsy spirit when facing a difficult mountain. He didn\'t give up and finally reached the top. His gutsy actions inspired others. **一位年轻的登山者在面对一座艰难的山峰时展现出了勇敢的精神。他没有放弃，最终到达了山顶。他勇敢的行为激励了其他人。**

> One day, I went to an Indian restaurant. The chef told me the special sauce for the dish was chutney. It was a sweet and spicy mix that made the food incredibly delicious. Now whenever I think of chutney, I remember that amazing meal. **有一天，我去了一家印度餐厅。厨师告诉我这道菜的特色酱料是酸辣酱（chutney）。它是一种甜辣混合的酱料，让食物变得极其美味。现在每当我想到酸辣酱，就会想起那顿美妙的餐食。**

> Once upon a time, there was a special necklace. It was one-of-a-kind, meaning there was no other like it in the whole world. It was unique and precious. No one could find another necklace exactly the same. **从前，有一条特别的项链。它是独一无二的，这意味着在整个世界上都没有其他像它一样的。它是独特且珍贵的。没有人能找到另一条完全相同的项链。**

> A little mouse was walking peacefully in the forest. Suddenly, a big owl appeared startlingly and scared the mouse away. The word \'startlingly\' describes how unexpectedly and shockingly the owl showed up. **一只小老鼠正在森林里安静地走着。突然，一只大猫头鹰惊人地出现，把老鼠吓跑了。单词\'startlingly\'描述的就是猫头鹰出现得多么出乎意料和令人震惊。**

> Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom. He had no teachers but was determined to learn. Through his own efforts and study, he became self-taught in many skills. Finally, he achieved great success. **从前，有个叫汤姆的人。他没有老师，但决心学习。通过自己的努力和钻研，他在很多技能方面自学成才。最终，他取得了巨大的成功。**

> Imagine a black entrepreneur who starts a successful business. People call it a \'black-owned\' company. It means the business is owned and controlled by someone who is black. This shows the pride and effort of black business owners. **想象一位黑人企业家开办了一家成功的企业。人们称其为'black-owned（黑人所有的）'公司。这意味着这家企业由黑人拥有和控制。这展现了黑人企业主的骄傲和努力。**

> In a baseball game, the pitcher was amazing. He didn\'t allow any hits from the opposing team. This feat is called a \'no-hitter\'. Everyone was cheering for him. It was a thrilling moment. **在一场棒球比赛中，投手表现惊人。他不让对方队伍击中任何球。这种壮举被称为"无安打比赛"。每个人都为他欢呼。这是一个激动人心的时刻。**

> A powerful tornado came and destroyed everything in the small town. Houses collapsed, trees were uprooted. It was a scene of total chaos. People were heartbroken as their peaceful life was destroyed in an instant. **一场强大的龙卷风袭来，摧毁了小镇的一切。房屋倒塌，树木被连根拔起。这是一片完全混乱的景象。人们心碎不已，因为他们平静的生活瞬间被摧毁。**

> A detective was profiling a criminal. He collected all the details about the criminal\'s habits and behaviors. By profiling, he hoped to catch the criminal quickly. **一位侦探正在对一名罪犯进行特征分析。他收集了关于罪犯习惯和行为的所有细节。通过特征分析，他希望能迅速抓住罪犯。**

> One day, Tom made a bad decision. His parents looked at him with disapproving eyes. They shook their heads, showing their dissatisfaction. Tom understood that their looks meant they didn\'t agree with what he did. **一天，汤姆做了一个糟糕的决定。他的父母用不赞同的眼神看着他。他们摇着头，表现出不满。汤姆明白他们的表情意味着他们不同意他的所作所为。**

> Once upon a time, a little boy named Tom lost his way. When asked where he lived, he could only stammer \'Yer\' as he was too scared to remember the exact address. Finally, kind people helped him find his home. **从前，有个叫汤姆的小男孩迷路了。当被问到住在哪里时，他因为太害怕，只能结结巴巴地说'yer'，记不清确切地址。最后，好心人帮他找到了家。**

> Imagine a family. The first generation works hard to build a foundation. The second generation expands it. Now, the third-generation comes along, bringing new ideas and innovations. They are the \'third-generation\' of this family, carrying on and evolving. **想象一个家庭。第一代努力打下基础。第二代进行拓展。现在，第三代出现了，带来新的想法和创新。他们就是这个家庭的"第三代"，传承并发展着。**

> One day, a little monkey was trying to count. It counted from one to forty-five smoothly, but then got stuck at forty-six. It scratched its head and finally remembered after much effort. **一天，一只小猴子正在努力数数。它从 1 顺利数到了 45，但在 46 这里卡住了。它挠挠头，费了好大劲终于记住了。**

> A group of friends were assigned a difficult project. At first, they worked separately and faced many problems. But when they started cooperating, sharing ideas and helping each other, the project went smoothly. They learned the power of cooperating. **一群朋友被分配了一个困难的项目。起初，他们各自工作，面临很多问题。但当他们开始合作，分享想法并互相帮助时，项目进展顺利。他们领略到了合作的力量。**

> In a basketball game, the team was losing. But at the last moment, our star player made a brilliant shot from far away. It was a three-pointer that turned the game around and made everyone cheer. **在一场篮球比赛中，球队处于落后。但在最后一刻，我们的明星球员从远处投出了一记精彩的投篮。这是一个三分球，扭转了比赛局势，让所有人欢呼。**

> Long ago, a simple creature started a journey. Through many challenges and changes, it gradually grew and changed. Eventually, it evolved into a complex and wonderful being. This is how evolution works - like the word \'evolved\'. **很久以前，一个简单的生物开始了一段旅程。历经许多挑战和变化，它逐渐成长和改变。最终，它进化成了一个复杂而奇妙的存在。这就是进化的过程------就像单词'evolved'所表达的那样。**

> Once upon a time, in a land long-ago, there was a beautiful princess. She lived in a big castle and had many adventures. People still talk about her story today. **从前，在很久以前的一片土地上，有一位美丽的公主。她住在一座大城堡里，有许多冒险经历。人们至今仍在谈论她的故事。**

> A young man always carried a big backpack and traveled around the world. People called him a backpacker. He explored new places, met different people, and had many wonderful adventures with his trusty backpack. **一个年轻人总是背着一个大背包环游世界。人们称他为背包客。他带着他可靠的背包探索新地方，结识不同的人，并有许多奇妙的冒险经历。**

> One day, I was on a long flight. The plane was on autopilot, which meant it could fly by itself without the pilot constantly controlling. It was like a magic system that made the journey smooth and safe. **有一天，我在一次长途飞行中。飞机处于自动驾驶状态，这意味着它可以自行飞行，无需飞行员持续控制。这就像一个神奇的系统，让旅程平稳又安全。**

> A microbiologist named Lily was always in her lab, studying tiny creatures. One day, she discovered a new microbe that could change the world. Her passion for microbes made her a great microbiologist. **一位名叫莉莉的微生物学家总是在她的实验室里，研究微小生物。有一天，她发现了一种能改变世界的新微生物。她对微生物的热情使她成为了一位出色的微生物学家。**

> A group of friends were playing darts. One friend\'s throws were always skewed, never hitting the center. It made everyone laugh. Later they realized it was because the dartboard was not placed straight. \'Skewed\' means not straight or distorted. **一群朋友在玩飞镖。有个朋友的投掷总是歪斜的，从未击中中心。这让大家都笑了。后来他们发现是因为镖靶没放正。\'skewed\'意思是不直的、歪斜的、扭曲的。**

> One day, I was at the store and saw a price tag of ninety-five dollars on a beautiful dress. I thought it was a bit expensive but still considered buying it. It made me remember the number ninety-five easily. **有一天，我在商店里看到一件漂亮的裙子标价 95 美元。我觉得有点贵但还是考虑买它。这让我很容易就记住了 95 这个数字。**

> A professor worked hard for years. Finally, he got tenured, meaning he had a secure job position at the university. No more worries about being fired easily. It was like finding a stable home after a long journey. **一位教授辛勤工作多年。最终，他获得了终身教职，这意味着他在大学里有了一个稳定的工作职位。再也不用担心轻易被解雇。这就像在长途旅行后找到了一个安稳的家。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler was looking for a special hotel. He finally found a four-star one. It had big rooms, nice food, and friendly staff. The four-star sign meant top quality and comfort. **从前，有一位旅行者在寻找一家特别的酒店。他最终找到了一家四星级的。它有大房间、美味的食物和友好的员工。四星级的标志意味着顶级的质量和舒适。**

> A tiger was pent-up in a small cage. It was full of pent-up energy and anger. When the cage was finally opened, it burst out with great force. Remember, \'pent-up\' means held in or repressed. **一只老虎被关在一个小笼子里。它充满了被压抑的能量和愤怒。当笼子最终被打开时，它猛地冲了出来。记住，\'pent-up\'意思是被抑制的，被压抑的。**

> Once upon a time, there was a person named Tom. He was an Afro-American. He faced many challenges but was proud of his heritage. His strength and determination showed the spirit of Afro-American people. **从前，有个人叫汤姆。他是一位非裔美国人。他面临许多挑战，但为自己的传统感到骄傲。他的力量和决心展现了非裔美国人的精神。**

> A researcher was confused about various studies. Then he discovered meta-analysis, which is like a magic key. It helps combine and analyze all those studies to get clear and useful conclusions. **一位研究人员对各种研究感到困惑。然后他发现了元分析，这就像一把神奇的钥匙。它有助于合并和分析所有那些研究，以得出清晰和有用的结论。**

> One winter day, I went for a walk in the mountains. Everywhere I looked was snow-covered. The trees, the ground, even the small paths were all hidden under a thick blanket of white snow. It was a beautiful and peaceful scene. **在一个冬日，我去山里散步。目光所及之处皆是白雪覆盖。树木、地面，甚至是小小的路径都被厚厚的白雪所掩盖。那是一幅美丽而宁静的景象。**

> In a fierce hockey game, the team was in trouble. But the defenseman was like a brave warrior. He blocked the opponent\'s attacks again and again, protecting the goal. Remember, a \'defenseman\' is one who defends in sports! **在一场激烈的曲棍球比赛中，球队陷入困境。但防守队员就像勇敢的战士。他一次又一次地阻挡对手的进攻，守护球门。记住，\'defenseman\'就是体育比赛中的防守队员！**

> Once upon a time, there was a brave soldier from Prussian. He fought bravely in many battles. His blue uniform and shiny helmet made him stand out. People always remember the strength and courage of Prussian soldiers. **从前，有一位来自普鲁士的勇敢士兵。他在许多战役中英勇作战。他的蓝色制服和闪亮的头盔使他脱颖而出。人们总是记得普鲁士士兵的力量和勇气。**

> Imagine you are on a long journey and very tired. Suddenly, you find a place that offers food, rest and all the services you need in one place. That place is a one-stop shop. It means providing all necessary services or items at one location. **想象一下你在长途旅行中，非常疲惫。突然，你发现一个能提供食物、休息和所有你需要的服务的地方，都在一处。这个地方就是一站式的。one-stop 这个词意思是在一个地方提供所有必要的服务或物品。**

> The Hopi people have a unique culture. They are known for their beautiful art and traditional dances. Imagine visiting their village and seeing their colorful ceremonies. Remember, Hopi refers to this special group of people. **霍皮族人有着独特的文化。他们以美丽的艺术和传统舞蹈而闻名。想象一下参观他们的村庄，看到他们色彩缤纷的仪式。记住，Hopi 指的就是这个特殊的族群。**

> Once upon a time, in a magical land, a group of friends were engaged in role-playing. They pretended to be wizards and warriors, each taking on a special role. It was so much fun and they really enjoyed the experience of role-playing. **从前，在一片神奇的土地上，一群朋友在进行角色扮演。他们假装是巫师和战士，每个人都承担着一个特殊的角色。这太有趣了，他们真的很享受角色扮演的体验。**

> One day, at a baseball game, everyone noticed a player who was a left-hander. He threw the ball with his left hand so differently that it caught everyone\'s attention. It was amazing how he used his left hand to play so well. **有一天，在一场棒球比赛中，所有人都注意到了一个左撇子球员。他用左手投球的方式非常与众不同，吸引了所有人的目光。他用左手能打得这么好，真是太令人惊奇了。**

> One day, a brave scientist was exploring deep in a cave. Suddenly, he detected a mysterious light - the gamma-ray. It was like a magic beam from another world, shining with unknown power and secrets. **有一天，一位勇敢的科学家在洞穴深处探索。突然，他探测到一束神秘的光------伽马射线。它就像来自另一个世界的神奇光束，闪耀着未知的力量和秘密。**

> At Christmastime, Santa Claus rides his sleigh through the snowy night. Kids wait excitedly for presents. Families gather around the decorated tree, singing carols and sharing joy. It\'s a magical time full of love and happiness. **在圣诞节期间，圣诞老人乘着他的雪橇穿过雪夜。孩子们兴奋地等待礼物。家人们围在装饰好的圣诞树旁，唱着颂歌，分享着快乐。这是一个充满爱和幸福的神奇时刻。**

> Once upon a time, I went to an amusement park. I was so excited to ride the roller-coaster. It went up and down, fast and slow, giving me a thrilling experience. **从前，我去了一个游乐园。我非常兴奋地去坐过山车。它上下起伏，时快时慢，给了我一次惊心动魄的体验。**

> A little rabbit played in the garden and accidentally soiled its white fur. It had to go back home and clean itself. Poor rabbit! Remember, soiled means made dirty or stained. **一只小兔子在花园里玩耍，不小心弄脏了它白色的毛。它不得不回家清洗自己。可怜的兔子！记住，soiled 意思是弄脏、玷污。**

> A brave diver ventured into the deep-sea. It was so dark and mysterious. He saw strange creatures and colorful corals. The depth and beauty of the deep-sea left a lasting impression on him. **一位勇敢的潜水员冒险进入深海。那里又黑又神秘。他看到了奇怪的生物和五颜六色的珊瑚。深海的深度和美丽给他留下了深刻的印象。**

> A little boy was struggling to climb a tree. A kind girl used an assistive ladder to help him. The boy was so happy and thanked the girl. The ladder here is like the meaning of assistive, providing help. **一个小男孩努力爬树却爬不上去。一个善良的女孩用一个辅助性的梯子帮助了他。小男孩非常高兴并感谢了女孩。这里的梯子就像 assistive 的意思，提供帮助。**

> A young designer was working hard on a project. He needed a full-page illustration to make it perfect. After days of effort, he finally created a beautiful full-page design that impressed everyone. **一位年轻的设计师正在努力做一个项目。他需要一幅整页的插图来使其完美。经过几天的努力，他终于创作出了一幅令人印象深刻的整页设计。**

> A director was in charge of a film. He directed every scene carefully. The actors followed his directions and the movie turned out great. Remember, \'directed\' means guided or managed. **一位导演负责一部电影。他仔细地指导每一个场景。演员们遵循他的指示，电影最终很棒。记住，\'directed\'意思是指导、管理。**

> A man was lost in his life. But one day, he had a powerful experience and became a born-again person. He changed his bad habits, started to be kind and positive. Now he lives a new and better life. **一个男人曾在生活中迷失。但有一天，他有了一次强大的经历，变成了一个重生的人。他改掉了坏习惯，开始变得善良和积极。现在他过上了全新且更好的生活。**

> 在遥远的星系中，有一艘红色的飞船。每当它快速飞行时，周围的光线就会发生奇特的变化，形成一种被称为\'redshift\'的现象，仿佛红色的光芒在拉伸。 **在天文学中，指光波因天体的退行而向光谱的红端移动的现象，即红移。**

> A knight found a double-edged sword. It could be very powerful in battle but also dangerous if not handled properly. > A factory was undergoing dismantling. Workers carefully took apart the machines, piece by piece. It was a complex process, but they were determined. \'Dismantling\' means to take apart or break down something. **一家工厂正在被拆除。工人们小心翼翼地把机器一块一块地拆开。这是一个复杂的过程，但他们很坚决。'dismantling'意思是拆开或拆除某物。**

> Imagine a football game. It\'s the third-quarter. The teams are giving their all. The score is close. This is the crucial third-quarter that decides the final outcome. **想象一场足球比赛。现在是第三节。球队们都全力以赴。比分很接近。这关键的第三节决定着最终的结果。**

> In a kingdom, all the important decisions were made by men. It was a male-dominated society. Women had little say. But one brave woman fought to change this, showing that such a system wasn\'t fair. **在一个王国里，所有重要的决定都由男人做出。这是一个男性主导的社会。女性几乎没有发言权。但一位勇敢的女性努力去改变这一状况，表明这种体制是不公平的。**

> There was a mysterious house with a gated entrance. A brave boy wanted to explore. But the gate was locked. Finally, he found the key and entered. The \'gated\' entrance protected the secrets inside. **有一座神秘的房子，入口处有一扇带门的。一个勇敢的男孩想要探索。但门是锁着的。最后，他找到了钥匙并进入。这扇'有门的'入口保护着里面的秘密。**

> A car was driving on a mountain road. Suddenly, it stalled. The driver was very worried. He tried to restart the engine many times but failed. Finally, a mechanic came and fixed the problem. **一辆汽车正在山路上行驶。突然，它熄火了。司机非常担心。他多次尝试重新启动引擎，但都失败了。最后，一位机械师来了并解决了问题。**

> A group of young people decided to go against the mainstream. They formed a counterculture, wearing unique clothes and having different ideas. They wanted to show that there\'s another way to live and think. **一群年轻人决定反主流。他们形成了一种反文化，穿着独特的衣服，有着不同的想法。他们想要表明还有另一种生活和思考的方式。**

> A young man\'s home was hit by a powerful typhoon. Everything was in ruins. He felt devastated, as if his world had collapsed. But he decided to rebuild and rise again. **一个年轻人的家被一场强台风袭击了。一切都成了废墟。他感到极度崩溃，仿佛他的世界崩塌了。但他决定重建并重新崛起。**

> 想象一个蓝色的芯片，它是世界上最先进、最可靠的芯片。就像那些业绩优秀、稳定可靠的蓝筹公司一样。所以 blue-chip 就是指蓝筹股、热门的优质股票。 **想象一个蓝色芯片代表优质可靠的股票，解释 blue-chip 意为蓝筹股、热门的优质股票**

> A poor artist was painting in the street. Everyone ignored him. But when he showed a very eye-catching painting of a beautiful bird, people stopped and gathered around. The painting was so attractive that it caught everyone\'s eyes. **一位贫穷的艺术家正在街头作画。大家都不理睬他。但当他展示出一幅非常引人注目的美丽鸟儿的画作时，人们都停了下来并围了过去。这幅画太有吸引力了，吸引了所有人的目光。**

> Imagine two political parties constantly fighting. But one day, they decide to work together for the common good. This act of coming together and cooperating is called bipartisanship. **想象两个政党一直在争斗。但有一天，他们决定为了共同的利益一起合作。这种走到一起并合作的行为就被称为两党合作。**

> At the year-end, Santa Claus was busy preparing gifts for children. He checked his list to make sure no one was missed. It was a time of joy and celebration. **在年终的时候，圣诞老人正忙着为孩子们准备礼物。他核对他的名单以确保没有人被遗漏。这是欢乐和庆祝的时刻。**

> A company was facing difficulties. The boss decided to make a reassessment. They checked all aspects, found new solutions, and finally turned the situation around. Reassessment means to assess again. **一家公司面临困境。老板决定进行重新评估。他们检查了各个方面，找到了新的解决方案，最终扭转了局面。reassessment 意思是重新评估。**

> Imagine a big competition. All the products are fighting to be the best. The one that gets the most praise and is at the very top is the top-rated one. It\'s like the winner of a race, standing out among all the others. **想象一场大型竞赛。所有的产品都在力争成为最好的。那个获得最多称赞并且处于最顶端的就是顶级的、一流的。它就像赛跑的冠军，在所有其他产品中脱颖而出。**

> A long time ago, in a small village, there was a tradition that was long-held. It was the custom of sharing food during harvest. This tradition had been passed down for generations and was deeply rooted in the hearts of the villagers. **很久以前，在一个小村庄里，有一个长期以来一直保持的传统。那就是在丰收时分享食物。这个传统已经传承了好几代，深深扎根在村民们的心中。**

> Once upon a time, in a land full of merchants, there was no barrier for trade. Goods could move freely. This situation was called \'free-trade\', meaning trade without restrictions or excessive regulations. **从前，在一个充满商人的国度，贸易没有障碍。货物可以自由流动。这种情况被称为"自由贸易"，意思是没有限制或过多规定的贸易。**

> A famous singer was highly praised, but when I went to his concert, I found his performance overrated. The sound was bad and he seemed not in a good mood. It made me understand that something might be praised more than it deserves. **一位著名歌手备受称赞，但当我去他的演唱会时，我发现他的表现被高估了。音响很差，他似乎心情也不好。这让我明白有些东西可能被赞誉过度了。**

> One day, I was shopping and saw a beautiful dress with a brand-name tag. I knew it was of high quality because of that well-known brand. The brand-name gave me confidence in my choice. **有一天，我在购物时看到一件漂亮的裙子，上面有一个品牌名称的标签。因为那个知名品牌，我知道它质量很好。这个品牌名称让我对自己的选择充满信心。**

> A brave adventurer was undeterred by the fierce storm and the dangerous path. He kept going forward, believing he would reach the hidden treasure. His determination showed what undeterred means - not being stopped or discouraged. **一位勇敢的冒险家没有被狂风暴雨和危险的道路吓倒。他继续前进，相信自己能找到隐藏的宝藏。他的决心展现了undeterred的意思------未被阻止或气馁。**

> Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sabine. She loved to explore the forest. One day, she found a hidden cave and inside was a magical book. Sabine\'s adventure began. **从前，有个叫萨宾的女孩。她喜欢探索森林。有一天，她发现了一个隐藏的洞穴，里面有一本神奇的书。萨宾的冒险开始了。**

> A company was in trouble because of bad public-relations. But a smart PR expert came and organized many helpful events. People loved them and the company\'s image improved. **一家公司因公共关系不佳陷入困境。但一位聪明的公关专家来了，组织了许多有益的活动。人们喜欢这些活动，公司的形象得到了改善。**

> A detective was investigating a crime scene. Every detail was handled impeccably. No mistakes, no flaws. Just like the detective\'s work, impeccably means in a perfect and faultless way. **一位侦探正在调查犯罪现场。每个细节都处理得无可挑剔。没有错误，没有瑕疵。就像这位侦探的工作一样，impeccably 意思是以完美无缺的方式。**

> A brave adventurer was exploring a mysterious cave. Inside, everything was abnormally quiet. No sounds of animals or water. It was so strange and unlike any other place he\'d been. This made him very cautious. **一位勇敢的探险家正在探索一个神秘的洞穴。里面异常安静。没有动物的声音，也没有水流声。这太奇怪了，和他去过的任何地方都不一样。这让他非常谨慎。**

> A king wanted to control his kingdom strictly. So, he decided to criminalize even the smallest bad behaviors. This made people very scared. But in the end, his plan backfired and caused chaos. **一位国王想要严格控制他的王国。于是，他决定把哪怕是最小的不良行为都定为犯罪。这让人们非常害怕。但最后，他的计划适得其反，引发了混乱。**

> A patient was struggling with drug addiction. The doctor prescribed methadone to help him recover. Methadone acted as a key to unlock his path to a healthy life. **一位患者正与毒瘾作斗争。医生开了美沙酮来帮助他康复。美沙酮就像是一把钥匙，开启了他走向健康生活的道路。**
> A city was destroyed by a disaster. But the people were determined. They worked hard and REBUILT it. They made it even better than before. **一个城市被一场灾难摧毁了。但是人们意志坚定。他们努力工作并重建了它。他们把它建得比以前更好。**

> Once upon a time, a young couple was looking for a new home. They found a lovely one-bedroom apartment. It had just one bedroom, but it was cozy and perfect for them. They were so happy to have their own little space. **从前，一对年轻夫妇正在寻找一个新家。他们发现了一个可爱的一居室公寓。它只有一个卧室，但很舒适，对他们来说很完美。他们很高兴拥有自己的小空间。**

> In a faraway land, there was a village constantly plagued by war. Buildings were destroyed, and people lived in fear. This village was war-torn, its peace and beauty shattered by the endless battles. **在一个遥远的地方，有一个村庄不断受到战争的困扰。建筑物被摧毁，人们生活在恐惧之中。这个村庄饱受战争摧残，它的和平与美丽被无休止的战斗所破坏。**

> Once upon a time, there was a superhero who was larger-than-life. He could fly higher and stronger than anyone. His presence was so powerful that people always felt safe around him. This means being very impressive and extraordinary. **从前，有一个超级英雄，他的形象比生活中的人大得多。他能飞得更高更强。他的存在如此强大，人们在他身边总是感到安全。这个词意思是令人印象深刻和非凡的。**

> A young entrepreneur was confused about his business strategy. An old wise man told him to adopt \'laissez-faire\', meaning let things take their own course without too much interference. The entrepreneur followed this and his business thrived. **一位年轻的企业家对他的商业策略感到困惑。一位睿智的老人告诉他采用\'自由放任\'，意思是让事情顺其自然，不要过多干涉。企业家照做了，他的生意蓬勃发展。**

> One day, Tom was very hungry. He opened his fridge but found nothing. Then he went to the store and bought some bread and milk. The bread and milk he got were store-bought. **一天，汤姆非常饿。他打开冰箱却什么也没发现。然后他去商店买了一些面包和牛奶。他买到的面包和牛奶就是"store-bought（商店买的）"的。**

> In a faraway land, the king made all the decisions alone without listening to the people. This was clearly undemocratic. The citizens were unhappy as their voices were ignored. **在一个遥远的国度，国王独自做所有决定，不听民众的意见。这显然是不民主的。公民们很不高兴，因为他们的声音被忽视了。**

> A brave explorer was lost in a deep cave. He shouted loudly, and the sound kept echoing. The repeating echoes made him feel scared but also helped him find his way out. **一位勇敢的探险家在一个深邃的洞穴中迷路了。他大声呼喊，声音不断回响。不断的回声让他感到害怕，但也帮助他找到了出路。**

> One day, I went to a store and saw a TV labeled \'high-definition\'. The picture on it was so clear and sharp, like I was right in the scene. It made me understand that \'high-definition\' means very clear and detailed. **有一天，我去一家商店，看到一台标有"高清晰度"的电视。它上面的画面非常清晰锐利，就好像我就在场景中。这让我明白了"high-definition"意味着非常清晰和详细。**

> One night, a girl was walking alone in the park. Suddenly, she felt someone was stalking her. She quickened her pace and finally reached a crowded place safely. Stalking means following someone secretly and often in a threatening way. **一天晚上，一个女孩独自在公园散步。突然，她感觉有人在跟踪她。她加快了步伐，最终安全到达了一个人多的地方。stalking 意思是秘密跟踪某人，通常带有威胁性。**

> A detective was called to conduct a post-mortem examination after a mysterious death. He carefully studied the body to find clues. \'Post-mortem\' means an examination after death to understand the cause. **一位侦探在一次神秘死亡事件后被叫来进行死后检查。他仔细研究尸体以寻找线索。\'post-mortem\'意思是死后的检查以了解死因。**

> A thief was seen escaping from the jewelry store. He jumped over fences and ran through alleys, but the police were not far behind. Finally, he was caught. Remember, \'escaping\' means running away to avoid being caught or punished. **一个小偷被看到从珠宝店逃跑。他跳过栅栏，穿过小巷，但警察紧随其后。最后，他被抓住了。记住，'escaping'意思是逃跑以避免被抓住或惩罚。**

> Once upon a time, there was a chef. He wanted to make a special dish and needed skinless chicken. So, he spent a long time removing the skins. Finally, he got the skinless meat and the dish was a big success! **从前，有个厨师。他想做一道特别的菜，需要无皮的鸡肉。所以，他花了很长时间去皮。最后，他得到了无皮的肉，这道菜大获成功！**

> A little butterfly was fluttering among the flowers. Its colorful wings moved gracefully. It seemed to be dancing happily, bringing beauty and joy to the garden. **一只小蝴蝶在花丛中翩翩飞舞。它五彩的翅膀优雅地扇动着。它似乎在欢快地跳舞，给花园带来了美丽和欢乐。**

> Once there was a man named Tom. He was always stressed and had trouble sleeping. A doctor told him it was because of his poor mental-health. Tom then learned to relax and take care of his mind, and finally felt better. **曾经有个叫汤姆的人。他总是压力很大，睡眠也有问题。一位医生告诉他这是因为他的心理健康状况不佳。汤姆于是学会放松和照顾自己的心灵，最后感觉好多了。**

> One day, Tom was playing with a balloon. He blew it up too much and it suddenly had a blow-up. The balloon burst with a loud bang. Poor Tom was quite shocked. **一天，汤姆在玩气球。他把气球吹得太大了，突然气球就爆开了。气球砰的一声炸了。可怜的汤姆非常震惊。**

> A young artist traveled to Florence and was deeply inspired by the city\'s beauty. He decided to call his new masterpiece \'Florentine\' to honor the place. Later, the word was used to describe anything related to Florence or having its style. **一位年轻的艺术家去了佛罗伦萨，被这座城市的美深深打动。他决定将自己的新杰作命名为"Florentine"以纪念这个地方。后来，这个词就被用来形容与佛罗伦萨有关或具有其风格的任何事物。**

> Imagine a person whose parents are from Asia but they were born and raised in America. They are an Asian-American. They have a unique blend of both Asian and American cultures. This is what Asian-American means. **想象一个人的父母来自亚洲，但他们自己出生并成长在美国。他们就是亚裔美国人。他们有着亚洲和美国文化的独特融合。这就是亚裔美国人的含义。**

> A long time ago, a talented artist engraved a beautiful pattern on a piece of wood. The detailed lines and exquisite design showed his superb skills. \'Engraved\' means to carve or cut a design or words into a surface. **很久以前，一位才华横溢的艺术家在一块木头上雕刻了一个美丽的图案。细致的线条和精美的设计展现了他高超的技艺。\'engraved\'意思是在表面雕刻或切割图案或文字。**

> A detective was wrongly accused of a crime. He was judged erroneously. But with his perseverance, he finally proved his innocence. This shows that being judged erroneously can be very unfair. **一位侦探被错误地指控犯罪。他被错误地判定了。但凭借他的毅力，他最终证明了自己的清白。这表明被错误地判定是非常不公平的。**

> Imagine a huge lottery win. You are handed a cheque for half-million dollars! It\'s exactly 500,000 dollars, a sum that could change your life. Now you\'ll never forget \'half-million\' means 500,000. **想象一下中了大奖。你拿到了一张五十万美元的支票！正好是 500,000 美元，这笔钱可能会改变你的生活。现在你永远不会忘记'half-million'意思是 500,000 了。**

> A hard rock was constantly washed by the gentle river. Over time, it softened and became smooth. Just like the rock, \'softened\' means to become less hard or tough. **一块坚硬的石头一直被温柔的河水冲刷着。随着时间的推移，它变软了，变得光滑。就像这块石头一样，\'softened\'意思是变得不那么坚硬或坚韧。**

> A dilapidated old house was revamped by a skillful architect. He added new windows, repainted the walls, and transformed it into a beautiful home. Now it\'s shiny and new! **一座破旧的老房子被一位技艺高超的建筑师翻新了。他添加了新窗户，重新粉刷了墙壁，把它变成了一个美丽的家。现在它焕然一新！**

> A famous artist usually creates colorful paintings. But one day, he made a black-and-white one. This was uncharacteristic of him. People were surprised. It means not typical or usual. **一位著名的艺术家通常创作色彩丰富的画作。但有一天，他画了一幅黑白的。这与他平时的风格不同。人们很惊讶。这个词意思是不典型的，不寻常的。**

> In a magical forest, fairies inscribed their names on ancient tree trunks. The word \'inscribed\' means to write or mark something on a surface, as the fairies did on the trees. **在一个神奇的森林里，仙女们在古老的树干上刻下她们的名字。单词"inscribed"意思是在表面上书写或标记某物，就像仙女们在树上做的那样。**

> One day, Tom was caught cheating in the exam. The teacher was very angry and punished him. Tom realized that cheating was wrong and promised never to do it again. **一天，汤姆在考试中被抓到作弊。老师非常生气并惩罚了他。汤姆意识到作弊是错误的，并承诺再也不这样做了。**

> One night, in a quiet forest, a little mouse whispered to its friend about a hidden cheese. They were so careful not to be heard by the big cats nearby. The soft and secret voice was like a \'whispered\' message. **一天晚上，在安静的森林里，一只小老鼠小声地跟它的朋友说起一块藏起来的奶酪。它们非常小心，以免被附近的大猫听到。那轻柔又隐秘的声音就像是'低声说'的消息。**

> A brave knight was on a quest. The challenges he faced intensified as he went deeper into the forest. But his determination also intensified, making him stronger. Finally, he achieved victory. **一位勇敢的骑士正在执行一项任务。当他深入森林时，他面临的挑战加剧了。但他的决心也增强了，使他变得更强大。最终，他取得了胜利。**

> A young baseball player dreams of making it to the major leagues. But for now, he\'s stuck in the minor-league, playing in small stadiums and facing tough challenges. He keeps training hard, believing one day he\'ll shine in the big leagues. **一位年轻的棒球运动员梦想着进入大联盟。但目前，他被困在小联盟，在小体育场比赛，面临着严峻的挑战。他一直在努力训练，相信有一天他会在大联盟中大放异彩。**

> A poor miner was exploited by a greedy boss. The boss made him work long hours in dangerous conditions but paid him very little. The miner\'s hard work was exploited for the boss\'s profit. **一位贫穷的矿工被一个贪婪的老板剥削。老板让他在危险的条件下长时间工作，却给他很少的报酬。矿工的辛勤劳动被老板用来谋取利润。**

> A scientist was conducting an experiment. To ensure fairness, he randomized the selection of samples. It was like a lottery, but for science! No one could predict which ones would be chosen. **一位科学家正在进行一项实验。为了确保公平，他随机选择样本。这就像抽奖，但却是为了科学！没人能预测会选到哪些。**

> Once upon a time, a traveler met a friendly artist in a small town. The artist was painting a beautiful scene and said he was from Flemish. The traveler was impressed by the unique style of Flemish art. **从前，一位旅行者在一个小镇上遇到了一位友好的艺术家。这位艺术家正在画一幅美丽的画，并说他来自佛兰芒。旅行者对佛兰芒独特的艺术风格印象深刻。**

> Imagine a person named Tom who always gets stressed because of work-related matters. He has endless tasks and meetings. One day, he decides to take a break and realizes how much these work-related things affect his life. **想象一个叫汤姆的人，他总是因为与工作相关的事情而感到压力很大。他有没完没了的任务和会议。有一天，他决定休息一下，并意识到这些与工作相关的事情对他的生活影响有多大。**

> A doctor found a new medicine. It made a serious disease treatable. Before, patients were very worried. But now, with this discovery, there was hope. They knew the disease could be dealt with and cured. **一位医生发现了一种新药。它使一种严重的疾病变得可治疗。之前，患者们非常担心。但现在，有了这个发现，就有了希望。他们知道这种疾病是可以处理和治愈的。**
> A spy was in a dangerous situation. He reflexively hid behind the wall when he heard footsteps. His reflexive action saved his life. **一名间谍身处险境。当他听到脚步声时，他本能地躲到了墙后面。他的本能反应救了他的命。**

> A little girl was given a cup of juice. She took a sip and made a sad face because the juice was unsweetened. She expected it to be sweet but it wasn\'t. Poor girl! **一个小女孩被给了一杯果汁。她喝了一口，露出了悲伤的表情，因为这杯果汁是不加糖的。她原本期待它是甜的，但却不是。可怜的女孩！**

> Once upon a time, there was a magical tree that seemed to live forever. People called it long-lived because it survived for countless years. It witnessed the changes of the world and remained strong. Just like this tree, long-lived means having a long life. **从前，有一棵神奇的树似乎永远活着。人们称它为长寿的，因为它存活了无数年。它见证了世界的变化并且依然强壮。就像这棵树一样，long-lived 意思是长寿的。**

> One day, a brave sailor was exploring the deep-water area. He faced big waves but was not afraid. The deep-water was mysterious and full of unknowns. Finally, he returned safely with great courage. **有一天，一位勇敢的水手正在探索深水区。他面对着巨浪但毫不畏惧。深水区神秘且充满未知。最终，他凭借巨大的勇气安全返回。**

> Imagine a world where Shakespeare\'s plays come alive. A young actor, passionate about performing, dreams of mastering the Shakespearean style. Through hard work and dedication, he finally achieves it, embodying the essence of Shakespearean drama. **想象一个世界，莎士比亚的戏剧栩栩如生。一位年轻演员，热衷于表演，梦想掌握莎士比亚式风格。通过努力和奉献，他最终做到了，体现了莎士比亚式戏剧的精髓。**

> One day, I went shopping and found a beautiful dress with a discounted price tag. I was so happy because it meant I could buy it at a lower cost. The discounted offer made my day! **有一天，我去购物，发现了一件漂亮的连衣裙，上面有打折的价格标签。我非常高兴，因为这意味着我能以更低的价格买到它。这个打折优惠让我这一天都很开心！**

> A famous designer was known for the exclusivity of her creations. Only a few lucky people could own them. This made her brand highly sought-after. People craved that unique and exclusive touch. **一位著名的设计师以其作品的独特性和排他性而闻名。只有少数幸运的人能够拥有。这使得她的品牌备受追捧。人们渴望那种独一无二和专属的感觉。**

> A king had two treasures, one was a magic sword and the other was a hidden map. The value of these two items combined was two-fold that of any single one. This showed the meaning of \'two-fold\', which means double or twice as much. **一位国王有两件宝物，一件是魔法宝剑，另一件是隐藏的地图。这两件物品的价值总和是任何一件的两倍。这体现了\'two-fold\'的意思，即两倍的、双重的。**

> A struggling company needed reinvention. They threw away old methods and came up with new ideas. It was like giving a tired old machine a complete makeover. Finally, they succeeded and became prosperous again. **一家苦苦挣扎的公司需要重新改造。他们抛弃了旧方法，想出了新点子。这就像给一台疲惫的旧机器进行彻底的改造。最终，他们成功了，再次繁荣起来。**

> A thief was being chased by the police. But luckily, he found a hidden passage and escaped. The police looked everywhere but couldn\'t find him. \'Escaped\' means to get away from a dangerous or unpleasant situation. **一个小偷正被警察追捕。但幸运的是，他找到了一个隐藏的通道并逃走了。警察到处找但没找到他。\'escaped\'意思是从危险或不愉快的处境中离开。**

> In a big race, Tom ran very fast and crossed the finish line first. Everyone shouted, \'Tom got the first-place!\' It means being the top or the best. Now you remember \'first-place\' means being number one. **在一场大型比赛中，汤姆跑得非常快，第一个冲过了终点线。大家都喊道：'汤姆获得了第一名！'这意味着处于顶尖或最佳位置。现在你记住'first-place'就是第一名的意思。**

> A designer presented a new dress. It was simple but elegant, with no excessive decoration. People praised its understated beauty. It wasn\'t showy but had a charm that was quietly appealing. **一位设计师展示了一件新裙子。它很简约但优雅，没有过多的装饰。人们称赞它低调的美。它不张扬，却有着悄然吸引人的魅力。**

> A detective was solving a mystery. He relied only on evidence-based clues. No guesses! Just facts and proof. With this approach, he finally caught the criminal. Remember, evidence-based means relying on solid evidence. **一位侦探在破解一个谜团。他只依靠基于证据的线索。不瞎猜！只有事实和证明。通过这种方式，他最终抓住了罪犯。记住，evidence-based 意思是基于证据的。**

> A detective was investigating a claim, but all the evidence presented was unsubstantiated. There were just rumors and no solid facts. It made the detective\'s job very difficult. **一位侦探正在调查一项指控，但所提供的所有证据都未经证实。只有谣言，没有确凿的事实。这让侦探的工作变得非常困难。**

> In a fictional country, a group of brave citizens stood up against the unfair rules of the government. They were called anti-government protesters. They fought for justice and a better life for all. **在一个虚构的国家里，一群勇敢的公民站出来反对政府的不公平规则。他们被称为反政府抗议者。他们为正义和所有人更好的生活而斗争。**

> One day, a young scientist was reading a book about Newton. Suddenly, he understood the Newtonian laws of physics. He was so excited and decided to explore more. Now, whenever he sees \'Newtonian\', he remembers that moment. **有一天，一位年轻的科学家正在读一本关于牛顿的书。突然，他理解了牛顿的物理学定律。他非常兴奋并决定去探索更多。现在，每当他看到'Newtonian'这个词，他就会想起那一刻。**

> A young traveler was lost in a strange land. A kind Sicilian man helped him find his way. The traveler was so grateful and always remembered the warm-hearted Sicilian. **一位年轻的旅行者在陌生的地方迷路了。一位善良的西西里人帮助他找到了路。旅行者非常感激，永远记住了这位热心的西西里人。**

> A brave artist submitted his masterpiece to a famous gallery, but it was rejected. He felt sad but didn\'t give up. Finally, his work was accepted elsewhere. Remember, \'rejected\' means being refused or not accepted. **一位勇敢的艺术家向一家著名的画廊提交了他的杰作，但被拒绝了。他感到伤心但没有放弃。最后，他的作品在别处被接受了。记住，'rejected'意思是被拒绝或不被接受。**

> A little rabbit was lost in the forest. Its thoughts were all muddled. It couldn\'t figure out which way to go. Finally, with the help of a kind bird, it found the right path home. **一只小兔子在森林里迷路了。它的思绪全都混乱了。它搞不清该走哪条路。最后，在一只好心的鸟的帮助下，它找到了回家的正确道路。**

> A traveler got lost in the Mojave Desert. He was thirsty and tired but finally found an oasis. The experience made him never forget the name Mojave. **一位旅行者在莫哈韦沙漠中迷路了。他又渴又累，但最终找到了一片绿洲。这次经历让他永远忘不了 Mojave 这个名字。**

> A little bird named Phono was always interested in the logical patterns of sounds. One day, it discovered the world of phonological and understood how different sounds combine. Phono became an expert in phonological and shared its knowledge with others. **一只叫 Phono 的小鸟总是对声音的逻辑模式感兴趣。有一天，它发现了音系学的世界，明白了不同声音是如何组合的。Phono 成为了音系学专家，并与他人分享了它的知识。**

> One day, a little boy was very excited because he was going on a seven-day trip. He packed his bags and imagined all the wonderful things he would see and do during these seven days. It was going to be an unforgettable adventure. **有一天，一个小男孩非常兴奋，因为他要去进行为期七天的旅行。他收拾好行李，想象着在这七天里他将看到和做的所有美好事情。这将是一次难忘的冒险。**

> A brave warrior was on a long journey. He faced many difficulties but never gave up. Finally, he achieved the goal of conquering the enemy\'s territory. With his strong will, he became a hero. **一位勇敢的战士踏上了漫长的征程。他面临诸多困难但从未放弃。最终，他达成了征服敌人领土的目标。凭借坚强的意志，他成为了英雄。**

> A brave astronaut was exploring a strange planet. He needed to describe the layout spatially to his team on Earth. He noticed how things were arranged in space, like mountains and rivers, and used the word \'spatially\' to explain precisely. **一位勇敢的宇航员正在探索一个陌生的星球。他需要向地球上的团队从空间上描述布局。他注意到像山脉和河流等事物在空间中的排列，并使用"spatially"这个词来精确解释。**
> 想象一下，森林中一场大火被扑灭后，仍有一些未燃尽的木头在冒烟，这就是 smoldering 的场景。那些微弱的、持续的烟，就像隐藏的怒火或未完全熄灭的热情。 **想象大火扑灭后未燃尽的木头冒烟的场景来辅助记忆 smoldering 这个词，意为阴燃的；闷烧的；郁积的**

> A worker was repairing a machine. The wrenching of the bolts was very difficult. But he didn\'t give up and finally fixed it. The wrenching here means causing great pain or difficulty. **一名工人正在修理机器。拧螺栓的过程非常艰难。但他没有放弃，最终修好了。这里的wrenching意思是引起极大的痛苦或困难。**

> One day, Tom was lost in a strange world. There were flying cars and robots everywhere. He realized he was in a science-fiction world. It was full of amazing and unimaginable technologies. **有一天，汤姆迷失在一个陌生的世界。到处都是飞行的汽车和机器人。他意识到自己身处一个科幻世界。这里充满了令人惊叹和难以想象的科技。**

> A poor student was desperately seeking financial aid. Finally, the kind university granting him a scholarship, changing his life. This act of granting brought hope and opportunity. **一个贫困的学生拼命地寻求经济援助。最后，善良的大学批准给他一笔奖学金，改变了他的生活。这种批准的行为带来了希望和机会。**

> Once upon a time, there was a small town. All the buildings in it were old-style. They had classic designs and simple decorations. These old-style structures made the town look charming and full of history. **从前，有一个小镇。镇里所有的建筑都是老式的。它们有着经典的设计和简单的装饰。这些老式的建筑让这个小镇看起来迷人且充满历史。**

> Once upon a time, in a village, whenever there was a new idea, a person always said no. This person was called a naysayer. He refused every possibility without even trying. Everyone disliked his negative attitude. **从前，在一个村子里，每当有新想法时，总有一个人总是说不。这个人被称为老是唱反调的人。他甚至不尝试就拒绝每一种可能性。每个人都不喜欢他的消极态度。**
